The motion suggests exploring the implementation of an opt-out system, whereby individuals would need to actively decline to have their organs donated after death. This review is deemed urgent to better align the system with public sentiment and to save lives, given that many patients are currently waiting for transplants.

title: Jönköping University som universitet
summary: The proposal advocates for Jönköping University to be considered for university status, highlighting its significant role in regional economic growth, development, and welfare. It emphasizes the importance of connecting research and education policies with regional and business objectives, particularly in light of the need for skilled labor in manufacturing and innovation. The motion calls for continued investment in educational infrastructure to enhance the region's competitive edge and ensure equal access to quality education and research opportunities.

title: Stärkt forskning kring förlossningsskador
summary: The motion advocates for increased research on childbirth injuries, highlighting the prevalence of tears and wounds experienced by women during vaginal delivery. It cites a reduction in severe tears due to systematic improvements in prenatal care and emphasizes the need for further investigation into both the physical and psychological impacts of childbirth. The aim is to enhance understanding and develop new methods to alleviate or prevent these issues, thus prioritizing research in this underexplored area.

title: En stärkt nationellt samordnad kompetensförsörjningspolitik
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1532 av Carina Ödebrink och Diana Laitinen Carlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for a strengthened national coordinated policy for competency supply in Sweden, proposing that regional development authorities be granted a clearer mandate to manage regional workforce development. The authors highlight the existing mismatch between labor supply and demand, emphasizing the need for tailored vocational training programs to address long-term unemployment and skills shortages in various sectors. They suggest that a unified approach encompassing labor market, education, and economic policies is essential to improve the effectiveness of competency supply systems.

title: En jämställd och feministisk handelspolitik
summary: The motion calls for the establishment of a gender-equal and feminist trade policy, highlighting the disproportionate benefits that international trade provides to men over women. It emphasizes the need for gender analyses and gender-disaggregated statistics in trade agreements to ensure fair treatment for women in the workplace and as consumers. The proposal urges the government to advocate for equal opportunities for women in trade negotiations and to review existing policies to promote gender equality within trade practices.

title: Förbättra de ekonomiska villkoren för kommuner med stor andel deltidsboende
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider the financial difficulties faced by municipalities with a significant proportion of part-time residents, particularly highlighting the example of Gotland. It argues that these municipalities encounter challenges in providing services due to seasonal population fluctuations, resulting in resource distribution that does not align with actual demand. The suggestion emphasizes the need for a reassessment of how resources are allocated in these communities to better address the demands placed on local services during peak seasons.

title: Minska det digitala utanförskapet
summary: The proposal seeks to address the issue of digital exclusion in Sweden by urging the government to consider the needs of all citizens in accessing public digital services. It highlights that a significant portion of the population, particularly the elderly and those living in rural areas, struggle with internet use and may lack support in navigating essential online services. The motion emphasizes the responsibility of the public sector to ensure that all citizens can utilize these services, aiming to enhance equality and citizen engagement in the digital age.

title: Skolan bör utbilda mer om svenska modellen på arbetsmarknaden
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for schools to provide education about the Swedish model of the labor market, highlighting its success and the diminishing awareness and respect for this model among Swedish youth. It argues that students lack knowledge of their rights and obligations in the workplace and that schools should better prepare them for the job market by prioritizing this education.

title: Minska risken för förlossningsskador
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1527 av Magnus Manhammar och Heléne Björklund (båda S)
summary: The proposal aims to reduce the risk of childbirth-related injuries by improving healthcare methodologies and practices. It references a report by the Swedish Health and Care Inspectorate, which highlights that many injuries could be prevented through better approaches and emphasizes the importance of patient involvement and communication in the birthing process. The motion calls for the government to take action based on these recommendations to ensure safer childbirth care.

title: Inför en klotterpolicy för Trafikverket
summary: Camilla Brodin from the Christian Democrats (KD) proposes that the Swedish government instruct Trafikverket to establish a graffiti policy and platform for reporting graffiti. The absence of a policy from Trafikverket has hindered efforts by municipalities and regional transport authorities to maintain clean environments and prevent further vandalism, which may lead to criminal behavior. Brodin emphasizes the need for a uniform approach in combating graffiti in urban areas to ensure a safe and aesthetically pleasing society.

title: Införande av en strategi för beredskapslager av elstolpar och sliprar
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of a strategy for emergency stockpiles of electricity poles and wooden sleepers in Sweden. It emphasizes the vulnerabilities of the existing infrastructure, particularly in light of changing weather patterns that increase the likelihood of storms, which can cause significant damage to the networks. The motion argues for the necessity of ensuring adequate supplies domestically to address crises swiftly, thereby safeguarding essential societal functions such as electricity and transportation during emergencies.

title: Inför kontaktdagar för kroniskt sjuka barn
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of ten contact days per year for parents of children with chronic illnesses, extending the current system that applies only to children covered by LSS (Support and Service for Persons with Certain Functional Impairments). The aim is to enhance parental support by allowing time off work to attend training and school-related activities, thereby ensuring that parents can provide the necessary stability for their children. The suggestion calls for an investigation into the possibility of including families with children suffering from other chronic conditions, such as type 1 diabetes and epilepsy.

title: Låt Åmål vara med och förbättra platsbristen hos Kriminalvården
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1523 av Camilla Brodin och Magnus Jacobsson (båda KD)
summary: The proposal advocates for establishing a new correctional facility in Åmål to address the current shortage of places in the Swedish correctional system. The authors emphasize the strain on the existing facilities and how Åmål's local government is ready to support the initiative, citing good logistics, education resources, and community backing as key factors for operational success. The motion presents Åmål as a viable solution to improve the overall capacity of the correctional system amidst growing demands.

title: Statligt statistikansvar för alkoholområdet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consolidate responsibility for all statistics related to alcohol under a single state authority to enhance the quality and availability of data. This is deemed necessary for informed decision-making in alcohol policy, as the current fragmented approach has resulted in insufficient and unreliable statistics. The motion suggests that either Statistics Sweden (SCB) or the Public Health Agency could take on this responsibility to improve access to comprehensive alcohol-related statistics, aiding politicians in making evidence-based decisions.

title: Synliggör skatter
summary: Camilla Brodin from the Christian Democrats proposes that the Swedish Parliament acknowledges the need to increase public knowledge about the tax system. The motion emphasizes the importance of transparency in government decision-making to foster trust between citizens and institutions. It highlights that many citizens are unaware of the actual tax burden they bear, particularly regarding hidden taxes such as employer contributions. The low level of awareness is seen as problematic for democracy and the effectiveness of tax reforms, necessitating improved public education on the tax system.

title: Tillsätt en Arlandaförhandling
summary: The proposal submitted by Camilla Brodin (KD) calls for the initiation of an Arlanda negotiation process aimed at enhancing infrastructure in the Stockholm growth region in response to the economic challenges posed by COVID-19. This motion highlights the importance of investing in infrastructure to create jobs, boost economic recovery, and facilitate collaboration among municipalities in large urban areas. The objective is to ensure sustainable development and to position Stockholm and its surrounding regions as a leading hub, thereby attracting more workplaces and investment.

title: Förenkla regelverket för temporära byggnader
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament instructs the National Board of Housing, Building and Planning (Boverket) to simplify regulations regarding temporary buildings, particularly rental modules and site cabins. The current regulations lead to inconsistencies across municipalities, complicating planning and rental processes. By clarifying guidelines for temporary structures, the aim is to enhance market conditions, facilitate construction-related solutions (e.g., for child care, education, and health services), and reduce costs for taxpayers due to inconsistencies in building permit interpretations.

title: Eftersupning
summary: The proposal advocates for the criminalization of 'eftersupning' (drinking after an accident) to enhance road safety and reduce alcohol-related traffic incidents in Sweden. It highlights the statistic that a significant number of traffic fatalities are linked to alcohol or drug use and points out that the current legal loophole allows drivers to evade responsibility by claiming they consumed alcohol after an accident. The motion suggests that implementing a law similar to Norway's, which prohibits drivers involved in accidents from consuming alcohol within six hours, would help to diminish such occurrences and restore public trust in the legal system.

title: Absolut skuldpreskription
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of absolute debt prescription for private debts in Sweden, aiming to alleviate the financial struggles of individuals trapped in debt. It argues that many people face severe consequences due to easily granted credits, leading to a cycle of debt that impairs their ability to secure housing, jobs, or credits. By implementing a rule that allows for absolute debt prescription after a certain period, such as 15 years, the proposal intends to encourage more careful credit assessments and decrease the need for debt restructuring, allowing resources to be redirected to combat serious crime.

title: Brottsrubricering vid bilbrand
summary: The suggestion proposes an amendment to the classification of the crime of vehicle arson, advocating that such acts should be categorized as 'gross damage' irrespective of the vehicle's value. The rationale behind this proposal is the escalating crime rates in Sweden, particularly the prevalence of vehicle fires, which are seen as being treated leniently under current laws due to low sentencing options. The motion aims to reflect the serious nature of the act by ensuring a uniform and stricter legal response.

title: Avskaffande av laglotten
summary: The proposal suggests abolishing the current legal system of laglotten, which guarantees heirs half of their inheritance regardless of the deceased's wishes. The motion argues that this system, established in 1857, is outdated and conflicts with property rights, as it allows heirs to inherit even if they have no relationship with or have harmed the deceased. It highlights the need for a review of inheritance laws in light of changes in society and European regulations that allow Swedish citizens living abroad to bypass laglotten rules.

title: Avskaffa Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the Allmänna arvsfonden (General Inheritance Fund) in Sweden, arguing that its structure is outdated and leads to bureaucratic inefficiencies. The author, Boriana Åberg, claims that the fund has misused its resources by financing organizations and projects that contradict democratic values and human rights, thus failing to properly fulfill its mandate to promote charitable activities for children, youth, and disabled individuals. The motion calls for a shift of these funds to directly benefit the state budget instead.

title: Vittnesskydd
summary: The motion presented by Boriana Åberg focuses on increasing the protection of witnesses in Sweden by proposing measures to ensure that more cases of witness intimidation lead to prosecution, increasing penalties for such offenses, and allowing anonymous testimony. It highlights the fear of retaliation that witnesses face which undermines the legal system and suggests that anonymous testimony could reduce the risk to witnesses, thus encouraging their participation in trials.

title: Produkter med dubbla användningsområden
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for a review of the regulations concerning dual-use products, which are items that can be used for both civilian and military purposes. It highlights the issue faced by Swedish companies experiencing frequent export application rejections from the Inspection for Strategic Products (ISP) due to vague reasoning, particularly concerning the recipient country's democratic status. The motion argues that such inconsistent decision-making undermines the development of innovative Swedish products and leads to job losses, calling for clearer legislation to improve the situation for the Swedish export industry.

title: Störande av ordning i rättssalen
summary: The suggestion proposes the introduction of prison sentences for disturbances in courtrooms, highlighting a significant increase in incidents where defendants threaten witnesses, use offensive language, and engage in disruptive behaviors during trials. The motion expresses concern for the safety of court personnel, jurors, and witnesses, as well as the overall integrity of the judicial process, and seeks to enhance order within court proceedings.

title: Avskaffa bosättningslagen
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the residence law, which mandates that all municipalities in Sweden must provide housing for newly arrived individuals granted residence permits. The author argues that the law leads to significant disparities in housing quality and creates problems in municipalities suffering from housing shortages. They claim that the law contradicts the principle of equal treatment in the housing market and places undue burdens on municipalities, challenging the concept of local self-government. The motion suggests that the increasing challenges associated with integration and related social issues necessitate the repeal of this ineffective legislation.

title: Övergång från traditionsprincipen till avtalsprincipen
summary: The motion proposes the abolishment of the traditions principle in favor of the contractual principle in transactions involving physical objects. It argues that the current traditions principle, rooted in Roman law, complicates transactions and places Swedish businesses at a disadvantage compared to their foreign counterparts. Transitioning to the contractual principle would enhance legal certainty for buyers when agreements are made, thereby improving the overall business environment and facilitating easier access to credit for companies. The motion contends that the benefits of this change outweigh concerns regarding potential issues during insolvency situations.

title: Trängande fara
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament clarifies the legal definition of 'imminent danger' to ensure that specific aggressive actions, especially those involving robbery and humiliation against children and youth, are recognized as robbery under the law. The proposal is motivated by a rise in such crimes and inconsistencies in judicial assessments, particularly where courts have dismissed cases based on the interpretation of imminent danger, leading to offenders being acquitted.

title: Öka benägenheten att vittna
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the protection for child and youth victims of crime in Sweden, addressing the significant increase in robberies and humiliating assaults against this demographic. It emphasizes the need for stronger measures to ensure that witnesses and victims feel safe to testify, highlighting the inadequacies of current legal frameworks that allow juvenile offenders to evade consequences and continue criminal behavior. The proposal calls for a shift in perspective where victims and witnesses are prioritized as the main subjects needing protection, rather than being displaced due to the actions of offenders.

title: Ersätt barnbidraget med skattesänkning på inkomst av arbete
summary: The motion proposes replacing child benefits for the fourth child and subsequent children, as well as the additional benefit for multiple children, with corresponding tax reductions on earned income. The rationale is to incentivize work over reliance on benefits, arguing that the current system does not encourage employment. The motion highlights that the child benefit system is seen as ineffective in addressing economic disparities and suggests that helping families achieve self-sufficiency through lower taxes is a more effective method to improve their economic conditions.

title: Skadestånd till frihetsberövade
summary: The motion, proposed by Boriana Åberg, aims to stipulate that compensation should not be awarded to individuals who have been found guilty of a crime by a final court ruling. It calls for legislative changes to ensure that such compensation can be denied or significantly reduced, particularly in cases involving serious crimes like sexual assault, arguing that it is unacceptable for taxpayers to financially compensate convicted criminals while victims receive much less.

title: Avskaffa EBO
summary: The suggestion proposes to abolish the EBO law, which allows asylum seekers to choose their own housing, citing that it has led to overcrowding, segregation, and transferred responsibility from the state to municipalities. The proposal argues that the current system encourages asylum seekers to move to areas with significant socio-economic issues and facilitates organized crime through the creation of a black market for housing. The motion advocates for a more restrictive asylum immigration policy and the cessation of the EBO provision to enhance integration and support from the Migration Agency.

title: Böter som straffpåföljd för ringa stöld
summary: The motion proposes abolishing fines as a punishment for minor theft and suggests replacing them with alternative penalties when there is a clear risk that fines will not be paid. The rationale behind this is to address the issue of foreign theft gangs that frequently operate in Sweden without the fear of detention or serious penalties, as fines do not ensure accountability and may lead to offenders leaving the country promptly after being apprehended.

title: Diskrimineringsombudsmannen
summary: The motion proposes that individuals who believe they have experienced discrimination should bear certain costs associated with pursuing discrimination cases. The aim is to reform the current system where the Equality Ombudsman possesses significantly more resources than individual claimants, which may create an unfair advantage in legal disputes. The motion highlights the need for a more balanced legal process to prevent an excessive number of claims and ensure that only legitimate cases are pursued.

title: Förverkande av kriminellas egendom
summary: The motion proposes to review and improve the legislation concerning the confiscation of property from criminals in Sweden, aiming to facilitate and expedite this process. It argues that current laws are too lenient and offers examples from other countries, advocating for a more effective approach to combat organized crime, enhance the rule of law, and prevent the financial incentives that lead individuals to engage in criminal activities.

title: Grovt brott mot tystnadsplikten
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a new crime classification, 'gross violation of confidentiality,' to address the issue of sensitive information from police databases being accessed illegally and potentially sold to criminals. The motivation emphasizes the need for stronger legal measures in light of cases where unauthorized searches were conducted, leading to severe consequences that threaten public safety and investigations.

title: Id-kort för efterlysta
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish police be granted the authority to check if individuals applying for ID cards are wanted by law enforcement. It emphasizes the need for improved cooperation between agencies and the use of existing criminal databases to enhance crime prevention efforts. The motion draws on comparisons with New York City’s successful implementation of identity checks that helped capture numerous criminals and argues for a more pragmatic approach to crime fighting in Sweden, balancing safety and individual privacy.

title: Kommunala ordningsvakter
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support local municipalities in hiring security guards to enhance public safety amid rising crime rates and increased violence. The motion highlights the challenges municipalities face, such as bureaucratic hurdles and disagreements with the Police Authority regarding the need for security personnel. It calls for a review of these processes to eliminate unnecessary bureaucracy and enable municipalities to responsibly engage in crime prevention and safety efforts.

title: Kommunernas rätt att sätta upp bevakningskameror
summary: The motion advocates for municipalities to have the authority to operate surveillance cameras without requiring permission from the Data Inspection Authority. The proposal highlights the significant problem of vandalism that burdens local communities and impedes their welfare efforts, urging the government to acknowledge the need for quicker implementation of preventive measures against such crimes, of which statistics show a notable increase.

title: Bilmålvakter
summary: The motion aims to combat organized crime in Sweden by addressing the issue of individuals known as 'bilmålvakter', who lend their names to register vehicles, allowing criminals to operate anonymously. The proposal includes measures to enhance the security of vehicle owner registrations, restrict car sales to individuals with significant vehicle debts, and empower police or the Transport Agency to verify vehicle ownership when discrepancies are suspected.

title: Synliggör löneskatter på lönebeskedet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should make all income taxes and fees visible on payslips to enhance public awareness of the tax burden. It argues that a significant number of employees underestimate their taxes, which impairs democratic discussions regarding tax policies. By displaying employer contributions, income taxes, and other deductions on payslips, citizens will have a clearer understanding of the taxes they pay, consequently fostering better-informed debates about potential tax increases or decreases.

title: Återinföra särskilda beredskapspolisen
summary: The suggestion advocates for the reintroduction of a special reserve police force, known as the 'särskilda beredskapspolisen', which was previously part of the Swedish police until its abolition in 2012 due to a perceived decrease in need. The reintroduced force would serve to protect critical sites for national defense and support the regular police during heightened states of alert and complex crime situations, particularly in the wake of increasing security challenges such as terrorism.

title: Försvaret av Sydsverige
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to enhance the defense capabilities of southern Sweden in response to increasing military tensions in the Baltic Sea region and a declining security situation. It calls for a long-term increase of defense spending to 2% of GDP and the strengthening of military presence through the establishment of a new army brigade in Skåne. The proposal highlights the importance of both military and civil defense, advocating for improved coordination and preparedness for various crises, including potential military conflicts, while acknowledging the strategic significance of the agricultural sector and transport infrastructure in Skåne.

title: Uppåkra
summary: The proposal advocates for national government responsibility in the preservation and accessibility of cultural heritage at Uppåkra, a significant archaeological site, along with the establishment of an international interdisciplinary research center at this location. The motion highlights the site's historical importance, ongoing archaeological efforts, and the potential for educational and research collaboration with local universities, emphasizing the need for additional national funding and support to fully realize its capabilities.

title: Bostadsbyggandet i Skåne
summary: The motion proposes removing the county administrative board as an appeals body in the housing construction process, advocating for a more streamlined approach to expedite building timelines in Skåne County. It emphasizes the need for the construction of approximately 59,000 new homes annually through 2029 to address the growing population, calling for regulatory reforms to simplify and accelerate approval processes by allowing appeals directly to environmental courts instead of the county board. The motion also highlights the negative impact of the county board's current approach to construction on agricultural land, which delays the development of housing in an area with high immigration and increasing housing demand.

title: Avtal med Storbritannien om svenska studenters studieavgifter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the establishment of an agreement with the United Kingdom regarding study fees for Swedish students at universities. It highlights the negative impact of Brexit, which has led to a significant increase in fees for Swedish students who previously received reduced rates, emphasizing the importance of internationalization in higher education.

title: Minskning av antalet myndigheter
summary: The motion proposes a review of the possibility to streamline state bureaucracy by reducing the number of governmental agencies in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of responsible use of taxpayer money and suggests that some agencies lack significant public benefit and are unnecessary in today's society. The motion argues for an evaluation of agencies that may be redundant, potentially based on interests that do not serve the wider public, advocating that the government should take responsibility for ensuring efficient agency operations.

title: Otillåten läsning av medicinska journaler
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen penalties for violations of the confidentiality law regarding medical records. It emphasizes the need for healthcare organizations to inform patients each time their journal is accessed, addressing the issue of unauthorized access by healthcare professionals, which has been discovered through routine checks. The motion highlights serious privacy violations that patients experience, particularly in sensitive contexts, and calls for immediate governmental action in response to these breaches.

title: Stoppa bedrägerierna med assistansersättning
summary: The motion advocates for stricter penalties for fraud related to assistance compensation and empowers the Swedish Social Insurance Agency (Försäkringskassan) to verify the qualifications and activities of personal assistants. It proposes halting payments to unapproved assistance companies and suggests that the Migration Agency should not grant work permits to personal assistants from outside the EU, aiming to prevent ongoing fraudulent practices that exploit welfare funds intended for individuals with disabilities.

title: Samla välfärdsutbetalningarna i en myndighet
summary: The proposal suggests that all welfare transfer payments should be managed by a single government authority to mitigate the significant increase in fraud cases against welfare systems. The motion highlights the challenges authorities face in controlling and preventing fraud due to the expanding complexity and volume of payments, which have made these systems attractive targets for criminal networks. By consolidating the management of welfare payments under one authority, the goal is to enhance oversight and ensure that taxpayer money is used appropriately for those in need, rather than being siphoned off by organized crime.

title: Försörjningsstöd till personer som uppehåller sig illegalt i landet
summary: The proposal advocates for a ban on municipalities providing financial support to individuals residing illegally in Sweden. It emphasizes that individuals who have had their asylum applications rejected and are hiding to avoid deportation should not receive social assistance, in light of a ruling from the Supreme Administrative Court. The motion argues that Swedish laws should apply universally and that taxpayer money should not fund the livelihood of those illegally in the country.

title: Etableringsstrategi för pråmtrafiken
summary: The motion proposes the development of a national establishment strategy for barge traffic, highlighting its potential to enhance the efficiency and sustainability of the transport system in Sweden. Barge traffic can alleviate road congestion, reduce noise and emissions, and is considered an effective alternative to road transport for urban logistics. The motion calls for legislative adaptations to integrate barge traffic as a recognized mode of transport, similar to trucking, and emphasizes the need for supporting knowledge and infrastructure to improve industry competitiveness.

title: Ändring i bostadsrättslagen
summary: The motion proposes the removal of the exemption in the housing cooperative law that allows municipalities and county councils to become members of housing cooperatives, arguing that it undermines the interests of individual homeowners and leads to market distortions. It highlights how municipal involvement can decrease property values and create inequalities between residents who can afford cooperative memberships and those who rely on municipal housing assistance, ultimately suggesting that the exemption generates more issues than it resolves.

title: Ändring av åldersgränserna för adoption
summary: The motion proposes changing the age limits for adoption in Sweden, arguing that current strict requirements hinder the possibility for older individuals to adopt, particularly in cases of international adoption. The proposer highlights the need for adoption assessments to be based on individual circumstances rather than arbitrary age limits, suggesting that older applicants could successfully adopt older children. The goal is to facilitate better living conditions for children in need and to enhance the opportunities for individuals to experience parenthood.

title: Sänkt straffmyndighetsålder
summary: The motion proposes lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 15 to a younger age in response to increasing youth crime and gang recruitment of children as young as eight. The author argues that the current age limit allows criminal gangs to exploit minors without facing legal repercussions, leading to a rise in organized crime among youth. The motion emphasizes the importance of timely legal consequences to prevent young offenders from developing into habitual criminals.

title: Säkerhetsspärr för överföring av lagfart
summary: The motion proposes to tighten the process for transferring property titles (lagfart) in Sweden to prevent fraud, such as title hijacking. It highlights the current ease with which fraudulent titles can be obtained using forged signatures and calls for measures like mandatory confirmation from the property owner by Lantmäteriet or digital processing requiring Bank-ID signatures.

title: Minska de stora viltstammarna och deras skadeverkningar i Sörmland
summary: The motion proposes measures to reduce high populations of game animals, particularly wild boars and fallow deer, in Sörmland, which are causing significant damage to local agriculture. It suggests that the government should take actions to control these populations and explore establishing Sörmland as a pilot region for state funding to erect fencing against hoofed game, as farmers are struggling to maintain their operations due to these issues. The motion also advocates forreducing regulations around the sale and processing of wild boar meat while ensuring traceability and testing requirements remain in place.

title: Begravningsavgift för personer som inte är folkbokförda i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the conditions under which the estate of a deceased individual, who was previously registered in Sweden but not at the time of death, can benefit from the burial fee that the individual paid during their life. This fee funds burial services, including cremation and grave maintenance, and the motion emphasizes that it is reasonable for estates to offset burial costs with fees previously contributed by the deceased.

title: Ökad trafiksäkerhet kring A-traktorer och mopedbilar
summary: The motion, presented by Pia Steensland of the Christian Democrats (KD), proposes several measures to enhance traffic safety for A-tractors and moped cars. It suggests the inclusion of practical training for these vehicles in the driver's education, mandates the use of seat belts in A-tractors, regulates passenger limits, and reviews the maximum speed limits associated with these vehicles. The motion highlights the increasing popularity of these vehicles among youth, particularly in rural areas, and emphasizes the importance of ensuring safety in their operation.

title: Stärkt straffrättsligt skydd för sjukvårdspersonal
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of granting certain healthcare personnel official status as civil servants and including them under the criminal offense of sabotage against blue light operations. The motivation emphasizes the need to enhance legal protections for healthcare workers, who frequently face violence and threats, particularly in emergency settings. The current lack of legal status and protections for these workers creates an unsafe working environment, thus compromising their ability to provide care.

title: Stärkt markersättning vid intrång som medför en stor klimatnytta
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the conditions for offering increased compensation to landowners affected by intrusions necessary for climate-beneficial projects. It highlights the importance of reducing fossil emissions to combat global warming and emphasizes the role of electrification, particularly in the context of producing fossil-free steel. The author argues for a careful and thoughtful expansion of the electric grid to support this transition, advocating for improved compensation for landowners whose land is significantly impacted.

title: Stärkt rättssäkerhet för personer med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning som begår brott
summary: The motion suggests strengthening the legal protection for individuals with intellectual disabilities who commit crimes by reinstating a requirement for culpability in legislation. The proposal highlights concerns regarding current legal practices in Sweden that do not recognize the lack of responsibility among individuals with intellectual disabilities, leading to their penalization despite their incapacity to understand their actions. The motion argues for reforms to ensure that these individuals are not judged inappropriately and, if penalized, are assigned to appropriate living arrangements rather than psychiatric care.

title: Stockholm Skavsta en värdefull flygplats för Sörmland och Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament conducts a review of the financing and geographical distribution of municipal and regional airports, emphasizing the importance of Stockholm Skavsta Airport for both domestic and international transportation, as well as its role in supporting national preparedness operations. The proposal highlights the need for a sustainable aviation infrastructure that accommodates the future development of electric flights and drone deliveries, while also addressing the airport's potential to reduce environmental impact by alleviating pressure on Arlanda Airport.

title: Obligatoriska synkontroller vid körkortsförnyelse
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of mandatory vision tests for individuals renewing their driver's licenses later in life. It emphasizes the importance of good vision for road safety and highlights that many drivers may have impaired vision without regular checks. The proposal references studies indicating public support for such measures and argues that regular vision testing would enhance both traffic safety and individual health, while expressing concerns about current regulations that only require vision checks for professional drivers.

title: Nationell strategi för drunkningsprevention
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of implementing a national strategy for drowning prevention. The proposal highlights the rising number of drowning incidents, especially during the summer months, and emphasizes the need for better knowledge regarding the causes of drowning and effective preventive measures. It calls for collaboration between relevant water safety organizations and authorities to gather and analyze statistical data, improve awareness, and reduce the number of drowning-related fatalities and injuries through evidence-based information and targeted interventions.

title: Erkännande av folkmordet seyfo
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament officially recognizes the Seyfo genocide committed against religious minorities, including Armenians, Assyrians, and Pontic Greeks, during the Ottoman Empire in 1915. It emphasizes the importance of this recognition for justice and rectification for the victims and their descendants, while drawing attention to the increasing risks of repeating such atrocities if they remain unacknowledged. The motion also references previous commitments by the Swedish government and actions taken by other nations and international bodies regarding the recognition of this genocide.

title: Förstärkt trafikundervisning i grundskolan
summary: The motion proposes to enhance traffic education in primary schools, highlighting the need for systematic instruction to ensure children, particularly those under 12, acquire the necessary knowledge and skills for safe behavior in traffic. It points out the responsibility of both parents and schools in providing this education, notes significant regional disparities in the current implementation, and emphasizes the importance of extending traffic education to older students as many young adults either delay or forgo obtaining a driver's license.

title: CSN:s hemutrustningslån
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament strengthens the requirements for the cancellation of CSN's home equipment loans, arguing that the current regulations are more generous than those for other CSN loans, which is viewed as unreasonable and offensive by many.

title: Avveckling av Barn- och elevombudet
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the Children's and Students' Ombudsman (BEO), arguing that while its original intent was positive, it has mismanaged its role and undermined teacher authority through controversial decisions and legal actions. The motion criticizes specific cases where BEO's interventions were deemed unreasonable and suggests that its existence contributes to a culture of entitlement and undermines the educational environment.

title: Reformering av LAS
summary: The motion proposes reforms to the Employment Protection Act (LAS) to adapt to changing labor market conditions, arguing that the current framework disproportionately disadvantages youth and newly arrived immigrants during layoffs. It advocates for a shift from seniority-based job security to a system that emphasizes skills and adaptability, suggesting that labor market fluidity and the ability to transition between jobs are key to future employment stability.

title: Slopat krav på domarerfarenhet
summary: The motion proposes to remove the requirement for judicial experience from the regulations governing the Swedish Transport Agency's investigation of safety incidents, arguing that this requirement is outdated and unnecessarily restricts the recruitment of qualified professionals. It highlights that the agency now employs its own investigative experts, making the previous requirement for judicial experience irrelevant and excluding other capable professionals from contributing to the investigations.

title: Översyn av lagen om Svenska skeppshypotekskassan
summary: The motion proposes a review of the law governing the Swedish Ship Mortgage Fund, stating that the current regulations, established over 40 years ago, are outdated and do not adequately support the financing of shipping operations. It emphasizes the need for improved financing options during economic downturns and for environmental investments, as the existing rules restrict access to loans during low market values and do not accommodate necessary upgrades to meet environmental standards.

title: Avskaffande av public service
summary: The motion proposes investigating the possibility of abolishing public service broadcasting in Sweden, citing concerns about state control, dominance in media channels, and the funding model, which has shifted from license fees to tax financing. The author argues that the existing public service channels, due to their funding and status, fail to provide a competitive media landscape and question the objectivity of their content, suggesting that they have outlived their purpose.

title: Missbruk av pass och andra svenska resehandlingar
summary: The suggestion addresses the issue of abuse of Swedish travel documents, proposing measures to prevent such misuse. It calls for the introduction of criminal liability for individuals who intentionally allow their passport to be used by others, the revocation of residence permits for individuals traveling to their countries of origin, and the placement of border control officers at high-risk airports to detect fraudulent documents. The aim is to enhance security and prevent illegal entries into Europe using Swedish documentation.

title: Lagen om rättshjälp
summary: The motion proposes a review of the legal aid law in Sweden in light of rapidly increasing costs associated with public defenders, which reached over 3.5 billion SEK last year. The motion underscores the need for reforms to enhance the system's legitimacy by addressing disparities between public perceptions and the realities of legal proceedings, including potential stricter regulations on compensation for lawyers and better accountability systems to keep costs in check, while also considering the ongoing challenges posed by organized crime and emerging forms of cybercrime.

title: Riksdagens tillkännagivanden till regeringen
summary: The motion proposes to formalize the government's handling of parliamentary announcements, establishing a constitutional obligation for the government to respond to these declarations. It argues that the current lack of legal regulation leads to systemic delays and avoidance of compliance by the government, as evidenced by a substantial backlog of unresolved announcements. The motion emphasizes the importance of respecting the role of the Parliament in the democratic process and the need for greater accountability from the government.

title: Begränsa möjligheten för utländska aktörer att köpa strategiska fastigheter i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to limit the ability of foreign actors to purchase or rent strategically located properties in Sweden, emphasizing the need for increased state oversight to ensure national security. It highlights past instances of foreign ownership, such as that of the German-Russian company Nord Stream 2, which raised concerns due to its proximity to military installations. The proposal calls for the government to intervene in foreign transactions involving strategic properties, especially in light of increasing aggression from Russia.

title: Det svenska skyddsrumssystemet
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the need for shelters in Sweden and the distribution of cost responsibility between the state and property owners. It highlights the financial burdens associated with maintaining and inspecting existing shelters, particularly those built between 1945 and 1962, and suggests a review of regulations governing shelter construction and maintenance to make them more relevant and fair to current conditions.

title: Den enskildes ansvar i händelse av olyckor och kris
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of individual responsibility in accident prevention and crisis management, advocating for increased public awareness and training in crisis handling. It highlights the need for analyzing the preparedness of households, the role of voluntary organizations in crisis situations, and the potential benefits of utilizing the skills of immigrants who may possess relevant knowledge in crisis management. The motion calls for a thorough examination of the educational and structural changes needed to improve the public's crisis response capabilities, as well as the support for the independence of voluntary organizations.

title: Förbjud kusingifte
summary: The motion proposes a ban on cousin marriages in Sweden, highlighting the associated medical risks of congenital disabilities and the influence of kinship on societal structures. It calls for healthcare providers to inquire about family relations at maternal care centers and inform potential parents about the risks of cousin marriages, as well as to offer early prenatal diagnostics for closely related parents. The motion argues that such measures would enhance individual freedoms and reduce the potential for coercive cultural practices, while promoting public awareness of genetic risks.

title: Krafttag mot svarta trafikskolor
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a driving instructor certification for professional driving schools to combat illegal driving schools operating in Sweden. It highlights the negative consequences of these illegal operations, such as the financial gain of criminal networks, poor education for students, and increased risks to traffic safety. The proposal seeks to empower consumers by providing a means to verify the legitimacy of driving instructors, thereby reducing the prevalence of unregulated driving schools.

title: Rösträtt och valbarhet i allmänna val bör kopplas till medborgarskap
summary: The motion proposes that the right to vote and be eligible for election in general elections should be tied to Swedish citizenship. The authors argue that citizenship should be valued more and that those granted Swedish citizenship should automatically receive the corresponding rights, including the right to vote and be elected in all public elections. They contend that individuals desiring to vote must possess adequate knowledge of the Swedish language and society, implying that voting rights should be restricted to those who meet these criteria, while acknowledging exceptions as required by EU law or international agreements.

title: Tolkservice
summary: The motion proposes to limit the right to free interpreting services in Sweden, emphasizing that while authorities should remain accessible, individuals have an obligation to integrate and learn Swedish. By restricting access to these services, it is suggested that this could incentivize newcomers to learn the language, thus enhancing their integration into Swedish society. However, it is noted that exemptions should be made for the elderly and individuals with disabilities.

title: Kvalificering till välfärden
summary: The suggestion proposes an investigation into a system for requiring qualifications for access to Sweden's welfare system. It argues that the extensive public welfare system, designed to ensure basic service and security for all residents, is unsustainable when individuals who have never contributed through taxes can access it immediately upon arriving in the country. The motion highlights the financial burden on Swedish taxpayers posed by non-self-sufficient newcomers and suggests that establishing qualification criteria would promote economic sustainability and incentives for new arrivals to enter the labor market.

title: Reglerna för arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The motion proposes to streamline the process for attracting highly qualified labor to Sweden while also addressing issues related to labor immigration regulations, particularly for lower-skilled workers. It emphasizes the need for special rules to attract foreign talents, noting that Swedish companies face a skills shortage that hinders growth. The motion advocates for measures against the abuse of labor immigration rules and calls for a review of regulations concerning low-skilled labor to prevent illegal practices.

title: Den skånska flaggans officiella status
summary: The motion proposes that the Skåne flag be recognized as an official flag in Sweden, reflecting its historical significance and regional pride among the people of Skåne. The motion highlights previous resolutions by Region Skåne and the municipality of Lund regarding the flag's use and calls for an investigation into changing regulations to allow the flag to be used in official contexts.

title: Störningsservitut
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a new legal concept called 'disturbance easement' to address the increasing number of complaints from individuals who move near facilities that generate noise or other disturbances, such as sports fields or motorways. This easement would make future property buyers aware of the potential disturbances related to nearby activities, ensuring they accept these conditions upon purchase. The implementation of this easement aims to reduce conflicts and legal disputes, and to relieve municipal departments handling environmental and building matters from less critical tasks.

title: Stärka rätten till nödvärn
summary: The motion proposes strengthening the right to self-defense in Swedish law, as current legislation heavily restricts this right, often leading to individuals defending themselves being convicted while attackers receive compensations. The author highlights a specific case where an individual faced severe penalties for defending himself during an attack, questioning the justice system's focus and calling for a legislative review to ensure that citizens can protect themselves and their homes adequately.

title: Statistiken om svenskarnas konsumtion av alkohol, tobak och spel
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the consolidation of responsibility for all statistics related to the consumption of alcohol, tobacco, and gambling under a single authority, with the aim of improving the reliability and comprehensiveness of data collection and analysis in these areas. It underscores the need for accurate and trustworthy statistics to inform balanced political decisions, pointing out the current fragmentation of data collection across multiple agencies, which leads to inefficiencies and unreliable information.

title: Säkerhetsåtgärder på sjukhusen
summary: This motion proposes several security measures for hospitals in response to increasing violence and threats, particularly around emergency departments. It suggests replacing the current permit requirement for surveillance cameras with a notification duty, implementing metal detectors at hospital entrances, and exploring the feasibility of 'gated hospitals' to enhance safety for patients and healthcare staff. The motion highlights the challenges posed by criminal activities, such as gang-related shootings, within hospital environments and calls for immediate action to improve security.

title: Rymning från fängelse
summary: The proposal aims to make it a criminal offense to escape from prison or any institution where an individual is held by court order. This is in response to the significant issues of crime in Sweden and the negative impact that escapes have on crime victims and their families. The motion emphasizes that the current lack of consequences for escapees encourages such behavior and that clearer legislation is necessary to deter future escapes, particularly by dangerous individuals who may commit new crimes while at large.

title: Presumtionen mot fängelse
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the presumption against imprisonment as a penalty and suggests that courts should shift their focus from the perpetrator to the victims of crime. It advocates for a comprehensive reform of criminal law in Sweden, arguing that existing regulations hinder the deterrent effect of prison sentences and contribute to rising crime rates, particularly due to issues such as gang violence and organized crime. The motion emphasizes the need for a legal framework that prioritizes victims' rights and societal protection over the rehabilitation of offenders.

title: Tillsätta ett sjöfartsråd
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a maritime council aimed at enhancing Sweden's maritime industry's competitiveness and ensuring that Swedish shipping has equal conditions as competing nations. The council would serve as a collaboration platform involving industry, unions, universities, and authorities, focusing on long-term strategies to support growth in the maritime sector. It would identify growth-inhibiting factors and report annually to the government, aiming for greater stability and clarity in maritime policy.

title: Tillgång till uppgifter i fordonsregistret
summary: The proposal suggests restricting access to information in the vehicle register to combat organized crime, particularly car thefts. It highlights that the ease of obtaining ownership details through digital services facilitates criminal activities. The motion advocates for mandatory identification verification, such as using bank ID, to access vehicle registry information, and recommends that vehicle owners be informed about who has requested their information.

title: Skyldighet att uppvisa körkort
summary: The motion proposes an amendment to current legislation regarding the obligation to present a driver's license when operating a vehicle. It highlights the issues of individuals driving without a valid license and being acquitted due to difficulties in proving the validity of foreign licenses. The motion argues that this situation undermines traffic safety and legal fairness, advocating for equal treatment under the law for all drivers regardless of the origin of their license.

title: Sjöfartsverket
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiates an investigation into the advantages and disadvantages of merging the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) with the Swedish Maritime Administration (Sjöfartsverket). Additionally, it suggests that Sjöfartsverket should be relieved of all responsibilities except for core functions such as fairway marking, icebreaking, certain rescue services, and pilotage where market solutions are not available, in order to improve operational clarity and financial stability.

title: Utvärdering av statliga myndigheter
summary: The motion argues that evaluations of government agencies should be conducted by independent entities rather than by the agencies themselves, as current practices often lead to biased results and undermine the credibility of the evaluations. This situation makes it difficult for elected officials to hold agencies accountable and calls for a system where independent evaluations can enhance transparency and reliability.

title: Begreppet sysselsättning
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should amend unemployment statistics by replacing the term 'employed' with 'self-sufficient', arguing that the current definition misrepresents employment by including individuals who work only one hour a month. This change aims to provide a clearer picture of integration and social exclusion, particularly highlighting that it takes an average of 13 years for immigrants in Sweden to achieve financial self-sufficiency.

title: Stoppa välfärdsbedrägerierna
summary: The motion proposes strengthening the control over welfare payments in Sweden, citing extensive fraud in the public transfer systems that have resulted in hundreds of billions being incorrectly disbursed. It highlights issues such as the lack of monitoring of residency and the prevalence of multiple identities used to claim funds illegitimately. The suggestion includes implementing secure identification methods, such as biometric data, to ensure that welfare payments are made only to eligible recipients.

title: Skönstaxerade inkomster
summary: The motion proposes that individuals with assessed incomes (skönstaxerade inkomster) should not be eligible for benefits from the welfare system, as the current process allows those who evade tax obligations to receive benefits without having paid the necessary taxes. It highlights the issue of non-payment of taxes on estimated incomes by the Swedish Tax Agency, which leads to individuals benefiting from social services despite not having contributed to the taxation system. The motion calls for legislative action to prevent such inequities.

title: Uppgradering av det svenska medborgarskapet
summary: The motion proposes changes to the Swedish citizenship law, suggesting that additional requirements be introduced to foster a stronger sense of belonging among citizens. It advocates for the implementation of a language test to assess Swedish language skills as a requirement for citizenship, as well as proof of self-sufficiency, stipulating that individuals who have relied on social support should repay their debts to society before being granted citizenship.

title: Språkkunskap för medborgarskap
summary: The motion proposes that knowledge of the Swedish language should be a requirement for obtaining Swedish citizenship. It argues that language proficiency is crucial for integration into society, employment, and understanding one's rights and responsibilities. The motion emphasizes the importance of Swedish language skills for refugees and immigrants, suggesting that participation in language courses should be a prerequisite for citizenship to encourage integration into Swedish society.

title: Migrationsverkets förvar
summary: The motion proposes to enhance security measures at the Migration Agency's detention facilities by making escape attempts punishable, allowing the installation of security systems, permitting searches of personal belongings without reasonable suspicion, and allowing the search of detainees prior to transportation. The aim is to ensure that individuals who have been denied asylum are detained securely and that the safety of both staff and detainees is prioritized, especially given the history of violence and escape attempts at these facilities.

title: Krafttag mot ringa stöld
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to consider harsher penalties for petty theft and to grant extended powers to security personnel. With retail theft increasing, despite fewer convictions for petty theft, the motion argues that current laws inadequately deter thieves and hinder the enforcement actions of security staff. It suggests that enhancing penalties and empowering security personnel would improve the effectiveness of theft deterrence and prosecution.

title: Konkurrensneutral biljettplattform
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a new competition-neutral ticket platform to facilitate ticket purchases for all forms of public and private transportation, promoting sustainable travel in Sweden. It argues that increased competition and transparency in ticket sales can lead to lower prices and an increase in train travel, with a particular emphasis on ensuring all operators have equal access to the ticket sales channel. The motion highlights the challenges faced by new market entrants due to the dominance of the current ticket platform and the need for a national ticket system to support fair competition and provide passengers with easier access to information about travel options.

title: Arbetstagarbegreppet
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1430 av Björn Wiechel och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for a clear definition of the term 'employee' in Swedish law to prevent the competitive undermining of labor protections. It argues that without a proper definition, individuals classified as independent contractors may perform work that should be compensated under collective agreements, leading to competition distortions and wage dumping. The motion emphasizes the importance of clearly distinguishing between employees and independent contractors to uphold social and legal protections for workers.

title: En tillfällig skrotbilspremie
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1429 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a temporary scrap car premium to incentivize the removal of abandoned vehicles, particularly in rural areas where municipalities struggle with the costs of locating owners and disposing of these cars. The lawmakers argue that a new incentive could help address environmental concerns and reduce littering, as many municipalities currently face significant expenses related to abandoned vehicles.

title: Infrastrukturen i Jämtlands län
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1428 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should examine the distribution model of funding between regional transport plans, particularly in light of the significant infrastructure needs in Jämtland County. The authors argue that with one-third of the population living in rural areas, a well-maintained road network is essential for transportation, tourism, and the forest industry, which are heavily reliant on the infrastructure for both local and external trade. The motion emphasizes the need for a reevaluation of the investment allocation to ensure that traffic volumes, including tourism and forestry transport, are better reflected in future funding decisions.

title: Digitalt utanförskap
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1427 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The motion addresses the issue of digital exclusion in rural areas of Sweden, proposing that the Riksdag consider forms of broadband support to facilitate the expansion of broadband infrastructure. It highlights the importance of fast broadband access for enabling growth, modern education, healthcare, and innovative production, especially during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. The proposal underscores the significant disparities in broadband access, with only about 70% of households in rural areas connected, and emphasizes the financial challenges faced by municipalities like Strömsund in achieving national connectivity goals due to insufficient support for connecting households.

title: Trafiksäkra och bra underhållna vägar i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1426 av Anna-Caren Sätherberg och Kalle Olsson (båda S)
summary: The motion argues for enhanced infrastructure planning in Sweden that prioritizes traffic safety and well-maintained roads across the country. It highlights the necessity of a reliable transportation system to support both urban and rural areas, emphasizing the importance of road improvements to serve the diverse population densities in the country. The motion criticizes proposed speed reductions by Trafikverket, suggesting that increased maintenance and infrastructure investments are essential for ensuring road safety and accessibility, particularly in rural regions where public transportation options are limited.

title: Skogen – vårt gröna guld
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1425 av Anna-Caren Sätherberg och Kalle Olsson (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of Sweden's forests as a vital resource for addressing the climate crisis and promoting sustainable economic growth. It advocates for increased innovation and the expansion of the bioeconomy, including building more homes from wood and developing new materials that replace fossil fuels. The proposal highlights ongoing governmental investments in green jobs, forest protection, and the enhancement of recreational access to forests, asserting the need for a long-term, sustainable forestry policy that balances production with environmental considerations.

title: Reglering av hummerfisket
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1424 av Mattias Jonsson och Adnan Dibrani (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a review and regulation of lobster fishing in Sweden to ensure the sustainability of professional fisheries. It highlights the increasing threat posed by recreational fishing to professional fishermen due to a lack of control and regulation. The motion suggests that recreational fishers should notify the authorities about their fishing activities and maintain a logbook, allowing better monitoring and prevention of illegal fishing practices.

title: Västsverige är ett tillväxtområde
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for enhanced economic policy to address recruitment challenges, job matching for the unemployed, and increase employability for newcomers in Västsverige. It also highlights the significance of supporting key industries like manufacturing and tourism, addressing financing difficulties for businesses, and promoting education and job placement initiatives that cater to local conditions. The motion advocates for government efforts to ensure businesses can access necessary resources and promotes collaboration between different sectors to improve job opportunities and transportation infrastructure in the region.

title: Viseringsfrihet Kosovo
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament advocate for visa-free travel for the population of Kosovo. It emphasizes the importance of visa liberation as a means to support stability, democratic development, and economic integration in the Western Balkan region, highlighting the isolation felt by young Kosovars who cannot travel freely to the EU while other Balkan nations enjoy this privilege. The motion argues that granting visa-free status would be a recognition of Kosovo's readiness as noted by the EU Commission and urge the Swedish government to act on this matter.

title: Förändrade åldersregler vid adoption
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1421 av Adnan Dibrani och Mattias Jonsson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the current age regulations for adoption in Sweden, suggesting that the maximum age limit of 42 years for adopting a child should be abolished. It emphasizes that societal changes, such as increased education levels and later family formation, warrant an update to these regulations, making the suitability of prospective parents a more important consideration than their age alone.

title: Mål för sjukförsäkringen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize the need for Försäkringskassan to collaborate more effectively with patients' doctors when determining sickness benefits and other compensations. The aim is to ensure that sickness insurance provides financial security and efficient support for individuals to regain their ability to work. It emphasizes that the focus should not solely be on reducing sick leave numbers, as this can lead to stricter assessments and increased denials of benefits, particularly affecting those with disabilities or unobservable conditions.

title: Trafikskadeförsäkringen
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1419 av Adnan Dibrani och Mattias Jonsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to investigate ways to strengthen support for individuals injured in traffic accidents during legal proceedings, addressing concerns about the financial risks associated with civil lawsuits against insurance companies. It emphasizes the need for a fair and just system that does not deter victims from pursuing legal claims due to the fear of high litigation costs.

title: Myndigheter till Halland
summary: The motion calls for the relocation of government agencies to Halland to enhance regional engagement and reduce feelings of polarization and disconnect from state governance. It criticizes past centralization trends and seeks to ensure that Halland is included in the ongoing efforts to decentralize governmental presence across Sweden.

title: Vägarna kring Ullared
summary: The motion calls for an assessment of the conditions necessary to improve the road standards of Highway 153 and 154, situated near Ullared, which is Sweden's largest tourist destination with five million annual visitors. The current infrastructure is deemed inadequate to handle the significant traffic, including frequent deliveries and employee commutes, necessitating an upgrade to accommodate the heavy transportation demands.

title: Trygga barn och unga i alla skolformer
summary: The motion advocates for an evaluation of the implementation of laws regarding the protection of children from bullying and harassment in schools. It emphasizes the need for a supportive environment where all children feel safe and included, proposing adjustments to current practices that may overburden school staff and fail to effectively address the needs of victims. The motion calls on the government to recognize and address these concerns.

title: Förändrad a-kassa
summary: The motion proposes to maintain the unemployment insurance benefit level at 80% throughout the entire compensation period, highlighting the need for a reliable transition insurance during unemployment. It critiques the current system of diminishing benefits over time, viewing it as a relic of outdated thinking that pressures the unemployed. The motion argues that a stable compensation level would better support individuals, especially those facing greater challenges in finding work, such as those with lower education, disabilities, or new arrivals.

title: Båtregister
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national boat register for recreational boats in Sweden to enhance the ability of authorities like the police and coastguard to quickly identify boats involved in crimes or accidents, especially given the recent increase in the number and size of recreational boats.

title: Stoppa fler religiösa friskolor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should consider preventing the establishment of new religious free schools. It highlights concerns that the existing system of free choice in education, initiated in 1992, has led to increased segregation and declining school performance, particularly affecting children in vulnerable areas. The motion argues that religious free schools contribute to segregation by dividing children based on religious beliefs and contravening principles of non-confessional education mandated in Swedish law. Additionally, it raises issues regarding the reinforcement of patriarchal values within certain religious communities, questioning the appropriateness of government funding for such schools.

title: Höjd ambitionsnivå på fritidshemmen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider raising the ambitions and resources allocated to after-school programs (fritidshem) to meet the needs of children in lower age groups, as these programs are essential for complementing early education and supporting children from socioeconomically disadvantaged backgrounds. The motion highlights the current inadequacies in staffing and resources that hinder the effective implementation of the curriculum and advocates for measures such as teacher certification for staff and improved collaboration between after-school programs and schools.

title: Tillgång till bilprovning i hela landet
summary: The proposal calls for a review of the consequences of privatizing vehicle inspections in Sweden, highlighting negative impacts on accessibility, particularly in rural areas. The authors argue that the privatization has led to a lack of available inspection services in some municipalities and has made it more expensive and less convenient for residents to comply with the legal requirement for vehicle inspections. They urge the government to reconsider this privatization in light of safety and accessibility concerns.

title: Avskaffande av den allmänna motionstiden
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the general motion period in the Swedish Parliament, suggesting instead a more flexible system that allows individual members to propose motions throughout the year. The author argues that the current model is outdated and limits the ability of parliamentarians to represent local issues and engage with citizens, and emphasizes the need for a reform that enhances democratic participation and responsiveness.

title: Säkrare metoder och snabbare bedövningseffekt vid avlivning av djur
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1409 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion suggests that the government allocate funds for research and development of safer methods for quicker anesthesia effects during the euthanasia of animals. It emphasizes that while Sweden has made progress in animal welfare, there remain areas for improvement, particularly concerning the commonly used carbon dioxide method, which poses risks to animal welfare. The proposal calls for enhanced methods that can mitigate stress during the euthanasia process, thereby improving animal welfare standards.

title: Koldioxidmärkning och pantsystem för en cirkulär ekonomi
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1408 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should consider expanding the deposit system for more products and advocate for common deposit systems in the EU. Additionally, it calls for the introduction of carbon labeling for products and services sold in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the urgent need for political action to address climate change and transition towards a circular economy, highlighting the necessity for collective action and investment in green technology to boost economic resilience and social equity.

title: Dawit Isaak måste friges och det fria ordet måste värnas
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1407 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to advocate for the release of Dawit Isaak, who has been imprisoned in Eritrea for 20 years due to his criticism of the government. It emphasizes the necessity for Sweden to take a firm stance in defending freedom of expression and democratic rights globally, particularly against authoritarian regimes. The suggestion calls for increased efforts to ensure Isaak is not forgotten and highlights the unacceptable nature of his detention without trial and the denial of access to humanitarian organizations.

title: Arbetsförmedlingstjänster i hela landet
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Employment Agency (Arbetsförmedlingen) should be present throughout the entire country, ensuring that all citizens have equal access to its services, regardless of their residential location. The proposal reacts against previous reforms that have led to cuts and privatizations of services, arguing that market-driven approaches might disadvantage rural and underserved areas. It emphasizes that resources should be allocated based on need rather than market demand or profitability.

title: Elöverföringskapacitet i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament address the issue of electrical transmission capacity across the country, emphasizing the importance of enhancing infrastructure to facilitate access to electricity produced in northern Sweden. The authors argue that this is crucial for achieving fossil-free society goals, enabling industries and communities to access and utilize the growing electricity generated from renewable sources like hydro, wind, and solar power, thus promoting economic growth and environmental sustainability.

title: Återinförande av skattereduktion för fackföreningsavgift
summary: The motion proposes the Swedish parliament to consider reintroducing a tax deduction for union fees, which was previously in place from 2002 until it was abolished in 2007 and briefly reinstated in 2018 before being removed again in 2019. The authors argue that recognizing the societal importance of trade unions and ensuring equal tax treatment between employee and employer organizations justifies the reintroduction of this deduction.

title: Lagstadgad reflexanvändning
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider introducing a law that mandates the use of reflective gear for pedestrians during dark conditions to enhance visibility and reduce traffic accidents. It highlights the significant risk of accidents occurring in the dark, pointing to a similar law in Finland as a model for Sweden.

title: Dubbelspår på Malmbanan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports an investigation into the conditions for establishing a double track on the Malmbanan railway, emphasizing its capacity to enhance both cargo transport and passenger services. The authors argue that the current single track is overburdened and suggest that increasing capacity would not only facilitate safer transportation but also contribute to economic growth in the Norrbotten region by improving links in the labor market and boosting tourism. They claim that the revenues from increased iron ore exports could finance the construction of the double track.

title: Säkra förlossningar
