summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring safe childbirths in Sweden, highlighting the need for improved methods and increased research in obstetrics to reduce severe childbirth injuries. It calls for a national strategy for maternal and childbirth care to create equitable healthcare across the country, ultimately aiming to enhance women's health and wellbeing post-delivery.

title: Könsbekräftande vård i hela landet
summary: The motion advocates for nationwide access to gender-affirming care, emphasizing the importance of this care as a human right for transgender individuals who face discrimination and challenges in accessing healthcare. It calls for equitable access across different regions in Sweden, ensuring that healthcare providers offer consistent and high-quality support without imposing unnecessary barriers or varying requirements for referrals.

title: Heltid som norm vid upphandling
summary: The motion advocates for increased emphasis on full-time work as the standard in public procurement processes, arguing that this will enhance economic independence, gender equality, and the quality of care for recipients. The proposal highlights the existing disparity in obligations for private versus public employers under public contracts and calls on the government to ensure that all procurement activities support full-time employment.

title: Utredning av porrens konsekvenser för ungas vardag
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive investigation into the harmful effects of pornography on various aspects of society, particularly focusing on its impact on children and young people's understanding of sex and relationships. It highlights concerns about the violent and degrading nature of pornographic content available online, which contradicts societal efforts to reduce violence against women and promote gender equality. The signatories emphasize the need for educational reforms to equip young people with the knowledge to navigate sexual relationships healthily and safely, advocating for legislative measures to protect individuals from exploitation in both physical and digital forms.

title: Kundtjänst
summary: This proposal advocates for legislation requiring companies to provide clear instructions on invoices for consumers to easily contact customer service to dispute charges. The motivation stems from the challenges consumers face when trying to address unexpected invoices, particularly due to misleading marketing practices and the use of intermediary companies, which complicate accountability. The intent is to ensure that consumers can effectively reach out and resolve discrepancies regarding their purchases.

title: Näringslivsbokslut i varje kommun
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the feasibility of implementing an annual business audit in each municipality, aimed at assessing local economic conditions and supporting job creation. The motivation emphasizes the importance of business development for funding welfare and suggests that municipalities should actively identify and support local businesses to facilitate their establishment and growth.

title: Förkorta tillståndsprocesserna
summary: The proposal by Larry Söder (KD) suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support measures to shorten the approval processes for expanding the essential electricity grid, emphasizing the necessity for faster implementation to meet population growth and climate challenges. It highlights that lengthy approval times hinder both infrastructure development and the transition to renewable energy, stressing that modernized and expanded electricity grids are crucial for Sweden to achieve its goal of 100% renewable energy by 2040. The motion calls for the government to address legislative gaps and ensure adequate funding for necessary investments in electricity infrastructure.

title: It-säkerhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the feasibility of establishing public sector server infrastructure within Sweden's borders to enhance IT security. It highlights current vulnerabilities in existing systems and emphasizes the need for centralized control and coordination of security-classified systems among various agencies. The proposal aims to reduce costs and improve efficiency through better organization of systems while creating jobs and maintaining necessary competencies within the country.

title: Kommunal polis
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a municipal police force with a one-year training program to enhance local security in response to growing public feelings of insecurity. The municipal police would focus on visibility, community presence, and the prevention of everyday crimes, operating under the direction of the national police but primarily serving within their own jurisdictions. This initiative aims to reallocate existing municipal funds currently spent on private security services to support the municipal police, thereby increasing public safety and trust in law enforcement.

title: Avskaffande av straffrabatter
summary: The motion proposes a review of the penalty discount system in Sweden, arguing that current practices lead to disproportionately lenient sentences for individuals convicted of multiple offenses. The suggestion emphasizes the need for each crime to be treated with the same severity, in order to ensure justice for victims and restore public trust in the legal system. It asserts that every additional crime should result in a significant increase in the imposed punishment, thereby reinforcing the message that all offenses have serious consequences.

title: Försäljning vid exekutiva auktioner
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should restrict the sale of properties at executive auctions to exceptional cases only, advocating that properties should preferably be sold through real estate agents to better reflect market value. This change aims to protect both individuals in financial distress and their creditors by ensuring fairer selling prices, as executive auctions often result in lower sale prices compared to market transactions.

title: Ny elproduktion i elområde 3 och 4
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to explore the possibilities of planning for new nuclear power production in electricity areas 3 and 4, in response to an anticipated 60% increase in electricity demand by 2045, due to population growth and a shift from fossil fuels to electricity. The motion emphasizes the need for continuous and reliable electricity generation, arguing that while wind and solar energy are important, they cannot replace nuclear power, which is more stable and environmentally friendly.

title: Vägarna kring Ullared
summary: The proposal advocates for prioritizing and upgrading roads 153 and 154 leading to Ullared, a significant tourist destination, to accommodate the growing traffic resulting from increased visitor numbers and local economic development. The motion highlights the inadequacy of the current road conditions, which pose safety concerns and hinder the accessibility of the area, and calls for the Swedish Transport Administration to take responsibility for necessary improvements.

title: Myndighet borde lokaliseras till Halland
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider relocating a government authority to Halland, as there is currently no authority based in that region. The proponent argues that such a move would foster a sense of community and combat feelings of exclusion, aligning with recent governmental actions to decentralize authorities from Stockholm to other parts of the country.

title: Klimatdeklarationer också för byggprojekt i utemiljöer
summary: The proposal advocates for the inclusion of outdoor building projects in climate declarations to foster sustainable urban environments in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of holistic urban planning and the need for municipal engagement and education regarding the sustainability of outdoor spaces. The motion argues for immediate action to ensure that building projects, including parks and public areas, are covered by climate regulations, aiming for a cooperative approach between municipalities, researchers, and industries.

title: Användning av rotavdrag för klimatomställning
summary: The proposal suggests reinstating the ROT tax deduction to a higher level of 50% to facilitate climate transition in the construction sector. It argues that this change would not only boost employment in the industry but also encourage the use of sustainable materials and practices. The motion emphasizes the successful track record of the ROT system and its potential to promote green building and create new jobs while also minimizing the reliance on unregistered labor.

title: Utbyggnad av riksväg 55
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1385 av Jessika Roswall och Ulrika Karlsson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to review the conditions for expanding Riksväg 55, including the Hjulstabron bridge. It highlights the heavy traffic and poor condition of the road, emphasizing its importance for transportation and public safety. The proposal stresses the need for improvements to enhance traffic safety and accessibility, particularly in light of previous accidents and the lack of prioritization of the Hjulstabron in the national infrastructure plan.

title: Flytt av icke brottsbekämpande arbetsuppgifter från polisen
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes that non-criminal policing tasks be transferred from the police to other entities in order to allow police resources to focus exclusively on crime-fighting efforts. The motion argues that various responsibilities, such as the oversight of shooting ranges and other non-essential duties, are detracting from the police's ability to effectively combat crime, particularly in light of increasing security threats. The proponent believes that redistributing these tasks will be beneficial for enhancing public safety and the effectiveness of law enforcement.

title: Behörighet för ordningsvakter att utfärda ordningsbot för mindre förseelser
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the conditions under which security guards could issue fines for minor offenses such as public urination, littering, and drinking alcohol in public places. It argues that empowering security guards in this way would help maintain order in public areas.

title: Upprättelseutredning för personer som blivit utsatta som barn
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1382 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Pål Jonson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate a restitution investigation for children who have suffered harm during investigations conducted by social services, police, or healthcare. It highlights the case of Kevin Hjalmarsson, a four-year-old boy who died in 1998, and calls for recognition of the adverse impacts on two young boys wrongly accused of his murder. The motion calls for an examination of the situation of children affected by serious abuses or neglect in these contexts and the possibility of providing compensation.

title: Säkerställande av att barn har enkel tillgång till socialtjänsten dygnet runt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should investigate the creation of a dedicated national emergency contact line for social services to ensure that children have access to support 24/7. The aim is to improve the availability of social services, which currently operate mostly during weekday business hours and lack resources during evenings, weekends, and holiday periods, leaving vulnerable children without adequate assistance during critical times.

title: Tillsynsansvaret för skjutbanor
summary: Marléne Lund Kopparklint proposes transferring the oversight of shooting ranges from the police to another authority, citing issues with the current system that has caused significant problems for shooting clubs. She argues that the police's inspections have been delayed, leading to the closure of some ranges and the imposition of costly modifications. The motion emphasizes the need for appropriate regulations that support hunting and sports shooting without excessive interference from the police, suggesting a suitable authority, potentially a future wildlife agency, to take on this responsibility.

title: Ökningen av sexualbrott
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1379 av Betty Malmberg och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The motion addresses the alarming increase in sexual crimes, particularly rape, in Sweden, highlighting the need for the government to take immediate action. It calls for improvements in the solvability rate of rape cases, a reduction in case processing times, and a push for a stronger political commitment to supporting victims and ensuring justice is served. The signatories emphasize that despite previous assurances of progress, the situation has not improved adequately, necessitating urgent reforms.

title: Vårdnadshavares rätt att bestämma över sitt barn när barnet familjehemsplaceras
summary: This motion advocates for prioritizing children's rights during family placements, asserting that once a child is placed in foster care due to the failure of their caregivers, the new foster caregivers should have the authority to make important decisions regarding the child's health, education, and welfare. It highlights the need for legal changes to ensure that children's safety and well-being are prioritized over the rights of their biological parents, especially in crucial matters such as vaccinations and schooling.

title: Bedömningssystemet för personer med funktionsvariation måste förenklas
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1377 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Betty Malmberg (båda M)
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to simplify the assessment system for individuals with disabilities regarding compensation models and assistance rights. It highlights the existing uncertainties in how the Försäkringskassan determines assistance rights, which leads to inconsistency in decision-making and hampers individual freedoms. The authors argue that current bureaucratic processes create unnecessary obstacles for individuals with disabilities, limiting their choices and development, and urge for clearer guidelines and improvements in the assessment process.

title: Införande av nationella kom ihåg-kort för att hjälpa våldsutsatta barn
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of national reminder cards aimed at assisting children who are victims of violence. It emphasizes the need for systematic support for these children, particularly those residing in sheltered accommodations and facing significant school absenteeism. The suggestion calls for the development of clear action plans and procedures in all Swedish preschools and schools to ensure that the unique needs of these children are met. Additionally, it underlines the importance of authorities taking a child-centered approach in handling situations involving child welfare, with particular attention to maintaining ongoing support and communication.

title: Snabbare implementering av BK4
summary: The proposal aims to expedite the implementation of BK4 highways in Sweden, which are designed to support heavier trucks, allowing for a gross weight of up to 90 tons on certain parts of the road network. It argues that the current maintenance and upgrading of roads has been insufficient, leading to reduced speed limits due to poor conditions. The motion highlights the potential benefits of allowing heavier vehicles, including reduced climate impact, lower transportation costs, and increased competitiveness for Swedish industries. It also references successful implementations in Finland to support its arguments.

title: Förlängd giltighetstid för kunskapsprov för körkort
summary: The motion proposes to extend the validity period for driving theory tests (kunskapsprov) in Sweden, arguing that current waiting times for practical driving tests have been exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic, making it difficult for applicants, particularly youth, to obtain their driver's licenses in a timely manner. The motion suggests a permanent extension of the validity period to prevent young people from having to retake the theory test due to delays in scheduling practical tests, which would consequently support their ability to enter the job market.

title: Ofödda barn
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1373 av Jessika Roswall och Maria Malmer Stenergard (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes an amendment to the Social Services Act to extend the reporting obligation to include pregnant women with unborn children, ensuring that social services are informed when an unborn child may be at risk. This measure aims to protect unborn children from harm, particularly in scenarios where a pregnant woman is encountered in dangerous situations, such as being intoxicated or in risky environments.

title: Minska förekomst av skarv
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1372 av Jessika Roswall och Ulrika Karlsson (båda M)
summary: The motion aims to address the increasing population of cormorants in Sweden, which is negatively impacting fish stocks and biodiversity. It suggests that measures should be taken to reduce cormorant numbers, including allowing regulated hunting on an individual basis and updating the current management plan for cormorants. The proposal highlights concerns from both professional and recreational fishermen who fear for the health of fish populations in sensitive ecosystems.

title: Underlättande av redovisningen för UF-företag
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulatory framework for UF companies (student companies) in Sweden, aiming to simplify the reporting process for service-based companies compared to product-based and trading companies. The motion emphasizes the importance of supporting students in entrepreneurship through UF companies, noting that the current rules are unnecessarily complex for service-focused businesses, which hinders the ability of students and teachers to start and manage these enterprises.

title: Skatt/avgift på elcyklar och elsparkcyklar
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a tax or fee on electric bicycles and electric scooters due to their societal costs and environmental impact. It argues that these vehicles should contribute financially like other vehicles, as they also require infrastructure, contribute to environmental degradation through battery production, imply increased electricity demand, and potentially lead to higher healthcare costs due to accidents.

title: Tillåtelse att skriva sig på en adress
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations regarding the ability for individuals to register an address, suggesting that a registered address should reflect actual residency, ownership, or rental obligations. The motion highlights issues arising from current regulations that allow individuals to register at addresses where they do not reside, which could lead to problems such as hiding one's actual residence or unjustly receiving housing benefits. The aim is to clarify legislation related to address registration.

title: Sänkt skatt för pensionärer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews the possibility of further lowering taxes for pensioners, who often struggle financially despite having worked and paid taxes throughout their lives. The motion argues that it is unjust for individuals who have contributed to society to face difficult economic conditions in their later years and highlights that other countries have implemented similar tax reductions for pensioners.

title: Minska slöseriet med skattepengar
summary: The motion aims to address and reduce the wasting of taxpayer money in Sweden by enhancing public awareness of the true tax burden and advocating for the consolidation and efficiency of government agencies. The proponent emphasizes that citizens should better understand how much of their income goes to taxes, which would enable more informed political discussions and enable taxpayers to demand better public services in return for their contributions. The motion also highlights specific examples of inappropriate use of public funds by local governments and calls for a more transparent approach regarding government spending.

title: Återinförande av revisorsplikten
summary: The proposal by Anders Hansson suggests the reinstatement of the auditing requirement for small limited companies in Sweden, which was abolished in 2010 to reduce administrative costs. The motion argues that while the abolition led to a surge in the number of small companies and reduced costs, it has also resulted in increased economic crime and reduced oversight, as evidenced by significant declines in reports of economic misconduct. The motion advocates for the reintroduction of the auditing requirement to enhance the detection of such crimes and improve financial accountability.

title: Undantag i kemikalieskatten för begagnade produkter
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into the design and environmental impact of the chemical tax on used electronic products, which is currently leading to unintended consequences such as double taxation and discouraging the sale of heavier used products. The motion argues that the tax undermines efforts towards a circular economy and requests an exemption for second-hand electronics to enhance environmental benefits.

title: Flytt av ansvaret för Tullverket till Justitiedepartementet
summary: The motion proposes transferring the responsibility for the Customs Authority (Tullverket) from the Ministry of Finance to the Ministry of Justice. It argues that Customs operations, which focus on the inspection of vehicles, cargo, and individuals, are more appropriately aligned under the Justice Ministry, particularly to enhance coordination with the police, which falls under the same department.

title: Ett öppet och demokratiskt Belarus
summary: The proposal advocates for an active Swedish policy towards Belarus, emphasizing support for democracy and human rights. It calls for Sweden to condemn the oppressive regime, declare the current leader illegitimate, and support perceived legitimate leaders for negotiations. The motion highlights the urgency for Sweden to take a leading role in enforcing strong sanctions against the Belarusian regime and to uphold moral support for the Belarusian people in their struggle for democracy.

title: Transparens i biståndspolitiken
summary: The motion advocates for increased transparency and effectiveness in Sweden's aid policy, proposing the abolition of the current one-percent aid target in favor of a four-year aid framework focused on measurable results. It emphasizes the need for proper allocation of Swedish tax money, ensuring that aid does not support totalitarian regimes, while promoting democracy, human rights, and economic reforms in recipient countries.

title: Tydlig Hongkongstrategi
summary: The motion advocates for a clear Swedish strategy regarding Hong Kong, emphasizing the need to uphold the region's autonomy and protect its rights as promised in international agreements. It highlights China's encroachment on Hong Kong's legal and political systems since the 1997 handover and calls for Sweden to explicitly criticize these actions while ensuring that international commitments are respected.

title: Kommunpolitiken bör kunna utvecklas
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament allow a number of municipalities to experiment with new methods for fulfilling their tasks by exempting them from certain laws and regulations. This idea originates from the Municipal Investigation report submitted in 2020, which recommended a pilot program similar to the previous 'Frikommunförsöket' conducted in the 1980s and 1990s. The goal is to enable municipalities to tailor their operations to local needs and foster innovation in local governance.

title: Stopp för överimplementering av EU-direktiv
summary: The motion calls for improved clarity in the implementation of EU directives in Sweden to prevent overimplementation, emphasizing the need for a better understanding of the minimum requirements set by the directives as well as comparisons with other countries. It advocates for Sweden to confidently interpret and implement EU directives independently, rather than exceeding the required standards due to a lack of knowledge or clarity in the legislative process.

title: Renodla statistiken om jaktbrott
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1358 av Åsa Coenraads och John Widegren (båda M)
summary: The proposal aims to refine the statistics related to hunting crimes in Sweden by creating a separate crime code for traffic-injured wildlife involved in hit-and-run incidents. The current statistics are misleading as they include traffic-related wildlife injuries under hunting crimes. The suggestion emphasizes the need for clearer categorization to better differentiate intentional hunting violations from unintentional traffic accidents, ultimately leading to improved prevention of wildlife-related traffic accidents and a more focused approach to combating poaching.

title: Brott som begås i samförstånd
summary: The motion proposes that individuals involved in a crime together should all be held accountable under the law, irrespective of who performed the specific criminal act. It argues that this approach would enhance the effectiveness of the legal system by simplifying the burden of proof and better supporting victims and their families, particularly in complex cases such as gang shootings or coordinated robberies.

title: Göra det mer lönsamt att jobba
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of an additional job tax deduction to make work more financially rewarding for individuals. It emphasizes that when more people are employed, it enhances Sweden's ability to produce goods and services, ultimately increasing national revenues and supporting a robust welfare system, including quality education, healthcare, and infrastructure.

title: Ledamotsstöd i Sveriges riksdag
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the support system for Members of Parliament, emphasizing that the current financial aid is largely being utilized for purposes other than parliamentary work. It calls for a reassessment to ensure that the funding intended for supporting MPs directly aligns with their responsibilities and doesn't inadvertently serve as party support, thereby reinforcing the independence of parliamentarians in their role within the democratic framework.

title: Översyn av förmånsbeskattning av färdigproducerad mat
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1354 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider a review of the taxation of benefits related to prepared food to reduce food waste, which is a significant environmental issue in Sweden. According to the proposal, a substantial amount of food produced is discarded instead of being consumed. The motion highlights instances where leftover food has been donated to charities or sold at discounted prices, emphasizing the financial impact of food waste. Some municipalities have sought to offer surplus food from school kitchens or elderly care facilities to staff at subsidized rates but have been denied by the Tax Agency, indicating a need for reform in benefit taxation to address this issue.

title: Ökade polisiära befogenheter för tulltjänstemän
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into increasing the police powers of customs officers, including the potential authorization for them to carry firearms, to better protect themselves and effectively combat armed criminals at the borders.

title: Ökad brandberedskap mot skogsbränder
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament enhance the country's preparedness for forest fires by increasing firefighting capabilities. It emphasizes the need for a review of Sweden's fire-fighting capacity, suggesting the acquisition of more fire-fighting aircraft to ensure effective and timely response to wildfires. The proposal highlights the inadequacies experienced during the 2018 summer fires, where reliance on foreign assistance was deemed unacceptable. The motion aims to establish a clear action plan for combating forest fires and to reorganize firefighting resources and personnel efficiently.

title: Svenskt Natomedlemskap för ökad säkerhet och samarbete
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should seek membership in NATO to enhance its security and cooperation with other nations. It emphasizes the necessity of a strong defense capability to safeguard Sweden's freedom and sovereignty, especially in light of increasing aggression from Russia and other global tensions. The motion advocates for a coordinated membership application process with Finland and encourages the government to develop a roadmap for this membership, arguing that NATO membership would provide Sweden with greater influence and security.

title: Brandlarm som fungerar för alla
summary: The motion proposes that the issue of fire alarms solely relying on sound, which may not effectively alert individuals with hearing impairments, should be addressed. It advocates for the development of fire alarms that incorporate additional warning functions, such as visual signals, to ensure that all individuals, regardless of their hearing ability, can be alerted to potential dangers and ensure their safety in case of a fire.

title: Beredskapslager av elstolpar och sliprar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government develop a comprehensive plan for establishing a reserve stock of electricity poles and sleepers to enhance the country's emergency preparedness. It highlights the vulnerability of the current wooden electricity poles, particularly in extreme weather events such as storms, and emphasizes the need for a guaranteed supply to ensure the stability and reliability of the electrical infrastructure as Sweden transitions to a fossil-free society.

title: System för skrotning av mopeder
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider implementing a regulatory framework for the recycling of mopeds, as the current lack of such a system creates practical challenges for moped owners and poses significant environmental risks due to improper disposal. The motion emphasizes the urgency of establishing a framework specifically for mopeds, which have lower economic incentives for proper handling compared to motorcycles.

title: Stärkt områdespolis i utsatta områden
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1347 av Anna Johansson och Mattias Jonsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes strengthening police presence in vulnerable areas to combat escalating crime and gang activity. It emphasizes the need for both preventive and repressive measures, advocating for an increase in local area police to enhance community trust and safety. The authors suggest recruiting officers with local connections to improve policing effectiveness and encourage collaboration among law enforcement, social services, schools, and local businesses. The focus is on creating a safer environment and breaking the cycle of criminal recruitment and activity.

title: Öka användningen av trä som fasadmaterial
summary: The motion proposes an increase in the use of wood as facade material in construction, emphasizing its benefits for reducing climate emissions, promoting ecological sustainability, and supporting the Swedish timber industry. It highlights the aesthetic qualities of wood, its significance in Swedish architectural tradition, and the potential for restoring older buildings. The proposal aims to encourage governmental measures to support wood construction in both new projects and renovations.

title: Nolltolerans mot dödsolyckor
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1345 av Mattias Jonsson och Gunilla Carlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the development of a comprehensive strategy for zero tolerance against fatal workplace accidents in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of ensuring that no individual should risk their life while at work, advocating for enhanced safety measures and support for safety representatives and labor unions. The motion calls for accountability from companies that do not prioritize employee safety, aiming to significantly reduce the occurrence of fatal accidents in the labor market.

title: Stärkt arbete i skolan mot hedersproblematik
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1344 av Mattias Jonsson och Anna Johansson (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of strengthening the school's efforts against honor-related violence and oppression, proposing that the Parliament support follow-up actions and clarify the school's responsibilities in addressing this issue. It highlights the significant role of schools in preventing such abuses, ensuring a safe and developing environment for all children, upholding democratic values, and promoting human rights and equality.

title: Utökad kontroll av vapenhandel
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1343 av Mattias Jonsson och Anna Johansson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes enhanced scrutiny of arms trading companies in Sweden, specifically advocating for inventory checks and necessary inspections prior to the acquisition or takeover of such businesses. It highlights existing deficiencies in current oversight practices and seeks to ensure that any transfer of operational licenses undergoes rigorous evaluation, similar to the original licensing process for arms dealers.

title: Krav på djurskydd och djurhållning vid offentlig upphandling
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should require more public procurement processes to include animal welfare and animal husbandry standards. It argues that Sweden's existing strong animal welfare legislation should be reflected in all public procurement, ensuring that governmental bodies prioritize the purchasing of animal products that comply with these standards, thereby supporting both animal welfare and domestic food production.

title: Inga burar inom den svenska äggindustrin
summary: Elin Lundgren's motion advocates for the Swedish government to set a deadline to end the use of cages in the egg industry, aligning Sweden with the EU's 'End the Cage Age' initiative. Despite Sweden's support for this movement at the EU level, there is currently no national decision to phase out caged housing for hens, which affects around 500,000 hens in the country. Lundgren emphasizes that this practice is deemed undignified and potentially inconsistent with Sweden's new animal welfare law enacted in 2019.

title: Insatser för att underlätta vildsvinsjakt i områden särskilt drabbade av Tjernobylolyckan
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1340 av Gustaf Lantz och Sanne Lennström (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider special measures to facilitate wild boar hunting in areas affected by the Chernobyl disaster, where high cesium levels have made the meat unfit for consumption and sale. The rapid increase in the wild boar population has caused significant issues, including traffic accidents and damage to agriculture. The authors argue that hunters play a critical role in managing the wild boar population but face barriers due to the toxicity of the meat in certain regions. They suggest that the government should acknowledge these challenges and explore innovative solutions, such as financial compensation for hunters.

title: Upphandlingskrav inom kollektivtrafiken
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for regulatory requirements in public transportation procurement to ensure job security for workers. It advocates for mandates that workers retain their positions and working conditions during transitions to new employers, addressing the shortcomings of existing practices. Additionally, the suggestion calls for the establishment of whistleblower protections to improve safety and accountability in the sector.

title: Trygga jobb
summary: The motion advocates for secure jobs in Sweden, addressing the issue of precarious employment which is viewed as detrimental to the labor market. It proposes measures to disincentivize employers from offering uncertain employment contracts by increasing employer fees for those with insecure jobs and reducing fees for those providing secure employment. The funds generated could be used to manage the increased health issues resulting from job insecurity.

title: Sjukersättning och rehabilitering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament endorses the need for reforming the system of sickness benefits and rehabilitation, highlighting the increasing challenges individuals face in obtaining sickness compensation despite significant impairments. It argues that the current system leads to economic insecurity, as many individuals are denied benefits and lack access to necessary rehabilitation services. The motion calls for the implementation of recommendations from an investigation aimed at improving the social insurance system, particularly emphasizing the need for timely assessments of rehabilitation needs by the Social Insurance Agency.

title: Jämställd fördelning av ekonomiskt bistånd
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1336 av Diana Laitinen Carlsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of legislation to ensure that economic assistance payments are distributed equally among adults in a household, rather than being typically allocated to one individual, usually the eldest male. The motion highlights the importance of economic independence for women, particularly in light of social challenges such as domestic violence, and calls for a uniform approach among municipalities to promote gender equality and empower individuals to make independent financial decisions.

title: Säkra och utveckla de ideella kvinnojourerna
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1335 av Diana Laitinen Carlsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal advocates for governmental support and development of non-profit women's shelters in Sweden, emphasizing their crucial role in addressing men's violence against women and children. It highlights concerns over the privatization of these services, which has led to diminishing quality and availability of support for victims. The motion calls for stronger protection and resources for these shelters to ensure they can continue to provide essential services without competition from profit-driven entities.

title: Infrastruktur i Jönköpings län
summary: The motion proposes improvements to the infrastructure in Jönköping County, focusing on enhancing communication systems, including road networks, railways, and broadband access. It highlights the necessity of a reliable and safe infrastructure to support employment, economic growth, and social equity. The motion calls for national responsibility for railway operations and emphasizes the importance of investments for regional and national connectivity, including the extension of flight services and broadband access to ensure equal opportunities across the country.

title: Bildningsverksamhet över längre tid
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider revising the reporting requirements for study associations to facilitate long-term educational activities. It highlights the significance of folkbildning in supporting democracy, increasing diversity, and improving educational levels, while emphasizing the current challenges posed by short-term project funding and reporting demands.

title: Förvaltning av siklöja
summary: The motion proposes a review of the collaborative management model for siklöja fishing in Bottenviken, emphasizing the importance of this fishery for both economic sustainability and ecological responsibility. It highlights the need for better cooperation among professional fishermen, researchers, and the regulatory authority, as the current model has reportedly weakened in recent years, affecting the livelihoods of local fishermen. The suggestion advocates for a re-establishment and strengthening of this joint management approach to ensure a sustainable fishery, in light of divergent scientific recommendations and national policies between Sweden and Finland.

title: Expandering av kriminalvården i Norrbotten
summary: The motion proposes the expansion of the correctional services in Norrbotten, emphasizing the need for additional prison facilities due to overcrowding and the increase in crime. It argues that relocating state jobs to the region would help diversify the local economy, which is currently dominated by industrial sectors such as forestry and mining. The motion highlights the historical presence of correctional services in Haparanda and suggests possible locations for new developments in Luleå and Älvsbyn, aiming to enhance both public safety and job opportunities in the area.

title: Ta bort undantaget från kravet på innehållsförteckning för vin
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1330 av Roza Güclü Hedin och Linus Sköld (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to remove the exemption from the requirement for ingredient labeling on wine, arguing that many wines contain additives that are not disclosed to consumers. The proposal emphasizes the need for transparency in wine production, as only sulfites are required to be listed on labels, while many other approved substances remain undisclosed. It calls for the government to support this clarification, in light of future EU directives on the matter.

title: Metalldetektorer – se över den danska modellen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider adopting the Danish model for metal detecting, which fosters collaboration between amateur metal detectors and archaeologists. The Danish approach emphasizes trust and clear legislation that allows metal detecting in most areas, protecting archaeological findings while benefiting cultural research. The motion highlights that the current Swedish regulations have led to a decline in permits, hindering the hobby, and argues for a shift towards a more permissive framework that encourages public involvement in archaeology and cultural heritage.

title: Vatten är vår gemensamma resurs
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of water as a shared resource and suggests that the Swedish parliament consider establishing a unified responsibility for water policy. It highlights the need for improved knowledge and data collection regarding water supply, especially in light of climate change and varying availability across regions. The proposal advocates for coordination within water management and calls for a governmental initiative to create a cohesive approach to national water policy, which includes collaboration between the public sector, industry, and research.

title: Samordnare för samhällsomställning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the consideration of appointing a coordinator for social transition in more regions, building on the existing role established in Norrbotten and Västerbotten. The motion emphasizes the importance of coordinated efforts among various stakeholders to address the challenges and opportunities arising from the green transition in the industry, noting the need for better alignment in processes to facilitate regional development and reduce uncertainty for businesses.

title: Säkerställande av ett hållbart trygghetssystem för frilansande kulturskapare
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament explore options to strengthen the social security system for freelance cultural creators, including artists, musicians, and writers. It highlights the increasing trend of freelancers operating as self-employed individuals due to changing labor market conditions and emphasizes the challenges they face regarding job security and access to unemployment insurance. The motion calls for an investigation into these issues, aiming to gather input from relevant stakeholders to enhance the working conditions and competitiveness of Sweden's cultural and creative sectors.

title: Förbifart Örnsköldsvik
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1325 av Kristina Nilsson och Anna-Belle Strömberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instructs the government to study solutions for improving the traffic situation in Örnsköldsvik, focusing on air quality and urban development possibilities. It emphasizes the negative health impacts of pollution and the barriers caused by the current European road passing through the city, which affects transportation for cyclists and pedestrians. The motion argues that the region deserves adequate infrastructure comparable to other areas of Sweden, given its industrial significance and the need for a modern road network that prioritizes public health and environmental concerns.

title: Ambulans- och sjuktransporter i Norden
summary: The motion proposes a review of the legislation concerning cross-border ambulance and medical transport in the Nordic countries to enhance healthcare accessibility in rural areas. It emphasizes the importance of timely medical care and suggests that greater cooperation in border regions could improve resource efficiency and patient safety. The motion highlights existing legislative barriers in Sweden that hinder these cross-border services and calls for a collaborative effort similar to those in other emergency services.

title: Bildande av Ombergs nationalpark
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider the establishment of the Omberg National Park, emphasizing the area's significant natural, cultural, and scientific values. The motion highlights local support in Östergötland, including backing from the county administrative board, and notes prior discussions regarding the lengthy process of creating a new national park, which would be facilitated by the state's existing ownership of the land and the proximity to the Naturum Tåkern visitor center.

title: Högskolan Väst
summary: The motion advocates for increased support for Högskolan Väst, emphasizing its critical role in addressing regional labor market needs by providing a strong educational framework and research capabilities. It highlights the importance of higher education in producing a skilled workforce, points out the inadequacy of current funding for research compared to other institutions, and calls on the government to reassess the distribution of research resources to better support institutions like Högskolan Väst, essential for local and national growth.

title: Apotekens glesbygdsbidrag och öppettider
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1321 av Gunilla Svantorp och Lars Mejern Larsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that pharmacies eligible for rural subsidies should remain open year-round to ensure equal access to services for rural residents as compared to urban areas. Currently, a pharmacy can receive subsidies even if it is closed seasonally, which the authors argue undermines the principle of equitable service availability, especially in light of the fact that private providers are compensated for maintaining open hours.

title: Statens institutionsstyrelse
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for improved conditions for the Swedish National Board of Institutional Care (Sis), particularly in light of recent escape incidents from its facilities. It acknowledges the government's proposed budget increase for Sis but argues for additional measures to safeguard employees' rights, especially concerning their personal safety when making decisions about electronic communication access for residents. The motion suggests introducing anonymized journal notes and investigating ways to protect staff identities in cases where rights are restricted for clients.

title: Fastighetsboxar i flerfamiljshus
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider requiring mailboxes in multi-family buildings to improve mail delivery services and enhance the working environment for postal workers. With a significant decline in letter volumes and a rise in parcel deliveries, the implementation of mailboxes is seen as a necessary step, especially in new and renovated buildings. The proposal aims to integrate this requirement into the ongoing evaluation of financing models for public postal services.

title: En jämlik sjukvård
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the implementation of the national guidelines established by the National Board of Health and Welfare for treating patients with Parkinson's disease. It emphasizes the importance of equal access to high-quality care, continuous follow-up, and available advanced treatments for all patients, regardless of their geographical location. The motion highlights existing disparities in treatment access and calls for measures to ensure that patients receive timely and appropriate healthcare services according to the guidelines.

title: Fortsatt stöd till idrotten genom Riksidrottsförbundet
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of continued government support for Swedish sports through the Swedish Sports Confederation (Riksidrottsförbundet). It highlights the significant role sports play in society, including health improvements and community building, and argues for a stable and long-term funding model post-pandemic to ensure the viability of sports organizations and activities for children and youth across the country.

title: Integrationsinsatser genom bildning och kunskap
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider measures to support social enterprises in providing educational initiatives focused on democracy and history, especially for foreign-born individuals who face barriers to the regular labor market. The aim is to enhance knowledge of rights, responsibilities, and societal values to facilitate integration and improve public health and community participation.

title: Förebyggande arbete mot gängkriminalitet
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for preventive measures against gang crime, particularly through initiatives in schools. It suggests that young men at risk of joining gangs require acknowledgment of their strengths, guidance, mentorship, and opportunities to channel their energy positively. Collaborative efforts among community institutions, including family, schools, and social services, are critical. The proposal includes specific suggestions such as mentoring programs, youth leadership courses, and funding for initiatives that aim to create alternative cultures to the prevailing macho culture and strengthen the role of fathers in communities.

title: Religiösa och etniska minoriteter i Irak och Syrien
summary: The suggestion advocates for Sweden to take initiative in the UN to preserve the religious and ethnic diversity in Iraq and Syria, emphasizing the importance of ensuring religious and belief freedoms for minorities such as Syrians, Assyrians, and Chaldeans. It calls for fostering religious dialogue among different groups and highlights the dire situation faced by these minorities, including persecution, displacement, and cultural loss due to radical extremism.

title: Trygghet och studiero
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1313 av Patrik Engström och Maria Strömkvist (båda S)
summary: The motion calls for a review of the Skolinspektionen to determine whether it requires clearer direction and enhanced oversight due to concerns regarding students' sense of safety and study environment in schools. Despite previous reports indicating a decline in student security perceptions, the current oversight by Skolinspektionen has proven inadequate in addressing ongoing issues of bullying and classroom management, with recurrent failures to implement follow-ups on violations. The authors argue that strengthening the Skolinspektionen's role could facilitate necessary changes to ensure a safer educational environment for students.

title: Barnomsorg på obekväm tid
summary: The motion proposes to improve access to childcare during inconvenient hours, such as early mornings, evenings, nights, and weekends, to support equal participation of both women and men in the labor market. A review indicated that only 70% of municipalities provide such services, often with limited hours that do not meet parents' needs. The lack of legal requirements for this type of childcare leads to neglect of the issue, causing concerns for families. The motion urges the government to consider enhancing these childcare options.

title: Vägförbättringar i inlands- och fjällområdena
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1311 av Isak From och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of road maintenance for job creation and growth across Sweden, particularly in rural and mountainous areas. It highlights the poor condition of roads in northern regions, which exacerbates existing accessibility issues and hinders economic opportunities. The proposal calls for an increase in infrastructure investment and road improvements to support both local communities and the tourism industry, aiming to ensure safer travel and enhance the quality of life for residents in these areas.

title: Trafiksäkerhetsarbetet
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of enhancing traffic safety in Sweden, building on the country's commitment to the Vision Zero concept, which aims to eliminate fatalities and severe injuries in road traffic. It calls for increased awareness among road users, more robust monitoring by police and transport authorities, improved education on safe driving practices, particularly for heavy vehicle operators, and a reconsideration of penalties for traffic violations. Additionally, the suggestion includes addressing issues related to vehicle ownership and registration to ensure accountability for traffic offenses.

title: A-traktorer och mopedbilar
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1309 av Ann-Christin Ahlberg och Paula Holmqvist (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the current speed regulations for A-tractors and moped cars, noting the increasing popularity of these vehicles among youth. The authors argue that the disparities in maximum speed limits—30 km/h for A-tractors, which are often modified cars, versus 45 km/h for moped cars that may not be as safe—could lead to accidents and traffic issues. They emphasize the need to reassess these regulations to enhance safety and accommodate young users who rely on these vehicles for transportation.

title: Marknadsföring av nätläkare
summary: The motion proposes that the marketing of online healthcare services, particularly those offered by mobile app providers, should be regulated by the government. The authors express concern that aggressive advertising by these companies creates unnecessary anxiety about minor health issues, leading to an increased demand for healthcare services that may not be needed. They argue that legitimate medical advice should be accessible for general inquiries but should not exploit consumers for profit, emphasizing the importance of responsible marketing practices within the healthcare sector.

title: Vänern och Göta älv
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish parliament to support the development of shipping in Göta älv and Vänersjöfarten as part of infrastructure planning. It emphasizes the environmental benefits of shipping as a means to reduce emissions from road traffic and highlights its economic advantages, including lower road maintenance costs and potential growth in regional transportation services. The proposal calls for enhanced collaboration among stakeholders to improve intermodal transport connections and to construct new locks to accommodate larger container ships, thus fostering economic growth and environmental sustainability.

title: Jordens öga
summary: The suggestion proposes the establishment of a global monitoring center focused on climate change, named 'Earth's Eye', utilizing satellite data collection to provide daily updates on global changes and their implications. It emphasizes the need for increased information to address climate-related risks, such as natural disasters and migration, suggesting that Sweden could take a leading role in this initiative while ensuring oversight by the United Nations to prevent misuse of the collected data.

title: Arbetsrättsliga kunskaper i gymnasieskolan
summary: The motion suggests that knowledge of labor rights should be incorporated into the high school curriculum in Sweden. It highlights a growing concern that students feel inadequately prepared for the job market, particularly in vocational programs. The motion points out that a lack of understanding of workers' rights and obligations can lead to exploitation in the workplace. Therefore, it calls for making education about collective agreements, unemployment insurance, and workplace safety obligatory for high school students to ensure they are better equipped for their future employment.

title: Det historiska kristna kulturarvet i Turkiet
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to engage with the European Union and the international community to protect and promote the historical Christian cultural heritage of Syrians, Assyrians, and Chaldeans in southeastern Turkey. It emphasizes the dire state of many valuable cultural sites and the challenges faced in their preservation due to governmental restrictions. The motion underscores the importance of this heritage for the identity and self-esteem of communities in Sweden connected to these groups.

title: Enhetlig utbildning för barnskötare
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a unified competence requirement for the training of childcare workers (barnskötare) to ensure that education and experience promote children's development and learning. It highlights the need for standardized training across different educational institutions to enhance quality and equity in preschool education. The proposal aims to align the educational structure and credit system for childcare training with that of healthcare assistant training, thereby improving workforce supply in preschool settings.

title: Tillgång till högre utbildning oavsett bostadsort
summary: The motion advocates for enhancing access to higher education across Sweden, regardless of geographical location. It calls for the development of collaborative structures that facilitate educational opportunities, a fair allocation of research resources, and the consideration of labor market needs in the distribution of educational placements. The proposal emphasizes the importance of validating skills for newcomers to Sweden and ensuring that educational institutions are equipped to meet the increasing demand for qualified professionals in a rapidly changing economy.

title: Eget boende (EBO)
summary: Mattias Jonsson from the Social Democratic Party proposes abolishing the Individual Housing Law (EBO), which allows asylum seekers to live anywhere in Sweden, citing that it has led to increased segregation, exploitation of vulnerable individuals by unregulated landlords, and challenges for municipalities that have been disproportionately impacted by refugee inflows. The proposal advocates for a reformed approach to refugee housing that promotes a controlled and equitable distribution of newcomers across the country, suggesting the adoption of accommodation centers and requirements for language and civic education for new arrivals.

title: Skydd mot ombildningar av hyresrätter till bostadsrätter
summary: This motion proposes measures to protect rental apartments from being converted into tenant-owner apartments by requiring that any conversions of public housing must be approved by the municipal council. Additionally, the motion seeks to prohibit discounted conversions, ensuring that any conversion can only take place if the tenant-owner association pays the full market price. The goal is to preserve the availability of affordable rental housing and prevent further exacerbation of the housing crisis in Sweden, particularly in urban areas like Stockholm.

title: Reglera elsparkcyklar
summary: This motion advocates for the regulation of electric scooters in Sweden, noting the rapid increase in their numbers and the associated issues such as hazards to pedestrians, public space clutter, and safety concerns. It suggests that municipalities should be given the authority to regulate and possibly penalize the use of shared electric scooters, and calls for legislation to legally distinguish electric scooters from traditional bicycles to facilitate improved management and safety in urban areas.

title: Utredning om elmarknadens funktionssätt
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the functioning of the electricity market in Sweden, particularly examining the effects of deregulation implemented in the late 1990s. It argues that deregulation has led to increased electricity network prices, deteriorating working conditions, and reduced job security, while highlighting the profits made by energy companies. The motion emphasizes the need to hire more personnel to maintain electrical infrastructure and suggests that a government agency should be responsible for training programs to ensure an adequate workforce. It also advocates for greater state intervention in ensuring companies maintain their own workforce rather than relying solely on subcontractors, which would improve working conditions and service reliability.

title: Likvärdiga möjligheter till organdonation i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes to promote equitable conditions for organ donation throughout Sweden, emphasizing the need for a uniform organization in handling organ donations to reduce regional disparities. It highlights that there are significant differences in how various regions execute their organ donation efforts and calls for a national framework to enhance coordination and increase the number of successful donations. The goal is to ensure that anyone wishing to donate organs has the opportunity to do so, and that all individuals in need of transplants receive them regardless of their regional affiliation.

title: Utökat skydd mot föreningsrättskränkning
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1296 av Leif Nysmed och Lars Mejern Larsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the protections against infringements of union rights as outlined in the Medbestämmandelag (Co-Determination Act). It highlights concerns that recent violations of union rights, such as during a strike by the Elektrikerförbundet, have become more prevalent. The current burden of proof lies on the victim to demonstrate that an infringement has occurred, which can be particularly challenging. The motion argues for the need to revisit and enhance these protections to ensure a more balanced power dynamic between employees and employers.

title: Högre böter och utökad hastighetsövervakning vid vägarbetsplatser
summary: The motion proposes increased fines for speeding violations near road work sites and enhanced monitoring of speed limits to address safety concerns for road workers. According to reports, the majority of road workers feel unsafe due to traffic violations in work zones, and there has been a significant rise in incidents over the past decade. The proposal aims to improve road worker safety by enforcing stricter penalties for traffic offenses and promoting better traffic management around construction areas.

title: Jämlik färdtjänst
summary: The motion suggests that the parliament should urge the government to review the transportation law regarding 'färdtjänst' (transportation services for individuals with disabilities). The authors express concern over recent decisions restricting access to transportation services for blind individuals, which they argue hinders their mobility and ability to work or study. They call for legislative changes to reinforce the rights of disabled individuals to access these essential services.

title: Äldreomsorgens långsiktiga finansiering och kompetensförsörjning
summary: The motion addresses the long-term financing and staffing issues of elderly care in Sweden, highlighting the negative impact of the COVID-19 pandemic which exposed existing deficiencies in care services, such as staff shortages and inadequate working conditions. It calls for increased funding to ensure sufficient resources and the need for better-trained personnel, while advocating for improved employment conditions and a shift from micromanagement to more trusting leadership styles. The proposal emphasizes the importance of ongoing educational initiatives and improved staffing to meet the growing care demands of an aging population.

title: Jämlik och tillgänglig tandvård
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1292 av Diana Laitinen Carlsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion advocates for equal and accessible dental care for all citizens in Sweden, highlighting the need to address health disparities related to dental health, particularly among vulnerable groups such as those with disabilities or low economic status. It emphasizes the importance of improving the dental care system to ensure financial accessibility and proposes reforms to the dental insurance system, including introducing individual dental health plans and extending support to young adults and individuals with special needs.

title: Ett principbeslut för nya stambanor
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag supports a principle decision to study the conditions for building new high-speed railways in Sweden. The aim is to modernize the transport system to enhance the country's development, growth, and competitiveness. The proposal highlights the increasing demand for train travel, the capacity limitations of existing railways, and the necessity for infrastructure improvements to ease goods transport, reduce environmental impact, and stimulate economic recovery post-pandemic. Overall, it emphasizes the long-term societal and economic benefits of new rail lines.

title: Registerutdrag för vuxna som arbetar med barn
summary: The motion advocate for the government to consider implementing requirements for background checks from the criminal register for adults seeking employment in educational settings and for those applying for voluntary leadership roles in organizations that involve children, in order to ensure children's rights and safety from sexual offenses.

title: Beredskapslager för livsmedel
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of food reserves in Sweden to ensure adequate food supply during crises or wartime. It highlights the decline in Sweden's self-sufficiency in food production, noting a drop from 80-100% in the 1980s to approximately 55% by 2013. The motion emphasizes the need for a coordinated national effort in food supply preparedness, considering recent global disruptions and climate change, and calls for measures to enhance domestic food production and sustainability.

title: E-sport
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1288 av Mattias Ottosson och Johan Löfstrand (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports e-sports as a legitimate hobby and takes steps to facilitate its growth within the country. It highlights the significant rise in the popularity and organization of e-sports, compares it to traditional sports, and emphasizes the need for Sweden to adapt legislation to allow for the mobility of players similar to athletes in conventional sports, thus ensuring a supportive environment for this burgeoning field.

title: En statlig identifieringstjänst – e-legitimation
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a state-run identification service to enhance digital inclusion and security for Swedish citizens. The motion highlights the current reliance on private companies for identification services, raising concerns about data ownership and security. It calls for a neutral, government-controlled solution that ensures equitable access for all citizens, including marginalized groups, and protects personal information from misuse.

title: Behandla narkotikapåverkade bilförare på samma sätt som alkoholpåverkade
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider treating drug-impaired driving in the same manner as alcohol-impaired driving, suggesting that appropriate measures and preventive actions be implemented to minimize the risk of reoffending. It highlights the increasing prevalence of drug-related offenses, particularly among youth, and calls for a review of current legal frameworks to ensure that all impaired driving cases are addressed with equal seriousness and that offenders receive necessary help and treatment.

title: Kapital i hela landet
summary: The proposal argues for increased diversity in the financial sector and highlights the need for measures to ensure equal opportunities for entrepreneurship and welfare across the country, especially in rural areas. It addresses the decline of bank branches in smaller municipalities and the associated negative impacts on local capital access for businesses and households. The proposal suggests establishing new savings banks or cooperative alternatives to counteract the withdrawal of major banks.

title: Infrastruktur
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the investigation into the conditions for developing road and rail infrastructure in Dalarna County, emphasizing the region's significant contribution to Sweden's economy through exports and tourism. The motion highlights the need for infrastructure improvements to keep pace with societal developments, particularly given the increasing pressure on transportation networks during peak tourism seasons. It argues for more substantial state responsibility in financing critical infrastructure investments in Dalarna due to its importance for both industry and tourism.

title: Arbetsträning och sommarledighet
summary: The motion proposes a review to consider the introduction of paid vacation for individuals participating in work training programs. Highlighting the importance of such programs in areas like Rinkeby and Järva, the motion emphasizes the need for clarity regarding vacation entitlements, particularly for those with children, to promote family time and prevent youth from being influenced by gangs during the summer months.

title: Nationellt perspektiv för långsiktigt hållbar va-försörjning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament initiate a review to enhance the sustainability of water and sewage supply systems in response to growing population demands, climate change, and new regulations. It emphasizes increased investment needs in the sector, projecting that annual investments must rise from 16 billion to approximately 23 billion SEK by 2040. The motion highlights the importance of collaboration among municipalities and calls for a reassessment of responsibilities and management to ensure equitable access to water while addressing security and crisis preparedness issues.

title: Statligt bidrag till Sala silvergruva
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider investigating the conditions for providing state funding to the Sala silver mine, which is recognized as one of the best-preserved historical mining environments in the world and an important part of Sweden's industrial history. The motion emphasizes the educational value of the site, which attracts over 80,000 visitors annually, and argues that state support is necessary to maintain and develop this cultural heritage amid substantial management costs.

title: Migrationsverkets kompetens
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:1280 av Jasenko Omanovic och Kristina Nilsson (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring adequate competence among staff at the Migration Agency to uphold the right to seek asylum, which is a fundamental human right. It argues that a fair and secure processing of asylum applications is reliant on the qualifications of the agency's personnel. The proposal calls for the government to guarantee that employees possess the necessary expertise and to ensure ongoing training to maintain high competency levels.

title: Ordning i trafiken
summary: This motion proposes to review the possibility of extending helmet requirements to include children under 15 years old riding in bicycle trailers and to establish a helmet mandate for all users of electric scooters regardless of age. It highlights the increase in bicycle traffic congestion andamp; the higher incidence of head injuries among electric scooter riders, arguing for more stringent safety regulations.

title: Sancta Birgitta Klostermuseum i Vadstena
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider ways to secure a long-term operational framework for the Sancta Birgitta Klostermuseum in Vadstena. It emphasizes the museum's historical significance related to Saint Birgitta, a notable figure in both Swedish and international religious history, and its role as a tourist attraction that supports the growing sector of pilgrim tourism. The proposal advocates for a national responsibility to ensure the museum can effectively present its exhibits and preserve its unique cultural heritage, potentially by integrating it into the operations of the National Historical Museums.

title: Producentavgift på sockersötade drycker
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a producer fee on the sugar content of sugary beverages in Sweden, aiming to combat rising rates of obesity and associated health issues. It highlights the significant increase in obesity among both adults and children in the country, referencing successful measures taken in the UK following a similar fee's implementation. The objective is to reduce sugar consumption by incentivizing producers to lower sugar levels in their products, contributing to improved public health outcomes.

title: Demokratiskt vald statschef
summary: The motion advocates for a fully realized democracy in Sweden by proposing the implementation of a democratically elected head of state, marking the centenary of democracy in the country.

title: Svenska kraftnät
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes a review of the energy reserve capacity in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of Svenska kraftnät (Swedish National Grid) in guaranteeing energy supply during crises. The motion highlights concerns over the privatization and fragmentation of the energy system, which has led to uncertainties regarding responsibility in emergencies. It argues that Svenska kraftnät should have its own personnel for maintenance and investments to ensure reliable energy supply and reduce dependency on foreign contractors.

title: Försäkringskassans handläggning av sjukförsäkringen
summary: Eva-Lena Jansson's motion highlights ongoing issues with Försäkringskassan's handling of sickness insurance, particularly the challenges faced by individuals with severe health conditions in obtaining benefits. It points to systemic issues since the reforms of 2008, leading to many being wrongfully denied assistance despite medical evidence. The motion calls for continued scrutiny and improvement of Försäkringskassan's practices to ensure fairness and legal compliance in the administration of sickness benefits.

title: Anstalt av högre säkerhetsklass i Östergötland
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a higher security prison facility in Östergötland to address the severe overcrowding in Swedish prisons, which currently operate at a 108% capacity. It highlights the increase in violent crimes and incidents related to this overcrowding and suggests that the region is well-suited for a new facility due to its location and available land. The initiative is believed to not only alleviate the capacity issues but also create new job opportunities in the region.

title: Stärkt yrkesroll och kompetensutveckling för fritidspedagoger
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the professional role and competence development for leisure educators in Sweden, highlighting their importance in children's learning and development within a cohesive school environment. It emphasizes the need for municipalities and independent schools to focus on training and professional growth for educators, in light of the increasing enrollment in leisure homes. Current challenges include high workloads, lack of resources for supporting children with special needs, and insufficient opportunities for professional development. The motion seeks to draw attention to these issues and encourage the government to create the conditions for enhancing the role and education of leisure educators.

title: Återhämtning för föreningslivet
summary: The suggestion advocates for the Swedish Parliament to review ways to facilitate increased engagement in associations and volunteer organizations, particularly in the context of children's and youth's participation in sports and cultural activities that were significantly impacted by the pandemic. It emphasizes the importance of organized leisure activities in promoting social integration and preventing youth from engaging in delinquency.

title: Nationell handlingsplan för sällsynta diagnoser
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of a national action plan for rare diagnoses in Sweden, arguing that such a plan is essential for providing adequate care and support for individuals with these conditions. The motion highlights the need for coordination among medical specialists and emphasizes the importance of addressing the unique challenges faced by patients and their families. It points out the absence of a national plan in Sweden, contrasting it with other European countries, and calls for the government to ensure that this plan is created and implemented effectively.

title: Båtskatt och båtregister
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a boat tax and the reintroduction of a mandatory recreational boat register in Sweden. It highlights environmental concerns caused by recreational boating, including damage to coastal ecosystems, pollution, and discarded boats. The motion argues that those who harm the environment, particularly recreational boat owners, should contribute financially to mitigate the issues they create. A mandatory boat register would help monitor the number of recreational boats and ensure accountability for disposal and recycling.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The Swedish government's proposal outlines a comprehensive goal for the total defense strategy for the period of 2021 to 2025, including new objectives for military and civil defense, and modifications in the defense organization. Furthermore, it addresses legal amendments concerning the restructuring of the Total Defense Recruitment Authority and assesses the security political developments and long-term defense policies, including international collaboration and cooperation in defense.

title: Screening med PSA-prov
summary: The motion proposes to consider the implementation of PSA testing for men at risk of developing prostate cancer, highlighting that early detection is crucial for improving survival rates, particularly for men over 50, who should be tested even in the absence of symptoms.

title: Reformera det statliga systemet för ersättning till enskilda vägar
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the state compensation system for private roads, arguing that the current model is outdated and insufficient for the needs of modern society.
