The author highlights the difficulties some establishments face in meeting these food service requirements, which limit their ability to serve alcohol. By removing this requirement, the motion aims to create more social spaces for people to gather and enjoy drinks without being forced to order food.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:140 2021 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: This parliamentary motion from the Left Party emphasizes the necessity for state-owned companies in Sweden to prioritize societal benefits over profit. It proposes several measures, including the evaluation of ownership directives for state companies to ensure their operations contribute positively to society, the environment, and gender equality. Notably, it advocates for state intervention in corporate strategies to boost local job creation, increase export value, and adhere to environmental goals, urging the government to reassess current directives and practices within these firms.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:214 Utökade möjligheter att avgöra mål på handlingarna i allmän domstol
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:59 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion submitted by Linda Westerlund Snecker and other members of the Left Party proposes that the Swedish Parliament reject the government's proposition 2020/21:214, which aims to allow appellate courts to resolve civil cases without a main hearing when it is unnecessary. The Left Party advocates for maintaining the rule that oral hearings should be the standard for indispositive civil cases in appellate courts, emphasizing the importance of safeguarding children's rights in family law matters and ensuring the thorough examination of complex cases.

title: Förbättrad mödravård
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a national care program aimed at improving maternal and childbirth care in Sweden. It highlights the need for increased funding for research related to postnatal care and childbirth injuries, as well as additional resources for postnatal care services, addressing issues such as childbirth-related anxiety and the mental and physical well-being of mothers post-delivery. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring that no woman feels anxiety about childbirth and that postnatal care meets the necessary standards.

title: Tillståndsplikt för utförande av laserbehandling
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament introduce a licensing requirement for individuals performing laser treatments in the beauty industry, highlighting the lack of current education or qualification requirements. The motion cites a specific incident where a customer was harmed due to inadequate training of the practitioner. It argues that having no licensing creates unreasonable risks for customers and suggests that requiring licenses would help ensure safer practices and eliminate unqualified practitioners in the industry.

title: Ökade insatser för det förebyggande arbetet mot självmord
summary: The motion advocates for increased funding for research into suicide prevention measures in Sweden, highlighting that suicide remains a leading cause of death, particularly among young men. The proposer points out the disparity in funding for suicide prevention compared to traffic safety research, and emphasizes the need for prioritizing preventive care in mental health services, particularly in light of recent statistical trends showing alarmingly stable suicide rates among youth despite overall reductions in the past 15 years.

title: Översyn av momssats
summary: Angelika Bengtsson (SD) proposes a review of VAT rates to address disparities faced by tourists in Blekinge. The motion highlights the inconsistency where overnight stays on boats incur a 25% VAT, while camping in tents or RVs is taxed at 12%. This proposal aims to create a more equitable taxation framework for the tourism sector, which plays a significant role in the local economy and job creation.

title: Hälsofrämjande kultur och organiserad idrott för äldre
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen efforts to promote health-enhancing culture and organized sports for the elderly in Sweden. It calls for the government to inspire a new initiative similar to the 2011 investment in cultural activities for older adults, ensuring equal access to art and culture regardless of socio-economic status or geographic location. Furthermore, it emphasizes the importance of encouraging organized sports among the elderly to enhance their physical activity and overall well-being.

title: Begränsat antal elever för handledare vid privat övningskörning
summary: The motion proposes to limit the number of students for private driving instruction to five per instructor and to intensify efforts against illegal driving school operations in Sweden. This proposal arises from concerns regarding the increase in illegal traffic schools and the need for stricter regulations on the industry to ensure safety and compliance.

title: Genomförande av en folkräkning i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament (Riksdagen) should conduct a census to better understand the demographic makeup of the country and to identify individuals residing without legal status. It argues that increased knowledge about the population is necessary to manage resources effectively, combat crime, and ensure that only those eligible for social welfare benefit from it. Additionally, the motion emphasizes that accurate statistics are essential for implementing appropriate labor market measures and increasing tax revenues.

title: Förstärkt samverkan mellan staten och Svenska kyrkan
summary: The proposal suggests strengthening the collaboration between the Swedish state and the Church of Sweden, following a separation that occurred in 2000. It argues that this partnership is crucial in addressing societal issues, fostering community values, and enhancing public well-being, particularly in light of rising crime and social unrest. The motion emphasizes the importance of the Church's role in pivotal life events and its potential contribution during crises, advocating for its integration into state efforts to improve social cohesion.

title: Insyn i barns läkemedelslista
summary: The motion proposes raising the age limit for children's responsibility for their medication lists to 18 years old, addressing concerns that current regulations prevent guardians from having digital access to their child's prescriptions after they turn 13. This change is seen as necessary to ensure that parents maintain oversight on their children's medication, promoting continuity in treatment, particularly in cases like diabetes where young patients may struggle to manage their medications independently.

title: Omvandla Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: The motion proposes to transform the Allmänna arvsfonden (General Inheritance Fund) into a crisis preparedness fund, arguing that the current fund's role is insufficient for addressing societal crisis needs highlighted during the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion emphasizes the importance of enhancing Sweden's crisis readiness by reallocating resources from the fund, which has historically supported charitable activities.

title: Värna kontanterna
summary: The motion proposes that cash must always be an accepted form of payment in stores, responding to the growing trend of cashless establishments which exclude significant segments of the population, particularly the elderly and disabled. It highlights concerns about the rapid decline in cash usage threatening Sweden's crisis preparedness and calls for legislative action to ensure that shops cannot refuse cash payments, building upon previous laws aimed at maintaining access to bank services.

title: Skolans sexualundervisning
summary: The motion proposes to enhance sexual education in schools to protect youths from physical and psychological harm caused by sexual practices influenced by readily available pornography. It argues that insufficient knowledge among young people leads to misconceptions about sex, resulting in an increase in sexual injuries. The motion calls for improved sexual education to ensure that youths are better informed, thus reducing the occurrence of sex-related injuries.

title: Reformera äldreomsorgen
summary: The proposal seeks to reform the elderly care system in Sweden, emphasizing the need for an urgent investigation into how to improve care services. It critiques the outcomes of the 1992 Ädelreform, which aimed to enhance the living conditions and dignity of the elderly, noting that, despite good intentions, the current system lacks adequate medical care and trained personnel. The motion highlights a significant decline in trust among the elderly regarding the care they receive and underscores the necessity for a prompt reform to ensure the right to proper medical attention and care.

title: Nationella beredskapslager
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:45 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt och Eric Westroth (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the re-establishment of national emergency reserves in Sweden for protective and medical equipment, essential medicines, food supplies, and fuel amid concerns highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes that the responsibility for maintaining these reserves should lie with the state rather than regional authorities or private actors, to ensure preparedness for future crises or conflicts, given historical shortcomings in emergency responses and the risks of disrupted supply chains.

title: Produktionsomställning vid samhällskris
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:44 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt och Eric Westroth (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for ensuring the existence of industries in Sweden capable of shifting their production to manufacturing protective equipment during crises. It highlights Sweden's prior failures in crisis preparedness, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic, where a lack of stockpiles led to dire shortages and significant consequences for vulnerable populations, such as the elderly. The proposal underscores the need for domestic production capabilities to maintain a steady supply of protective materials, thereby enhancing national security and public trust during emergencies.

title: Prostatacancerbehandling
summary: The motion proposes a prompt investigation into the possibility of introducing radioisotope treatment for prostate cancer in Sweden, highlighting the current challenges of long waiting times for treatment and the need for advanced treatment options for patients, particularly the elderly. The motion emphasizes the importance of making the latest treatment methods available domestically to improve patient outcomes.

title: Hjärnskador vid ECT-behandling
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Social Agency should reevaluate ECT (electroconvulsive therapy) due to concerns about brain injuries it may cause. The motion highlights the low success rates of ECT in younger patients and the potential cognitive side effects, such as memory loss. It calls for a shift in psychiatric care to focus on holistic approaches rather than solely relying on treatments like ECT.

title: Rekommendationer gällande adhd-medicin
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the Swedish Socialstyrelsen's recommendations on ADHD medication for children, suggesting that the current educational system overly relies on medication instead of exploring alternative support methods such as therapy. It raises concerns about the increasing number of children being prescribed ADHD medications, the efficacy and necessity of the diagnosis, and the potential negative impacts on children's health and future opportunities.

title: Sfi – uttalets betydelse för språkinlärning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of pronunciation in the Swedish language courses (SFI) for immigrants, particularly for those working in elder care. It suggests that the Swedish National Agency for Education should prioritize teaching pronunciation to ensure that care workers can communicate effectively, especially with elderly patients who may have difficulty understanding poorly spoken Swedish. The motion highlights that many workers in the healthcare sector lack sufficient language skills, and proposes that attention to pronunciation at the beginning of SFI courses could improve overall language acquisition and completion rates.

title: Äldres rätt till ett värdigt, respektfullt bemötande och rätten till den egna kroppen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government revise the elderly care reform to ensure dignity, respect, and the right to self-determination for elderly individuals in care, particularly those with dementia. It emphasizes the negative impact of having multiple caregivers on the quality of care and argues that elderly people's rights, especially regarding their own bodies and personal care preferences, should be prioritized over staff assignments. The motion highlights ethical concerns regarding the treatment of elderly individuals in care homes and the implications of policies during the pandemic.

title: Ökad synlighet i trafik
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for increased visibility in traffic by addressing the issue of vehicles operating without illuminated rear lights, which poses a danger to drivers and other road users. It calls for the automotive industry and car dealers to take responsibility in raising awareness about proper lighting usage while also suggesting targeted information campaigns at local, regional, and national levels to enhance public knowledge and improve traffic safety, particularly in light of variable weather conditions in Sweden.

title: Utbyggnad av Bohusbanan
summary: The motion proposes a prompt review of the potential expansion of the Bohusbanan railway to enhance infrastructure in the Västra Götaland region, highlighting economic benefits from reduced travel times, increased commuting opportunities, and positive impacts on local businesses and communities. It suggests that the government should take action to prioritize this development, emphasizing widespread political and community support for the project.

title: Hållbart fiske i Östersjön
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of fishing regulations in the Baltic Sea, emphasizing the need for increased hunting of cormorants, limitations on seal populations, tools to protect fish resources, and a reassessment of fishing quotas to support small-scale fishing. It calls for the establishment of protected zones and discussions with Nordic countries to develop a joint fishing strategy that balances cultural heritage, environmental stewardship, and economic viability in fisheries.

title: Avskaffa flerbarnstillägget
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the additional child benefit, known as flerbarnstillägget, which is granted to families with more than one child. The rationale for this proposal stems from an evaluation by the Swedish National Audit Office, indicating that the additional benefit's cost-effectiveness and equitable distribution have diminished. The author argues that families typically do not face significantly higher costs when adding additional children due to the sharing of resources within the family. Furthermore, the motion highlights concerns about the potential negative social impacts and environmental implications of incentivizing larger families, particularly in relation to integration challenges for immigrant families.

title: Barnsäkerhet i bil
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of legislation to mandate rear-facing travel for young children in vehicles, as current practices pose significant risks in the event of an accident. The proposal also addresses the issue of the unauthorized use and sale of expired car seats, emphasizing the need for improved safety measures and the importance of keeping children rear-facing until at least the age of 4-5 years for their safety.

title: Högre straff för brott mot griftefriden
summary: The motion proposes to increase the penalties for crimes against grave peace by introducing a new classification for severe violations, thereby ensuring that offenders cannot evade harsher punishments through lesser charges when they desecrate a corpse to obstruct justice. It argues that current penalties are disproportionately low compared to the seriousness of the actions, particularly in cases where the desecration is linked to murder cover-ups.

title: Förhindra att unga blir rökare
summary: The motion proposes to gradually raise the legal age for purchasing cigarettes to prevent youth smoking. It suggests that the government should make it illegal to buy, sell, or give cigarettes to anyone below the established age limit and highlight the harmful effects of smoking on health and the environment. The goal is to phase out smoking by ensuring that those currently under the age limit cannot legally buy cigarettes when they reach adulthood, aiming for a 'non-smoking generation'.

title: Låsta föräldradagar vid vårdnadstvister
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:31 av Angelica Lundberg och Mikael Eskilandersson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that parental leave days should be locked during custody disputes, ensuring that both parents have access to these days regardless of the ongoing legal proceedings. This is aimed at preventing situations where one parent, typically the mother, exhausts all available leave days while the custody issue remains unresolved, thereby potentially hindering the other parent's opportunity to bond with the child.

title: Höjd åldersgräns för könsbyte
summary: The proposal suggests raising the age limit for gender reassignment surgery from 18 to 25 years. It argues that individuals under 25 lack the emotional and intellectual maturity required to make such irreversible decisions regarding their biological sex. The motion references increasing numbers of young individuals seeking gender transition and reports of regret and mental health issues following these procedures. It advocates for enhanced mental health support for young people as an alternative to medical gender transition.

title: Lämplighetspröva äldre förare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the implementation of suitability assessments for elderly drivers, citing concerns about safety due to age-related declines in vision, hearing, and reaction times. Current medical reporting procedures to the Transport Agency are deemed insufficient, as many elderly drivers who may be unfit to drive continue to do so, posing risks to themselves and others. The proposal emphasizes the importance of traffic safety and suggests establishing clear guidelines for evaluating the driving capabilities of older individuals.

title: Nya bestämmelser gällande däck
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a ban on the use of studless friction tires during the summer months and requests the government to investigate the implementation of age restrictions for tires. The rationale behind this proposal is centered on traffic safety concerns, highlighting that summer use of friction tires poses significant risks, such as longer braking distances and increased likelihood of aquaplaning. Additionally, the motion calls for regulations around the age of tires, as older tires, even with sufficient tread depth, may have compromised safety due to degradation over time.

title: Skatteväxla för folkhälsan
summary: The motion proposes adjusting taxes to promote public health by imposing higher taxes on sugary products while reducing taxes on healthier food options, such as fruits and vegetables. It highlights the increasing rates of obesity, diabetes, and mental health issues among Swedish children and stresses the need for better dietary habits. The goal is to make healthier food choices more affordable and encourage the consumption of nutritious alternatives, thereby benefiting both public health and local agriculture.

title: Slopat stöd för produktion av socker
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:26 av Angelica Lundberg och Mikael Eskilandersson (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for the abolition of state support for sugar production intended for food purposes, citing health risks associated with sugar consumption, particularly among children. It argues that high sugar intake is linked to diseases such as diabetes, obesity, and heart conditions, and calls for Sweden to push for the discontinuation of subsidies for sugar producers within the EU.

title: Öka antalet dubbeldagar
summary: The motion proposes to increase the number of 'dubbeldagar' (double days) in the parental insurance system, allowing both parents to simultaneously take parental leave for a greater duration during their child's first year. The motion argues that this would better support families during the transition to parenthood, enable both parents to bond with their child, and accommodate various family dynamics and needs. It advocates for the removal of the current limit on double days, allowing families the flexibility to manage their parental leave according to their unique circumstances.

title: Översyn av tillsatser i mat
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:24 av Johnny Skalin och Angelica Lundberg (båda SD)
summary: The motion calls for an investigation into the effects of food additives and stresses the need for increased oversight to ensure consumer safety. It argues that while some additives may be harmless individually, their combined effects require scrutiny. The motion emphasizes the precautionary principle, suggesting that additives should not be approved until their safety has been thoroughly evaluated, taking into account changes in consumption patterns and new health findings since many additives were approved decades ago.

title: Reserverat barnbidrag vid vårdnadstvister
summary: The motion suggests reserving child benefits during custody disputes between parents, allowing half of the benefit to be held until custody is determined. This aims to ensure that the non-custodial parent, often the father, does not lose out on financial support during prolonged disputes, and helps to maintain equitable financial conditions for the child.

title: Höständringsbudget för 2021
summary: The proposition from the Swedish government outlines budget amendments for the year 2021, including changes to state expenditures across various sectors. It specifically suggests temporary reductions in railway fees due to the COVID-19 pandemic and related adjustments in the budgetary allocations for different areas such as healthcare, social services, and international aid, while also proposing modifications to the railway legislation.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022
summary: The proposal presents a correction to the expenditure ceiling levels for 2024, highlighting necessary updates to previously published figures due to miscalculations. It emphasizes the importance of adhering to a sustainable fiscal policy while aiming for a balanced budget in light of uncertainty related to the ongoing economic impacts of the pandemic. The correction also outlines the government's intention to streamline its financial resources, maintaining consistency with set economic targets and ensuring compliance with legislative requirements regarding budgetary oversight.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 8 Migration
summary: The proposal outlines the Swedish government's budget for migration-related expenditures for the fiscal year 2022, emphasizing a sustainable migration policy that upholds the right to asylum, facilitates regulated immigration, promotes labor migration based on needs, and enhances European and international cooperation. The budget includes allocations for various authorities, including the Migration Agency, and outlines the financial commitments and guidelines for future periods, aiming to ensure a fair and efficient asylum process while managing migration effectively.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 7 Internationellt bistånd
summary: The proposal outlines the framework for Sweden's international development aid for the year 2022, recommending a budget allocation of 1% of the estimated Gross National Income (GNI), amounting to approximately 57.4 billion SEK. This framework focuses on various priority areas including democracy, human rights, gender equality, sustainable development, and humanitarian assistance. The government emphasizes the importance of maintaining a robust development aid strategy that addresses both national and global challenges, with additional plans for guarantees and capital injections to support development cooperation initiatives.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 6 Försvar och samhällets krisberedskap
summary: The government of Sweden proposes a series of measures for strengthening the country's defense and crisis preparedness in the context of escalating global tensions. This includes authorizing a credit of up to 40 billion SEK for defense spending, approving investment plans for military material, and allowing the authorities to incur debts and make economic commitments for future preparedness efforts. The overall aim is to enhance the military capability and resilience of society against potential crises and military threats.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 5 Internationell samverkan
summary: The proposal outlines the Swedish government's budgetary allocations for the area of International Cooperation for the year 2022. It emphasizes the significance of maintaining and enhancing Sweden's relationships with other states and international organizations, with allocated funds to support peacekeeping, security initiatives, and international collaborations, including within the Nordic region and the Baltic Sea area.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: The proposal outlines the budget and strategic direction for Sweden's justice system for the fiscal year 2022, emphasizing increased allocations for various agencies including the police, courts, and crime prevention bodies. The goals include reducing crime rates and enhancing public safety, along with improving the efficiency and quality of the justice process. The document further discusses the need for continued reforms and resources to address crime trends and support victims of crime.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 3 Skatt, tull och exekution
summary: The proposal focuses on ensuring the financing of the public sector and promoting a well-functioning society while combating crime through the administration of taxes, customs duties, and enforcement actions. It outlines the responsibilities and budget allocations for key agencies such as the Swedish Tax Agency, the Customs Agency, and the Enforcement Authority, as well as the economic implications related to their operations and the overall fiscal landscape from 2022 to 2024.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 27 Avgiften till Europeiska unionen
summary: The proposal entails the Swedish government's request for authorization from the Riksdag to enter into financial commitments as dictated by the EU budget for the fiscal year 2022, with a specified allocation of approximately 47.8 billion SEK for Sweden's contributions to the European Union. This budget proposal outlines the scope, development, goals, and indicators for the EU fee, emphasizing the significance of a balanced budget within the EU framework while addressing the historical variations in Sweden's contributions influenced by factors such as the national income levels and EU agreements.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 26 Statsskuldsräntor m.m.
summary: The proposal outlines budgetary allocations for the fiscal year 2022 regarding public debt interest payments, unexpected expenses, and costs associated with the Swedish National Debt Office's borrowing and debt management. It aims to ensure that the costs of managing the national debt are minimized over the long term while maintaining appropriate risk management. The total proposed budget for this area is approximately 12.2 billion Swedish kronor, with expected reductions in expenses through 2024 as economic conditions and fiscal strategies evolve.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 25 Allmänna bidrag till kommuner
summary: The proposal outlines a budget allocation for the year 2022 for general grants to municipalities, totaling approximately 152 billion kronor. It includes specific contributions aimed at balancing the financial disparities between different municipalities and regions, with an emphasis on supporting both small municipalities and those facing increased social challenges. The government also identifies the need for ongoing financial oversight to ensure that these grants lead to effective local governance and service provision.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 24 Näringsliv
summary: The proposal outlines the government's budget for the business sector, including various measures to strengthen innovation, entrepreneurship, and trade. It includes authorizations for credit guarantees totaling up to 475 billion kronor for export credits, support for tourism policies, and funding for innovation systems. The budget allocation for 2022 is 9.3 billion kronor, with future projections for 2023 and 2024. The proposal aims to enhance competitiveness and international trade while promoting sustainable investments.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: The proposal outlines the budget allocation for the year 2022 within area 23, focusing on agricultural industries, rural development, and food supply. It includes provisions for various sectors such as forestry, fisheries, animal health, environmental measures, and rural entrepreneurship, with a total budget of 22,044 million kronor. The suggestion emphasizes the importance of supporting sustainable practices and enhancing the competitiveness of the food sector while also addressing the financial needs of agricultural and rural stakeholders.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 22 Kommunikationer
summary: The government proposes a budget allocation of 76,965 million kronor for the Communications expenditure area in 2022, with projected amounts of 75,749 million kronor for 2023 and 77,076 million kronor for 2024. This expenditure covers various infrastructure and transport sectors, and includes provisions for financial support and investment plans for entities such as the Maritime Administration and the Civil Aviation Administration, along with ensuring sustainable transport infrastructure maintenance and development.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 21 Energi
summary: The proposal outlines the government's budget for the energy sector for the year 2022, detailing funding allocations for various energy-related initiatives, including energy efficiency programs, renewable energy production, and electricity infrastructure. The government's goals focus on achieving a sustainable energy supply with a mix of increased renewable energy usage and improved efficiency targets through financial support and strategic investments by the Swedish Energy Agency and other involved organizations.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 20 Allmän miljö- och naturvård
summary: The proposal outlines governmental initiatives in the area of general environmental and nature conservation for the year 2022, with a focus on achieving national environmental quality goals and addressing climate change impacts. It includes an allocation of approximately 21.9 billion SEK to various environmental agencies and programs, emphasizing increased funding for nature protection, climate adaptation, and effective governance mechanisms. The suggested actions are aimed at improving air quality, reducing harmful emissions, conserving biodiversity, and preventing water pollution, through systematic monitoring and innovative research.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 19 Regional utveckling
summary: The Swedish government proposes a budget allocation for regional development in 2022, including specific funding for various initiatives such as regional development measures, transport subsidies, and contributions from European funds. The proposal emphasizes the importance of sustainable regional development, aiming to enhance competitiveness and collaboration across different levels of government. It also includes statistical measures to track the performance and impact of these initiatives on local economies.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
summary: The government proposes to grant the parliament authority to issue credit guarantees for new housing and modifications, as well as to facilitate arrangements for individuals to secure homes, with a focus on restructuring municipal housing companies and increasing investment support for student housing. This initiative aims to enhance the housing market's functioning and ensure sustainable living environments through targeted funding in the budget.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The proposal outlines the budget for the 2022 fiscal year for the area of 'Rikets styrelse' in Sweden, detailing allocations and authorizations for various governmental functions, including the operations of the Riksdag, Riksrevisionen, Sametinget, and funding for human rights and democracy initiatives. It includes provisions for loans to support investments in infrastructure and various operational expenses, with overall funding set at 17,268 million kronor.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 17 Kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid
summary: The proposal outlines budget allocations and legislative changes related to the financing of public service radio and television in Sweden for the year 2022. It includes financial support for Sveriges Radio, Sveriges Television, and Sveriges Utbildningsradio, along with various grants and contributions for cultural, media, and religious activities under the broader category of culture, medi and leisure sectors.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
summary: The proposal outlines changes to higher education regulations, including amendments to the Higher Education Act and budgetary provisions for various universities and institutions. It emphasizes the government's intention to enhance educational quality and accessibility, along with increased funding for research and education in various disciplines over the period 2022-2024.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
summary: The suggestion involves a governmental proposal to authorize borrowing up to 264.5 billion SEK for student loans, along with a budget allocation for various student support programs, including grants and loans aimed at enhancing education participation and promoting social equity. The proposal also outlines the development of performance reporting to parliament and budgetary allocations for specific student support initiatives.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The proposal includes amendments to the unemployment insurance laws aimed at changing eligibility requirements and associated budget allocations for the labor market and employment initiatives, such as increased funding for unemployment benefits and labor market programs for the upcoming years.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 13 Jämställdhet och nyanlända invandrares etablering
summary: The proposal seeks to allocate the budget for 2022 towards gender equality and the establishment of newly arrived immigrants, outlining measures for integration, combating discrimination, and reducing segregation within Swedish society. The suggestion includes financial commitments to various initiatives and aims to enhance equality and opportunities for all residents, regardless of their ethnic or cultural background.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 12 Ekonomisk trygghet för familjer och barn
summary: The proposal outlines legislative amendments aimed at enhancing economic security for families and children. It recommends changes to social security laws, maternity and parental leave regulations, as well as provisions for a new family week and an increase in maintenance support for children aged 7 to 10. The government seeks to establish a family day allowance to better balance work and family life while ensuring more equitable financial conditions for households with and without children.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Ålderspensionssystemet vid sidan av statens budget
summary: The proposal outlines a plan for the age pension system in Sweden to be managed independently from the state budget, emphasizing the need for a financially sustainable and trustworthy pension system. It discusses various aspects including the necessity for increased pensions, adjustments to working age limits, and the reform of the premium pension system to enhance security and efficiency. The proposal aims to ensure that the pension system remains robust in light of demographic changes and economic pressures while striving for broader political consensus among the parties.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 11 Ekonomisk trygghet vid ålderdom
summary: The proposal includes several amendments to the Social Insurance Code aimed at enhancing financial security for the elderly in Sweden, focusing on increasing housing supplements for pensioners and providing reasonable economic support to surviving spouses after a death. Additionally, the proposal outlines changes to ensure cost-effective administration of the pension system and the implementation of goals to maintain a guaranteed income for individuals with low or no pension benefits.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 10 Ekonomisk trygghet vid sjukdom och funktionsnedsättning
summary: The proposal outlines changes to the social insurance legislation to enhance economic security for individuals facing illness or disability. It includes amendments to various laws that govern sickness benefits, parental leave, and related financial support mechanisms, aiming to ensure better coverage and support for those affected. Key changes proposed include increased benefit levels and alterations to how eligibility and benefits are calculated, along with provisions for enhanced flexibility and security within the social insurance framework.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2022 - Utgiftsområde 9 Hälsovård, sjukvård och social omsorg
summary: The proposal outlines a series of legislative changes and budget allocations related to health care, social services, and public health, including amendments to the Social Services Act, allocations for emergency investments in COVID-19 vaccinations, and budget authorizations for various government health agencies for the fiscal year 2022 and beyond. It also includes provisions for price-setting in vaccine sales to ensure public health needs are met without prioritizing profit.

title: Ingen människa ska behöva dö av och i trafiken
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:22 av Emma Berginger och Emma Hult (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes a broadening of Sweden's zero vision for traffic safety to include those harmed by traffic-related air pollution and sedentary lifestyles. It advocates for lowering the base speed limit in urban areas, implementing speed compliance measures, and increasing active mobility initiatives to improve public health. Additionally, it requests a government investigation into the introduction of geofencing technology to enhance speed regulation enforcement.

title: Utveckla trafikprognoser och samhällsekonomiska bedömningar för tillförlitliga beslutsunderlag
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish parliament to improve traffic forecasts and societal economic assessments to provide reliable decision-making data. It highlights the discrepancies in current traffic projections, which often underestimate train travel and overestimate car travel. The motion advocates for the application of goal-oriented planning instead of predictive models in infrastructure planning to better align with societal needs, especially in achieving climate objectives.

title: Öka cyklandet och tydliggör statens ansvar för en tillgänglig cykelinfrastruktur
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive plan to increase cycling in Sweden by developing a national goal for enhanced cycling infrastructure, supporting municipalities, ensuring safe bicycle paths for children, and increasing investments in cycling infrastructure. It highlights the positive effects of cycling on health and the environment, the need for specific resources and regulations to facilitate cycling, and emphasizes the importance of making cycling a preferred method of transportation, particularly for children and youth.

title: Smällare, raketer och fyrverkerier endast vid offentliga arrangemang
summary: The motion proposes to restrict the use of fireworks, rockets, and firecrackers to public events only, arguing that such a ban is necessary to protect both human safety and animal welfare. The proponents highlight the dangers associated with these pyrotechnics, including injuries to individuals and distress to pets, as well as the ineffectiveness of current regulations in preventing harm. They call for government endorsement of this approach to ensure public safety and compliance with animal protection laws.

title: Avståndsbaserad skatt på lätt trafik
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the implementation of a distance-based tax on light traffic to address the external costs associated with increased electric vehicle usage, such as congestion, accidents, and road wear. It argues for a reform of road taxation to include a differentiated approach based on geography and vehicle type, ensuring that tax measures can adapt to a growing number of electric vehicles and their associated impacts. The motion emphasizes the need for timely investigation to prepare for future reforms as electric vehicle adoption increases.

title: Begränsning av myndigheters offentliggörande och försäljning av personuppgifter
summary: The motion proposes significant restrictions on government agencies' ability to publicly disclose or sell personal data, advocating that such actions be limited primarily to public-benefit applications. It highlights current practices where agencies frequently sell personal information without proper consent or transparent communication to individuals, which raises privacy concerns and increases the risk of crime and fraud. The proposal calls for revised guidelines ensuring that personal data is only shared with clear consent from the individuals involved.

title: Erkännande av Somaliland som en självständig stat
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:16 av Ingemar Kihlström och Magnus Oscarsson (båda KD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate the process to officially recognize Somaliland as an independent state, citing its democratic development and stability in a region characterized by violence and dictatorship. The advocates highlight Somaliland's achievements in governance, education, and human rights, arguing that Sweden should support democracy and peace in the face of surrounding oppression and terrorism, and assert that Somaliland meets the established criteria for state recognition.

title: Postnords postutdelning och pakethantering i hela Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should issue directives to Postnord to ensure that mail distribution and package handling meet acceptable standards across Sweden. The proposal highlights concerns regarding Postnord's alternate day delivery model, which could lead to delays in mail and newspaper deliveries. It calls for daily mail delivery to all residents and suggests that improved coordination with other distributors could help maintain service levels, especially in areas facing post office closures, ensuring package drop-off options remain available for local businesses.

title: Åtgärder för att motverka den spanska skogssnigelns utbredning och skadeverkningar
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a comprehensive national strategy aimed at combating the spread and damage caused by the Spanish slug, also known as the killer slug, in Sweden. It highlights the absence of coordinated national efforts to address the growing issue and calls for specific actions such as categorizing the slug as a national pest, designating a responsible authority, imposing mandatory reporting for occurrences, and ensuring that commercial growers conduct sanitation measures to prevent the sale of infected plants. The proposal emphasizes the need for research funding to develop effective control methods.

title: Skolavslutning och firanden av högtider med konfessionella inslag i kyrkolokaler
summary: The suggestion from Ingemar Kihlström (KD) seeks to provide clearer directives for conducting school graduations and celebrations of traditional holidays with confessional elements in church venues. The proposal highlights ongoing uncertainty within schools regarding the participation of church personnel and the types of content that can be included. It advocates for the facilitation of such events, allowing for collaboration with church staff and the inclusion of songs and teachings connected to church traditions, while ensuring that students are not required to participate in acts of confession or other confessional activities.

title: Utred förutsättningarna för att utöka rotavdraget
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the conditions for increasing the ROT deduction, which is a tax deduction for labor costs associated with construction and renovation services for private properties. The original deduction of 50% was reduced to 30%, which the proposal argues has led to an increase in black market labor and reduced economic benefits for both homeowners and businesses. The motion stresses the importance of restoring the deduction to promote fair competition in the construction industry, provide a safer work environment, and increase tax revenues for public services.

title: Kontanter som betalningsmedel
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden investigate the feasibility of enacting a law requiring businesses and traders to accept cash as a payment method. It argues that despite existing legislation ensuring cash access for consumers, the increasing number of establishments refusing cash payments threatens the continued use of cash, potentially leading Sweden to become the world's first cashless country. The motion cites examples from Denmark and Norway, where such laws exist, emphasizing the importance of cash for financial inclusion, crisis preparedness, and education about money for younger generations.

title: Sista etappen av vägförbättrande ombyggnation av väg 181
summary: The motion proposes the final stage of improvements to regional road 181 to ensure better access for businesses and residents in Västra Götaland. It emphasizes the importance of a robust regional road network to connect with national infrastructure, specifically highlighting the need for upgrades between Bråttensby and Bergagärde. The improvements aim to enhance traffic safety and efficiency, reduce transport times, and facilitate future developments in the region, including connections to the Skaraborg Logistic Center.

title: Fortsatt satsning på säkra och trygga stationsmiljöer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support an investigation into the conditions for continuing efforts to create safe and secure station environments. It highlights the importance of travelers feeling safe while using public transport and cites issues such as poor lighting and vandalism at stations. The motion advocates for measures like the installation of surveillance cameras, citing positive results from similar initiatives at other stations, and calls for increased funding from the government to address safety concerns at stations from 2022 to 2024.

title: Samordna regelverk för bevattningsförbud
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the feasibility of a nationwide regulatory framework for watering bans, due to recent low rainfall leading to decreased groundwater levels, which threatens water availability for households and businesses, as well as for fire safety. The motion highlights inconsistencies in local regulations and enforcement across municipalities and aims to ensure a uniform approach to managing water resources.

title: Ljudnivåer från idrottsanläggningar
summary: The motion proposes changing the maximum allowed noise levels for sports facilities to match those for roads and railways, specifically to 55 dBA during weekends and nights, and 60 dBA during the day. This change is aimed at alleviating the challenges faced by sports associations due to current restrictions, which are seen as detrimental to their operations and financially burdensome. The motion emphasizes the societal benefits of simplifying regulations for sports organizations, especially those involved in important youth activities.

title: Registrering av testamenten
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a registry for wills in Sweden to ensure that individuals' last wishes are respected and easily accessible after their death. It highlights the risks of wills being lost, disputed, or forged due to the current lack of a formal recognition system, and suggests that the Swedish Tax Agency (Skatteverket) should manage this registry, leveraging its existing responsibilities associated with death registrations. The motion calls for swift action by the government to set up this registry and investigate its implementation.

title: Utbyggnad, planskilda korsningar och utökat underhåll för Västra stambanan
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament endorse the investigation and expansion of the Västra stambanan railway, including the construction of grade-separated crossings and increased maintenance. It emphasizes the importance of the railway for both passenger and freight transport and requests an expanded budget for maintenance from 2022 to 2030. Additionally, it highlights the need for improved capacity and the construction of an extra double track between Alingsås and Göteborg, as well as the urgency of upgrading crossings on the Floby–Göteborg section to enhance travel speed and safety.

title: Om Sveriges roll i FN och stormaktsspelet om kvinnors rättigheter
summary: The proposal emphasizes Sweden's need to advocate for women's rights internationally, particularly in the UN, by addressing issues like honor-based violence, female genital mutilation, and child marriage. It calls for ending support to organizations that perpetuate these forms of oppression, reaffirming commitments to core UN conventions regarding women's rights, and ensuring that Swedish foreign aid does not support regimes violating these rights. Furthermore, it critiques the normalization of prostitution and the threat of relativism towards women's rights in international discussions.

title: Folkomröstning om utträde ur EU
summary: The proposal suggests conducting a referendum in Sweden regarding the country's exit from the EU, citing concerns over increased inequality and centralization of power within the union. It criticizes the EU's neoliberal policies, the prioritization of banks over citizens, and the adverse impacts these have had on social rights and justice. The motion argues for a reassessment of Sweden's EU membership in light of past promises that have not been fulfilled, and it calls for giving citizens the opportunity to decide on their continued membership in the EU.

title: Sveriges avvägningar i samband med utredningarna av Dag Hammarskjölds död
summary: The proposal calls for the formation of a working group to critically examine the available materials regarding the decisions made by Swedish governments surrounding the circumstances of Dag Hammarskjöld's death in 1961. The motion highlights the need for transparency and accuracy in understanding Sweden's involvement and responses during the investigations, considering the historical context and the geopolitical influences of the time.

title: Lex Botkyrka – skarpare lag angående deponering av avfall
summary: The suggestion calls for stricter regulations regarding the professional deposition of waste to combat illegal activities and ensure environmental safety. It requests that the Parliament approve increased licensing requirements for waste management operations, enhance penalties for violations, clarify landowners’ responsibilities, prohibit waste deposition within water protection areas, and redefine waste storage rules to prevent circumvention of laws. The aim is to prevent criminal misuse of waste management and protect the environment and local communities.

title: Behandling av personuppgifter vid Försvarsmakten och Försvarets radioanstalt
summary: The government proposes the introduction of two new laws governing the handling of personal data by the Swedish Armed Forces and the Defence Radio Establishment. These laws will replace existing legislation related to personal data in military intelligence and security services. The aim is to enhance the protection of individuals' fundamental rights while allowing the Armed Forces to process and exchange personal information effectively with other entities. The new regulations are intended to supersede the EU's General Data Protection Regulation and should come into effect on January 1, 2022.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om statens ansvar för veterinär service
summary: The Swedish government has submitted a report addressing the conclusions and recommendations from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the state's responsibility for veterinary services and the management by the Swedish Board of Agriculture. The report highlights significant shortcomings in the oversight and implementation of veterinary services, stressing the need for a review of regulations and the separation of roles within veterinary service provision, particularly in maintaining competition and ensuring service availability across different regions. The government supports the need for improved monitoring and has set directives for a committee to explore long-term solutions for sustainable animal healthcare.

title: Anpassningar av svensk lag till EU:s förordningar om Schengens informationssystem
summary: The government proposes legislative amendments to align Swedish law with the new EU regulations regarding the Schengen Information System (SIS). This includes the repeal of the existing law (2000:344) on SIS, the introduction of a new law with complementary provisions, and changes to several existing laws, such as the Aliens Act and the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act. Notably, the amendments expand the conditions under which residence permits can be revoked and enhance data privacy measures related to SIS.

title: Statlig ersättning för personskada orsakad av vaccin mot sjukdomen covid-19
summary: The government proposes a new law providing state compensation for personal injuries caused by COVID-19 vaccines. The aim is to ensure that those injured receive compensation comparable to other approved medical injury compensations. The state will pay compensation if it is highly likely that the injury was caused by a COVID-19 vaccine provided in Sweden and only if the Läkemedelsförsäkringen (Medical Insurance) does not provide coverage. Additionally, the proposal includes certain conditions, exceptions, and regulatory changes to existing laws concerning the handling of sensitive personal information.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om administrationen i statliga myndigheter
summary: The Swedish government outlines its assessment of the Swedish National Audit Office's report on public sector administration, particularly emphasizing the need for a better balance between administrative tasks and core activities. The report highlights the slow progress in digitalizing administrative processes and the challenges posed by centralized service models. The government acknowledges the recommendations provided by the audit office and expresses its commitment to ongoing improvements in resource efficiency, digital support, and administrative organization to ultimately enhance the effectiveness of public service delivery.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:209 Utökade möjligheter att använda tidiga förhör
summary: The proposal suggests implementing several changes to enhance the use of early interrogations as evidence in criminal proceedings. It advocates for using audio and video recordings of initial testimonies in court, allowing for easier planning and execution of trials, and addressing concerns about the pressure on witnesses. The motion also calls for the consideration of removing the requirement for all parties to consent to submit written witness statements as evidence, aiming to modernize and streamline the legal process in response to the increasing complexity of serious criminal cases.

title: Bättre uppföljning av läkemedel för djur
summary: The proposal aims to improve the monitoring and management of animal medications by requiring open pharmacy operators to report specific information to the E-Health Authority upon dispensing prescriptions for animal treatments. It includes provisions for confidentiality among pharmacy staff, authorization for the government to set the reporting requirements, and amendments to existing laws relating to pharmacy data and public access to sensitive information. These changes are proposed to take effect from January 1, 2022.

title: Nya regler om husrannsakan för att söka efter vapen och andra farliga föremål
summary: The Swedish government proposes new legislation to enhance police powers to conduct searches for weapons and dangerous objects in shared areas of multi-family houses for crime prevention purposes. The proposal is driven by a significant increase in gun violence and bombings linked to conflicts between criminal groups, with the aim of preventing such items from being used in violent crimes. The suggested law, which addresses the evolving landscape of crime and public safety, includes provisions on how and when searches can occur, emphasizing the necessity for prompt action in urgent situations.

title: Utökade möjligheter att avgöra mål på handlingarna i allmän domstol
summary: The government proposes changes to procedural laws to allow more cases in general courts to be decided based on written documents instead of requiring an oral hearing. This aims to increase flexibility in court proceedings, shorten processing times, and improve efficiency, particularly for simpler cases. The proposed changes would enable district courts to decide criminal cases without a hearing when the outcome does not necessitate a different penalty than fines, and allow appellate courts to handle civil cases similarly under certain conditions.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:140 2021 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government initiate a process to sell state-owned companies that do not have specific social missions or strategic importance. The rationale emphasizes that the state should focus on its core welfare functions and allow private enterprises to operate effectively in the market. The motion aims to reduce state ownership in competitive markets to prevent unfair competition and promote transparency and sustainability among state-owned enterprises. Additionally, it suggests that proceeds from any sale could be used to reduce national debt and potentially distribute shares or profits to households if the debt is at a sustainable level.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:219 Fortsatt giltighet av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:4111 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The proposal advocates for a reassessment of the COVID-19 laws every two months, ensuring they are only in effect when absolutely necessary. It emphasizes the need for transparency from the government regarding how these laws are implemented. Furthermore, it suggests measures to increase vaccination rates among various demographics, including children aged 12-15, and introduces the concept of national vaccine passes to facilitate normal life for vaccinated individuals. The motion reflects a balance between managing public health and protecting individual freedoms.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:219 Fortsatt giltighet av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The motion proposed by the Center Party seeks to ensure that the COVID-19 law and related temporary measures on public gatherings remain in effect only as long as necessary. It argues for a regular review of the law every four weeks, emphasizes the need for a governmental agency to take on general coordination responsibilities, and insists that regulations affecting similar activities should be uniformly applied to avoid inconsistencies. The motion raises concerns about the delegation of powers from the parliament to the government and its potential impact on civil liberties, advocating for stronger checks and balances in the implementation of these laws.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:219 Fortsatt giltighet av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:4109 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: The motion by the Christian Democrats (KD) proposes the extension and modification of the COVID-19 legislation and temporary infection control measures for food service establishments. The suggested changes include extending the validity of these laws until the end of November 2021, while also advocating to remove the government's ability to impose societal shutdowns in future extensions. The motion emphasizes the need for economic compensation for businesses affected by these regulations and calls for clearer guidelines regarding compensation rights.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:219 Fortsatt giltighet av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The proposal seeks to extend the validity of the COVID-19 law and specific temporary infection control measures at hospitality venues until the end of November 2021. It emphasizes the importance of balancing effective infection control with the protection of individual freedoms and rights during the ongoing pandemic, advocating for a cautious and proportionate approach to any restrictions. The motion also calls for a more immediate scrutiny process by the parliament for measures taken under the law, and proposes amendments to clarify and tighten the legal language concerning limits on gatherings and other public assemblies.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:219 Fortsatt giltighet av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The motion proposes to limit the continuation of two laws established in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly regarding measures taken at serving establishments and special restrictions to prevent the spread of the virus. The Liberals agree with the government that the ongoing pandemic remains serious, but they argue that the government's proposed measures are excessively broad and infringe on individual freedoms. The motion seeks to shorten the validity of the laws from four months to two, ensuring that government powers in limiting freedom are proportionate and justifiable based on the current pandemic status.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:219                                                                           Fortsatt giltighet av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats (SD) proposes to extend the validity of the COVID-19 laws concerning temporary infection control measures at serving establishments and limitations to prevent the spread of COVID-19 until the end of January 2022. However, the motion advocates for a reduced extension period and calls for a detailed analysis of the situation before any further prolongation. It emphasizes the need to strengthen regional resources to address vaccination inequalities among diverse groups in society.

title: Fortsatt giltighet av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The Swedish government proposed extending the validity of the COVID-19 law and the law concerning temporary infection control measures at dining establishments until the end of January 2022. Both laws, which were originally set to expire at the end of September 2021, are designed to help prevent the spread of COVID-19 through various measures including restrictions on gatherings and requirements for infection control in public venues. The government argues that this extension is necessary due to the ongoing pandemic, while several stakeholders have expressed the need for continual assessment of the situation and proportionality of measures.

title: Skärpta straff för våld och andra kränkningar i nära relationer
summary: Regeringen föreslår skärpta straff för våld och kränkningar i nära relationer, vilket inkluderar höjning av minimistraffet för grov fridskränkning och grov kvinnofridskränkning från nio månader till ett år, samt avskaffande av böter för överträdelse av kontaktförbud. Ytterligare åtgärder för att förebygga sådant våld och skydda utsatta personer omfattar att förtal ska kunna inräknas i brotten och att kontaktförbud kan åtföljas av elektronisk övervakning som en förstahandsåtgärd. Lagändringarna föreslås träda i kraft den 1 januari 2022.

title: Vård av unga vid Statens institutionsstyrelses särskilda ungdomshem
summary: The government's communication outlines the measures taken to ensure the safety and quality of care for young individuals placed in the special youth homes operated by Statens institutionsstyrelse (SiS). Following a directive from the parliament, the government reports on ongoing and completed initiatives aimed at addressing existing deficiencies, enhancing staff competency, and promoting a knowledge-based and equitable approach to care. The government emphasizes the continuous effort to improve the system to provide suitable and legally secure treatment for the youth and proper working conditions for the staff.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om riktade utbyggnadsuppdrag till universitet och högskolor
summary: The government has submitted a report confirming Riksrevisionen's findings that targeted expansion assignments to universities and colleges have not significantly increased the number of graduates in shortage professions. While the number of students has reached record levels, the government recognizes that previously set goals have largely not been met. Recommendations include conducting a comprehensive goal fulfillment analysis and clarifying future expansion assignments to better align with institutional capabilities.

title: Redovisning av fördelning av medel från Allmänna arvsfonden under budgetåret 2020
summary: This document outlines the management and allocation of funds from the General Inheritance Fund in Sweden for the fiscal year 2020. It reports on the activities of the Inheritance Fund Delegation, including the distribution of support across various areas, evaluations of its operations, and future priorities for funding in sectors beneficial to children, youth, people with disabilities, and the elderly.

title: Utökade möjligheter att använda tidiga förhör
summary: The Swedish government proposes amendments aimed at modernizing and enhancing the effectiveness of legal processes, particularly for serious criminal cases. This involves expanded use of early witness testimonies as evidence, allowing for more reliable proof and potentially lessening the burden on victims and witnesses. The changes would enable evidence to be presented in court prior to the main hearings, enhancing the judicial process and increasing the likelihood of accurate verdicts.

title: 2021 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: The government presents an annual report detailing the management of state-owned companies and the activities conducted by these entities as of the end of 2020. The report highlights the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic, the value development of state assets, the financial performance of various state companies, and ongoing efforts to enhance corporate governance. It underscores the importance of the government's role as an active owner focused on long-term value creation and ensures that mandated societal tasks are effectively executed by the companies under its purview.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:207 Skattereduktion för investeringar i inventarier anskaffade år 2021
summary: The proposal argues against the government's initiative to provide tax reductions for investments in equipment made in 2021, which is expected to cost 5.5 billion SEK. The Left Party believes that while supporting small and medium-sized enterprises is crucial, subsidizing large companies, which are showing significant profits and planning large dividends, is unjustifiable. Therefore, they recommend that the parliament reject the government's proposition.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/21:201 Stärkt skydd för hyresgäster
summary: The motion proposed by the Sweden Democrats (SD) calls for the rejection of a government proposal aimed at strengthening protections for tenants, particularly in situations of property damage, rental transitions post-renovation, and changes to the rental agreements. The SD expresses concern that the government's suggestions could threaten property owners' rights, disrupt the rental market, create legal uncertainty, and impose excessive burdens on smaller landlords. They advocate for a more flexible approach to private rental agreements and highlight the need to balance the interests of landlords and tenants.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:201 Stärkt skydd för hyresgäster
summary: The proposal by the Moderate Party seeks to amend the rental laws to strengthen tenant protections while addressing concerns that government proposals may unintentionally harm the rental market. It suggests that specific protections for tenants should not lead to hindering rental options, especially in cases involving private rental agreements. The motion proposes to disallow government changes that would restrict landlords' ability to terminate fixed-term leases before their end while ensuring that tenant rights are preserved.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:201 Stärkt skydd för hyresgäster
summary: The suggestion from the Christian Democrats (KD) opposes governmental proposals aimed at changing tenant protections related to rent increases during renovations and restrictions on private landlords' ability to terminate fixed-term leases. The motion argues that the proposed gradual rent increases may deteriorate the rental market by reducing investment in rental properties, and that additional limitations on landlords' rights could lead to decreased rental availability, ultimately harming both landlords and tenants.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:201 Stärkt skydd för hyresgäster
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:4101 av Ola Johansson och Catarina Deremar (båda C)
summary: The proposal addresses concerns about tenant protections in the context of housing laws, emphasizing that any increases in rent due to renovations should be exceptional and limited to individual units. It advocates against mandatory leasing arrangements for tenant replacements after property damage and opposes changes to rental laws that restrict landlords from terminating fixed-term leases prematurely. The motion seeks to balance the needs of tenants and property owners, highlighting the importance of flexibility in the housing market amid current shortages.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:203 Justerad indragningsbestämmelse inom underhållsstödet
summary: The motion proposed by the Swedish Democrats aims to extend the withdrawal period of maintenance support from six months to a minimum of twelve months. It emphasizes the need for clarity regarding special circumstances that may warrant continued maintenance payments for a duration of six months to four years, particularly in cases of conflict, violence, or temporary financial issues faced by the liable parent. The motion aims to safeguard children's financial security and address alleged inequalities in the existing maintenance support system, advocating for a modernized framework that reflects the income of both parents and their ability to pay.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:201 Stärkt skydd för hyresgäster
summary: The suggestion from the Liberal Party (L) seeks to reject parts of the government's proposal aimed at strengthening tenant protections, specifically concerning tenants' rights to receive new rental agreements after a total loss of accommodation, gradual rent increases, and changes in private rental laws that limit landlords' rights to terminate fixed-term leases. The Liberals argue that the government's proposals would diminish the availability of rental properties, reduce the willingness of landlords to invest in renovations, and pose challenges to the landlord's rights over their properties. They advocate for more flexibility in the rental market and cautions against measures that may lead to a reduction in rental housing supply.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:203 Justerad indragningsbestämmelse inom underhållsstödet
summary: The motion argues that the government should propose changes to the maintenance support system to ensure that maintenance is handled through support whenever one parent wishes it, particularly in cases of potential conflict or economic abuse. It highlights the need for further protections for parents and children beyond what the government has proposed, emphasizing the importance of safeguarding vulnerable individuals in familial arrangements.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:201 Stärkt skydd för hyresgäster
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:4097 av Momodou Malcolm Jallow m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion seeks to enhance the protection of tenants in Sweden by introducing various measures aimed at improving tenant rights, particularly in cases of poor property management and during renovations. It proposes that municipalities aid in appointing effective property managers when properties are poorly maintained, facilitates rent reductions for inadequate maintenance, reinstates a previous acquisition law to prevent unscrupulous landlords from buying rental properties, and ensures that tenants retain their rights even after damage to their dwellings, such as fire incidents. Moreover, it calls for adjustments in rental agreements to mitigate the effects of rent increases post-renovation and suggests prohibiting speculative practices that lead to excessive rent hikes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:205 Utbetalning av ersättning för personlig assistans endast vid tillstånd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the idea that personal assistance compensation should be paid out for a minimum of three weeks after a user has been informed of changes regarding their assistance provider. The Left Party emphasizes the importance of personal choice in selecting assistance providers to ensure quality and inclusion for individuals with disabilities, arguing that current proposals which restrict this choice are inadequate for meeting users' needs.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om transportbidraget
summary: The government responds to the Swedish National Audit Office's report on the transport subsidy, acknowledging concerns about its contribution to regional development and climate impact. The audit points out that the effectiveness of the subsidy is unclear and that assessments of its climate consequences have not been conducted. The government agrees with the need for a thorough review of the transport subsidy structure, including an assessment of actual transport costs, but does not plan to change its support aimed at increasing the processing level within the relevant industries at this time.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:208 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 – Förlängda ersättningar på sjukförsäkringsområdet, stöd till företag, kultur, idrott och civilsamhälle samt andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The proposal by Moderaterna advocates for enabling businesses to apply for short-term work support starting July 1, 2021, and extending the application period beyond November 2021. The motion emphasizes the need for quicker processing times for financial aid to assist companies affected by the pandemic and highlights previous recommendations to improve the system for support during short-term employment schemes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:208 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 – Förlängda ersättningar på sjukförsäkringsområdet, stöd till företag, kultur, idrott och civilsamhälle samt andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes that the Swedish Parliament reject the government's recommendation to issue credit guarantees for the SAS airline, citing the need for a robust environmental action plan from SAS that aligns with climate goals. The motion also supports the extension of short-time work subsidies due to the pandemic, emphasizing the importance of these measures for job retention. Vänsterpartiet calls for stricter regulations on companies receiving state aid, including restrictions on dividend payments and oversight of support eligibility, while urging the government to enhance efforts against emerging COVID-19 variants through increased funding and operational clarity for health authorities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:208 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 – Förlängda ersättningar på sjukförsäkringsområdet, stöd till företag, kultur, idrott och civilsamhälle samt andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for an evaluation of the support mechanisms in place for short-term work assistance and related measures due to the ongoing economic impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic. It suggests streamlining the application and payment processes for aid, assessing the support for the nonprofit sector, and ensuring sufficient emergency funding for businesses and civic organizations affected by government restrictions. The motion emphasizes the need for flexibility in regulations regarding seasonal businesses and argues that the current administrative requirements for receiving aid are overly stringent, potentially leading to job losses.

title: Meddelande om kommande förslag om begränsning av avdragsrätten för underskott från tidigare år
