summary: The motion advocates for a reduction in public service costs in Sweden, proposing a thorough review of public service operations, its funding through the TV tax, and the possibility of streamlining its functions. It emphasizes the need for public service to maintain impartiality and regain trust from the public by examining its mandate, financial sustainability, and the relevance of its current offerings.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:170 Barn som bevittnar brott
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should resume its subscription to various national and rural newspapers and place them back in the Parliament's newspaper room. This initiative aims to enhance accessibility to local news for members of Parliament and staff, allowing for better awareness of local issues across the country, as currently, only Stockholm-based newspapers are present in the room.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:163 Förebyggande av våld i nära relationer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3992 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes to establish a clear responsibility for public officials regarding misconduct, emphasizing the need for the government to expedite the implementation of such accountability as previously recommended in 2018. It aims to enhance the citizens' legal security and trust in public administration by ensuring that more acts of misconduct can be penalized and that investigations do not take excessive time.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:158 Skärpt kontroll över explosiva varor
summary: The motion advocates for a thorough evaluation of the formation of Västra Götalandsregionen before initiating the creation of new regions. It emphasizes learning from past mistakes, ensuring that agreements made with municipalities are honored, and considers whether regional governance is the most effective method of administration. The proposal suggests compensating municipalities that have been adversely affected due to non-compliance with state commitments.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:170 Barn som bevittnar brott
summary: The motion proposes a review of the accommodation conditions and compensation for Members of Parliament, suggesting that the distance threshold for overnight housing be increased from five to at least seven miles. It advocates for a bidding system for the apartments to ensure market-adjusted rents and calls for a cap on the reimbursement for accommodation costs at a maximum of 5,000 kronor per month, encouraging MPs to cover any additional housing expenses themselves to promote fairness and save taxpayer money.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:158 Skärpt kontroll över explosiva varor
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a dedicated agriculture and forestry committee in the Swedish Parliament to better address issues related to farming, forestry, and rural development. The current Environmental and Agriculture Committee is seen as prioritizing environmental concerns at the expense of important agricultural issues. The aim is to allow for a clearer focus on agricultural production and its vital role in rural development, suggesting that a separate environmental committee would better handle environmental matters.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:163 Förebyggande av våld i nära relationer
summary: The proposal by Sten Bergheden (M) suggests that the Swedish Parliament clarifies the governance of state authorities, agencies, and companies to prevent political communication and influence from these institutions. The motivation emphasizes the need for state agencies to remain apolitical in their communications and advertising, citing an example of Systembolaget's attempts to influence political decisions against the sale of alcoholic beverages from farms. The motion calls for a review of existing regulations to ensure these entities do not engage in political propaganda.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:95 Barns och ungas läsning
summary: This motion proposes to strengthen the regulations around the Riksdag's directives to the government, ensuring that the government implements decisions made by the Riksdag within a reasonable timeframe. It emphasizes that when a majority in the Riksdag makes a decision, it should be respected and acted upon by the government, which must report back with a time frame for implementation within two months. The motion argues that the current situation allows the government to delay responding to directives, which undermines the democratic process.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:170 Barn som bevittnar brott
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3986 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the support system for political secretaries to allow members of parliament greater autonomy in determining how this support and assistance in their political work is structured and utilized. The intention is to adjust the existing framework so that individual parliamentarians can better tailor the support they receive to their specific needs and workloads, which can vary considerably based on their constituency.

title: Tidsfrister och kontaktpunkt för att främja tillförsel av förnybar energi
summary: Anders Hansson proposes a review of the support provided to members of the Swedish Parliament to ensure that it is used effectively for parliamentary duties, as suggested in the Democracy Inquiry report. The motion highlights concerns that the current funding is often redirected to other activities, thus undermining the ability of members to fulfill their democratic responsibilities and weakening their independent role in parliament. The goal is to clarify and improve the allocation and usage of this support to promote a stronger representative democracy.

title: Reduktionsplikt för bensin och diesel – kontrollstation 2019
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive and neutral evaluation of the Hornborgasjön restoration project, which is one of Sweden's largest conservation initiatives. It highlights concerns raised by critics regarding the project's adverse ecological impacts and the treatment of affected landowners. The motion calls for assessing the project's costs, objectives, management relations with landowners, unforeseen consequences on biodiversity, and compensation for impacted parties, while emphasizing the importance of balancing environmental goals with the interests of the surrounding community.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:95 Barns och ungas läsning
summary: The motion proposes measures to facilitate job and housing opportunities for young people by suggesting the implementation of practical training across all high school programs, enhancing the job focus in career guidance, and introducing a tax deduction for young individuals saving for their own housing. The aim is to strengthen the connection between education and the labor market, equipping youth with necessary information for informed career choices while incentivizing savings for future housing.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:163 Förebyggande av våld i nära relationer
summary: The proposal suggests abolishing the general coastal protection regulations in Sweden and removing the involvement of county administrative boards in coastal protection matters. The motion argues that current restrictions hinder the construction of housing in attractive waterfront areas and limit property owners' rights, thus advocating for more flexible regulations that would allow municipalities to determine coastal protection zones based on local needs. The proponents claim these changes would foster growth, increase housing opportunities, and attract new residents to rural areas.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:161 Löneutmätning och digitala ansökningar i utsökningsförfarandet
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should enhance its defense capabilities to ensure the safety of its inhabitants and be able to respond to potential threats. It also advocates for Sweden to apply for NATO membership to strengthen national security in light of current global uncertainties. The motion emphasizes the need for immediate action to improve defense readiness and engage in discussions regarding future defense strategies.

title: Avgift för intyg om godkänd bastjänstgöring
summary: The motion proposes that libraries in Sweden should classify and make searchable literary works under the initial letter of the country or language they represent, rather than using outdated abbreviations like 'BKS' for Bosnian, Croatian, and Serbian. It argues for a clear and logical organization of literature to reflect the independence and official recognition of these languages, thus improving the accessibility and clarity of library catalogs.

title: Anpassningar till EU:s nya förordningar om medicinteknik - del 2
summary: The motion proposes allowing individuals greater freedom in choosing their parish within the Swedish Church, rather than being assigned to a geographically nearest one. This change would enable members to join the congregation they feel more connected to, reflecting their personal relationships and emotional ties, regardless of their geographic location.

title: Framtidens infrastruktur – hållbara investeringar i hela Sverige
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity of providing information about which high school programs lead to jobs in the labor market, starting career education in primary school, and providing continuous education for career counselors to ensure they have up-to-date knowledge of various professions. It argues that better awareness of career options and modern job realities is crucial for students to make informed educational choices, addressing the current gap in awareness of available occupations.

title: Kompletterande regler för uppehållstillstånd vid gymnasiestudier
summary: This motion emphasizes the urgent need to address capacity shortages in the electricity system in southern Sweden. It calls for the government to investigate the potential of local networks to alleviate this issue, speed up permit processing related to electricity production and transmission, and ensure that existing and new regulatory instruments do not inadvertently encourage increased electricity consumption. The proposal highlights the growing demand for electricity due to developments in various sectors, warning that the current electricity infrastructure is insufficient to meet the new energy needs.

title: Årsredovisning för staten 2020
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Energy Agency should be tasked with financing test and demonstration facilities for the development of fourth-generation nuclear power. It emphasizes the urgent need for Sweden to reduce carbon emissions and highlights the potential of a carbon-free energy mix, which includes nuclear power, as a future export opportunity. The authors argue that practical testing is essential for effective technology development, and they call for increased investment in these facilities to enhance Sweden's technological advancements in energy production.

title: 2021 års ekonomiska vårproposition
summary: The motion proposes to enhance coordination by merging the Coast Guard and Border Police into a single agency with a unified leadership and budget. The author argues that this consolidation would improve efficiency and clarify responsibilities currently divided between the two entities, and calls for an evaluation of this restructuring.

title: Vårändringsbudget för 2021
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should seek membership in NATO as a means to enhance national defense and security in light of increasing global tensions, particularly from Russia. The motion argues that NATO membership would strengthen Sweden's role in defense and security cooperation with other nations, improve its influence in security matters, and contribute to regional stability. It suggests that a structured plan for this membership process should be developed, ideally in collaboration with Finland, to address contemporary security concerns in Europe.

title: Redovisning av skatteutgifter 2021
summary: The motion proposes that parents be allowed to access the academic results of their adult children who are still in school, despite the children reaching the age of majority. The argument is based on the concern that without parental oversight, there is a higher risk of students disengaging from their studies, especially in light of the current mental health challenges exacerbated by the pandemic. The proposal suggests a legal right for parents to receive academic feedback and communicate with teachers, thereby ensuring continued support for their children's education until the age of 21.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:182 Kompletterande regler för uppehållstillstånd vid gymnasiestudier
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3982 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå och Jennie Åfeldt (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews the internal charging of data between authorities and researchers to improve access to research data. It calls for granting permanent measurement permissions to accredited researchers, streamlining the process for obtaining dissemination permits, and for the Digitaliseringen Authority to modernize outdated data management structures. The proposal aims to address the issues of high costs and long wait times faced by researchers when accessing vital maritime and environmental data, stressing the importance of open data for effective research and national security.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:143 Institutet för mänskliga rättigheter
summary: The proposal aims to develop a comprehensive strategy for strengthening and enhancing the Swedish defense industry in light of upcoming investments and challenges. It emphasizes the importance of the defense industry for Sweden's growth and defense capabilities, calling for a reevaluation and diversification of the sector to meet global demands. The motion advocates for collaboration with other industries to ensure mutual growth alongside the defense sector's recovery, ultimately seeking a modern approach to Sweden's defense landscape.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:143 Institutet för mänskliga rättigheter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers placing a national stockpile of medical supplies in Västmanland to enhance the country's preparedness for health crises, especially in light of vulnerabilities exposed by the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the need for a national stockpile to meet domestic needs and outlines Västmanland's logistical advantages for establishing such a facility.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:165 Utvidgade möjligheter att utreda förlisningen av passagerarfartyget Estonia
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3979 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal advocates for a national emergency preparedness plan for transport and mobility, emphasizing the importance of securing fuel supplies in the event of a crisis. It highlights the critical role of transportation in ensuring the economy functions smoothly, particularly in situations where goods must be delivered and people must be able to travel for work. It calls for a structured approach to address logistics, domestic production, and storage to enhance Sweden's resilience in future emergencies.

title: Modernare regler för bekräftelse av föräldraskap, faderskapsundersökningar och för att åstadkomma könsneutral föräldraskapspresumtion
summary: Betty Malmberg proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the establishment of Sweden as a 'research hub' by ensuring long-term funding for national research infrastructure, creating a prompt action plan for the storage, collection, and sharing of health and care data, and promoting the standardization and compatibility of health data from various regions. This initiative aims to enhance Sweden's research capabilities, attract international experts, and improve the quality of clinical research and healthcare outcomes.

title: Stärkt kompetens i vård och omsorg - reglering av undersköterskeyrket
summary: The motion proposes that all state, regional, and municipal authorities and organizations involved in crisis preparedness should be mandated to implement the Rakel telecommunications system to ensure effective communication during emergencies. The author argues that unified communication is crucial for successful collaboration among various actors during a crisis, as differing communication systems can lead to coordination issues and delays in response efforts.

title: Genomförandet av MKB-direktivet i plan- och bygglagen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should explore ways to strengthen the defense of Gothenburg and the west coast, citing the city's strategic importance due to its major port, which is critical for Sweden's economy and trade. It emphasizes the risks posed by potential military threats to the region, particularly concerning Baltic states dynamics, and calls for enhanced military capabilities including amphibious forces and mine clearance teams to secure Gothenburg's harbor and ensure the uninterrupted flow of goods and supplies.

title: Nya kapitaltäckningsregler för värdepappersbolag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament simplify and clarify the requirements for environmental impact assessments (MKB) to streamline the approval processes for various projects, highlighting the need to define essential species for examination in specific areas to prevent complications in the permitting process.

title: Angiven yrkesgrupp - åtgärder för en begriplig sjukförsäkring
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the authorities' powers to store transport data provided by transportation companies for intelligence purposes. It argues that such data storage would enable authorities to effectively combat smuggling, tax evasion, and other crimes by linking suspicious individuals to illegal activities. The proposal emphasizes improving the efficiency of law enforcement through better access to transport-related information.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om statens insatser mot exploatering av arbetskraft
summary: The motion suggests improvements for law-abiding hunters and firearm owners in Sweden by urging the government not to over-implement the EU's firearm directive, expediting license processing, allowing more firearms in personal collections, and removing the licensing requirement for sound suppressors. The proposal emphasizes that stringent controls already in place for firearm owners should facilitate these changes without posing security risks.

title: Strategisk exportkontroll 2020 - krigsmateriel och produkter med dubbla användningsområden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should actively promote the preservation and appreciation of the motor historical heritage in Sweden through state cultural support. It calls for legislative measures to define the responsibilities of authorities regarding historical vehicles and museums, and to facilitate the use of land for events related to vintage cars. The proposal emphasizes the importance of this heritage as a part of Swedish culture and history, arguing that it requires clearer support from the government to ensure its continuation and development.

title: Återkallelse av regeringens proposition 2020/21:48 Organdonation
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should strengthen its preparation and planning efforts against a potential outbreak of African swine fever in Sweden, emphasizing the need to minimize the risk of such an outbreak and to mitigate damages if it occurs.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:166 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Förlängda ersättningar på sjukförsäkringsområdet, stöd till företag, kultur och idrott samt andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers granting police officers the ability to obtain concealed addresses and personal information to enhance their safety. It highlights the risks faced by police due to potential threats from criminals in both their professional and private lives. The proposal emphasizes the need for a streamlined process to allow police officers to hide their personal information from public access online when necessary.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:160 Säkrare samordningsnummer och bättre förutsättningar för korrekta uppgifter i folkbokföringen
summary: The proposal advocates for all students in Sweden to receive education in entrepreneurship at some point during their school years. It suggests that the government should explore the possibility of offering the 'Young Entrepreneurship' program in all high schools and across all educational tracks, emphasizing the need for increased business initiatives and opportunities for youth to engage with enterprise.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:160 Säkrare samordningsnummer och bättre förutsättningar för korrekta uppgifter i folkbokföringen
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the inclusion of education within youth sentences, emphasizing that educational programs could reduce recidivism among young offenders. The proposal argues that sentences should be tailored to individual needs, with education as a central component, encouraging youth to achieve necessary qualifications to reintegrate successfully into society.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:160 Säkrare samordningsnummer och bättre förutsättningar för korrekta uppgifter i folkbokföringen
summary: The motion proposes that Mälardalens högskola be granted the status of a technical university in order to enhance its research capabilities and better serve the educational and labor market needs of the Mälardalen region. The motion highlights the strong development of the high school, including a significant number of students and researchers, and argues that its elevation to a technical university would increase research funding and improve education quality, addressing the expected shortage of skilled labor in the region.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:133 Nationell strategi för hållbar regional utveckling i hela landet 2021-2030
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity of maintaining competence requirements in various professions, particularly in the context of restarting the economy after COVID-19. It argues that relaxing these standards in response to workforce shortages risks devaluing professions and jeopardizing the quality of services, especially within the welfare sector. The authors highlight the historical consequences of lowering educational standards and stress that recruitment should focus on ensuring qualified personnel rather than merely filling positions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:157 Material och produkter avsedda att komma i kontakt med livsmedel
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider making personal finance education an obligatory subject in primary and secondary schools to prevent young people from accumulating debts and seeking assistance from the Enforcement Authority (Kronofogden). The motion highlights the significant increase in debt applications among young adults and emphasizes the need for proactive measures to equip them with financial knowledge.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:135 Reduktionsplikt för flygfotogen
summary: The motion proposes to amend the requirements for obtaining assistance in schools and daily activities for individuals with disabilities by removing the current clause of 'special reasons' that restricts access to support. The aim is to enhance the ability of these individuals to acquire knowledge, secure job opportunities, and maintain personal integrity. The motion emphasizes the necessity of personal assistants for effective learning and social interaction, as well as equal rights to meaningful daily activities.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:133 Nationell strategi för hållbar regional utveckling i hela landet 2021-2030
summary: The motion advocates for the government to review and improve funding procedures for the Historical Museum of Lund, which is responsible for handling archaeological finds in southern Sweden. The museum is currently under the jurisdiction of Lund University and the Ministry of Education rather than the Ministry of Culture, leading to challenges in securing adequate state resources for its operations. The motion highlights the risks of financial strain on the university due to the increased number of finds from the rich archaeological site of Uppåkra and emphasizes the need for a sustainable solution to ensure the museum's continued work.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:156 Justerad beräkning av bilförmån
summary: The motion proposes a review of the cost responsibility associated with archaeological excavations in Sweden. It highlights concerns regarding the financial burdens placed on developers and how these costs can impede project developments, particularly in rural areas with significant archaeological sites. The motion calls for evaluations of collaborative governmental efforts as presented in a recent report by the National Heritage Board, emphasizing the need for clearer guidelines and support for local businesses facing these challenges.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:150 Ett stärkt barnrättsperspektiv i vårdnadstvister
summary: The motion proposes that conditional release from prison should only occur under strict conditions, including the completion of high school education and Swedish for Immigrants (SFI) studies for immigrants, to enhance rehabilitation and reduce recidivism. It emphasizes that those with previous convictions should not qualify for conditional release, and the requirements should be adjusted based on the length of the prison sentence.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:156 Justerad beräkning av bilförmån
summary: The proposal seeks to preserve eel fishing along the Skåne coast by allowing eel fishermen to transfer their rights and recognizing the cultural significance of eel fishing as part of the international cultural heritage 'Ålarvet'. The motion outlines the economic benefits of eel fishing to local communities, the need to sustain the eel population despite various environmental threats, and calls for an active effort by the government to list Ålarvet as an intangible cultural heritage with UNESCO. It emphasizes the importance of adapting regulations to facilitate generational transfers of fishing rights and ensuring that eel fishermen receive compensation for economic losses resulting from current regulations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:152 Vissa insatser för ökad lärarkompetens
summary: The motion proposes to expedite the permitting processes for electricity infrastructure to support Sweden's transition to a fossil-free energy system, emphasizing the need for a reliable electricity supply for key sectors like transportation and industry. The motion highlights the current lengthy waiting times for permits, which can take up to ten years, as a significant barrier to achieving climate goals. It suggests that the government should implement measures to shorten these processes while maintaining legal security and consider compensating applicants for delays.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:154 Miljöstyrande start- och landningsavgifter
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the stamp duty, arguing that it acts as a burden on property transactions without covering actual administrative costs, which are already covered by an application fee. It highlights that the stamp duty negatively affects mobility in the housing market and poses moral questions about tax burdens related to frequency of moving. The motion suggests that if the state requires revenue, it should come from more transparent taxes rather than the stamp duty.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:156 Justerad beräkning av bilförmån
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of a maternity and childbirth care commission to investigate and reform Sweden's maternity and delivery healthcare services, addressing issues such as limited access, inadequate support, and significant regional disparities in care quality. The motion highlights the need to scrutinize current practices and learn from successful models in other countries to ensure secure delivery and postpartum care.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:155 Ändringar i regelverket om hantering av finansiella företag i kris
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a legal framework in Sweden that allows for the indefinite confinement of particularly dangerous offenders who have committed serious violent or sexual crimes. The motion highlights existing practices in countries like Canada, England, and Norway, where such offenders can be detained based on a reverse burden of proof after repeated offenses. The proposal aims to provide Swedish courts with enhanced options to protect society from individuals repeatedly posing a danger due to their criminal behavior.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:144 Klimatdeklaration för byggnader
summary: The suggestion aims to strengthen Sweden's efforts in preserving and promoting its intangible cultural heritage by supporting the work of the Institute for Language and Folklore in relation to UNESCO's convention. It proposes to enhance the documentation and visibility of various minority cultures, including Estonian Swedes, Finnish Swedes, Tornedalians, and Sami heritage. Additionally, it suggests establishing a knowledge base to evaluate measures for the preservation of the cultural heritage of the visually and hearing impaired, as well as conducting an investigation to potentially designate the House of Folk Music in Dalarna as a national folk music center, ensuring its future funding.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:135 Reduktionsplikt för flygfotogen
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of 'culture on prescription', a model established during the previous center-right government, to aid individuals who have been unemployed due to long-term health issues such as stress, burnout, and stroke. It emphasizes the therapeutic benefits of cultural experiences for rehabilitation and suggests that research should inform reforms to integrate cultural activities more broadly within the healthcare system.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:149 Förbud mot erkännande av utländska månggiften
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should develop a cultural canon inspired by the Danish model, which integrates both material and immaterial cultural heritage. This initiative aims to foster discussion and reflection around Swedish culture, history, and identity amidst current challenges such as cultural fragmentation and apathy towards cultural policy issues. The suggestion includes organizing a national debate to identify key values and traditions that hold significance for Sweden's future.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:150 Ett stärkt barnrättsperspektiv i vårdnadstvister
summary: The suggestion presented by Aron Emilsson and colleagues emphasizes the importance of cultural heritage in Sweden, advocating for enhanced cultural planning and coordination among government agencies. It calls for a national review of legislation and municipal capabilities regarding cultural heritage protection, highlighting the current inadequacies in resources and expertise at both national and local levels. The proposal seeks to ensure the preservation and integration of culturally significant environments in community planning to safeguard Sweden's historical narrative and collective identity.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:90 Nordiskt samarbete 2020
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3959 av Linda Modig och Magnus Ek (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament explore the establishment of a national church history museum in collaboration with the Church of Sweden, emphasizing the significant impact of Christianity on Swedish culture and the necessity of preserving this heritage. The motion highlights the challenges faced by the church in maintaining its cultural heritage due to decreasing membership and financial constraints, and it cites the successful model of the Museum Catharijneconvent in the Netherlands as a potential inspiration.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:132 En förnyad strategi för politiken avseende alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och nikotin samt spel om pengar 2021–2025
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive strategy to enhance the Swedish road infrastructure and transportation safety, which includes creating a dedicated police unit for heavy traffic controls, increasing penalties for trafficking violations, halting the introduction of environmental taxes on transportation, and directing funds for road upgrades. Additionally, it advocates for standards in road planning to ensure safety for all road users, enhancing education on traffic safety, and evaluating current regulations regarding various vehicle types, all while prioritizing environmental considerations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:131 Privat initiativrätt - planintressentens medverkan vid detaljplaneläggning
summary: The motion seeks to enhance the competitiveness and functionality of the Swedish railway system through various proposals, including strengthening market funding for urgent measures, increasing railway maintenance by having Trafikverket manage it directly, and improving administrative efficiency. It highlights the necessity of reopening negotiation processes for existing infrastructure agreements, building new double tracks, and enhancing safety and efficiency in freight transport. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for sustainable transport solutions, such as promoting alternative fuels and the modernization of railway technology while increasing resources for regional networks and ensuring accessibility for all citizens.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:144 Klimatdeklaration för byggnader
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the abolishment of the congestion tax in cities like Stockholm and Gothenburg, arguing that the tax has not effectively reduced traffic congestion and has instead been used to finance past debts rather than future infrastructure needs. The authors contend that the existing tax burden on residents is already high and that the necessary infrastructure should be funded without imposing additional local fees on citizens.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:159 Vissa identitetsfrågor inom utlänningsrätten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3955 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of splitting the current Trafikverket into two separate entities: a Vägverk responsible for the road network and a Banverk responsible for the railway network. It argues that since the merger of these entities in 2010, there has been a significant increase in staff numbers and questions whether this structure is optimal for taxpayers, suggesting that the previous arrangement may have better maintained the necessary expertise and efficiency.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:90 Nordiskt samarbete 2020
summary: The motion proposed by Jimmy Ståhl and other members of the Sweden Democrats (SD) aims to strengthen broadband development in rural areas, review penalties for data breaches, safeguard essential IT infrastructure, and ensure reliable postal services in sparsely populated regions. It includes suggestions for the potential divestiture of Telia, improved security protocols for IT, better coordination in fiber installation, and a mandate for the government to enhance service and efficiency in postal delivery, especially in rural areas.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:150 Ett stärkt barnrättsperspektiv i vårdnadstvister
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should exempt Class 2 cars weighing over 7.5 tons from the requirement for a tachograph, regardless of the vehicle's weight, as long as they are not used for commercial transport. The argument is made that requiring a tachograph on recreational vehicles creates unnecessary costs for owners and represents an over-interpretation of existing regulation, which is primarily aimed at vehicles involved in commercial transport.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:132 En förnyad strategi för politiken avseende alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och nikotin samt spel om pengar 2021–2025
summary: The motion proposes clarifications to the occupational traffic laws in Sweden regarding the temporary registration of vehicles during situations like the coronavirus pandemic, which has forced many transport companies to temporarily suspend their operations. The authors argue that the current interpretation of EU regulation 1071/2009 by the Swedish Transport Agency is too strict and impacts small businesses adversely by revoking their traffic permits even when the cause is the pandemic-induced vehicle suspension, rather than financial mismanagement. They suggest a more flexible legal framework to account for such extraordinary circumstances.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:149 Förbud mot erkännande av utländska månggiften
summary: The motion aims to strengthen Swedish shipping by establishing a shipping council and removing various fees associated with maritime operations, such as fairway fees and icebreaking costs. It advocates for a review of the pilotage system and the financing model of the Swedish Maritime Administration to enhance competitiveness. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the importance of sustainable practices in shipping, urging international cooperation and compliance with environmental regulations. The proposal reflects a comprehensive strategy to support Sweden's maritime industry while ensuring equal competitive conditions on a global scale.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:105 Ungdomspolitisk skrivelse
summary: This motion addresses the rising issue of gang crime in Sweden, particularly among youth in vulnerable areas. The proposal emphasizes preventive measures, notably within the education system, to provide recognition and positive role models for at-risk boys and young men. It advocates for collaboration among various societal institutions, such as schools, social services, and the police, to create a supportive environment. The aim is to redirect the energies of these youths towards constructive societal roles and enhance their future prospects through mentorship, educational initiatives, and community engagement.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:135 Reduktionsplikt för flygfotogen
summary: The motion calls on the Swedish Parliament to express concern regarding the dire situation in Kashmir following the abrogation of Article 370 by India, which limited the rights and autonomy of the Kashmiri people. It highlights the severe restrictions on communication, the presence of a large military force, the suppression of dissent, and the lack of access to healthcare during the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion urges the Indian government to lift the blockade and respect human rights in the region, advocating for a peaceful resolution to the conflict.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:159 Vissa identitetsfrågor inom utlänningsrätten
summary: The motion emphasizes the responsibility of Swedish companies regarding human rights, arguing that both public and private enterprises have the potential to combat poverty through sustainable trade. However, it highlights the failure of these companies to adequately ensure respect for human rights within their supply chains, with many lacking acceptable processes to prevent violations. The motion calls for binding legislation to enforce Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD) requirements, drawing attention to the inadequacies of voluntary guidelines and referencing similar legislation in other European countries. It argues that without such legislation, ethical companies face unfair competition from those neglecting human rights.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:90 Nordiskt samarbete 2020
summary: The motion argues for the need to clarify the Social Services Act regarding the quality of life for the elderly, emphasizing that the current law lacks a defined standard for a 'reasonable living level', leading to discrepancies in care based on municipalities and caseworkers. The proposal supports the establishment of a specific legislation for elderly care to ensure equitable standards and improve quality of life, particularly highlighted by the challenges faced during the pandemic.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:131 Privat initiativrätt - planintressentens medverkan vid detaljplaneläggning
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a new national strategy to combat homelessness in Sweden, proposing several key measures including the introduction of a national guarantee for housing, the implementation of a 'Housing First' model in all municipalities, and the provision of economic incentives for local governments to update housing policies. The motion emphasizes the need for a coordinated and effective approach to address the growing issue of homelessness, which affects various societal groups, particularly families and the elderly.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:152 Vissa insatser för ökad lärarkompetens
summary: This motion expresses concern over the ongoing human rights violations in the Xinjiang region of China and calls for the Swedish Parliament to support clear stances and international initiatives to address these issues. The authors urge Sweden to take action within the UN and the EU to hold the Chinese government accountable for these violations, highlighting the importance of international scrutiny and support for independent investigations into the situation.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:109 Politik för konstnärers villkor
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of addressing human rights violations in Chile and urges the Swedish government to promote economic growth and democratic reforms in the country. It highlights the ongoing issues of inequality and political unrest in Chile, which have been exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic. The proposal calls for Sweden to take an active role in advocating for respect for human rights and the release of political prisoners, while also encouraging Chilean authorities to consider alternative measures for those at risk due to the pandemic.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:132 En förnyad strategi för politiken avseende alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och nikotin samt spel om pengar 2021–2025
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3943 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The suggestion advocates for a review of the blood donation regulations in Sweden to ensure they are based on evidence and to eliminate discriminatory practices against men who have sexual relations with men. It highlights the inconsistency in the current regulations, which require 12 months of celibacy for these individuals before donating blood, despite them being in stable relationships. The proposal emphasizes the importance of increasing blood donors and ensuring the safety of blood donations, arguing for a more equitable approach that separates risk behavior from sexual orientation.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:105 Ungdomspolitisk skrivelse
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a uniform definition of the term 'working capacity' in the regulations governing unemployment insurance (a-kassa) and sick leave benefits. Currently, individuals are facing difficulties due to varying interpretations of the term across different agencies, leading to confusion and a lack of support for those who find themselves between the cracks of the system. The motion calls for the government to ensure that the definition of working capacity is consistent regardless of the respective authority, thereby strengthening social safety nets and improving the clarity of eligibility criteria.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish parliament to review measures needed to ensure that Roma people in Sweden and Europe are granted the human rights stipulated by the conventions of the Council of Europe and the United Nations. It highlights the historical discrimination faced by Roma, particularly during the Holocaust, and the lack of formal restitution and support for their rights. The motion calls for improved representation of Roma interests and argues that the support provided to Roma communities has been insufficient compared to other national minorities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:132 En förnyad strategi för politiken avseende alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och nikotin samt spel om pengar 2021–2025
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive overview of the sickness insurance system to ensure that no individual falls outside the safety nets during illness. It advocates for a unified definition of work capacity between Försäkringskassan and Arbetsförmedlingen to prevent individuals from being left without support when transitioning between sickness benefits and employment services. The motion highlights the current gaps in responsibility that lead to economic and psychological vulnerability for those affected by illness.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:139 Ett modernt regelverk för Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: The proposal calls for a review of the reasons behind the higher sick leave rates among women compared to men. It highlights that women's sick leave compensation is nearly double that of men's and points out that mental health issues and unfair treatment in the sickness leave process contribute to this disparity. The motion emphasizes the need for immediate actions to address these inequalities, including the impact of domestic violence on women's health and the differing conditions in the workforce and healthcare treatment received by women.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:150 Ett stärkt barnrättsperspektiv i vårdnadstvister
summary: The motion advocates for promoting mixed schools and reconsidering the school funding system in Sweden to combat increasing segregation and inequality in education. It highlights the adverse effects of the free school choice system established in 1992, which has contributed to disparities in educational quality. The proposal emphasizes the need for equitable education opportunities for all children, regardless of their background, and suggests reforms to ensure that school funding aligns with the diverse needs of students.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:149 Förbud mot erkännande av utländska månggiften
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of intermediate care measures for patients released from psychiatric inpatient care to facilitate their transition back into the community. It highlights the inadequacies of current follow-up services and suggests the establishment of 'intermediate care teams' comprising psychiatric expertise to support patients with conditions such as severe depression or psychosis. These teams aim to improve coordination between various healthcare actors and offer timely interventions to prevent relapses while also providing support for patients' relatives.

title: Med anledning av prop. 2020/21:132 En förnyad strategi för politiken avseende alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och nikotin samt spel om pengar 2021–2025
summary: The motion suggests improving the psychosocial aftercare for new parents by enhancing healthcare support to identify and manage physical and mental health complications following childbirth. It highlights the gaps in current healthcare that lead to untreated postpartum depression and the need for increased follow-up care to ensure better outcomes for parents and their children.

title: Med anledning av prop. 2020/21:139 Ett modernt regelverk för Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: Motionen föreslår en översyn av rätten till personlig assistans för att göra den mer allomfattande och säkerställa att barn och andra med funktionsnedsättning får det stöd de är berättigade till. Det påpekas att nuvarande förslag från regeringen kan leda till begränsningar av assisterande hjälp och ökad osäkerhet för berörda individer. Förbättringar krävs för att uppfylla Sveriges åtaganden enligt FN:s konvention om rättigheter för personer med funktionsnedsättning och för att främja jämlikhet och goda levnadsvillkor.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:149 Förbud mot erkännande av utländska månggiften
summary: The proposal advocates for measures to combat gambling addiction by limiting gambling advertising and considering further regulations within the gambling market. It emphasizes the severe impact of gambling addiction on individuals and their families and calls for stronger actions to mitigate the negative effects of gambling, including a complete ban on gambling advertisements in public spaces such as public transport.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:141 Tidsbegränsad lösning för att säkerställa tillgång till skolinformation
summary: The motion proposes a review of necessary measures to prevent, identify, and treat mental health issues among the elderly, highlighting the prevalence of anxiety and depression in this demographic. It stresses the need for improved detection of mental health conditions, which may differ in presentation and are often overlooked as part of aging. The proposal calls for increased preventive measures and education within primary care, as well as more research into the mental health of seniors, given the higher suicide rates among the elderly.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:105 Ungdomspolitisk skrivelse
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national knowledge center for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in Sweden, aimed at ensuring timely access to appropriate care for individuals suffering from PTSD. It emphasizes the significant underdiagnosis and undertreatment of PTSD patients and calls for systematic improvements in screening, treatment availability, and education across various sectors, including primary care and educational institutions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:135 Reduktionsplikt för flygfotogen
summary: The proposal suggests a comprehensive reform of the Swedish sickness insurance system, aiming to enhance security for individuals unable to work due to illness. Key suggestions include revising the rehabilitation chain, defining what constitutes 'normally occurring jobs' in the labor market, improving support for individuals transitioning back to work after illness, and prioritizing coordination efforts within the authority managing sickness benefits. The motion emphasizes the importance of a supportive framework to prevent individuals from falling into poverty due to sickness and advocates for a system that recognizes the diverse needs of those affected by illness, ensuring fair treatment and adequate support.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:159 Vissa identitetsfrågor inom utlänningsrätten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3930 av Christina Höj Larsen m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes to improve the training in insurance medicine within medical education, introduce follow-up seminars for experienced doctors, and consider changes to the sick leave process where specialized physicians take over when a sick period may become prolonged. It emphasizes the need for better communication between healthcare providers and Försäkringskassan, as well as a reassessment of current medical decision support tools to enhance the sick leave process.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:132 En förnyad strategi för politiken avseende alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och nikotin samt spel om pengar 2021–2025
summary: The motion proposes a review of the driver education for moped cars in response to a significant increase in accidents, suggesting that the current mandatory training may not adequately prepare drivers for safe operation. The authors argue that, similar to the review requested for jet ski driving due to rising incidents, a similar examination should be conducted for moped cars to address the alarming rise in accident frequency.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:150 Ett stärkt barnrättsperspektiv i vårdnadstvister
summary: The proposal advocates for the closure of the Swedish Public Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen), citing its perceived ineffectiveness and the emergence of parallel labor market initiatives by municipalities. It suggests transferring various responsibilities to municipalities, including adult education and a unified flexible wage subsidy. Furthermore, it recommends the assessment of local labor market measures by the Institute for Labour Market Policy Evaluation (IFAU) and the transfer of unemployment statistics management to Statistics Sweden (SCB).

title: Barn som bevittnar brott
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of limiting the entitlement to government-funded interpretation services in Sweden. It argues that while assistance for recent immigrants is necessary for communication with authorities, the current system allows long-term residents to demand interpretation services indefinitely, which is deemed unreasonable. The motion suggests that access to interpretation should be limited based on criteria such as completion of Swedish language education and time spent in the country, in order to encourage language learning and reduce taxpayer burden.

title: Undantag från sekretess för beslut om stöd vid korttidsarbete
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of the Social Services Act aimed at simplifying processes, enhancing legal certainty, and allowing municipalities to impose activity requirements on all recipients of financial assistance. It advocates for the removal and modification of specific sections of the act, the introduction of a cap on assistance payments, and a more uniform approach to assessments across municipalities, arguing that current discrepancies lead to unfair evaluations and extensive administrative burdens.

title: Riksrevisionens granskning av miljöskatter på lång sikt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish tax declaration should clearly indicate how taxpayers' money is allocated, including total taxes paid. It argues for increased transparency and awareness regarding public spending, suggesting that this may strengthen democracy by informing citizens about government resource management.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Förlängda ersättningar på sjukförsäkringsområdet, stöd till företag, kultur och idrott samt andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion advocates for enhanced measures against welfare fraud in Sweden, suggesting that municipalities should have the authority to conduct systematic and unannounced home visits to ensure that welfare assistance is allocated to those eligible. It proposes introducing requirements for all recipients of welfare support to participate in work-related activities, a reporting obligation for social services in cases of suspected fraud, and ensuring thorough investigations of fraud reports. The motion emphasizes the need for a more effective model for municipalities to tackle incorrect disbursements and calls for increased resources for the police to address fraud effectively.

title: Utvidgade möjligheter att utreda förlisningen av passagerarfartyget Estonia
summary: The motion proposes a national regulation to define the housing responsibility of municipalities towards newly arrived immigrants in Sweden, suggesting that this responsibility should last for a maximum of two years. This aims to address inconsistencies and perceived unfairness in how different municipalities handle housing for immigrants, ensuring that the same rules apply regardless of location. The proposal emphasizes the need for a structured approach to integration, linking housing with education and employment while maintaining that the primary responsibility for finding housing ultimately lies with the individual.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:154 Miljöstyrande start- och landningsavgifter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament reevaluates the portal paragraph governing elderly care in Sweden to ensure living conditions for the elderly are good rather than merely adequate. It highlights the inconsistent interpretation of what constitutes 'adequate living conditions' among municipalities, especially in light of the challenges faced during the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion advocates for recognition of a dignified aging process as a right throughout the country and calls for a clearer legislative framework that guarantees higher standards of support for the elderly.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:148 En effektivare konkurshantering
summary: Cecilie Tenfjord Toftby proposes a parliamentary investigation into the rights of security guards to receive compensation for damages due to personal violations, akin to the protections currently offered to police and other public service workers. The aim is to evaluate and potentially expand the circumstances under which security guards can claim financial compensation for serious violations, advocating for legislative changes that would ensure consistent treatment in cases of assault against them.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:115 Verksamheten i Europeiska unionen under 2020
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need for a revitalization of the traffic police in Sweden due to a significant increase in vehicle numbers and a simultaneous decrease in traffic police personnel. It suggests learning from the effective organizational strategies used in neighboring countries such as Norway and Germany, where civilian inspectors collaborate with the police. The motion advocates for a modernized traffic police structure to improve traffic safety and enforcement against illegal transport activities.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:133 Nationell strategi för hållbar regional utveckling i hela landet 2021-2030
summary: The proposal advocates for a long-term organization and funding plan for beach cleanup efforts along Sweden's coasts, highlighting the environmental threats posed by marine debris. It calls for the government to explore increased EU cooperation to reduce marine litter at the source and develop a sustainable strategy for waste collection and management. The motion emphasizes that the responsibility for cleaning beaches should not fall solely on municipalities or volunteer organizations, as much debris originates from international waters, and thus requires coordinated efforts across borders.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:149 Förbud mot erkännande av utländska månggiften
summary: Cecilie Tenfjord Toftby proposes a motion urging the Swedish parliament to develop concrete measures to ensure the stability of the electricity system as the share of intermittent energy sources increases. She highlights the risks posed by weather-dependent energy production, particularly during periods of low wind or sunlight, which may lead to power shortages and outages impacting both industry and society. Toftby criticizes the current government's inaction regarding these issues and emphasizes the importance of establishing a reliable electricity supply for the continuous functioning of both households and industry, recommending that the government present specific proposals to safeguard the electricity supply.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:150 Ett stärkt barnrättsperspektiv i vårdnadstvister
summary: Cecilie Tenfjord Toftby proposes that financial subsidies for electricity production should have clear goals and defined exit strategies from the outset. The motion argues that while support for emerging technologies can facilitate market entry, it is crucial to establish when and how to phase out these supports to prevent them from becoming permanent. This is essential for maintaining fair competition and ensuring that mature technologies do not become disadvantaged by prolonged subsidies, ultimately advocating for economically sustainable investments.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:159 Vissa identitetsfrågor inom utlänningsrätten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3921 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå och Jennie Åfeldt (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports an initiative to explore the possibility of a unified Nordic approach to energy production and regulation of the energy market. It emphasizes the need for energy transition to address climate change while ensuring continued economic growth and prosperity. The motion highlights the potential advantages of a coordinated effort among the Nordic countries to optimize their energy resources and strengthen their position in negotiations with the European Union regarding energy policy.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:122 Bättre studiestöd högre upp i åldrarna
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3920 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: Cecilie Tenfjord Toftby proposes that the Swedish Parliament conducts a thorough review of the current legislation on energy taxes, citing the need for transparency and public understanding of the taxes' purposes and impacts. She argues that many energy taxes are perceived as opaque and unjust, particularly as domestic households face increasing tax burdens while incentives are offered to attract foreign investors. The proposal aims to clarify the objectives of various energy taxes, examine their economic and environmental roles, and ensure that no overtaxation occurs, ultimately leading to greater public acceptance.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal advocates for a unified legal age for purchasing alcohol in Sweden, suggesting that the current standard of 18 years is inconsistent with other adult responsibilities, such as voting and military service. The motion argues that the existing age limits are illogical and allows for illegal access to alcohol by younger individuals, highlighting the risks associated with such access. The author compares Sweden's laws to Norway's differentiated age limits for different types of alcohol, suggesting that the responsibility of alcohol consumption should lie with individuals rather than establishments.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:106 Verksamheten inom Europarådets ministerkommitté under andra halvåret 2019 och helåret 2020
summary: Cecilie Tenfjord Toftby proposes that the Swedish parliament initiate a review of the Environmental Code (miljöbalken) to incorporate a clearer climate perspective, highlighting the increasing urgency of addressing climate change and its severe impacts such as flooding, wildfires, and loss of biodiversity. She emphasizes the need for a modern Environmental Code to support sustainable development and ensure responsible nature stewardship.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:134 Förbud mot otillbörliga handelsmetoder vid köp av jordbruks- och livsmedelsprodukter
summary: Cecilie Tenfjord Toftby's motion urges the Swedish Parliament to reconsider the classification of agriculture in the environmental code, arguing that it should not be labeled as environmentally harmful. The motion emphasizes the importance of the agricultural and food sectors as vital for society, particularly following the COVID-19 crisis, and advocates for the acknowledgment of their contributions to food self-sufficiency and minimal environmental impact compared to other countries.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:125 Stärkt skydd för geografiska beteckningar och tydligare regler vid registrering av varumärken och företagsnamn i ond tro
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish parliament to reduce foreign aid allocations, which have increased to 52 billion SEK for the upcoming year. The motion highlights public dissatisfaction with current aid management, citing issues such as inefficiency, corruption, and inadequate oversight in recipient countries. It calls for stricter criteria for receiving aid and aims to address the growing needs within Sweden, suggesting that the government's focus should shift towards improving domestic conditions rather than continuing significant increases in foreign aid.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:112 En heltäckande tobaksbeskattning - för ökad tydlighet och enhetlighet
summary: The motion proposes that municipalities in Sweden should be allowed to employ their own doctors, particularly to address the healthcare needs of the elderly, who often find themselves inadequately supported during the COVID-19 pandemic. It argues that having local doctors could reduce unnecessary hospital visits, improve preventive care, and strengthen medical expertise within municipalities, which may currently face challenges in collaboration with regional healthcare services.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:134 Förbud mot otillbörliga handelsmetoder vid köp av jordbruks- och livsmedelsprodukter
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into how to establish competitive tax regulations for industries heavily reliant on temporary workers, specifically focusing on the berry-picking industry in Sweden, which relies substantially on foreign labor. It highlights concerns that proposed changes to tax rules could discourage foreign workers from coming to Sweden, jeopardizing the berry industry and its economic contributions. The motion calls for a new tax reform that would ensure the competitiveness and sustainability of Swedish berry companies in the future.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:123 Undantag för deltidsbrandmän vid beräkning av arbetslöshetsersättning
summary: Motionen föreslår en översyn och skärpning av systemet med samordningsnummer för utländska medborgare i Sverige, för att förhindra och upptäcka brott relaterade till missbruk av dessa nummer, inklusive svartarbete och välfärdsbrott. Förslaget betonar behovet av bättre kontroll och samordning mellan olika myndigheter samt möjligheten att införa enhetliga system inom EU för att öka säkerheten.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:97 Slopad nedsättning av energiskatt på bränslen i vissa sektorer
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need to secure electricity supply in southern Sweden due to increased demand from growing cities, new industries, and electrification. It highlights the risk of electricity shortages hindering new development and suggests that reducing nuclear power without adequate stable energy replacements is impractical. The motion advocates for fast and effective measures, including optimizing current usage and exploring local energy production, while acknowledging the lengthy process of building new power lines.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:134 Förbud mot otillbörliga handelsmetoder vid köp av jordbruks- och livsmedelsprodukter
summary: Katarina Brännström proposes a comprehensive review of the current regulations related to beach protection in Sweden, arguing that existing laws hinder housing development near water bodies. She highlights the severe housing shortage and the need for more flexible construction opportunities near waterfronts, particularly in areas already developed. The motion advocates for local municipalities to have greater authority in determining the suitability of building on shoreline properties and for exceptions to be made for individual plots under current protections, aiming to balance development with public access to nature.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:115 Verksamheten i Europeiska unionen under 2020
summary: The motion proposes a review of the burial law to allow for more flexible options regarding the burial and scattering of ashes after death. It highlights changing societal views on death and burial practices, including the rise of civil funerals, direct cremation, and differing opinions among surviving relatives about the deceased's final resting place. The proposal seeks to address issues caused by existing regulations, which can lead to delays in burial and disagreements among family members, by allowing the division of ashes for scattering at multiple sites.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:115 Verksamheten i Europeiska unionen under 2020
summary: The motion proposes an evaluation of the possibility to outsource certain tasks of the Swedish mapping authority, Lantmäteriet, to improve efficiency and reduce long wait times that hinder construction and development in municipalities. It underscores the necessity for the government to take action to enhance service levels for the public by potentially involving additional market actors such as municipalities or contracted entrepreneurs.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:134 Förbud mot otillbörliga handelsmetoder vid köp av jordbruks- och livsmedelsprodukter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament restrict the number of vehicles that an individual can own to combat the issue of 'bilmålvakter', or vehicle proxies, who register numerous vehicles under someone else's name to evade taxes and fines. This practice not only exacerbates the financial struggles of vulnerable individuals but also contributes to a growing problem of unpaid debts. The motion calls for renewed regulatory measures to address this misuse of vehicle registration and related identifiers.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:122 Bättre studiestöd högre upp i åldrarna
summary: This congressional motion advocates for investigating the establishment of a unified system for the stockpiling of pharmaceuticals and improving transparency regarding the availability of medications in community pharmacies across Sweden. The proposal emphasizes lessons from the COVID-19 pandemic, highlighting the shortcomings in crisis preparedness related to medicine supply that arose from past regulatory changes. The authors argue for the need for a stronger governmental role in ensuring that necessary medications are available both in normal times and during crises.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:110 Ytterligare förstärkt nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för personer som arbetar med forskning eller utveckling
summary: The motion aims to enhance the work environment in Sweden by reinforcing the role and responsibilities of the Swedish Work Environment Authority (Arbetsmiljöverket). It calls for improved educational requirements and specialist knowledge within the work environment sector to decrease workplace accidents and fatalities. The proposal emphasizes the importance of collaboration between employers and employees, ensuring that both have adequate training to manage and oversee workplace safety effectively. Furthermore, it advocates for increased funding to the authority to bolster its inspection capabilities and support preventive efforts.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:118 Tillfällig nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för upp till två anställda
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for improved infrastructure in Jönköping County to facilitate economic growth and enhance mobility for residents. It advocates for investments in transportation networks, including railways, roads, and broadband access, as essential for job creation, safety, and a sustainable economy. Moreover, it asserts that the government should ensure the maintenance and expansion of infrastructure, especially in areas underserved due to market limitations, while addressing specific projects that link various regions and promote regional employment opportunities.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:116 Riksrevisionens rapport om granskningsnämndens granskning av public service
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for equal and accessible dental care for all citizens, highlighting the ongoing disparities in oral health influenced by economic status and disability. It calls for improvements in the dental care system to mitigate health inequalities, particularly for low-income individuals and those with disabilities. The proponents argue for the development of dental insurance that focuses on regular and preventive care, particularly for the growing elderly population who require more regular dental services. The motion seeks legislative support to ensure that dental health is not determined by social class.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:110 Ytterligare förstärkt nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för personer som arbetar med forskning eller utveckling
summary: The motion proposes a review of legislation to ensure that economic assistance payments are distributed equally among all adults in a household, rather than primarily to one person, often the male partner. The aim is to promote gender equality and economic independence for women, addressing the current disparities in how municipalities administer these payments, which can perpetuate women's dependency and limit their ability to escape harmful relationships.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:117 Riksrevisionens rapport om Sidas garantiverksamhet
summary: The motion addresses local electricity shortages and pricing discrepancies in Sweden, particularly focusing on the challenges faced by the Malmö region and Mälardalen due to increased electricity demand from growing urban areas and industrial expansion. It emphasizes the need for the government to expedite the construction of new power lines and local energy production measures to alleviate these shortages. The motion also critiques the current division of Sweden into electricity pricing areas, which has led to higher costs for consumers and businesses in southern Sweden, suggesting that the government should consider enhancing grid capacity and streamline the expansion of electricity networks.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:113 Utökad befrielse från energiskatt för egenproducerad el
summary: The motion proposes to improve the pension system in Sweden to ensure that all pensioners receive at least 70% of their previous income. It highlights the inadequate pension contributions made during working years, particularly affecting blue-collar workers and women in low-wage jobs. The motion calls for a system that considers the number of working years rather than solely the retirement age. It stresses the need for better working conditions and an overhaul of the premium pension system to protect pension funds from excessive private fees and ensure that pensioners benefit from their contributions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:97 Slopad nedsättning av energiskatt på bränslen i vissa sektorer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider introducing sanctions against employers who fail to fulfill their obligation to provide employment certificates necessary for workers applying for unemployment benefits. The motion emphasizes the importance of a timely transition to unemployment benefits for individuals facing financial uncertainty and highlights the need for a balance in responsibilities between employees and employers within the unemployment insurance system.

title: Återkallelse av proposition 2020/21:64 En konsultationsordning i frågor som rör det samiska folket
summary: The motion calls for a review of how individuals can be better protected from unwanted use of personal data amidst rapid digitalization. It highlights concerns regarding personal integrity, the ownership of individual information, and the need for political solutions to ensure that personal data is safeguarded against misuse by both public authorities and private corporations. The authors advocate for potential regulations to enhance transparency and protect individuals' rights in the digital space.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om särskild löneskatt för äldre
summary: This motion calls for a ban on the sale of toy guns that resemble real firearms, highlighting concerns over safety and the impact of such toys on children's perception of violence. It references a tragic incident where a young man with Down syndrome was mistakenly shot by police who believed he was armed with a real weapon. The motion argues that the availability of realistic toy weapons contributes to violent play among children and creates dangerous situations for the public, advocating for the consideration of legislation to prohibit these toys.

title: Löneutmätning och digitala ansökningar i utsökningsförfarandet
summary: The proposal calls for a review of the regulations concerning personal watercraft, specifically jet skis, based on suggestions from the Agency for Marine and Water Management from 2013. The motion highlights concerns over rising speeds, safety issues, and increased accidents associated with jet skis. It suggests implementing a high-speed certificate for vessels reaching at least 35 knots and a qualification certificate for crafts capable of 15 knots, as well as reviewing existing regulations related to personal watercraft.

title: Skärpt kontroll över explosiva varor
summary: The motion proposes improving infrastructure in Västsverige by studying necessary conditions and making investments in transportation systems, including railways, ports, and air travel. Key recommendations include enhancing the reliability and capacity of rail services, deepening the harbor in Gothenburg, and developing Landvetter Airport to become a significant hub. The motion emphasizes the importance of infrastructure for economic growth and environmental considerations, particularly regarding electrification and sustainability in transport.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om utgiftstaket
summary: The motion advocates for a collaborative approach to housing for newly arrived asylum seekers, proposing that municipalities share the responsibility regardless of their political affiliations. It highlights that better integration can be achieved by distributing asylum seekers across diverse housing areas to avoid social issues caused by concentrated populations in socioeconomically challenged locales. The motion references past reports and legislative changes regarding the management of asylum seekers' independent housing, calling for ongoing monitoring and additional measures if current laws prove inadequate.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om tillämpningen av det finanspolitiska ramverket 2020
summary: The motion proposes measures to strengthen local and coastal Baltic Sea fishing in Skåne and Blekinge, addressing challenges such as the current cod fishing ban and calls for governmental support to enhance sustainable development, jobs, and entrepreneurship in the sector. It emphasizes collaboration among municipalities, research institutions, and private companies to foster innovation and improve ecological understanding of the marine environment, while promoting local food production and job growth in the fishing industry.

title: Barns och ungas läsning
summary: This motion by Per-Arne Håkansson and others emphasizes the importance of strengthening the tourism sector in Skåne, recognizing it as a key national interest due to its significant contribution to the economy and its status as a top destination in Europe. The proposal calls for a strategic development program involving collaboration between government and industry stakeholders to enhance international marketing efforts and promote sustainable tourism development to accommodate increasing visitor numbers while preserving the area's natural and cultural resources.
