title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:125 Stärkt skydd för geografiska beteckningar och tydligare regler vid registrering av varumärken och företagsnamn i ond tro
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen climate cooperation at various governmental levels to combat coastal erosion along the coasts of Skåne and Halland, which are particularly vulnerable to rising sea levels and severe weather due to climate change. It emphasizes the need for enhanced support and collaboration among municipalities and regional authorities, as well as leveraging expertise from key national agencies to implement effective erosion prevention measures, including soft and hard erosion controls, thereby ensuring the sustainability and safety of these vital coastal areas.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:119 En ny fastighetsmäklarlag - förstärkt tillsyn över fastighetsmäklarbranschen
summary: The motion proposes a review of the distribution of state support for regional airports in Sweden to ensure the continued operation of the Ängelholm-Helsingborg airport, which is owned and operated by a joint company of seven municipalities in northwestern Skåne. It emphasizes the importance of regional airports for Sweden's overall infrastructure, economy, and competitiveness, and highlights the need for state involvement to guarantee good transport connectivity while also addressing environmental impacts and improving operational efficiency within the aviation sector.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:117 Riksrevisionens rapport om Sidas garantiverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes improvements to the E6 motorway through Skåne by expanding sections to three lanes. It emphasizes the motorway's significance for both commuters and the economy, particularly due to heavy traffic from the Öresund Bridge and Trelleborg's port. The need for expansion is driven by increasing traffic volumes, including a high percentage of heavy trucks. The motion highlights previous studies by Trafikverket that recommend further enhancements to manage congestion and improve infrastructure for the growing population and regional traffic demands.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:152 Vissa insatser för ökad lärarkompetens
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the idea of nationwide information campaigns aimed at reducing the consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages and promoting public health. It emphasizes the importance of preventive measures and public awareness regarding health issues, particularly among children, and suggests exploring taxation on sugary drinks as a potential effective strategy. The motion highlights the need for collaboration with schools and community organizations to facilitate these efforts and notes the socioeconomic factors that influence health behaviors.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:103 Kommittéberättelse - kommittéernas verksamhet under 2020
summary: This motion advocates for a review of the conditions for the continued development of municipal cultural schools in Sweden, highlighting the importance of accessible cultural education for children and youth. The proposal emphasizes the role of cultural schools in fostering artistic talent and social engagement, the economic implications for local communities, and the challenges posed by budget cuts and prioritization against other municipal needs such as elderly care. It urges the government to ensure that all children have the opportunity to participate in cultural activities, regardless of their socioeconomic background or geographical location.

title: Förebyggande av våld i nära relationer
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the possibility of implementing controls and quality assurance for treatment homes and their methods in the context of substance abuse care. The aim is to ensure individuals receive adequate support for recovery, while also addressing the financial balance challenges faced by municipalities. The motion emphasizes the importance of following up on treatment and aftercare to minimize the risk of relapse, advocating for a standardized system to enhance the effectiveness of treatment programs.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:120 Ökad säkerhet för vissa identitets- och uppehållshandlingar - anpassning av svensk rätt till en ny EU-förordning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3894 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå och Jennie Åfeldt (båda SD)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for social initiatives to prevent and reduce the risk of youth choosing a criminal lifestyle, particularly in socially vulnerable areas. It advocates for the development of social services in these regions and the establishment of a clearer link between social work and relevant research. The motion calls for timely preventative measures, such as placing social workers in schools and enhancing collaborations among various stakeholders to support at-risk children and youth, while also stressing the importance of research to identify effective interventions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:154 Miljöstyrande start- och landningsavgifter
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need to improve digital infrastructure across Sweden, ensuring equitable access to fast internet for all households and businesses, regardless of their location. It advocates for a faster expansion of broadband and mobile networks to meet the increasing demands for digital connectivity, especially in underserved areas like Dalarna, where connectivity is lacking. The proposal calls for government action to bolster digital infrastructure, recognizing its critical role in daily activities such as e-commerce, banking, and distance learning.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:108 Riksrevisionens rapport om Polismyndighetens arbete i utsatta områden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate and enhance police powers to combat disruptive noises, particularly from vehicles playing loud music during the night. It highlights the negative impact of such disturbances on local communities, the economy, and the ability of residents to live and work comfortably. The authors argue that current legislation limits police intervention, suggesting that improved tools are necessary to help maintain public peace and respect within society.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:108 Riksrevisionens rapport om Polismyndighetens arbete i utsatta områden
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive review of the conditions for job creation in rural areas of Sweden. It emphasizes the need for the state to ensure access to basic commercial and public services, as well as post-secondary education across the country. The motion highlights the importance of improving mobile coverage, broadband, and transportation, while also suggesting measures to support green industries, local raw material production, and the simplification of regulations for small-scale food production. By enhancing rural tourism and creating more jobs, the suggestion aims to contribute to sustainable development and quality of life in rural areas.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:122 Bättre studiestöd högre upp i åldrarna
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden ensure fair and secure treatment for LGBTQ+ refugees within the framework of the EU's common asylum system. It highlights the need for Sweden to reassess its strict migration laws and emphasizes the importance of protecting vulnerable refugee groups, including LGBTQ+ individuals, amidst worsening global conditions. The authors argue that current laws contribute to exploitation and undermine the Swedish labor market, advocating for reforms to support proper integration and uphold the right to asylum.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:108 Riksrevisionens rapport om Polismyndighetens arbete i utsatta områden
summary: The proposal advocates for standardized tobacco packaging in Sweden to reduce smoking prevalence and associated healthcare costs. It highlights that smoking costs society over 31 billion kronor annually, equating to the expenses of primary healthcare providers. The suggested packaging would be neutral, minimizing branding and appealing less to tobacco users, thereby discouraging consumption. The motion references successful implementations of similar measures in several countries and EU guidelines supporting such initiatives.

title: Säkrare samordningsnummer och bättre förutsättningar för korrekta uppgifter i folkbokföringen
summary: The motion calls for increased competence within the judiciary regarding hate crimes targeting LGBTQ+ individuals, emphasizing the need for comprehensive education and training on these issues for law enforcement and legal authorities. It highlights the necessity for better preventive measures and investigations into hate crimes, greater research awareness, and the importance of creating an inclusive environment where LGBTQ+ individuals feel safe to report such offenses.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:107 Fortsatt giltighet av lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to push for the European Union to develop an action plan aimed at protecting and promoting the human rights of LGBTQ+ individuals within the EU. It highlights the discrimination, oppression, and violence faced by LGBTQ+ people globally, particularly in countries where homosexuality is criminalized. The proposal emphasizes Sweden's role in supporting international LGBTQ+ rights, especially in the face of regressive policies in certain EU member states, and calls for stronger measures to ensure that fundamental human rights are upheld across the Union.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:108 Riksrevisionens rapport om Polismyndighetens arbete i utsatta områden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3887 av Johan Hedin och Helena Vilhelmsson (båda C)
summary: This proposal aims to establish Sweden as a strong advocate for LGBTQ+ rights on the international stage, urging the government to take active steps in UN bodies and other intergovernmental organizations to promote a convention against discrimination based on sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression. It emphasizes increasing aid efforts for LGBTQ+ rights in development work and promoting comprehensive EU legislation on discrimination that includes all grounds outside the labor market, as well as recognizing registered partnerships and same-sex marriages across the EU.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers enhancing LGBTQ+ competence in schools by ensuring that all staff in preschools, schools, and leisure activities possess this knowledge. It calls for LGBTQ+ education to be mandatory in relevant teacher training programs and emphasizes the need for a safe and inclusive environment for all children, particularly those identifying as LGBTQ+. It advocates for a curriculum that informs students about various sexual orientations, gender expressions, and identities, while aiming to eliminate prejudice and promote sexual health.

title: Med anledning av prop. 2020/21:107 Fortsatt giltighet av lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of 'lex Sarah' in schools to strengthen efforts against abusive treatment, harassment, and discrimination. It suggests that school staff should be required to report such misconduct and emphasizes the need for adequate training to prevent and handle these situations. There is also a call for an investigation into how to effectively enforce these regulations while considering the administrative burden on teachers.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:136 Möjlighet för regeringen att tillfälligt frångå huvudregeln för fördelning av platser vid urval till högskolan vid extraordinära händelser i fredstid
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3884 av Ilona Szatmari Waldau m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider allowing children to have more than two legal guardians, reflecting the diversity of modern family structures and acknowledging the challenges posed by current legislation. The proposal argues that the restriction to two guardians does not serve the best interests of children, particularly those in blended families or with same-sex parents, as it excludes non-biological parents from legal decision-making roles in areas such as education and healthcare.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:108 Riksrevisionens rapport om Polismyndighetens arbete i utsatta områden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3883 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the use of generic names for medications in prescriptions to improve patient awareness and reduce confusion, especially among elderly patients. The author emphasizes that patients often do not recognize the names of their medications, which can lead to issues in emergencies and general health management. The motion suggests that using the substance name in prescriptions and labeling would mitigate these problems and maintain consistency despite any substitution of medications.

title: Vissa identitetsfrågor inom utlänningsrätten
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establishes legislation to prohibit racist and anti-democratic organizations in light of their increasing activities and associated violence. It calls for a review to be conducted, especially regarding necessary amendments to existing laws to ensure that such organizations can be criminalized, in accordance with Swedish constitutional principles and international human rights conventions.

title: Material och produkter avsedda att komma i kontakt med livsmedel
summary: The motion proposes to exempt municipalities with their own city networks from the localization principle for broadband expansion, arguing that this exemption would expedite the development of broadband infrastructure, which has significantly slowed in recent years. The motion highlights the urgent need for robust internet connections, particularly in rural areas, as the pandemic has underscored the importance of reliable broadband access. It suggests that removing this regulatory barrier could enhance efficiency in broadband deployment, similar to existing exceptions for essential infrastructure like water and energy.

title: Justerad beräkning av bilförmån
summary: The motion proposes that dental care be included in the high-cost protection framework of the healthcare system to alleviate the financial burden on individuals, especially those with lower incomes or who are socioeconomically disadvantaged, thus ensuring better access to dental services.

title: Ändringar i regelverket om hantering av finansiella företag i kris
summary: Denis Begic's motion proposes to make investment support for rental apartments more effective to address the shortage of private landlords constructing rental properties. The proposal suggests that by improving investment support, particularly for building in less populated areas, the costs of constructing rental properties can decrease, leading to more affordable housing. Modifications to the investment support mechanism are recommended, including long-term low-interest loans and tax deductions for landlords who commit to long-term ownership, thus discouraging speculation in the rental market.

title: Miljöstyrande start- och landningsavgifter
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at enhancing sports engagement in Sweden, particularly in underserved areas. It emphasizes collaboration between civil society organizations and sports federations to create local sports clubs, formulate a national strategy for organizing championships, improve access to sports for individuals with intellectual disabilities and parasports, as well as ensure that seniors have opportunities for physical activity. The proposal also advocates for improved tax regulations for sports organizations, the establishment of an infrastructure for para-sport equipment, funding for sports facilities, and addressing doping within amateur sports. Overall, it seeks to strengthen Sweden's sports culture and infrastructure, promote inclusivity, and enhance community engagement through sports.

title: Gränsöverskridande tillgång till radio- och tv-program
summary: The motion highlights the significance of the equestrian industry in Sweden, advocating for measures to recognize its benefits, improve rider safety through designated paths, ensure adequate horse feeding, establish a national animal welfare police, mandate daily outdoor access for horses, and suggest the creation of a northern-to-southern riding trail to boost equestrian tourism. It seeks to counteract proposals perceived as detrimental to this sector and emphasizes the industry's role in health, employment, and cultural preservation.

title: Vissa insatser för ökad lärarkompetens
summary: The proposal seeks to recognize and commemorate the Swedish population in historical emigration areas, particularly focusing on the Swedish-speaking communities in South America, such as in Argentina and Brazil. It emphasizes the importance of preserving and promoting knowledge about these communities' dialects and cultures, which are largely unknown in Sweden. The motion calls for governmental action to support efforts in valuing this heritage and raising awareness in Swedish education about these historical connections.

title: Ett stärkt barnrättsperspektiv i vårdnadstvister
summary: The proposal advocates for increased support and integration of outdoor recreation (friluftsliv) into various societal sectors in Sweden, with specific measures including investigating potential Nordic collaborations, reintroducing regulated outdoor school days, and addressing the legal status of outdoor activities in relation to health and social security laws. It emphasizes the importance of outdoor life for public health, education, and environmental stewardship.

title: Förbud mot erkännande av utländska månggiften
summary: The proposal aims to recognize e-sport as an official sport in Sweden, equating it with traditional sports in various legislative contexts, including cultural recognition and immigration policies for e-sport athletes. The motion seeks to lower VAT on digital games and promote inclusivity in e-sport, particularly encouraging participation among seniors. Additionally, it suggests the establishment of an e-sports institute to foster industry growth and address concerns like online fraud and ensure equality in funding and opportunities within e-sport.

title: En effektivare konkurshantering
summary: The motion proposed by the Sweden Democrats advocates for equal grading standards for individuals studying general courses in folk high schools, calls for the establishment of an independent body to manage funding allocation for folk education, urges a review to prevent fraud and improper disbursement of funds, and suggests that general courses should constitute approximately 15% of state-funded activities at folk high schools.

title: Verksamheten inom Organisationen för säkerhet och samarbete i Europa (OSSE) under andra halvåret 2019 och hela kalenderåret 2020
summary: The proposal from the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the need for a comprehensive reform of Swedish film policy, outlining strategies to enhance industry collaboration, improve funding mechanisms, and address issues such as illegal distribution of films. It calls for new financial models, a review of regional cinema taxation, and greater support for domestic films while ensuring that industry stakeholders have a more significant role in policymaking. Additionally, it suggests studying potential collaborations with other Nordic countries to boost film production incentives, thereby revitalizing the Swedish film industry.

title: Klimatdeklaration för byggnader
summary: The motion proposes to enhance Sweden's national library strategy by improving digital library services, creating a plan to ensure libraries remain safe environments for study, and revising library laws to strengthen the position of the Swedish language. It emphasizes the importance of libraries as places of knowledge and study, advocating for adequate funding for the digitization of cultural heritage and maintaining a quiet atmosphere in libraries.

title: Institutet för mänskliga rättigheter
summary: The motion advocates for increased public influence in the design of architectural and public spaces in Sweden, proposing measures such as local beauty councils in municipalities and the reinforcement of cultural environmental competence. It emphasizes the need for aesthetic quality and historical preservation in architecture, addressing public dissatisfaction with modern structures, while also calling for the implementation of architectural programs and regulations to prevent past demolition trends from recurring.

title: Regler om internationellt samarbete anpassas till nya regler om skyddstillsyn och tillträdesförbud till butik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate whether the use of headphones while driving poses a risk in traffic. It highlights the increasing prevalence of headphones designed to block out ambient sounds, which can distract drivers and lead to traffic accidents. The motion argues for the need to evaluate all potential traffic risks to support the government's goal of halving traffic fatalities by 2030, especially in light of past regulations prohibiting the use of handheld mobile phones while driving.

title: Ett modernt regelverk för Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: The proposal advocates for the continued relocation of state authorities to areas with low localization rates to ensure equal access to government services across Sweden. It highlights the need for a strong state presence in all regions to prevent urbanization effects and improve local and regional development, as well as to address disparities between urban and rural areas. The motion builds on previous efforts made from 2014 to 2018 to relocate agencies from Stockholm and calls for the reinforcement of existing regional organizational structures.

title: Uppsägning av skatteavtalet mellan Sverige och Portugal
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government ensure that regional authorities, the police, and the Public Prosecution Authority have the necessary tools and resources to effectively investigate hate crimes in Sápmi, particularly in light of rising hostility and threats against the Sami population following the Girjas ruling. The author highlights the challenges faced by law enforcement in addressing these crimes, especially those occurring on social media, and calls for better understanding of the underlying conflicts within the local communities that contribute to these issues.

title: Uppsägning av skatteavtalet mellan Sverige och Grekland
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of a robust state industrial policy to ensure a sustainable and competitive industrial sector in Sweden. It advocates for increased regional and national power transfer capacity in electrical grids, highlighting the necessary investments in research and development to foster economic growth through innovation. The motion supports the ongoing initiative 'Industriklivet', aimed at aiding the industrial sector's transition towards zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2045, while also underscoring the need for improved infrastructure to accommodate new green industrial establishments, especially in northern Sweden.

title: Reduktionsplikt för flygfotogen
summary: The motion advocates for state-owned companies to serve as exemplary employers by ensuring that they hire staff directly instead of relying on staffing agencies. It highlights the negative impact of temporary employment practices on workers' mental and physical health, and seeks to enforce regulations that would limit the use of temporary staffing to short periods, promoting job security within state enterprises.

title: Privat initiativrätt - planintressentens medverkan vid detaljplaneläggning
summary: The motion proposes a thorough investigation into the conditions and protection available for women and children living under significant threat, as they often have to hide their identities and relocate to escape dangerous situations. It highlights the challenges faced by approximately 800 women in Sweden who are forced to live in hiding due to threats from violent partners, emphasizing the lack of support and the responsibility placed on them to maintain their anonymity amidst digital challenges. The motion calls for a comprehensive understanding of their living conditions, including the dangers of exposed protected information and the impacts on children who are also affected, aiming to propose necessary changes to enhance their safety and life circumstances.

title: Genomförande av ändringar i Solvens II-direktivet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports an evaluation of expanded compensation models for property owners affected by the construction of electric connections. This comes in light of the need to address network capacity shortages that can lead to regional energy imbalances, emphasizing the importance of upgrading and expanding the national grid to ensure sufficient electricity transportation. The proposal highlights that existing processes for determining compensation can be slow and complicated, and more flexible models could facilitate quicker resolutions and enhance the expansion of the electricity network.

title: Politik för konstnärers villkor
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a fair national intellectual property strategy for Sweden's cultural and creative industries, emphasizing the need to support and protect the intellectual property rights of creators and businesses. It highlights the significance of these sectors to Sweden's economy and global cultural influence, particularly in music, and calls for government intervention to modernize the regulatory framework ensuring fair competition and compensation for creators, particularly in the face of evolving digital platforms.

title: Ungdomspolitisk skrivelse
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a national knowledge center for intellectual property rights in Sweden, aimed at enhancing understanding and expertise in this crucial area for innovation and economic growth. The center would provide support and resources to various stakeholders including public procurement officials, educational institutions, and small and medium-sized enterprises, addressing the current knowledge gap in intellectual property issues and facilitating collaboration between academia and industry.

title: Nordiskt samarbete 2020
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a dedicated Data and Digitalization Committee in the Swedish Parliament to effectively manage the increasing complexities related to digitalization, data handling, and its impact on various societal aspects. It argues that such a committee would provide the necessary focus and leadership to address future challenges in technology, economy, democracy, and public administration as Sweden aims to be a leader in harnessing the opportunities provided by digitalization.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:124 Transportstyrelsens olycksdatabas
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament support the idea of investigating the possibility of the State Property Agency taking over ownership of Österbybruk's manor to ensure the conservation and long-term management of the area. This is in response to the current deterioration of the historic site, which is facing a significant threat due to insufficient maintenance resources from the Bruno Liljefors Foundation. The unique and well-preserved cultural heritage site from the 18th century is deemed invaluable and has potential for future tourism.

title: Nationell strategi för hållbar regional utveckling i hela landet 2021-2030
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should ensure that municipalities and regions comply with the new minority legislation, which has been in effect since January 2019. It calls for improved coordination and follow-up activities to address the significant knowledge gaps and prejudices regarding national minority rights among staff in various sectors, particularly in elderly care and healthcare. The motion emphasizes the need for better training, standardization, and potential sanctions for non-compliance to guarantee that the rights of national minorities are upheld in accordance with international human rights commitments.

title: En förnyad strategi för politiken avseende alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och nikotin samt spel om pengar 2021–2025
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a new paragraph in Chapter 5 of the Tort Liability Act to improve the handling of personal injury claims by insurers. It emphasizes the need for oversight on medical assessments to ensure quality and objectivity, taking into account potential conflicts of interest and the necessity for insurers to provide clear, understandable information throughout the claims process. The aim is to facilitate quicker and more reliable medical evaluations for those injured, ultimately preventing prolonged court proceedings and ensuring compliance with the conclusions drawn by the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om statliga stöd med delat myndighetsansvar
summary: The motion proposes to reintroduce the concept of sports into the Planning and Building Act (PBL) to address the inequalities in access to sports facilities and areas for spontaneous sports among different regions and municipalities. It emphasizes the importance of sports for public health and calls for clear requirements for municipalities to consider the need for sports facilities in urban planning, in line with previous provisions in the PBL.

title: Tidsbegränsad lösning för att säkerställa tillgång till skolinformation
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of Mittuniversitetet for Sweden's growth and welfare by highlighting the need for increased investment in higher education and research. It argues that a well-educated populace is crucial for competitiveness in the global market and that educational opportunities must be accessible to all, regardless of background. The proposal calls for the government to acknowledge Mittuniversitetet's role in fostering regional development and producing skilled workers necessary for the job market.

title: Bättre studiestöd högre upp i åldrarna
summary: The motion proposes a review of the permitting processes in Sweden to improve clarity and efficiency, particularly for industrial and infrastructure projects. It emphasizes the need for a maximum time limit for the decision-making process without compromising democratic opportunities for public input, aiming to reduce uncertainty for investors and facilitate timely investments.

title: Verksamheten i Europeiska unionen under 2020
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to expedite the development of the New Ostkustbanan railway, emphasizing its importance for regional population growth, industrial transport, and environmental benefits. It highlights the necessity of enhanced railway infrastructure to support the substantial growth of goods transport, particularly in Norrland, and to improve job accessibility in the area. The motion also points to the strategic importance of the Ostkustbanan within the European Union's transport corridors, arguing that timely investment in this railway will positively impact employment, climate, and the economy.

title: Verksamheten inom Europarådets ministerkommitté under andra halvåret 2019 och helåret 2020
summary: The motion advocates for improved energy supply to strengthen Sweden's economy and support the growth of both large and small businesses. It emphasizes the need for reliable and competitively priced electricity to enable a transition to a fully renewable energy system by 2040. The proposal highlights the importance of energy security for sustainable global growth and addresses concerns about insufficient energy provision in Västmanland, which could impede potential investments and job creation in the region.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:94 Särskilt investeringsutrymme för elnätsverksamhet - investeringar i ökad nätkapacitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3881 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the relocation of state agencies to Blekinge, emphasizing the need for increased government presence in the region to foster community cohesion and counteract the centralization trend that has historically favored larger cities. The motion highlights the economic benefits of establishing government jobs in Blekinge, including growth in local job markets and enhanced regional attractiveness, while also referencing previous successful relocations of government agencies to bolster state service accessibility across Sweden.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:94 Särskilt investeringsutrymme för elnätsverksamhet - investeringar i ökad nätkapacitet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the government in studying the conditions for the expansion of E22 in longer and more cohesive sections, emphasizing the importance of planned investments in the highway. E22 is deemed vital for regional development in Blekinge and southeastern Sweden, serving as a crucial transportation route that faces challenges such as uneven quality and bottlenecks that hinder economic growth. The motion stresses the necessity for timely investments and a holistic approach to roadworks associated with E22 to ensure safety and environmental considerations.

title: Förbud mot otillbörliga handelsmetoder vid köp av jordbruks- och livsmedelsprodukter
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish Parliament to support investments in the Sydostlänken infrastructure project, which aims to enhance transportation flexibility, integrate key regions into a unified labor market, and improve the competitiveness of the area by connecting Swedish transport corridors with those in the Baltic region. It argues that the project is not only essential for local businesses like Volvo and Ikea but also deemed economically viable by Trafikverket, emphasizing its significance for national infrastructure and economic growth.

title: Ändrade regler för mervärdesskatt vid handel med avfall och skrot
summary: The motion proposes an increase in vocational college placements in Blekinge, highlighting a national shortage of skilled labor in various professions. It argues for equitable distribution of educational opportunities across Sweden, asserting that the state has a responsibility to support the workforce needs of all regions, not just the larger cities. The authors emphasize the importance of vocational education in meeting labor market demands and fostering regional growth.

title: Värdlandsavtal mellan Sverige och Banken för internationell betalningsutjämning
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a legal right to buy out historical tenancies in Sweden, aiming to abolish the remnants of a feudal system that has persisted since the 1600s and 1700s. The authors argue that the current system restricts farmers from purchasing the lands they have cultivated for generations, as it favors landowners from the nobility. They highlight that Sweden is unique in retaining these historical tenancies compared to other Nordic countries, and they call for reform to align Sweden with modern democratic and equitable principles.

title: Utbyte av körkort som utfärdats i Färöarna eller Förenade kungariket
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should explore the possibility of implementing a unified return and deposit system for glass bottles, PET bottles, and beverage cans within the EU. The rationale is based on the existing successful deposit system in Sweden and the growing cross-border trade within the EU. Such a system would help ensure that packaging does not end up in landfills or nature, thus promoting recycling and sustainability.

title: Stärkt skydd för geografiska beteckningar och tydligare regler vid registrering av varumärken och företagsnamn i ond tro
summary: The proposal suggests reviewing the Sustainability Reporting Act to enhance the engagement of over 1,500 companies, which represent approximately 45% of all employment, in structured sustainability practices. It emphasizes the necessity for further actions to fulfill the goals outlined in Agenda 2030. The motion calls for increased dialogue between the government and societal actors regarding the potential imposition of expanded sustainability reporting requirements, particularly addressing the loophole that allows subsidiary companies to circumvent these responsibilities if their parent company fulfills the reporting obligations.

title: Undantag för deltidsbrandmän vid beräkning av arbetslöshetsersättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers relocating government agencies to Halland to enhance regional participation in government operations. It asserts that the absence of state presence diminishes a sense of community and may lead to polarization. The motion references previous efforts to decentralize government functions from Stockholm and advocates for Halland to be among the next regions to receive such relocations.

title: Ökad säkerhet för vissa identitets- och uppehållshandlingar - anpassning av svensk rätt till en ny EU-förordning
summary: The motion calls for a review of measures to strengthen equal maternity and childbirth care across Sweden, addressing disparities in access and quality of care. It highlights ongoing variations in maternal health services, linked to socioeconomic factors such as women's education levels, and emphasizes the need for individualized aftercare as well as accessibility to care before, during, and after childbirth. The proposal aims to ensure women's safety and health during the maternity process, advocating for equitable healthcare availability nationwide.

title: En ny fastighetsmäklarlag - förstärkt tillsyn över fastighetsmäklarbranschen
summary: The motion proposes an examination of opportunities to ensure gender-equal research and knowledge regarding diabetes and cardiovascular diseases. It highlights existing inequalities in healthcare access and understanding, particularly regarding the differences in how diseases affect women compared to men. The authors stress the need for improved knowledge in primary care to ensure women receive timely and appropriate treatment for these conditions, advocating for national measures to balance healthcare outcomes between genders.

title: Tillfällig nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för upp till två anställda
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should review sexual crime legislation to ensure that purchasing sex always results in incarceration. It emphasizes that current penalties, which often only involve fines or a maximum of one year in prison, fail to adequately convey the severity of the crime. The authors argue that stricter penalties would send a strong message about the unacceptability of such offenses and support gender equality by addressing the underlying issues of trafficking and exploitation.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om Sidas garantiverksamhet
summary: The proposal seeks to amend Swedish law by removing the requirement of double criminality for purchasing sexual services abroad. It argues that the current legislation, which allows Swedish citizens to legally buy sex abroad, undermines the seriousness of the crime and contributes to the exploitation of women's bodies. The motion emphasizes that strengthening the sex purchase legislation is vital to combat human trafficking, as many trafficking victims are exploited for sexual purposes.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om granskningsnämndens granskning av public service
summary: The motion proposes reviewing legislation regarding custodial rights for parents who engage in violence, emphasizing the need for courts to conduct documented risk assessments in custody disputes. The authors highlight findings that demonstrate a lack of accountability in courts, where violent parents often retain custody despite evidence of domestic violence. The proposal aims to prioritize children's safety and rights in custody decisions, countering current practices that focus more on parental access than on the best interests of the child.

title: Utökad befrielse från energiskatt för egenproducerad el
summary: The motion advocates for strengthening Sweden's efforts to support the rights of the Sahrawi people in Western Sahara, which is under Moroccan occupation. It calls for increased awareness and humanitarian assistance for those in refugee camps, the need for clearer guidelines for Swedish companies to avoid investments that might infringe on human rights, and stronger demands for legitimate agreements regarding natural resources with Sahrawi representatives. The proposal emphasizes Sweden's role in upholding human rights and adhering to international regulations.

title: En heltäckande tobaksbeskattning - för ökad tydlighet och enhetlighet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers how to make preschool more equitable across the country, emphasizing the importance of all children attending preschool. It highlights preschool's role in laying the foundation for lifelong learning and reducing dependency on welfare systems, particularly for girls and children from lower-educated families. The motion suggests exploring the possibility of mandatory preschool from the age of two, providing childcare support during evenings, holidays, and weekends, and making preschool free of charge, aiming to ensure that financial circumstances do not hinder any child's development.

title: Genomförande av bestämmelsen i EU:s direktiv mot skatteundandraganden för att motverka omvända hybrida missmatchningar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider reducing the size of preschool groups to better accommodate the diverse needs of children. It argues that smaller groups would enhance children's development by providing a more balanced composition in terms of gender, age, ethnicity, and social background, ultimately fostering a more supportive learning environment. The motion emphasizes the importance of giving preschool staff the best possible conditions to fulfill their roles effectively and ensuring that all children have equal opportunities to develop freely according to their individual needs.

title: Ytterligare förstärkt nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för personer som arbetar med forskning eller utveckling
summary: The proposal aims to enhance gender equality in the labor market by addressing existing economic barriers to further education, improving workforce competency, and strengthening vocational training. It highlights the increased unemployment due to the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly among young women who work in sectors with poor conditions. The motion calls for actions to equalize employment opportunities and compensation between genders, encourage women's access to various professions, and ensure that education and job security are accessible to all, emphasizing the importance of comprehensive measures for a more equitable society.

title: Kommittéberättelse - kommittéernas verksamhet under 2020
summary: The proposal advocates for national regulations to ensure that all children in Sweden have access to municipal culture schools, emphasizing equality and democracy. It highlights the importance of culture schools for children's development and argues that recent trends of reduced municipal resources and privatization threaten access. The motion calls for the government to consider measures that make culture schools available statewide, regardless of a child's background or family's financial situation, and likens this to existing national library legislation.

title: Slopad nedsättning av energiskatt på bränslen i vissa sektorer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the development of a national strategy for hydrogen production and carbon dioxide storage, urging the government to explore effective means to accelerate green hydrogen production and utilization as part of the effort to reduce emissions. It emphasizes the importance of fostering both hydrogen technologies and carbon capture systems to address greenhouse gas emissions from industrial processes, advocating for increased research and international cooperation in these areas.

title: Riksdagens skrivelser till regeringen - åtgärder under 2020
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament instructs the government to ensure that police always file a report to social services for individuals convicted of purchasing sex who are also guardians of children. The motion emphasizes the protection of children and the need for stricter penalties for sex buyers, as many are involved in human trafficking and pose a potential risk to children's safety. It argues that making such reports mandatory would align with children's rights and bolster efforts against human trafficking in the EU.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:121 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 – Förlängda och förstärkta stöd vid korttidsarbete och omställningsstöd för företag med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: This parliamentary motion advocates for governmental support for e-sports in Sweden, citing its rapid growth and importance as a modern form of sport. It notes that e-sports have become internationally significant and calls for changes in regulations to facilitate player mobility and recognition of e-sports athletes akin to traditional sports. The motion emphasizes the need for updated legislation to sustain and promote the development of e-sports in the country.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:121 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 – Förlängda och förstärkta stöd vid korttidsarbete och omställningsstöd för företag med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider integrating security guards into authorized companies to ensure they can perform their duties effectively. The motion highlights the importance of public trust in security personnel, especially given past reports of excessive force and discrimination within the entertainment sector. The proposal aims to strengthen the legitimacy of security guards by regulating their employment to authorized security firms.

title: Möjlighet för regeringen att tillfälligt frångå huvudregeln för fördelning av platser vid urval till högskolan vid extraordinära händelser i fredstid
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament take steps to identify strategic ports where the government will assume increased responsibility for infrastructure planning and investments related to maritime transport. It emphasizes the importance of shipping as an environmentally friendly mode of transportation that is projected to play a significant role in future goods transport. The motion advocates for coordinated planning for these ports, particularly in relation to road and rail infrastructure, to improve the efficiency of transportation logistics in the region.

title: Transportstyrelsens olycksdatabas
summary: The proposal seeks to review the application of the discount policy for multiple offenses in order to impose stricter penalties on repeat offenders. It argues that a functioning justice system is crucial for fostering trust in society and that current leniencies in sentencing undermine this goal. By amending legislation, the motion aims to ensure that repeat crimes are treated with greater severity, sending a clear message of justice to both offenders and victims, and addressing concerns about organized crime and public safety.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 – Förlängda och förstärkta stöd vid korttidsarbete och omställningsstöd för företag med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament acknowledges the importance of including sports facilities in urban planning processes, emphasizing the need for a balanced coexistence between housing development and recreational spaces. The authors argue that sustainable urban growth must address citizens' needs for active leisure and community involvement through sports, as current trends show a neglect of such facilities despite ongoing residential expansion, leading to increased health disparities and social segregation.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om Polismyndighetens arbete i utsatta områden
summary: The motion proposes measures to prevent, regulate, and combat labor market crime in Sweden, emphasizing the need for equal working conditions and compliance with collective agreements amidst challenges brought by an influx of foreign workers. It criticizes the previous government's lack of action and calls for stronger enforcement of labor laws, improved cooperation between authorities, and requirements for fair employment conditions in public procurement to combat issues such as wage dumping, exploitation, and human trafficking in various industries.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:89 Riksrevisionens rapport om granskning av statens styrning av äldreomsorgen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3877 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes creating better conditions for order and regulation in the labor market by mandating that personnel registers reflect outsourced labor and their employers. It suggests that the current system lacks electronic transmission of these details to the Tax Agency, thus complicating oversight and potentially allowing tax evasion. The motion calls for electronic reporting to the Tax Agency and the ability to cross-reference personnel data with employer contributions to enhance compliance and control in the construction industry.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:89 Riksrevisionens rapport om granskning av statens styrning av äldreomsorgen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament requires subcontractors involved in work qualifying for the ROT tax deduction to also possess a valid F-tax designation, aligning their status with the main contractors currently mandated to have F-tax for such deductions.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:93 Riksrevisionens rapport om Finansinspektionens arbete för att motverka intressekonflikter
summary: The motion proposes a review of the public access and secrecy laws to facilitate better cooperation among social services, healthcare, and other authorities when dealing with individuals with complex needs, particularly vulnerable children. Currently, existing confidentiality provisions can hinder necessary information sharing that is crucial for effective care and to combat welfare fraud. The motion emphasizes that while protecting individual privacy is essential, it should not obstruct collaborative efforts to ensure the welfare of at-risk individuals.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:89 Riksrevisionens rapport om granskning av statens styrning av äldreomsorgen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3874 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: The proposal discusses the situation of the Kurdish people and the historical context of Kurdish nationalism and autonomy, detailing the challenges they have faced across Turkey, Iran, Iraq, and Syria regarding language, political representation, and human rights violations. It highlights the Kurds' lack of recognition and autonomy, despite historical agreements that suggested self-determination. The motion calls for the Swedish government to acknowledge these issues and advocate for the rights of the Kurdish people in international forums.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:89 Riksrevisionens rapport om granskning av statens styrning av äldreomsorgen
summary: The suggestion proposes the establishment of a folk movements museum in Sweden to preserve and increase awareness of the historical significance of various folk movements that transformed the nation from a poor, underdeveloped state into a modern democracy in the late 19th century. It emphasizes the importance of documenting and making accessible the contributions of organizations like the temperance movement and labor movements, while also advocating for increased support to the existing archives and organizations tasked with preserving these memories.

title: Mer ändamålsenliga sammansättningsregler för mark- och miljödomstolarna
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish Parliament to ensure that all students in primary and secondary education receive regular instruction in aesthetic subjects, highlighting the importance of artistic education in fostering creativity and critical thinking. The authors argue that the current educational framework provides insufficient exposure to visual arts and music, which limits students' opportunities to engage with and appreciate art. The motion emphasizes the need for aesthetic subjects to be reintroduced as mandatory in high school programs to promote equality in educational access and prepare students as informed citizens.

title: Fortsatt giltighet av lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The proposal advocates for reforming Sweden's labor immigration rules to implement stricter labor market assessments during visa applications. It argues that the current liberal immigration system has led to exploitation and wage dumping while failing to address labor shortages in crucial sectors. The motion suggests reintroducing a more organized approach for assessing labor immigration, similar to systems in the USA, Australia, or Canada, and highlights the need for expedited processes for skilled workers, researchers, and foreign students.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om automatiserat beslutsfattande i statsförvaltningen
summary: The motion proposes measures to strengthen the fight against organized crime in Sweden, including increasing the number of police officers, transferring certain police tasks to other authorities, reevaluating sentencing discounts for young offenders, and enhancing coordination for crime prevention. It acknowledges the rise in serious crime and emphasizes the need for both stricter punishments and societal efforts to address the root causes of criminal behavior, particularly among youth.

title: Dröjsmålstalan vid erkännande av yrkeskvalifikationer
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of protections for witnesses and victims in order to better prosecute criminal activities, particularly in the context of increasing organized crime and witness intimidation. It emphasizes the need for enhanced safety measures for witnesses, including potential legislative changes concerning witness testimony and increased support for anonymous testimony, alongside a call for government action to strengthen the overall legal framework surrounding these issues.

title: Särskilt investeringsutrymme för elnätsverksamhet - investeringar i ökad nätkapacitet
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a marine reserve around the Arctic, emphasizing the need for Sweden's continued strong engagement in the Arctic Council. It highlights the threats posed by climate change to the unique Arctic ecosystem, including biodiversity loss due to melting ice and increased oil and gas exploitation. The motion argues for the necessity of halting detrimental activities such as bottom trawling and calls for the protection of the Arctic's marine life, drawing on the precedent of the marine reserve established in Antarctica as a model for action.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:86 Riksrevisionens rapport om Trafikverkets drift och underhåll av järnvägar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3872 av Anders Åkesson och Helena Gellerman (C, L)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of consumption-based climate targets in Sweden, highlighting the need for increased awareness of individual carbon footprints. It argues that while production-based emissions are currently measured, they do not fully capture the impact of consumption, particularly for imported goods. The motion calls for a complementary approach to existing targets to help achieve the climate goals set by the Paris Agreement, particularly in light of the need for drastic emissions reductions to limit global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:92 En god arbetsmiljö för framtiden - regeringens arbetsmiljöstrategi 2021-2025
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government direct state-owned companies involved in night train services to review their fleet and improve the quality of the vehicles, promoting higher standards and better competitive pricing against air travel. It highlights the current low standards of night trains between major cities, the lack of incentives for travelers, and the necessity for upgrades to meet passenger expectations and align with environmental goals.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:92 En god arbetsmiljö för framtiden - regeringens arbetsmiljöstrategi 2021-2025
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes that the Swedish government review the regulations regarding land sales above the cultivation boundary in northern Sweden. It highlights the ongoing investments and growth in municipalities north of the Dalälven River and argues that the state's restrictive land ownership limits opportunities for housing and industrial development. The motion advocates for a regulatory overhaul to facilitate growth and enhance living conditions throughout the country.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:86 Riksrevisionens rapport om Trafikverkets drift och underhåll av järnvägar
summary: The motion proposes multiple government interventions aimed at fostering growth and equality in Norrbotten by addressing several key areas: enhancing support for industry through improved education and innovation, ensuring access to essential services across rural areas, expediting permit processes, developing green energy solutions, and increasing the presence of state authorities in local communities. It emphasizes the importance of leveraging Norrbotten's natural resources for economic development and sustaining local populations.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:92 En god arbetsmiljö för framtiden - regeringens arbetsmiljöstrategi 2021-2025
summary: The motion proposes immediate measures to improve compulsory care for youth and substance abusers in Sweden. It highlights the shortcomings in the effectiveness of current care provided by the National Board of Institutional Care (SiS), which suffers from a lack of well-trained staff, insufficient evaluation of methods, and inadequate investment in research. The motion calls for improved quality of care, a better working environment for employees, and increased training and research to meet contemporary needs. It suggests that if existing proposals do not result in the desired improvements, further investigation into the future of compulsory care should be considered.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:86 Riksrevisionens rapport om Trafikverkets drift och underhåll av järnvägar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should evaluate the potential for sustainable public procurement to accelerate Sweden's transition towards climate goals and social justice. Emphasizing the need for collective action and responsibility, the motion calls for a revision of public procurement policies to ensure they meet both environmental and social standards, thereby supporting the country's commitment to achieving net-zero emissions by 2045.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:87 Godkännande av rådets beslut om systemet för EU:s egna medel för perioden 2021 och framåt
summary: This motion proposes a review of the parental leave conditions for parents of twins in Sweden, advocating for an increase in the number of days eligible for parental benefit at the sickness benefit qualifying level. Currently, twin parents receive a total of 480 days of parental leave with only 90 days at the higher benefit level, which is deemed insufficient to support their well-being and bonding with their children during the challenging early stages of parenting twins.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:92 En god arbetsmiljö för framtiden - regeringens arbetsmiljöstrategi 2021-2025
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of ensuring the health and safety of personnel in the healthcare and social care sectors, particularly in light of the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. It calls for the re-establishment of emergency stockpiles of protective equipment, the inclusion of personal assistants under hygiene regulations, and more frequent checks on compliance with workplace safety rules. The aim is to create a safer working environment and prevent future health risks for employees involved in caregiving roles.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:87 Godkännande av rådets beslut om systemet för EU:s egna medel för perioden 2021 och framåt
summary: This motion proposes enhancing opportunities for work and housing along Sweden's west coast and in Dalsland, focusing on supporting municipalities reliant on tourism and prioritizing regional infrastructure in rural areas. It emphasizes the necessity of diverse housing options and basic service guarantees to attract permanent residents, while addressing economic challenges linked to seasonal tourism. The proposal calls for collaborative efforts among the state, industry, and education providers to promote tourism and create tailored training programs, thereby contributing to job creation and reversing negative demographic trends.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om granskning av statens styrning av äldreomsorgen
summary: The proposal suggests reviewing ways to stimulate both public and private actors to organize safe meetings and to inform the government of these findings. It emphasizes the need for secure meeting spaces post-pandemic, considering factors such as safety from infection, and encourages the government to lead by example while rewarding those who adapt their operations to provide secure meeting venues.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om Finansinspektionens arbete för att motverka intressekonflikter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the initiative to ensure a long-term sustainable energy supply throughout Sweden, emphasizing the importance of a reliable energy system for job creation and investment in rural areas. It highlights efforts to make Gotland the first region with a fully renewable energy system and calls for the construction of an additional power cable to enable the integration of new energy producers and support the transition to renewable energy. The motion stresses the need for secure electricity supply for Gotland, promoting ecological sustainability and competitiveness while contributing to Sweden's goal of becoming the world's first fossil-free welfare state.

title: En god arbetsmiljö för framtiden - regeringens arbetsmiljöstrategi 2021-2025
summary: The motion advocates for the recognition of metal detecting as a hobby and calls for the abolition of the 700 SEK fee required to obtain a permit for using metal detectors. The proposer, Roza Güclü Hedin, highlights that the fee has discouraged many enthusiasts, particularly older individuals and pensioners, from pursuing this activity, which promotes public health and helps remove metal debris from public spaces. The motion seeks to encourage the government to facilitate metal detecting as a hobby by addressing the current permit fee structure.

title: Uppskjuten tillämpning av kravet att upprätta redovisning i Esef-format
summary: The proposal suggests that the Riksdag should consider recognizing Älvdalska as a minority language or regional language, emphasizing its cultural significance and linguistic uniqueness. With around 3,000 speakers, Älvdalska has been acknowledged by international bodies and has undergone a standardization process. The aim is to ensure the language's preservation and promotion, particularly among the youth, while facilitating the right to mother tongue education as stipulated by Swedish language laws.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om Trafikverkets drift och underhåll av järnvägar
summary: The motion proposes the reinstatement of the tax deduction for membership fees in trade unions and unemployment insurance funds, which were abolished in 2007 and then temporarily reinstated in 2018 before being removed again in 2019. The authors argue that the removal of this deduction negatively impacted membership levels in these organizations and undermined stability in wage formation in Sweden, particularly following the financial crisis. They advocate for restoring the deduction to strengthen the Swedish model and improve the security of the labor market.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:85 Utökade kontroll- och stödmöjligheter avseende skyddstillsynsdömda
summary: The motion proposes improvements to the conditions for lay judges (nämndemän) in Sweden, emphasizing their crucial role in maintaining a democratic judiciary. It highlights the need for increased compensation and benefits, as current remuneration has been unchanged since 2007 and does not reflect the demands of the role. Additionally, the motion calls for enhanced security measures for lay judges, who face rising threats as court caseloads increase, potentially compromising their well-being and the overall effectiveness of the judicial system.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:85 Utökade kontroll- och stödmöjligheter avseende skyddstillsynsdömda
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3862 av Helena Vilhelmsson och Hannes Hervieu (båda C)
summary: The motion advocates for increased penalties and enhanced speed monitoring at road work sites to improve the safety of road workers, who face significant risks due to high traffic speeds. It cites a report by the Seko union indicating that a majority of road workers feel unsafe and that incidents at road works have increased. The authors propose raising fines for speeding near these sites and call for a review of penalties for other traffic violations to support the initiative.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:85 Utökade kontroll- och stödmöjligheter avseende skyddstillsynsdömda
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing requirements for mailboxes in multi-family buildings. It argues that the modern postal market necessitates such changes due to declining letter volumes and increasing parcel deliveries, particularly in the context of e-commerce growth. By introducing property boxes, the motion asserts that efficiency in mail delivery can be improved, which would enhance service in urban areas and benefit rural regions by supporting Postnord's societal mission.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:82 En översyn av regleringen för tjänstepensionsföretag
summary: The motion submitted by Jimmy Ståhl and others aims to enhance the competitiveness of the Swedish aviation industry by abolishing the aviation tax, investigating investment support for new airports, and expanding existing facilities like Arlanda and Bromma airports. It emphasizes the importance of a robust aviation sector for transportation within Sweden and internationally, while proposing measures to improve safety, security, and operational efficiency at airports. Additionally, it calls for a review of regulations related to air traffic and drone usage, alongside addressing environmental concerns linked to air travel.

title: Godkännande av rådets beslut om systemet för EU:s egna medel för perioden 2021 och framåt
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to establish requirements for employee transfer and whistleblower protection in public transportation procurement. It highlights the job insecurity faced by workers in the sector due to the current procurement practices and emphasizes the need for policies that ensure employees retain their jobs with adequate working conditions during transitions to new employers. Additionally, it advocates for the inclusion of whistleblower protections to allow employees to report safety issues without fear of reprisal.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:82 En översyn av regleringen för tjänstepensionsföretag
summary: The motion advocates for increased research and the establishment of guidelines regarding lipedema, a chronic condition predominantly affecting women. The motion emphasizes that many women struggle to receive proper diagnosis and treatment due to a lack of awareness among healthcare providers in Sweden, leading to misdiagnosis, unnecessary treatments, and significant psychological distress. The proposer calls for the government to enhance the understanding and management of this condition within the Swedish healthcare system.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:85 Utökade kontroll- och stödmöjligheter avseende skyddstillsynsdömda
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish healthcare system to become the sole overseer of addiction treatment, emphasizing the need for a cohesive approach to care. It calls for a thorough review of the Swedish National Board of Institutional Care's operations and related policies, greater training for staff, routine drug testing for residents in treatment facilities, and an expansion of restrictions on drug possession at youth homes and substance abuse facilities. It also seeks to enhance support for families affected by addiction and proposes an independent investigation into Sweden's drug policy to encourage data-driven legislative reform.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:84 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Förlängda ersättningar på sjukförsäkringsområdet, stöd till företag och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion advocates for increased state responsibility for infrastructure of national interest in Sweden, emphasizing the need for modern and sustainable transport systems that can support both freight and passenger transport. It highlights current limitations in infrastructure, particularly in Trelleborg, which affect import and export operations, and argues for a national investment to alleviate traffic bottlenecks that hinder the effectiveness of transport chains vital to the Swedish economy.

title: Redovisning av verksamheten i Internationella valutafonden, Världsbanksgruppen samt regionala utvecklings- och investeringsbanker 2019 och 2020
summary: The motion advocates for improved support for individuals with disabilities by addressing the geographical disparities in assistance provided by different municipalities. It highlights the anxiety many disabled individuals face when relocating, due to concerns about losing current support and the lengthy process for obtaining aid in a new location. The proposal calls for legislative changes to ensure that support follows the individual regardless of residence, suggesting a two-tier decision-making process for assistance to enhance access and security for those in need.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:78 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Vissa ändrade regler inom sjukförsäkringen
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of permanent emergency reserves for critical medical supplies, vaccines, and medicines in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for such reserves to be in place to ensure availability during various situations, especially given the reliance on international suppliers and the uncertainties in supply chains. The motion argues that previous reserves were dismantled and suggests that national preparedness should include comprehensive planning for what materials will be stocked, their storage locations, and the duration for which they should last.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:62 Riksrevisionens rapport om effektiviteten vid Kriminalvårdens anstalter
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish parliament to examine the feasibility of constructing the Öresundsmetron to improve transportation between Sweden and Denmark, addressing expected increases in freight traffic and reducing CO2 emissions. The motion outlines several benefits, including alleviating congestion on the Öresund Bridge, enhancing trade opportunities, promoting regional growth, facilitating easier access to European destinations via train, and ensuring a cost-effective, sustainable infrastructure project that integrates well with existing transport systems.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:78 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Vissa ändrade regler inom sjukförsäkringen
summary: The proposal suggests that municipalities in Sweden be granted the authority to install and finance speed cameras to enhance traffic safety. Citing the effectiveness of speed cameras in saving lives and reducing accidents, the motion highlights the lack of such cameras in urban areas and references successful implementations in places like New York. The initiative aims to address public concerns about speeding, improve air quality, and promote safer traffic environments.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:69 2020 års redogörelse för tillämpningen av lagen om särskild utlänningskontroll
summary: The motion SD227 proposes a series of measures aimed at strengthening the social services concerning children and youth. It emphasizes the need to uphold the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, enhance training and support for social workers, and improve collaboration between various sectors to ensure the protection and well-being of vulnerable children. The motion also calls for the introduction of national specialist education and better handling of complex social issues, including violence and mental health among children in foster care. It stresses the importance of clear action plans and greater oversight within the social services to protect children's rights and welfare.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:73 En ny straffbestämmelse som skyddar betalningsverktyg
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3852 av Helena Vilhelmsson och Hannes Hervieu (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a new unit within Försäkringskassan aimed at investigating crimes related to welfare fraud, emphasizing the need for dedicated resources to combat economic crimes affecting the welfare system and to maintain public trust in these social safety nets.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:62 Riksrevisionens rapport om effektiviteten vid Kriminalvårdens anstalter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3851 av Helena Vilhelmsson och Hannes Hervieu (båda C)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a comprehensive ten-year national strategy to enhance mental health services in Sweden, addressing increasing mental health issues through structured and coordinated actions. Key elements include the establishment of a national council for mental health, a research program, strengthened roles for the Public Health Agency of Sweden, and initiatives to improve psychiatric competencies in primary care. It also advocates for preventive measures, the integration of mental health education in schools, and the addressing of specific needs for vulnerable groups, reflecting a holistic approach to mental health.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:62 Riksrevisionens rapport om effektiviteten vid Kriminalvårdens anstalter
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to revise, develop, and modernize the LSS law to ensure it fulfills its original intentions while adapting to current needs. It advocates for a flexible approach based on individual needs rather than strict diagnoses, promotes a review of coordination regulations, and stresses the importance of the state's responsibility for personal assistance. The motion also seeks to establish sustainable funding models, enhance the availability of support for families, and ensure equitable access to resources for individuals with disabilities across Sweden, aligned with international human rights standards.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:69 2020 års redogörelse för tillämpningen av lagen om särskild utlänningskontroll
summary: The proposal seeks to strengthen the role of pharmacies in Sweden's healthcare system by allowing them to conduct simple laboratory tests, manage medication distribution more effectively, and ensure environmental oversight of pharmaceuticals. It also calls for an increase in the production of vaccines and medicinal research, better management of drug shortages, and the establishment of a comprehensive state-led approach to healthcare preparedness. The motion emphasizes the need for improved legislative clarity on pharmaceutical responsibilities and national coordination in healthcare crisis scenarios.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:62 Riksrevisionens rapport om effektiviteten vid Kriminalvårdens anstalter
summary: The motion proposes various measures to enhance collaboration between primary care, psychiatry, addiction treatment centers, and social services to combat substance abuse and dependencies. It calls for the establishment of more support lines for relatives of substance users, inclusion of additional addiction types in the national strategy on alcohol, narcotics, doping, and tobacco (ANDT), and a comprehensive risk assessment of these substances. Additionally, it advocates for the creation of specialized facilities for at-risk users and the allowance of farm sales of locally produced alcoholic beverages.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:78 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Vissa ändrade regler inom sjukförsäkringen
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance the accessibility and effectiveness of primary healthcare in Sweden by expanding the patient register to include primary care for systematic national follow-up, urging the government to take greater responsibility for the training and distribution of specialist doctors, and empowering the Health and Social Care Inspectorate to establish regulations for ensuring a fixed doctor-contact in primary care. This initiative aims to improve patient-centered and equitable healthcare, strengthen governance, and ensure a conducive work environment for primary care professionals.

title: Utökade kontroll- och stödmöjligheter avseende skyddstillsynsdömda
summary: The proposal outlines various measures aimed at improving the Swedish healthcare system post-pandemic, including increasing state responsibility, implementing a national waiting list for treatments, enhancing digital healthcare access and information sharing among various healthcare providers, and ensuring equal access to care. Additionally, it suggests improvements for healthcare workers' conditions and the establishment of national guidelines to address issues such as palliative care and chronic conditions management, thus aiming for a more accessible and equitable healthcare system.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Förlängda ersättningar på sjukförsäkringsområdet, stöd till företag och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes multiple measures aimed at improving the care and rights of elderly individuals in Sweden. Key proposals include the establishment of a new rights law for the elderly, the implementation of quality-focused procurement in elderly care, increased funding for oversight bodies, and the enhancement of personal qualifications in elder care.
