The motion underscores the need for comprehensive strategies to address the growing challenges faced by the elderly population, particularly regarding their living conditions, safety, and access to healthcare services.

title: En översyn av regleringen för tjänstepensionsföretag
summary: The proposal from the Sweden Democrats outlines a series of measures aimed at improving economic security for children and families, including extended parental benefits, a more flexible parental insurance system, and adjustments to child allowances. The motion emphasizes the need for both parents to have statutory rights to attend prenatal care appointments and suggests a new temporary parental benefit for such visits. It also advocates for a comprehensive approach to child welfare, promoting an inclusive family policy that recognizes the unique needs of families while providing adequate support for economically vulnerable groups.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:71 Uppenbart ogrundade ansökningar och fastställande av säkra ursprungsländer
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to consider establishing a new target for consumption-based emissions in order to achieve net-zero emissions by 2045. It highlights the increasing consumption-based emissions and emphasizes the need for a transition to a circular economy, addressing the inequities in consumption patterns among different demographics. The authors argue that action is necessary to accelerate this transition and build upon Sweden's existing climate policies and leadership.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:64 En konsultationsordning i frågor som rör det samiska folket
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should examine the possibility of clarifying the education law to ensure that all students can participate in school-related activities without any costs. It argues that the current system, while mostly fee-free, often imposes small fees that create inequality among students and families. Reports indicate that even minor charges can prevent students from participating in activities, leading to significant concern among parents and children. The motion advocates for a completely fee-free education system to uphold Sweden's commitment to children's rights under the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:64 En konsultationsordning i frågor som rör det samiska folket
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3844 av Karin Enström m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should increase its sustainable and equitable agricultural aid to combat hunger aggravated by the coronavirus pandemic. It emphasizes support for small-scale farmers, particularly women, and their organizations to address the escalating issues of poverty and food insecurity globally. The proposal argues that sustainable agriculture is crucial for mitigating climate change effects and asserts that Swedish aid should focus on root causes of hunger while improving food security and local production in the most affected countries.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:71 Uppenbart ogrundade ansökningar och fastställande av säkra ursprungsländer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3843 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive tax reform aimed at addressing growing inequality in Sweden, enhancing welfare, and achieving greater equity among citizens. It emphasizes the necessity for a tax overhaul to boost employment, simplify the tax system, reduce current economic divides, and support environmental goals, ultimately ensuring the sustainability of welfare services.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:83 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Förstärkta stöd till företag, nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för unga och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: This motion emphasizes the need for continuity in healthcare, particularly regarding the regulation of digital healthcare providers (nätläkare). It argues for increased oversight to ensure that public funds are effectively utilized and to promote equitable access to care for vulnerable patient groups. The proposal incorporates findings from a government investigation advocating for more uniform reimbursement principles in primary care that consider socio-economic factors, and calls for integration between digital and physical healthcare to enhance patient experiences.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:64 En konsultationsordning i frågor som rör det samiska folket
summary: The motion proposes a review of municipalities' ability to charge non-income-tested meal fees in special housing for the elderly, with the aim of ensuring residents have sufficient funds for necessary expenses. It also calls for municipalities to be required to disclose the actual costs of meals to prevent these fees from being a source of revenue for municipal elderly care. The motion highlights concerns about the financial burden of high meal fees on elderly residents, which can lead to negative financial conditions and insufficient living standards.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:71 Uppenbart ogrundade ansökningar och fastställande av säkra ursprungsländer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3840 av Christina Höj Larsen m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion highlights the issue of undernourishment among the elderly in Sweden, emphasizing that a significant portion of the population over 65 is affected. It calls for greater awareness and understanding of the prevalence of this problem, particularly among those living at home, and advocates for the Socialstyrelsen to update its assessments of societal costs related to elderly undernourishment and the potential savings from preventive measures.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:64 En konsultationsordning i frågor som rör det samiska folket
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3839 av Mia Sydow Mölleby m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes a national implementation plan to realize the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, calling for the abolition of the term 'reduced work capacity' and advocating for flexible social insurance systems. It suggests establishing tripartite agreements to create a more inclusive labor market, focusing on the capabilities of individuals rather than their limitations. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for adaptability in employment and insurance systems to better support individuals with varying abilities and health conditions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:71 Uppenbart ogrundade ansökningar och fastställande av säkra ursprungsländer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3838 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå och Jennie Åfeldt (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a national coordination function to enhance the development of regional centers for rare diagnoses in Sweden. It calls for the urgent creation of a national action plan for rare diagnoses and seeks to ensure more equitable financial support for organizations representing individuals with rare conditions. It highlights the existing gaps in care and expertise for patients dealing with rare diseases, emphasizing the need for organized, accessible, and equal healthcare services across the country.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:83 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Förstärkta stöd till företag, nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för unga och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament endorse a principle decision to build new high-speed rail corridors as a crucial part of the country's infrastructure planning. It emphasizes the need for a modern and stable transport system to enhance national development, growth, and competitiveness, addressing current capacity issues in the railway system. The initiative highlights the environmental benefits of shifting freight from road to rail and aims to create larger labor market regions by improving connectivity. Additionally, it argues that such infrastructure investments can stimulate the economy and generate employment, while also being linked to essential housing developments in involved municipalities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:77 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Stöd till företag, medel för vaccinering och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers implementing the principle of public access to statistics for all publicly funded schools, emphasizing the need for transparency and equal access to information. It argues that current restrictions on sharing data about school performance hinder effective planning and quality assurance in education, and calls for a return to a system that allows parents and guardians to make informed choices based on comprehensive school statistics.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Förstärkta stöd till företag, nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för unga och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the development of the sharing and platform economy to enhance positive aspects and ensure fair competition in the housing market, while promoting social sustainability. It emphasizes the need for regulations to address challenges and negative effects associated with this growing sector, notably the impact on housing availability and competition with traditional accommodation services. Additionally, the motion advocates for Sweden to adopt a more proactive approach to these economic models based on learnings from other countries.

title: Ytterligare kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om elektronisk identifiering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament actively works to ensure equal childhood opportunities for all children in Sweden, in line with the principles of the Convention on the Rights of the Child. It emphasizes the importance of creating a national action plan that addresses various factors contributing to inequality, including economic conditions, education, healthcare, and support for children with disabilities. The proposal highlights the need for a multifaceted approach to equalize living conditions for children, thereby aiming to reduce social disparities and enhance children's rights.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:77 Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Stöd till företag, medel för vaccinering och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: Anders Österberg's motion emphasizes the need for a dental care reform in Sweden, highlighting the socio-economic disparities in access to dental services and the impact of oral health on overall health. It calls for the integration of dental care into the broader healthcare and insurance systems, aiming for equitable access to dental care. The motion stresses that many individuals, particularly the elderly, face financial barriers that prevent them from seeking necessary dental treatment, which could lead to further health complications and increased public healthcare costs.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:60 Forskning, frihet, framtid - kunskap och innovation för Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3834 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes strengthening police training in the Järva area, particularly by conducting parts of the police education at the old Ross Tensta Gymnasium and utilizing Hästa gård in Akalla for horse training. The initiative aims to enhance public safety, increase job opportunities, and foster community engagement by having police trainees develop a better understanding of the local environment, in light of the area's struggles with gang-related crime.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:60 Forskning, frihet, framtid - kunskap och innovation för Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should investigate the possibility of providing home insurance for residents living in public housing, particularly in light of past incidents where tenants suffered losses without insurance coverage, as experienced during the fires in Järvafältet. The aim is to enhance the security of public housing and ensure that tenants can recover from damages to their property.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:56 Internationella försvarssamarbeten
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a coordinating body for foreign direct investments in Sweden to enhance the country's attractiveness to international investors. It highlights the significant role that foreign investments play in building production capacity, creating jobs, and driving innovation in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the need for improved coordination among various stakeholders involved in investment promotion to boost Sweden's international competitiveness.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:72 Sveriges tillträde till Europarådets konvention om it-relaterad brottslighet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3831 av Helena Vilhelmsson och Hannes Hervieu (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the national forest company Sveaskog fulfill its mandate to provide areas for recreation for both the Swedish population and foreign visitors, specifically in the Malingsbo-Kloten region. This area has a longstanding tradition as a recreational site and is well-positioned to attract a significant number of visitors. The local municipality is collaborating with a university to study the area's strengths and weaknesses to develop an economic growth plan for the tourism sector while considering the region's natural resources. The proposal emphasizes the importance of developing hiking, biking, and nature experiences in the area.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:63 Redovisning av åtgärder i enlighet med målsättningarna i det nationella brottsförebyggande programmet Tillsammans mot brott
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3830 av Helena Vilhelmsson och Hannes Hervieu (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament study the possibility of establishing a mandate within the regulatory letters to state authorities to ensure their responsibility for local and regional development. This is to address the negative effects of office closures in smaller municipalities due to rationalization needs within government agencies, which limit citizens' access to quality public services, hinder local job opportunities, and diminish regional attractiveness. The authors advocate for measures to enhance local competence supply and suggest that regulatory letters could include requirements for agencies to contribute to regional development.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:57 Lag om estetiska kirurgiska ingrepp och estetiska injektionsbehandlingar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate ways for state-owned companies to actively create opportunities for individuals with disabilities to access employment or internships. The motion underscores the higher unemployment rates among people with disabilities compared to the general population and emphasizes the role of the public sector, particularly the state-owned company Samhall, in providing jobs for these individuals. It calls for the government to utilize its ownership of state businesses to contribute to inclusivity and employment initiatives.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:63 Redovisning av åtgärder i enlighet med målsättningarna i det nationella brottsförebyggande programmet Tillsammans mot brott
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity of maintaining the presence of Arbetsförmedlingen (the Swedish Public Employment Service) in all municipalities across Sweden, especially in light of rising unemployment due to the ongoing pandemic. It criticizes the centralization of services and highlights the negative impacts on jobseekers, particularly those far from the labor market, who are facing delays in support and lack of local resources. The motion advocates for a more localized approach to employment services, ensuring that personal interactions and local knowledge are prioritized to facilitate job matching and training opportunities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:72 Sveriges tillträde till Europarådets konvention om it-relaterad brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament advocate for the establishment of a system that allows residents across the country to access prescription medication and consult with pharmacists remotely, addressing the challenges faced by rural areas, particularly after the closure of local pharmacies. This change is aimed at ensuring that residents do not have to travel long distances to obtain medication and advice from qualified pharmacists.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:68 Förstärkt och förenklad miljöstyrning i bonus-malus-systemet
summary: The motion proposes to enhance libraries as centers for lifelong learning in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of continuous education for both individuals and society. It advocates for equitable access to knowledge resources and the role of libraries in facilitating learning through shared experiences and diverse media, ultimately contributing to personal growth and adaptation to societal needs.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:66 Nya bestämmelser om hållbarhetsrelaterade upplysningar för vissa aktörer på finansmarknadsområdet
summary: The motion proposes measures to ensure equal participation in recreational activities for all children and youth, emphasizing the significance of culture, sports, and outdoor activities for their health and quality of life. It highlights financial barriers that prevent economically disadvantaged children from engaging in such activities and suggests the establishment of 'sportotheks' or 'leisure banks' to provide necessary equipment at no charge. The motion advocates for the reduction or elimination of fees associated with recreational activities, proposing that government support for youth activities be conditional on limiting these fees.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:63 Redovisning av åtgärder i enlighet med målsättningarna i det nationella brottsförebyggande programmet Tillsammans mot brott
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament consider the possibility of legally regulating culture schools to ensure accessibility and quality for all children. It highlights the importance of culture schools for children's health, well-being, and educational success while addressing current issues such as the lack of national goals, varying accessibility, and substantial participation fees that often exclude economically disadvantaged families. The proposal advocates for establishing overarching objectives, teacher qualifications, and a fee cap within the education law framework to enhance the status and effectiveness of culture schools.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:72 Sveriges tillträde till Europarådets konvention om it-relaterad brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should explore options to facilitate housing construction in rural areas, addressing the current housing shortage that hampers economic development. It highlights obstacles such as difficulties in obtaining bank loans for new construction due to high building costs compared to expected market values. The motion suggests possible solutions, including enhancing loan financing, increasing the presence of state loan institutions, and expanding state support for constructing climate-smart housing in rural regions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:57 Lag om estetiska kirurgiska ingrepp och estetiska injektionsbehandlingar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers an investigation into how to improve the function of legal guardianship in society. It highlights the need for better quality and recruitment of guardians, as current practices are inconsistent across municipalities, leading to varying standards of support for those in vulnerable situations. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring that guardianship roles are filled by qualified individuals and suggests exploring the establishment of a public organization with professional guardians, similar to systems in Norway and Finland, to address issues surrounding the recruitment and management of guardians.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:66 Nya bestämmelser om hållbarhetsrelaterade upplysningar för vissa aktörer på finansmarknadsområdet
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a third legal gender in Swedish legislation to better accommodate non-binary individuals and ensure their rights and identities are recognized. It argues that the current binary system discriminates against those who do not identify strictly as male or female, and emphasizes that having a legal gender that aligns with one's gender identity is crucial for the well-being of non-binary individuals. The motion seeks to encourage the government to study the conditions for implementing this change.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion addresses the issue of hidden discrimination in blood donation policies in Sweden, specifically targeting the rules that prevent men who have sex with men from donating blood. It proposes that the Swedish government direct the National Board of Health and Welfare to review these regulations, highlighting the importance of increasing blood donors to ensure a sufficient blood supply and questioning the fairness of current restrictions compared to heterosexual relationships.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:61 Riksrevisionens rapport om styrning av ämneslärarutbildningen vid Högskolan i Gävle, Linnéuniversitetet och Stockholms universitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3819 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should review the regulations governing transport services for individuals with disabilities, specifically to facilitate access to sports training and competitions. It emphasizes the importance of physical activity for mental and physical well-being and highlights the challenges faced by those using specialized mobility aids who are often denied transportation. The aim is to ensure equal access to public transport services for all citizens, particularly for those with varying abilities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:72 Sveriges tillträde till Europarådets konvention om it-relaterad brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews legislation regarding payment services to reduce the disadvantages faced by associations in managing their finances. It highlights the importance of associations in Swedish society and their reliance on volunteer efforts, noting the financial challenges they face, especially concerning transaction fees from payment services like card payments and Swish. The aim is to negotiate for reduced transaction fees for associations to enhance their financial viability.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:63 Redovisning av åtgärder i enlighet med målsättningarna i det nationella brottsförebyggande programmet Tillsammans mot brott
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the critical norm work in schools to support students' understanding of diverse family structures and identities in a changing society. It emphasizes the importance of addressing and challenging existing norms that may marginalize children based on their family situations, backgrounds, or identities, ensuring that schools become safe spaces where all students can feel accepted and valued.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:56 Internationella försvarssamarbeten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3816 av Pål Jonson m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposes making preschool education in Sweden free of charge and mandatory for all children from the age of two. It emphasizes the importance of accessible preschool education for children's development, equal opportunities regardless of parents' employment status, and the promotion of gender equality by supporting women's participation in the workforce. The proposal underlines that equitable access to preschool contributes to societal equality and the well-being of children from various backgrounds.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:70 Integritetsskydd vid signalspaning i försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3815 av Pål Jonson m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposed by Anna Wallentheim and colleagues from the Social Democratic Party advocates for an increase in the transparency of teacher-led instruction at universities and colleges in Sweden. It suggests that statistics related to such teaching time should be collected and made publicly available on the university admissions website, antagning.se, to ensure equity among different study programs and enhance competitiveness within higher education.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:56 Internationella försvarssamarbeten
summary: The motion proposes to extend the general mandate granted to the Swedish Hunting Association (Svenska Jägareförbundet) to a multi-year duration, in order to facilitate better planning and long-term investments in wildlife management and hunting education. The proposal emphasizes the importance of wildlife management as a balance between conservation and public interest, and it seeks to uphold the successful collaboration between the association and the state, which has been in place for over 80 years.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:60 Forskning, frihet, framtid - kunskap och innovation för Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3813 av Ilona Szatmari Waldau m.fl. (V)
summary: Monica Haider proposes a comprehensive management approach for hoofed wildlife in Sweden, emphasizing the need to address the collective grazing pressure caused by various species, not just moose. The motion calls for a review of current wildlife management practices to incorporate all hoofed animals into a unified regional management system, ensuring decisions are made locally and balancing the impact of wildlife on agriculture and forestry.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:63 Redovisning av åtgärder i enlighet med målsättningarna i det nationella brottsförebyggande programmet Tillsammans mot brott
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3812 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen home and consumer studies in schools, emphasizing its importance in preparing students for adult life by providing knowledge about household economics, rental agreements, consumer laws, and emphasizing practical skills such as cooking. The suggestion advocates for a greater focus on integrating practical and theoretical learning, suggesting that increased instructional time in this subject could benefit students' overall education and life skills.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:55 Språkplikt - deltagande i vuxenutbildning i svenska för invandrare (sfi) för rätt till försörjningsstöd
summary: This proposal calls for an investigation into the need for means-testing the child allowance in Sweden, which currently provides a fixed amount to all parents regardless of income. The motion highlights that the child allowance aims to ensure a good economic standard for all families with children, but contends that a review is necessary to evaluate the possibility and implications of income-testing the allowance, given the significant costs involved and the potential for improved target accuracy.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:56 Internationella försvarssamarbeten
summary: The motion advocates for a review of cash handling in rural areas, emphasizing the need for accessible cash services as the society transitions towards a cashless economy. It highlights the difficulties faced by rural businesses and citizens who struggle with limited cash deposit options, potentially impacting local economies and social services. The proposal seeks to ensure that cash continues to be a viable option for transactions, particularly for those who prefer not to use card payments and for international visitors.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:68 Förstärkt och förenklad miljöstyrning i bonus-malus-systemet
summary: The proposal aims to increase the legal status of service dogs and service horses in Sweden, advocating for them to be recognized as more than property under the law. This change would enable harsher penalties for violence against these animals, reflecting their significant contributions to public safety and law enforcement efforts. The motion emphasizes the physical dangers faced by these animals in their work and the inadequacy of current legal protections.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:66 Nya bestämmelser om hållbarhetsrelaterade upplysningar för vissa aktörer på finansmarknadsområdet
summary: The motion proposes to facilitate a standard shoreline protection limit of 100 meters in Södermanland County, arguing that current extended limits of up to 300 meters hinder housing development and exacerbate the housing crisis. The proposer highlights the need for more housing to support job mobility and economic growth, particularly in regions with good connections to Stockholm.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:55 Språkplikt – deltagande i vuxenutbildning i svenska för invandrare (sfi) för rätt till försörjningsstöd
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3807 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of raising the threshold for non-profit organizations, specifically sports clubs, to submit tax reports for compensation payments from 100 SEK to 3,000 SEK. This change aims to reduce administrative burdens on small clubs and allow them to focus more on their core activities of training and competition for children and youth.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:57 Lag om estetiska kirurgiska ingrepp och estetiska injektionsbehandlingar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the right of municipalities to employ doctors within elderly care, highlighting the increasing medical needs of older patients and the challenges posed by insufficient medical competence among care personnel. The author argues that the current lack of geriatricians and medical leadership in many municipalities contributes to significant shortcomings in municipal elderly healthcare, which demands urgent attention.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:60 Forskning, frihet, framtid - kunskap och innovation för Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the implementation of sanctions, including fines, against vehicles abandoned on roadsides, parking lots, or ditches, highlighting the associated traffic safety and environmental hazards. The motion cites examples from Södermanland, where abandoned cars pose significant risks, and refers to regulations in France that penalize such behavior. The goal is to improve traffic safety and reduce littering and environmental violations related to abandoned vehicles.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Vissa ändrade regler inom sjukförsäkringen
summary: Lotta Finstorp proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider making winter time the standard time instead of the current practice of changing to daylight savings time. The motion argues that there are no clear socio-economic benefits to the time change and cites research indicating negative effects on individuals, including disrupted sleep patterns, increased risk of accidents, and higher rates of heart attacks following the clock adjustment. By adopting winter time as the permanent standard, the proposal aims to eliminate the biannual clock changes.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2021 - Stöd till företag, medel för vaccinering och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish state should take responsibility for co-financing the expansion of the Spårväg City project, which is crucial for public transportation in Stockholm. The proposal highlights the project's importance in enhancing sustainability and urban development, while addressing concerns over delays attributed to government policies affecting housing and financing. The motion argues that state involvement is essential to ensure the successful implementation of the transport system needed to support the area's significant residential and workplace growth.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:80 Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden's primary and secondary schools should enhance their focus on knowledge and be more compensatory in nature. It suggests modernizing teacher education based on research about children's learning, while advocating for a balance between factual learning and independent study. The motion highlights the need to improve the quality of education to enable equal opportunities for children, rectifying a trend of declining performance evidenced in international assessments.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:80 Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to enhance efforts to facilitate the return of foreigners who have received legally binding rejections of their asylum applications. It emphasizes improving diplomatic relationships with their home countries, utilizing stronger conditions for aid disbursement as leverage in negotiations. The motion argues for a regulated asylum immigration process, asserting that those without valid claims must not remain in Sweden, and highlights the need to mitigate the increase of undocumented individuals in the country.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:80 Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should empower municipalities to relocate shipwrecks and ownerless boats as needed, and to investigate the establishment of producer responsibility for decommissioned recreational boats. The proposal criticizes the government's delays in addressing these issues, emphasizes the importance of providing municipalities with proper tools to manage shipwrecks and the associated environmental hazards, and calls for a sustainable approach to handle the disposal and recycling of recreational boats without retroactive burdens on current boat owners.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:80 Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government instructs the Coast Guard to assist the Transport Agency in enforcing the sulfur regulations in shipping to ensure compliance and fair competition in the maritime industry. The suggestion highlights the need for stricter controls to detect and penalize violations effectively, particularly in sulfur emission zones, and suggests utilizing new monitoring techniques, including aerial surveillance, to enhance compliance efforts.

title: med anledning prop. 2020/21:80 Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3800 av Anders Åkesson m.fl. (C, L)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive strategy to enhance Swedish aquaculture, emphasizing the need for increased coordination among relevant governmental agencies, improvements in existing legislation, and an overhaul of EU directives pertaining to water. It aims to address bureaucratic hurdles and outdated laws that currently inhibit the growth of the aquaculture sector, which has the potential to create jobs and contribute positively to environmental sustainability. The motion includes recommendations for knowledge enhancement within authorities, legislative adjustments for simplifying permits, and an overall initiative to support the aquaculture industry in Sweden.

title: Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: This motion advocates for a series of measures aimed at improving and sustaining the Swedish commercial fishing industry. It suggests the establishment of a regulatory simplification commission to reduce bureaucracy, the development of a strategic action plan to facilitate generational transitions in the fishing industry, support for selective and environmentally friendly fishing methods, and a proposal to raise the minimum size for the common lobster. The motion also highlights the need for greater state responsibility regarding fisheries infrastructure and increased research on the impact of cormorants on fish stocks.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:79 En tillfällig covid-19-lag
summary: The motion proposes a uniform VAT rate for accommodations in the maritime tourism sector, specifically reducing VAT for guest harbors from 25% to 12% to align with other accommodation types. This aims to create a level playing field, support the recovery of the severely impacted maritime tourism during the COVID-19 crisis, and enhance the sector's competitiveness, growth, and job creation prospects. Additionally, the motion advocates for regulatory simplifications and coordinated oversight for guest harbors and marinas.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:79 En tillfällig covid-19-lag
summary: Johan Hultberg's motion advocates for strengthened property rights within Sweden's mineral legislation to ensure greater respect for landowners during the mineral exploitation process. He highlights the potential for increased mineral extraction to generate jobs, export revenues, and support the green transition, while emphasizing the need for sustainable practices. The motion calls for a government investigation into how existing laws can be reformed to enhance landowners' rights and address concerns over lengthy exploration permits that can hinder land use and property sales.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:79 En tillfällig covid-19-lag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3797 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M, C, KD, L)
summary: The proposal suggests tightening the process for transferring property titles in Sweden to prevent title fraud, which, while not widespread, causes significant distress for victims. It highlights the ease with which titles can be fraudulently acquired, particularly through forged documents. The motion advocates for the implementation of new procedures, such as requiring confirmation from the original title holder before a transfer is processed by the Land Surveying Office, or digitizing the process to include secure authentication methods like bank-ID.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:79 En tillfällig covid-19-lag
summary: The motion advocates for the development of an establishment strategy for barge traffic in Sweden, recognizing its potential to create a more efficient and sustainable transport system. It highlights the advantages of barge transport in alleviating road congestion and reducing noise and emissions, as well as addressing existing regulatory challenges that hinder its implementation. The proposal calls for government acknowledgment and action to create specific legislations and regulations in line with European standards to integrate barge traffic into the national transport system effectively.

title: En tillfällig covid-19-lag
summary: The motion proposes enhancing the compliance with international maritime regulations in Sweden, motivated by lessons learned from a significant oil spill incident in Tjörn in 2011. It emphasizes the need for clear roles and responsibilities among various authorities during such incidents and calls for the government to advocate for stricter sanctions within the EU and IMO to ensure that stakeholders are held accountable for any maritime accidents.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om effektiviteten vid Kriminalvårdens anstalter
summary: The motion addresses the significant landslide risk in the Götaälvdalen region, emphasizing the need for immediate measures to enhance safety due to historical incidents and ongoing urban development. It highlights the increasing erosion linked to climate change and the importance of establishing a long-term safety plan for the area. The proposal requests the government to create a sustainable financial model to support necessary geotechnical improvements and a delegation for climate adaptation.

title: En särskild straffbestämmelse för uppmaning till självmord
summary: The proposal urges the government to take immediate action to stop the export of stolen goods from Sweden, emphasizing the ease with which international crime rings can smuggle such items out of the country. It highlights that the current measures are insufficient, with minimal risk for offenders. The motion calls for enhanced inspections and stricter regulations for shipping companies to mitigate this issue and protect the public from the increasing crime rate associated with the smuggling of stolen property.

title: En ny straffbestämmelse som skyddar betalningsverktyg
summary: The motion proposes measures to enhance safety in public transportation, including the reinstatement of a dedicated police presence in the subway and the introduction of specialized prosecutors and graffiti police. It advocates for the development of technology, particularly cameras, to aid in crime prevention and evidence collection, amidst rising concerns over crime and insecurity in society, particularly affecting women and young people. The motion underscores the importance of a visible police presence to counteract crime and restore public trust in public transport.

title: 2020 års redogörelse för tillämpningen av lagen om särskild utlänningskontroll
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government sell Sveaskog, the state-owned company that is the largest forest owner in Sweden. The author argues that state involvement in a competitive market like forestry is unnecessary and potentially market-distorting. Instead of being a major owner, the state should ensure sustainable forestry through legislation and regulation, not through direct ownership. The proposed sale of Sveaskog would allow for the forest to be owned by multiple private owners, thereby enhancing market functionality.

title: Sveriges tillträde till Europarådets konvention om it-relaterad brottslighet
summary: The motion advocates for the continuous modernization of nursing education in Sweden, emphasizing the need for the curriculum to adapt to societal developments, including the increasing use of digital services in healthcare. It suggests that nursing programs should equip students with the necessary tools to support patients in this evolving landscape, ensuring that their training remains relevant in light of new practices and community needs.

title: Uppenbart ogrundade ansökningar och fastställande av säkra ursprungsländer
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the collaboration between academia and industry in Sweden to address the challenge of skills supply for businesses. It argues that a better alignment between educational institutions and labor market needs is crucial for improving job creation and economic growth. The motion suggests introducing financial incentives for universities and colleges to involve industry in curriculum development and to prioritize quality over quantity in education, ultimately facilitating a smoother transition for graduates into the workforce.

title: Förstärkt och förenklad miljöstyrning i bonus-malus-systemet
summary: The motion proposes that nutrition and healthy eating habits be made a mandatory component of the training for preschool teachers and leisure leaders. It highlights the crucial role that early childhood education plays in promoting healthy eating, given that preschool children consume a significant portion of their calories in preschool settings. The motion emphasizes the need for societal cooperation alongside parental responsibility to establish healthy eating behaviors from a young age.

title: Undersökningstillstånd
summary: The motion proposes that health conversations conducted by school health services should routinely include questions about sexual abuse, as a significant number of children in Sweden are affected by such incidents. The author argues that directly asking about these experiences encourages victims to disclose their situations, thereby addressing a critical aspect of children's mental and physical health.

title: Nya bestämmelser om hållbarhetsrelaterade upplysningar för vissa aktörer på finansmarknadsområdet
summary: The proposal suggests expanding the mandate of unemployment funds to offer preventative services to their members that can help avoid unemployment rather than only providing support after unemployment occurs. This is based on legal restrictions that currently limit unemployment funds to just providing unemployment insurance for specific professions or sectors. The motion advocates for legislative changes to allow these funds to proactively assist members in securing employment, especially benefiting small business owners and those with disabilities.

title: Tillfällig utvidgning av statligt stöd genom nedsatt energiskatt
summary: Lotta Finstorp's motion emphasizes the need for an increased number of bomb shelters in Sweden to accommodate the growing population and enhance civil protection in the face of evolving security threats. The proposal advocates for a comprehensive inventory and restoration of existing shelters, as well as the construction of new ones tailored to current demographic and security needs. It also calls for improved organizational capacity and public awareness regarding shelter locations and operational readiness.

title: En konsultationsordning i frågor som rör det samiska folket
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should consider revising the legislation concerning flag burning, as the act is not currently punishable despite being perceived by many as deeply offensive and disrespectful to the country. The motion argues that the importance of the Swedish flag as a national symbol is not adequately protected under current laws, as it is only safeguarded by provisions regarding public disturbance. Therefore, the proposal advocates for a reassessment of how flag burning is treated legally.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om styrning av ämneslärarutbildningen vid Högskolan i Gävle, Linnéuniversitetet och Stockholms universitet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the facilitation of implementing evidence-based research results at a national level. It argues that researchers across fields such as technology, education, and healthcare should not have to start their own companies to bring their innovations to the public. Many researchers lack the time, knowledge, or interest to commercialize their work, leading to underutilization of publicly funded innovations. By improving the implementation process, the motion aims to make better use of state funds and enhance societal benefits.

title: Forskning, frihet, framtid - kunskap och innovation för Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider allowing more private operators to manage prisons in response to overcrowding issues, which have resulted in inmates experiencing extended waiting periods before serving their sentences. This change is aimed at reducing the waiting time and preventing recidivism among offenders.

title: Integritetsskydd vid signalspaning i försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the possibility of introducing mandatory vision tests for driver's license renewals, highlighting that vision deteriorates with age and can impact driving ability. It references a previous parliamentary decision aiming for a zero vision in traffic as a rationale for this suggestion.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:54 Ökad ordning och säkerhet i frivården
summary: The proposal suggests a review of the current regulations on the coastal protection laws to grant municipalities greater authority in managing these areas, aiming to facilitate the construction of more housing. The motion argues that the existing legal framework has not achieved desired outcomes and emphasizes the need for municipalities, which possess better local knowledge, to have more decision-making power regarding coastal protection.

title: Redovisning av åtgärder i enlighet med målsättningarna i det nationella brottsförebyggande programmet Tillsammans mot brott
summary: This motion proposes the creation of incentives to prevent digital exclusion, particularly affecting the elderly with low income or pensions. The motion emphasizes the increasing necessity of digital participation in society, highlighting that many essential services are conducted online. It suggests examining the possibility of providing tax relief for internet subscriptions to aid older individuals in overcoming barriers to digital access.

title: Redovisning av användningen av hemliga tvångsmedel under 2019
summary: The proposal advocates for a bike-friendly train travel experience in Sweden by allowing passengers to bring their bicycles on trains, particularly on those operated by the state-owned company SJ, which currently imposes restrictions that prevent full-sized bicycles from being taken aboard. The motion highlights the need to align with EU standards, which require train operators to accommodate a minimum of eight bicycles. The intention is to boost bike tourism and facilitate cycling as a commuting option for employees.

title: Internationella försvarssamarbeten
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of safe cycling routes in larger cities to accommodate the increasing number of commuters using bicycles, particularly electric bikes. It highlights the dangers associated with interactions between cyclists and vehicles or pedestrians, as well as issues related to road surface conditions leading to accidents. The proposal emphasizes the need for wide, separated paths for various types of bicycles, ensuring year-round maintenance to enhance safety and promote better public health.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:58 Möjlighet till betyg från årskurs 4 - efter försöksverksamheten
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the conditions necessary to enhance incentives for cycling to work by equalizing the tax deductions for bicycle commuting with those for moped commuting, thus promoting environmental benefits and public health.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:58 Möjlighet till betyg från årskurs 4 - efter försöksverksamheten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3793 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The proposal suggests the dissolution of the Children's and Students' Ombudsman (BEO), arguing that the agency has misunderstood its role and has made absurd decisions that undermine the authority of teachers. The motion emphasizes that BEO's actions, including granting compensation to students for inappropriate behavior and pursuing long legal battles against teachers, have created stress and difficulties in maintaining a harmonious school environment. The author contends that a state authority that undermines teachers' authority and perpetuates a culture of grievance in schools is unjustified.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:58 Möjlighet till betyg från årskurs 4 - efter försöksverksamheten
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a new legal concept called 'störningsservitut' (disturbance easement) to address complaints from residents regarding disturbances from nearby activities such as sports fields, highways, or agricultural operations. It aims to clarify the expectations for new property owners, ensuring they are aware of potential disturbances at the time of purchase. This measure is intended to reduce conflicts, alleviate the workload of municipal authorities, and decrease the number of legal disputes regarding noise and other disturbances.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:53 Riksrevisionens rapport om riktade statsbidrag för socioekonomiskt utsatta områden
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen penalties for violations of privacy laws regarding medical records and mandates that healthcare providers inform patients each time their journal is accessed. The motion highlights cases of unauthorized access to patient records by healthcare staff, emphasizing the need for reforms to protect patient confidentiality and prevent serious breaches that could harm vulnerable individuals.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:53 Riksrevisionens rapport om riktade statsbidrag för socioekonomiskt utsatta områden
summary: The proposal advocates for tightening the requirements for the cancellation of home furnishing loans issued by CSN, particularly for those involved in municipal refugee reception or registered with the Employment Agency and receiving establishment assistance. The motion emphasizes that the current conditions for loan cancellation are more lenient than those for other types of loans offered by CSN, which many perceive as unfair. The aim is to align the cancellation criteria for home furnishing loans with those applicable to other CSN loans.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:50 Skadeståndets omfattning vid finansiell rådgivning
summary: This motion proposes that access to information in the Swedish vehicle register should be restricted to combat the rising organized crime, specifically focusing on car thefts. It suggests implementing mandatory identification verification, such as using bank-ID, for individuals seeking to obtain data from the vehicle register. Additionally, the motion calls for notifying vehicle owners about any requests made for their information, aiming to minimize criminal exploitation of available data for theft purposes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:52 Tillträdesförbud till butik och förstärkt straffrättsligt skydd mot tillgreppsbrottslighet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3788 av Johan Forssell m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The proposal calls for all welfare transfer payments to be managed by a single authority to enhance oversight and control, addressing the significant increase in fraud within welfare systems. The motion criticizes the current inability of agencies to manage these payments effectively due to their complexity and rising criminal activities targeting welfare funds, advocating for better instruments to prevent misuse of taxpayers' money.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:52 Tillträdesförbud till butik och förstärkt straffrättsligt skydd mot tillgreppsbrottslighet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3787 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes that the police should be given the authority to check if individuals applying for ID cards are wanted persons. It emphasizes the need for improved cooperation among authorities to utilize existing criminal records effectively, as the current lack of legal support for such checks allows wanted criminals to obtain ID cards undetected. The proposal suggests that identifying wanted individuals at the point of ID card issuance could enhance crime prevention, citing successful practices from other cities like New York.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:58 Möjlighet till betyg från årskurs 4 - efter försöksverksamheten
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a commission to propose necessary legislative changes to restore municipal self-governance in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for local responsibility and influence over public matters, citing the historical roots and constitutional backing of municipal autonomy. The motion argues that increased state regulation and financial controls have eroded this autonomy, thereby hindering municipalities' ability to provide high-quality services tailored to local needs.

title: Språkplikt - deltagande i vuxenutbildning i svenska för invandrare (sfi) för rätt till försörjningsstöd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament intensify control over welfare payments to address the substantial misappropriation of public funds, which has become a significant societal issue. It highlights the increasing number of fraudulent claims associated with welfare systems, such as individuals using multiple identities and residing at the same address to claim benefits. The motion calls for immediate measures to ensure that government expenditures are directed to eligible recipients, suggesting that identification should be secured through biometric data to prevent identity fraud.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:50 Skadeståndets omfattning vid finansiell rådgvning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should advocate within the EU and the UN for the Republic of China (Taiwan) to contribute to UN organizations, highlighting Taiwan's democratic values, contributions to humanitarian efforts, and the need for its inclusion in global partnerships addressing cross-border issues such as pandemics and climate change.

title: Lag om estetiska kirurgiska ingrepp och estetiska injektionsbehandlingar
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a maritime council in Sweden to enhance collaboration between the government and the maritime industry, aimed at boosting the competitiveness of the maritime sector. The proposal highlights the importance of shipping for Sweden's economy and international trade, and draws on the success of similar councils in Denmark. The council would develop long-term strategies, identify growth-inhibiting factors, and ensure that Swedish shipping operates under favorable conditions compared to competing nations, with annual reporting to the government.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:51 Konkurrensverkets befogenheter
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of absolute debt prescription for private debts in Sweden. It argues that many individuals fall into a debt trap due to easily granted credits, and a significant number struggle to escape lifelong debts, impacting their quality of life and opportunities. By implementing a rule for absolute debt prescription after a set period, the proposal aims to improve credit assessments by lenders, reduce the need for debt restructuring services, and free up resources for combating serious crime.

title: Ökad ordning och säkerhet i frivården
summary: The motion proposes an increase in baseline funding for research within Swedish universities while reducing strategic funding and external funding caps, emphasizing academic freedom and merit-based allocations without quotas. It also advocates for improved conditions for researchers, the establishment of a cultural heritage fund, and a reorientation of EU research priorities to strengthen national competitive advantages in innovation and research quality.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:49 Utökade möjligheter för Tullverket att besluta om postspärrar
summary: The motion proposes several measures aimed at reforming the Swedish primary school system. Key recommendations include establishing state control over public schools, increasing resources for school inspections, creating a council to evaluate educational materials, prohibiting value-based veils, mandating training on honor-related issues for school staff, and enhancing collaboration between schools and community organizations. It also suggests specific actions to address the needs of rural schools and teachers, improve staffing levels, and implement external grading for national exams, all to ensure a high-quality educational environment for every student.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:51 Konkurrensverkets befogenheter
summary: The proposal suggests reforms to the Swedish upper secondary school and adult education system, advocating for a return to state management of schools, a reduction of practical programs to two years, the introduction of subject grading, and a more structured approach to guidance and qualifications. It emphasizes the need for strong leadership in schools, improved relations with the labor market, and opportunities for university-level teachers to educate at the secondary level. The aim is to combat declining educational performance and ensure that students are adequately prepared for the workforce.

title: Möjlighet till betyg från årskurs 4 - efter försöksverksamheten
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive reform of Sweden's preschool system, emphasizing evidence-based teaching practices, mandatory certification in the Swedish language for all preschool staff, and the prohibition of value-driven practices such as gender pedagogy and the wearing of certain veils. It seeks to improve integration for children from immigrant backgrounds by enforcing obligatory preschool attendance, particularly in socio-economically challenged areas. The motion also calls for enhanced working conditions for preschool staff and stricter guidelines on educational practices in order to foster both child development and integration into Swedish society.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om riktade statsbidrag för socioekonomiskt utsatta områden
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of the Swedish primary education system aimed at enhancing educational quality and promoting Swedish culture. Key suggestions include introducing grades from year four, mandatory grading in individual subjects, addressing absenteeism in reports, bolstering Swedish language instruction, abolishing mandatory mother-tongue education (with exceptions for national minority languages), and establishing obligatory preparatory schools for newly arrived students. The motion emphasizes a focus on core knowledge, increased physical activity in schools, improved study and career guidance, and the need for a politically neutral education environment, while also allowing voluntary school uniforms.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:48 Organdonation
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3781 av Michael Anefur och Camilla Waltersson Grönvall (KD, M)
summary: The suggestion by the Sweden Democrats proposes several reforms to enhance the quality and autonomy of higher education in Sweden. Key points include increasing academic freedom, abolishing quotas in admissions, ensuring equal standards across disciplines, consolidating funding for teaching and research, and increasing resources for higher education. The motion advocates for enhancing student employability through collaboration with the community and suggests a revision of the funding system to prioritize quality over quantity in education. It also calls for public accountability of higher education institutions and the establishment of combined roles for teaching and research.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:48 Organdonation
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at improving the school environment in Sweden by introducing written conduct reports from grade 1, increasing the powers of teachers and principals to maintain order, establishing agreements on behavior between students, parents, and schools, implementing mandatory training for staff on workplace conditions, enforcing a mobile phone ban in schools up to grade 9, creating emergency classes for disruptive students, and providing special education for students who have committed crimes. The overall goal is to create a safe and conducive study environment for all students.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:48 Organdonation
summary: Lotta Finstorp proposes a review of the distribution of state regional development funds among counties in Sweden, emphasizing significant disparities in allocation that reflect outdated perceptions of regional needs. She highlights Sörmland's challenges, such as high unemployment and low educational attainment, which have led to insufficient state support compared to other regions like Jämtland and Skåne, advocating for a reassessment to address these inequalities.

title: Tillträdesförbud till butik och förstärkt straffrättsligt skydd mot tillgreppsbrottslighet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take steps to increase the number of individuals training as craftsmen to support the transition to a circular economy. It highlights a lack of awareness about existing vocational education programs among the public, particularly regarding crafts, and stresses the urgent need for greater efforts to promote and sustain craftsmanship education to meet future labor demands. The motion argues that craftsmen play a crucial role in repairing and maintaining high-quality products, which is vital for achieving sustainability goals.

title: Skadeståndets omfattning vid finansiell rådgivning
summary: The motion suggests that the government should consider appointing an investigation to develop a model for a mandatory primary workers' compensation insurance based on an insurance principle, which would create economic incentives for employers to ensure safe and secure work environments. The author cites concerns about the current workers' compensation system, highlighting that it redistributes costs from safe workplaces to those that are hazardous, thereby lacking incentives for employers to improve workplace safety.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:48 Organdonation
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the regulatory complexities faced by the equine industry in Sweden, highlighting the sector's economic significance and the need for reduced bureaucracy to encourage entrepreneurship and job creation. It emphasizes that the viability of equine enterprises is often undermined by unfavorable tax assessments and calls for clearer regulations to support growth within this popular sector.

title: Konkurrensverkets befogenheter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support a follow-up and evaluation of the application of cash register regulations in the tax procedures act. Since the implementation of these regulations in 2010, issues have arisen in their interpretation and practice, particularly affecting outdoor vendors who face challenges related to the reliability and quality assurance of cash registers. The motion calls for a thorough assessment of the actual consequences of the cash register requirement for businesses.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:43 En anpassning av bestämmelser om kontroll i livsmedelskedjan till EU:s nya kontrollförordning
summary: The proposal suggests reducing the waiting period for vehicle tax refunds from 15 days to 4 days for vehicles in commercial traffic (buses, trucks, taxis) and rental vehicles, highlighting the impact of the COVID-19 crisis on the transport sector. The motion emphasizes the need for flexibility to ensure business survival and protect jobs, arguing that a shorter waiting period would ease administrative burdens and minimize costs for small and medium-sized enterprises in the industry.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:42 Genomförande av 2017 års ändringsdirektiv till EU:s vapendirektiv
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of abolishing the requirement that tenants must continuously conduct VAT-taxable activities in the premises they rent. The current VAT exemption on property rentals limits access for non-profit organizations, such as sports associations, to localities suitable for their operations. The change is sought to alleviate the difficulties faced by these organizations in finding rental spaces, particularly due to recent regulatory shifts by the Swedish Tax Agency which have worsened the situation. The proposal aims to open up opportunities for non-VAT-taxable entities, enhancing their ability to secure necessary venues for their activities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:42 Genomförande av 2017 års ändringsdirektiv till EU:s vapendirektiv
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the regulations surrounding the use of digital communication devices by children and youth placed in care facilities like HVB-hem and Sis homes. It suggests that these facilities should have the legal capability to restrict mobile and internet access, especially during the initial treatment phase, to protect youths from destructive influences and maintain conducive environments for rehabilitation. The motion emphasizes the need for careful, individualized assessments when deciding on these restrictions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:42 Genomförande av 2017 års ändringsdirektiv till EU:s vapendirektiv
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3774 av Johan Hedin och Helena Vilhelmsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should clarify the responsibilities outlined in health and medical care legislation to ensure that healthcare providers engage a patient's employer early in the rehabilitation process to avoid sickness absence. Additionally, it suggests allowing healthcare providers to refer patients to occupational health services when health issues are believed to be related to workplace conditions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:43 En anpassning av bestämmelser om kontroll i livsmedelskedjan till EU:s nya kontrollförordning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of providing more care and treatment for intoxicated individuals at the time of their apprehension under the law governing the apprehension of intoxicated persons. It highlights the geographical disparities in the handling of these cases, where a significant majority are taken to arrest instead of health care facilities, posing medical risks and hindering support for those in need of addiction treatment. The motion emphasizes the importance of addressing the responsibilities regarding the care of apprehended individuals and calls for attention to be given to the minor children of those apprehended.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:39 Riksrevisionens rapport om Arbetsförmedlingens tjänst Stöd och matchning
summary: The motion proposes expediting the removal of level crossings in urban areas where high-speed trains pass, citing significant safety risks, particularly for children. It highlights the dangers of level crossings, noting that over ten fatalities occur annually in related accidents. The motion emphasizes the need for continued prioritization of this safety work, as previous efforts have halved the number of such crossings and resulted in a significant decrease in fatalities and injuries.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:47 Uppföljning av vaccinationer mot covid-19
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support efforts to facilitate data sharing between government agencies to reduce erroneous welfare payments and combat organized crime. Previous studies indicated that incorrect disbursements from welfare systems amount to approximately 18 billion kronor annually, with some funds potentially benefiting criminal networks. The motion argues that existing regulations limiting data sharing may unnecessarily hinder government operations and that agencies like the Employment Service should be able to verify information with the Social Insurance Agency to prevent fraud.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:42 Genomförande av 2017 års ändringsdirektiv till EU:s vapendirektiv
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should transition from a hereditary monarchy to a system where the head of state is democratically elected by the people. The proponents argue that the current hereditary system is inconsistent with democratic principles and is a remnant of an outdated societal structure. They call for the government to consider a future review of the state system to ensure that the head of state represents and is accountable to the electorate.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:42 Genomförande av EU:s ändringsdirektiv till EU:s vapendirektiv
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the oversight of human rights for individuals with disabilities in Sweden, emphasizing their right to equality and full participation in society. It highlights the importance of ensuring that people with disabilities are not discriminated against and can engage in all aspects of political, social, economic, and cultural life on equal terms with others, urging the government to take further actions in line with previous initiatives.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:42 Genomförande av 2017 års ändringsdirektiv till EU:s vapendirektiv
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3768 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament consider making Midsummer Eve a national day, emphasizing its importance as a significant cultural celebration in Sweden, symbolizing summer, leisure, and a historical marker of the agricultural calendar.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the extension of student financial aid and changes to the regulations to enhance lifelong learning. It highlights the growing mismatch in the Swedish labor market exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic and emphasizes the need for continuous education and adaptability. The motion suggests that current systems do not adequately support adults seeking further education and proposes measures such as increased financial aid, flexible study options, debt forgiveness for studies in demand professions, and raising the age limit for student loans.

title: Utökade möjligheter för Tullverket att besluta om postspärrar
summary: The motion advocates for increased funding and prioritization of research on women's diseases and health, highlighting the historical neglect of such subjects in medical research. It points out that conditions like endometriosis, incontinence, fibromyalgia, migraines, burnout, and pregnancy-related diseases are under-researched, which has led to higher mortality rates and inadequate treatment for women. The motion emphasizes the need for comprehensive studies and investments in understanding how various diseases specifically impact women, arguing that this would not only benefit individual women and their families but also result in economic savings for society.

title: Organdonation
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a national action plan to improve the treatment of endometriosis in Sweden, addressing the significant delays in diagnosis and the inadequate care currently available. It highlights the severe pain and suffering experienced by over 200,000 women with endometriosis, calls for enhanced training for healthcare professionals, and emphasizes the need for specialized care and better access to effective medications, which should also be included under the high-cost protection scheme.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:38 Förlängning av lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3766 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: The motion proposes strengthening the legislation regarding traffic offenses to enhance the collection of evidence against drivers suspected of DUI who claim to have consumed alcohol after an incident. This issue has been increasingly noted in various legal cases, especially in incidents where breath tests cannot be administered immediately. The lack of effective legislation has led to challenges in prosecuting such cases, necessitating a more robust legal framework similar to that which has been successfully implemented in Norway.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:31 Riksrevisionens rapport Vägen till arbete efter nekad sjukpenning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate ways to strengthen support for victims of traffic accidents in legal processes. It highlights the difficulties individuals face when seeking compensation from insurance companies due to high legal costs and the risk of financial burden from prolonged litigation. The authors argue that the current system deters victims from pursuing their rights and call for reforms to ensure a fair and just process for those injured in traffic incidents.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:31 Riksrevisionens rapport Vägen till arbete efter nekad sjukpenning
summary: The proposal suggests reviewing the current age regulations for adoption in Sweden, particularly the maximum age limit of 42 years for international adoptions. The motion highlights societal changes, such as increased education levels and delayed family formation, arguing that these factors necessitate an update to existing adoption laws to prioritize the suitability of parents over strict age limits.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:31 Riksrevisionens rapport Vägen till arbete efter nekad sjukpenning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3763 av Julia Kronlid och Linda Lindberg (båda SD)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to support the study of improving the road conditions on roads 153 and 154, which are heavily used due to the high volume of traffic from Gekås in Ullared, Sweden's largest tourist destination. The current road standards are deemed inadequate given the significant transportation demands from visitors, employees, and local businesses, suggesting that the state should take responsibility for these improvements.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:31 Riksrevisionens rapport Vägen till arbete efter nekad sjukpenning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3762 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: This motion advocates for increased measures to ensure a safe and healthy working environment for employees in Sweden, as the rise in workplace accidents and ill health among workers undermines their ability to work until retirement age. The motion emphasizes the need for better resources for the Work Environment Authority, knowledge dissemination to improve work conditions, and collaboration with labor market partners to prioritize a healthier work life, calling on the government to act urgently in this area.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:31 Riksrevisionens rapport Vägen till arbete efter nekad sjukpenning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the cessation of Israel's occupation and settlement policies in Palestine, respect for the divided status of Jerusalem, and efforts by Sweden and the EU to assist the suffering inhabitants of Gaza. It stresses that Sweden should actively work through the UN and EU to prevent the annexation of occupied Palestinian territories, advocating for a peaceful resolution based on international resolutions and equitable negotiations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:29 Pausad BNP-indexering för drivmedel
summary: The proposal calls for a change in the seating arrangement of members of the Swedish Parliament (Riksdag) from being based on electoral districts to a party-based arrangement. The authors argue that this change would facilitate better internal communication within parties, allow for more collective voting during decisions, and enhance the quality of debates by aligning members with their respective party groups. They contend that this modernization is necessary, as the current system is outdated and creates difficulties for smaller parties, and that such a change would not require additional resources or a new election.

title: Uppföljning av vaccinationer mot covid-19
summary: The motion proposes a governmental review of legislation to ensure that fines imposed on offenders are more proportional to the harm caused by their crimes. The author highlights examples of disproportionate fines, where the penalties do not reflect the actual damage or costs incurred by their actions, suggesting that current practices often result in offenders being under-penalized relative to the impact of their offenses.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:28 Riksrevisionens rapport om tillväxthämmande incitament i den kommunala inkomstutjämningen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3759 av Rickard Nordin och Lars Thomsson (båda C)
