summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to review the regulations governing increased drainage in forests to facilitate higher timber production. It emphasizes that enhanced forest growth can contribute to carbon dioxide binding, provide more sustainable building materials, and support the transition to biofuels. The motion also argues that current laws limiting drainage represent a significant restriction on property rights, and it suggests that well-drained forests are more resilient to storms, advocating for governmental support in this area.

title: Ny lag om tvingande vård av vårdnadshavare (LVV)
summary: The proposal advocates for a review and reduction of vehicle and road taxes in Sweden, particularly for trucks and buses, to enhance the competitiveness of Swedish transportation companies. It argues that the current tax burden is excessively high compared to competitors in other European countries, which hampers the ability of Swedish businesses to compete effectively in the open market.

title: Utbyggnad av E16 på sträckan Gävle–Oslo
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into the possibility of granting customs officers the authority to carry weapons and to have additional police powers, due to the risks they face from armed criminals at the borders. It emphasizes the need for customs officials to be adequately protected and equipped to effectively manage encounters with crime, particularly when police assistance may not be immediately available.

title: Heltidsarbete som norm inom offentlig sektor
summary: The proposal calls for a review and evaluation of the chemical tax imposed on electronic products, arguing that it burdens consumers and may lead to negative consequences for Swedish jobs and businesses without improving environmental outcomes. It suggests that the initial rationale for the tax, which was to affect the production of electronic products, has not materialized as intended, potentially harming the circular economy instead. The motion urges the government to conduct this assessment and ultimately repeal the tax.

title: Möjliggörande av föräldraledighet för mor- och farföräldrar
summary: The motion proposes that companies managing hazardous waste should be required to obtain certification to ensure proper handling and transportation of such materials. It addresses the growing issue of illegal dumping and mismanagement of hazardous waste, particularly in light of the increasing use of batteries. The lack of oversight and the presence of unscrupulous companies have led to environmental pollution, affecting both land and water quality, posing health risks to humans and animals. A certification system is suggested as a potential solution to mitigate these environmental hazards.

title: Förebyggande drogtester i skolan
summary: The motion proposes that the protection status for certain bird and animal species should be time-limited and regularly evaluated. It highlights the risk of overpopulation and dominance of protected species, which can threaten other wildlife, as demonstrated by the increase in crane populations. The motion advocates for assessments of protected status every five years to prevent ecological imbalances.

title: En utbyggnad av Ostkustbanan till dubbelspår
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Board of Agriculture should review its recommendations on varroa treatment and measurement methods to promote sustainable beekeeping practices. The proposal highlights the importance of pollinators to ecosystems and agriculture, suggesting that breeding honeybees with increased varroa tolerance is essential for long-term sustainability. It criticizes current practices that prioritize chemical treatments over natural management strategies, advocating for updated guidelines that support healthier bee populations.

title: Utbyggnad av E4:an på sträckan Gävle–Sundsvall
summary: The motion proposes allowing private individuals to sell chicken eggs directly to retailers, which is currently restricted by regulations requiring registration as a primary producer. It advocates for the sale of eggs sorted by weight and quality, as well as the washing and cleaning of eggs to meet consumer demand for locally produced food and to facilitate competition with larger producers.

title: Utökad undervisning om mänskliga rättigheter som ett enskilt ämne i skolan
summary: The motion proposes increased investment in food technology and innovative food research in order to address climate change and public health issues. It emphasizes the need for Sweden to shift its food production methods and consumption patterns to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions and combat lifestyle-related diseases. The motion advocates for political support for food tech initiatives, suggesting that Sweden could become a leader in food research in Europe while contributing to sustainability and improved health outcomes.

title: Diskriminering i vården
summary: The motion proposes to increase incentives for wild boar hunting by allowing individuals to sell wild boar meat directly without passing through a game handling facility, reviewing the regulations for such facilities to ease their establishment, and reassessing the management of the wild boar population. It highlights the rapid growth of the wild boar population causing significant damage to agriculture and increased wildlife accidents, advocating for changes that would enable hunters to sell wild boar meat more freely while maintaining health safety measures.

title: Om slöjan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3650 av Leila Ali-Elmi och Camilla Hansén (båda MP)
summary: The proposal suggests that all children and youth in Sweden should receive education in entrepreneurship at least once during their school time, emphasizing the importance of fostering new businesses and encouraging young people, regardless of their background, to explore opportunities in entrepreneurship.

title: En tryggare, mer flexibel och individanpassad sjukförsäkring
summary: The proposal suggests implementing licensed hunting of cormorants and increasing egg treatment efforts in the Stockholm archipelago and across Sweden, to mitigate the bird's negative impact on local fish populations and biodiversity. The motion argues that the cormorant population has surged, leading to significant fish consumption and environmental degradation, harming both local fisheries and ecosystems. The aim is to establish better population control measures that support the sustainability of the archipelago's environment and economy.

title: Inför rotationsprincip för riksdagsledamöter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament acknowledge the need to address coastal erosion caused by the sea as a state responsibility. It suggests a review of regulations governing beach nourishment to streamline the process by reducing the number of involved authorities, and questions the current state compensation claims from municipalities for sand recovered from eroded beaches. The authors emphasize the importance of coastlines for communities, commerce, and biodiversity, and argue for a more integrated and supportive governmental approach to effectively tackle coastal erosion.

title: Politik för det samiska folket
summary: The motion proposes a review of the VAT legislation regarding dance bands, aiming to harmonize tax rates and improve conditions for the cultural sector during and after the pandemic. It highlights the inconsistent VAT rates applied to concerts and dance events, arguing that a lower VAT rate for dance could promote public health and support the recovery of the dance band industry. The motion also calls for a unified tax rate within the culture sector to foster a dynamic industry.

title: Färre och mer miljövänliga resor för riksdagsledamöter efter coronapandemin
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3646 av Annika Hirvonen Falk och Lorentz Tovatt (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes to expedite investment in new locks in Trollhättan and Lilla Edet while considering landslide risks. A study indicates that without new locks, Vänersjöfarten may cease operations by 2030, significantly increasing truck and train traffic. The current locks are outdated and require replacement to accommodate larger vessels and improve environmental transport efficiency. The government is urged to reassess funding timelines to ensure the project is properly executed and that safety measures against increased traffic-related slide risks are taken into account.

title: Tandvård för våldsutsatta kvinnor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the development of a strategy to ensure the survival of regional airports, which have been significantly impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic. The authors argue that these airports are essential for local economies, tourism, and provide critical civil defense functions. They emphasize that the government's financial aid has primarily benefitted larger airports, neglecting the regional ones, and call for immediate action to safeguard their future viability.

title: Hinder för framkomlighet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3644 av Emma Hult och Camilla Hansén (båda MP)
summary: The motion addresses the need for measures to ensure the long-term survival of Trollhättan Airport and other small and medium-sized airports in Sweden post-COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the importance of reliable air transport for business communication within Sweden and the crucial role of regional airports in supporting essential services such as medical transport and defense operations. The motion calls for government intervention in the form of a support system to help these airports resume commercial operations while also facilitating economic growth and regional development.

title: Barns tillgångar i samband med familjens rätt till bostadsbidrag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should advocate for the government to implement clearer requirements for food labeling, specifically to enhance the visibility of nutritional information on packaging. This initiative aims to assist consumers in making healthier dietary choices amidst rising obesity rates, especially among younger populations.

title: Ett väl fungerande återvändande
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3642 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes measures to address involuntary loneliness and isolation, particularly among the elderly, by increasing meeting places and improving opportunities for communal meals. It highlights the negative health impacts of loneliness, exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic, and suggests adopting successful strategies from the UK, such as appointing a loneliness minister and enabling doctors to prescribe social activities.

title: Medborgarråd för rättvis omställning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3641 av Rebecka Le Moine och Lorentz Tovatt (båda MP)
summary: The motion calls for active measures to combat the increasing national and global development of antibiotic resistance, highlighting its severe health implications and the need for a comprehensive monitoring program. It emphasizes that antibiotic resistance poses significant threats to public health worldwide, necessitating urgent attention from both the Swedish parliament and the government to prevent future health crises and deaths caused by resistant infections.

title: Utred basinkomst
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3640 av Rebecka Le Moine och Mats Berglund (båda MP)
summary: The proposal calls for the establishment of a favorable and stable system for personal pension savings due to the increasing inadequacies of the current pension system in Sweden. The current system has left many full-time workers facing low pensions, with growing numbers of pensioners in financial hardship. The motion argues for revitalizing personal pension savings options, which were more beneficial in the past, allowing individuals to have a greater say in their future pensions. It emphasizes the urgency of addressing this issue and suggests that further investigation into specific measures is necessary.

title: Stoppa regnskogsskövlingen
summary: The motion proposes making the general vaccination program for children mandatory, with the government tasked to explore conditions for enforcement and sanctions against parents who refuse vaccination. It highlights the rise of vaccine skepticism fueled by misinformation and the need to protect public health. The motion also calls for legislative changes to allow vaccination when only one guardian consents, addressing situations where one parent's opposition prevents necessary vaccinations.

title: En grön återstart av kulturen i pandemins spår
summary: This motion proposes a review of measures regarding underage individuals who commit crimes in Sweden. It suggests lowering the age of criminal responsibility and examining how to require parents of young offenders to engage with authorities in addressing their children's criminal behavior. Additionally, it advocates for exploring potential penalties for parents who fail to fulfill these obligations, aiming to enhance societal measures against juvenile delinquency and ensure the rights of victims.

title: Hälso- och sjukvård
summary: The motion proposes a review of the need for measures to prevent the misuse of Attefall rules in Sweden, which allow for increased housing development in existing areas. The author, Erik Ottoson, highlights that while these regulations have facilitated more housing options, they have also led to challenges for municipalities in maintaining planning authority. Specifically, there have been instances where developers exploit these rules to build multiple units on properties designated for single-family homes, resulting in unintended consequences such as overcrowding and strain on local infrastructure and services. The suggestion calls on the government to ensure that the use of these regulations aligns with their original intent.

title: Sydafrika
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3636 av Roger Richthoff och Björn Söder (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to address the housing shortage for students and young adults by advocating for tax exemptions on rental income from student housing and reviewing existing mortgage regulations for young borrowers. This includes suggesting exceptions to the mortgage ceiling, credit assessment rules, and amortization requirements to facilitate access to housing for young individuals entering the market.

title: Bättre villkor för den forskande life science-industrin i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to improve compensation opportunities for relatives of crime victims affected by police barricades or other coercive measures. It highlights that during ongoing investigations, families bear significant costs related to the property that is under investigation, which are not covered by insurance. The motion emphasizes the state's interest in protecting crime victims to maintain public trust in its legal system.

title: Förbättrade möjligheter för den svenska sjöfartens konkurrenskraft
summary: Karin Enström proposes to investigate the number of accidents caused by mobile phone use among cyclists and to extend the existing ban on holding a mobile phone while driving motor vehicles to also include bicycles. The motion argues for enhanced safety in traffic, highlighting the increasing danger posed by mobile phone use among cyclists, which has been shown to be a growing issue without current statistical tracking in Sweden.

title: Möjlighet att betala skadestånd retroaktivt även efter att preskriptionstiden förfallit
summary: The proposal seeks to allow longer-duration relocations of students to different schools, enabling placements that can last up to a term, with potential extensions for an additional term. It aims to address disciplinary issues by providing students with a more effective change of environment, which could help improve behavior and educational engagement. Additionally, it suggests the possibility of relocating students to neighboring municipalities to enhance this environmental change.

title: Möjlighet att stryka kandidater i allmänna val
summary: The motion proposes that CSN loans should be deductible under the interest deduction rules in Sweden, allowing students to benefit from tax reductions. Additionally, it advocates for the right to CSN loans to be granted to students regardless of their income levels, aiming to remove the current limits on earnings while studying, known as the 'fribelopp', which restrict students' income without affecting their financial aid.

title: Möjligheter med genmodifierade grödor (GMO)
summary: The motion proposes that students elected to public office should have the right to take leave from their studies to fulfill their duties, similar to the rights granted to employees participating in municipal meetings. The current system forces students to choose between attending mandatory academic sessions and fulfilling their democratic responsibilities, which is deemed unreasonable.

title: Att underlätta för fritidspolitiker att verka inom rikspolitiken
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament evaluate and enhance the conversion of International Baccalaureate (IB) points into Swedish merit points. The motion argues that the current system makes it increasingly difficult for IB students to achieve high merit scores necessary for university admission in Sweden compared to international standards. The motion points out that the criteria for converting IB points have become more stringent, leading to a decline in interest among prospective IB students, and calls for a fairer assessment process that acknowledges the rigors of the IB program.

title: Äganderätten
summary: The motion proposes several reforms aimed at improving the quality of higher education in Sweden. Key suggestions include revising the evaluation methods for university programs, establishing a ranking system for educational quality, reallocating resources based on quality rather than quantity, enhancing collaboration between educational institutions and the labor market, enabling more flexibly governed universities, and facilitating talent acquisition for foreign experts and researchers through changes to taxation and visa regulations.

title: Höjd standard på E14
summary: The motion proposes to reduce waste of taxpayer money by implementing a broader accountability framework for public officials, which includes responsibility for managing public funds. It highlights the current lack of accountability for decisions that lead to financial mismanagement and suggests that public officials should face proportionate consequences for their actions.

title: Mittuniversitetet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish tax authorities should include a detailed breakdown of how tax revenues are utilized on tax declarations. This initiative aims to increase transparency regarding public spending and hold politicians accountable for their financial priorities, especially in light of concerns over wasteful expenditures and budget overruns in public projects.

title: Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
summary: The proposal suggests making it mandatory for employers to include the employer's social security contributions on pay slips in Sweden. This aims to increase public awareness of the overall tax burden and ensure that citizens have a clear understanding of how much of their earnings are taxed. By enhancing transparency regarding tax payments, the motion intends to allow individuals to better assess their satisfaction with the tax levels and hold the government accountable for public spending. The proponent argues that this requirement would not significantly increase the administrative burden on employers.

title: En moderniserad delgivningslag
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need for the Eastern Connection project in Stockholm County, advocating for state co-financing due to the region's rapid population growth and the resulting traffic congestion. It highlights the economic benefits of improved infrastructure, stressing that the project would alleviate significant delays and costs associated with traffic, while also considering future advancements in cleaner transportation. The motion argues that supporting this project is crucial for sustainable urban growth and to ensure Stockholm remains a key contributor to Sweden's economy.

title: Gifttunnor i Bottenhavet
summary: The motion proposes that the registration for organ and tissue donation in Sweden should be made possible through the tax declaration process. This change aims to simplify the registration for individuals, as current methods show that a significant majority of the population supports organ donation, yet a much smaller percentage has officially registered. By facilitating registration, the motion seeks to increase the number of registered donors, ultimately aiming to save more lives.

title: Handlares rätt att avvisa notoriska snattare
summary: Ida Drougge proposes that the Swedish Parliament should review current driving regulations allowing lighter vehicles with poorer braking systems to tow heavier trailers than larger, safer vehicles. The motion argues this creates unsafe driving conditions, as heavier vehicles with better braking capabilities are often restricted by weight limits. It suggests that the government should instruct the Transport Agency to consider allowing four-wheel drive cars with higher towing capacity to pull heavier trailers to enhance road safety.

title: Lokalisering av statliga bolag och myndigheter
summary: Ida Drougge's motion calls for a review and modification of the congestion tax regulations for residents of Ropsten and Lidingö. The motion argues that the current positioning of the congestion tax payment station in Ropsten contradicts the goal of reducing traffic congestion and incentivizing public transportation usage. It highlights that the existing congestion tax discourages collective transport due to increased costs for those who park at Ropsten and subsequently use public transport, while proposing an exemption for such commuters to improve accessibility and fairness.

title: Papperskvitton
summary: The motion proposed by Ida Drougge emphasizes the need for a more transparent tax system in Sweden. It argues that most households underestimate their tax burden and that improving awareness around taxes is essential for democracy. The proposal suggests making certain taxes, such as employer contributions and VAT, more visible on payslips and in stores to enhance public understanding of their financial obligations, while also ensuring that this does not increase administrative burdens for businesses. Additionally, it draws comparisons to the Danish model, advocating for clearer labeling of taxes and a potential change in reporting practices.

title: Köp och försäljning av häst och levande djur i konsumentköplagen
summary: This proposal suggests converting the employer's contribution fee into income tax to increase transparency in the tax system. The motion highlights that a significant portion of the employer's contribution is essentially a tax that is not linked to any specific insurance and argues that making this change would clarify the tax obligations for citizens.

title: Alltid sommartid
summary: The motion proposes a transparent tax system that allows citizens to clearly understand how much tax they pay and how it is used. It suggests that the government should require states and municipalities to report taxation details directly to taxpayers, potentially through their bank statements. The aim is to enhance awareness about tax contributions to facilitate informed public discourse about political choices and government spending, ultimately leading to a more democratic dialogue about taxation and resource distribution.

title: Förändrade cruisingtillstånd
summary: The motion proposes that the Parliament of Sweden should investigate the definition of what constitutes a fee and recommends that fees which are effectively taxes be renamed accordingly. The motion argues for transparency in the naming of fees and taxes, emphasizing that fees should be proportionate to the cost of the service provided. The sponsor highlights the confusion surrounding the distinction between fees and taxes and argues that a clear definition is necessary to prevent misleading terminology.

title: E20 som projektväg för elektrifiering (t.ex. laddstolpar)
summary: The motion proposes stricter regulations for the chicken industry in Sweden, focusing on improving living conditions for chickens and implementing zero tolerance for legal violations during the slaughter process. It highlights severe welfare issues, such as overcrowded living conditions, health problems due to rapid breeding, and cruel handling before and during slaughter. The motion demands the government to review and enhance current regulations to ensure better treatment and protection for chickens.

title: Skarven i Roxen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3616 av Jonas Andersson i Linköping (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that landlords should have the right to require tenants to have home insurance and suggests investigating the possibility of making such insurance mandatory in certain cases. It argues that while most of the population already has home insurance, a significant minority does not, and these individuals often belong to economically vulnerable groups. The proposal highlights the risks and financial burdens associated with not having home insurance, especially in the event of disasters or accidents that could lead to substantial economic loss.

title: Framtiden för Sancta Birgitta Klostermuseum
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3615 av Jonas Andersson i Linköping (SD)
summary: This proposal advocates for stricter regulations concerning the breeding of certain brachycephalic animals, addressing the ethical concerns surrounding their welfare due to health issues stemming from their physical characteristics. It calls for mandatory health certificates for breeding, mapping of animals with respiratory issues, increased consumer awareness of their suffering, and the introduction of new regulations to mitigate their suffering. The proposal also seeks to prohibit breeding of individuals that have undergone corrective surgeries for breathing problems.

title: Redovisning och reducering av kostnader för asyl- och anhöriginvandring
summary: The proposal advocates for a national grant for seniors to purchase anti-slip devices to prevent fall accidents, which pose a significant risk for individuals aged 65 and over. The motion highlights the rise in severe injuries and fatalities due to falls, exacerbated by inadequate infrastructure and the cost of preventative aids like slip protectors. By implementing this grant, the aim is to reduce the pressure on healthcare services and enhance the safety of the elderly population during winter conditions.

title: Det rullande kulturarvet
summary: The proposal suggests amending the school curriculum by removing the responsibility for schools to counteract traditional gender roles while advocating for the inclusion of explicit references to honor-related violence and oppression. It argues that the current curriculum lacks clarity on traditional gender roles and emphasizes the importance of addressing honor-related issues systematically to ensure student safety and individuality.

title: Insjöfarten på Vänern och Vättern
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of e-petitions to enhance citizen participation in Swedish democracy and a clearer definition of the responsibilities of the Swedish National Audit Office. The motion emphasizes increasing public involvement and responsiveness among decision-makers by enabling citizens to submit proposals that can be supported by their peers. Additionally, it seeks to strengthen the oversight role of the National Audit Office to ensure responsible use of tax funds and improve transparency in governmental actions.

title: Skönhetsbranschen
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of a recognized certification for the profession of personal trainer, aiming to legitimize the title and ensure that individuals seeking personal training services can trust the qualifications of their trainers. It highlights the importance of personal health and the risks associated with unqualified trainers providing potentially harmful advice, especially in light of heightened awareness regarding health due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion calls for an investigation into the necessary qualifications for obtaining the title of certified personal trainer before its official implementation.

title: Narkotikapolisens krav på familjeklassning
summary: The motion proposes changes to the current coastal protection legislation in Sweden to facilitate the construction of new homes near water bodies while still protecting access to beaches and unique natural values. It argues that the strict regulations have hampered development, especially in less populated areas, and calls for the government to revise the legislation to strike a better balance between environmental conservation and housing development.

title: Fler åtgärder för att undvika brott
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden's aid agency, Sida, require its strategic partner organizations to adhere to scientific evidence in their operations. It calls for systematic evaluations to ensure that the aid provided is based on reliable and factual information, rather than misinformation or unscientific claims. The aim is to enhance the quality of development aid and prevent taxpayers' money from being used to support baseless assertions that could diminish trust in the aid sector and its effectiveness.

title: Dubbelspår Sundsvall–Gävle
summary: The motion proposes establishing April 24 as a national memorial day dedicated to the victims of the Seyfo genocide, which primarily affected Armenians, Assyrians/Syriacs, Greeks, and Yazidis during the Ottoman Empire from 1915 onwards. The motion emphasizes the historical significance of these events and the ongoing lack of recognition for the victims, highlighting the importance of commemorating their suffering and the need for acknowledgment of the atrocities committed.

title: Förbifart Härnösand
summary: The motion proposes that gender equality should be a core principle across all government agencies and administrative bodies as outlined in the annual regulatory letters. It argues that while the Swedish Equality Agency has a role, the responsibility for gender equality should not rest solely on one authority. The proposal emphasizes the need for all agencies to contribute to meaningful progress in reducing wage gaps and structural inequalities, suggesting that a cultural and leadership change within organizations is essential for promoting gender equality throughout the state.

title: Kommunala poliser
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a unified basic training program for personnel in the police, Customs, and the Coast Guard in Sweden, arguing that this would enhance collaboration among these agencies in crime prevention and enforcement. It suggests that the training for Customs and the Coast Guard should be equal to higher education and emphasizes the need for common education to break down territorial thinking and improve cooperation. The proposal also highlights the economic benefits of a shared training program, which could free up resources within the agencies for other operations.

title: Ådalsbanan mellan Sundsvall och Härnösand
summary: The motion proposes to amend the handling of amounts under 100 kronor on tax accounts, suggesting that both assets and liabilities below this threshold should remain unprocessed within the account instead of being paid out or demanded. The aim is to reduce administrative burdens and costs for taxpayers by treating small amounts more fairly, as the current practice allows surplus amounts to remain while requiring payment of even trivial deficits.

title: Straffrättsreform
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament allow police to conduct crime provocation on the internet in cases of suspected sexual offenses against minors and individuals with intellectual disabilities. The intention is to use undercover operations where police pose as minors to identify and apprehend adults seeking sexual contact with children. The motion argues that this method, appropriately regulated, could help combat organized networks of offenders by providing law enforcement with access to restricted forums and ultimately safeguard vulnerable groups.

title: Föräldraalienation och umgängessabotage
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to initiate an investigation into joint liability for damages (solidarisk skadestånd) in order to prevent recidivism in criminal behavior. The authors argue that while this system benefits crime victims by allowing them to claim damages from any of the liable parties, it may also hinder the rehabilitation of offenders by imposing burdensome financial responsibilities that do not accurately reflect their involvement in the crime. The motion seeks to balance the rights of victims to receive compensation with the need to facilitate the reintegration of former offenders into society.

title: Sverige och svenskan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the consideration of allowing the police to confiscate property from individuals with debts to Kronofogden, enhancing their ability to combat criminal organizations. The current limitation requires that property be in police possession, hindering actions against known criminals who carry valuable items but are not under arrest. By permitting police access to Kronofogden's debt registers, officers would be empowered to confiscate property temporarily, thereby increasing pressure on criminals.

title: Slopa vägtrafikskatten för tävlingsfordon
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should take measures to restrict access to the vehicle register maintained by Transportstyrelsen for crime prevention purposes. It highlights the increasing risks associated with the current transparency of vehicle ownership information, which has been exploited by criminals to threaten vehicle owners and steal vehicles. The motion argues for a review of the access policies of the vehicle register, noting that some other countries have stricter regulations that limit the availability of such information, and calls for the government to investigate effective restrictions.

title: Värmländsk finnskog med rökstugor som världsarv
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into ownership taxes in Sweden with the aim of making them more competitive. It highlights the historical challenges faced by the Swedish economy due to unfavorable conditions for business ownership, leading to a decline in investment and ownership by local entrepreneurs. The motion argues for a reduction in capital income tax to stimulate investment, create jobs, and enhance Sweden's economic performance in comparison to other countries, suggesting that such changes could lead to significant GDP growth and increased employment.

title: Kampanj om kommunismens brott mot mänskligheten
summary: The motion proposes that the State Service Center should regularly disclose employer contributions on pay slips to enhance transparency and public understanding of the tax system. It argues that many citizens underestimate the tax burden and that employer contributions, which significantly contribute to public sector revenues, should be clearly presented to foster trust in government institutions.

title: Skolavslutning med tradition
summary: The suggestion proposes urgent measures to increase safety in public spaces by enhancing police presence and the deployment of trained security guards. It highlights an urgent need for a rapid increase in police personnel in external service and improvements in community safety, especially in vulnerable areas. The initiative calls for government action to facilitate the hiring of more police and security personnel, as well as potential temporary fast-track training for new officers.

title: Gemenskap och trygghet med morgonsamling
summary: Lars Jilmstad's motion advocates for the Swedish government to combat age discrimination by implementing an appointment policy that prioritizes the hiring of competent older individuals for temporary positions. The proposal highlights the benefits of retaining older workers, including their improved health, ongoing professional development, and potential contributions to the workforce. Jilmstad argues that the state should take the lead in promoting the recruitment of senior talent, which may encourage other sectors to follow suit, thereby enhancing workplace diversity and capitalizing on the experience of older employees.

title: Värna om dialekterna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should allow for more than two legal guardians for children, reflecting the modern reality where many children grow up in diverse family structures. The current limitation on the number of legal guardians creates challenges for non-biological parents or additional caregivers who wish to take on a legal role in a child's upbringing. This proposal seeks to amend the existing laws to accommodate the needs of contemporary family dynamics.

title: Folkparken som kulturbärare
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a regulatory guillotine process in Sweden to simplify the business environment for entrepreneurs by reducing regulatory burdens. It refers to the previous advocacy of Johnny Munkhammar and highlights the increasing challenge posed by existing regulations. The proposal suggests that this methodology could enhance business conditions by assessing existing regulations based on their necessity, legality, and friendliness towards enterprises, with examples from other countries showcasing its potential effectiveness.

title: Dansbandsmomsen
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a tax exemption for the first income earned from work to encourage more individuals, particularly students and newcomers to the job market, to enter employment. By making initial earnings tax-free, it aims to reduce barriers to entry in the labor market and enhance the incentive to work.

title: Argentinasvenskarnas okända historia bör uppmärksammas
summary: The motion proposes that service pensions should be included in the property division during divorces and that they should be transferable to a partner during marriage without requiring a formal division of assets. The motivation for the proposal is to address the economic disparities faced by women due to their greater take-up of parental leave and part-time work, which result in lower lifetime earnings and pensions. The motion highlights a societal preference for equal pension sharing, as indicated by a survey where over half of Swedes supported this change.

title: Reformera äldreomsorgen
summary: The motion proposes several measures to restrict welfare benefits in Sweden, including abolishing child allowances for those who have never worked, completely eliminating retroactive parental benefits for newcomers, limiting parental benefits to the first year of the child's life for those who haven't worked, and tying public assistance to participation in language education and community service. The intent is to ensure that the welfare system remains sustainable by ensuring only those who contribute through work and taxes are eligible for full benefits.

title: Värmlands regionala utveckling
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of an electronic warning system in the Swedish Tax Agency's database when more than two adults are registered at the same address. This aims to combat benefit fraud, which has significantly impacted the Swedish welfare system, resulting in substantial financial losses since 2005. The proposal emphasizes that individuals should contribute to the social insurance systems through work to qualify for benefits and suggests enhanced measures for identity verification to minimize fraudulent activities.

title: Bevara Norrköpings Skolmuseum
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3590 av Jonas Andersson i Linköping (SD)
summary: The proposal suggests implementing measures to combat benefit fraud by requiring individuals applying for benefits to authorize the sharing of their information with relevant authorities. The Moderates argue that access to social insurance systems should be contingent upon having contributed through work, citing significant financial losses due to misappropriated benefits as a major issue. They propose that increased collaboration between agencies and stricter identification methods, including the use of biometric data, could help deter fraudulent activity and enhance the integrity of the welfare system.

title: Lagen om särskilt stöd till vissa funktionshindrade
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3589 av Sofia Westergren och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: Moderaterna propose the establishment of a new authority to oversee all welfare system payments in Sweden to combat welfare fraud, which has cost the country approximately 300 billion SEK since 2005. The proposal suggests that individuals should qualify for social insurance systems based on their contributions from work, echoing principles of private insurance. The initiative aims to create a fair and robust welfare system, learning from the model used in Norway, which could eliminate existing issues with inter-agency confidentiality concerning welfare payments.

title: Reformer för en liberaliserad och konkurrenskraftig arbetsmarknad 2030
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the conditions for making visits to child health services mandatory in Sweden. The author highlights the concern that while most parents care well for their children, some fail to do so and may expose their children to harm. Making visits mandatory is seen as a necessary measure to ensure that children receive the protection they need from societal interventions, particularly for those in harmful situations.

title: Liberal politik för de nationella minoriteterna och minoritetsspråken
summary: The motion proposes strengthening the connection between final grades and nationwide tests in Swedish primary schools, citing the need for equitable grading across the country. It highlights issues of grade inflation and discrepancies between final grades and test scores, particularly in mathematics, indicating that many students receive higher final grades than their test results would suggest. The proposal calls for a review of the design and implementation of national tests to ensure they serve as effective benchmarks for grading, thus promoting fairness and reducing grade inflation.

title: Solidaritetsförklaring till Storbritannien
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen Nordic collaboration through various measures, such as promoting the use of Scandinavian languages, enhancing access to Nordic public service digital TV services, creating a white paper for further integration of Nordic labor markets and economies, and advancing Nordic defense cooperation with a roadmap for Sweden's NATO membership. The motion emphasizes the importance of enhancing relationships among Nordic countries to effectively address crises and create a stronger regional presence on the global stage.

title: Liberal bostadspolitik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establishes a national goal to increase the self-sufficiency rate among the population, particularly focusing on immigrants. It emphasizes the importance of labor market participation for integration and economic independence, suggesting that current employment statistics do not adequately reflect the true self-sufficiency levels. It calls for an investigation into how such a goal can be defined and implemented, with the aim of using self-sufficiency rates as a key indicator of integration policy effectiveness.

title: Hästens betydelse för Sverige
summary: The motion advocates for implementing higher educational and language proficiency requirements for employment in elderly care, stating that only individuals with basic care education and sufficient Swedish language skills should be allowed to hold permanent positions. The proposal highlights the increasing demand for competent staff due to a growing elderly population and emphasizes the importance of communication skills and proper training to ensure quality care. It suggests that the government should establish clear definitions of basic care education and implement national language tests for prospective employees in elderly care.

title: Integrationsarbete med häst
summary: The motion proposes changes to employment protection laws in Sweden, advocating for increased flexibility for employers to exempt employees from seniority rules during layoffs and to reduce the requirements for dismissals based on personal reasons. The intent is to make hiring easier for businesses, particularly smaller ones, by allowing them to retain key staff and lessen the legal complexities and potential costs associated with terminations. This includes suggestions for a government review to revise the criteria governing dismissals and to enable employers to terminate permanent contracts without just cause, provided they pay a reduced severance.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The motion advocates for limiting the right to free interpretation services in Sweden due to the challenges faced in integration and language acquisition among migrants. It argues that many individuals have lived in Sweden for years without learning Swedish, leading to significant costs for taxpayers and inefficiencies in public services. The proposal includes a recommendation for an investigation into the matter and suggests implementing a personal fee for those who miss meetings where an interpreter has been arranged.

title: Utgiftsområde 13 Jämställdhet och nyanlända invandrares etablering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibilities and conditions for legalizing and regulating assisted dying and euthanasia in Sweden. It highlights the inadequacies of current regulations that prevent people with incurable diseases from receiving assistance in ending their lives, emphasizing the need for a change in the law to allow for active euthanasia and assisted dying under specific circumstances.

title: Utgiftsområde 25 Allmänna bidrag till kommuner
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to ensure full funding for the Tvärförbindelse Södertörn project, which aims to improve transportation efficiency in southern Stockholm County and alleviate traffic congestion. The author argues that the project is crucial for connecting various areas, particularly with the anticipated increase in freight traffic due to the new Norvik harbor. The absence of complete financing threatens the project's timeline and, consequently, the economic growth potential for the region.

title: Låt Skaraborg bli namnet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports reducing the late payment fee for congestion charges, which is currently deemed excessively high compared to the actual charge for using the roads. The motion argues that the current fee of 500 kronor for late payment is unfair and requests the government to present a proposal for a lower fee.

title: Lokal polis för ökad trygghet
summary: The proposal from Erik Ottoson aims to address various concerns related to hunting and wildlife management in Sweden, particularly focusing on the management of the wolf population. It suggests measures such as allowing increased licensed hunting in areas heavily affected by wolves, establishing guidelines for protective hunting of bolder wolves, and facilitating the use of hunter identification for wildlife cameras and traps. The motion also proposes legal revisions to allow nighttime hunting using artificial lighting and thermal imaging for specific wildlife that negatively impacts biodiversity.

title: Smidigare, miljövänligare och säkrare trafik
summary: The motion proposes that taxes should be made visible on receipts for various consumer purchases that are subject to multiple layers of taxation. It emphasizes the need for clarity regarding taxes and public subsidies, allowing consumers to see the true cost of services and products. The motion argues that this transparency would enable better comparisons between different providers and promote accountability among those managing public funds.

title: Småföretagares bokförings- och deklarationsmöjligheter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3576 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive review and reform of the tax equalization system in Sweden to ensure equitable conditions for municipalities without pitting them against each other. It suggests that the state should fully compensate municipalities that need financial support and has the authority to withdraw funding from those that do not manage their finances responsibly. The motion emphasizes that current mechanisms incentivize poor financial practices and detrimental policies, ultimately harming both growth and community services across the country.

title: Civil olydnad
summary: The motion proposes that the parliament mandates municipalities and the state to clearly justify the calculations behind fees and their correspondence to services rendered, ensuring transparency and preventing the mislabeling of fees as taxes. It emphasizes the need for clarity in how fees are determined and their relation to the provided service, mentioning that discrepancies can lead to distorted competition and that fees should not exceed actual costs.

title: Närproducerade livsmedel
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government explore the possibility of selling SBAB, arguing that state ownership in the mortgage market is unnecessary since it functions well as a private sector market. The author suggests that state involvement creates a potential conflict of interest, as the state simultaneously acts as both a market participant and regulator.

title: Värdet av vattenkraftsproduktion
summary: Ida Drougge's motion calls for active measures to facilitate compliance with the new sewage disposal law for boat owners, emphasizing the need for improved infrastructure for sewage disposal stations in Swedish waters. The motion highlights the challenges posed by insufficient disposal facilities and the lack of awareness regarding the process for reporting needs, as well as the deficiencies in the existing app that provides information about disposal stations. The proposal aims to enhance the preservation of the marine environment by addressing issues related to sewage discharge from leisure boats.

title: En differentierad tullsats för en förbättrad miljö
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish state sell its ownership in the airline SAS, arguing that the airline industry has become highly competitive and that a state-owned entity disturbs the market. The author suggests that it is unreasonable for the state to act as both a regulator and a competitor in the same market and believes that transferring ownership to private owners is a more suitable approach.

title: Hårdare tag mot huliganism
summary: The motion proposed by Niklas Wykman emphasizes the urgent need to protect the Baltic Sea porpoise and address various environmental challenges in the Baltic Sea. It calls for the establishment of marine protected areas to support the species' survival, collaboration with neighboring countries to ban bottom trawling of cod, increased efforts to remove ghost nets and marine debris, and prioritization of measures against eutrophication. The motion advocates for a comprehensive approach to safeguarding the marine ecosystem, benefiting both biodiversity and sustainable fishing practices.

title: Bättre mat för våra äldre
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity for strengthened auditing processes in Swedish municipalities to ensure accountability among politicians and the effective use of taxpayer money. It argues for the engagement of external actors in the evaluation of policies and calls for enhancements in the auditing practices within municipalities, akin to those at the state level. The proposal highlights the importance of qualified reviewers in the auditing process to mitigate risks of fraud and corruption, ensuring that resources are utilized efficiently in the provision of welfare services.

title: Generell tillståndsplikt oavsett utförare
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3569 av Alexandra Anstrell och Maria Stockhaus (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the taxation of global digital advertising and media providers to strengthen competition neutrality in the media industry. It highlights the significant disparity in tax liabilities between global platforms like Facebook and Google and local media companies, leading to adverse effects on Swedish journalism and democratic processes due to decreased advertising revenue for local outlets. The motion calls for a unified regulatory framework to ensure fair taxation and competition in the Swedish advertising market.

title: Snabbare utvisningsbeslut
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should enhance the role of municipalities in combating organized welfare crime. It highlights the increasing exploitation of the welfare system by criminal activities and suggests that municipalities should have greater authority and collaboration with government agencies to prevent and address such occurrences. The motion calls for improved information sharing between state and municipal authorities and emphasizes the need for municipalities to be included in national efforts against welfare fraud.

title: Avskaffa den dolda momsen för utbildningsföretag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3567 av Alexandra Anstrell och Maria Stockhaus (båda M)
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to enhance the care and treatment for thyroid diseases, particularly hypothyroidism, which disproportionately affects women. It highlights the increasing number of patients diagnosed and treated for this condition and points out shortcomings in the current healthcare approach, including delayed diagnoses, inadequate treatment options, and the prevalence of misdiagnoses. The motion calls for the government to instruct the Socialstyrelsen to develop national guidelines and support for healthcare providers, as well as to address the shortage of endocrinologists, thus improving the overall management of thyroid-related health issues.

title: En bättre socionomutbildning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3566 av Alexandra Anstrell och Malin Höglund (båda M)
summary: The motion advocates for the elevation of Södertörn University College to university status, emphasizing its significant contributions to higher education in southern Stockholm and its role in addressing issues like unemployment and segregation. The proposal highlights the importance of university status in enhancing the visibility and credibility of the institution's degrees and research, which are deemed crucial for societal development and the region's competitiveness.

title: Föräldrars ansvar för sina barns handlingar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament support the planning of a new traffic solution, either in the form of a bridge or tunnel over the Saltsjö-Mälarsnittet in Södertälje, to enhance capacity for vehicle traffic. This comes in light of vulnerabilities in the existing transportation infrastructure highlighted by past incidents, particularly focusing on the need for improved safety and redundancy in the transport system to prevent significant disruptions in traffic flow for both personal and goods transportation.

title: Explosiv ökning av vildsvin
summary: The motion proposes increased measures to combat the growing parallel black housing market in Sweden, which is associated with severe economic crime. It emphasizes the need for stricter regulations against black market rental practices and the abolishment of the EBO law that contributes to these issues. The motion suggests establishing more rent tribunals, implementing a housing cooperative register, tightening rules around subletting, and improving the monitoring of individuals' housing situations to prevent abuse of the welfare system related to housing.

title: Skaraborg – Sveriges kornbod
summary: The motion proposes to increase the number of rental boards in Sweden to shorten processing times and more effectively address illegal subletting. The current system suffers from excessive delays due to a lack of boards, particularly in regions like Stockholm, where only one board handles all cases. This situation has led to prioritization issues for cases related to illegal subletting and inadequate housing needs, contributing to a problematic housing market and the persistence of fraudulent rental activities.

title: Jakten på privat ägande
summary: The motion calls for increased collaboration between the Swedish Social Insurance Agency (Försäkringskassan) and the Public Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen) to better address the needs and circumstances of individuals who are sick or unemployed. It highlights the current issue where these agencies sometimes make contradictory decisions regarding the same person's ability to work, leading to individuals being left without income and dependent on municipal support. The proposal aims to create a more integrated approach that ensures coherent support for citizens within the welfare system.

title: Den svenska hästen
summary: Jasenko Omanovic's motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider leveraging the interests and engagement surrounding sports and climate issues to enhance learning in mathematics and natural sciences. The motion emphasizes the need to maintain Sweden's innovative and high-tech status by addressing the declining interest in these subjects among students and suggests that incorporating sports and climate discussions into education could improve this situation.

title: Jakt med båge
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a review of the financing mechanisms for maritime education in Sweden, advocating for increased industry involvement and goals for gender-equitable recruitment in these programs. It highlights the financial challenges faced by maritime education due to high costs associated with specialized training facilities and equipment, which limit student enrollment. The motion argues that enhancing maritime training is crucial for the Swedish economy and competitiveness, particularly given the current low number of applicants and the gender disparity in student demographics.

title: Utvecklat strandskydd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers improving the governance of high school education offerings in relation to labor market demands. It highlights the ongoing challenge of matching the right skills among job seekers with employer needs, noting the existence of approximately 100,000 unfilled jobs due to a skills mismatch. The authors stress the importance of effective education as a societal investment and argue for a clearer connection between job market needs and the number of places available in various educational programs, while still allowing students to choose engaging fields of study.

title: Utlandssvenskar berikar handel och främjar export
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3558 av Cecilia Widegren och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports initiatives for improving workplace environments as the retirement age is raised due to the increasing average life expectancy. It emphasizes the need for a better work environment to prevent higher rates of sickness and early retirement, particularly in physically and mentally demanding jobs. The motion calls on the government to formulate a plan ensuring good working conditions to meet the challenges posed by an aging population.

title: Fler överlevare när fler donerar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3557 av Cecilia Widegren och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to improve night train services in northern Norrland and emphasizes the need for regional infrastructure planning that supports cross-border rail connections with Finland and increased accessibility for both residents and the tourism sector. It highlights the growing demand for sustainable transportation options and aims for a long-term commitment from the government to maintain and enhance the night train system in northern Sweden, as well as to better connect with international rail networks.

title: Underlätta rörligheten mellan Sverige och Norge
summary: The motion advocates for the consideration of legislation requiring pedestrians to wear reflective gear while walking in darkness, citing that approximately 40% of pedestrian-related traffic accidents occur during nighttime. The proponents argue that wearing such reflectors significantly reduces the risk of accidents and reference existing regulations for other modes of transport. The proposal suggests adopting a law similar to Finland's, which mandates reflectors for pedestrians at night.

title: Störningar från fordon i stadskärnor och bostadsområden
summary: The motion proposes to enhance dialogue and municipal participation regarding state land interests in order to facilitate access to land for new constructions and other developments in Norrbotten. The current complex process, involving multiple state agencies and lengthy decision-making times, has left many municipalities feeling powerless, especially concerning the establishment of nature reserves. The proposal emphasizes the need for improved communication between relevant authorities and local municipalities to ensure they have a greater say in land use decisions.

title: En stark arbetslöshetsförsäkring som skyddar alla som förlorar sin inkomst
summary: The motion advocates for ensuring all children's right to education in their mother tongue and minority languages, emphasizing that such instruction strengthens identity and language development. It highlights the declining availability of mother tongue education in several municipalities, where regulations often allow for its reduction or elimination. The motion calls for a review of existing legislation to prevent educational authorities from denying access to this vital teaching, arguing that every child should have the right to learn in their own language.

title: Konkurrensvillkoren för svenska mikrobryggerier
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibilities for implementing a support system for farmers, inspired by a similar system in Finland. The motion highlights the decline in the number of dairy farmers in Norrbotten and the challenges of maintaining agricultural production and local food sources. It emphasizes the importance of increasing the status of agricultural professions and improving the working conditions for farmers to attract more young people to the sector.

title: Åtgärder mot internationella stöldligor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government initiate a dialogue with banks regarding their presence across the country, emphasizing the importance of access to capital for development in rural areas. It highlights the challenges faced by residents and businesses in sparsely populated regions in obtaining loans, particularly as many bank branches have closed over the years, leading to detrimental effects on local economies. The authors argue for the necessity of maintaining bank branches in rural settings to ensure equitable financial services and investments crucial for regional development.

title: Svensk-norskt samarbete vid förvaltningen av den skandinaviska vargstammen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider enshrining the right to education in and on braille in the Education Act, ensuring that children with visual impairments have guaranteed access to learning materials in braille. It emphasizes the importance of enabling all children, regardless of their visual abilities, to read and write, and highlights the need for education for relatives of children using braille to better support them. The proposal references the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and calls for measures to address existing shortcomings in fulfilling these rights.

title: Jämställda regler för ambulanssjukvård
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a sustainability labeling system for food products to help consumers make more climate-friendly choices. It highlights the current difficulties consumers face in identifying sustainable food options and emphasizes the need for improved information on the climate impact of food purchases. The proposal points out that the food production sector significantly contributes to emissions and that a consistent sustainability label could lead to more informed consumption patterns, considering various factors beyond just greenhouse gas emissions.

title: Förbud mot erbjudanden och kampanjer på godis och läsk
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider investigating the possibilities for state funding for the Sala silver mine, a historically significant site and one of the best-preserved mining environments in the world. The proposal highlights the mine's importance during its peak in the 16th century and emphasizes the need for financial support to preserve and develop the site, which attracts over 80,000 visitors annually. Despite receiving some municipal funding, the current lack of state funding is seen as a barrier to maintaining the site's cultural and historical legacy.

title: Insatser mot hemlöshet
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of civil defense in Sweden by enhancing the country's food supply resilience. It suggests integrating preparedness perspectives into environmental policies and ongoing initiatives aimed at strengthening food sovereignty. The motion emphasizes reducing dependency on imported agricultural inputs to bolster Sweden's resilience against potential crises, arguing that fostering local, fossil-free agricultural practices will improve food security and overall capability to manage both peacetime and wartime challenges.

title: Förändring av donationsregistret
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the examination of the conditions necessary to commence the construction of a new Hjulstabro on road 55. This initiative aims to enhance maritime transport efficiency, alleviate pressure on land infrastructure, and contribute to the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions in line with Sweden's climate goals. The current Hjulstabron, built in 1953, poses limitations for larger vessels, which hinders the potential for increased cargo transport to the Mälarhamnar. This proposal emphasizes the importance of land infrastructure improvements to enable greater use of shipping for transporting goods.

title: Psykisk hälsa för unga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament backs the immediate construction of the E18 Köping–Västjädra to motorway standards due to its significance for regional development in Mälardalen, as it is a critical transportation route currently operating below capacity and safety standards. The proposal addresses traffic congestion, safety issues with hazardous goods transport, and the need for improved infrastructure, emphasizing the importance of swift action to facilitate better traffic flow and regional growth.

title: Förenkla för vägsamfällighetsföreningar
summary: The motion proposes enhancing travelers' ability to influence public transport, emphasizing the importance of addressing environmental challenges and the need for smarter transportation solutions. It highlights that many households currently rely heavily on personal vehicles due to inadequate public transit options connecting residential areas with schools, workplaces, and shops. The motion calls for greater involvement of passengers in the planning processes of public transport services, suggesting that their needs and feedback have not been sufficiently considered. It stresses the necessity of establishing a stronger passenger organization and aligning consumer policy with improving public transport access and satisfaction nationwide.

title: Generella straffskärpningar
summary: The proposal suggests a review of the regulations regarding ROT and RUT services conducted abroad, aiming to limit these tax deductions to services performed within Sweden. It highlights that Swedish taxpayers have been subsidizing foreign companies for such services, which undermines the original intent of the deductions to create jobs and reduce black market work in Sweden. The motion also points out that these subsidies disproportionately benefit high-income earners and calls for an urgent revision of the regulations.

title: Utgiftsområde 9 Hälsovård, sjukvård och social omsorg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament conduct an in-depth analysis of the feasibility of implementing a sugar tax as part of a tax reform. The rationale for this tax is rooted in the increasing sugar consumption in Sweden, which poses health risks, particularly concerning obesity and diabetes. Advocates, including public health officials and organizations like Cancerfonden, suggest that a sugar tax could reduce consumption of sugary drinks and promote better health outcomes, with positive examples from other countries like Mexico and France. However, the proposal also stresses the importance of ensuring that the tax does not disproportionately affect lower-income households who typically have poorer dietary habits.

title: Försvaret av Sydsverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports measures to enhance knowledge about dementia diseases within healthcare and social services. It suggests assigning Socialstyrelsen to collaborate with key stakeholders to develop strategies for increasing awareness and care quality for people with dementia. Additionally, the proposal emphasizes the need for patients with dementia to have the right to a consistent doctor-patient relationship to improve their treatment outcomes.

title: Strategi för minskad användning av antibiotika inom EU
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the concept of 'special reasons' within the underwriting principles of insurance companies, particularly as it pertains to premature infants. It highlights the importance of ensuring that these children have access to insurance regardless of their weight, length, or age, and argues for a reassessment of how insurance providers apply the principle of equal treatment. Given the advancements in medical care for premature infants, the proposal calls for policy changes that would eliminate the long waiting period for insurance coverage for those born weighing 1,000 grams or less.

title: Stärk det enskilda vägnätet
summary: This proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to examine ways to strengthen asylum rights for LGBTQI refugees, highlighting that despite existing rights, many such individuals have been returned to countries where they face persecution. Reports indicate that the temporary asylum legislation implemented in 2016 has made it more difficult for LGBTQI people to obtain asylum, leading to an increase in rejections and poor decision quality regarding their cases. The proposal emphasizes the need for reforms to enhance protection for those fleeing persecution based on sexual orientation or gender identity.

title: Skärpta straff för rattonykterhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the development and improvement of the Tjust and Stångådalsbanan railways as part of infrastructure planning. It emphasizes the need for such projects to stimulate the economy following the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly in the Kalmar region, where economic distress has resulted in increased unemployment. The motion highlights the importance of enhancing public transport infrastructure to better connect job seekers with employment opportunities, advocating for upgrades that would lead to increased job creation and a transition to fossil-free transport by 2030.

title: Totalförsvaret
summary: The motion addresses the need for the Swedish Parliament to examine possibilities for preventing and managing water shortages, emphasizing the importance of adapting current legislation to address these issues, particularly in light of climate change and increasing water demand. It notes that municipalities face significant costs in maintaining drinking water supplies during dry years, and calls for greater state responsibility to ensure a reliable water supply across the country.

title: Tullen och stöldgods
summary: The motion addresses the challenges of integration and establishment of newly arrived individuals in Sweden, emphasizing the need for coherent policies and reasonable requirements for language learning and self-sufficiency. It critiques the EBO law, which allows asylum seekers to settle anywhere if they arrange their own accommodation, arguing it leads to segregation and poor living conditions. The motion advocates for reforms to ensure that all municipalities share the responsibility for accommodating refugees and asylum seekers, in order to tackle integration challenges effectively.

title: Arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of a locally anchored police force in Sweden, advocating for the recruitment of an additional 10,000 police officers by 2024 to enhance public safety and crime prevention, especially in rural areas. It highlights the need for improved working conditions for police employees and the establishment of new police training programs. A stronger emphasis on preventive policing, particularly aimed at protecting youth from crime and substance abuse, is considered essential for fostering community trust in law enforcement.

title: Försäljning av statliga bolag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognizes the significance of Strömsholms canal in Dalarna and Västmanland, emphasizing its importance for local communities, cultural heritage, and tourism. The canal has historical value and potential for development in recreational boating and tourism. However, the financial challenges faced by the canal company and the small communities responsible for its maintenance are highlighted, suggesting that it is unreasonable for these municipalities to bear the primary responsibility for the canal, which is of national interest. The motion calls for increased support and involvement from additional stakeholders to ensure the canal's sustainability and preservation.

title: Vård av förälder
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers investigating the compensation for lost occupational pension for lay judges (nämndemän) who take leave from their employment to serve in court. It highlights the importance of lay judges in ensuring public trust in the judiciary and argues that the current lack of compensation for lost pension benefits discourages younger individuals from becoming lay judges. The motion references previous investigations that have addressed this issue without resulting in changes to the existing regulations.

title: Placering i kammaren
summary: The motion calls for a review of the current legislation regarding wage guarantees in the event of bankruptcy, highlighting significant limitations such as amount caps and time restrictions that expose employees to financial risk when their employer goes bankrupt. The authors argue that the existing wage guarantee law needs to be updated to provide better protection for employees' earned rights, particularly concerning back pay and earned vacation value.

title: Långsiktiga villkor för välfärdsföretagandet
summary: The proposal suggests reviewing the speed limits for A-tractors and introducing a specialized driver's license for these vehicles and moped cars, aimed at enhancing the mobility of young people in rural areas. It highlights the cultural significance of these vehicles, emphasizes their safety compared to mopeds, and draws attention to similar legislative changes in Finland as a potential model for Sweden.

title: Avskaffande av tidsomställningen
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a provision in the social services act that mandates preventive measures to combat homelessness, particularly focusing on families with children and individuals with mental health issues at risk of eviction. The motion emphasizes the need for early intervention by social services to avoid evictions and ensure stable housing, asserting that no child should be made homeless due to eviction. It calls for systematic follow-ups after evictions and suggests that social services be empowered to pay rent directly to landlords when providing economic assistance to prevent homelessness.

title: Kristdemokraternas budgetmotion för 2021 – Sverige förtjänar bättre
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a review of regulations regarding cross-border ambulance and healthcare transport in the Nordic region, highlighting that such collaboration could enhance patient safety and make better use of shared resources, particularly in rural areas. The authors argue that current restrictions in Sweden regarding ambulance operations and medication transportation hinder effective cross-border cooperation, and they advocate for reforms that align with the principles of the Nordic welfare model to ensure equitable access to healthcare services.

title: Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a preparedness stockpile for medications and addressing shortages in availability, highlighting the deficiencies revealed during the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the need for regulatory responsibility and proposes the reinstatement of a coordinated effort similar to what existed before the deregulation of Apoteket AB in 2009, which had previously managed national pharmaceutical preparedness. The motion asserts that the free market has not adequately addressed the supply of essential medications, leading to significant difficulties for patients.

title: En hållbar ekonomisk familjepolitik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3528 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the educational structure for professions in healthcare and social care. It emphasizes the importance of qualified personnel in elder care due to a notable decline in applicants for relevant educational programs. The motion highlights the need to improve working conditions and provide better training to ensure high-quality elder care, arguing for a cohesive educational strategy to standardize and enhance training across Sweden.

title: Sjukförsäkringen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3527 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes altering Sweden's current regulations on shoreline protection to create a uniform framework suitable for all regions.
