The authors argue that existing rules are overly restrictive, especially in rural areas, hindering the development of livable environments near lakes and coasts. They contend that these regulations disproportionately affect rural communities and suggest allowing municipalities to have more discretion in granting building permits to better cater to local conditions.

title: Uppvärdera medborgarskapet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3526 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion advocates for increased transparency in schools by proposing that all statistics related to education be made publicly available. The authors express concern over a recent court ruling that classified information about grades and student demographics as business secrets, which they argue undermines the fundamental principle of informed choice in the school system. They emphasize the need for visibility into how public funds are utilized in education to prevent declining quality and potential fraud, highlighting that the focus should be on knowledge and equal opportunities for students.

title: Reformera arbetskraftsinvandringen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3525 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes to limit and regulate the right to establish companies and abolish the Law on Freedom of Choice (LOV) in sectors with significant abuse. It highlights the challenges posed by the LOV, including poor working conditions and exploitation by companies. The motion argues that the current law allows organized crime to thrive and calls for stricter controls to ensure that resources in welfare are allocated based on need, ultimately aiming to protect welfare and improve service quality.

title: En målstyrd och långsiktigt hållbar migrationspolitik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3524 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: Eva Lindh's motion proposes a review of coordination between governing bodies and suggests expanding the Finsam initiative to improve the support and rehabilitation of individuals aged 16 to 64. The motion argues that current organizational structures hinder effective cooperation and that removing these barriers is essential for enhancing the welfare system. It emphasizes the importance of integrated efforts between authorities to provide better support, leading to improved social outcomes.

title: Utgiftsområde 12 Ekonomisk trygghet för familjer och barn
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3523 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation and change to the pre-assessments in the Social Services Act to allow for greater accessibility and searchability of prior anonymous reports concerning child welfare. The authors argue that the current system makes it difficult to track the cumulative evidence of potential risks to children, which can be critical for ensuring their safety and support. By amending the law, it is believed that authorities can better respond to situations involving children at risk, particularly in cases where multiple reports have been filed without leading to further investigation.

title: Utgiftsområde 11 Ekonomisk trygghet vid ålderdom
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3522 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion advocates for improving access to high-speed broadband across Sweden, particularly in rural areas where access has been inadequate. It underscores the growing importance of fast internet highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic, as many adapted to working and studying remotely. The proposal calls for the government to review and enhance broadband strategies to ensure that all households and businesses can take advantage of digital opportunities, regardless of their location. It emphasizes that digital connectivity is essential for living and working in all parts of Sweden and outlines previous government measures aimed at increasing broadband access.

title: Utgiftsområde 10 Ekonomisk trygghet vid sjukdom och funktionsnedsättning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3521 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support efforts to create safe and sustainable roads rather than lowering speed limits. It emphasizes the need for reliable infrastructure to drive economic growth and ensure accessibility in both urban and rural areas, highlighting concerns about the potential negative impact of reduced speed limits on transportation and regional development, particularly in sparsely populated areas like Jämtlands län. The authors suggest that investments in road maintenance, wildlife fencing, and improved road standards are more effective measures to enhance traffic safety and meet transport needs.

title: Utgiftsområde 8 Migration
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3520 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion advocates for improving the Norra stambanan railway line, emphasizing its importance for regional growth, efficient communication, and transportation across Sweden. It highlights the need for faster connections between northern and southern regions to support work, study, and tourism. The proposal references a report suggesting a 2 billion SEK investment would significantly reduce travel times between Östersund and Stockholm, thus enhancing competitiveness and alleviating freight transport pressures. The authors assert that further investments in rail infrastructure are vital for national cohesion and economic development.

title: Krigs- och terrorbrott
summary: The proposal suggests implementing a loan forgiveness program for student loans to attract qualified labor to rural municipalities in Sweden. It argues that many municipalities, particularly those in rural areas, face significant challenges in staffing and growth opportunities due to the outmigration of residents seeking education in larger cities. The proposal aligns with recommendations from both the parliamentary rural committee and the municipal investigation to facilitate greater access to education and promote residency in these areas by partially writing off student loans over time.

title: Förbättrad möjlighet till flygpendling
summary: The motion proposes an increase in housing construction in Sweden's rural areas by urging the government to explore opportunities for improving conditions for new and renovated housing. It highlights the growing interest in living outside urban centers and emphasizes the need for more affordable housing options, particularly for young people facing high barriers to entry in the housing market. The motion points out financing challenges and advocates for special rural loans and enhanced financing measures to support housing development in low-value market areas, which are critical for attracting new residents and sustaining local communities.

title: Minskat antal riksdagsledamöter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the development of electric aviation in Sweden to enhance transportation efficiency, particularly in remote areas. It highlights the need for a 'green restart' post-COVID-19, promoting Sweden's potential to lead in electric domestic flights within the EU. The authors point out various ongoing initiatives, such as funding for charging infrastructure and advancements by Swedish companies in electric aircraft technology, and suggest that Sweden aims for ambitions similar to Norway's goal of fully electrifying domestic flights by 2040.

title: Rätten att själv bestämma över sin kvarlåtenskap
summary: The motion proposes a review of the funding for independent schools in Sweden, suggesting that their financial support should reflect the responsibilities they hold compared to municipal schools. Currently, independent schools receive 100% of the municipal average cost per student, which has led to concerns about unfair competition and accountability, especially as independent schools can choose their students and are not required to establish themselves in less profitable areas. The motion calls for adjustments to ensure equal competitive conditions among all schools, taking their differing responsibilities into account.

title: Idrottssveriges möjligheter att bedriva elitverksamhet för ungdomar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider and present effective measures to combat racism within the school system. It highlights the importance of schools in fostering democratic values, providing equal opportunities for all students, and the negative impact of racism on students' educational and mental wellbeing. The motion argues for improvements in student health services, professional development for school staff, and adjustments to curricula to ensure that all students have a safe and respectful learning environment.

title: Utred slöjförbud i grundskolor och förskolor
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the economic conditions affecting children in Sweden to ensure that all children grow up free from economic poverty. It emphasizes the need to address relative poverty, especially for families with a low income and those relying on social support. The motion calls for an evaluation of existing support systems such as child allowances and maintenance support to ensure they are effective and relevant. Additionally, it stresses the importance of ensuring that schools are fully free of charge to students, eliminating any hidden costs that place a financial burden on families.

title: Register över och kvalitetsuppföljning av familjehem och jourhem
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament ensure that economic support does not reduce other forms of support for individuals with low incomes. It highlights the issue of multiple types of support potentially undermining each other, creating economic instability rather than improving living conditions. The motion emphasizes the necessity for coordinated support systems to promote equality and prevent economic despair for those with limited income.

title: Rätt att erbjuda sociala tjänster utan biståndsbedömning
summary: The proposal suggests a review of regulations governing alcohol advertising to better protect young people from the associated risks. It cites evidence from the WHO on effective measures to reduce alcohol-related harm, highlighting the rise of alcohol promotion on social media and the lack of age controls. The motion emphasizes the need for stricter regulations to prevent young audiences from being targeted, considering the significant percentage of youth using social platforms where such advertising is prevalent. The goal is to maintain the declining trend in youth alcohol consumption and to address the serious consequences of alcohol use among young people.

title: Medgivande för att genomföra flyttanmälan
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a national strategy to combat income inequality in Sweden. It argues that large income disparities have detrimental effects on society, leading to lower trust in systems, higher crime rates, and decreased overall well-being. The motion calls for a comprehensive action plan that addresses income disparities through a holistic approach, ensuring that every individual's upbringing and background do not determine their future opportunities in education, health, and income.

title: Stärk väljarnas makt
summary: Elin Lundgren's suggestion calls for an evaluation of Sweden's handling of unaccompanied minors who arrived in 2015, highlighting the challenges they faced in the asylum process, including issues with legal representation, mental health concerns, and the inconsistencies in asylum decisions based on geographical locations. The motion emphasizes the urgent need for a comprehensive assessment of the situations experienced by these individuals to inform future policymaking regarding unaccompanied minors in Sweden.

title: Sänkt skatt och bidragstak
summary: The motion proposes an amendment to the Swedish Nuclear Activities Act to explicitly prohibit the importation of nuclear weapons into Sweden, similar to Finnish legislation. It emphasizes the humanitarian dangers of nuclear weapons and prioritizes Sweden's role in international disarmament efforts while promoting regional stability. The motion calls for clarity regarding Sweden's stance on nuclear weapons to reassure the public and the international community.

title: Center för marinarkeologi vid Linnéuniversitetet i Kalmar
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of an international convention that prohibits nuclear weapons, highlighting their destructive capability and the humanitarian consequences of their use. It references Sweden's historical commitment to disarmament and multilateralism, and calls upon the government to support this initiative as a responsibility to future generations.

title: Ett nytt förhållningssätt till tobakspolitiken – det är skillnad på tobak och tobak
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a transition committee in the Swedish Parliament to enhance efforts in reducing greenhouse gas emissions in line with the Paris Agreement. It emphasizes the need for direct involvement of elected representatives in addressing climate change and ensuring Sweden maintains a leadership role in global environmental initiatives.

title: Regler för hemarbete
summary: The motion proposes several initiatives aimed at enhancing national preparedness and coordination in healthcare during pandemics, including establishing a national platform for vaccine registration, increasing the transparency and cooperation of healthcare authorities, and improving the working conditions for care personnel. It emphasizes the need for a thorough assessment of the issues exposed by the COVID-19 pandemic, such as staffing shortages and long wait times for treatment, and suggests legislative changes to ensure adequate healthcare resources and response strategies.

title: Harmonisera momssatsen mellan s.k. science centers och museer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3505 av David Josefsson och Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of imposing business bans on individuals connected to organized crime in Sweden. It highlights the involvement of gang criminals in legitimate businesses, where they allegedly drain resources before leading companies to bankruptcy. The motion emphasizes the need for administrative measures to prevent the use of businesses in organized and economic crime, noting that business bans could play a critical role in crime prevention while being cautious of the potential negative impact on legitimate businesses.

title: Civilsamhälle och kyrka
summary: Sverigedemokraterna propose several amendments to the Swedish citizenship criteria aimed at strengthening national identity and security. Key proposals include increasing the residency requirement for citizenship to ten years, implementing stricter conduct and language requirements, introducing a loyalty declaration, and allowing for the revocation of citizenship under certain conditions. The motion also emphasizes protecting minors' citizenship rights and assessing applicants' integration into Swedish society before granting citizenship.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:3 Riksrevisionens rapport om Kommerskollegiums arbete med handelshinder
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive and responsible migration policy emphasizing principles such as need-based labor immigration, sustainable family immigration, and effective refugee policies. It calls for temporary residency permits with clear links to granting grounds, increased focus on repatriation efforts, and the importance of qualifying for welfare benefits only after demonstrable contribution to society. The motion advocates for stricter requirements for citizenship, including a moratorium on citizenship grants until better processing systems are in place, and highlights the necessity of regular checks on residency grounds and character assessments.

title: med anledning av skr. 2020/21:3 Riksrevisionens rapport om Kommerskollegiums arbete med handelshinder
summary: The motion presents a proposal for stricter asylum policies in Sweden, advocating for the principle of 'first safe country' and the implementation of measures such as enhanced verification requirements for asylum seekers, limitations on their rights to public legal aid, and promoting safe return to their home countries. The authors argue that the current immigration system is overburdened and lacks clear regulations, resulting in increased societal unrest and strain on welfare services. The motion calls for significant reforms to ensure a more controlled and efficient migration process, urging the government to prioritize security and economic aspects in the asylum process.

title: Utgiftsområde 21 Energi
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures to tighten the rules surrounding family immigration in Sweden, particularly for beneficiaries of protective status. Key points include stricter family reunification criteria, increased demands for personal financial support, and measures to prevent abuse of family immigration. The motion also calls for enhanced screening processes involving background checks and DNA testing to verify relationships. Additionally, it emphasizes protecting vulnerable individuals, particularly children, and advocates for a minimum age requirement for marriage to address forced unions.

title: Utgiftsområde 24 Näringsliv
summary: The suggestion proposes a comprehensive consumer policy in Sweden aimed at empowering consumers to make informed, sustainable choices. It emphasizes the necessity for mandatory origin labeling on all animal products, the prohibition of animal slaughter without prior stunning, improved transparency in food labeling and marketing practices, especially when targeting children, and various measures to enhance consumer protection against fraud and exploitation. The proposal also highlights the importance of promoting Swedish goods and supporting local businesses as part of a broader consumer rights objective.

title: Utgiftsområde 19 Regional utveckling
summary: The motion proposes various reforms to address insolvency and financial management issues in Sweden. It calls for mutual recognition of debt relief decisions in the Nordic region, an overhaul of the guardianship system, measures against illegal vehicle ownership, the establishment of a national representative register, and enhanced consumer protection in debt advisory services. The motion emphasizes the need for a robust framework to prevent over-indebtedness, particularly in light of worsening economic conditions post-COVID-19, and seeks to ensure accountability for those in positions of financial trust.

title: Terrorism
summary: The motion presented by the Sweden Democrats calls for a comprehensive overhaul of housing policy aimed at creating safer and more stable residential environments. Key proposals include enhancing police presence in vulnerable neighborhoods, developing a national action plan for safe housing areas, utilizing the CPTED method in urban planning, and establishing free access to mapping services. The motion also suggests measures to limit the housing rights of asylum seekers, promote local housing associations, and ensure better financing options for young people and vulnerable groups, while aiming to stimulate construction and reduce bureaucratic barriers in the housing development process.

title: Kriminalvården
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government actively work within the OSCE's third dimension to combat the increasing discrimination against Christians and other religious minority beliefs in participating states, particularly during Sweden's upcoming presidency of the OSCE. It highlights growing intolerance and discrimination against these groups and calls for measures to ensure their rights are protected and respected, as well as to address institutional oppression and violence against religious minorities.

title: Brottsoffer
summary: The motion presents various proposals aimed at enhancing the regulatory framework surrounding companies, associations, and foundations in Sweden. Key proposals include evaluating optimal capital requirements for limited liability companies to prevent liquidation, preventing the misuse of associations and foundations for money laundering and terrorism financing, eliminating quotas and diversity reporting requirements for companies, implementing anonymized employment processes, and establishing a zero-tolerance policy against nominee directors, among others. The underlying goal is to ensure that the business environment promotes responsible entrepreneurship while safeguarding against criminal activities.

title: Översyn av rutinerna kring utbetalning av skadestånd till brottsmisstänkta
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a 'childhood guarantee' aimed at ensuring the well-being and rights of children in Sweden. It includes a series of initiatives to combat homelessness, child welfare, and improve the quality of family placements for children. Key actions include a zero-vision for child poverty and homelessness, establishing a national database for family homes, providing independent representation for children in care, and increasing cooperation among social services and local authorities to safeguard children's rights and ensure a stable upbringing.

title: Ändrat regelverk för Stockholmstraktamente och övernattningslägenheter
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of family law in Sweden, focusing on ensuring children's rights and welfare. It suggests establishing a 'childhood guarantee' to protect children from abuse and promote their best interests, making shared custody the default in parental separations, and introducing measures to prevent child marriages, forced marriages, and polygamy. The motion also calls for improving the legal process surrounding paternity establishment and inheritance rights, with an emphasis on digital management of family-related documents.

title: Nationellt register för parkeringstillstånd för personer med nedsatt rörelseförmåga
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3493 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: This proposal advocates for an investigation into how the Swedish government can take responsibility for the additional healthcare costs incurred by Gotland due to its status as an island and its small population. It highlights the unique challenges faced by Gotland's healthcare system, including the need for a fully equipped emergency hospital, and suggests that the government implement a special support mechanism or an 'island factor' to address these challenges and ensure equitable healthcare access in accordance with Sweden's healthcare laws.

title: Lindrigare läkemedelsalternativ inom sjukvården
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should work towards ensuring the implementation of plans for a third electricity cable to Gotland, as the existing two cables are aging and insufficient for the island's energy needs. The motion emphasizes the importance of stable electricity supply for Gotland's development and its transition to a climate-smart society, particularly given the local potential for renewable energy sources and the requirement for increased electricity consumption by local industries aimed at becoming climate-neutral by 2030.

title: Nationell handlingsplan rörande våld mot barn
summary: The motion proposes the development of laws that allow for coexistence between military and civilian activities in military influence areas, particularly in relation to the Tofta firing range on Gotland. The author argues that the recent expansion of the influence area, which has led to significant restrictions on construction and development, is unnecessary and creates conflicts of interest between military operations and local residents. The motion calls for legal frameworks that enable new housing construction within these areas while accommodating military noise, similar to existing regulations regarding traffic noise.

title: Utgiftsområde 21 Energi
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should investigate the creation of a disaster fund specifically for the agricultural sector to mitigate the financial impacts of natural disasters, such as droughts and floods, which are expected to become more frequent due to climate change. The motion highlights the vulnerabilities of Sweden's food supply chain and the risks posed by heavy reliance on food imports, particularly noted during the COVID-19 pandemic and the severe drought of 2018, which incurred significant costs to the agricultural industry.

title: Utgiftsområde 24 Näringsliv
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government direct the Swedish Energy Agency to continue the efforts for Gotland to become a pilot region for transitioning to a 100% renewable society. It highlights the importance of infrastructure and funding, specifically requesting an annual allocation of 50 million SEK to support the project, with a target to complete the transition by 2030 in line with national goals.

title: En tillväxtagenda för hela Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the transition to renewable fuels in the ferry traffic to Gotland by establishing foundations for the next traffic procurement process. It emphasizes the need for reliable, environmentally friendly transportation options and calls for governmental investigation into state support for biogas production to facilitate this transition. The proposal highlights the importance of communication for Gotland's development and stresses that price competitiveness and operational flexibility are essential for future ferry services, while also aiming for significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030.

title: Handel utvecklar världen
summary: The motion suggests adjusting the congestion tax regulations at Ropsten to alleviate the burden on residents of Lidingö who need to pick up or drop off passengers. Since Ropsten is the main public transport hub for Lidingö but is located within the congestion zone, local residents face double taxation when using their vehicles for this purpose. The proposal aims to eliminate this issue by allowing exemptions from the congestion tax for specific trips, thereby encouraging more people to use public transport while addressing the negative impact of current regulations on Lidingö's residents.

title: Regelförenklingar för Sveriges företagare
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of social media's impact on mental health and the need for a list of major sporting events to be publicly accessible in Sweden. It highlights concerns about the diminishing trust in traditional media and the growing influence of social media, which may lead to mental health issues among the youth. Additionally, it calls for access to significant sporting events as a means to foster national cohesion and solidarity among the population.

title: En konkurrenskraftig gruv- och mineralnäring
summary: The proposal suggests the construction of a new modern nuclear power plant in Barsebäck to meet the growing electricity demands in Skåne over the next 50 years, addressing the current issues of electricity supply and the planned increase in energy consumption due to electric vehicles and other industrial needs. The motion argues that a nuclear facility would be a sustainable and efficient alternative to fossil fuel plants and ensures a stable energy supply for the region.

title: En ny energipolitik för Sverige
summary: The proposal suggests that Skåne be designated as a pilot region for the sale of locally produced beer, wine, and cider. It calls for a review of existing regulations to allow small-scale producers to sell their products directly to consumers. The motion emphasizes the importance of supporting local breweries and stimulating rural entrepreneurship, while also respecting Sweden's alcohol retail monopoly through a controlled integration of farm sales.

title: En långsiktig svensk konkurrenskraft
summary: The suggestion advocates for significant infrastructure improvements around Ystad Port and the E65 highway to accommodate increasing traffic demands due to the port's expansion and the introduction of new ferry routes. It emphasizes the need for safe and accessible roadways, addressing current congestion and environmental issues. The proposed developments include a new underpass for smoother traffic flow and the expansion of the E65 to allow for more efficient movement of goods and people between southern Sweden and other regions.

title: Fast förbindelse mellan Helsingborg och Helsingör
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into user-financed infrastructure improvements for the Oslo-Stockholm railway corridor, aiming to reduce travel time to three hours. It emphasizes the climate benefits and social utility of better train connections to reduce air travel, boosting economic ties and commuter flows between Sweden and Norway. The proposal calls for a dialogue with the Norwegian government and explores financing options through rail fees.

title: Slopat skattefinansierat stöd till och utökad granskning av trossamfund
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into a new model for capital gains tax on residential property sales, arguing that the current 22% tax is unfair, especially for families needing to upsize as they grow. It suggests a tiered tax rate based on the duration of property ownership, with decreasing rates for longer ownership periods, ultimately eliminating the tax for properties owned for over ten years. The proposal aims to address both fairness and speculation in the housing market.

title: En socialtjänst att lita på
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate the implementation of mandatory legislation requiring the consideration of environmental and social sustainability in public procurement processes. Currently, sustainability criteria are not obligatory, which may allow less sustainable options to win contracts. The motion advocates for the inclusion of these requirements to ensure that public sector purchases contribute positively to environmental quality goals.

title: Ett nytt digitalt ledarskap för Sverige
summary: The motion proposes a review of the education and safety requirements for the use of moped cars, which have gained popularity among teenagers. With a significant increase in registered moped cars and a concerning rise in accidents and injuries associated with them, the motion emphasizes the need to address the safety standards and regulations governing these vehicles to protect young users.

title: Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of local contact and service points for state activities in Swedish municipalities, addressing the growing issue of reduced state presence in smaller communities. It highlights the negative impacts of centralization on citizens' access to government services and emphasizes the need for a coordinated effort to ensure personal contact between citizens and state agencies. The authors advocate for a collaborative approach with municipalities to improve access to government support and maintain citizen trust.

title: Sverige ska bli världens bästa land för delningsekonomi
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government consider implementing a traffic obligation for the route between Sälen, Mora, and Stockholm to enhance accessibility for business and tourism in the Dalarna region. The motion emphasizes the importance of regular air connections to support local industries, which are crucial for job creation and economic growth. It highlights the need for sustainable travel solutions and indicates community backing for initiatives to facilitate climate-neutral travel options, such as supporting electric aircraft and biofuels.

title: En effektiv offentlig förvaltning som fokuserar på kärnuppdraget och minskar byråkratin
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for increased investment in infrastructure in Dalarna to support the region's strong industrial sector and enhance transportation efficiency. It argues that sustainable and effective transport systems are crucial for the economic competitiveness of Dalarna's industries, promoting job creation and climate transition. Specific suggestions include improving the Dalabanan railway, enhancing electrification of the transport sector, and facilitating the use of heavier and longer trucks and trains to optimize logistics and reduce emissions.

title: Ett hållbart flyglyft för Sverige
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a more secure and long-term operation for the Sancta Birgitta Klostermuseum in Vadstena, highlighting its historical significance and role in promoting pilgrimage tourism. The motion stresses the necessity of state involvement to maintain and modernize the museum's exhibits, which are currently managed by a non-profit organization that lacks adequate resources. It suggests incorporating the museum into the operations of the National Historical Museums to enhance the preservation of Sweden's medieval and religious history.

title: Starkare rättsstatliga principer, ett förstärkt fri- och rättighetsskydd och andra grundlagsfrågor
summary: The motion advocates for increased construction using wood as a cost-effective climate measure that promotes job creation across the country. It emphasizes the lower climate impact of wooden buildings compared to concrete, particularly for multi-story structures. The proposal highlights the potential for thousands of new jobs in prefabricated wooden housing by 2025 and suggests that public procurement should favor sustainable solutions. It calls for support for pilot projects and competitions to stimulate innovative building techniques and sustainable urban development.

title: En svensk digitaliserad offentlig förvaltning i framkant
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish Parliament to prioritize the construction of the Ostlänken railway project, emphasizing the need for environmentally friendly infrastructure and long-term planning. It highlights the benefits of central travel hubs to enhance public transportation and regional development. The motion addresses challenges related to cost overruns and planning delays, and suggests that environmental concerns should not impede progress on this significant railway initiative. Additionally, it stresses the importance of training personnel for efficient project execution.

title: En modern tågpolitik för stärkt pendling och bättre transporter
summary: The proposal advocates for measures to enhance diversity within the financial sector in Sweden, particularly addressing the decline of local bank branches that has negatively impacted rural areas. It highlights the importance of establishing new cooperative banking models, such as savings banks, to meet the financial needs of small businesses and households, thus promoting competition and financial inclusivity.

title: Åtgärder för att stärka demokratiska värderingar och mänskliga rättigheter samt motverka hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support a study on incentives for increased wooden housing construction. It highlights Sweden's growing population and the current housing shortage, while emphasizing the environmental benefits of using wood as a building material. The authors argue that modern wooden construction is not only climate-friendly but also cost-effective and beneficial for the local economy. They urge the government to consider economic stimuli to promote wooden housing and to prioritize initiatives outlined in the existing timber construction strategy.

title: Utgiftsområde 22 Kommunikationer
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of achieving the vision of zero traffic fatalities by advocating for a more comprehensive analysis of the consequences of speed limit changes on regional roads. It argues that factors such as wildlife collisions and meeting accidents need more specific investigation and that measures like wildlife fencing and road modifications should be prioritized over merely lowering speed limits. The motion also highlights the need for public acceptance of traffic regulations and the potential regional economic impacts of speed changes, particularly in tourism-dependent areas like Dalarna.

title: En modern hållbar sjöfartspolitik för tillväxt och trygghet
summary: The motion proposes a review of the long-term financing of additional teacher assistants in Swedish schools, emphasizing their role in relieving teachers and improving the psychosocial work environment. It calls for a definition of the roles and conditions of teacher assistants to complement existing staff effectively, ensuring they receive the necessary training. The motion also highlights the importance of ensuring equal opportunities for teacher assistants regarding permanent full-time positions, aiming to enhance the overall quality and continuity of education.

title: En hållbar transportpolitik för jobb och tillväxt
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive national information campaign to raise awareness about the marginalized situation of Roma people in Sweden and Europe. It draws on the success of the previous 'Levande historia' campaign, which improved knowledge about the Holocaust, and highlights the ongoing prejudices and discrimination faced by Roma in society. The motion calls on the government to explore possibilities for this initiative, emphasizing the need to educate the public about the enduring structural discrimination against Roma communities.

title: En modern infrastrukturpolitik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take measures to reduce traffic accidents at road work sites by improving compliance with safety regulations and increasing the use of mobile speed cameras. It highlights that approximately 300 accidents occur annually at such sites, causing injuries or fatalities. The motion references a 2016 survey in which a large majority of road workers expressed concerns about their safety, compounded by insufficient adherence to safety protocols and the need for better traffic management. Suggestions include raising speeding fines, increasing inspections by the Work Environment Authority, and mandatory education on road work safety for new drivers.

title: En modern cykelpolitik för trygghet, pendling och bättre folkhälsa
summary: Motion S 1190 proposes that the Swedish Parliament ratify the third optional protocol to the Convention on the Rights of the Child, which would grant children the right to individually file complaints regarding violations of their rights. The motion emphasizes that children in Sweden struggle to seek redress when their rights are infringed, and it criticizes the current limitations of the Children's Ombudsman in addressing individual cases. The motion calls for the establishment of child-friendly complaint mechanisms and an expansion of the Ombudsman's mandate to allow for the reception of individual complaints from children.

title: Försvaret av Göteborg och västkusten
summary: The motion proposes an extension of the existing helmet requirement for children under 15 years old to include those riding in bicycle trailers, as well as a potential helmet requirement for all users of electric scooters, regardless of age. This is in response to increasing traffic congestion and a rise in head injuries associated with electric scooters, suggesting that enhanced safety measures are necessary for both scenarios.

title: Minskat klimatavtryck för bostadssektorn genom resurseffektiv användning och återanvändning av byggmaterial
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3464 av Emma Hult och Amanda Palmstierna (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the conditions necessary to facilitate quicker access to housing for women and children who are victims of violence. It highlights the serious social problem of domestic violence and the difficulties these victims face in breaking free from abusive relationships due to long waiting lists for housing. The proposal emphasizes that society has a responsibility to provide safety for these vulnerable individuals by granting them priority in housing queues.

title: Ökade befogenheter för och upprustning av Tullverket
summary: The motion addresses the need for enhanced measures at Statens institutionsstyrelse (Sis) in response to recent escapes from youth facilities. It acknowledges the government's budgetary increase for Sis but emphasizes the necessity of considering the rights of employees regarding electronic communication tools. The motion argues for the introduction of anonymous documentation to protect staff identities when making decisions that restrict rights, ensuring a better working environment and effective care for the youth.

title: Medvetenhet kring skador av plast i livsmedel
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3462 av Markus Wiechel och Ludvig Aspling (båda SD)
summary: This motion proposes the consideration of establishing a special court for land and environmental cases to address recruitment challenges for judges with expertise in environmental law. The current Mark- and Environmental Court of Appeal struggles to attract such judges due to uncertainty about their work assignments, risking a decline in environmental competence within the court system's highest authority on these matters.

title: Utvidgade trafiksäkerhetsåtgärder
summary: The motion proposes viewing Swedish for Immigrants (SFI) education as a long-term investment rather than a short-term cost, urging the government to grant SFI the same funding per student as other comparable educational institutions. It calls for considerations to ensure resource equity across the country and emphasizes the importance of SFI in addressing segregation and social inequality to support integration and meet future workforce needs.

title: Utökat skydd för personer som har drabbats av pressetiska övertramp
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3460 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the installation of solar panels on the rooftops of its buildings as a means to model and promote climate-smart practices. Emphasizing the urgency of addressing global warming and adhering to the Paris Agreement, the motion highlights the potential benefits in energy independence and technological advancement. Previous considerations have identified challenges due to historical preservation, but recent developments, such as the Royal Palace's experiment with solar panels, suggest that such installations may be feasible and worthwhile to reassess.

title: Ökad användning av avfall och restprodukter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3459 av Markus Wiechel och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes to investigate the conditions for increased use of timber products in the construction of public outdoor environments, residential areas, and densely populated urban areas in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the importance of utilizing renewable materials to combat climate change and advocates for a holistic approach to sustainable urban development. It highlights the environmental benefits of using locally sourced timber and suggests that strategic investments in new products and research can stimulate economic growth and job creation in forest regions.

title: Återinförd registrering och kontroll av EU-medborgare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establishes a 'zero vision' for plastic usage within its premises in response to the growing environmental challenges posed by plastic waste. The author emphasizes the need for systemic change and individual responsibility to promote environmental sustainability. Citing alarming statistics about plastic pollution in marine environments, the motion calls for immediate action as current trends predict a future where oceans may contain more plastic than fish. The motion advocates for the Parliament to lead by example in reducing its plastic consumption and encourages further investigations into sustainable alternatives to plastic.

title: Åtgärder för att minska rökning
summary: The motion proposes a review of the criteria for protective hunting in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a more efficient application due to rising populations of large predators. It argues for a process that considers the unique circumstances of individual cases, such as the economic impact on livestock owners and the psychological stress experienced, rather than using inflexible guidelines. The motion seeks to ensure equitable treatment across different regions and livestock sectors, advocating for swifter decision-making by authorities regarding protective hunting to better support affected farmers.

title: Nationell strategi för nutrition och fysisk aktivitet
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for increased research into childbirth injuries, highlighting that many women experience tears or wounds during vaginal deliveries, which can lead to long-term pain, reduced work ability, and psychological issues. It suggests that systematic efforts within maternity care have shown positive results in reducing severe injuries and advocates for prioritizing research to discover new methods that can mitigate or prevent these problems.

title: Avveckling av Myndigheten för kulturanalys
summary: The proposal suggests that the parliament considers measures to combat grade inflation and ensure fair grading in schools, emphasizing that grades should reflect students' knowledge and not be influenced by external factors such as school competition. It highlights the need for a standardized grading system to maintain trust and consistency across different schools.

title: Utveckla Mälardalens högskola till tekniskt universitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3454 av Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage och Lotta Finstorp (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the possibility of supporting artistic embellishment in public construction through the implementation of a one percent rule, where one percent of the construction cost for new or renovated public buildings is allocated for artwork. The motion highlights the importance of public art in democratic society and suggests that all citizens should have access to art in their surroundings. It also calls for a review of adherence to this rule among municipalities, especially as smaller municipalities struggle, and recommends the establishment of a register for public art to prevent loss and theft.

title: Åtgärder för att förebygga hedersbrott och stötta utsatta
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3453 av Markus Wiechel och Sara Gille (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers implementing mental health screenings in schools to address the increasing rates of anxiety and depression among young people, which have risen by 300 percent over the past decade. The motion highlights the role of socioeconomic factors and the stressful school environment in contributing to mental health issues. The goal is to ensure that all students receive equitable support for their mental well-being.

title: Åtgärder för en ökad möjlighet till en egen bostad
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3452 av Markus Wiechel och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of limiting marketing within gambling advertisements, highlighting the rise in gambling addiction which affects around 2% of the population, and is particularly concerning among young men under 25, where the prevalence is 10%. The motion calls for implementing similar restrictions for gambling advertisements as currently exist for alcohol advertisements to protect vulnerable individuals.

title: Uppdaterade regler för överförmyndare och gode män
summary: Monica Haider proposes that the Swedish parliament adopt a zero vision regarding child poverty, urging the government to consider this initiative. Additionally, she calls for the development of an action plan aimed at ensuring equality in childhood. Despite improvements in absolute measures of child poverty, relative poverty has risen in recent years, highlighting the need for increased political commitment and support for families with children to prevent poverty from affecting their life chances.

title: Minskad användning av palmolja samt märkning av höga salt- och sockerhalter i livsmedel
summary: Hillevi Larsson's motion emphasizes the importance of dental health as part of overall health, arguing for the inclusion of dental care within the general healthcare system. The motion points out the health risks associated with untreated dental issues, such as an increased risk of cardiovascular diseases. It highlights that access to necessary dental care has become a class issue, with low-income individuals often unable to afford treatment. The proposal calls on the government to consider integrating dental care into the broader healthcare framework, ensuring equitable access for all citizens.

title: Hepatit C, TBC, HPV och vaccineringsfrågor
summary: The proposal aims to examine the feasibility of offering favorable state loans to cover adoption costs and to establish mandatory parental education linked to the adoption process. Currently, adoption costs can be prohibitively high, leading to adoption becoming a class issue where only those with higher incomes can afford it. The motion advocates for equitable access to adoption financing and training opportunities, ensuring that becoming a parent through adoption is not limited by financial constraints.

title: Utgiftsområde 6 Försvar och samhällets krisberedskap
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a legal mandate for user influence in addiction care, aiming to enhance the participation of individuals with substance abuse issues in the design and quality of care services. It argues that, unlike other groups such as the elderly and individuals with disabilities, people with addiction problems lack sufficient legal rights to influence care decisions. Enhancing user influence is positioned as a crucial step to improve care outcomes and as a matter of democratic rights and human rights.

title: Sveriges förmåga att stå emot hybridhot
summary: The motion by Monica Haider advocates for simplifying the permitting process for mobile cranes to enhance their operational efficiency, which is crucial for construction and other urgent needs. The proposal highlights the current complexities of obtaining permits, the extensive number of movements (approximately 250,000 annually) that warrant permits, and the variations in how municipalities process applications. The motion emphasizes that the existing system can lead to illegal operations due to these hurdles and calls for streamlining the process to ensure compliance while supporting the construction industry and traffic safety.

title: Stärkt civilt försvar och krisberedskap
summary: The motion highlights the urgent need for a comprehensive investigation into the harmful effects of pornography on various societal aspects, particularly its impact on children and young people's perceptions of sex and gender relations. It argues that the increasing accessibility of violent and degrading pornography correlates with rising aggression and inappropriate sexual behavior, undermining efforts for equality and consent in sexual relations. The proposal calls for measures to limit exposure to such content, enhance sexual education in schools, and revise legal frameworks to address digital sexual exploitation more effectively.

title: Svensk säkerhetspolitik för en orolig tid
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should advocate for providing all children with equal access to meaningful leisure activities, particularly for those living in socioeconomically disadvantaged areas. The authors highlight the barriers faced by children due to lack of resources and propose measures to enhance community engagement, increase access to associations, and utilize empty facilities for recreational purposes, aiming to foster inclusion and reduce segregation.

title: Cybersäkerhet och cyberförsvar
summary: This motion seeks to enhance regulations surrounding the establishment and operation of debt collection agencies in Sweden to combat the growing issue of fraudulent invoicing, which has been increasingly affecting businesses and individuals. It highlights the inadequacies of current requirements for these businesses to obtain official permits and calls for stricter oversight to prevent criminal actors from exploiting the system.

title: Ett starkt svenskt försvar
summary: The motion proposes to enhance landowners' rights in Sweden by ensuring their participation and the ability to appeal any decisions affecting their property, thereby reinforcing property rights as a fundamental aspect of democracy. The current framework is criticized for allowing decisions regarding key biotopes and green infrastructure to be made without landowners' knowledge or a chance to appeal, leading to uncertainty about the future use of their land.

title: Materiel, forskning och industri
summary: The motion calls for a reduction in processing times at the Land Survey Authority (Lantmäteriet), arguing that the current nearly year-long wait for property subdivisions is a significant barrier to construction in Sweden, especially as there is a housing shortage in many municipalities. The proposal suggests that the government initiate a review of Lantmäteriet to allow for more competition in the sector and to legislate processing times comparable to municipal regulations, which require decisions within 10 weeks.

title: Förenklat regelverk för egen finansiering för föreningar
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen property rights in cases where the state expropriates land for public purposes. Currently, private landowners are inadequately compensated for their losses, receiving significantly less than the market value of their land. The proposal emphasizes that when the government must limit property rights, it should provide fair and adequate compensation to avoid economic disadvantage for the affected landowners.

title: Tillsätt en kriskommission för svensk elförsörjning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3440 av Jan Ericson och Lars Beckman (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the creation of a new building type called Bohmanhus, measuring 100 square meters, advocating for its recognition by the government to facilitate easier construction without bureaucratic hurdles. It emphasizes the need for simplified regulations compared to the existing Attefallshus, aiming to enhance individual freedom in building and supporting people's dreams of constructing small homes, storage, and cabins.

title: Ökat skydd av känsliga personuppgifter
summary: The motion proposes a review of the legislation concerning boating under the influence, specifically the provisions established in 2010, which set the blood alcohol limit for boating at 0.2 per mille. Concern has been expressed regarding the effectiveness of this legislation within the recreational boating community. The motion emphasizes the importance of evaluating whether the law has achieved its intended results and suggests that the government should undertake this assessment, as no such review has yet been conducted.

title: Ökat stöd för veteraner
summary: The motion advocates for increased access to childcare during unconventional working hours, emphasizing the vital role of preschools in supporting parents' ability to work and in children's development. It argues that all children have the right to childcare, especially during odd hours, and that municipalities should have the flexibility to address local needs. The proposal highlights the importance of such access for gender equality, particularly benefiting women who often bear a disproportionate share of unpaid work at home. The motion asserts that more needs to be done to ensure that parents are not forced to reduce their working hours due to insufficient preschool availability.

title: Ökad organdonation och fler blodgivare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the need for the Post and Telecom Authority (PTS) to investigate the potential for distributing time and frequency services to more actors across various sectors. The aim is to enhance national preparedness by making these services available widely, thus reducing dependency on the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) for synchronization purposes.

title: Starkare skydd av fornlämningar
summary: The motion proposes reforms to Sweden's rent negotiation laws to allow public housing foundations more freedom in setting rental prices for standard enhancements. It highlights the current complexities and inefficiencies in the existing system, particularly the low willingness of tenant associations to engage in pricing agreements, and suggests that these foundations, which do not operate with profit motives, should be able to establish their own pricing lists for enhancements, with tenants simply agreeing to the changes. The proposal aims to simplify the rental process and allow for adjustments in rent when new tenants move in.

title: Samlad satsning för den svenska diasporan
summary: Mats Green proposes the introduction of a 'Royalties for Regions' system in Sweden, which would allocate mineral fees generated from mining and hydropower activities to local municipalities and regions affected by such industries. This system aims to ensure that local communities benefit from the revenues generated by mining operations, particularly as interest in developing new mines increases due to rising commodity prices. The proposal draws on successful practices from Western Australia, where similar initiatives have positively impacted local economies by enhancing infrastructure and public services, ultimately leading to growth and development in regional areas.

title: Liberal arbetsmiljöpolitik
summary: The suggestion advocates for enhancing local self-determination by allowing wildlife management delegations to serve as the highest decision-making authority in all wildlife management matters. It criticizes the previous government's decision to favor environmental interests over hunting interests in these delegations and calls for a return to a more balanced composition that better represents local concerns and interests, asserting the principle of local anchoring in decision-making processes.

title: Fysisk aktivitet på fritidshem
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of mandatory glycol recycling in Sweden, highlighting the environmental benefits of a unique recycling method developed in Jönköping that purifies used glycol for reuse. The proposal emphasizes the potential environmental damage from glycol leakage, the finite nature of glycol as a resource, and the inefficiencies of current disposal methods that incinerate glycol, contributing to pollution. By mandating recycling, the motion aims to enhance sustainability efforts and help businesses meet environmental commitments.

title: Funktionsrättspolitik
summary: The motion argues against government support for organic farming, stating that it is not the role of politics to dictate farming methods. Instead, it proposes that production goals for organic farming should be replaced with aims for a more resource-efficient agriculture. The authors believe that the current emphasis on organic production misleads consumers about its environmental and health benefits when compared to conventional farming, which they argue is already advanced in terms of sustainability. They call for market forces to take a greater role in organic production, stating that such methods should prove their own value without government subsidies.

title: En högre utbildning med högre ambitioner
summary: The motion proposes a review of the late payment fees for minor tax liabilities, suggesting that the current fee of 500 SEK is excessive, especially in light of the fact that it was previously reduced for congestion tax payments. The proposal emphasizes that small businesses, which often make numerous tax payments, are particularly affected by such high fees for minor errors or oversights, and calls for the government to consider lowering these fees.

title: Liberal politik för färre och enklare regler
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should initiate measures to make public data concerning private roads free and accessible. It emphasizes the importance of improving the quality of the property register, enhancing search functionalities, and facilitating the management of private roads, which constitute a significant portion of Sweden's road network. The proposal highlights the potential societal benefits derived from open and high-quality data, estimating a yearly societal utility of over 100 million SEK for the management of private roads.

title: Liberal försvarspolitik
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of student loans for obtaining driver's licenses for everyone, addressing the growing difficulties and costs associated with acquiring a driver's license. The author argues that current regulations and financial burdens disproportionately affect young individuals, hindering their employability in a job market where driving skills are increasingly necessary. The motion suggests that just as other forms of education are supported through loans, so too should driver's education, which would enhance societal benefits by increasing the number of licensed drivers entering the workforce.

title: Bättre regler för bostadsköpare
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the national secretariat for gender research, arguing that gender research is not scientific but rather a matter of opinions and political beliefs. The authors suggest that state support for gender studies at Swedish universities should cease and that relevant gender issues should be addressed within the framework of other research disciplines.

title: Liberal politik mot våld i nära relationer och sexualbrott
summary: The motion proposes that diapers should not be included in the fees for preschool placements in Sweden. It argues that the current variation among municipalities regarding diaper inclusion is problematic and that a standardized approach is necessary. Allowing parents to provide their own diapers would ensure that children receive the appropriate type and size, while avoiding financial strain on preschools that could impact resources available for education, food, or staff.

title: Internationalisering av svenska gymnasieskolan
summary: The proposal advocates for increased investment in the Dalabanan railway to improve transportation within Dalarna, which is a large county in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of efficient transport systems for supporting regional industries, including export and tourism. The motion argues that enhanced railway capacity is essential for sustainable growth and connectivity with major urban areas like Stockholm, ultimately benefiting the entire country economically and socially.

title: Ettårig polisutbildning för akademiker
summary: The motion calls for an evaluation of the possibility of implementing a compensation system for land seized under the EU's Nature and Habitat Directive and the Species Protection Ordinance in Sweden. It emphasizes the need to reassess the current practices that allow authorities to halt forestry operations without compensation to landowners, arguing for the protection of both private property rights and adherence to EU directives.

title: Ge alla ungdomar tillgång till de bästa pedagogerna
summary: The motion proposes strengthening property rights in Sweden by requiring specific justifications for nature protection measures that affect privately owned land. It asserts that the current challenges to property rights threaten democracy and calls for tailored reasoning for each individual case of land protection instead of relying on broad guidelines.

title: Effektivare hantering av bilstödet för anpassning av fordon
summary: The motion advocates for clearer requirements on regional councils to limit the increase of hunting prices on state-owned land to no more than the consumer price index. This measure aims to make hunting more accessible and sustainable, supporting both cultural heritage and rural employment in areas affected by depopulation.

title: Knäck arbetslösheten och bekämpa kriminaliteten – Moderaternas budgetmotion för 2021
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3422 av Ulf Kristersson och Elisabeth Svantesson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive strategy for the Swedish outdoor recreation industry, emphasizing the need for coordinated efforts in managing access to nature, promoting the right of common access (allemansrätten), and ensuring the maintenance of hiking, skiing, and snowmobile trails. The motion advocates for the Swedish Tourist Association (STF) to take responsibility for the management of state-owned trails and highlights the importance of balancing tourism growth with environmental sustainability, as well as increasing public awareness regarding the responsibilities associated with the right of common access.

title: Samverkan mellan scoutrörelsen och Försvarsmakten
summary: The motion proposes changes to the Swedish Parenthood Law (Föräldrabalken) to ensure that a parent convicted of lethal violence against the other parent automatically loses custody rights to their shared children. The aim is to prioritize the children's best interests and prevent situations where children are forced to witness violence. The proposal suggests appointing specially designated guardians to take care of the children, with a possibility for the offending parent to regain custody after demonstrating suitability after a period.

title: Förändrad prioritering gällande arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for increased police presence in rural areas of Sweden to enhance public safety and crime prevention. It highlights the importance of accessibility to law enforcement services, particularly in regions with longer distances between communities. The motion expresses concern over the rising number of police resignations and the need for effective resource allocation to address crime, especially in areas facing significant challenges. Ensuring that essential social services and a visible police force are available in rural areas is deemed crucial for maintaining safety and encouraging population retention.

title: Nationellt beslutad lista över terroristorganisationer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament acknowledges the need for improved cash handling and payment services in rural areas, highlighting the challenges posed by digitalization that has led to significant distances to payment facilities for many residents. It stresses the importance of ensuring access to essential payment services for vulnerable groups, including the elderly and small businesses, and suggests that the government should consider recommendations from the Rural Committee to address these issues effectively.

title: Ett reellt tjänstemannaansvar
summary: The proposal advocates for creating conditions that enhance the number of female innovators in Sweden, highlighting the importance of women's participation in entrepreneurship as a means to achieve gender equality. It points out the lack of recognition for women's innovations, the barriers they face in accessing networks and funding, and the need for a broader perspective on innovation that includes contributions from women. The motion suggests that a national innovation strategy should focus specifically on female innovators to boost Sweden's entrepreneurial landscape.

title: Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen regional management of predators and allow for protective hunting when predators cause damage to farmers. It emphasizes the importance of balancing biodiversity with sustainable livelihoods in rural areas, ensuring that the population can live and work in the countryside while increasing food production under the Swedish food strategy. The motion advocates for easier access to hunting and regional measures to reduce wolf populations in areas where they are most common, aiming for a coexistence between wildlife and human activities.

title: Reformering av den s.k. hotellagen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3416 av Markus Wiechel och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes allowing municipalities the authority to install speed cameras to enhance traffic safety and address problems related to speeding, which is a major cause of accidents and community concern. The motion calls for an investigation into how this can be implemented effectively, emphasizing that current collaborations between the Transport Agency and the police may not adequately address issues such as reckless driving in urban areas.

title: Rättvist förfarande vid arbetstvister
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3415 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The proposal calls for an investigation into the eligibility of sick pay for non-medical cosmetic surgeries, arguing that current regulations impose undue financial burdens on employers when employees undergo such elective procedures. It suggests that sick pay should only apply to medical conditions that necessitate time away from work due to legitimate health issues rather than elective surgeries, which should be reassessed to ensure fair use of welfare resources.

title: Kontroll av PPM-rådgivning och ökad lönsamhet för amortering
summary: This parliamentary suggestion proposes a review of Swedish legislation to address the challenges posed by 'deepfake' technology, which enables the creation of highly convincing fake videos that could mislead the public and damage reputations. The motion emphasizes the risks posed to both individuals, such as public figures and ordinary citizens, and the potential for manipulation in the political landscape, advocating for updated laws to protect against misuse and uphold public trust in media.

title: Hänsyn till kvalifikationer i samband med flyktingmottagande
summary: Tina Acketoft's motion proposes the establishment of a unified payment system for all forms of tax-funded benefits, requiring applicants to automatically certify the accuracy of their information under penalty of perjury. It suggests that governmental authorities should have permission to cross-reference relevant databases to ensure that individuals receive the benefits they are entitled to, aiming to reduce welfare fraud and inaccuracies that lead to significant financial losses for society.

title: Krav på uppehållsrätt från Försäkringskassan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3412 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: Tina Acketoft proposes the abolition of the statutory inheritance rights in Sweden, suggesting that individuals should have complete authority to determine the distribution of their estate upon death. This reform aims to adapt to modern family structures and individual rights, allowing testators to bypass outdated laws that limit their control over their assets.

title: Utgiftsområde 13 Jämställdhet och nyanlända invandrares etablering
summary: The motion proposes an analysis of the police authority's organization in Sweden to reduce bureaucracy and improve the allocation of resources towards local policing and community engagement. It highlights concerns that current structures hinder effective resource distribution and suggests a need for simplification in the command chain, clarification of regional police chiefs' roles, and enhancements in police recruitment to address competency gaps and career pathways.

title: Jämställdhet och diskriminering
summary: The motion proposed by Roger Haddad (L) calls for planning investments to enhance safety and security along the transportation route between Västerås and Eskilstuna. It emphasizes the importance of good communication for local and regional growth, highlighting the heavily trafficked and accident-prone road. The proposal insists on the necessity of widening the road to accommodate increasing vehicle capacity and prevent accidents, urging the government to prioritize these infrastructural improvements in future planning.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The motion calls for intensified efforts against violent extremism and radicalization at the regional level in Sweden. It highlights ongoing issues with organized crime, non-democratic organizations receiving public funding, and the influence of returning terrorists. The proposal urges the government to direct county administrative boards to coordinate regional efforts, increase municipal preparedness, and enhance collaboration between social services, police authorities, and educational institutions to prevent radicalization.

title: Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
summary: This proposal emphasizes the need for measures against the sale of stolen goods online, highlighting the ongoing issues of everyday crimes such as bicycle theft and theft of tools. The motion calls for the government to enhance police capabilities, increase digital presence, and reform legislation to tighten penalties related to such crimes. It aims to empower victims to report their stolen items more efficiently and prevent further sales.

title: Förbättringar av investeringssparkonto
summary: The proposal suggests amending the Municipalities Act to stipulate that elected representatives who leave their party should not be allowed to retain their roles as municipal councilors or in committees where they were nominated by that party. The motion argues that since these positions are tied to the party and the election results, it is reasonable to allow the respective party to replace those who have left, thus maintaining party representation.

title: Kartläggning av socioekonomiska faktorers påverkan på barns och ungas idrottande
summary: The motion proposes a legal ban on conversion therapy aimed at changing the sexual orientation of LGBTQ individuals, classifying it as a criminal offense. It seeks to also eliminate funding for organizations that practice or support such therapies. The authors argue that conversion therapy is a form of psychological violence that is already condemned by various health organizations and that it infringes on the rights of individuals to live freely. They emphasize the need for Sweden to take a progressive stance on LGBTQ rights similar to that taken by other countries.

title: Integration och samhällsgemenskap
summary: This motion proposes renaming Landvetter Airport to Landvetter Torgny Segerstedt Airport to honor Torgny Segerstedt's legacy as a prominent journalist who fought against totalitarianism and inspired individual freedom during World War II. The motion emphasizes the importance of remembering historical figures like Segerstedt, especially in the current climate of rising extremism and xenophobia, and seeks to highlight the contributions of Gothenburg and its citizens to an open society.

title: Sveriges kostnad för EU:s återstartsfond
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of high-speed train connections between Oslo, Göteborg, and København as part of the EU's TEN-T network. It emphasizes the need for research into the potential for double tracks along this route, arguing that improved rail connections would promote economic growth and connectivity between major Scandinavian cities. The motion highlights the importance of infrastructure investments for regional development and the need for a comprehensive approach to creating efficient transport links.

title: Utgiftsområde 13 Jämställdhet och nyanlända invandrares etablering
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen individual privacy protections during online data collection by ensuring that consumers have control over their personal data. It suggests imposing stricter penalties on companies that improperly collect personal information and emphasizes the need for enhanced data protection legislation. The proposal advocates for consumer consent before data is shared with third parties and promotes transparency regarding the use of personal data to uphold privacy rights in the digital landscape.

title: Utgiftsområde 10 Ekonomisk trygghet vid sjukdom och funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a citizen's right of proposal, known as 'folkmotion', to the Swedish Parliament and local assemblies to enhance democracy and allow citizens more influence between elections. It suggests that a proposal be considered if supported by at least one percent of eligible voters and argues for the removal of the current system of citizen proposals in local government legislation in favor of this new mechanism, aiming to invigorate political engagement among the population.

title: En levande och välmående skärgård
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3401 av Markus Wiechel och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes relocating the Chemical Agency from Stockholm to Gothenburg to enhance the agency's performance and contribute positively to Gothenburg's job market, which currently has few government authorities compared to its population size. The authors argue that the move would not only improve local employment opportunities but also leverage the existing expertise in chemistry within the region, ultimately benefiting both the agency and the city.

title: Förbud mot snabblån och stöd till skuldsatta
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3400 av Markus Wiechel och Sara Gille (båda SD)
summary: Robert Hannah proposes limiting the apanage granted to the Swedish royal family, suggesting that the king receive a salary equivalent to that of the Prime Minister and the Speaker of the Riksdag instead of an apanage. The motion calls for an investigation into the reduction of apanage size and the establishment of clear regulations on its distribution and use, arguing that taxpayer money would be better allocated towards social services rather than supporting a wealthy royal family.

title: Erkännande av polisers insats i samhället
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3399 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the preliminary tax for companies, allowing them to pay taxes only on actual earned income instead of estimated profits. This change aims to enhance clarity for businesses and authorities, reduce bureaucracy and administrative costs for taxpayers, and address challenges faced during crises like the COVID-19 pandemic, where many companies incurred losses yet were required to pay estimated taxes.

title: Hot mot och ansvar som förtroendevalda
summary: The proposal suggests implementing a trial allowing 16-year-olds to vote in the 2026 municipal elections in participating municipalities. This initiative stems from a 2014 democratic investigation aimed at enhancing youth participation in democracy. The motion emphasizes that early voting can be beneficial for young people's understanding of the democratic system, potentially increasing their future electoral participation and addressing disparities in voting behaviors among different socioeconomic backgrounds.
