summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity for Swedish production taxes imposed on agriculture to consider the profitability and competitiveness of Swedish farmers, highlighting the declining self-sufficiency in agricultural products and the challenges posed by climate change and urban migration. It calls on the government to acknowledge these issues and work towards a taxation system that supports agricultural viability to ensure a secure food supply for the population in times of crisis.

title: Liberal politik för hbtq-personers lika rättigheter och möjligheter
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the legislation regarding accountability for referring women to maternity clinics, as there are instances where women are forced to seek care at different hospitals due to lack of available space in their designated clinics. The motion suggests that regions not providing adequate maternity services may face financial penalties to address this issue and ensure women are accommodated properly during childbirth.

title: Hälsa för alla – liberal folkhälsopolitik
summary: Lotta Olsson proposes that the responsibility for removing abandoned vehicles should shift from private landowners and road associations to the municipality or state. This change is necessary because current legislation makes vehicle owners solely responsible for removal, which creates issues when ownership cannot be identified. The motion suggests that if a vehicle has not been removed within a week after a police report is filed, the municipality or state should take action to remove it.

title: Välfärdsaktörer ska inte diskriminera för ålder – liberal politik för årsrika
summary: This proposal emphasizes the importance of retaining the copper network until equivalent broadband and telephone services can be provided in affected areas. It argues that the government's ambitious broadband strategy faces challenges, particularly for households reliant on existing copper and ADSL services. The motion calls for a coordinated approach to the dismantling of the copper network by Skanova to prevent households from being left without functional telecommunications services.

title: Liberal feministisk politik för lika rättigheter och möjligheter
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establish clear criteria for what qualifies as a winter tire for vehicles, emphasizing that current evaluations based only on tread depth or studs are insufficient. The proposal aims to ensure that the rubber material and other specifications are addressed to enhance the effectiveness of winter tires.

title: Liberal politik för levande hav och vatten
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for personalized meals for individuals of all ages suffering from dysphagia, particularly in elderly care facilities, schools, and hospitals. It advocates for improved meal quality and nutrient-rich options to combat malnutrition, which is increasing among the elderly. Additionally, it calls for the dissemination of knowledge regarding meal preparation and procurement processes to ensure that meals are appetizing, nutritious, and tailored to the needs of those with swallowing difficulties, ultimately aiming to enhance the quality of life for individuals affected by these issues.

title: Ett starkt civilsamhälle
summary: The motion advocates for improved mobile phone coverage across Sweden, emphasizing its essential role for residents and businesses, particularly in rural areas where service is currently lacking. It suggests that mobile operators should more effectively share infrastructure to enhance coverage without overloading the systems, and calls on the government to facilitate this collaboration.

title: En liberal migrationspolitik
summary: The proposal seeks to abolish the plastic bag tax that was introduced in May 2020, arguing that it has been ineffective in reducing plastic usage and has led to increased unemployment in the manufacturing sector. The motion claims that the tax generates far less revenue than projected, and it fails to differentiate between types of plastics. It suggests that efforts to tackle plastic pollution should focus on reducing emissions at the source, rather than punitive taxes that do not address the root of the problem.

title: Fem reformområden för ökad rättssäkerhet på skatteområdet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government classify melatonin as a dietary supplement, allowing it to be sold over-the-counter, similar to regulations in much of Europe and the USA. The authors argue that the current prescription requirement in Sweden limits accessibility for individuals who struggle with sleep issues, particularly those with irregular light exposure, such as shift workers or the visually impaired. The motion emphasizes that making melatonin accessible as a supplement could help mitigate serious sleep-related health problems exacerbated by the lack of sunlight during Sweden's darker months.

title: Ett förbättrat regelverk för investeringssparkonton
summary: The motion proposes increased governmental support for vaccination against TBE, particularly in areas severely affected by the disease such as Skaraborg. It suggests that Skaraborg be designated as a pilot region for free vaccinations and that TBE vaccination be included in the national vaccination program. This initiative aims to prevent and mitigate the impacts of TBE, thereby reducing long-term illness and associated healthcare costs.

title: En vitaliserande idrottspolitik
summary: The motion addresses the need for improved care and treatment for women suffering from endometriosis in Sweden. It calls for adherence to national guidelines for adequate treatment, the establishment of a national quality registry, and increased education and awareness about the disease among healthcare providers. The motion highlights the significant impact of delayed diagnosis and treatment, which can lead to severe pain, infertility, and financial costs to the healthcare system. It emphasizes the importance of early diagnosis and consistent treatment across regions to improve the health outcomes for affected women.

title: Utred plattformsföretagens skatteregelbörda
summary: Åsa Coenraads proposes that the Swedish Parliament allows farm sales of alcoholic beverages in Västmanland as a pilot project. This initiative aims to revive small-scale brewing traditions, boost local tourism and produce, and offer consumers locally produced beverages. The proposal highlights the growth of microbreweries and the potential for developing farm-based tourism in Sweden. It suggests starting small-scale sales in Västmanland to evaluate the effects on society while addressing existing restrictive laws surrounding alcohol sales.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes a review of capital gains taxation on residential property sales, specifically suggesting the reduction or elimination of such taxes to enhance mobility in the housing market. It calls for a parliamentary investigation into broader housing policies, noting that high transaction costs currently deter elderly homeowners from moving to more suitable living situations, thereby exacerbating a nationwide housing shortage. The motion emphasizes the need for a functioning housing market to support all demographics, particularly the elderly, youth, and newcomers, by addressing both taxation and regulatory challenges.

title: Kulturpolitik för ett rikare land
summary: The motion proposes abolishing the discount on sentencing for individuals who repeatedly commit crimes, arguing that the current system allows many offenders to escape justice because their past records diminish the perceived severity of new offenses. The proposal highlights the negative impact on crime victims and public safety, particularly in light of increasing organized crime and violence in urban areas. It calls for legislative action to ensure that repeat offenders face appropriate penalties without the benefit of sentencing discounts.

title: Familjerätt och övrig civilrätt
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament considers the possibility of implementing REP- and ROST-tax deductions, similar to existing RUT and ROT deductions. The aim is to promote job creation in the automotive repair industry, enhance road safety, reduce the costs of vehicle maintenance for individuals, and decrease the prevalence of black market work in this sector.

title: En liberal politik för regional utveckling i hela Sverige
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive approach to combat organized car theft and car parts theft in Sweden. It suggests that the government consider stricter penalties and additional measures to address these crimes, which have evolved with the advancement of technology. The motion emphasizes the importance of using modern techniques such as tracking devices and improving cooperation with border authorities and other nations to prevent theft and recover stolen vehicles. It also highlights the systemic nature of car parts thefts, often perpetrated by organized criminal networks, and calls for targeted police actions and legislative changes to enhance enforcement capabilities.

title: Återupprätta en fungerande elförsörjning
summary: The motion proposes allowing farm sales of locally produced alcohol, specifically targeting Swedish wine producers who are currently hindered by strict regulations and the monopoly of Systembolaget. By permitting small alcohol producers to act as agents for Systembolaget, the motion aims to enable direct sales to consumers, thereby enhancing the businesses of local vineyards and supporting rural development without compromising existing alcohol regulations or public health.

title: Liberal politik för elektrifiering av transportsektorn
summary: The motion proposes that continuity should be a fundamental principle in the Swedish healthcare system, emphasizing that patients should have a consistent primary care contact to ensure quality and availability of care across regions. The motion highlights the problems caused by an over-reliance on temporary staff, advocating for a system that prioritizes stable patient-provider relationships to enhance care quality, especially for the elderly and those with chronic conditions.

title: Mediepolitik för mångfald och kvalitet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government expedite the investigation into the preparedness of the healthcare system for emergencies and crises. It emphasizes the need for municipalities to be adequately equipped with personal protective equipment and clear national guidelines for crisis scenarios. Given the lessons learned from the COVID-19 pandemic, the motion argues that a comprehensive plan for crisis response should not be delayed until 2022, as further crises may arise. The motion calls for swift action to ensure that healthcare services can respond effectively to potential emergencies.

title: Liberal digitaliseringspolitik för Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden strengthen its international efforts against antibiotic resistance by developing a new national strategy, systematically evaluating current strategies, and encouraging lower antibiotic prescriptions within the EU. It emphasizes the need for enhanced research and innovative business models to incentivize the pharmaceutical industry to develop new antibiotics, addressing the growing global health threat posed by resistant bacterial strains.

title: Kortare ledtider och lägre kostnader för ny kärnkraft
summary: The motion proposes the initiation of a renewed zero vision for suicide prevention in Sweden, emphasizing the urgent need to evaluate past efforts and develop new strategies based on evidence-based practices. It calls for the National Center for Suicide Research and Prevention (NASP) to create a suicide prevention program specifically targeting young people, highlighting the increasing suicide rates within this demographic and the lack of effective measures in place.

title: Kinas nya världsordning och det liberala svaret
summary: The motion aims to address the environmental impact of pharmaceutical production by advocating for the inclusion of environmental criteria in the EU's Good Manufacturing Practice regulations. It urges the Swedish government to push for stricter environmental standards in the production of both original and generic medicines, as well as calling for the European Court of Auditors to evaluate compliance with these environmental requirements. The motion highlights the lack of sufficient environmental considerations in drug manufacturing, particularly in developing countries, and calls for these aspects to be integrated into the decision-making process of the Dental and Pharmaceutical Benefits Agency.

title: Sverige behöver Natomedlemskap
summary: The motion addresses the issue of youth crime in Sweden, highlighting the overrepresentation of young individuals as suspects in criminal activities. It emphasizes the need for measures such as witness protection and enhanced police efforts to combat gang crime. The authors argue for the importance of early preventive actions to deter young people from engaging in criminal behavior and stress the necessity of providing law enforcement with adequate resources and strategies to address these challenges effectively.

title: En liberal svensk Rysslandspolitik
summary: The motion proposes the removal of VAT on driver's license training and the introduction of a tax deduction for driver's license costs, referred to as RATT deduction. This move aims to alleviate the financial burden on young individuals seeking employment, as possessing a driver's license is essential for job opportunities and geographical mobility. The petitioner argues that reducing these costs would not only encourage more people to obtain driver's licenses but also enhance road safety and traffic understanding.

title: Vägen till en cirkulär ekonomi
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the gradual elimination of mortgage interest deductions and instead reduce other taxes, arguing that using taxpayer funds for these deductions contributes to rising housing prices and inflates the housing bubble. It suggests that the government should appoint an inquiry to explore the phase-out of these deductions over a 15 to 30-year period.

title: Forskning och innovation i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates the structure and environmental impact of the chemical tax, specifically advocating for an exemption for used electronic products. The motion argues that the current implementation of the tax has led to unintended consequences, such as double taxation of second-hand goods and discouraging the resale of heavier electronic items, which undermines the goals of circular economy and environmental sustainability.

title: Liberal politik för naturvård och biologisk mångfald
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to review its space legislation to allow for space tourism and for space tourism to be incorporated into the national tourism strategy. The proponents argue that Sweden has the potential to be a leader in the space tourism sector, much like it was during the emergence of the airline industry. They claim that a focus on space could generate jobs, research opportunities, and educational initiatives, enhancing Sweden's standing in the global market for space activities.

title: Liberal infrastrukturpolitik för framtiden
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for improved knowledge and competence regarding ADHD and dyslexia among preschool and school teachers. It points out that many students do not receive adequate pedagogical support until they reach high school, resulting in significant knowledge gaps. The motion calls for the government to ensure that all educators are trained to implement appropriate teaching methods for students with these learning difficulties.

title: Liberal integrationspolitik
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a licensed level for nursing assistants (undersköterskor) in Sweden, highlighting the importance of their role in healthcare and the need for a clear career path and specialization akin to that of nurses and doctors. It aims to enhance the status of nursing assistants, establish a consistent foundational education, and ensure a competent workforce in the sector, particularly in light of recent challenges highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: En likvärdig kunskapsskola
summary: The motion proposes several initiatives for the development of coastal fishing and aquaculture in Sweden. It suggests establishing a governmental mandate for regulatory simplification to reduce the administrative burden on the fishing sector, reviewing shoreline protections to facilitate mussel farming, and considering measures to enhance the functionality of Fiskebäck harbor to support the fishery industry. Additionally, it calls for evaluating the possibility of accommodating state operations in Fiskebäck, aiming to foster a collaborative network of maritime activities.

title: Stärkt eftervård efter förlossning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish state should take responsibility for managing damage caused by the spruce bark beetle in its own forests, similar to the obligations of private forest owners. The spread of the spruce bark beetle has severely impacted forests in Västmanland, where the damage is worsening. The motion argues that state-owned forests, including those managed by Sveaskog and in nature reserves, are contributing to the spread of the beetle to private lands and that this situation necessitates governmental intervention to mitigate economic and climate impacts.

title: Gode män och offentligt biträde
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of an accreditation system for water towers and large water reservoirs to ensure the safety and quality of drinking water in Sweden. It emphasizes the necessity for regular inspections and maintenance to prevent contamination due to aging infrastructure, referencing past incidents of unsafe drinking water in both Sweden and Norway. The intention is to enhance civil preparedness and uphold the high standards of potable water that Sweden has traditionally maintained.

title: Kostnader för rovdjursskador
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3230 av Joar Forssell och Lina Nordquist (båda L)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize the rights of individual property owners regarding their wastewater solutions, specifically opposing mandatory connections to municipal sewage systems for owners of functioning individual systems. It calls for an assessment of the environmental and economic impacts before municipalities enforce such mandates, emphasizing property rights and questioning the environmental benefits versus the costs of forced connections, particularly in rural areas.

title: Sjukvården framåt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament takes a strong stance against unwelcomed and unscrupulous telephone sales practices, urging the government to enhance collaboration between businesses and relevant authorities to create a safer and more secure framework for telephone sales. The proposal highlights the issues of fraudulent invoices and verbal contracts, emphasizing the need for ongoing monitoring of the telephone market to deter dishonest actors while ensuring that legitimate telephone sales continue to provide employment opportunities for youth.

title: En liberal politik för statligt ägda bolag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government establish a clear strategy for increasing the analysis of wastewater samples to better track and limit the spread of viral diseases and pandemics. It highlights the current lack of requirements for virus analysis in wastewater and the absence of responsible authorities for this issue. The motion calls for improving collaboration both nationally and internationally, particularly within the EU, to enhance early detection and response to potential outbreaks through strategic wastewater sampling.

title: Stärkta arbetsvillkor inom vård, stöd och omsorg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should explore the possibility of making it financially feasible to install elevators in apartment buildings that currently lack them, highlighting the benefits for senior households and society as a whole. It argues that many elderly individuals live in buildings without elevators, leading to increased care needs and declining quality of life. By facilitating elevator installations and necessary environmental upgrades, the proposal aims to improve accessibility, allow seniors to remain in their homes, and reduce costs for community care services.

title: Mobbning i skolan
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to strengthen its national strategy towards China, highlighting the rapid development and rising global influence of the Chinese state. It outlines concerns regarding human rights violations, aggressive foreign policy, and attempts by the Chinese government to suppress criticism, both domestically and internationally. The authors express dissatisfaction with the current government's approach, demanding clearer stances against Chinese influence and actions that threaten democratic values and freedoms in Sweden.

title: Vuxenutbildning för integration och arbete
summary: The motion proposes several measures to attract and facilitate the immigration of talented individuals to Sweden for research, entrepreneurship, and employment. It recommends the evaluation of previously implemented regulations for foreign students and researchers, the introduction of a talent visa, and amendments to immigration rules to ease the process for qualified individuals seeking to establish businesses or invest in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the need for efficient handling of bureaucratic processes related to migration and work permits while proposing a review of administrative hurdles faced by newcomers.

title: Ett attraktivt läraryrke
summary: The motion proposes that Försäkringskassan be required to inform insurance companies about changes in payment conditions for individuals receiving benefits due to reduced work capacity. Currently, when Försäkringskassan stops payments after reassessing an individual's capacity, insurance companies may continue to provide payments without knowledge of this change. The proposal aims to improve communication between Försäkringskassan and insurance companies, similar to practices in Norway, to ensure that individuals do not receive overlapping payments inadvertently.

title: En gymnasieskola för bildning och flit
summary: The motion addresses the need to investigate conditions for continued forest production in Sweden, emphasizing the economic importance of forestry for the national GDP and local welfare, particularly in Västmanland. It highlights concerns over the challenges faced by the forestry industry, including environmental regulations and wildlife population management, and advocates for a balanced approach that considers both production and ecological goals.

title: Utgiftsområde 20 Allmän miljö- och naturvård
summary: The proposal advocates for reducing the wolf population in Västmanland, arguing that the current management has failed, leading to increasing wolf numbers and associated problems such as livestock deaths and local fear. The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support a decrease in the wolf population to 170 individuals in order to mitigate issues in Västmanland and restore public confidence in wildlife management practices.

title: Angående det offentligas förhållningssätt till jämställdhetsbegreppet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament emphasize the production of plant-based food as a means to enhance the resilience of the country's food supply against major crises. It highlights the vulnerability of Swedish agriculture, particularly during events like the 2018 drought, and argues for a structural shift towards diversified, plant-based agriculture to improve self-sufficiency. The motion calls for government support to facilitate this transition and adapt to changing consumer demands for vegetarian products.

title: Utgiftsområde 3 Skatt, tull och exekution
summary: The motion proposes an increase in fire safety measures for wood-burning stoves by suggesting the certification of installers. It highlights the significant number of residential fires in Sweden, particularly those caused by improper installation and operation of stoves, and emphasizes the need for better regulation in order to prevent these occurrences. The motion calls for governmental action to enhance safety standards and ensure that installers possess adequate skills and knowledge.

title: Rättvisa skatter på fordon och transporter och stärkt sammanhållning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of forestry for Sweden's economy and sustainability, advocating for the protection of property rights and urging the government to explore the use of non-native tree species to enhance growth and productivity in forestry. It argues that sustainable forest management is crucial for achieving a fossil-free Sweden and reflects concerns among landowners about the erosion of property rights. Additionally, it calls for a review of regulations surrounding the use of foreign tree species in order to adapt to changing climate conditions and improve the forestry sector's resilience and productivity.

title: Skatteförslag för en effektiv miljö- och klimatpolitik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support initiatives to generally reduce the processing times for environmental permits, as the current lengthy approval process, which can take 5-10 years or longer, hinders investments and job creation. The proposal suggests that the government evaluate measures such as strengthened rights for changes in permit conditions, the use of best available techniques, and a review of the detail and scope of permit conditions to facilitate quicker approvals.

title: Stärk gränsskyddet och Tullverket
summary: This motion proposes the creation and implementation of signage for suddenly emerging downhill slopes on major roads to improve safety for heavy transports such as timber. It emphasizes the need for better road awareness, especially in winter conditions, where unexpected hills can lead to difficulties in controlling heavy vehicles, posing significant safety risks.

title: Ordning och reda i staten för att stävja fusk och brott
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a tax deduction for individuals who obtain a bus or truck driver's license, aimed at encouraging more young people to acquire these licenses and subsequently pursue careers as drivers. This initiative seeks to reduce the financial burden associated with driver education, thereby facilitating greater access to employment opportunities in the transportation sector, which currently faces a shortage of drivers in Sweden.

title: Stärk integrationen och jämställdheten
summary: The motion proposes a review of the patient data law to facilitate improved information sharing between healthcare systems across different regions in Sweden. It highlights the discrepancies in healthcare quality that arise from varied regional regulations and emphasizes the need for a seamless integration of healthcare services to enhance patient care nationwide. The authors argue that despite advancements in Region Halland, the inability to exchange data due to existing laws undermines the overall quality of care, suggesting that a more flexible legal framework is needed to drive innovation in Swedish healthcare.

title: Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
summary: The motion proposes that municipalities should provide clearer reporting in their annual financial statements on how their expenditures are allocated between statutory and voluntary activities. This is aimed at increasing transparency for taxpayers about the use of public funds and enhancing understanding of municipal financial priorities.

title: Utgiftsområde 7 Internationellt bistånd
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of quality assurance measures for cosmetic surgeries and procedures in Sweden, highlighting that the current lack of regulation can lead to subpar outcomes and complications for patients. The proponent argues that while some procedures require certification, many do not, resulting in varying standards of safety and quality.

title: Ofödda barn
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3212 av Jessika Roswall och Maria Malmer Stenergard (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a principal authority for addiction care in Sweden to clarify responsibilities between regions and municipalities, addressing the current inefficiencies that contribute to the high rate of deaths among substance users. It emphasizes the need for urgent government action to implement this framework, as the lack of clear accountability has led to many individuals falling through the cracks in the healthcare system, ultimately resulting in significant social and economic costs.

title: Skarv
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3211 av Jessika Roswall och Marta Obminska (båda M)
summary: The proposal suggests that relatives of elderly and disabled individuals should have greater opportunities to assist them in discussions regarding their choices of living arrangements, food, and other forms of support. It emphasizes the importance of involving family members in these conversations to ensure that the elderly and disabled can express their preferences without fear or undue pressure from officials or care institutions.

title: Förbindelse Skokloster–Knivsta
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3210 av Jessika Roswall och Marta Obminska (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government review the possibility of implementing dental care fees for asylum seekers and temporary visitors, ensuring that these costs are consistent for all patients. It also suggests investigating the option of recording unpaid dental bills as debts to be settled later, emphasizing the importance of equal treatment in dental care costs for all individuals in Sweden.

title: Riksväg 55
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3209 av Jessika Roswall och Marta Obminska (båda M)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for public services to remain accessible to the elderly who lack digital connectivity, suggesting that the government should ensure that programs are available without reliance on external platforms. It highlights the digital divide affecting approximately 400,000 seniors in Sweden and calls for the Public Health Agency to review the digital authentication requirements that hinder their access to services. Additionally, it advocates for high-capacity broadband at senior centers to enhance participation and reduce social isolation, recognizing the rapid pace of digitalization as a challenge for many elderly individuals.

title: Privatekonomi i skolan
summary: The motion proposes a review of the expropriation law in Sweden, specifically focusing on the compensation offered to landowners when their land is acquired for public use. It highlights issues with current compensation practices, where landowners receive market value plus a 25% increase, while contractors subsequently sell the repurposed land at significantly higher values. The motion also calls for an investigation into what constitutes important public interests in the context of land expropriation.

title: EU och digitalisering
summary: This motion proposes a series of reforms to improve the legislation surrounding guardianship in Sweden, aiming to establish a national authority responsible for overseeing guardians and a mandatory training program. It suggests creating a national register for guardians, enhancing recruitment strategies, and addressing the issue of potential financial abuse. The proposal also calls for the possibility of professional guardians, the modernization of existing laws, and the introduction of insurance for guardians to protect them in their roles, ensuring that those in need receive proper support.

title: Globala utmaningar i spåren av covid-19
summary: The motion proposes that individuals filing for bankruptcy must use electronic identification, such as BankID, to verify their identity, ensuring that fraudulent bankruptcy applications are prevented. It further suggests that courts must promptly inform the legitimate owners and authorized signatories of any bankruptcy decisions made, to aid victims in addressing wrongful claims without unnecessary delays or complications.

title: Politik för handel och utveckling
summary: The motion suggests easing the regulations on waterfront protection in Sweden to facilitate increased housing construction. It highlights the growing population and the current housing shortage across the country, stressing the need for renovations and new buildings. The proposal calls for a reassessment of the existing strict protection measures, which currently hinder municipal development near water bodies, and advocates for a maximum protection limit of 100 meters to enhance construction efforts.

title: En utrikespolitik utifrån svenska intressen
summary: The motion proposes that housing construction be recognized as a national interest in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a balance between national interests, such as nature conservation and cultural value protections, and the urgent demand for housing, especially in the Stockholm region. It calls for the government to initiate a new investigation aimed at creating better conditions for housing development, as current laws prioritize environmental and conservation interests to the detriment of necessary housing projects.

title: En äldrepolitik att lita på
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into whether requiring a permission to appeal in administrative courts for logging disputes is a sensible arrangement. It highlights issues such as long processing times and high costs resulting from current regulations linked to the Århus Convention, suggesting that these problems could be mitigated and that a proper cost assessment was not previously conducted. The motion aims to lead to a more legally secure system that benefits both the government and individuals.

title: Krafttag mot det illegala gatuspelet
summary: The motion proposes that government authorities should not designate private land without legal backing or an agreement with the landowner, emphasizing that such designations have negative impacts on private land use and can occur without the landowner's knowledge. The motion argues for the protection of individual land rights and the necessity for formal legal support for any governmental claims over private property.

title: Lättnader i strandskydd för betande hästar och andra djur
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3201 av Sofia Westergren och Alexandra Anstrell (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of an external, real-time updated register of borrowers' total debts to address the increasing issue of over-indebtedness in Sweden. Citing alarming statistics from the Swedish Enforcement Authority, the motion highlights the rising number of individuals in debt, particularly among the young and vulnerable groups affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion advocates for regulatory measures similar to those being implemented in Norway and under consideration in Finland to mitigate the risks associated with excessive borrowing.

title: Eldrivna mindre fordon i stadsmiljö
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3200 av Sofia Westergren och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament ease mortgage restrictions for seniors, enabling them to move into more suitable housing as they age. Currently, many seniors are unable to afford senior housing due to existing amortization requirements tied to their mortgage loans. Easing these restrictions would not only help seniors relocate to more accessible living arrangements but also facilitate a smoother housing market by allowing seniors to sell their homes, thereby benefiting younger families looking for suitable properties and reducing loneliness among seniors in community housing.

title: Registrering av äldre fordon
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3199 av Sofia Westergren och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to ensure that Postnord provides equal quality postal service to all citizens and businesses across the country, particularly in rural areas. It calls for the cancellation of plans for every-other-day delivery, an investigation into increased re-regulation of the postal market, and a separation of Swedish postal services from Danish ones. The motion argues that Postnord's financial difficulties stem from deregulation and competition from private companies, highlighting the need for state support to maintain nationwide postal services.

title: Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures to enhance animal welfare in Sweden, including phasing out cages in the egg industry by 2023, prohibiting fur farming, banning the sale of newly produced fur, and ending the use of carbon dioxide for stunning pigs during slaughter. It also advocates increased support for organic farms, ensuring outdoor access for farm animals, reducing transport times for animals within the EU, and improving regulations around pet ownership and breeding practices. The motion calls for stronger animal rights and welfare policies, reflecting a significant shift towards a more humane treatment of animals in agricultural practices.

title: Utgiftsområde 20 Allmän miljö- och naturvård
summary: The motion aims to improve working conditions in the transport industry, particularly in maritime and taxi sectors, by advocating for stricter oversight, the involvement of trade unions in the appointment of safety representatives, and the implementation of comprehensive regulations to prevent exploitation and ensure worker rights. Specific proposals include transferring oversight of maritime working environments to the Swedish Occupational Safety Authority and implementing measures to combat social dumping and ensure equitable practices within Swedish transport.

title: Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive plan for achieving a fossil-free transport sector in Sweden by 2035, emphasizing the importance of transport efficiency and climate goals in infrastructure planning. It includes measures such as banning the sale of fossil-fueled vehicles after 2025, implementing a green mobility strategy, enhancing bicycle infrastructure, and facilitating local governments' ability to impose congestion charges. The motion argues for a shift away from car dependency and urges the government to review current transport investment plans to align them with climate targets.

title: Utgiftsområde 22 Kommunikationer
summary: The proposal by Vänsterpartiet advocates for increased investment and improved access to public transport in Sweden, emphasizing the need to double the market share of public transportation to achieve climate goals. It includes measures such as reducing fares, implementing a national ticketing system, and eliminating tax benefits for company cars to encourage greater usage of public transit. The suggestion outlines a plan for the government to develop a comprehensive action plan aimed at enhancing both the efficiency and attractiveness of collective transportation systems, thereby promoting environmental sustainability and accessibility for low-income individuals.

title: Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: The motion proposed by Elin Segerlind and others from the Left Party aims to strengthen the protection of forests in Sweden to meet environmental quality goals related to biodiversity and recreation. It suggests adopting new targets for forest protection in line with international obligations and outlines measures to ensure the long-term preservation of forests with high natural and social value, enhance environmental considerations in forestry practices, and increase the establishment of protected areas and national parks. The motion emphasizes the need for legal reforms to provide effective sanctions for violations of forestry regulations and to secure sustainable forestry practices.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive upgrade of elderly care services in Sweden following the COVID-19 pandemic, emphasizing the need for improved medical competence, increased powers for medical supervisors, and mandatory emergency preparedness plans in all elderly care facilities. It outlines the pressing issues within the current system, including low staffing levels, precarious employment conditions, and insufficient training, and advocates for a significant state investment to enhance personnel security, training, and a focus on delivering dignified care to the elderly population.

title: Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government initiate an investigation into how the state can facilitate worker-owned enterprises and transitions of threatened production to employees. It also calls for relevant authorities to create proposals for measures that ease generational transitions in businesses. The Left Party emphasizes the importance of cooperative and employee-owned companies for fostering diverse ownership structures, enhancing workers' influence over their workplaces, and improving access to capital and financing for these firms.

title: Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The parliamentary motion proposes a series of measures aimed at increasing participation in cultural life among children and young people, including an investigation into further training for preschool teachers in artistic expressions, the implementation of a cultural guarantee modeled after Norway, and the reintroduction of aesthetic subjects in all gymnasium programs. The motion emphasizes the importance of equal access to cultural experiences and creative expression for all children, regardless of their social or economic background, and outlines the significant role of education in fostering this inclusivity.

title: Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
summary: The proposal from Vänsterpartiet suggests comprehensive reforms to the Swedish pension system to ensure economic security and equity among pensioners. It highlights the system's current inadequacies in providing adequate pensions, particularly for low and middle-income earners, while also addressing gender disparities and the influence of the COVID-19 pandemic on future pension outlooks. The motion calls for an evaluation of the pension age, increased contributions, and a shift towards a more generous and redistributive pension model.

title: Tjänstevapen för tullinspektörer
summary: This motion proposes a comprehensive reform of Sweden's sickness insurance system, focusing on increased support and protection for individuals suffering from illness or disability. It emphasizes the need to eliminate the current rehabilitation chain, improve economic safety measures for temporary workers during sickness, and enhance individuals' rights to engage in studies and volunteering without losing benefits. Further, the motion suggests reviewing and modifying various elements of the insurance system to ensure a fairer and more accessible process, ultimately aiming to provide better health outcomes and economic stability for those affected by health-related work absences.

title: Krafttag mot radikala muslimer och jihadresenärer
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at improving conditions for children and adults in economically vulnerable families in Sweden. Key proposals include integrating computer and broadband access into the basic financial support framework, allowing parents receiving such support to take leaves for vacations with their children, ensuring individual assessments for economic assistance, excluding compensation payouts from being counted as income, reviewing guidelines related to economic support, improving data collection on economic aid, and creating a national action plan against child poverty.

title: Förhindrande av oskäliga skadestånd vid frihetsberövanden
summary: The motion addresses the need for Sweden to enhance its development cooperation with the Horn of Africa, emphasizing political and economic self-determination. It calls for increased political support for women's movements, LGBTQ rights, and labor rights while prosecuting human rights violations. The motion advocates for a collaborative approach through the EU and UN to support democratic development, human rights, and a humane migration policy in Ethiopia, Somalia, Eritrea, and Djibouti, ensuring the inclusion of marginalized groups in the political process.

title: En ekonomiskt och socialt hållbar bostadsmarknad
summary: The motion proposes new legislation aimed at preventing the use of proxy individuals ('målvakter') in corporate bankruptcy situations, particularly to combat credit fraud against businesses. It highlights the inability of existing authorities to effectively address the issue, as individuals can engage in multiple bankruptcies without facing consequences. The motion emphasizes the need for legal measures to stop individuals who exploit identities for fraudulent business practices from establishing additional companies, thereby protecting legitimate entrepreneurs from potential harm.

title: Utvidgat ROT-avdrag som omfattar enskilda avloppsanläggningar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3185 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament evaluate the alcohol limit of 0.2 promille for boating, which has been in place since 2010. It argues for a thorough assessment of the law's impacts on reducing accidents at sea, the effectiveness of monitoring efforts, and the costs and resources allocated for enforcement, emphasizing the importance of regular reviews of legislation.

title: Skärpta åtgärder mot djurrättsaktivism
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3184 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: This motion proposes simplifying the process of domestic adoption in Sweden to ensure that more vulnerable children can grow up in safe and stable family environments. It emphasizes the importance of prioritizing the child's perspective over that of the biological parents, especially for those children who have been in foster care for extended periods or have experienced multiple placements. The motion calls for a revision of existing procedures to facilitate adoptions and highlights the societal responsibility to support children in need of stable homes.

title: Säkerställd äganderätt av skog
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3183 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament (Riksdag) instruct the government to investigate new protective measures to prevent personal indebtedness. The motion highlights societal issues surrounding consumerism and the lack of mechanisms that help individuals manage their financial decisions effectively, particularly with the rise of online shopping and easy access to credit. It calls for the introduction of features similar to those available for gambling addiction that would enable individuals to set limits on their spending behavior, thereby preventing excessive consumption and debt accumulation.

title: Nationellt meänkielicentrum till Övertorneå
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3182 av Linda Modig och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the general shoreline protection laws, arguing that these regulations hinder rural development and the creation of attractive living environments. The motion suggests that the existing laws are overly restrictive and ambiguous, leading to difficulties in exploitation and development. It advocates for municipalities to have the authority to designate protected areas under stricter regulations to bolster rural areas and encourage more people to settle there.

title: Avskaffande av gränshinder för veterinärer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take steps to establish legal certainty regarding the measurement of building heights. It emphasizes the need for clear guidelines to resolve inconsistencies in court interpretations and practices, which have rendered many buildings non-compliant with existing building permits. The proposal calls for granting the Swedish Construction Agency (Boverket) the authority to issue regulations, thereby addressing the significant challenges faced by municipalities, regional authorities, and courts due to fragmentation in legal practices surrounding building height calculations.

title: Nationellt stöd för mjölkproduktion
summary: The motion proposes modernizing the lease legislation (arrendelagstiftningen) to provide greater contractual freedom, arguing that current laws are outdated and lead to short leases that diminish agricultural yields and soil quality. By allowing longer agreements, farmers would be more inclined to invest in land improvements, increasing productivity and contributing to climate efforts. The proposal suggests abolishing or making the current protection of tenants (besittningsskyddet) optional in order to adapt the legislation to contemporary agricultural practices and enhance the resilience of Swedish agriculture.

title: Åtgärder mot spelmissbruk
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the National Board of Housing, Building and Planning (Boverket) to simplify regulations concerning temporary buildings to increase the availability of housing and support local needs for various facilities. It highlights the urgent need for more housing, estimating about 500,000 new units required by 2025, and argues that current rules are too complex and hinder the swift placement and relocation of temporary structures like building cabins. The motion suggests introducing a new 'Uppställningstillstånd' to differentiate temporary structures from permanent building regulations.

title: Förverkligande av Norrbotniabanan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3178 av Helena Lindahl och Linda Modig (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes to enhance legal certainty in the calculation of building heights and urges the government to grant the Swedish National Board of Housing, Building and Planning (Boverket) the authority to issue regulations. It highlights inconsistencies in judicial interpretations and practices regarding building heights, leading to confusion and legal disputes for property owners and municipalities. The motion calls for clear legislative guidelines to improve the measurement and assessment processes related to building heights.

title: Ett fritt och brett kulturliv i hela landet
summary: The motion proposed by Maria Stockhaus advocates for the revision of current noise regulations to facilitate increased housing construction in densely populated areas, particularly near public transportation. The argument supports the notion that modern building technology can mitigate indoor noise levels despite proximity to noise sources. It highlights that existing regulations are hindering housing development, with a significant percentage of municipalities expressing this concern. The motion suggests raising noise threshold limits and allowing for a more flexible approach to noise categorization, with a recommendation for the Swedish National Board of Housing, Building and Planning to oversee the noise regulation framework.

title: Ett idrottsliv, friluftsliv och civilsamhälle tillgängligt för alla
summary: This motion proposes the reintroduction of mandatory auditing for smaller limited companies in Sweden, which was abolished in 2010 to reduce administrative costs for businesses. The motion argues that while the abolition led to increased company formations and reduced costs, it also resulted in a rise in economic crimes, as the lack of audits has decreased the ability of authorities like the Economic Crime Authority to detect misconduct. The author believes that the benefits of mandatory audits outweigh the initial advantages of their removal, citing recommendations from the National Audit Office to reinstate them.

title: Demokratiska och mänskliga rättigheter
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should explore the possibility of making home insurance mandatory for residents of multi-family housing. The rationale behind this suggestion is that a resident without insurance can cause damage to neighbors' properties, and current insurance policies may not adequately cover such incidents. Implementing mandatory insurance would provide better protection and safety for residents in these buildings.

title: Fri journalistik och opinionsbildning som bevakar hela Sverige
summary: Lotta Olsson's motion proposes introducing a mandatory travel insurance that covers the costs of medical repatriation for Swedish citizens who fall ill while abroad. The rationale behind this motion is to address the financial burdens faced by individuals who get sick during their travels, particularly those on long trips where standard home insurance may not apply. The motion highlights the current lack of coverage for such transport costs and compares the proposal to existing compulsory insurances, like traffic insurance, to ensure that necessary expenses are covered.

title: Regionalt differentierade arbetsgivaravgifter
summary: Mats Green proposes strengthening the weakened Swedish property rights by reviewing and clarifying the 'environmental exemption' in the Swedish constitution. He argues that current interpretations of property rights related to environmental protection have led to inadequate compensation for property owners when their rights are infringed upon. Green emphasizes that the principle of property rights is fundamental to democracy and contends that the law should be amended to ensure stricter limitations on the use of environmental protection as a justification for expropriation, as well as to increase compensation for property owners affected by such actions.

title: Hållbara transporter med hög tillgänglighet i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the Swedish shore protection law to better balance property rights and environmental concerns. It argues that the current stringent regulations hinder property owners and municipalities from developing valuable waterfront areas. The authors advocate for a revised framework that would allow more flexibility in building near shorelines, while maintaining protections for significant natural values. They suggest that municipalities take on responsibility for managing shore protection to improve transparency and efficiency, and recommend transferring the appeal process for land use decisions from county administrative boards to environmental courts to expedite housing development.

title: Grön omställning av transportsektorn
summary: Motion M1995 proposes the abolition of regulations requiring employers to notify the Swedish Public Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen) of operational cutbacks that lead to layoffs. The motion argues that the current requirement imposes unnecessary administrative burdens on companies, consuming time and resources.

title: Vägen ut ur krisen – en plan för jämlikhet och grön omställning
summary: The motion advocates for the investigation into the possibility of introducing special building permits that allow construction in noise-affected areas, aiming to facilitate living opportunities for individuals connected to the countryside. The proposal highlights that current strict regulations often reject building applications due to potential disturbances from surrounding environments, such as agriculture or airports, even when applicants are willing to accept these conditions. It suggests that specific clauses and agreements should accompany building permits to empower individuals to build on their own land despite the disturbance risks.

title: It som femte transportslaget
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a principle of proportionality for conflict measures in the labor market, arguing that current rules disproportionately favor trade unions over employers. It asserts that the existing framework leads to an imbalance in negotiation strength and can harm businesses, particularly highlighting the need for a balanced approach to prevent excessive damage from union actions. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring that the means employed in labor disputes are proportionate to their intended goals and consequences.

title: Ökad motståndskraft för transporter
summary: Mattias Karlsson proposes to amend the regulations of the reindeer husbandry law to expand the rights to own caretaker reindeer throughout Norrbotten. The current regulation restricts ownership of caretaker reindeer to individuals living within a specific area, which has led to concerns about loss of income and connections to one's hometown for those who move outside this area. The proposal aims to allow individuals who own or operate agricultural properties within the relevant region of Norrbotten, regardless of their actual residence, to retain their rights to caretaker reindeer.

title: Avkastningen av markköp till markägaren istället för statens underentreprenör
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3167 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes to reduce the current 100-meter setback rule for residential construction near water bodies to 50 meters in order to facilitate the building of thousands of new homes in Sweden. It argues that the existing regulations hinder necessary housing development in urban areas experiencing significant housing shortages, while emphasizing the importance of managing land use effectively.

title: Berörda kommuners och regioners del av vind- och vattenkraftens värden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3166 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to strengthen property rights in Swedish forestry policy, arguing that robust ownership rights are essential for facilitating active forestry practices. It highlights the importance of forests for the economy, job creation, and environmental benefits, while expressing concern over increasing restrictions and regulations that threaten property rights and create uncertainty for landowners. The motion calls for a new forestry policy that prioritizes voluntary agreements with landowners regarding conservation and ensures full compensation for any limitations on harvesting.

title: Tillägg och förtydligande i fastighetslagen angående hänsyn till landsbygdens lokala behov
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3165 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes to revise the requirement for personnel registers in the construction industry, suggesting that the responsibility should solely lie with the employer rather than the client ordering the construction. This change aims to ensure that businesses hold complete accountability for their employee attendance records, in line with existing rules applied in other sectors like restaurants and hairdressing, and to eliminate the unreasonable expectation that clients are responsible for ensuring compliance by employers.

title: Polisens närvaro i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3164 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of an alternative organization number for sole proprietorships to accommodate individuals with protected identities and those without a Swedish personal number, ensuring they can start a business while maintaining privacy regarding their personal information.

title: Snöröjning av enskilda vägar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3163 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes to introduce the right to tax deductions for wellness expenses for sole proprietorships, aiming to ensure equal treatment between different legal business forms. Currently, while employers can provide tax-free wellness benefits to their employees, sole proprietors are excluded from these benefits. The proposal highlights the need for fairness as 425,000 sole proprietors contribute significantly to job creation and tax revenues, and aims to enhance public health by allowing these entrepreneurs access to the same wellness incentives as those running limited companies.

title: Krafttag för helhetssyn vid tillståndsprövning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3162 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion calls for the establishment of a national action plan for rare diseases in Sweden, highlighting the challenges faced by individuals with rare diagnoses, including lack of information, delayed diagnoses, and absence of treatment. It points out that Sweden is among the last EU countries without such a plan, despite a recommendation from the European Council over ten years ago. The proposed plan aims to improve healthcare access and coordination for individuals suffering from rare diseases.

title: Ekonomiska frizoner för företag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3161 av Helena Lindahl och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of extending the periods for data download from driver cards and digital tachographs, aiming to reduce administrative costs for bus companies. The current regulations are seen as burdensome and costly, and an extension from 28 to 61 days for driver cards and from 90 to 183 days for vehicle units could lead to significant time and cost savings for medium-sized bus operators while maintaining competitive fairness and road safety.

title: Förenklade skatteregler för enskilda näringsidkare
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of tightening legislation regarding crimes committed during the ongoing asylum process. It emphasizes the need to maintain a strong legal system while upholding a humanitarian refugee policy, asserting that both can coexist harmoniously. The motion argues for the importance of ensuring that asylum seekers adhere to Swedish law from the moment of arrival, thus protecting both newcomers and existing citizens.

title: Elnätsutbyggnaden i Norrbotten och norra Västerbotten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3159 av Linda Modig och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates the conditions for reintroducing the 'fritidspeng', a financial support for children whose parents rely on long-term welfare assistance, to enable greater participation in cultural and sports activities. The motion highlights the negative effects of socioeconomic disparities on children's well-being and the need for state support to reduce barriers to access for these families.

title: Skattefri bärplockning
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should consider eliminating the taxation of employee parking benefits associated with their workplaces. The motion argues that recent changes in tax legislation have unfairly imposed this taxation on employees who receive free parking, especially impacting those who must commute by car due to inadequate public transport or work irregular hours in sectors like healthcare and emergency services. The motion advocates for abolishing this tax, particularly in areas where public parking is otherwise free.

title: Ersättning för rådighetsinskränkningar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should analyze new taxes before their implementation to ensure they fulfill their intended purpose and do not become mere symbolic measures or harmful to society. The author criticizes the current government's environmental taxes for lacking clarity in their benefits and for potentially harming Swedish industries and regional economies. The motion calls for a reassessment of the tax system to restore public trust.

title: Trafikverkets förslag till beredskapsflygplatser
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3156 av Linda Modig och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should urge the government to investigate the possibilities for a long-term plan aimed at reducing taxes. The authors argue that Sweden has one of the highest tax burdens in the world, while citizens feel they do not receive adequate value for their taxes. They highlight issues such as crime, healthcare deficiencies, and educational shortcomings, suggesting that a clearer prioritization of welfare, police, and defense could lead to tax reductions while also improving essential services. The motion advocates for a structured effort to implement a defined annual budget reduction to match OECD averages, thereby facilitating discussions on resource allocation.

title: Effektiviserad gruvprövning
summary: The motion proposes to increase transparency around the tax burden on employees by mandating that employers explicitly display employer contributions on paychecks. Additionally, it suggests considering a reform to convert employer contributions into a salary tax, thereby clarifying the total tax amount that employees are paying. This initiative is intended to address the general lack of awareness among citizens regarding their actual tax contributions, which the authors argue is essential for informed democratic engagement.

title: Insyn i barns läkemedelslista
summary: The proposal suggests limiting welfare benefits and financial support exclusively to Swedish citizens, arguing that current practices allow non-citizens to receive aid for unrelated purposes, such as vacations abroad or bringing family to Sweden. The motion calls for explicit legal regulations to ensure that such assistance is provided solely for direct living costs within Sweden.

title: Genomför en folkräkning i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes transferring the authority over new access permits from the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) to municipal building permit authorities. It argues that current bureaucratic hurdles hinder the construction of new housing, particularly small houses, as Trafikverket can block projects by denying access to public roads, limiting the municipalities' influence on development decisions.

title: Beslut om tjänstemannaansvar
summary: The proposal advocates for making the process of obtaining a driver's license simpler and cheaper. It highlights the increasing complexity and costs associated with licensing, driven by new mandatory requirements and political decisions, which could discourage young people from getting their licenses and hinder their job opportunities. The motion calls for a comprehensive review to eliminate unnecessary steps and fees while preventing the introduction of additional costs and requirements, all while maintaining traffic safety standards.

title: Privat övningskörning och olaglig körskoleverksamhet
summary: The proposal aims to facilitate the preservation of Sweden's movable cultural heritage, particularly concerning older vehicles and other forms of transport that are cherished by enthusiasts. It points out that current regulations and fees create significant hurdles for the restoration and maintenance of these vehicles, often leading owners to make damaging alterations. The motion calls for clearer regulations and reasonable exemptions in existing laws to support the conservation efforts of Sweden's movable cultural heritage.

title: Hälsofrämjande kultur och organiserad idrott för äldre
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of state funding for gender research, arguing that the research has shifted focus from promoting equality between men and women to promoting various gender identities based on social constructs. It suggests that gender studies should be integrated into mainstream research rather than existing in isolation, as this has created a lack of critical scrutiny and potentially hindered progress towards equality. The authors believe that state support for gender research promotes a specific ideological stance and that relevant gender issues should instead be examined within other academic disciplines.

title: Reglerna kring betalningsanmärkning
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the Children's and Students' Ombudsman in Sweden, citing a recent court ruling that affirmed a teacher's right to use reasonable force to maintain order in schools. The motion argues that the Ombudsman has prioritized the rights of disruptive students over maintaining a safe and orderly school environment, leading to a situation where teachers feel hindered in their responsibilities. It emphasizes the need for teachers to be able to act without fear of legal repercussions, suggesting that parental and institutional channels should be sufficient for addressing grievances.

title: Tillsättande av ny utredning om Estonias förlisning
summary: The proposal advocates for increased research into next-generation nuclear power in Sweden to ensure a reliable and environmentally friendly electricity supply. It highlights concerns about current electricity imports and the reliance on fossil fuels due to the shutdown of operational nuclear reactors. The motion urges the government to support the development of a test reactor and, eventually, a fully operational nuclear reactor to maintain Sweden's fossil-free electricity production.

title: Skolans sexualundervisning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament classify loud music played from vehicles in public spaces as disturbing noise and create legislation allowing for the confiscation of vehicles causing such noise. It addresses the increasing issue of vehicles with powerful sound systems causing disturbances in residential areas, particularly during evenings and nights, and argues that existing laws are insufficient for police to effectively manage the situation. The motion advocates for assigning responsibility to the vehicle's driver or owner and suggests penalties, including vehicle confiscation and license suspension, for violations of proposed noise limits.

title: Värna kontanterna
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of supervision costs for service sectors in rural areas and unmanned stores to ensure their viability against competition from larger shopping centers. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining local commerce in villages and suggests that the current oversight fees are disproportionately burdensome for small businesses compared to larger retailers.

title: Pornografins skadeverkningar
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of establishing and maintaining a reliable flight connection to and from Mora Airport, highlighting its significance for the local economy, tourism, and emergency preparedness. It argues that the airport is vital for attracting essential skills and facilitating work commuting, especially in tourism-heavy regions like Mora. The motion calls on the government to ensure the flight connection from Mora to Arlanda through a mandated service obligation, given the inadequacy of existing regulations that disadvantage Mora compared to other European regions.

title: Politik för ett stärkt civilsamhälle
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognizes the EU firearm pass, which allows individuals with firearm permits in one EU country to carry their weapons when traveling to another EU country without needing additional authorization. The lack of recognition by Sweden and Ireland hinders hunting tourism and international shooting competitions, causing economic drawbacks for rural areas and related businesses.

title: Utgiftsområde 17 Kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a 'declaration of interest' requirement for public employees in Sweden, aiming to address concerns over personal activism in public service that may lead to conflicts of interest. The motion draws on examples from other countries and emphasizes that such a declaration would enhance transparency, strengthen the rule of law, and increase public trust in governmental authorities.

title: Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
summary: This motion argues against the current parliamentary goals promoting organic farming, highlighting its lower yields compared to conventional methods and the implications for food security, climate, and environmental sustainability. The authors suggest that the government should align its policies with scientific research and market dynamics rather than mandating specific farming practices, advocating for a diverse approach to agriculture that responds to local conditions and challenges.

title: En hälso- och sjukvård att lita på
summary: The proposal seeks to strengthen the weakened private property rights in Sweden through a review and modification of the Environmental Code and the Species Protection Ordinance, citing concerns over increased restrictions on ownership due to political and administrative pressures. The motion emphasizes the importance of private property rights as foundational to democracy and argues that current legislation undermines this principle.

title: En ny uppdaterad nationell cancerstrategi
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3140 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: Saila Quicklund proposes a review of the governance structure for regional and specialist healthcare in Sweden, emphasizing the need for equitable healthcare access across the nation. She argues that the growing complexity and costs of modern medicine create disparities in healthcare quality, particularly affecting smaller regions with limited tax bases. Quicklund believes that the state should ensure equal healthcare services for all citizens, regardless of their location, and calls for an investigation into the current governance model to make necessary adjustments.

title: Stärk utsatta barns trygghet – behov av reformer där barnets bästa ska väga tyngst
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3139 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: Saila Quicklund proposes measures to improve postal service delivery in sparsely populated areas, highlighting recent changes by Postnord that have led to residents and businesses facing unacceptably long distances to retrieve their mail. The motion argues that while the Swedish Postal and Telecommunications Authority (PTS) has the authority to enforce regulations, it has opted for non-binding general advice, leaving citizens in remote areas with insufficient postal services. The proposal calls on the government to reassess the situation and enhance postal service accessibility in rural regions.

title: Trygg och säker försörjning och användning av läkemedel – jämlik och god tillgång till nya mer avancerade läkemedelsbehandlingar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3138 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament prioritize rural areas in the implementation of self-driving vehicles, recognizing the reliance of these regions on road transportation due to long distances. It criticizes the current government's approach to road maintenance and infrastructure, advocating for advancements in self-driving technology that could enhance accessibility to public transport and facilitate the use of autonomous trucks. The proposal aligns with the rural committee's position on the potential benefits for rural development.

title: Ett samlat omhändertagande av de mest sjuka och sköra
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3137 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: This motion proposes a review of the regulations governing special transport services (färdtjänst) for individuals with disabilities. It emphasizes the need for clearer guidelines in the law to define permissible types of travel and to ensure equitable access to transport services, particularly for those lacking access to public transportation or unable to drive due to their disabilities. The motion underscores that current ambiguities may lead to inconsistent interpretations by local authorities.

title: Trygg och tillgänglig hälso- och sjukvård och äldreomsorg – en nationell reformagenda under och efter covid-19-pandemin
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3136 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes changes to the calculation methods for infrastructure funds, emphasizing the need for greater consideration of various industries, particularly in Jämtland, rather than just population size. It highlights the significance of maintaining road quality to support local industries such as forestry, agriculture, and tourism, notably in ski resorts like Åre, where seasonal traffic demands reliability in transport. The motion calls for the government to factor these considerations into future infrastructure plans to enhance accessibility and competitiveness.

title: En nationell hälsofrämjande strategi – ett långsiktigt hälsosammare Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3135 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports initiatives to promote entrepreneurship education in elementary schools, encouraging collaboration with local businesses and community involvement. It emphasizes the need for entrepreneurial learning to be integrated into the entire school system from an early age, helping students develop an entrepreneurial mindset that benefits them in various career paths. The motion references successful models and previous studies that demonstrate the positive impacts of entrepreneurship education on employment and economic performance.

title: Riv hinder för digitalisering av hälso- och sjukvård
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3134 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion calls for an alignment of higher education to better meet the needs of local labor markets, particularly in rural areas. It emphasizes the importance of adapting education and training to ensure that institutions respond effectively to the demands for qualified labor, suggesting a review of funding indicators to enhance relevance to local job markets.

title: Stärk vårdens och omsorgens medarbetare
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3133 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider investigating the enhancement of student health services due to the increasing physical inactivity among children and youth, which poses risks such as obesity and mental health issues. The proposal emphasizes the need for daily physical activity in schools and calls for the inclusion of physiotherapists in the school health team to improve children's physical and mental well-being.

title: Stärk seniorers livskvalitet, frihet och valfrihet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3132 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of higher education centers in rural municipalities that currently lack access to universities and face workforce challenges. It emphasizes the importance of these centers in increasing educational opportunities for young people in rural areas, fostering the transition to post-secondary education, and supporting local businesses in finding the right workforce.
