title: En trygg diabetesvård – i hela Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3131 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews how nearby residents can be compensated for decreasing property values resulting from the establishment of wind farms. It highlights the expectation of significant wind power expansion and notes that even with sufficient distance from residential buildings, many people experience disturbances from wind turbines, leading to a reduction in property values. The motion references a similar compensation system in Denmark and suggests that Sweden should consider a state- or wind farm owner-funded compensation scheme for affected homeowners.

title: Hjärt-kärlsjukvården – patientens rätt till jämlik vård av hög kvalitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3130 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support a clearer mandate for county boards and regions to promote Swedish food craftsmanship, highlighting its significance to tourism and local businesses, particularly in rural areas. The motion underscores the importance of responsible food sourcing and high animal welfare standards, while advocating for Sweden to lead in establishing stringent regulations for animal husbandry within the EU framework.

title: Stärkt migränvård – patientens rätt till jämlik vård av hög kvalitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3129 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the powers of the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) over municipal planning activities, arguing that excessive and costly demands from Trafikverket hinder the development of new housing areas, particularly in urban and rural settings. It advocates for greater autonomy for municipalities in planning matters, allowing for more local decision-making and development tailored to community needs.

title: Investera i Sverige – Sverigedemokraternas förslag till statsbudget 2021
summary: Saila Quicklund's motion proposes to limit and better define the areas classified as national interests under the Environmental Code, arguing that the current extensive designation of approximately 46% hinders the opportunity for new housing and business development, especially in rural areas. Quicklund supports the view that the proposed extension of these national interests should not be implemented, advocating for clearer specifications to facilitate rural development.

title: Stoppad finansiering av genusteori inom högre utbildning
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the expropriation law to enhance the protection of private landowners in Sweden, ensuring fair compensation during expropriations. It highlights the need for a revised compensation structure, particularly in areas with housing shortages, where the current system (market value plus 25%) may not suffice for displaced residents to find suitable replacement housing. The motion advocates for a general rule that addresses increased housing costs due to expropriation, in line with recommendations from a previous memorandum by the Ministry of Justice.

title: Krafttag mot psykisk ohälsa bland unga
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support efforts to reduce processing times at the Lantmäteriet, which currently take almost a year for property division, significantly hindering new construction amidst a housing shortage. The proposal suggests that the government should explore introducing competition and additional service providers in the field to improve efficiency and recommends that processing times be legislated to align with the 10-week timeframe for municipal approvals under current planning and building regulations.

title: Åtgärd mot falsk folkbokföring
summary: This motion advocates for a review and modernization of Sweden's property formation law to enhance opportunities for building and residing throughout the country. It emphasizes the need for legislation that reflects contemporary societal requirements and facilitates easier property formation. The motion highlights that existing regulations, which have not significantly changed in nearly fifty years, hinder development and countryside growth, and proposes an inquiry to explore potential reforms.

title: Flerbarnsavdrag i stället för flerbarnstillägg
summary: The motion proposes measures to strengthen the Swedish tourism and hospitality sector, emphasizing its importance for the economy and employment, particularly for youth and immigrants. It highlights the sector's growth and potential, especially in rural areas, and calls for regulatory simplifications and financial support to promote growth and sustainability within small and medium-sized enterprises in the tourism industry.

title: Nationellt mål om återvandringsnetto och återvandringsmyndighet
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to reduce regulatory burdens associated with housing construction in order to increase building rates. It argues that a more effective housing policy should align with individual needs, facilitating movement for jobs, family, or education, which in turn could alleviate unemployment. The motion advocates for streamlining laws and regulations surrounding housing, including reassessing national interests, relaxing noise regulations, and allowing the repeal of nature reserves to enable more construction.

title: Folkhögskola som utbildningsform
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the investigation into the possibility of upgrading the Inlandsbanan railway line to improve conditions for businesses and job creation in inland Norrland. It highlights the current poor state of infrastructure, particularly in northern Sweden, and asserts that restoring the railway is vital for sustainable transportation, regional development, and the overall economy, especially for industries dependent on this transport route.

title: Översyn av studieförbundens verksamhet
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity for state authorities to enhance coordination in addressing the needs of rural areas in Sweden. It suggests the establishment of clearer regulations for rural policy and proposes that the Swedish Board of Agriculture take on a coordinating role to ensure the achievement of national rural policy goals. The motion advocates for the government to recognize and implement these recommendations.

title: Utgiftsområde 17 Kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid
summary: The motion proposes to reform Sweden's noise regulations to facilitate housing development near noise sources like airports and motor tracks by adjusting sound level limits and focusing on equivalent noise levels rather than peak levels. It advocates for the introduction of noise declarations, the delegation of regulations to the National Board of Housing, and the exploration of new noise measurement methods, aiming to balance housing needs with modern construction techniques that can mitigate noise issues.

title: Utgiftsområde 19 Regional utveckling
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review how revenues from hydropower production can be allocated to the municipalities and regions where this production takes place. It emphasizes the importance of hydropower in Sweden's energy system, its environmental benefits, and the need for compensation to communities affected by hydropower infrastructure. The suggestion draws a comparison with Norway's system of returning a significant portion of hydropower revenues to producing municipalities, advocating for a similar approach in Sweden to support rural areas that host these energy facilities.

title: Utgiftsområde 21 Energi
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3118 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes strengthening the weakened Swedish property rights by issuing clearer directives in government regulations to ensure that authorities prioritize property protection. It argues that property rights are fundamental to democracy and that current political and public administration pressures threaten these rights. The proposal calls for permanent and explicit requirements in regulatory documents for authorities to respect property rights in their operations.

title: Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider allowing property tax revenue from wind power facilities to benefit the municipalities where they are located. This proposal aims to support the expansion of wind energy in Sweden, ensuring that local communities receive a share of the value generated by wind power, thus fostering sustainable development and local acceptance of wind energy projects.

title: Utgiftsområde 25 Allmänna bidrag till kommuner
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should review the possibility of including Svenskt Friluftsliv under the social contributions law's half basic amount rule, which currently benefits some sports organizations. The motion argues that friluftsliv organizations, unlike many sports organizations, face uncertainty regarding their tax and fee treatment, thus advocating for a more equitable status.

title: Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The motion by Désirée Pethrus advocates for Sweden to take active measures within the EU to ensure that member states adhere to the Agenda 2030 goals, particularly by committing at least 0.7% of their GNI to aid. It emphasizes the importance of prioritizing civil society, human rights, gender equality, and reproductive health rights in EU's budget negotiations, while also calling for enhanced efforts against corruption in aid distribution. The motion underlines the necessity for improved transparency in EU aid efforts and a robust adherence to OECD-DAC criteria.

title: Utgiftsområde 2 Samhällsekonomi och finansförvaltning
summary: The motion presented by Désirée Pethrus advocates for the Swedish government to strengthen its support for sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) within its aid budget. It emphasizes the need for a follow-up mechanism for SRHR financing, enhancing efforts against child marriage globally, promoting gender equality in EU development work, and addressing the treatment of Uighurs and other minorities in China. The proposal stresses the importance of prioritizing SRHR efforts in humanitarian aid and addressing the negative impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on these issues.

title: Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen savings and investment rights in Sweden by reducing taxes on investment accounts and capital insurance, restoring a system for private pension savings, improving transparency in the corporate bond market, and fostering better liquidity conditions in financial markets. It highlights the importance of favorable tax regulations to encourage personal savings, address the challenges faced due to high transfer fees in the insurance market, and calls for legislative reforms to facilitate investments in a competitive economy.

title: Utgiftsområde 6 Försvar och samhällets krisberedskap
summary: The proposal aims to ease the requirements for service pension funds to obtain permits to operate as pension companies. It allows such funds to be granted permits even if they do not currently meet the capital base requirement, provided that they can be expected to comply with the risk-sensitive capital requirement after taking necessary measures. This change is intended to prevent financially viable pension funds from being denied the ability to operate due to temporary challenges posed by the current market situation.

title: Utgiftsområde 8 Migration
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3110 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes active efforts to combat foreign organized crime groups responsible for a significant increase in thefts and burglaries in Sweden. It highlights statistics showing that nearly half of all burglaries are perpetrated by these groups and argues for reforms aimed at reducing Sweden's appeal as a low-risk environment for criminals. Suggested measures include increasing police training, removing volume discounts for minor offenses, and reviewing customs authority powers.

title: Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
summary: The motion proposes to review and potentially increase the penalties for drug trafficking in Sweden, highlighting the ongoing destruction caused by drugs despite existing restrictive drug policies. It advocates for broader informational campaigns on the negative effects of drugs and continued support for those struggling with addiction, emphasizing the need for law enforcement to reduce drug availability through stricter punishments for sellers.

title: Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to review organizational and methodological improvements within the Swedish Police Authority to combat illegal commercial traffic. It highlights the need for fair competition in the transport industry, noting that illegal practices, particularly concerning cabotage and drivers' working hours, are prevalent. The motion suggests that Sweden could benefit from studying Germany's approach, where a dedicated agency has been established to tackle illegal commercial traffic more effectively.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a national ban on begging in Sweden, arguing that relying on begging by vulnerable EU citizens, primarily from Romania and Bulgaria, is unsustainable and does not alleviate poverty. It emphasizes the responsibility of these individuals' home countries to address issues of discrimination, poverty, and misery rather than allowing such practices to continue in Sweden, ultimately undermining trust in the EU.

title: Utgiftsområde 11 Ekonomisk trygghet vid ålderdom
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports a review of the possibilities to reinforce police presence in Norrland, particularly in the inland areas where citizens often face delayed police response during emergencies. The motion emphasizes that the police, holding a monopoly on violence, are expected to protect citizens, and this expectation is not met in many rural areas due to significant distances and low population density.

title: Utgiftsområde 12 Ekonomisk trygghet för familjer och barn
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the rolling property assessment system, arguing that its original purposes are no longer relevant due to the removal of the wealth tax and the introduction of municipal property taxation. It suggests that current assessment values could remain unchanged for future property tax calculations, and that a standardized value for new constructions should be established based on production costs or localized market values. The motion emphasizes that the existing system creates unnecessary burdens for property owners and tax authorities, hence it merits reconsideration.

title: Höjd kunskapsnivå kring äldres nutrition och hälsa
summary: The motion proposes increased documentation requirements for municipalities when rejecting individual septic systems, arguing that current practices leave property owners vulnerable, as municipalities can deny systems solely based on age without a functional assessment. The motion suggests that the burden of proof should lie with the municipalities to justify any rejection of septic systems.

title: Familjerätt
summary: Jan Ericson's motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should request the government to initiate a review of how various EU regulations are implemented by Swedish authorities. The motion argues that Sweden, known for its loyalty to EU directives, may be overly strict in its application of these regulations compared to other EU countries, which could harm domestic competition and create unnecessary complications for citizens and businesses.

title: Reformer för ett ökat byggande och en bättre fungerande bostadsmarknad
summary: The suggestion proposes the abolishment of the hotel permit requirement established in 1966, which mandates that those wanting to operate a hotel or guesthouse with a minimum capacity must apply for a permit from the police. The motion argues that this requirement is an unnecessary cost and bureaucratic burden, as there are already multiple regulations in place concerning safety, health, and environmental standards for hospitality businesses.

title: Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the laws regarding incitement against ethnic groups in Sweden's penal code and constitutional laws. It highlights the need to balance the protection against racism and attacks on minority groups with the allowance for factual discussion on topics such as religions. The proposal argues that current legislation is vague regarding the acceptable limits of speech, particularly in the context of social media and public discourse, and suggests that an update is necessary to reflect contemporary societal norms and legal practices.

title: Associationsrätt
summary: The motion proposes the dismantling of the Gender Equality Agency, arguing that it was established without thorough analysis of its necessity and suggesting that prioritizing government efficiency requires reducing the number of authorities.

title: Konsumentpolitik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of raising or abolishing the income limit ('fribeloppet') for students receiving financial aid. The author argues that despite previous increases, further action is necessary to fully eliminate this limit, as it encourages students to work while studying and empowers them to earn money without impacting their aid. The suggestion aims to promote a work ethic among students and to simplify the rules governing student loans.

title: Sörmland som pilotlän för arbete för minskad arbetslöshet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3098 av Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion advocates for the protection and continued investment in Umeå University as a vital knowledge center in Västerbotten, highlighting the importance of such investments for the long-term growth and competitiveness of the region, especially in light of budgetary pressures and potential cuts to funding for higher education.

title: Översyn av ansvar för krisberedskap
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3097 av Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage och Lotta Finstorp (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider increasing the fines for individuals who cannot present a valid driver's license while driving, in response to recent cases where drivers claimed to have lost foreign licenses and were acquitted. The motion emphasizes the need for a robust legal system that provides adequate penalties for serious offenses that endanger the public, such as driving without a license.

title: Ersättning till brottsoffer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews the possibility of increasing the maximum allowed speed for tow trucks from the current limit of 40 kilometers per hour to 80 kilometers per hour. The argument highlights that slow towing can create traffic hazards, especially when towing occurs on faster roads, and notes that several other countries have higher speed limits for tow trucks.

title: Inför biometrisk identifiering vid utfärdande av personnummer/samordningsnummer
summary: The motion proposes to increase penalties for speeding in the vicinity of roadwork sites to enhance safety for workers who are often unprotected from reckless drivers. It emphasizes the need for motorists to be considerate of those working on the roads and points to examples from other countries that impose double fines for such violations. This measure aligns with the zero vision initiative aimed at reducing fatal and severe traffic accidents.

title: Delad pensionsavsättning under föräldraledighet
summary: The motion proposes an examination of the possibility to increase penalties for speeding in proximity to emergency personnel, emphasizing the need for drivers to show respect for the safety of those working at accident sites. It highlights practices in other countries that impose doubled fines in such situations, aligning with Sweden's vision to reduce traffic fatalities and severe accidents.

title: Säkrad trafiksäkerhet på väg 55
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3093 av Lotta Finstorp m.fl. (M, C, KD)
summary: The motion advocates for increasing the number of organ donations in Sweden by urging the government to reassess existing legislation or consider new laws to facilitate more organ transplants. The proposal emphasizes the high willingness of the population to donate organs, yet highlights that this does not reflect in the low number of actual donations, indicating a need for better alignment between intention and action.

title: Nationella prov för särskolan
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support a review of the controls surrounding assistance compensation, highlighting concerns about criminal exploitation of the system intended for individuals with severe disabilities. It emphasizes the necessity of maintaining the integrity of the compensation system, which costs over 30 billion kronor annually, and advocates for rigorous checks to prevent fraud while ensuring that legitimate recipients continue to receive the support they need.

title: Obligatorisk undervisning i privatekonomi
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national thyroid strategy in Sweden to address the significant number of individuals diagnosed with thyroid disorders. It highlights the existing gaps in healthcare knowledge regarding these conditions, leading to delayed diagnoses and inadequate treatment. The aim is to improve diagnosis, care, and treatment through increased research, better training for healthcare professionals, and updated national guidelines, ultimately enhancing the quality of life for those affected.

title: Uppdragsutbildningar i bristyrken
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3090 av Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage och Lotta Finstorp (båda M)
summary: The motion advocates for the legalization of farm sales of alcoholic beverages in Sweden, emphasizing the growing production of beer, wine, and cider by local producers who often contribute to tourism. It argues that the current restrictive alcohol policies hinder these businesses by limiting their ability to sell directly to customers and favoring Systembolaget's purchasing policies. The proposal suggests that it is possible to combine an alcohol monopoly with farm sales, as demonstrated in Finland, and urges the government to initiate legislation that enables limited farm sales while respecting the monopoly. The motion highlights the importance of supporting new industries in rural areas to foster growth and employment.

title: Punktskrift – en rättighet i skollagen för synskadade
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3089 av Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage och Lotta Finstorp (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a national strategy to prevent future infectious diseases, emphasizing the increasing issue of antibiotic resistance and the need for proactive measures in healthcare facilities. It highlights the importance of modernizing hospitals and enhancing hygiene practices to address the looming medical challenge posed by resistant bacteria and viruses.

title: Språktest för arbete i skola och omsorg
summary: The motion advocates for the promotion of preventive cancer screening in order to enhance early detection and improve survival rates for cancer patients. It emphasizes that identifying cancer at an early stage, before symptoms appear, leads to better patient prognoses and can reduce treatment costs for society. The motion calls on the government to support initiatives aimed at increasing the use of cancer screening technologies.

title: Totalförsvarets skyddscentrum i Umeå
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to maintain flexibility in its security policy and consider potential NATO membership, especially in light of increasingly aggressive actions from Russia. It criticizes the current government's stance against NATO membership and suggests that having options for strengthening Sweden's defense capabilities is crucial given the current geopolitical tensions.

title: Myndigheternas informationssäkerhet
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations surrounding allowances for soldiers, taking into account the unique conditions they face during international missions. It highlights that current Swedish regulations are not suitable for soldiers deployed abroad, particularly regarding deductions from daily allowances for meals provided in the field, which do not reflect the quality of food available. The motion argues that improving these conditions is essential to encourage more individuals to undertake overseas military service.

title: Nationell strategi mot nätmobbning
summary: The motion advocates for stopping the implementation of a kilometers tax, arguing that it would harm the competitiveness of the industrial sector, particularly in Northern Sweden. The proponent, Edward Riedl, contends that such a tax would lead to job losses and negatively impact essential industries by increasing costs related to transportation, which is vital in a sparsely populated country. He suggests that measures to reduce emissions should focus on environmental improvements rather than penalizing transport in areas with long distances and proposes a review of lowering the tax burden on transportation.

title: Avskaffa möjligheten att sälja lotter på kredit
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers revising the tax regulations for babysitting services, aimed at easing the burden on families and enabling easier access to childcare solutions. The current tax reporting requirements for payments to private individuals for babysitting services are seen as overly stringent, particularly the threshold of 1,000 kronor and the higher reporting obligations for payments exceeding 10,000 kronor per year. The motion suggests that these thresholds have not been updated in years and that reforming them would benefit both families and young people seeking work in informal babysitting roles.

title: Minska centraliseringen av journalister
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing a tax deduction for individuals purchasing gym memberships and other related expenses for exercise, competition, and physical activity. The motion argues that increased physical activity leads to improved public health, which in turn reduces the need for medical care and related costs, thereby benefiting the overall economy and public finances.

title: Översyn av oskäliga påföljder i diskrimineringslagstiftningen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3082 av Jan Ericson och Lars Beckman (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the permanent removal of the over-indexation of taxes on gasoline and diesel, arguing that it leads to unreasonably high fuel prices, particularly affecting individuals in rural areas who rely on cars due to a lack of alternatives.

title: Översyn av statens stöd till organisationer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the possibility of introducing a RUT tax deduction for taxi fares to make taxi services more affordable and accessible for everyday use. The suggestion argues that a lower cost for taxi rides could reduce the necessity for personal car ownership, thereby creating more space in urban areas and potentially leading to job growth within the taxi industry.

title: Begränsa möjligheten till undantag för lottförsäljning på kredit
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3080 av Jan Ericson och Lars Beckman (båda M)
summary: The motion proposed by Edward Riedl calls for the abolition of the national flight tax implemented by the previous government, arguing that it negatively impacts jobs and employment in Sweden's aviation and tourism sectors. The motion posits that the flight tax is an ineffective means of reducing carbon emissions, suggesting that it leads to increased use of cars instead of promoting eco-friendly alternatives. Riedl highlights the negative experiences of other European countries that have tried similar taxes and emphasizes the importance of making air travel more accessible while also focusing on sustainable aviation fuels and technological solutions for emission reductions.

title: Vårdnadsbidraget
summary: The motion proposes to promote tourism in Sweden as it has become one of the fastest-growing sectors in the labor market. It highlights the importance of marketing Sweden as a tourist destination and emphasizes the need for a favorable business climate to support young entrepreneurs in the tourism industry. The motion calls for the government to take active measures to enhance tourism promotion and simplify regulations for starting and running small businesses.

title: Harmonisering av karenstid för sjukpenning oavsett om man betalar egenavgift eller har en anställning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3078 av Mattias Karlsson i Luleå (M)
summary: The proposal by Edward Riedl advocates for a review of the regulations affecting small businesses in Sweden, emphasizing the need to simplify the bureaucracy and reduce employer contributions to encourage job creation and economic growth, particularly in rural areas. It highlights the vital role that small enterprises play in the economy and calls for governmental recognition and support for their needs.

title: Behandling för patienter med Skelleftesjukan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3077 av Mattias Karlsson i Luleå (M)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider introducing an export support program for the domestic small boat industry, similar to programs in other countries. This initiative aims to enhance the competitiveness of Swedish manufacturers in the international market, as they are facing increasing competition and declining exports, which threatens jobs in rural areas where these companies are predominantly located.

title: Motarbeta osunda kroppsideal
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to strengthen property rights for landowners, particularly in relation to forestry. It argues that recent governmental decisions have restricted landowners' rights to utilize their land, leading to economic harm without appropriate compensation. The proposal calls for general reinforcement of property rights and demands that any state interventions must be proportional and reasonably compensated to avoid financial loss for landowners.

title: Legitimation och spelregistrering vid landets minsta travbanor
summary: The motion proposes that all publicly driven operations in Sweden should conduct food procurement based on the minimum requirements of Swedish law, rather than primarily focusing on the lowest possible price. This approach aims to support and promote the Swedish agricultural sector by ensuring fair conditions that foster development and growth.

title: Idrottsföreningar och barnrättsperspektivet
summary: The motion proposes a review of Sweden's right of public access (allemansrätten) to enhance trust in this right, particularly concerning its implications for commercial activities on private land. It argues that while the right is important for individuals enjoying nature and activities like berry and mushroom picking, it should not permit commercial enterprises to operate on private property without the owner's consent, as this undermines property rights.

title: En fristående antidopningsenhet
summary: The motion proposes to reform the building regulations concerning the shore protection area in Sweden, advocating for simplified rules to better accommodate construction needs in rural areas. It suggests that current regulations are overly complicated and hinder development, particularly because they apply broadly to even small waterways. The motion emphasizes the need for a more reasonable approach to shore protection laws to facilitate construction while still protecting natural resources.

title: Hälsofarliga substanser i kosttillskott
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the position of the Granskningsnämnden, the regulatory body for public service broadcasting, by enhancing its powers to ensure compliance with impartiality and content regulations. Currently, the Granskningsnämnden can only review individual segments without having broader regulatory authority or sanctions, which limits its effectiveness. The proposal suggests considering sanctioning powers to improve the legitimacy and public trust in public service operations.

title: Idrott för nyanlända
summary: The motion proposes a review of the administrative requirements for businesses, advocating for a system where information submitted to the government is used collectively across agencies to eliminate redundant reporting. The aim is to reduce the administrative burden on businesses, allowing them to focus on growth and job creation rather than excessive documentation, thereby enhancing Sweden's competitiveness in the global market.

title: Krav vid förnyelse av körkort
summary: The motion advocates for the modernization of Swedish government agencies by replacing outdated methods, specifically the use of fax machines, with digital solutions. It highlights the need for digitalization to improve efficiency and security in governmental procedures, particularly in processes related to social services. The motion calls for the establishment of requirements for digital identification to streamline interactions within government systems.

title: Fler brottsbekämpande byråkrater
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a regulatory framework to support regional and international airports in Sweden, emphasizing their importance for a robust infrastructure system. It highlights the role of Stockholm-Skavsta Airport as a significant hub for both passenger traffic and regional economic growth, as well as its strategic importance for critical air services. The motion argues that the recent crisis has severely impacted the aviation industry, prompting the need for targeted support to ensure the sustainability and development of these airports.

title: Yttre portar för att skydda Göteborg mot översvämningar och höjda havsnivåer
summary: The motion proposes enhancing infrastructure for transportation within the Stockholm-Mälardalen region to support its growing population and economic output. It outlines the expected population increase, job growth, and rising goods transport that necessitates improved infrastructure to alleviate congestion and ensure sustainable growth. Specific investments in railway maintenance and construction, as well as improvements to major roadways, are emphasized as crucial for supporting regional and national transport needs, thereby bolstering Sweden's economic competitiveness.

title: Falska miljöpåståenden i reklam
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the implementation of fines for railway operators who do not utilize granted track slots, in order to optimize rail infrastructure usage. It highlights the current capacity issues in Sweden's railway system, where granted track slots are not fully used, creating gaps that hinder access for other operators. The suggested fines aim to discourage unnecessary applications for track slots and ensure that only those intending to utilize the slots apply, ultimately improving capacity utilization and enhancing rail transport efficiency.

title: Kortare arbetstid
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3066 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: This motion proposes a review of the social services legislation in Sweden aimed at facilitating the placement of youths in institutional care to combat crime. It emphasizes the need for municipalities to have the ability to apply for placements in specialized institutions when all voluntary measures have failed, particularly in cases where youths are at risk of engaging in criminal behavior due to negative influences and poor decision-making. The motion argues that the current legislation is inadequate for addressing the rising numbers of youths being drawn into criminal activities and highlights the importance of professional care and isolation from harmful social environments.

title: Sänk kostnaden för mensskydd
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3065 av Rebecka Le Moine och Annika Hirvonen Falk (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the plastic bag tax, arguing that it has not effectively reduced plastic consumption but rather increased the use of paper bags and plastic bags on rolls for waste disposal. The proponent suggests that the tax has not achieved its intended environmental benefits and that efforts should instead focus on reducing plastic packaging in general and promoting environmentally friendly materials. The motion advocates for a shift towards using recycled or renewable materials while identifying more effective strategies for reducing plastic use.

title: Förbud av troféjakt
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish parliament to investigate the possibility of transferring the financial responsibility for the LSS (Act concerning Support and Service for Persons with Certain Functional Impairments) from municipalities to the state, addressing significant disparities in assistance assessments and costs across different regions. The motion emphasizes the importance of LSS for ensuring equal opportunities for individuals with disabilities in leading independent and fulfilling lives, and suggests that a state-level financial oversight would enhance consistency and accessibility of support services.

title: HNJ-banan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3063 av Emma Hult och Elisabeth Falkhaven (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the implementation of assisted suicide for terminally ill patients and those in the final stages of life. It emphasizes the importance of individual self-determination and the right to choose how to end one's life, particularly under circumstances of unbearable suffering. The motion argues that Sweden should provide an option for assisted death domestically, rather than forcing citizens to seek this option abroad, thereby upholding dignity and responsibility in personal life choices.

title: Testamenten och digital signering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament empower municipalities to hire their own doctors in order to enhance the care provided to the elderly. The author argues that as more elderly individuals are living longer and healthier lives at home, there is a need for improved medical contact and continuity of care within local elderly care teams. This would enable earlier interventions and contribute to better overall service for the aging population.

title: Stärk konsumentskyddet för köpare av nyproducerade bostadsrätter
summary: The motion calls for the establishment of an evidence-based strategy for suicide prevention in each region of Sweden and for conducting investigations when children or young individuals attempt or commit suicide. The proposal emphasizes the need for society to take greater responsibility for suicide prevention, particularly by employing school counselors who can provide relevant support and training for staff to identify warning signs and intervene appropriately. The motion highlights the significant societal costs of suicide and the urgent need for a coordinated response to address this pressing issue.

title: Skydda Vätterns vatten
summary: The motion proposes to transfer school health care responsibilities to regional authorities in order to provide more cohesive care for students. It argues that the current division between municipalities and regions disrupts continuity and quality of care, leading to potential gaps in services for children and youth. The proposal highlights the importance of consistent health care and the need for individualized support, advocating for students to be able to seek care from the same health care provider throughout their schooling.

title: Ökat träbyggande
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3059 av Emma Hult och Mats Berglund (båda MP)
summary: The motion advocates for an investigation into the possibility of offering greater access to guide dogs for visually impaired individuals in Sweden, aiming to enhance their freedom and integration into society. It highlights the significant discrepancy in the availability of trained guide dogs in Sweden compared to other Nordic countries, emphasizing the need for an increase in the current number of guide dog teams to better support the visually impaired community.

title: Förlängning av livet på prylarna och planeten
summary: This motion advocates for the construction of a new power line from Hedenlunda to Oxelösund to support SSAB’s transition to fossil-free steel production utilizing hydrogen instead of coke. The motion highlights the significant environmental benefits of the HYBRIT technology, which is expected to reduce carbon dioxide emissions in Sweden and Finland substantially. The urgency of building this power line is emphasized to prevent negative impacts on SSAB's operations and job security in the region.

title: Barnfamiljer med osäkra boendeförhållanden
summary: The motion calls for a review of existing regulations to address the increasing issue of loud music from vehicles, which disturbs residents' sleep and creates frustration within communities. It highlights that current laws are insufficient for law enforcement to issue fines to drivers playing excessively loud music, and suggests that clearer accountability measures are needed in traffic regulations. The motion stresses the importance of maintaining public order and protecting the well-being of citizens who work hard, particularly during nighttime hours.

title: Avgiftsfri utbildning för alla
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations governing blood donations in Sweden, advocating for a modern approach that allows individuals to donate blood regardless of their sexual orientation. Currently, homosexual men are prohibited from donating blood, which is deemed discriminatory given that heterosexual men can donate without similar restrictions, regardless of their sexual risk behaviors. The motion emphasizes the importance of addressing blood shortages and ensuring the blood supply is secured by updating the outdated regulations based on scientific facts and advancements in blood testing.

title: En socialt, ekonomiskt och ekologiskt hållbar bostadspolitik
summary: The motion proposes a reduction in the stamp duty for property registration and mortgage deeds, arguing that the current high taxes are unreasonable and do not reflect the reduced workload due to the digitalization of the process. The author suggests that the system should be changed from a percentage-based stamp duty to a fixed fee that aligns more closely with the actual costs incurred by authorities or, alternatively, that the stamp duty rates be significantly lowered.

title: Elevers fristående organisering
summary: The motion proposes to review the possibility of limiting child allowances in Sweden, arguing that while the allowance is beneficial for many families, it provides disproportionately high amounts to families with many children. The suggestion emphasizes that having multiple children is a voluntary choice and that families should be responsible for their own financial capacity to support them.

title: Elevers studiemiljö
summary: The motion proposes that temporary residence permits granted on asylum grounds should be revoked if the individual travels back to their home country for vacations or to visit relatives. The authors argue that such travel undermines the justification for the permit and should lead to its immediate cancellation by authorities.

title: Undervisning i sexualitet, samtycke och relationer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3052 av Annika Hirvonen Falk och Janine Alm Ericson (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should support the idea of making pandemic-related regulatory simplifications for businesses permanent. It suggests that the swift regulatory adjustments during the pandemic demonstrated the ability of government and local authorities to ease bureaucracy effectively. The motion advocates for a structured review of these measures to determine which can be sustained post-pandemic in order to support local businesses and employment, while avoiding unnecessary return to bureaucratic norms.

title: En mer effektiv minoritetspolitik
summary: The motion advocates for increased legal security in decisions regarding animal bans, highlighting concerns about the current application of animal protection laws, overzealous inspectors, and unclear legal frameworks. It emphasizes that animal bans significantly impact people's lives both emotionally and financially, and that the current appeal process is inadequate as bans are often enacted immediately, leaving no chance for rectification if later overturned by a court. The proposal calls for legislation to ensure that animal bans are not enforced until confirmed by a court decision.

title: En jämlik utbildning för alla
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government review the regulations governing authorities to ensure they focus solely on their mandated duties and refrain from engaging in political opinions formation. It emphasizes that while authorities can share information about their activities and existing regulations, active promotion of specific opinions or political positions undermines public trust in their impartiality.

title: Bättre och mer träffsäkra trafikprognoser och samhällsekonomiska beräkningar
summary: The motion advocates for the review of the over-implementation of EU legislation within Swedish law, highlighting concerns from a recent survey that reveals a significant proportion of businesses find governmental regulations increasingly complex. The proposer suggests establishing a principle that national regulations should not exceed the minimum requirements set by EU directives, to streamline compliance and reduce unnecessary burdens on businesses.

title: En mer miljövänlig sjöfart
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3048 av Emma Berginger och Janine Alm Ericson (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should support improved oversight of public service media (SVT, SR, and UR) and communicate this to the government. It emphasizes the need for a media ethics system and the importance of impartiality and accuracy in public service due to its funding through taxes. The initiative highlights a decline in public trust and calls for strengthening the current oversight body, which lacks effective sanctioning authority, to enhance the legitimacy of public service funding and improve trust in media impartiality.

title: Avidentifierade jobbansökningar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the protection of freedom of expression on social media platforms and communicate this to the government. It emphasizes the importance of safeguarding individual rights against arbitrary account suspensions and the potential for political bias in moderating content. The motion calls for social media companies to establish clear contact points for users who feel wrongfully blocked or suspended, ensuring accountability and a fair process for users to contest such decisions.

title: Meritpoäng i urfolksspråken och de nationella minoritetsspråken
summary: The motion advocates for securing the electricity supply to Gotland, addressing persistent power outages that have adversely affected both local residents and industries. The proposal highlights concerns regarding the reliability of the current electrical infrastructure and calls for the government to take action to enhance the robustness of the electricity network, including the potential construction of an additional power line to mitigate vulnerabilities. The motion emphasizes that investment in a more secure power supply is crucial for maintaining the island's attractiveness for both residents and businesses.

title: Osund konkurrens från det offentliga
summary: The motion proposes to improve the availability of qualified community building education in the Stockholm-Mälardalen region to address the growing workforce shortages in the infrastructure sector. It emphasizes the need for more education opportunities to meet the demand created by regional development, including infrastructure projects and housing construction. The motion stresses the importance of regional access to education to ensure a skilled labor force capable of supporting future growth in the region.

title: Obligatorisk kameraövervakning på slakterier
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3044 av Annicka Engblom och Ulrika Heindorff (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes investigating the possibility of creating validation education programs for shortage professions to ensure quality skills in the workforce in response to Sweden's demographic changes and increasing population. It highlights the need for improved qualifications for workers in fields like healthcare and education, many of whom lack formal recognition of their experience or credentials. The initiative aims to capitalize on existing competencies, increase employability, and enhance the quality of Swedish welfare services.

title: Veterandagen som allmän helgdag
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of developing digital national tests that enable efficient and secure grading. It emphasizes the importance of having a uniform national assessment tool to gather knowledge results among students, which can help identify trends both nationally and within individual classes. The current testing process is time-consuming for teachers, and the motion advocates for modernizing the system to ease this burden while maintaining the integrity of the assessment process.

title: Krigsplacera även kulturarbetare
summary: The motion proposes investigating the possibility of implementing a suitability test for prospective teacher education candidates, emphasizing the need for skilled teachers as essential for preparing students for adulthood. It argues that teaching success requires more than academic proficiency; it involves the ability to engage and motivate students effectively. A suitability test would assess applicants' motivation for the teaching profession, their communication skills, and leadership potential, thereby enhancing the quality of teacher training in Sweden.

title: Ett nationellt center inom dykeri, undervattensteknik och medicin
summary: The motion proposes to unlink student financial aid (studiemedel) from earned income, suggesting it should instead be based solely on completed academic credits. This change aims to encourage students to work while studying, as the current system discourages earning extra income by penalizing students who exceed the set income threshold, potentially harming their motivation and career prospects.

title: Svenskt medlemskap i Nato
summary: The proposal calls for an investigation into the possibility of increasing the minimum number of school days in Sweden by five days per academic year in order to enhance students' knowledge and competencies. The motion highlights the issue of many students leaving primary school without the qualifications necessary for further studies and argues that increasing the number of school days would provide more teaching hours, reducing stress for both students and teachers, and ultimately helping students achieve basic educational goals.

title: Införlivande av säl och skarv i viltförvaltningen
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of reforming teacher education in Sweden to emphasize early practical experience. It argues that many prospective teachers currently leave their training programs or the profession altogether, which poses a risk to the education system and the availability of skilled teachers. The suggested changes aim to increase the effectiveness of teacher training by integrating practical components earlier in the curriculum, thus preparing future educators more adequately for the realities of the teaching profession.

title: Nationella utbildningskrav för brandmän och deltidsbrandmän
summary: This motion emphasizes the need to secure and enhance Sweden's electrical infrastructure to facilitate the transition to a more sustainable society, highlighting the challenges faced by an industry-heavy and export-dependent economy. It stresses that significant reforms are required to meet the rising electricity demands in Södermanland due to the ongoing industrial changes and increased digitalization, and calls for long-term sustainable regulations and improved infrastructure in collaboration with local stakeholders.

title: Villkorsskillnader inom camping- och gästhamnsnäringen
summary: The motion proposes to designate Södermanland as a pilot region to develop new routines, collaborations, and schedules to enable more individuals to obtain driver's licenses. It highlights the importance of having a driver's license for employment, especially in rural areas where public transport options are limited. The motion calls for an assessment of the current system, which has been strained by the pandemic, and suggests implementing measures such as increasing available testing slots, enhancing flexibility around exam schedules, and extending the validity period of theory tests.

title: Underlätta för rekrytering av personal till räddningsvärnen
summary: The motion proposes a review of infrastructure planning to establish long-term and predictable railway schedules that enhance the resilience of the transportation system. It emphasizes the need for efficient train connections to support commuting from rural areas to urban centers, thereby encouraging more balanced population distribution and promoting accessibility to jobs and education. The motion highlights the current instability in scheduling, which deters relocation and impacts individuals' ability to manage work and family responsibilities.

title: Behåll Bromma flygplats
summary: This motion calls for a review of the prioritization criteria for train track allocations to facilitate commuting for studies and work, particularly in and around major urban areas in Sweden. The proposal emphasizes the need for infrastructure that allows for efficient commuting, thereby addressing housing shortages in cities while promoting climate-friendly travel. The motion argues that current regulations unfairly favor long-distance business travel over commuter needs, suggesting a change to support daily commuting as a priority, which benefits both individuals and the environment.

title: Utvärdera systemet med personalliggare
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for the Swedish Parliament to establish guidelines for systematic checks on assistance payments in order to prevent fraud. It argues that economic crime undermines the welfare system, highlighting concerns over significant fraudulent activities within the assistance payments that could detract from necessary funding for public services. The proposal calls for collaboration among authorities and the implementation of a digital system with built-in controls to mitigate fraud risks, while also ensuring that measures are in place to discourage individuals from engaging in criminal behavior.

title: Karl XI:s drabanter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3033 av Annicka Engblom och Anders Hansson (båda M)
summary: The proposal suggests that the parliament supports investigating the possibility of initiating a pilot project offering specially designed health checks for seniors to identify health issues and prevent illness. This initiative aims to address the increasing elderly population's healthcare needs and establish tailored health assessments, starting with a pilot region such as Södermanland, to eventually implement such measures across all regions.

title: Strategi för att fasa ut djurförsök
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the potential for a preventive program aimed at increasing knowledge for the early detection and support of elderly individuals suffering from mental health issues, particularly focusing on suicide prevention among those over 55 years of age. It emphasizes the societal impact of suicide, the need for training for those working closely with the elderly to recognize warning signs, and the allocation of resources for education and support to help save lives.

title: Talangstrategi för Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3031 av Kristina Axén Olin och Johan Forssell (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a crisis commission to address the decreasing number of police officers in visible roles, amidst rising organized crime and public safety concerns in Swedish cities. The authors highlight ongoing issues with gang violence and public fear, citing a significant reduction in the proportion of active police officers on the streets since 2015. They call for an in-depth analysis of these trends to propose effective measures for increasing police presence and tackling criminal activities.

title: Sta¨rkt fo¨rebyggande arbete mot va°ldsbejakande extremism och organiserad brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes measures to improve the efficiency of the Swedish prison system in response to increasing pressure from serious crime and overcrowding. It highlights the need for reform, emphasizing suggestions from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding better resource management and cost reduction. The motion suggests exploring shared accommodations for inmates and reevaluating the required standards for prison facilities. Additionally, it recommends a strategy for outsourcing prison sentences abroad in cases involving deportation.

title: Läkemedelsförsörjning vid krig och kris
summary: The motion proposes to establish a national approval system for technical specifications of small houses, allowing companies that receive approval in one municipality to gain automatic acceptance across all municipalities. This approach aims to reduce unnecessary administrative work during building permit applications, ultimately lowering costs for customers. Furthermore, it suggests implementing a reduced building permit fee for these types of structures due to the expedited approval process.

title: Inrättande av faddersystem för nyanlända
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the requirements in the discrimination law regarding wage mapping, arguing that the current legislation has limited impact on reducing wage disparities between men and women in the labor market and imposes excessive administrative burdens on employers.

title: Infrastruktur i Halland
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the mandatory requirement for hiring a control manager during the construction of small houses, arguing that this regulation adds unnecessary bureaucracy and costs, which hinder the development of new housing. The author, Jan Ericson, believes that it should be the choice of the builder to decide whether to employ such oversight rather than being compelled to do so, as is currently mandated by law.

title: Statlig myndighet till Halland
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the legal right of churches and religious communities to perform marriages in Sweden, arguing that allowing religious representatives to act as authorities creates conflicts between religious interpretations of marriage and societal views. The author contends that marriage should be a legal act performed at a government office, applicable to all, while individuals can choose to have a religious ceremony afterward if they wish. This change aims to reinforce the separation of church and state and reduce conflicts regarding marriage officiation.

title: Sverige behöver ha en riktig strategi för vår energiförsörjning
summary: The motion proposes the dissolution of the Swedish Authority for Work Environment Knowledge, arguing that it was established without a thorough analysis of necessity and that reducing the number of government agencies is essential for maintaining welfare and public services for taxpayers.

title: Bostadsbyggande
summary: The motion proposes that the parliament support efforts to enhance the competitiveness of Arlanda Airport, highlighting its significance as an economic growth engine for Sweden. It critiques the government-imposed flight tax, arguing that it undermines this competitiveness and offers only minimal environmental benefits, thereby suggesting that the government should focus on strengthening Arlanda rather than weakening it.

title: Danstillstånd
summary: The motion proposes a change in legislation to allow the use of winter tires beyond the current deadline of April 15, taking into account Sweden's diverse geographical conditions and varying weather patterns. The current law, which mandates a switch to summer tires by April 15, can pose risks in northern regions where snow and ice may still prevail, potentially leading to accidents and hazardous driving conditions. The motion argues for the need to align tire regulations with actual weather conditions to enhance road safety.

title: Likabehandling
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the regulations governing A-traktorer (a type of modified vehicle) to consider increasing the maximum allowable speed from 30 km/h to 45 km/h for individuals holding an AM driving license. This change aims to enhance the attractiveness and usability of A-traktorer, which have been subject to the current speed limit since the 1950s.

title: Utvärdera kassaregistren
summary: The motion proposes a review of traffic speed limits to enhance both road safety and accessibility. It suggests that appropriate speed limits are crucial for traffic safety and need to be adjusted based on context, vehicles, and road conditions. The motion highlights concerns that the lowering of speed limits, often affecting rural areas disproportionately due to the prioritization of road upgrades, is negatively perceived by daily road users. It emphasizes the need for speed reductions to be based on sound reasoning and acknowledges the general support among parliamentarians for prioritizing traffic safety.

title: Omvänd ordning vid organdonationer
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should encourage the government to explore the implementation of arterial stiffness testing at primary healthcare centers in order to better detect cardiovascular diseases, which are the leading cause of death in Sweden. The motion highlights the importance of early measurement of arterial stiffness using available technology, currently limited to a few research clinics, to identify at-risk patients and potentially save lives.

title: Avskaffande av reklamskatten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the ability of authorities to better inform individuals about their right to consent to the disclosure of confidential information. It emphasizes the importance of confidentiality while addressing the issues that arise when media covers individual cases without the government's ability to respond due to privacy laws. The intention is to enhance public dialogue and trust by allowing individuals the option to waive confidentiality, thus enabling a more balanced discourse.

title: Enklare momsregler
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3018 av Lars Püss och Åsa Coenraads (båda M)
summary: The motion by Jan Ericson proposes the establishment of a national deposit system for batteries in Sweden, similar to a system currently operational in Norway. The aim is to improve battery recycling rates and reduce environmental damage caused by improperly disposed batteries. By implementing this system, a higher percentage of batteries could be collected and recycled, leading to significant environmental benefits.

title: Ersätt nuvarande krav på personalliggare med den danska modellen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider the introduction of a tax deduction for services provided by physiotherapists, chiropractors, and similar professions. The intention is to encourage individuals to invest in their own health, reduce the burden on public healthcare, and ultimately lower societal costs related to sickness absence. The motion argues that such a tax deduction, similar to existing deductions for household services (RUT) and renovation work (ROT), would promote personal responsibility for health and create more jobs in the service sector.

title: Unga entreprenörer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3016 av Lars Püss och Åsa Coenraads (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider implementing a tax deduction for registration fees related to various sporting competitions, such as the 'En svensk klassiker' and 'Tjejklassikern'. The aim is to encourage more physical activity among citizens by reducing financial barriers, thereby improving public health and decreasing costs associated with diseases related to a sedentary lifestyle.

title: Regelförenklingar för företag genom solnedgångsparagrafer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examines the possibility of introducing tax deductions for volunteer leaders in youth sports, in recognition of their significant contributions. It highlights that around 3 million volunteers dedicate substantial time to coaching, and there are growing challenges in recruiting and retaining these leaders. Implementing tax deductions for related expenses, such as travel and meals, is suggested as a means to support these individuals without imposing significant costs on the government budget, thereby promoting youth sports and encouraging future leadership.

title: Opinionsbildande myndigheter och statliga bolag
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of implementing a trial period for lower fuel taxes in rural areas, where alternatives to car use for transportation are limited. The aim is to reduce the financial burden of fuel taxes on inhabitants of these regions, while still supporting efforts to redirect urban traffic towards public transport and cycling.

title: Myndigheternas vägledningsansvar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3013 av Lars Püss och Åsa Coenraads (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a reduction in gasoline and diesel taxes in Norrland, arguing that the region's residents are heavily reliant on cars due to limited public transportation options. The motion emphasizes that rising fuel taxes impose financial burdens on individuals and businesses, complicating daily life and impacting local competitiveness. It suggests that Norrland should not be subjected to the same fuel tax rates as areas with better alternative transportation options.

title: Bekämpa stöldligorna
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3012 av Lars Püss och Helena Antoni (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national competence center to support relatives of individuals who have committed suicide. It emphasizes the lack of public discussion on mental health issues and the specific challenges faced by those left behind after a suicide. The suggested competence center would provide multidisciplinary support and resources, involving collaboration between municipalities and healthcare services, to help these families cope with their grief and reintegrate into daily life after such tragedies.

title: Rikets säkerhet och miljöbalken
summary: The motion proposes to reduce the gasoline tax in Sweden to support development and facilitate living and business opportunities across the country, particularly benefiting those in rural and less populated areas. The high gasoline tax is seen as a financial burden on families, especially where public transport is limited, leading to inequality in access to work and recreational activities, potentially discouraging people from living in these areas.

title: Natomedlemskap för Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to explore the possibility of expanding the ROT deduction to include repairs and safety-enhancing measures for vehicles. The rationale is that proper vehicle maintenance is essential for safety and can reduce the prevalence of unregulated work in the market, thereby increasing tax revenues and creating more jobs in the sector. This expansion is viewed as a beneficial initiative for both vehicle owners and the broader community.

title: Förenklade utredningar om faderskap vid samboförhållande
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3009 av Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström m.fl. (M)
summary: The proposal suggests investigating changes in tax legislation to make general employee training a tax-free benefit for companies in Sweden. The motion argues that current tax regulations create obstacles for employers aiming to develop their staff, particularly as general training programs are often not classified as tax-free benefits. This change is posited to foster more opportunities for education, enhance individual competencies, and ultimately strengthen the workforce for businesses, creating a mutually beneficial situation.

title: Ungas ohälsa, BUP och elevhälsan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:3008 av Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström och David Josefsson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the consequences of reducing the advertising tax to enhance funding opportunities for associations. It emphasizes the importance of the Swedish association life, particularly in supporting youth and community building, and stresses the financial challenges faced by these organizations in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic. The suggestion highlights the obstacles posed by the current tax system, which hampers the potential for sponsorships and increases reliance on public funding, advocating for a change that could benefit both associations and the overall tax system during economic crises.

title: Statens institutionsstyrelse
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of enabling employees to pursue professional development through gross salary exchange. It highlights the importance of skills development for maintaining Sweden's status as a knowledge-based nation, especially in the wake of the pandemic. The motion addresses the existing tax complexities that discourage proactive employee development, advocating for simplification of regulations to encourage both employees and employers to pursue further education and training.

title: Tomträttsavgäld
summary: The proposal suggests the introduction of a language test as a requirement for acquiring Swedish citizenship. The motion emphasizes the importance of language skills for integration into Swedish society and the labor market, arguing that language proficiency is essential for communication and participation in various social contexts. The motion highlights the need for education and high expectations to facilitate a sense of belonging and pride among new citizens, aligning with practices already implemented in many EU countries.

title: Kontroll mot belastningsregister vid anställning inom yrken där människor kan komma att stå i beroendeställning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of conducting annual surveys to assess populations of animal species that cause damage to agriculture and the fishing industry. It emphasizes the need to manage increasing populations of harmful species, such as cormorants, seals, and wolves, which threaten these industries. The motion suggests that once a favorable conservation status for a species is established, counts should be conducted to inform decisions about allowable hunting of surplus individuals, facilitated by regional county administrative boards.

title: Öresundsmetron
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament approve a minimum population threshold to ensure favorable conservation status for certain animal species that are causing harm to agriculture and fisheries. It suggests that hunting should be permitted on surplus animal populations, addressing issues particularly with species such as cormorants, cranes, swans, wolves, and seals, which are contributing to ecological and economic challenges in farming and fishing sectors.

title: Uteblivet studiestöd
summary: The motion proposes a review of the coastal protection regulations in Sweden to allow for new construction in coastal areas where possible, recognizing the diverse conditions across the country. The aim is to address housing shortages in certain regions, particularly in declining municipalities, by alleviating existing restrictions of coastal protection that are perceived to hinder development and attract residents. The proposal also suggests that the regulations be adjusted to exclude smaller rivers and streams from the same restrictive framework.

title: Smärtfri vardag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the creation of a national exception from the Bird Directive regarding cormorants, arguing that their increasing population poses challenges to local environments, fisheries, and tourism. It contends that cormorants should no longer be considered a specially protected species due to their stable and growing numbers, and that local authorities should have the power to make decisions based on current conditions rather than outdated protection status.

title: Hämta hem barnen
summary: The motion advocates for stricter enforcement of expulsion for foreign nationals who commit serious crimes in Sweden. It argues that the current legal framework only permits expulsion in cases where imprisonment is included in the penalty, resulting in many offenders remaining in the country due to lenient sentences and challenges in implementing expulsion. The motion expresses that this situation could undermine the Swedish public's tolerance towards foreigners and the credibility of Sweden's immigration policies, calling for a review of the existing regulations to facilitate more expulsions.

title: Legalisering av surrogatmoderskap
summary: The motion proposes the repeal of the ban on uranium mining in Sweden, arguing that the previous prohibition severely hampers the extraction of critical rare earth metals necessary for innovation, especially in battery manufacturing. The motion emphasizes that the existing legislation already imposes strict requirements for mining, including rigorous environmental assessments, and suggests that the ban sets a dangerous precedent that could harm Sweden's reputation as a mining nation and weaken its mining industry's competitiveness.

title: Nationell Öresundsagenda
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of economic free zones in rural areas, particularly in Northern Sweden, to address various issues such as reduced profitability in agriculture, depopulation, and lack of community services. The aim is to promote employment opportunities by reducing employer contributions for newly established businesses, thereby decreasing dependency on government aid and enhancing self-sufficiency in these regions.

title: Alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och spel om pengar
summary: The motion proposes to end the practice of municipalities forcing individuals to connect to municipal water and sewage systems, arguing that such actions are unreasonable when viable, less expensive alternatives exist. It stipulates that municipalities must prove that existing systems do not meet health standards before enforcing connections and emphasizes that environmental benefits must justify costs for individuals.

title: En funktionshinderspolitik att lita på
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for Swedish governmental agencies to enhance their understanding of the child perspective in decision-making processes that affect children's lives. It highlights previous findings from the Children’s Ombudsman indicating that many agencies fail to incorporate this perspective, despite the legal mandate for child consequence analyses and the incorporation of the Child Convention into Swedish law. The motion calls for increased training for staff in these agencies to better integrate the child perspective into their work.

title: Stärkta förbindelser mellan Sverige och Taiwan
summary: The motion proposes that all public services in Sweden should be subject to scrutiny and able to be reported to a supervisory board, as currently, only broadcast programs are fully accountable. The author argues that significant public funding should ensure transparency and accountability across all public service activities, especially as these services increasingly move away from traditional platforms.

title: Vattenpipor
summary: The motion proposes to investigate a merger between Försäkringskassan and Arbetsförmedlingen to reduce bureaucracy and the number of contact points for individuals who are outside the labor market. The aim is to facilitate quicker access to meaningful employment and financial support for those affected by the challenges brought on by the COVID-19 crisis.

title: Göteborgs hamn
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2993 av David Josefsson och Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström (båda M)
summary: This motion proposes a review of the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act to enhance citizens' ability to access transparent information regarding the management of public funds. It emphasizes the importance of developing standards for public services in healthcare, education, and social care, advocating for available and quality statistics that allow public agencies to compare their operations. The motion argues that current interpretations of the law create barriers to transparency, particularly concerning economic data and statistical reporting, which hinders both public oversight and service development.

title: Möjliggör för andra aktörer att sälja biljetter via SJs webbplats och app
summary: The motion proposes a review of the penalties for child pornography offenses in Sweden, advocating for increased sentences to make them more severe and reflective of the horrific nature of the crime. The authors highlight that current penalties are inadequate, as demonstrated by cases where offenders received minimal sentences despite possessing large quantities of illicit material. The motion calls for greater resources for investigations and a clearer legal framework to combat these serious crimes against children.

title: RUT-avdrag i boenden med serviceutbud
summary: This motion proposes a comprehensive study on the impact of pornography and sexual crimes on children and adolescents, highlighting the increasing prevalence of sexual offenses perpetrated by youths. It advocates for stricter penalties for sexual offenses, a new categorization for severe sexual harassment, and research to better understand the motivations behind these crimes, as well as how exposure to pornography affects young people's wellbeing and sexual health. The motion calls for governmental acknowledgment and action around these issues.

title: Uppmuntran av användande av miljöbilar och bilpooler
