It calls for a clear definition of the public service mandate that focuses on societal information such as news, factual programs, social debates, and science, rather than extensive entertainment productions. Additionally, it suggests modernizing the public service framework to adapt to the increasing diversity of commercial channels and recognizing digital platforms as part of public service broadcasting.

title: Möjlighet att fritt välja vård i Norden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2850 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament evaluate the consequences of removing the requirement for membership fees for organizations applying for funding from the authority MUCF. Previously, organizations were mandated to charge a membership fee to qualify for funding, but this requirement has been abolished, resulting in significant increases in membership numbers for some organizations, notably leading to higher funding. The motion argues that this situation is not equitable and suggests a prompt evaluation of the impacts of this change, particularly on less well-off associations.

title: Organdonation
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2849 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive investigation into Swedish bureaucracy to reduce processing times and costs. It argues that Sweden's bureaucracy has grown excessively, impacting essential societal functions like education and healthcare. The motion suggests that merging or eliminating certain agencies could improve efficiency and reduce costs, and calls for political action to streamline regulations and enhance coordination among agencies.

title: Äldres valfrihet i omsorgen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2848 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to allow Swedish civil marriage officiants to perform weddings for Swedish couples in Nordic neighboring countries. It suggests a review of current laws to modernize and enable these officiants to carry out civil marriages beyond Swedish borders, accommodating couples who wish to marry in specific locations or on ships that cross international waters.

title: Omotiverade åldersgränser för screening av sjukdomar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2847 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm (båda M)
summary: Betty Malmberg proposes that the Swedish parliament establish a function to enhance voters' ability to make informed choices in elections. She emphasizes the need for objective comparisons between party programs, noting challenges faced by voters due to the volume and timing of campaign pledges. Drawing inspiration from the Netherlands, where parties can submit their programs for independent assessment, she calls for a similar initiative in Sweden to improve the quality of electoral debate and voter understanding of party proposals.

title: Hörselinstruktörer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2846 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that authority figures in Sweden should be allowed to sign official decisions using their service numbers instead of their names. This change aims to enhance the safety and security of public officials, particularly in light of threats from criminal organizations. By using service numbers, officials would be less exposed to personal risks and could make unbiased decisions without fear of retribution. The proposal argues that such a change would promote lawful decision-making while protecting the personal information of authority figures and their families.

title: Behov av äldrecoacher
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2845 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a legislative office or legislative assistance within the Swedish Parliament (Riksdag) to support the majority in enacting laws directly, reducing reliance on the government for legislative processes. The intent is to expedite legislation that has been delayed or hindered by the government, ensuring that decisions made by the Parliament are respected and implemented without unnecessary delays.

title: Ökad patientsäkerhet vid ambulanstransporter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2844 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for the new administrative law to be fully implemented across all government authorities to ensure legal certainty and accountability. It highlights existing shortcomings in the application of administrative law, particularly by authorities handling environmental legislation, and calls for regulatory documents to prioritize and monitor the application of this law to enhance predictability and fairness in governmental operations.

title: Nationell förarutbildning för utryckningsfordon
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2843 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion by John Widegren proposes that the government ensures that directives to authorities clearly state that the rule of law governs their operations. It emphasizes the need for training for state employees to recognize the importance of the rule of law in their work, addressing concerns that bureaucratic guidelines can hinder entrepreneurship and contribute to a growing disregard for authority, particularly in areas like forestry policy.

title: Äldres rättigheter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2842 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish Parliament to consider changes to the existing requirements for personal information on service credentials for vulnerable occupational groups, emphasizing the need for protective measures for employees such as police officers, ambulance personnel, and first responders who face threats and harassment. It also suggests reviewing the possibility of protected residential information for these professions and expanding anonymization efforts to include other sectors like social services and migration authorities.

title: Entreprenörskap i skolan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2841 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to transfer the responsibility for assessing applications for the approval and use of pesticides in agriculture from the Chemicals Agency (Kemikalieinspektionen) to the Swedish Board of Agriculture (Jordbruksverket). The motion argues that the current process by Kemikalieinspektionen has harmed crop production and competitiveness for Swedish farmers, as they face delays and restrictions compared to their European counterparts. By moving this responsibility, the motion aims to create a more cohesive approach to the needs of agriculture regarding pesticide use and ensure a functioning food production system in Sweden.

title: Partnerskap inland-Akademi Norr
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2840 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion calls for the development of a clear action plan to expand Sweden's electricity grid to meet the rising demand for electricity. It emphasizes the need for reliable electricity supply through increased production from nuclear power, alongside the ongoing investment in wind and solar energy. The proposal highlights the necessity of enhancing grid capacity to support electric vehicles and the transition of industries towards greater electricity usage, while addressing current deficiencies in the electricity network that hinder development.

title: Satsning på geriatrisk och gerontologisk forskning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2839 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm (båda M)
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need for increased support and rapid interventions for children and adolescents experiencing mental health issues, which have significantly worsened, partly due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It calls for improved accessibility to psychiatric care, better collaboration between municipalities and regions, and greater freedom of choice for patients while ensuring quick access to necessary treatment to prevent long-term problems.

title: Hemtjänst–deltidsbrandmän
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2838 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that Socialstyrelsen's evaluation should guide future agreements between the government and municipal authorities regarding mental health initiatives. It highlights past challenges in assessing the effectiveness of these initiatives, emphasizing the need for clear goals and metrics to ensure equitable access and improved quality of care in mental health services. The signatories urge parliament to communicate these concerns to the government.

title: ROT-avdrag för den ideella sektorn
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2837 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that individuals seeking personal assistance should have the option to request a 'second opinion' from a qualified healthcare professional if their application for assistance is denied. This aims to enhance the quality of care and oversight in the allocation of assistance funds, ensuring that the needs of beneficiaries are accurately assessed and that the system is not misused.

title: Skatt på transporter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2836 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson (båda M)
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance personal privacy regarding the reporting of food poisoning incidents by requesting that personal data linked to such reports be treated as confidential. The motion highlights the public health implications of ensuring that individuals feel safe to report suspected food poisonings without fear of their information becoming publicly accessible. It argues that the current system, where personal details are made public, could discourage individuals from reporting incidents, potentially leading to increased public health risks.

title: Förenklade regler för resegaranti
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2835 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to investigate potential deficiencies in the criminal law protections against unauthorized intrusions on farmers' properties, consider classifying violent animal rights organizations as extremist groups, and instruct the Security Police (Säpo) to map violent animal rights activists. It highlights the increasing crimes by animal rights activists against farmers and related professions, asserting that the State must take urgent action to ensure the safety and security of those affected.

title: Ungas kriminalitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2834 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament develop a strategy to ensure trade in seal products, which has historical significance for coastal communities and is necessary for managing seal populations that threaten fish stocks. The author highlights the importance of ethical and sustainable hunting practices, as well as the need for continued opportunities for trade in seal products to support fishing industries while maintaining ecological balance.

title: Allemansrätten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2833 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a review of wildlife management objectives to enhance local governance in Västmanland, emphasizing the need for viltförvaltningsdelegationer (wildlife management delegations) to have clearer mandates and decision-making authority. The author argues that despite initial intentions to decentralize decision-making, these delegations have become ineffective discussion forums, failing to adequately represent local interests regarding increasing predator populations and their impact on local communities.

title: Jämställt företagande
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2832 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion suggests a review of the biotope protection laws in order to alleviate restrictions on private landowners, specifically addressing the issues faced by farmers and forest owners in managing their land. It argues that current regulations unfairly restrict land use, pointing out the impracticality of biotope protection for newly established stone heaps that are created for agricultural use. The proposal emphasizes the need for a reasonable approach that allows landowners to utilize their land efficiently while balancing conservation efforts.

title: Översyn av förmånsbeskattning av färdigproducerad mat
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2831 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The proposal suggests that if Sweden needs to designate more forest areas as reserves or protected forests, this should only be done using state-owned forests. The motion argues against the continued allocation of additional forest land to reserves, emphasizing the importance of producing more timber for job creation and economic growth. It asserts that if the government intends to allocate forest land due to EU requirements, it should come from its own holdings rather than private lands.

title: En rättvisare transportsektor i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2830 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates the economic consequences of reduced forest production for both society and individual forest owners, as well as the climate benefits of forests when production decreases. It emphasizes the importance of forests to the national economy and acknowledges the various challenges that threaten production, including regulatory restrictions and growing wildlife populations. The authors argue that understanding these impacts is crucial for sustaining both economic viability and climate benefits from the forests.

title: Angående försäkringsskydd som utryckningspersonal omfattas av
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2829 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to simplify regulations surrounding wild boar traps by allowing individuals to build and use traps without needing a specific permit, provided they meet minimum design criteria established by the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency (Naturvårdsverket). This aims to encourage more people to manage wild boar populations effectively, as they pose increasing challenges for agriculture, gardens, and public areas. The motion also suggests that Naturvårdsverket should clarify these minimum requirements to facilitate trap construction.

title: Angående ambulanshelikoptrar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2828 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm och Ann-Britt Åsebol (båda M)
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should clarify Vattenfall AB's ownership directive concerning energy production to ensure that production guarantees network stability and meets demand for electricity and system services. It emphasizes the necessity of primarily using controllable fossil-free energy sources, supplemented by intermittent fossil-free sources, without jeopardizing system stability. The proposal highlights the risks associated with reduced energy production due to weather conditions, the closing of nuclear facilities, and existing capacity issues affecting electricity supply.

title: Fortsatt utveckling av vård och omsorg i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2827 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm m.fl. (M)
summary: This motion proposes that the Riksdag develop a strategy for charging infrastructure and electric roads in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of transport for individuals and businesses. The motion highlights the rapid advancements in vehicle electrification and the need for a collaborative effort between the government and stakeholders to address challenges related to the implementation of electric roads and ensure adequate charging facilities amidst the ongoing energy crisis.

title: Skogsmuseet i Lycksele bör bli ett nationellt centrum
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to create a clear strategy for making government agencies more business-friendly by focusing on efficiency and reducing bureaucracy. It emphasizes the importance of facilitating the growth of new and existing companies by streamlining processes, minimizing costs, and adapting agency operations to better understand and meet the needs of businesses, particularly in rural areas where entrepreneurs often deal with multiple agencies.

title: Kultursektorn är bred och vi måste se alla delar inom sektorn
summary: Sten Bergheden's motion advocates for a regular review and comparison of industry-specific costs and regulations in Sweden with those in competing countries to maintain the competitiveness of Swedish businesses. The proposal emphasizes the need for Sweden to adapt its regulations and tax policies in line with global changes to avoid losing market share and jobs, particularly in sectors like agriculture and trucking that have already seen declines due to international competition. The motion calls for enhanced monitoring and assessment of these factors to ensure a strong business environment in Sweden.

title: Konkurrensneutralitet inom vård- och omsorgssektorn
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2824 av Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion advocates for strengthening property rights in the mining law, emphasizing that landowners should have greater say regarding mineral discoveries on their land. Currently, landowners and their neighbors are often not consulted before permits for mineral exploration are granted, leading to potential exploitation without sufficient compensation for the landowners. The proposal calls for a revision of the mining legislation to better protect landowners and affirm that minerals are part of their property rights.

title: Export av klimatbonusbil
summary: The motion proposes an evaluation of the societal benefits and costs associated with wind power expansion in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of stable and sustainable energy supply while questioning the current ambitious goals for wind power, arguing that a thorough assessment of costs, benefits, and the impact on local communities is necessary. The motion suggests that decisions should respect local veto rights and that power generation choices should be based on comprehensive analysis rather than aggressive targets.

title: Livsmedelsverkets avgifter
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament conduct a review of the requirements for information submission from businesses to reduce the administrative burden on entrepreneurs. It emphasizes the need for better coordination and simplification of forms and data submissions, so that businesses are not required to repeatedly provide the same information to different government agencies.

title: Gifttunnor
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need for additional legislative measures to combat serious and organized crime in Sweden, particularly focusing on areas suffering from high crime rates like Gothenburg. It highlights the growing sense of insecurity among residents and suggests a range of strategies, including harsher penalties for gang-related offenses and the potential adoption of practices from Denmark, such as witness protection measures and area bans for criminals. The motion advocates for a comprehensive approach that integrates law enforcement with social investments in education and employment to counteract crime effectively.

title: Säl och skarv
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should review the possibility of introducing RUT deductions for home delivery of groceries. The author argues that, especially in times of pandemics when minimizing social contact is important, allowing RUT deductions for grocery delivery would be beneficial. The proposal suggests that this service should also be available in non-pandemic times as a convenience for the public.

title: Återkalla medborgarskap
summary: The motion proposes enhanced border controls to prevent stolen cars, caravans, and motorhomes from leaving Sweden undetected. It argues for the necessity of an investigation to develop proposals that address the rising number of stolen vehicles disappearing out of the country, despite a significant decrease in overall car thefts over the past decade.

title: Ambulerande tivolin
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency (MSB) to establish regulations for fire safety in special housing for elderly and severely ill individuals, aiming to create a uniform minimum standard. It highlights the vulnerability of these groups concerning residential fires due to reduced mobility and the risks associated with various health conditions. The motion suggests implementing adaptive fire safety measures, such as automatic sprinkler systems, to prevent fire-related fatalities and injuries, backed by economic analysis showing that such measures are socially beneficial.

title: Nationellt tiggeriförbud
summary: The suggestion advocates for increasing knowledge and utilization of socioeconomic analyses in the social sector to address issues like bullying and mental health among youth. It emphasizes the need for developing tailored socioeconomic models for social interventions and highlights that early and preventive actions can lead to long-term benefits, both in terms of individual well-being and cost savings for society. The proposal calls for the establishment of updated socioeconomic analyses by the National Board of Health and Welfare to support informed decision-making for timely interventions.

title: Förenkla för legitima vapenbärare
summary: The motion proposes reforms aimed at strengthening Swedish competitiveness and enhancing the infrastructure of the Port of Gothenburg. It emphasizes that entrepreneurs create jobs and generate tax revenue for essential welfare areas like education and police services. The motion highlights the need to reduce regulatory burdens, address housing and labor market challenges, and improve transportation infrastructure to ensure Swedish industries remain competitive in the global market, particularly in light of increasing international competition.

title: Digitalisering av offentliga verksamhetsområden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate a review of the situation for Swedish citizens living abroad, referred to as 'utlandssvenskar'. It highlights issues related to the registration and recognition of these citizens upon their return to Sweden for short visits, which can lead to difficulties in transactions and interactions with banks and authorities due to their non-registered status in Swedish systems. The motion emphasizes the need for the Swedish Tax Agency to play a key role in addressing these challenges.

title: Strategi för hemarbete
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates banks to ensure a sufficient level of cash handling services, addressing concerns that the decline in cash services is disproportionately affecting rural residents and those who rely on cash transactions. The motion argues that the growing trend towards cashless banking is excluding many citizens from essential banking services and emphasizes the need for banks to fulfill their societal responsibility in providing accessible cash services.

title: Avveckla extratjänster som arbetsmarknadspolitisk åtgärd
summary: The motion calls for an investigation into the safety of moped cars, highlighting a significant increase in accidents involving these vehicles, with a 250% rise over five years. It emphasizes the inadequacies in their design compared to regular cars, particularly in terms of crash safety. The motion suggests various measures to enhance safety, such as improved seatbelt usage, better tire regulations, and a review of crash protection and training. The aim is to identify necessary legislative actions to improve moped car security.

title: Lönekartläggning hos statliga myndigheter
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of automatic compensation payments to crime victims from the state, rather than relying on offenders to make these payments. The motion emphasizes the need for smoother access to compensation for victims, who often struggle to receive the funds awarded to them due to offenders lacking financial means, resulting in undue bureaucratic burdens on the victims. It proposes that the state assume responsibility for compensating victims directly once a court ruling is finalized, and then pursue reimbursement from the perpetrator.

title: Polisens bedömning av jaktvapen
summary: The proposal suggests that Sweden should re-evaluate its aid to Palestine to ensure that Swedish taxpayer money is not misused for corruption or terrorist activities, but rather directed towards humanitarian assistance. It emphasizes the need for Sweden to impose requirements on the Palestinian leadership regarding the appropriate use of aid, citing concerns over the allocation of funds in the Palestinian budget and the moral integrity of the leadership. The motion argues for a responsible foreign policy that includes explicit demands on the Palestinian authority as a precondition for continued aid.

title: Mini-jobs på svensk arbetsmarknad
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of removing the VAT exemption on betting, lotteries, and similar activities. The proponent argues that the current VAT exemption leads to hidden costs for businesses, limiting their ability to invest and potentially driving them overseas, particularly in the context of increasing digitalization in the gaming sector. The motion highlights that other jurisdictions, like Malta, have modified their VAT regulations on gambling, creating competitive disadvantages for Swedish companies.

title: Utgiftsområde 22 Kommunikationer
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into eliminating the requirement that rental must occur to a business that is subject to tax liability or has the right to a refund, particularly aimed at simplifying and modernizing the rules surrounding rental VAT for non-profit organizations. It highlights that the current VAT rules are outdated and inflexible, which hinders the effective use of premises and inhibits sustainable growth and community development, specifically affecting non-profit associations that typically do not engage in VAT-liable activities.

title: Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament encourage greater collaboration between governmental agencies such as Sveaskog and local communities to boost nature tourism and local entrepreneurship in state-owned natural areas. It also calls for an investigation into the best ownership and management practices that balance species protection with public access to attractive natural spaces.

title: Utgiftsområde 20 Allmän miljö- och naturvård
summary: The suggestion proposes to expedite the introduction of a driver's license requirement for operating jet skis in Sweden, citing concerns over the increasing number of jet skis and the associated risks of accidents. The motion emphasizes incidents like a serious accident involving a 16-year-old girl and argues that a license requirement would ensure operators are knowledgeable about maritime regulations, ultimately aiming to prevent severe accidents on the water.

title: Hållbart fiske
summary: The motion proposes an increase in the minimum allowable mesh size for Swedish shrimp fishing from 35 mm to 45 mm, arguing that a larger mesh size would lead to higher catches of the more valuable kokräka and support the conservation of smaller shrimp. The motion emphasizes the importance of aligning national regulations with this goal and advocates for Sweden to take a progressive stance within the EU regarding fishing policies.

title: Trafiksäkerhetspolitisk motion
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a support system for cod fishermen in the Baltic Sea who have been negatively affected by the cod fishing ban implemented in 2019. It argues that many of these fishermen have lost their livelihoods due to the prohibition, which remains in effect, and emphasizes the need for immediate financial assistance until the cod population recovers sufficiently to allow for commercial fishing.

title: Jakt och viltvård
summary: The proposal seeks to develop a timeline for phasing out mink farming in Sweden, drawing inspiration from Norway's ban on the practice. It highlights persistent animal welfare issues within Swedish mink farming, stating that the industry has failed to meet animal protection laws. Various studies and reports have pointed out inadequate living conditions for mink, including overcrowded and poorly maintained cages, leading to health and welfare concerns. The suggestion points to a growing trend in Europe to ban fur farming and calls for Sweden to follow suit by establishing a plan to end mink farming by 2025.

title: En långsiktigt hållbar migrationspolitik
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national animal protection police in Sweden to address animal welfare and cruelty issues more effectively. It emphasizes the importance of trained personnel in managing such cases, citing the success of local animal protection police established in cities like Stockholm and Norrbotten. The author argues that this initiative should be reinstated at a national level to ensure proper handling and prevention of animal abuse, while also suggesting the creation of a specialized training program for recruitment.

title: Reformering och åtstramning av bidragssystemen
summary: The proposal advocates for a nationwide review of Swedish zoos to ensure compliance with Swedish animal protection laws. It suggests amending the laws to prohibit zoos from breeding more animals than they can care for and to ban the killing of surplus animals. The motion highlights the educational and conservation roles of zoos, while also addressing concerns about the welfare of animals and the working conditions within these facilities.

title: En mer rättvis skadeståndsrätt
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the home furnishings loan, which is aimed at newly arrived immigrants to assist with furnishing their homes. The author argues that the government's practice of forgiving these loans is inappropriate and that financial responsibility should be upheld. Furthermore, the motion suggests that having a loan program exclusively for immigrants is unfair to Swedish citizens, especially young people, who also face difficult financial situations.

title: Moratorium för kompetensutvisningar
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a new crime classification for severe animal cruelty, termed 'grovt djurplågeri' (serious animal cruelty), which would mandate prison sentences for offenders. It also suggests creating a dedicated animal welfare Act to consolidate existing legislation regarding animal rights. The urgency is underscored by studies indicating a correlation between animal cruelty and other forms of violence, emphasizing the need for stricter penalties and improved societal protections for animals.

title: Utbetalningar av bidrag via Skatteverket
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a long-term effective system of emergency airports in Sweden, emphasizing the need for increased funding and an expansion of the current system. Traffic Agency's recent report highlights that the existing system is insufficient, proposing to maintain the current ten emergency airports while adding nine more, including Stockholm Skavsta Airport, which already serves essential functions. The motion also suggests improved financing models and equal service standards across all emergency airports, stressing their importance for public health and safety.

title: Regelförenklingar efterlyses
summary: The motion calls for measures to break school segregation in Sweden, highlighting the failure of the current market-based school system to achieve equality and improved results. It proposes a comprehensive review of school placement regulations, the introduction of a national school choice system managed by the National Agency for Education, and a restriction on 'school funding flight' to prevent funds allocated for local education from being transferred between municipalities. The motion emphasizes the need for equitable opportunities for students regardless of their backgrounds, while also addressing resource allocation issues for municipal schools.

title: Utvecklat entreprenörskap ger tillväxt
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a tax reform aimed at reducing the growing economic inequalities in Sweden, which have intensified over the past 30 years. It highlights that the abolition of the wealth tax has contributed to these disparities, primarily due to increased capital incomes among the wealthiest. The motion advocates for the government to ensure that upcoming tax reforms, as per the January agreement, address these inequalities effectively.

title: Djurrättsextremism måste stoppas
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2796 av Åsa Coenraads och Lars Püss (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a Swedish Barents Institute in Norrbotten to enhance cooperation and development in the Barents region, which includes northern Scandinavia and northwestern Russia. It emphasizes the region's untapped economic potential in trade, export of raw materials, and tourism, and calls for investment in physical infrastructure to strengthen Sweden's role as a trade center. The motion also highlights the importance of promoting peace and reducing tensions through continuous collaboration among the countries in the region.

title: Eftersupning
summary: The motion advocates for an expansion of broadband infrastructure and free internet access across Sweden, emphasizing its importance as a democratic issue for young people. It highlights the necessity for all children and adolescents to have reliable internet connectivity, especially as digitalization increases and distance learning becomes more prevalent. The proposal also calls for measures to ensure safety in online environments to protect users from threats and harassment, thereby enhancing the democratic framework surrounding internet access for the youth.

title: Rätt att använda kroppsskanner
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for improved healthcare services within elderly care facilities, particularly following the challenges highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic. It calls for the government to recognize and address shortages in nursing and medical care that have been exacerbated by increasing needs among the elderly with complex health issues. Despite existing initiatives to improve working conditions for nursing staff, the proposal underscores the necessity for more qualified healthcare personnel and structured, multidisciplinary teams to enhance patient safety and care quality.

title: Bättre villkor för personer med funktionsvariationer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2793 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament study the feasibility of a model for income and cost equalization among municipalities that considers the challenges faced by areas with a high proportion of seasonal residents. It highlights issues such as demographic and geographical disparities that affect the financial capabilities and service demands on municipalities, exemplified by the influx of summer visitors to regions like Gotland, which complicates budget planning and service provision.

title: Jämställdhetsutbildning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament promote distance delivery services for the public sector and state-owned companies, emphasizing the need for Sweden to lead in digitalization. Currently, acceptance of distance delivery is at the discretion of each entity, which can hinder opportunities for businesses, especially in smaller areas, to compete for contracts. The proposal calls for regulations that require all state actors to accept distance delivery in procurement processes.

title: Anonyma vittnesmål vid fall med gängkriminella och organiserad brottslighet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2791 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Sofia Westergren (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament urge the government to review measures to prevent threats and violence against state employees, ensuring proper protection for those affected. It suggests that all state agencies should develop standardized procedures for handling incidents of threats and violence, as these occurrences are increasingly common and detrimental to both physical safety and mental well-being of employees. The motion emphasizes the need for clarity and support from employers and highlights the importance of state accountability in addressing violence against public servants, which poses a threat to democracy.

title: Inför förbud mot statushöjande personliga saker på anstalt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2790 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Sofia Westergren (båda M)
summary: The proposal suggests the creation of a national action plan to combat homelessness in Sweden, highlighting the increasing number of homeless individuals, including a rise in homeless women and families with children. It emphasizes the need for a coordinated approach among state, municipal, and local actors to effectively address the various causes of homelessness, including social challenges, separation, poverty, and housing market issues. The motion calls for the government to implement this action plan to assist municipalities in their efforts to provide housing and support to the homeless population.

title: Flytta tillsynsansvaret för skjutbanor från polisen
summary: This motion emphasizes the importance of providing necessary information to consumers in online shopping, particularly regarding product origin, shipping practices, and invoicing. It highlights the growing interest among consumers to make climate-smart choices and calls for improved transparency in the delivery process to minimize unnecessary emissions and facilitate sustainable consumer behavior. The proposal advocates for measures to ensure such information is disclosed at both the national and EU levels.

title: Låt miniminivå gälla när det gäller EU:s vapendirektiv
summary: The proposal advocates for establishing full-time employment as the standard norm across the labor market to promote equality, economic freedom, and a more just work environment, particularly for women in traditionally low-paying, part-time jobs. The motion highlights the disparity between full-time job offerings in male-dominated industries compared to the challenges faced in female-dominated sectors, arguing for legislative action to ensure equal opportunities and rights for all workers.

title: Säkerställ socialtjänstens tillgänglighet via 112
summary: The proposal calls for a review of employers' responsibilities regarding work environment safety for employees working from home, prompted by the challenges that have arisen during the pandemic. It emphasizes the need for ergonomic assessments and appropriate working conditions to prevent health issues associated with remote work, advocating for a minimum standard that all employers should meet.

title: Möjlighet till personlig utveckling för personer med funktionsvariationer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2786 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Betty Malmberg (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the compensation for reindeer lost to predators and outlines several measures to support the reindeer industry, including establishing a tolerance level for losses, implementing preventive measures such as fencing, allowing protective hunting within national parks, and creating a tax account similar to the forest account to facilitate generational transitions within reindeer herding.

title: Förtydliga och förenkla bedömningssystemet för personer med funktionsvariation
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2785 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Betty Malmberg (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes urgent government action to secure the future of growth companies in Sweden, particularly in light of the economic challenges posed by the coronavirus pandemic. It suggests that the government should provide equity capital to these companies through Almi Invest, ensuring state interests and a healthy stock market by implementing certain requirements for investments. The goal is to support essential sectors like life sciences and technology to prevent significant societal values from being destroyed and to sustain job creation.

title: Inför ett fribelopp för personer med funktionsvariation
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2784 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Betty Malmberg (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to expand the Växa support program to include simple companies, which are partnerships between two individuals operating a business together without formal registration. The current Växa support only covers sole proprietors and certain types of partnerships, excluding simple companies that are commonly found in rural areas, thus creating an inequity. The proponent argues that changing the regulations to cover simple companies would eliminate this discrimination and support economic activity in rural regions.

title: Bevarande av prakt- och originalkänslan hos veteranbilar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2783 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Sofia Westergren (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that compensation for nature conservation agreements should be allowed to be deposited into a forest account, facilitating financial support for landowners engaging in sustainability initiatives. The author argues that the current taxation framework, which requires immediate taxation of compensation without allowance for periodization, creates a heavy financial burden on landowners. By enabling the establishment of forest accounts for these compensations, the proposal aims to incentivize landowners to enter into conservation agreements, thus promoting long-term environmental preservation efforts.

title: Långtidssjuka i covid-19 måste prioriteras högre
summary: The motion calls for a national gathering to support Sweden's bid to host the 2030 Winter Olympics, citing previous successful events in Åre and Östersund as evidence of the country's capability. It emphasizes the importance of government and private sector backing to create a robust application, underlining that a Winter Olympics in Sweden would serve as a significant investment for growth and development in the region.

title: Förebygg suicid som riskerar att öka i pandemins fotspår
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2781 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Betty Malmberg (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should mandate offering and providing screening for Group B Streptococcus (GBS) to all pregnant women prior to childbirth. It emphasizes the potential life-threatening risks that GBS poses to newborns, including pneumonia and blood infections, and argues for the necessity of updating current health guidelines to ensure no child suffers severe complications or death due to preventable GBS infections. The suggestion draws attention to the inadequacy of current screening practices and advocates for a systematic approach, akin to those implemented in other countries.

title: Stoppa gängkriminalitetens utveckling i Värmland
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to include elderly citizens in Sweden's digitalization efforts through various measures such as enhancing resources for adult education aimed at digital skills, ensuring broadband coverage in rural areas, considering tax subsidies for purchasing digital tools and internet access, and allocating funds for research on digital inclusion. The motion underscores that equitable access to digital technology can promote health and well-being among the elderly, reduce social isolation, and enhance independence.

title: Minska ojämlikheterna inom cancervården
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2779 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Sofia Westergren (båda M)
summary: The motion calls for the abolition of age limits for free cancer screening, emphasizing that healthcare should be accessible to all individuals regardless of age. It argues that recent age-discriminatory policies in Sweden's healthcare system are unacceptable and that research funding for diseases affecting older adults should be increased. The motion highlights that early detection of cancer benefits individuals of all ages and criticizes the current age limitations on screening programs, suggesting they contribute to inequities in healthcare.

title: Barn ska skyddas från porr på internet
summary: The suggestion advocates for the implementation of mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) standards for healthcare workers in Sweden, similar to existing regulations in the construction industry. It emphasizes that every individual in healthcare should have specific protective equipment to ensure their safety in high-risk environments. The motion calls for amendments to occupational health and safety laws to prevent healthcare personnel from working in dangerous conditions without the necessary protections, highlighting this as an issue of equality and justice for both men and women in the workforce.

title: Barn ska skyddas från material på internet som innehåller grovt våld
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for increased awareness and research regarding lipedema, a chronic condition that primarily affects women and leads to severe pain and mobility issues. It highlights the lack of adequate treatment and support for affected individuals, who often face psychological challenges and socioeconomic barriers due to insufficient recognition of the disease within the healthcare system. The motion calls on the government to recognize lipedema and support research and healthcare initiatives to improve patient outcomes.

title: Utgiftsområde 5 Internationell samverkan
summary: The proposal advocates for an increase in operational funding for municipal airports with state-ordered flight traffic, citing the financial struggles these airports face due to low traffic and rising operational costs. The motion highlights that many municipalities are forced to provide substantial financial support to keep their airports operational, which detracts from funding for essential services like education and healthcare. It calls for the government to consider providing higher operational subsidies to ensure the sustainability of these airports.

title: Utgiftsområde 6 Försvar och samhällets krisberedskap
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive development package for Jämtlands län, which includes establishing a system for hydropower rebates to ensure economic resources remain in the region, relocating government agencies to the area, enhancing rural safety based on local needs, and increasing funding for infrastructure. It also advocates for a new equitable tax redistribution system to support welfare across Sweden and the reinstatement of Inlandsinnovation's operations to foster business growth. The overarching aim is to improve economic conditions and public services in Jämtlands län.

title: Utgiftsområde 12 Ekonomisk trygghet för familjer och barn
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a new wildlife authority in Jämtlands län to improve wildlife management, which is currently under the oversight of the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency. This recommendation follows a previous study from 2013 and aims to address ongoing criticisms of the agency's handling of wildlife issues, particularly concerning the management of large predator populations that have negatively impacted reindeer herding.

title: Psykisk hälsa
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2773 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need for the release of Dawit Isaak, a Swedish-Eritrean journalist imprisoned in Eritrea for advocating for democracy and freedom of speech. It calls on the Swedish Parliament to stand firm in promoting press freedom and ensuring that no individual is forgotten, while also demanding a consistent policy towards undemocratic regimes. The motion highlights the importance of free expression and the unacceptable nature of detention without trial, urging the government to explore new methods for securing Isaak's freedom.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes enhanced infrastructure planning in Skåne to ensure functional transport networks, emphasizing the need for increased investments in both rail and road maintenance. It highlights the importance of sustainable transportation options, calls for improved connections between Sweden and Denmark, and advocates for specific projects such as the HH-connection and Öresundsmetro to alleviate congestion and promote regional development. A strong focus is placed on addressing current traffic issues and enhancing safety on the roads through better control of freight transport.

title: Översyn av lagen (1995:732) om skydd för gravfriden vid vraket efter passagerarfartyget Estonia
summary: The motion advocates for making full-time work the standard norm in the Swedish labor market, particularly highlighting the prevalence of part-time positions among women in sectors like public service, retail, and hospitality. It addresses the financial challenges faced by part-time workers, especially those in female-dominated professions, and the negative implications of low wages and insecure employment. The motion calls on the government to consider measures that would ensure full-time employment opportunities and livable wages for all workers, emphasizing the need for workplace equity irrespective of gender.

title: Obligatorisk språkförskola och särskilda insatser i svenska språket
summary: The proposal emphasizes the crucial need for early support interventions for students requiring special assistance in schools. It argues that inadequate support can lead to severe negative outcomes for children, including increased risk of unemployment, poverty, and health issues. The motion calls for improved training for educators in special education to address these needs effectively. Additionally, it highlights the social challenges these children face during non-classroom hours and the wider impact on families due to insufficient support.

title: Höjning av grundavdraget
summary: The motion proposes an increase in the housing supplement for individuals receiving sickness and activity compensation, highlighting the financial struggles faced by pensioners and those on these subsidies due to rising rental costs. The author emphasizes the need for a comprehensive housing policy and better information dissemination to ensure that eligible individuals are aware of and can apply for the housing supplement.

title: Brandstationer ska klassas som skyddsobjekt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the investigation of increased freight train capacity across the Öresund Strait as part of the infrastructure plan. It highlights the upcoming Fehmarn Belt connection, which is expected to significantly enhance freight traffic and reduce transportation times between Sweden and continental Europe. The motion emphasizes the need for alternative crossings to accommodate the projected increase in freight train traffic and suggests examining various options, including a metro connection and a railway link between Landskrona and Copenhagen, to help facilitate this capacity increase.

title: Järnvägslänk mellan Oslo, Fyrstadsregionen, Göteborg och Köpenhamn
summary: This motion advocates for a comprehensive review of the sickness insurance regulations in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a system that provides security for individuals during periods of illness or unemployment. It highlights issues with the current system where individuals feel inadequately supported by the Försäkringskassan and are sometimes forced back into work despite being unwell. The motion calls for immediate action to restore trust in the sickness benefit system and to better protect those affected.

title: En utredning om Folkbildningsrådet
summary: The motion presented by Åsa Eriksson and others advocates for the removal of silos in Sweden's social welfare system, calling for a coordinated strategy that prioritizes individual needs. It highlights the challenges faced by people with complex support requirements, including vulnerable groups like children, the elderly, and those with mental health issues, who struggle to receive coordinated assistance due to the fragmented nature of current welfare governance. The motion emphasizes the necessity for a comprehensive political strategy to enhance the effectiveness of welfare services and promote collaboration among various stakeholders, including government authorities and civil society.

title: Dalslands vägnät
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of strengthening study and career guidance for students, arguing that effective guidance can reduce dropout rates in upper secondary education and improve students' connection to the labor market. It highlights that early exposure to career options and ongoing support throughout schooling are essential for informed decision-making about future educational paths. The motion calls for better prioritization and accessibility of guidance services in schools to ensure that all students receive adequate preparation for their future.

title: Djurvälfärd i praktiken
summary: Johan Andersson proposes the establishment of Ombergs nationalpark, emphasizing the area's significant natural, cultural, and scientific values, along with broad local support, particularly from Östergötland's county administration. The motion highlights that the state already owns the necessary land and suggests that the government should explore the potential for this area to achieve national park status.

title: Efterlevandeskydd
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should consider how society can take greater responsibility for ensuring that children learn to cycle and gain knowledge about traffic safety. It emphasizes the importance of cycling for public health and the need for community involvement, especially since many parents are unable to teach their children to cycle. The motion advocates for improved traffic safety around schools to encourage cycling as a safe mode of transportation for children.

title: Nolltolerans mot hederskultur och införandet av en nationell handlingsplan mot barnäktenskap
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament reviews and potentially changes the criteria for national interests regarding drinking water sources, to ensure that entire water extraction areas, such as lakes, can be protected from environmental threats. The current legislation only allows for protection of specific sites of water extraction, which does not adequately safeguard larger bodies of water used as drinking sources, like Lake Vättern. The motion highlights the increasing importance of Vättern and other lakes for water supply in various regions.

title: I händelse av krig blir det lätt att spara pengarna på kontot
summary: Åsa Karlsson's motion proposes that the transition between activity compensation and sickness compensation be secured to prevent individuals from falling through the cracks in the social security system. The motion emphasizes the need for clear definitions and processes to ensure those with disabilities or health conditions receive appropriate support without interruption, particularly when they age out of activity compensation at 30 years old.

title: Forum för levande historias utgångspunkt i Förintelsen och i kommunismens brott mot mänskliga rättigheter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2760 av Ann-Sofie Alm och Lotta Olsson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of including internet access as part of the reasonable living standard in the national norm for social assistance, emphasizing its necessity for distance education and work, as well as its importance in a digital society for accessing news and vital information. The motion highlights the challenges faced by asylum-seeking students and others without internet access, and argues for internet as a right within a democratic context.

title: Nationell samordning för att trygga människor och miljön runt Vänern och Göta älv
summary: The motion proposes a constitutional budget framework mandating that defense spending in Sweden should not fall below 2% of GDP, emphasizes the need for directives to strengthen both military and civil defense capabilities, and advocates for various enhancements including military education, recruitment, logistics, and international military collaborations. It addresses the necessity for a comprehensive total defense strategy that integrates civilian and military efforts to ensure national security amidst increasing geopolitical tensions.

title: Gulskimrande solnedgångar eller en effektiv tillsyn över svavelbestämmelserna
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of additional control stations for heavy vehicles in Södermanlands län as part of infrastructure planning. Citing the increasing number of truck transports and the importance of traffic safety, the motion highlights issues such as overloading and non-compliance with driving and resting times among some transport operators. It emphasizes that more control measures are vital to reduce violations and ensure adherence to stricter EU regulations on transport.

title: Nyttoeffekter av en upprustning av Bohusbanan
summary: This motion proposes a review of the regulations governing the right to temporary parental benefits for parents of adult children with developmental disabilities living at home. Currently, the right to these benefits is limited to children under 21 years old or 23 years for those attending special upper secondary school, which creates significant challenges when an adult child with a developmental disability falls ill. The motion seeks to extend the eligibility for parental benefits indefinitely until the child moves out of the parent's home, highlighting the need for support and compensation for parents caring for their adult children, especially in light of complications arising from the pandemic.

title: En nationell lotsfunktion för större företagsetableringar
summary: The proposal advocates for the promotion and preservation of local culinary experiences in Sörmland to strengthen tourism. It highlights the growing consumer interest in local and organic food and emphasizes the importance of collaboration among local food producers. The motion stresses the need for better support and development for local businesses to enhance meal tourism, bolster the food industry, and improve sustainability in food production. It aligns with the national strategy towards a sustainable food system and tourism sector, highlighting the significance of Sweden's culinary landscape as a key growth area.

title: En nationell flygstyrelse
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to support visa-free travel for the population of Kosovo, emphasizing the importance of this measure for increasing integration with the European Union and promoting stability in the Western Balkan region. It highlights that Kosovo is currently the only Western Balkan country without visa-free travel to the EU, which contributes to feelings of isolation among its youth. The motion references previous instances where the EU has granted visa-free status to other Balkan nations and argues that Kosovo has met the necessary criteria for such a policy change.

title: All blåljuspersonal ska ha tjänstemannastatus
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament study the possibility of introducing mandatory Building Information Modeling (BIM) requirements in Sweden for construction and infrastructure projects. The motion argues that BIM can improve collaboration among architects, engineers, and contractors, leading to enhanced efficiency and sustainability, as evidenced by successful implementations in other countries like the UK and Germany, which have reportedly achieved substantial cost savings and improved project completion rates.

title: Säkerhet för hund i bur
summary: The proposal advocates for the registration of Kosovo citizens as such in the Swedish population registry, reflecting Sweden's recognition of Kosovo as an independent state. The motion argues that current practices unfairly designate Kosovo citizens as Serbian nationals, disregarding their declared preference for Kosovo citizenship. It calls on the government to act to ensure proper registration.

title: Inför systemet Amber Alert i Sverige för att rädda barns liv
summary: The proposal calls for a review of payment routines in the public sector to ensure timely payment of invoices by the state, regions, and municipalities, especially towards small businesses, which often struggle with liquidity issues. It highlights past failures during the financial crisis when payments were delayed, causing many small companies to go bankrupt. The motion advocates for the government to set a standard for prompt payment and suggests that a general overhaul of payment regulations in the business sector should also be considered, urging for shortened payment times facilitated by digitalization.

title: En trygg demokrati
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider a review of the fees paid into the Crime Victims' Fund by offenders. Currently, individuals convicted of crimes that carry a prison sentence are required to pay an 800 kronor fee, while those serving sentences under electronic monitoring pay a daily fee of 80 kronor, capped at 9,600 kronor. The fund, managed by the Swedish Crime Victim Authority, finances research and projects aimed at improving support for victims of crime. The motion emphasizes the importance of enhancing the fund's work to provide better support for both victims and witnesses during and after legal proceedings.

title: Strandskyddet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government considers measures to preserve and develop the vallonbruken, highlighting their historical significance and potential for future cultural and tourism initiatives. The motion emphasizes the importance of these historical sites, not only for their aesthetic value but also as vital parts of Sweden's economic and social history, advocating for their restoration and broader utilization for educational and tourism purposes.

title: Åtgärder för nationellt strandstädningsansvar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider implementing a requirement for buses to have access to child safety seats, particularly for infants and toddlers, who are currently not adequately protected during transit. The motion emphasizes the need for enhanced safety measures for young children, citing existing risks in accidents and the lack of legislated protection during bus travel. It references a successful implementation in Örebro where built-in child seats have improved safety without sacrificing seating capacity.

title: Vildsvin passar bäst på grillen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider establishing a national strategy to increase the number of women in engineering professions to achieve a more balanced gender representation. It highlights the ongoing gender disparity in engineering fields, the potential economic impact of underutilizing female talent, and the importance of fostering a diverse engineering workforce for Sweden's innovation and competitive edge.

title: Minska den svenska vargstammen
summary: The motion proposes a review of the current regulations regarding the right to appeal construction projects in municipalities that do not directly affect the appellant. It argues that the existing widespread rights to appeal, particularly by organizations from other municipalities, hinder the construction of much-needed housing and extend planning processes unnecessarily. The motion calls on the government to consider limiting appeals to only those who are directly affected or at least to residents of the municipality where the construction is proposed.

title: Apotek och läkemedel – en självklar del av hälso- och sjukvårdskedjan
summary: The motion advocates for a more equitable distribution of higher education programs and places, emphasizing the importance of regional considerations. It argues that geographic access to education is vital for narrowing educational disparities, which are linked to socio-economic issues, health outcomes, and regional development. The motion suggests that improving access to local higher education institutions and learning centers can enhance educational attainment and meet the workforce needs of various regions, ultimately contributing to regional growth and sustainability.

title: En folkhälsopolitik att lita på
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a sustainable and efficient transportation system in Sweden, addressing the slow reduction of emissions from the transport sector, the need to phase out fossil fuels by 2035, and the enhancement of rail and public transport infrastructure. It emphasizes the importance of urban planning that fosters accessibility to various functions without reliance on cars and calls for increased governmental funding for transport initiatives, dynamic congestion taxes, and a shift towards a kilometer-based road tax system. The proposal also suggests that transport planning should prioritize sustainability and considers collaboration among different levels of government.

title: Obetalda böter ska omvandlas till andra straff
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support increased infrastructure investments in Blekinge County, considering its strategic geographical position for trade with Eastern Europe and beyond. It emphasizes the need for a national strategy to enhance regional infrastructure, which is vital for economic growth and connectivity in the context of growing international trade. The authors advocate for continuous infrastructure planning and the completion of already decided projects while highlighting the importance of connecting Blekinge's ports to European transport corridors to boost trade opportunities.

title: Gränslöst skydd mot nättrakasserier
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of higher penalties for speeding in construction zones in Sweden, citing the annual occurrence of at least 300 accidents resulting in injuries or fatalities, particularly affecting vulnerable road users like pedestrians and cyclists. The motion highlights the inadequacy of current safety measures for road workers and argues that increasing fines for speeding in these areas, similar to practices in Canada, would help reduce speeds and consequently decrease accidents and fatalities related to road work.

title: Återinför tunnelbanepolisen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should commit to integrating a greater proportion of bicycle paths in the infrastructure planning of all major roads in Sweden. It builds on the existing national bicycle strategy, advocating for higher prioritization of bicycles over cars, especially in urban areas, to promote environmental sustainability and public health. The motion calls for investigations to implement bicycle paths alongside road constructions and to ensure that cycling access is maintained on newly constructed and renovated roads. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of cycling for tourism and suggests ambitious targets for the percentage of roads with bicycle paths by 2025, 2030, and 2040.

title: Ge kommuner och regioner ökade befogenheter gällande ordningsvakter
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of regulating the marketing of unhealthy foods, citing evidence that such foods are significant contributors to lifestyle diseases among both adults and children. The motion references successful regulations in countries like Chile and Canada, highlighting the need for clearer guidelines and stricter enforcement compared to existing voluntary measures, particularly in the context of marketing directed at children.

title: Krav på medlemsavgift för att motverka fusk med statliga bidrag till barn- och ungdomsorganisationer från MUCF
summary: The motion proposes to review and potentially amend the school law to empower political parties and youth organizations to visit schools, which is currently restricted by school principals. It emphasizes the importance of allowing students to engage with political entities as a means of enhancing their understanding of democracy and political processes. The motion advocates for clarifying students' rights to freedom of association and calls for the Swedish National Agency for Education to provide guidance on students' rights to politically organize.

title: Folkbildningsrådet
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the National Board of Housing, Building and Planning (Boverket) to develop guidance for municipalities to ensure the availability of sports facilities in or near residential areas. The motion emphasizes the positive societal impacts of sports, including benefits to public health, community integration, and social cohesion. It expresses concerns about the ongoing housing developments that neglect sports facilities and calls for a strategic partnership to prioritize and incorporate sports areas in urban planning.

title: Sänkt skatt på tjänstepension för ett ökat respektavstånd
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for secure employment conditions in the elderly care sector in Sweden, highlighting the challenges faced during the COVID-19 pandemic that exacerbated existing issues. It advocates for enhanced welfare standards, including a permanent increase in resources for elderly care, better working conditions, and professional development opportunities for staff. The motion calls for reforms to ensure that elderly individuals receive high-quality care and that the workforce is stable and adequately trained.

title: Reformering av socialtjänstlagen
summary: The proposal advocates for the removal of the requirement of double criminality for purchasing sexual services abroad, arguing that it is essential to combat sexual exploitation and promote gender equality. It emphasizes that men often purchase sex overseas, undermining efforts to deter such actions within Sweden. The motion highlights the need for Swedish law to apply equally to sexual purchases, regardless of location, to hold offenders accountable and protect vulnerable individuals from exploitation and human trafficking.

title: Vuxenutbildningen är nyckeln till en fungerande integration
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2736 av Josefin Malmqvist och Niklas Wykman (båda M)
summary: The motion advocates for increasing equality in the Swedish school system by reducing school segregation, considering a more equitable school choice, and ensuring professional development for teachers and school leaders. It emphasizes the importance of providing all children, regardless of their background, with good educational opportunities to foster a stronger society. The authors highlight the current disparities in educational achievement influenced by family background and propose measures to create a more inclusive and fair system, while addressing the negative impacts of the current school choice model introduced in the 1990s.

title: Nationellt minoritetsspråk i skolan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2735 av Annika Hirvonen Falk och Camilla Hansén (båda MP)
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to increase funding for Högskolan Väst to bolster higher education and research in Sweden, as the future workforce demands highly educated personnel. It highlights the successful applicant rates and the school's efforts to address social inequalities in education. The motion calls for the government to review the distribution of research funding to ensure that Högskolan Väst, along with similarly positioned institutions, receives adequate resources to attach research to their educational offerings, thereby securing its role as a vital contributor to regional and national growth.

title: Natur, friluftsliv och rörelse i skolan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2734 av Annika Hirvonen Falk m.fl. (MP)
summary: Ola Möller proposes that the Swedish model and knowledge about it should be integrated throughout the educational curriculum to enhance understanding among citizens. He argues that awareness of the collective bargaining system, the lack of a legal minimum wage, and the impact of the Swedish model on equality and welfare is limited. The proposal emphasizes the importance of teaching how the Swedish labor market is organized and the role of collective agreements, suggesting that this knowledge should be presented alongside entrepreneurial education in schools.

title: Sovmorgon till fler
summary: The motion proposes a revision of the Work Environment Act to ensure that all employees in the preschool sector receive appropriate work clothing. It highlights the current lack of access to work clothes, which contributes to gender inequality in traditionally female-dominated professions. The suggestion emphasizes the importance of proper work attire for health, safety, and professional recognition, as well as the necessity to combat infection risks in preschool environments. The motion advocates for employers to provide suitable work clothing and to improve the work environment for preschool workers, arguing that the cost should not fall on the employees themselves.

title: Naturen är värd att skydda
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2732 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion proposes a review and reinstatement of tax deductions for union fees, which were removed for employees in 2019. The author argues that allowing employees to deduct their union fees is a matter of fairness, as employers still benefit from similar deductions for their membership in employer organizations. The motion aims to promote equity on the Swedish labor market.

title: Sverige bör ta initiativ till Ekocidlagstiftning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2731 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP, S)
summary: The motion advocates for enhanced employment security in Sweden, highlighting the challenges faced by temporary workers, particularly in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the need for stable employment to improve individual financial security, ensure access to social benefits, and enhance the quality of public welfare services. The authors argue that a lack of permanent positions undermines the competence and health of the workforce, therefore urging the government to take action to increase the number of secure jobs.

title: Sveaskog – svenska folkets skog – inom planetens gränser
summary: The motion proposes changes to the Swedish sickness insurance system to enhance its flexibility and ensure support for individuals who are sick and unable to work. The main suggestions include assessing a person's work capacity based on their employment situation after 90 days of reduced ability, and allowing partial sick pay arrangements that consider different working hour adjustments to aid the return to work. The goal is to create a more comprehensible and secure sickness insurance that supports reintegration into the workforce.

title: Cirkulär ekonomi
summary: The proposal advocates for a clear and secure sickness insurance system in Sweden, emphasizing that social insurance should provide support during times of health crises. It highlights the importance of having a reliable system that protects individuals, especially those with disabilities or in high-risk jobs, from the need for private insurance. The motion suggests specific changes to improve the assessment of work capacity, ensuring that the insurance supports quick rehabilitation and provides economic security for sick individuals.

title: Mediernas frihet och oberoende – en förutsättning för levande demokrati
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish parliament to consider the need for clearer guidance and increased monitoring in the efforts to combat bullying and harassment in schools. It highlights the responsibility of the state to ensure that children have a safe and secure school environment, referencing ongoing issues of bullying that lead to significant distress among students. The motion criticizes the current effectiveness of school authorities and the School Inspectorate, suggesting that they have failed in their duties and need more explicit direction and oversight to address these issues.

title: Social rättvisa
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for continuous skills development within the industry to secure Sweden's economic development and welfare. It highlights the importance of qualified workforce as Sweden competes not on low wages but on high competence. The motion calls for the government to explore opportunities to enhance ongoing training and education for workers to meet the demands of evolving technologies and organizational changes, as well as compensating those negatively affected by structural transformations.

title: Lär av Malmö
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2726 av Karolina Skog och Johanna Öfverbeck (båda MP)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to extend the state funding reform for free admission to state museums to include regional museums across the country. It argues that the current success of free entry at state museums has increased visitor numbers significantly and enhanced cultural access, particularly among young adults and first-time visitors. The motion emphasizes the need for equitable cultural access throughout Sweden, as most state museums are located in Stockholm, leaving many citizens without the same opportunities. Extending this reform to regional museums is seen as a way to promote cultural understanding, integration, and tourism, while also improving the overall quality of life.

title: En flexiblare elmarknad
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2725 av Lorentz Tovatt och Janine Alm Ericson (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes improvements to the quality assurance of the Swedish Social Insurance Agency's (Försäkringskassan) operations, highlighting issues faced by individuals, particularly women, who encounter difficulties in obtaining sick pay due to bureaucratic challenges and inadequate assessments. It calls for the government to enhance digital communication, involve independent assessments in compensation claims, and ensure equitable handling of cases, ultimately aiming to improve the experience for clients and efficiency for the agency.

title: Snabba på energieffektiviseringen
summary: The motion proposes the exploration of long-term measures for the improvement of elderly care and support for its personnel, emphasizing the need for a high-quality care system for the elderly, who have contributed significantly to Swedish society.
