It emphasizes the industry's critical role in the economy and outlines several key areas for investigation, including energy supply, regulatory burdens, infrastructure needs, and education and skills training. The motion calls for inclusive participation from all political parties in crafting a comprehensive and sustainable industrial strategy that addresses the challenges of a changing global market.

title: När det är samhällsekonomiskt lönsamt ska bro byggas och ersätta färja
summary: The proposal by Mattias Bäckström Johansson and others from the Sweden Democrats (SD) calls for the Swedish government to take action regarding Telia Company AB by splitting it into two separate entities: one for critical infrastructure and another for telecommunications operations. The motion criticizes the state's indirect ownership of television channels through Telia and raises concerns about the perception of state control over media, which could undermine democratic values. The motion urges the government to expedite this division and to authorize the sale of the telecommunications segment.

title: Bonus–malus och WLTP
summary: The proposal suggests splitting Svenska Spel AB into two separate companies: one for competitive gaming forms and another for monopolistic gaming forms. Additionally, it calls for the government to divest its stake in the segment of Svenska Spel that operates in the competitive market. This shift aims to modernize the state gambling policy and enhance regulation while ensuring consumer protection and public health.

title: Flerbarnstillägg
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Institute (SI) be mandated to develop an action plan to better utilize its network of foreign scholarship holders, which includes future leaders in their home countries. It emphasizes the importance of prioritizing countries that would benefit most from leadership programs and enhancing trade relations with Sweden. Additionally, the motion suggests increasing partnerships similar to the 'SHE Leads' program and addressing the negative narratives about Sweden abroad without taking a political stance on the perceptions of Sweden in other countries.

title: Stoppa olagliga körkort
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2592 av Sofia Westergren och Camilla Waltersson Grönvall (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for strengthened conditions for life sciences in Sweden, calling for targeted innovation funding to improve accessibility in healthcare, enhanced administrative digitalization, a new biobank law, a national coordination function for resource distribution in medical innovation, and regulatory simplifications to foster competitiveness. It emphasizes the importance of integrating clinical development into healthcare and supporting Swedish companies in a global market.

title: Positionering vid samtal till 112
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at enhancing security for shop owners in Sweden, responding to a rising trend of thefts and violence directed at retailers. Key proposals include imposing business bans on those dealing in stolen goods, reinforcing the work of the Customs Agency to combat organized crime, simplifying the process for permitting surveillance cameras in stores, implementing entry bans for repeat offenders, and initiating an investigation to strengthen overall safety for shop owners. The motion argues that the current state of crime has led to feelings of helplessness among shopkeepers, particularly in areas identified as socially vulnerable.

title: Yrkeskompetensbevis för seniora förare
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2590 av Sofia Westergren och Camilla Waltersson Grönvall (båda M)
summary: The suggestion advocates for the continuation of state ownership in crucial societal functions to maintain government influence and ensure that national resources benefit Swedish citizens. It expresses opposition to the government's current gender sustainability target of having at least 40 percent of each gender in state-owned company boards, arguing that such quotas constitute negative discrimination and undermine individual merit-based evaluation.

title: Kännbara straff för nedskräpning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2589 av Sofia Westergren och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The proposal seeks to extend the time allowed for paid leave to pursue entrepreneurial activities from six to at least twelve months and to establish a program offering startup grants to currently employed individuals with innovative business ideas. This initiative is aimed at enhancing Sweden's business climate and encouraging more individuals to start companies by providing financial support similar to unemployment benefits, while also imposing high standards for eligibility based on the potential for growth and innovation.

title: Strandstädning
summary: The proposal suggests the Swedish parliament support a review of the financial targets set for SJ AB, advocating for a reduction in the profitability requirements in order to enhance the operation and accessibility of train services across Sweden. The motion emphasizes the importance of reliable and high-quality train services to encourage public transport usage and reduce greenhouse gas emissions, while also highlighting the need for SJ AB to provide services in areas where other operators do not find profitability.

title: Sjösäkerhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government develop a national strategy for the establishment of data centers in Sweden, emphasizing the country's competitive advantages such as its cold climate, skilled workforce, and strong IT infrastructure. It also calls for the reintroduction of energy tax refunds for data centers regardless of equipment ownership, arguing that previous changes in tax refunds have led to financial difficulties for many server hall businesses, threatening future investment and job opportunities in this sector.

title: Fler och bättre bostäder för seniorer
summary: This motion proposes measures to promote sustainable regional growth in Sweden by increasing regional revenue through the regionalization of property taxes on industrial properties, improving infrastructure, enhancing citizen services, and ensuring access to high-speed internet across all regions. It emphasizes the role of local businesses, the importance of reliable transportation, and the need for governmental support for rural areas facing challenges such as depopulation and urbanization.

title: Öppna fibernäten för alla
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes several measures aimed at reducing bureaucracy and regulatory burdens for Swedish businesses. Key suggestions include relocating the Regulatory Council to the Prime Minister's Office, streamlining government and administrative efforts towards regulatory simplification, and implementing a stop function for regulations lacking thorough impact assessments. Additionally, it calls for the identification of costly administrative processes, the establishment of an implementation council akin to Denmark's, and the investigation of after-the-fact billing for supervisory fees. These reforms are seen as necessary to enhance competitiveness and promote business growth in the face of existing administrative challenges.

title: Den akuta effektbristen i Skåne
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should investigate the economic and legal consequences of splitting Postnord AB into separate entities. It highlights issues faced by Postnord since its formation, such as financial losses due to declining letter volumes and challenges posed by digitalization. The motion suggests that a similar inquiry has already been initiated in Denmark, indicating the need for Sweden to assess different pathways forward amidst varying regulations and digitalization stages.

title: Värna det försvarshistoriska arvet i Göteborg
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2583 av Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström och David Josefsson (båda M)
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the importance of a market-liberal and trade-oriented approach to industrial policy. It advocates for creating a favorable business climate for companies, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises, to thrive and innovate in Sweden. The proposal includes measures to simplify regulations, improve energy availability, lower taxes to enhance competitiveness, support capital funding for growing businesses, and focus on education to ensure access to skilled labor. Additionally, it highlights the need for infrastructure improvements and promotes free trade as crucial for Sweden's economic growth.

title: Jämställd idrottssponsring
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive revision of Sweden's mineral policy to enhance the competitiveness of the mining industry. It recommends strengthening infrastructure, ensuring stable energy supply, promoting education related to mining, and reforming mineral compensation among other initiatives. The motion argues for the need to balance interests of various stakeholders while addressing increasing demand for minerals driven by technological advancements and economic growth. It also highlights the importance of a robust legislative framework to support mining activities, including the controversial topic of uranium extraction.

title: Förbättrad svensk läkemedelsberedskap
summary: The motion focuses on improving conditions for rural areas in Sweden, advocating for a reduction in fuel taxes, an evaluation of speed limits, enhancements in transportation infrastructure, better access to broadband, support for local education, and measures to sustain small local businesses. It emphasizes the necessity for government measures to bolster rural development and ensure equitable living conditions throughout the country.

title: Rörelseglädje i skolan och dess utemiljö
summary: The proposal aims to establish a government-managed warning list for fraudulent invoices to assist businesses in identifying and contesting such invoices, which have become a widespread issue affecting companies, particularly small and micro-enterprises. It calls for increased support for businesses in disputing incorrect invoices and emphasizes the need for government action in response to the ongoing problem of invoicing fraud, which has reportedly not been adequately addressed since a 2015 investigation on the topic.

title: IB-elevers rättigheter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2579 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall och Ulrika Heindorff (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government initiate the divestment of Lernia AB, a fully state-owned company involved in staffing, education, and labor matching, as it is argued that its continued state ownership distorts market competition and lacks a clear public benefit. The motion highlights previous financial struggles of the company, suggests that it has no societal mission, and notes the existing mandate from the parliament for its complete sale, which has yet to be acted upon.

title: Förstärk livsmedelsstrategin
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2578 av Ulrika Heindorff och Annicka Engblom (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should instruct the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency to establish 'end of waste' criteria for used tires. This measure aims to facilitate the recycling and repurposing of tire material, which currently faces limitations due to its classification as waste in Sweden, unlike in several other European countries. By creating such criteria, used tire material could be innovatively used in construction and infrastructure projects, leading to environmental benefits and job creation in the face of economic challenges following the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Registrering och id-märkning av katter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2577 av Ulrika Heindorff och Annicka Engblom (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a new investigation into the fate of Raoul Wallenberg, a Swedish diplomat who played a crucial role in saving thousands during World War II. The author emphasizes the significance of Wallenberg's actions and the mystery surrounding his disappearance after being detained by Soviet authorities. The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to endorse the need for this investigation and urges the government to take action to clarify what happened to Wallenberg, asserting that the lack of clear answers remains a national shame.

title: Färdigställ Västkustbanan
summary: The motion proposes the reintroduction of civil servant accountability in Sweden, arguing that recent political activism among government employees undermines democratic processes and erodes public trust. The authors highlight various instances where officials have acted contrary to politically decided guidelines, potentially jeopardizing the integrity of public administration. They stress the importance of restoring the non-partisan civil service ideal to ensure that decisions are made objectively, without personal agendas interfering.

title: En skärpt biståndspolitik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognizes Jerusalem as the capital of Israel, citing the city's historical and religious significance to the Jewish people, as well as its central role in Jewish identity and culture. The proponents argue that recognition aligns with actions taken by several other nations, including the USA and Australia.

title: En familjevänlig barnomsorg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews or terminates the mutual legal assistance agreement with Hong Kong in criminal matters due to concerns that the legal system in Hong Kong has become subject to Chinese control and no longer upholds democratic values. The motion argues that Sweden should not be complicit in potential abuses of power by the Chinese government against pro-democracy activists in Hong Kong.

title: Barn som olovligen förs ut ur Sverige
summary: Sverigedemokraterna propose that Sweden's foreign policy should prioritize the United Nations (UN) as a central mechanism for international cooperation, emphasizing higher standards for countries leading UN work, and ensuring that EU institutions do not represent Sweden in the UN. The motion also advocates for enhanced efforts against corruption both internally and externally within the UN, alongside recommendations for regular evaluations of Sweden's work on the 2030 Agenda. It reflects on the importance of human rights enforcement and suggests reforms to improve transparency and accountability within the UN system.

title: Effektiv klimatpolitik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2572 av John Weinerhall och Viktor Wärnick (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should revoke its recognition of Palestine, express that a Palestinian leadership including Hamas is not considered legitimate, and impose conditions on aid to the Palestinian Authority. The motion also advocates formally recognizing Jerusalem as Israel's capital and relocating the Swedish embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. The proponents argue that the previous recognition was hasty and lacking parliamentary support, emphasizing the need for both parties in the Israel-Palestine conflict to engage in negotiations for lasting peace.

title: Sänkt bensin- och dieselskatt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the termination of pre-membership aid to Turkey, halt accession negotiations with Turkey, and call for the EU to produce a new corruption report. It emphasizes concerns about Turkey's stability and democratic situation, advocating for reduced EU funding for member states implicated in fraud against the EU budget. The motion argues that the current state of EU anti-corruption efforts is inadequate and calls for measures to enhance accountability in the use of EU funds.

title: En pension att kunna leva på
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament formally recognize the genocide of various minorities in the Ottoman Empire in 1915, the Islamic State's terror campaign in Iraq and Syria as genocide, and the forced famine in Ukraine from 1932-1933 as genocide. It argues that recognizing these events is a necessary step for Sweden to uphold its values regarding human rights and historical accountability, asserting that previous governments have failed to act on earlier parliamentary resolutions supporting these recognitions.

title: Stoppa falskskrivna bilar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2569 av John Weinerhall och Viktor Wärnick (båda M)
summary: The suggestion proposes the establishment of a Swedish Magnitsky law, which would impose sanctions on individuals responsible for human rights violations, similar to legislation already adopted by several countries. The proposal emphasizes the urgency of implementing such a law in Sweden to hold accountable those involved in serious human rights abuses and corruption, in light of ongoing issues in countries like Belarus. It aims to prevent corruption by imposing personal sanctions without adversely affecting the general populace.

title: Ett fritt och självständigt Tibet
summary: The motion submitted by Fredrik Lindahl and others from the Sweden Democrats addresses several electoral reform suggestions aimed at strengthening the democratic and parliamentary processes in Sweden. Key proposals include enhancing the significance of citizenship in elections, introducing a common ballot system, implementing machine reading of ballots, enforcing ID checks at polling stations, establishing national guidelines for election informants, and prohibiting political propaganda near polling places. These recommendations aim to improve electoral integrity, transparency, and public trust in the voting process.

title: Omkörningsförbud för tung trafik
summary: The motion proposes several reforms aimed at strengthening parliamentary democracy in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a clearer process for the distribution of parliamentary positions, the introduction of a time limit for government formation, and the restoration of the monarch's role in appointing the government. It argues that these changes would enhance transparency and reflect electoral results more accurately in decision-making processes.

title: Skattefrihet för arbetsgivarbetalda sjukvårdsförsäkringar
summary: The suggestion emphasizes the importance of restoring local self-governance in Sweden, which has been undermined by EU membership. It proposes reforms to ensure clearer regulations against political discrimination in municipal jobs, enhance the opposition's oversight in financial matters, and improve the structures around municipal referendums and minority protections. Additional reforms are suggested for managing political representatives to increase accountability and transparency within local governance.

title: Anpassad kapitalvinstbeskattning på bostäder
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2565 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes stronger mechanisms for accountability of government officials, including a mandate for ministers and other officials to appear before the Constitution Committee under penalty of sanction, an obligation to tell the truth during proceedings, and guidelines for holding the government accountable for actions taken by appointed national coordinators. The intent is to ensure greater transparency and responsibility among public officials, deter political misuse of complaint processes, and clarify accountability when delegation of authority occurs.

title: Motverka ensamhet och psykisk ohälsa bland äldre
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2564 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm (båda M)

title: Boende för det goda livet för Sveriges äldre
summary: The suggestion proposes several administrative reforms aimed at increasing the efficiency of Swedish public authorities and enhancing accountability. Key proposals include implementing a comprehensive civil servant responsibility, conducting an inventory of existing authorities to eliminate those deemed unnecessary, abolishing the Gender Equality Agency, and reviewing the legal status of the Bar Association. Additionally, it calls for a renewed review of the Administrative Procedure Act and limits on the right to translation and interpretation services for long-term residents.

title: Öka mandat och ansvar för landets science centers
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2562 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Malin Höglund (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to initiate negotiations to establish a framework for diplomatic guarantees regarding humane treatment, emulating the British model. This is aimed at addressing challenges related to the repatriation of suspected and convicted terrorists, particularly those connected to ISIS, and ensuring compliance with international law to avoid torture or capital punishment upon their return to their home countries.

title: Bättre villkor för seniorer på arbetsmarknaden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2561 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Lotta Finstorp (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate regular external international evaluations of Sweden's implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. The aim is to ensure accountability and effectiveness in Sweden's global development efforts, particularly in comparison to similar countries. The motion emphasizes the importance of continuous assessment in light of the changing governmental policies since the adoption of the joint responsibility for global development policy in 2003.

title: Valfrihet och jämförelser i äldreomsorgen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2560 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm (båda M)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to support the termination of the political dialogue and cooperation agreement between the EU and Cuba (PDCA), arguing that the agreement legitimizes the undemocratic Cuban regime while excluding political opposition from discussions. It emphasizes the lack of demands for change from Cuba and criticizes the previous ratification as a betrayal of the Cuban opposition, particularly in light of increasing governmental pressure on civil society.

title: Mer flexibilitet och bättre information kring val av tjänstepensionsuttag
summary: The motion presented by Markus Wiechel and others (SD) seeks to officially recognize Taiwan as an independent country rather than a province of China. It calls for the Swedish government to advocate for Taiwan's participation in the UN, expand bilateral cooperation, broaden the mandate of Business Sweden in Taipei, and work towards a free trade agreement between the EU and Taiwan. The proposers emphasize shared values such as democracy and human rights, and argue for Taiwan's importance as a significant global trade actor.

title: Nationella kvalitetsgränser och statlig tillsyn inom äldreomsorgen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2558 av Ann-Britt Åsebol och Elisabeth Björnsdotter Rahm (båda M)
summary: The suggestion calls for Sweden to establish a defensive defense alliance with Finland while maintaining military non-alignment with NATO and major power alliances. It emphasizes enhancing Nordic defense cooperation through NORDEFCO, participation in international operations under UN and OSCE mandates, the establishment of a domestic arms industry, and measures to combat international terrorism. Furthermore, the proposal includes strengthening the military's role in supporting law enforcement during major terror attacks and addressing violence in especially vulnerable areas, with a focus on national security and increasing Sweden's food self-sufficiency.

title: Mer idrott och hälsa i grundskolan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2557 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall och Ulrika Heindorff (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament urges the government to develop a clearer regional strategy for the Syria crisis, implement control mechanisms to ensure the suitability of organizations receiving international aid, cease support for organizations linked to extremism like Islamic Relief, and advocate for a review of sanctions against Syria to alleviate humanitarian suffering. The suggestions emphasize the importance of supporting civilians and ensuring any aid does not inadvertently support extremist factions or worsen the conflict.

title: Uranbrytning i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2556 av John Weinerhall och Viktor Wärnick (båda M)
summary: The proposal emphasizes Sweden's active engagement in the Council of Europe to uphold individual rights including political expression and union membership, combat rising antisemitism, press Turkey to adhere to fundamental values, advocate for Somaliland's partnership in democracy, prevent sharia-inspired legislation in Europe, and demand independent scrutiny of the European Court of Human Rights to mitigate corruption allegations. The motion calls for the Swedish government's rigorous defense of democratic principles and human rights both domestically and in international contexts.

title: Kostnadstak för veterinärvård
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support initiatives to promote women's and girls' rights globally and to condemn the oppression of women in totalitarian states, especially Islamist regimes. It suggests utilizing diplomatic tools to advocate for women's rights in countries like Iran and Palestine, including the revocation of diplomatic recognition of Palestine and cutting aid to its authority until human rights standards are met. Additionally, the motion emphasizes addressing issues such as forced marriages, female genital mutilation, and access to education for girls, highlighting the urgent need for a foreign policy focused on combating all forms of violence and oppression against women.

title: Sverigevänlig skatte- och indrivningspolitik för välfärd, trygghet och företagande
summary: The motion proposes Sweden's recognition of Somaliland as an independent state, contingent upon improvements in religious freedom. It includes establishing an embassy in Hargeysa, fostering collaborations between Swedish and Somaliland authorities, revising travel advisories for Somaliland, prioritizing Somaliland's economic relations through Business Sweden, and supporting the Somaliland Development Fund to enhance the region's stability and growth.

title: Arbetskraftsinvandring
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2553 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the government in providing temporary assistance to the Somali regions of Puntland and Galmudug, adapt Somalia's democratic model to its clan structure, establish independent service authorities to facilitate aid, and create regulations for security service providers to prevent funds from reaching terrorists and promote a legitimate economy.

title: Krafttag mot illegal migration för ett säkrare Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2552 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå m.fl. (SD)
summary: This proposal from the Sweden Democrats calls on the government to strengthen EU sanctions against Russia unless the situation for vulnerable groups improves significantly. It emphasizes the need to protect opposition politicians and journalists in Russia, opposes international disarmament agreements that favor Russia, and advocates for support to independent countries considered part of Russia's sphere of influence, while also aiming to prevent the expansion of this sphere near Sweden.

title: Sverigedemokraternas biståndspolitik
summary: This parliamentary motion emphasizes the importance of prioritizing social and economic rights in foreign policy regarding development countries, enhancing support for women's development, and addressing issues like gender-based violence, human trafficking, and the rights of children and minorities. It advocates for Sweden to align its efforts with international human rights standards, including the reduction of gender-selective abortion and increased attention to the rights of vulnerable populations.

title: Särskild valkrets för utlandssvenskar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2550 av Lars Andersson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to recognize an independent Kurdistan in Northern Iraq and advocate for greater autonomy for Kurdish regions in Syria, Turkey, and Iran. It emphasizes the need to respect the human rights of Kurds in these areas, provide support for Kurdish-majority regions, and protect the identity of the inhabitants of the Nineveh Plains in Iraq. The motion also seeks Swedish aid to rebuild the Nineveh plains and support self-defense forces in the area.

title: Reglering av sjukvård och försäkringar för utlandssvenskar boende utanför EU/EES och Schweiz
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2549 av Lars Andersson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes various measures aimed at improving state risk capital financing to support small and newly established growth companies. Key suggestions include prioritizing funding for these enterprises, establishing a special loan fund for depopulated areas, enhancing the conditions for employee stock options, investigating the possibility for legal entities to benefit from investment deductions, and restoring previous tax rules for investment savings accounts. The overarching goal is to stimulate investments in small businesses and ensure a fair competitive environment, with particular attention to the challenges faced by companies in rural areas.

title: Förnyelse av svenska körkort i utlandet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2548 av Lars Andersson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The committee motion SD35, presented by Josef Fransson and others from the Sweden Democrats, advocates for the modernization of copyright laws in response to challenges posed by the digital society. It calls for the government to investigate broader exemptions in copyright regulations, evaluate current protection periods, facilitate legal access to copyrighted works, and ensure the maintenance of free expression while combating copyright infringement. The motion emphasizes the need for a balanced approach that protects creators' rights and supports the free exchange of information online.

title: E-röstning från utlandet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2547 av Lars Andersson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes stricter regulations regarding the trade of scrap metal to combat theft and illegal activities. It includes suggestions for a cash ban in transactions, mandatory traceability for purchases, a licensing requirement for scrap dealers, and increased penalties for dealing with stolen scrap metal. The aim is to address the significant societal and economic impact of metal theft affecting various sectors, including railways and churches, while enhancing law enforcement's ability to trace and prosecute such crimes.

title: Bevara utlandssvenskars folkbokföring i det statliga personadressregistret SPAR
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2546 av Lars Andersson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should work towards abolishing the European Union's export ban on Swedish snus. The authors argue that Sweden should promote alternatives to smoking, given the low rates of tobacco-related deaths in the country attributed to snus usage. They contend that the ban is incompatible with the principles of the EU's internal market, lacks compelling arguments for its maintenance, and imposes significant economic costs on Sweden, leading to lost export revenues and potential job losses. They advocate for equal conditions across the EU for snus sales and production.

title: Dawit Isaak – undersökningskommission
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2545 av Amineh Kakabaveh m.fl. (-, M, C, L, MP, KD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a national council comprising expert advisors to focus on exponential technologies and other significant technological areas. It highlights the rapid development of information-based technologies and their potential to address human needs in various sectors such as healthcare, education, and sustainable resources. The suggestion emphasizes the importance of a coordinated approach to these technologies to maintain Sweden's leadership in this field.

title: Turisttrafik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2544 av Per Åsling och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion advocates for a growth-oriented policy for Sweden's industrial sector, emphasizing the need to reform energy policy, enhance investment incentives for individuals in small businesses, and support targeted investments in depopulated areas. It calls for intensified efforts in education, particularly in science and engineering, while promoting measures for skills development and international recruitment. The motion also highlights the importance of prioritizing industrial needs in infrastructure planning, addressing tax reform for improved competitiveness, and simplifying legislation and regulations to facilitate business operations.

title: Bättre förutsättningar för fjällräddarna
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament adopts a comprehensive energy policy aimed at ensuring a long-term competitive and reliable energy supply. Key proposals include establishing a goal for completely fossil-free electricity production by 2040, enhancing energy efficiency to be 50% better by 2030 compared to 2005 levels, and promoting various energy sources such as water power, nuclear power, and renewable sources while ensuring environmental considerations are balanced with energy production interests.

title: Kontinuerlig varumärkesvård, uppförandekod och goda kund- och medborgarrelationer för statliga bolag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2542 av Per Åsling och Anne-Li Sjölund (båda C)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a proactive trade policy to enhance Sweden's economic growth and competitive edge in global markets. It advocates for a comprehensive review of competition policies, the promotion of non-distorting trade practices, and strong support for free trade agreements that prioritize Sweden's interests. Additionally, the motion calls for the government to focus on improving export capabilities, reduce import barriers, and ensure that trade agreements incorporate social and environmental standards. The overarching goal is to strengthen Sweden's position in international trade while mitigating the effects of protectionism.

title: Värdepapperisering av svenska försäkringsrisker
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2541 av Per Åsling och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of prioritizing the Swedish steel industry in energy policy, advocating for improved infrastructure planning that caters to industrial needs, enhancing educational initiatives related to metallurgy, and increasing funding for metallurgical research and development. It highlights the steel industry’s significant contribution to the economy through exports and stresses the need for stable energy supplies and robust transport systems to maintain competitiveness in the global market.

title: Inlandsbanan
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the chemical tax implemented in Sweden, arguing that it imposes excessive administrative burdens and negatively impacts the competitiveness of Swedish businesses. The authors suggest that the tax does not effectively reduce exposure to harmful chemicals and propose that the government should instead develop a new strategy to tackle potentially hazardous chemicals, in collaboration with other countries and in alignment with EU regulations.

title: Minskad saltanvändning på vägar med vinterväglag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2539 av Per Åsling och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive program for enhancing women's safety in various environments, particularly by increasing police presence, providing specialized training, and implementing additional security measures. Key recommendations include hiring more civilian staff for police, establishing a national action plan to identify unsafe areas, ensuring effective outdoor lighting, and setting stricter accountability for workplaces regarding safety against gender-based violence. The motion also addresses the need for special provisions in handling sexual crimes, particularly in professional contexts, as well as educational provisions for students involved in criminal activities to guarantee a safer educational environment.

title: Utveckling av Jämtlands län
summary: The motion addresses men's violence against women and violence in close relationships, proposing a series of measures to prevent and punish such violence. It calls for a zero-vision approach targeting women's violence, the establishment of a commission for every case of deadly violence against women, a national help line for perpetrators seeking to change their behavior, simplification of restraining orders, and stricter penalties for violations and related crimes. It emphasizes women's safety as a fundamental issue of gender equality and demands stronger governmental action to mitigate the social and economic consequences of such violence in Sweden.

title: Motorcykeln – till nytta och nöje
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for intensified efforts to combat violence and oppression associated with honor in Sweden, advocating for increased education, awareness, and supportive measures in schools and communities. It calls for strict actions against practices like forced marriages and female circumcision, enhanced training for educators, and the establishment of more resources for victims of honor-related oppression.

title: Ökad trygghet i trafiken
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2536 av Johan Hedin och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposed by Ebba Hermansson and others from the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the importance of gender equality, advocating for political goals related to equal treatment, education, health, economic equality, and the effects of honor-related violence. It calls for the rejection of quotas in public service under the premise that gender-based differentiation is detrimental, pushing for a more nuanced understanding of gender equality that respects individual choice and circumstances. Additionally, it argues for the abolition of the Swedish Gender Equality Agency, proposing that its resources be redirected to existing governmental bodies.

title: Ta bort gränskontrollerna mellan Sverige och Danmark
summary: The proposal seeks to address various urgent issues related to workplace safety in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic, urging the government to initiate investigations into the consequences of remote work, the impacts of the pandemic on healthcare staff, and to extend the statute of limitations for occupational safety offenses. It also advocates for abolishing involuntary split shifts, restructuring the role of safety representatives by removing union preferential rights, and replacing regional safety representatives with independent workplace safety advisors to improve the current work environment.

title: Våld i nära relationer
summary: The proposal suggests a series of reforms to the Swedish employment agency (Arbetsförmedlingen) and the unemployment insurance system. It advocates for the introduction of a tax-funded mandatory unemployment insurance, an increase in unemployment benefits, and the reintroduction of the 100-day rule for job search area restrictions. Additionally, it calls for exceptions to employment termination rules for small businesses, a shift to needs-based labor immigration, the exploration of apprenticeship systems, and the extension of support for starting businesses. The motion also emphasizes the importance of supporting individuals with disabilities and improving transition opportunities for those affected by job market changes due to COVID-19.

title: Försäljning av öl och vin i licensierade livsmedelsbutiker
summary: The proposal emphasizes Sweden's commitment to supporting persecuted Christian minorities globally, particularly in countries like Egypt, Pakistan, Nigeria, North Korea, and Indonesia. It calls for concerted efforts from the Swedish government to advocate for the safety and rights of Christians, urging the United Nations and the European Union to apply pressure on relevant governments to ensure religious freedoms and protect these communities from violence and discrimination.

title: Biobaserad samhällsekonomi utan råvara
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2532 av Per Åsling och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should create a checklist of criteria to assess the democratic nature of elections globally. It emphasizes the importance of accountability and effective governance in maintaining democracy, particularly in less developed countries, and advocates for the formation of an international federation of democratic nations to foster cooperation and promote democratic values.

title: Förintelsemuseet
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish Parliament to support international efforts to regulate wildlife trade, enhance conditions for captive animals, allow independent inspections of markets contributing to disease outbreaks, and to promote a globally recognized animal welfare declaration. It emphasizes the need for a unified EU standard for animal welfare and highlights the interconnectedness between animal treatment and human welfare, particularly in light of health risks posed by current practices in certain countries.

title: Vildförtöjda båtar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government ensures military contributions and humanitarian efforts are focused on the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) in Iraq, supports self-defense groups for minority populations like Yazidis and Christians, increases humanitarian initiatives in conflict zones, and conducts a phased withdrawal of Swedish military involvement in Afghanistan and Mali. It emphasizes a strategic alignment with the United Nations' mandates for international military efforts and humanitarian assistance.

title: Utanförskapsområden
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish government to initiate an international coalition aimed at investigating leaders and countries that have assisted the Islamic State (IS). The motion highlights Turkey's alleged authoritarian practices, violations of international law, and connections to Islamist groups, particularly during the Syrian civil war. It argues for accountability regarding the support from multiple nations to one of the world's most brutal terrorist organizations, emphasizing the need for a coordinated international response.

title: Långsiktigt och gemensamt ansvar för bekämpningen av översvämningsmyggor
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into how Nordic language comprehension can be strengthened and improved, emphasizing its importance for Nordic cooperation and communication. It highlights concerns about the declining understanding of Nordic languages among younger generations, particularly Swedish in Finland, and advocates for increased educational initiatives, such as the 'Norden i skolan' program, to emphasize and promote Nordic language teaching from an early age. The motion calls for systematic political and economic investments in teaching neighboring languages to improve linguistic competencies among students and address the challenges faced in current teacher training programs.

title: Åtgärder mot övergrepp mot barn i den digitala världen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2527 av Ola Johansson och Helena Vilhelmsson (båda C)
summary: The motion calls for an investigation into the possibilities of establishing a 'Nordens hus' (House of the North) in Sweden to enhance Nordic cultural cooperation and dialogue. It emphasizes the importance of preserving and promoting the Nordic cultural community in light of increasing globalization and centralization from the European Union. The proponents argue that a dedicated center in Sweden could facilitate a more vibrant debate on Nordic issues and improve visibility and collaboration among Nordic nations.

title: Livsmedelsstrategin och corona
summary: The proposal suggests various measures to address rising crime among young offenders in Sweden. It includes lowering the age of criminal responsibility, allowing young offenders to be tried as adults for serious crimes, increasing drug testing for minors, and ensuring more thorough investigations of crimes committed by those under 15. The aim is to implement stricter consequences and oversight to deter juvenile crime and promote rehabilitation.

title: Återinför skrotbilspremien
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of Sweden's gun legislation, including the establishment of a new licensing authority for firearms, reducing processing times for licenses, abolishing five-year licenses, and re-evaluating the interpretation of 'particular reason' in the law. It suggests prioritizing Swedish gun regulations over EU directives, authorizing shooting associations, allowing temporary storage of licensed firearms by others, expanding the limit on legally owned firearms, easing borrowing of firearms for hunting, and revising ammunition storage rules. The motion also calls for stricter penalties for firearm-related crimes and better management of firearm magazines, aiming to facilitate legal firearm ownership while addressing the issue of illegal gun possession among criminal networks.

title: Tvåårsregeln och våld mot anknytningskvinnor
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2524 av Ola Johansson och Helena Vilhelmsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes several measures to enhance the capabilities of the Swedish Customs Agency in combating organized crime, including allowing customs officers to be armed, extending the data retention period for camera surveillance, and granting customs the authority to detain goods and transporters until police arrive. It emphasizes the need for better protection for customs personnel due to increasing threats from organized crime and suggests legislative changes to empower customs to intervene against illegal drug imports and other criminal activities. The motion also calls for improved collaboration with other authorities to strengthen efforts against organized crime.

title: Porrfilter i offentliga datorer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2523 av Ola Johansson och Helena Vilhelmsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal from the Sweden Democrats encompasses a series of measures aimed at combating terrorism and radicalization in Sweden. Key suggestions include stricter regulations for funding non-profit organizations and religious groups, a ban on the full-face veil in public and in preschools, and prohibitions on calls to prayer and the propagation of terrorism. Additionally, there are calls for a national action plan against radicalization, improved training for relevant agency personnel to detect signs of extremism, and the establishment of a registration system for individuals sympathizing with terrorist organizations. Overall, the motion expresses a need for substantial state intervention to strengthen public safety and reduce extremism.

title: Tydlig skyltning för allmänheten vid strandnära platser
summary: The motion calls for a comprehensive reform of Sweden's criminal law system, proposing significant changes to punishment frameworks, including stricter sentencing for various crimes, a reassessment of mitigating and aggravating circumstances, and a review of the existing penalties to better reflect public perceptions of justice. The proposals also advocate for mandatory deportation for serious offenses and the elimination of certain discounts for repeat offenses, with a special emphasis on harsher penalties for crimes against vulnerable groups such as the elderly. Additionally, it encourages the establishment of new legislation regarding self-defense rights and civil courage, reinforcing a tougher stance on crime overall.

title: Utökad rätt att bevilja reflektionsperiod gällande offer för människohandel
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes several amendments to the Swedish legal system regarding criminal investigations and witness protection. Key proposals include the implementation of a 'kronvittnessystem' (crown witness system) that would allow for reduced penalties in exchange for vital testimony, enhancements to witness protection programs, and the use of anonymous witnesses. Additionally, it advocates for the relaxation and modernization of the regulations governing the use of secret surveillance measures, such as phone tapping. The motion aims to improve the efficiency of the justice system and facilitate the prosecution of organized crime.

title: Värdesäkra socialförsäkringarna
summary: The proposal suggests increasing the number of police officers in Sweden and improving their working conditions through various measures, including higher recruitment standards, paid police training, increased salaries, and a more practical focus in police education. It also advocates for removing positive discrimination policies in recruitment and enhancing police powers in certain scenarios, aiming to bolster public safety and ensure that policing meets the needs of the community amidst rising crime rates.

title: Märkning av tillsatt socker i livsmedel
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2519 av Mats Wiking och Kristina Nilsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests a comprehensive reform of the Swedish correctional system aimed at increasing the number of prisons and detention centers, exploring the possibility of renting prison spaces abroad, and introducing stricter regulations for imprisonment and parole processes. It emphasizes the need for improved capacity and safety measures in response to rising crime rates and overcrowding, along with enhancing the rights of victims in the parole process, ensuring that those released do not pose a threat to society.

title: Moderniserad lagstiftning för att motverka spridning av våldsam pornografi
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes various amendments to the 1991 law on special control of foreigners, including making certain provisions mandatory, transferring decision-making authority from the Migration Agency to the Security Police, instituting lifetime bans on re-entry for those deported, and tightening regulations regarding temporary visits. The motion advocates for stricter enforcement of deportations, increased penalties for violations, and the registration of biometric data for individuals deported under this law, all aimed at enhancing national security.

title: Försäljning av vildsvinskött
summary: The motion proposes a reform to the Swedish penal system by addressing the principle of 'mängdrabatt' (quantity discount) applied in cases of repeated offenses. The author argues that this principle leads to lighter sentences for certain crimes, resulting in inadequate restitution for victims. Akhondi suggests that sentences should instead be proportionate to the severity of each offense, asserting that stricter penalties for repeat offenders would contribute to reducing recidivism and enhancing public safety.

title: UF-företag och skolan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2516 av Anders Åkesson och Johan Hedin (båda C)
summary: This motion proposes a review of how Trafikverket is fulfilling its mandate to maintain a good standard for the Swedish road network. It highlights the deteriorating condition of the infrastructure, which is falling behind European standards, and argues for increased political will to invest in improving road quality, particularly in the context of rising traffic volumes and the need for technological advancements in electric and self-driving vehicles. The proposal calls for a unified standard for road markings within the EU to enhance traffic safety and ease the implementation of autonomous driving technology.

title: Stärk urfolket samernas självbestämmande och inflytande
summary: Alireza Akhondi proposes measures to enhance safety and reduce crime in Sweden, advocating for better police presence and resources, particularly in vulnerable areas. The motion emphasizes the importance of preventing crime through community and police collaboration, providing support for individuals seeking to leave criminal lifestyles, and ensuring that local governments play a crucial role in crime prevention. It also calls for the cessation of funding to organizations that do not adhere to democratic values.

title: Oslo–Stockholm 2.55
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2514 av Helena Vilhelmsson m.fl. (C, KD, M, L, S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take measures to allow the flagging of addresses for ambulances in order to inform emergency services about known dangerous locations, similar to how the police are alerted to potential risks at certain addresses. This measure aims to enhance the safety of ambulance personnel who may unknowingly respond to calls at locations where they could be at risk due to prior incidents of violence.

title: Religionsfrihet är en mänsklig rättighet
summary: The proposal suggests abolishing the system of politically appointed lay judges in Swedish courts to enhance judicial independence and ensure fair trials. It argues that the presence of politically affiliated lay judges can compromise the impartiality of the judiciary and lead to biased outcomes, particularly against individuals with ethnic minority backgrounds. The motion calls for a review of the current system to eliminate potential political influence in court decisions.

title: Lättare att välja svenskt kött på restauranger
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive evaluation of Swedish addiction policy, emphasizing the need for enhanced preventive efforts against substance abuse, assessing the effectiveness of current legislation on drug use, and placing healthcare as the primary responsible body for addiction treatment. Additionally, it advocates for increased support for the relatives of those struggling with addiction, recognizing the substantial impact on families and the higher risks faced by children of individuals with serious substance use issues.

title: Skarvens påverkan i Blekinge
summary: The motion proposes that naloxone, a life-saving medication for overdose situations, be made available without a prescription in Sweden and distributed within addiction treatment facilities. The aim is to reduce overdose deaths by improving access to naloxone for users and their families, aligning with WHO recommendations and practices in other countries where naloxone is already available OTC.

title: Tillåt inte vargföryngringar inom renskötselområdet
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to initiate an investigation into the gray areas surrounding end-of-life care, including the consideration of euthanasia. It emphasizes the necessity to evaluate existing legislation due to changes in the legal landscape and increasing public support for allowing individuals to influence their fate during severe suffering at life's end. The motion references past recommendations from the National Council on Medical Ethics for uniform regulations in pain management practices across different regions.

title: Värna acceptansen för den svenska älgförvaltningen
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should take a more active stance against the increasing global influence of the Chinese Communist Party. It highlights the suppression of rights within China, including the use of invasive surveillance and control over the legal system, as well as military aggression towards neighboring countries. The motion advocates for a stronger criticism of China from Sweden and the EU, emphasizing the need to uphold democratic values and the international rule of law.

title: Gör kustfisket till en del av livsmedelsstrategin
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2508 av Sanne Lennström och Elin Lundgren (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of structural measures for circular food production systems in Sweden to address the challenges of food scarcity and climate change, and urges the government to task the Swedish Agency for Economic and Regional Growth with investigating the development of a center for circular food production systems. It emphasizes the need for innovation, knowledge, and collaboration to enhance sustainability and competitiveness in food production while reducing environmental impact.

title: Utveckla det småskaliga och kustnära fisket
summary: The proposal aims to enhance knowledge about cooperative enterprises and economic associations, facilitate employee takeovers of businesses through improved support and financing, and ensure that municipal and state-funded business consulting is comprehensive and neutral regarding different organizational forms. It emphasizes the significance of cooperative businesses in Sweden's economy, especially in light of the impending generational succession in many companies, and draws lessons from international practices to foster cooperative ownership.

title: Underlätta för fler svenska aktörer att producera biodrivmedel
summary: The motion proposes a review of Swedish legislation to improve the economic conditions for renewable energy cooperatives, allowing them to have equal or better provisions compared to individual producers. The suggested reforms include reducing or eliminating energy taxes for cooperative members who purchase their own renewable energy, permitting investment deductions, and abolishing the taxation of withdrawals from cooperatives selling energy at cost price. The authors argue that these changes are necessary for facilitating the transition to a renewable energy system in Sweden and to encourage wider community engagement in energy production.

title: Ge Örebro län ett andrum från varg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament amend the regulations regarding wellness grants to include owners of sole proprietorships, allowing them to benefit from tax-free wellness contributions. Currently, such contributions are only available to employees of incorporated companies, excluding approximately 425,000 sole proprietors who contribute significantly to the economy. The motion argues that physical activity is essential for health and wellness and that sole proprietors deserve equal access to these benefits.

title: Ersättningssystemet för rovdjursrivna tamdjur
summary: The motion calls for improved dialogue between public authorities, state companies, and the general public to enhance understanding and trust in the decisions they make. It emphasizes the importance of effective communication, responsiveness, and acknowledgment of individual concerns rather than focusing solely on legislative issues, aiming to prevent erosion of trust in governmental institutions and suggesting an evaluation of existing processes to create a coherent policy for better engagement.

title: Myndigheternas samarbete för en effektiv omställning
summary: The motion proposes a new distribution system for research funding in Sweden, highlighting the need for a better balance between education and research to enhance quality across higher education institutions. It argues that current funding disparities hinder the development of new universities and colleges, which contribute significantly to innovation and democratic education. The authors advocate for an increase in basic funding for higher education institutions rather than relying heavily on competitive funding, suggesting that such a change would lead to improved research outcomes and support the educational system's overall quality.

title: Obligatorisk ursprungsmärkning av kött på restaurang
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for greater recognition and support for freelance employment (egenanställning) in Sweden, urging the government to ensure that relevant authorities, such as Försäkringskassan and Arbetsförmedlingen, are well-informed about this form of employment. It calls for improved access to unemployment benefits for freelancers and increased awareness of freelance opportunities among job seekers to ultimately reduce unemployment and stimulate entrepreneurship.

title: Oskyldiga markägare drabbas av kostnader för bortforsling av skrotbilar
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to legislate a privacy act, known as an 'integritetsbalk', to enhance the legal protection of individual privacy in the face of advancing technology and increasing surveillance. It argues that current laws are insufficient and stresses the need for a balance between privacy concerns and state oversight, particularly in light of recent measures that infringe on personal privacy for security purposes. The motion emphasizes protecting citizens' rights to their personal data and improving privacy legislation to adapt to modern societal developments.

title: Begränsad möjlighet till spelreklam
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2500 av Abraham Halef och Ingela Nylund Watz (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes measures to enhance women's entrepreneurship in Sweden by advocating for targeted venture capital for women entrepreneurs, supporting young women in starting businesses, and allocating a portion of state rural funds specifically for women-led enterprises. It emphasizes the need for increased representation of female business owners in Sweden, as current statistics reveal only 5.38% are women, significantly below the EU average of 10%. The motion argues that the lack of access to venture capital is a major barrier for women, with only 1% of risk capital currently going to them, and highlights the economic and societal benefits of fostering female entrepreneurship.

title: Placera museet om Förintelsen i Malmö
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the establishment of state funding to support the creation of communal spaces in newly built senior housing. The intent is to address challenges faced by the elderly, including mobility issues and feelings of loneliness, by providing a dedicated space for social interaction and activities. The proposal highlights that despite existing state support for accessibility modifications in multifamily housing, such programs have seen limited uptake. Therefore, targeted funding for communal spaces in senior housing is suggested to enhance quality of life for older residents.

title: Haven
summary: The motion proposes to decriminalize late submissions of annual reports by companies and to introduce a new system of financial penalties based on revenue and the length of delay. It highlights that current laws lead to severe penalties for many small and medium-sized businesses, which the proposer argues are often unaware of the implications of their late submissions. The motion emphasizes the need for a supportive business environment, particularly in light of the economic challenges following the COVID-19 pandemic, and suggests implementing reminders for submission deadlines and allowing for graduated fines, asserting that these changes would lead to better compliance and benefit the economy.

title: Förstärk den straffrättsliga regleringen av de sociala nätverksplattformarna
summary: The motion proposes to make the role of a medically responsible person for rehabilitation (MAR) mandatory in Sweden's healthcare law. Currently, local governments have flexibility in appointing MARs, leading to inconsistencies in both rehabilitation services and quality of care across municipalities. The motion emphasizes the importance of rehabilitation for patients’ recovery and advocates for the inclusion of a MAR alongside the existing medically responsible nurse (MAS) positions, arguing that both roles are essential for ensuring comprehensive healthcare and improving patient outcomes, particularly for the elderly.

title: Regler mot skrubbning
summary: This proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to initiate a trial program for the sale of alcoholic beverages at farms. The motion highlights the slow progress of an ongoing investigation into this issue and argues that small breweries have suffered significantly due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It suggests that allowing small breweries to apply for temporary permits to sell their products directly could benefit the economy, tourism, and rural areas, while also providing valuable data for the ongoing inquiry.

title: Minkars rätt att kunna utöva sitt naturliga beteende i fångenskap
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2495 av Elin Lundgren och Kristina Nilsson (båda S)
summary: Kerstin Lundgren proposes to the Swedish Parliament a change in the law regarding Swedish citizenship to eliminate the automatic loss of citizenship at the age of 22 for individuals born to Swedish parents but raised abroad. The motion argues that this policy sends a negative signal and complicates the process for young Swedes living abroad who wish to maintain a connection with their heritage, suggesting instead that individuals should have to actively request to lose their citizenship rather than having it revoked automatically.

title: Inrätta en nationell insatsstyrka mot livsmedelsfusk
summary: The proposal suggests an investigation into the implementation of a three-term system in Swedish education, prompted by the establishment of the first such school in Göteborg. The motion argues that this system could increase the number of teaching hours, aligning Sweden more closely with many other European countries. It aims to address the current lower level of instruction time compared to OECD averages, which reflects in poorer educational outcomes in assessments like PISA. The proposal emphasizes the potential benefits in terms of improved learning and knowledge retention for students, despite the increased demand for teaching resources.

title: Omarrondering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament take action to expand and distribute animal care education to meet the increasing need for trained animal caregivers due to a growing pet population. It suggests establishing new training locations, particularly in Umeå and Skara, to enhance the availability of qualified personnel, as the current supply of veterinarians and animal caretakers is insufficient to meet demand. The importance of animal care for public health is emphasized, alongside the growing market for pet care services.

title: Läkemedel i avloppsvatten
summary: Kerstin Lundgren proposes a parliamentary investigation into the potential legalization of assisted dying in Sweden for individuals experiencing unbearable suffering at the end of life. The motion highlights the right of individuals to make autonomous choices regarding their death when palliative care is insufficient. It discusses the ethical considerations and societal debates surrounding this issue, referencing experiences from countries like Belgium and Oregon where different models of assisted dying have been implemented. Lundgren argues for the necessity of examining whether similar options should be made available in Sweden.

title: Miljövänligare flyg
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to strengthen and secure the connections of the E4 and E20 highways through Södertälje, suggesting the consideration of a motorway tunnel to bypass the Södertälje Canal. It highlights the vulnerability of the existing infrastructure, noting past traffic disruptions, and calls for greater attention to strategic infrastructure planning at the national level. The motion advocates for a thorough review of the area's traffic capacity and the potential for improvements to ensure sustainable infrastructure development in the Stockholm region.

title: Minnesmonument efter folkmordet i Srebrenica
summary: The motion advocates for a legislative change to allow the use of surveillance cameras at temporary workplaces to combat vandalism, theft, and accidents, particularly impacting entrepreneurs, farmers, and forestry companies. It underscores the financial burden of downtime caused by theft and proposes that such surveillance can also aid in monitoring wildlife, particularly wild boar, contributing to more effective hunting and wildlife management. The suggestion emphasizes the need for clearer guidelines that balance surveillance with individual privacy rights.

title: Skrotbilspremie
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should direct the government to require reports from responsible authorities regarding the status of emergency and evacuation lighting in public facilities. It emphasizes the need for regular inspections and maintenance, citing past tragedies like the Göteborg disco fire as a catalyst for improving safety standards. The proposal calls for a comprehensive report on the current state of this lighting across various public venues and the establishment of mandatory reporting requirements for property owners, similar to existing ventilation regulations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:12 Särskilt investeringsutrymme för elnätsverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the need for regulated hunting of seals to manage their population, which has significantly increased and is threatening the livelihoods of small-scale coastal fishermen by competing for fish resources. The motion argues for a balance between the existence of seals and the fishing industry, advocating for a general management hunt on seals to coexist with professional fishing interests.

title: Insatser för turismen i Sverige
summary: The proposal advocates for the trial implementation of farm sales of beer and wine in southeastern Sweden. It highlights concerns from local breweries and wine producers regarding existing sales regulations and argues that such sales can enhance the visitor experience and support the local economy, especially in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic. The Center Party suggests starting this initiative in specific regions, including Kronoberg, Kalmar, and Blekinge, with plans to expand nationwide if successful.

title: Molntjänster
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2486 av Lotta Olsson och Jan R Andersson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes measures to balance the wild boar population in Sweden due to its significant increase and the ensuing problems faced by landowners, such as traffic accidents and crop damage. The authors advocate for more flexible regulations around hunting, including the use of drones and larger traps, as well as the need to stimulate demand for wild boar meat by easing sales regulations and subsidizing trichina tests. They also highlight the economic impact of wild boars on landowners and suggest the establishment of more local game slaughterhouses to reduce transport issues for hunters.

title: Utsatta barns tillgång till socialtjänsten
summary: The motion presented by Josef Fransson proposes to abolish the current form of public service in Sweden and replace it with a system that allows citizens to choose which media outlets receive their contributions. This new model aims to create a more democratic and pluralistic media landscape by funding multiple private producers while ensuring accountability and adherence to specific regulations. The proposal argues that the existing public service has a left-wing bias and that a restructured public service could provide benefits without the current issues of political manipulation.

title: Stoppa id-kapningar
main_author: Betty Malmberg och Marléne Lund Kopparklint
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2484 av Betty Malmberg och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should swiftly investigate and create a legal framework to enable the expulsion of foreign nationals who have been convicted of serious crimes, regardless of whether an expulsion order was previously issued by the courts. The motion argues that Sweden currently has too many foreign criminals allowed to remain in the country and suggests that it is a moral imperative to remove offenders of serious violent and sexual crimes from Sweden. It calls for the government to mandate relevant authorities to systematically begin these expulsions.

title: Underlätta regelverket för vatten- och branddammar
summary: The motion proposes several measures to strengthen the justice system in Sweden, including the establishment of a 'jourdomstol' (emergency court) to ensure swift trials for certain offenses, enabling immediate sentencing and incarceration for shorter durations. The motion also calls for the repeal of specific provisions in the penal code that soften sentences, as well as a revision allowing for shorter prison terms than 14 days. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for more prison facilities at a reduced cost to better manage both short- and long-term incarceration, aiming to enhance community safety and tackle gang-related crime effectively.

title: Märkning av material i kläder
summary: This proposal seeks to combat institutionalized corruption in Sweden by advocating for significant reforms including the downsizing of public service, abolishing press and party funding, reinstating civil servant accountability, and eliminating institutions associated with gender research and ideologically driven policies. It emphasizes the need for transparency in governmental appointments and lobbying activities while minimizing public funding for organizations perceived as promoting ideologies and propaganda.

title: Aktiv dödshjälp
summary: The proposal seeks to investigate the feasibility of constructing the Öresund Metro to enhance connectivity and promote economic growth between Sweden and Denmark. The motion emphasizes the need for improved transportation systems to facilitate commuting and integration in the Öresund region, while also highlighting the environmental benefits of a metro system in reducing carbon emissions and alleviating traffic across the Öresund Bridge. Proponents argue that this infrastructure project would capitalize on existing frameworks and support a robust labor market across the region.

title: Åtgärder för att rädda besöksnäringen
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes that Sweden should recognize Somaliland as an independent state, highlighting its democratic development in a region marred by dictatorship and violence. The motion argues that Somaliland meets the necessary criteria for statehood, such as having a permanent population, defined territory, and a functioning government. It emphasizes the importance of supporting democracy and peace, especially in contrast to surrounding regions struggling with authoritarianism and terrorism.

title: Antibiotikamat från EU
summary: The motion proposes that surgical interventions and hormone treatments for gender dysphoria should not be performed on individuals under 25 years of age, and calls for an independent investigation into gender-affirming care in Sweden. It advocates for standardized psychotherapy as a first-line treatment and the development of national guidelines aimed at improving the mental health of LGBTQ individuals, arguing that existing treatment methods lack sufficient scientific evidence and are potentially harmful.

title: Utökad tillgång till naloxon
summary: The motion advocates for increased cooperation between the Nordic and Baltic countries, emphasizing the desire to maintain open borders among Nordic citizens, bolster integration, and enhance regional collaboration in various sectors, including climate issues, security policy, and digital development. It proposes measures such as reviewing tax treaties, advancing a common 5G action plan, and promoting a nuclear-free Nordic region, while also focusing on human rights and the rights of minorities.

title: En starkare arbetsmarknad i Stockholm
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should evaluate the handling of extra budget amendments during the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly focusing on the rights of opposition parties to submit follow-up motions. The suggestion highlights the need to clarify the rules concerning follow-up motions to ensure fair procedural rights for opposition parties in budgetary decisions.

title: Ungas möjligheter att köpa bostadsrätt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the storage of biometric information, challenging the current practice of immediate destruction post-search. It argues for a reevaluation of governmental positions on this issue, citing the concerns of law enforcement agencies and suggesting that data retention should align with EU law or until it's deemed unnecessary.

title: Döden på jobbet
summary: The motion proposes inviting the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe's Office for Democratic Institutions and Human Rights (ODIHR) to observe the Swedish general elections in 2022. It emphasizes the need for an evaluation of the Swedish media landscape, particularly public service broadcasters, to ensure impartiality and transparency in campaign financing and reporting. The authors highlight concerns regarding potential biases in public service media and advocate for ODIHR's expertise in assessing and improving the democratic election process in Sweden.

title: Livskraftig regionalpolitik
summary: The motion proposes amendments to regulations and directives governing government authorities to limit the sale of personal data to only non-profit applications, enhancing individual privacy rights. It emphasizes the need for clearer communication regarding the sale of personal data to individuals and suggests that such sales should require explicit consent from the registered individuals before proceeding.

title: Utrivning av dammar
summary: The proposal suggests expanding the ROT tax deduction to include the non-profit sector in Sweden, aimed at supporting community organizations that own and maintain properties. It emphasizes that many associations face financial challenges in upkeep and that a tax deduction could alleviate this burden, reduce black market labor, increase employment, and enhance local services. The motion argues that by facilitating access to resources for upkeep and renovation, the non-profit sector can better serve communities, especially in rural and smaller urban areas.

title: Långsiktig vargförvaltning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the rapid construction of a third track and an additional double track west of Alingsås, alongside significant upgrades to the Västra stambanan railway. This development is deemed essential for improving freight and passenger transport efficiency between Sweden's two largest cities, Stockholm and Göteborg, to meet the increasing transport demands and ensure the growth of industries reliant on swift and secure goods deliveries.

title: Goda och långsiktiga förutsättningar för kooperativ företagsrådgivning
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the conditions for calculating the sickness benefits qualifying income (SGI) for sole proprietors based on declared income rather than historical incomes. This change aims to provide more predictable rules for determining SGI, thereby reducing administrative burdens and improving clarity for entrepreneurs regarding their entitlement to sickness benefits and parental leave.

title: Barnomsorg på obekväm arbetstid
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2470 av Teresa Carvalho och Johanna Haraldsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to enforce reporting obligations on platform companies to disclose payments made to contractors to the Swedish Tax Agency.
