summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider increasing support for community center operators, which are significant organizations in promoting community gatherings and rural development. The proposal argues for annual funding to help these centers recover from financial hardships exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic, ensuring that local communities can maintain democratic engagement and social activities. The support should allow operators to determine how funds are utilized while requiring accountability for the usage and community benefits derived.

title: Tydligare regler kring ingrepp i estetiskt syfte
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to investigate whether the current regulations set by CSN (the Swedish National Board of Student Aid) that govern the academic year should be revised. The motion highlights concerns regarding the rigid structure of the academic year, which requires students to earn at least 1.5 university credits per week to be eligible for full-time study funding. It argues that the existing system may hinder students' recovery time and suggests a more flexible approach to the academic schedule, potentially improving students' mental health.

title: Grovt brott mot tystnadsplikten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instructs the government to ensure that the AP funds do not invest in companies that lobby for fossil fuels. It highlights the urgent need to transition from fossil to renewable energy due to climate change and emphasizes the significant influence of pension funds on the market and climate sustainability. The proposal advocates for stricter measures to prevent investments in companies that actively lobby against climate commitments, emphasizing the growing trend of climate lobbying by fossil fuel interests.

title: Försörjningsstöd till personer som uppehåller sig illegalt i landet
summary: The motion proposes the investigation into the introduction of producer responsibility for recreational boats and the establishment of a national system for scrapping such boats. It highlights the environmental issue of abandoned boats and the difficulty in identifying their owners. The motion aims to create a sustainable recycling system to prevent pollution and improve public safety by addressing the responsibilities of boat owners, municipalities, and potential financial incentives for proper disposal.

title: Migrationsverkets förvar
summary: The motion proposes measures to improve the quality of elderly care in Sweden, particularly highlighting the need for increased medical competence within municipal elderly care services. It suggests the appointment of a medically responsible doctor in municipalities to oversee elderly care and infection control, thereby enhancing the quality of care and ensuring patient safety. Additionally, it calls for better access to medical technology in care facilities. The motion emphasizes that the recent budgetary increase should facilitate these improvements.

title: Språkkunskap för medborgarskap
summary: The proposal aims to legislate a national ban on the use and sale of fireworks to private individuals in Sweden, citing growing concerns about improper and illegal use, which creates public safety issues and distress for many, including animals. It highlights the inadequate measures currently available to municipalities and police to manage these problems and suggests that a total ban or a system requiring permits for all fireworks use would help address the situation.

title: Avslag på asylansökan för personer som begår brott
summary: This proposal emphasizes the essential role of municipalities in local crime prevention efforts, advocating for legislative changes to clarify and assign responsibilities for such work. It argues that while police play a key role in prevention, community involvement is critical to effectively tackle crime and enhance safety. The proposal calls for municipalities to develop a coordinated approach to support victims of crime and address organized crime issues, stressing the importance of a unified strategy to support those affected by crime and to combat local criminal activity.

title: Sänkt straffmyndighetsålder
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review how to ensure compliance with Article 19 of the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, which guarantees individuals with disabilities the right to choose their residence and home. The motion argues that current arrangements limit the ability of persons with disabilities to select their living locations due to municipal restrictions and inadequate support, effectively leading to a form of 'municipal arrest', particularly affecting individuals with intellectual disabilities.

title: Den enskildes ansvar i händelse av olyckor och kris
summary: The motion advocates for more efficient land use in Sweden by coordinating infrastructure projects such as power lines with road and railway constructions to minimize land intrusion. It emphasizes the need for regional planning of infrastructure to ensure effective land utilization and calls for reforms in the compensation system for landowners affected by these projects. Additionally, it proposes that state authorities provide guidelines to protect collective land and forest resources, aiming to balance developmental needs with environmental sustainability.

title: Kommunernas rätt att sätta upp bevakningskameror
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the expansion of the RUT deduction to encompass all purchased household services from certified providers. It argues that RUT has positively impacted the labor market by converting informal jobs into formal ones, increasing employment opportunities for those with weak ties to the workforce, and freeing up time for families. The motion advocates for removing restrictions on deductible services, allowing for a broader range of certified household services to flourish, thereby promoting sustainable economic growth and greater service consumption over goods.

title: Förverkande av kriminellas egendom
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes to reject the government's proposal 2020/21:6 regarding changes to the use of photographs and fingerprints in the Schengen Information System (SIS II), emphasizing the need for a more humane and dignified asylum policy in Sweden and Europe. They argue that the current measures undermine the rights of asylum seekers and refugees, reinforcing a 'Fortress Europe' mentality that hampers access to protection and rights to fair assessment of asylum claims. The motion calls for reforms that respect human rights and enhance individual agency in the asylum process.

title: Ändra postlagen
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at combating honor-based violence, gang crime, and religious extremism in Sweden. It calls for a comprehensive mapping of the connections between these issues and demands enhanced education on Swedish democracy and rights for newly arrived immigrants. It also advocates for the prohibition of virginity checks and operations, specialized training for educators and law enforcement on honor-related issues, and increased governmental efforts to address these challenges through awareness campaigns and improved social services.

title: Kvinnors hälsa
summary: The motion proposes several measures to improve the equality and economic independence of immigrant women in Sweden, advocating that half of subsidized services should go to them, and that efforts should be tailored to their actual needs rather than stereotypes. It emphasizes the need for more public sector job opportunities, a reassessment of economic incentives to avoid reinforcing traditional gender roles, special state education for immigrant parents, and a thorough investigation of the impact of honor culture on society and democracy. The motion highlights the systemic discrimination faced by immigrant women and the importance of their contributions to the welfare state.

title: Skyldighet att uppvisa körkort
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive strategy to combat gun violence and increase safety in socially vulnerable areas. Key suggestions include enhancing police trust-building initiatives, establishing a national commission to address gun violence, implementing mobile police stations, and increasing social intervention programs. The aim is to create a more effective collaboration among various authorities and community actors to address the root causes of crime, particularly focusing on social welfare and preventive measures rather than purely punitive responses.

title: Samlat statistikansvar om konsumtion av alkohol, tobak och spel
summary: The motion proposes that the government should present a broad initiative to increase accessibility to culture for individuals with disabilities and to create a state investigation into the conditions of the music industry, including state subsidies and collaboration with authorities. The aim is to ensure inclusive cultural participation and support for cultural workers, addressing economic challenges faced by cultural organizations, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Ett nationellt biljettsystem
summary: Robert Halef's motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament limit betting on sports results to only the two highest divisions of team sports and intensify efforts against match-fixing and corruption in sports. The motion highlights Sweden's vulnerability to match-fixing, citing examples of young players being coerced and organized crime infiltrating teams. It calls for stricter measures against any involvement in match-fixing and emphasizes the need for additional resources for police and sports organizations to combat this issue.

title: Begränsa möjligheten för utländska aktörer att köpa strategiska fastigheter i Sverige
summary: Désirée Pethrus from KD proposes that the Swedish government should undertake a diplomatic initiative to promote democracy in Turkey, emphasizing the importance of addressing the country's declining human rights and democratic standards. The motion highlights the lack of effective response from Sweden to Turkey's deteriorating political situation, particularly concerning the treatment of dissenters, the press, and minority groups. Pethrus calls for Sweden to actively support democracy and provide assistance to those advocating for human rights in Turkey, stressing the need for concrete actions in line with the government's declared commitment to a democracy offensive.

title: Ändring i bostadsrättslagen
summary: The motion by Désirée Pethrus from the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for the Swedish Parliament to urge the government to push for the European Union to terminate its political dialogue and cooperation agreement with Cuba due to ongoing human rights abuses and the lack of democratic reforms in the country. The motion highlights the persistent persecution of opposition figures, arbitrary arrests, and the undemocratic nature of Cuba's political system, arguing that the current agreement fails to bring about meaningful changes in human rights conditions.

title: Översyn av lagen om Svenska skeppshypotekskassan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should take action against blasphemy laws and death penalties for converts, highlighting the need for collaboration within the EU and the UN to combat religious persecution. It cites various human rights articles from the UN charter that affirm freedom of thought, conscience, and religion, and condemns ongoing violations in countries such as China and India. The motion advocates for documenting abuses against religious minorities and taking measures like condemnations and reviews of trade agreements to enforce compliance with international law.

title: Avskaffande av laglotten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports a clearer mandate for the police to protect farmers, hunters, and Sami people from threats and violence, and suggests an investigation to determine if these cases should be handled by the police or the Security Police (Säpo). The motion highlights the increasing incidents of violence against individuals in these sectors and emphasizes the need for the government to take stronger actions to ensure their safety.

title: Ändring av åldersgränserna för adoption
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate how municipalities providing care can receive a share of the tax revenues intended for individual care, when the care is delivered in a municipality different from where the individual normally resides. It highlights the challenges faced by elderly and disabled persons who seek care while spending time in different municipalities, especially during vacations, leading to conflicts regarding financial responsibilities between municipalities.

title: Bilmålvakter
summary: The proposal suggests that real estate transactions conducted on leasehold land should be handled similarly to regular property transactions. It highlights current legal loopholes allowing property sales on leasehold land to evade tax reporting, resulting in unfair competition between those complying with tax laws and those who do not. The motion calls for an investigation into a model that ensures transparent and equitable taxation for all real estate transactions in Sweden.

title: Det svenska skyddsrumssystemet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review the VAT rates for different types of tourist accommodations, as there are significant disparities in tax treatment. While hotels, campsites, and hostels are taxed at 12%, services utilized by families staying on boats are taxed at 25%, leading to unfair competition among similar services. This discrepancy challenges the equal treatment of various accommodation forms, particularly between boats and RVs, despite their use of similar facilities. The motion argues for a reassessment to ensure that overnight stays on boats are taxed comparably to land-based accommodations.

title: Tidsbegränsat förordnande för myndigheter
summary: The motion proposes that dental care should be included within the same high-cost protection system that applies to regular healthcare, as existing disparities negatively impact older individuals and those with lower incomes. The author argues that dental health is crucial to overall health and a reflection of economic status. To address these disparities, the motion suggests a reduction of the high-cost protection limits and the establishment of a study to develop concrete proposals that tackle the existing issues in dental care access.

title: Ambassadstatus för Republiken Kinas representation
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should initiate the development of a joint strategy with Nordic countries for responding to future pandemics and crises. Emphasizing the vision for the Nordics to become the world's most sustainable and integrated region by 2030, the motion highlights the challenges faced during the COVID-19 pandemic, including border closures that have disrupted daily life and strained relationships. The motion calls for collaboration to ensure that borders remain open in future emergencies.

title: Stärkt egendomsskydd för bostadsrätter
summary: Kjell-Arne Ottosson proposes that the Swedish government develop a national strategy to ensure mobile coverage across the entire country, emphasizing the need for adequate connectivity, particularly in rural areas. The motion highlights the importance of mobile phones in daily life and for businesses, as well as for public safety during emergencies. Additionally, it calls for mobile masts to be secured with backup power to maintain functionality during power outages.

title: Sänkt ålder för att få handla på Systembolaget
summary: The suggestion advocates for the upgrading of länsväg 131 between Österbymo and Tranås, emphasizing the need for improvements in traffic safety, logistics, and reduced travel times. The proposal highlights the road's critical importance for the local community and economy, as well as its historical neglect in infrastructure planning. It calls for the road's inclusion in Trafikverket's planning to ensure regional development and safety.

title: Andrahandsuthyrning av bostadsrätter
summary: The motion proposes that personal identification numbers (personnummer) should not be considered public records in order to protect individuals from identity theft and fraud. It argues that the current accessibility of this information has led to a rise in identity fraud cases, which burden law enforcement resources. The motion highlights the need to balance public access to information with the risks associated with identity theft and calls for a review of the public status of personnummer.

title: Ett reformerat strandskydd
summary: The suggestion proposes a review of the Nordic tax agreement to eliminate existing border barriers that hinder the labor market between Sweden and Norway. It highlights the negative impacts of current taxation and declaration processes faced by cross-border workers, advocating for a more efficient and fair taxation system that recognises the contributions of these workers to the Swedish welfare system.

title: Reformera PBL
summary: The motion proposed by Kjell-Arne Ottosson advocates for the Swedish government to investigate additional support for the private road network, which constitutes a significant portion of the country's total road infrastructure. The motion highlights the importance of these roads for rural communication, daily commutes, and the transportation needs of the forestry industry. It argues for reform to enhance funding mechanisms for these roads to prevent closures that could adversely affect the competitiveness of Sweden's agricultural sectors.

title: Östlig förbindelse och Södertörnsleden
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support the establishment of an investigation aimed at improving healthcare accessibility for marginalized groups who are currently distant from health services. It emphasizes the need for legislative revisions to ensure equitable healthcare delivery across all regions, and mandates appropriate authorities to develop and implement guidelines to cater to these vulnerable populations, including the homeless, mentally ill, and those with addiction issues.

title: Höjd hastighet på motorvägar
summary: The motion proposed by Ali Esbati and others from the Left Party aims to enhance cooperation between authorities to combat labor market crime in Sweden. It suggests establishing a national labor crime center to reinforce joint efforts among various public agencies and to implement stricter regulations for self-employed individuals under the F-tax system. The motion advocates for equal treatment of posted workers compared to local employees, improved rules for foreign companies operating in Sweden, and measures to ensure fair employment conditions and transparency in subsidized employment.

title: Förbud mot bottentrålning efter ostkusten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the installation of more wildlife fences along roads in Kalmar county with high accident rates, emphasizing that such fences can save lives and reduce the significant costs associated with wildlife accidents. The motion highlights the lack of existing fences in the region and presents wildlife fencing as the most effective measure to prevent accidents, advocating for their combination with warning systems to effectively manage wildlife movements.

title: Skredrisken i Götaälvdalen
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a working group to critically examine available documentation regarding the Swedish government's handling and actions surrounding the death of Dag Hammarskjöld in a plane crash in 1961. It highlights the complexities of previous investigations, the conflicting narratives from Swedish representatives, and the need to reassess the circumstances of the incident in light of newly declassified materials and testimonies.

title: Öka ersättningarna vid markintrång
summary: The motion proposes that the announcement of the Astrid Lindgren Memorial Award (ALMA), a prestigious literary prize for children's literature, be permanently relocated to Vimmerby, Sweden, where Astrid Lindgren grew up. The motion emphasizes the cultural significance of Vimmerby in promoting the legacy of Lindgren and argues that hosting the announcement there would enhance the authenticity and international interest in the event, which has been held in Stockholm in recent years.

title: Strategi för ökad export av svensk mat
summary: The proposal suggests establishing a national Astrid Lindgren Day to celebrate the influential works and legacy of the renowned Swedish author. It emphasizes Lindgren's significant impact on culture, her advocacy for children's rights, and her role as a powerful opinion leader in society. The motion advocates for this recognition to take place annually on her birthday, November 14.

title: Ökad information till markägaren
summary: The motion submitted by Gudrun Brunegård from the Christian Democrats (KD) seeks to expedite the development of a sustainable regulatory framework for municipalities to manage abandoned and neglected properties. It highlights the increasing number of such properties, which can harm the surrounding area and pose safety risks, while also addressing the challenges faced by municipalities in locating property owners. The motion advocates for measures introduced by the National Board of Housing, Building and Planning (Boverket), proposing improved procedures that respect property rights and encourage renovation or redevelopment of these neglected buildings.

title: Miljöbalken måste förenklas
summary: The motion suggests the Swedish Parliament support necessary measures for the partial electrification of the Stångådalsbanan and Tjustbanan railways, advocating for fossil-free transport solutions. It highlights the environmental benefits of rail transport and proposes using multimodal trains capable of running on electricity, batteries, and diesel to improve regional connectivity, reduce costs, and set an example for similar initiatives across Sweden.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance the preservation, use, and development of Sweden's automotive historical heritage by urging the government to monitor how the Transport Agency conducts document control and ascertain the origin of vehicles. It suggests revising the Vehicle Registration and Use Regulation (2019:383) to clarify the scope and limitations of origin checks, emphasizing that the current strict documentation requirements may hinder the registration of historical vehicles.

title: Reservaten måste skötas så att granbarkborren ej orsakar skador på närliggande fastigheter
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to consider reducing the VAT on dancing, currently set at 25%, to align it with lower tax rates for other forms of music-related activities. The motion emphasizes the social and health benefits of dancing as a widespread cultural activity and argues that a lower tax rate could make dancing more accessible and financially viable for both participants and organizers.

title: Minska den svenska vargstammen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should investigate how individuals with disabilities can have the opportunity to choose their own assistive devices, irrespective of their geographical location or age. The motion emphasizes that access to necessary assistive devices should not vary based on municipality or age, highlighting that current practices can significantly impede the ability of individuals to live active and fulfilling lives.

title: Skaraborgs valkrets
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take action to improve opportunities for individuals with disabilities to start and run their own businesses. It emphasizes the need for better integration of these individuals into society and the labor market through entrepreneurship, highlighting current barriers they face, such as loss of necessary support and inadequate adaptations for business operations.

title: Tolkkostnader
summary: The motion proposes to facilitate the introduction of mobile mammography units in Sweden, particularly to serve women living outside metropolitan areas. It emphasizes the challenges faced by these women in accessing mammography services due to time constraints and transportation difficulties. The motion suggests that mobile units would improve access to vital health checks, reduce the risk of women delaying or missing screenings, and enhance early detection of health issues. It calls on the government to eliminate any regulatory barriers that may hinder the implementation of such services by regional authorities.

title: Minskning av antalet ledamöter i Sveriges riksdag
summary: The motion proposes allowing municipal co-financing for broadband expansion and encourages the government to recognize the importance of voluntary cooperation agreements among municipalities. The authors argue that access to fast and reliable broadband is essential for participation in modern society and highlight the significant digital divide between urban and rural areas. They emphasize that without public investment, many rural households will remain without adequate internet access, perpetuating economic and social disparities. The proposal calls for public funding to bridge this digital gap and enhance digital services in underserved regions.

title: Stärk markägaren angående allemansrätten
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the organization of international adoptions in Sweden, focusing on how to support adopted children and the responsibilities of different authorities in the process. It highlights a decrease in international adoptions and emphasizes the need for adequate support for adoptive families, especially in light of the higher prevalence of mental health issues among adopted children. The motion calls for measures to ensure that adopted children receive proper assistance and can seek their roots if desired.

title: Minska skogsreservaten och producera mer skog
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the continuation of work on a fixed connection between Helsingborg and Helsingör, emphasizing its importance for regional integration and growth in the Öresund region. The proposal highlights the need for improved infrastructure to reduce travel times, enhance labor market integration, expand the housing market, and increase access to education and research. Funding options are mentioned, with indications that the project could be self-financing through user fees from a motorways tunnel that would support a passenger train tunnel.

title: Byggnation av nya djurstallar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament support the establishment of Öresund as a marine protected area and subsequently a biosphere reserve. This initiative aims to address environmental degradation, enhance biodiversity, and promote sustainable development practices in the region, while allowing for continued human activities such as sailing and wind power installation.

title: Möjlighet till ökad kemisk bekämpning av granbarkborren
summary: The motion by Niels Paarup-Petersen calls for the Swedish government to establish equitable regulations for cross-border commuters, particularly focusing on issues arising from job loss and taxation due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the need for better cooperation among Nordic governments to address the unique challenges faced by commuters in the Öresund region and proposes a series of actions, including simplifying tax situations, increasing flexibility in social security rules, and creating a fairer unemployment insurance system for those who work across borders.

title: Skattebefria svensk biodling
summary: The motion proposes a review of regulations that lead to the closure of clubs in Swedish cities to support the survival of cultural and nightlife venues, which have been struggling due to economic impacts from COVID-19 and stricter noise regulations. The suggestion highlights successful initiatives from major European cities like Berlin, London, and Paris that could serve as models for fostering vibrant urban nightlife and protecting cultural venues from complaints by new residents.

title: Höjda straff för fortkörning förbi vägarbeten
summary: The motion advocates for the construction of additional connections across the Öresund Strait to enhance regional cooperation between Sweden and Denmark. It proposes a model of joint financing for these infrastructures, similar to the successful Öresund Bridge, arguing that it would promote economic development in the Öresund region without burdening the Swedish state financially. The document highlights the need for improved integration and the removal of barriers that have hindered cross-border mobility, emphasizing that new connections would benefit both national and regional interests.

title: SMO-utbildning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish state should contribute financially to the archaeological excavations at Uppåkra, the largest known Iron Age settlement in Scandinavia. The author argues that despite Uppåkra's significant historical importance, state interest and funding have been minimal compared to other sites like Birka. This lack of support is deemed unacceptable given the site's cultural heritage and the inadequate financing currently provided solely by local municipalities. The motion emphasizes the need for state involvement to properly uncover and preserve Uppåkra's archaeological findings for public access and appreciation.

title: Modernisera systemet för krisinformation
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2286 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Sten Bergheden (båda M)
summary: The motion advocates for simplifying public procurement regulations in Sweden for contracts below the EU threshold, asserting that the current complex rules hinder effective procurement and competition. The proposal calls for a review of the direct procurement limit and aims to align national policies with EU legislation to facilitate better business transactions in the public sector, benefiting both buyers and sellers.

title: Förmågan att möta biologiska smittor i framtiden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports efforts to clean and restore the Baltic Sea, addressing the ecological damage caused by ghost nets and hazardous materials from historical events such as World War II. It highlights the importance of both economic and ecological perspectives concerning the sea, emphasizing the need for both Sweden and other Baltic states to collaborate in cleaning the shared waterway for future generations.

title: Livsmedelstrygghet i händelse av kris
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2284 av Betty Malmberg och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The motion presents various proposals aimed at enhancing safety in Malmö and Sweden. It includes recommendations to restrict the ownership of cars linked to criminal activities, improve police enforcement against organized crime, streamline communication between government agencies, and bolster support for municipalities tackling crime. Additionally, it suggests increasing resources for social services, revising legislation to facilitate better oversight of organized crime, and improving witness protection measures. The overall goal is to combat violence and criminality stemming from gang activities through comprehensive and coordinated efforts across sectors.

title: Hemvärnets mörkerförmåga
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of a state regulatory body in Sweden to combat food fraud, inspired by similar units in Denmark, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. It highlights the increasing issue of food fraud, which poses health risks to consumers and harms the food industry by offering unfair competition to compliant businesses. The current municipal oversight is deemed insufficient, lacking the necessary resources and expertise to effectively address the complexities of food fraud, which has led to a rise in criminal activities in the sector. The motion calls for a more robust national effort to intensify controls and investigations related to food fraud.

title: Brandsäkerhet inom hemtjänsten
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the introduction of a 'lex Ahmed' for the police, aimed at creating a system that allows for learning from mistakes rather than solely focusing on punishing individual officers. It emphasizes the need for a systematic approach to address organizational errors in police work, pointing to the unresolved murder case of Ahmed Obaid as an example of the failures in the current system.

title: Införandet av en skyddsrumsavgift
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should examine the possibility of including income transferred to a periodization fund in the sickness benefit qualifying income (SGI) calculation, as well as investigate how such income should be incorporated. Currently, income allocated to a periodization fund does not count toward an individual's SGI either when it is set aside or when it is returned and taxed, which can lead to complications for business owners seeking sickness benefits.

title: Möjligheten för idrottsrörelsen och föreningslivet att använda försvarsmark
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of the Öresund metro, which aims to enhance transportation and communication between Sweden and Denmark. It emphasizes the importance of this infrastructure for trade, commuting, and economic collaboration in the Öresund region, suggesting that the metro would significantly improve regional connectivity and allow for a greater labor market. The motion calls for government support to incorporate the Öresund metro in infrastructure planning and to use surplus funds from the Öresund Bridge for regional investments.

title: Ökad brandberedskap mot skogsbränder
summary: The proposal from Vänsterpartiet seeks to protect and strengthen the Swedish rent-setting model by removing the specific requirement for rent assessments, amending the rent laws to prioritize agreed-upon rental systems, initiating an investigation into the effects of presumed rents, and repealing recent regulations regarding optional charges in rental agreements. The motion emphasizes the need for fair and reasonable rental development to ensure tenant security and voices opposition to market-driven rental reforms proposed by other political parties.

title: Beredskapslager med skydd och mediciner
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament prohibits all types of mopeds from using bicycle paths in detailed planning areas to enhance safety for cyclists, who currently face risks from moped-related robberies. The motion argues that eliminating moped access to these paths would create a clearer distinction for allowed users and provide cyclists with a more secure environment.

title: Beredskapslager av mat
summary: The motion proposes that a driving license requirement be established for various powered vehicles, similar to that of moped class 2, and introduces an age limit of 15 years for operation. The motivation highlights concerns over the uncontrolled use of electric vehicles like e-bikes and electric scooters on sidewalks and roads, which have been involved in serious accidents. The motion aims to increase safety through mandatory training for users of these vehicles.

title: Avskaffa Systembolagets monopol
summary: This proposal suggests the implementation of a unified digital journal system for all healthcare facilities in Sweden to enhance patient safety and efficiency. Currently, the lack of standardization across regional digital journal systems complicates access to patient records when individuals seek care outside their home regions. The proposed system would allow healthcare providers to easily access patient information regardless of location, potentially reducing the risk of important medical details being overlooked. The motion also includes features for patient convenience, such as wait time visibility through a mobile application, which aims to streamline patient management and improve overall healthcare delivery.

title: Utvisning av brottslingar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Customs Authority (Tullverket) be tasked with controlling outgoing goods, vehicles, and transport at Sweden's borders to combat the theft of valuable items, which are often trafficked to other countries by criminal organizations. The motion highlights the current lack of oversight for outgoing shipments and argues that strengthening border security will help reduce crime related to stolen property.

title: Reglerna för arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The Left Party is proposing that the Swedish parliament reject government proposition 2020/21:5 regarding the handling of sensitive personal data in testing activities under the Aliens Data Act. They argue that the government has not adequately considered the risks to personal privacy or provided sufficient analysis of the necessity of handling such data, and that these issues should be prioritized more in legislative processes. The Left Party calls for a more thorough proposal that addresses these concerns and emphasizes the need for a comprehensive risk analysis regarding personal integrity.

title: Krafttag mot svarta trafikskolor
summary: The motion advocates for increased government intervention in the expansion of digital infrastructure in Sweden, specifically proposing that municipal networks be exempted from the localization principle to allow for greater broadband access, the establishment of a state-owned cloud service for secure data management, and the state-led development of 5G networks to ensure data security and promote collective benefits such as improved communication in rural areas.

title: Minska kostnaderna för public service
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for enhanced consumer rights and protections, particularly in light of increased complexities faced by consumers, such as overspending and aggressive marketing tactics. It calls for mandatory municipal consumer guidance, improved training for consumer advisors, measures to address overspending, and bans on quick loans. Additionally, it suggests implementing a final limitation period for debts and fostering preventive strategies against overspending, particularly to safeguard children in affected families.

title: Riksdagens tidningsrum utan landets tidningar
summary: The motion put forth by Jonas Sjöstedt and others aims to enhance democracy and safety within Swedish schools by addressing issues such as the detection and support of children in crisis, the prevention of sexual harassment, afrofobia, and discrimination. It calls for the Skolinspektionen to regularly monitor schools' efforts against these issues and proposes legislative changes to clarify students' rights to political information and organizational forms for influence, as well as ensuring free breakfast provision and banning surveillance during school hours. The overall goal is to strengthen students' rights and create a more equitable educational environment.

title: Förtydliga tjänstemannaansvaret
summary: The motion aims to strengthen laws against sex purchasing and human trafficking in Sweden by removing fines from the penalty scale for sex purchase, defining the status of victims in sex purchase cases, implementing mandatory education for convicted sex buyers, abolishing the dual criminality requirement for sex purchases abroad, enhancing police cooperation in combating prostitution and trafficking, and investigating links between pornography and organized crime. The proposal seeks to elevate the seriousness of sexual purchasing offenses and provide better support for victims.

title: Utvärdering av bildandet av Västra Götalandsregionen
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for sustainable and equitable fishing practices in Sweden. It calls for the government to instruct the Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management to overhaul the resource allocation system to enable more flexibility in fishing, conduct investigations into banning large-scale trawling within twelve nautical miles, and limit environmentally harmful bottom trawling. Additionally, the motion advocates for advice from ICES concerning sustainable fish stocks and the impact of fishing regulations on local ecosystems and fishing communities. It highlights the imbalance caused by industrial fishing and aims for a fairer distribution of fishing resources to support small-scale fishermen and local economies.

title: Riksdagsledamöternas övernattningsbostäder
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the need for stricter oversight of Swedish adoption organizations and transfer the responsibility for adoption documentation to a public authority to enhance transparency and accessibility. It also calls for inquiries into how Swedish authorities and adoption organizations have managed international adoptions, particularly from Chile, highlighting concerns about past irregularities and ensuring that adopted individuals have the right to know their origins.

title: Inrätta ett jord- och skogsbruksutskott i riksdagen
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of Sweden's housing policy to address the ongoing housing shortage, housing segregation, and environmental challenges. It emphasizes the need for increased state responsibility in ensuring affordable housing as a social right for all citizens, and suggests the establishment of a national strategy and a new housing target aimed at promoting equity and sustainability in housing development. Specific proposals include the creation of a state construction company for affordable rental housing, a housing social inquiry to analyze current issues, and legislative changes to enhance energy efficiency in new developments.

title: Politisk påverkan från statliga myndigheter
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to work within the UN and EU to update the legal framework to incorporate ecocide as a crime in the Rome Statute. This would provide stronger legal protections for nature and the environment, enabling the International Criminal Court to prosecute significant environmental offenses similarly to war crimes and crimes against humanity. By establishing ecocide as a prosecutable offense, it seeks to hold accountable those responsible for extensive environmental degradation, particularly impacting poorer nations with weaker environmental laws.

title: Genomförande av tillkännagivanden
summary: The proposal by the Left Party (Vänsterpartiet) aims to strengthen the position of public housing and tenant rights in Sweden. It advocates for at least one public housing company in each municipality, requiring government measures to prevent the sale and conversion of public housing into private ownership. The motion includes a ten-year moratorium on such conversions, demands tighter regulations on value transfers from public housing companies to municipalities, and calls for improved tenant rights during property transformations. The overarching goal is to ensure affordable housing access and eliminate practices that risk exacerbating housing shortages.

title: Stödet för politiska sekreterare
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government initiate a comprehensive and transparent mapping of regions' capabilities to handle significant infectious outbreaks and crises, enhance national preparedness through crisis exercises specifically for healthcare, and implement a unified national strategy for healthcare resources during pandemics and disasters. The motion emphasizes the necessity for stronger governmental oversight, coordination of healthcare resources, and the inclusion of private healthcare providers in crisis preparation efforts. Additionally, it advocates for a national inventory of medical equipment and medicines, a focus on mental health support due to the pandemic, and improved training for healthcare staff.

title: Ledamotsstöd i Sveriges riksdag
summary: The proposal by Birger Lahti and others from the Left Party emphasizes the need for Sweden to transition to a fully renewable energy system by 2040, highlighting the importance of wind, solar, and hydroelectric power. It calls for the abolition of municipal vetoes against wind power projects, a mandatory compensation scheme for communities affected by wind farms, and financial support for increased production from state-owned entities like Vattenfall. The motion outlines specific actions such as the construction of an underwater cable to Gotland, the removal of connection fees for offshore wind power, and the need for a legislative framework to support these initiatives.

title: Utvärdering av konsekvenserna runt Hornborgasjön
summary: The motion presented by Christina Höj Larsen and others from the Left Party calls for comprehensive measures to combat racism in Sweden, including the establishment of equality data, prioritization of racially motivated crime in law enforcement, review of hate speech legislation, and the formation of a crisis commission against discrimination. It emphasizes the historical and systemic nature of racism, advocates for state accountability, and seeks to acknowledge Sweden's role in the transatlantic slave trade, proposing a national day of remembrance for its victims.

title: Underlätta för ungdomar till jobb och bostad
summary: The motion proposes a ban on the sale, import, and use of food products derived from force-feeding animals, particularly targeting foie gras production. It calls for Sweden to take a strong stance on animal welfare by advocating for international bans on such practices and ensuring clear labeling of affected products in the market. The motion highlights the unethical treatment of animals in the production process and emphasizes the responsibility of the government to protect animal rights.

title: Minska strandskyddet och ta bort länsstyrelserna i strandskyddsärendena
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognizes Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and urges the government to move the Swedish embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. The motion argues that Jerusalem is historically and religiously significant for Jews and that moving the embassy would support better relations with Israel while acknowledging the complexities of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

title: Öka vår försvarsförmåga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports measures to ensure that meat purchased through public procurement comes from animals slaughtered in accordance with Swedish animal welfare regulations. It advocates for a general ban on non-stun slaughter across the EU, seeks exemptions for Sweden to prohibit the import of such meat, and calls for warning labels on meat produced through non-stun methods. The motion emphasizes Sweden's role in improving animal welfare on a global scale and aims to promote ethical and sustainable food consumption.

title: Indelning av länder och språk på bibliotek
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2258 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: The suggestion advocates for increased tax transparency in Sweden, proposing that all tax deductions and contributions associated with every transaction should be disclosed. It argues that citizens currently lack a clear understanding of the total tax burden due to incomplete reporting on wage slips and consumer receipts. The proposal emphasizes that greater transparency will empower citizens to make informed decisions regarding consumption and hold decision-makers accountable.

title: Friare församlingstillhörighet
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a portal for individuals to access various government services and websites, similar to the existing portal for businesses, verksamt.se. The aim is to streamline the process for private individuals, allowing them to handle multiple official matters, such as registration and inquiries, through a single login, thus improving accessibility and efficiency in government interactions.

title: Förutsättningar för yrkesval i skolan
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the requirement for food service in order to obtain a liquor license in Sweden. The proponent argues that current laws are outdated and do not reflect the evolving dining culture in Sweden, which limits the ability of certain restaurants to serve alcohol. The motion advocates for more social gathering spaces by removing regulatory barriers tied to food service, allowing for a more flexible approach to alcohol distribution in various establishments.

title: Energi- och effektbrist i elsystemet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2255 av Betty Malmberg och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the school law and related regulations in Sweden to redefine who is eligible for access to the education system. Jörgen Grubb from the Sweden Democrats argues that the current definition of 'residents in Sweden' should be changed to 'registered in Sweden,' in response to the financial burden of immigration on municipalities, particularly in light of increased demand for public services such as education and elderly care.

title: Test - och demonstrationsanläggningar fjärde generationens kärnkraft
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2254 av Betty Malmberg och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for mandatory testing of driving abilities for individuals aged 65 and older, focusing on visual, auditory, perceptual, and reaction capabilities every five years to maintain their driver's license. The aim is to reduce traffic accidents caused by older drivers, despite acknowledging that younger drivers are more frequently involved in accidents. The tests are suggested to be free and government-funded.

title: Samordning mellan Kustbevakningen och gränspolisen
summary: The motion advocates for the construction of a new roadway specifically for trucks between Malmö and Helsingborg, addressing the current poor traffic conditions on the E6 highway. The proposal highlights issues such as frequent accidents, congestion, and disparities in speed limits that contribute to these problems. By creating a dedicated route for heavy truck traffic, the aim is to improve safety and traffic flow. Additionally, it mentions that expanding the existing E6 could also be necessary but suggests that a new road would minimize disruption during construction.

title: Svenskt medlemskap i Nato
summary: The proposal suggests lowering the capital gains tax on the sale of private residences to encourage more homeowners, particularly older individuals, to downsize to smaller homes. It argues that the current high rate of 22% discourages moves, causing housing shortages as many prefer to stay in larger homes. The suggestion includes a potential reduction of the capital gains tax to 11% for properties owned for at least five years, mimicking previous tax rules for stocks based on ownership duration, to facilitate housing mobility.

title: Föräldrars möjlighet att ta del av myndiga barns studieresultat
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the operations and future of the Allmänna arvsfonden, as well as how funds from the foundation should be allocated. It highlights concerns regarding the current distribution of funds to various organizations, some of which are questioned for their democratic foundations and values, suggesting that the fund is not living up to its mandate to support democratic activities.

title: Hinder med forskningsdata
summary: The motion proposes that an address in the population registry should only become valid after the tenant receives a confirmation from both the landlord and the property owner when renting in a sublet situation. This measure aims to combat welfare fraud linked to population registration abuses in Sweden, ensuring that resources are allocated correctly and that legitimate residents can receive the help they need without the risk of others exploiting the system.

title: Utveckla svensk försvarsindustri
summary: Hans Eklind from the Christian Democrats proposes a legislative amendment to include a prohibition against 'eftersupning' (drinking after driving) in traffic laws. He argues that the lack of such a law allows intoxicated drivers to evade punishment by claiming they consumed alcohol after driving, thus endangering public safety. Eklind points out that Norway effectively addresses this issue with their existing regulations, which have been in place for over 60 years, and calls for similar measures in Sweden to enhance traffic safety and uphold the country's zero vision for road fatalities.

title: Nationellt beredskapslager i Västmanland
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2248 av Åsa Coenraads och Mikael Damsgaard (båda M)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should require that salary taxes and fees are displayed on pay slips, aiming to increase taxpayer awareness of the extent of their tax burdens. This is particularly important as many taxpayers underestimate their tax payments, especially regarding employer contributions, which they commonly believe are solely borne by employers. The motion argues that a clearer presentation of these taxes will promote understanding and transparency of the tax system, as well as ensure that the government sets a good example by delineating gross salaries and applicable taxes and fees.

title: Åtgärder för att värna transporter och mobilitet i händelse av kris
summary: The motion proposes the cancellation of all coordination numbers in Sweden unless individuals can verify their identity in-person at the Tax Agency with valid ID. The motion emphasizes the ease of obtaining these numbers, which has contributed to a parallel society and identity fraud. It argues for stricter controls and time limitations on the use of coordination numbers, in contrast to the government's approach which is seen as facilitating the misuse of these numbers. The Kristdemocrats aim to enhance identity verification to combat the growing shadow society and associated crimes.

title: Forskningsinfrastruktur är grunden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review relevant legislation to allow local authorities to prohibit regular and institutionalized public calls to prayer (adhan) from religious buildings, regardless of noise levels. The proponent argues that while religious freedom is a fundamental right, it should not force individuals to listen to recurring calls to prayer in their homes, especially when such practices have not historically existed in Sweden. The motion emphasizes that the ability to stop these calls does not infringe upon religious freedoms but rather respects the rights of those who do not wish to be subjected to them.

title: Rakel
summary: The motion proposes that the government should review the regulations defining national interests for energy production to ensure they do not hinder modern urban planning. The author highlights the challenges posed by the designation of areas, such as the Barsebäck nuclear power plant site, which is currently under long-term deconstruction and cannot be utilized for years, despite local interest in developing housing and renewable energy projects in the area.

title: Försvaret av Göteborg och västkusten
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of introducing a gender-neutral personal identification number. This change aims to address practical issues faced by individuals undergoing gender transition, as the current personal numbers are designed for male and female categories. The motion advocates for equal rights and obligations for all individuals, independent of gender identity, and references similar initiatives in other countries.

title: Förtydliga och förenkla MKB
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiates an investigation into how municipalities define essential societal interests, particularly in relation to the protection of arable land. It highlights the importance of arable land for food production and addresses concerns that increasing construction for housing and infrastructure is encroaching on this vital resource. The motion argues for clearer guidelines to ensure that the exploitation of arable land is limited and that community interests do not override the necessity to preserve agricultural land.

title: Lagring av trafikuppgifter i underrättelsesyfte
summary: The proposal suggests that Skåne be designated as a pilot region for farm sales of beer, wine, and cider, allowing producers to sell their products directly to customers at their farms. This initiative aims to support local businesses and enhance consumer access to regional beverages, while still maintaining the existing monopoly of Systembolaget. The motion emphasizes the need for a swift investigation into this possibility, especially in light of changing circumstances post-COVID-19.

title: Förbättra för laglydiga jägare och vapenägare
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider automatically offering all women the opportunity for sick leave following a cesarean section, as well as ensuring uniform application of regulations regarding sick leave after such procedures. It highlights the dangers and challenges faced by women recovering from cesarean sections compared to those who have had uncomplicated deliveries, arguing for equal treatment and the proper assessment for sick leave eligibility to promote gender equality.

title: Värna Sveriges rullande kulturarv
summary: The Swedish government's written communication evaluates the Riksrevisionen's report on the Kommerskollegium's work against trade barriers, highlighting deficiencies in how the agency collects information from businesses, which may not adequately represent the collective Swedish economic interest. The government agrees with the report's findings and acknowledges the need for improvements in the effectiveness and efficiency of information gathering, as well as better reporting practices to enhance transparency and support for businesses affected by trade barriers.

title: Ökad beredskap för svinpest i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates an evaluation of the newly proposed changes to property tax regulations for agricultural properties, following the general property tax assessment scheduled for 2023. The changes aim to clarify and simplify the tax rules, improve register quality, and allow for automated decisions to reduce processing times. However, concerns have been raised about inadequate consequence descriptions of these changes, as presented by various stakeholders. The Christian Democrats stress the importance of evaluating the impact of these reforms and the possibility of further modifications if deemed necessary.

title: Dold adress och dolda personuppgifter för poliser
summary: The motion proposes the extension of criminal record checks for individuals working with children and youth, emphasizing the long-term harm caused by sexual offenses against minors. It argues that while individuals should not bear the burden of their past offenses indefinitely, crimes against children require stricter monitoring. The motion calls for ongoing checks to prevent individuals with past offenses from returning to positions where they could harm children, highlighting the necessity of safeguarding children and ensuring employers are informed.

title: Entreprenörskapsutbildning i skolan
summary: This motion proposes the abolishment of the monarchy in Sweden and suggests various reforms to enhance democratic values. It calls for investigations into eliminating the royal immunity from prosecution, ensuring religious freedom for the head of state, and removing restrictions on marriage for members of the royal family. The motion argues that a hereditary head of state is incompatible with a modern democratic society and that any representation of Sweden should be determined through democratic processes rather than inheritance.

title: Nya ungdomsstraff
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of implementing a system to confiscate valuables from asylum seekers upon their arrival in Sweden. The goal is to use these seized items to help finance the living expenses of the asylum seekers during the asylum process. Similar laws already exist in Denmark, Switzerland, and parts of Germany, which require asylum seekers to contribute financially if they possess significant wealth.

title: Låt Mälardalens högskola bli ett tekniskt universitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2235 av Åsa Coenraads och Mikael Damsgaard (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a ban on non-medical circumcision of children in Sweden, arguing that it violates the child's rights to integrity and self-determination. It highlights the lack of clear legal rights for circumcision on non-medical grounds and the conflicts between cultural practices and children's rights. The motion is supported by various medical professionals and organizations advocating for children's rights and emphasizes that such procedures should only occur with the individual's consent once they reach adulthood.

title: Bibehålla kompetenskrav
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2234 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposed by Richard Jomshof from the Sweden Democrats calls for a referendum on Sweden's immigration policy, arguing that the current approach has led to significant social issues, including crime and insecurity. Jomshof asserts that the Swedish population has not been adequately consulted on immigration matters, unlike in other European countries. He contends that the mass immigration is detrimental to Swedish society and suggests that the government should allow the people to decide on whether to maintain or restrict current immigration policies.

title: Förebygg skulder hos Kronofogden bland unga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament implement an advertising campaign similar to Denmark's, aimed at reducing the number of asylum seekers and family reunification immigrants coming to Sweden. The argument presented emphasizes the negative impact of high immigration on Swedish society and suggests that a public information initiative could effectively communicate the difficulties and limitations faced by potential immigrants, mirroring strategies used by the Danish government in 2015.

title: Bevara den personliga integriteten i skolan för personer med funktionsvariation
summary: The proposal from the Christian Democrats (KD) addresses changes to taxation rules for temporary work in Sweden, urging the government to simplify regulations by removing the 15-day working limit for foreign workers. It suggests that only a total cap on days worked should be applied, arguing that the current rules could deter foreign companies from conducting business in Sweden, thereby harming the country's economy and attractiveness as a location for conferences and projects.

title: Lunds historiska museum
summary: This proposal urges the Swedish government to clarify how parts of Sweden's policy for global development that are not covered by the new Agenda 2030 goal will be monitored. The Christian Democrats express support for the government's intentions in advancing Agenda 2030 but raise concerns about the potential reduction in reporting frequency from every two years to once per parliamentary term, which they believe could hinder oversight and evaluation of development cooperation efforts.

title: Kostnadsansvar vid arkeologiska utgrävningar
summary: The proposal advocates for significantly increased penalties for serious firearm offenses in response to current firearm legislation perceived as insufficient. It urges the separation of gun laws for illegal and legal firearms, ensuring that legal gun owners are not negatively affected by harsher penalties aimed at illegal firearms. The motion argues for a higher maximum sentence for particularly severe gun crimes, emphasizing the distinction between legal and illegal firearm possession and aiming to protect responsible gun owners from being penalized for minor infractions.

title: Krav för villkorlig frigivning
summary: The suggestion proposes to expand the authority of police officers to conduct body searches during interrogations beyond the current limits set to specific agencies and locations. This includes allowing searches in additional agency premises and enabling officers other than police to carry out these searches. The rationale emphasizes the need for enhanced protection for employees in law enforcement agencies in light of rising threats and violence, asserting that broader search rights would facilitate better cooperation between various authorities in crime prevention.

title: Bevarande av ålfisket
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2228 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes that the government should improve the management and reporting processes of holding companies associated with universities and colleges in Sweden. It suggests establishing clearer guidelines for the activities of these entities, ensuring that the board chair of each holding company possesses relevant business qualifications, and enhancing the development and monitoring of strategic goals and risk assessments within these companies. The aim is to address issues highlighted by the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the current oversight and management of holding companies.

title: Snabbare tillståndsprocesser för en snabbare omställning
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the establishment of a ferry connection between Skokloster and Knivsta in Uppsala County. The authors argue that such a service would greatly benefit the local population, facilitate commuting to major cities like Stockholm and Uppsala, promote tourism to Skokloster Castle, and contribute to the overall development of the area as it expands. Additionally, the ferry service is seen as a way to reduce travel distances, improve access to key locations, and enhance environmental considerations.

title: Avskaffa stämpelskatten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of introducing ten contact days per year for parents of children with chronic illnesses, similar to the current provision for parents of children eligible for LSS. The intent is to provide parents with greater opportunities to support and educate themselves about their child's needs, with the suggestion that this provision should also cover children with other chronic conditions like type 1 diabetes and epilepsy.

title: Tillsätt en förlossnings- och mödravårdskommission
summary: The proposal advocates for initiating an Arlanda negotiation to enhance infrastructure and economic recovery in Sweden's growth region in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. It stresses the importance of state involvement in infrastructure development to create jobs and facilitate sustainable urban expansion, connecting Stockholm and Uppsala, and outlines the significance of airports in fostering business and organizational collaboration.

title: Inför en möjlighet till förvarstagande av särskilt farliga brottslingar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2224 av Maria Malmer Stenergard och Jessika Roswall (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government assign Trafikverket to establish a graffiti policy and platform aimed at ensuring that graffiti is removed within a specific timeframe, similar to existing policies in municipalities and regions. This initiative is intended to create a safer and more aesthetically pleasing environment and to prevent further criminal behavior linked to vandalism.

title: Immateriellt kulturarv
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of Swedish firearm legislation to address the dual challenges of legal and illegal weapon ownership. It advocates for the elimination of time-limited licenses and a differentiation between administrative violations related to licensing and serious firearm offenses. The motion emphasizes that current government proposals could inadvertently punish lawful owners, such as hunters and sport shooters, while not effectively tackling the rise of illegal weapons, thereby highlighting a need for a more balanced approach.

title: Kultur på recept
summary: This motion advocates for governmental action to improve the effectiveness and fairness of the employment agency system in Sweden, acknowledging the challenges revealed by the National Audit Office's report regarding disparities in the performance of job centers. The motion highlights an increasing unemployment rate exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic and proposes that a reformed employment agency can better address the matching between job seekers and employers, ensuring that interventions are tailored to individual needs and taxpayer funds are utilized effectively.

title: Kulturkanon
summary: The proposal emphasizes the crucial role of the private sector in implementing Agenda 2030 and advocates for policies that promote growth to meet its goals. It underlines the importance of ensuring that national measures for emissions reductions do not lead to increased emissions elsewhere and calls for the government to raise national ambition levels where the country is currently falling short, particularly regarding violence reduction. The motion also suggests phasing out traditional development aid after the Agenda's implementation and mandates more frequent reporting on progress towards achieving these goals.

title: Kulturmiljöfrågor
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen legislation regarding the handling of firearms and explosives. It suggests criminalizing offenses related to flammable and explosive materials at the stages of trial, preparation, and conspiracy, as well as implementing stricter penalties for possession of explosives in public spaces. The proposal also advocates for a review of firearm legislation to differentiate between illegal firearms and offenses committed by licensed firearm holders, ensuring that the proposed legal changes do not negatively affect the rights of sport shooters and hunters. Additionally, the proposal highlights the necessity for better oversight of explosive materials management and the introduction of DNA-marking for commercial explosives to aid law enforcement investigations.

title: Kyrkohistoriskt museum
summary: The proposal from the Moderate Party seeks to clarify the responsibilities of housing cooperatives and real estate agents in the sale of newly produced condominiums, urging the government to enhance consumer rights by ensuring adequate information for buyers. The motion also calls for amendments to legislation related to consumers' rights to rescind purchases if there are unreasonable delays in the completion of properties, in response to identified gaps in consumer protection during such transactions.

title: Ett konkurrenskraftigt svenskt väginfrastruktursystem
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a system that enhances regional influence and coordination in the allocation of national resources for skills supply and skills matching in Sweden. It highlights the challenges faced in meeting tomorrow's skill needs and emphasizes the importance of a well-functioning skills supply system for individual, organizational, and regional development. The authors argue for increased regional control to optimize educational initiatives, suggesting that current national level decision-making limits local opportunities and does not adequately reflect regional priorities.

title: En konkurrenskraftig svensk järnväg
summary: The motion calls for the inclusion of labor market parties in the ongoing investigation to ensure that labor immigration in Sweden does not contribute to human trafficking. It emphasizes the need for companies to provide employees with fair working conditions and wages, as well as to prevent situations where employees are subject to unreasonable conditions and are unable to return to their home countries. The motion suggests that regular checks by labor market parties on member companies can help identify and address any irregularities in employee treatment.

title: Avskaffa trängselskatt
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament initiates an investigation into how to support individuals who were internationally adopted under incorrect circumstances. It highlights the historical context of international adoptions in Sweden, especially in cases where these adoptions were not conducted properly, and emphasizes the need to assist those who have recently discovered their adoption status and origins.

title: Dela upp Trafikverket i ett vägverk och ett banverk
summary: The proposal calls for the establishment of a daily ferry service across Skofjärden, connecting Skokloster in Håbo municipality with Örsand in Knivsta municipality. It highlights the increased importance of local tourism during the COVID-19 pandemic and the growing population in the Mälardalen area, which necessitates better transport links across the fjord. The motion emphasizes that a ferry could alleviate traffic on the narrow existing road and support both tourist and commuter access while considering environmental concerns.

title: Post och it i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the inclusion of the Stockholm-Uppsala route in the construction plans for high-speed railway connecting Stockholm, Malmö, and Göteborg. It argues that Uppsala, as a major city housing significant institutions and being part of a key life science cluster, should not be overlooked in railway developments. The motion emphasizes the importance of integrating Uppsala in national rail infrastructure plans to prevent traffic bottlenecks and ensure efficient transportation.

title: Nationellt undantag för husbilar över 7,5 ton
summary: The suggestion aims to enhance the safety and accessibility of public transportation for all, particularly for individuals with disabilities and women who may feel unsafe at dark bus stops. It advocates for improvements in bus stop infrastructure across both urban and rural areas, ensuring that no stops are excluded from upgrades. The proposal supports the continuation of the Multikoll project by Trafikverket, which focuses on making public transport more accessible and secure, particularly for schoolchildren.

title: Förtydliga yrkestrafiklagen vid tillfälliga avställningar av fordon
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the establishment of student health services at all institutions of higher education and emphasizes the importance of preventive outreach efforts by these services. Given the challenges students face, particularly due to changes brought on by the COVID-19 pandemic, the motion highlights the need for access to comprehensive medical care and mental health support for students. It advocates for an expansion of student health services' responsibilities to include preventive measures that can reduce illness and promote well-being.

title: En konkurrenskraftig svensk sjöfart
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament legislate the role of family homes in decisions regarding children's continuing care and well-being. Additionally, it advocates for providing family homes with ongoing support and training to enhance their effectiveness and ensure children's safety. The motion highlights the necessity for clarity in regulations concerning family homes and emphasizes the significant responsibility of municipalities to support these homes while improving their status within the community.

title: Förebyggande arbete mot gängkriminalitet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the initiative to consider utilizing national funds for the reconstruction of Hjulstabron. The rationale behind this is the significant increase in population and traffic in the region, leading to an urgent need for improved infrastructure to facilitate the transport of people and goods, particularly due to the rising freight traffic and military logistics. The motion emphasizes the necessity for a reliable transportation route over the Mälaren, highlighting the urgency for upgrading the bridge and surrounding roads.

title: Kashmir
summary: The motion proposes the construction of a pedestrian and bicycle path connecting Uppsala, Flottsund, and Vassunda, aiming to enhance traffic safety and promote outdoor activities. It emphasizes the growing need for such infrastructure, particularly in light of the COVID-19 pandemic, and underscores the historical and natural significance of the area. The motion highlights community support and collaboration among local municipalities and organizations, advocating for the timely initiation of the project to benefit public health, local tourism, and environmental awareness.

title: Företagens ansvar gällande mänskliga rättigheter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2208 av Serkan Köse och Mattias Vepsä (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of a new railway connection in the Arosstråket region to enhance transportation links between Enköping and Uppsala. This railway would significantly reduce travel times and improve connections to Arlanda airport, ultimately boosting economic integration and increasing the market share of public transportation in the area. It is identified as a vital investment to strengthen growth and address regional transportation deficiencies.

title: Socialtjänstlagen och äldres livskvalitet
summary: The proposal advocates for strengthening the responsibilities of municipalities to ensure that residents of elderly care facilities receive consistent physical training and activities. It emphasizes the importance of regular exercise for health benefits, especially for the elderly, and argues that such programs should be mandatory in all care homes, involving various staff members, not just physiotherapists. The suggestion reflects accumulated evidence showing the benefits of physical activity for improved health, reduced need for medication, and better overall wellbeing among older adults.

title: Ny strategi mot hemlöshet
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament legislates for long-term preventive work addressing children and youth to combat gang criminality. It emphasizes the need for society to take responsibility and provide alternatives to youth at risk, rather than merely increasing sentences and prison sentences. The motion advocates for improved collaboration between various societal sectors, including schools and social services, to offer necessary support to vulnerable children, and highlights the importance of non-criminal influences and role models in their lives.

title: Mänskliga rättigheter kränks i Xinjiang
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2205 av Serkan Köse och Thomas Hammarberg (båda S)
