summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament approve a clothing allowance for preschool personnel to help cover the costs of durable and weather-resistant work clothing, which is often paid for out of pocket by employees. It emphasizes the wear and tear on clothing due to the nature of the job, which includes active work with children, and suggests that a targeted clothing allowance would not only alleviate financial burden but also encourage staff to model appropriate dressing habits for children.

title: Bättre förutsättningar för ordning och reda på arbetsmarknaden
summary: The motion proposes a revision of the Law on Public Water Services (2006:412) to enable greater housing construction in rural areas by alleviating the financial risks for municipalities associated with forced connections to municipal water systems. The current law complicates development outside urban areas by mandating municipalities to connect all properties to public water systems if one private system fails. The motion suggests that municipalities should instead focus on ensuring clean water and functional wastewater solutions through enhanced oversight, and recommends a 10-year planning horizon for areas potentially affected by such changes.

title: Krav på F-skatt för underentreprenörer vid ROT-avdrag
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should mandate the acceptance of imported cans and bottles at all beverage container return stations, including those not covered by the Swedish deposit system. The aim is to minimize waste and encourage recycling by ensuring that these containers are accepted for return, preventing them from ending up in regular waste or the environment.

title: Se över sekretesslagen
summary: Michael Rubbestad's proposal advocates for a law change to prohibit the issuance of parking violations and control fees for emergency vehicles, such as police cars, ambulances, and fire trucks, during ongoing emergencies. The rationale is that these vehicles have the right to disregard parking prohibitions while responding to emergencies, yet they still face penalties related to paid parking, which the motion argues is unreasonable and wastes resources.

title: Kurder och Kurdistan
summary: Michael Rubbestad from the Sweden Democrats proposes an amendment to the Marketing Act that would require individuals to give active consent before receiving direct marketing materials. Currently, individuals can opt out by placing a sign indicating their refusal, but this motion aims to reverse the default assumption to one of consent. The proposal is intended to reduce waste and improve environmental outcomes by decreasing the amount of unsolicited paper distributed to households.

title: Ett folkrörelsernas museum
summary: The proposal suggests reducing the reminder fee for unpaid congestion tax and limiting the additional fee to cases where the reminder fee has not been paid. It also calls for vehicles to be removed from traffic and prohibited from driving until payment is made if the fees are not recorded by Transportstyrelsen by the due date. The motion argues that the current high additional fee is considered excessive by the public and asserts that the state should not rely on penalties from citizens’ mistakes to fund infrastructure projects.

title: Estetiska ämnen i grundskolan och i gymnasiet
summary: The proposal suggests expanding the anti-discrimination legislation in Sweden to include political opinion as a protected category. It highlights concerns about individuals feeling unsafe to express their political views due to potential repercussions in various sectors, including employment and public services. The motion emphasizes that political engagement is a fundamental right in a democracy, which should be safeguarded from discrimination, and calls upon the government to investigate these possibilities.

title: Moderniserade regler för arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The motion proposes an amendment to the Swedish Weapons Act to allow easier access to pepper spray by eliminating the restrictive licensing requirements currently in place. It suggests implementing educational and certification requirements for users, along with tracking and annual limits on purchases to prevent misuse. The motion argues that these measures would enhance personal safety, particularly in cases of assault or attempted sexual violence.

title: Om rättspolitik, straffrabatter och jämlikhet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2064 av Mathias Tegnér och Serkan Köse (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates the inclusion of PET-type soft drink bottles in the existing bottle deposit system, enhancing recycling efforts and reducing littering. This initiative follows a previous voluntary system that saw a significant participation from retailers, and aims to further improve the sustainability of packaging in Sweden.

title: Trygghet för brottsoffer och övergrepp i rättssak
Marint reservat runt Arktis
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2062 av Mathias Tegnér och Serkan Köse (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into national interests and protected coastal areas to reduce their extent in favor of housing construction. It suggests limiting the right to appeal in planning and building processes. The motivation emphasizes the need for a balance between environmental protection and the demand for housing, arguing that current regulations disproportionately hinder development and that a more equitable representation of experts from various sectors is required in decision-making processes.

title: Om konsumtionsbaserade klimatmål
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Armed Forces should implement complete uniform neutrality, prohibiting uniformed personnel from wearing their uniforms at political demonstrations or events where personal, political, or religious symbols may be displayed. The motion criticizes the decision to allow uniformed personnel to participate in pride parades, viewing it as a political stance that undermines the neutrality of the armed forces. The authors argue that strict adherence to these guidelines should be enforced at all times, both during working hours and off-duty.

title: Upprustning av nattåg
summary: The proposal calls for an investigation into the regulation of loot boxes and similar lottery-like mechanisms in video games, emphasizing the rising popularity of these features among children and adolescents. It highlights concerns regarding the introduction of minors to gambling and the potential for gaming addiction. The motion advocates for clearer legislation that extends existing gaming laws to cover loot boxes, ensuring the same regulations apply regardless of the platform or technology used.

title: Möjliggör tillväxt norr om odlingsgränsen
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate measures to combat the abuse of lost passports. Despite a law enacted in 2016 aimed at making it more difficult and costly to lose a passport, the issue persists, with tens of thousands of passports reported lost each year, exacerbating the black market for Swedish identification documents. The motion calls for further restrictions to address this ongoing problem, which undermines the legitimacy of Swedish identification and could impact citizens' ability to travel abroad.

title: Regionalpolitik för ökad tillväxt och jämlikhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate measures and actions to address the criminal activities of animal rights extremists, who have reportedly threatened hunters and engaged in vandalism against hunting-related properties. The author emphasizes the need for increased resources for relevant authorities to combat such criminal behavior and protect both hunters and livestock farmers.

title: Åtgärder för att omgående förbättra tvångsvården av unga och missbrukare
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into improvements and measures regarding the working environment and labor market conditions for night workers in Sweden. It highlights the challenges faced by individuals working unconventional hours, particularly night shifts, which can impact family life, health, and well-being. The motion emphasizes the need for solutions, such as reduced working hours for night workers, to enhance their quality of life and addresses the lack of night-time childcare options that can affect single parents.

title: Hållbar offentlig upphandling för klimat och rättvisa
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of allowing the use of studded tires until April 30, regardless of road conditions, and to revert to the regulations that were in place before December 1, 2009. The motivation highlights the unpredictable weather conditions in Sweden during mid-April, which can lead to increased accident risks if drivers are forced to switch to summer tires too early, and stresses the importance of road safety over concerns about air pollution from studded tires.

title: Föräldraledighet för tvillingföräldrar
summary: The motion proposes improvements to sexual education in Swedish schools by emphasizing relationships and responsibility in sexual conduct, enhancing the quality of teaching, and strengthening gender equality in the curriculum. It emphasizes the need for teacher training in sexual education and suggests involving qualified professionals to provide comprehensive and unbiased education. The need for a balanced approach to sexual education is highlighted to ensure that young people are equipped with knowledge about relationships, consent, and respect, alongside preventing early sexual debut and associated risks.

title: Personalens hälsa får inte riskeras
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2054 av Caroline Helmersson Olsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal advocates for the creation of guidelines for a family-friendly train service in order to facilitate easier travel for families with young children. It emphasizes the need for designated spaces on trains for strollers, as well as access to appropriately equipped restrooms with changing tables. The motion stresses the importance of enabling families to travel by train while reducing the challenges they currently face, such as limited space and inadequate assistance from train staff.

title: Arbete och boende längs västkusten och i Dalsland
summary: The proposal aims to prohibit all forms of call to prayer (böneutrop) from religious buildings in Sweden. The motion argues that such calls are not only religious expressions but also public proclamations of Islam, potentially infringing on the rights of non-Muslims to freedom from religious messaging in public spaces. The motion insists that religious beliefs should remain private and that any public expression of faith should require permits like other public gatherings, asserting a need for a secular public environment.

title: Möten efter covid-19
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should initiate new regulations to reinstate stricter environmental standards for vehicle inspections, including higher requirements for emissions testing and specific checks on electric and hydrogen vehicles' electrical systems. It also advocates for the prohibition of additional costs imposed on vehicle owners during inspections of gas vehicle tanks and lines, emphasizing the need for Sweden to lead in environmental efforts, as current standards have been lowered, putting Sweden among the EU countries with the least stringent vehicle inspection requirements.

title: Långsiktigt hållbar energiförsörjning i hela landet
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for improved working conditions for teachers and educational staff in Sweden. It suggests that the government should investigate requirements for school authorities to facilitate training and certification for unqualified personnel in preschools, schools, and leisure centers. The motion also calls for the introduction of measures to enhance teachers' working environments, advocating for better support systems and increased educational opportunities to address the shortage of qualified educators, while also highlighting the need to strengthen the role of support staff to ensure quality education.

title: Metallsökning som hobby
summary: The parliamentary motion proposes several measures aimed at strengthening consumer protection in Sweden's financial markets. Key recommendations include adopting a Finnish model for mortgage loans, investigating the advantages and disadvantages of banning product packaging, requiring annual cost summaries from banks, mandating banks to accept cash deposits from individuals and businesses, and ensuring that retailers accept cash payments. The motion also calls for investigations into pricing signaling on the banking market, high-frequency trading regulations, and equitable access to financial infrastructure.

title: Erkännande av älvdalskan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2049 av Roza Güclü Hedin m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion advocates for a comprehensive review of family law in Sweden to ensure it is both materially and linguistically gender-neutral. It proposes legislative measures that would allow couples and single women the explicit right to choose a known donor for assisted reproduction, as well as the ability for sperm donors to confirm paternity. The motion highlights the outdated and heteronormative nature of current laws, arguing for legal reforms to promote equal rights for all family structures, including same-sex couples.

title: Avdragsrätt för medlemsavgift i fackföreningar och arbetslöshetskassor
summary: The proposal advocates for the transformation of police education into a higher education program with a professional degree, aimed at enhancing specialists' competence within the police force. It calls for government investigations to explore creating more entry points into police training, evaluating the psychological interviews in the recruitment process, and establishing an institute for police scientific research. The motion emphasizes improving the educational framework to prevent high turnover rates among police officers and to foster a more effective policing system through better training and research integration.

title: Förbättrade villkor för nämndemän
summary: The proposal advocates for further investigation into the increasing digitalization of schools in Sweden, taking into account experiences from the 2020 shift to distance learning during the COVID-19 pandemic. It suggests that the government commission Skolverket to create quality labels for secure apps and digital resources that safeguard student privacy, as well as for educational materials aligned with the curriculum's values. Additionally, it calls for Skolinspektionen to investigate potential misuse of distance learning, emphasizing the need for technical support and equitable access to digital tools in education, while cautioning against rapid digitalization that may compromise educational integrity.

title: Högre böter och utökad hastighetsövervakning vid vägarbetsplatser
summary: The motion proposes significant reforms to strengthen job security in Sweden by amending the Employment Protection Act. Key proposals include eliminating general fixed-term contracts, introducing objective criteria for temporary employment, establishing a maximum duration for fixed-term contracts, and enhancing re-employment rights. The motion argues that current labor laws favor employers and undermine worker rights, leading to increased job insecurity and a decline in collective bargaining power. The Vänsterpartiet (Left Party) seeks to protect workers' rights and restore balance in power dynamics between employers and employees.

title: Inför fastighetsboxar i flerfamiljshus
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should investigate and modernize civil duty in light of current security challenges, emphasizing the necessity for a civil defense that includes diverse roles beyond military service. It suggests reintroducing civil duty to enhance national preparedness for various crises, including environmental, health, and social issues, while ensuring that this duty reflects the skills and motivations of individuals within the community.

title: En konkurrenskraftig svensk flygindustri
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for stricter regulations on private health insurance policies to ensure they align with the public health care laws in Sweden. It argues that private health insurance creates inequities in access to health care, allowing wealthier individuals to receive faster and potentially better care than those without insurance. The motion calls for the government to conduct a comprehensive review of the impacts of private health insurance on public healthcare, particularly concerning patients with high medical needs, such as the elderly and those with chronic conditions. Additionally, it seeks to prevent private insurance from conflicting with the principles of equal access and necessity in healthcare services.

title: Krav på verksamhetsövergång och meddelarfrihet vid upphandlingar i kollektivtrafiken
summary: The motion advocates for a national responsibility in Sweden for the reception and integration of newly arrived immigrants, emphasizing the need for the government to conduct investigations into existing programs, particularly the establishment program and the settlement law. The proposal highlights the shortcomings of these initiatives and calls for enhanced state oversight and funding to address challenges faced by municipalities, aiming to promote effective integration into the labor market and society.

title: Forskning och riktlinjer vid lipödem
summary: The government's proposition proposes a temporary amendment to the regulations for the First to Fourth AP Funds, allowing these public pension funds to exceed the current voting rights limitation on holdings in individual Swedish stock companies. This change aims to support liquidity in companies affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, enabling the funds to acquire additional shares exclusively through new issues, with the maximum holding capped at 15% of the voting rights. Any excess holdings must be divested within a specified timeframe to minimize losses for the funds.

title: Förbättra missbruks- och beroendevården
summary: Nina Lundström proposes that cycling should receive equal status in transportation planning and recommends various measures to enhance cycling infrastructure and safety. Her suggestions include establishing criteria for traffic safety cameras focused on cycling, allowing right turns on red lights, maintaining a minimum passing distance of 1.5 meters for vehicles overtaking cyclists, implementing uniform signage for cyclists, and encouraging car-free cycling events. The motion emphasizes the importance of promoting sustainable transport options and improving road conditions for cyclists to enhance safety and encourage more people to cycle.

title: Ökat statligt ansvar för infrastruktur med riksintresse
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2040 av Marianne Pettersson och Per-Arne Håkansson (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes that Sweden's implementation of the Agenda 2030 should be based on the Swedish context, focusing on national needs and circumstances while also ensuring that it benefits the nation and its municipalities. It argues for clear goals, measurable outcomes, and a strong link to economic growth, suggesting that Sweden should prioritize addressing domestic issues over international leadership in sustainable development. The motion highlights the importance of sustainable climate and environmental policies, including investments in advanced nuclear power, while advocating for responsible stewardship of national resources and a tailored approach to the existing parliamentary goals.

title: Stöd till personer med funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government adopt a global strategy for sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) to enhance international efforts and support women's rights worldwide. It emphasizes the need for sustainable water and sanitation systems, encourages the International Criminal Court to address sexual violence, and advocates for continued Swedish support for women's rights, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The motion also calls for increased humanitarian aid for SRHR, greater focus on conflict prevention, and the prioritization of women's issues, particularly for marginalized groups such as the LGBTQ+ community. Overall, it aims to strengthen Sweden's leadership in promoting gender equality globally.

title: Skapa permanent beredskapslager för material, vacciner och mediciner
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of Sweden's addiction care policy, emphasizing the need for a national coordinator to oversee dependency issues and the establishment of a national knowledge center for interventions against drug-related harm and deaths. It advocates for integrating gender perspectives in addiction treatment, moving the responsibility of dependency care for individuals over 18 to regional units, and enhancing care guarantees for individuals with dependencies. The motion also recommends implementing syringe exchange programs nationwide, accessibility of naloxone, decriminalizing personal drug use, and improving support systems for women and young people at risk of addiction.

title: Öresundsmetron
summary: The suggestion from Maj Karlsson and others advocates for various social support measures for individuals involved in prostitution and human trafficking for sexual purposes. It calls for clearer responsibilities for municipalities in providing social assistance, the establishment of a national exit program for those wishing to leave prostitution, and the creation of a national resource center to coordinate efforts against prostitution and human trafficking across Sweden.

title: Kommunala hastighetskameror
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2036 av Joakim Sandell och Niklas Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion from Vänsterpartiet addresses various rights and challenges faced by individuals with disabilities in Sweden, advocating for the incorporation of the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities into Swedish law. It proposes measures to enhance legal protection against hate crimes, increase participation of persons with disabilities in democratic processes, and improve accessibility across various sectors. The motion also emphasizes the need for a national action plan to address health disparities, advocate for job inclusion, and ensure state responsibility in providing personal assistance.

title: Socialtjänst och barnfrågor
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2035 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion presents various proposals aimed at modernizing Sweden's policy toward the Sámi people, including establishing a truth commission, repatriating Sámi remains, ratifying ILO 169, and improving consultations regarding Sámi rights. The motion emphasizes the need for Sweden to acknowledge historical injustices, implement the UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples, and ensure that Sámi voices are integrated into decisions affecting their lands and communities. It seeks to enhance Sámi self-determination and welfare through legislative measures and government actions.

title: Enhet för att stävja fusk hos Försäkringskassan
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should initiate an investigation into the feasibility of a general reduction in working hours, aiming for a shorter workweek with maintained salaries. It highlights the historical struggle for reduced working hours, current working conditions characterized by stress and gender inequality, and the growing productivity that supports the potential for a shorter workweek. The motion calls for a national initiative to test a six-hour workday in various sectors and emphasizes the need for continued exploration and discussion around working hours in relation to societal and economic development.

title: Psykisk ohälsa
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government introduces legislation allowing tenants with historical leases to buy out their properties and abolishes the institution of fideicommiss, which is a legal construct that restricts property ownership rights. The proposal argues that the current arrangement creates an imbalance of power between landowners and tenants and preserves remnants of a feudal system. The authors emphasize the need for a legislative change to ensure fair rights for tenants and to promote equal property ownership opportunities.

title: En värdig funktionsrättspolitik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2032 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The proposal by Per Lodenius advocates for the commemoration of the 100th anniversary of the Ålandsöverenskommelsen in 2021, emphasizing its historical significance for Åland and its relationship with Sweden. The motion requests the Swedish Parliament to recognize this milestone and encourage the government to collaborate with Åland's representatives in the celebrations.

title: Apotek och läkemedel
summary: The proposal by Daniel Bäckström calls for a review and clarification of the missions of wildlife management delegations in Sweden to ensure local and regional influence in decisions related to predator management. The motion highlights concerns about the current low impact of these delegations on decision-making, the centralization of authority, and the increasing disconnect between rural communities and government bodies. Strengthening regional involvement is deemed crucial for fostering public trust in wildlife management.

title: ANDT-politik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate an investigation into the access to post-secondary education for individuals with intellectual disabilities. It emphasizes the need for a comprehensive review of various factors that affect this access, including funding, the format of education, and logistical support such as housing and travel. The motion argues that existing studies and regulations do not sufficiently address these issues and calls for the development of a cohesive framework to facilitate better educational opportunities for this group.

title: En nära och tillgänglig vård
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports actions to develop more bicycle paths alongside state roads to promote cycling as a viable means of transportation for commuting and recreational purposes, particularly for children and individuals living in rural areas. It emphasizes the need for safety improvements to facilitate cycling, especially given the increasing reliance on personal vehicles and the desire to avoid public transport during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: En tillgänglig sjukvård i världsklass
summary: The motion proposes a review of the law governing the management of community facilities to address issues that arise from the current consensus requirement, which allows minority owners significant control and can hinder necessary maintenance and improvement actions by the majority. The motion also calls for a simplified and cost-effective process to transfer 'useless' community facilities to interested property owners, as well as for Lantmäteriet to provide services at reasonable and predictable prices, particularly for rural areas facing unique challenges.

title: God vård och omsorg om äldre
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2027 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats (SD) critiques the government's suggestion of a regional tax reduction aimed at economically weaker municipalities, arguing that it fosters geographic division instead of cohesion. The SD asserts that the proposed tax relief is minimal and fails to adequately address the needs of residents in other regions facing similar economic challenges. They advocate for an alternative approach focusing on lowering income and fuel taxes and enhancing deductions for travel to work, which they believe would more effectively support households in need.

title: Ekonomisk trygghet för barn och familj
summary: The motion by the Sweden Democrats calls for the government to address the challenges faced by Sweden's part-time firefighters, particularly pertaining to recruitment and the impact of unemployment insurance regulations on their employment. The existing rules significantly hinder recruitment and retention rates among part-time firefighters, as they risk losing unemployment benefits if they lose their primary job. The motion urges the government to provide a solution that better supports these essential personnel for maintaining emergency readiness.

title: Hållbar konsumtion för att nå netto noll senast 2045
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2025 av Mattias Vepsä och Magnus Manhammar (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a government-operated platform for all public procurement in Sweden, managed by the Procurement Authority. This platform aims to enhance transparency and competition in public procurement processes, allowing all businesses to register for free and follow relevant procurement opportunities. The intent is to improve access for small and newly established companies, ultimately leading to better quality and lower prices for public services and products, benefiting taxpayers and enabling better oversight by citizens and media.

title: En jämlik skola fri från avgifter
summary: The proposal suggests renaming Sweden's representation in Taiwan to 'Sveriges kontor i Taipei' to strengthen diplomatic relations between Sweden and Taiwan, which share core values like democracy, human rights, and the rule of law. The motion argues that formal recognition and enhanced cooperation would align with Sweden's stance on supporting democracy globally and would follow the example of other European nations that have established similar offices in Taiwan.

title: Öka hållbart och jämställt svenskt jordbruksbistånd för att bekämpa hungern i spåren av corona
summary: The suggestion proposes the establishment of a constitutional court in Sweden to enhance the separation of powers and ensure that legislation aligns with fundamental rights protected by the constitution. It argues that current mechanisms for reviewing laws are insufficient and that an independent constitutional court would strengthen the protection of individual rights against the state. The motion calls for an investigation into the structure, appointment, and mandate of this proposed court.

title: Skatteöversyn för ökad jämlikhet och rättvisa
summary: This proposal calls for an investigation into the limitations on how municipalities can use dividends from municipal companies. It highlights the inappropriate use of these funds for municipal operations instead of their intended purpose, potentially burdening customers and increasing financial risk. The motion suggests that dividends should primarily finance necessary investments, with restrictions on using them for operational costs, unless in exceptional circumstances of unforeseen revenue shortfalls.

title: Kontinuitet i vården och reglering av nätläkare
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2021 av Anna Vikström och Ingela Nylund Watz (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate how to prioritize among the country's strategically important ports, advocating for a more pronounced state responsibility instead of relying solely on local municipalities. It argues that consolidating operations to around 10 key ports could reduce costs associated with shipping and trade, thereby making Swedish exports more competitive and ensuring smoother logistical operations.

title: Måltidsavgifter i särskilt boende
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should advocate for the EU to enter into a bilateral investment agreement (BIA) with Taiwan, aiming to deepen trade relations and strengthen economic cooperation. The motion emphasizes the shared values of democracy and human rights between Sweden and Taiwan and highlights the potential benefits such an agreement could bring, not only in enhancing economic growth and job creation but also in supporting democratic principles in East Asia.

title: Undernäring bland Sveriges äldre
summary: The motion proposes to investigate consolidating the responsibilities of various Swedish transportation agencies into a single authority located in Western Sweden. It argues that despite the existence of Trafikverket, which oversees road, rail, maritime, and air transport, other agencies like Luftfartsverket and Sjöfartsverket operate separately with unclear justifications. The proposal advocates for increased coordination across different modes of transport to enhance efficiency and competition neutrality, thereby benefiting industries reliant on transportation in the region, particularly in light of significant local players like the Volvo Group.

title: En inkluderande arbetsmarknad
summary: The motion, presented by Niklas Wykman and others from the Moderate Party, opposes the government proposal for a tax reduction aimed at residents in sparsely populated areas. It argues that such a tax reduction would create new injustices in the Swedish tax system instead of addressing underlying economic issues such as high unemployment and low growth, particularly in rural areas. The Moderates advocate for general tax reductions to promote job creation and investment across Sweden, emphasizing measures like increased job tax deductions and reduced marginal taxes as more effective solutions to enhance economic vitality in both urban and rural settings.

title: Nationellt samordnad vård för personer med sällsynta diagnoser
summary: The suggestion from the Christian Democrats advocates for the Swedish government to consider selling off state-owned companies that do not have a specific societal mission or are not strategically important. Additionally, it calls for an improvement in the governance of these state-owned enterprises, particularly in light of mismanagement observed during the COVID-19 pandemic. The proposal emphasizes the need for clarity in the state's role as an owner, ensuring effective competition and adherence to market principles, while also highlighting the importance of transparency and sustainability among state-owned entities.

title: Principbeslut för nya stambanor
summary: The suggestion proposes changes to the unemployment insurance law to exempt part-time firefighters from income calculations affecting their unemployment benefits. It also calls for the government to empower the Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency (MSB) and county administrative boards to assist municipalities in developing risk management plans for drought and water shortages. This aims to strengthen community protection and preparedness in light of increasing risks due to climate change and the recent challenges faced by part-time firefighters during the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Offentliggörande av skolstatistik
summary: The motion proposes a reassessment of the governance and role of state-owned companies in Sweden, emphasizing the need for responsible management, better competition, and clearer boundaries for state engagement in public opinion. It also suggests giving the government a mandate to responsibly reduce its ownership in Svenska Spel's competitive market segments.

title: Delnings- och plattformsekonomin
summary: The motion aims to enhance the efficiency of Sweden's return policy in migration by addressing conflicts within migration policy, improving coordination between authorities, and revising data protection laws. It proposes the establishment of a joint working group among the Migration Agency, Police Authority, and Criminal Care, directed to identify and overcome practical and legal obstacles. The motion emphasizes the necessity of clear accountability to ensure that a rejection of residency applications is enforced, thereby promoting a more sustainable migration policy.

title: Jämlik barndom
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government promptly address the issue of exporting environmentally friendly cars without increasing the administrative burden or significantly reducing incentives for purchasing these vehicles in Sweden. The suggestion emphasizes the importance of the bonus-malus system in encouraging the transition to low-emission vehicles and highlights the need for measures to prevent subsidized climate bonus vehicles from being exported. The motion also advocates for the public sector to lead by example by committing to procure only environmentally friendly vehicles.

title: Tandvård
summary: The motion proposes a review of the state's ownership policy regarding its companies to make it clearer and to ensure better competition and procurement oversight for state-owned enterprises. The Center Party acknowledges the importance of state ownership while emphasizing the need for transparency, accountability, and sustainability in managing these businesses, particularly in light of their societal impact and the role of the government as both legislator and owner.

title: Förstärkt polisutbildning i Järva
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes that the Swedish Riksdag supports continuous evaluation of the effects of the RUT tax deduction, following insights from the Swedish National Audit Office's report. The motion emphasizes the need for ongoing studies to better understand the economic impacts, employment effects, and the potential for reducing black market labor among households. It highlights the RUT deduction's role in enhancing women's labor market participation and encourages the government to acknowledge the necessity of systematic evaluations.

title: Hemförsäkring för allmännyttan
summary: The motion proposes amending the regulations under the Public Order Act to facilitate temporary shooting ranges for hunters, allowing them to train safely without needing permits, which has become a bureaucratic burden. The author argues that current requirements for permits are unnecessary and do not reflect the safety record of hunting training activities, advocating for the removal of these regulations to support the hunting community.

title: Samordningsinstans för utländska direktinvesteringar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2009 av Maria Strömkvist och Roza Güclü Hedin (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish Parliament that the government conduct thorough consequence analyses for measures in the transport sector aimed at increasing the proportion of environmentally friendly vehicles. It suggests replacing the current bonus-malus system with a more efficient alternative that promotes greater emissions reductions. Furthermore, the motion calls for urgent action to address the issue of exported environmental vehicles, which lead to taxpayer funds subsidizing foreign markets.

title: Utvecklad besöksnäring Malingsbo-Kloten
summary: The motion proposes the removal of the permit requirement for placing timber on one's own land, arguing that current regulations do not enhance traffic safety and act as a hidden tax on the forestry industry. The author suggests that the costs associated with permits deter landowners from necessary forestry practices, which could worsen problems such as bark beetle infestations.

title: Statliga myndigheters ansvar för regional utveckling
summary: The proposal suggests that individuals residing in sparsely populated municipalities in Sweden should be allowed to have their student loans forgiven more rapidly to address the shortage of skilled labor in these areas. It argues that high taxes and poor services have made rural areas less attractive for professionals such as teachers, engineers, and doctors, leading to a decline in local communities. The motion calls for the implementation of a system similar to that in Norway, which facilitates quicker student loan forgiveness for rural residents, as a means to counteract this trend.

title: Ansvarsfullt ägande för statliga bolag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2006 av Maria Strömkvist och Roza Güclü Hedin (båda S)
summary: This proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to support the introduction of a national action plan against bullying, highlighting the absence of such a plan and the necessity to address violence against children. It advocates for a comprehensive approach that includes prevention, identification, investigation, rehabilitation, and monitoring of violence against children, in alignment with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The proposal emphasizes the need for government action and the involvement of children in planning and implementing measures to ensure their rights and protection.

title: Arbetsförmedlingen i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a cap on the number of children allowed in a single foster home, citing concerns that many children in need are placed in homes where their care may be compromised due to overcrowding. The proposer argues that children who have been removed from their families deserve an upbringing similar to that of a typical family, with sufficient adult attention and support. The motion calls for the government to investigate and establish a suitable limit to ensure a more nurturing environment for foster children.

title: Farmaceut på distans
summary: The motion proposes that children should never be placed in foster care with families that have debts registered with the Swedish enforcement authority, Kronofogden. It argues that financial burdens on foster families can jeopardize the care and welfare of the placed children, and urges the government to amend social services legislation to reflect this principle.

title: Biblioteken som centrum för livslångt lärande
summary: The motion proposes allowing employers to pay off their employees' student loans to address the shortage of skilled labor in rural areas of Sweden. It highlights the difficulties faced in attracting professionals such as teachers, engineers, and doctors to work in less populated municipalities, and suggests that employer-sponsored loan payments could incentivize these individuals to relocate. While longer-term solutions have been proposed, the motion calls for immediate actions that can be implemented to reverse the negative trend of population decline in these areas.

title: Mer jämlika fritidsaktiviteter för barn och unga
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2002 av Linus Sköld och Ida Karkiainen (båda S)
summary: The proposal recommends transitioning to open source software and open standards within the public sector to reduce dependency on specific vendors, improve software reliability, and enable cost savings. It highlights the increasing trend towards open solutions in Swedish public administration, as encouraged by initiatives like the E-delegation. The transition faces challenges, notably the inertia created by existing vendor contracts and the comfort with current solutions, but a principled stance on adopting open source is deemed essential for the future.

title: Lagreglera kulturskolan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:2001 av Linus Sköld och Ida Karkiainen (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament examine the feasibility of establishing year-round ferry traffic between Oskarshamn and Byxelkrok to alleviate traffic on Ölandsbron, especially during the summer when tourism significantly increases the local population. The proposal suggests that enhanced ferry services would provide better commuting options for residents of northern Öland, enabling them to access job opportunities in Oskarshamn, thus supporting local economic growth and community development.

title: Bostäder på landsbygden
summary: The motion proposes that every municipality in Sweden should have a legally mandated minimum police staffing level to address rising insecurity, particularly in rural areas. It calls for a parliamentary investigation to examine ways to reduce bureaucracy within the Police Authority and enhance organizational efficiency, aiming to ensure that all citizens receive adequate police service regardless of their location.

title: Ställföreträdare – bättre rättssäkerhet, kvalitet och rekrytering
summary: The proposed motion suggests that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of establishing a marine archaeological museum for the regalskepp Kronan, regalskepp Svärdet, and amiralskepp Mars on Öland or in Kalmar. This museum would serve to display artifacts recovered from these historical ships and prevent looting of the Svärdet wreck. The authors argue that such a museum would enhance tourism, create jobs, and allow for a full excavation and reconstruction of the Kronan wreck, making the finds accessible to visitors.

title: Ett tredje juridiskt kön
summary: The motion proposes the upgrading of the Stångådalsbanan and Tjustbanan railways in southeastern Sweden, emphasizing the importance of improved infrastructure for rural areas to enhance commuting options and stimulate local economies. Additionally, it calls for an investigation into the feasibility of a new coastal railway to better connect the labor market regions in the area, addressing existing infrastructure deficiencies that hinder development and contributing to population stagnation.

title: Regnbågsblod
summary: Moderaterna propose a series of reforms to strengthen Sweden's municipal rescue services, focusing on increased state oversight, maintaining local leadership structures, ensuring democratic legitimacy in decision-making, and addressing employment concerns for part-time firefighters. The motion supports the need for a thorough investigation of the organization of rescue services to ensure equity and efficiency across municipalities, while rejecting the government's plan to shift supervisory responsibilities to the Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency.

title: Färdtjänst till och från idrottsträning
summary: The motion put forth by Hanna Gunnarsson and others from the Left Party calls for the government to conduct an investigation into the possibility of regional or state governance of the fire service to enhance uniformity and coordination. It opposes the proposal allowing municipalities to delegate initial emergency actions to private entities, arguing this could lead to privatization of emergency services. Additionally, it emphasizes the need to create exceptions for part-time firefighters in unemployment benefit calculations and advocates for a more comprehensive and effective national fire service management.

title: Betaltjänster för föreningar
summary: The parliamentary motion proposes an exemption for part-time firefighters from unemployment insurance calculations to enhance recruitment and improve the effectiveness of municipal rescue services in Sweden. It highlights the long-standing challenges in recruiting part-time firefighters and suggests that modifying regulations around unemployment benefits could help address these issues. The motion also calls for increased support from the Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency (MSB) for municipalities in recruiting and training part-time firefighters, aiming for a more equitable level of emergency response across the country.

title: Förstärkning av skolans normkritiska arbete
summary: The government proposes to expand the possibilities for converting unpaid fines into prison sentences in cases of blatant defiance from the fined individual. This change removes the requirement that it must be obvious that the individual is willfully avoiding payment and modernizes the language used in the law. The intention is to make the penalty for fines credible and effective as a deterrent by ensuring that those with the means to pay their fines do so, promoting the use of fines as a punishment for offenses effectively.

title: En öppen, obligatorisk och avgiftsfri förskola
summary: The government proposes amendments to the existing laws regarding photographs and fingerprints in relation to the Schengen Information System (SIS II), making it mandatory for foreigners undergoing entry or exit checks to provide these biometric data to facilitate their identification when their identity cannot be established otherwise. This is in response to updates in EU regulations and aims to enhance border security and cooperation among member states.

title: Lärarledd tid som konkurrensfaktor för universitet och högskolor
summary: The government proposes an amendment to the Immigration Data Act to allow the processing of sensitive personal data in testing activities, provided these data are absolutely necessary for the purpose of the processing. This change aims to enable the Swedish Migration Agency, the Police Authority, and foreign authorities to develop and test necessary technology for effective and legally sound operations, particularly in light of EU regulations requiring the processing of sensitive data such as biometrics.

title: Gör det allmänna uppdraget flerårigt
summary: Eric Palmqvist's motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate how to best prevent legionella outbreaks originating from cooling tower facilities. The motion suggests exploring the implementation of a registration or permit requirement for these facilities to improve public health safeguards, given the potential dangers that legionella bacteria pose and the lack of effective tracking measures for existing cooling towers. The motion highlights past incidents of legionella infections linked to cooling towers and emphasizes the need for a national regulatory framework.

title: En samlad klövviltsförvaltning
summary: The motion proposes the restoration and relocation of the Riksäpple sculptures to Helgeandsholmen, emphasizing the importance of preserving cultural heritage. The authors argue that many of these sculptures are currently neglected and scattered around Stockholm, requiring restoration and a proper setting close to the Parliament.

title: Stärk hem- och konsumentkunskapen i skolan
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish government to ensure the existence of domestic industries capable of converting their production to manufacturing protective equipment during crises. It highlights past failures in preparedness, particularly illustrated during the COVID-19 pandemic when a lack of protective gear for healthcare personnel resulted in severe consequences. The motion emphasizes the need for increased domestic production of protective materials to secure Sweden's ability to respond effectively in future crises.

title: Behovspröva barnbidraget
summary: The proposal aims to introduce an age limit for tires, suggesting that old and cracked tires pose significant safety risks for vehicles. The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining tires in good condition as they are the sole contact between vehicles and the road, impacting acceleration, braking, and cornering capabilities. It advocates for government investigation into implementing tire age restrictions and establishing penalties for violations, paralleling existing regulations on tire tread depth and suitability.

title: Kontantanvändning – en valfrihetsfråga
summary: The motion proposes the investigation of the possibility to introduce a new vehicle class in Sweden, termed 'light passenger car', modeled after Finland's vehicle classification system. The aim is to address the transportation needs of youth, particularly in rural areas, by providing greater mobility without compromising safety. The proposal highlights the importance of transportation for young people's daily activities and the necessity of adapting vehicle regulations to better suit contemporary needs, thereby supporting rural development and youth independence.

title: Höj tjänstehundars och tjänstehästars rättsstatus
summary: The motion highlights the need for improved voting accessibility for visually impaired individuals in Sweden, emphasizing that the current system does not allow them to exercise their voting rights fully and privately. The proposal calls for the development and implementation of technical solutions to ensure that all eligible voters, including those with visual impairments, can participate in elections in accordance with the intentions of the Swedish Constitution. The motion advocates for a revision of the voting system to honor the centenary of universal suffrage in Sweden.

title: Strandskyddet i Sörmland
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the development of a new, simplified taxation model for Class II vehicles, specifically motorhomes, and temporarily halt the implementation of a new, higher vehicle tax for these vehicles. The current tax system, based on the bonus-malus model, has led to disproportionately high taxes for motorhomes, resulting in a significant drop in sales and threatening the industry. The motion argues that the tax model is flawed for this vehicle category and calls for a review to create a more reasonable taxation system that reduces administrative burdens while supporting the motorhome market.

title: Höjd gräns för att lämna kontrolluppgift
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1984 av Lotta Finstorp och Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for increased accessibility for hearing-impaired individuals within the Swedish Parliament, suggesting that sign language interpretation should be considered the norm for all debates and not just for specific events. It emphasizes the importance of inclusivity in political discussions, especially in a democratic society celebrating 100 years of universal suffrage, and highlights the challenges faced by the hearing-impaired in accessing real-time political debates and discussions.

title: Kommunalt anställda läkare inom äldreomsorgen
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the additional child benefit known as 'flerbarnstillägget', which is provided to families with more than one child. The argument states that the current system is costly and inefficient, with a significant portion of the national budget going towards this benefit without sufficient justification. It highlights the financial burden on the government, the reality that larger families often inherit items for younger siblings, and the concern over promoting long-term dependency on social benefits, especially among immigrant families. The motion calls for the parliament to support this abolishment and notify the government.

title: Sanktioner mot övergivna bilar
summary: The proposal by Angelica Lundberg (SD) advocates for new legislation mandating the use of rear-facing car seats for small children to enhance road safety and reduce the risk of serious injury or death in traffic accidents. It emphasizes the importance of adherence to safety guidelines that recommend rear-facing travel for children up to 4-5 years old and suggests prohibiting the use and sale of expired car seats to improve child safety measures in Sweden.

title: Vintertid som standardtid
summary: The motion proposes to increase the penalties for offenses against grave peace in Sweden, arguing for the introduction of a new classification for 'serious offenses against grave peace' to ensure that individuals committing severe acts, such as desecrating a body to conceal a murder, face harsher consequences. The current maximum penalty for these offenses is insufficient compared to the gravity of the act, and the motion seeks to align penalties more closely with the seriousness of such crimes to deter potential offenders.

title: Spårväg City
summary: The motion proposes to expedite the reconstruction of the important regional road 26/47, which is heavily trafficked and has a history of serious accidents, including fatalities. It emphasizes the need for improvements to enhance traffic safety and capacity, arguing that the current state of the road poses significant risks to commuters and freight transport. The proposed renovations would cost approximately 171 million SEK and include upgrades such as separating lanes and installing wildlife barriers, aiming to align with national safety goals.

title: En kunskapsbaserad och kompensatorisk skola
summary: The motion proposes to gradually raise the legal age for purchasing cigarettes to prevent young people from smoking. It calls for making it illegal to buy, sell, or give cigarettes to individuals below the established age and highlights the health and environmental risks of smoking. The aim is to help current smokers quit while ensuring that new generations do not start smoking at all, advocating for measures similar to those implemented for alcohol.

title: Återvändandearbetet vid avslagsbeslut
summary: The proposal advocates for raising the legal age for undergoing gender transition procedures from 18 to 25 years old, citing concerns about the psychological and emotional maturity of individuals making irreversible decisions. The motion also highlights the increase in young people seeking gender transition and stresses the importance of addressing underlying psychological issues instead of allowing premature medical interventions.

title: Skeppsvrak, ägarlösa båtar och uttjänta fritidsbåtar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the planning of a new railway connection between Helsingborg and Jönköping to enhance competitive transport options for both goods and passengers. It argues that improved railway infrastructure is crucial for Sweden's competitiveness in the global economy, highlighting the current lack of connections for several communities along the route, leading to long detours via car or train. The suggested new railway along the E4 would significantly enhance connectivity for multiple communities, relieve existing transport routes, and is seen as a priority for future infrastructure development.

title: Bättre miljö och rättvis konkurrens genom skärpt kontroll av efterlevnaden av svavelförordningen
summary: The motion proposes to lock parental leave days during custody disputes involving unmarried parents of newborns until a final custody decision is reached. This is aimed at preventing situations where one parent uses all parental leave while the other loses the opportunity to bond with the child during critical early months.

title: Syresätt svenskt vattenbruk
summary: The proposal suggests implementing suitability assessments for elderly drivers due to concerns over their declining visual and auditory abilities, which may contribute to traffic accidents. It emphasizes the lack of clear routines and reliable instruments for assessing driving capabilities among the elderly, despite a significant number of new diagnoses each year that could impair their driving. The motion aims to enhance traffic safety by ensuring that those who may no longer be fit to drive are identified appropriately.

title: Ett hållbart och konkurrenskraftigt yrkesfiske
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament enact a ban on the use of studless winter tires during the summer months due to safety concerns, stating these tires provide inadequate grip on summer roads and increase the risk of accidents. Additionally, it advocates for an investigation into the establishment of an age limit for tires, as aging affects their performance, potentially compromising road safety.

title: Stärk den maritima besöksnäringen
summary: The proposal seeks to reserve half of the child benefit during custody disputes between parents to ensure that both parties have equitable access to financial support for the child. It aims to address the disparity where the custodial parent, often the mother, receives the full benefit during prolonged disputes, potentially disadvantaging the other parent, commonly the father. The motion suggests that if the custody ruling favors the mother, the reserved funds would be returned to her, while the father would receive the reserved funds if he is granted full or shared custody.

title: Stärkt äganderätt i minerallagstiftningen
summary: Angelica Lundberg of the Sweden Democrats (SD) proposes a tax shift aimed at improving public health by increasing taxes on unhealthy food items high in sugar and reducing taxes on healthier food options. The motion highlights the rising issues of obesity, diabetes, mental health disorders, and other health problems among children and adults and emphasizes the need to encourage healthier eating habits. The proposal aims to make healthier food choices more economically viable while supporting local farmers and producers.

title: Säkerhetsspärr för överföring av lagfart
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of subsidies for sugar production used for food purposes, emphasizing that there are no health benefits to consuming added sugar, which is linked to various diseases such as diabetes, obesity, and heart-related issues. The motion highlights the growing epidemic of childhood obesity and argues that it is unreasonable for public funds to support sugar production, advocating for Sweden to work through the EU to eliminate current subsidies.

title: Etableringsstrategi för pråmtrafiken
summary: Angelica Lundberg from the Sweden Democrats proposes to increase the number of 'dubbeldagar', or simultaneous parental leave days, in parental insurance from the current maximum of 30 days during the child's first year. The motion emphasizes the benefits of both parents being at home together, especially during the initial adjustment to family life, and argues that families should have the freedom to decide how to use their parental benefits without government-imposed limitations on simultaneous leave days.

title: Förbättra efterlevnaden av det internationella regelverket avseende sjöfarten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the effects of food additives, emphasizing the need for greater oversight to protect consumers from potential health risks. It argues for a reassessment of previously approved additives, particularly in light of changing consumption patterns and new research on health effects. The authors advocate for an approach based on the precautionary principle, suggesting that additives should not be approved until their safety has been thoroughly evaluated by independent, government-funded researchers.

title: Skredrisken i Götaälvdalen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1968 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall och Sten Bergheden (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should conduct further investigations into the environmental effectiveness of government measures aimed at increasing the number of environmentally friendly cars, as well as to assess the distribution effects across different regions and income groups. It emphasizes the need for a more cost-effective, long-term, and predictable framework for the purchase and ownership of new vehicles, addressing issues raised in a previous report by the National Audit Office regarding high societal costs and uneven benefits from current policies.

title: Stoppa utförseln av stöldgods
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to take total responsibility for the Vättern lake to secure it as a vital freshwater source for the surrounding population, which includes approximately 300,000 people. It emphasizes the importance of managing the lake sustainably, addressing ongoing challenges from surrounding activities that pose environmental risks, particularly the use of harmful chemicals. The motion highlights improvements made since the 1950s and advocates for accelerating efforts by responsible authorities to protect and ensure the quality of Vättern's water as a drinking water source.

title: Ökad trygghet i kollektivtrafiken
summary: The motion advocates for the construction of new railway mainlines (stambanor) in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of an intermodal transport system for the development of Jönköping County. It highlights the county's strategic location as a transport hub and argues that improved railway communication is essential for regional development and connectivity. The motion calls on the government to take immediate action to initiate the construction of these mainlines.

title: Sälj Sveaskog
summary: The Christian Democrats propose to evaluate the extent of government support for civil society organizations impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic and urge the government to implement several measures. These include extending economic assistance to small businesses, increasing the limits on tax deductions for donations to non-profits, and ensuring civil society organizations can access support mechanisms such as credit guarantees. They argue that ongoing government delays have jeopardized the survival of many small businesses and non-profits. The proposal seeks a more robust and adaptable governmental response to mitigate the economic fallout from the crisis.

title: Kontinuerligt moderniserad sjuksköterskeutbildning
summary: The motion presented by the Sweden Democrats calls for the government to evaluate the conditions for transition support to businesses affected by the coronavirus, as well as support for individual entrepreneurs and the current sick leave deduction system. The proposed changes include extending financial support for businesses, maintaining consistent conditions for eligibility, and fully eliminating the sick leave deduction during the pandemic. Additionally, the motion advocates for increased support to the civil society sector, particularly outdoor organizations, which have been significantly impacted by the pandemic, proposing budget reallocations to ensure their financial sustainability.

title: Brobyggande mellan akademin och näringslivet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament formally recognizes Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and instructs the government to relocate the Swedish embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, citing historical ties and previous international agreements that support the Jewish connection to the land.

title: Kost och matvanor - obligatoriskt inslag under förskollärar- och fritidsledarutbildningen
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to formally recognize the genocide committed in 1915 against various minorities in the Ottoman Empire and to incorporate education about this genocide into the Swedish curriculum. It points out that previous governmental attempts to acknowledge the genocide have been lacking, despite earlier parliamentary resolutions, and emphasizes the importance of educating future generations about historical atrocities to uphold human rights ideals.

title: Elevhälsans hälsosamtal - inkludera sexuella övergrepp som en rutinfråga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government evaluate the existing laws on publisher responsibility in the Freedom of the Press Act and the Fundamental Law on Freedom of Expression concerning online databases, with the goal of preventing impunity for the crime of incitement against a people group. It suggests that the current rules allow publishers to evade responsibility for publishing harmful content by exploiting a loophole that grants them a two-week grace period to remove such content after being notified of its problematic nature. The motion expresses concern that this situation has led to the misuse of these laws by extremist organizations to disseminate hateful content without consequence.

title: Utökat uppdrag för arbetslöshetskassorna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament mandates a committee to investigate changes to the monarchy, aiming to establish a republic, increase transparency in royal finances and operations, revoke the monarch's total legal immunity, and review the system for adjutants serving the royal family. The motion argues for democratic principles in choosing the head of state and for accountability in the use of public funds.

title: Befolkningstillväxt och behovet av fler skyddsrum
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should set parliamentary members' basic salary to 100% of a price base amount per month, which would help narrow the income disparity between members and the general public. Additionally, it suggests investigating the elimination of extra compensations for specific parliamentary roles, citing these as unnecessary expenses. The proposal argues that reducing salaries and removing extra allowances would also simplify administrative processes and reduce state costs.

title: Underlätta implementeringen av evidensbaserade forskningsresultat
summary: The proposal aims to enhance the working conditions and capabilities of the police force in Sweden by implementing various measures to improve strategic planning, increase administrative support, ensure better physical and psychosocial work environments, strengthen community policing efforts, and review private security sectors. The motion particularly emphasizes the need for modern technology and training to better equip officers, reduce workplace hazards, and foster inclusivity and competence within the police force.

title: Fler fängelser
summary: The proposal by Linda Westerlund Snecker and others from the Left Party focuses on a comprehensive reform of the Swedish correctional system, emphasizing the need for alternatives to incarceration, particularly for short sentences. Key recommendations include expanding electronic monitoring for offenders, exploring alternative penalties for adult offenders, addressing issues related to overcrowding in prisons, and ensuring specialized care for young offenders. The motion aims to create a more rehabilitative environment within the penal system, reducing recidivism through better integration and education efforts for those serving sentences, while stressing the importance of a humane approach to criminal justice.

title: Inför obligatoriskt syntest vid körkortsförnyelse
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes a review of the parliamentary regulations to limit the number of vice chairpersons in the committees of the Swedish parliament, arguing that the current increase in their numbers has led to unnecessary costs and is not warranted by the committee's functioning. They suggest tying parliamentary salaries to a defined financial measure and eliminating additional compensation for vice chairpersons to enhance trust between elected officials and the public.

title: Kommunens strandskydd
summary: The motion presented addresses the concern of government funding flowing to Islamist schools in Sweden, proposing measures to halt this funding and implement stricter scrutiny of their operations and finances. It emphasizes the need for local municipalities to have a greater influence in the establishment of such schools and calls for the immediate closure of schools linked to violent extremist environments or that perpetuate gender segregation and honor-based oppression. Additionally, the motion advocates for the possible nationalization of the educational system to ensure all children receive equal education grounded in scientific principles rather than outdated religious beliefs.

title: Incitament för att förhindra digitalt utanförskap
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should allocate a larger portion of its international aid to combat illiteracy, promote gender equality, and support the liberation of children from slavery, forced marriages, and honor-related violence. It calls for increased efforts within the EU and UN to prioritize issues like child marriages, female genital mutilation, and women's reproductive health. The motion also suggests that the danger of female genital mutilation should be recognized as sufficient grounds for asylum, advocating for a comprehensive ban on child marriages and better provision of resources for women's health and education in impoverished countries.

title: En cykelvänlig tågresa även inom Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to revise the ownership strategy of state-owned companies in cases where societal interests conflict with profit requirements. It advocates for state-owned enterprises to prioritize social utility, environmental sustainability, and gender equality, and suggests measures such as refraining from selling these companies, ensuring they remain neutral in political affiliations, and focusing on increasing job creation and exports. Additionally, it stresses the importance of sustainable resource management and an expanded role of the state in various economic sectors.

title: Säkra pendlingsvägar för cyklar i våra större städer
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes that the Swedish Parliament reject the government's proposal for an amended allocation regarding the transition support meant for businesses impacted by the coronavirus. While the party supports increased funding for cultural and sports activities as well as an extension of temporary measures in sick leave, they argue that the current transition support disproportionately favors business owners over the workforce. They call for further investments in welfare to improve quality and working conditions amid the pandemic's challenges.

title: Ett ökat incitament för cykelpendling
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the quotas in Sweden's parental insurance, arguing that families should have the freedom to manage their parental leave without state-imposed restrictions. It emphasizes the importance of individual choice for parents to determine what works best for their families, criticizing the existing quota system as ideologically driven and unfair to many families.

title: Avveckling av Barn- och elevombudet
summary: The motion advocates for relocating the Swedish embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, emphasizing that Jerusalem is Israel's capital and that moving the embassy would signify Sweden's recognition of Israel's sovereignty and democratic status. The proposal references similar actions taken by other countries, including the United States and Guatemala, and argues that every state has the right to determine the location of its capital.

title: Störningsservitut
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should stop all financial aid to the Palestinian authorities due to allegations of misuse of funds for supporting terrorism. It emphasizes the importance of not financing organizations that promote violence or anti-democratic actions, suggesting that Sweden should adopt stricter oversight of such aid and align its stance with the recent actions taken by the US Congress to reduce funding to organizations linked to violence.

title: Otillåten läsning av medicinska journaler
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports persecuted Christians worldwide, highlighting the increasing severity of their plight in various countries. It cites a report indicating that around 300 million Christians face persecution and underscores the urgent need for Sweden to raise awareness and show solidarity with these communities. The motion calls for the government to take action to address the human rights violations experienced by Christians, notably in regions like the Middle East, China, and India.

title: CSN:s hemutrustningslån
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the environmental impact of existing individual sewage systems compared to replacing them. It suggests that property owners should have the option to refrain from replacing functioning sewage systems, given the high costs and limited environmental benefit associated with their replacement. The authors argue that municipalities should act in the best interest of citizens and reassess the environmental implications based on current research.

title: Tillgång till uppgifter i fordonsregistret
summary: The proposal, submitted by Björn Söder (SD), advocates for the cessation of all aid to the Palestinian Authority, citing concerns over corruption, mismanagement of funds, and lack of adherence to democratic principles. The motion outlines that despite substantial financial contributions from Sweden, the Palestinian Authority has failed to combat corruption effectively and has been implicated in financing terrorism. It questions the transparency and accountability of aid distribution and argues that continued support undermines Swedish values and taxpayer responsibility.

title: Samla välfärdsutbetalningarna i en myndighet
summary: The proposal suggests establishing a national memorial day in Sweden dedicated to the victims of communism, similar to the Holocaust memorial day, and calls on the Swedish government to advocate for a global remembrance day within the United Nations. The motion argues that while the atrocities of National Socialism are widely recognized, the impact of communism, which is believed to have resulted in a higher death toll, has received less attention and recognition. It emphasizes the need for increased awareness among Swedish youth about the crimes committed under communist regimes and urges legislative action to honor those who suffered under this ideology.

title: Id-kort för efterlysta
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government formulate a strategy to facilitate Taiwan's participation in international organizations, reflecting earlier statements that both Sweden and the EU support Taiwan's involvement. The motion criticizes the government's lack of a clear approach and urges the development of a specific framework to promote Taiwan's inclusion in these organizations.

title: Kommunalt självstyre
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government actively advocate for Taiwan's inclusion in the World Health Organization (WHO). The reasoning highlights Taiwan's early response to the COVID-19 pandemic and its relevant healthcare experience, arguing that exclusion from global health initiatives undermines collective efforts to combat health crises.

title: Stoppa välfärdsbedrägerierna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government classify the left-wing extremist network Antifascistisk Aktion (Afa) as a terrorist organization. It argues that Afa's actions, which include violence and threats against individuals and institutions they deem 'fascist', pose a significant threat to democracy and individual rights. The motion cites incidents and evaluated risks posed by Afa, asserting that terrorism classifications are necessary to robustly confront such violent activities and uphold social order.

title: Republiken Kinas deltagande i FN:s underorganisationer
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of converting Villa Bonnier into the official residence and representation venue for the Speaker of the Parliament. The motion highlights the lack of an official residence for the Speaker, unlike the Prime Minister, and emphasizes the importance of having a suitable venue for representation purposes, in accordance with the provisions of the original donation of the property.

title: Tillsättning av ett sjöfartsråd
summary: The proposal suggests amending the Swedish constitution to transfer the responsibility of proposing a new prime minister from the Speaker of the Riksdag back to the Head of State. The motion argues that the current system, established by the Torekov compromise in 1971, has led to the Speaker's role being entangled in political strategies, especially following the 2018 elections which changed the political landscape. The author believes that the Head of State, being politically neutral, can mitigate the political maneuvering that has affected the Speaker's role and restore dignity to the office.

title: Absolut skuldpreskription
