Additionally, it allows customs prosecutors to prosecute these new offenses and enhances the powers of the Customs Authority and Coast Guard in regard to fields related to driving under the influence offenses, effective from November 1, 2020.

title: Rättvisare fördelning av infrastrukturpengarna
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1808 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The government proposes a reform aimed at strengthening primary healthcare in Sweden, shifting the focus to make primary care the central hub for patient treatment and care coordination. This includes plans to redefine the responsibilities of primary care to encompass various healthcare and preventive measures without requiring specialized medical resources. Changes to documentation requirements are also proposed to facilitate more efficient healthcare service delivery. The reform is built on the premise that improving primary care accessibility and patient involvement will lead to more effective use of healthcare resources and better health outcomes.

title: Global nedrustning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1807 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The document provides an annual report by the Swedish government on the activities of the pension funds (AP-funds) up to 2019. It includes an overview of the funds' financial performance, sustainability efforts, and adherence to new regulations for responsible investments aimed at promoting sustainable development while ensuring returns. The funds achieved significant returns in 2019 and have implemented measures for transparency and efficiency, including improved carbon reporting and compliance with climate-related financial disclosure frameworks. The report also highlights the funds' role in the overall pension system and their responsibilities in managing contributions and pensions.

title: Fler sysselsättningsmodeller för personer med funktionsvariation
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1806 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Betty Malmberg (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the government clarify how exceptions to school attendance requirements can be made and define the responsibilities of municipalities in monitoring whether students are participating in schooling abroad. This follows criticism from the National Audit Office regarding inconsistent application of the law governing school attendance, and emphasizes the need for improved guidance from relevant authorities. The aim is to ensure children's right to education while accommodating families living abroad.

title: Stärkt vittnesskydd och rättssäkerhet i fall med gängkriminella
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1805 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Sofia Westergren (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the Swedish Education Act concerning school attendance obligations and regulations regarding absences in order to enhance the support provided to students, particularly those with long-term absences, including 'hemmasittare' (students who stay home). It emphasizes the need for clearer and more effective implementation of the law and calls for the Swedish National Agency for Education to regularly collect and analyze data on student attendance in schools.

title: Kostnader för avlyssning
summary: The suggestion proposed by the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for the Swedish Parliament to evaluate various changes related to welfare measures stemming from the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Key areas of focus include assessing the modifications to unemployment insurance, housing allowances, and civil society support, as well as advocating for increased funding for railway maintenance and additional measures to bolster the welfare system. The proposal aims to ensure that both individual and collective economic needs are adequately met during this crisis and emphasizes the importance of maintaining pathways back to the job market.

title: Situationen i Belarus
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government should evaluate the funding for maintaining the country's transportation infrastructure in light of the economic downturn caused by the coronavirus crisis. The authors argue that increased investments in infrastructure, particularly in railway and road maintenance, as well as the expansion of the subway system in Stockholm, are crucial to mitigate rising unemployment and stimulate economic activity. They suggest adding 3 billion kronor to the budget, with specific allocations for various infrastructure projects, and advocate for support for regional airports to ensure continued access and essential transport services across Sweden.

title: Polisutbildning till Örebro
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1802 av Lotta Olsson och Malin Höglund (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to restrict school principals' authority to approve student leave without the consent of the governing body to a maximum of 20 days, clarify the definition of 'exceptional reasons' in school law to exclude certain types of leave, impose fines on parents who disregard principals' decisions regarding absences, enhance oversight by the School Inspectorate over the handling of student leave, and demand the government to quickly present necessary modifications to school law in response to the recommendations from the National Audit Office.

title: Fred, frihet, demokrati och transparens
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government initiates an investigation into the legislation surrounding school attendance and the exceptions to the compulsory education law, in response to concerns raised by the Swedish National Audit Office regarding inconsistent interpretations by municipalities. The Left Party supports the recommendation for a review and clarification of the existing legislation, emphasizing the importance of completed schooling in combating future health issues and poverty.

title: Ordningsvakter
summary: The motion proposed by Fredrik Christensson and colleagues emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to adhere to the recommendations from the National Audit Office regarding school attendance regulations. It highlights the right to free basic education as fundamental and points out inconsistencies in the enforcement of compulsory schooling. The proposal includes the introduction of a national absence register to better monitor school attendance and ensure that all children receive quality education, irrespective of their socio-economic background.

title: Jämställt företagande
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats suggests a range of actions in response to the government's extra budget proposal for 2020, focusing on the evaluation of the sick pay system, support for families affected by the coronavirus crisis, and infrastructure investments, particularly regional airports. It calls for the complete abolishment of the sickness deduction, increased scrutiny on housing allowances for families, and reallocation of budgets to enhance support for elderly care and media sectors, while rejecting certain financial provisions for cultural funding and illegal migrants.

title: Försäkringskassans uppdrag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1798 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: Sverigedemokraterna propose that the Swedish Parliament reject the Swedish Central Bank's request to provide a loan to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) amounting to 500 million Special Drawing Rights (approximately 6.9 billion kronor). The party argues that such financial activities should remain under Swedish control and supervision, especially given the current economic challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic, including significant declines in GDP and social welfare concerns. They assert that resources should be prioritized for domestic needs rather than being allocated to international entities.

title: Äldres rätt att få välja sin mat
summary: The government proposes a supplementary budget for 2020 to address the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. This includes measures to support healthcare and education, increase financial aid to low-income families with children through a temporary housing supplement, and adjust conditions for educational support. The proposal also plans to allocate additional funds to cover local government expenses related to managing the outbreak and enhance unemployment insurance benefits.

title: Översyn av avgifter inom äldreomsorgen
summary: The Moderates propose evaluating temporary tax exemptions for employees, especially in frontline roles, during the COVID-19 crisis. They emphasize the importance of not taxing benefits such as free meals and parking that are provided to healthcare and care personnel, arguing that it is both decent and essential for the legitimacy of the tax system. Additionally, the party suggests expanding short-time work support to include full-time permits with state coverage of 75% of costs, while they also welcome the government's plans to reduce delay fees for tax payments.

title: Tillåt gårdsförsäljning på försök omgående i Sverige
summary: This motion from the Christian Democrats proposes several measures to evaluate and modify existing laws concerning short-term work support in response to the economic impact of the coronavirus crisis. The motion emphasizes the need to assess the permitted levels of short-term work, the treatment of gifts to employees, and suggests increasing the allowable temporary layoff rate from 80% to 90%. It also argues for the inclusion of temporary workers in the support measures and the relaxation of requirements for companies without collective agreements, aiming to prevent unnecessary layoffs and oversights in the system.

title: Inför gårdsförsäljning i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1794 av Sten Bergheden och Marléne Lund Kopparklint (båda M)
summary: The motion by the Sweden Democrats (SD) calls for the government to evaluate several measures taken in response to the economic consequences of the coronavirus pandemic. It emphasizes the need to temporarily eliminate the fee for tax deferrals, allow for a 100% reduction in working hours for short-time work support, and exempt healthcare workers from benefit taxation on meals and taxi services. The motion also stresses the importance of establishing clear control mechanisms to prevent abuse of public funds associated with the support measures.

title: Stärka rätten över privatägd skog
summary: The proposal outlines a temporary budget amendment for 2020 in response to the economic impact of the coronavirus pandemic, proposing tax exemptions for free parking at workplaces and gifts for employees up to 1,000 SEK. It also includes adjustments to the regulations regarding temporary deferrals in tax payments and extends support for short-term work, allowing significant reductions in working hours. The proposal emphasizes enhanced oversight for tax fraud cases and the sharing of information within the Swedish Tax Agency to prevent criminal activities related to the agency's operations.

title: En konkurrenskraftsjämförelse årligen för lantbruket
summary: The motion proposes that companies offering training for professional competence certificates should be allowed to issue exams remotely. The Kristdemocratic party supports the government's initiative to extend the validity period for these certificates and emphasizes the need for harmonization with EU regulations. They argue that allowing online training would help maintain the operational continuity of training providers and facilitate the upholding of necessary certifications during the ongoing challenges posed by COVID-19.

title: Försäljning av Sveaskogs skogar
summary: The suggestion from the Sweden Democrats proposes that the government urgently investigate extending the deadline for holding company and association meetings in light of the ongoing economic crisis caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. They argue that Swedish companies deserve similar flexibility as European counterparts to facilitate operations and decision-making, highlighting that experts have also suggested measures to support businesses during this challenging time.

title: Förbättrade villkor för fjällräddare
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1790 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to extend the validity period for professional competence certificates in response to the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. It argues for alignment with an EU Commission proposal that extends the exception period from March 1 to August 31, 2020, to allow drivers to complete necessary training without facing expiration of their certificates due to canceled courses and restrictions.

title: HLR i skolan - en livsviktig kunskap
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1789 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal involves amending the law on professional driver's competence to extend the validity period of professional competence certificates due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It grants the government authority to issue regulations for extending the validity of these certificates for up to six months and allows exceptions for certificates that expired between March 1, 2020, and May 31, 2020. The proposed law is set to come into effect on June 1, 2020, and is aimed at preventing disruptions in essential societal functions stemming from the pandemic.

title: Skydd för gemensam egendom
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1788 av Niklas Karlsson och Joakim Sandell (båda S)
summary: The proposal introduces temporary measures allowing companies and associations to conduct general meetings entirely without physical attendance to mitigate the spread of the COVID-19 virus. Meetings can be held through electronic connection combined with postal voting or solely via postal voting. This change applies to various organizational forms, including housing cooperatives and financial institutions, facilitating safer participation for shareholders and members.

title: Tullverkets möjligheter till brottsbekämpning
summary: The Swedish Government's letter addresses the need to review the application of the School Act concerning exemptions from school attendance. The findings from the National Audit Office indicate that existing regulations are not being applied as intended, leading to inconsistencies in how exemptions are granted and monitored. The government agrees with the audit's recommendations to clarify regulations and increase oversight by the Swedish Schools Inspectorate, and to enhance support materials from the National Agency for Education.

title: Översyn av knivlagen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1786 av Niklas Karlsson och Adnan Dibrani (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament endorse the creation of clearer guidance on when waste ceases to be classified as waste, tasking the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency (Naturvårdsverket) with improving procedures for determining waste status and potentially developing end-of-waste criteria. The motion also advocates for a digital tracking system for hazardous waste that aligns with EU directives, opposing any over-implementation that would impose higher standards than required by EU regulations to avoid competitive disadvantages for Swedish businesses.

title: Satsningar på ökat byggande ger ökad sysselsättning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1785 av Lars Mejern Larsson och Björn Petersson (båda S)
summary: The suggestion by the Moderaterna party calls for a review and tightening of regulations regarding the handling of explosives, in order to enhance oversight and control over explosive substances, including the consideration of DNA marking for commercial explosives. The party emphasizes the need to address identified weaknesses in current regulatory frameworks that could lead to the misuse of explosives for criminal purposes, particularly in light of rising gang violence and instances of explosions in Sweden. It advocates for improved oversight, clearer responsibility distribution among authorities, and increased resources for enforcement agencies to combat illegal explosive manufacturing.

title: Avställda bilar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1784 av Lars Mejern Larsson och Pyry Niemi (båda S)
summary: The Christian Democrats propose that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the introduction of a general tax exemption for residual waste from landfill recovery. They argue that this would encourage the use of recycled materials, reduce environmental impact, and strengthen the circular economy. The party believes that the government's current stance on not implementing this exemption overlooks significant potential environmental benefits and would have minimal financial consequences for the public sector.

title: Utökat skydd mot föreningsrättskränkning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1783 av Lars Mejern Larsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The Christian Democrats propose that the Swedish government evaluate how the implementation of the EU waste directives affects the competitiveness of Swedish companies. They support the government's efforts to create a more resource-efficient society but express concerns over potential over-implementation of the directives, lack of transparency, and inadequate assessment of the consequences for businesses. They call for a thorough review within a year to ensure that the regulations do not disadvantage Swedish enterprises compared to their foreign competitors.

title: Dödsolyckor på arbetsplatser
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1782 av Lars Mejern Larsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion submitted by the Sweden Democrats calls for the government to provide a clearer evaluation of the impact and objectives of the free entry reform for government museums, emphasizing the need for comprehensive statistics on visitor demographics and the balance between accessibility and the quality of museum offerings. The proposal also advocates for an assessment of how the reform affects the power dynamics between museum authorities and the state, and the introduction of reliable visitor measurement systems to ensure that the goals of the reform are met and to evaluate its effectiveness across different regions in Sweden.

title: Oseriösa företag på svensk arbetsmarknad
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1781 av Lars Mejern Larsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal advocates for museums in Sweden to maintain their independence and have the authority to decide on free entry policies. It stresses the importance of supporting all types of museums, including state, association-driven, and private institutions, rather than focusing solely on state museums in urban areas. It calls for government support to enhance digitalization efforts and improve overall conditions for museums to attract diverse audiences, particularly children and young people.

title: Se över Försäkringskassans hantering av ärenden rörande livränta
summary: The Swedish government proposes changes to the transitional provisions of the legislation on medical devices and the legislation on accreditation and technical control, in response to the European Parliament and Council's decision to postpone the application date of the EU Regulation 2017/745 on medical devices by one year, to May 26, 2021. The revisions aim to ensure that older provisions remain in effect until this new application date for organizations assessing compliance with the new requirements.

title: Följ svensk lagstiftning vid offentliga upphandlingar
summary: The motion presented by Elisabeth Svantesson and other Moderate Party members calls for a thorough evaluation of government support measures in light of the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the need for additional resources for municipalities and regions due to increased demands on healthcare and social services, as well as decreased revenues. The motion requests that the government quickly analyze the extraordinary costs that local authorities have borne as a result of the pandemic, advocate for the extension of short-term work allowances to cover full-time permits, and improve funding for the police and justice system to enhance public safety.

title: Utvärdering av samhällsnyttan av målen för ekologiska livsmedel inom offentlig upphandling
summary: Vänsterpartiet's motion addresses the economic and social challenges faced by Sweden in light of the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the need for a strong welfare system that ensures economic security during times of illness and unemployment. The party proposes an additional allocation of funds to the municipal sector, supports increased funding for healthcare and working conditions, and suggests educational initiatives to fill labor shortages in vulnerable sectors. Moreover, it calls for comprehensive stimulus packages for businesses and cultural organizations, alongside a more progressive tax policy to redistribute wealth and finance necessary public investments.

title: Tillåt ökad skogsdikning
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats addresses the ongoing health crisis due to the COVID-19 pandemic and its severe economic repercussions. It emphasizes the necessity of providing comprehensive support for healthcare, social services, and businesses to mitigate the effects of the crisis. The proposal advocates for initiatives such as cost support for affected companies, an expansion of short-term layoffs, incentives for hiring in healthcare, and increased funding for community organizations. The aim is to protect jobs and ensure the resilience of essential services, thereby prioritizing the well-being of individuals during this unprecedented challenge.

title: Sänkt fordonsskatt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1776 av Sten Bergheden och Sofia Westergren (båda M)
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats (SD) outlines various measures in response to the economic challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic, arguing that government actions are insufficient. Key suggestions include implementing a revenue support scheme for businesses, eliminating employer and self-employment fees, enhancing short-term layoff systems akin to Norway's, reducing interest rates on state loans, and emphasizing the need for robust crisis preparedness in society. The SD asserts that these measures are urgent to support the economy, address rising unemployment, and ensure adequate resources for municipalities and regions facing fiscal difficulties due to the pandemic.

title: Ökade polisiära befogenheter för tulltjänstemän
summary: Moderaterna föreslår en omfattande strategi för att hantera den ekonomiska krisen orsakad av coronapandemin. Förslagen inkluderar att slopa arbetsgivaravgifter, möjliggöra heltidpermittering och införa stöd för fasta kostnader för företag med inkomstbortfall. Motionen betonar vikten av att rädda jobb, öka resurser till välfärden, och skapa en exitstrategi för att öppna upp ekonomin, samtidigt som den tar hänsyn till särskilda grupper som påverkas av krisen, inklusive kvinnor och invandrare.

title: Översyn och slopande av kemikalieskatten
summary: Amineh Kakabaveh proposes a new economic policy aimed at addressing the severe economic crisis brought on by the coronavirus pandemic. The suggestion critiques the existing neoliberal economic framework, advocating for a shift towards full employment, social welfare, and a more robust state role in the economy. Kakabaveh argues that the current austerity measures must be abandoned in favor of significant public investment to ensure job security and support vulnerable populations, highlighting the importance of creating a more equitable labor market and addressing the challenges faced by unemployed individuals and marginalized groups.

title: Certifiering av företag som omhändertar miljöfarligt avfall
summary: The government proposes adjustments to fuel regulations in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, specifically to postpone the transition to summer gasoline from May 1 to June 1, 2020. This measure aims to mitigate potential gasoline shortages due to reduced sales of winter gasoline caused by the pandemic. Additionally, the proposal includes returning the summer period to its existing definition from the previous law, with changes set to come into effect on specified dates in May and January of the following year.

title: Utred tidsbegränsningar vid fridlysning och tidigare fridlysta fågel- och djurarter
summary: The proposal suggests postponing the implementation of the national pharmaceutical list and the internship program for doctors due to the spread of the COVID-19 virus. The new proposed effective dates for the relevant laws are outlined, with the national pharmaceutical list set to take effect on May 1, 2023, for specific sections and May 1, 2021, for others, while the internship program is proposed to commence on July 1, 2021.

title: Angående en hållbar biavel
summary: The motion presented by Håkan Svenneling and others from the Left Party calls for a thorough evaluation of Sweden's arms export laws, particularly in relation to human rights violations and conflicts in countries such as Yemen and Brazil. Key proposals include halting all arms exports to countries involved in the Yemen conflict, instituting an EU and UN arms embargo, and ensuring that Sweden does not contribute to human rights abuses through its arms exports. The motion emphasizes Sweden's role in promoting democracy and human rights and argues for transparency in the government's arms export decisions.

title: Försäljning av ägg från hägnat tamfjäderfä
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to establish a national register for guardians, address the abuse of vulnerable people's situations, consider the implementation of professional guardians, ensure insurance for guardians, and modernize the legislation surrounding guardianship to enhance accountability and protection for both guardians and the individuals they assist.

title: Innovativ livsmedelsforskning
summary: The government proposes a new law that includes supplementary provisions to the EU platform regulation, aiming to establish responsibilities and enforcement mechanisms for compliance with the regulation. The law will designate a competent authority to ensure adherence to the regulation and will also amend the existing law concerning patent and market courts to align with these new provisions. The proposed regulations seek to improve transparency and fairness in online intermediary services.

title: Privat försäljning av vildsvinskött
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports a change in legislation to allow the granting of permits for secret coercive measures, such as surveillance, to be tied to individuals rather than electronic devices or addresses. The motion argues that this change is necessary for effective law enforcement, as both the Security Police and the National Police have expressed the need for such an adjustment despite concerns raised by the government and investigations regarding its practicality.

title: Entreprenörskapsutbildning till alla
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a general confidentiality-breaking provision to enhance information sharing between police and social services in the fight against terrorism. It emphasizes the pressing need for effective collaboration to address the heightened threat posed by various extremist groups, while advocating for a careful balance between individual privacy rights and societal safety requirements. The motion calls for governmental acknowledgment of the necessity for such a provision and suggests further examination of its legislative framework.

title: Åtgärder för att minska skarvens påverkan i Stockholms skärgård och i resten av Sverige
summary: The motion put forward by Mats Green and other members of the Moderate Party, Center Party, Christian Democrats, and Liberals requests the Swedish Parliament to reject the government's proposal regarding the implementation of the EU directive on posted workers. The motion argues that the government's proposal undermines the free movement of labor and imposes excessive administrative burdens on employers. It calls for a revised proposal that includes the reinstitution of previous regulations and emphasizes the importance of maintaining fair working conditions for both domestic and posted workers while ensuring that Sweden remains attractive for foreign businesses.

title: Stranderosion
summary: The Christian Democrats propose that decisions for secret surveillance should be tied to individuals rather than to phone numbers or specific devices. They support a simplified process for legal permissions related to surveillance of anonymous prepaid cards, arguing that the legal framework should keep pace with technological advancements. They emphasize that this change is necessary for the effectiveness of law enforcement agencies such as the Police, Customs, and the Security Service.

title: Dansbandsmoms och övriga förutsättningar för kultursektorn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament evaluate the new stricter legislation regarding intellectual property infringements three years after its implementation, and to consider a revision of the penalties based on the principles of proportionality and equivalence. The proponents express concerns that the legislation could disproportionately target individuals over organized infringement activities, and they argue for a review of the legal system to ensure that the penalties for intellectual property crimes align appropriately with penalties for other serious offenses, like sexual crimes.

title: Samordnad slussled och skredsäkring
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the proposed changes in the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act to facilitate better information exchange between police, social services, schools, and healthcare in combating terrorism. The Moderaterna party supports the need for effective collaboration against terrorism but argues that current privacy regulations hinder communication and that the proposed conditions for information sharing are overly burdensome for social service authorities. They suggest that the bar for sharing information should be lower to allow police and security services to prevent terrorist acts more effectively.

title: Regionala flygplatser
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1762 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that permission for secret surveillance of electronic communication should be tied to individuals rather than specific phone numbers or devices. It argues that the current system is bureaucratic and inefficient, requiring multiple court approvals for each new device used by the same individual. By linking the permissions to a person, the suggestion aims to streamline the process, increase efficiency for law enforcement agencies, and effectively address the evolving nature of serious crimes.

title: Trollhättans flygplats
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1761 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall och Ann-Sofie Alm (båda M)
summary: The proposal outlines amendments to Sweden's waste management regulations to implement revised EU directives on waste. Key changes include the redefinition of municipal waste, clarifications on waste producers' responsibilities, and adjustments to the responsibilities of municipalities for construction and demolition waste. Additionally, the proposal introduces provisions for when waste ceases to be classified as waste and expands authorizations to enforce compliance with waste management requirements. The amendments are intended to strengthen waste management practices and come into effect on August 1, 2020.

title: Redovisning av innehåll i livsmedel
summary: The government proposes amendments to legislation concerning the handling of explosive precursors in response to a new EU regulation. The changes include restrictions on the supply, possession, and use of certain chemicals, extending reporting obligations to more parties, and enhancing oversight and awareness measures. The new regulation mandates stricter control mechanisms to prevent misuse of precursors intended for legitimate purposes but which could potentially be used to produce explosives.

title: Ofrivillig ensamhet och isolering
summary: The proposal suggests amendments to the waste tax legislation, including a provision for the refund of taxes paid on waste that has been removed from non-taxable disposal facilities under certain conditions. It also recommends the elimination of waste tax exemptions for certain types of waste such as return fiber waste and decontamination sludge from paper recycling, as well as coal waste and dust/sludge from flue gas treatment in aluminum production. Additionally, the threshold for cesium-137 in biomass ash exempt from waste tax is proposed to increase from 5 to 10 kilobecquerel per kilogram. The changes are expected to come into effect on January 1, 2021.

title: Motverka antibiotikaresistens nationellt och internationellt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1758 av Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström och David Josefsson (båda M)
summary: The Swedish government's document evaluates state borrowing and debt management from 2015 to 2019, focusing on the goal of minimizing debt costs while managing risks. Throughout the evaluation period, the unconsolidated state debt decreased significantly, both in absolute terms and as a percentage of GDP, influenced by historical low-interest rates. The report discusses the operational alignment of the Debt Office with governmental guidelines, findings from annual surveys on lender confidence, and the impact of the central bank's bond purchases on market liquidity. It concludes that both the government's directives and the Debt Office's strategies have generally adhered to the legislative objectives set for state debt management.

title: Bättre villkor för personligt pensionssparande
summary: Johan Hedin from the Center Party proposes that the Swedish government evaluate new legislation aimed at enhancing cooperation and information sharing between police and social services in the fight against terrorism. The motion expresses support for the government's efforts since a 2017 agreement, while emphasizing the need for a balance between effective crime fighting and the protection of individual privacy and integrity. Hedin calls for a comprehensive discussion about the intersections of privacy, openness, and information exchange and suggests that a broader investigation be initiated to develop a modern and secure legal framework concerning these issues.

title: Obligatoriskt allmänt vaccinationsprogram för barn
summary: The motion proposes amendments to Swedish legislation regarding the treatment of posted workers, aiming to ensure equal pay and working conditions for foreign workers compared to local employees. Specifically, it advocates for the ability to demand compensation for travel, food, and lodging costs for workers sent to Sweden, along with extending notification obligations to individuals receiving services for private use. The proposal seeks to strengthen labor rights, combat wage dumping, and maintain fair competition within the labor market.

title: Översyn av åtgärder för minderåriga som begår brott
summary: Vänsterpartiet motionerar om att riksdagen ska avslå regeringens proposition om ett effektivare informationsutbyte mellan polis och socialtjänst vid samverkan mot terrorism, med undantag för att socialtjänsten ska kunna lämna ut uppgifter till Säkerhetspolisen för att förebygga brott begångna av unga. De argumenterar för att en stark sekretess är viktigt, samt att det är nödvändigt att ha tydligt definierade och proportionerliga sekretessbrytande regler. Vänsterpartiet vill även se ett bredare fokus på att bekämpa olika typer av brottslighet och framhåller vikten av en gemensam välfärd som en lösning mot kriminalitet.

title: Motverkande av missbruk av attefallsreglerna
summary: The government submits a report addressing the observations and recommendations made by the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the implementation of the fiscal policy framework in 2019. The audit highlights issues regarding the clarity of the retrospective eight-year average for financial savings and the adequacy of the government's forecasts in relation to public expenditures and tax revenues. The government acknowledges several of the audit's recommendations and commits to improving transparency and reporting within the economic propositions, while also noting the complexities of different forecasting methods.

title: Fler bostäder för studenter och unga
summary: The proposed legislation clarifies the state's responsibilities regarding nuclear activities in Sweden. It amends existing laws to ensure that if no individual or entity is accountable for safety at a nuclear facility, the state will take on that responsibility. The state will also handle safety for permanently closed geological repositories for nuclear waste, with funding for necessary safety measures sourced from specific funds. The proposal aims to establish a clear framework for accountability in managing nuclear safety and environmental impacts, slated to take effect on November 1, 2020.

title: Rätt till ersättning vid avspärrning
summary: The Swedish government has presented an assessment of the Riksrevision's report on the 'Free Entry to State Museums' reform, which was implemented in 2016. The report highlights the increase in museum visits due to the free entry policy but identifies issues with the clarity of the reform's goals and objectives as perceived by the museums. The government agrees that while the museums have generally implemented the reform well, improvements are needed in governance and follow-up processes to ensure the continued success of the initiative without negatively affecting the museums' ability to fulfill their primary missions. The government plans to clarify the reform's purpose and has allocated additional funding to support museums in managing increased visitor numbers.

title: Mobilförbud på cykel
summary: The government proposes amendments to existing legislation that would allow insurance associations, previously classified as support associations but not as occupational pension funds, to be exempt from various provisions in insurance operations and annual reporting laws. The proposal includes adjustments for smaller associations and outlines specific criteria that these associations must meet to maintain their exemption, including governance, financial requirements, and reporting duties. Additionally, these associations would not be classified as companies of public interest and would be exempt from anti-money laundering laws.

title: Möjliggör omplaceringar i annan skola under längre tid
summary: The government report presents the financial outcome of Sweden's state for the year 2019, indicating a financial surplus of 112 billion SEK, an improvement from the previous year. The report details insights into budgetary goals, income sources, expenditures, the development of state debt, and risk analyses regarding state guarantees and loans. It notes a decrease in public financial saving as well as the state debt, which dropped to 1,054 billion SEK, representing 21.0% of the GDP. The report concludes that the government's fiscal direction for 2019 was in line with established surplus targets.

title: Uppmuntra till studier och arbete genom CSN
summary: The Swedish government's economic spring bill for 2020 outlines proposed guidelines for economic and budget policy, aimed at addressing the significant economic challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. It includes measures for financial stability, support for businesses and employees affected by the crisis, adjustments to tax regulations, and a revised budget incorporating changes to public spending and financial management. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of collaboration between various sectors and levels of government to combat the pandemic's impact.

title: Politiskt engagerade studenter
summary: The Swedish Parliament approves various budget allocations and authorizations for the years 2020-2022, focusing on health care, education, agricultural support, and economic security. This includes funding for increased accessibility in healthcare, university research, and capital contributions to state-owned companies, as well as membership fees for innovation platforms within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT).

title: Omvandling av IB-elevers poäng till meritvärde
summary: In the report, the Swedish government outlines the tax expenditures for 2020, analyzing the impact of special rules in tax legislation on tax revenues. It provides a comprehensive overview of various tax expenditures across different tax categories, evaluates their economic efficiency, and establishes comparison norms to ensure uniform taxation. The report aims to increase transparency regarding state support for businesses and households through tax mechanisms, as mandated by the Budget Law.

title: Högre utbildning och forskning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for more effective handling of remand processes in response to rising serious violence and youth crime in Sweden. It advocates against proposed time limits for remand detention, proposes lowering the threshold for mandatory remand for serious crimes, increasing the ability to remand young offenders, and establishing specialized youth remand facilities. The motion calls for an evaluation of new rules concerning remand restrictions after two years to ensure they effectively support crime investigations.

title: Stoppa slöseri med skattemedel och inför tjänstemannaansvar
summary: The proposal aims to enhance the legal framework for combating honor-related violence and oppression in Sweden by urging the government to swiftly introduce specific legislation categorizing honor crimes and expanding the conditions under which travel bans can be imposed to protect children from being taken abroad for harmful practices such as child marriage or genital mutilation. It stresses the need for a dedicated crime classification to increase awareness, improve law enforcement efforts, and better protect vulnerable individuals.

title: Redovisa vad skattepengarna används till
summary: The motion proposes improvements to the management of detentions and reducing isolation in Sweden's justice system. It argues against a proposed six-month time limit on pre-trial detention and insists that the prosecutor should retain decision-making authority regarding any restrictions imposed on detainees. The motion emphasizes the importance of a comprehensive perspective on the justice system, notes the challenges posed by longer detention periods, and raises concerns about the potential bureaucratic burden on prosecutors. Additionally, it advocates for detaining minors in police custody under certain conditions, while calling for a more thorough analysis of the proposals' impacts on law enforcement resources.

title: Synliga skatter
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance legal protections against honor-related crimes in Sweden by introducing a new classification for such offenses, urging governmental investigation into the application of existing laws regarding forced marriages, child marriage crimes, and misleading marriage arrangements, as well as proposing stricter penalties for these offenses. It highlights the increasing occurrence of honor-based violence and oppression in Sweden, calling for comprehensive legislative measures to combat outdated norms and promote gender equality while ensuring that past victims are also protected under new regulations.

title: Östlig förbindelse
summary: The proposal by Johan Hedin from the Center Party aims to improve the handling of detentions and reduce isolation, particularly concerning individuals under 18 years old. It suggests establishing joint detention and main hearings, advocating for a faster process to minimize the time suspects spend in custody. The motion emphasizes the need for explicit legal provisions to clarify existing principles regarding detaining minors and suggests that detaining a child in police custody should only occur when absolutely necessary, with a preference for alternative placements.

title: Anmälan till donationsregistret via deklarationen
summary: The motion proposes that the government initiate an investigation to review and potentially amend confidentiality regulations that currently hinder information sharing between government agencies, particularly in the context of consumer protection in the financial sector. It highlights that despite improvements, consumers are facing increasing problems and suggests measures such as better origin labeling, enhanced consumer protection for children in digital environments, stricter rules on telemarketing, and improved inter-agency information exchange.

title: För säkrare transporter av släp
summary: The Swedish government presents its strategic export control policies for 2019 concerning military equipment and dual-use products, detailing legal frameworks, international cooperation within the EU, and the statistics of exports over the year. The report outlines the importance of export control in preventing the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction and highlights ongoing efforts to enhance transparency and compliance with international treaties. Additionally, it discusses the export relationships with various countries and the increasing number of entities receiving export licenses.

title: Ändra trängselskatten i Ropsten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should evaluate and report on the impact of new VAT regulations related to e-commerce between businesses and consumers, particularly concerning the administrative burden on companies. The authors emphasize the importance of minimizing unnecessary hurdles for entrepreneurs and improving the conditions for businesses, especially small enterprises. They express concern about the lack of thorough analysis regarding the administrative consequences of the proposed regulations.

title: Åtgärder för ett transparent skattesystem
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for consistent and long-term economic governance of the Health and Care Inspectorate (IVO) in Sweden, as highlighted in a report by the National Audit Office. The motion calls for improved tracking of inspection results over time and urges the government to report back to Parliament in a year on actions taken. The Kristdemocrats express concern over the current inefficiencies within IVO, such as the inadequate use of sanction tools and the necessity for better IT systems, advocating for stable financial frameworks to enhance IVO's ability to conduct its oversight responsibilities effectively.

title: Konvertera arbetsgivaravgiften till inkomstskatt
summary: The motion from the Moderaterna party proposes that the Swedish government should include municipal care operations in the exceptions to the Planning and Building Act (PBL) for dealing with the spread of dangerous diseases such as COVID-19. The party stresses the need for rapid responses in municipal care settings, especially with the risks posed to vulnerable populations in elderly care facilities. They argue that without such legislative changes, the government may be ill-equipped to meet urgent health care needs arising from outbreaks.

title: Transparent skattesystem
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to investigate the implementation of a system with common ballots, following recommendations from the National Audit Office regarding the current ballot system's issues. The motion criticizes the government's reluctance to conduct a comprehensive review of the ballot system and encourages the establishment of a parliamentary committee to explore solutions aimed at reducing the number of ballots needed, potentially alleviating problems such as long queues and mismanagement of ballots.

title: Definition av avgift
summary: The Christian Democrats propose that the government should notify the parliament when new regulations related to the COVID-19 pandemic are being developed and emphasize the need for a clear compensation framework for businesses affected by government actions. They argue that the current law is insufficient in addressing economic consequences and that early communication about regulations would improve parliamentary oversight. The proposal underscores the importance of ensuring that economic support measures are established concurrently with new legislative powers granted to the government.

title: Skärpta krav på kycklingindustrin
summary: The suggestion by the Sweden Democrats (SD) argues against the government's proposed extension of access rights for regional safety representatives to workplaces without union members, citing the need for a comprehensive strategy to address workplace safety. They assert that the current model is inadequate, as it limits access to safety oversight to union-affiliated representatives and does not sufficiently protect all workers. The SD proposes a new model involving state-employed safety inspectors who would have access to all workplaces, aiming to improve workplace safety for all workers and counteract the rise in occupational fatalities.

title: Obligatorisk hemförsäkring
summary: The motion addresses the state planning of high-speed railways in Sweden, urging the government to improve its infrastructure project evaluations. The committee references the Riksrevisionen's report, which highlights insufficient problem descriptions and a lack of comprehensive analyses in the planning process. It emphasizes the need for detailed economic assessments and calls for utilizing experiences from other high-speed rail projects to guide future investments and decision-making.

title: Etisk avel
summary: The proposal argues for a governmental review of the role of regional safety representatives in Swedish workplaces, indicating that the current labor environment has evolved since the labor laws were established in the 1970s. It highlights the decline in union membership and the rise of smaller companies, noting that modern workplace challenges, such as mental health issues, harassment, and bullying, require an updated system for safety representatives. The authors oppose a proposed expansion of access rights for regional safety representatives, advocating instead for a comprehensive assessment of their function to better address contemporary workplace issues.

title: Nationellt bidrag för broddar till seniorer
summary: The proposal advocates for an independent evaluation of the government's actions under temporary amendments to the Infection Control Act in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining democratic principles during crises while allowing the government to take necessary actions to curb the virus's spread. The motion acknowledges the need for robust legal safeguards against the misuse of power and highlights the economic impact of potential restrictions on businesses. It insists that any government-imposed limitations should be accompanied by compensation measures for affected entities, and calls for ongoing oversight by the parliament.

title: Förändringar i läroplanen
summary: This motion proposes that the arrendenämnd (rental board) should only have decision-making authority to increase rental fees in exceptional cases, in response to the government's proposition on property law issues. The motion argues that while the government's measures to streamline procedures for land surveying and registration are beneficial, the proposed blanket protection rule for tenants against significant fee increases would unfairly impact landowners who deserve fair compensation that reflects the true value of their rental rights. The motion emphasizes the need for a balanced approach that allows adjustments to rental fees in line with property values while protecting tenants from unjustified increases.

title: Införande av e-petitioner samt tydligare uppgift för Riksrevisionen
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for an evaluation of the role and effectiveness of regional safety representatives before any expansion of their access rights, as outlined in government proposition 2019/20:135. The KD expresses concerns that proceeding without a thorough assessment may undermine the local collaboration necessary for effective workplace safety management, and emphasizes the need for improved trust between employers and these representatives.

title: Förändrad strandskyddslagstiftning
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the rights of students from national minorities to develop their culture and language, similar to the rights currently afforded to the Sami language. It advocates for increased flexibility in educational regulations, allows for remote and distance learning even in practical subjects, and seeks to improve provisions for schools with limited resources for in-person instruction. Additionally, it calls for the removal of financial burdens on municipalities regarding funding for students requiring extensive support and promotes the integration of virtual learning methods while ensuring close contact between educators and students.

title: Biståndsarbete ska baseras på vetenskap och evidens
summary: The proposal aims to enhance oversight in the environmental sector by allowing undercover test purchases as a measure for regulatory compliance, but only in exceptional cases where other options have been exhausted. It emphasizes the need for well-defined regulations to ensure fair and consistent oversight across the country and limits the use of undercover operations to instances of identified direct danger related to specific products.

title: Minnesdag tillägnad seyfos offer
summary: The motion proposes a series of amendments to the existing regulations on distance and remote education in Sweden, advocating for broader usage and less restriction on distance education in all subjects and levels. The proposal emphasizes the need for high-quality education provided by qualified teachers, irrespective of geographic location, addressing the issue of teacher shortages in rural areas. It aims to ensure that remote education can be a viable option, particularly for students facing obstacles to traditional classroom learning. Moreover, it calls for all students to have the opportunity to complete their entire upper secondary education online, while also opposing governmental restrictions on the size and scope of distance education classes.

title: Jämställdhetsmyndigheten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1724 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the Infection Control Act to grant the government temporary powers for internal trade of medicines and medical equipment during the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the need for a balanced distribution of power from the parliament to the government due to the crisis, and insists on compensation for individuals affected by government regulations. The motion also highlights the necessity for ongoing communication between the government and parliament regarding new regulations and urges for a future review of legal frameworks for civil crises.

title: Gemensam grundutbildning för Polismyndigheten, Tullverket och Kustbevakningen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1723 av Anders Hansson och Annicka Engblom (båda M)
summary: This motion from the Moderaterna party proposes that the Swedish parliament supports measures for test purchases under concealed identity, emphasizing that such practices should only be utilized in exceptional circumstances to ensure compliance with regulations. The motion calls for clear governmental regulations to define the conditions under which these test purchases can occur, as well as for oversight mechanisms to ensure transparency and limit misuse by authorities. It argues for a fair market environment to protect both consumers and entrepreneurs while maintaining constitutional rights.

title: Belopp under 100 kronor på skattekontot
summary: The government proposes temporary amendments to the Communicable Diseases Act to enable the issuance of specific regulations aimed at controlling the spread of COVID-19. This includes provisions for limiting gatherings, closing certain businesses and cultural sites, and coordinating the distribution of medical resources. The regulations are designed to be temporary, lasting no more than three months, and must be approved by the Riksdag immediately after issuance.

title: Brottsprovokation på internet
summary: The government proposes to amend the Planning and Building Act to allow temporary exemptions from certain regulations during a public health crisis, such as the spread of a dangerous infectious disease. This would enable the government to quickly implement necessary measures if healthcare facilities are at risk of being insufficient. The proposed changes would permit exceptions to requirements concerning building permits and land use, ensuring that urgent healthcare needs can be addressed without the usual bureaucratic delays. The amendments are intended to be temporary and proportional to the risks they aim to mitigate.

title: Förebygg återfall i kriminalitet genom att utreda solidariskt skadestånd
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1720 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Sofia Westergren (båda M)
summary: The proposal aims to implement changes in Swedish legislation regarding the posting of workers, aligning with EU Directive 2018/957. Key changes include extending the ability to regulate conditions of posted workers through collective agreements, mandating that wages are not limited to a minimum wage, and enhancing protections for posted workers, including applying principles of equal treatment. Additional proposals involve stricter reporting obligations and provisions to ensure oversight and compliance in the posting of workers.

title: Angående polisens rätt att omhänderta egendom
summary: This government proposal aims to address the significant increase in intellectual property crimes by introducing stricter penalties for the most severe cases of such offenses. It proposes specific sentencing guidelines for deliberate gross violations across various intellectual property laws, with prison sentences ranging from a minimum of six months to a maximum of six years. Key factors for determining the severity of a crime include prior planning, involvement in organized crime, larger scale operations, or particularly dangerous acts. Additionally, the proposal includes changes to the rules governing public prosecution of these crimes.

title: Försvåra tillgången till fordonsregistret
summary: The Swedish government's proposition aims to amend national legislation to align with the new EU regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and trailers. This legislative adjustment is necessary for compliance with the European Parliament and Council's regulation (EU) 2018/858 and is intended to come into effect on September 1, 2020.

title: Få fart på investeringarna genom sänkta ägarskatter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should reject the government's proposition to expand the access rights of regional safety representatives, arguing that the current system requires reassessment due to changes in the labor market, such as decreased union membership and the increase of small businesses. The motion highlights the importance of regional safety representatives while suggesting a review of their effectiveness and the need for improved rights for employees, especially in workplaces lacking collective agreements.

title: Redovisa arbetsgivaravgifterna på lönespecifikationen
summary: The motion by Alireza Akhondi and Martin Ådahl from the Center Party opposes the government's proposition to extend the access rights of regional safety representatives to workplaces without union members. They argue that while strengthening workplace health and safety is important, the proposed extension would lead to confusion regarding the roles and mandates of these representatives. Instead, they advocate for an independent evaluation of the regional safety representatives' effectiveness and suggest that resources should focus on providing support and advice to small businesses through the Work Environment Authority.

title: Snabbspår för ökad trygghet på gator och torg
summary: The proposal from the Left Party advocates for limiting remote teaching to specific subjects in primary and middle school, specifically allowing it only for mother tongue and integrated Sami education in lower grades, while also recommending unrestricted distance teaching in other subjects during certain circumstances. The motion calls for legislative support to clarify regulations around remote education, emphasizing the importance of teacher-student relationships and social interaction in effective learning.

title: Fler äldre i statlig tjänst
summary: Moderaterna propose that the Riksdag follows recommendations from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the planning of high-speed railways. They suggest that Trafikverket should be tasked with improving capacity issues in the railway network and investigating high-speed rail options, applying the four-step principle for infrastructure projects. They express concerns about the high costs and potential mismanagement of the high-speed railway project, suggesting that it's essential to conduct thorough evaluations and consider alternative solutions instead of pursuing costly large-scale projects immediately.

title: Fler vårdnadshavare
summary: This motion by the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for the government to instruct Trafikverket to conduct a comprehensive investigation into the deficiencies in relation to the national transport policy goals, particularly focusing on the high-speed rail projects. The motion emphasizes the need for an analysis that identifies existing problems, explores alternative solutions, and adheres to the principle of cost-effectiveness. It highlights concerns raised by the National Audit Office regarding the planning process and quality of cost estimates, ultimately advocating for a thorough re-evaluation of the high-speed rail project's approach in light of these findings.

title: Regleringsgiljotin
summary: The government proposes that the Swedish Parliament approve amendments to the Communicable Diseases Act, classifying COVID-19 as both a communicable and a socially dangerous disease. The changes, effective July 1, 2020, would implement necessary measures under the law to control and prevent the spread of COVID-19 in accordance with existing public health regulations.

title: Gör de första arbetsinkomsterna skattefria
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reject the government's proposition regarding distance education in primary schools, suggesting instead a three-year trial period for such education for certain students, coupled with the requirement that all distance educators be certified teachers. The motion argues that the government’s proposal to implement distance education is merely a 'quick fix' that fails to address the underlying issues in the education system, such as the shortage of qualified teachers and challenges stemming from an influx of new students. Furthermore, it expresses skepticism about the potential for distance education to reduce school attendance and integration among students with special needs and calls for a restoration of smaller classroom sizes to cater to all students.

title: Jämställda pensioner
summary: The proposal advocates to reject the government's proposition regarding travel bans for minors at risk of forced marriages or genital mutilation. Instead, it calls for clearer criteria for assessing risks related to such travel bans, emphasizing the need for individualized support for those facing honor-related violence. The proposal also highlights the importance of collective accountability in cases of honor-related oppression and reinforces the call for improved education and resources for professionals dealing with vulnerable youth.

title: Kvalificering till välfärden
summary: The proposal aims to limit the maximum detention time for minors under 18 years old to 30 days, advocate for the placement of such minors in specialized youth homes instead of detention centers, and prohibit their placement in police custody. The motion highlights concerns regarding the inhumane treatment and isolation of young detainees, as emphasized by various human rights organizations, and seeks legislative changes to align Sweden's practices with international standards regarding the treatment of children.

title: Åtgärder mot bidragsfusk genom elektronisk varning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of enhancing Nordic cooperation in response to global changes, advocating for an updated Arctic strategy and a collaborative approach to pressing regional challenges. It highlights the potential benefits of joint efforts in areas such as environment, security, and trade, while also underscoring the need for harmonization of regulations to facilitate movement and economic activity among Nordic countries. The motion calls for a strategic partnership with Baltic states to bolster influence and coordination in international contexts, and to effectively respond to crises and geopolitical shifts.

title: Åtgärder mot bidragsfusk genom att godkänna information
summary: The motion by Sverigedemokraterna seeks to strengthen Nordic-Baltic cooperation in various areas, including trade, innovation, education, cultural understanding, animal welfare, defense, and environmental standards. It emphasizes the importance of a coordinated Nordic response to common challenges, enhancing the region's global standing while ensuring that national identities and interests are preserved. The proposal also calls for developing a common Nordic strategy for crisis preparedness, establishing a common external border for enhanced security, and fostering deeper collaboration among Nordic countries in both economic and cultural domains.

title: Åtgärder mot bidragsfusk genom en myndighet som genomför utbetalningarna
summary: The Swedish government acknowledges the findings of the National Audit Office regarding the national accounts, which are deemed to be of sufficient quality for informed fiscal policy decisions. However, it is recommended that the distribution and processing of this statistical data be improved to enhance accessibility and reliability. The government agrees to ensure that distribution occurs directly through the Statistics Sweden to minimize delays and inconsistencies in the data provided to users.

title: Obligatoriska besök på barnavårdscentral
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government should adhere to the recommendations of the National Audit Office regarding the planning and evaluation of high-speed rail projects. It emphasizes the need for a comprehensive review of significant infrastructure projects in the country, suggesting that the high-speed rail initiative should not receive priority without proper evaluation against other urgent infrastructure needs. The motion critiques the government's previous handling of the high-speed rail project and highlights concerns over expected costs and feasibility.

title: Stärkt koppling mellan slutbetyg och nationella prov i grundskolan
summary: The proposal outlines emergency measures to address the societal effects of the coronavirus pandemic, including temporary changes to unemployment insurance and student assistance policies. Key changes involve reducing eligibility requirements for unemployment benefits, allowing for quicker access to assistance, and adjusting budget allocations to support various sectors impacted by the pandemic. Additionally, the proposal seeks to implement financial aid for culture, sports, and organizations assisting vulnerable groups, with an intention to support economic recovery.

title: Ökat samarbete för ett starkare Norden
summary: The proposal from the Moderates calls for the government to swiftly repeal limitations on reductions of employer and self-employed fees due to the economic impact of the coronavirus. They argue that removing these fees for two months would significantly alleviate pressures on businesses, preserving jobs and boosting liquidity. The proposal emphasizes the urgency of effective economic policies to combat the crisis, suggesting broader changes than those currently offered by the government to support employment and reduce financial burdens on firms.

title: Nationellt mål för ökad självförsörjningsgrad
summary: The KD proposal emphasizes the need for the government to evaluate the design and limitations of reduced employer contributions in response to the economic impact of the coronavirus crisis. It supports government measures for temporary reductions but calls for a broader and more targeted approach to support businesses affected by the pandemic, particularly highlighting the disparities faced by different sectors. The proposal argues that adjustments should be made to existing support mechanisms, such as expanding short-term layoffs and increasing the wage cap for eligibility.

title: Högre krav på utbildning och språkkunskaper inom äldreomsorgen
summary: This motion suggests that Sweden's participation in the military operation in Mali should depend on the ongoing development of COVID-19 and contributions from other countries. It calls for the parliament to receive quarterly updates on the operation and for the government to return to parliament with an agreement regarding operations in Niger if an invitation is received. The importance of clear goal descriptions for Swedish participation is emphasized to enhance governance, follow-up, and evaluation, while acknowledging the complex security situation in the Sahel region and the need for a coordinated response that includes international cooperation and development assistance.

title: Anställningskydd
summary: The motion proposes establishing a clear examination function to prevent fraud and misuse in the context of 'establishment jobs', a new employment model aimed at newly arrived immigrants and long-term unemployed individuals. It calls for continuous evaluation of these jobs' effectiveness as labor market policy measures and emphasizes the need for improved oversight by the Swedish Public Employment Service to ensure the integrity and success of the program.

title: Begränsa rätten till gratis tolk
summary: The motion proposes a follow-up and evaluation of the merger between special adult education (särvux) and municipal adult education (komvux) in Sweden. It suggests limiting the right to study in a different municipality only to courses not offered in the home municipality, addressing concerns about financial risks for smaller municipalities associated with expanded study rights. The motion highlights the importance of komvux in addressing workforce competence needs and emphasizes the necessity for targeted skills among educators to support vulnerable groups, while also advocating for the evaluation of these changes two years post-implementation.

title: Inför aktiv dödshjälp
summary: The Moderates propose improvements to Sweden's adult education system, Komvux, emphasizing higher quality, better selection processes, and more individualized support for students. They advocate for clearer goals that prioritize adult integration into the labor market and suggest a new grading system, while opposing the proposed merger of Komvux and Särvux. The party stresses the necessity of a diverse range of education providers and state oversight to ensure effective learning outcomes, including a results-based funding model for adult education programs.

title: Säkerställ full finansiering för projektet Tvärförbindelse Södertörn
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish parliament to condition Sweden's military participation in a mission in Mali on the development of the COVID-19 situation and the contributions of other nations. It emphasizes the need for clear objectives for Sweden's involvement, regular updates to Parliament, and transparency regarding agreements with Niger. The Moderates support participation in the mission to enhance security in the Sahel region while stressing that Sweden's military engagements should align with national interests and the broader European security context.

title: Förseningsavgiften för sent inbetald trängselavgift
summary: The motion proposed by Jonas Sjöstedt and other members of the Left Party calls for the rejection of the government's proposal for reduced social fees for employers and sole proprietors. It emphasizes the need for an altered income calculation to support particularly affected sectors during the economic downturn caused by the coronavirus pandemic, while expressing support for other economic relief measures. The Left Party argues that blanket reductions in social fees disproportionately benefit all business owners, regardless of their economic viability, thus proposing targeted support instead.

title: Vissa frågor om jakt och viltvård
summary: The motion proposes several measures to address the rising youth crime rates in Sweden, including the need for more flexible curfews, clearer roles for social services in youth supervision, the removal of confidentiality barriers between police and social services, and increased use of the Special Care of Young People Act (LVU) for handling young offenders. The aim is to create a more systematic and proactive approach to preventing youth crime and ensuring appropriate consequences for serious offenses.

title: Gör skatten synlig på kvitton
summary: The proposal aims to ensure that prison sentences for Swedish citizens convicted abroad are served in their home country, removing the requirement for the convicted individual's consent for such transfers. The motion argues that the responsibility for managing citizens who commit crimes abroad lies with their home country, and emphasizes the need for reforms in both criminal and migration policies to uphold public safety in Sweden.

title: Nytt skatteutjämningssystem
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1693 av Ida Drougge och Josefin Malmqvist (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to clarify the term 'special reasons' for granting exemptions from height limitations in vehicle support for individuals with disabilities, define this term in relation to adaptation grants for standard equipment, and to replace 'additional equipment' with 'optional equipment'. Additionally, it advocates for vehicle support to include specially adapted child seats to ensure safe travel for children with disabilities.

title: Redovisning av avgiftsberäkningar
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats advocates for enhanced measures against young offenders, suggesting a combination of restrictions on movement and supervision. It emphasizes the need for appropriate societal responses to juvenile delinquency, including the implementation of weekend house arrest in conjunction with other restrictions. The motion intends to ensure that juvenile supervision applies strictly to those under 18 years of age, arguing that the current judicial responses are insufficient and must be revised to effectively address the risk of reoffending.

title: Sälj SBAB
summary: The motion proposes to permanently abolish the ceiling for tax deferrals on capital gains from the sale of private residences to enhance mobility in the housing market. The argument is based on the contention that the temporary uplift to a maximum of 3 million kronor is insufficient and does not resolve ongoing issues in the housing market. The authors argue that eliminating this cap would allow for better utilization of housing resources and insists that continued reforms are needed to support first-time buyers and improve housing supply overall.

title: Toatömning i skärgård
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the government's assessment of the conditions for Swedish participation in the military operation aimed at enhancing security in Mali. It emphasizes the need for thorough analysis considering both international contributions and the needs within Sweden, especially in light of the global pandemic affecting logistics and safety in deploying military forces.

title: Sälj SAS
summary: The motion by Alexander Christiansson and other members of the Sweden Democrats (SD) opposes the government's proposal for subsidized jobs aimed at newly arrived individuals and the long-term unemployed. It argues for broad solutions accessible to all job seekers, regardless of their background, and expresses concern over the potential negative impact of targeted subsidies. The motion supports increased control measures within the labor market policy to ensure the effective use of state resources and calls for a separate proposal focused on improving oversight rather than mixing it with a politically controversial subsidized employment plan.

title: Förstärkt revision i landets kommuner
summary: The proposal seeks to introduce a simplified procedure for certain decisions regarding secret surveillance of electronic communications to enhance efficiency in law enforcement. Currently, the process is resource-intensive due to the requirement of court meetings for each new authorization when criminals frequently change phone numbers and SIM cards. The suggested change would allow for additional permission for secret surveillance to be granted without the need for court sessions, streamlining the process while maintaining the same legal controls.

title: Konkurrensneutralitet mellan medieföretag verksamma i Sverige
summary: The government has submitted a response to the Riksrevisionen's report on the electoral process, acknowledging the effectiveness of the current voting system while noting areas for improvement. It welcomes recommendations for enhancing collaboration among electoral authorities and considers minor adjustments to the existing ballot system rather than a comprehensive overhaul. Additionally, the government sees no current justification for increasing early votes counted on election night, despite recognizing the need for careful local planning to avoid long queues and ensure voter participation.

title: Ge kommunerna en tydligare roll i den myndighetsgemensamma satsningen mot organiserad välfärdsbrottslighet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1685 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal aims to enhance the collaboration and information exchange between the police and social services in Sweden to effectively combat terrorism. Currently, existing secrecy regulations impede the sharing of relevant information between these authorities, which hinders their collective efforts against terrorism. The government suggests amending the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act to simplify and broaden the circumstances under which police can share information with municipal social services, particularly for preventing and addressing potential terrorist activities, while still ensuring legal safeguards.

title: Utveckla och förbättra vård och behandling av sköldkörtelsjukdomar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:1684 av Ingela Nylund Watz och Azadeh Rojhan Gustafsson (båda S)
summary: The government proposes amendments to the value-added tax (VAT) regulations primarily influenced by changes in the VAT directive for e-commerce.
