It advocates for a ban on the sale of new fossil fuel cars after 2025, proposes targeted subsidies for electric vehicles, a scrapping premium, and a conversion subsidy. The motion emphasizes the need for a national strategy to develop a comprehensive and equitable charging system throughout Sweden, as well as measures to facilitate car-sharing and parking solutions. It also calls for improved support for the mining industry to ensure a sustainable supply of critical metals necessary for the transition to electric mobility.

title: Åtgärder mot extremism i civilsamhället
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:809 av Jonas Andersson i Linköping m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes increased accessibility and equity in dental care in Sweden by incorporating the needs-based solidarity principle into dental law, setting a national goal for at least one dental visit per year for all citizens, and enhancing cross-regional collaboration, workforce education, and regulations for private dental care providers. The aim is to address current inequalities in dental health access based on socioeconomic status and geographic location, ensuring equitable treatment across the country.

title: Svenskt kulturarvsår
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen Sweden's economic family policy by indexing allowances and benefits to cope with rising living costs, advocating measures such as enhanced housing support and child allowances. It suggests gradual tapering of benefits as children age out of eligibility to assist families during transitions, and emphasizes a more inclusive policy that encompasses households without children. The motion highlights the increasing economic vulnerability of families, particularly single parents, and seeks to reform benefits to better support these groups, while also addressing administrative inefficiencies.

title: Språkfrågor
summary: The proposal put forth by Nooshi Dadgostar and others emphasizes the urgent need for a functioning sickness insurance system in Sweden. It advocates for a comprehensive reform of the current system to enhance economic security for the sick, streamline rehabilitation processes, and ensure better support for individuals unable to work due to illness. Key recommendations include abolishing the waiting period for sick pay, adjusting the criteria for sickness compensation, and increasing compensation levels to reflect actual living costs, all aimed at fostering a more inclusive and supportive workplace environment.

title: Spelmarknadspolitik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:806 av Jonas Andersson i Linköping m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes an increase in budget allocations for regional development in Sweden, specifically supporting local businesses like rural shops and enhancing tourism incommunities with significant old-growth forests. It rejects the government's general budget cuts, arguing that such savings harm public services and that increased funding is necessary for the sustainability of rural economies and the modernization of small businesses.

title: Scenkonst
summary: This motion proposes budget allocations for energy-related initiatives in Sweden for 2024, prioritizing investments in renewable energy, including wind and biogas, alongside infrastructure improvements. It specifically requests funding for the expansion of energy efficiency measures, local renewable energy production, and support for electric vehicle charging infrastructure, while rejecting the government's general budget cuts that could negatively impact public service efficiency.

title: Samiska utbildningsfrågor
summary: The Left Party proposes a new budget for 2024, opposing the government's general cuts to the state administration, which they believe will negatively impact core services and citizen trust. They suggest an increase in funding for the Swedish Tax Agency and the introduction of a new regulation for sick pay income, leading to additional costs of 10 million kronor.

title: Public service-frågor
summary: The Left Party proposes a budget allocation for education and university research in 2024, emphasizing increased funding for various educational institutions and support mechanisms. They reject the government's general spending cuts, advocating for more specific allocations to ensure the quality of education and support for students, particularly those with disabilities. The proposal includes increased funding for preschool, adult education, and support for student organizations, while also opposing the government's priorities aimed at reducing education spending.

title: Politik för ett starkt och oberoende civilsamhälle
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:802 av Jonas Andersson i Linköping m.fl. (SD)
summary: The suggestion aims to allocate the budget for 2024 within the area of study support, with Vänsterpartiet proposing increased funding for various study aid programs, including a higher budget for study start assistance and adjustments to student loan repayment regulations. The proposal opposes the government's general budget cuts, arguing that such measures undermine the effectiveness of public administration and harm citizen services.

title: Nationella minoriteter i Sverige
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes a comprehensive investment program for 2024 aimed at addressing the housing crisis in Sweden through increased funding for climate-smart rental housing, renovation of existing buildings, and improved consumer guidance. The initiative includes various allocations for housing development, energy efficiency, and support for municipalities to create more accessible living spaces, while rejecting the government's proposed budget cuts. The party emphasizes the importance of state intervention to stimulate construction and renovation to meet climate goals and ensure affordable housing for all citizens.

title: Nationell handlingsplan för kyrkor som tas ur bruk
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes significant increases in funding for various climate, environment, and nature-related initiatives in Sweden for 2024, rejecting the government's proposed budget cuts and emphasizing the importance of strengthening environmental protections, sustainable practices, and climate adaptation measures. The proposal includes increased allocations for biodiversity, environmental monitoring, and various specific programs aimed at addressing climate-related challenges and enhancing the capacity of environmental agencies.

title: Museifrågor
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes an increase in the budget for 2024 for a range of initiatives aimed at enhancing Sweden's agricultural and rural sectors. The motion emphasizes the importance of environmental sustainability, animal welfare, and local food production, including funding for organic farming, compensation for wildlife-related damages, and investments in veterinary education. The suggested budget increases total approximately 2.6 billion kronor compared to the government's proposals, with specific allocations for forest management, animal health, ecosystem conservation, and water management in agriculture.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal from the Left Party aims to increase funding for the justice sector in 2024, emphasizing the establishment of a dedicated emergency helpline for women facing violence, enhanced resources for customs enforcement to combat drug and weapon trafficking, and a femicide package to improve the legal response to violence against women. They also advocate for increased funding for the Crime Victim Compensation and education about online threats to children, alongside reforms for legal aid to make it more accessible. The overall aim is to strengthen the capacity of law enforcement and judicial institutions to address various forms of violence and crime more effectively.

title: Grundlag
summary: Vänsterpartiet presents a proposal to the Swedish Parliament for budget allocations in 2024, emphasizing the need to reject proposed general cuts to the government administration that would negatively impact public service. The motion suggests an increase in funding for various areas, including support for the Sametinget, measures for national minorities, and enhanced media support, while proposing reductions in allocations for the Royal House and administrative offices. Overall, the party argues for a more equitable distribution of funds to better serve the needs of society, specifically in the context of economic pressures on households.

title: Östersjöns miljö- och fiskeripolitik
summary: The proposal from the Left Party (V) outlines a detailed budget allocation for 2024 within the area of labor market and working life. It emphasizes the need for increased funding for various programs aimed at improving employment, providing unemployment benefits, enhancing labor market training, and combating labor market crime. The party criticizes the government's plan for general budget cuts, asserting that such cuts would reduce essential services for citizens. The Left Party advocates for a stronger public workforce and better support systems for job seekers, with recommended increases in specific budget allocations for agencies including the Employment Agency and workplace safety inspections.

title: Strandskyddet och utvecklingen i skärgården och på landsbygden
summary: The proposal suggests allocating funds for 2024 under expenditure area 26, specifically for state debt interest rates, and recommends increasing the budget for tax-free maintenance provisions for property owners by 10 million kronor, following a suggestion from the Left Party to promote tax-free maintenance savings in relation to rental housing and public utility support.

title: Handläggningstider vid utbyggnad av elnätet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:794 av Ola Johansson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposed by Vänsterpartiet outlines a detailed budget allocation for 2024, focusing on transportation infrastructure and sustainable transport initiatives. It advocates for an increase in funding for public transport, including establishing a national 'Sverigebiljett' for regional transport, investing in climate-friendly transport modes, maintaining existing infrastructure, and supporting education in the railway and maritime sectors. The proposal strongly opposes the government's general cuts in public administration that are deemed detrimental to service delivery.

title: Förlängd nedfrysningstid för befruktade äggceller
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes adjustments to the budget for 2024 within the economic area of business, recommending increased funding for research on sustainable building materials, support for small businesses, and initiatives aimed at promoting women's entrepreneurship. They also oppose the government's general cuts to public spending, arguing that such measures undermine the capacity of public services. Additionally, the party seeks to establish a new program for the green transition of the paper industry, aimed at enhancing renewable energy production, while maintaining the politcal goal for sustainable tourism.

title: Hemmasittare
summary: This parliamentary motion by Nooshi Dadgostar and others from the Left Party proposes a budget allocation for 2024 focusing on various areas within the economic framework. It calls for changes in funding for the Financial Policy Council, including its potential abolition and creation of new institutes like the Stockholm Institute for interdisciplinary economic research and the Climate Investment Agency. The motion also rejects the government's general budget cuts to public administration, emphasizing the need for effective public services.

title: Anpassade bemanningsregler för den mindre yrkessjöfarten
summary: The proposal from Vänsterpartiet emphasizes the need for increased financial support to municipalities to improve public services, particularly in response to rising costs due to inflation. The motion suggests allocating approximately 23 billion kronor more than the government's proposal for the municipal sector in 2024, addressing various areas such as healthcare, social services, and support for vulnerable households, including significant raises in welfare benefits. Additionally, it calls for a new investment support fund for community facilities to meet substantial infrastructural needs.

title: Jämställt bistånd för entreprenörskap och miljö
summary: Vänsterpartiets motion aims to strengthen the police organization in Sweden by proposing several measures, including the establishment of a national commission to address shootings and gang crime, an information campaign to prevent youth recruitment into crime, and regular firearms amnesties. The party emphasizes the importance of a local and community-engaged police force and calls for strategies to enhance the effectiveness and trustworthiness of the police, as well as to tackle issues like ethnic profiling and private security sector regulation.

title: Höjd hastighetsgräns för A-traktor
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive tax reform aimed at creating a fairer tax system in Sweden. It suggests measures such as introducing a uniform capital income tax, establishing a new inheritance and gift tax with an exemption threshold for regular households, and implementing a state property tax. Additionally, the proposal aims to phase out job tax deductions for high earners and close tax gaps for various forms of income. It emphasizes the need for equitable taxation to enhance social justice and reduce economic inequality while also promoting environmental tax reforms.

title: Höjd maxfart för personbil med husvagn
summary: The motion presents a comprehensive proposal for a new housing policy in Sweden, arguing that housing is a social right that should be accessible to all citizens. It calls for the government to establish a national strategy to ensure affordable housing, reinstate investment supports for rental and student housing, and emphasizes the importance of sustainable development in building practices. It also proposes measures to combat homelessness, promote equitable housing policies, and enhance climate-friendly construction methods. The motion advocates for active state intervention to address the housing crisis and improve living conditions for marginalized groups.

title: Nytt organdonationssystem – opt-out
summary: The motion proposes a series of reforms aimed at strengthening the legal protections for tenants in Sweden, particularly against exploitative landlords and to enhance the role of public housing. Key suggestions include increasing government oversight of rental practices, enforcing stricter requirements for landlords to maintain properties, and introducing measures to protect tenants during renovations and other property changes. The motion emphasizes the importance of affordable and secure housing for all residents, advocating for the restoration of rights for tenants and the fortification of the public housing sector.

title: Tillåt fler språk än svenska vid myndighetsutövning
summary: The motion proposes that all young people should have the opportunity to learn more about personal finance in school. It suggests that the Riksdag supports efforts to investigate possibilities for the Swedish National Agency for Education to enhance personal finance education across all school forms. The motivation includes survey results showing that a significant majority of high school students and teachers believe in the importance of financial education, due to concerns about low financial literacy among youth and the potential for improved decision-making regarding personal finances.

title: Plats för cykling, hållbarhet och hälsa
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:785 av Ola Johansson och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider a review of legislation and regulations to combat hooliganism at football matches, as incidents of disorder, especially during derby matches, continue to strain police resources. The motion emphasizes the need for a safer atmosphere at these events, allowing families to attend without fear and enabling police to allocate resources more effectively to tackle gang-related crime.

title: Lika villkor för hästnäringen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:784 av Ola Johansson och Annika Qarlsson (båda C)
summary: This motion calls for the Swedish healthcare system to adopt a salutogenic approach to strengthen mental health and reduce suicides. It emphasizes the need for timely intervention for at-risk individuals, advocating for alternatives to medication such as therapy, physical activity, and social support. The motion also proposes a review of the psychiatric care guarantee, ensuring timely access to care, and enhancing communication with families regarding treatment. Additionally, it suggests the establishment of an investigation into suicides to learn from each case, and to develop a zero-vision policy for suicides in Sweden.

title: Ökad avskjutning av vildsvin
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:783 av Mikael Larsson och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should review the possibility of differentiating the tax rates on commercial betting and online gambling, suggesting a lower tax rate for commercial betting. It argues that a potential increase in the gambling tax from 18% to 22% could negatively impact the horse industry, which supports thousands of jobs and contributes significantly to state revenue. The motion suggests maintaining the current tax rate for commercial betting while raising the tax on online gambling to ensure the industry remains financially viable and can continue supporting public health initiatives by promoting safer gambling options.

title: Bildande av naturreservat
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:782 av Mikael Larsson och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibilities for elderly individuals to choose nutritious and appealing meals within elderly care, and encourages municipalities to open up for more food suppliers in home care services. The importance of good and nutritious meals for preventing physical and mental health issues among the elderly is emphasized, alongside the need for municipalities to provide a greater variety of meal options from different suppliers, catering to the individual preferences of seniors.

title: Ordningsvakter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider implementing stricter language requirements, including a language test prior to hiring, for personnel working in elderly care. It emphasizes the importance of effective communication in the care sector, particularly in sensitive situations where understanding and speaking Swedish is crucial. The motion also advocates for immediate Swedish language instruction for new residents in Sweden.

title: Stöd till enskilda vägar och skogsvägar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament consider introducing dental care fees for asylum seekers and temporary visitors, ensuring that they are subject to the same charges as Swedish citizens. The aim is to maintain equity in treatment and create a system where unpaid dental fees can be recorded as debt, to be settled at a later date if necessary.

title: Gynnsam bevarandestatus i fråga om varg
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of farm sales of alcoholic beverages in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a regulatory framework that allows for this practice while maintaining the existing state monopoly. It highlights the economic and environmental benefits of such sales for local producers, particularly in regions like Skåne, where the wine and microbrewery industries are thriving. By facilitating direct sales at production sites, the proposal aims to boost local tourism and improve the livelihoods of producers, ensuring that Sweden aligns with agricultural practices observed in Southern Europe.

title: Avgifter för utbildning av ordningsvakter
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to review fees within elderly care services, particularly focusing on the financial situation of pensioners. It highlights that many eligible seniors do not benefit from housing supplements due to higher municipal fees, which undermine the intention of the support. The proposal calls for adjustments in fee structures and better consideration of the economic circumstances of pensioners to ensure fairness and transparency in the elderly care system.

title: Landbaserade fiskodlingar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:777 av Daniel Bäckström och Fredrik Christensson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing a requirement for police background checks for individuals working in home care and elderly care, similar to existing requirements for childcare and educational institutions. This measure aims to enhance safety and assurance for vulnerable individuals receiving care at home, ensuring that caregivers do not have a history of violent or sexual offenses.

title: ROT-avdrag för renovering av fönsterbågar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:776 av Daniel Bäckström och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for municipalities in Sweden to be granted the authority to hire doctors in order to improve the continuity and quality of care for the elderly. It argues that as the population ages, there is an increasing need for close collaboration between care teams and medical professionals to provide proactive healthcare, thus enhancing the overall service delivered to citizens.

title: Farledsavgifter
summary: The proposal advocates for an increased availability of trained guide dogs for the visually impaired in Sweden, aiming to review and enhance current provisions to provide a more flexible daily life for this community. It highlights the disparity in access to guide dogs between Sweden and other Nordic countries, suggesting the need for an increase in the number of guide dogs from 261 to 500 to match the accessibility levels in countries like Norway. The motion calls for a reassessment of funding and collaboration strategies to facilitate the training of more guide dogs.

title: Information om vilka fordon en person äger
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the right to assisted suicide for individuals facing terminal illnesses, emphasizing respect for personal choice and self-determination in end-of-life situations. The motion argues for the need to investigate how legally allowed active euthanasia could be implemented in Sweden, referencing ongoing debates and previous reports on the subject, and criticizing the current absence of such provisions that compel individuals to seek assistance abroad.

title: Slopad mängdrabatt
summary: The proposal advocates for increased access to entrepreneurship education in Swedish high schools, emphasizing the importance of early exposure to business for fostering future entrepreneurs, particularly among women. It suggests that more students should have the opportunity to participate in the 'Ung Företagsamhet' program, allowing them to learn about running a business and potentially guiding them towards entrepreneurship after graduation. The proposal encourages flexibility in course selection, allowing students to opt for entrepreneurship as an individual choice regardless of their main program of study.

title: Stoppa högt spelande fordon på allmän plats
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:772 av Peter Helander och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the examination of expanding cancer screening programs to enable the early detection of various cancers, emphasizing the importance of timely diagnosis to improve patient outcomes and reduce the burden on healthcare services.

title: Gränshinder mellan Sverige och Norge
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:771 av Fredrik Christensson och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider a review of crisis preparedness in Sweden to clarify responsibilities related to civil defense. It emphasizes the necessity for well-defined roles at all levels of society, including individuals, authorities, and organizations, to ensure effective crisis management. The motion highlights the importance of training, preparedness planning, and regular exercises to foster strong community resilience and effective responses to both major and minor emergencies.

title: Investeringsstöd till jordbruk via landsbygdsprogrammet
summary: The proposal advocates for increasing the number of individuals training as craftsmen to support a circular economy. It highlights the need for improved awareness of available vocational education in craftsmanship, especially among young people and their parents, to address the impending shortage of craftsmen due to retirements and to meet the demand for services in sectors like the wood and furniture industry. The motion emphasizes sustainable consumption and the role of quality craftsmanship in prolonging the lifespan of goods, while also calling for a focus on craftsmanship education at both high school and lower school levels.

title: Länsstyrelsens besiktningspersonal
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive assessment and study of the impact of pornography and sexual offenses on children and adolescents, including a review of the accessibility of pornography and its potential harmful effects on their well-being and sexual health. It advocates for stricter penalties for severe sexual offenses committed by youths and calls for a clearer societal stance against such crimes. The proposal seeks to gather knowledge about the characteristics of sexual offenses and is aimed at informing legal reforms and preventive measures against abuse.

title: Småskaliga slakterier
summary: The motion proposes enhancing civil protection measures in Sweden to address contemporary threats, including an assessment of existing shelter infrastructure and the need for new constructions. It emphasizes the importance of adapting emergency preparedness to modern challenges, including energy, food, and water security, and calls for an active monitoring of risks to ensure a robust response capability.

title: Turkiets agerande i Mellanöstern
summary: The motion proposes to restrict access to personal data on digital search services in Sweden, highlighting the risks posed to individuals, particularly the elderly, by available information that can be exploited by criminals. It suggests that individuals should have the right to not appear on these search services and indicates that legal changes may be necessary to balance freedom of expression with personal privacy.

title: Ordningsvakter
summary: The motion proposes to revise the current regulations governing liquor licenses for restaurant owners, suggesting that a single license should enable a restaurateur to operate in multiple municipalities and establish additional restaurants without the need for repetitive application processes. This aims to simplify the permitting process and reduce administrative burdens on restaurant owners.

title: Föräldrars och elevers rätt till information om skolor
summary: The proposal suggests transferring the oversight of independent preschool facilities in Sweden from local municipalities to the national School Inspection Authority. It argues that the current system, where different authorities supervise educational institutions, risks undermining the equality and effectiveness of oversight, and raises concerns about potential conflicts of interest and political bias in how oversight is conducted.

title: Likställighet för barn i friskola
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament conducts a review of the land acquisition law (jordförvärvslagen) to address concerns about allowing agricultural properties to be transferred to legal entities via inheritance, thereby bypassing the current legal requirements. The motivation highlights the need for maintaining a balance in the ownership of agricultural properties between individuals and corporations, and seeks to ensure the law's objectives can be upheld.

title: Småskaliga slakterier
summary: The motion proposes to lower the VAT on private music education from 25% to 6%, emphasizing the benefits of music education for individuals and society. It argues that the current high tax rate creates barriers for private music schools, limiting access and contributing to cultural decline. The motion highlights the need for a diverse music education market and suggests that reducing the VAT would stimulate social and cultural entrepreneurship.

title: Översyn av va-lagen
summary: Richard Jomshof proposes the Swedish Parliament conduct an investigation to address illegal street gambling that targets tourists, particularly in central Stockholm. He highlights that organized crime has exploited the increasing tourism in Sweden, with illegal games misleading visitors into believing they can win money, leading to substantial financial losses. Jomshof calls for a legislative change to impose stricter penalties, such as prison sentences and deportation, for those involved in these scams, and emphasizes the need for effective measures to protect tourists and enhance their experience in Sweden.

title: En svensk industriplan
summary: The motion proposes a ban on non-medical circumcision of children in Sweden, arguing that such procedures violate children's rights to bodily integrity and self-determination. The motion references ongoing debates and expert opinions opposing non-medical circumcision and suggests that decisions regarding circumcision should be postponed until individuals are 18 years old and can provide their consent. It emphasizes the need to protect children's rights in line with international conventions.

title: Fler tjänster i RUT
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national animal protection police in Sweden to investigate and combat animal cruelty. It highlights the importance of effective animal welfare and protection, citing successes from previous regional initiatives that led to more efficient handling of animal welfare cases. The proposal calls for an urgent investigation into the feasibility of implementing such a national authority, ensuring that it operates without detracting from existing police resources through specialized training for new personnel.

title: Utvärdering av skatteutjämningssystemet i sin helhet - för hela Sveriges skull
summary: The suggestion proposes to the parliament to implement a ban on the wearing of Muslim headscarves in Swedish preschools and primary schools. It argues that children should not be subjected to what it describes as oppression at home, allowing them to experience their childhood free from such constraints. The motion emphasizes that wearing the headscarf promotes unhealthy gender roles and reinforces a patriarchal view that undermines women's rights, thereby contradicting the principles of equality and democracy in Swedish society.

title: Redovisning av hela skatten
summary: The motion proposes a ban on Muslim free schools in Sweden, citing concerns over the quality of education and potential links to extremist ideologies. The proposal includes immediate halting of new establishments of Muslim free schools and calls for stricter oversight of existing confessional schools to ensure compliance with non-confessional education standards and democratic values. It emphasizes the need to counteract the ongoing 'Islamization' of Swedish society.

title: Effektutvärdering av den skadliga kemikalieskatten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:757 av Camilla Brodin och Larry Söder (båda KD)
summary: This motion advocates for the prohibition of halal and kosher slaughter practices in Sweden, highlighting the suffering caused to animals due to slaughter without prior stunning. It proposes that meat from such slaughter methods should carry a warning label, that Sweden should push for EU regulations to ensure similar labeling across Europe, and that exceptions should be sought within the EU to ban imports of such meat. Additionally, it calls for legislation mandating that all meat purchased through public procurement complies with Swedish animal welfare standards.

title: Kraftförsörjningen i Sörmland
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:756 av Caroline Helmersson Olsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish parliament the introduction of conduct assessments for students in schools, particularly for those in higher grades and gymnasiums. These assessments would serve as a supplementary document to term grades, evaluating students on their punctuality, respect for others, ability to follow instructions, and compliance with rules. The intent is to provide students with a credible reference for prospective employers, filling the gap left by lack of work experience, while also promoting better behavior and a more orderly school environment.

title: Bygg fler små hyresrätter med stöd
summary: The motion proposes to modernize the subject of home and consumer studies in Swedish schools, emphasizing the need for updated education that equips students with essential knowledge about economics, budgeting, and financial management. The motion argues that while practical skills like cooking are important, economic education should be a primary focus to help students manage their finances and avoid issues such as high-interest loans. The proposal suggests a reform that would integrate comprehensive economic education into this subject, while reallocating certain topics, such as nutrition and exercise, to physical education.

title: Reglera godtyckliga arrendekostnader
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national competence center to support relatives of individuals who have taken their own lives. It emphasizes the urgent need for focused support due to the stigma surrounding mental health issues, particularly suicide, which significantly impacts families left behind. The center would draw on multidisciplinary expertise from both municipal and regional resources to effectively aid those affected in their recovery journey following such tragedies.

title: Små barn som utsatts för brott
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of anonymizing social workers in difficult situations by replacing their names with 'socialtjänsten' (social services) to protect their identities. This measure aims to alleviate the harsh pressures faced by social workers during tough decisions, such as child custody cases and financial aid assessments, which can threaten their personal safety and job security. The motion is positioned as a way to enhance the attractiveness of social work and ensure the availability of competent professionals in the field, while maintaining necessary confidentiality for oversight.

title: Momsregler och civilsamhället
summary: The motion proposes that the legal age for parental responsibility regarding children's medical contacts and access to medication lists be raised to 18 years. The reasoning presented highlights the maturity of individuals at 18 and argues that current regulations, allowing 13-year-olds to manage their healthcare independently, may hinder parental support for children with mental health issues or disabilities who cannot seek help or understand their healthcare needs. The motion aims to ensure that parents can provide necessary support during critical health decisions.

title: Överväg en "läskskatt"
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:751 av Mats Wiking och Kristina Nilsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers the possibility of transferring the financial responsibility for LSS (the Act on Support and Service for Certain Functional Impairments) from municipalities to the state, due to significant variations in service assessments and costs across different municipalities. The intent is to ensure equal opportunities for individuals with disabilities to lead fulfilling lives and to enhance their autonomy and quality of life.

title: Insatser mot näthat
summary: The motion calls for increased awareness and knowledge about endometriosis, a chronic autoimmune disease affecting 1 in 10 women of childbearing age. It emphasizes the importance of early diagnosis and proper treatment, as many women face misdiagnosis and inadequate care, leading to painful symptoms and significant impact on education and quality of life. The motion urges the government to ensure that primary care, youth clinics, and school health services have established routines to provide timely diagnosis and treatment for affected young women.

title: Tillsvidareanställning
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform framework aimed at increasing economic growth in the Stockholm region. Key elements include reforming the tax system to enhance work incentives, implementing activity requirements for welfare support, and facilitating labor immigration. The motion emphasizes the necessity of improving the business climate, investing in education, enhancing infrastructure, and increasing support for entrepreneurs and innovation. It advocates for measures that promote workforce mobility, such as tax deductions for personal education expenses and stipends for fields experiencing labor shortages.

title: Avdragsrätt för fackföreningsavgift
summary: The motion advocates for the government to consider making coastal erosion caused by the sea a state responsibility and to streamline the regulations surrounding beach nourishment. It highlights the increasing risks associated with coastal erosion due to climate change and emphasizes the economic and environmental importance of addressing the issue. The proposal calls for a review of the state's compensation requirements for municipalities that recover sand from the sea to combat erosion, noting the burden this places on local governments and the necessity for a coordinated approach to manage the challenges of coastal erosion effectively.

title: Behovet av mer arbetsmarknadsutbildning och förbättrad matchning på arbetsmarknaden
summary: The motion aims to enhance infrastructure in Skåne by prioritizing and expediting various projects, including transportation links, road expansions, and new connections with Denmark. It suggests using revenue from the Öresund Bridge to fund future investments and advocates for improvements in rail and road networks to alleviate congestion and improve conditions for businesses and workers in the region. The proposal highlights the necessity for a well-functioning infrastructure to support Skåne's economic growth and employment opportunities, especially in the context of rising unemployment and economic downturns.

title: Det allmänna uppdraget i viltförvaltningen
summary: The motion submitted by Lars Engsund focuses on improving the transportation infrastructure in Kalmar County, particularly the E22 road and regional road networks. It proposes government review and potential implementation of plans for speed limit adjustments, increased state responsibility for bus rapid transit corridors where rail is absent, electrification of railways, and enhanced maritime transport of goods. This proposal aims to bolster economic growth, address traffic safety concerns, and support a shift towards more sustainable transport methods, thereby ensuring effective transportation for both the local workforce and businesses.

title: Avskaffa fideikommiss
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the conditions for establishing an Öresund Metro, aiming to enhance integration between Malmö and Copenhagen. It argues that improving transportation will address socio-economic challenges in Malmö, boost employment, and enhance regional connectivity. The Öresund Metro is seen as a cost-effective and environmentally friendly infrastructure investment that would benefit the entire region and strengthen Sweden's trade relationships.

title: Barnomsorg på de tider då föräldrarna arbetar
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of activity requirements within economic assistance for all individuals capable of work, aiming to promote economic independence and reduce dependency on benefits. It highlights that municipalities have different approaches to welfare support, which may hinder individuals' progress towards employment. The proposal suggests that these activity requirements should be tailored to each individual based on their needs, such as offering practical work experience or language training. The goal is to encourage self-sufficiency and combat intergenerational dependency on social benefits.

title: Registrering av testamente
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the Alcohol Act to allow the delivery of alcoholic beverages alongside food from restaurants. Currently, such deliveries are prohibited despite the allowance for other age-restricted products like medication and tobacco. The suggestion encourages the government to consider amending the law to facilitate this practice.

title: Förutsättningar för gode män och förvaltare
summary: The motion proposes that charging stations for electric vehicles located on municipal land should be subject to building permits, allowing municipalities to impose design standards. This is aimed at accelerating the expansion of charging infrastructure while ensuring that such installations do not negatively impact the aesthetics of urban areas.

title: Ökad kunskap och samarbete för att motverka psykiska ohälsa
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:741 av Per-Arne Håkansson och Marianne Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the possibility of extending the duration that an artist, cultural practitioner, or athlete can stay in Sweden before being considered a resident for tax purposes, suggesting a change from the current six months to twelve months. This change aims to make Sweden a more attractive destination for professionals in the cultural and sports sectors.

title: Hållbar utveckling för va-system
summary: This motion proposes that Stockholm be designated as a test municipality for Systembolaget, Sweden's alcohol retail monopoly, to explore the feasibility of extended opening hours, including Sundays, and the sale of chilled beverages. The motion argues that past changes to Systembolaget's operating hours have had no significant negative impact on alcohol consumption and suggests that increased accessibility could be beneficial.

title: Fordonsverkstäder bör bli anmälningspliktig verksamhet
summary: The motion proposes making it mandatory for all employers in Sweden to clearly specify the employer's social security contributions on employee pay slips. The intention is to enhance transparency around the total tax burden and the costs associated with employment, ensuring that employees better understand the financial obligations their employers face.

title: Flexiblare regler för uttag av tjänstepension
summary: The proposal suggests several measures to combat the rising rates of sexual crimes in Sweden, including increasing the minimum sentences for rape, facilitating the expulsion of non-citizen perpetrators, and ensuring that all reasonably suspected individuals are interrogated. The motivation highlights the significant rise in sexual offenses during the past government term, particularly affecting young women, and calls for more effective investigations and greater accountability within law enforcement.

title: Sjuk- och aktivitetsersättning
summary: The motion addresses the importance of enhancing the agricultural production capacity and food industry in Skåne, Sweden, stressing the need for government support in simplifying regulations, promoting local businesses, and increasing job opportunities in rural areas. It advocates for an improved marketing strategy for the region as a tourist destination by leveraging local food and beverage production while encouraging deregulation to facilitate growth in the agricultural sector.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om flerbarnstillägget i barnbidraget
summary: The motion proposes a review of the national regulations regarding housing for newly arrived immigrants in Sweden, suggesting that municipalities should be required to provide housing for a maximum of two years as part of the settlement law. The aim is to create a uniform approach across municipalities, ensuring fairness and reducing competition between groups for housing resources. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the importance of individual responsibility in finding housing after the initial support period and seeks to harmonize laws to improve integration outcomes.

title: Integritet på nätet och nätjättarnas växande makt
summary: The suggestion advocates for a reform of the societal orientation course aimed at newly arrived immigrants in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for an overhaul to improve attendance and the quality of education by introducing examinations, increasing the number of instructional hours, and starting the course earlier in the integration process. It also calls for a clearer national curriculum and tailored courses for different educational backgrounds to ensure uniformity and higher quality in the instruction provided.

title: Ändamålsenlig kemikaliepolitik
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should enhance ownership and coordination of regulatory simplification efforts between government departments to effectively reduce the regulatory burden on businesses. Improved coordination is deemed essential to minimize duplicative efforts and achieve a comprehensive approach in regulatory reforms, as per suggestions from Kristina Alsér's investigation.

title: Politik för värnad och stärkt äganderätt
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should explore the possibility of implementing a differentiated capital gains tax on the sale of residential properties. The aim is to alleviate the current tax burden, which is a flat 22% on any profit made from selling a home, thereby encouraging more mobility in the housing market. This differentiated tax system would adjust the rate based on the duration of property ownership, promoting flexible living arrangements and preventing speculative buying while supporting homeowners in transitioning between properties throughout their lives.

title: Ett resurseffektivt samhälle
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a language proficiency test for employees in preschools and schools to ensure they possess adequate Swedish language skills necessary for safe and effective participation in educational activities. The motion emphasizes the importance of language in integrating individuals into the Swedish labor market and the need for clear communication between teachers and students to foster a conducive learning environment.

title: Svenskt fiske och vattenbruk
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament encourages the government to enhance and promote the interest among school students in learning the German language, in recognition of Germany's importance as a significant trade partner for Sweden. The motion expresses concern over the declining interest in German among students and advocates for measures to reverse this trend to foster better trade relations and job growth.

title: Svenska livsmedel
summary: The proposal suggests investigating changes to tax legislation to allow general employee education to be a tax-exempt benefit. The motivation behind this is to overcome existing barriers that hinder Swedish entrepreneurs from developing their staff, due to unclear tax regulations regarding employee training. The motion argues that making such educational programs tax-free would encourage companies to invest in employee development, enhancing overall skills and benefiting the businesses.

title: En skogspolitik för lönsamt brukande och biologisk mångfald
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider enabling companies to repair and sell previously broken products from private individuals in order to increase the level of circular economy and promote recycling. Currently, such products are classified as household waste, which is managed by municipalities, thus the motion calls for a legal review to allow businesses either permanently or through permits to handle these products.

title: Marin miljö och vattenvård
summary: The proposal suggests allowing individuals, other than parents, to open bank accounts for children and young people, with the option to lock the funds until the child turns 18. This aims to enable relatives like grandparents or stepparents to set aside money for a child without requiring parental involvement in the account.

title: En effektiv klimatpolitik
summary: The proposal suggests a comprehensive review of Swedish bureaucracy aimed at reducing processing times and cutting costs by at least 30 percent. It highlights the inefficiencies caused by the proliferation of agencies that often duplicate efforts and calls for mergers or closures of certain bodies to enhance efficiency. The motion argues that reducing bureaucracy is essential for maintaining competitiveness in Sweden and calls for political action to revise regulations to facilitate better coordination among agencies.

title: Kulturarv och miljöer i fädernas bygder
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to support robust measures aimed at curbing crimes committed by animal rights activists and theft gangs threatening the agricultural sector. It highlights the serious risks these activities pose to Swedish animal and food production, emphasizing that the current legal protections for farmers are insufficient and urging the government to take stronger action to ensure the safety and viability of rural businesses.

title: Jakt, viltvård och tradition
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament review and potentially change the regulations governing the food served at accommodations for asylum seekers. It argues that having a uniform food policy for all refugees is unreasonable, particularly in terms of dietary restrictions and cultural preferences, exemplified by the need for allowing pork for Ukrainian refugees who traditionally incorporate it in their diet. The motion calls for government action to ensure that food offerings reflect the diverse needs of various groups of asylum seekers.

title: Det svenska jordbruket
summary: The proposal aims to revise the regulations concerning gun collections in Sweden to facilitate and support the preservation of important cultural heritage. It emphasizes the need for clearer rules regarding the collection, storage, and expansion of weapon collections, as current ambiguities have led collectors to face restrictions or the need to sell or destroy parts of their collections. The motion calls for better support for collectors, who contribute significantly to cultural preservation efforts without compensation.

title: Ett starkare djurskydd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers investigating the potential establishment of a system for taking leave to care for sick parents, similar to the existing system for caring for sick children. This reform aims to support workers, particularly women, who currently face challenges in balancing work and caregiving responsibilities for aging parents, thereby promoting gender equality and a more humane society.

title: Bekämpning av ekoterrorism
summary: The proposal suggests enhancing the status of psychiatry by establishing career pathways specifically for professionals in the field, aimed at increasing retention and attractiveness of psychiatry as a career. It emphasizes the importance of continuous employment in psychiatry to ensure quality patient care and tackles the growing mental health issues, advocating for more research and evidence-based practices within psychiatry.

title: Ökad flexibilitet för egenföretagare
summary: The motion proposes to amend the waiting period for vehicle tax refunds for vehicles in commercial traffic, such as buses, trucks, taxis, and rental vehicles, from 15 days to 4 days. This change aims to help transport sector businesses that have been heavily impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic and are struggling to maintain operations. By reducing the waiting period, the motion seeks to encourage the efficient use of vehicles, reduce administrative burdens, and support companies, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises, in overcoming financial difficulties.

title: Vattenfall AB
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:720 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion asserts that property rights are constitutionally protected and proposes that the government reassess how to strengthen these rights to prevent government agencies from enacting new rules that undermine property ownership. The motion highlights concerns that existing regulations progressively weaken property rights, and calls for the government to ensure that any regulatory changes are carefully evaluated against the principle of property ownership.

title: Utred en avkriminalisering av för sent inlämnade årsredovisningar
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the penalty scale for child pornography crimes, advocating for increased punishments to reflect the severity of these offenses. It highlights the current inadequacies in sentencing, particularly in cases involving significant quantities of abusive material, and calls for more investigators and broader knowledge to combat these crimes effectively.

title: Utred s.k. carry-back inom bolagsskattesystemet
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of educational requirements for personnel working in psychiatry, highlighting the increasing demand for psychiatric care and the current deficiencies in staff knowledge and continuity. It aims to ensure that healthcare professionals have adequate training to improve patient care and address the growing mental health crisis in society.

title: Uppfinningslandet Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to consider the establishment of a language education program specifically tailored for work within LSS (Support and Service for Persons with Certain Functional Impairments) and transportation services. It emphasizes the importance of language skills for effective communication and safety in these roles, particularly for clients who may have difficulty understanding spoken language. By improving language competence among workers, the proposal aims to enhance the quality of service and foster a safer and more competent environment for both service providers and clients.

title: Turism och besöksnäring
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the conditions and possibilities for transferring the responsibility for continuous education of doctors, as some regions are not investing sufficiently in their training. The aim is to ensure that all physicians in Sweden can pursue further education without needing to change their workplace or region.

title: Tillsättande av en industrikommission
summary: The proposal suggests the implementation of a specialized further education program for psychiatric staff, modeled after existing programs for dementia care, in response to increasing mental health challenges in society. It highlights current shortcomings in knowledge and continuity of care among psychiatric personnel, advocating for enhanced training to improve patient treatment and staff retention in the field of psychiatry.

title: Telia Company AB
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:714 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes transferring the responsibility for the oversight and quality control of preschools and educational care from municipalities to the Swedish Schools Inspectorate (Skolinspektionen) to ensure uniform quality assessments across all regions. It also suggests that the Swedish National Agency for Education (Skolverket) should oversee the authorization process for independent preschools. The goal is to achieve a consistent quality control in line with the national curriculum and to mitigate disparities in oversight standards among municipalities.

title: Svenska Spel AB
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:713 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: Mats Green proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing mandatory glycol recycling requirements, highlighting the environmental and economic benefits of a unique recycling method available in Sweden. This method purifies used glycol for reuse, reducing resource waste and environmental harm caused by improper disposal. The proposal aims to align with EU waste management directives, emphasizing prevention, reuse, and material recovery in waste legislation.

title: Svenska institutet
summary: The proposal aims to enhance local decision-making in wildlife management by restoring the previous composition of wildlife management delegations and allowing them to be the highest decision-making body in matters concerning wildlife management. It emphasizes the importance of local representation and criticizes the centralization and disproportionate influence of environmental interests over hunting interests in these delegations, arguing for a balanced approach that reflects the needs and rights of local stakeholders.

title: Stärkta förutsättningar för livsvetenskap
summary: The motion proposes to amend Paragraph 28 of the hunting legislation to enhance the ability of livestock and pet owners to protect their animals from wolf attacks. The motion argues that current regulations give greater rights to wolves than to those whose livestock is threatened, making it unreasonable to wait for an attack before being allowed to take action. The change aims to improve the rights of farmers and pet owners by enabling them to scare off or cull nearby wolves, ultimately fostering a more cautious wolf population in Sweden.

title: Stärkt trygghet för Sveriges butiksägare
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag should review whether the funds from the Wildlife Management Fund should exclusively be used for hunting and wildlife management initiatives, emphasizing that these funds, contributed by hunters through an annual wildlife management fee, should not support any organizations or projects that are contrary to the interests of hunters.

title: Statligt ägande
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:709 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive hydrogen regulatory framework by the Swedish Energy Markets Inspectorate and a clear action plan by the Swedish Energy Agency to ensure sufficient electricity supply for hydrogen production. It emphasizes the importance of hydrogen as a crucial element in Sweden's future energy mix to meet EU carbon reduction targets, particularly in balancing the energy grid and supporting industrial and transport sectors, amid the current challenges of energy supply and regulatory uncertainty.

title: Starta eget-bidrag till yrkesverksamma
summary: The motion proposes allowing individuals to make voluntary additional tax payments to support various government initiatives, enhancing personal freedom in financial contributions. This flexibility would enable citizens to designate additional funds for specific projects, such as infrastructure or healthcare research, and would cater to those wishing to contribute beyond their mandatory taxes.

title: SJ AB
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:707 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion advocates for reducing fuel taxes to support development and opportunities for living and entrepreneurship across Sweden, particularly benefiting residents in rural and sparsely populated areas who rely on cars due to limited public transport options. It argues that high fuel taxes disproportionately impact families and seniors, potentially leading to a divide between urban and rural living conditions. The proposal seeks to enhance the attractiveness of living outside cities by making transportation more affordable for ordinary citizens.

title: Serverhallar - en ny basnäring
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:706 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates the Swedish Board of Agriculture to conduct an annual competitiveness analysis comparing Swedish agriculture with that of other European countries. This initiative is aimed at monitoring the effectiveness of Sweden's food strategy, which seeks to enhance competitiveness and increase food production. The report should identify which agricultural sectors are losing or gaining competitiveness relative to their European counterparts.

title: Regional tillväxt – för ett levande Sverige
summary: This motion proposes the implementation of a tax deduction system (rutavdrag) for vehicle repairs and safety improvements to encourage professional services over unqualified or illegal labor. It aims to increase tax revenues by formalizing the market and enhancing traffic safety by ensuring that vehicles are properly maintained and repaired by skilled professionals.

title: Mindre betungande regler och byråkrati för svenska företag
summary: The motion proposes a review of the possibility to lower and unify the value-added tax (VAT) rates for the tourism industry in Sweden. It argues that the current differing VAT rates create unfair competition and administrative burdens for small tourism businesses, potentially leading to their closure. The proposal emphasizes the need for simpler and clearer tax regulations to promote growth in the tourism sector, decrease tax evasion, and ultimately enhance Sweden's tourism attractiveness.

title: Postnord AB
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:703 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The proposal calls for a review of the regulations governing financial reporting for smaller associations in Sweden, aiming to simplify administrative processes and reduce the burdens faced by volunteers and community organizers. The motion argues that excessive regulations can hinder engagement and threaten the existence of these associations, which play a crucial role in community life, particularly for youth activities. By streamlining requirements, the intention is to foster a more vibrant and functional association environment.

title: Näringspolitikens inriktning
summary: The motion advocates for an investigation into the legal and economic possibilities for individuals to receive compensation for their legal costs when taking action against government authorities. It emphasizes that the right to property is fundamental to democracy and highlights that individuals currently bear the financial burden of legal proceedings against stronger public institutions, undermining trust in the legal system particularly for those with limited resources.

title: Mineralpolitik för en stark gruvnäring
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the idea of integrating entrepreneurship into the curriculum of teacher education programs to enhance the entrepreneurial skills of future teachers. This initiative aims to better equip teachers to guide students in launching their own businesses, thereby contributing to economic growth and job creation in Sweden.

title: Rimliga förutsättningar för landsbygden
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish parliament review the possibility of establishing a high-cost protection for dental care, similar to that already available for healthcare, to ensure that individuals, especially the elderly, do not forgo necessary dental treatments due to financial constraints.

title: Krafttag mot bluffakturor
summary: The proposal calls for a review of the rights to tailored educational forms based on individual support needs stemming from diagnoses such as autism and ADHD. It emphasizes the need for adjusting current regulations to ensure that all students, particularly those with neuropsychiatric diagnoses, have access to appropriate educational settings that meet their unique requirements. The goal is to prevent exclusion and foster an environment where every student can thrive and reach their full potential.

title: Lernia
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:698 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of providing dental care on the same terms as healthcare for the rest of the body. The author argues that teeth are an essential part of the human body and emphasizes the risk of diminished quality of life for individuals unable to afford dental care, which could lead to further health complications. The motion aims to ensure that dental care is treated similarly to other medical care, potentially improving overall quality of life across one's lifespan.

title: Sverige bör införa s.k. end of waste-kriterier för uttjänta däck
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament evaluate ways to reduce costs for businesses when hiring employees, particularly by increasing transparency in employer contributions. It argues that a favorable business climate is crucial for national wealth and innovation, and suggests that reducing hiring costs will enable more jobs, thus supporting social welfare. The motion criticizes the high cost of employer contributions, especially the general payroll tax, and calls for a review to lower these expenses, thereby fostering employment and economic growth.

title: En ny utredning om vad som hände med Raoul Wallenberg
summary: The motion proposes a review of laws and regulations to strengthen the authority of school staff to handle disruptive behavior in Swedish schools. It suggests empowering teachers to act more decisively against students who disturb the learning environment, considering expedited suspension procedures for such students. The motion emphasizes the need for clarity in student responsibilities concerning safety and a conducive learning atmosphere, and advocates for the establishment of 'jourskolor' as facilities to support suspended students until they can return to their regular classes.

title: Återinför tjänstemannaansvaret
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:695 av Kjell-Arne Ottosson och Larry Söder (båda KD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the inclusion of mandatory education in personal finance as part of the curriculum in Swedish primary schools, emphasizing the importance of equipping citizens with essential financial knowledge to better navigate their futures and avoid common pitfalls such as excessive debt.

title: Erkänn Jerusalem som Israels huvudstad
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:694 av Magnus Oscarsson och Mikael Oscarsson (båda KD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support initiatives to ensure a secure electricity supply to Gotland, addressing ongoing power outages that have negatively impacted local businesses and residents. The proposal highlights the need for a robust power infrastructure to prevent costly interruptions and to maintain Gotland's attractiveness for residents and businesses alike. It advocates for an action plan that includes both immediate and long-term measures to enhance energy security, particularly given the island's unique vulnerability due to its distance from the mainland.

title: Hongkong
summary: The motion advocates for clearer guidelines on the implementation of EU directives in Sweden, emphasizing the need to avoid over-implementation. It calls for transparency regarding minimum compliance levels and encourages comparisons with other EU member states' implementations. The authors argue that Sweden should assert its right to interpret directives more freely, considering national circumstances rather than adhering to stricter standards than required by the EU.

title: Förenta nationerna
summary: The suggestion advocates for a review of the regulations surrounding crime victim compensation to emphasize the perspective of crime victims. It proposes that compensation awarded by courts should be paid out through the Crime Victim Authority without requiring victims to take action themselves, addressing the current challenges victims face in accessing the awarded compensation.

title: Fredsprocessen Israel-Palestina
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should review the inclusion of the TBE vaccine in the national vaccination program, particularly in areas severely affected by TBE, such as Skaraborg and parts of the Stockholm archipelago. The rationale is to reduce the economic barriers to vaccination and ultimately prevent severe health issues associated with TBE, thereby lowering long-term sick leave and human suffering.

title: Europeiska unionen
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to improve opportunities for community building education in the Stockholm and Mälardal regions in response to a significant labor shortage in this sector. It highlights the risks of competence deficiency that could arise due to aging workforce and claims that a lack of skilled workers is delaying essential infrastructure projects, costing the economy significantly. The motion advocates for regional training programs to ensure a continued supply of qualified personnel to meet future construction and infrastructure demands.

title: Erkännande av folkmord
summary: The proposal advocates for the allowance of covert property surveillance to enhance safety in response to increasing vandalism and arson incidents in certain areas, including public transport. The motion argues that current regulations hinder effective property protection and suggests that enabling private individuals and security companies to engage in covert monitoring could lead to better outcomes in preventing and addressing such crimes.

title: En svensk Magnitskijlagstiftning
summary: The motion proposes to expand the existing RUT tax deduction to include assistance with transportation services, aiming to create more legitimate jobs and improve the quality of life for urban families by enabling greater access to taxi services. This expansion is expected to generate new job opportunities, particularly for transport needs that current services do not adequately meet, such as flexible travel options for individuals who can no longer drive themselves.

title: Några valfrågor
summary: The proposal advocates for a review and simplification of the regulatory framework and permit processes for building water and fire dams in Sweden. The aim is to enhance fire preparedness by making it easier and more cost-effective for landowners to construct these dams, which are seen as essential for protecting forests, fields, and properties against wildfires. The motion argues that current regulations are overly bureaucratic and expensive, hindering the ability to build necessary infrastructure for fire prevention.

title: Några parlamentariska frågor
summary: This motion proposes a review of the Social Services Act to allow municipalities to request placements under the Care of Young Persons Act (LVU) with the Swedish National Board of Institutional Care (Sis) at an earlier stage, aiming to counteract criminal behavior among youth. The current legislation requires municipalities to exhaust all voluntary measures before seeking such placements. The motion suggests that more proactive measures are necessary to address the increasing number of youths engaging in harmful behavior due to negative influences, including gang recruitment.

title: Några kommunala frågor
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of lifting confidentiality between banks, police, and social services in order to prevent criminal foreign payments. It emphasizes the need for collaboration among these entities to effectively identify and mitigate opportunities for financial support of criminal activities.

title: Granskning och normprövning
summary: The motion proposes to assess the possibility of implementing early mandatory swimming education within physical education classes in elementary schools to reduce drowning incidents. The motion argues that learning to swim should be as fundamental as learning to read and write, and emphasizes that early instruction will enable children to acquire this critical life skill, consequently decreasing the risk of drowning accidents among young individuals.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament investigate the potential for a closer collaboration between the country's hunters, sport shooters, and the military, similar to arrangements in other European countries. This collaboration is seen as a way to enhance national defense capability by utilizing individuals who are experienced in weapon handling and have local knowledge, thereby enabling Sweden to respond more effectively in times of increased readiness.

title: Förvaltningsfrågor
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of employer contribution rates to potentially lower them, aiming to increase job opportunities for young and newly arrived individuals who are currently outside the labor market. It highlights that high employer costs can deter hiring, and emphasizes the need to reduce these expenses to enhance the competitiveness of Swedish companies against foreign firms.

title: Diplomatiska garantier om human behandling
summary: The proposal advocates for the modernization of the 1904 law regarding civil marriage officiants, allowing Swedish civil officiants to perform weddings for Swedish couples in neighboring Nordic countries. It also calls for a review of the conditions and compensation for civil marriage officiants, highlighting the need for timely officiation when couples wish to marry in locations that cross international borders.

title: Återkommande utvärdering av Sveriges arbete med Agenda 2030
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the municipal equalization system in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a review that ensures municipalities are not competing against each other. It suggests that the state should fully compensate municipalities that require assistance without penalizing those that show fiscal responsibility. The motion calls for the removal of equalization contributions from municipalities that do not manage their finances, and encourages a system that promotes job creation and reduces dependency on welfare, aiming for a more equitable distribution of resources while maintaining incentives for growth.

title: Uppsägning av EU–Kuba-avtalet
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should consider implementing a language test to ensure that employees in the care and elderly care sectors possess sufficient Swedish language skills. This measure aims to facilitate effective communication and enhance safety and trust for individuals receiving support and care. The need for such a test is emphasized due to the challenges faced by individuals from non-Swedish speaking backgrounds in integrating into the Swedish job market, particularly in sensitive professions.

title: Republiken Kina (Taiwan)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of preserving small-scale fishing and subsistence fishing along the Skåne coast, calling on the government to ensure that these practices are not prohibited. It highlights the cultural and historical significance of fishing in the region, advocating for a sustainable approach that supports local fishing communities while balancing environmental concerns. The proposal urges the government to direct relevant authorities to revisit previous decisions that may restrict local fishing and to explore new pathways for sustainable fish distribution akin to practices in Denmark, enhancing the local economy and ensuring food security.

title: Säkerhetspolitik
summary: The motion proposes the development of an evidence-based suicide prevention strategy for each region in Sweden, emphasizing the need for conducting inquiries into incidents where children or young people have attempted or committed suicide. The aim is to identify and address any shortcomings in public responsibilities concerning mental health support. Highlighting the significant societal impact and costs associated with suicides, the motion advocates for a more proactive approach in schools, including employing counselors to educate and support students, to prevent such tragedies.

title: Syrien
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to address human rights violations in Tibet during bilateral discussions with China. It calls for the Swedish government to bring attention to the issue of Chinese 'internat schools,' affirm the Tibetan people's right to choose their next Dalai Lama, and highlight violations of Tibetan culture and religion due to Chinese policies. The motion emphasizes the long-standing oppression faced by Tibetans since China's invasion in 1950, including cultural assimilation and religious suppression.

title: Sveriges arbete i Europarådet
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of a competitive Swedish shipping industry for the country's economy, highlighting the sector's critical role in export, import, and tourism. It criticizes the lack of political attention given to shipping, which has led to a decline in the Swedish merchant fleet. The proposal calls for the government to act on the findings of an investigation aimed at enhancing the competitiveness of Swedish shipping, including measures to abolish stamp duty and develop tonnage tax, while drawing inspiration from neighboring countries with more favorable conditions.

title: Stöd för utsatta kvinnor i utrikespolitiken
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the current confidentiality legislation between government agencies to enhance information sharing, thereby increasing efficiency in dealing with issues such as the deportation of individuals living in Sweden without permission. The motion emphasizes that improved coordination between the police, correctional services, and the migration authority is critical for addressing challenges and ensuring public safety while managing taxpayer resources effectively.

title: Somaliland
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament implement systematic controls and guidelines to prevent fraud within assistance compensation programs. Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage emphasizes the threat posed by economic crimes to the welfare system and argues for robust oversight to ensure that resources remain available for legitimate support, while also addressing the need for collaboration between authorities and the use of digital systems for better fraud prevention.

title: Somalia
summary: The motion calls for the Riksdag to support the development of a national strategy and action plan for the education and well-being of particularly gifted students in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for these students to receive proper stimulation and challenges in their learning, similar to the support provided for students with special needs. The motion highlights existing shortcomings in the current system and proposes that Skolverket be tasked with creating this framework, incorporating proven experiences and research to enhance educational practices for gifted students.

title: Ryssland
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider developing a plan to abolish the airline tax, which has faced significant criticism since its introduction. With a majority of responses to the related inquiry being strongly negative, concerns have been raised regarding the tax's calculation methods and its potential negative impact on Sweden's competitiveness and economic growth, particularly in light of new EU regulations.
