The proposal suggests that the government should work on completely phasing out the tax, which generates approximately 1.2 billion SEK annually.

title: Mänskliga rättigheter i utrikespolitiken
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider establishing guidelines for the maximum processing time that the Swedish Tax Agency may have for handling normal estate inventories (bouppteckningar). The current processing times have significantly increased, causing financial strain on estates while they await approval. The author argues that a standardized time limit could lead to more efficient handling of straightforward cases, allowing estates to better manage costs and plan for the sale of properties.

title: Kurdistan och Nineveslätten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the introduction of service guarantees for businesses, aimed at ensuring faster, higher-quality, and more predictable administrative services from government authorities. It emphasizes the need for openness and transparency in licensing and administrative operations, arguing that delays in decision-making by authorities hinder competitiveness and the ability of businesses to grow in Sweden.

title: Kapitalförsörjning och riskkapital
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:668 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government takes several measures to combat illegal labor, including reviewing the Swedish Tax Agency's capacity to fight tax evasion related to illegal work, developing an action plan for tackling illegal labor, reassessing penalties for exploiting illegal labor, and studying how other EU countries have addressed these issues. The authors express concern about the prevalence of tax evasion among unscrupulous businesses, which they argue undermines legitimate enterprises and poses a risk to the integrity of the labor market.

title: Immaterialrättsliga frågor i ett digitalt samhälle
summary: The motion proposed by Sten Bergheden calls for an examination of the possibility for municipalities to be required to provide clearer accounting in their annual reports regarding the allocation of expenses between statutory and voluntary activities. This is aimed at enhancing transparency for taxpayers, allowing them to easily understand how their tax money is spent and how priorities are set within municipal budgets.

title: Hårdare reglering av handel med metallskrot
summary: The proposal suggests a review of the anti-money laundering law to enable individuals, particularly immigrant women, to obtain a bank ID and bank account independently, without the need for family members to verify their identity. The motion argues that current regulations hinder personal freedom by making it difficult to access essential banking services necessary for integration and employment.

title: Export av snus
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the public procurement process to enhance cost-effectiveness and maximize utility from taxpayers' money across various sectors such as healthcare, construction, and public food services. It emphasizes the importance of improving procurement practices to ensure quality and sustainability, while addressing the challenges faced by municipalities and regions in financing welfare services. The proposal also suggests a shift in how intellectual property rights are handled in public procurement, advocating for only the acquisition of usage rights instead of ownership, to foster innovation and avoid hindering future business opportunities.

title: Exponentiella teknologier
summary: The motion proposes a review of the law on public procurement to simplify the process and better achieve its original aims of promoting cost-effective use of taxpayer funds and ensuring competition. Concerns are raised that complex regulations deter bidders and reduce the number of contractors, potentially increasing prices and undermining the law's intent. The proposal emphasizes the need to address excessive appeals that cause delays and extra costs in public procurement.

title: En tillväxtorienterad politik för industrilandet Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:663 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes measures to facilitate employment and housing for young people by introducing mandatory internships in all secondary education programs, enhancing career counseling with a stronger focus on job market relevance, and considering a tax deduction for young individuals saving for their own housing.

title: En hållbar energipolitik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:662 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should support extending the pause on all ongoing review processes concerning small-scale hydropower plants. It argues that Sweden is currently facing an electricity shortage that threatens businesses and jobs, and highlights that reducing production from these hydropower plants would worsen the situation. The motion calls for a review of the consequences of these processes on electricity production before proceeding with any reductions.

title: En handelspolitik för tillväxt
summary: The motion calls for measures to ensure that conditions for independent/private operators in the welfare sector are on par with those of publicly run services. It emphasizes the significant role of these private actors in meeting the growing welfare needs in the Stockholm region and advocates for equal treatment in legislation, funding, and quality criteria to enhance service quality and equitable access for users.

title: Det svenska stålet
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the municipal equalization system in Sweden, emphasizing the need for fair conditions to address issues related to depopulation in rural areas and rapid population growth in urban regions. It argues that the current system inadequately compensates municipalities facing increased costs due to population growth, thus stifling economic growth and leading to inefficiencies in public service funding. The motion calls for a thorough examination of income and cost equalization effects, advocating for a well-structured system that could ultimately allow the state to cover costs while maintaining transparency.

title: Avskaffa kemikalieskatten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the conditions for increasing requirements and prerequisites for starting and conducting debt collection operations, aimed at combating the growing issue of fraudulent invoices affecting businesses and individuals. It highlights the lack of sufficient regulatory standards for debt collection activities compared to other financial operations, leading to an influx of unscrupulous debt collection agencies that exploit the system and perpetrate economic crime, particularly targeting vulnerable small businesses.

title: Åtgärdsprogram för kvinnors trygghet i vardagen
summary: The motion advocates for improved pedagogical competence regarding ADHD, dyslexia, and other neuropsychiatric diagnoses in Swedish schools. It highlights the inadequate support many children with these conditions receive in preschool and primary education, leading to significant knowledge gaps and lost self-esteem by the time they reach high school. The proposal calls for mandatory training in these areas for teachers and preschool educators, ensuring they are equipped to adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of all students, regardless of their educational stage.

title: Mäns våld mot kvinnor och våld i nära relationer
summary: The motion proposes a review of psychiatric care to ensure a secure treatment process that involves collaboration with relatives of patients. It highlights the increasing prevalence of mental health issues among younger individuals and emphasizes the need for better involvement of family members in the care process, including invitation to planning meetings, education, and support for their well-being.

title: Krafttag mot våld och förtryck i hederns namn
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish parliament should consider eliminating the tax on employee meal benefits in order to support the struggling restaurant industry, which has faced significant challenges due to the pandemic and rising costs. The motion argues that reducing this tax burden could help improve customer patronage in restaurants, especially in rural areas, and subsequently lead to the creation of more jobs in the hospitality sector, which often provides entry-level employment for young people and newcomers.

title: Jämställdhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing a clearer burden of proof for adults regarding the legal age of their sexual partners, with the aim of better protecting children from sexual exploitation. It addresses the issue of offenders being acquitted under the pretext of not knowing the age of their victims and suggests that establishing stricter legal standards could help reduce such defenses and subsequently protect more children.

title: Arbetsmiljö
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the cost distribution related to archaeological excavations that are required when private landowners, such as farmers, encounter archaeological finds during construction. The motion argues that the financial burden of archaeological investigations should not fall on individual landowners, as they gain no personal benefit from the findings and often face delays and costs in their own projects.

title: Arbetsmarknad
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to support an initiative to evaluate the possibilities of establishing stockpiles of food supplies while working towards higher self-sufficiency in food production, emphasizing the need for preparedness in crisis situations such as war.

title: Internationellt stöd till utsatta kristna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establishes a minimum population number to ensure a favorable conservation status for wildlife species that threaten agriculture and fisheries, allowing for hunting of surplus animals. The authors highlight increasing damage to farming and fishing industries due to rising populations of certain species and emphasize the need for management changes to protect both wildlife and economic activities.

title: Internationellt demokratiarbete
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews and enhances the country's stockpiles of protective equipment, medications, and medical supplies, citing vulnerabilities exposed during the COVID-19 pandemic and emphasizing the need for improved preparedness for unexpected disasters.

title: Internationellt arbete för en sund djurhållning
summary: The proposal aims to improve the diagnosis and treatment of individuals with ME/CFS (myalgic encephalomyelit/chronic fatigue syndrome) by advocating for better support resources for physicians, integrating knowledge of the condition into medical education, and exploring the establishment of a national competence center dedicated to ME/CFS. The motion highlights the significant suffering and societal costs associated with inadequate support and treatment for affected patients.

title: Internationella militära insatser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the possibility of increasing the study pace in educational programs for occupations facing labor shortages by allowing studies to continue during the summer. This initiative aims to address the skills gap highlighted by the Swedish Business Association and facilitate a quicker transition for students into the workforce, particularly in critical areas such as teaching.

title: Internationell koalition för att granska ledare som bistått Islamiska staten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the implementation of popup training programs in collaboration with universities and colleges to address skill shortages in specific regions. This initiative aims to provide accessible education close to home, encouraging local residents and students to pursue careers in areas with high demand for skilled workers, ultimately improving regional employment and addressing workforce gaps.

title: Ökad nordisk språkförståelse
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the development of digital national tests for primary schools to facilitate efficient and secure grading. It emphasizes the importance of having a standardized national assessment to track knowledge results among students over time, while addressing the current heavy workload on teachers during testing periods. The aim is to modernize the testing system by incorporating digital elements to streamline the grading process and allow teachers to focus more on direct instruction.

title: Nordens hus i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should review the possibility of enhancing the school's curriculum to include more practical skills training, aimed at better preparing students for real-world challenges they face after completing their education.

title: Åtgärder mot unga lagöverträdare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers amending the Education Act to grant children and youth with severe visual impairments the right to braille education. The rationale behind the motion is that braille allows visually impaired individuals to access written information and participate fully in society. Currently, rights to braille are not included in the Education Act, which limits educational opportunities for these children compared to their peers with different native languages.

title: Sveriges vapenlagstiftning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider alternatives for marginalized youth who are at risk of engaging in criminal behavior and dropping out of school. It suggests allowing these individuals to gain work experience instead of being sent to institutions or alternative educational settings. The proposal emphasizes the importance of practical learning through work placements to enhance skills and reduce the likelihood of youth involvement in crime and drugs.

title: Tullfrågor
summary: The suggestion advocates for Sweden to support Taiwan's increased participation in international organizations, recognizing Taiwan's unique political status and its contributions to global commerce. It calls for Sweden to promote Taiwan's inclusion as an observer in critical organizations like WHO and to push for its broader involvement in international collaborations, emphasizing the importance of Taiwan in addressing transnational issues such as conflict resolution and climate change.

title: Terrorism
summary: The motion proposes a review of Sweden's foreign aid payments, suggesting that costs incurred due to migrants unable to return to their home countries should be deducted from the aid provided to those countries. The aim is to increase transparency and accountability in the aid system and address the financial burden on Sweden from unexecuted deportation orders.

title: Straffrättsliga frågor
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should review the implementation of a grading system focusing on responsibility, order, and discipline for older students in schools. This system aims to provide a clearer assessment of students' ability to manage their education and responsibilities outside of school, benefiting students, parents, and future employers by offering insights into students' behavior and work readiness.

title: Processrättsliga frågor
summary: The motion calls for a review of relocation taxes in Sweden, advocating for their reduction to enhance mobility in the housing market and stimulate economic growth. It argues that high relocation taxes, including capital gains tax and stamp duty, restrict individuals from moving, particularly affecting younger and older populations. The proposal suggests that lowering or eliminating these taxes could facilitate better housing choices, alleviate loneliness, and improve labor market matching, ultimately leading to increased growth and reduced emissions.

title: Polisfrågor
summary: The proposal suggests that Swedish government officials be allowed to sign decisions using their service number instead of their name to enhance security and confidentiality. This change aims to protect officials from potential reprisals related to their decisions, especially in cases involving organized crime. The author argues that current practices expose officials to threats and that the proposed method would maintain legal integrity while safeguarding the personal safety of those tasked with enforcing government decisions.

title: Kriminalvårdsfrågor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers the possibility of incorporating education into youth sentencing, emphasizing that education can reduce recidivism among young offenders. It suggests that sentences should be tailored to individual needs and capacities, ensuring that young individuals are challenged and motivated to complete their education before being released. The proposal reflects the belief that providing education and proper guidance is crucial for enabling young offenders to lead lawful lives post-incarceration.

title: En effektiv lag om särskild utlänningskontroll
summary: The motion submitted by Helena Storckenfeldt advocates for a parliamentary investigation into the possibility of allowing licensed firearm owners to store their weapons in the secure cabinets of others, particularly when they move for education or work. Current laws require weapons to be stored at the owner's registered address, which can create logistical challenges and risks during transport. The proposal aims to reduce unnecessary bureaucracy while ensuring weapons are stored safely.

title: Straffrabatt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review the possibilities for legalizing active euthanasia in Sweden, advocating for the right of individuals with terminal illnesses to choose to end their lives on their own terms. It argues that the current legal restrictions, which only allow passive euthanasia, can lead to prolonged suffering and that the state should facilitate safe and legal processes for those who are suffering and have no hope for recovery.

title: Framtidssäkring av det svenska vägnätet
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of an implementation council that evaluates the consequences of new EU legislation on Swedish businesses. It highlights concerns about Sweden over-implementing EU laws compared to other countries, potentially harming competitiveness and jobs. The council would conduct thorough analyses to ensure Swedish companies do not face harsher impacts than their EU counterparts.

title: Ett tryggt Sverige fritt från brott och extremism
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should evaluate the effectiveness and application of the access ban legislation introduced in 2021. It highlights the challenges traders face due to increasing theft and harassment, particularly in regions like Örebro and Södermanland. The motion aims to facilitate an increase in the number of approved access bans to better protect retailers and their employees from crime, suggesting that the current law is underutilized and requires review to enhance the security and viability of retail businesses.

title: Flaggning av adresser för ambulans
summary: The motion proposes a review of tax legislation concerning sports sponsorship in order to establish a gender-neutral system. It addresses the existing valuation practices that disadvantage women's sports by linking sponsorship deductions to market value, which is often lower for female sports due to fewer spectators. The current guidelines create inequalities that undermine sponsorship opportunities for women's sports and perpetuate outdated structures in athletics.

title: Politiskt tillsatta nämndemän
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports measures to enhance the opportunities for political youth organizations to engage with high school students. It emphasizes the importance of fostering democratic values among the younger generation and notes that disparities exist in how schools allow political youth organizations to interact with students. The motion argues for equitable access to political engagement opportunities in schools to strengthen democracy in a polarized society.

title: Utvärdera den svenska missbrukspolitiken
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:631 av Niels Paarup-Petersen och Alireza Akhondi (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the teacher education program in Sweden by increasing practical training elements, aiming to better prepare future teachers and reduce dropout rates during training. The intent is to ensure that newly qualified teachers are equipped with real-world experience, which will improve educational outcomes for students and address the ongoing shortage of skilled teachers.

title: Receptfria naloxonläkemedel
summary: The motion proposes a review of access to digital communication for children and adolescents placed in housing for care (HVB) or youth homes (Sis) in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a balance between protection and normalcy. The author argues that mobile phone and internet restrictions during the initial treatment phase, aimed at safeguarding youth from destructive influences, should be reconsidered. The proposal highlights the importance of enabling digital access as the treatment progresses, while ensuring that care institutions can implement tailored restrictions based on individual assessments to protect vulnerable youth.

title: Utred gråzoner i livets slutskede inklusive dödshjälp
summary: The proposal suggests replacing the current requirement for hotel permits with a simpler notification obligation, allowing hotel owners to register digitally rather than waiting for an approval process, which consequently aims to reduce administrative burdens and improve police resource allocation for crime fighting.

title: Kinas ökande makt
summary: The proposal advocates for prioritizing research into the beneficial effects of physical and social activities on mental health, aiming to reduce reliance on psychiatric medication. It highlights the rise in mental health issues exacerbated by the pandemic, particularly among the youth and elderly. The motion suggests that promoting activities rather than medication could enhance recovery and overall well-being.

title: Cirkulära livsmedelssystem
summary: This motion proposes the creation of a register for DNA samples taken during investigations to enhance the resolution of crimes. The current practice does not retain results from DNA testing, limiting its use to individual cases. The motion argues that a comprehensive database could facilitate faster crime-solving and address concerns about unpunished offenses by minors under 15 years, who often evade the criminal justice system.

title: Stärkta möjligheter för medarbetarägda och kooperativa företag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:626 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The proposal seeks to enable non-Swedish citizens convicted of crimes in Sweden to be expelled to their home countries to serve their sentences, in response to the increasing crime rates and the lack of capacity within the Swedish correctional system.

title: Förbättrade villkor för energikooperativ
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:625 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the establishment of a regulatory framework that would deny Swedish support to individuals who actively participate in wars abroad without being officially deployed by Sweden. It argues that those who voluntarily choose to engage in conflicts should be responsible for their own return to Sweden and should not expect assistance from the Swedish state.

title: Friskvårdsbidraget måste gälla för alla företagsformer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:624 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognizes the seriousness of all quantity crimes and requests the government to take this issue more seriously. The motivation highlights the increasing violence and threats faced by retail employees, particularly impacting recruitment in the trade sector, which plays a crucial role in the economy. With a significant portion of the workforce employed in retail, and considering the high rates of crime reported in stores, the motion emphasizes the need for better investigation and prosecution of these crimes to create safer working environments.

title: Åtgärder och policy för bättre myndighets- och bolagsdialog med allmänheten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:623 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers the possibility of implementing language requirements for personnel in healthcare and elderly care to ensure that all staff possess sufficient Swedish language skills. This is aimed at enhancing patient and client safety through better communication, both verbal and written. The motion highlights current issues with inadequate language skills among staff and suggests that clear, national language standards be established to ensure consistent requirements across the country.

title: Fördelningssystem för bättre balans mellan utbildning och forskning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:622 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The suggestion advocates for expanding the Swedish vaccination program to include a vaccine for tick-borne encephalitis (TBE), particularly in regions heavily affected by ticks that pose health risks, such as Sörmland. The proposal highlights the need to prevent serious illnesses through increased vaccination rates, especially among young children, and calls for the government to explore financing models that would support this implementation nationwide.

title: Egenanställning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:621 av Solveig Zander och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a unified medical records system in Sweden to facilitate patient care across different regions. It argues that the current fragmented systems hinder timely and efficient healthcare delivery, especially for patients requiring continuous treatment, such as pregnant women and cancer patients. By creating a centralized system that patients can control and access through digital means, the proposal aims to improve the quality of care while reducing unnecessary costs associated with administrative inefficiencies.

title: Integritetsbalk
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support the review of the possibility to expand the E4 highway between Söderhamn and Gävle to a four-lane standard in order to reduce traffic disruptions and enhance the transportation logistics for both goods and individuals in the region. It highlights the current limitations of the two-plus-one road structure which negatively affects emergency services and causes congestion, especially during peak travel times. The motion emphasizes that an incremental expansion prioritizing the Tönnebro-Gävle section would significantly benefit the area and requests the government to consider this proposal urgently.

title: Kvinnors företagande
summary: The motion proposes that the government review measures to allow rural and sparsely populated regions, particularly those north of the Dalälven, to retain a greater share of the value generated from their local industries and resources. The author argues that these regions play a crucial role in Sweden's economy, providing essential resources like electricity, forestry, and agriculture. The current economic policies and tax equalization systems favor urban areas, limiting the financial benefits that rural regions receive from their production. The suggestion is for the government to act in a way that acknowledges and supports the economic contributions of these regions.

title: Öka välbefinnandet - inför stöd till gemensamhetslokal i nybyggda seniorhus
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the general beach protection laws in Sweden, suggesting that the rules should vary in strictness depending on the region. It argues that the current framework hinders residential and developmental opportunities in less populated areas while still ensuring public access to coastal regions, particularly in densely populated cities. The proposal calls for new legislation that recognizes different local conditions and allows for more flexibility in property rights and development possibilities.

title: Underlätta för företag att lämna in årsredovisningar i tid
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of farm sales of alcoholic beverages in Sweden, highlighting the long-standing discussions and previous studies, including a 2021 report that analyzed the legal framework around this issue. The proponents argue that allowing such sales would support local producers, enhance tourism, reduce unnecessary transportation costs, and align Sweden with practices common in other EU countries. The motion emphasizes the potential economic benefits for local businesses, particularly in regions with a strong presence of wineries and microbreweries, notably in Skåne, and calls for swift implementation.

title: Inför en obligatorisk MAR i hälso- och sjukvårdslagen
summary: The motion proposes allowing public hunting of cormorants in Sweden as a measure to address their rapid population growth, which is adversely affecting coastal and archipelago areas, particularly in Gävleborg County. It emphasizes that the cormorant's presence is detrimental to fishing, tourism, and local ecosystems, advocating for more proactive measures in addition to hunting to alleviate the negative impacts of this invasive species.

title: Gårdsförsäljning nu
summary: The motion proposes revised calculation bases for infrastructure funding to ensure better support for road maintenance, particularly in regions like Jämtlands län, which relies heavily on industries such as forestry, agriculture, and tourism. It argues that current metrics, which primarily consider population size, do not adequately reflect the unique transportation needs driven by seasonal tourism and local economies, and calls for greater consideration of these factors in future funding allocations by the government.

title: Svenskt medborgarskap har stupstock vid 22 års ålder
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews and modifies the support and tax conditions for the country's mountain rescue volunteers. It suggests implementing investment support for the necessary equipment such as snowmobiles and all-terrain vehicles, and introduces financial assistance for reconnaissance trips essential for training and preparedness. The aim is to alleviate the economic burden on mountain rescuers, ensuring they can afford the necessary investments and continue their crucial work.

title: Treterminssystem i skolan
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish parliament to review and strengthen efforts to promote sports among newly arrived immigrants. It emphasizes the social benefits of sports such as improved public health, reduced youth criminality, and enhanced community integration. The proposal highlights how involvement in local sports clubs provides social connections, cultural understanding, language practice, and identity development for immigrants, particularly unaccompanied refugee minors, and calls for increased support for organizations that assist in integration through sports.

title: Sverige behöver fler djurskötare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports increasing police presence in rural areas to enhance public safety and crime prevention. It emphasizes the importance of accessible police services, especially in remote regions where distances can delay response times. The motion highlights the growing concern over police attrition and calls for better allocation of police resources to effectively address criminal activities, ensuring that rural residents feel as secure as those in urban areas.

title: Rätten att avsluta sitt liv vid svåra lidanden i livets slutskede
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support efforts to shorten the processing times at Lantmäteriet, the agency responsible for property division and regulation, which currently has processing times of nearly a year. The proposal highlights the severe housing shortage in Sweden and suggests that reducing these times would facilitate new construction. It also recommends an examination into introducing competition within Lantmäteriet's services to enhance efficiency and proposes legislative measures to align Lantmäteriet's processing times with those mandated for municipal planning and construction permits.

title: Stärka och säkra förbindelserna E4 och E20 genom Södertälje
summary: The motion proposes strengthening student health services in Sweden to address increasing physical inactivity among youth, which is linked to obesity, metabolic diseases, and mental health issues. It emphasizes the importance of daily physical activity and the inclusion of all children in sports and leisure activities, regardless of background or ability. The proposal advocates for the involvement of physiotherapists in student health services to promote physical development and enhance both students' and teachers' well-being.

title: Kameraövervakning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:609 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should review how revenues from hydropower production can be distributed to the municipalities and regions where it occurs, emphasizing the importance of hydropower in Sweden's energy system and advocating for a compensation system similar to that in Norway. The motion highlights the disparity in current funding, noting that Swedish municipalities only receive a fraction of what their Norwegian counterparts obtain, despite significant contributions to the national economy and welfare from these areas.

title: Bättre kontroll av nödbelysning i allmänna lokaler
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:608 av Per Schöldberg och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider legislation to mandate the installation of alarm gates or metal detectors at emergency and psychiatric care facilities. The aim is to enhance safety for patients and staff by preventing weapons and dangerous items from entering health care locations, thereby addressing concerns related to threats and violence in society, including terrorism.

title: Åtgärder för bättre balansering av sälstammen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider lowering the VAT on cinema tickets and amusement parks back to the original rate of 6% from the current 25%, as the previous increase has significantly raised costs for families. The aim is to make these recreational activities more accessible to the public and to stimulate the production of Swedish films by increasing attendance.

title: Gårdsförsäljning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:606 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes an expansion of the E4 highway between Gävle and Sundsvall to improve traffic flow, enhance safety, and boost the attractiveness of Norrland for economic growth and commuting. It emphasizes the necessity of including this expansion in the national infrastructure plan to establish a reliable transport link from northern to southern Sweden.

title: Åtgärder för balansering av vildsvinsstammen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:605 av Per Schöldberg och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider expanding the operations of the Plikt- och prövningsverket to northern Sweden to facilitate and increase interest in applying for police education and military service. Currently, the organization's main office is located in Karlstad, with testing offices only in southern cities, making it difficult for individuals in northern Sweden to access these services due to long travel distances.

title: Avskaffande av public service i dess nuvarande form
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should instruct the government to consider changing the threshold level for parties to gain representation in municipal councils. The authors argue that the current dual threshold system creates confusion and suggest aligning the municipal threshold with that of regional councils at three percent, regardless of the number of electoral districts in the municipality. This change aims to simplify the electoral system and eliminate incentives for manipulating electoral districts.

title: Utvisning av dömda brottslingar trots avsaknad av utvisningsdom
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should evaluate the possibility of implementing an Amber Alert system in Sweden, aiming to enhance public safety by quickly disseminating urgent messages in cases of child abduction or disappearance, similar to the existing system in the USA which has proven effective in locating missing children.

title: Åtgärder för rättsväsendet
summary: The proposal suggests strengthening legislation to better protect service dogs and service horses used by authorities, highlighting that current legal protections are insufficient. It emphasizes the need for laws that specifically address and prevent violence against these service animals to enhance their safety and effectiveness in police duties.

title: Åtgärder mot institutionaliserad korruption
summary: The motion proposes that the government should consider allowing payment of fines for public order offenses via Swish, a widely used mobile payment solution in Sweden. This would facilitate immediate payment by including a QR code for Swish on the fines issued by the police.

title: Öresundsmetron – en klimatsmart investering
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:600 av Patrick Reslow och Jörgen Grubb (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should explore the possibility of expanding operations at the Gävle prison, emphasizing the need for increased capacity due to anticipated demand in the prison system. This expansion is seen as a way to utilize available land adjacent to the existing facility and is also expected to create jobs in the surrounding community.

title: Erkännande av Somaliland som självständig stat
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:599 av Ingemar Kihlström och Magnus Oscarsson (båda KD)
summary: The motion proposes that the responsibility for emergency services be transferred from municipalities to regions in Sweden. The authors argue that smaller municipalities struggle to provide adequate emergency services and that integrating these services at the regional level could yield operational efficiencies and better coordination, especially between emergency services such as fire and ambulance. The motion also calls for ensuring fire stations remain accessible in smaller towns.

title: Höjd åldersgräns för kirurgiska ingrepp och hormonbehandling vid könsdysfori
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support a consideration for establishing a military regiment in Gävleborg County, highlighting the region's historical association with military education and operations. The proposal emphasizes the ongoing security threats to Sweden and suggests that a regiment could enhance coastal defense by utilizing the strengths of the cities Gävle, Söderhamn, and Hudiksvall, while leaving the specific type of regiment to be determined by the government.

title: Samarbetet i Norden och Baltikum
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support an investigation into a legislative change that would grant public sector employees the right to full-time work, addressing the issue of involuntary part-time employment. It highlights the negative impact of part-time jobs on wages, career opportunities, and future pensions, particularly emphasizing the implications for gender equality as the majority of part-time workers are women. The motion calls for government action in response to the lack of progress in collective bargaining efforts regarding this issue.

title: Motionsrätten på extra ändringsbudgetar
summary: The proposal advocates for the rehabilitation of the Inlandsbanan railway to enhance conditions for increased business and job creation in Northern Sweden. It emphasizes the need for improved infrastructure, particularly in light of the existing challenges posed by under-maintained railways in the region. The suggestion points out that upgrading Inlandsbanan is crucial for ensuring sustainable transport systems, supporting local industries, and fostering regional development in Norrland. It also calls for collaboration between Trafikverket and the business sector to assess the potential for upgrades.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:6 Ändrade bestämmelser om fotografier och fingeravtryck i SIS II-regelverket
summary: This motion calls for the Swedish parliament to review the governance of specialized healthcare in Sweden, highlighting the challenges faced by the healthcare system, including rapid medical advancements and rising medication costs. The author, Saila Quicklund, argues that there is increasing inequality in healthcare access among citizens due to varying regional funding capacities. She advocates for a national approach to ensure equitable healthcare services for all, regardless of their place of residence.

title: Valobservatörer i valet 2022
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:594 av Sven-Olof Sällström och Björn Söder (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes several measures to improve the regulation of dietary supplements in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a centralized oversight by the Swedish Food Agency to prevent dangerous substances in these products. It recommends requirements for manufacturers and distributors to report their products before marketing, the ability for the agency to impose sales bans, and better utilization of existing pharmaceutical laws to classify harmful substances. Additionally, it suggests the Public Health Agency address harmful substances in supplements and supports targeted educational initiatives for young athletes about the risks associated with such products.

title: Förändra regelverk samt förordningar så att myndigheters försäljning av personuppgifter begränsas
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of Swedish food craftsmanship and calls for clearer directives to regional authorities and county boards to support this sector. It highlights the tradition and significance of food tourism in regions like Jämtland and advocates for maintaining high agricultural standards within the EU framework. The proposal references past government efforts to elevate Sweden's reputation as a food nation and stresses the need for collaboration among food producers, authorities, and stakeholders to enhance local food production.

title: ROT-avdrag för den ideella sektorn
summary: The motion addresses the issue of illegal taxi operations, commonly known as 'black taxi' services, and their negative impact on public trust and the legal taxi industry. It calls on the Swedish parliament to propose measures to combat illegal taxi services, particularly those promoted through social media. The motion highlights the significant tax losses incurred due to illegal operations, the safety risks associated with unregulated rides, and the detrimental effects on the legal taxi sector and public transportation availability, especially in rural areas.

title: Västra stambanan
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:591 av Ulrika Heie och Annika Qarlsson (båda C)
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for improved cash handling and payment services in rural areas of Sweden, highlighting the challenges faced by certain demographics, including the elderly and small cash-dependent businesses. It calls for the government to revise the payment services law to better accommodate these needs, especially considering the rapid digitalization of the market which has exacerbated access issues.

title: Förutsägbara regler för beräkning av den sjukpenninggrundande inkomsten för enskilda näringsidkare
summary: The motion proposes to limit and clarify the geographical areas designated as national interests under the Swedish Environmental Code, arguing that the current designation of approximately 46% hinders housing development and business establishment in rural areas. The author expresses concern that an expansion of these areas would further restrict rural development opportunities, advocating for a revision to better define these interests to facilitate growth in these regions.

title: Rapportering till Skatteverket
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the initiative to invest more in the Dalabanan railway to improve transportation accessibility in Dalarna, which is the fourth largest county in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of decent infrastructure for a growing export industry and tourism, stating that the current limitations hinder access to jobs and resources. The proposal aims to raise the capacity and reliability of Dalabanan to facilitate sustainable growth in the region and strengthen connections between Dalarna and the rapidly developing Mälar- and Stockholm region, benefiting the entire Swedish economy.

title: Snabbare hantering av tillståndsärenden hos myndigheter och domstolar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate a collaborative effort between the government and sports organizations to combat unhealthy body ideals that negatively impact young people. The motion highlights the media's role in promoting unrealistic standards and the resulting pressure on youth, which can lead to harm such as substance abuse, illness, and self-harm.

title: Minskat regelkrångel för besöksnäringen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament reviews the regulation of supervision costs for service industries, particularly in rural areas and for unmanned stores, to ensure they are not disproportionately disadvantaged compared to larger retailers. It argues that the current cost structure is unreasonable and should be differentiated to support the survival of local businesses amidst growing competition from shopping centers.

title: Komplettera skolidrott med pulsträning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament encourages the government to enhance the promotion of entrepreneurship within the primary school curriculum. It emphasizes the need for entrepreneurship to be integrated throughout the education system, particularly by fostering collaboration with the local business community and engaging students with practical experiences. The aim is to cultivate an entrepreneurial mindset in students that will benefit them in various aspects of life, regardless of whether they start their own businesses or enter the workforce.

title: Barn som bevittnat våld ska betraktas som brottsoffer
summary: The motion proposes to increase physical activity and sports at after-school programs (fritidshem) in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of physical activity for improved student performance across all subjects. It calls for enhanced collaboration between after-school programs and sports associations to ensure that all children and youth can participate in sports, especially those who lack a connection to organized club sports.

title: Ge studenter en tryggare studietid
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the idea of providing childcare during inconvenient working hours, emphasizing its importance for facilitating parental employment and preparing children for schooling. It argues for increased municipal autonomy to address the varying needs of different communities, highlighting that right-leaning municipalities offer such childcare more frequently than left-leaning ones. The motion stresses that accessible childcare is a significant reform for women's freedom and employment, noting Sweden's high female employment rate but insisting on further improvements to ensure parents are not forced to reduce working hours due to inadequate childcare availability. It advocates for a review of municipal capabilities to offer childcare during inconvenient hours, with a focus on gender equality.

title: Rättvisa taxor för vatten och avlopp
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:583 av Sofia Nilsson och Stina Larsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for the expansion of the Ostkustbanan railway to a double-track system, emphasizing its necessity due to high traffic on the existing single-track line. It highlights the economic benefits, asserting that this expansion would significantly enhance transportation efficiency between Sundsvall and Stockholm, facilitate freight traffic, and yield an estimated net societal benefit of 13 billion kronor after accounting for various costs. The proposal urges the government to recognize this project as a vital investment for national infrastructure.

title: Jordbrukets benämning i miljöbalken
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:582 av Sofia Nilsson och Stina Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion advocates for an increased police presence in rural and less populated areas of Sweden, addressing concerns about the lack of local policing which leads to safety issues and delays in emergency response. It emphasizes that all citizens, regardless of their location, should feel secure in the state's provision of essential services. The motion calls for prioritizing police deployment in these regions to uphold the societal contract.

title: Snabbare hantering av tillståndsärenden hos myndigheter och domstolar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:581 av Sofia Nilsson och Per Åsling (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes significant improvements to the infrastructure at and around Arlanda Airport in Sweden to enhance transportation reliability, accessibility, and capacity. It emphasizes the importance of a well-functioning transport system for national and international connectivity, suggesting that the government task Swedavia with preparing for an increase in taxi and runway capacity, along with exploring enhancements to the road and rail infrastructure leading to the airport. Additionally, it calls for the monitoring of commercial flight routes that are vital for society and the negotiation for reduced fees for non-A-Train travelers to promote sustainable transport options.

title: Förbättra trygghetssystemet
summary: The proposal aims to consider investigating a new model for scrutinizing the budget proposals of political parties in the Swedish Parliament. It argues that while the financial framework has been beneficial, the scrutiny of opposition parties' economic policies is lacking, leading to potential risks if unfinanced reforms are proposed. The motion suggests emulating the Dutch model where all parties' budgets are reviewed by a responsible authority, such as the Economic Institute, to enhance credibility and stability in Swedish economic policy.

title: Ålfiske
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support the idea of instructing the Swedish Tax Agency to enhance public awareness regarding the positive effects of the job tax deduction on employment and the size of employer contributions to taxes. The authors argue that better information regarding job tax deductions could increase employment rates by emphasizing their financial benefits, while greater transparency about employer contributions could improve public understanding of tax burdens, thereby fostering democracy.

title: Svenska djurskyddsregler som krav
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports measures to enhance both military and civilian defense on Gotland due to escalating security threats in Europe, including Russia's aggression in Ukraine. It emphasizes the importance of strengthening Gotland's military presence, infrastructure, and cooperation with NATO and Nordic countries to address modern security challenges, while ensuring redundancy in transport systems and preparing for potential future crises.

title: Utveckla studenthälsan
summary: The motion proposes a review of the Swedish Constitution to allow the government to make quicker decisions regarding the evacuation of Swedish citizens in danger abroad, based on the recent evacuation from Sudan which highlighted the need for a more efficient political process in emergency situations. The authors argue for a re-evaluation of whether the government should always require parliamentary approval in such urgent circumstances.

title: Byggnation på landsbygden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:576 av Mikael Larsson och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should evaluate selling several state-owned companies including Vasallen AB, Svevia AB, Statens Bostadsfinansieringsaktiebolag (SBAB), Aktiebolaget Svensk Bilprovning, and its stake in Sweden House. The authors argue that the state should limit its involvement in private markets where there are no compelling reasons for state ownership, due to risks related to monopolistic and oligopolistic situations. They suggest that the government investigate the appropriateness and timing of these sales, as the state presence in these sectors may no longer be justified.

title: Reformerat lantmäteri
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examines the need for a dedicated policy for the islands of Sweden, emphasizing the importance of sustainable development, conservation of biodiversity, and addressing the unique challenges faced by island communities, particularly in areas like healthcare and infrastructure. The motion highlights the example of Gotland, where specific regional conditions necessitate tailored strategies for welfare and public services.

title: Näringstillförsel i skogen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:574 av Anders Åkesson och Per Schöldberg (båda C)
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to establish a national water strategy in light of increasing water scarcity in Europe and recent extreme weather events that have affected Sweden. The proposal emphasizes the need for better guidance for municipalities in managing their water supply systems, which are currently inadequate for modern demands. A national strategy aims to enhance the resilience and preparedness of the country's water management in response to both drought and heavy rainfall.

title: Bygg mer på gamla detaljplaner
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:573 av Peter Helander och Per Schöldberg (båda C)
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider transforming SOS Alarm into an authority specifically responsible for emergency services. The motion argues that SOS Alarm has deteriorated in its effectiveness due to the loss of its emergency alert functions in various regions, which has led to dissatisfaction among local emergency services. The author advocates for re-establishing SOS Alarm's focus on emergency management and improving response times, while also integrating military and civil defense aspects.

title: Regelförenkling inom besöksnäringen
summary: The proposal by Thomas Ragnarsson seeks to investigate ways to increase personnel availability in volunteer organizations in Sweden, particularly in the context of war and heightened preparedness. It emphasizes the critical role of these organizations, such as local fire brigades and the Swedish Sea Rescue Society, in national emergency response, highlighting concerns that their volunteer personnel are being assigned elsewhere, which could compromise their operational capacity in times of crisis.

title: Vägskyltning vid allmänna vägar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:571 av Ulrika Heie och Fredrik Christensson (båda C)
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to instruct the Post and Telecom Authority to ensure mobile coverage is maintained throughout the country, especially during the transition from older mobile networks to newer ones. It highlights the increasing issue of diminished mobile connectivity, particularly in rural areas, as older networks are phased out while newer technologies are not fully implemented. This lack of reliable communication is seen as a critical concern for both emergency preparedness and rural development.

title: Mer solenergi
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:570 av Martina Johansson och Annika Qarlsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the development of a dual carriageway on the European route E4 through Gävleborg to enhance transportation infrastructure, which is deemed essential for the industrial and logistical needs of the region. The aim is to improve transport efficiency for both local workers and businesses by integrating various transport modes, ensuring that Gävleborg remains a critical transport hub that connects northern industries with southern Sweden and beyond.

title: Räntetak för effektiv ränta gentemot låntagare
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a new mandatory law that would strengthen the ability of social services to intervene in situations involving children and youth by requiring parents to undergo treatment and support, rather than allowing these interventions to remain voluntary. The aim is to ensure that children are not left in unsafe environments due to the inadequacies of their guardians, promoting better outcomes for their development and well-being.

title: Ta bort onödig administration i vården
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports planning for a train stop at Hagsta along the Ostkustbanan in the upcoming infrastructure plan. This initiative aims to improve transportation links within Gävleborg and the rest of Sweden, especially as the region plans for new railway developments and double tracks between Gävle and Sundsvall. Despite rising costs, proponents argue that a train stop in Hagsta is crucial for reducing fossil fuel emissions by promoting rail travel over car use for local commuters.

title: Modernisera regelverket för uppkörning på motorcykel
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider reintroducing a structured education program for company doctors to address the significant shortage of professionals in this field, as nearly 900 out of 1,100 company doctors are over 65 years old. The lack of a defined educational pathway has led to inadequate training, which is primarily reliant on private companies. The motion advocates for legislative action to ensure a sufficient number of company doctors are trained annually and discusses potential state funding for this education to strengthen the capacity of occupational health services.

title: Gör E6 genom Skåne sexfilig
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider implementing a loan forgiveness program for student loans for individuals working in essential services in rural areas. It emphasizes the importance of ensuring access to education, healthcare, and care services outside urban centers, and aims to attract more professionals to these regions by offering financial incentives through gradual loan forgiveness based on continued service in these vital roles.

title: Ny trafikplats vid Boråstorpet på riksväg 40
summary: The motion proposes that the government should consider legislative changes to ensure that municipalities and private preschool operators are not allowed to charge fees for preschool services during the summer months when the preschools are closed. The authors argue that it is unreasonable for parents to pay full fees when the service is unavailable, even though some operational costs may remain.

title: Viltets ökning i Kalmar län
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:564 av Anne Oskarsson och Mattias Bäckström Johansson (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the investigation of legal changes to enable drug testing in schools to combat drug abuse among youth. It emphasizes the need to address the significant drug issues in society, suggesting that early detection and intervention through drug testing can prevent negative outcomes such as accidents, early death, and criminality. The motion argues that by implementing drug tests, there could be a cultural shift that encourages students to avoid drug use, as well as potential economic savings for municipalities burdened by costs associated with drug-related issues.

title: Äldres rätt till ett värdigt, respektfullt bemötande och rätten till den egna kroppen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider making education about the VMA system (important message to the public) mandatory and recurring for students in primary and secondary schools. The aim is to enhance public awareness of this emergency notification system, especially in light of increased security concerns following the conflict in Ukraine, thereby strengthening national preparedness for serious incidents.

title: Trafiksäkerheten på Ölandsbron
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:562 av Anne Oskarsson och Mattias Bäckström Johansson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a digital high-cost protection service within the healthcare system in Sweden. It aims to facilitate citizens' access to their healthcare expenses by allowing them to register visits digitally, preferably through the 1177 service, while maintaining the option for traditional paper-based high-cost protection. The motion also calls for the government to initiate an investigation into the implementation of a unified digital system and to suggest any necessary legal changes.

title: Sfi - uttalets betydelse för språkinlärning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider instructing Trafikverket to implement announcements in English and/or German at train stations during the summer months of June, July, and August to assist foreign travelers. Historically, such multilingual announcements were made to aid international passengers, and the motion suggests that this could alleviate navigation difficulties for the increasing number of tourists during the summer season.

title: Hjärnskador vid ECT-behandling
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish government should consider introducing legislation to create 'rescue corridors' on roads to improve accessibility for emergency vehicles in the event of accidents. The proposal would require drivers to move their vehicles to the sides of the road during incidents, thereby creating a clear lane for rescue operations, similar to practices in Germany. This change aims to enhance emergency responses and address increasing traffic volumes.

title: Rekommendationer gällande adhd-medicin
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider lowering the age for obtaining a driver's license for passenger cars from 18 to 17 years, citing safety concerns related to slower vehicles on the roads. It suggests that allowing younger individuals to drive could improve traffic safety by reducing dangerous overtaking maneuvers and encourages the government to explore options analogous to existing regulations for moped and motorcycle licenses.

title: Översyn av Polishögskolans antagningskrav vid neuropsykiatrisk diagnos
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of requiring bus drivers to display their identification to passengers, similar to existing regulations for taxi drivers. The goal is to enhance the safety and security of both passengers and drivers by ensuring that their credentials are visible and accessible during transportation.

title: Slopa befintlig skatt på plastbärkassar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider allowing right turns at red lights, following a practice common in the United States. It argues that this change could improve traffic flow, especially during off-peak hours when traffic is low, while ensuring that safety can be maintained through appropriate regulations.

title: Nödvändiga åtgärder för att stärka Sveriges regionala flygplatser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the Transport Agency (Trafikverket) to investigate the implementation of traffic lights with countdown timers at pedestrian and cyclist crossings. The motivation emphasizes the need for safer crossings for all users, particularly for the elderly and people with disabilities, by allowing them to better plan their crossing times. The motion highlights successful examples from other countries and calls for a pilot project to assess traffic flow improvements and accident reduction.

title: Förbättrad reglering av transportering av hästar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government consider implementing a system for adopting highways, similar to initiatives in the United States. This system would allow organizations, companies, and individuals to contribute financially to the maintenance and cleanliness of highways. In return, they would receive recognition through signage along the adopted stretch of highway. This approach aims to enhance community engagement and provide additional resources for improving the country's road infrastructure.

title: Så får fler unga sin första bostad
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to review and potentially raise the speed limit for passenger cars towing trailers, which is currently set at 80 km/h. The motion argues that advancements in vehicle and road safety warrant a reevaluation of this limit, suggesting that an increase to 90 km/h or more could improve traffic flow and reduce the frequency of overtaking maneuvers, as evidenced by policies in countries like Germany and Austria.

title: Sveriges ambassad till Jerusalem
summary: The motion advocates for the expansion of the E16 road between Gävle and Oslo to alleviate traffic bottlenecks and enhance infrastructure. The proposed upgrade to a '2 + 2' free-flowing road is deemed crucial for boosting economic growth, facilitating commuting for work and education, and supporting tourism, especially during the winter season. The motion calls for the inclusion of this expansion in the national infrastructure plan.

title: Statliga startlån
summary: The motion proposes allowing higher education institutions in Sweden to implement 'no-show' fees for students who confirm their enrollment but fail to attend on the registration day. The authors argue that this measure would reduce unnecessary bureaucracy, improve the effective management of student admissions, and ultimately enhance educational accessibility for other students. By imposing consequences for those who do not show up, the motion aims to ensure a more efficient and competitive higher education system.

title: Uppskjutna avgifter för nystartade företag till Bolagsverket
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations governing anti-competitive conduct by public entities in Sweden, advocating for stronger tools for the Competition Authority (Konkurrensverket) to impose fines for violations. This is in response to concerns raised by many businesses encountering unfair competition from public operations, particularly in the services sector. The proposal emphasizes the need for more effective enforcement mechanisms to address and prevent such competition.

title: Statligt ägande av Sunpine
summary: The motion M1581 presented by Johan Hultberg proposes a comprehensive plan for improving the infrastructure between Gothenburg and Oslo. It calls for the expansion of the railway along this route, seeking solutions for both public and potential private funding. Key measures include establishing a Nordic council for infrastructure and transportation, enhancing traffic modeling for cross-border rail transport, and developing a Nordic infrastructure plan. The urgency is underscored by recent natural disasters affecting critical roads and the current inadequacies of the existing transportation network. The ultimate aim is to create a more resilient and efficient transport corridor between Sweden and Norway, enhancing economic ties and reducing environmental impacts.

title: Starta eget-lån för unga vuxna
summary: Motion M1166 proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the design of the job tax deduction to prevent it from encouraging higher municipal taxes. The current job tax deduction system inadvertently subsidizes increased municipal taxes, which can create an unfavorable economic environment by raising marginal tax rates and reducing employment incentives. The motion calls for an evaluation of the municipal equalization system and other measures to ensure that high municipal taxes are not incentivized by state support.

title: Marknadskompletterande riskkapitalfond
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes a revival of Nordic cooperation following the setbacks caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. It outlines several suggestions including the establishment of a Nordic corona commission, a guarantee of cross-border freedom, improved collaboration among authorities, and enhanced cross-border infrastructure. The motion emphasizes the need for closer Nordic integration to address the challenges faced during the pandemic and to prepare for future crises while ensuring that the everyday lives of border residents can function seamlessly even in times of crisis.

title: Hållbar semesterstart
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish Parliament to act against the use of 'mobile proxies' which have become a loophole for criminals to evade regulations on anonymous prepaid phone cards. It highlights the growth of organized crime and the need for tighter controls in the wake of a security crisis. The motion calls for reforms to limit the number of phone subscriptions or prepaid cards that an individual can hold, thereby complicating criminal communications and enhancing the effectiveness of law enforcement.

title: Företagsamhet bland unga
summary: The motion proposes various measures to improve the accessibility and quality of healthcare in Sweden, including banning non-medical circumcision of minors, addressing unwanted shifts and rotating schedules for healthcare workers, implementing safety-classified care placements for high-risk patients, reducing student debts for healthcare professionals in rural areas, and establishing a national vaccination registry. The motion emphasizes that healthcare should be based on the latest advancements and aims to ensure timely, equitable access to care for all patients, as well as improved safety for staff and patients alike.

title: Eget utträde
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a national coordination office for Swedish healthcare and a revision of the life science strategy to enhance fundamental research and ensure proper reinvestment of technologies in the healthcare system. It emphasizes the need for well-structured educational initiatives for healthcare personnel and the implementation of stringent quality control processes within the life science sector, aiming to improve the effectiveness and safety of medical innovations.

title: Alkoholservering i den svenska hockeyligan (SHL)
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:544 av Dennis Dioukarev och Mattias Bäckström Johansson (båda SD)
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen the social services sector in Sweden by enhancing risk assessments, improving working conditions for social workers, establishing continuous career pathways, and introducing specialized education for social workers. It also emphasizes the need for better supervision, accountability measures, and increased support systems for vulnerable children and youth in care. The focus is on ensuring a robust social welfare system that prioritizes the rights and well-being of children, as well as providing adequate training and resources for professionals within the social services.

title: Samlokalisering av Skatteverket, Kronofogden och Försäkringskassan
summary: The suggestion calls for the government to enhance regional, national, and international collaboration regarding rare diseases, improve support measures for families affected by such diseases, and develop care initiatives specifically for children diagnosed with rare conditions. The proposal emphasizes the need for a national action and coordination plan for rare diseases to ensure equitable healthcare access for all affected individuals in Sweden.

title: Förnybara drivmedel i kollektivtrafiken
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a comprehensive response to violence against women and domestic violence in Sweden. It advocates for proactive measures including a 'stay' guarantee for children in abusive situations, the establishment of a commission to investigate cases of lethal violence, and increased educational efforts for professionals dealing with affected individuals. The motion highlights the necessity for improved statistics on domestic violence, legal definitions of crimes, and actions to address post-violence scenarios, asserting that understanding these issues is crucial for promoting gender equality and reducing societal harm.

title: Inled processen för att flytta Sveriges ambassad i Israel till Jerusalem
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should develop a comprehensive action plan focusing on the improvement of dietary habits and physical activity among children and adults. It emphasizes promoting healthier lifestyles, reducing the use of alcohol, drugs, and tobacco, ensuring quality in public health initiatives, and addressing the impact of social media on mental health. Additionally, the proposal includes mandatory health checks for asylum seekers, measures to alleviate involuntary loneliness, enhancing sexual education in schools, and recognizing sex and love addiction as a dependency disorder.

title: Se över möjligheten att utöka ROT-avdraget
summary: This motion proposes to clarify the legal recognition of individuals with severe visual impairments, including the blind and deafblind, as part of a specific group entitled to support under disability laws in Sweden. Additionally, it calls for the government to create a list of essential information that should be accessible to the public, develop a plan to reduce digital exclusion, and retain the current responsible organization for guide dog services instead of transferring it to a governmental authority. The motion emphasizes the need for equal rights and access to essential services for persons with disabilities.

title: Sista etappen av vägförbättrande ombyggnation av väg 181
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish government should consider assigning the National Board of Health and Welfare to develop regulations for making the dental hygiene profession a protected title, alongside investigating reduced student debt for dentists who choose to work in rural and sparsely populated areas. This proposal stems from concerns over workforce shortages in dental care, particularly in rural regions, and aims to improve working conditions and attract more professionals to the field.

title: Västra stambanan
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a ten-year national strategy to strengthen mental health across Sweden, involving a clearer and enhanced role for the Public Health Agency, the formation of a national council to oversee mental health efforts, and the initiation of national research programs. It aims to improve access to psychiatric competence in primary care, set standardized guidelines for psychiatric medication for children and adolescents, and enhance preventative measures and early intervention strategies in schools. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the necessity of modernizing psychiatric care in response to rising mental health issues and ensuring effective support and treatment for affected individuals.

title: Likställ krav på ljudnivåer från idrottsanläggningar med krav för vägar och järnvägar
summary: The motion proposes to maintain and develop the Swedish model of forestry, emphasizing the importance of sustainable forest management and use. It advocates for Skogsstyrelsen to be the primary authority overseeing forestry regulations, ensuring that ongoing land use on productive forest land is always considered forestry unless determined otherwise in individual cases. The proposal seeks to avoid increasing the area of protected forests, acknowledges the significance of privately owned forests, and stresses the need for thorough impact assessments before signing international agreements. It reiterates support for continuity forestry practices, promotes the Swedish bioeconomy, and suggests streamlining processes related to forestry management while protecting the rights of landowners.

title: Samordna regelverk för bevattningsförbud
summary: The motion presented by Carina Ståhl Herrstedt and others from the Sweden Democrats focuses on enhancing Sweden's approach to substance abuse and dependency treatment. It proposes the establishment of knowledge centers to support coordinators in public health initiatives, as well as considering restrictions on the marketing of alcoholic beverages. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the need for increased awareness of alcohol misuse among youth, strategies to combat drug-related deaths, and efforts to address online drug availability. It also advocates for an updated substance strategy to include harm reduction perspectives for tobacco and nicotine products and encourages a comprehensive evaluation of the current narcotic situation in Sweden.

title: Skolavslutning och firanden av högtider med konfessionella inslag i kyrkolokaler
summary: The suggestion calls for the Swedish government to enhance the care and treatment of asthma and allergy patients by establishing national guidelines, creating a knowledge center for allergy care, and implementing a national allergy program. It emphasizes the need for continuous monitoring of care for asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) patients while promoting preventive health measures to improve overall public health and address healthcare disparities across regions.

title: Fortsatt satsning på säkra och trygga stationsmiljöer
summary: The motion proposes several initiatives aimed at improving the handling and distribution of pharmaceuticals in Sweden, including the return rights for refrigerated medicines, better management of leftover medications, and environmental assessments of pharmaceuticals. It also calls for an investigation into the increasing prescription of antidepressants to youth and proposes that the official Drug Book continue to be available in printed form alongside its digital version, emphasizing the importance of access and security amidst digital vulnerabilities.

title: Åtgärder mot störande musik från bilar i tätorter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should enhance diabetes care throughout the country, advocating for equality in access to diabetes treatment and medication. It emphasizes that diabetes care should be consistent across the nation, advocating for improved knowledge dissemination and ensuring that necessary medications are not sold outside the benefit system. The authors argue that variations in treatment and resources are unacceptable in a welfare state and that steps must be taken to ensure all individuals with diabetes receive proper care regardless of their location.
