title: Åtgärder för att motverka den spanska skogssnigelns utbredning och skadeverkningar
summary: The motion proposes several measures to enhance cancer care in Sweden, particularly focusing on expanding screening programs for breast and cervical cancers to include older women, increasing knowledge about risk factors, and improving cancer research capabilities in the regions. It underscores the importance of preventive health measures and aims to reduce regional disparities in cancer treatment.

title: Tandtekniker
summary: The suggestion proposes a comprehensive overhaul of the Swedish Statens institutionsstyrelse (Sis) to ensure a safer and more effective treatment environment for youth with psychosocial challenges, separating them from youth involved in severe criminal behavior. Key proposals include improving safety measures, phasing out isolation as a disciplinary method, empowering staff with protective equipment, reviewing legal frameworks governing Sis, enhancing recruitment and training for personnel, and providing healthier food options. The motion emphasizes the need for Sis to focus on mental health care while addressing the broader societal issues affecting the youth in care.

title: Ett självständigt Libanon behöver Sveriges och omvärldens stöd
summary: The motion urges the Swedish Parliament to consider raising ambitions for popular education, ensuring its freedom, and restoring funding for folkbildning (popular education) amidst recent cuts. It emphasizes the importance of an educated populace for a vibrant democracy and criticizes increased political control over educational content, advocating for voluntary and unregulated pathways for personal development.

title: Åtgärder för kristna flyktingar
summary: The motion advocates for the implementation of mandatory collective agreement requirements in public procurement processes. It argues that collective agreements protect worker rights, help to prevent unhealthy competition and wage dumping, and support the Swedish model of labor relations. The proposal emphasizes that public sector contracts should only be awarded to suppliers who have collective agreements, ensuring a fair labor market and reinforcing the importance of these agreements.

title: Klostret Mor Gabriel
summary: The motion proposes increasing investments in cycling infrastructure in Sweden to encourage more people to use bicycles instead of cars, which would reduce emissions, improve public health, and decrease traffic congestion in urban areas. It highlights the need for additional resources for municipalities to enhance cycling pathways and emphasizes the significance of cycling as part of sustainable transport solutions outlined in the government's national cycling strategy.

title: Samtidigt bygglov/bygganmälan för utbyggnad av befintlig fastighet och attefallshus
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a cohesive policy for Sweden's tourism industry to enhance its long-term sustainability and attractiveness. It highlights the importance of this sector, which significantly contributes to the economy and employment. Key challenges identified include a lack of capital, inadequate infrastructure, and insufficient access to support compared to other industries. The authors advocate for improved public support for small tourism businesses, enhanced infrastructure development, and the establishment of destination companies to help coordinate and promote local tourist opportunities sustainably.

title: Reform av strandskyddsreglerna
summary: The motion advocates for stronger measures to combat tax evasion and tax avoidance in Sweden, arguing that such financial practices drain the welfare system of billions each year and undermine public trust in a fair tax system. It highlights the inadequacies of current legislation, such as the ten-year rule on capital gains taxation after emigration, and calls for a reform based on successful models from other European countries. The motion urges the government to re-establish an investigation into taxation for individuals with capital gains who relocate abroad, which was dismissed by the current administration.

title: Stärkt skydd för anonyma vittnen vid gängrelaterade brott
summary: The proposal emphasizes the necessity of establishing long-term regulations and financial incentives to stimulate domestic production of sustainable aviation fuel in Sweden. It highlights the current challenges faced by Swedish fuel producers regarding high costs, low demand, and dependency on fossil fuels. The motion advocates for a flexible revenue guarantee system that encourages investments in production facilities, thereby fostering innovation and job creation. Additionally, it underscores the role of biofuels in reducing carbon emissions and facilitating a green transition in the aviation sector, aligning with EU initiatives aimed at decreasing the climate impact of air travel.

title: En tydligare koppling mellan villkorlig frigivning och deltagande i återfallsförebyggande åtgärder
Elcertifikat - stoppregel och kontrollstation 2019
summary: The proposal calls for a comprehensive review of the Swedish pharmacy market, asserting that pharmacies are crucial for equitable healthcare and quality assurance. It emphasizes the need for accessibility across the country and the importance of having knowledgeable staff available to assist patients. The motion critiques the privatization of pharmacies that occurred in 2009, arguing it has led to uncertainties in the availability of necessary medications, particularly in rural areas, and emphasizes the ethical stance against profit-driven distribution of medicine.

title: Sekretess för uppgifter om statliga tjänstepensionsförmåner
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need for effective measures on the Malmbanan railway due to its critical role in the industrial production chain. Current deficiencies threaten the green industrial transition in Norrbotten, and the national transport infrastructure plan includes necessary capacity improvements. A recent report from Trafikverket highlights the time-sensitive nature of these issues and proposes expediting capacity-enhancing actions to support new industrial developments in northern Sweden.

title: Bestämmelserna om nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifterna för den först anställda görs permanenta
summary: The proposal advocates for the expansion and individualization of parental insurance in Sweden, emphasizing its importance as a key gender equality reform. It aims to achieve gender equality in the workplace by enabling both mothers and fathers to share parental leave more equitably. The motion highlights the stagnation in achieving equal use of parental leave between genders and argues that current governmental proposals could worsen the situation. Additionally, it seeks to ensure that the reform facilitates a greater take-up of parental days during a child's first year, ultimately supporting a more balanced family structure and addressing the financial gap between genders over a lifetime.

title: Åtgärder till skydd för Sveriges säkerhet vid överlåtelser av säkerhetskänslig verksamhet
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a high-cost protection scheme for dental care in Sweden, similar to existing protections in the healthcare sector, to ensure that dental health is accessible to all, regardless of economic status. It argues that current patient fees create barriers to necessary dental visits, making oral health a class issue and underscoring the need for dental care to be treated equally to other health services. The motion emphasizes that healthcare should be based on individual needs rather than financial capability.

title: Strategi för den arktiska regionen
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the for-profit school sector in Sweden by prohibiting profit withdrawals from schools, banning confessional schools, and ensuring equal access to all educational institutions through revisions of the queue systems used by independent schools. The authors argue that the current market-based education system has led to increased inequality, prioritization of profits over educational quality, and diminished public oversight, calling for a return to a more equitable and democratic school system.

title: Sänkt fordonsskatt på personbilar och lätta lastbilar
summary: The suggestion emphasizes the need to facilitate housing construction in rural and sparsely populated areas of Sweden, where the challenges include difficulties in obtaining loans due to low market values. It proposes measures such as targeted investment support for climate-smart apartments, a renovation support scheme for private homes, and utilizing government loan guarantee systems to ease financing. The motion aims to address housing shortages that hinder socio-economic development in these regions.

title: Fastighetsavgift
summary: The motion proposes to intensify efforts to connect the Swedish and Finnish railway networks, highlighting the importance of the Haparandabanan for international transport corridors in Europe. It emphasizes the need for a modern border crossing to facilitate cross-border rail traffic and calls for a coordinated plan between the Swedish and Finnish governments to realize the potential of this transportation link, particularly in light of current security conditions.

title: Kriminella och medborgarskap
summary: The motion proposes to review the possibility of abolishing the unjust sick leave deduction (karensavdrag) in Sweden, arguing that it disproportionately affects workers who cannot perform their jobs remotely and can lead to increased health risks and economic penalties for those who fall ill. The authors assert that Swedish sickness insurance should be equitable and accessible, and that current regulations contribute to unfairness within the social safety net, particularly highlighted during the pandemic.

title: Minska personal utanför kärnverksamheten på myndigheterna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider investigating the conditions necessary to establish a protected professional title for childcare workers (barnskötare). The aim is to ensure that all individuals in this role possess appropriate educational qualifications, particularly at the upper secondary level, to improve the quality of preschool education. The authors argue that a standardized title would enhance professional clarity and ensure that all children have access to qualified caregivers in preschool settings, thereby promoting equity in early childhood education.

title: Grundavdrag för kapitalinkomster
summary: The motion proposes the urgent introduction of a deadline for the completion of property division following a divorce or separation. It highlights the challenges faced by women who are victims of violence, particularly in terms of securing a stable living situation post-separation. The lack of a defined timeline for property division can lead to economic difficulty and compel victims to return to abusive relationships. The motion calls for the government to act promptly to implement a time limit for property division to ensure a fair and effective process.

title: Fingeravtrycksläsare för att kvittera ut bidrag
summary: The proposal advocates for the reintroduction of tax deductions for union membership fees, which were previously abolished in 2007 by a conservative government. The motion emphasizes the importance of economic equality and fair treatment between unions and employer organizations, arguing that workers' contributions should be treated similarly to those of employers. A high level of worker organization is deemed crucial for the health of the Swedish labor market.

title: Försök inom medicinsk forskning
summary: The motion aims to strengthen efforts against labor market crime in Sweden by enhancing cooperation among governmental authorities such as the Tax Agency, Labor Inspectorate, and police. It highlights the exploitation of vulnerable workers by unscrupulous companies and the threat posed by organized crime. The proposal advocates for stricter penalties for violations and suggests reviewing the use of subcontractors in public procurement to improve oversight, thereby ensuring a fair and healthy labor market.

title: Övervakningsansvar vid tvångsavvisningar
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to actively promote a global carbon price to combat climate change, which is viewed as an existential threat. It emphasizes the need for stronger commitments from countries to meet the Paris Agreement goals, increase investments in green transitions, and phase out fossil fuel subsidies. The motion suggests that a global carbon pricing mechanism, where polluters pay for their emissions, would effectively reduce emissions, particularly in regions lacking existing emission trading systems. It also highlights the importance of predictability in climate policy for businesses and the general population.

title: Miljöfrämjande grödor för ett hållbart jordbruk
summary: The proposal advocates for the right to proper work shoes for employees in health care, social services, and preschool, emphasizing the importance of a good work environment and equal access to equipment for all workers, particularly focusing on the needs of predominantly female staff. It highlights the health risks associated with inadequate footwear and argues that providing appropriate shoes is essential for both workplace safety and gender equality in public sector employment.

title: Skapa incitament för ekonomisk tillväxt i Sveriges kommuner
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates origin labeling of meat served in restaurants to enable consumers to make informed and ethical choices regarding their meat consumption. The initiative aims to reduce meat consumption in Sweden for climate and animal welfare reasons while promoting Swedish meat, which supports local farmers and adheres to higher animal welfare standards compared to other countries. The motion emphasizes the importance of such labeling in increasing the market for Swedish meat and enhancing consumer awareness and pride.

title: Motorsport och motorhobby
summary: The motion advocates for the strengthening, inflation-proofing, and permanent establishment of the housing allowance to ensure that all children have a secure home. It emphasizes the importance of stable housing as a social right and highlights the financial struggles faced by low-income families, particularly in light of rising living costs. The proposal calls for a thorough review of the housing allowance system to increase social justice and provide families with long-term financial security.

title: Översyn av LAS
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider measures to ensure equal access to cultural schools across all municipalities, and investigate how to reduce barriers preventing children and youths from participating in cultural school activities. It emphasizes the importance of cultural education and the unequal participation currently observed in cultural schools, particularly among socioeconomically disadvantaged groups. The motion argues for a more accessible and equitable cultural school system as a matter of equality and societal integration.

title: Vårdnadshavares rätt till information
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the fairness of the sickness benefit deduction, known as karensavdraget, highlighting its disproportionate impact on certain professions, particularly those in female-dominated and essential worker roles who cannot work remotely. The proposal emphasizes the need for a system that allows individuals to take sick leave without financial strain, thus reducing presenteeism and its associated long-term costs, especially in the healthcare sector.

title: Möjlighet att skatta i två kommuner
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a truth commission to investigate the historical and current situation of the Roma in Sweden, addressing issues of persecution, discrimination, and prejudice that have persisted over time. It highlights the need for recognition of past injustices as well as ongoing discrimination, with the aim of promoting understanding and combating stereotypes against the Roma community.

title: En individuell sjukförsäkring
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the tax system in Sweden to achieve greater economic justice between different forms of housing. It highlights the economic disadvantages that rental housing faces compared to ownership models, particularly in terms of tax deductions and benefits available to homeowners. The motion emphasizes the need to investigate tax-free maintenance funds to facilitate sustainable renovations and energy-efficiency improvements in rental properties, thereby also addressing issues related to rent increases following major renovations. The aim is to create a more equitable tax framework that supports the maintenance and improvement of rental housing.

title: Föräldraledighet från alla politiska uppdrag
summary: The motion proposes steps to enhance social insurance protections for pregnant women, addressing inadequacies that contribute to gender inequality. Insufficient financial support during pregnancy can discourage family planning due to economic uncertainty. It highlights the need for equal treatment in social benefits for all pregnant women, including the proposal for a non-means-tested pregnancy allowance that covers the last week before childbirth. The aim is to improve fairness, gender equality, and job security for expectant mothers.

title: Sanktionsmöjligheter vid försvårande av umgänge
summary: The motion proposes a review of the protected amount for elderly citizens to improve their standard of living. It highlights that previous reforms during the Social Democratic government aimed to assist the most economically vulnerable pensioners, particularly women and low-wage workers. Concerns are raised over the lack of adjustment of the protected amount in line with pension increases, which has led to difficulties for many elderly in benefiting from actual pension hikes, allowing municipalities to decrease financial support instead.

title: Riksväg 40
summary: The motion proposes a voluntary gradual phase-out of mink farming in Sweden, emphasizing the right of minks to a good life and strong animal welfare standards. It highlights the welfare concerns of minks raised for fur, the inability of these animals to engage in natural behaviors, and the negative impact of mink farming on biodiversity, particularly the introduction of escapee minks into the wild. The motion calls on the government to support these changes and reinforce animal welfare legislation.

title: Kampen mot antisemitism
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the introduction of green credits to reduce risks for municipalities during the green transition. It also suggests considering a 'kommunkliv' initiative to prevent municipal levels from becoming bottlenecks in this transition, with the aim of ensuring that the local welfare is not compromised while speeding up necessary investments for sustainable community development in the context of the green shift, particularly focusing on the needs of municipalities like those in Norrbotten.

title: En ännu bättre tonnageskatt
summary: The motion proposes a revision of the depreciation rules to address the significant economic challenges faced by the municipalities of Gällivare and Kiruna due to extensive societal transformations caused by LKAB's mining activities. The changes have resulted in increased infrastructure and housing needs, leading to high depreciation costs that the municipalities currently struggle to cover. The proposal suggests modifying the regulations to allow depreciation for investments to be charged against equity, thereby alleviating the financial burden and preventing cuts to essential local services.

title: Maritimt program
summary: The motion advocates for mobile coverage and broadband access to be recognized as a state responsibility, emphasizing the importance of reliable internet access for residents across Sweden, particularly in rural areas. It argues that good connectivity is essential for various aspects of life, including education, social interaction, and economic growth, and calls for government intervention to ensure sufficient coverage where private market solutions are inadequate.

title: Bonus-malus
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a Barents Institute in Norrbotten to enhance collaboration in the Barents region, calls for increased military activity in Sweden, the creation of a Northern Combat School, and the establishment of a recruitment and selection office in Norrbotten, emphasizing the strategic importance of the region for security and defense in the context of Sweden's NATO membership.

title: Flygskatt
summary: The proposal suggests that the transition from unemployment benefits to activity support should be reviewed to prevent job seekers from facing financial difficulties. It emphasizes the need for synchronized payment periods between the two forms of support, which currently leads to economic instability for those participating in employment programs. The motion aims to improve the economic security of job seekers during this transition and encourage greater participation in labor market initiatives, thus promoting a fairer labor market policy.

title: Fastighetsskatt
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for improved conditions for new industrialization in northern Sweden, highlighting the importance of sustainable growth and the crucial role of green energy production. It calls for a more efficient investment framework, streamlined regulatory processes, enhanced infrastructure, and better housing and education opportunities to attract and retain skilled labor. The proposal advocates for a balanced and fair policy approach that prioritizes regional needs and supports the growth of competitive industries across the country, while ensuring environmental sustainability.

title: Akut översyn av behandling vid tidigt debuterande könsdysfori
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:500 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå (SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider resuming the construction of protective bunkers with state funding and providing better compensation for property owners renovating existing shelters. This is in response to the deteriorating security situation in Sweden due to geopolitical tensions, particularly following the Russian invasion of Ukraine, emphasizing the need for a robust civil protection system that includes access to shelters.

title: Entreprenörskap som obligatoriskt gymnasieämne
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:499 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå (SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the consideration of measures to achieve high-quality preschools with appropriately sized child groups. It emphasizes the need for equitable access to quality preschool education across Sweden and calls for strengthened requirements and support for municipalities to ensure that all children receive the preschool experience they are entitled to, regardless of their location.

title: Inköpspris för permanentbostad justerat efter inflationsindex vid beräkning av realisationsvinst
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:498 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå (SD)
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need for continued development of infrastructure for transport in northern Sweden to support the growth of the green industry. It calls for increased state responsibility in funding infrastructure investments associated with new industrial establishments and stresses the significance of cross-border transport and regional connectivity. The motion highlights that underfunding of public infrastructure by local municipalities is unsustainable and may hinder economic growth and job creation. It further underscores the necessity of a well-maintained transport network, including roads, railways, and airports, to achieve Sweden's goal of becoming the world's first fossil-free welfare state, while ensuring accessibility and safety for both goods and passengers.

title: Nationellt förbud mot böneutrop från religiösa byggnader
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:497 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå (SD)
summary: The motion proposes a ban on profits in the welfare sector, arguing that public funds designated for welfare should primarily serve welfare purposes rather than generate private profits. The motion emphasizes the need to regain democratic control over welfare services, which have increasingly been influenced by profit-driven enterprises, leading to inequalities in access to education and healthcare. It calls for the evaluation of market and choice models that dominate the public sector and suggests that resources should be allocated efficiently to ensure quality care and education for all.

title: Ökat kunskapsstöd rörande vård av sköldkörtelsjuka
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:496 av Jonas Andersson i Skellefteå (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the development of more industrially produced wooden buildings to address the housing shortage, particularly in regions undergoing green industrial transformation. The authors argue that a lack of housing exacerbates social segregation and unemployment, and they advocate for government intervention in the housing market rather than relying solely on market forces. They emphasize the environmental benefits of wooden construction and the potential for faster, more cost-effective building processes, which could help alleviate the housing crisis while promoting sustainable building practices.

title: Uppföljning av sexköpslagen – åtgärder mot pornografi
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for effective skills development initiatives in northern Sweden to support the green industrial transition and ensure climate neutrality by 2045. It advocates for enhancing adult education, particularly through folk high schools, to provide greater access to learning opportunities in sparsely populated areas. The proposal highlights the importance of adapting education to meet the evolving labor market demands, promoting continuous learning, and ensuring equitable access for young people and immigrants who are currently facing higher rates of unemployment.

title: Stoppa försäljning av pass inom EU
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports increasing the responsibility of employers for the rehabilitation of employees returning to work after illness. It emphasizes the need for tailored support systems to assist individuals who are temporarily unable to work, highlighting that employers should implement careful planning and personalized actions to facilitate successful reintegration into the workforce. The motion addresses the importance of ensuring that all able individuals have opportunities to work, and it calls for measures to prevent situations where employers do not sufficiently assist employees in their rehabilitation process.

title: Offentlig fond för kvalitetsjournalistik
summary: The motion proposes measures to enhance support for parents of children with disabilities by ensuring access to personal advocacy and coordination services. It highlights the challenges faced by these parents in navigating care and resources, leading to inequitable access to support. The motion calls for the government to improve the existing framework and resources available to assist caregivers, emphasizing the importance of effective support systems as a matter of equality and rights.

title: Uppgradering av Mora flygplats
summary: The motion proposes to enhance support within primary care for children and adolescents experiencing mental health issues. It emphasizes the importance of addressing inequalities in health driven by disparities in resources and highlights the need for early interventions to ensure children's health and development. The motion calls for an analysis of healthcare restructuring with a focus on children's rights and proposes the development of specific competencies within primary care to effectively meet the mental health needs of young individuals.

title: Kartläggning av kristofobi i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take decisive action against social dumping, which involves municipalities transferring individuals dependent on welfare to other areas without their consent, often leading to worsened socio-economic disparities. It highlights cases where affluent municipalities encourage vulnerable families to move, exacerbating inequality and creating segregated neighborhoods. The motion calls for the continuation of investigations into this issue and the development of policies to prevent social dumping, emphasizing the need for collaboration among municipalities to address these challenges.

title: En nationell värdekommission
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize and secure the right to escort services for individuals with visual impairments, addressing the significant reduction in access to such services in recent years. It highlights the challenges faced by blind and severely visually impaired individuals in maintaining their independence and social activities due to municipalities increasingly denying support. The motion advocates for legislative clarification to ensure that individuals with severe visual impairments, blindness, and dual sensory loss are explicitly included in the eligibility criteria for support under existing laws.

title: Rådslag om Dalarnas turistindustri
summary: The proposal seeks to strengthen legislation against online hate, threats, and harassment by urging the government to study the conditions for such legal enhancements. It recognizes online hate as a unique crime due to its potential for wider dissemination and suggests that existing laws have not adequately kept pace with the evolving nature of these offenses, including issues like the non-consensual sharing of intimate images.

title: Åtgärdsplan för Dalabanan
summary: The proposal aims for the Swedish government to develop a national action plan to achieve animal-free research, emphasizing the need for improved oversight and control of institutions using test animals, which is currently lacking due to funding cuts. It references the EU's animal testing directive and suggests that Sweden follow the example of the Netherlands in creating such a plan, with Sveriges 3R-center deemed suitable for this task.

title: Ställ krav på palestinska myndigheten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:487 av Mikael Oscarsson och Magnus Oscarsson (båda KD)

title: Reformera Folkbildningsrådet för att stoppa bidrag till skattefinansieringen av antidemokratiska organisationer
summary: The proposal seeks to phase out the confinement of hens in cages in Sweden, highlighting the significant restrictions on the hens' movement and welfare. It cites the growing trend internationally, with several countries having already implemented bans, and emphasizes strong public support for such a measure alongside a shift towards free-range production among consumers and producers. The motion argues that keeping hens in cages is incompatible with modern animal welfare standards.

title: Åtgärder mot stölder av vapen i Regeringskansliet
summary: The motion proposes that all employees in Sweden should have access to occupational health care, as current access is uneven and often lacking, particularly in smaller workplaces and among certain professions. The motion highlights a downward trend in access to such services and argues for mandatory occupational health care to improve workplace conditions and prevent health issues, thereby reducing sick leave and promoting better physical and mental well-being among employees.

title: Ryssland måste ge all information om Raoul Wallenberg
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of standardized guidelines for odorous emissions in Sweden, acknowledging the lack of current regulations and the need for a modernized approach to address environmental concerns related to industrial smells that can be bothersome to the public. The motion highlights the differences in odor perception and the progression of societal standards since the 1980s, citing established practices in other European countries as models for creating a similar framework in Sweden.

title: Stöd den demokratiska kampen i Belarus
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider elevating Högskolan Dalarna to university status, citing its substantial student body, well-rounded educational offerings, and strong ties with local industry. The motion emphasizes that Högskolan Dalarna meets the necessary criteria for university status and notes its existing recognition as a university in international contexts. Granting this status is expected to enhance research funding and strengthen the institution's role in regional development.

title: Riksväg 282
summary: The proposal calls for the establishment of regulations and a registration system for PR agencies and lobbyists working with the Swedish government and parliament. It highlights the influence of lobbyists and the lack of accountability they currently have, emphasizing that their operations often occur in secrecy, which can undermine democracy. The motion suggests that these professionals should report their activities, clients, and financial expenditures to ensure transparency and protect the integrity of decision-making processes in Sweden.

title: Barnomsorgspeng
summary: This motion emphasizes the necessity for the Swedish parliament to instruct the government to study the conditions for the Strömsholms Canal in the infrastructure planning. The proponents argue that the canal's operational sustainability is threatened due to financial strain and the cessation of utility traffic, leading to an overarching reliance on support from local municipalities. They highlight the potential for enhancing tourism and collaboration among various stakeholders to leverage the canal's historical significance and natural attributes, advocating for increased national interest similar to that granted to other canals in Sweden.

title: Värna ett levande fäbodbruk
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:480 av Peter Helander och Per Åsling (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers tasking Sveaskog with further developing the nature conservation area of Malingsbo-Kloten, emphasizing the area's potential to boost tourism and local economic development. The motion highlights the importance of improving accessibility and enhancing visitor experiences through investments in infrastructure such as marked trails, fishing and hunting facilities, and picnic areas. This development is aimed at benefiting both the region and visitors who appreciate the area's natural beauty.

title: Garanterad samhällsservice
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:479 av Peter Helander och Per Åsling (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament encourages the government to give more visibility to local languages and dialects, such as Älvdalska, in schools, as many of these languages are endangered and lack a written tradition.

title: Investeringar i Dalabanan
summary: The motion calls for a review of the possibilities to abolish or reform the 'karensavdrag' (sick leave deduction) to promote a more equitable labor market in Sweden. It highlights the health risks associated with working while sick, the economic burden on workers, particularly those in low-income and contact professions, and the exacerbation of existing inequalities. The proposal advocates for ensuring that being sick does not have financial repercussions, stressing that all workers should have the same rights and opportunities when it comes to illness.

title: Bättre kreditgarantier för bostadsbyggande på marknadsmässigt svaga marknader
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:477 av Peter Helander och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of state maintenance and investment support for municipal properties in Sweden, addressing the financial difficulties faced by municipalities and regions. It argues that insufficient funding for maintenance leads to costly repairs, reduced services for residents, and poor working conditions for staff. By implementing such support, the proposal aims to enhance development, maintain existing investments, stimulate the construction sector, create jobs, and promote sustainable growth in the housing and property market.

title: En hållbar turist- och besöksnäring i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:476 av Peter Helander och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should oppose the closure of the Film Archive in Grängesberg and communicate this stance to the government. The archive is deemed crucial for preserving knowledge about the lives and work of the Swedish people in the 20th century. The motion argues against the government's recent proposal to relocate the archive, highlighting its historical significance, the local community's investment in the facility, and the potential loss of jobs and expertise in the region.

title: Konkurrenskraftsmål
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:475 av Peter Helander och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament prioritize funding for infrastructure investments throughout the country, ensuring that planning models better reflect actual costs. It highlights the need for quality roads and railways outside urban areas and addresses discrepancies between projected and actual costs in infrastructure projects, using the example of a crucial road in Hälsingland that has faced significant delays and safety issues.

title: Marksnål teknik
summary: The motion proposes strengthening Sweden's unemployment insurance to maintain and secure the Swedish model, which is crucial for the labor movement's strength against employers. It emphasizes the unemployment insurance's role in mitigating economic crises and maintaining consumption during downturns, while also advocating for its adaptation to societal developments and increased living costs, ensuring it remains accessible to a broader group.

title: Forskning och rådgivning kring insjöfiske och vattenbruk
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:473 av Anders Åkesson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes measures to facilitate the connection process to the electrical grid to support the green industrial transition in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for faster application procedures and the review of regulations governing electricity reservation for future expansion, in response to the current capacity constraints that hinder the establishment of energy-intensive businesses in municipalities. The motion aims to prevent job losses in areas with high unemployment by enabling new green jobs and improving existing industrial capabilities.

title: En ny egnahemsrörelse
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:472 av Anders Åkesson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal urges the government to accelerate the development of simpler payment solutions and consolidated information for electric vehicle owners. It highlights the increase in electric vehicle sales driven by past government incentives and EU regulations, emphasizing the need for accessible charging infrastructure and streamlined payment options to facilitate the transition to a fossil-free vehicle fleet. The motion calls for enhanced collaboration in the industry to provide necessary information for public charging and underscores the importance of swift action to avoid falling behind compared to other European countries that have made significant progress.

title: Sekretess inom djurskydd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports phasing out the use of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in Sweden and the EU as soon as possible and seeks a global ban on these chemicals through international bodies. The motion emphasizes the dangers posed by PFAS to human and environmental health, citing evidence of their potential harmful effects on reproduction, cell functions, hormones, and possible links to cancer. It argues for immediate action against PFAS usage, highlighting that safer alternatives are available and framing the issue as not only an environmental concern but also a matter of human rights and equality.

title: Kostnadsförslag vid nya kraftledningar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Riksdag should study the conditions for implementing limits on reminder fees charged by government authorities, similar to those imposed on private companies. The motion argues that current laws allow public agencies to charge excessively high fees for minor debts, which is inconsistent with public sentiments regarding fairness in debt collection practices.

title: Övervakningsorgan för illegala penningflöden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider investigations into the optimal construction of offshore wind farms to minimize environmental impact and maximize benefits. It suggests reviewing designated offshore areas based on current technological capabilities and streamlining regulations to coordinate permitting processes. This approach aims to ensure a sustainable development of offshore wind energy while protecting marine ecosystems and enhancing biodiversity.

title: Friskvårdsbidrag för personer i egen firma och handelsbolag
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of safeguarding the independence of non-profit organizations in Sweden, highlighting their critical role in promoting democracy and social well-being. It argues that a vibrant civil society, comprising sports clubs, trade unions, religious communities, and youth organizations, is essential for fostering democratic engagement and community involvement. The motion calls for ensuring that these organizations remain autonomous from state and municipal control as well as strong economic interests, allowing them to self-finance and make independent decisions.

title: Naturbruksskolorna och de gröna näringarna är framtiden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:467 av Mikael Larsson och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: This proposal advocates for the reintroduction of 'outdoor days' in schools to meet national outdoor policy goals. It highlights concerns about increasing sedentary behavior and mental health issues among children, noting a decline in outdoor activity and engagement with nature. The motion stresses the importance of schools in providing equal opportunities for all children to experience outdoor activities, which can enhance their health and educational outcomes.

title: Ersättning för markinlösen
summary: The motion proposes increasing investments in fossil-free energy production in southern Sweden and calls for an investigation into the pricing models of electricity, aiming to address existing disparities caused by the division of Sweden into different electricity pricing zones. The motion highlights the negative impact of rising electricity prices on consumers and businesses in southern Sweden due to inadequate energy production and external influences from neighboring countries. It advocates for exploring alternative pricing methods to create a fairer and more stable electricity market.

title: Bedrägerier med personnummer
summary: The motion advocates for increased prioritization of care and support for women after childbirth, addressing both physical and psychological issues that may arise. It highlights the inadequate availability of treatment and support, the stigma surrounding these problems, and the need for better research and knowledge dissemination. The motion calls on the government to take national responsibility for improving these healthcare services to ensure women receive proper care without unnecessary delays or challenges.

title: Lättläst demokratisatsning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:464 av Per Lodenius och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for a more locally anchored labor market policy in Sweden, highlighting the diminishing local presence and knowledge of the Public Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen). It emphasizes the need for the agency to receive increased resources and support to assist jobseekers, particularly those far from the labor market, and suggests that municipalities may need to take on a coordinating role. The motion calls for a review of state support for municipalities to enhance local labor market initiatives and improve accessibility to employment services across the country.

title: Offentlig information på lättläst svenska
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:463 av Per Lodenius och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that individuals receiving pregnancy benefit should have the same employment protection as those on parental leave during termination of employment. It highlights the lack of legal protection against dismissal for those on pregnancy benefit, despite the potential risks in the workplace that could affect pregnant individuals. The proposal aims to ensure job security and a safer work environment for pregnant employees by mandating that any dismissal while on pregnancy benefit be treated as if they are on parental leave, with the notice period only commencing upon their return to work.

title: Stärkt stöd till samlingslokalshållarna
summary: The proposal aims to ensure a secure and continuous level of compensation for individuals transitioning from activity compensation to sickness compensation, particularly addressing the challenges faced by those between the ages of 19 and 29 who have disabilities. It highlights the current bureaucratic issues leading to financial insecurity due to prolonged processing times for sickness compensation applications, which often force individuals to seek municipal support. The motion calls for a system that allows for activity compensation to continue until the decision on sickness compensation is made and emphasizes the obligation of the Social Insurance Agency to assist those with disabilities in the application process.

title: Översyn av regler som styr det akademiska läsåret
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider measures to simplify and reduce the costs for municipalities and other developers in northern Sweden to acquire state-owned land above the cultivation limit, addressing the challenges related to land access for new construction in the region.

title: AP-fonderna och klimatlobbning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should support a requirement for all municipalities to provide school transportation for children attending adapted primary schools to and from after-school activities (fritids). Currently, municipalities are not obligated to offer this service, which poses challenges for families, especially for children with disabilities who may struggle to commute independently. The proposal emphasizes the importance of after-school programs for social interaction and independence among children.

title: Producentansvar för fritidsbåtar och nationellt system för skrotbåtar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament strengthen Sweden's role in advocating for the rights and autonomy of Western Sahara, which remains occupied by Morocco. It emphasizes the humanitarian crisis faced by Sahrawi refugees in Algeria and highlights the violation of human rights in occupied areas. The motion calls for Sweden to recognize Western Sahara as an independent nation, a move that would position Sweden as the first European country to do so, potentially influencing others to follow suit and increasing pressure on Morocco to adhere to international resolutions regarding the territory.

title: Kvalitet i äldreomsorgen
summary: The proposal suggests reinstating a mandatory national boat register for recreational boats in Sweden, which was abolished in 1992. The register would aid authorities like the police and coast guard in quickly identifying boats involved in incidents or accidents, especially in light of the significant increase in the number and size of recreational boats that raises risks of accidents. It also argues that a boat register would enhance legal security concerning insurance and sales while helping to prevent money laundering.

title: Fyrverkeriförbud för privatpersoner
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a new investment support program aimed at the construction of rental housing and student accommodations in Sweden. Highlighting the increasing housing queues and the urgent need for affordable housing, the motion underscores the negative impact of rising costs and interest rates on housing construction. It argues that a previously existing investment support program was crucial for the housing market and advocates for a reinstated, more extensive support initiative to address the current housing crisis.

title: Samlat grepp för det lokala brottsförebyggande arbetet
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support infrastructure planning in Dalarna County, focusing on the development of road and railway systems. It highlights Dalarna's significant economic contributions as a prominent export region and a leading tourist destination, stressing that growing visitor numbers and industrial expansions demand improved infrastructure. The proposal calls for accurate decision-making based on a better understanding of Dalarna's export statistics, which may be underreported and lead to insufficient infrastructure investments vital for the region's economic and environmental future.

title: Möjlighet för personer med funktionsnedsättning att välja bostadsort
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:455 av Per Lodenius och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the potential revitalization of the Älvdalsbanan railway between Mora and Älvdalen, as well as an extension of the Västerdalsbanan to Särna. The proposal emphasizes the importance of this development in the context of Sweden's changing security landscape, climate challenges, and the need for enhanced military transportation capabilities. By improving rail infrastructure, the motion aims to boost national security, promote tourism, and support industrial transport and exports in the Dalarna region.

title: Effektivare markanvändning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:454 av Annika Qarlsson och Fredrik Christensson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider establishing more municipal land surveying authorities to reduce processing times, which have been excessively long under the current national authority. With only 39 municipalities allowed to establish their own surveying authorities, the remaining municipalities face significant delays, exacerbating community development challenges. The motion emphasizes the need for improved efficiency and quicker service delivery for Swedish citizens.

title: RUT-avdrag
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the feasibility of implementing Norway's model for a robust and sustainable tourism industry in rural and sparsely populated areas of Sweden. It highlights the importance of tourism as a key income source for local communities, while acknowledging challenges such as environmental concerns and workforce shortages. The suggestion includes measures like enhancing education and job opportunities in the tourism sector, creating incentives for sustainable practices, and improving cooperation among government levels to effectively manage tourist flows and promote sustainability.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:6 Ändrade bestämmelser om fotografier och fingeravtryck i SIS II-regelverket
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:452 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to initiate a dialogue with banks regarding their presence across the country, particularly in rural areas where access to capital is crucial for development. It highlights that the lack of local bank branches has negatively impacted businesses, especially in agriculture, leading to difficulties in obtaining loans. The motion calls for banks to reassess their lending practices to better support rural communities and ensure fair economic opportunities throughout Sweden.

title: Om hedersvåld, gängkriminalitet och religiös extremism
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the professional role of healthcare assistants (undersköterskor) by creating incentives for better working conditions and salary development, addressing the ongoing staffing crisis in the healthcare sector. It emphasizes the importance of healthcare assistants in ensuring quality and safety in care, and points out that many are leaving the profession due to poor working conditions and low wages. The proposal calls for measures to enhance the attractiveness of the role, ultimately aiming to improve patient care and safety.

title: Invandrade kvinnors jämställdhet och ekonomiska oberoende
summary: The motion proposes increased national involvement in culture schools to ensure that all children have equal and rich opportunities to participate in cultural activities, addressing disparities related to economic, cultural, or social backgrounds. It highlights the historical context of culture schools and the current challenges they face, including variable funding and accessibility, especially in less affluent municipalities.

title: Stoppa skjutningarna och öka tryggheten i socialt utsatta områden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:449 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider strengthening the preventive work of physiotherapists and occupational therapists in relation to fall accidents among the elderly. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining quality of life in old age through preventive measures, access to training, and adjustments in the home environment to reduce fall risks. The authors advocate for improved access to these professions in primary care and elder care.

title: Vissa kulturpolitiska frågor
summary: The motion proposes an expansion of vocational education within adult education and higher vocational training in Sweden to meet labor market needs. It advocates for the development of university programs, especially in northern Sweden, and emphasizes the importance of accessible education that allows individuals to study locally without the need to relocate. Additionally, the motion underscores the necessity for active labor market policies that support individuals' ability to adapt and gain the skills required for employment in both public and private sectors.

title: Rädda idrotten från matchfixning
summary: The proposal aims to facilitate generational transitions within the agricultural sector in Sweden, addressing the declining number of young farmers and the aging population of current farmers. It highlights the risks associated with the decrease in local agricultural production, which can impact food security and rural economies. The suggestion includes measures such as offering state credit guarantees for young farmers, reviewing regulations related to ownership transfers, and encouraging banks to enhance their local presence to better understand and support the agricultural landscape.

title: Turkiet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers enabling comprehensive train travel across the entire country, from Malmö to Kiruna, without transfers, through an appropriate procurement process. It emphasizes the necessity for developed passenger train services to support sustainable travel and addresses the growing demand for direct routes, reflecting on past initiatives and the potential benefits for climate and future generations.

title: Kuba
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the existing beach protection regulations to allow for construction in attractive coastal areas with low exploitation pressure. It argues that by enabling more housing in these regions, particularly in sparsely populated areas like Norrbotten, it can facilitate growth and migration to rural areas. The motion highlights that current regulations restrict building opportunities contrary to their original intent and underscores the need for a more flexible approach to local and regional planning.

title: Stoppa hädelselagar och dödsstraff för konvertiter
summary: The motion advocates for strengthening national equity in healthcare by addressing disparities in service quality and accessibility across regions in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of providing care on equal terms, suggesting the implementation of a common level for patient fees nationwide, establishing national standards for health data management, and standardizing waiting times for treatments.

title: Hot och våld mot jordbrukare, jägare och samer
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a green and independent energy reserve to enhance Sweden's preparedness and security during crises such as power outages. It proposes that all municipalities develop contingency plans for energy supply, moving away from fossil fuel generators in favor of renewable energy sources like battery storage and solar power. The motion highlights successful initiatives in Ludvika that provide backup power to critical services, thus promoting energy self-sufficiency and climate-friendly solutions. It calls for state support to replicate these efforts nationwide, improving Sweden's overall energy resilience.

title: Hemvård i annan kommun
summary: The motion urges the Swedish government to take new measures to secure the release of journalist Dawit Isaak, who has been imprisoned in Eritrea for 22 years due to his criticism of the government. It emphasizes the importance of defending press freedom globally and highlights the humanitarian concerns regarding Isaak's prolonged detention without due process. The motion calls for a consistent and determined Swedish foreign policy towards undemocratic regimes, arguing that the oppression of press freedom often foreshadows the emergence of dictatorship.

title: Fastigheter som säljs på ofri grund
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize the right of every child to access preschool, regardless of their parents' employment situation. It highlights the importance of preschool in supporting children's development and promoting equality of opportunity, particularly for those from disadvantaged backgrounds. The motion suggests that the state and local governments should actively encourage participation in preschool among children from families who may not traditionally engage with these services.

title: Likställ olika former av turistboenden
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of the ferry traffic between Gotland and the mainland for the economic growth and development of the region. It calls for the integration of Gotland traffic into the national infrastructure plan, ensuring it is treated similarly to other critical transport routes. The motion highlights the need for reliable and cost-effective ferry services throughout the year, adapting operations to seasonal fluctuations and demand from both passengers and freight. It stresses that the state should clarify its responsibilities in maintaining these transport links and ensuring fair pricing amid recent sharp increases in travel costs due to external factors such as the war in Ukraine.

title: En kropp, en försäkring
summary: The motion proposes to investigate changes in Swedish legislation to improve the economic conditions for the production and consumption of renewable energy through cooperatives. It emphasizes that collective efforts in solar and wind energy initiatives could enhance local energy production and foster greater public interest and investment in renewable energy.

title: Ett starkare Norden
summary: The proposal seeks to establish a requirement for individuals in public trust positions, such as elected officials and high-ranking civil servants, to disclose their membership in fraternal and secret societies. The motion argues that transparency is necessary due to the often secretive nature of these organizations, which may involve powerful elites operating outside public scrutiny.

title: En strategi för mobiltäckning
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports a motion for the government to consider establishing a memorial for the victims of the Srebrenica genocide and the Balkan wars. This motion highlights the historical context of the conflicts in the 1990s, their impact on Sweden, and the need for remembrance and reconciliation as part of the healing process for affected families and communities.

title: Upprustning av länsväg 131 mellan Österbymo och Tranås
summary: The suggestion advocates for maintaining the current form of local veto powers concerning nuclear technology issues in Sweden. It argues that such powers are crucial for ensuring democratic support, safety, and effective electricity supply, emphasizing that local engagement has historically supported the country's nuclear industry and energy stability. The motion expresses concern over potential governmental changes to the veto and calls for political consensus to sustain local involvement in energy policy.

title: Skydda personnummer
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen the labor market for young people in Västsverige by addressing high youth unemployment and creating better job conditions. It emphasizes the importance of education, especially focusing on skills for shortage occupations, and suggests increased collaboration between municipalities and local businesses to facilitate meaningful employment. Furthermore, the motion advocates for improved labor conditions, fair wages, and support systems to combat insecurity and promote young people's integration into the labor market.

title: Nordiskt skatteavtal
summary: The proposal seeks to establish an investigation to adapt ADHD assessments based on gender and age to improve the diagnosis and support for individuals with ADHD, specifically addressing the disparities in diagnosis rates between boys and girls. The motion emphasizes the need for tailored diagnostic methods to ensure that all young people, regardless of gender, receive appropriate support within educational and healthcare systems.

title: Enskilda vägar
summary: The motion proposes setting a target for the installation of one million electric vehicle charging stations by 2030 in order to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions and promote the use of electric cars. It emphasizes the necessity of robust charging infrastructure to support the growing electric vehicle market and draws a parallel with the ambitious housing goals from the 1960s, urging the government to take swift action to facilitate this development.

title: Vård för marginaliserade grupper
summary: The motion advocates for state guarantees to upgrade the Inlandsbanan railway in Sweden, highlighting its historical importance for transportation and its potential as a sustainable transport corridor. It emphasizes the need for environmentally friendly solutions, such as hydrogen-fueled trains, to support local industries and meet climate goals. The proposal aims to create new job opportunities and enhance railway capacity while advocating for a more efficient decision-making process for infrastructure investments.

title: Ordning och reda på arbetsmarknaden
summary: The proposal advocates for the protection of cows' right to pasture and outdoor access, emphasizing its importance for animal welfare in the Swedish dairy industry. It highlights that outdoor grazing promotes biodiversity and improves the health of cows compared to confinement settings, which can negatively affect their well-being. The motion calls for strengthening the rights for young bulls to graze outdoors and argues that maintaining pasture rights is essential for sustainable agriculture and consumer support for Swedish food products.

title: Viltstängsel i Kalmar län
summary: The motion suggests that Sweden should support the strong implementation of ecosystem-based marine management, which considers how species within an ecosystem interact and emphasizes sustainable use and conservation. It highlights the importance of achieving balance in marine ecosystems to enhance resilience against climate change and other challenges, and calls for Sweden to champion this approach both domestically and within the EU.

title: Sveriges ställningstagande beträffande orsaken till Dag Hammarskjölds död
Tillkännage mottagare av Litteraturpriset till Astrid Lindgrens minne (ALMA) i Astrid Lindgrens stad Vimmerby
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports a transition towards a more plant-based food production system aimed at combating climate change, creating green jobs, and increasing self-sufficiency in food production. It advocates for the Swedish Board of Agriculture to investigate how to foster this change and for governmental support to assist farmers and food companies in adopting more sustainable practices. Additionally, the motion highlights the importance of a plant-based sector in achieving national food strategy goals and reducing climate impact.

title: Inrätta en nationell Astrid Lindgren-dag
summary: The proposal suggests establishing an annual rotating political and democracy week that moves between different municipalities in Sweden, aiming to improve political communication and representation. Critics of the current Almedalen Week argue that it has become a platform for lobbyists and large corporations, thus excluding smaller organizations and limiting diverse participation. The motion seeks to restore the original intent of Almedalen as a space for inclusive political discourse accessible to all citizens.

title: Underlätta kommunernas hantering av övergivna hus
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament study the feasibility of redirecting commercial shipping routes away from sensitive areas in the Baltic Sea, due to the environmental impact of ship noise and pollution, which threatens local wildlife, particularly the endangered harbor porpoise.

title: Fossilfri järnvägstrafik på Stångådalsbanan och Tjustbanan
summary: The suggestion calls for the Swedish Parliament to consider a national action plan for plant-based food, recognizing the growing demand for vegetarian and vegan diets. It emphasizes the potential for the Swedish agricultural sector to capture significant market shares and proposes measures to stimulate both private and public markets, enhance consumer knowledge, and promote sustainability in food production. The plan should involve collaboration among producers, businesses, consumer organizations, and authorities, with specific proposals including goals for protein crop cultivation, increased funding for plant breeding, and targeted investments in innovative agricultural technologies.

title: Bättre förutsättningar för att bevara, använda och utveckla det motorhistoriska kulturarvet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:424 av Per Lodenius och Per Åsling (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for the maintenance of a cost-free and efficient approval process for animal barns in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of this process in ensuring animal welfare and preventing construction errors. The proposal argues that eliminating the pre-approval may lead to decreased animal protection, compromised working conditions, and increased costs due to potential corrections in construction flaws. A study from SLU indicates that animal owners generally support the current pre-approval process.

title: Sänkt dansmoms
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:423 av Per Lodenius och Johanna Jönsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for equitable access to technological aids for diabetes care in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of devices such as insulin pumps and glucose monitors in managing diabetes effectively. It highlights the need for improved investment by regional authorities and the state to ensure that all individuals with diabetes receive the necessary resources for better health outcomes, which could also reduce long-term healthcare costs associated with diabetes complications.

title: Hjälpmedel för personer med funktionsnedsättning
summary: This proposal emphasizes the need for a coordinating function among government agencies to address issues related to confidentiality that hinder collaboration. It highlights the challenges faced by individuals caught between agencies like Försäkringskassan and Arbetsförmedlingen, resulting in delays in receiving support that could lead to employment or education. The motion calls for innovative solutions to improve cooperation and ensure individuals are not overlooked due to bureaucratic barriers.

title: Eget företagande för personer med funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes to consider implementing free school breakfasts in Sweden, highlighting the issue of children going hungry due to high food prices and economic difficulties faced by families. It argues that adequate nutrition is essential for children's concentration and performance in school, particularly noting an increase in demand for school meals on Mondays and Fridays when children may not have had sufficient food at home.

title: Mobila mammografienheter
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of legislating mandatory rear-facing car travel for young children up to the age of four in order to enhance their safety during car journeys. The motion highlights the risks associated with improper use of child car seats and emphasizes research showing that rear-facing seats significantly reduce the risk of injury in the event of a collision. The initiator argues that it is essential for the government to ensure that children traveling in vehicles do so safely.

title: Bredband i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:419 av Martina Johansson och Niels Paarup-Petersen (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for a revision of the Public Procurement Act (LOU) to allow requirements for collective agreements during public procurement. It stresses the need to combat increasing labor crime within public sector contracts and ensure that taxpayer money is allocated to companies that adhere to legal and fair labor practices. The motion calls for Sweden to actively push for changes in EU legislation to permit member states to implement collective agreement requirements, ensuring fair working conditions and equal treatment for all employees in the supply chain.

title: Internationella adoptioner
summary: Motionen föreslår att riksdagen överväger att avskaffa preskriptionstiden för fängelsestraff för att säkerställa att dömda personer inte kan undkomma sina straff genom att undanhålla sig från myndigheterna. Det framhålls att preskriptionstider motverkar rättssystemets syfte att upprätthålla rättvisa och ansvarighet, särskilt för allvarliga brott, och att argumentet för att bibehålla preskriptionen som skydd mot överdriven statlig makt behöver omvärderas när det gäller fängelsestraff. Det påpekas också att ett sådant förslag skulle kräva en noggrann granskning av rättsliga och konstitutionella aspekter.

title: Fast förbindelse mellan Helsingborg och Helsingör
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:417 av Jonny Cato och Niels Paarup-Petersen (båda C)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament conduct a review of unjustified disparities in healthcare access and outcomes across the country, aiming to identify solutions to increase equality in healthcare services. It highlights that factors such as socio-economic status, geography, education, and ethnicity contribute to unequal healthcare experiences and outcomes, and emphasizes the need for a reform policy that ensures equitable health conditions for all citizens.

title: Gör Öresund till biosfärområde
summary: The motion advocates for the consideration of expanding defense activities in Strängnäs, given the changing geopolitical landscape and increased aggression from Russia. With Sweden's application for NATO membership and a political consensus on boosting defense spending, the proposal emphasizes the need to quickly and cost-effectively enhance Sweden's defense capabilities by possibly reinstating a military regiment in Strängnäs, leveraging its historical military significance and existing resources.

title: En fungerande arbetsmarknad i hela Öresundsområdet
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of additional control stations for heavy vehicles in Södermanland County to enhance traffic safety and working conditions. As the demand for freight transport grows with population increases, the need for effective monitoring of heavy trucks becomes critical to prevent issues such as overloading and non-compliance with driving regulations. The suggestion emphasizes the importance of geographical distribution of control points to meet Sweden's traffic safety goals and to facilitate more stringent vehicle inspections by authorities.

title: Gör Sveriges städer roligare
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of public service media in Sweden for maintaining a well-functioning democracy. It highlights the necessity for public service broadcasters to operate independently and provide a diverse range of programming to engage citizens. The proposal calls for a robust public service that can adapt to the changing media landscape and reinforces democratic values amid increasing disinformation. It suggests that strong public service media are beneficial for both citizens and the commercial media landscape.

title: Bygg fler broar och färre hinder i Öresundsregionen
summary: The motion highlights the need for the Swedish Public Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen) to maintain a presence in every municipality across the country. It emphasizes that many individuals, especially in rural and sparsely populated areas, feel neglected as public services disappear, and stresses the importance of local knowledge in addressing unemployment and the skills gap faced by businesses. The proposal urges the government to ensure that the Employment Service is available in all municipalities and to improve collaboration with local and regional stakeholders.

title: Staten måste bidra till utgrävningen i Uppåkra
summary: The proposal advocates for establishing a standardized care process for women who are victims of violence in intimate relationships, emphasizing the need for a cohesive and uniform support system across the country. The motion highlights the widespread nature of domestic violence and its impacts on victims and their children, arguing for increased responsiveness from healthcare providers and a consistent approach to care that includes safe housing, child welfare, and connection with social services and law enforcement. The aim is to ensure that all regions provide similar levels of protection and support for victims, thus addressing the disparities in current systems.

title: Upphandling och offentliga inköp under EU:s tröskelvärde
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament study the feasibility of replacing Bromma Airport with Skavsta Airport in the infrastructure planning. It calls for the national aviation strategy to highlight the significance of Skavsta and urges an acceleration in the development of alternative aviation fuels. The authors argue that Skavsta, located further south, can improve flight connections to the continent and reduce congestion in Stockholm while also serving as a pilot site for electric flights and alternative fuels. Additionally, they suggest that the repurposing of Bromma’s land for housing is necessary as it obstructs other developments.

title: Sanering av Östersjön
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports efforts for a secure energy supply through improved coordination, addressing the local challenges related to electricity supply on a national level. It emphasizes the ongoing need for reliable infrastructure investments and regulatory frameworks to facilitate the transition to sustainable energy sources, particularly in light of increased demand from industries like SSAB's new fossil-free steel production process. The motion underscores the importance of a holistic approach to energy management involving both regional and national coordination to ensure future growth and employment.

title: För ett tryggare Malmö och Sverige
summary: The proposal advocates for a faster and more efficient permitting process in Sweden, particularly to facilitate the green transition of the steel industry, exemplified by SSAB's adoption of the Hybrit technology, which allows for steel production without fossil fuels. The suggestion emphasizes the need for prioritization in new energy infrastructure, specifically new power lines, to support these advancements, thereby enabling significant reductions in carbon emissions and contributing to national climate goals.

title: Statlig kontrollstyrka mot livsmedelsfusk
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to enhance efforts and knowledge gathering concerning suicide prevention within public authorities. It advocates for increased support for organizations dedicated to suicide prevention and calls for proactive measures in mental health interventions, highlighting the urgent need to address the growing suicide rates among youth and older individuals.

title: Införande av lex Ahmed för polisen
summary: The suggestion advocates for a comprehensive review of the housing situation for students in Sweden, addressing the significant shortage of affordable student housing. It proposes the reintroduction of investment support, the establishment of a state-owned housing company, and measures to counter market-driven rents, with the aim of ensuring that students can afford decent housing without having to compromise their studies.

title: Gör avsättningar till en periodiseringsfond sjukpenninggrundande
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider making free school lunches mandatory for all gymnasieskolor (upper secondary schools). It argues that free lunches are essential for students to focus and perform well in school, and highlights the connection between education, food insecurity, and youth involvement in crime. The motion emphasizes that many families are struggling with rising food prices, making it important to provide free meals to support students' well-being and educational outcomes.

title: Öresundsmetro
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:405 av Niels Paarup-Petersen och Jonny Cato (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that all students have the right to access textbooks, which should be incorporated into the education legislation. It emphasizes the importance of providing equal opportunities for students to succeed in school, especially considering the shift from printed to digital reading materials. The motion argues that not all students have equal access to technology and that physical textbooks can enhance reading comprehension, thus advocating for legislative changes to ensure equitable access to educational resources.

title: Hyressättning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:404 av Momodou Malcolm Jallow m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national digital infrastructure for healthcare and elder care in Sweden, addressing the increasing demand for services due to a growing population of elderly individuals.
