title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:185 Riksrevisionens rapport om samverkansprogram och strategiska innovationsprogram
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen efforts against invasive species, such as the Spanish slug and Canada geese, which threaten Sweden's ecosystems and economy. The motion highlights the increasing number of invasive species due to global trade, travel, and transportation, and calls for a more coordinated approach at both municipal and national levels to combat these threats, increasing public awareness and involvement in the process.

title: Folkmordet 1915
summary: The motion proposes a review of the year-end billing issue related to the green tax deduction in order to simplify the process. It highlights the increased demand for green technology installations, such as solar cells and charging stations, which is impacted by current tax regulations that only allow deductions for payments made in the year the installation is completed. This situation poses challenges to both customers and installers regarding payment timing and financial security, particularly when installations span over the year's end. The motion suggests that adjustments are necessary to prevent economic downturns in the industry during December.

title: Förmånsbeskattning av utrustning som kan användas privat
summary: The motion proposes to expand the requirements for transparency regarding the financing of political parties to include elected parties at local and regional levels. It emphasizes the importance of citizen insight into funding sources, arguing that current laws only apply nationally and that local parties are becoming more prominent without sufficient oversight. The motion calls for a review and potential amendment of the legislation to enhance transparency and prevent undue influence from questionable financial donations.

title: Förtydligande i vapenlagen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:270 av Per Söderlund och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests implementing a 'blue tax deduction' to incentivize citizens to invest in water-saving technologies in response to the growing issue of water scarcity in Sweden. The motion argues that as water shortages become increasingly common across various regions in Sweden, measures to promote sustainable water use must be introduced. By allowing tax deductions for the purchase of water-saving technologies, similar to existing deductions for energy-saving technologies, the motion aims to encourage citizens to reduce water consumption and mitigate the impact of climate change.

title: Rättshjälp vid tvist gentemot det allmänna
summary: The proposal suggests abolishing the right to anonymous party donations for smaller amounts and disallowing separate fundraising organizations, in response to recent revelations of violations of existing party finance regulations. It emphasizes the need for increased transparency in Sweden's democracy, as evidence has shown that several parties were willing to circumvent the laws regarding party donations. The motion highlights the importance of eliminating avenues for anonymous contributions to prevent corruption and ensure accountability in political financing.

title: Vargfrågor
summary: The motion proposes to expand the travel ban in Sweden to encompass all forms of honor-related abductions of children and young people abroad. It calls for improved implementation and management of the travel ban, an investigation into the support needs of siblings in cases of abduction, the confiscation of all types of travel documents, and the establishment of a national reporting system for such abductions. Additionally, it suggests creating a support package for individuals returning to Sweden after an abduction, addressing gaps in current support systems for victims.

title: Vildsvinsjakt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:267 av Per Söderlund och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the health and social effects of cannabis legalization in neighboring countries, noting that various nations in Europe and North America have begun to legalize cannabis. The motion emphasizes the potential impact on Sweden, including possible increases in cannabis use among Swedish citizens who may travel to these countries, and highlights the importance of understanding how these legal changes affect crime rates, state revenue, and public health. It calls for the government to task relevant authorities with monitoring these developments to inform future Swedish drug policy.

title: Antibiotikaresistens
summary: The motion proposes allowing Systembolaget to sell alcoholic products such as 'alkoglass' and chilled beverages. It argues that current Swedish alcohol policy is inconsistent and inadequate, particularly regarding products that resemble alcoholic drinks but do not fall under existing regulations. The motion emphasizes the need for a more equitable approach to alcohol sales, suggesting that liberalization would enhance societal enjoyment for adults, while criticizing the current moralistic stance as overregulation.

title: Förenklade regler för nystartade företag
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:265 av Alexander Christiansson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to simplify regulations surrounding the rental of accessory apartments in Sweden. It argues that many municipalities face housing shortages and highlights the existing tax deduction that allows for tax-exempt rental income up to a certain level. The current requirement that owners must reside in accessory apartments for part of the year creates challenges, as it may lead owners to engage in illegal long-term rentals or disrupt tenant stability. The proposal seeks to remove this residency requirement for non-commercial rentals, thereby facilitating easier rental processes.

title: Professionalisering och samordning av äldreomsorgen
summary: The proposal advocates for the opening of public data by government agencies through licenses like Creative Commons, arguing that this would foster innovation, new business ideas, and job creation. It highlights the potential benefits to research and sustainable consumption by making non-sensitive data more accessible to the public, while ensuring that sensitive information remains protected.

title: Romansbedrägerier
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:263 av Alexander Christiansson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of unrestricted speed limits for electric vehicles and other climate bonus cars in Sweden, similar to the practices on Germany's Autobahn. It emphasizes the need for more incentives for electric vehicle ownership due to a notable decline in sales following the government's removal of prior economic support. The proposal argues that allowing higher speeds could improve road safety through increased sales of newer, safer vehicles.

title: Licens på enhandsvapen för jägare
summary: The proposal suggests establishing a registry for recreational boats, implementing producer responsibility for these boats, and including them in the lost property law, to address the environmental concerns posed by abandoned and aging boats in Sweden. The measures aim to facilitate the recycling and return of boats to their rightful owners while preventing marine pollution caused by deteriorating vessels.

title: Utöka patronkapaciteten i halvautomatiska hagelvapen
summary: The motion proposes a review of the legislation concerning drone usage and dissemination permits, arguing that current regulations create unnecessary hurdles for public and commercial activities, as well as for emergency services. It highlights how long waiting times for permit approvals can hinder news photography, data analysis for urban planning, and timely responses in emergencies. The motion suggests that the law should focus on the content being filmed, rather than the method of filming, to better accommodate technological advancements and operational needs.

title: Ökat nationellt stöd för elever med diagnosen dyslexi
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider adjusting fixed sums in legislation and practice to account for inflation. It calls for changing certain fixed monetary fines for traffic offenses to daily fines, arguing that current fixed amounts disproportionately affect lower-income individuals and become less significant over time due to inflation. The motion emphasizes the need for fairness in financial penalties and regulatory burdens on businesses by automatically adjusting thresholds to reflect current monetary value.

title: Överlåt beslut om skyddsjakt på varg till berörd kommun och polis
summary: The motion proposes an expansion of the mineral law in Sweden to include geothermal fields and geothermal water, aiming to facilitate the development of geothermal energy production. This change is motivated by the high costs of exploration and drilling, which currently deter investments due to the absence of legal protections for these resources. The motion also emphasizes the necessity for a unified legal framework to enhance stakeholder rights in geothermal energy, while ensuring that small-scale ground source heat applications remain unaffected.

title: Åtgärder för trygghet i utsatta områden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament task Trafikverket, in cooperation with Inlandsbanan AB and local businesses, to assess the future role of Inlandsbanan with Swedish standard integration and connectivity to the railway network. It emphasizes addressing urgent capacity shortages in the railway system, fostering job growth and business expansion in inland areas, and contributing to global climate goals through improved and efficient freight transport. The motion also highlights the strategic importance of Inlandsbanan for transporting forest resources and minerals, improving competitiveness, and enhancing national defense capabilities by facilitating transportation in the country's interior.

title: Irak
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a proportionality principle for environmental permit processes in Sweden. It argues that many permit applications are rejected by courts due to minor formalities, which leads to unnecessary delays and increased costs for businesses. The motion calls for a system where minor errors do not derail entire applications, thereby streamlining the permitting process and reducing bureaucratic backlog.

title: Dawit Isaak
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament (Riksdag) review the opportunities for altered taxation of microbreweries to support the growth of small-scale alcohol production in Sweden. The authors argue that a lower alcohol tax on beer produced by independent small breweries would enhance competitiveness and bolster local businesses, particularly in rural areas. They reference EU provisions that allow for reduced alcohol taxes for small producers and cite examples from other EU countries where such measures have positively impacted local markets.

title: Tibet
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the conditions for mountain rescuers in Sweden by advocating for tax deductions for their expenses and increased support for their operations. With the growing interest in hiking leading to higher demand for rescue services, the motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring better working conditions and support for these voluntary rescuers, who often bear significant costs for their equipment and operations in challenging weather conditions.

title: Religionsfrihet och förföljelse av kristna
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:254 av Désirée Pethrus och Robert Halef (båda KD)
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should direct the government to investigate the possibility of establishing a clothing allowance for preschool staff. The motivation behind this is the high personal costs for work clothes faced by preschool employees due to the demanding nature of their work, which requires durable and weather-resistant apparel suitable for both indoor and outdoor activities. By introducing a clothing allowance, it is argued that personnel could better manage their costs and also set a positive example for children in terms of appropriate clothing choices.

title: En ny förbindelse som alternativ till motorvägsbron i Södertälje
summary: The proposal suggests implementing a speed limit of 30 km/h near preschools to enhance the safety of children. Currently, there is no specific law setting this limit, although there are general rules for vehicle speeds in the vicinity of children. The motion emphasizes the need for legislative action to reduce traffic fatalities among children, which average about 30 per year, and aligns with Sweden's long-term vision of achieving zero traffic deaths.

title: Afrika
summary: The proposal suggests that tips should be exempt from being classified as taxable income, arguing that tips are gifts given by customers in appreciation for service rather than wages. It highlights the inconsistency in current taxation policies regarding tips, noting that while tips are treated as income for tax purposes, they are not considered pensionable income or subject to VAT. The motion aims to alleviate the financial burden on service workers by eliminating taxes on tips, which are perceived as small gifts from patrons.

title: En högskola anpassad för studenter med funktionsnedsättning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:251 av Ilona Szatmari Waldau m.fl. (V)
summary: Michael Rubbestad from the Sweden Democrats proposes that the government should investigate and ultimately reduce the costs associated with starting and operating a business, citing the increasing financial burdens that small business owners face despite improvements in the ease of starting a company.

title: En politik för att möta coronapandemins globala effekter
summary: The proposal suggests enabling individuals to start businesses with only one owner by revising existing regulations, thus allowing for more corporate structures beyond sole proprietorships. The current law limits options for solo entrepreneurs, as they can only register as sole proprietorships unless they have a partner for other types of companies. The aim is to facilitate entrepreneurial endeavors and offer individuals a way to separate their personal and business finances.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:188 Sveriges genomförande av Agenda 2030
summary: The proposal suggests simplifying the voluntary liquidation of financially healthy limited companies in Sweden, arguing that while starting a business has become easier, the process of dissolving a well-functioning company is currently complicated and costly. The motion calls for the government to review and implement measures that would make this process less complex and more affordable.

title: Möjlighet att ersätta färjor med bro
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should implement a mandatory acceptance of imported cans and bottles at all recycling stations and machines, regardless of whether consumers receive a deposit. This is aimed at reducing waste and encouraging recycling of containers that are currently often discarded in household trash or the environment due to limited acceptance in the existing deposit system.

title: Rättvisare folkräkning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:247 av Fredrik Christensson och Peter Helander (båda C)
summary: The proposal aims to legally equate animals with dependent humans to ensure stronger penalties for crimes against animals in Sweden. It argues that current penalties for animal abuse are insufficient, comparing them unfavorably to penalties for property damage. By recognizing animals as living beings with rights similar to those of children or care recipients, the motion seeks to impose harsher consequences for offenders.

title: Möjligheten att dela kommunalskatten mellan flera kommuner
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a deposit system for ink cartridges, similar to existing systems for plastic and metal beverage containers. It aims to encourage users to return used cartridges for refilling or environmentally friendly disposal, thereby promoting recycling and waste reduction.

title: Allemansrätten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:245 av Peter Helander och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament prohibits the sale of feathers made from bird down in order to reduce demand and prevent the unethical practice of plucking feathers from live birds. The motion highlights the challenges consumers face in identifying whether feathers come from live or slaughtered birds, and points to the ongoing animal welfare concerns associated with such practices, which contradict EU directives.

title: Innovationsvänlig lagstiftning
summary: The motion proposes an amendment to the municipal law allowing local councils to regulate speaking times and the number of contributions in debates, making them binding provided there is a unanimous decision within the council. The aim is to promote efficient discussions while preserving democratic rights and the ability of elected representatives to participate in debates.

title: Bättre förutsättningar för det kustnära yrkesfisket
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:243 av Fredrik Christensson och Sofia Nilsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal calls for an investigation into the provisions of the Local Government Act (2017:725) concerning accountability and remarks, highlighting concerns about potential misuse of the current legislation by majority opposition to deny accountability without substantive grounds. It suggests that while the ability to direct remarks should remain for transparency and democracy, the law needs to be revised to prevent misuse, particularly in the context of increasing minority governance in Swedish municipalities.

title: Driftsstöd till icke-statliga flygplatser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament restrict inappropriate language usage in radio and television broadcasts, highlighting the need to protect minors from exposure to strong language. It suggests that broadcasting licenses should include conditions that prohibit the use of profanity and harsh gendered language, ensuring that content is suitable for audiences of all ages.

title: Politisk åsikt som diskrimineringsgrund i svensk diskrimineringslagstiftning
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to investigate the possibility of implementing a ban on screens in public swimming facilities due to increasing incidents of parents being distracted by their mobile devices, which in some cases has led to dangerous situations, including near-drowning events involving children. The motion highlights the growing concern among facility staff about parental negligence attributed to screen usage and the need to enhance safety measures to prevent accidents. Additionally, it addresses privacy concerns related to unauthorized photography and filming at these venues.

title: Regelverk om tillåtet antal folkbokförda i en och samma bostad
summary: The proposal seeks to prohibit the issuance of parking tickets and control fees for emergency vehicles, such as police cars, ambulances, and fire trucks, while they are responding to emergencies. The motion argues that existing regulations unjustly require these vehicles to pay for parking, even during urgent operations, and it calls for changes to the applicable laws to prevent this situation.

title: Skyldighet för mobil- och teleoperatörer att samverka med rättsvårdande myndigheter
summary: The proposal suggests that parking for individuals with disabilities who hold a permit should be free of charge across all municipalities in Sweden. It highlights the current inconsistencies in parking fees set by different municipalities, which causes confusion for permit holders who travel between areas with varying regulations. The motion aims to standardize these rules to improve accessibility for individuals with disabilities.

title: Välfärdspengar
summary: This motion proposes to simplify the process of trademark registration for business names in Sweden by allowing sole proprietors to protect their business name across all counties without the additional fees currently imposed for registering in multiple counties. The motion suggests that the government should consider national registration or waive the fees for applications made in different counties to adapt to modern business practices, where entrepreneurs often operate beyond their local regions.

title: Orimliga konsekvenser för företag
summary: The proposal aims to make it mandatory for PET-type juice bottles to be included in Sweden's deposit return system, which is expected to enhance recycling efforts and reduce littering in the environment. This follows a successful voluntary adoption by major retailers and aims to further integrate such packaging into the existing recycling framework.

title: Insatser för äldre hemlösa
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate a new cost model for veterinary care to ensure that pet owners are not deterred from seeking necessary medical treatment for their animals due to high costs. It highlights the disparity in veterinary expenses and the financial burden placed on animal owners, especially in severe medical cases, and aims to promote equitable access to veterinary services to prevent unnecessary euthanasia of pets.

title: Folklig granskning inför ratificering av internationella avtal
summary: The suggestion proposes a revision of the Animal Welfare Act (2018:1192) to reduce the number of unnecessary euthanasias of animals. The proposal is prompted by a case where eight cats were euthanized by the regional veterinary authority despite public interest in their care, suggesting that the current legislation may lead to unjustified animal deaths. The motion seeks to ensure that alternative solutions are considered before any decision to euthanize is made.

title: Former för att säkerställa medborgarnas informerade och fria åsikter vid folkomröstning
summary: The suggestion proposes amending the law (1992:339) on proportional representation to allow for by-elections, enabling parties to fill vacant positions if elected officials resign or vacate their roles for other reasons. This change aims to ensure that parties are not excluded from representation in municipal committees when other parties collaborate electorally and secure all committee positions.

title: Färdigställande av riksväg 40 till dubbelfilig väg
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government investigate the possibility of 'donating' forgotten historical buildings, similar to an initiative by the Italian state, to encourage their renovation and transformation into tourist facilities. The aim is to preserve cultural heritage and make these buildings accessible to both domestic and foreign tourists, thereby revitalizing areas that currently suffer from neglect.

title: Förfarande för faktagranskning av EU-domstolens underlag
summary: The suggestion proposes amending the Swedish weapons law to ease restrictions on the possession and use of pepper spray, currently categorized similarly to firearms. The motion advocates for the introduction of a training and certification requirement, as well as traceability measures for pepper spray, to minimize potential misuse while acknowledging its potential use as self-defense against violent attacks.

title: Möjliggöra återinträde i akademisk forskning
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a dedicated day to honor the personnel working in emergency services, known as 'blåljuspersonal' (blue light personnel), including police, healthcare, and fire services. The motion aims to raise awareness and oppose the recent increase in attacks and violence against these workers, advocating for recognition and respect towards their critical roles in society.

title: Semestervecka på landet för barnfamiljer
summary: The motion proposes that the law on direct advertising should be amended to require active consent from individuals to receive such advertising, shifting the burden from individuals needing to opt-out to an opt-in system. This change aims to reduce unwanted paper waste and promote environmental sustainability by ensuring that only those who explicitly agree to receive advertising will do so.

title: Öka demokratin genom att underlätta folkinitiativ
summary: The motion proposes to amend the legislation to make it illegal for private individuals to photograph or film accident sites, citing the growing issue of bystanders taking images during emergencies. It highlights the emotional impact on victims' families and encourages respect for accident scenes.

title: Översyn av färdtjänsten
summary: This motion proposes a revision of the Swedish law (2006:412) on public water services to alleviate obstacles for housing construction in rural and sparsely populated areas. It argues that the current legislation imposes significant financial risks on municipalities by mandating them to provide water and sewage services, often leading to forced connections to municipal systems and increased costs for residents. The motion advocates for a shift in responsibility and planning requirements, aiming to support sustainable growth in rural communities while ensuring access to clean water.

title: Förenklade delgivningsregler
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into establishing a ferry connection between Skokloster and Knivsta in Uppsala County, aimed at enhancing transportation, boosting local commerce, and facilitating tourism around Skokloster Castle. The initiative is seen as beneficial for the local population and the broader community, reducing travel distances to key destinations, thus promoting development in the area.

title: Förutsättningar för Sveriges fortsatta roll som kunskapsnation
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:226 av Staffan Eklöf och Mats Nordberg (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for the responsibility of assessing species occurrences in forests to be placed on the state rather than individual forest owners, emphasizing the need for clarity regarding the investigative duties of authorities like the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency and the Swedish Forest Agency, especially in light of recent changes to the species protection regulations that have placed a financial and logistical burden on forest owners.

title: Förändrad rättsprocess för att bekämpa organiserad brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive upgrade and investment in Sweden's transmission grid, emphasizing the need for infrastructure development to support future energy demands, particularly in northern regions. It also advocates for halving the permit processing times to facilitate quicker investments and job creation in local communities, particularly in Robertsfors, which is anticipating substantial industrial growth. The motion calls on the government to prioritize these improvements and address current bottlenecks in the energy network to attract new businesses.

title: Kostnader för folkinitiativ
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government expedite the financing and development of the Norrbotniabanan railway project, emphasizing its importance for enhancing transport infrastructure in northern Sweden, stimulating job creation, and supporting regional economic growth. It suggests that the government should explore funding solutions, including potential loans and partnerships with Norrbotniabanan AB and Trafikverket to ensure timely completion of the railway, which is designated as a vital link in Europe’s transport network.

title: Utövningen av reglerna om yttrandefrihet
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of an action plan for plant-based foods in Sweden, highlighting the importance of sustainable agriculture for climate-smart food production. It argues that increasing focus on plant-based foods can enhance food production efficiency, respond to consumer demand, and support biodiversity. The action plan aims to align Sweden's agricultural policies with evolving food strategies at the EU level and promote public health and environmental sustainability.

title: Ta bort vistelsetid i Sverige som hinder för utvisning på grund av brott
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish National Agency for Education (Skolverket) should be tasked with promoting outdoor education and activities within schools, with specific emphasis on reinstating outdoor education days and improving physical activity among students. The motion highlights the concerning decrease in outdoor education and the increase in sedentary behavior and mental health issues among children and youth, advocating for a stronger incorporation of physical activity and nature-based learning into school curricula to enhance students' well-being and educational outcomes.

title: Ändringar i lagen (1995:831) om transplantation m.m.
summary: The motion proposes to revise the congestion tax system in Sweden, suggesting that if multiple charges occur within a defined time frame due to wrong turns or quick re-entries at toll stations, these should be considered as a single passage to minimize unnecessarily high costs for motorists.

title: Bindande beslut i Allmänna reklamationsnämnden
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament supports an investigation into the implementation of average speed cameras, which would measure vehicle speed over a distance between multiple cameras. This system aims to deter drivers from temporarily reducing speed when passing traditional cameras and to enhance traffic safety by reducing speeding-related accidents, as evidenced by successful implementations in other countries that have shown significant reductions in traffic incidents and fatalities.

title: Straff för brott kopplade till gängrelaterad brottslighet
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament supports the elimination of VAT (moms) for DJ performances and advocates for reducing the VAT on dance events to 6%. Currently, DJs must charge 25% VAT on their fees, whereas performers like singers and musicians can be VAT-exempt under certain conditions. The motion argues that this creates an unfair system, as DJs, who present copyright-protected works to an audience, should also be recognized as performing artists and be exempt from VAT. Furthermore, the motion claims that the VAT charges for event organizers are unreasonable and should be standardized at 6% for dance events.

title: Höständringsbudget för 2020
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of issuing temporary parking permits for individuals with disabilities. The motion highlights scenarios such as a person recovering from an accident or a pregnant woman facing mobility challenges who may require a temporary permit while their applications for permanent permits are processed. It calls for a swift approach to provide these permits in situations where mobility limitations are temporary or pending bureaucratic processing.

title: Budgetpropositionen för 2021
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should revisit its negotiation with the EU regarding the management of wildlife conservation, specifically advocating for the reinstatement of a model where the Swedish Hunter's Association receives funding to manage hunting and wildlife conservation activities. The authors argue that the previous government's decision to tender these responsibilities undermines a well-functioning system and that jägare's own contributions should not be subject to competitive bidding, as this leads to potential funding of organizations opposing hunting.

title: Statligt ansvar för en reservhamn i Gotlandstrafiken
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden must take a more active stance against the increasing global power of the Chinese Communist Party, urging the government to recognize the threat posed by China's actions both domestically and internationally. It emphasizes the need for democratic countries to uphold human rights and promote a free international order while highlighting China's oppressive regime and ongoing cyber threats to Sweden's infrastructure.

title: Rättssäkerhet vid demenssjukdom
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of implementing register checks on individuals who have direct and regular contact with persons with intellectual disabilities. This aims to enhance safety within community organizations by extending current legislation regarding background checks, which currently only applies to those working with children, to also include vulnerable adults with intellectual disabilities to prevent exploitation and abuse.

title: Breddade kriterier för Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: The Center Party proposes that the Swedish Parliament follow up in one year on the effectiveness of newly granted police powers aimed at clarifying identities during internal immigration checks. They emphasize that any measures to increase the return of individuals without legal residency in Sweden must be proportional and respectful of individual rights. The party acknowledges the need for such powers, like body searches and luggage inspections, while remaining cautious of their implications on privacy, and insists on considering the perspectives of children in the evaluation process.

title: Artskyddsförordningen
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive investigation into economic violence against women, suggesting the establishment of a national debt register and the review of enforcement regulations to safeguard victims from the impacts of male violence. Additionally, it recommends changes to debt restructuring laws and requirements for in-person meetings for credit granting in suspected cases of economic abuse, as well as advocating for better handling of asset distribution during separations involving economic violence.

title: Gammalsvenskby
summary: The proposal calls for increased prioritization and resources for the care of runestones in Sweden, recognizing their significance as historical and linguistic artifacts. It emphasizes the urgent need for restoration efforts, as many runestones are currently in poor condition and often lack proper maintenance and scientific examination. The motion requests the government to investigate long-term strategies for ensuring adequate funding and responsibility distribution among relevant actors to improve the scientific quality and sustainability of runestone preservation.

title: Plan för Gotlands infrastruktur
summary: The proposal advocates for increased research funding on artificial wombs to enhance reproductive freedom and control for individuals capable of bearing children. It argues that such technology can alleviate the physical burdens of pregnancy, promote equality in parenting responsibilities, and improve access to reproductive healthcare for those unable to conceive naturally due to medical reasons. The motion emphasizes the feminist perspective by challenging traditional gender roles and societal norms surrounding pregnancy and parenthood, aiming for a more equitable society.

title: Slopande av rökförbud på uteserveringar
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish state to adopt a worldview-open foundation, ensuring equal treatment for religious communities and belief societies, thus promoting freedom of expression and enhancing secularism in the country. It emphasizes the necessity for the state to embrace a variety of beliefs to foster a diverse society while safeguarding democracy and religious freedom.

title: Utökad kontroll vid ansökan om personlig konkurs
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the examination of conditions for improved railway connections between Stockholm and Oslo. The aim is to make train travel more competitive by reducing travel time to under three hours, thereby encouraging more passengers to choose trains over flights. This could lead to increased revenue, a better labor market along the route, and contribute to sustainable transportation by shifting a significant number of air travelers to rail.

title: Förhandsbesked för SÄBO
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen democracy by simplifying the voting process for Swedish citizens living abroad, aiming to increase voter participation among expatriates. It highlights the obstacles faced by overseas voters, such as the complexities of registering and voting from outside Sweden, and calls for the government to investigate ways to enhance accessibility and ensure timely information about voting procedures. The motion emphasizes the state's responsibility to facilitate this process to ensure that all eligible Swedes can exercise their voting rights in elections.

title: Införande av blåljuspersonalens dag
summary: The proposal addresses the rights and support for Swedish minorities living abroad, particularly those in Ukraine, Estonia, Finland, and South America. It highlights the historical presence of Swedish-speaking communities and the cultural challenges they face, especially in the context of historical migrations and recent conflicts like the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The motion calls for the Swedish government to acknowledge and strengthen support for these communities to preserve their language and culture, suggesting that additional resources and strategic initiatives are necessary.

title: Förbud mot försäljning av fjädrar av fågeldun
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national framework for 'avhopparverksamhet' (exit support services) as part of crime prevention efforts in Sweden. It emphasizes the growing need for structured support for individuals wishing to leave criminal organizations, addressing issues like substance abuse and trauma. The proposal calls for a national strategy that includes goals, guidelines, and the appointment of a national coordinator to facilitate cooperation among municipalities. Additionally, it highlights the importance of a secure national register for tracking and supporting the implementation of the strategy.

title: Skärmförbud på badanläggningar
summary: This motion proposes the abolishment of the unjust tax gap affecting individuals on sickness and activity compensation, which was established with the introduction of the job tax deduction in 2007. The proposal argues that these individuals are unfairly taxed at a higher rate than those who are employed. The motion emphasizes the financial difficulties faced by over 260,000 citizens relying on such compensation, particularly in light of recent tax increases for people with disabilities. It calls for a fair tax system that does not penalize those unable to work due to health conditions.

title: Förändrad mervärdesskatt för utövande konstnärer och danstillställningar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament ensures all victims of violence and their children are guaranteed support for securing permanent housing, addressing the significant barriers they face due to violence in close relations and the current housing shortage. It emphasizes the need for a uniform support system across municipalities to facilitate the ability to leave violent situations, stating that one's municipality should not determine access to necessary help.

title: Hastighetsbegränsning om 30 km/tim vid förskolor
summary: The proposal advocates for increased funding for the University of Skövde, emphasizing its importance as a regional and national growth engine. It argues that higher education access is crucial for regional development, workforce recruitment, and lifelong education. The motion highlights the current funding cuts to the university and the need for additional resources to address educational shortages, particularly in the Skaraborg region. It asserts that the university's development is vital for supporting local industries, fostering employment opportunities, and driving regional growth.

title: Inför pantsystem för färgpatroner
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at improving housing policies for women and children affected by violence. Key suggestions include prioritizing access to public housing for these individuals, easing income requirements for housing applications, eliminating the requirement for being debt-free, facilitating housing exchanges across municipal borders, and establishing a national housing queue specifically for those affected by domestic violence. The motion emphasizes the urgent need for national coordination and additional reforms to ensure safe housing options, asserting that current policies are inadequate in addressing the severe issue of domestic violence in Sweden.

title: Klassa sex- och kärleksberoende som beroendesjukdom
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a strategy to enhance collaboration between public authorities, businesses, and civil society to improve crime prevention efforts in Sweden. It emphasizes the urgent need to address the growing disillusionment among children and youth, particularly young boys who are increasingly drawn into criminal activities. The proposal advocates for a cohesive infrastructure that includes civil society in the efforts to provide positive environments, role models, and a sense of hope for the future.

title: Klädbidrag till personal inom förskola
summary: The motion proposes an increased police presence in society, emphasizing the importance of safety for all citizens as a foundational aspect of equality and freedom. It argues that rising gang violence poses a threat to democracy and calls for a collaborative effort to address both crime and its underlying causes. The proposal highlights the previous government's initiative to increase the number of police officers by 10,000 by 2024 and urges the current government to continue this effort, particularly in vulnerable areas where police visibility is most needed.

title: Kommunens skyldigheter enligt lagen om allmänna vattentjänster
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should review current regulations regarding the invitation of political parties into schools to enhance civic education and democratic engagement among students. It argues that existing laws have made it increasingly difficult for youth organizations to access schools for discussions on democracy and political participation, which is detrimental to fostering a vibrant civic environment within schools.

title: Obligatoriskt mottagande av importburkar och flaskor
summary: The proposal suggests reviewing and implementing more flexible regulations for shoreline protection near lakes and waterways to facilitate housing development while balancing the preservation of natural environments. It emphasizes the necessity for clear guidelines on when exceptions to these protections can be granted, aiming to enhance housing availability in rural areas and small towns without compromising the integrity of Sweden's unique aquatic ecosystems.

title: Parkeringsanmärkningar och kontrollavgifter för blåljusfordon
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of continuing efforts for climate adaptation in Sweden, urging the government to maintain funding for climate initiatives in light of increasing climate challenges such as extreme weather, invasive species, and land instability. The proposal criticizes the current government for significantly reducing the budget for climate work, which contradicts recommendations from its own expert advisors, and calls for an updated national impact analysis to assess future adaptation needs for the benefit of upcoming generations.

title: Aktivt samtycke till direktreklam
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a national absence register in Swedish schools to ensure students' right to education and enhance monitoring of absenteeism. The motion addresses the growing issue of problematic absenteeism and highlights its detrimental effects on students' academic performance and mental health. It aims to facilitate early identification of students at risk of honor-related violence and oppression. The motion emphasizes that a national statistics framework is essential for effective intervention and comparison among educational institutions.

title: Sänkt påminnelse- och tilläggsavgift för trängselskatt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:197 av Michael Rubbestad och Patrik Jönsson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that political youth associations should be allowed to inform and engage students in schools, as they often face restrictions in visiting educational institutions. The motion argues that fostering political interest and engagement among the youth is crucial for maintaining a vibrant democracy, and highlights the need for legislative support to ensure these organizations can reach students effectively.

title: Utökad diskrimineringslagstiftning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:196 av Sven-Olof Sällström och Michael Rubbestad (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider maintaining low taxation for investment savings accounts (ISK) to encourage saving, reduce household debt, and support economic growth. It emphasizes that saving is essential for personal financial security and contributes to national growth, while also arguing against double taxation on savings. By making ISK more attractive, the proposal aims to allow more people to participate in investing and improve their financial autonomy.

title: Ändring i vapenlagen gällande pepparsprej
summary: This motion proposes an increase in the number of educational placements for advanced nurse practitioners in Sweden, highlighting the importance of advanced specialists in healthcare teams to enhance care quality for severely ill patients. The motion cites successful models from Anglo-Saxon countries and research indicating improved patient outcomes when cared for by advanced specialists, advocating for more available training spots to meet the high educational demands of the role.

title: Pant på saftflaskor - en stor miljövinst
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of clarifying the status of the equestrian industry in Sweden, particularly regarding its recognition as a legitimate business sector by the Swedish Tax Agency (Skatteverket). It highlights that many equestrian activities, including breeding and training, are often mistakenly classified as hobby activities rather than recognized as businesses. The proposal calls for the government to acknowledge the significance of small equestrian enterprises and ensure that appropriate guidelines are developed to distinguish between hobby and business activities in this sector.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion calls for a review of the legislation regarding dental care as part of medical treatment for individuals diagnosed with epilepsy. It highlights the need for broader criteria for coverage related to dental damage caused by seizures and emphasizes the importance of increasing awareness of these issues within dental education. The goal is to enhance dental care outcomes and reduce potential costs for patients.

title: Översyn av riksintressen och strandskyddade områden
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:192 av Mikael Strandman och Monika Lövgren (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposed by Margareta Cederfelt aims to strengthen efforts to combat antibiotic resistance, recognizing it as a significant global health issue. The motion argues for the necessity of effective antibiotics for safe healthcare and highlights the risks posed by increasing antibiotic resistance on both routine and advanced medical treatments. It calls for preventive actions within healthcare, behavioral changes among professionals and patients, and increased research efforts to understand and combat resistance development. The proposal also emphasizes the need for collaboration with the pharmaceutical industry and civil society, advocating for a multifaceted, global approach to this pressing concern.

title: Uniformsneutralitet inom Försvarsmakten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:191 av Matheus Enholm och Josef Fransson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the study of measures to accelerate the increase of track capacity on the Västra stambanan railway line, specifically between Alingsås and Göteborg. The authors argue that the current high usage of the line restricts the potential for increased train services without degrading existing traffic quality. They highlight the need for a new double track to ease congestion, enhance punctuality, and foster regional growth and housing development along the route. The motion emphasizes the global environmental challenges necessitating expanded railway traffic and asserts that the improvement of Västra stambanan is essential for the economic growth of the entire country.

title: Åtgärder mot lootlådor och andra lotteriliknande moment inom dataspel
summary: The motion proposes a review of the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act to facilitate information sharing among agencies for improved support and cooperation, particularly for vulnerable children and to combat welfare fraud. The authors argue that current confidentiality rules can hinder necessary collaboration that benefits individuals, and they emphasize the need to balance privacy with the ability to detect and address welfare crimes effectively.

title: Insatser mot missbruk av förkomna pass
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of preserving and managing Swedish properties abroad, including embassies and residences, which contribute to Sweden's cultural heritage and international presence. The authors urge the government to prioritize caution in decisions related to these properties, advocating against selling them without significant justification, to maintain their historical and cultural value.

title: Insatser mot djurrättsextremisters brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers developing a strategy for establishing a reserve stock of essential goods to ensure adequate supplies of food, drinking water, energy, and medicines in the event of a serious security crisis or war. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining a supply readiness for the total defense of the country, citing significant societal changes that undermine the previous organizational framework for emergency preparedness.

title: Förbättringar och andra åtgärder kring arbetsmiljö och arbetsmarknad för nattarbetare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review the implementation of a uniform taxation system for earned income. It argues that the current tax disparities, introduced by the previous government, create unfair burdens on those unable to work, such as pensioners and recipients of social insurance. The motion emphasizes the need for a fair tax system that does not penalize individuals based on their income sources, and encourages the government to consider reforms to achieve equitable taxation.

title: Tillåta dubbdäck fram till den 30 april
summary: The motion proposes a review of the F-tax regulations to prevent misuse by unscrupulous employers, emphasizing that current rules allow for easy access to F-tax status, which can lead to the circumvention of labor protections typically afforded to employees.

title: Förbättrad kvalitet och stärkt jämställdhet i sexualundervisningen i skolan
summary: The proposal emphasizes the necessity of workforce skills development in connection with the construction of the Ostlänken high-speed railway, which is deemed a major infrastructural investment for Sweden's east region. The motion advocates for the Swedish government to recognize and plan for the anticipated demand for trained labor, including various construction and engineering roles, as well as the broader economic growth opportunities that the project presents for the surrounding areas.

title: En familjevänlig tågtrafik
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:184 av Julia Kronlid och Linda Lindberg (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for increasing the moose population in certain geographical areas of Sweden and suggests that various factors should be considered when setting moose hunting quotas. It calls for the reduction of predators affecting the moose population and emphasizes the need for collaboration among hunters, landowners, and regional authorities to achieve a high-quality moose population. The proposal warns that without these measures, moose might be red-listed in the EU by 2025.

title: Förbud mot böneutrop
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of labor market testing for labor immigration to Sweden, highlighting concerns over the liberal labor immigration system that has led to exploitation of workers and prioritized employer interests. It emphasizes the need for reforms to ensure that available jobs primarily goes to unemployed residents while allowing skilled labor to be recruited when necessary. The proposal also aims to strengthen regulations to prevent fraudulent practices and protect vulnerable workers from exploitation.

title: Miljöanpassad fordonsbesiktning
summary: The motion proposes to transition Sweden from a monarchy to a democratic system where the head of state is elected based on democratic principles, rather than inherited. It argues that, in a modern democracy, all individuals, including the head of state, should be treated equally and subject to the same laws, advocating for a parliamentary strategy to phase out the monarchy and establish a more democratic governance structure.

title: Lärarnas arbetsvillkor
summary: The motion proposes to extend the confidentiality of ongoing police investigations (preliminary investigations) to prevent potential interference with evidence and witnesses until the trial phase. The current law allows for confidentiality only until charges are filed, but the authors argue that risks remain high until the trial, especially in cases involving criminal networks. Therefore, the suggestion calls for a review of legislation to enhance the protection of information during this critical period.

title: Konsumenternas ställning på de finansiella marknaderna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should examine how to achieve competition neutrality between different transport systems, with a focus on increasing the role of shipping in freight transport. It highlights the potential for transferring goods from roads to maritime transport, particularly in regions like Västerås, and emphasizes the need to remove existing bottlenecks to facilitate sustainable growth and transportation. The proposal also calls for a review of the costs associated with icebreaking and pilotage to ensure fair competition among transport modes.

title: Jämlik familjerätt
summary: The motion proposes a plan to phase out animal testing in research and education, advocating for a faster transition to alternative methods. It highlights the ethical concerns of using animals in experiments and points to the existence of effective alternatives. The motion calls for political support to ensure these alternatives are adopted widely and emphasizes the need for a significant change in approach, similar to a previous EU directive that aimed to replace animal testing with non-animal methods.

title: Polisutbildning och polisforskning
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:178 av Ilona Szatmari Waldau m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal advocates for establishing full-time work as the normative standard in the Swedish labor market to address the growing prevalence of part-time and temporary employment, particularly among young women and in lower-wage jobs. It highlights the negative impact of certain legal changes that have allowed employers to reduce working hours regardless of prior agreements, leading to increased insecurity for employees. The motion calls for a legislative review to ensure that the new full-time law functions as intended and to restore stability in the labor market for the sake of equality and gender equity.

title: Digitaliseringen av skolan
summary: The motion advocates for the inclusion of economic violence against women in the national strategy and specific action programs addressing men's violence against women. It highlights the prevalence and seriousness of economic violence, which is often overlooked in political discourse, and emphasizes the need for a thorough review of the issue, current legislation, and the capacities of relevant authorities to provide necessary support and interventions for affected women.

title: En starkare arbetsrätt för ökad trygghet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament implement mandatory origin labeling for meat served in restaurants and other large-scale food service establishments. This is in response to consumer demand for transparency regarding the origin of food products, which has increased awareness of the environmental and ethical implications of meat consumption. While origin labeling is already required for packaged meat sold in stores, it is not enforced in the restaurant sector. The motion aims to ensure consumers can make informed choices and promote fair competition in the food industry, aligning with similar regulations in other EU countries.

title: En modern civilplikt
summary: The motion advocates for the modernization and investment in the Kinnekullebanan railway to support the growing industrial sector in Västra Götaland, particularly due to new establishments like a Volvo battery factory. The proposal emphasizes the strategic importance of Kinnekullebanan for regional development, job commuting, goods transportation, and tourism, and criticizes the government's failure to prioritize necessary infrastructure investments despite previous promises.

title: Privata sjukvårdsförsäkringar och vårdprioriteringar
summary: The motion proposes the reinstitution of a tax deduction for union membership fees, aimed at increasing union participation among workers. This deduction was previously implemented by the Social Democratic government in 2002 but was abolished in 2007 and again in 2019. The proposal emphasizes the importance of a strong union presence for the balance of power in the labor market and to support the Swedish model of labor relations.

title: Gemensamt ansvar för nyanländas boende och etablering
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:173 av Christina Höj Larsen m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion aims to improve the validation process for foreign medical degrees to better integrate international healthcare professionals into the Swedish healthcare system. It emphasizes the need for a diverse workforce that reflects the society it serves and underlines the importance of utilizing the skills of immigrant doctors to meet the growing demands of an aging population. The authors argue that enhancing the validation process will contribute to a more competent and accessible healthcare system.

title: Tillfällig ändring i Första-Fjärde AP-fondernas placeringsregler med anledning av covid-19
summary: This proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to add the plant 'parkslide' to the list of invasive alien species, which would create mandatory obligations to combat its spread. The motion highlights the rapid proliferation of parkslide and its negative impact on gardens, infrastructure, and native species, urging the government to legislate against it as it currently lacks regulation at both the EU and national levels.

title: Cykling
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to support the initiative for Sveriges Radio to establish an open archive to make historical radio programs accessible to the public, in celebration of the station's upcoming centenary in 2025. The motion emphasizes the importance of preserving cultural heritage and historical knowledge, enabling citizens to learn from past broadcasts and understand societal changes over time.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:188 Sveriges genomförande av Agenda 2030
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the need for mandatory eye examinations for private drivers at the time of license renewal, particularly for those aged 45 and older. It emphasizes that good vision is a crucial factor for safe driving, as impaired vision can lead to significant traffic hazards. The motion aims to enhance traffic safety and facilitate the early detection of vision problems by introducing regular eye checks for drivers, which are already required for professional drivers from the age of 45.

title: Sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter i världen
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of increasing electricity network capacity across Sweden to support the transition to a sustainable society and reduce reliance on fossil fuels. It highlights the specific electricity needs in Värmland due to its growing energy requirements from industry, advocating for investments in both electricity infrastructure and renewable energy sources such as wind and solar power. The motion argues that equitable access to electricity is essential for regional development and that current costs disproportionately affect businesses in rural areas.

title: En solidarisk beroendevård
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should present recommendations for an expanded liability for public officials regarding malfeasance, in alignment with the Tidö Agreement. This suggestion aims to enhance the legal accountability of officials, thereby increasing citizens' trust in public administration and ensuring that officials can be held responsible for their actions.

title: Sociala stödinsatser vid prostitution och människohandel för sexuella ändamål
summary: The suggestion proposes that the parliament investigate the possibility of increasing penalties for disturbances during parliamentary sessions, particularly focusing on disruptions caused by activists in the viewing area. It highlights a recent increase in disturbances during parliamentary meetings, emphasizing the need for respect towards the parliamentary process and the rules governing spectators. The motion suggests that current penalties, including fines or up to six months of imprisonment for such disturbances, are insufficient deterrents and calls for a review of these penalties to protect democratic operations.

title: Funktionsrättsfrågor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of allowing the storage of hunting firearms at an address other than the person's registered address. This arises from the challenges faced by individuals moving to urban areas while maintaining hunting traditions, which necessitate safe transport of firearms and ammunition between residences and hunting grounds. The current law poses security risks due to potential thefts in urban settings, and the proposal suggests that firearms could be stored with close relatives or individuals with valid firearm licenses to mitigate these risks.

title: En modern samepolitik
summary: The motion proposes changes to the noise regulations governing motorsport arenas in Sweden, arguing that current legislation imposes unrealistic standards that could jeopardize the survival of these venues. It highlights the challenges of managing noise from not only combustion engines but also from tire friction and wind. The proposal suggests that as urban areas develop and dense housing increases, current noise thresholds should be reconsidered, especially in light of the growing trend toward electrification in motorsports.

title: Arbetstidsförkortning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider an investigation into the possibility of restricting the use of welfare funds to ensure that these resources are utilized only for essential goods such as housing, food, clothing, and hygiene products. It emphasizes preventing welfare funds from being spent on non-essential items, including drugs, alcohol, tobacco, vacations, and transferring funds abroad, to protect against misuse and support of foreign criminal or terrorist networks.

title: Fideikommiss och historiska arrenden
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into establishing a regulatory framework that would require mobile operators in Sweden to cooperate with law enforcement agencies during criminal investigations. It highlights current difficulties in obtaining necessary information from operators, noting that the costs and lack of willingness from some operators impede investigations. The motion advocates for conditions in the operators' licenses that mandate such cooperation and regulate compensation levels for fulfilling these requests accordingly.

title: Ålandsöverenskommelsen 100 år
summary: The motion suggests investigating the possibility of anonymizing the names and personal details of healthcare staff in patient records accessible to patients, aiming to enhance the safety and security of healthcare professionals amid increasing concerns over threats and violence directed at them by patients. The proposal highlights that while patients benefit from accessing their medical records, the potential risks to healthcare workers necessitate a review of current practices regarding the disclosure of personal information.

title: Viltförvaltningsdelegationerna
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate how more private roads affected by natural disasters can be included in state support programs. The gravity of the damage caused by heavy rainfall in summer 2023, particularly evident in areas like Rättvik, underscores the need for state responsibility in restoring these roads, as many of them do not currently qualify for financial aid. Despite the government's announcement of 100 million kronor in additional funding for individual roads, many lesser roads that are often the most severely damaged are excluded from the existing support system.

title: Eftergymnasial utbildning för personer med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the feasibility of constructing a new permanent connection to Öland, citing concerns about the aging Ölandsbron, which is over 50 years old and inadequate for modern traffic demands. The motion highlights the bridge's structural deficiencies, notably the lack of a bicycle lane and median barriers, as well as the significant increase in vehicle traffic well beyond projections. Given the bridge's crucial role for commuting, education, and food supply, along with national security considerations, the motion urges the government to task Trafikverket with planning a second bridge to ensure a more reliable and safer transport link to the mainland.

title: Åtgärder för säker cykeltrafik utefter det statliga vägnätet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament acknowledges the need to enhance opportunities for individuals with disabilities to pursue further education at the upper secondary level, specifically through folk high schools. The motion highlights the importance of tailored educational programs and support services, noting that many municipalities fail to provide adequate resources, leaving vulnerable students without educational options. It calls for improved regulations and funding mechanisms to ensure accessibility and support for disabled students seeking education after compulsory school.

title: Förvaltning av samfälligheter
summary: The motion aims to enhance support and protection for women living in hiding due to violence from men, particularly in terms of housing, legal rights, and ensuring safe contact with authorities. It emphasizes the need for better resources to help women and their children secure stable living arrangements after leaving protected housing. Additionally, it calls for clarity on municipal obligations to prioritize housing for victims, simplify asset division from their abuser, and reinforce the rights of victims concerning shared custody arrangements. The proposal seeks to prevent information leaks regarding protected identities and emphasizes the importance of training service providers in handling issues related to men's violence against women.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:175 Skattereduktion för boende i vissa glest befolkade områden - regional skattereduktion
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should consider granting temporary parental benefits to parents during childbirth, especially for those with older children. The current system is criticized for being overly reliant on social networks that may not be available at short notice, particularly during emergencies such as illness or pandemics. This change aims to provide necessary support for parents needing to manage childcare during a crucial time.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:176 En effektivare kommunal räddningstjänst
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support a national goal to reduce car traffic and instruct the Transport Administration to shift from forecast-based infrastructure planning to goal-oriented planning. This change is aimed at achieving a more transport-efficient society, enhancing citizens' access to work, services, and leisure without increasing dependency on personal cars. The motion highlights the need for a planned approach that promotes cycling, improved public transport, and community development that minimizes long-distance travel, aligning transportation efficiency with climate goals.

title: En statlig plattform för upphandling
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support the inclusion of sibling priority in municipal school placements, allowing families to choose schools that their children can attend together. This change aims to enhance family convenience, reduce daily challenges for parents, and provide a sense of security for younger siblings. The motion references a governmental investigation advocating for this priority, indicating that it would not significantly affect social composition or school segregation.

title: Sveriges kontor i Taipei
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government prioritize funding for the maintenance and management of nature reserves and national parks, emphasizing the importance of these areas for public health. It highlights the significant budget cuts that have impacted outdoor recreational facilities and infrastructure, which could lead to closures and negatively affect an increasing number of visitors seeking to enjoy nature. The motion argues that proper upkeep of natural spaces is not only essential for environmental conservation but also a vital investment in public health.

title: Inrätta en författningsdomstol i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the need for national actions to support children who are abducted from Sweden, emphasizing the lack of existing procedures and knowledge among authorities to prevent such abductions and assist returned children. It suggests the establishment of a national competence team to improve cooperation among police, social services, schools, and healthcare providers, ensuring better handling of cases and supporting the safe return of abducted children as well as their reintegration and ongoing support after their return.

title: Begränsa användningsområdena för utdelning ur kommunala bolag
summary: The proposal seeks to review legislation regarding the custody rights of violent parents, emphasizing the need for courts to conduct documented risk assessments in custody disputes. It highlights that domestic violence often does not impact custody outcomes and argues for the importance of prioritizing children's safety and rights over the desires of the adult parents, especially in light of recent laws designed to protect children witnessing domestic violence.

title: Ett tydligare statligt ansvar för de viktigaste hamnarna
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need to enhance democratic engagement in Sweden by proposing measures to increase voter turnout, particularly in socioeconomically disadvantaged areas. It calls for a review of education laws to facilitate the outreach of political youth organizations in schools and stresses the importance of building trust between authorities and young people. The proposal outlines a plan for better communication between government agencies and youth to counteract misinformation and foster a more inclusive and participatory democracy.

title: Europeiskt investeringsavtal med Taiwan
summary: The motion advocates for the introduction of free menstrual products in primary and secondary schools in Sweden. It highlights the importance of access to these products not only as a public health issue but also as an economic matter impacting students who menstruate. The proposal draws on successful implementations of free menstrual products in other countries, such as New Zealand and Scotland, suggesting that such a measure could enhance school attendance and equity among students.

title: Ett samlat statligt ansvar för alla transportslag
summary: The suggestion advocates for the expansion of Sweden's railway capacity through the construction of new main railway lines to accommodate the increasing demand for both passenger and freight transport. With a projected population growth and an ongoing rise in regional travel, the proposal emphasizes that improving railway infrastructure is critical for sustainable growth, economic competitiveness, and achieving climate goals. It also highlights that current capacity limitations lead to significant delays and inefficiencies and stresses the need for immediate action in light of previous governmental halts on new railway projects.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:175 Skattereduktion för boende i vissa glest befolkade områden - regional skattereduktion
summary: The suggestion calls for stricter sanctions against Russia, advocating for additional measures to enhance compliance with existing sanctions. It emphasizes the need for improved coordination among Swedish authorities responsible for sanction enforcement and suggests that a single agency may be designated for overseeing this effort. The proposal also points out that Russian access to prohibited components must be curtailed and proposes increasing obligations on exporting companies to prevent their goods from indirectly supporting the Russian military during its aggressive actions.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:140 2020 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing a maximum limit on the number of prepaid cards that a single individual can own, suggesting a cap of five cards per person. This measure aims to strengthen anti-crime efforts by preventing individuals from being registered under multiple prepaid cards, a loophole that has been exploited by criminals to bypass recent regulations that require such cards to be registered to a physical person.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:176 En effektivare kommunal räddningstjänst
summary: The proposal calls for changes to the rules regarding the karensavdrag (sick leave deduction), highlighting that the current system disproportionately impacts workers in professions that cannot work from home. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the temporary removal of this deduction showed a consensus among political parties on the need for reform to encourage employees to stay home when ill without facing financial penalties. The motion argues that the current structure of the karensavdrag forces financially vulnerable workers to choose between going to work sick or facing economic hardship, risking their health and that of their colleagues.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:140 2020 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should assess the feasibility of converting unused padel halls into sports halls to address the shortage of sports facilities in Sweden. It highlights the negative impact of this shortage on youth participation in physical activities, noting that many children do not meet recommended physical activity levels. The motion calls for a national initiative to transform padel halls, which have seen declining interest and multiple bankruptcies, into suitable spaces for various sports, thereby supporting public health and sports organizations in Sweden.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:191 Riksrevisionens rapport om återvändandeverksamheten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:145 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the acceleration of climate transition in the aviation sector by increasing the demand for biofuels. It highlights the environmental benefits of using biofuels, such as a significant reduction in CO2 emissions and improved air quality, while also addressing the economic potential of a growing biofuel industry in Sweden. Additionally, the proposal suggests that all public sector flight tickets should require a minimum of 50% biofuels, which could drive the green transition in aviation and reduce dependency on fossil fuels.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:170 Riksrevisionens rapport om statliga åtgärder för fler miljöbilar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review Trafikverket's responsibility for financing state infrastructure projects, especially in light of delays and cost overruns, as seen in the controversial Västlänken project in Gothenburg. It argues that the financial burden should not fall disproportionately on local taxpayers, particularly given the significant contributions already made through congestion taxes, and emphasizes the need for new regulations to prevent similar issues in the future.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:140 2020 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Gambling Authority, Spelinspektionen, should have its mandate expanded to serve as a coordinating body to enhance and broaden dialogue with market participants. The intention is to ensure a sustainable and safer gambling market that protects consumers while improving state oversight. The motion highlights the need for ongoing communication and collaboration among stakeholders in the gambling sector, noting that the authority has been criticized for a lack of dialogue with industry players.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:177 Riksrevisionens rapport om rutavdraget
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider measures to combat over-indebtedness and review the regulations surrounding credit reporting and payment defaults. It highlights the growing issue of debt in Sweden, with nearly 400,000 individuals registered with debts, and discusses how current credit reporting practices negatively impact individuals' lives, their ability to obtain jobs, loans, and housing. The motion suggests looking at regulatory changes similar to those recently implemented in Finland to improve the situation in Sweden.

title: Underlätta för jägare att träna skytte
summary: This proposal advocates for the continued expansion of alcohol control barriers, known as alkobommar, at all Swedish ports receiving foreign ferry traffic. The aim is to address the issue of intoxicated truck drivers entering the Swedish roads after consuming alcohol during their ferry crossing.
