The motion emphasizes the importance of alkobommar as a traffic safety measure, which can effectively prevent impaired driving and contributes to the goal of zero fatalities in traffic accidents.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:170 Riksrevisionens rapport om statliga åtgärder för fler miljöbilar
summary: This motion calls for the establishment of a national coordinator to oversee the government's work on a national strategy for rare diagnoses, the urgent adoption of a national action plan, and a review of equitable financial support for organizations representing individuals with disabilities. The proposal highlights the challenges faced by people with rare diagnoses in Sweden, emphasizing the need for coordinated healthcare services and improved access to specialized medical care and support.

title: Ingen tillståndsplikt för virkesupplag på egen mark
summary: The suggestion proposes a comprehensive review and reform of Sweden's income taxation system to enhance its competitiveness, reduce inconsistencies in tax treatment across different income types and regional jurisdictions, and potentially replace certain welfare support mechanisms with tax deductions for working families. It also suggests measures to promote savings, address over-indebtedness, and streamline and monitor existing tax deductions like RUT and ROT for better efficiency and compliance.

title: Snabbare avskrivning av studielån
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of Sweden's VAT system to address discrepancies and create a more equitable taxation framework across various sectors, including healthcare, business, and culture. It emphasizes the need for competition-neutral VAT in healthcare, voluntary tax liability for business premises, and harmonization of VAT rates in the tourism industry, while also advocating for maintaining reduced VAT rates in the cultural sector to support public access to cultural activities.

title: Nationell handlingsplan mot mobbning
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of various taxes in Sweden, aiming for fair tax conditions on the energy market, including the abolition of the flight tax, phasing out congestion taxes, and reassessing the bonus-malus system. It advocates for tax improvements related to housing maintenance, agriculture, shipping, and a reduction in fuel taxes to enhance competitiveness and support small businesses, particularly in rural areas. The motion emphasizes the need for reforms to aid various economic sectors, asserting that current tax structures inadequately support Swedish competitiveness and environmental goals.

title: Inför tak för antal barn i familjehem
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive overhaul of tax procedures and transparency in Sweden's taxation system. It includes recommendations for increasing the transparency of payroll, final tax assessments, and receipts, improving the efficiency of personnel registers to combat tax evasion, reviewing personal registration systems to reduce errors, enhancing the legal security in tax processes, and implementing protective measures for sensitive personal data. Further, it calls for an assessment of taxation rules affecting the gig economy, a simplification of tax declarations for small businesses, and stricter regulations on the import of restricted goods to prevent criminal activities. This overall aim is to foster a clearer, more effective taxation system that safeguards taxpayer interests and facilitates business operations.

title: Barn ska aldrig placeras i fattigdom
summary: The motion proposes several measures to improve Sweden's customs procedures, including simplifying the import tax system, streamlining the rules for customs declarations and surcharges, increasing customs personnel, expanding their authority to stop vehicles and individuals leaving the country, and investing in better customs equipment and technology. The goal is to ensure efficiency and minimize errors for companies involved in import and export, while enhancing border security.

title: Gör det möjligt för arbetsgivaren att betala av på studielånen
summary: The proposal suggests relocating the Swedish Food Agency (Livsmedelsverket) and the Customs Agency (Tullverket) to Skåne to enhance regional development and better align these agencies with their operational contexts. The motion highlights the ongoing issue of centralization in Stockholm, arguing for an investigation into the placement of governmental agencies nationwide, as a means to strengthen state presence and support local economies.

title: Öppen källkod
summary: This motion proposes to designate Öresund as a marine protected area and subsequently a biosphere reserve, in response to environmental pressures such as declining water quality and biodiversity loss due to high traffic and pollution. The proposal emphasizes the unique ecological and cultural significance of the region, advocating for collaborative efforts between Sweden and Denmark to establish protective measures that allow for sustainable development alongside nature conservation.

title: Färjetrafik mellan Oskarshamn och Byxelkrok
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:132 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson och Anne Oskarsson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a licensing requirement for protected accommodations, along with mandated support for children residing in these facilities. It highlights the need for support structures for children who accompany their mothers escaping domestic violence, as current services often overlook their specific needs. The motion argues that children are equally affected by violence and trauma, and emphasizes the necessity of providing therapeutic support to aid their recovery both during and after their stay in protected housing.

title: Polisbemanning på landsbygden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the creation of new connections over Öresund, advocating for joint financing of infrastructure such as the HH connection and Öresund Metro. It emphasizes that these projects should not burden the Swedish state financially, as they could be funded through state-guaranteed loans and user payments, similar to the Öresund Bridge model. The motion argues for the removal of current barriers that complicate cross-border movement, and highlights the potential economic and cultural benefits for the Öresund region if these connections are realized.

title: Marinarkeologiskt museum
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:130 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson och Anne Oskarsson (båda SD)
summary: The proposal aims to enable municipalities to use procurement as a tool to better regulate electric scooters and other micro-mobility vehicles in urban environments. It emphasizes the positive impacts of these vehicles, such as reducing car travel and improving accessibility. However, it also addresses issues regarding improper parking and safety concerns associated with electric scooters. The motion suggests that municipalities need legal tools to manage these vehicles effectively, including the ability to select companies based on safety and operational criteria through procurement processes.

title: Tåginfrastruktur i sydöstra Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:129 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of shortening the processing time for logging notifications to three weeks, in response to the significant damage caused to forests by storm Hans, which resulted in the loss of up to a million cubic meters of timber. The motion highlights the urgency of efficiently handling logging requests to mitigate the impact of future storms and suggests learning from neighboring Finland's quicker processing times.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:176 En effektivare kommunal räddningstjänst
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament advocate for the government to review and potentially reinstate investment support for private and forest roads. The authors argue that the existing infrastructure for rural areas is crucial for development and that the lack of state support threatens the maintenance of these roads, which are essential for local communities, tourism, and forestry. They stress the importance of a functional road network for both everyday life and national preparedness.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:176 En effektivare kommunal räddningstjänst
summary: The motion proposes to evaluate the possibility of financing the electrification of the Tvärbanan railway in Västerbotten, which currently has only a portion electrified. The aim is to enhance environmental benefits and cost efficiency for both goods and passenger transport while reducing emissions from diesel locomotives. The electrification is seen as a crucial step towards diminishing fossil dependence and boosting the competitiveness of Swedish industry, especially with increased regional industrial activity and potential defense transport needs due to geopolitical developments.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:176 En effektivare kommunal räddningstjänst
summary: The proposal calls for an investigation into and revision of Lantmäteriet's fees for rural municipalities, citing that high costs and lengthy processing times for parceling land hinder rural development, leading to fewer residents and housing construction. The authors argue that the expense associated with parceling land can equal its value, discouraging sales and exacerbating decay of properties.

title: Utvidgade möjligheter att förvandla obetalda böter till fängelse
summary: The proposal advocates for the transformation of Högskolan i Borås into a university to enhance knowledge, research, and development in the region, focusing on strengthening the textile sector. The motion argues that university status would attract more resources, students, and researchers, thereby creating job opportunities and enabling more sustainable practices in textiles and fashion.

title: Ändrade bestämmelser om fotografier och fingeravtryck i SIS II-regelverket
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiates an investigation to clarify the definition of 'essential societal interests' concerning land use planning, in order to strengthen the protection of arable land, which is crucial for food security. The authors highlight the increasing threat to arable land due to urban development and the need for stricter guidelines to ensure that housing and infrastructure do not come at the expense of agricultural land necessary for self-sufficiency in food production.

title: Behandling av känsliga personuppgifter i testverksamhet enligt utlänningsdatalagen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of means-testing child benefits, arguing that the current system distributes funds equitably but may inadvertently favor more affluent families. The motion highlights the necessity of redirecting resources to support families in greater need and argues that this reform could lead to more equitable outcomes and allow for the reallocation of funds to improve healthcare and support employment for those outside the workforce.

title: Utred anmälnings- eller tillståndsplikt för kyltornsanläggningar
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should ensure that all individuals wishing to get married have the right to be wed by any wedding officiant authorized to perform marriages, regardless of personal beliefs about the couples. It emphasizes the need for a reform that could either make the right to officiate personal, requiring officiants to adhere to the non-discrimination principles of the Marriage Code, or to transfer the authority of marriage ceremonies from religious organizations to the state, allowing such organizations to perform only blessings but not legally binding wedlocks.

title: Återför riksäpplena till Helgeandsholmen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:124 av Christina Östberg och Carina Ståhl Herrstedt (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to simplify the regulations for public procurement under the EU threshold values to align with EU legislation, suggesting a review of the direct procurement threshold. The motion criticizes the current government's complicating of procurement rules, which has hindered public buyers from securing favorable deals and led to reduced competition. It advocates for a less stringent framework that would enhance procurement efficiency and better serve both buyers and suppliers, and suggests that many public procurements could be simplified significantly while remaining compliant with EU legislation.

title: Produktionsomställning vid samhällskris
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:123 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt och Eric Westroth (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support efforts to clean up the Baltic Sea, emphasizing the ecological damage caused by abandoned fishing nets and hazardous materials from World War II and its aftermath. It calls for both national and cooperative actions among all Baltic Sea states to ensure a cleaner marine environment for future generations.

title: Åldersbegränsning på däck
summary: The motion proposes that naloxone should be made available over the counter in Sweden, facilitating its distribution within addiction care settings and to relatives of drug users. It also suggests that police should be allowed to carry naloxone to help prevent overdoses effectively. The proposal references best practices from other countries, emphasizes the non-controversial nature of naloxone, and argues for a shift from a zero-tolerance approach to one that prioritizes harm reduction.

title: En ny fordonsklass
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should evaluate the possibility of including income transferred to a periodization fund in the sickness benefit qualifying income (SGI). It argues that the current exclusion of this income from SGI calculations, both when reserved and when taxed, is outdated and may lead to unfair rejections of sickness benefits by Försäkringskassan. The motion seeks to ensure that business owners have better access to social safety nets.

title: Synskadade och valsystemet
summary: The suggestion proposes a revision of Sweden's electoral system to enhance its reliability by implementing a unified ballot for all parties, similar to systems used in Denmark and the Netherlands. The motion highlights ongoing issues such as ballot tampering and misinformation at polling stations that undermine the democratic process, advocating for changes to minimize these risks and improve electoral integrity.

title: Beskattning av husbilar
summary: The motion advocates for the continuation of the development of a fixed connection between Helsingborg and Helsingør, emphasizing the significance of the Öresund region for both Denmark and Sweden. It highlights the increased traffic across the Öresund Bridge since its opening in 2000 and identifies potential economic growth opportunities that a new connection could facilitate. The motion also addresses the challenge of financing such infrastructure projects while suggesting that the project could self-fund through tolls on the highway tunnel that would support a rail tunnel, crucial for better regional integration and reduced traffic congestion.

title: Hörselskadade och riksdagen
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of a governmental investigation to assess the future requirements for education and the labor market in light of the implications of artificial intelligence (AI). It includes recommendations for ongoing data collection and the creation of an observatory to study new business models and labor organization influenced by AI advancements. Additionally, it suggests allowing companies to depreciate investments in human capital similarly to physical capital investments.

title: Avskaffa flerbarnstillägget
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of various outdated or problematic laws in Sweden that are seen as unnecessary bureaucratic hindrances. Key proposals include the removal of biotope protection on temporary stone piles, mandatory notifications for dance events, and various licensing requirements related to composting, electricity production, and gambling. The motion argues that these regulations impede social activities, entrepreneurship, and individual freedoms, and that their removal would streamline processes and foster a more free and progressive society.

title: Barnsäkerhet i bil
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of reducing taxes for small craft breweries in line with EU regulations. The authors highlight the economic challenges faced by small producers compared to large breweries and argue that such a tax reduction would help support local employment and economic activity, particularly in rural areas. They emphasize the need for Sweden to follow the lead of other EU countries that already allow for such differentiated taxation.

title: Högre straff för brott mot griftefriden
summary: This motion proposes to permit tax deductions for the renovation of window frames that are removed from construction sites and repaired in workshops, arguing that current regulations hinder the ability of craftsmen and do not support the preservation of cultural heritage in old buildings. It calls for the government to amend existing tax rules to allow for such deductions.

title: Fortsatt ombyggnation av väg 26/47
summary: The motion proposes a change to the accounting law with the aim of simplifying and modernizing it, based on the framework outlined in SOU 2021:60. It argues that reducing the regulatory burden on businesses, particularly small enterprises, will allow them to focus more on productive activities. The proposed changes would eliminate outdated requirements, such as the need to retain paper receipts, potentially saving businesses up to 3.9 billion kronor per year and providing significant administrative and economic relief.

title: Förhindra att unga blir rökare
summary: The motion proposes to expedite the completion of the double-track expansion of the Västkustbanan railway between Göteborg and Malmö, emphasizing that this infrastructure is crucial for connecting approximately 8 million residents in Scandinavia's major urban centers. It highlights the limitations of single-track operations, which constrain train frequency, and argues that completing the double track would significantly enhance capacity, reduce travel times, increase punctuality, and provide environmental benefits by shifting freight transport from road to rail. The authors contend that delaying the project wastes taxpayer money and hampers potential economic growth in Västsverige.

title: Höjd åldersgräns för könsbyte
summary: The proposal by Niels Paarup-Petersen seeks to enhance safety in Malmö and Sweden by introducing various measures to combat organized crime and improve law enforcement. It includes suggestions to restrict the number of cars owned without special approval, enable police to stop suspected vehicles in motion, improve identity verification during vehicle ownership transfers, and enhance collaboration between state and municipal authorities in tackling organized crime. Additionally, it calls for increased resources for social services and law enforcement agencies, amendments to corporate laws to prevent fraud, and better protection for witnesses and victims of crime.

title: Järnvägsförbindelse mellan Helsingborg och Jönköping
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:111 av Mikael Eskilandersson och Angelica Lundberg (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports equal conditions for all blood donors, specifically addressing the exclusion of men who have sex with men from donating blood. The motion argues that existing regulations label male homosexuality as a risk behavior, which is considered unreasonable by the author. To address blood shortages in regions like Skåne, the proposal suggests a five-year pilot program to allow these individuals to donate blood on equal terms.

title: Låsta föräldradagar vid vårdnadstvister
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:110 av Angelica Lundberg och Mikael Eskilandersson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to lower the minimum age for purchasing alcohol from 20 to 18 years at Systembolaget, arguing that the current regulations are overly restrictive and lack empirical support. The motion emphasizes that at 18, individuals in Sweden can take on various adult responsibilities, yet are not permitted to buy wine, which appears inconsistent. It advocates for a liberalization of alcohol laws, pointing out that despite increased availability, alcohol-related harms have not worsened significantly in recent decades.

title: Lämplighetspröva äldre förare
summary: The motion advocates for a coordinated and expedited investment in the double track expansion of the New Ostkustbanan railway between Gävle and Härnösand. The proposal emphasizes the need for improved railway infrastructure to support the export industry in northern Sweden, addressing existing capacity issues, security vulnerabilities, and long travel times. It highlights the significance of this railway for both passenger and freight transport and calls for prioritization by the government to accelerate the project, which is essential for regional and national economic benefits.

title: Nya bestämmelser gällande däck
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament review and impose limitations on hunting pregnant elk (högdräktiga älgkor) in response to ethical concerns about the welfare of the animals, especially during certain hunting conditions. While acknowledging the need for elk management due to ecological impacts on forests, the motion emphasizes that hunting highly pregnant elk is considered unethical and may cause harm to their fetuses.

title: Reserverat barnbidrag vid vårdnadstvister
summary: The motion proposes a review of existing regulations to facilitate the use of locally sourced and processed construction timber by private forest owners, suggesting that it should be easier for smaller sawmills and forest owners to build with timber from their own trees, which is currently hindered by mandatory CE-marking requirements that increase costs.

title: Skatteväxling för folkhälsan
summary: The motion proposes an enhancement of Sweden's cultural cooperation model to ensure equitable access to cultural resources across the country, particularly in rural areas. It argues for aligning the funding of cultural institutions with that of fully state-operated institutions and expanding the national mandate of these institutions to promote cultural outreach throughout the nation.

title: Slopat stöd för produktion av socker
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:105 av Angelica Lundberg och Mikael Eskilandersson (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests implementing stricter identity verification measures for individuals applying for personal bankruptcy to prevent fraud through identity theft. It calls for increased checks, including confirmation of identity documents and inquiries into any police reports regarding identity theft. The intention is to reduce the incidence of false bankruptcy applications and the severe consequences they can have on individuals.

title: Öka antalet dubbeldagar
summary: The suggestion proposes to abolish the smoking ban in outdoor serving areas, arguing that the extension of the smoking ban implemented by the parliament was excessive. It emphasizes the need for individual restaurants to decide their own policies regarding outdoor smoking, stating that outdoor dining is different from public areas, and encourages voluntary initiatives by restaurants to reduce smoking rather than enforcing such measures through legislation.

title: Översyn av tillsatser i mat
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:103 av Johnny Skalin och Angelica Lundberg (båda SD)
summary: This motion proposes that municipalities and regions affected by wind and hydropower developments in Sweden should retain a fair share of the values generated by these energy sources. The authors argue that while the rural areas contribute significantly to Sweden's renewable energy production, they receive minimal compensation for the environmental impacts of energy production. To address these inequalities, the motion calls for the establishment of a system that allows these regions to benefit financially, thereby promoting regional development and increasing local support for energy projects.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:170 Riksrevisionens rapport om statliga åtgärder för fler miljöbilar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instructs the Transport Administration (Trafikverket) to modify their procurement practices for snow clearing to ensure timely services for both state-managed and privately maintained roads, particularly in northern Sweden where current regulations have led to significant delays and inadequate service, potentially impacting emergency services and residents' safety.

title: Vättern en viktig friskvattentäkt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:101 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson och Andreas Carlson (båda KD)
summary: This motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support the development of the police's crime-fighting and preventive work in rural areas. It highlights the increasing crime rates, including gang shootings and drug dealings, particularly affecting vulnerable populations. The proposal emphasizes the need for more police presence, the reopening of police stations, improved operating hours, and specialized units to address crimes common in rural areas, aiming to enhance safety and security for rural residents.

title: Nya stambanor och ett förstärkt transportsystem
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:100 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson och Andreas Carlson (båda KD)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations guiding agencies that handle permit applications, emphasizing the need for a holistic approach that incorporates all three pillars of sustainability. It highlights the importance of the mining and minerals sector to Sweden's economy and its commitment to environmental responsibility. Additionally, it calls for the government to update proposals from the Environmental Authority Inquiry aimed at improving environmental work efficiency and to allocate extra resources to agencies to reduce processing times for permit applications.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:4 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 - Förlängda och förstärkta stöd och ersättningar med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the implementation of a 'lex Ahmed' for the police, aimed at establishing a framework that allows for organizational learning from mistakes rather than focusing on disciplining individual officers. This initiative is prompted by the unresolved murder case of Ahmed Obaid, highlighting the need for a system similar to those in healthcare and aviation that promotes accountability and improvement in police practices.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:4 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 - Förlängda och förstärkta stöd och ersättningar med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should initiate an investigation into the gray areas surrounding end-of-life care, including euthanasia. It emphasizes the importance of evaluating current legislation in light of public opinion, which shows a strong majority in favor of allowing individuals to have a say in their end-of-life decisions. The motion highlights inconsistencies in pain relief practices across different regions and underlines the need for more uniform regulations regarding end-of-life care.

title: Erkännande av Jerusalem som Israels huvudstad
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider providing state funding for archaeological excavations at Uppåkra, a historically significant Iron Age site in Skåne. It highlights the site's importance, including evidence of transitions between paganism and Christianity, and argues that current funding comes solely from local municipalities, which is deemed insufficient and inequitable given the site's national cultural heritage. The motion calls for state support to facilitate further excavations and make findings accessible to the public.

title: Erkännande av folkmordet 1915
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the support area division for national and compensation support in northern Sweden, arguing that the current structure leads to unequal treatment of farmers in Umeå and Skellefteå municipalities. It highlights how the division, based on temperature measurements, has unfairly penalized some farmers while benefiting others and calls for the removal of these 'islands' of support to ensure equitable conditions for all farmers in the region, which is essential for local food production and resilience.

title: Utgivaransvar för databaser och hets mot folkgrupp
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:95 av Mia Sydow Mölleby m.fl. (V)
summary: The suggestion advocates for the establishment of a year-round ferry service between Umeå and Holmön to address ongoing transportation issues experienced by residents. The lack of reliable communication has been a persistent problem, impacting the daily lives and businesses of those living on the island. Various governmental actors have been involved, but solutions have been inadequate, leading to concerns about the sustainability of life on Holmön.

title: Ett modernt och demokratiskt statsskick
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:94 av Mia Sydow Mölleby m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the allbolag legislation to facilitate housing construction in smaller municipalities by municipal housing companies, addressing the current overly strict focus on business-like operations which restricts building in less urbanized areas despite existing demand for housing.

title: Riksdagsledamöternas arvoden och ersättningar
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:93 av Mia Sydow Mölleby m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes to allow the sale of beer and wine in licensed grocery stores in Sweden, arguing that the current Systembolaget monopoly has led to significant illegal sales, particularly among youth, and has not decreased alcohol consumption. It suggests implementing stricter licensing with rigorous controls to prevent sales to minors, while also supporting rural shops and simplifying access for residents in sparsely populated areas.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of farm sales for beer, wine, and cider in Sweden, allowing producers to sell their products directly to customers on-site without volume restrictions. The proponents argue that this would benefit rural tourism and businesses by enabling customers to purchase products directly from producers, creating added value and enhancing marketing opportunities. They express the belief that allowing farm sales could encourage competition and better reflect consumer choice, while still retaining the Systembolaget monopoly.

title: Bättre förutsättningar för polisens arbete
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:91 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion addresses the challenges faced by cross-border commuters in the Öresund region, proposing several measures to ensure equal treatment regarding taxation, social security, and unemployment insurance. It calls for the Swedish government to work with other Nordic countries to create clearer regulations and communication pathways, particularly during crises like the COVID-19 pandemic, and to eliminate double taxation on pensions. The motion emphasizes the need for a fairer unemployment insurance system for these workers and greater flexibility in social security regulations.

title: Strategi för kriminalvården
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:90 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion advocates for a review of regulations that lead to the closure of clubs in Swedish cities, emphasizing the need to support cultural and nightlife activities which have been adversely affected by strict noise regulations and the economic impact of COVID-19. It highlights examples from other European cities that successfully maintain vibrant nightlife and cultural scenes through supportive measures, suggesting that a lively culture is essential for the vibrancy of cities.

title: Översyn av riksdagsordningen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:89 av Mia Sydow Mölleby m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal aims to enhance Sweden's drug policy by advocating for preventive measures in addiction treatment, a comprehensive evaluation of current drug legislation, and the exploration of decriminalization of drug use. It emphasizes the need for healthcare to oversee addiction treatment, increase support for families affected by addiction, and consider implementing supervised injection spaces to reduce drug-related deaths. The motion also calls for the allowance of continued treatment for individuals who may still be using drugs, arguing for a more compassionate and effective approach to dealing with substance abuse issues.

title: Religiösa skolor, jämställdhet och hederskultur
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support an investigation into the country's electricity pricing areas and differentiated compensation for electricity prices. It highlights the increasing price differences between the four electricity areas in Sweden, which negatively impact businesses and households. The motion calls for a review of the electricity areas to aim for a unified national price area to better serve Swedish citizens and businesses, considering the economic implications and structural imbalances in the electricity supply system.

title: Bistånd till kvinnors och flickors frigörelsekamp
summary: The motion proposes increasing the speed limit for A-traktors from 30 km/h to 45 km/h to match that of class 1 EU mopeds, arguing that A-traktors should be treated similarly due to their comparable nature and the improvements in safety regulations. The author highlights the freedom it provides for individuals unable to drive conventional cars, while also asserting that such a change would reduce the temptation to modify vehicles for higher speeds.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:140 2020 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a tax deduction for donations made to cultural organizations, similar to existing tax deductions available for donations to social assistance and scientific research. The aim is to enhance financial support for both national and local cultural activities while ensuring continued separation between state funding and cultural operations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2020/21:4 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 - Förlängda och förstärkta stöd och ersättningar med anledning av coronaviruset
Avkvotering av föräldraförsäkringen
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:84 av Alexander Christiansson och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for an increase in operating subsidies for municipal airports that provide state-subsidized flight traffic in order to ensure their viability. With ongoing reductions in these subsidies alongside rising operational costs, many municipalities face financial strain, forcing them to allocate resources from other crucial areas such as education and healthcare. The motion emphasizes the need for sustained municipal airports to maintain essential transportation services across less accessible regions of Sweden.

title: Flytta den svenska ambassaden från Tel Aviv till Jerusalem
summary: The motion advocates for increasing knowledge and education about cooperative enterprises in Sweden. It highlights the importance of cooperatives to the economy, noting that many cooperative companies face challenges due to a lack of awareness and understanding among educational institutions, financial institutions, and government bodies. The proposal calls for incorporating cooperative business models into higher education curricula, increasing research on cooperatives, and ensuring that public financial advisory services adequately support cooperative enterprises.

title: Stoppa bistånd till palestinska myndigheter
summary: The motion proposes urgent and long-term interventions to prevent the recruitment of children and young people into gangs. It highlights the increasing violence and criminality involving minors in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a collective societal effort to address the issue. The motion calls for intensified preventive measures, such as providing summer activities, increased child benefits, and enhanced cooperation between the police and other authorities to safeguard young people's development and ensure a safer society.

title: Stöd förföljda kristna
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish government to resume the development of voting aids for visually impaired individuals to enable them to vote independently while maintaining ballot secrecy. Currently, those with severe visual impairments struggle to vote autonomously due to existing laws that require assistance, thereby compromising their privacy. The motion emphasizes the necessity of creating reliable methods for these individuals to identify and cast their votes without external help, highlighting that halting such developments contradicts previous parliamentary agreements and undermines democratic rights.

title: Enskilda avlopp
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:80 av Alexander Christiansson och Runar Filper (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for exempting professionals in the education and healthcare sectors from the obligation to report individuals at risk of deportation, highlighting the ethical dilemmas this requirement could create for those tasked with educating and caring for vulnerable populations. It cites the Convention on the Rights of the Child, emphasizing that all children, including undocumented ones, have the right to education, and argues that the duty to report could deter individuals from seeking necessary care and support. The proposal aims to ensure that public institutions remain inclusive and that professionals can focus on their primary roles without navigating complicated ethical issues.

title: Upphörande av bistånd till den palestinska myndigheten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should advocate for increased EU pressure on the Iranian regime to release all political prisoners and expand sanctions against regime officials and their families. It calls for Sweden to take a leading role in designating the Islamic Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organization and to organize an international solidarity conference for those supporting democracy and freedom in Iran. This response follows the brutal oppression faced by Iranians since the protests sparked by the death of Jina Mahsa Amini.

title: Minnesdag tillägnad kommunismens offer
summary: The motion proposes the abolishment of the waiting period deduction (karensavdrag) in Sweden, arguing that it creates unfair differences in job conditions between various professions, particularly affecting those who must physically be present at work, such as healthcare and education workers. The motion highlights that most Nordic countries have eliminated this deduction, and it calls for the government to take immediate action to rectify this situation for all professional sectors, as it hinders recruitment and contributes to economic insecurity among workers.

title: Strategi för inlemmande av Taiwan i internationella organisationer
summary: The suggestion advocates for broadening the options available for adjusting study pace for participants in folk high schools, emphasizing the need for flexibility in terms of time and support for those who may not have thrived in the traditional education system. It highlights the unique pedagogical approach of folkbildning, which allows individuals, especially those with functional variations or specific needs, to progress at their own pace without the risk of losing their eligibility for student financial aid (CSN) due to perceived delays in course completion.

title: Verka för att Taiwan tillåts delta i WHO
summary: The proposal advocates for the investigation of eliminating the failing grade 'F' in Swedish primary schools, citing rising mental health issues among students. It argues that the current grading system contributes to significant stress and anxiety, hindering students' learning experiences. By abolishing the 'F' grade, the motion aims to create a more encouraging educational environment that allows students to learn from failures, thereby increasing opportunities for students to qualify for high school and ultimately improve their life prospects.

title: Terrorklassning av Afa
summary: The proposal advocates for amending the law governing economic associations to allow certain cooperative rental associations to own and operate subsidiaries. This change aims to enhance the viability and growth of cooperative rental housing, which is seen as a sustainable and beneficial form of housing. Currently, existing legislation restricts these associations from engaging in subsidiary ownership, hampering their ability to adapt and grow within the housing market, particularly in areas with high demand for new housing.

title: Villa Bonnier som talmansbostad
summary: This motion calls for an analysis of the consequences that decreased state funding for folk high schools has on individuals with disabilities. It emphasizes the importance of folk high schools as a complementary education option that caters to the individual needs of students, particularly those with disabilities who may require on-campus living to benefit fully from their education. The motion highlights the significant number of individuals with disabilities among folk high school students and argues for the government to recognize the adverse effects of the funding cuts on their educational opportunities and social participation.

title: Återför ansvaret för att föreslå ny statsminister för riksdagen till statschefen
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should continue to affirm its commitment to international solidarity by allocating 1% of its Gross National Income (GNI) to foreign aid and ensuring the presence of Swedish youth delegates in the UN's processes. The motion argues that this commitment has historically given Sweden a strong global voice and that recent governmental cuts to youth representation undermine this tradition, which has critical implications for Sweden's role in promoting human rights, climate policy, and international cooperation.

title: Rätt att framföra lätt motorcykel med körkortsbehörighet B
summary: The motion proposes the removal of the 'speed premium' in the parental insurance system to promote gender equality in the labor market and improve the welfare of children. Introduced in 1986, this premium allows women who have a second child within specific time frames to retain the same compensation level as their first child. Studies indicate that this policy has led to increased birth rates in quick succession, negatively impacting women's long-term income and children's educational preparedness. The proposal argues that abolishing the premium could encourage women to work full-time between pregnancies, enhancing their economic independence and addressing disparities in unpaid and paid labor.

title: Ändrad placering av ledamöter i plenisalen
summary: The suggestion advocates for a review of the unfair sick pay deductibles (karensavdrag) that penalize workers unable to work from home during illness. It highlights the negative impact of these deductions on low-paid workers, particularly in caregiving and essential roles, who are at higher risk of illness but cannot choose to stay home without suffering financial loss. The proposal urges the government to reassess how these policies disproportionately affect vulnerable workers.

title: Ändring i grundlagen och avlägsnande av EU-symbol i riksdagens plenisal
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament encourage the government to explore the possibility of cross-border statistics, highlighting the challenges faced by communities bordering other countries, such as Norway. The author points out that current data often fails to capture the economic realities of families with cross-border employment, which can lead to misunderstandings about local economic conditions. The absence of cross-border statistics was notably problematic during the pandemic, and there is a call for the state to take a more active role in addressing this issue to support work and growth across national borders.

title: Riksmötets öppnande i Rikssalen
summary: The motion proposes reviewing the possibility of implementing a licensed hunt for cormorants and increasing egg treatment measures throughout Sweden to manage cormorant populations, which are negatively impacting the fishing industry and the ecological balance in the Stockholm archipelago. The authors argue that cormorants, while part of Sweden's fauna, have proliferated to such an extent that they threaten both local biodiversity and the livelihoods of professional fishermen, necessitating more effective population control strategies.

title: Utvidgad nödvärnsrätt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:68 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider implementing a legalized or protected professional title for orthoptists, emphasizing the specialized care required in examining children's vision. Currently, orthoptists operate under delegation from ophthalmologists without formal recognition. The proposal highlights the need for proper qualifications and could help reduce waiting times in pediatric eye care by allowing for broader establishment of competent orthoptist clinics.

title: Statligt testamentsregister
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament support a review of regulations to require clearer labeling on food packaging, aiming to enhance consumer awareness and facilitate healthier choices in light of rising obesity rates. It points to the pressing public health issues related to overweight and obesity and advocates for more visible information regarding energy content, fat, sugar, and salt on food products, drawing examples from effective practices in the UK.

title: Statligt huvudmannaskap för sjukvården
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament support a hunting season for roe deer bucks starting from August 16. This change is motivated by concerns about the impact of spring hunting on the roe deer population, particularly regarding the need for large males during the breeding season and the potential negative effects on the genetic diversity of the population. The authors argue that spring hunting may jeopardize wildlife management due to the influx of foreign hunters seeking to maximize their experience without consideration for conservation.

title: Reformerad plastpåseskatt
summary: The proposal suggests a review of the stamp duty system for property deeds and mortgages, arguing that the current tax rates are excessively high and not reflective of the actual administrative costs incurred by authorities. In light of the shift to digital processing, the motion advocates for either a restructure of the tax into a flat fee or a significant reduction of the current percentage rates to alleviate the financial burden on property buyers and promote housing development.

title: Förbud mot koldioxidbedövning vid slakt
summary: The motion proposes measures to reduce accidents associated with new mobility solutions such as electric scooters and unicycles, particularly in urban areas where these vehicles are increasingly used. It highlights the risks posed to pedestrians when these vehicles are operated at high speeds, suggesting that reducing speed limits and motor power would be effective strategies to enhance safety for all road users.

title: Ett transparent skattesystem
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should examine the possibility of halting public funding for religious activities and ending the Swedish Church's right to collect membership fees through the Tax Agency. The motion argues for true secularism in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a clear separation between state and religion to uphold democracy and ensure that tax funds are allocated to public services rather than religious practices.

title: Beredskapslag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament urges the government to publicly apologize to the families of the crew members who died in the 1961 plane crash that killed UN Secretary-General Dag Hammarskjöld. It calls for continued diplomatic pressure on nations to release relevant records regarding the incident, the establishment of a truth commission to investigate the Swedish government's decisions during the investigations from 1961-1962, and access to all available documents, including classified ones, for this commission and researchers.

title: Assisterad dödshjälp för svårt sjuka
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament takes back democratic control over railway maintenance by reinstating it as a state-run operation. It argues that the current deregulated system has led to insufficient maintenance and cost control, as highlighted by various reports. The motion emphasizes that effective railway maintenance is crucial for the increasing demand on rail traffic and that returning this responsibility to the state will help establish better oversight and accountability.

title: Sekretess vid våldtäkt
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need for increased construction of rental apartments for young people in Sweden, highlighting the current housing shortage that forces many young individuals to live with their parents until well into adulthood. It advocates for the reinstatement of government investment support aimed specifically at building rental accommodations for youth and students, which had previously been successful during the Social Democratic government but was eliminated by the subsequent center-right administration. The motion calls for action to ensure accessible housing options that facilitate independence for young people and contribute to a healthier demographic trend.

title: Socialtjänstens utredningar
summary: The motion proposes to clarify the school law to ensure that education is entirely free of charge, eliminating hidden fees that currently burden students and parents. It highlights the financial strain caused by additional costs for meals, sports equipment, and technology, which perpetuate inequality in the education system. The motion also advocates for collaboration with organizations like sports banks to provide equitable access to sports and leisure activities for all students, regardless of their family's financial situation.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 - Förlängda och förstärkta stöd och ersättningar med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to urgently develop a plan for a fair transition to a sustainable society, emphasizing the importance of addressing climate change and protecting community well-being. It proposes that guidelines for public procurement be adjusted to prioritize 100% sustainable goods and services, highlighting the economic impact of public purchasing and the need to support local producers. The authors stress the urgency of these actions given the current government's climate policies, which they perceive as inadequate.

title: Öka handelsutbytet med Kosovo
summary: This motion proposes that all children in preschool up to the age of 12 should be offered at least ten hours of after-school care per week and during school vacations, with plans for making this service free of charge. Additionally, it suggests that school transportation for eligible children should be adjusted according to their attendance at after-school care. The aim is to enhance the quality and accessibility of after-school services, ensuring equitable opportunities for all children to engage in activities that support their development, learning, and social skills.

title: Utbilda för arbete
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for cross-party discussions on Sweden's energy issues due to the anticipated increase in electricity demand driven by population growth and the transition from fossil fuels to electric solutions in industry and transport. It calls for a review of Sweden's electrical pricing zones to address significant price increases, especially in southern Sweden, where infrastructure bottlenecks have led to higher costs for consumers and industries. The proposal highlights the importance of creating stable conditions for energy production and competitive electricity prices to maintain the viability of electric-intensive industries in the country.

title: Inför en skatt på sockrade och kolsyrade drycker
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:56 av Mikael Strandman och Monika Lövgren (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support efforts to enhance state presence in all regions of the country, particularly focusing on relocating government agencies to areas that currently lack them. The authors emphasize the importance of ensuring that all parts of Sweden feel included in government activities to prevent feelings of division and to promote national unity. They highlight past relocations of agencies and argue that Halland, which has yet to receive any relocated authority, should be prioritized in these efforts to foster inclusivity.

title: Stärk skyddet för etniska och kulturella svenskar inom hatbrottslagstiftningen
summary: This proposal aims to enhance security for entrepreneurs in Sweden by advocating for improved regulations regarding sick pay, unemployment insurance, and high-cost protection for small businesses. It emphasizes the importance of promoting entrepreneurship within the educational system and aims to ensure that self-employed individuals have opportunities similar to those of traditional employees. The proposal outlines specific measures to support entrepreneurs, acknowledging their role in job creation and economic dynamism.

title: Avskaffa kravet på certifierad kontrollansvarig
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:54 av Mikael Strandman och Monika Lövgren (båda SD)
summary: The proposal emphasizes strengthening military and civil defense in Halland, particularly highlighting the importance of the air defense regiment Lv 6. It argues that in light of increasing security threats, particularly due to Russia's aggression in Ukraine, a modern and effective defense is essential for Sweden's peace and independence. The motion calls for increased investments in air defense and improved resources for Lv 6 to address current and future challenges in national and international security.

title: Striktare krav för namnteckning vid identitetshandlingar utfärdade av myndigheter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:53 av Mikael Strandman och Thomas Morell (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive national innovation strategy focusing on intellectual property rights to enhance the commercialization of research results, improve knowledge among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) about protecting their innovations, and combat the impact of piracy and illegal activities like illegal IPTV. It emphasizes the need for deeper analysis of patent data and better collaboration between academia and industry to ensure Sweden remains a world leader in innovation.

title: Id-märkning av katt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:52 av Monika Lövgren och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes a review to limit or abolish cost-increasing systems within the healthcare sector to ensure that patients receive care based on need rather than financial constraints. The authors argue that the current cost crisis affects regional healthcare as insufficient government funding leads to reliance on expensive temporary staffing and the misuse of digital healthcare services, which can drain resources from traditional care. They highlight the necessity to regulate private healthcare companies and ensure that public funding is aligned with patient needs rather than corporate profits.

title: Bostadstillägg för pensionärer
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:51 av Mikael Strandman och Monika Lövgren (båda SD)
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for increased national funding for public transport outside urban areas in Sweden. It argues that a well-functioning public transport system is crucial for maintaining cohesion in the country and supporting the transition to more environmentally friendly transportation options. The authors highlight the challenges posed by sparse populations and fragmented financing, stressing that addressing public transport issues should be a national environmental priority requiring greater financial commitment.

title: Avskaffande av lagen (2014:227) om färdigställandeskydd
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:50 av Mikael Strandman och Monika Lövgren (båda SD)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need for a sustainable infrastructure in Halland, noting its significance for national interests and the regional economy. It highlights the critical role of efficient transport systems, including roads and railways like the Västkustbanan, in promoting growth and connectivity, especially in the context of increasing daily commutes and freight transport. Investment in infrastructure is depicted as essential for ensuring economic competitiveness, environmental sustainability, and overall regional development in collaboration with surrounding areas.

title: Förenklade regler för omräkning av andelstal i vägsamfälligheter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:49 av Mikael Larsson och Per Schöldberg (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament ensure long-term funding for women's shelters (kvinnojourer) in Halland and across the country through state support. It highlights the urgent societal problem of violence against women, citing statistics on domestic violence and the critical role of women shelters in providing necessary assistance to victims. The motion emphasizes the need for sustainable financing, as many shelters face financial instability and potential closure due to diminishing municipal grants.

title: Trafikpoliser
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:48 av Martina Johansson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a temporary educational position for preschool teachers and teachers who are currently studying, aiming to address the teacher shortage in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of encouraging students who have completed at least 50% of their teacher training with passing grades to work in the education sector. The authors highlight the necessity of integrating practical training with educational theory and support for non-certified teachers to eventually attain certification, thereby strengthening collaboration between educational institutions and school administrators.

title: Bidrag till civilsamhället
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the consideration of a national initiative for organized recess activities in schools. It highlights the growing concern about children's mental health and physical inactivity during recess, advocating for a structured approach to enhance the school environment. The proposal calls for the appointment of a national recess coordinator, the allocation of resources to municipalities for planned recess activities, and the provision of research funding to improve knowledge about organized recess.

title: Förenkla för företag inom besöksnäringen
summary: The proposal aims to enhance rehabilitation within the sickness insurance system in Sweden by examining the rights to rehabilitation and early interventions. It suggests developing the sickness insurance framework to provide more sick individuals with access to preventive measures and the appropriate support for rehabilitation. This initiative seeks to shift the focus from reactive responses after deterioration of health to proactive measures to prevent long-term absence from work due to illness. The motion emphasizes the need for a comprehensive strategy involving various stakeholders to effectively support the sick from the onset of their conditions.

title: Förenklade tillståndsansökningar och tillsyn
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for investments to enhance the transport infrastructure in the Stockholm-Mälar region, citing the high volume of daily commuters and the critical role of this region's transport system for the entire country. It highlights that although the national infrastructure plan (2022-2033) has begun to address some issues, significant gaps remain that could hinder sustainable growth and transport reliability in the region. The motion calls for robust infrastructure development to support increased capacity and efficiency, benefiting not only the local population but also the national transport network as a whole.

title: Samverkan för att minska psykisk ohälsa
summary: The proposal aims to enhance regulations regarding public procurement by limiting the number of subcontractors and requiring that subcontractors be approved by the primary contractor. This initiative seeks to ensure responsible procurement practices that guarantee quality services, uphold labor standards, and reduce the potential misuse of public funds, emphasizing the importance of systematic follow-up and compliance with contractual obligations.

title: Beredskapsflygplatser i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations concerning corporate groups owning application doctor services, pharmacies, and healthcare centers, emphasizing the need to prevent conflicts of interest that could arise from physicians having financial stakes in pharmacies. It highlights concerns regarding the potential over-prescription of medication due to financial incentives, as well as the risk of pharmacies directing customers towards additional services within the same corporate group, which could undermine patient care. The motion argues for updated legislation to encompass the new corporate structures in the healthcare sector to ensure patient safety and manage costs effectively.

title: Handledning som arbetsmarknadsstöd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate how to incorporate digital technology to facilitate the management of firearm licenses, including the possibility of an electronic license verified through mobile Bank ID, responding to strong public demand for such improvements.

title: Kostnad för överklagandeprocesser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establish a structure to provide newly arrived immigrants with a contact person or contact family to facilitate their integration into Swedish society. It argues that while Sweden has improved integration significantly, challenges remain, particularly regarding employment and social segregation. By having a contact person, newcomers would have better opportunities to practice the language and form connections within the community, thereby enhancing their integration experience.

title: Lika förutsättningar för utförare inom skola, vård och omsorg
summary: The proposal aims to empower social services with the ability to implement a form of intermediate coercion, referred to as mellantvång, to better serve children and young people at risk. It emphasizes the need for timely intervention in cases where voluntary measures fail due to parental resistance or when children are in detrimental or criminal environments. The motion asserts that prioritizing the best interests of the child necessitates stronger tools for social services to facilitate support and prevent further involvement in criminal activities.

title: Nationell enhet inom polisen för utredning av brott mot lantbrukare av djurrättsaktivister
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider whether security guards should be required to work for authorized security companies to perform their duties. This review is motivated by concerns over public trust in the profession, particularly given reports of excessive force and discrimination associated with security personnel in the entertainment industry. The aim is to enhance the legitimacy and accountability of security guards by potentially restricting them to employment within regulated firms.

title: Pedagogiska tjänster och fjärrundervisning
summary: The motion proposes a review of the Municipal Act to allow political parties to influence the resignation of elected officials who leave their party to become independent, or 'political freeloaders'. This arises from concerns that such officials can maintain their positions and salaries, potentially undermining the influence of the party they were elected to represent.

title: Samarbete för framtida planering av elstamnätet
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to actively support an international framework that allows developing countries to exchange state debt for climate and environmental measures. It emphasizes the need for wealthy developed nations to lead in financing climate adaptation and development in these vulnerable countries, arguing that a fair transition must ensure all nations can grow sustainably, regardless of their economic status.

title: Säkerställ att skadestånd utbetalas till de drabbade
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider amending the school law regarding the educational costs for children with protected identities. It highlights the financial challenges faced by municipalities due to rising costs and inadequate state funding, particularly for schools accommodating children with protected identities, who often require additional support. The proposal emphasizes the need for resources to meet the educational needs of these students, as municipalities currently do not receive compensation for their expenses.

title: Förbättrad lagstiftning kring skattereduktion för gåvor till ideell verksamhet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:35 av Mattias Karlsson i Norrhult (SD)
summary: The suggestion advocates for a review of measures to reduce traffic accidents at roadwork sites in Sweden, proposing increased use of mobile speed cameras and stricter enforcement of traffic regulations to enhance safety for both drivers and workers. It highlights the rising concern among workers about safety and the need for better compliance with existing regulations, as well as suggestions for improving inspections and driver education regarding work zones.

title: Fördjupat transatlantiskt samarbete för att globalt avkriminalisera homosexualitet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:34 av Mattias Karlsson i Norrhult (SD)
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish Parliament to support the planning of the Ostlänken infrastructure project, emphasizing the need for environmentally friendly new railway lines. It highlights challenges in maintaining budgetary constraints while ensuring effective regional transport hubs and calls for improved planning conditions to facilitate timely construction and minimize costs. The authors urge the government to expedite the expansion of the Ostlänken railway line between Järna and Linköping.

title: Motion angående ökat statligt stöd för giftsanering i småländska glasriket och andra platser
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:33 av Mattias Karlsson i Norrhult (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should explore the possibility of designating certain ports as strategically important in infrastructure planning, allowing the state to take greater responsibility in coordinating infrastructure investments for maritime transport. The motion emphasizes the importance of shipping for goods transport, especially in light of the expected increase in shipping volumes and lower environmental impact. It calls for a cohesive policy to integrate maritime transport planning with road and rail infrastructure, with the Swedish Maritime Administration being tasked with enhanced responsibilities for connections to these strategic ports.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:179 Förskottsbetalning i vissa ärenden om utlämnande av allmän handling
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:32 av Mia Sydow Mölleby m.fl. (V)
summary: The suggestion advocates for reforming the Public Water Services Act to facilitate reinvestment and new investment in water and sewage systems in order to achieve a sustainable water supply. The current legislation is seen as a barrier that limits flexibility in the fee system and imposes a requirement for balance within a three-year period, hindering long-term investments necessary for modernization and climate adaptation. The proposed reform aims to provide municipalities with better conditions to address the challenges related to secure drinking water and environmental protection.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:186 Ett förstärkt medarbetarskydd för polisanställda
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:31 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes the restoration and improvement of the work injury insurance system, emphasizing its importance as a crucial part of the social safety net. The motion advocates for full income security until retirement for those affected by work-related injuries and highlights the need for active workplace health services to effectively address and prevent long-term sick leave. The proposal calls on the government to consider recent recommendations from the work injury investigation that aim to enhance working conditions and maintain trust in the welfare system.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:171 Riksrevisionens rapport om konsumentskydd vid köp av nyproducerade bostadsrätter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:30 av Momodou Malcolm Jallow m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion calls for a review of the seal and cormorant populations in the Baltic Sea due to their significant increase in the past decades, which has led to severe impacts on both professional and recreational fishing. The proposal suggests that the government should assess the need for additional measures, including potentially increasing hunting quotas for these species, to ensure the sustainability of fisheries in Sweden's waters.

title: Olaglig skyltning längs väg
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:29 av Matheus Enholm och Caroline Nordengrip (båda SD)
summary: The motion suggests a review of the discount applied in sentencing for repeated crimes, known as 'mängdrabatt', to ensure that individuals convicted of multiple offenses receive harsher and clearer penalties, particularly for serious crimes. The proposal aims to enhance public trust in the justice system and send a stronger signal to both victims and offenders regarding the seriousness of repeated criminal behavior.

title: Säkerställ tillgången på jodtabletter
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:28 av Monika Lövgren och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should update its AI strategy to regain its status as a global leader in digitalization and AI. It emphasizes the importance of responsibly and ethically harnessing AI to benefit society while addressing challenges related to security, privacy, and democratic values. Additionally, it calls for increased investments in research and education to enhance digital competence within the AI field and emphasizes the need for collaboration between state actors, academic institutions, and the private sector, using best practices from leading countries like Estonia.

title: Vaccination mot TBE i det allmänna barnvaccinationsprogrammet
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:27 av Monika Lövgren och Mikael Strandman (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment and development of training facilities for railway-related professions in the Stockholm-Mälar region, aiming to address a severe shortage of skilled workers necessary for railway maintenance and new construction. The motion highlights the significant economic consequences of this skills gap, estimated to cost society up to 25 billion SEK over the next decade, along with lost tax revenues and delayed infrastructure projects. It emphasizes the need for regional training programs and adequate resources to ensure a competent workforce to support the region's infrastructure development.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: Hans Ekström's motion requests the Swedish parliament to review and modernize the parking legislation, which is seen as outdated and lacking adequate consumer protection. The proposal highlights issues such as the burden placed on consumers regarding parking fines, the inconsistency in penalties across municipalities, and the reliance on revenue generation from fines by local governments and private parking companies. Ekström argues that a comprehensive investigation is needed to create a more equitable and fair parking system that aligns with current technological advancements and consumer rights.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:193 Kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om utländska direktinvesteringar
summary: This motion proposes a review of the Public Procurement Act (LOU) to ensure future competence in the construction industry by requiring construction companies to employ apprentices and provide internship opportunities for students in public contracts. The motion emphasizes the increasing demand for skilled workers and calls for stipulations that support the training of tradespeople through apprenticeships and adequate supervision, with the aim of bolstering the workforce in the construction sector.

title: Förbud mot muslimska friskolor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament strengthen the consultation process with labor unions regarding labor market policies aimed at integrating the unemployed into the workforce through measures like internships. It emphasizes the importance of monitoring subsidized employment to prevent employers from exploiting these subsidies to distort competition.

title: Förbud mot heltäckande muslimsk slöja
summary: This proposal calls for stricter regulations on the marketing of telemedicine services, commonly referred to as network doctors. It argues that the current advertising practices contribute to unnecessary health concerns among the public, leading to an increased demand for healthcare services that do not require professional medical attention. The motion emphasizes that healthcare should be readily available for genuine needs and that marketing strategies used by private companies can distort patients' perceptions of their health, undermining the integrity of the healthcare system.

title: Stopp för utländsk finansiering av moskéer
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the collaboration between organizations involved in rehabilitation services by further developing the Finsam legislation. It emphasizes the need for a review of the current legislative framework to include more areas and facilitate data sharing among different authorities. The motion argues that improved coordination among municipalities, regions, the Employment Agency, and the Social Insurance Agency can significantly enhance support for individuals requiring rehabilitation, thereby increasing their chances of achieving a better and safer life.

title: Slöjförbud i den svenska för- och grundskolan
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the EBO (Eget Boende) law, which allows asylum seekers in Sweden to choose their place of residence. The authors argue that this law has led to increased segregation, as many asylum seekers settle in areas with larger communities of fellow nationals, resulting in demographics that lack diversity. They claim that this contributes to overcrowding and can foster tensions, potentially leading to higher crime rates. The motion supports recent government changes that exclude certain areas from this law but emphasizes the need for a full abolition to promote better integration.

title: Uniformer fria från religiösa och politiska markörer
summary: The motion proposes to enhance care and treatment for young individuals sentenced to closed youth custody, addressing their complex issues and the challenges faced by the current system. It highlights the responsibilities of society in supporting at-risk youth, particularly those with severe psychosocial problems. The authors emphasize the need for improvements in the treatment facilities under Statens institutionsstyrelse (Sis), citing issues such as escapes, violence, and inadequate support. The aim is to provide better care to prevent these youths from falling into criminality and to promote their reintegration into society.

title: Förbud mot halal- och koscherslakt
summary: The proposal advocates for an urgent investigation into the effects of the Fehmarn Bält connection's opening in 2029 on Sweden's transportation infrastructure. The new underwater tunnel between Germany and Denmark is expected to significantly impact Swedish imports and exports by providing faster trade routes. The motion highlights the potential increase in truck traffic by up to 120% while cautioning that the rail transport capacity in Sweden is already constrained, which could complicate efforts to shift goods transport from road to rail as per EU targets. The motion calls for a swift assessment to optimize Sweden's infrastructure in light of these developments.

title: Förbud mot kommersiellt bruk av allemansrätten
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:18 av Caroline Nordengrip och Matheus Enholm (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes to the Swedish Parliament the introduction of an expanded educational requirement for unemployed individuals receiving social assistance, aiming to improve labor market matching and increase the participation in vocational education programs. It highlights the issue of a high number of unemployed individuals, many of whom lack relevant skills, while also addressing the inconsistencies in the current educational obligations and funding systems.

title: Applåder under debatt
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:17 av Caroline Nordengrip och Bo Broman (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the establishment of a national responsibility for the preservation and accessibility of the cultural heritage of Uppåkra, as well as the creation of an international center for interdisciplinary research at the site. It highlights the historical significance of Uppåkra as a major Iron Age urban center and the ongoing archaeological efforts that engage both the public and children in discovering and understanding history through archaeology.

title: Sjuklön vid icke-medicinskt ingrepp
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:16 av Caroline Nordengrip och Josef Fransson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate ways to improve waste management practices to mitigate the spread of African swine fever, following its first reported outbreak among wild boars in Sweden. It highlights the importance of proper handling of food and waste to prevent wild boars from accessing potentially infectious material, thereby reducing the risk of virus transmission and protecting both animal welfare and national food security.

title: Stärkt konsumentskydd på inlåningsmarknaden
