summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should actively support the maintenance of the 'one country, two systems' principle regarding Hong Kong, in line with the EU's stance. It highlights concerns over China's actions that undermine Hong Kong's autonomy and calls for Sweden to clearly express criticism when international agreements that China has committed to are not upheld. This is deemed essential for promoting justice and democratic values in the region.

title: En granskning av public services opartiskhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should advocate for the selection of the next Dalai Lama to be a matter exclusively of Tibetan and religious significance, free from political interference, particularly from China. The authors emphasize the importance of the Dalai Lama's role as a spiritual leader and symbol of Tibetan identity and independence, highlighting the need for international support against Chinese influence over this religious process.

title: Stoppa skattehöjningarna på drivmedel
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national arena for building preservation in Sweden to enhance the efforts of existing organizations and communities dedicated to maintaining and promoting building care. It argues that despite a growing public interest in building preservation, the current fragmented responsibility and lack of resources hinder effective collaboration and knowledge transfer in this field. The motivation emphasizes the need to update societal views on building care, integrating environmental, cultural, and historical perspectives, similar to practices in other countries like France.

title: Skärpta regler kring samordningsnumren
summary: The proposal outlines a comprehensive national plan aimed at phasing out fossil fuels in Sweden by 2030, alongside the introduction of various renewable energy initiatives including the expansion of offshore wind and solar energy. Key measures include abolishing fossil fuel subsidies, classifying peat as a fossil fuel, reforming local veto rights regarding wind power, and enhancing the efficiency of renewable energy generation and utilization through state support. The motion emphasizes a shift towards a robust energy system focused on sustainability and reducing reliance on fossil fuels, while addressing energy poverty and providing incentives for energy efficiency.

title: Skärpta regler för passhantering och skärpta straff för otillåten passhantering
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should actively pursue the establishment of a global disarmament agreement aimed at halting the extraction and production of fossil fuels. It emphasizes the urgent need for international cooperation to ensure a just transition to renewable energy and to align with climate goals, specifically the aim of limiting global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius. The motion highlights that the fossil fuel industry plans to significantly increase production, which poses a severe risk to climate stability, and calls for Sweden to leverage its history of international engagement in disarmament and environmental issues to lead this effort.

title: Skärp kontrollen vid utbetalning av bidrag samt förändra lagen så att olika myndigheter kan samköra sina register
summary: The motion proposes to phase out the breeding of fast-growing broiler chickens in favor of slower-growing breeds to reduce animal suffering. It emphasizes aligning Swedish legislation with the European Chicken Commitment (ECC) criteria, enhancing animal welfare standards, and prohibiting the use of coccidiostats in chicken farming. The aim is to provide more space and natural living conditions for chickens, thereby addressing systematic animal cruelty in Sweden's poultry industry.

title: Utse granskningsnämnden genom en parlamentarisk grupp
motion_id: Motion 2020/21:10 av Robert Stenkvist och David Lång (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at strengthening the rights and support for national minorities in Sweden, including enhanced language education, permanent funding for language centers, and better public awareness about minority cultures and languages. The suggestions also call for establishing information centers for various minority groups, increasing public service offerings in minority languages, and exploring the possibility of including language as a discrimination ground. The overarching goal is to ensure equality and promote the preservation of minority identities and languages in Sweden.

title: Skärp straffen för fornminnesbrott
summary: The proposal suggests lowering the voting age to 16 years in Sweden to enhance and broaden democracy by including more young people in the electoral process. It advocates for a trial period for this measure in local elections, citing examples from other countries that have already adopted similar changes. The authors argue that involving youth in voting could increase their sense of inclusion and influence in political decision-making, as well as strengthen commitment to democratic values.

title: Rimlig rätt till försörjningsstöd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate an investigation to strengthen the rights of creators and performing artists in light of advancements in artificial intelligence (AI). It advocates for Sweden to take a proactive role within the EU to revise copyright legislation and emphasizes the need for enhanced media and information literacy concerning AI. The motion highlights the challenges posed by generative AI on existing copyright laws, stressing the importance of ensuring that creators' rights are protected and that they receive compensation for the use of their work.

title: Regeringen ska godkänna utländska investeringar av strategisk betydelse
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive approach to modernizing Sweden's water supply and sewage systems (va), emphasizing the need for sustainable practices and climate adaptation. It calls for legislation to ensure municipalities secure water access and quality, the establishment of a municipal stormwater tax, enhanced collaboration between municipalities, and financial support mechanisms for individuals struggling with sanitation costs. The motion advocates for innovations in water conservation, infrastructure updates, and regulatory frameworks to protect water resources and ensure the viability of water services for future generations.

title: Garantera verksamheten vid Uppåkra
summary: The proposal seeks to significantly reduce the use of plastic in Sweden and enhance recycling efforts by phasing out fossil-based plastics, banning certain single-use plastics, and introducing stricter criteria for plastics to facilitate recycling. It emphasizes the importance of clear labeling on packaging regarding material content and recycling instructions, as well as promoting the integration of recycled materials in new plastic products. Additionally, it suggests establishing a deposit system for more plastic products and phasing out harmful chemicals that complicate recycling processes.

title: Krav på registrering av kontantkort
summary: The motion MP2503 proposes a comprehensive green climate action plan for Sweden, which includes declaring a climate emergency, establishing a scientifically based national carbon budget, adopting annual emission budgets, and implementing various regulatory and support measures to facilitate a transition to sustainable practices across multiple sectors, aiming to meet the Paris Agreement targets and enhance local and regional climate adaptation efforts.

title: Inför tidsgränser för språktolk
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the oversight of public procurement in Sweden by granting the Competition Authority increased authority to impose procurement damage fees and requiring that investigation mandates also apply to suppliers, not just procuring authorities. The Social Democrats support these initiatives as a means to improve transparency and compliance in public procurement processes, ensuring better enforcement of reporting requirements and facilitating the monitoring of procurement adherence.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:193 Kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om utländska direktinvesteringar
summary: This motion calls on the Swedish parliament to ensure that the benefits of digitalization are accessible to individuals with disabilities. It emphasizes the right of these individuals to live independently and participate in society equally, highlighting that the transition to a cashless society may create barriers for those who struggle with technology. The motion advocates for tailored digital services that accommodate the needs of people with disabilities, particularly in relation to digital identification and banking services.

title: Hedra Dag Hammarskjölds minne i Sveriges riksdag
summary: The motion aims to strengthen the rights of deaf and hard-of-hearing students in primary school to receive instruction in Swedish sign language. Currently, these students can only access mother-tongue education in sign language if it is also the mother tongue of their parents, which is often not the case. The motion argues for making sign language instruction available to all deaf and hard-of-hearing students, emphasizing the importance of language transfer between parent and child and the legal rights outlined in Swedish language legislation.

title: ILO:s hundraårsdeklaration för framtidens arbetsliv
summary: The motion advocates for the development and implementation of a national strategy for safe maternity and childbirth care in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for research into innovative and safe childbirth practices to reduce maternal injuries, as current statistics show a significant number of women suffer from severe complications during delivery. The authors argue that despite advancements in surgical procedures, there has been insufficient progress in ensuring safe deliveries for women, and call for prioritized funding and initiatives in this area.

title: Tystnadsplikt vid utkontraktering av teknisk bearbetning eller lagring av uppgifter
summary: The proposal advocates for strengthening the Swedish Customs Agency's capabilities in crime prevention and enforcement. It calls for the government to submit the Customs Authority's powers investigation proposals to Parliament, emphasizing the need for all authorities to cooperate in addressing the rising crime rates. The proposal highlights the absence of provisions in existing smuggling legislation that would allow the Customs Agency to conduct investigations and enforce certain measures, arguing for expanded powers comparable to those of the Coast Guard.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om holdingbolag vid universitet och högskolor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the introduction of financial assistance to promote vaccination against TBE (Tick-borne Encephalitis) in risk areas such as Blekinge. The aim is to enhance vaccine uptake, as the disease poses health risks and there is currently no treatment available. The lack of a cost-effective vaccination option may deter residents from seeking vaccination, making it a matter of equality in health access for families in affected regions.

title: En strängare syn på hantering av vapen och explosiva varor
summary: The proposal advocates for the exploration of conditions to subsidize the construction of smaller rental apartments, highlighting a significant shortage of such housing in Blekinge County. It emphasizes that smaller rental units serve as an accessible option for young individuals moving out for the first time, as well as catering to the housing needs of seniors and new employees. The motion calls on the government to review regulations to encourage and support the development of these essential rental properties.

title: Kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om ömsesidigt erkännande av beslut om frysning och beslut om förverkande
summary: The motion proposes establishing a national coordination framework for maritime spatial planning and national interests to facilitate the permitting process for investments in offshore wind power. It highlights the current challenges, such as long timelines and conflicts of interest, that hinder necessary investments towards a sustainable energy system, particularly in areas with high energy demand.

title: Delegationsbestämmelser för Skatterättsnämnden och Forskarskattenämnden och några ändringar i fråga om informationsutbyte på skatteområdet
summary: The motion addresses the need for increased vocational education positions in Blekinge, emphasizing the shortage of qualified workers in various professions such as aviation technicians, nursing assistants, construction workers, preschool teachers, and teachers. It argues that vocational schools play a crucial role in meeting labor market demands and that the government should allocate more training opportunities across Sweden, not just in larger cities. By increasing the number of vocational education spots in Blekinge, the motion aims to support regional growth and ensure a well-functioning labor market.

title: Ändrade regler för taxering av lantbruksenheter och för automatiserat beslutsfattande vid fastighetstaxeringen
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of prioritizing and financing the Sydostlänken infrastructure project to enhance the transportation system in southern Sweden. It is expected to improve connectivity for both freight and passenger traffic, integrate regions including Blekinge and southern Småland into a common labor market, and support a climate-efficient transport corridor for trade with Eastern Europe and Asia. The initiative aims to bolster regional competitiveness, provide new opportunities for effective goods transport, alleviate congestion on the Södra stambanan, and meet the growing demands from local businesses.

title: Kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om utländska direktinvesteringar
summary: The proposal calls for an investigation into the effects of various market solutions in healthcare, specifically regarding adherence to the health and medical care law's principle of providing care based on need. It critiques the privatization and market-driven approaches that have evolved over the past few decades, arguing that they have led to fragmentation and unequal access to healthcare services. The motion emphasizes the necessity for a comprehensive analysis to ensure that resources are allocated equitably and effectively, especially in the wake of challenges exacerbated by the pandemic.

title: Ett ändamålsenligt minoritetsskydd i aktiebolag och ekonomiska föreningar
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of municipalities' responsibility in preventing organized crime that targets welfare systems. It highlights how profits from criminal activities form a foundation for these criminal ecosystems, enabling other crimes such as drug trafficking. The motion calls for legislative support for enhanced information exchange between authorities and a clearer mandate for municipalities to address economic crime and welfare fraud, building on prior government initiatives aimed at combating organized crime.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om effektiviteten i förmedlingsverksamheten
summary: The motion proposes that all usage of fireworks should require a permit due to significant issues surrounding their improper and illegal use in Sweden, which causes public concern, safety risks, and environmental harm. The current regulations are deemed inadequate as they do not allow municipalities to outright prohibit personal use. The motion calls on the government to recognize the need for stricter controls, arguing that a permitting system could help mitigate the risks associated with fireworks, particularly during holiday periods when misuse is prevalent.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om återvändandeverksamheten
summary: The motion proposes to increase the number of rental boards in Sweden to reduce case processing times, aiming to combat illegal subletting and improve the overall state of the housing market. It argues that the current lengthy waiting times—often 1.5 to 2 years in Stockholm—hinder landlords' efforts to address fraud and create order in the housing market, thus exacerbating problems related to the black rental market and limiting access to secure housing for citizens.

title: Ett förstärkt medarbetarskydd för polisanställda
summary: The motion proposes a review and reform of the boarding allowance for high school students studying in a different municipality or facing long commutes. It highlights that while the existing boarding allowance aims to cover some housing and travel costs, its model is outdated in terms of amounts, regulations, and views on transportation methods, necessitating a reevaluation to better reflect current circumstances.

title: Redovisning av fördelning av medel från Allmänna arvsfonden under budgetåret 2019
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance gender equality in higher education by advocating for researcher stipends and grants to be recognized as income for sickness benefit purposes, and by requiring universities to take measures to improve gender equality within academic research. It highlights the underrepresentation of women in senior academic positions despite a majority of female students, and emphasizes the need for political action to support equality and retention of women in research roles.

title: Ekonomiskt arbetsgivarbegrepp - förändrade skatteregler vid tillfälligt arbete i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a law requiring that retouched images in advertising and social media be clearly marked, addressing concerns over unrealistic body ideals that may negatively impact young people's self-image. Drawing on similar legislations in Norway and France, the motion aims to mitigate the effects of body shaming exacerbated by manipulated images and emphasizes the need for additional measures to support youth.

title: Digital kommunikation i domstolsprocesser
summary: The proposal suggests amending legislation to prevent the application of tax deductions for the 'rut' and 'rot' schemes for work carried out abroad. It also calls for efforts within the EU to ensure that national tax deductions can only be applied within the respective countries. The motivation behind this change is to support Swedish jobs and reduce underground work by ensuring services are paid for and taxed correctly within Sweden, as the current system allows foreign companies to benefit from Swedish tax deductions, which has increased by 40% since 2014.

title: Fortsatt giltighet av lagen om vissa register för forskning om vad arv och miljö betyder för människors hälsa
summary: The motion proposes legislation to facilitate easily accessible support within social services by allowing simplified assistance assessments across more areas. This aims to empower individuals and enable them to access certain support services without formal assistance requests, thereby promoting self-determination and early intervention, particularly for those struggling to seek help through conventional channels.

title: Sveriges genomförande av Agenda 2030
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports securing Ronneby Airport as a long-term state airport, emphasizing its strategic importance in southeastern Sweden for defense, emergency services, and healthcare. The motion argues that a recent proposal to remove the airport from the state infrastructure risks undermining national security and the efficient transport of patients.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om samverkansprogram och strategiska innovationsprogram
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for an investigation into the spread and impact of cormorants in Blekinge to develop effective long-term measures aimed at improving the fishing conditions for both commercial and recreational fishermen. It highlights the significant consumption of fish by cormorants in the region, which undermines existing fishing regulations and conservation efforts, potentially affecting local fish populations, including economically important species like cod and pike.

title: Särskild beräkning av tandvårdsersättning med anledning av sjukdomen covid-19
summary: The suggestion advocates for the implementation of measures to enhance sustainable fishing along the east coast of Sweden, responding to the concerning decline of local herring populations due to overfishing by large-scale industrial fisheries. It emphasizes the need for urgent management actions, including protected areas and fishing bans for industrial fishing while allowing for small-scale coastal fishing. Additionally, it calls for a review of fishing controls and reporting practices to ensure accurate fish catch data and promote the well-being of marine ecosystems and local fishing communities.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om konsumentskydd vid köp av nyproducerade bostadsrätter
summary: The motion advocates for restricting the freedom of establishment in the public sector, particularly in education and healthcare, to ensure equitable access and quality services based on societal needs rather than market-driven competition. It argues that the current liberalization favors already well-positioned areas and neglects those in need, emphasizing the importance of planned services that align with public welfare ideals.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:187 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 - Ersättning till riskgrupper, kapitalinsatser i statligt ägda företag och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion advocates for clearer regulations regarding students' access to staffed school libraries in Sweden, highlighting a decline in reading among Swedish schoolchildren. It emphasizes the importance of school libraries in fostering literacy and critical thinking skills, and calls for increased resources and professional staffing to ensure that libraries meet their intended purpose. Currently, the lack of specific requirements for library staffing and qualifications is seen as a barrier to improving students' reading habits.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:187 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Ersättning till riskgrupper, kapitalinsatser i statligt ägda företag och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a high-level forum focused on digital expertise and development within the tech sector, aiming to address the current skills shortage and underrepresentation of women in the industry. It emphasizes the importance of coordinated efforts to promote tech education in schools, attract more individuals into technical fields, and ensure that tech-related services and products reflect the diversity of the entire population. The forum would also facilitate communication and cooperation among various political bodies to enhance understanding and knowledge about digitalization.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:187 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Ersättning till riskgrupper, kapitalinsatser i statligt ägda företag och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes a long-term plan to expand the E6 highway through western Skåne into a three-lane motorway in more sections, emphasizing the necessity due to increasing traffic, especially heavy goods vehicles, which impacts both local commuters and national/international transportation. It highlights the highway's critical role in southeastern Sweden's infrastructure and urges for a renewed study on traffic conditions in light of population growth and increased transit demands, alongside modernizing existing traffic interchanges.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:187 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Ersättning till riskgrupper, kapitalinsatser i statligt ägda företag och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that Ängelholm-Helsingborg Airport should be included in the national basic infrastructure and designated as a preparedness airport. This suggestion comes after an extensive investigation that highlights the critical role of regional airports for Sweden's economy and competitiveness, ensuring good transportation connections across the country. The motion emphasizes the significance of public ownership and management of such infrastructure, particularly as municipalities face challenges in sustaining ownership due to resource allocation towards public welfare. The long-term strategic importance of maintaining regular air traffic in this region is also underscored.

title: Förskottsbetalning i vissa ärenden om utlämnande av allmän handling
summary: The motion proposes raising the minimum amount for share capital in order to combat economic crime and organized crime. The proponents argue that increasing the minimum share capital can enhance accountability and prevent the misuse of limited liability companies, which are often involved in illicit activities due to their anonymity and lack of personal liability for owners. The motion highlights the significant economic damages caused by such crimes and emphasizes the need for preventive measures alongside investigations and prosecutions.

title: Kompletterande bestämmelser till utträdesavtalet mellan Förenade kungariket och EU i fråga om medborgarnas rättigheter
summary: The motion proposes to reinstate the auditing requirement for small companies in Sweden, which was removed in 2010 with the aim of reducing administrative burden and costs for these businesses. The authors argue that the removal has led to negative consequences including lower tax revenues, increased economic crime, and deteriorating quality of financial reporting. They cite various studies indicating that companies without auditors are more prone to fraud and financial misreporting, and they suggest that reintroducing the auditing requirement would help mitigate these issues.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om rutavdraget
summary: The motion advocates for increased public investment in the music sector, including the establishment of a state music inquiry, enhanced financial support for cultural initiatives, the creation of free municipal music schools, and a broader offering of musical education across Sweden, particularly in rural areas. It emphasizes addressing the financial inadequacies in the artistic sector to ensure the viability and growth of musical talent and infrastructure, thus preventing centralization and promoting diverse musical opportunities for all communities.

title: En effektivare kommunal räddningstjänst
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the relationship between the state and the Church of Sweden regarding the responsibilities for the preservation of the common cultural heritage represented by church buildings. It emphasizes the importance of economic compensation for maintaining and restoring these historical sites, which are considered common property by the public. The motion highlights the inadequacy of current funding, calling for a review of the historical compensation system to better support the upkeep of church heritage and address increasing renovation costs.

title: Skattereduktion för boende i vissa glest befolkade områden - regional skattereduktion
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for fair remuneration for artists and musicians from the revenue generated by the streaming economy. It argues that current copyright laws do not adequately protect music creators, who receive disproportionately low payments compared to the revenues generated by major digital platforms. The proposal calls for an assessment of copyright legislation to ensure a more equitable distribution of digital income, including the consideration of an unassignable compensation right and the introduction of a user-centric payment model that would benefit smaller artists over major acts.

title: Några frågor om clearing av OTC-derivat och om transaktioner för värdepappersfinansiering
summary: The motion proposes that guests at the Swedish Parliament's restaurant, Strömmen, should be allowed to order half portions as a measure to reduce food waste. The author highlights the significant global issue of food waste, its environmental impact, and the necessity of sustainable food practices, particularly in light of climate change challenges. The motion aligns with the Agenda 2030 goal to halve global food waste by 2030 and suggests that offering smaller portion sizes can help minimize waste and promote sustainability.

title: Några sekretessfrågor på finansmarknadsområdet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider implementing free menstrual products in primary and secondary schools. It emphasizes the importance of equitable education for all children, regardless of gender or socioeconomic status. The motion highlights the financial burden menstruation can place on young women and the potential for this to hinder their educational opportunities. By providing free menstrual products in schools, it aims to reduce stigma, ensure that no student has to miss school due to lack of access to necessary sanitary products, and create a more inclusive and supportive educational environment.

title: 2020 års redogörelse för företag med statligt ägande
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of providing compensation for individuals who are dependent on cars, particularly in rural areas where public transportation options are limited. It emphasizes the need to achieve national climate goals by promoting more efficient transport methods while also acknowledging the high costs of fuel that disproportionately affect families reliant on driving. The motion highlights the historical context of previous government measures aimed at mitigating inequalities faced by residents in sparsely populated regions.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Ersättning till riskgrupper, kapitalinsatser i statligt ägda företag och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the conditions for providing more equitable and enhanced care for women in menopause, highlighting the current disparities in treatment access across Sweden. It emphasizes the need for improved information and knowledge support for both women and healthcare providers regarding menopause symptoms and treatments, as many women face misdiagnosis and inadequate care, leading to decreased quality of life.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:164 Inriktningen för en nära och tillgänglig vård - en primärvårdsreform
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3644 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into achieving greater economic justice among different housing types, highlighting the unfavorable tax treatment of rental housing compared to ownership forms like condominiums and single-family homes. The authors argue that current tax policies disadvantage renters, as they do not benefit from various tax deductions that homeowners receive, leading to financial inequities and increased rents. The proposal calls for the government to reassess housing policies to promote fairness across housing types.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:183 Förlängd giltighetstid för undersökningstillstånd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support increased government presence throughout the country, emphasizing the importance of equitable public services in both urban and rural areas. It highlights the decline of state institutions in smaller communities and the negative impact on local development and trust in authorities. The motion seeks to ensure that regardless of location, citizens should have access to similar levels of service, advocating for the continuation of efforts to decentralize state functions initiated by the previous government.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:183 Förlängd giltighetstid för undersökningstillstånd
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should consider implementing free TBE vaccinations for children and young people under 18 years old, in response to the increasing number of TBE cases in Sweden, which have nearly tripled between 2004 and 2022. The motion highlights the serious health risks associated with TBE, especially for young children, and points out that some regions already offer subsidized vaccinations while the costs can be prohibitive for families. The intention is to ensure equitable access to vaccination regardless of geographical location or family income, promoting outdoor activities without the fear of TBE.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:183 Förlängd giltighetstid för undersökningstillstånd
summary: The motion proposes several measures to improve transparency and trust in the real estate market in Sweden. These include reviewing legislation regarding accepted prices, ensuring brokers provide assessments of market value, verifying the identity of bidders, creating an anonymized bidding list for both buyers and sellers, clarifying the responsible parties for property descriptions, establishing a consumer agency for housing purchases, and regulating the bidding process to enhance consumer confidence and market fairness.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:164 Inriktningen för en nära och tillgänglig vård - en primärvårdsreform
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3640 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: The proposal seeks to establish national guidelines to ensure that parents convicted of murder automatically lose custody of their children. It highlights the detrimental impact on children who witness or learn of their parent's violent crime, emphasizing that they are left vulnerable and dependent on offenders who can restrict access to essential support and services. The motion argues for immediate custody reviews when a parent is suspected of murdering the other parent, with a presumption that the offender forfeits their custodial rights, barring exceptional circumstances.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:169 Utvidgad förundersökningsrätt för Tullverket
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish government to review school meal offerings to ensure that all students have access to healthy, quality food and to consider supporting schools that provide nutritious options. Additionally, it suggests investigating the fees associated with medical dietary accommodations, arguing these should not be a financial burden on students and should be addressed in education legislation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:169 Utvidgad förundersökningsrätt för Tullverket
summary: The suggested motion calls for a comprehensive review of the legislation concerning guardians and curators in Sweden, highlighting serious deficiencies in the current system and proposing the establishment of professional guardians and a national register for them. The motion emphasizes the need for improved oversight and accountability to address issues of financial mismanagement that have harmed vulnerable individuals relying on guardianship.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:168 En moderniserad radio- och tv-lag
summary: This parliamentary suggestion proposes an examination of how underutilized and vacant land in Sweden can be better utilized. It advocates for a review of the tiny house movement to accommodate affordable compact housing for individuals with low income. Additionally, the motion suggests revitalizing the owner-occupier movement to encourage homeownership, particularly in rural areas, by introducing government incentives such as buy-back options for new homeowners after ten years.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:183 Förlängd giltighetstid för undersökningstillstånd
summary: The motion proposes several measures aimed at increasing accountability and efficiency among elected officials in Sweden. It suggests investigating the possibility of simplifying the removal of representatives who neglect their responsibilities, harmonizing municipal meetings to occur on Mondays to facilitate local engagement, establishing a two-tiered remuneration system for parliamentarians based on workload, ensuring that all parties represented in elected assemblies have a right to attend relevant committees and boards, and appointing independent examiners for the review of politicians' activities instead of politicians themselves.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:183 Förlängd giltighetstid för undersökningstillstånd
summary: The proposal advocates for a continuous and transparent reporting system for corruption cases at Swedish foreign missions. It suggests that the Swedish Parliament support the government in reviewing the possibility of enhancing transparency regarding reported irregularities. Additionally, it calls for clearer guidelines to the National Audit Office on identifying risk areas for corruption within these missions, following an increase in reported corruption related to migration services.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:168 En moderniserad radio- och tv-lag
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive approach to consumer lending practices in Sweden, advocating for a ban on fast loans due to their potential to lead to significant financial problems for consumers. It suggests improving consumer guidance and education regarding borrowing and household economics, particularly for vulnerable groups who are prone to falling into debt traps. The motion also seeks to explore the introduction of a waiting period before loan disbursement and the development of social loans as alternatives to fast loans. Additionally, it addresses issues related to deceptive discount pricing practices, calling for stricter regulations to protect consumers from false marketing.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:164 Inriktningen för en nära och tillgänglig vård - en primärvårdsreform
summary: The proposal submitted by Markus Wiechel and Alexander Christiansson from the Sweden Democrats aims to enhance the building process in Sweden by suggesting a review of the usage of undeveloped land, shortening the planning and building procedures, investigating the designation of environmental courts as the first appeal instance, and potentially introducing fees for appeal processes concerning planning and building permits. Furthermore, the proposal advocates for regional rather than municipal housing planning, simplifying building permit procedures for farmers and businesses on industrial land, and allowing for building permits in areas where non-health hazardous disturbances are present.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:181 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Förstärkt stöd till välfärd och företag, insatser mot smittspridning och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The suggestion advocates for the State Historical Museums of Defence to take on the responsibility of preserving the Home Guard's military historical legacy. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining this aspect of Sweden's military heritage for future generations, as the Home Guard has played a significant role in Sweden's defense since its establishment in 1940. The motion also highlights the historical connection between the Home Guard and the army, underscoring the need for its history to be preserved comparably to other branches of the military.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:181 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Förstärkt stöd till välfärd och företag, insatser mot smittspridning och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support the criminalization of organ tourism and activities that assist in organ theft. It aims to encourage the government to investigate these issues and to advocate for China and other nations to adopt the Santiago Convention against human trafficking, amid growing concerns over the systemic organ theft linked to illegal organ trade.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:181 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Förstärkt stöd till välfärd och företag, insatser mot smittspridning och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that individuals convicted of crimes and subject to deportation be monitored with electronic ankle bracelets to prevent absconding. Additionally, it seeks to make it a criminal offense for those under supervision to fail to report as required. The proposal comes in response to issues with detainee escapes from migration authorities and aims to enhance the enforcement of deportation orders by utilizing technology for better monitoring.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:181 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Förstärkt stöd till välfärd och företag, insatser mot smittspridning och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of trade union sympathy actions in labor disputes, highlighting their negative impact on businesses and the need for favorable conditions for entrepreneurs. It argues that while the right to strike is important, current regulations allow innocent businesses to suffer consequences of disputes they are not involved in, potentially harming Sweden's competitiveness and attractiveness for entrepreneurs.

title: Förlängd giltighetstid för undersökningstillstånd
summary: The motion advocates for a review of legislation related to threats against elected officials, proposing that incitement to crime by such officials should be classified as a democratic offense, with harsher penalties for both threats against politicians and negligence involving classified information. The authors argue that recent trends in public debate have led to increased polarisation and threats against politicians, which undermine democracy. They call for specific legal measures to improve the safety and accountability of elected officials, especially in light of past incidents involving mishandling of confidential information.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Förstärkt stöd till välfärd och företag, insatser mot smittspridning och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: This motion proposes the investigation into the establishment of a civil courage law in Sweden. It aims to create a legal obligation for individuals to assist those in need, especially in life-threatening situations. The motion argues that such a law would encourage personal responsibility and foster a sense of community and trust among citizens, addressing the growing concerns of insecurity and passivity in society. Additionally, it suggests the introduction of an annual civil courage award to recognize and encourage exemplary acts of bravery.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:172 En ny lag om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3628 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews legislation to establish more proportional fine amounts for criminal offenses. It argues that current fines often do not reflect the actual harm caused by the offenses, with some severe violations resulting in disproportionately low penalties. The motion highlights examples where fines fail to account for the broader economic damages and societal impacts of certain actions, urging the government to implement a system where fines correspond more closely to the harm inflicted.

title: En ny lag om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The suggestion presented by Markus Wiechel and Alexander Christiansson (both from SD) calls for increased education on entrepreneurship and practical skills in Swedish schools. It proposes that the government investigate making entrepreneurship a mandatory subject in high school, introduce vocational internships for middle school students, and enhance traffic safety education. Other recommendations include incorporating lessons on respect, etiquette, social codes, the importance of civic duty, and increased interaction between schools and public services like the military and emergency services. The aim is to equip students with skills that are crucial for their future employment and societal participation while also addressing current challenges like high youth unemployment.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om statliga åtgärder för fler miljöbilar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should improve the availability of information regarding job opportunities aligned with different educational paths and enhance career guidance services. It calls for an investigation into the establishment of open educational offerings at universities and colleges to address the poor match between labor market needs and existing educational programs, ultimately aiming to improve job outcomes for students and better address the skills required in the labor market.

title: En moderniserad radio- och tv-lag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament urges the government to reconsider the curriculum's responsibility to combat traditional gender norms and to investigate the need for updating the curriculum to include explicit references to honor-related violence and oppression. It emphasizes the importance of education in shaping children's identities while advocating for the right to personal gender identity choice, arguing that existing curriculum mandates may conflict with this principle. Furthermore, it stresses the necessity of clear guidelines in the curriculum regarding honor-related issues to combat related violence and oppression, recognizing the increasing prevalence of such problems in society.

title: Utvidgad förundersökningsrätt för Tullverket
summary: The motion proposes measures to encourage environmentally friendly practices in the archipelago of Sweden, including the promotion of bottom washing for boats to reduce pollution from bottom paint and the development of methods to utilize rapidly growing sea asparagus for biogas production. It emphasizes the need for infrastructure to allow boat owners to dispose of sewage waste properly and suggests government support for these initiatives to boost tourism and improve the marine environment.

title: Inriktningen för en nära och tillgänglig vård - en primärvårdsreform
summary: This motion proposes several traffic-related reforms aimed at improving road safety, traffic flow, and environmental sustainability. Key suggestions include allowing right turns at red lights, implementing countdown timers at traffic lights, permitting light motorcycles to be operated with a standard car driver's license, enhancing signage at road intersections, mandatory installation of alcohol locks in vehicles owned by individuals convicted of driving under the influence, the introduction of a point system for traffic violations, efforts to prevent cheating during driving tests, and ensuring stricter accountability for drivers to prove their license ownership.

title: Redovisning av AP-fondernas verksamhet t.o.m. 2019
summary: This motion proposes that the Riksdag considers clarifying the role of the National Audit Office (Riksrevisionen) to enhance its function in monitoring the use of taxpayer money and improving efficiency within public institutions. It highlights the need for increased scrutiny and transparency in the spending of public resources, arguing that a more effective audit process could diminish reliance on external bodies, such as the 'Slöseriombudsman', to address wasteful bureaucratic practices.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:162 Riksrevisionens rapport om undantag från skolplikten – regler, tillämpning och tillsyn
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3627 av Kristina Axén Olin och Gudrun Brunegård (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national register for parking permits for individuals with reduced mobility to enhance accessibility and societal participation. It addresses concerns regarding misuse of the current parking permit system, emphasizing the need for improved coordination and safeguards to ensure that permits are issued only to those genuinely in need.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:162 Riksrevisionens rapport om undantag från skolplikten – regler, tillämpning och tillsyn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament implement increased transparency in its committees and the EU Committee by maintaining statistics on their activities, similar to what is done for general parliamentary actions. It suggests that motions, voting records, and committee members' attendance should be documented, and that government propositions should be clearly labeled with the relevant committees they pertain to, making this information accessible to the public and aiding in the understanding of legislative processes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:167 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Stöd till hälso- och sjukvården, utbildningsinsatser och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations regarding overnight accommodations for members of the Swedish Parliament, emphasizing the need to consider actual travel time and commuting circumstances rather than just distance from the Parliament. The authors argue that this would ensure fairer access to accommodations for all members, facilitating their ability to balance family life with their political duties.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:167 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Stöd till hälso- och sjukvården, utbildningsinsatser och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the signing of an air transport agreement between Sweden and Taiwan. The advocates argue that a direct flight connection would significantly enhance international linkages for individuals, businesses, and education, fostering collaboration based on shared fundamental values and existing economic ties.

title: Med anledning av skr. 2019/20:162 Riksrevisionens rapport om undantag från skolplikten – regler, tillämpning och tillsyn
summary: The motion suggests making visits to the Child Healthcare Center (BVC) mandatory and proposes reducing child benefits if parents do not comply with the visitation schedule. The aim is to ensure that children receive necessary healthcare and parents receive adequate support, given the trend of increasing parental non-attendance at these important appointments.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:162 Riksrevisionens rapport om undantag från skolplikten – regler, tillämpning och tillsyn
summary: The motion proposes to review the classification of gifts for children and youths, suggesting that such gifts should be considered personal and not included in their parents' income when calculating welfare support. This aims to ensure that children can receive gifts without it negatively impacting their family's financial assistance, as current welfare calculations can offset the value of gifts or donations received.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:162 Riksrevisionens rapport om undantag från skolplikten – regler, tillämpning och tillsyn
summary: The proposal suggests exploring the possibility of amending the law to criminalize actions that obstruct police officers in their duties, in response to increasing threats and hostile situations faced by the police. It emphasizes the need to protect law enforcement and maintain public safety, particularly in the face of organized crime.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:167 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Stöd till hälso- och sjukvården, utbildningsinsatser och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes a review of the blood donation regulations in Sweden to modernize the process and remove discrimination based on sexual orientation, particularly addressing the current ban on male homosexuals donating blood. The aim is to increase the number of eligible blood donors to alleviate the existing blood shortage and ensure a stable supply for the future, advocating for changes informed by new research and testing methods.

title: med anledning av framst. 2019/20:RB5 Medgivande för Riksbanken att ingå ett avtal om lån till Internationella valutafonden (IMF)
summary: The motion proposes measures to enhance the safety of social workers in Sweden by protecting them from pressure and threats from dissatisfied individuals regarding social services decisions. It suggests that decision-making in challenging cases should shift from individual social workers to a collective group approach to reduce the risk of harassment and intimidation while maintaining the right to appeal decisions.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Stöd till hälso- och sjukvården, utbildningsinsatser och andra åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the Swedish customs authorities' powers by granting them police-like authority to combat the trafficking of stolen goods and prohibited items. It emphasizes the need for customs to effectively intervene against international crime rings that exploit existing laws to smuggle stolen property out of the country, and to better prevent the import of dangerous goods such as narcotics and weapons.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:166 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Fler kraftfulla åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The proposal advocates for the consideration of implementing a taxation system linked to a scoring mechanism for forestry and agriculture. This would incentivize landowners to enhance natural values and long-term land stewardship by reducing taxes based on the environmental quality of their land. Higher scoring would correlate with lower tax liabilities, encouraging land users to prioritize biodiversity and sustainable practices.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:166 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Fler kraftfulla åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The proposal aims to simplify the regulations surrounding family businesses in Sweden by addressing the complexities of defining 'related parties' within the 3:12 rules. This simplification is intended to encourage more individuals to start family businesses, increasing job opportunities and supporting economic growth in a country facing high unemployment rates within the EU. The motion calls for the government to review these regulations to make them more understandable and accessible for potential family business owners.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:166 Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Fler kraftfulla åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should explore the possibility of conducting seamanship training for adults, in response to the challenges faced by the shipping industry regarding the recruitment and provision of skilled personnel. Currently, seamanship education is only available as a three-year high school program, which limits opportunities for individuals who wish to pursue this career later in life. The motion advocates for a review of existing regulations to allow seamanship education to be offered as a vocational training program or another educational format for adults.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2020 – Fler kraftfulla åtgärder med anledning av coronaviruset
summary: This proposal advocates for mandatory PCR testing for individuals facing deportation from Sweden, arguing that such a requirement would streamline the process and reduce costs associated with detaining individuals who refuse to be tested. The motion suggests that current voluntary testing leads to inefficiencies in enforcing deportation decisions, causing delays and additional burdens on the system. The aim is to ensure that Sweden can execute deportations more effectively by making PCR tests compulsory.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:165 Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigates the feasibility of implementing suitability tests for prospective students in teacher education programs. It emphasizes the importance of skilled teachers for preparing students for adult life and argues that the current teacher training does not adequately assess candidates' motivations and abilities to engage effectively with students. The goal is to enhance the quality of teacher education by focusing on the complex skills required for successful teaching.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:163 Fler tillfälliga åtgärder för att underlätta genomförandet av bolags- och föreningsstämmor
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national digital register for treatment and family homes to assist social services in municipalities. The aim is to create a centralized database containing information about the available places, their services, and a connection to quality control, making it easier for social workers to find appropriate placements for individuals with diverse needs, ultimately enhancing the quality of care provided.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:165 Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to consider implementing an obligatory statement regarding organ donation in tax declarations, aiming to increase the number of registered organ donors in response to the current shortage and long waiting lists for transplants.

title: Förlängd giltighetstid för yrkeskompetensbevis
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of validation training programs for shortage occupations in Sweden to ensure a skilled workforce in the face of demographic challenges. It emphasizes the need to recognize the competencies of individuals currently working in these roles, particularly those who lack formal qualifications or certification, such as healthcare and education professionals. By implementing national validation training, the aim is to improve both employment security for workers and the quality of welfare services in Sweden.

title: Fler tillfälliga åtgärder för att underlätta genomförandet av bolags- och föreningsstämmor
summary: The motion proposes to establish a standardized education and certification program for restaurant operators, allowing a single permit to be valid nationwide, rather than requiring separate certifications for each municipality. This change aims to simplify the process for entrepreneurs and reduce unnecessary administrative burdens, while maintaining high standards for knowledge in the field.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om undantag från skolplikten – regler, tillämpning och tillsyn
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag consider implementing a system where police officers are identified by service numbers instead of their names while on duty. This change aims to protect individual officers' identities from being disclosed and prevent potential threats against them. Such a system would better ensure officer safety during their service while still allowing for accountability and tracking of their actions through recorded documentation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:156 Genomförande av EU-direktiv på avfallsområdet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider investigating the implementation of a national ban on begging. It argues that begging does not lead to security or an exit from poverty, often involving individuals from other countries who come to Sweden due to their home countries' failure to address their citizens' welfare. The proposal highlights concerns about increased criminality and human trafficking associated with begging, especially when children are involved. By exploring a national ban, the motion suggests it could reduce these risks, which should be a primary goal in Sweden today.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:154 Skärpta regler avseende hanteringen av sprängämnesprekursorer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider providing more care and treatment options for individuals taken into custody due to intoxication under the Act on the Detention of Intoxicated Persons. It highlights that while the number of intoxicated individuals being detained remains steady, there are significant geographical disparities in the care provided, and advocates for a system that prioritizes medical assessment over punitive measures to improve health outcomes and support for those struggling with substance abuse.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:124 Vissa ändringar i avfallsskattelagen
summary: The motion proposes to consider easing confidentiality restrictions concerning medical records to facilitate the enforcement of deportation decisions. It argues that delays in returning individuals who have been denied residency in Sweden create financial burdens and challenges for both the individuals and society. The suggestion highlights the need for access to health information, such as PCR test results, to ensure that authorities can implement deportation orders effectively.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:156 Genomförande av EU-direktiv på avfallsområdet
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to develop proposals aimed at facilitating the work of collectors in the country, who play a significant role in preserving historical items and heritage. It argues that the state should provide more support and encouragement to collectors, making their collections more accessible to the public rather than imposing regulations that complicate their efforts.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:147 Riksrevisionens rapport om fri entré till statliga museer
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national bank of best practices and successful projects to facilitate the exchange of functional solutions and competency-building initiatives among municipalities and regions in Sweden. This initiative aims to enhance knowledge sharing and promote improvement in local governance by creating a centralized resource for inspiration, ideas, and best practices, ultimately preparing municipalities better for future challenges.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:147 Riksrevisionens rapport om fri entré till statliga museer
summary: The proposal advocates for the reclassification of books in Swedish libraries, suggesting that literature from Bosnia, Croatia, and Serbia should be searchable under the first letter of the respective country or language, instead of the outdated abbreviation 'BKS'. The motion emphasizes the need for clear and logical organization of literature to improve accessibility and reflects the status of these languages as independent entities.

title: Ändrade övergångsbestämmelser när det gäller medicintekniska produkter
summary: The motion advocates for the development of national tests for adapted schools in Sweden to ensure all students, including those with special needs, have access to a quality education and fair assessment. Currently, there are no national tests for adapted schools, which undermines equitable evaluation compared to mainstream education. The proposal aims to ensure that students in adapted schools receive a standardized assessment similar to their peers in general education.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:99 Vårändringsbudget för 2020
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the consideration of a research study on the significance of relatives in the care plans for patients with mental illness. It highlights the increasing societal issue of mental health and the essential role that family support plays in patient recovery, pointing out the current inadequacies in care plans that often fail to involve the family effectively in the treatment and rehabilitation process.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:100 2020 års ekonomiska vårproposition
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the legal protection for elected officials at all levels in Sweden to ensure the integrity of democratic processes and safeguard democracy, in response to increasing reports of threats and hate directed towards these representatives.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:100 2020 års ekonomiska vårproposition
summary: The proposal suggests initiating a pilot project in Södermanland to offer specially designed health checks for seniors aimed at identifying health deviations and preventing illness. This initiative addresses the increasing needs of the aging population, advocating for tailored health assessments to enhance public health and improve the overall quality of life for seniors.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:100 2020 års ekonomiska vårproposition
med anledning av prop. 2019/20:100 2020 års ekonomiska vårproposition
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a designated coordinator for individuals requiring integrated healthcare, particularly targeting elderly patients with multiple health issues. This role would encompass overseeing the entire healthcare process, ensuring that patients receive cohesive and comprehensive treatment, thereby reducing the burden on patients to manage their own care across various medical professionals.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:100 2020 års ekonomiska vårproposition
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of routine screenings for type 2 diabetes for individuals over 45 years old, due to the increasing risk of the condition with age and the need for timely intervention through lifestyle changes.

title: Tillfällig åtgärd för att underlätta övergången till sommarbensin
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a preventive program aimed at increasing knowledge for early detection and support of elderly individuals experiencing mental health issues, addressing the critical problem of suicide among older adults, particularly those over 55. It emphasizes the need for training individuals who interact with the elderly to recognize warning signs and highlights the significant societal costs of lost lives due to suicide.

title: Senarelagt införande av nationell läkemedelslista och bastjänstgöring för läkare
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should oversee the placement of youth within the Statens institutionsstyrelse (Sis), emphasizing the need for more thoughtful placement strategies to ensure that young people with different backgrounds, such as those with no criminal history or those with specific behavioral issues, are not grouped together. The motion highlights the risks of mixing youths of varying ages and backgrounds, with particular concern for how older youths' behaviors can negatively influence younger ones.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:114 Strategisk exportkontroll 2019 - krigsmateriel och produkter med dubbla användningsområden
summary: The proposal suggests linking student grants to completed academic credits instead of earned income, arguing that the current system disincentivizes work during studies. It contends that students should be encouraged to gain work experience alongside their education, as this enhances employment prospects and personal development. The motion seeks to reform the rules governing student financial aid to better support students aiming to balance work and study.

title: Gode män
summary: This motion proposes a review of the sentencing guidelines for repeated criminal offenses, arguing that the current system inadequately penalizes repeat offenders compared to first-time offenders. The proponent suggests that harsher penalties for repeated offenses would serve as a deterrent and provide justice for victims, aligning the legal consequences with societal views on crime and punishment.

title: Kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s plattformsförordning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the possibility of anonymizing police witness accounts in criminal investigations to protect the identities of individual officers, who are increasingly subject to threats and harassment. This measure aims to ensure that police officers can testify without fear of retaliation or harm to themselves or their families.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:145 Ett förenklat förfarande vid vissa beslut om hemlig avlyssning
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a special assessment process for students applying to adapted schools in Sweden. It aims to address the current rigid criteria that exclude many children and young people who fall just outside current special education diagnoses. The motion argues for a more individualized approach that considers various circumstances and conditions affecting a student's ability to follow standard curricula, allowing those who do not meet conventional academic thresholds yet still require support to access education and avoid exclusion.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:123 Ett effektivare informationsutbyte mellan polis och socialtjänst vid samverkan mot terrorism
summary: The motion advocates for a review of methods to reduce the waste of medications, which is currently a significant issue due to large quantities being discarded by hospitals, care homes, and individuals. It suggests that medications should be packaged in a way that allows unused portions to be safely utilized by others, as well as proposing smaller packaging sizes to limit waste when medication regimens change. The motion emphasizes that wasting usable medications is not only inefficient but also disregards the needs of those who cannot afford them.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:150 Mer likabehandling och ett stärkt skydd vid utstationering
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3597 av Mats Green m.fl. (M, C, KD, L)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider developing a clear and comprehensive action plan to ensure the country can manufacture sufficient personal protective equipment for its population during disasters or pandemics. The motion emphasizes the importance of self-sufficiency in protection gear, arguing that Sweden should not rely on imports from other countries in times of crisis, and stresses the need for preparedness and continuous updates to the production capabilities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:145 Ett förenklat förfarande vid vissa beslut om hemlig avlyssning
summary: The proposal suggests transferring responsibility for school health care to regional authorities to ensure cohesive health services for children and youth. It argues that the current division of responsibilities between regions and municipalities hampers continuous care and that a single regional entity would enhance quality and accessibility, allowing families to seek consistent health support without interruptions due to school enrollment.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:149 Skärpta straff för de allvarligaste fallen av immaterialrättsintrång
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider revising the laws and penalties related to illegal wolf hunting, arguing that the wolf population has significantly increased, no longer qualifying as endangered or particularly protected. The proposal suggests that wolves should be legally categorized similarly to other game animals, such as moose and bears, thus aligning the penalties for illegal hunting of wolves with those for other licensed game species.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:123 Ett effektivare informationsutbyte mellan polis och socialtjänst vid samverkan mot terrorism
summary: The proposal aims to enhance the legal status of service animals, specifically police dogs and horses, to ensure they are better protected under the law. Currently, acts of violence against these animals are treated as property damage, leading to minimal penalties for offenders. The motion advocates for a legal re-evaluation to classify attacks against service animals as a specific offense, allowing for more appropriate legal repercussions that reflect their societal value and contributions in law enforcement.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:145 Ett förenklat förfarande vid vissa beslut om hemlig avlyssning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should address the issue of 'invisible taxes' by advocating for greater transparency in tax-related costs, such as employer contributions. The author argues that high marginal taxes reduce incentives for work and productivity, and emphasizes the importance of citizens being aware of their tax contributions to foster informed opinions on government expenditure.

title: Genomförande av EU-direktiv på avfallsområdet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider making it explicitly clear on tax declarations how taxpayers' money is utilized, including a breakdown of total taxes paid, such as employer contributions and consumption taxes. It emphasizes the need for transparency and accountability in the management of public funds, given Sweden's high tax burden. The motion argues that enhancing taxpayer awareness and understanding of public expenditures would strengthen democracy by informing citizens about government spending and increasing their engagement.

title: Skärpta regler avseende hanteringen av sprängämnesprekursorer
summary: The proposal suggests reviewing the possibility of exempting the first 500,000 SEK earned by Swedish citizens from taxes. This measure aims to alleviate financial concerns faced by many, particularly the youth, enabling them to save for future needs such as purchasing property or retirement. The goal is to foster a more secure economic foundation for individuals early in their lives.

title: Vissa ändringar i avfallsskattelagen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government review the possibility of selling more state-owned enterprises, arguing that it is inappropriate for the state to own and operate businesses that compete with private companies in a free market, while acknowledging the potential value in state ownership in critical sectors.

title: Utvärdering av statens upplåning och skuldförvaltning 2015-2019
summary: The motion proposes the reform of the shoreline protection law, advocating for its abolition to allow municipalities to better manage shoreline areas. It suggests that local authorities have more appropriate knowledge to make decisions about shoreline protection zones, which should be flexible to promote both housing development and environmental protection. Furthermore, it calls for an investigation into compensating landowners for any devaluation caused by shoreline protection regulations, with the aim of balancing property rights and enabling community growth, especially in rural areas facing population decline.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:123 Ett effektivare informationsutbyte mellan polis och socialtjänst vid samverkan mot terrorism
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate regulations for deformation zones on cargo bicycles to enhance safety. Given the increasing use of square-designed cargo bikes, the motion highlights the risks of serious injuries resulting from collisions on narrow bike paths. The proposal advocates for the mandatory installation of shock-absorbing materials on the front edges of these bicycles to reduce the severity of injuries in accidents.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:150 Mer likabehandling och ett stärkt skydd vid utstationering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate how the state can support Swedish soldiers who have fought for Ukraine, as well as how to assist their families. It highlights the historical and moral support Sweden has provided to Ukraine since the Russian invasion, and acknowledges the personal sacrifices made by many Swedes to aid Ukraine. The motion emphasizes the need for better support structures, particularly psychological care, for returning soldiers and their families to help them reintegrate into normal life after experiencing the realities of war.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:123 Ett effektivare informationsutbyte mellan polis och socialtjänst vid samverkan mot terrorism
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3590 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal suggests increasing the maximum penalty for the crime of grooming from two years to ten years, in response to the severe consequences of grooming behavior on children. It emphasizes the growing instances of adults contacting minors for sexual purposes, often leading to lifelong trauma for the victims. The motion highlights past tragic cases and argues that the current maximum sentence does not adequately reflect the gravity of such offenses.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om tillämpningen av  det finanspolitiska ramverket 2019
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should review the possibility of making school uniforms legal in order to enhance discipline and order within the educational environment. The motion argues that the current interpretations by the School Inspectorate are overly strict and hinder schools from effectively implementing dress codes. The author cites increasing interest in school uniforms as a potential solution to maintaining a conducive learning atmosphere, despite concerns about infringing on students' freedom of expression.

title: Ett förtydligat statligt ansvar för vissa kärntekniska verksamheter
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of regulated quota fishing for the bluefin tuna along the Bohus coast to promote sustainable sports fishing and bolster tourism. It highlights the recovery of bluefin tuna populations due to effective management and suggests that regulated fishing could provide economic benefits while ensuring conservation efforts are upheld.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om fri entré till statliga museer
summary: The proposal aims to increase support for bereaved relatives following suicides, recommending several actions including investigating enhanced assistance from Försäkringskassan, ensuring uniform access to support across Sweden, and establishing POSOM teams in every municipality for preventive mental health support. The motion focuses on the urgent need for better care and follow-up for those affected by suicide, addressing gaps in the existing system and advocating for compassionate, accessible assistance to alleviate the profound shock and grief experienced by families.

title: Anpassade regler för understödsföreningar som inte är tjänstepensionskassor
Årsredovisning för staten 2019
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the establishment of a national responsibility for cleaning up international debris along the west coast beaches. The proponent emphasizes the mounting problem of plastic waste affecting local municipalities and the inadequacy of their current efforts. It calls for collaboration with the European Union to share responsibility in addressing marine litter, suggesting that state involvement and resources are essential to effectively manage this environmental challenge.

title: 2020 års ekonomiska vårproposition
summary: The motion proposes to review and update Sweden's animal protection laws and the recommendations from the Swedish Board of Agriculture regarding the safety of dogs transported in crates. It suggests the implementation of national standards for crash testing of dog crates and advocates for similar standardization at the EU level. The aim is to ensure that dog owners have access to safe transportation options for their pets, as current guidelines have not been updated in over thirty years.

title: Vårändringsbudget för 2020
