title: Höjt tak för uppskov med kapitalvinst vid avyttring av privatbostad
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider the possibility of a parliamentary investigation into euthanasia, emphasizing the right of individuals to determine how and when they wish to end their lives. The motion argues that current options for severely ill individuals are limited and advocates for exploring legislative frameworks that align with human rights, specifically referencing European human rights principles about individual autonomy and the right to privacy in matters of life and death.

title: En effektivare hantering av ärenden om överförande av straffverkställighet
summary: The motion proposes the repeal of the requirement for food service in order to obtain permanent or temporary alcohol serving permits for bars and other establishments. The current law imposes costs and complications for businesses that wish to focus solely on beverage sales, leading to calls for a review and potential amendment of the alcohol legislation to eliminate this requirement.

title: Svenskt deltagande i militär insats för stärkt säkerhet i Mali
summary: The proposal suggests investigating a smoking ban in Swedish correctional facilities as part of a broader initiative to make Sweden smoke-free. It highlights the health benefits of reducing smoking rates and addresses the disparities in smoking prevalence among different social groups. The motion points out that smoking in prisons leads to conflicts among inmates and with staff, poses fire risks, and undermines the overall goals of rehabilitation. A smoking ban is posited as a measure that would support both the inmates' reintegration into society and the safety of prison environments.

title: Kompletteringar till nya EU-regler om aktieägares rättigheter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government review the management structure for burial services to prevent unhealthy competition between the Swedish church and private funeral services. It highlights that the church's involvement creates an unfair advantage, such as preferential scheduling and resource sharing that undermine private operators. The motion suggests the need for limits akin to those in other sectors where management has been transferred to non-state actors.

title: Komvux för stärkt kompetensförsörjning
summary: The proposal suggests classifying shooting ranges as critical infrastructure for Sweden's total defense, emphasizing their importance for national security and the effective use of firearms. It argues that proper access to shooting ranges is essential for training individuals in handling weapons, particularly in light of global security challenges. The motion highlights the need for Swedish authorities to support shooting ranges by easing regulations that hinder their operations, especially for smaller associations that struggle financially. This classification aims to ensure the sustainability of shooting ranges and, by extension, bolster defense capabilities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:84 Förbättringar för barn inom den psykiatriska tvångsvården
summary: The parliamentary motion proposes that the Swedish government promptly investigate the feasibility of requiring FM radio receivers in all new cars, following concerns about the global security situation and the importance of radio communication for public safety in emergencies. The motion highlights the reliability and wide reach of Sweden's FM network, which is crucial for disseminating vital information during crises.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:84 Förbättringar för barn inom den psykiatriska tvångsvården
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a control function in Swedish legislation aimed at preventing the creation of cross-border barriers, inspired by a similar initiative in the Faroe Islands. The proposal highlights the importance of free movement and argues that recent legislative actions have unintentionally led to new obstacles. It calls for the government to investigate the feasibility of implementing such a control measure to ensure that new laws do not infringe upon the principle of free mobility within the Nordic region.

title: Verksamheten i Europeiska unionen under 2019
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports moving Sweden's embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, arguing that this aligns with the standard practice of placing embassies in capital cities and would improve Sweden's relations with the Israeli government amid currently strained ties.

title: Genomförande av ändringar i yrkesförardirektivet
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of regulations requiring that all relevant public information be made available in easy-to-read Swedish. It emphasizes the importance of accessibility for all citizens, particularly for individuals with intellectual disabilities and new Swedish residents who speak other native languages. The motion argues that clear and understandable information is crucial for effective participation in democracy, especially highlighted during the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Operativt militärt stöd mellan Sverige och Finland
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to enable national support for environmentally friendly engines in fishing boats, aligning with EU financial assistance aimed at enhancing energy efficiency and reducing carbon emissions in the fishing industry. The motion emphasizes the necessity of modernizing the aging Swedish fishing fleet to maintain competitive equality with other EU countries and highlights the environmental benefits of such support.

title: Kamerabevakning i kollektivtrafik och apotek - ett enklare förfarande
summary: This motion proposes the creation of incentives and regulations to combat food waste in the grocery trade in Sweden. Highlighting that nearly one-third of all food produced is wasted, the motion emphasizes the environmental and economic repercussions of this issue. It suggests that grocery stores should be required to donate unsold but edible food to charities or sell it at significantly reduced prices, especially aimed at helping economically disadvantaged individuals. The motion draws inspiration from French legislation that has successfully tackled food waste since 2016.

title: Stärkt integritet i Rättsmedicinalverkets verksamhet
summary: The motion proposes to investigate a model for lowering barriers to the housing market in Sweden, ensuring comparable conditions for different forms of tenure, such as rental and ownership. The author emphasizes that housing is a basic human need and highlights the social responsibility of the state to provide adequate housing. The motion argues that the current barriers to accessing both rental and ownership markets are too high and adversely affect individual freedom. A unified housing policy could enhance individual choices and help address the housing shortage in Sweden.

title: Kommittéberättelse - kommittéernas verksamhet under 2019
summary: This motion proposes measures to limit the population of wild boars in Sweden due to the threat posed by African swine fever, which impacts both wild and domestic pigs. The motion highlights the negative effects of wild boars on agriculture, property damage, and public safety, urging the government to take immediate action to control their numbers and manage the consequences of invasive species.

title: Stärkt sekretesskydd för hotade personer och snabbare handläggning av vissa hyrestvister
summary: The motion proposes to modernize Sweden's alcohol law by removing the requirement for establishments serving alcohol to also provide food and for them to have an on-site kitchen. The current regulations, established in 2011, are deemed outdated and disproportionate to contemporary social habits. The motion highlights that many patrons seek to enjoy a drink without the necessity of dining, arguing that current food requirements lead to unnecessary costs, waste, and inequality in regulatory interpretations across municipalities.

title: Personlig assistans för samtliga hjälpmoment som avser andning och måltider i form av sondmatning
summary: The motion proposes to ensure equal economic and social conditions for employees who lose their income and self-employed individuals who lose their contract income. It highlights the disparities in unemployment benefits between these two groups and calls for clearer definitions of unemployment for self-employed individuals, a simplified application process for unemployment benefits, and a system that allows self-employed individuals to receive benefits comparable to those of employees.

title: Resultatskrivelse om utvecklingssamarbete och humanitärt bistånd genom multilaterala organisationer
summary: The motion proposes the initiation of a national program aimed at improving the health and well-being of children and young people in Sweden by promoting daily physical activity and healthy eating habits. It highlights the increasing sedentary lifestyle among youth, which contributes to various health issues including obesity and mental health problems. The motion emphasizes the collective responsibility of policymakers, schools, communities, and parents to address these challenges and create supportive environments for healthier lifestyles.

title: Ett förbud mot spridning av bilder från rättegångar
summary: The motion proposes that appeals against detailed plans should not exceed ten weeks for resolution, aligning the time frame with the existing ten-week period for municipalities to process building permits. This change aims to expedite the appeal process to avoid delays in construction projects, which can lead to significant cost increases for individuals, businesses, and municipalities.

title: Riksdagens skrivelser till regeringen - åtgärder under 2019
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to prioritize electric aviation to Visby Airport and to plan for additional airports as local energy nodes. It argues that electrification of aviation could revolutionize regional accessibility by reducing operational costs and emissions, paving the way for new flight routes. The proposal suggests preparing Sweden's infrastructure for a network of electrified airports to facilitate fossil-free transport. This initiative could simultaneously create new job opportunities and allow for local electricity production, supporting other electric vehicles and potentially producing hydrogen for future electric aircraft.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om statens arbete för att förhindra och hantera kärntekniska olyckor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates how to enhance the Swedish For Immigrants (SFI) program by integrating 15 hours of language study with local vocational training, effectively transitioning to full-time studies. Additionally, it suggests creating options within the SFI curriculum for both vocational and academic tracks, similar to high school, to better accommodate the diverse needs of learners and improve their chances of entering the labor market.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:77 Riksrevisionens rapport om det kommunala utjämningssystemet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the National Board of Health and Welfare to investigate the provision of assistive devices for individuals with disabilities, including both typical assistive devices and those related to housing adaptations. It also advocates for a review of legislation to ensure that assistive devices related to housing are owned by municipalities, facilitating their reuse and sustainability. The motion highlights existing disparities in availability and access to assistive devices across the country and stresses the importance of retaining essential support for individuals with disabilities.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:77 Riksrevisionens rapport om det kommunala utjämningssystemet
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into how financial guarantees can be established for companies operating landfills to ensure that funds are available for site cleanup in case the company ceases operations. It also suggests that municipalities should receive compensation from companies found liable for violating waste management regulations, allowing them to use these funds for site remediation.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:77 Riksrevisionens rapport om det kommunala utjämningssystemet
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate necessary legislative updates to accommodate increased remote work, which has significantly risen due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the benefits of telecommuting, including improved work-life balance, reduced stress from commuting, and potential cost savings for businesses. However, it also addresses challenges related to both physical and psychosocial work environments when working from home, advocating for clearer guidelines regarding responsibilities and expectations for both employees and employers in this context.

title: Handlingsplan för att motverka en ny migrationskris (väckt enligt 9 kap. 15 § riksdagsordningen med anledning av händelse av större vikt)
summary: The motion proposes an increase in collaboration between traffic police and specially trained vehicle inspectors to ensure effective monitoring of road traffic and cargo transport. It highlights the necessity of specialized knowledge for assessing compliance with transport regulations, given the rising number of vehicles on the roads. The motion argues that due to the decrease in traffic police availability, employing trained inspectors can enhance road safety and compliance, freeing up police resources for other duties.

title: Ökat skydd för sjömäns anställning vid sjöröveri eller väpnat rån mot fartyg
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of how the expansion of renewable energy in Sweden can be accomplished, emphasizing the need for early involvement of municipalities in planning processes. It suggests establishing compensation for landowners affected by infrastructure projects and calls for coordinated planning between local, regional, and national authorities to resolve conflicts and facilitate the transition to renewable energy, particularly in relation to climate goals.

title: Förbättringar för barn inom den psykiatriska tvångsvården
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support the investigation into how municipalities can create a tourism overview plan (TÖP) to enhance growth in the tourism sector. It emphasizes the need for municipalities to include tourism planning in their development strategies and calls for Trafikverket to incorporate the tourism industry into its utility assessment calculations. This initiative aims to facilitate the growth of the tourism industry and improve connections within public transport to various tourist destinations.

title: Inget grundavdrag vid bestämmande av brottsskadeersättning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for expanded fiber broadband access across Sweden, particularly in rural areas, to combat digital exclusion and ensure that all citizens can participate in the digital society. It calls for enabling municipal co-financing for fiber expansion and recognizing voluntary collaboration agreements among municipalities to enhance connectivity for households, businesses, and remote locations. The motion advocates for governmental action to address disparities in broadband access and aims to bridge the growing digital divide between urban and rural communities.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:76 Riksrevisionens rapport om Konkurrensverkets tillsyn
summary: The proposal calls for an investigation into the abolition of the monarchy in Sweden, emphasizing that the country's highest public office should not be inherited but determined through democratic processes. It also seeks to repeal the monarch's legal immunity, the requirement for the monarch to adhere to certain religious principles, and restrictions on royal marriage and travel, advocating for a more equitable and modern state structure that aligns with democratic values.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:73 Riksrevisionens rapport om stöd till start av näringsverksamhet – långsiktiga effekter och Arbetsförmedlingens arbetssätt
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3500 av Mats Green m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: Martina Johansson's motion suggests that the Swedish government should review and simplify the permit application process for businesses by investigating current requirements and potentially differentiating between small and large enterprises. The proposal includes appointing a coordinator to collaborate with businesses in assessing legislative regulations, offering guidance from authorities during applications, and possibly modifying requirements based on business size and operational history. The goal is to create a more efficient and supportive regulatory environment for entrepreneurs in Sweden.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:76 Riksrevisionens rapport om Konkurrensverkets tillsyn
summary: The proposal advocates for updated legislation governing hunting in Sweden, focusing on wildlife management in both abundant and scarce populations. It calls for a review of the regulations surrounding the feeding and hunting of wildlife, as well as simplifying rules to promote the sale of wild game meat. The motion emphasizes the need for a balanced approach to mitigate wildlife-related damages to agriculture and forests, while ensuring both hunting and farming can coexist sustainably.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:76 Riksrevisionens rapport om Konkurrensverkets tillsyn
summary: The proposal suggests that A-tractors should be regulated under the same speed limits as moped cars, allowing them to travel at 45 kilometers per hour instead of 30. This change aims to provide consistency in regulations since A-tractors are modified cars with better safety features compared to moped cars. The motion also calls for a review of driver education to address the increasing rate of accidents involving these vehicles, particularly in rural areas where A-tractors are popular among youth.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:76 Riksrevisionens rapport om Konkurrensverkets tillsyn
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance solar energy utilization by allowing electrical connections between houses, enabling shared use of solar energy, permitting the construction of solar parks for collective consumption when individual roofs are unsuitable, and advocating for a more flexible definition of energy production versus private consumption to encourage microproduction of renewable electricity. The aim is to facilitate private investments in renewable energy and contribute to the goal of a fully renewable energy system in Sweden by 2040.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:76 Riksrevisionens rapport om Konkurrensverkets tillsyn
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3496 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government conducts an investigation to eliminate the right to claim rotavdrag (tax reduction for renovation) for properties located outside Sweden. The intention is to ensure that only properties within Sweden are eligible for this tax deduction, as the current system allows Swedish taxpayers with foreign properties to benefit from the rotavdrag, which is seen as unintended and contrary to the original purpose of the tax relief.

title: med anledning av framst. 2019/20:RB4 Medgivande för Riksbanken att delta i Internationella Valutafondens (IMF) finansieringslösning
summary: Martina Johansson suggests that the Swedish Parliament evaluate the possibility of reallocating a larger portion of property tax revenues to municipalities and regions, as current regulations allow only the state to benefit from these taxes on industrial properties and energy production. She argues that local governments should receive tax revenues from businesses that operate on their land, as they bear the costs of providing services and support to these businesses. Johansson believes that a review of the property tax reforms is necessary to ensure that local authorities receive sufficient funding to support the infrastructure and services related to these properties.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:79 Presentation av betalningssätt vid marknadsföring av betaltjänster online
summary: The motion proposes several measures to facilitate the operation of businesses within the tourism sector. It advocates for local decision-making on shoreline protection, the allowance of selling all farm-produced goods on-site, the need for more flexible employment arrangements, and a review of legislation differentiating requirements based on company size. The aim is to remove existing barriers to growth and enable smaller businesses to thrive in a competitive market.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:79 Presentation av betalningssätt vid marknadsföring av betaltjänster online
summary: Martina Johansson (C) proposes that the Swedish government investigate how the delegation system in healthcare can be made more effective. Currently, delegations given by healthcare professionals are personal and cease to be valid when the delegator leaves their position. This can disrupt patient care and create administrative burdens. The suggestion advocates for delegations to remain valid as long as the employee is still in the organization, regardless of the delegator's employment status, thereby improving efficiency and reducing waiting times for patients.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om det kommunala utjämningssystemet
summary: The motion proposes an investigation to address the issue of online hate, emphasizing the increasing risks faced by individuals, especially women, in expressing their opinions on social media. It highlights the need for specific legislation to combat online harassment, encourages schools to educate students about online safety, calls for improved police response to these offenses, and urges internet providers and social media companies to take greater responsibility in preventing bullying and hate speech.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:74 Genomförande av EU:s direktiv om automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar som rör rapporteringspliktiga gränsöverskridande arrangemang
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of expanding and broadening the tax deductions for donations to non-profit organizations. It highlights the importance of civil society and non-profits in addressing community needs and indicates that current tax deduction limits and approved organizations hinder potential donations. The proposal aims to increase both the range of organizations eligible for deductions and the amounts that can be deducted, thereby enhancing financial support for the non-profit sector.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:66 Redovisning av verksamheten i Internationella valutafonden 2019
summary: The motion proposes to amend the education law in Sweden to include the right to learn and use braille for children with visual impairments. It argues that literacy is a fundamental right and that the absence of this right for braille prevents many visually impaired children from achieving independent reading and writing skills. The proposal highlights the negative social and economic impacts of this deficiency and calls for legal recognition to ensure equal educational opportunities for all children, regardless of disabilities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:69 Barnpornografibrottet och preskription av brott mot barn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews current laws and regulations to facilitate signage for businesses located along public roads. It emphasizes the importance of effective signage for businesses, particularly in rural areas, to attract customers. The author argues that the existing legal framework restricts many businesses from erecting signs, which hinders their ability to operate successfully and connect with potential customers.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:69 Barnpornografibrottet och preskription av brott mot barn
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish parliament to support the creation of a national strategy aimed at identifying and implementing climate adaptations in agricultural landscapes to handle water management in response to both drought and heavy rainfall. The motivation highlights the increasing impact of climate change on agriculture, exemplified by the extreme weather conditions of 2023, and emphasizes the necessity for voluntary measures supported by information and financial assistance, along with collaboration with representatives from the green sectors.

title: Ett nytt konto- och värdefackssystem
summary: The proposal suggests a comprehensive reform of the coastal protection legislation in Sweden's rural areas to allow construction in waterfront locations. It argues that current regulations, rooted in policies designed for urban areas since the 1970s, hinder development in the countryside by restricting building near bodies of water. The proposal calls for municipalities to assume primary responsibility for these regulations while maintaining a minimal buffer zone to ensure public access to coastlines.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om föråldrade it-system i statsförvaltningen
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into raising the permit threshold for biogas facilities under the Environmental Assessment Regulation to facilitate the establishment of new biogas plants in Sweden. Currently, facilities producing over 3 GWh per year require a permit, which is deemed too low given the significant domestic demand for biogas and the potential for increased local production. The motion aims to promote biogas as a sustainable energy source and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

title: Genomförande av EU:s ändringsdirektiv om byggnaders energiprestanda
summary: This motion emphasizes the need to protect property rights in Sweden, asserting that individual ownership must be constitutionally safeguarded and that clear compensation rules are essential when restrictions are placed on land use. It advocates for management agreements when establishing nature reserves and warns against the commercial exploitation of public access rights, stressing that property owners should be acknowledged as effective managers of their land.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om Konkurrensverkets tillsyn
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to support a review of the regulations and compensation for civil registrars appointed by county administrative boards. It highlights the increasing demand for civil registrars, the lack of adequate training and support for them, and the longstanding issue of low compensation rates, which have not changed in 30 years. The motion advocates for a new investigation to establish fairer compensation and clearer responsibilities.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om stöd till start av näringsverksamhet - långsiktiga effekter och Arbetsförmedlingens arbetssätt
summary: The motion advocates for allowing school authorities in Sweden to purchase pedagogical services and to expand the subjects permitted for remote education. It aims to improve the quality of education by enabling schools facing challenges in hiring qualified teachers, particularly in small or specialized subjects, to access necessary educational resources. The proposal reflects a response to experiences gained from digital education during the pandemic, emphasizing the need for varied educational methods to ensure every child's successful schooling.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:72 Riksrevisionens rapport om Trafikverkets upphandling av drift och underhåll av statliga vägar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should direct the National Board of Health and Welfare to develop guidelines for the use of chemotherapy and other high-risk medications in home settings. The motion emphasizes the importance of allowing children undergoing cancer treatment to receive care in a familiar environment, while also addressing the risks parents face when administering medications without proper support and education.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:72 Riksrevisionens rapport om Trafikverkets upphandling av drift och underhåll av statliga vägar
summary: Martina Johansson proposes that the Swedish government conducts an investigation into the possibility of implementing a differentiated water tax based on consumption levels. This suggestion arises from growing concerns about water scarcity in Sweden, where certain municipalities have already implemented watering bans. Johansson argues that those who use an excessive amount of water, such as for lawn irrigation or pools, should pay more than those who only consume water for essential household needs. The aim is to create a system that reflects the value of water and helps finance the necessary infrastructure for its supply.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:68 Förstärkt nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för personer som arbetar med forskning eller utveckling
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should instruct the Transport Administration (Trafikverket) to focus on increasing the development of cycling paths in rural areas. This aim is to improve traffic safety, encourage cycling as a viable transportation option amid rising fuel costs, and decrease fossil fuel emissions. The motion highlights the need for safer roads that accommodate cyclists, particularly in regions where the infrastructure has primarily been adapted for motor vehicles.

title: Ersättningsbeloppet i insättningsgarantin och vissa andra frågor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament initiate an investigation to develop more adaptable regulations for infrastructure planning by Trafikverket, emphasizing the need for better collaboration with local communities during construction and renovation projects. It highlights the negative impact of rigid regulations on local residents and businesses, advocating for a more flexible approach to ensure that the needs of communities are considered during infrastructure improvements.

title: Presentation av betalningssätt vid marknadsföring av betaltjänster online
summary: The motion proposes that fraud against the elderly should be classified as a serious crime in Sweden due to the increasing vulnerability of older individuals who may struggle to protect themselves from scammers. The current classification of these frauds as regular crimes leads to minimal penalties and hampers law enforcement efforts in investigating and prosecuting the perpetrators. The motion suggests amending the legal definition to include a clause that recognizes the exploitation of an individual's vulnerable position as a qualifying factor for serious offenses.

title: Genomförande av EU:s direktiv om automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar som rör rapporteringspliktiga gränsöverskridande arrangemang
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament take measures to review and enhance how supplementary vocational training programs are developed in collaboration with various industries, addressing the issue of workforce shortages amidst a growing population. It emphasizes the need to better match job seekers, particularly young people and foreign-born individuals, with available positions by improving awareness of vocational options and providing relevant training. Additionally, it highlights the importance of offering language training in vocational Swedish to assist non-native speakers in integrating into the job market.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:68 Förstärkt nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för personer som arbetar med forskning eller utveckling
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider including students in social insurance systems to better protect them against illness, unemployment, and parenthood-related challenges. The author argues that the current lack of coverage leaves students financially vulnerable, particularly in cases of summer illness, new parenthood, or post-graduation unemployment. The motion emphasizes the need for sustainable and comprehensive regulations to ensure a safer study period for students and facilitate their graduation.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om stöd till renovering och energieffektivisering
summary: The motion proposes increased opportunities for licensed wolf hunting in regions with high domestic animal populations, arguing that this is necessary to alleviate the stress and harm that wolves cause to livestock. It suggests that the licensed hunting period should coincide with the moose hunting season to enhance hunting efficiency.

title: Redovisning av verksamheten i Internationella valutafonden 2019
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government assign the Geological Survey of Sweden (SGU) the responsibility for environmental monitoring at Ranstad to ensure no adverse environmental effects arise from the decommissioned uranium mining site. Additionally, it suggests that SGU should explore acquiring land for protection to mitigate potential future risks, addressing longstanding local concerns about environmental degradation and accountability.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:67 Användningsförbud och avskyltning av fordon med obetalda felparkeringsavgifter
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the initiative to develop the building rules set by Boverket in order to increase the use of reused building materials. It emphasizes the necessity of quality assurance, standardization, and digitalization in the construction industry to reduce climate impact, and highlights the inadequacies of current regulations that hinder the adoption of recycled materials.

title: Finansiella företags uppgifter till Riksgäldskontoret och vissa betaltjänstfrågor
summary: The motion addresses the traffic situation in Ystad, emphasizing the importance of Ystad port as a key hub for ferry traffic to Poland and Bornholm. With an expected increase in passenger traffic of up to 80% by 2030, the motion calls for measures by Trafikverket to enhance the safety and accessibility of traffic routes to and from the port, which is currently not well-suited for the heavy and increasing traffic associated with the port's expansion.

title: Barnpornografibrottet och preskription av brott mot barn
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support measures to combat erosion along the coasts of Skåne. It emphasizes the need for a comprehensive strategy based on knowledge and research to help municipalities address both erosion and flooding risks. The motion highlights the importance of sand beaches for tourism and local infrastructure while advocating for improved collaboration among municipalities and authorities to develop timely solutions for managing coastal erosion effectively.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:67 Användningsförbud och avskyltning av fordon med obetalda felparkeringsavgifter
summary: The proposal advocates for enhancing student health services to better support students recovering from illness and returning to their studies. It emphasizes the need for specialized rehabilitation focused on academic integration, arguing that current rehabilitation paths often require employer involvement, which is not suitable for students. The motion calls for increased resources and an expanded mandate for student health services to provide study-oriented rehabilitation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:65 En samlad politik för klimatet - klimatpolitisk handlingsplan
summary: The motion calls for a review of how Trafikverket is fulfilling its mandate to maintain high road standards across Sweden, emphasizing the urgent need to upgrade the deteriorating Swedish road network. It argues that poor road conditions hinder traffic safety and the development of electric and autonomous vehicles, which rely on a well-maintained infrastructure. The proposal advocates for increased political investment in road safety and technology, harmonization of road standards across the EU, and better collaboration with private entities to strengthen the overall transport system in Sweden.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:65 En samlad politik för klimatet - klimatpolitisk handlingsplan
summary: The suggestion proposes measures to enable the flagging of addresses known to be dangerous for ambulances and rescue services, similar to the existing protocol for the police. The motion emphasizes the need for enhanced safety for ambulance personnel by allowing them to be warned of previous incidents of violence at specific locations, thereby reducing potential risks when responding to emergencies.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:65 En samlad politik för klimatet - klimatpolitisk handlingsplan
summary: The proposal aims to create a safer Sweden free from crime and extremism, emphasizing the urgent need for effective policing and community engagement to address systemic crime, particularly in vulnerable neighborhoods. It calls for increased police presence, the abolition of funding to organizations that disrespect democratic values, and enhanced support for individuals leaving criminal lifestyles, alongside a systematic approach involving both municipalities and the local business sector.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:65 En samlad politik för klimatet - klimatpolitisk handlingsplan
summary: The motion proposes significant reforms to strengthen the legal protection of children against sexual crimes in Sweden. Key proposals include abolishing the puberty criterion in child pornography laws, introducing strict liability regarding the age of the child when it comes to sexual offenses, mandating platforms to detect and report child abuse materials, establishing coordinators in police forces to support child victims of sexual crimes, and allowing victim statements in court proceedings related to child pornography offenses to highlight the impact on the victims.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om Trafikverkets upphandling av drift och underhåll av statliga vägar
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to take concrete actions to address and develop efforts against violence in intimate relationships. It highlights that while women are predominantly affected, men also experience violence and calls for comprehensive support systems for all victims. The motion proposes increasing awareness, expanding preventative measures, and ensuring municipal and county responsibilities in funding and supporting initiatives led by non-profit organizations. Additionally, it seeks to enhance the accessibility of assistance for victims and improve cooperation with civil society in tackling this issue.

title: Förstärkt nedsättning av arbetsgivaravgifter för personer som arbetar med forskning eller utveckling
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the system of politically appointed lay judges in Swedish courts in order to strengthen judicial independence and ensure fair trials. The author argues that political affiliation among lay judges can influence judicial outcomes and that this undermines the rule of law and impartiality necessary for a just legal system.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:50 Riksrevisionens rapport om jämställd sjukfrånvaro
summary: The Swedish government proposes amendments to the Education Act to enhance students' access to appropriate educational materials, ensuring that students at all levels, from preschool to upper secondary education, receive textbooks and other necessary learning tools at no cost. The proposal includes clear definitions for educational materials and stipulates that any personal learning tools that students may keep may be purchased by them or offered at a cost equal to the provider's acquisition costs. These amendments are set to take effect on July 1, 2024.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:53 Underskott i förhållande till elnätsföretagens intäktsramar för tillsynsperioden 2012-2015
summary: The proposal suggests amendments to the Education Act (2010:800) aimed at removing the 'student's choice' in compulsory education, special schools, and Sami schools. This change is intended to reallocate teaching time to subjects that require more instructional hours, thereby creating better conditions for all students to achieve educational goals. The amendments are proposed to take effect on July 1, 2024, starting with the education that begins in the autumn term of 2024.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:62 2019 års redogörelse för tillämpningen av lagen om särskild utlänningskontroll
summary: The government proposes to amend existing legislation to facilitate the construction and operation of new nuclear reactors in Sweden. This includes removing the previous requirement that new reactors could only replace permanently shut-down reactors and limiting the number of simultaneous operational reactors to ten. The proposed changes aim to allow for more than ten reactors to be operational at once and to initiate construction at different locations. The changes are intended to support increased electricity production and are scheduled to come into effect on January 1, 2024.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:64 Hemlig dataavläsning
summary: The government proposes changes to the laws regarding direct award contracts for public transport on railways, aiming to restrict the Swedish Transport Administration's ability to directly award such contracts only to those valued under €7,500,000. Additionally, the proposal seeks to remove an authorization for the government or a designated authority to issue regulations on limited port security investigations. These changes are intended to align Swedish regulations with EU law and are set to take effect on December 25, 2023.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:58 Reglering av vapenmagasin
summary: This proposal suggests amendments to Sweden's income tax laws to clarify tax treatment regarding business restructuring under new EU corporate law allowing cross-border operations. It includes provisions for exceptions from immediate taxation for corporate asset transfers under separation and cross-border reorganization, as well as deductions for expenses incurred when transferring a business's registered seat outside Sweden within the EEA. The changes are intended to take effect from January 1, 2024.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:50 Riksrevisionens rapport om jämställd sjukfrånvaro
summary: The government proposes that the Swedish Parliament ratifies a protocol signed on May 22, 2023, to amend the tax agreement between Sweden and France. This amendment aims to avoid double taxation and prevent tax evasion concerning income and wealth taxes. It incorporates minimum standards developed within the OECD/G20 framework to combat base erosion and profit shifting, which Sweden signed in June 2017. Upon ratification, the new provisions will be applicable as law in Sweden.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:52 En utvecklad översiktsplanering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize the Skåne flag as an official symbol, allowing its use in official contexts alongside the Swedish and EU flags. This follows historical use by Region Skåne and local government initiatives, and acknowledges past concerns regarding the official status of regional flags as stated by Riksarkivet. The motion calls for an investigation into changing regulations to facilitate the official recognition of the Skåne flag.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:64 Hemlig dataavläsning
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider initiating an investigation into the re-establishment of national emergency stocks for protective and medical equipment, essential medicines, food supplies, and fuels. The proposal emphasizes the need for these reserves to ensure preparedness for future crises, citing failures observed during the COVID-19 pandemic and advocating for state responsibility rather than reliance on private actors or regional efforts to maintain these stocks.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:50 Riksrevisionens rapport om jämställd sjukfrånvaro
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3470 av Julia Kronlid och Linda Lindberg (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish government review and simplify legislation regarding cooperative rental rights to enhance accessibility and affordability in housing for low-income households. It emphasizes the need for national coordination and financial support to promote cooperative housing models, including creating a national coordinator for cooperative housing, facilitating the creation of cooperative rental associations, and establishing sharing housing as an official category to address current gaps in the housing market.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:70 Integritetsskydd vid signalspaning i försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3469 av Pål Jonson m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion by Åsa Eriksson advocates for clear guidelines regarding the types of financial support available to women who are victims of domestic violence and cannot work due to protected identity. The proposal emphasizes that these women and their children should not face financial hardship as a result of their circumstances and calls for government action to establish a form of economic compensation for these individuals until they can return to work.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:58 Reglering av vapenmagasin
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need for Sweden to address plastic pollution by increasing investments in recycling infrastructure and modern technologies for sorting and material recycling. It advocates for an extended producer responsibility system for plastic products to encourage sustainable design and increase the use of recycled materials. Additionally, a national campaign is proposed to educate the public on plastic pollution and individual contributions to the solution, aiming to foster a circular economy and enhance Sweden's leadership in sustainable development.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:62 2019 års redogörelse för tillämpningen av lagen om särskild utlänningskontroll
summary: The proposal focuses on strengthening elderly care in Sweden by advocating for the continuation of the Äldreomsorgslyftet initiative, improving working conditions for staff, and ensuring stable financing for elderly care services. It emphasizes the growing need for specialized care due to an aging population and aims to enhance training and support for healthcare workers in this sector. The authors argue that better working conditions and adequate staffing are essential for providing quality care to the elderly, particularly in light of recent challenges faced by the sector.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:51 Totalförsvarsdatalag - personuppgiftsbehandling vid Totalförsvarets rekryteringsmyndighet
summary: The motion proposes improvements in rehabilitation for long-term sick individuals, highlighting the challenges they face in obtaining sickness benefits due to strict assessments and inadequate support for rehabilitation. It emphasizes the need for better coordination among various agencies to ensure that those with diminished work capacity receive the necessary support and security in their welfare system. The motion advocates for implementing recommendations from a government-commissioned investigation aimed at enhancing the social safety net for these individuals.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:58 Reglering av vapenmagasin
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3465 av Johan Forssell m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for Sweden's shoreline protection laws to be adapted to local conditions, acknowledging the diverse geographical contexts across the country. It advocates for regulations that ensure public access to nature while considering the specific needs of municipalities with extensive shorelines, aiming for consistent interpretation of these rules across counties to support habitation and economic activity.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:62 2019 års redogörelse för tillämpningen av lagen om särskild utlänningskontroll
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support achieving its target of maintaining a wolf population of 170-270 individuals in Sweden, potentially through hunting or other measures, as the current population is estimated to be around 460. The motion highlights the issues caused by the overpopulation of wolves, particularly for residents and agriculture in rural areas, and emphasizes the need for decisions to be made close to those affected.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes an overhaul of the grading system in schools to eliminate failure and the feeling of exclusion for students. The aim is to create an environment that allows all students, regardless of their background, to focus on learning and improving their knowledge without the stress of traditional grading, which can lead to feelings of inadequacy, particularly for those who do not achieve passing grades.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:63 Tydligare regler vid konsumentavtal
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3462 av Martina Johansson m.fl. (C, KD, M)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should initiate an investigation into the reasons why certain children are less likely to seek healthcare services, both for necessary treatment and preventative care. The aim is to assess and understand the disparities in healthcare access among children to inform policies that promote equity in pediatric healthcare. The motion emphasizes the importance of viewing healthcare access through a lens of equality, ensuring that resources are allocated based on individual needs rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:58 Reglering av vapenmagasin
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament seek a review of municipalities' responsibilities regarding childcare during non-standard working hours. It highlights the increasing demand for 24/7 availability of services due to a digitalized society, emphasizing the need for childcare support to promote gender equality and workforce participation, particularly for single parents. The motion calls for an analysis of how to distribute any additional costs between the state and municipalities to ensure access to childcare when needed.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:63 Tydligare regler vid konsumentavtal
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance legal safeguards for employees undergoing security vetting in response to increasing security threats. It highlights the significant rise in the number of security checks performed by the Security Police and the lack of recourse for individuals who may be wrongly assessed. The motion calls for a review of current legislation to ensure that employees have the ability to challenge or understand the results of their security assessments, balancing the need for national security with individual rights.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:60 Riksrevisionens rapport om resurseffektivitet och produktivitet vid Sveriges lärosäten i nordisk jämförelse
summary: The proposal suggests abolishing the statute of limitations for violent crimes against children, arguing that like sexual offenses, children who experience violence from adults suffer long-term detrimental effects on their health and well-being. The motion emphasizes that repealing the limitation would provide victims with better access to justice and support, and help disrupt the cycle of violent behavior often perpetuated within families.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:54 Riksrevisionens rapport om mörkertal inom bostadstillägget
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3458 av Julia Kronlid och Linda Lindberg (båda SD)
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to intensify efforts to investigate the atrocities committed against the Yazidi people by Daesh, acknowledging these acts as genocide. The proposal emphasizes the need to hold those responsible for crimes against humanity accountable and advocates for the establishment of an international tribunal in the affected region. It also urges Sweden to take a leading role in international initiatives to ensure that individuals responsible for these crimes are prosecuted in both international and national courts.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:54 Riksrevisionens rapport om mörkertal inom bostadstillägget
summary: The motion advocates for the gradual construction of a double-track railway on the Skånebanan from Helsingborg to Kristianstad, recognizing its significance as a heavily trafficked single-track railway essential for commuters and regional connectivity. The proposal emphasizes the need for improved public transportation to support both the growing population and the industrial development along the corridor, addressing current capacity issues that lead to delays. The motion highlights the broader implications for job growth and regional development, calling for the government to consider these improvements in infrastructure planning.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:50 Riksrevisionens rapport om jämställd sjukfrånvaro
summary: The proposal suggests the implementation of measures to reduce smoking in Sweden, including the introduction of hidden tobacco sales and mandatory identification checks for tobacco consumers. The intention is to enhance public health and curb tobacco use, particularly among minors, by preventing tobacco products from being displayed openly in stores and requiring individuals to present ID when consuming tobacco.

title: med anledning av skr. 2019/20:62 2019 års redogörelse för tillämpningen av lagen om särskild utlänningskontroll
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3455 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament initiate an investigation into the introduction of assisted dying for severely ill patients in Sweden. The motion highlights the importance of respecting patient autonomy and alleviating suffering, particularly for those in terminal stages of illness. It references existing models of assisted dying from the USA and Benelux countries, advocating for a legal framework that allows for assisted dying under strict conditions, aligning with the public support for such measures.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of a Nordic coronacommission to evaluate the handling of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Nordic countries and to strengthen international health cooperation. It emphasizes the importance of collaboration among Nordic nations in crisis situations and suggests assessing current health agreements, creating a unified strategy for sharing healthcare materials, and evaluating common preparedness stocks to enhance response to future crises.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes a series of initiatives aimed at improving elderly care in Sweden by enhancing professional qualifications within the field. It emphasizes the necessity for minimum competency requirements for caregivers, central coordination in geriatric care, and the inclusion of geriatrics in medical training. Moreover, it calls for the establishment of a national elderly ombudsman to protect the rights and interests of seniors, a review of public meal standards in elderly care, and the introduction of a national subsidy for anti-slip devices for seniors to prevent fall accidents.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:57 Vissa ytterligare ändringar av placeringsreglerna för Första-Fjärde AP-fonderna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate the possibility of fully assuming responsibility for the Halmstad–Nässjö railway line, citing its importance for efficient and environmentally friendly transport, economic development, and regional connectivity. It emphasizes the line's role in improving commuting options and supporting local industries, while also addressing concerns about potential service cuts due to funding challenges faced by regional authorities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2019/20:64 Hemlig dataavläsning
motion_id: Motion 2019/20:3451 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: This motion proposes measures to ensure uniformity in the assessment of personal votes by county administrative boards in Sweden, particularly in response to concerns raised following the 2022 parliamentary election. The motion calls for personal votes to be recorded similarly to party votes to enhance transparency and reliability in the electoral process. It argues that the current practices allow for inconsistencies in determining the validity of personal votes, which undermines voter confidence and could impact the final election outcomes, especially for candidates from smaller parties.

title: Användningsförbud och avskyltning av fordon med obetalda felparkeringsavgifter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of a standardized marking for learner drivers in the EU and Nordic countries, suggesting a recognizable 'L' sign for vehicles used in driving education, which would enhance road safety by aiding recognition for all drivers, regardless of language proficiency. The motion highlights that current Swedish signage is not accessible for non-Swedish speakers and advocates for alignment with international practices, such as those in Norway and other countries.

title: Stärkta skolbibliotek
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into whether the Folkbildningsrådet should be merged with or incorporated into a governmental authority due to its inability to ensure that organizations receiving state funding comply with established requirements. Concerns are raised about financial irregularities and the potential misuse of public funds by organizations linked to undemocratic practices, including antisemitism and gender inequality. The motion emphasizes that public money should not support such activities and calls for improved oversight to ensure adherence to democratic values and human rights.

title: Nationell säkerhetsstrategi
summary: The motion proposes a review of Sweden's sexual offenses law to enhance protections for children against severe digital sexual crimes, equate severe posing crimes involving penetration with rape, emphasize the victim's age in sentencing, and increase penalties for offenders who contact children online for sexual purposes. The motion argues that current laws are insufficient and need strengthening to adequately protect children and reflect the severity of such offenses.

title: Redovisning av fördelning av medel från Allmänna arvsfonden under budgetåret 2023
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review and tighten legislation to allow landlords and housing associations to prohibit smoking in residential properties and on balconies. It highlights the health risks associated with tobacco smoke, both for active smokers and those exposed to secondhand smoke, emphasizing the need for a smoke-free living environment to mitigate these risks and promote health equity.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:151 Förbättrade levnadsvillkor för utlänningar med tillfälligt skydd
summary: Ola Möller's motion calls for the establishment of an investigative commission to analyze the impact that recent public actions, including Koran burnings, have had on Sweden's security and foreign relations. The motion highlights the significant deterioration in Sweden's safety and international reputation due to these events, emphasizing the need for a thorough examination of the roles of various actors involved. The aim is to understand the causes of these actions, assess the extent of the damage, and propose measures to restore Sweden's security and standing.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:144 En ny förverkandelagstiftning
summary: The motion aims to strengthen the freedom of association in Sweden by ensuring that organizations have the right to determine their own membership without state interference. It emphasizes the importance of this freedom for a functioning democracy and highlights a legal case where a union's decision to expel a member was overturned by the court, arguing that such decisions should remain within the discretion of the organizations themselves.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:151 Förbättrade levnadsvillkor för utlänningar med tillfälligt skydd
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish parliament to consider implementing a general hunting season for cormorants due to their increasing population, which threatens fish stocks and the fishing industry, especially in Gävleborg County. The motion highlights the need for additional measures alongside existing opportunities for protective hunting to manage the cormorant population effectively, as their presence creates environmental concerns.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:144 En ny förverkandelagstiftning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support efforts to incorporate a children's rights perspective in the development of accessible and quality healthcare. It highlights the need to address health inequalities that stem from resource disparities, particularly among children from socioeconomically disadvantaged backgrounds. The proposal emphasizes the importance of ensuring that children and young people can actively participate in the planning and provision of healthcare services, taking their unique needs and perspectives into account.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:151 Förbättrade levnadsvillkor för utlänningar med tillfälligt skydd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate how regions can be better supported to develop maternal and delivery care, ensuring that parental support reaches all expecting parents. It emphasizes the significant impact that early life conditions have on children's health outcomes, and highlights existing inequalities in access to healthcare resources. The motion critiques the government's current funding approach, which is deemed insufficient to address the ongoing challenges faced by municipalities and regions, particularly in light of rising mental health issues among expectant mothers and disparities in support accessibility for disadvantaged groups.

title: Tilläggsprotokoll 16 till Europakonventionen – en möjlighet för de högsta domstolarna att begära rådgivande yttrande från Europadomstolen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support strengthening the conditions for international trade union cooperation in development assistance, highlighting the crucial role of independent and democratic unions in promoting democracy and reducing poverty. It emphasizes the alarming global status of workers' rights, where union activities are often met with violence and repression, and calls for a review of Swedish development assistance policies to better advocate for labor rights and monitor the impact of aid, particularly in light of budget cuts affecting civil society's capacity to inform the public and advocate for workers' situations globally.

title: Kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om digitala tjänster
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive review of the taxi industry in Sweden, citing numerous structural issues that negatively impact drivers, citizens, and reputable companies. The motion highlights problems such as price dumping, low wages, poor working conditions, and a driver shortage exacerbated by the gig economy. It emphasizes the need for better employment terms to ensure the safety and reliability of transportation services, particularly in rural areas where access to taxis is limited. The authors call for society to regain control over industry development to ensure fair competition and quality service.

title: Flexiblare regler för utbetalning från pensionsförsäkring och pensionssparkonto
summary: The motion proposes changes to regulations regarding sickness and activity compensation, advocating for increased support for education and retraining programs for individuals furthest from the labor market, particularly the low-skilled and long-term unemployed. It emphasizes the need for ensuring that individuals can study while receiving financial support and calls for simplifying pathways between various compensation systems and educational funding to enhance employment opportunities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:151 Förbättrade levnadsvillkor för utlänningar med tillfälligt skydd
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of folk high schools in Sweden for lifelong learning, advocating for the preservation and enhancement of their freedom and economic support. It highlights the need for financial stability to maintain diverse and tailored education opportunities, particularly for individuals with lower education levels and those with disabilities, ensuring access to study grants and the ability to participate in courses without financial hindrance. The motion also underscores the role of folk high schools in supporting civil society and cultural enrichment.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:152 Steg på vägen mot en mer effektiv miljöprövning
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of demand-driven obstacle lighting for wind turbines in Sweden to reduce the blinking lights that are currently a disturbance for rural residents. It highlights the need for more renewable energy sources to meet climate goals and suggests that such lighting could improve acceptance of wind power developments by minimizing environmental impact. The motion advocates for changing existing regulations to permit this technology, which is already in use in Germany.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:143 Aktsamhet vid bygg-, rivnings- och markåtgärder
summary: The proposal suggests a comprehensive review and potential dissolution of the Public Health Agency of Sweden, redistributing its responsibilities to other governmental bodies. It advocates for the establishment of a national strategy focusing on nutrition, physical activity, and public health, and emphasizes increased knowledge and measures related to hepatitis C treatment and testing accessibility. The motion also calls for enhanced vaccination information against HPV and the development of a domestic vaccine for HSV-2. Furthermore, it urges the formulation of a national crisis plan to combat tuberculosis following WHO recommendations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:152 Steg på vägen mot en mer effektiv miljöprövning
summary: The proposal advocates for reviewing the possibility of strengthening privacy protection in relation to Ivo (the Health and Social Care Inspectorate) complaints. It highlights the tension between public transparency and the sensitivity of personal healthcare information, arguing that the current public access principles may deter patients from reporting significant issues, thus undermining care quality and accountability.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:148 Två frågor om taxi – prisuppgiftsskyldigheten och ålderskravet för taxiförarlegitimation
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament classify corporal punishment of children as a public health problem and urges the government to acknowledge this classification. The motion emphasizes Sweden's pioneering role in prohibiting corporal punishment in 1979 and highlights the positive effects of this law on parental attitudes and child development. It argues that both physical and psychological abuse can lead to severe consequences for children, including long-term health issues and criminal behavior. The motion calls for Sweden to align its policies with commitments made under the UN's Agenda 2030 to eliminate all forms of violence against children.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:152 Steg på vägen mot en mer effektiv miljöprövning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate necessary measures to secure and develop regional airports, emphasizing their critical role for both private and business travel, especially in light of the ongoing recovery of the aviation industry post-COVID-19. It highlights the importance of these airports for national defense, emergency services, and as vital infrastructure for the economy, stressing the need for government intervention to prevent the closure of essential regional air services and ensure operational readiness for defense needs.

title: Ändrad åldersgräns för avgiftsfri tandvård
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament endorses the need for upgrading the road network in Fyrbodal, emphasizing the importance of reliable transportation for both industry and tourism in the region. It highlights the current state of neglect of the roads in Dalsland and Bohuslän, which affects not only local businesses but also everyday travel for residents, students, and tourists. The proposal calls for increased governmental support for road maintenance and improvements, particularly for key routes such as road 172 and road 171.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om statens skydd av hotade personer
summary: The motion proposes that the responsibility for inspecting shooting ranges in Sweden be transferred back to the Fortifications Agency, as the current oversight by the Police Authority has led to various negative consequences, including unnecessary closures and operational limitations of shooting ranges. The authors argue that police inspections are overly stringent and hinder the development of shooting skills necessary for hunters and sport shooters. They emphasize the importance of maintaining a competent population of gun handlers for national defense, and state that a dedicated agency should focus on this task to allow the police to concentrate on crime prevention.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:152 Steg på vägen mot en mer effektiv miljöprövning
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2911 av Andrea Andersson Tay m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the benefits of establishing a double-track railway between Gothenburg and Oslo. It emphasizes the need to eliminate border obstacles for improved cross-border commuting and highlights the vulnerabilities of current transport routes. The motion argues that a railway would significantly reduce harmful emissions, enhance the labor market, provide better recruitment opportunities for businesses, and improve the overall welfare and education sector in the region.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:144 En ny förverkandelagstiftning
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of combating homelessness and integrating social perspectives into community planning. It calls for the strengthening of outreach efforts and national strategies to address the needs of the homeless population, which is diverse and faces various challenges. The proposal underlines the necessity of coordinated actions at both municipal and national levels to ensure that no one sleeps outdoors due to lack of adequate housing and that every individual is supported to transition into stable living situations.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes changes to the Swedish legal process to enhance its efficiency and fairness by investigating the potential removal of the immediacy principle and allowing greater use of evidence gathered during preliminary investigations. It aims to make it more difficult for suspects to fabricate stories and manipulate outcomes in criminal cases, drawing lessons from Denmark's handling of organized crime cases.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal advocates for enhancing national cohesion within schools in Sweden, suggesting that government initiatives should foster a sense of community among students. It highlights the decline of national unity in an increasingly individualistic society and recommends practices such as regular flag-raising ceremonies and the singing of the national anthem in schools to promote inclusion and shared values from an early age.

title: Ett levande hav – ökat skydd, minskad övergödning och ett hållbart fiske
summary: The motion proposes that all public dental care clinics be tasked with openly reporting the costs associated with providing dental care to undocumented immigrants and asylum seekers. The motivation emphasizes perceived unfairness in the current system, where these groups pay a nominal fee while older citizens struggle with dental costs. The motion highlights the lack of transparency regarding taxpayer funding for these services and calls for a review of the policy by the government.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:142 EU:s nya utsläppshandelssystem för fossila bränslen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate the implementation of mandatory life sentences for manslaughter and murder of police officers. The author emphasizes increasing violence against police and the need for stronger deterrents to protect officers serving to combat crime. The motion seeks to prevent future scenarios where police might become targets and aims to ensure that such offenses carry a uniform and severe penalty, promoting safety for law enforcement.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:142 EU:s nya utsläppshandelssystem för fossila bränslen
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish government establish a state fund to subsidize holiday weeks in rural areas for families with children, aiming to provide urban children with exposure to the countryside and farming life. The proposal emphasizes the importance of family bonding, reducing the psychological divide between urban and rural populations, and creating lasting memories for children. It also suggests that this initiative could help diversify rural economies by increasing the demand for rental properties in the countryside, thereby benefiting rural communities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:142 EU:s nya utsläppshandelssystem för fossila bränslen
summary: The motion proposes a review of the transport service for people with disabilities, emphasizing the need for consistent service quality across regions. It highlights issues such as unreliable transportation and the lack of adequate oversight and accountability against service providers who fail to deliver. The review aims to explore potential sanctions for untrustworthy operators and compensation strategies for affected customers, ultimately advocating for a reliable transportation system that supports equal mobility for individuals with disabilities.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2024 – Ytterligare försvarsmateriel och ekonomiskt stöd till Ukraina
summary: The motion proposes a review of Sweden's existing structures for supporting domestic actors in harnessing the economic potential of research and innovations. The aim is to enhance these opportunities, as Sweden currently has a relatively low ability to capitalize on its research potential compared to international peers. The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining Sweden's position as a knowledge-based economy, highlighting concerns over intellectual property awareness, the risk of idea theft, and the need for better collaboration between academia and industry.

title: Redovisning av AP-fondernas verksamhet t.o.m. 2023
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should explore opportunities for individuals who have previously left academic research to re-enter the field. It argues that current selection criteria for research funding often disadvantage those who have worked outside academia, even in knowledge-intensive sectors, which can offer valuable insights relevant to societal needs. The motion suggests creating new, earmarked funding specifically for these returnees while ensuring collaboration with active researchers, in order to enrich academic research and its practical applicability.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:138 Avancerat ramavtal mellan Europeiska unionen och dess medlemsstater, å ena sidan, och Republiken Chile, å andra sidan
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2904 av Jacob Risberg och Janine Alm Ericson (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament initiates a study to create a system that allows the public to have a genuine opportunity to review and provide input on international agreements and treaties that impact Swedish law and politics before ratification or signing. The motion highlights the current lack of transparency and public involvement in the negotiation and ratification processes of such agreements, underscoring the need for democratic engagement and a proposed amendment to the constitution to include public consultation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:139 Explosiva varor – ett nationellt tillståndsregister och kriminalisering av förstadier till brott mot tillståndsplikten
summary: The motion proposes that a parliamentary investigation be established to analyze the impact of international agreements on democracy in Sweden, highlighting the increasing influence of such agreements on political decisions made by elected representatives. The motion argues that the current process undermines democratic legitimacy, as many agreements do not reflect national or local issues and are often approved by minority governments without sufficient public input. It suggests potential reforms, including the involvement of the parliamentary speaker in negotiations and requiring public elections before ratifying significant agreements, to enhance democratic oversight and legitimacy of these international treaties.

title: Kompletterande bestämmelser till nya unionsregler på konkurrensområdet
summary: The suggestion proposes a review and modernization of the regulations governing speed limits for A-tractors, considering recent developments that have made it easier to modify these vehicles and harder for police to enforce existing rules. The motion argues that current regulations are inconsistent and places A-tractors at a disadvantage compared to moped cars, potentially compromising road safety. It aims to harmonize the speed limits for A-tractors and moped cars, proposing an increase in the maximum allowable speed for A-tractors to 45 km/h.

title: Steg på vägen mot en mer effektiv miljöprövning
summary: The motion proposes prioritizing the expansion of the road E40 to a dual carriageway between Ulricehamn and Jönköping in order to improve traffic flow and safety. This segment is currently the only part of the route not upgraded to dual lanes, which is crucial for efficient transportation of goods and for private traffic, enhancing the overall traffic safety along the route from Gothenburg to E4 in Jönköping.

title: Förbättrade levnadsvillkor för utlänningar med tillfälligt skydd
summary: The proposal suggests that Sweden's Administrative Act should be amended to clarify the necessity of dialogue between authorities and the stakeholders affected by administrative actions to ensure the proportionality principle is upheld. It emphasizes the importance of understanding the context and circumstances of the parties involved, particularly in complex cases, to ensure fairness and efficiency in administrative decision-making.

title: Ny patentlag
