The initiator emphasizes the need for clearer legislation to protect children and ensure that video games containing gambling-like mechanics adhere to the same regulations applied to traditional gambling activities, including age restrictions.

title: Gotlands försvar
summary: This motion proposes an investigation into measures to combat the abuse of lost passports in Sweden, highlighting that despite previous legislation intended to make it more difficult to lose a passport, the number of missing passports remains high. The proponent argues that the existing system is inadequate and suggests further actions to curb the misuse of Swedish identification documents, which is perceived as damaging to their legitimacy and could impact Swedish citizens' ability to travel internationally.

title: Ändamålsenlig grundlag
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2108 av Jesper Skalberg Karlsson och Johan Hultberg (båda M)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates measures and actions against crimes committed by animal rights extremists, highlighting the challenges faced by hunters and farmers due to threats and vandalism linked to these activists. The motion argues that such actions not only target hunters but also affect those involved in animal husbandry, leading to a climate of fear and necessitating a governmental response.

title: Statens företag
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2107 av Jesper Skalberg Karlsson och Louise Meijer (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for Dalarnas län to be reassigned to the same electricity pricing area as southern Norrland, highlighting that Dalarnas is no longer an electricity production deficit area. It cites issues such as the impact of high electricity prices on local industry, notably the closure of a paper mill, and the need for Dalarnas to receive benefits from the ongoing investment surge in regions with electricity surpluses. The motion underlines the disparity in electricity costs faced by residents and businesses in Dalarnas compared to those in elprisområde 2.

title: En svensk ö-politik
summary: Larry Söder (KD) proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize the need for clearer regulations to prevent the abuse of the right of public access (allemansrätten) in Sweden. He highlights issues such as environmental damage and unauthorized commercial activities taking place on private land, despite existing prohibitions. The proposal emphasizes the importance of differentiating between acceptable public access and the necessity for commercial entities to obtain permission from landowners, as well as the need for educational initiatives in schools to better inform the public about the rights and responsibilities associated with allemansrätten.

title: Nationell vattenstrategi
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the initiative to enhance labeling regulations for honey in accordance with EU standards. It emphasizes that current labeling does not adequately inform consumers about the origins of honey, leading to risks of fraud and poor quality products. The suggestion aims for the Swedish Food Agency to be tasked with adjusting labeling rules so that both domestic and imported honey can be marked with their respective origins, thereby promoting local honey production and contributing to biodiversity.

title: SOS Alarm som myndighet
summary: The motion proposes a review of infrastructure improvements to support job creation and economic value in Oskarshamn, emphasizing the need for better road quality on E22 and other local roads, increased government responsibility for vital transport routes without railway access, electrification of existing railways, and enhancing freight transport via sea. It aims to ensure a sustainable and efficient transport system to bolster regional economic activity and employment, specifically addressing the anticipated rise in transport demand and the importance of maintaining Oskarshamn as a manufacturing hub.

title: Krigsplacering av frivillig personal
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag mandates an investigation into the presentation of actual wages, including salary and payroll taxes, on the payslips of public sector employees. The authors contend that many citizens underestimate their tax burden due to hidden taxes, which poses a democratic issue. They argue that transparency regarding the actual taxation levels is essential for informed civic engagement, especially in times of economic difficulty.

title: En fungerande telekommunikation i hela landet
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish parliament reject Proposition 2023/24:5, which proposes a fee for filing disputes with the General Complaints Board (ARN). The Left Party argues that charging fees would create barriers for economically disadvantaged consumers, especially the elderly, who are frequently targeted by unscrupulous businesses. They advocate for stronger consumer guidance within municipalities rather than imposing fees, positing that this approach would lead to more accurate and valid complaints being processed by ARN.

title: Dubbelfilig E4 genom Gävleborg
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2101 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposed by Karin Rågsjö and others from the Left Party aims to enhance the quality and equity of elderly care in Sweden by implementing national staffing guidelines and requirements for medical competency within the sector. It calls for the establishment of permanent medical personnel in nursing homes and better education and support for staff, focusing on the needs of an aging population and addressing disparities exacerbated by previous austerity measures and privatizations. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring that all elderly individuals, especially those over 85, have access to appropriate housing and care, with a systematic assessment of needs post-pandemic.

title: Ny lag om tvingande vård av vårdnadshavare
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2100 av Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: This motion proposes to align the maximum allowable noise levels for sports facilities with those set for roads and railways, increasing the limits from 45 dBA at night and 55 dBA during the day to 55 dBA at night and 60 dBA during the day. The reasoning behind this change is to support sports clubs, which are vital community organizations, by alleviating operational challenges and reducing potential costly compliance measures due to current noise regulations.

title: Tågstopp längs Ostkustbanan vid Hagsta i Gävle kommun
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2099 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for prioritizing the infrastructure needs of Jämtland in the next traffic infrastructure proposition, emphasizing its geographical and cultural significance as a vital link between northern and southern Sweden. It highlights the importance of investing in infrastructure to enhance accessibility, stimulate economic growth, attract businesses, improve the job market, and support the tourism sector, ultimately benefiting both the region and the nation.

title: Utbildning för företagsläkare
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2098 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to enhance and prioritize the maintenance of hiking trails on state-owned land in Jämtland, assess the potential of mountain tourism to support the region's economy, and update practices regarding the coexistence of reindeer husbandry and tourism. It calls for an independent investigation into the impact of various activities on reindeer populations and the sustainable management of their numbers. The motion argues that tourism is crucial for local economic development and should be promoted rather than restricted, given recent cuts in mountain tourism services.

title: Möjlighet till avskrivning av studielån vid tjänstgöring på landsbygden inom samhällsviktiga verksamheter
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2097 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the existing shoreline protection laws to facilitate construction near shorelines while maintaining ecological balance. The proposal emphasizes the potential for local economic growth through increased property development in less populated areas and calls for a new study to create a more effective regulatory framework that empowers local municipalities to make decisions based on their specific circumstances.

title: Förskoleavgiften under sommarstängt
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2096 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The Swedish government has presented a report addressing the findings and recommendations of the National Audit Office regarding the effectiveness of digital services provided by government authorities to private individuals. The audit concludes that the government's efforts in developing these digital services have been insufficient, primarily due to systemic-level barriers. The government acknowledges the need for long-term strategies and clearer roles for the Agency for Digital Administration to enhance the delivery of accessible and user-friendly digital services.

title: Drogtester i skolan för att motverka missbruk
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2095 av Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes a review of hunting seasons and management of the moose population in Sweden, highlighting a significant decline in moose numbers in various regions. It suggests that the hunting season for moose should end by December 31 to better protect the species and calls for a comprehensive analysis of moose management strategies moving forward.

title: Obligatorisk utbildning i VMA-systemet för elever i grund‑ och gymnasieskola
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2094 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish parliament to adopt the recommendations from the National Audit Office regarding the strengthening of individuals' rights under the lex Maria and lex Sarah regulations. It emphasizes the need for improved patient safety and involvement of individuals and their relatives in the reporting and evaluation of incidents that lead to serious care injuries. The motion highlights the bureaucratic nature of current practices and advocates for a more person-centered approach, calling for increased authority for the National Board of Health and Welfare to ensure these rights are upheld.

title: Digitalt högkostnadsskydd inom hälso- och sjukvården
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2093 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of an opt-out procedure for group litigation in Sweden, aligning with EU directives that protect collective consumer interests. This system would allow consumers to automatically be included in group claims unless they choose to opt out, as opposed to the current opt-in model, which requires individual registration. The motion argues that this change would better accommodate consumers, increase participation in group lawsuits, and enhance corporate accountability by allowing larger groups to present claims even for small individual losses.

title: Utrop på tågstationer
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2092 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports previous reforms aimed at revitalizing the teaching of national minority languages in high schools. It emphasizes the establishment of national minority languages as a formal school subject and highlights the importance of making it easier for students to learn these languages, particularly at the beginner level. Additionally, it calls for a comprehensive follow-up on the effects of existing reforms related to minority language education to ensure effective implementation and outcomes.

title: Räddningskorridorer för bättre framkomlighet vid olyckor
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2091 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for the government to ensure that the Police Authority adheres to the recommendations provided by the National Audit Office regarding the handling of volume crimes, which account for over 80% of reported crimes and are related to organized crime. The audit highlighted inefficiencies in the police's management of these crimes, stemming from issues like insufficient staffing and inadequate training. The motion emphasizes the need for improved policing practices and better tools to combat crime effectively.

title: Sänkt körkortsålder för personbil i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2090 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the government ensure that the Police Authority follows the recommendations from the National Audit Office regarding handling special events aimed at combating organized crime. The motion highlights that while special events can be effective in the initial hours or days, prolonged events can cause more harm than good due to resource allocation issues. The audit reveals that the Police Authority lacks comprehensive tracking of such events and their associated costs, which raises concerns about the effectiveness of these approaches against serious crime. The Green Party calls for a more systematic dissemination of knowledge and evaluation of special events within the Police Authority.

title: Legitimation för persontransporter med buss
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2089 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the idea that pedestrians and cyclists should be able to cross the Kalmar Strait without any cost, similar to the existing arrangements for motor vehicle traffic. It argues that since tolls were introduced for cyclists and pedestrians, their ability to travel has been significantly hindered, resulting in a decrease in cycling activity. The motion advocates for provisions to ensure free public transport options like buses or ferries for non-motorized traffic, aligning with national goals for increased cycling and sustainable transportation.

title: Möjligheten att svänga höger vid rött ljus
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2088 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes several measures aimed at improving animal welfare and promoting sustainable consumption of animal products in Sweden. Key suggestions include implementing origin labeling for animal products served in restaurants, increasing public procurement of organic food, banning the use of products from animals subjected to practices prohibited in Sweden, and encouraging reduced consumption of animal products with higher welfare standards. The goal is to foster a more ethical and environmentally friendly food system while ensuring that Swedish animal producers can compete fairly.

title: Trafikljus vid övergångsställen med nedräkning av tid
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2087 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into the necessity of a basic income system in response to the rise of automation and artificial intelligence, which threatens traditional job security. Citing the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on employment and income stability, the motion calls for the government to consider new economic models that address potential job losses due to technological advancements. Advocates suggest that a basic income could provide financial support to those without income, regardless of their past earnings.

title: Adoptera en motorväg och bidra till upprustning av vägsystemet i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2086 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to expedite the construction of double tracks along the Nya Ostkustbanan and the Norrbotniabanan to improve railway infrastructure in northern Sweden. It emphasizes the need for increased railway investments to facilitate sustainable travel, support growing industries, and ensure better logistics for goods transportation. The proposal also highlights the importance of aligning railway investments with EU priorities and enhancing the competitiveness of Swedish railways.

title: Höjd hastighetsgräns för personbil med släp
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2085 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a government investigation to ensure equal access to high-quality Barnahus (children's houses) for all children in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for a coordinated approach to support children who have experienced violence, as current access and quality of services vary significantly across the country. The motion highlights the inadequacies of existing Barnahus and calls for national guidelines, coordination, and legislation to protect and assist vulnerable children effectively and consistently throughout the nation.

title: Utbyggnad av E16 på sträckan Gävle–Oslo
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2084 av Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national register for sperm donors in Sweden in response to concerns about the large number of genetic half-siblings arising from donations, especially highlighted by cases in other countries. The absence of a central registry has resulted in situations where donors have inadvertently fathered numerous children across different clinics, leading to potential emotional challenges for those affected. The proposal underscores the importance of ensuring children's right to information about their origins, as mandated by the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

title: No-show-avgifter
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2083 av Jesper Skalberg Karlsson och Johan Hultberg (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national leisure certificate for children and young people with disabilities to standardize access to leisure facilities across Sweden. This certificate would clarify the child's needs, facilitate entry procedures at amusement parks and other venues, and allow for accompanying individuals to enter without charge, enhancing accessibility. The initiative aims to reduce administrative burdens for families, harmonize regulations across different municipalities, and improve inclusion in recreational activities while connecting the certificate to public transport facilities.

title: Vassare verktyg för att stävja osund konkurrens från offentliga aktörer
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2082 av Johan Hultberg och Jesper Skalberg Karlsson (båda M)
summary: The suggestion advocates for the Swedish Transport Administration to assess the need for upgrading the E20 road segment between Malmö and Ängelholm, in light of increasing transport demands expected from improved connections with Denmark and Germany. The proposal emphasizes the importance of enhancing infrastructure to prevent Skåne from becoming a bottleneck for freight transport, which could hinder both local and national economic development.

title: Åtgärder för en bättre infrastruktur mellan Göteborg och Oslo
Subvention av höga kommunalskatter
summary: The motion proposes that the government investigate new methods for financing future infrastructure, addressing the significant backlog of maintenance in current infrastructure. It highlights the inadequacies of the existing budget model, which prioritizes short-term resources over long-term investments, and suggests a return to an earlier budget model used before 1980. Additionally, there is a call for exploring local financing options, such as tolls, to expedite projects at the municipal and regional levels. The motion also encourages the involvement of private enterprises in infrastructure investments, advocating for a regulatory framework that facilitates cooperation between municipalities, regions, and the state.

title: Pånyttfödelse för det nordiska samarbetet
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden's electoral legislation be updated to recognize digital signatures as equivalent to traditional written signatures. This change aims to streamline the process for political parties and candidates, reducing bureaucratic hurdles associated with the numerous forms and declarations required for participation in general and European Parliament elections. The motion emphasizes the need for modernization in the electoral process ahead of the 2026 elections.

title: Stopp för mobilmålvakter
summary: The motion proposes a review of the aviation law in Sweden to enable the procurement of qualitative and cost-effective air traffic control services. It addresses the challenges faced by airports, particularly in rural areas, due to financial strains, emphasizing the need for a competitive framework similar to that seen in other European airports. The aim is to ensure that all airports, including state-owned ones, can choose the best solutions for their needs through competitive procurement.

title: En tillgänglig sjukvård i världsklass
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2077 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of infrastructure in West Sweden from a security policy perspective, emphasizing the need for military preparedness in case of sustained conflict, particularly focusing on the Russian threat. It calls for the restoration of the I 17 regiment to enhance military logistics and urges improvements to transportation links, including railways to ports and strategic highways, to facilitate resource movement during a conflict. The motion also suggests collaboration with private logistics operators to strengthen the state's response capabilities in emergencies.

title: Life science
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2076 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The suggestion advocates for the construction of bridges along the Bohus coast, addressing infrastructure issues faced by the municipalities of Lysekil and Orust due to overutilized access roads. It proposes the use of toll financing, similar to models used in Norway, to help fund a floating bridge in Lysekil and a new bridge between Orust and Stenungsund. The motion also calls for the government to facilitate the use of toll financing in collaboration with local municipalities for larger infrastructure projects.

title: Socialtjänsten
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2075 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates Trafikverket to investigate the Europaspåret, a proposed integrated infrastructure solution aimed at improving connectivity between Sweden and Denmark. The motion highlights the challenges faced in the Öresund region regarding traffic flow and capacity in both regional and international railway transport. It argues that a thorough investigation of alternative connections, including the Europaspåret, is essential for enhancing mobility, economic growth, and sustainability in the region, while potentially benefiting from EU funding to alleviate financial burdens.

title: Sällsynta sjukdomar och särläkemedel
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2074 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes the expansion of the road network in the Fyrbodal region to improve transportation infrastructure, which is deemed essential for the region's economic development, including sectors such as forestry, agriculture, industry, trade, and tourism. The current roads, particularly the 45 and E6 highways, are insufficient to connect various localities effectively. The motion urges the government to reassess the national infrastructure plan to ensure Fyrbodal's growth is supported adequately.

title: Mäns våld mot kvinnor och våld i nära relationer
summary: The proposal advocates for the expansion of railway infrastructure in the Fyrbodal region, which lies at the border between Norway, Värmland, and the Gothenburg region. It highlights the area's potential for various sectors such as forestry, agriculture, industry, trade, and tourism, which require an efficient transport system. The motion calls for improvements to the railway line from Gothenburg to Oslo and the development of double tracks to enhance connectivity, thereby enabling Fyrbodal to better leverage its strategic location between major labor markets.

title: Folkhälsan i fokus
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2072 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a digital service for displaying driving licenses in Sweden, aligning with EU initiatives and practices in neighboring countries. The author, Magnus Jacobsson, highlights Sweden's digital infrastructure strengths while pointing out the absence of a digital driving license, a service already available in other European nations. The motion calls on the government to task the Transport Agency with the introduction of this digital solution, which could also have broader applications.

title: Inkludering av döva, blinda och dövblinda
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2071 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should investigate how to prioritize and manage the country's ports more effectively, given that many municipal and privately owned ports may not be optimal for a small nation like Sweden. The argument highlights the importance of Göteborgs hamn for both national and regional trade, suggesting that concentrating resources on a few strategically selected ports can reduce costs and increase efficiency for imports and exports. The motion also emphasizes the need for proper infrastructure supporting these ports, especially in light of changing geopolitical circumstances such as the war in Ukraine.

title: En stark tandvård med välmående personal
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2070 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that Sweden should organize a recurring conference focused on trade and reconciliation in the Balkans, emphasizing the importance of trade in normalizing relations between countries such as Kosovo and Serbia, while addressing ongoing issues like corruption and the influence of external powers. The initiative aims to facilitate cooperation within the EU and enhance economic opportunities in the region, with the long-term goal of benefiting both Swedish and Balkan economies.

title: En stärkt psykisk hälsa i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2069 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should eventually relocate its embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, asserting that current diplomatic arrangements signal a closer relationship with the Palestinian Authority than with Israel. The motion argues that establishing an embassy in Jerusalem would affirm Sweden's commitment to a balanced peace process and strengthen regional cooperation, echoing historical examples of Nordic collaboration in Berlin.

title: Skogspolitik med helhetssyn
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2068 av Mattias Eriksson Falk m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to take action against blasphemy laws and the death penalty for converts through cooperation with the EU and the UN. It emphasizes the need to uphold human rights, particularly the right to freedom of thought, conscience, and religion, and calls for measures such as condemnations and trade reviews to pressure countries violating these rights.

title: ANDTS och missbruks- och beroendevård
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2067 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: This motion proposes to extend the moratorium on the review process for small-scale hydropower projects for an additional year. It argues that the initial government pause on reviews, due to increasing bureaucratic demands and complexities, has not been respected by certain authorities, leading to complications for plant owners. The motion emphasizes the need for the government to amend regulations and ensure compliance from all relevant agencies to support the viability of these hydropower initiatives.

title: Astma- och allergivården i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2066 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion advocates for shortening the processing times for estate inventories, noting that current waiting periods have increased to approximately 14 weeks, up from 8-10 weeks before the COVID-19 pandemic. The prolonged processing times hinder the ability of estates to sell properties, contributing to housing shortages and increasing costs for estate heirs. The motion calls for actions to expedite the approval process by the Tax Agency or permit sales of properties prior to such approval in uncomplicated cases.

title: En effektiv apoteks- och läkemedelskedja
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2065 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the municipalities of Uddevalla and Strömstad be allowed to pilot the procurement of healthcare centers, aiming to enhance cooperation between healthcare and elderly care. The underlying issue is the current fragmentation between municipal and regional responsibilities in healthcare, which has led to local dissatisfaction and calls for better coordination. The pilot would take place over a five-year period to evaluate potential improvements in service delivery for the elderly.

title: En jämlik diabetesvård i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2064 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The proposal calls for increased long-term support for Ukraine from Sweden and the EU, including military assistance and the preparation of a Marshall Plan for post-war reconstruction. It emphasizes the need for sustained aid, both military and humanitarian, to help Ukraine defend its integrity and plan for future rebuilding efforts following the conflict with Russia.

title: En kvalitativ cancervård i framkant
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2063 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should act within the EU to investigate Elon Musk's involvement in the Ukraine war, in light of allegations that he has hindered Ukraine's ability to defend itself by limiting Starlink access and has made statements comparing Ukrainian actions against Russian forces to attacks against Russia. It calls for clarification on whether Musk could be placed on the EU sanctions list for oligarchs supporting Russia's aggression.

title: En stark och kvalitativ Sis-vård i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2062 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion submitted by Magnus Jacobsson emphasizes the urgent need to address mental health issues among indebted individuals and the link to suicide rates. It calls upon the government to enhance suicide prevention efforts and to review the posthumous support systems for bereaved families, which are currently deemed inadequate. The motion highlights the increased risk of suicide among those with significant debt and urges reforms on regulations regarding high-interest loans.

title: Folkbildningen är grundläggande för demokratin
summary: The proposal suggests changing the legal classification of violence against police and security dogs to align it with violence against public officials in terms of sentencing. This would allow for harsher penalties when such incidents occur, raising the status of these working animals that play critical roles in law enforcement.

title: Offentlig upphandling och krav på kollektivavtal
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of promoting 'hunting with loose dogs' as a unique aspect of Nordic culture, advocating for its inclusion on UNESCO's World Heritage List to preserve this cultural heritage, which has been practiced since prehistoric times and is currently threatened by opposition from various organizations.

title: Ökade satsningar på cykelinfrastruktur
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament revert to previously established hunting times for foxes, which were shortened without justification in the last term. The author argues that this change negatively impacts Swedish cultural heritage, hunting with driving dogs, and wildlife management, as foxes are significant predators.

title: Besöksnäringen ökar attraktiviteten och får hela landet att leva
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should review the licensing regulations for handguns used in hunting and tracking, as it is currently very difficult to obtain such a license except for target shooting purposes. The proposal emphasizes the need for a more accessible licensing process for registered tracking hunters and established dog handlers, particularly in situations where swift and effective action is required, such as in the case of wild boar.

title: Bekämpande av skatteflykt och skatteundandragande
summary: The motion proposes to prohibit general spring hunting of roe deer (råbock) in Sweden, arguing that the previous decision to allow it has led to increased hunting pressure, particularly in southern Sweden, where the population management of roe deer is already challenging due to commercial hunting and high demand from foreign hunters. The motion stresses the necessity for regional decision-making concerning hunting regulations due to varying conditions across the country.

title: Inhemsk biodrivmedelsproduktion
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2056 av Isak From och Monica Haider (båda S)
summary: The proposal from the Center Party calls for the Swedish Parliament to support the development of a national action plan aimed at enhancing quality and patient safety in elderly care, following critical findings from the National Audit Office regarding the state's prevention of care injuries. It urges the government to ensure adequate resources for the Health and Social Care Inspectorate (Ivo) and to improve the involvement of individuals and their relatives in investigations of care-related incidents.

title: Samma hastighet för A-traktorer som för mopedbilar
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2055 av Isak From och Joakim Järrebring (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should examine whether landlords should have the right to require tenants to have home insurance and explore the possibility of making home insurance mandatory in certain cases. The argument is based on the rationale that just as traffic insurance is mandatory to protect vehicle owners, home insurance could minimize the financial impact on individuals in the event of accidents or natural disasters, particularly benefiting economically vulnerable tenants who currently lack coverage.

title: En genomgripande översyn av den svenska apoteksmarknaden
summary: The motion proposes several measures to improve access to housing in Sweden, including the establishment of a national register for rental apartments, public statistics on rental prices, and a central public registry for condominiums. It also suggests reviewing current rental regulations to stimulate new construction and enhance the availability of rental properties. Key recommendations include allowing condominium owners more autonomy in renting out their properties, adjusting the role of rental boards in disputes, and extending presumptive rents to facilitate better planning in the housing market.

title: Industrins brådskande behov av åtgärder på Malmbanan
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2053 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli och Ida Karkiainen (båda S)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament encourages the government to consider an internal recruitment system for school principals at state, regional, or municipal levels, emphasizing the importance of having principals with a teaching background. The motion argues that current recruitment practices may not adequately align with the needs of the educational environment, leading to trust issues and inefficiencies. The proposal aims to enhance cohesion within schools by ensuring that school leaders have a broad understanding of the challenges faced by teachers and better relationships with staff.

title: Individualiserad föräldraförsäkring
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider introducing merit points for individuals who have completed military service in order to recognize and enhance the value of military training in civilian life. The motion argues that military service offers significant personal development and social bonding, contributing positively to society. It advocates for translating parts of military training into relevant civilian qualifications to better prepare individuals for the job market and mitigate risks of social exclusion.

title: Rätten till god tandhälsa
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2051 av Jim Svensk Larm m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider making nutrition and dietary science a mandatory part of the education for all medical students due to the current insufficient training in this area, which is significantly lower than in other European countries. It emphasizes the importance of nutrition in general health and recovery, highlights the lack of adequate nutrition education in Swedish medical programs, and points to the demand from medical students for more training in this subject to better assist patients with lifestyle-related chronic diseases.

title: Avskaffande av marknadsskolan
summary: This parliamentary proposal, presented by Markus Wiechel from the Sweden Democrats (SD), suggests several changes to student financial support regulations. It recommends that the government consider adjusting study grants based on the cost of living in different study locations, eliminate the income limit (fribelopp) for students receiving study support, review the eligibility of certain courses for study support, and abolish the right to receive student financial aid for religious studies abroad.

title: Bostadsbyggande i lands- och glesbygd
summary: The proposal advocates for the public disclosure of the Stasi archives to facilitate free and independent research, emphasizing the importance of confronting Sweden's historical connections to East German espionage during the Cold War. It highlights the risks of keeping these archives secret, including the potential for false accusations against individuals and the need for victims and former agents to address their pasts. The suggestion seeks to enable a better understanding of historical events and their implications for contemporary society.

title: De svenska och finska järnvägsnäten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should evaluate the separation of local and regional elections from national parliamentary elections. The motivation highlights that the current combined election system leads to a lack of attention to local issues and politicians, with voters often making their choices based on national policies. By establishing different election days for local and national elections, it aims to ensure better accountability for local leaders and raise awareness of local matters, particularly in larger urban areas.

title: Ett rättvist karensavdrag
summary: The motion proposes establishing knowledge and safety requirements for operating certain recreational boats in Sweden, including the introduction of a driving license based on speed and size, an age limit for operators, and mandatory equipment for specific types of boats. The aim is to promote safe boating practices and address the risks associated with increased speeds and larger vessels, while maintaining the accessibility of boating to the public.

title: Skyddad yrkestitel för barnskötare
summary: This motion proposes that Swedish authorities should adopt the Ukrainian spelling 'Kyiv' for Ukraine's capital instead of the Russian 'Kiev', as a symbolic gesture of support for Ukraine amidst ongoing conflict with Russia. The motion emphasizes the importance of adapting official references to reflect the current geopolitical situation and align with the preferences expressed by Ukrainians.

title: Skyndsamt införande av tidsgräns för bodelning
summary: The proposal from Angelica Lundberg (SD) calls for the Swedish Parliament to investigate the possibility of creating legislation that mandates rear-facing car travel for small children and prohibits the use and sale of expired car seats. The motivation emphasizes Sweden's leadership in traffic safety and highlights the significant risk of serious injury for children riding forward-facing in the event of a crash. The proposal aims to enhance child safety in vehicles by ensuring parents make informed choices and by encouraging manufacturers to develop suitable rear-facing seats for larger children.

title: Avdragsrätt för fackföreningsavgift
summary: This motion emphasizes the need to reduce the consumption of unhealthy foods in Sweden, as rising rates of diabetes, mental health issues, obesity, and cardiovascular diseases pose significant public health challenges. Highlighting concerning statistics about children's dietary habits and the negative impacts of high sugar consumption, the motion calls on the government to explore preventive measures to promote healthier food options and improve accessibility to nutritious foods, ultimately aiming to better the overall public health landscape.

title: Krafttag mot arbetslivskriminaliteten
summary: The motion proposes the planning of a new railway connection between Jönköping and Göteborg to enhance competitiveness in the global economy and improve transportation options for goods and passengers. The lack of a direct railway along route 40 currently necessitates inconvenient detours, which hinders commuting and travel efficiency. Establishing this railway line is expected to facilitate easier commuting, support the industry in Jönköping, and reduce travel time between the two cities, thus prioritizing it in future infrastructure development plans.

title: Globalt pris på koldioxid
summary: This motion proposes the introduction of a ban on the use of studless friction tires during the summer months and urges the government to investigate the possibility of implementing an age limit for tires. The motion emphasizes concerns regarding traffic safety, citing studies that indicate friction tires significantly increase stopping distances and the risk of hydroplaning on summer roads, thereby posing a danger to drivers and pedestrians. Additionally, it points to the absence of regulations regarding the age of tires, asserting that older tires could compromise vehicle safety despite having adequate tread depth.

title: Arbetsskor till omsorgs- och förskolepersonal
summary: The motion proposes the construction of a new nuclear power plant in Barsebäck to meet the electricity needs of Skåne for the next 50 years, addressing the region's ongoing energy supply problems due to a lack of local base energy and inadequacies in the power grid. The authors highlight past electricity shortages, the reliance on fossil-fuel plants as a temporary solution, and emphasize that modern nuclear energy is safe, clean, and cost-effective. They argue that the previous decision to decommission Barsebäck was detrimental to the region's energy consumption and propose that a new facility is vital for future energy security in southern Sweden.

title: Restaurangbesökares möjlighet att göra medvetna och djuretiska val
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate freezing the tax on snus and eliminating the current tax indexation. It argues that snus presents fewer health risks compared to cigarettes and that current taxation creates a significant financial burden on snus users, who subsidize non-users through higher tax contributions. The proposal advocates for reducing the tax on snus to encourage its usage as a healthier alternative to smoking.

title: Förstärkning av bostadsbidraget för alla barns rätt till ett tryggt hem
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish parliament should support the development of a generational transition plan for eel fishing, advocate for measures at the EU level to help the recovery of European eel stocks, facilitate the passing of eels past hydroelectric dams, and investigate ways to enhance the funding of the Ålfonde for the long-term sustainability of eel fishing practices. The motion emphasizes the cultural heritage of eel fishing and the importance of maintaining local jobs while also addressing the critical situation of declining eel populations.

title: Jämlik tillgång till kulturskola
summary: The motion proposes an examination of the operations and future of the Allmänna arvsfonden (General Inheritance Fund) and how the funds should be allocated. It raises concerns about the direction the fund has taken in recent years, suggesting that while certain organizations receive funding justifiably, others, particularly those associated with cultural or ethnic foundations and some leftist movements, may not align with the fund's democratic principles. Therefore, it calls for clear resolutions from the parliament to improve governance of the fund and its distribution.

title: Ett rättvist karensavdrag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the implementation of better compensation options for hunting-related injuries. It highlights issues arising from hunters not having liability insurance, which can lead to inadequate compensation for affected individuals, particularly in cases involving foreign hunters. The suggestion includes the consideration of mandatory liability insurance for those participating in hunting in Sweden.

title: Sanningskommission för romer
summary: Kjell-Arne Ottosson proposes the establishment of a national island policy in Sweden to address the unique challenges faced by island regions, particularly Gotland. The proposal highlights the need for regional adaptations and support, noting the lack of a coordinated national strategy for island development compared to other European countries. It calls for government recognition of these issues, emphasizing the importance of national responsibility for infrastructure, healthcare, and overall welfare in island regions.

title: Skatteöversyn för ekonomisk rättvisa mellan boendeformer
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of an opt-out procedure for collective lawsuits in Sweden, emphasizing that such a system would enhance consumer protection and align with practices in neighboring countries like Norway and Denmark. The motion urges the government to further consider this approach, highlighting its potential benefits in terms of legal efficiency and increased group participation.

title: Ett modernt, rättvist och jämställt socialförsäkringsskydd för gravida
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2034 av Sanna Backeskog och Anna Wallentheim (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should cease all aid to countries that refuse to condemn Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The argument presented highlights that while many democratic nations have imposed sanctions on Russia, some nations still accept aid from Sweden while failing to support these sanctions, thereby undermining efforts against the Russian regime. The motion characterizes this situation as unjust and calls for an end to financial support to those nations.

title: Förbehållsbelopp för utsatta äldre
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2033 av Jim Svensk Larm m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes to amend the Swedish Constitution to formally declare Sweden as a Christian nation, citing the historical and cultural significance of Christianity in shaping the country. It argues that despite secularization, Christian traditions and holidays remain central to Swedish culture, thus warranting acknowledgment in the legal framework.

title: Pälsdjursuppfödning och vikten av ett starkt djurskydd
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament initiate an investigation into updating legislation regarding cash as a payment method, addressing the limitations of current laws due to numerous exceptions. It emphasizes the need for residents to be able to use cash for essential purchases during emergencies, while also advocating for a differentiation between vital services and less critical ones when determining the application of cash requirements.

title: Stöd till samhällsomställningen
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2031 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that police uniforms in Sweden should be strictly neutral, prohibiting the wearing of any religious symbols, particularly head coverings, to maintain uniformity and clear representation of state authority. It argues that religious symbols undermine the secular nature of the police force and could lead to distrust in law enforcement from individuals seeking protection, especially from those affected by cultural or religious oppression.

title: Behovet av förändrade avskrivningsregler, lex Malmfälten
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2030 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of introducing bounties on wild boars to help reduce their population, which has significantly increased from around 500 in the early 1990s to an estimated 150,000 to 300,000 today. The rising numbers of wild boars have led to economic losses for farmers due to crop damage, increased traffic accidents, and the risk of disease outbreaks affecting domestic pigs. The suggested bounty system aims to incentivize hunters to kill more wild boars, thus alleviating these issues and potentially providing economic benefits in the long run.

title: Samhällsmaster och uppkoppling som statlig angelägenhet
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2029 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli och Linus Sköld (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should prioritize its foreign aid to promote production in democratic developing countries and enhance trade between these nations and Sweden/EU. It argues that as China's economic power grows, it threatens global democracy and human rights, and thus Swedish aid should support the establishment of manufacturing industries in these developing countries to reduce reliance on China and counter its influence.

title: Samarbete och säkerhet i Norrbotten
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2028 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a motorway connection between E6 and Ullared to accommodate the high traffic volume to the popular shopping destination, thereby increasing travel speed and improving the living environment for local residents by reducing heavy vehicle traffic on the existing roads.

title: Bättre övergång från arbetslöshetsersättning till aktivitetsstöd
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2027 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of imposing stricter requirements on adults to verify the legal age of their sexual partners, in response to cases where adults have evaded responsibility for engaging in sexual relations with minors under the age of 15 by claiming ignorance of the minor's age.

title: Stärkta förutsättningar för nyindustrialisering
summary: The government proposes amendments to the Aliens Act to tighten the conditions for family reunification and limit the possibilities for granting residence permits on humanitarian grounds. Key changes include raising the age limit for denying permits based on family ties, restricting exceptions to the income requirement for family reunification involving individuals with alternative protection status, and removing provisions for residence permits due to particularly distressing circumstances, allowing such permits for children only under specific severe conditions. These changes aim to reduce the influx of asylum seekers and address challenges related to integration in Sweden.

title: Nybyggnation av skyddsrum
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2025 av Peder Björk och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The government proposes amendments to the Insurance Business Act (2010:2043) to update certain euro amounts in accordance with revisions made by the European Commission. These changes affect the specifications related to exemptions from the law's application, the definition of large risks, and the required guarantee amounts. The amendments, designed to align Swedish law with updated EU regulations, are set to take effect on January 1, 2024.

title: Barngruppernas storlek i förskolan
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2024 av Jim Svensk Larm och Sanna Backeskog (båda S)
summary: The Swedish government proposes an amendment to the law regarding public pension funds (AP-funds) to ensure that the Seventh AP Fund complies with the EU regulations on sustainability disclosures. This change aims to enhance transparency regarding sustainability efforts in the fund's management by aligning its information requirements with the more detailed EU directives, effective from January 1, 2024.

title: Infrastruktur för människor och industri i norra Sverige
summary: The Swedish government has proposed a new law aimed at modernizing and enhancing the resilience of the clearing and settlement system for payments. The current legislation is considered outdated and not in line with digital advancements or international standards. The proposal includes extending the definition of clearing operations, implementing requirements for risk management, preparedness, cybersecurity, and governance, and establishing criteria for outsourcing clearing activities. The new regulations are expected to come into effect on July 1, 2024.

title: Förbud mot vinster i välfärden
summary: The proposal suggests replacing the existing choice system for electronic identification services with an authorization system that will also include digital mail services. It aims to create a framework where individuals can select service providers for electronic identification, ensuring equal opportunities for all public entities to utilize these digital services. This new regulation is set to come into effect on January 1, 2024.

title: Fler bostäder i den gröna industriella omställningens spår
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2021 av Isak From och Malin Larsson (båda S)
summary: This proposal advocates for the expansion of energy production at the Forsmark nuclear power plant by constructing a fourth reactor. The motion suggests that increased energy output is crucial for maintaining low electricity prices, which are essential for economic growth and the competitiveness of Swedish industries. The authors highlight current challenges posed by high electricity prices and argue that expanding nuclear capacity will support both fossil-free electricity generation and future energy needs.

title: Kompetensförsörjning i den gröna industriella omvandlingen
summary: The motion advocates for the earlier start date of the fall hunting season for bucks, suggesting that beginning the hunt on August 10 would allow for sustainable hunting practices without harming the deer population. It aims to acknowledge the concerns of hunters regarding the balance of wildlife preservation and hunting opportunities.

title: Stärkandet av rehabiliteringsansvaret för företagaren
summary: Magnus Jacobsson (KD) proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate why authorities and institutions do not account for carbon sequestration by agriculture when assessing its climate impact, arguing that current models exaggerate the sector's negative climate effects. He highlights that agriculture and forestry sequester significant amounts of carbon, which are not considered in existing calculations that focus solely on emissions. Jacobsson emphasizes the importance of accurate data for informed policy decisions and suggests that miscalculations may lead to ineffective climate measures that undermine food production.

title: Stärkt anhörigstöd för föräldrar till funktionsnedsatta barn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the government's divestment of its ownership in AB Svensk Bilprovning, arguing that the state no longer has a strategic role in this competitive market. The motion points out that private inspection companies are effectively ensuring accessibility in rural areas, while the state-owned company has withdrawn and lacks a societal responsibility. Therefore, it suggests that the state's role should be limited to regulation and oversight rather than direct involvement in the market.

title: Bättre stöd inom primärvården till barn och unga med psykisk ohälsa
summary: The motion emphasizes the significance of preserving fäbodbruket (mountain pasture farming) in Sweden and advocates for the need for protective hunting against predators, particularly wolves, threatening these cultural and biodiversity-rich sites. It highlights the increasing conflicts between fäbodbrukare (pastoralists) and growing predator populations, detailing instances of attacks on livestock and the challenges of ensuring animal safety. The proposal calls for quicker and more extensive permissions for protective hunting to support the sustainability of both the cultural heritage and biological diversity associated with fäbodar.

title: Krafttag mot social dumpning
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2016 av Sanna Backeskog och Kristoffer Lindberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to enhance its marketing efforts to promote Sweden as a travel destination for both domestic and international visitors. It highlights the importance of the tourism sector as a significant contributor to economic growth, job creation, and social integration, especially for young people and immigrants. The motion calls for strategic initiatives to maximize the potential of the tourism industry and improve Sweden's international image.

title: Säkrad rätt till ledsagarinsatser
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish parliament to urgently initiate measures aimed at reducing the wolf population, particularly in Dalarna, due to concerns over safety in rural areas, impacts on hunting traditions, and threats to pets and livestock. The motion highlights that the current wolf numbers, estimated at around 450, exceed the parliamentary mandate of maintaining a population between 170 and 230 individuals, and calls for immediate government action to address this issue.

title: Skärpning av lagstiftningen mot näthat
summary: The suggestion calls for the Swedish parliament to support the need for a comprehensive long-term plan for mosquito control in the area around the lower Dalälven and similar regions affected by high mosquito populations. The proposal highlights the recurring nature of mosquito issues exacerbated by increased rainfall and flooding, impacting local communities, businesses, and quality of life. It emphasizes the necessity for sufficient resources and revised regulations regarding pesticide use to effectively manage mosquito outbreaks and ensure residents can enjoy their environment without constant mosquito disruptions.

title: Nationell handlingsplan för att nå en djurfri forskning
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish government should investigate how it can take greater financial responsibility for costs associated with protection hunting, particularly in the context of livestock farmers facing losses due to predatory animal attacks. The proposal highlights the inequity of farmers bearing the costs of protection hunting and advocates for state support to ensure that both wildlife and agricultural interests are balanced effectively.

title: Förbud mot avlivning av tuppkycklingar till förmån för tidig könsbestämning i äggen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should enhance its presence in Dalarna by increasing the number of state jobs in the region. The argument emphasizes the importance of local government representation for service accessibility, employment opportunities, and community development, particularly in rural areas that have faced a decline in state employment compared to national averages. The motion advocates for a strategic push to maintain and develop state roles in rural areas to ensure equitable access to government services and to validate the significance of rural communities.

title: Förbud mot burhållning av hönor i Sverige
summary: The proposal suggests allowing individuals in Sweden to own more than four firearms without needing special permission, arguing that current regulations create unnecessary bureaucracy and unfair assessments. The motion references Sweden's strong tradition of hunting and sport shooting, contending that licensed individuals have already proven their competency through training and testing, and that existing restrictions are overly limiting. By easing these regulations, it is believed that hunting practices would improve, benefiting rural communities and wildlife management.

title: Företagshälsovård för alla arbetstagare
summary: The proposal suggests banning all types of mopeds from using bicycle lanes within detailed urban planning areas in Sweden. The motion argues that the presence of mopeds, particularly moped class 2, compromises the safety of cyclists, who face increased risks of theft and intimidation. By enforcing this ban, the motion aims to enhance the security for cyclists and create a clearer distinction regarding permissible users of bicycle lanes.

title: Standardiserade riktvärden för luktföroreningar i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of lowering the capital gains tax on the sale of private residences in Sweden. It highlights that many individuals, particularly the elderly, are reluctant to move to smaller homes due to the current capital gains tax rate of 22%, which diminishes the proceeds available for financing the next home. The suggestion advocates for a reduced tax rate of 11% for individuals who have owned their property for at least five years to encourage movement within the housing market and alleviate housing shortages.

title: Universitet i Dalarna
summary: The motion proposes that drivers aged 70 and older should undergo testing to assess their abilities related to vision, hearing, perception, and reaction for the retention of their driving licenses, with tests conducted every five years. The rationale is to reduce traffic accidents, which can be influenced by age-related declines in these abilities, while noting that many elderly individuals remain alert and capable.

title: Reglering av pr-byråer och lobbyister
summary: The motion proposes the investigation of the feasibility of constructing a new road specifically for heavy truck traffic between Malmö and Helsingborg to alleviate traffic congestion and reduce accidents on the existing E6 highway. The motion suggests that a dedicated road would improve traffic flow by separating different types of vehicles and would minimize disruption during the construction period compared to expanding the current highway.

title: Strömsholms kanal
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:2006 av Olle Thorell och Sofie Eriksson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes requiring a driving license for operating various motorized vehicles, including electric bicycles, scooters, skateboards, and others, similar to the existing requirements for class 2 mopeds. It suggests implementing a minimum age of 15 for drivers and emphasizes the need for training to prevent accidents associated with these vehicles, which often reach speeds exceeding 20 km/h and have been involved in serious incidents.

title: Utveckling av naturvårdsområdet Malingsbo-Kloten
summary: The suggestion proposes that Sweden and Denmark jointly investigate the feasibility of the Öresund Metro, a subway connection between central Malmö and central Copenhagen, to address the growing demand for improved public transport in the Öresund region. This region is crucial for economic growth, housing a significant portion of both countries' GDP and requiring enhanced connections due to population growth and future transport developments. The Öresund Metro aims to facilitate a more integrated labor market, alleviate traffic congestion on the Øresund Bridge, and support educational and research collaborations.

title: Älvdalska
summary: The proposal aims to ban the manufacturing and sale of cigarettes in Sweden due to the significant health risks associated with smoking, which causes numerous diseases and leads to around 12,000 deaths annually in the country. The motion highlights the economic burden of smoking, costing society approximately 30 billion kronor each year, and advocates for a public health strategy that aligns with the World Health Organization's tobacco convention. It argues for the ethical responsibility of politicians to protect public health and urges an investigation into the feasibility of a total ban on cigarette production and sales.

title: Karensavdraget
summary: The suggestion proposes to ease the process of relocating vehicles that are parked or abandoned on someone else's property. It highlights the current difficulties faced by property owners in getting vehicles removed and argues for a legal change that would allow property owners greater rights to determine which vehicles are permitted on their land. The proposal also advocates for a system of fines for unauthorized parking and for property owners to have the ability to request prompt removal of vehicles by appropriate authorities.

title: Statligt underhålls- och investeringsstöd för kommunala fastigheter
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the conditions for implementing a regional property tax for electricity production and industrial properties in Sweden. This initiative aims to address the economic challenges faced by rural municipalities that often lack adequate tax revenue despite being home to significant industrial production. By allowing these regions to retain tax revenues generated from local industries, the motion seeks to enhance their financial stability and public services while promoting equitable distribution of tax benefits across municipalities that contribute to national production.

title: Filmarkivet i Grängesberg
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate how compensation models for private dentists can be adjusted to encourage establishment in areas of greatest need, addressing the significant disparity in dental care availability between urban and rural regions in Sweden. The motion highlights the shortage of dentists in certain areas, leading to long waiting times for patients, and argues that current compensation frameworks lack incentives for dentists to set up in underserved locations.

title: Statens infrastrukturinvesteringar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of introducing an age limitation for tires to prevent the use of excessively old tires, which may compromise road safety. It emphasizes the importance of tire condition for vehicle performance and safety, and calls for mechanisms to ensure compliance with this proposed regulation, including the imposition of fines for non-compliance.

title: En stark arbetslöshetsförsäkring
summary: The proposal aims to enhance accessibility and safety at Sweden's roadside rest areas, which are currently misused for various unauthorized activities, leading to discomfort and insecurity for drivers, particularly women. It suggests that the government direct Trafikverket to assess the situation and take necessary measures to ensure rest areas are available for their intended purposes, such as resting and using restrooms.

title: Rättvisare och enklare energiprocesser för fler gröna jobb i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1998 av Linnéa Wickman och Sanna Backeskog (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into the possibility of implementing a vehicle inspection guarantee in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for equitable access to vehicle inspection services across different regions, particularly as the deregulation of the inspection market has led to a concentration of stations in urban areas while diminishing availability in rural settings. The suggestion highlights the burdens placed on vehicle owners, municipalities, and businesses due to long travel distances required for inspections, and proposes a system where vehicle owners are assured inspection opportunities within a reasonable timeframe and locality.

title: En förenklad vardag för elbilsägare
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1997 av Linnéa Wickman och Sanna Backeskog (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the possibility of reducing the vehicle tax for diesel-powered passenger cars and light trucks compliant with Euro class 6d-Temp or newer. It also calls for examining the counterproductive effects of the current malus tax and its potential abolition. The motion argues that the existing bonus-malus system, intended to promote environmentally friendly vehicles, inadvertently penalizes rural drivers who rely on diesel vehicles while disproportionately benefiting urban drivers. The proposal advocates for adjustments to the vehicle tax system to facilitate a quicker transition to a climate-neutral vehicle fleet.

title: Förbud mot PFAS i Sverige, EU och världen
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations governing the ability to charge individuals for unused interpreter services, highlighting the rising costs of publicly funded interpretation services in Sweden. It argues that individuals over 18 years old should be held financially responsible for interpreter costs if they fail to attend appointments without valid reasons. The motion emphasizes the need to address the costs associated with interpreter services in order to encourage personal responsibility for language acquisition among immigrants and reduce governmental expenses.

title: Rimliga avgifter för betalningspåminnelser
summary: The proposal aims to improve the voting system in Sweden to ensure that visually impaired individuals can exercise their right to vote independently and with maintained secrecy. The current system requires visually impaired voters to rely on assistance for personal votes and lacks provisions for smaller parties' ballots in accessible formats. The motion emphasizes the need for technological advancements to facilitate equal voting opportunities, aligning with the principles of democracy and the Swedish constitution.

title: Förnybar energi till havs
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a regulatory framework governing the procedures and responsibilities when a municipality faces financial insolvency. It highlights the economic challenges many Swedish municipalities, particularly in rural areas, are encountering due to rising care costs and declining revenues. The proposal suggests that such a framework would clarify state obligations and the conditions under which a municipality could declare bankruptcy, which could enhance municipal creditworthiness and reduce borrowing costs, ultimately benefiting taxpayers.

title: Föreningsfriheten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should enhance accessibility for hearing-impaired individuals by ensuring that sign language interpretation is provided during all parliamentary debates, rather than just occasionally. The aim is to combat the exclusion of hearing-impaired citizens from political discourse, thereby promoting inclusivity in the democratic process.

title: Friluftsdagar i skolan
summary: The proposal suggests making visits to school health services mandatory for all students in lower and upper secondary education due to rising mental health issues among youth in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the significant disparity in access to these services across different schools and the importance of early intervention to support students dealing with mental health challenges.

title: Rättvisa elpriser i södra Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should seek a national and permanent exemption from the EU's Working Time Directive, which mandates an 11-hour rest period within any 24-hour period. It argues that many sectors, particularly the municipal sector in Sweden, currently operate outside of these regulations and that adhering to the directive would lead to staffing challenges and decreased job satisfaction for workers, particularly in rural areas. Supporters contend that existing work schedules do not pose risks to health or safety, and they advocate for the government to support negotiations for more exemptions.

title: Bättre vård efter förlossning
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the Environmental Code in Sweden, arguing that the current legislation hampers crucial industrial sectors and investment due to protracted and unpredictable permit processes. The motion emphasizes the urgent need for minerals and metals to achieve fossil-free goals and suggests that local protection interests hinder national progress. It advocates for modernizing the Environmental Code to better balance societal interests, expedite processes related to national security, and enhance infrastructure development, while still maintaining high environmental standards.

title: En lokalt förankrad arbetsmarknadspolitik
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the legislation governing the conditions for granting protection hunting permits for Canada geese and proposes measures to limit their population due to their non-native status in Sweden. It also suggests pursuing a national exemption from the EU's protection of the barnacle goose, arguing that its population has increased significantly and is no longer considered conservation-worthy in Sweden.

title: Utökat skydd vid uppsägning vid graviditetspenning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to investigate how to best prevent legionella infections from cooling tower installations and to consider whether these installations should be subject to registration or permit requirements. It highlights the health risks associated with legionella bacteria, the historical instances of outbreaks in Sweden, and the need for better regulation and monitoring of cooling towers to prevent potential health crises. Additionally, it argues that while cooling towers are energy-efficient, their operation necessitates stringent hygiene practices to minimize risks.

title: Personer som går från aktivitetsersättning till sjukersättning
summary: The proposal aims to introduce mandatory education on total defense in Swedish schools, including primary and secondary levels, to enhance public understanding of national security and defense obligations. It emphasizes the need for comprehensive training to prepare citizens for potential crises or conflicts, highlighting the historical context of Sweden's total defense system and advocating for a reinvigoration of knowledge in this area among the population.

title: Marktillgång ovan odlingsgränsen
summary: The suggestion advocates for the government to investigate a new and simplified tax calculation model for leisure vehicles classified as passenger car class II, which has faced excessive tax under the current 'bonus-malus' system. The proposal highlights the detrimental effects of the existing taxation model on the sales of these vehicles and calls for a more reasonable and less bureaucratic approach to their taxation, considering their recreational use and relatively low annual mileage.

title: Skolskjuts till och från fritis för barn inom anpassad skola
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes to investigate the necessity of formal education for pilots operating aircraft carrying skydivers, highlighting safety concerns that arose from several tragic accidents, including a 2019 crash in Umeå that resulted in the deaths of nine individuals. The motion emphasizes the lack of formal training requirements for such pilots and advocates for establishing a formal training regimen, potentially guided by the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), to enhance safety protocols without hindering skydiving clubs' operations.

title: Sveriges roll i arbetet för ett fritt Västsahara
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament develop a framework for donating the Swedish flag that flies on the roof of the Riksdag to the public, reflecting its historical significance as a symbol of unity and democracy. The motion highlights the importance of the flag in Swedish culture and proposes adopting practices seen in other countries, such as Canada, where citizens can request flags that have been flown by the parliament.

title: Obligatoriskt båtregister för fritidsbåtar
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a regulatory framework that allows members of the Swedish Parliament to donate Swedish flags to the public. This initiative aims to celebrate the flag's historical significance and its role as a symbol of national unity, democracy, and freedom, similar to practices in countries like Canada. The suggestion highlights the importance of the flag in various societal contexts and seeks to reinforce citizens' pride in their nation.

title: Införande av nytt investeringsstöd till byggnation av hyresbostäder och bostäder för studenter
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into a new model for managing state-owned buildings, suggesting that the state should take direct responsibility for the maintenance and operation of these properties instead of using a rental model. The current system is criticized for creating a circular flow of funds within the government, which could lead to inefficiencies and deteriorating quality of services. The motion argues that this new approach would allow for better accountability and more efficient use of resources.

title: Infrastruktur Dalarna
summary: The motion proposes the relocation of state authorities to various locations outside of Stockholm to enhance regional development and strengthen the presence of the state in other parts of Sweden. It emphasizes that such relocations can positively impact the job market for university-educated individuals living outside major cities and suggests that the government should regularly review and implement relocations where appropriate.

title: Älvdalsbanans och Västerdalsbanans utveckling
summary: The suggestion advocates for a comprehensive review of Sweden's VAT regulations with the aim of implementing a unified VAT system. The current differentiated VAT system is characterized as complex and burdensome for businesses, which ultimately affects consumers due to compliance costs. Examples are given to illustrate discrepancies in VAT rates across similar services, highlighting how these variations politically influence consumption. The proposal seeks to develop a unified VAT framework that would remain revenue-neutral for government finances.

title: Kommunala lantmäterier
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations regarding snow removal on private roads throughout Sweden to ensure that residents in rural areas can access necessary infrastructure year-round. It highlights the difficulties faced by rural residents, particularly in terms of the financial burden resulting from inadequate snow clearing services, which are often unavailable due to contractors prioritizing state roads. The motion aims to create a fairer system for funding snow removal for both private and public roads to support rural communities.

title: Bärkraftig besöksnäring i lands- och glesbygd
