The motion emphasizes the need for a more robust public discourse around the issue and suggests that actions taken should not only address direct support but also initiate long-term societal change regarding attitudes towards gender-based violence.

title: Campusförlagda utbildningsplatser på Mittuniversitetet i Sundsvall
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1339 av Peder Björk och Malin Larsson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for stricter regulations on transformation consultants involved in converting rental apartments to condominiums. It aims to strengthen consumer protection against unethical practices by these consultants, who have been reported to make misleading promises leading to significant financial risks for consumers. The proposal calls for legislative measures to enhance transparency in the conversion process and curb the influence of unscrupulous actors in the industry, ensuring that consumers are adequately protected when making such substantial financial commitments.

title: Stärkt kooperativt företagande
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1338 av Peder Björk och Malin Larsson (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity for the Swedish Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen) to be accessible in every municipality across the country. It highlights the challenges citizens face due to insufficient public service presence, especially in the context of increased unemployment and the need for local knowledge of the labor market. The proposal urges the government to ensure that Arbetsförmedlingen has at least one location in all municipalities and to enhance collaboration with regional and local businesses to effectively fulfill its mission.

title: Utredning för att förbättra Sveriges AI-kompetens
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports relocating Sweden's embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, arguing that this move would reflect Sweden's genuine neutrality in the Middle Eastern conflict. The authors criticize previous governments for being perceived as pro-Palestinian due to their diplomatic engagements and highlight the U.S. move to Jerusalem as a precedent.

title: Lagen om offentlig upphandling (LOU)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of allowing the sale and consumption of strong beer in selected sections during certain sports events, specifically in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). It argues that the current restrictions on alcohol sales contribute to excessive drinking during intermissions and could create a better overall experience for fans by permitting consumption at their seats, while also highlighting that violence at SHL events is significantly lower compared to other sports.

title: Ett statligt bank-id
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to establish an effective governance framework for climate transition, aiming to accelerate the current rate of carbon dioxide emissions reduction to 7-10% annually. The motion highlights the inadequacies of existing structures in managing the broad impacts of climate change on all sectors of society and advocates for a new model of governance that ensures local engagement and investment while coordinating efforts between municipalities, the state, and the EU.

title: Införandet av ett viseringsgarantisystem
summary: The motion proposes several measures to strengthen the Stockholm region's role as a growth engine while emphasizing climate action. Key suggestions include phasing out Bromma airport in favor of developing Arlanda as a center for fossil-free flights, improving infrastructure, increasing housing availability, and upgrading Södertörn University to a full university status. The proposals aim to bolster transportation, promote equality in job access, and attract international talent to support regional development.

title: Möjligheter att förbjuda bränning av religiösa skrifter utan att inskränka på yttrandefriheten
summary: The motion proposes a ban on the trade of children and women within the surrogacy industry, emphasizing the exploitation of women in impoverished countries and the associated risks to both women and children. It calls for the government to draft legislation prohibiting surrogate agencies that market their services in Sweden, aligning with Swedish law and the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

title: Undervisa om folkmordet seyfo 1915
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1332 av Denis Begic och Ingela Nylund Watz (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for a labor market with favorable conditions and a school system free from market influences, urging the parliament to support initiatives aimed at improving urban regions as growth engines, addressing housing shortages, regulating labor immigration, improving conditions for international talents, and promoting women's entrepreneurship. It highlights the detrimental effects of market-driven educational systems and the importance of equal access to education and housing to combat segregation and unemployment.

title: Skattereform för bättre fördelningspolitik
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures to simplify regulations for entrepreneurs in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of streamlining rules to foster a more supportive business environment, particularly for small and medium-sized enterprises. It calls for the operationalization of previous goals set for regulatory simplification, sectoral reviews of regulations, an evaluation of the implementation of EU rules, enhanced agency responsibilities, and improved consequence analysis processes, all aimed at promoting business growth and enhancing competitiveness.

title: Avdragsrätt för medlemskap i a-kassa och fackförening
Koranbränning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews the possibility of making public transportation free for high school students and other students during the summer months. It argues that rising costs and inflation make it increasingly difficult for young people and families to afford transportation, and that eliminating fees would promote equality. The proponents emphasize that free public transit is necessary for students to access summer jobs, recreational activities, and maintain social connections without financial strain.

title: Utrikes föddas upplevelse av sin arbetsmiljö
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a more gender-equal work environment and fair occupational safety standards, specifically highlighting the need for employers to provide necessary work shoes for healthcare and educational staff, predominantly women, who currently bear the financial burden. The motion points out the significant wage gap and poor working conditions faced by these workers, linking the provision of appropriate footwear to increased workplace safety, better hygiene, and potential economic benefits for society by reducing sick leave and injuries.

title: Al-nakba
summary: The motion advocates for strengthening the coordination and control functions of authorities to combat fraud and labor crime within publicly funded welfare services in Sweden. It highlights the prevalence of organized crime in the home care and personal assistance sectors, where fraudulent practices such as unrendered services and exploitation of workers are common. The proposal emphasizes the need for improved oversight to protect vulnerable individuals and maintain the integrity of the welfare system, asserting that taxpayer money should not benefit criminal enterprises.

title: En trygg och rättvis arbetsmarknad
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the development of a comprehensive national strategy for global cyber policy to enhance coordinated decision-making within the state. It stresses the need for international collaboration to address the increasing threats to internet freedom, security, and human rights, emphasizing that cybersecurity issues are inherently global challenges. The motion highlights the importance of maintaining an open and safe internet, advocating for Sweden to take a leading role in shaping global norms that protect human rights and democracy in cyberspace.

title: Sverige som ett mer innovativt och etablerat investeringsland
summary: The motion highlights the need for significant investments in the labor market to address skill shortages and unemployment in Västsverige, particularly within the manufacturing and agricultural sectors. It emphasizes the importance of enhancing vocational education and adapting it to meet market demands. The proposal includes measures for improved labor market education, resources for job placement services, and reforming unemployment benefits to ensure accessibility and support for job seekers, while advocating for effective labor immigration policies.

title: Säkerställa och färdigställa Hjulstabron
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1324 av Lena Johansson och Fredrik Olovsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal seeks to extend the funding for the Elder Care Lift, a government initiative that allows employees in elder care to gain further education and qualifications during paid work hours. This initiative includes covering the costs of employees' salaries while undergoing training to become care assistants or specialist care assistants, as well as offering Swedish language education to improve care quality and patient safety. The motion emphasizes the need for enhanced workforce education in light of increasing demands in elder care due to a growing elderly population and existing staffing shortages, as well as the introduction of a protected title for care assistants.

title: Nytt skatteavtal med Grekland
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for improved access to statistics within the social services sector, particularly regarding staffing levels in elderly care. It argues that reliable national-level data is crucial for accountability among politicians, oversight, quality improvement in care services, and effective workforce planning. The lack of comprehensive statistics has been highlighted by various investigations, including the Coronakommissionen and a proposed elderly care law. The motion advocates for legislative support to enable the collection of individual-level data to enhance transparency and responsibility in social welfare management.

title: Energieffektivisering av bostadsbeståndet för en rättvis klimatomställning
summary: The motion highlights the need for a stronger collaboration in the healthcare sector to address the backlog of care accumulated during the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the importance of equal access to healthcare and improving working conditions for healthcare staff, alongside enhancing competency supply in the sector. The document calls for coordinated efforts to reduce waiting times, increase primary healthcare capacity, and implement health-promoting initiatives targeting socioeconomically vulnerable groups, as well as ensuring sufficient medical supplies for future emergencies.

title: En rättvis arbetslöshetsförsäkring
summary: This parliamentary suggestion proposes to strengthen the protection against violations of trade union rights under the Co-Determination Act. It highlights concerns over the increasing reports of such violations, particularly in light of recent strike actions. The motion argues for a more balanced burden of proof in cases where union rights are claimed to be infringed, aiming to address the uneven power dynamics between employers and employees in labor disputes.

title: Plattformsekonomin
summary: The motion proposes a knowledge uplift regarding children's rights in Sweden, advocating for enhanced education for both children and professionals working with them about the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. It emphasizes the necessity of regular trainings for educators, public servants, and support for children's organizations to ensure children understand their rights and can advocate for them. The goal is to integrate this knowledge into schools and public institutions, recognizing the importance of familiarity with these rights to empower children.

title: Förtydligande gällande förordningen om körkortslån
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1319 av Peter Hedberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion suggests strengthening Sweden's economic policy in Västsverige by addressing recruitment issues, improving job matching, increasing employment among newly arrived immigrants, and enhancing support for various industries adversely affected by the pandemic. It emphasizes the importance of innovation financing, local conditions for adult education, and the role of municipalities in helping the unemployed while advocating for better labor conditions, including equitable wages. Additionally, it calls for better access to commercial services and governmental presence in rural areas, underlining the necessity for improved infrastructure and transport logistics for industrial growth.

title: Närhet till sjukvård
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1318 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a strong total defense system in Sweden, advocating for the development of military capabilities, increased collaboration with NATO and Nordic countries, and support for military personnel. It seeks to enhance Sweden's defense budget to 2% of GDP, increase the number of conscripts, and ensure a robust national defense infrastructure in light of deteriorating security conditions in Europe, particularly due to Russian aggression. Importantly, the proposal asserts that the military and civil defense must work cohesively to safeguard Sweden's territorial integrity.

title: Förbättrande av adoptionsprocesserna
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1317 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of national language requirements for healthcare and elderly care staff, emphasizing that all personnel must have a good command of Swedish. The aim is to ensure clear communication with patients and clients, which is essential for their safety and participation in care. It highlights existing issues with insufficient language skills among care providers and supports the need for standardized language proficiency to mitigate risks and improve service quality.

title: Skolfrukost
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1316 av Malin Larsson och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes abolishing the statute of limitations for sexual offenses, increasing compensation for victims of sexual crimes, and imposing stricter minimum sentences for rape. It highlights the alarming increase in sexual assaults among youth, with a high percentage of victims not seeing justice due to low conviction rates. The motion emphasizes the need for the legal system to support victims and ensure accountability for offenders to restore trust in societal institutions.

title: Skatteavtal med Portugal
summary: This motion proposes the introduction of behavior assessments, or 'ordningsomdömen', in Swedish schools as a supplementary feature to students' term grades. The intention is to assist students in their job applications by providing a reference indicating their ability to follow rules, respect others, and manage time. It aims to promote better student behavior, enhance classroom order, and improve overall safety and learning conditions within schools.

title: Oseriösa aktörer i offentlig upphandling
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1314 av Hanna Westerén och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the development of a national strategy and action plan aimed at enhancing the learning and well-being of exceptionally gifted students. It argues that while all students deserve the opportunity to reach their full potential, gifted students often lack proper stimulation and support in schools, which can lead to decreased motivation and mental health issues. It advocates for tailored approaches to meet the unique needs of this demographic, paralleling existing provisions for students requiring special support.

title: Utbildningsinsatser under och efter anstaltstiden
summary: The motion proposes transferring the oversight of preschools and pedagogical care from municipalities to Skolinspektionen to ensure uniform quality control across Sweden. It argues that current inspection disparities between municipal and independent preschools could result in inconsistent quality standards. The proposal also suggests that Skolinspektionen should take over the responsibility for granting permits for independent preschools to enhance the quality control process and detect potential issues, including those related to confessional influences.

title: Ekonomisk utvärdering av olika former av energiproduktion
summary: The motion proposed by Johanna Rantsi advocates for the introduction of detection tools to combat child pornography in public sector IT environments. It emphasizes the need for stronger measures against sexual crimes, particularly those involving children, and highlights the correlation between the consumption of child pornography and actual sexual offenses against minors. The motion suggests that existing measures, such as background checks, are insufficient and calls for the implementation of effective real-time detection tools to prevent potential abuses.

title: Stärkt förutsägbarhet och likvärdighet i den s.k. habiliteringsersättningen
summary: This motion proposes a review of current laws and regulations to empower school staff with clearer responsibilities and rights to intervene in disruptive behavior in classrooms. It suggests that the process for suspending students should be expedited to prevent them from disrupting the learning environment, and that the responsibilities of students for maintaining a safe and productive school environment should be more explicitly defined in legislation.

title: Stärkt tillträdesrätt för skyddsombud
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to consider establishing better long-term conditions for vocational higher education (yrkeshögskola) and to enhance opportunities for educational providers to offer preparatory courses for students' eligibility. The aim is to align vocational education with labor market needs, address labor shortages, and facilitate career changes by offering more pathways into vocational education, thereby improving employment outcomes.

title: Återinförande av kommunal förköpsrätt
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1309 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of increasing the sale of forest land owned by Sveaskog to promote economic growth and development in rural areas. The argument is that Sveaskog's ownership of a significant portion of Sweden's forest land restricts local landowners and businesses from expanding and developing their operations, thereby hindering rural development. The motion advocates for a shift towards privatization of forest ownership to enhance local management and profitability.

title: Flytt av trålgränsen
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1308 av Tomas Eneroth och Hanna Westerén (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes an evaluation of the societal benefits related to the goals for organic food within public procurement in Sweden. It argues for allowing the market and consumers to dictate the demand and supply of organic food, rather than political directives. The motion highlights the importance of supporting Swedish food production and the potential economic disadvantages of increasing organic food goals, which may lead to higher costs and more reliance on imported goods, ultimately questioning the net benefits to society.

title: Utökat skydd mot föreningsrättskränkning
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of vocational schools and preparatory programs for vocational education in Sweden to address the anticipated shortage of skilled professionals by 2035. It emphasizes the need for improved career guidance to promote vocational training as a viable option and suggests greater involvement of employers in shaping the curriculum to ensure its relevance to labor market needs. This initiative aims to enhance employment opportunities for students while meeting the growing demands of the job market.

title: Avgiftsfritt TBE-vaccin för barn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should urge the government to explore ways to increase timber production in Sweden. It argues that enhanced forest production can contribute to carbon dioxide binding and facilitate the production of wood as an environmentally friendly building material and biofuels, which are essential for climate transition. The motion highlights that current laws and regulations restrict forest owners from increasing production, which it views as a significant limitation on property rights.

title: Förändring av vallagen
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of preserving small-scale fishing and household fishing traditions in Skåne, advocating for governmental support to ensure these practices are allowed along the coasts. It highlights the cultural and historical significance of fishing to the local communities, calls for sustainable fishing practices, and suggests the need for new distribution pathways for fresh fish to local markets. The motion argues against proposed bans on household fishing, asserting they lack sufficient evidence and should be reconsidered in favor of balanced conservation efforts that allow both wildlife preservation and fishing traditions to coexist.

title: Krav på kollektivavtal vid offentlig upphandling
summary: The motion urges Sweden and the EU to take decisive actions to lift the Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip in order to alleviate the suffering of its inhabitants. It discusses the historical governance and control of Gaza, the impact of the Israeli occupation, and the humanitarian crisis that has arisen due to the blockade, which restricts the movement of people and goods in and out of Gaza.

title: Jämlik och jämställd klimatpolitik
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish parliament to continue investigating and improving the railway connection between Oslo and Stockholm, aiming to reduce travel time from around five hours to three hours. It emphasizes the environmental benefits of switching travelers from flights to trains and highlights the economic and strategic significance of this connection, especially in light of increased needs for defense collaboration in the region. The proposal calls for further studies and financial planning to enhance the infrastructure effectively.

title: Jämlik tandvård
summary: The motion proposes allowing farm sales of alcoholic beverages in Sweden while maintaining the monopoly of Systembolaget. It highlights that farm sales are important for local tourism and businesses, and argues that current regulations create unnecessary logistical challenges for local producers, negatively impacting both the environment and their operations. The motion suggests that Sweden could adopt similar regulations as Finland to enable farm sales without conflicting with existing laws.

title: Reformering av Gotlandstillägget
summary: The motion proposes to modernize the subject of home and consumer knowledge in schools to better prepare students for personal finance and budgeting. It argues that while current education focuses on core subjects, essential skills related to economics, budgeting, and financial management should be more thoroughly integrated into the curriculum, as many young people lack these competencies. The motion suggests that practical skills such as cooking should be considered parental responsibilities, while economics should be prioritized in the education system.

title: Ny lagstiftning för att värna säkerhet och trygghet för personer med demenssjukdom
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of mobile coverage and broadband access as a state responsibility, advocating for improved connectivity across Sweden, particularly in rural and underserved areas. It calls for the government to ensure that by 2025, 99.9% of the population has access to at least 100 Mbit/s, addressing the digital divide and the specific needs of residents in regions like Norrbotten.

title: Grundlagsfästning av public service
summary: The motion proposes that all upper secondary schools in Sweden should offer education in entrepreneurship to provide students with an early introduction to business ownership. It argues that understanding entrepreneurship at a young age is crucial for fostering future entrepreneurs, particularly among women. The motion emphasizes the importance of accessible entrepreneurial programs, like the 'Ung Företagsamhet' initiative, across all educational tracks rather than allowing access to be limited by the type of program a student is enrolled in. It supports the idea of making entrepreneurship courses an option for students rather than a mandatory part of the curriculum.

title: Tidiga insatser för att säkra barns skolgång
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for improved and sustainable infrastructure in Västsverige, highlighting its strategic significance for trade and regional development. It calls for investments in various transportation modes including maritime, rail, and road networks to facilitate efficient movement of people and goods, ensure environmental sustainability, and support economic growth in the region. The authors stress the importance of modernizing infrastructure, enhancing digital connectivity, and expanding bicycle paths to promote a healthier and more environmentally friendly society.

title: En väg till stärkt demokrati, integration och individuell utveckling
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1297 av Anna Wallentheim och Hanna Westerén (båda S)
summary: This proposal emphasizes the need to strengthen the opportunities for political youth organizations to engage with high school students in Sweden. It argues that democracy should not be taken for granted and that every new generation must be educated in democratic values. The motion highlights the current inconsistencies in how different schools allow or restrict access to political organizations, which may undermine equal opportunities for political engagement among youth. It calls for greater support from the parliament to ensure that young people can interact regularly with youth politicians, thus fostering political interest and engagement over time.

title: Reformerad bränsleskatt
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1296 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament's restaurants implement origin labeling for meat and take measures to increase the proportion of Swedish meat and food served. The proponents emphasize the high quality and sustainability of Swedish food production, advocating for its promotion within the parliamentary dining facilities to support local farmers and enhance food security in Sweden, particularly in light of recent challenges such as war and climate events.

title: Registrering av testamente
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1295 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to criminalize virginity operations and checks, calling for the revocation of medical licenses for those who offer such services. It aims to address and combat the spread of honor-related violence and oppression, emphasizing that the control of women's sexuality through outdated cultural norms is unacceptable. The proposal stresses the need for a scientific and factual approach to counter these practices and protect women's rights and freedoms in Sweden.

title: Modernisering av regelverket för A-traktorerna
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1294 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: This parliamentary motion advocates for initiatives aimed at ensuring skills supply in northern Sweden as part of the transition to a green economy. It emphasizes the importance of providing education accessible remotely or in sparsely populated areas to support workforce development in emerging industries, particularly in light of Sweden's goal to achieve climate neutrality by 2045. The proposal also highlights the need for a national framework to address skills shortages in sectors such as healthcare and acknowledges the importance of local labor market needs, suggesting enhancements to adult education and greater support for the Swedish Public Employment Service.

title: Översyn och förändring av regler kring energi, anläggningsbegrepp och nätkoncession
summary: The proposal advocates for an expansion of background checks for individuals employed in roles with children and young people, emphasizing the need to safeguard against sexual abuse. The motion suggests that all prospective employees engaged in direct contact with children should undergo comprehensive checks that include criminal records from non-EU countries, aiming to bolster the safety and security of children and youths.

title: Kommuners rätt att placera ut trafiksäkerhetskameror
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1292 av Peter Hedberg och Malin Larsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag should support an investigation into a clearer regional development policy and a strengthened role for county administrative boards in regional development. It highlights the need for improved collaboration between various levels of government and the regional boards, arguing that the current lack of clarity and guidance hampers effective cooperation and evaluation of regional development efforts.

title: Kriminalisering av fler substanser
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a new criminal classification specifically for offenses against school personnel in response to rising incidents of threats and violence in schools. The author emphasizes the need for enhanced legal protection for teachers and school staff to ensure a safe working environment and uphold the integrity of the educational institution.

title: Banker i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes to re-evaluate and increase the speed limit for A-tractors and epatractors from 30 km/h to 45 km/h, arguing that these vehicles are safer than moppebilar, which are allowed to travel at the higher speed. The suggestion includes implementing safety measures such as seatbelt requirements and aims to improve traffic flow and reduce dangerous overtaking incidents.

title: Kommunalt vindkraftsveto och rätt till kompensation
summary: The proposal suggests that libraries in Sweden should organize and categorize books by the initial letter of the country's name and the language's name rather than using outdated abbreviations. This would facilitate easier access for users searching for literature from independent nations such as Bosnia, Croatia, and Serbia, placing Croatian literature distinctly under the letter 'K' instead of the current collective 'BKS' classification.

title: Ö-faktor
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to secure electricity supply in the Gothenburg labor market area, which has experienced significant job and economic growth over the past decade. It calls for the government to facilitate new electricity production through a mix of energy sources, particularly highlighting the potential of offshore wind power. The motion criticizes the current conservative government's focus on nuclear energy and calls for urgent government actions to ensure stable and affordable electricity supply for households and businesses in the region.

title: Certifiering av fastighetsägare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government implement measures to ensure that all municipalities around Gothenburg have full access to public services. It emphasizes the importance of having government institutions present in local communities, as ongoing centralization has led to decreased availability of essential services. While digital access is acknowledged, the motion argues that not all residents can or wish to use online services, highlighting the necessity for physical public service locations in all eleven municipalities represented.

title: Anmälningsplikt för fordonsverkstäder
summary: The motion proposes to modernize the 1904:26 law to allow Swedish civil officiants to perform weddings for Swedish couples in neighboring countries. It also suggests a review of the conditions under which these officiants operate, emphasizing the need for timely wedding ceremonies for couples wishing to marry across borders and advocating for fair compensation for officiants.

title: Förverkligande av Öresundsmetron – för jobb och utveckling i södra Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1285 av Joakim Sandell och Rose-Marie Carlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for an examination of unjustified healthcare disparities in Sweden, emphasizing the need for equality in healthcare access irrespective of social, economic, or geographical factors. It calls for the government to develop measures to address these disparities and promote a modern, accessible, and efficient healthcare system, focusing on primary care and recognizing the impact of social conditions on health outcomes.

title: Begränsade möjligheter till överklagan för att inte äventyra samhällsutvecklingen
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1284 av Peder Björk och Hanna Westerén (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for the implementation of 'mellantvång' (a form of intermediate coercion) within the social services law to enhance the ability of social services to intervene in cases involving children and youth who lack necessary support from their families. The motion emphasizes the need to prioritize children's rights to safety, education, and the development of their capabilities, allowing social services to act earlier and with stronger measures, particularly for young individuals involved in destructive and criminal environments.

title: Ett förbud mot lustgasanvändning och skärpta begränsningar av försäljningen av lustgas
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for enhanced care and treatment for young individuals facing serious psychosocial issues, particularly those sentenced to closed youth care. It highlights the responsibility of society to support vulnerable youths and address the shortcomings in the current system, including inadequate treatment options and reports of serious misconduct within the care facilities. The goal is to prevent these young people from resorting to crime or further psychosocial challenges, ensuring they receive proper treatment, support, and a safe environment.

title: Utvärdering av LAS och tillämpningen av hyvling
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1282 av Ola Möller och Hanna Westerén (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a licensing requirement for sheltered housing to ensure quality support for women and children affected by domestic violence, emphasizing the need for a stronger child rights perspective. It highlights that many children in these situations do not have their own placement decisions and suffer from trauma while living in temporary, often uncertain housing situations. The goal is to regulate these facilities to improve the support provided.

title: Långsiktigt hållbar energiförsörjning
summary: The motion proposed by Eva Lindh and others aims to amend the Social Services Act to make reports regarding children searchable. The intent is to enhance the social services' ability to provide necessary support to children growing up in difficult circumstances by allowing for a comprehensive review of past reports, enabling authorities to identify children in need of help that may otherwise go unnoticed.

title: Utfasning av djurförsök
summary: The motion proposes to limit and amend the regulations surrounding the right to establish new businesses and to abolish the Law on Freedom of Choice (LOV) in areas where misuse is prevalent, citing issues such as poor working conditions and the facilitation of organized crime due to the current system. The proposal aims to enhance the governance of services, reduce costs that do not benefit individuals, and ensure equitable distribution of resources within welfare services.

title: Uppdaterad vapenlag
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations concerning cross-border ambulance and medical transport in the Nordic countries to enhance healthcare services in remote rural areas. It emphasizes the need for people to feel secure in accessing healthcare and suggests that increased cooperation in border areas could strengthen safety and utilize shared resources more effectively. The motion highlights existing challenges, such as Swedish legal requirements for medical personnel and the transportation of medications across borders, and calls for an update of these regulations to improve ambulance care collaboration in northern regions.

title: Skydd för barn mot kriminella gäng
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support increased collaboration among Nordic countries for the procurement of vaccines and medications, as well as the establishment of shared emergency stockpiles for pharmaceuticals and medical supplies. The proposal highlights lessons learned from the pandemic, arguing that joint efforts can enhance access to essential health resources and improve crisis preparedness across the region.

title: Slopat tillstånd för provsmakning av gårdsproducerade alkoholhaltiga drycker
summary: The proposal suggests establishing a Nordic register for healthcare professionals with valid credentials to enhance safety and security in the healthcare system across Nordic countries. The register aims to allow for the tracing of professionals who may have lost their licenses in one country while working in another, addressing concerns about the ability to verify qualifications across borders.

title: Minskning av den antimikrobiella resistensen både nationellt och internationellt
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1276 av Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing a national ban on PFAS in food packaging, citing the health and environmental risks associated with these harmful chemicals. The motion references a report indicating links between PFAS exposure and various health issues, along with substantial economic costs due to health impacts in Europe. The authors urge that Sweden follow Denmark's lead in addressing the risks of PFAS until an EU-wide ban is established.

title: Ett Skåne fritt från varg
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1275 av Lars Johnsson och Emma Ahlström Köster (båda M)

title: Att bryta ofrivillig ensamhet och isolering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigates the possibility of increasing the study pace for programs in shortage occupations by allowing studies to continue during the summer. This initiative aims to address the skills shortage hindering business growth, improve employment opportunities, and facilitate faster entry into professions for students, particularly in areas like teaching where there is a noted scarcity of labor. The motion suggests offering educational programs in two tracks: a regular pace and an accelerated pace utilizing summer breaks for studies, ultimately shortening the time to graduation.

title: Utredning om dödshjälp – rätten att själv bestämma när och hur man vill avsluta sitt liv
summary: The proposal suggests that the Riksdag should consider reviewing the operations of county administrative boards in Sweden, with an aim to streamline bureaucracy and reduce costs. It proposes evaluating the possibility of abolishing county boards, redistributing their responsibilities to municipalities or regions, or transferring tasks to other authorities. The motion emphasizes the necessity of reducing public administration expenses to better address essential services such as education, healthcare, and security.

title: Slopat matkrav för alkoholservering
summary: The motion proposes a review of regulations pertaining to old stone walls and cultivation mounds to facilitate more efficient agricultural practices. It argues that landowners should be able to utilize their land with modern machinery without being burdened by excessive demands regarding maintenance and environmental protection of stone walls. The proposal highlights the need for Sweden to increase its food production by adopting rational farming methods and suggests that if certain biotopes are protected, the government should find cooperative solutions and provide better compensation to landowners for any limitations imposed on their property rights.

title: Förbud mot rökning på svenska anstalter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament increase pressure on the Iranian regime in response to its violent crackdown on peaceful protests, condemn the regime's actions, reassess Sweden's policy towards Iran, and expand sanctions against it. It emphasizes the significance of recent protests in Iran as a matter of European and Swedish security, arguing for a shift from previous diplomatic approaches to a more assertive stance against the Iranian government.

title: Förhindrande av osund konkurrens inom begravningsverksamheten
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a contact person to assist families, enhancing inter-agency collaboration to prevent youth involvement in crime. It emphasizes the importance of building trust with families through various supportive touchpoints like maternal and child healthcare, thereby improving engagement with social services and authorities. The motion also calls for changes to regulations to allow contact persons to work across agencies, which would enable better information sharing and more effective preventive measures against youth crime.

title: Klassning av skjutbanor som kritisk infrastruktur
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should present measures to assist municipalities in fulfilling their housing responsibilities, particularly focusing on increasing the production of affordable rental housing and helping first-time buyers enter the ownership market, given the current economic challenges such as high inflation and interest rates, which make it difficult for municipalities to address housing needs effectively.

title: FM-mottagare vid nybilsförsäljning
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1268 av Hans Eklind och Larry Söder (båda KD)
summary: The proposal seeks to limit the number of subcontractors in public procurement processes and requires that subcontractors be approved by the primary contractor. This aims to address issues of accountability and transparency in public spending, ensure quality in services, and enhance working conditions for employees. The motion emphasizes the importance of responsible procurement that adheres to collective bargaining agreements, aiming to prevent the misuse of taxpayer money and ensure fairness in competition among businesses.

title: Lagstiftning utan gränshinder
summary: The motion proposes granting regional safety representatives extended access rights to workplaces, particularly to address the lack of safety representatives in many smaller workplaces where temporary employment is prevalent. The current requirement for union members on-site limits the ability of these representatives to perform their roles, leaving many employees unprotected and without a voice in workplace safety. The proponent argues that union involvement is critical for ensuring that safety representatives effectively advocate for employees rather than employers.

title: Flytt av Sveriges ambassad i Israel
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden, as a party to the Rome Statute, advocate for the inclusion of ecocide as a crime under the International Criminal Court (ICC) to address severe environmental destruction. It also suggests initiating a national investigation into the incorporation of ecocide into Swedish legislation, citing the urgent need for international legal measures against large-scale environmental harm that profoundly affects ecosystems and communities.

title: Offentlig information på lättläst svenska
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1265 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the allocation of public funds for 2023 to various pension-related benefits aimed at ensuring economic security for the elderly. It includes specific figures for guaranteed pensions, survivor pensions, housing supplements, and pension support, totaling approximately 55.4 billion kronor. Additionally, the Left Party suggests a new allocation for increased income pensions which will take effect in 2024 and 2025, highlighting a commitment to enhancing financial support for retirees.

title: Möjliggörande av stöd från EU till miljömotorer i fiskebåtar
summary: The motion proposes to align the regulations for A-tractors with those of moped cars, suggesting an increase in the maximum speed limit for A-tractors from 30 km/h to 45 km/h. It emphasizes the need to tighten education and safety requirements for A-tractors, including mandatory seat belts for all passengers and winter tires during the winter season. The authors argue that the current speed limit is outdated and that A-tractors are safer than moped cars, which have poorer crash safety performance.

title: Matsvinn i livsmedelshandeln
summary: The motion proposes a series of reforms aimed at streamlining the environmental permitting processes in Sweden to promote new industrialization, particularly in the green transition of the vehicle industry. It emphasizes the need for politically endorsed reforms to increase the capacity and collaboration among relevant authorities, and it suggests appointing a coordinator to facilitate significant establishments in the green transition. The motion outlines the importance of reducing lengthy approval times and enhancing predictability for investors, while maintaining Sweden's high environmental standards.

title: Låga trösklar till bostadsmarknaden
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of Sweden's municipal equalization system to ensure fairness among municipalities by having the state fully compensate those in need, reduce disparities and incentivize responsible financial management. It argues that the current system penalizes responsible municipalities while rewarding those with poor economic governance, hindering economic growth and equitable public services across the country.

title: Begränsning av förekomsten av vildsvin
summary: The motion proposes several measures to enhance the status and preservation of the Swedish language, including classifying Swedish as the official language of Sweden, promoting linguistic uniformity in public communication, prioritizing an adequate and rich use of language in public administration, and considering changes to language legislation to include braille. It emphasizes the importance of balancing unique language expressions of different groups while ensuring mutual understanding across the population, drawing inspiration from Icelandic language policies to maintain the integrity of Swedish.

title: Modernisering av alkohollagen och slopande av sambandet mellan alkoholtillstånd och mat
summary: The proposal advocates for the reintroduction of civil service responsibility in Sweden, emphasizing the need for public trust in officials' adherence to laws and regulations. It argues for clearer sanctions and punishments for officials who deviate from guidelines, aiming to ensure that citizens are treated fairly and correctly in their interactions with public administration. The motion suggests reviewing the regulations that existed before 1976 to create a modern version of these responsibilities.

title: Arbetslöshetsersättning för arbetstagare och egenföretagare
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider investigating the possibility of introducing conditional building permits that would allow construction in areas subject to disturbances, such as near agriculture or airports. The motivation for this change comes from individuals wishing to build homes connected to their roots despite the existing restrictive regulations that currently prevent such developments due to potential noise or odor issues. The proposal aims to facilitate construction while ensuring future buyers are aware of any disturbances through specific agreements.

title: Förbättrad hälsa hos barn och unga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the development of a clear strategy to increase both the production and export of Swedish food. It emphasizes the need for Sweden to utilize its agricultural potential more effectively in order to enhance self-sufficiency and create more jobs, particularly in rural areas. The motion suggests learning from other European countries like Germany and Denmark, which have successfully marketed and exported their food products, to improve Sweden's food production and marketing efforts.

title: Tidsgräns för domstolars handläggning av överklagande av detaljplaner m.m.
summary: The motion proposes a thorough review of the Environmental Code in Sweden to simplify regulations and reduce bureaucracy, which are seen as barriers to business development. The aim is to alleviate the extensive administrative burden and high investigation costs that currently hinder companies, while also encouraging compliance rather than punishment for those that err. The motion emphasizes the need to protect Swedish production and companies by preventing the relocation of production to countries with lower environmental standards.

title: Luftbro med elflyg till Gotland
summary: The proposal advocates for reducing the wolf population in Sweden to a specified range of 170 to 270 wolves, citing concerns over the negative impacts on rural communities, livestock farming, and hunting activities. It emphasizes the need to balance wildlife management with agricultural productivity and local economic growth, particularly in relation to food production and export.

title: Vidareutveckling av sfi
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament evaluate the total environmental benefit of installing new individual sewage systems in rural and sparsely populated areas. It suggests granting municipalities greater authority to issue waivers for expanding such systems, stressing the need to consider the overall environmental impact and costs of these investments, which may not always be justified in remote areas with limited access to services.

title: Översyn av hjälpmedel och bostadsanpassning
summary: The motion argues for improved state management of nature reserves to prevent the spread of the spruce bark beetle, which is causing significant damage to surrounding forests and private properties. It emphasizes the need for the government to actively remove affected trees in protected areas, similar to practices in privately owned forests, to mitigate economic losses for landowners and ensure the health of vital forest ecosystems.

title: Ekonomiska garantier för avfallsplatser
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1253 av Martina Johansson och Malin Björk (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should explore the possibility of locating the new wildlife authority in Skaraborg. It emphasizes the need for the authority to be established with knowledgeable personnel and to be situated in a rural community rather than in larger cities, arguing that Skaraborg's proximity to nature and expertise in hunting and nature issues make it an ideal location.

title: Lagstiftning för distansarbete
summary: The motion proposes that relevant Swedish authorities should align their actions with the goals of the national food strategy, which aims to increase domestic food production. The motion emphasizes the need for additional political measures to enhance profitability, competitiveness, and equal conditions for farmers, as well as reducing bureaucracy and taxes to encourage investment in agriculture.

title: Trafikpoliser
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1251 av Martina Johansson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers revising the compensation regulations for Natura 2000 areas, which currently require landowners to manage these protected lands without automatic compensation for the restrictions imposed on their use. The motion highlights the difficulties faced by landowners, especially when agricultural activities become unviable due to various factors, such as profitability and wildlife issues. The aim is to ensure that landowners have greater rights to utilize their lands without being hindered by the Natura 2000 regulations.

title: Förnybar energiomställning
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1250 av Martina Johansson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish parliament to review and clarify regulations surrounding demersal fishing to align with those in neighboring countries. It emphasizes the importance of establishing a more permanent system for transferring fishing permits, enhancing the fishing industry's competitiveness, and ensuring Sweden keeps pace with EU developments to avoid disadvantages compared to other EU nations.

title: Turismöversiktsplan
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1249 av Martina Johansson och Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the removal of the plastic bag tax introduced in Sweden in May 2020, citing that the expected tax revenue has not materialized and that the importation of plastic bags from China has increased, which is environmentally detrimental compared to Swedish recycled bags. It argues that the current policy is counterproductive and calls on the government to examine the possibility of abolishing the tax.

title: Fiber i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1248 av Martina Johansson och Niels Paarup-Petersen (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider introducing an additional job tax deduction, arguing that increased employment will lead to greater production and, consequently, higher state revenues. This should, in turn, support a robust public welfare system, including education, healthcare, and infrastructure. The proposal emphasizes the importance of ensuring that those who work hard see the benefits reflected in their personal finances through reduced taxes.

title: Ett modernt statsskick
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1247 av Niels Paarup-Petersen m.fl. (C, S, L, MP, V)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should consider lowering the VAT on dance concerts from 25% to 6%, arguing that the current rate unfairly penalizes attendees compared to other concert types. The motion emphasizes the health benefits of dancing and the importance of fostering social interactions through such activities, advocating for a tax regime that encourages participation in dance events rather than discouraging it through high taxes.

title: Förenklade tillståndsansökningar och tillsyn
summary: The proposal calls for a review of laws and regulations to enhance the competitiveness and production of Swedish honey. It highlights the challenges faced by domestic beekeepers due to competition from lower-cost imported honey, emphasizing the need for clearer labeling and supportive measures to improve profitability and sustainability in Swedish beekeeping. The motion requests that the government consider making Swedish beekeeping tax-exempt to promote its viability and the associated benefits to biodiversity and agriculture.

title: Förändrad lagstiftning för jakt
summary: The motion proposes several measures to facilitate job and housing opportunities for young people. It suggests the implementation of practical work experiences across all high school programs to strengthen the connection between education and employment. Additionally, it calls for a more job-oriented focus in career counseling to better inform students about future job prospects. Lastly, it advocates for a tax deduction for young individuals saving for their own housing, aiming to provide stronger financial incentives for saving.

title: Harmoniserad hastighet för A‑traktor och mopedbilar och förbättrad förarutbildning
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider reforming the tax account system so that both assets and liabilities under 100 kronor are not paid in or out during the year. The motion argues that allowing small amounts to remain on tax accounts would reduce administrative burdens and costs for both taxpayers and the tax authority, promoting a more equitable approach to how small debts and credits are handled.

title: Mer solenergi
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider reducing the tax on beer produced by small breweries, as allowed by EU regulations. This reduction would improve competitive conditions for Swedish small breweries, which currently face disadvantages due to higher taxes compared to their foreign counterparts. The proposal argues that taking advantage of this opportunity would promote growth and job creation within the Swedish craft beer sector.

title: Rotavdrag från utlandet
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations surrounding tax deductions for home offices to facilitate both employees and self-employed individuals. Currently, smaller businesses face limitations on deductions for office space within their homes, making it complicated and unprofitable to maintain a home office. The proposal highlights the shift towards remote work during the pandemic and suggests that modernizing the rules would not only support businesses but also contribute to environmental and time-saving benefits by reducing commuting.

title: Utvärdering av fastighetsskatten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers reviewing and potentially abolishing the requirement for a personnel register in smaller companies, arguing that maintaining such a register imposes an unreasonable bureaucratic burden on these businesses, particularly family-owned ones. The motion acknowledges the importance of record-keeping in larger companies but emphasizes the need to reduce bureaucracy across the board to facilitate easier operations for all businesses.

title: Företag inom besöksnäringen
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a tax deduction for individuals who obtain a bus or truck driver's license, aimed at encouraging more young people to pursue these qualifications and enter the workforce as drivers. The rationale is to alleviate the financial burden of obtaining the license, thereby addressing the demand for more bus and truck drivers in Sweden.

title: Delegationer i sjukvården
summary: The motion proposes a review of the possibility to reduce the gasoline and diesel taxes in Sweden, citing the high tax burden on individuals who rely on vehicles for daily activities due to the country's geography and population density. The motion argues that current fuel taxes negatively impact competitiveness and quality of life in less populated areas, making it difficult for residents to commute, shop, and participate in social activities. It emphasizes the need for lower fuel taxes to support overall economic growth and job creation throughout Sweden.

title: Krafttag mot näthat
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish pension system to better reflect the work individuals have performed throughout their lives. It calls for an evaluation of the pension reform, citing concerns that many retirees face low pensions and inadequate economic security despite having worked. The motion suggests that improvements are needed to ensure that working contributes significantly to pension benefits, thereby restoring legitimacy to the pension system and enhancing confidence among the working population.

title: Utökat och breddat skatteavdrag för gåvor
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1237 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Christofer Bergenblock (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should urge the government to explore possibilities for increasing the proportion of funds from the national plan for new investments in Stockholm County, as the current share has decreased from 20% to 17% between the planning periods 2014–2025 and 2018–2029, while the overall funding for regional plans has reportedly increased. The region is responsible for significant infrastructure financing and requires stronger state support for vital transport infrastructure projects.

title: Införande av rätten till punktskrift i skollagen
summary: The motion proposes allowing the sale of beer and wine in licensed grocery stores in Sweden, arguing that the current monopoly of Systembolaget is ineffective in controlling alcohol consumption, particularly among youth. The proposal includes stricter licensing requirements with severe penalties for non-compliance, aiming to enhance regulation and support rural shops.

title: Skyltning längs med allmänna vägar
summary: The motion highlights the need for increased investment and collaboration in the development of cycling infrastructure in Sweden, aiming to raise the bicycle usage in urban regions from about 7% to 20% by 2030. It emphasizes the importance of 850 km of regional cycling paths, improved funding from the state, and a modernized legal framework to better facilitate the construction of cycling routes. The proposal seeks to ensure that cycling is recognized as a standalone form of transportation, similar to car travel.

title: Strategi för klimatanpassningar i jordbrukslandskapet
summary: The suggestion proposes the establishment of a high-speed train connection between Stockholm and Oslo, aiming to reduce travel time to under three hours. This initiative is presented as a means to enhance competitiveness among metropolitan regions, promote regional development and job creation in central Swedish industrial counties, and significantly reduce climate impact by encouraging travelers to opt for trains instead of flights. The proposal highlights the economic interdependence between Sweden and Norway, emphasizing potential benefits for various sectors including industry, commerce, and employment.

title: Ett reformerat strandskydd för Sveriges landsbygder
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive evaluation of Sweden's drug policies, emphasizing the need for preventive measures, decriminalization, and a shift of responsibility for addiction treatment to the healthcare system. It highlights the high prevalence of drug-related deaths among youth and the lack of effective support for addiction treatment. The proposal advocates for improved care methodologies based on scientific evidence, and calls for increased support for relatives of those affected by addiction.

title: Underlätta för etablering av nya biogasanläggningar
summary: The proposal advocates for a clear definition of 'brukningsvärd jordbruksmark' (arable agricultural land) in Sweden's environmental laws to better protect high-quality farmland from exploitation for construction projects. It highlights the current issue where large housing developments often take precedence over preserving valuable agricultural land due to ambiguities in regulations. The motion calls for a revised interpretation of the law that takes into account the quality of the land, rather than just the size of the development, ensuring that important agricultural land is safeguarded.

title: Urholkning av äganderätten
summary: The motion proposes establishing an investigation to redefine and clarify the term 'significant societal interests' in land planning, particularly to better protect arable land from being converted for development. The authors emphasize the importance of arable land for food self-sufficiency, especially in light of recent global events that have heightened concerns about food security. They argue that current legislation inadequately protects arable land from being developed for housing and infrastructure, and they seek to ensure that decisions about land use are made with greater consideration for agricultural needs.

title: Arvode till vigselförrättare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate ways to increase plastic recycling in Sweden, citing the environmental benefits of reducing waste and enhancing material recovery. It highlights the current low rate of plastic recycling compared to other materials and suggests that a comprehensive study should identify effective measures to improve plastic recycling processes and reduce reliance on incineration.

title: Pedagogiska tjänster samt fjärrundervisning
summary: This motion proposes improvements to the Viskadalsbanan railway to enhance accessibility and increase train speeds between Borås, Mark, and Varberg. It highlights the importance of sustainable travel for education, work, and leisure, emphasizing the need to reduce travel times, increase safety by closing unmonitored level crossings, and establish more passing tracks to facilitate additional train services. The motion calls for prioritizing these improvements to better serve the communities and promote train usage.

title: Fler beredningsformer för cytostatika
summary: This motion proposes an investigation into raising the threshold for permitting requirements according to the Environmental Assessment Regulation for biogas plants in Sweden. It highlights the growing demand for biogas, which is a climate-smart product made from waste, and suggests that the current threshold of 3 GWh for mandatory permits is too low. The motion argues that raising this limit would facilitate the expansion of domestic biogas production, particularly on farms, and is necessary for meeting increased demand within the country.

title: Differentierad vattentaxa
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibilities for expanding and broadening the tax deduction for donations to non-profit organizations in Sweden. Currently, only a limited number of organizations can receive such donations and the tax relief is capped at a modest amount. The authors argue that the existing rules restrict the financial contributions to the non-profit sector and suggest a review of the regulations to allow more organizations to benefit and to increase the deductible amounts significantly.

title: Bättre tillgång på cykelvägar
summary: The proposal advocates for a reform of the current shore protection legislation in Sweden, suggesting that municipalities should take primary responsibility for shore protection matters, while abolishing the general shore protection measures that currently restrict development. The motivation highlights the difficulties faced by a local housing company in Varberg trying to build new apartments due to existing regulations, emphasizing that the rules hinder growth in rural areas. The suggestion includes maintaining a smaller buffer zone along the shores to ensure free passage for people and animals, ultimately aiming to create more opportunities for housing and business development in proximity to water bodies.

title: Situationsanpassade regelverk vid infrastrukturplanering
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to expedite financing solutions for the Norrbotniabanan railway project, which is a critical infrastructure link in northern Sweden. It suggests that the government should consider borrowing funds for the project and tasking Norrbotniabanan AB and Trafikverket with its execution. The urgency is emphasized due to the increasing industrial investments in northern Sweden, which require improved transport infrastructure to facilitate growth and meet transportation demands.

title: Bedrägerier mot äldre
summary: The motion proposes to remove the requirement for a detailed plan for the construction of up to five houses in rural areas, arguing that the current planning requirement is time-consuming and costly for builders while primarily impacting only the landowner and developer. The motion suggests that such a requirement is unnecessary in low-impact areas with few stakeholders.

title: Utbildning för arbete
summary: The motion proposes a review of the law governing who has the legal right to appeal in planning and building permit processes, emphasizing that only property owners and stakeholders should have the ability to challenge decisions. It argues that the current inclusion of non-stakeholders, such as interest organizations, undermines property rights and leads to unnecessary legal processes that burden landowners and local authorities.

title: Tryggare studietid för studenter
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should explore the possibility of allowing individuals to open bank accounts for children and adolescents without requiring parental signatures. It emphasizes that this would enable relatives or guardians to save money for a minor, locked until the child turns 18, thus facilitating alternative ways to provide financial support without reliance on parents.

title: Ökad möjlighet till licensjakt på varg i tamdjurstäta län
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of Swedish bureaucracy with the goals of reducing processing times and cutting costs by at least 30%. It highlights the need to address the inefficiencies resulting from overlapping responsibilities among government agencies, which contribute to increased time and expenses. The motion advocates for mergers or closures of certain agencies to streamline operations and improve effectiveness, thereby enhancing Sweden's competitiveness for businesses and job creation.

title: Ranstad
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament implement measures to enhance the understanding of entrepreneurship within government agencies and make them more business-friendly. It emphasizes the need to streamline bureaucracy, reduce administrative burdens for businesses, and ensure that government operations are efficient and cost-effective. The motion suggests that the number of agencies should be evaluated and their efficiency improved to better serve businesses and taxpayers, ultimately allowing for more resources to be allocated to vital services such as education and healthcare.

title: Boverkets regler för mer återbrukat byggmaterial
summary: The motion proposes a review of regulations to ensure that government agencies cannot request the same information that another agency has already gathered. It emphasizes the need for better coordination in data collection among agencies to reduce the burden on individuals and businesses, allowing them to avoid submitting duplicate information.

title: Trafiksituationen i Ystad
summary: The proposal advocates for an enhancement of the reporting and comparison metrics of welfare services in Sweden, emphasizing the need for clearer information to help users and their families make informed choices regarding care and education. It highlights the current complexity of data, which hinders effective comparisons of care forms and schools, and suggests learning from international best practices to improve transparency and facilitate better decision-making.

title: Insatser mot erosion på Skånes kuster
summary: The motion suggests several measures to enhance the Stockholm region as a growth hub, emphasizing its potential as a national innovation zone and the need for improved digital infrastructure in welfare services. It calls for Stockholm to be made a pilot area for different election days to better engage democratic processes, alongside a focus on sustainable coastal communities and increasing transportation capacity to facilitate accessibility and growth.

title: Utveckla studenthälsan
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulatory framework to facilitate and simplify the permitting process for constructing water and fire dams in Sweden, aiming to enhance fire preparedness and response capabilities in the face of increasing wildfire risks. The current regulations are seen as cumbersome and costly, hindering landowners' ability to protect their properties from potential fires. The motion advocates for a more accessible and efficient process for building such dams.

title: Framtidssäkring av det svenska vägnätet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate the potential for closer collaboration between the country's hunters, sport shooters, and the military as part of national defense efforts. It emphasizes the examples set by other European countries, such as the Czech Republic, where this cooperation is seen as beneficial. The motion argues that skilled hunters and shooters could enhance Sweden's preparedness and defense capabilities, particularly given the current global uncertainties.

title: Flaggning av adresser för ambulans
summary: The motion proposes that the government should consider enhancing the Swedish Tax Agency's ability to combat tax evasion related to illegal labor. It suggests developing an action plan to fight illegal labor, reviewing the penalties for exploiting illegal workforce, and studying how other EU countries have addressed the issue. The motion highlights the serious challenges posed by unscrupulous companies that evade taxes and harm legitimate businesses, emphasizing the need for effective measures to maintain a fair labor market in Sweden.

title: Ett tryggt Sverige, fritt från brott och extremism
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament evaluates the alcohol limit of 0.2 promille for boating, which has been in effect since 2010. The objective is to assess the impact of this regulation on reducing accidents at sea, review the effectiveness of enforcement efforts, and consider aligning the limit with neighboring countries. The motion emphasizes the importance of continuously reviewing the consequences of laws to ensure public safety.

title: Barnens rätt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take strong actions to combat crimes committed by animal rights activists and thefts by organized crime that threaten animal and food production in Sweden. It argues that current protections for farmers and food production are inadequate, leading to increased insecurity in rural areas and potential cessation of agricultural activities due to these illegal actions.

title: Våld i nära relationer
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations surrounding weapon collections in Sweden to facilitate and support the important cultural work of preserving and maintaining significant cultural heritage. It highlights the challenges faced by weapon collectors due to unclear regulations that restrict their ability to collect and store weapons, which can hinder their pursuits. The suggestion advocates for clearer guidelines to enable collectors to expand their collections while ensuring their valuable contributions to cultural preservation are encouraged and supported.

title: Politiskt tillsatta nämndemän
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should create initiatives to support collectors in the country by facilitating public access to their collections and simplifying regulations concerning them. It emphasizes the importance of collectors' work in preserving cultural heritage and suggests that society should actively appreciate and assist in showcasing these collections rather than imposing restrictions.

title: Stärkt tillgång till läromedel
summary: The proposal suggests that the responsibility for the Customs Agency (Tullverket) be transferred from the Ministry of Finance to the Ministry of Justice. The rationale behind this motion is that customs operations, which primarily involve the inspection of vehicles, freight, and individuals, are more aligned with the responsibilities of the Justice Department. The proposal also emphasizes the need for increased coordination with the police, which operates under the Ministry of Justice.

title: Bättre anpassad undervisningstid i grundskolan, specialskolan och sameskolan
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of forest ownership rights as a foundation for sustainable forestry in Skåne, Sweden. It stresses the need for a stronger emphasis on property rights and the challenges posed by EU regulations that may undermine local decision-making regarding forest management. The proposal advocates for increased flexibility in forest policy to accommodate regional differences in climate and geography, and it calls for a reevaluation of the restrictions on using foreign tree species in forestry, considering the potential benefits they may have under changing climate conditions.

title: Ny kärnkraft i Sverige – ett första steg
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the fees charged by Lantmäteriet (the Swedish mapping, cadastral, and land registration authority) to enhance its efficiency and reduce costs. It emphasizes the need for faster processing times and suggests that unnecessary complexities in laws and regulations should be addressed to streamline operations. The proposal aims to lower fees for both businesses and private individuals, thereby encouraging growth and development in Sweden's competitive market.

title: Ändrade regler om direkttilldelning av avtal om kollektivtrafik på järnväg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to review the distribution of costs associated with land exploitation. It argues that when developers build on agricultural land and alter local water flows, they should automatically bear the costs of any necessary adjustments to water drainage shares and maintenance expenses, rather than passing these costs onto individual landowners.

title: Vissa skattefrågor med anledning av nya aktiebolagsrättsliga regler om bolags rörlighet över gränserna inom EU
Ändring i skatteavtalet mellan Sverige och Frankrike
summary: The motion proposes a review of regulations concerning construction within the agricultural sector to enhance competitiveness and address recognized barriers to investment in farming and food production. It recommends allowing limited construction without building permits for certain structures, simplifying regulations for water and sewage services, and considering the removal of mandatory preliminary approvals for new or remodeled animal barns. Additionally, it suggests eliminating building permit requirements for farm shops to leverage the increasing interest in local food production and artisanal products.

title: Den skånska flaggans officiella status
summary: The suggestion proposes expanding the ROT deduction in Sweden to include individual wastewater treatment facilities, aiming to incentivize homeowners to upgrade their systems to meet environmental standards. This would address the significant environmental impact of poorly functioning facilities, which currently contribute to pollution in lakes and seas. The motion also suggests allowing exceptions to existing regulations in areas where environmental impact is low, thereby balancing environmental benefits with cost considerations for homeowners.

title: Nationella beredskapslager
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1208 av Ann-Christine Frohm Utterstedt och Eric Westroth (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the reinstitution of investment support for private and forest roads to enhance rural infrastructure, which is deemed vital for rural development and daily life in sparsely populated areas. The motion highlights the negative impact of the withdrawal of state road subsidies by the Transport Administration, emphasizing the importance of maintaining these roads for local communities, tourism, and governmental services.
