summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats calls for the Swedish Parliament to review and potentially revoke its recognition of Palestine, stating that a government including Hamas cannot be seen as legitimate. It also demands that aid to the Palestinian Authority be conditioned on fulfilling specific criteria related to corruption, respect for human rights, and the renunciation of terrorism. Additionally, the motion advocates for the formal recognition of Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and the relocation of the Swedish embassy to that city.

title: Internationell solidaritet – en stark röst för hbtq-plus-personers rättigheter
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1072 av Anna Wallentheim och Daniel Vencu Velasquez Castro (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports measures to prevent foreign purchases of land and real estate in strategically important locations if such acquisitions could negatively impact Sweden's security. The motivation highlights concerns over foreign investments, particularly by Russian businessmen, in sensitive areas which may pose risks to national safety.

title: Idrott för alla
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider investigating the use of digital technology to facilitate the handling of gun licenses, suggesting the introduction of an electronic license that can be verified via mobile BankID to ease compliance with current regulations requiring physical presentation of the license for ammunition purchases.

title: Säkrad övergång mellan aktivitetsersättning och sjukersättning
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1070 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognizes Somaliland as an independent state contingent upon improvements in religious freedom. It suggests establishing an embassy in Hargeysa, enhancing diplomatic relations, and promoting cooperation between Swedish and Somaliland authorities. Additionally, it calls for updating travel recommendations to Somaliland, prioritizing business relations, and supporting the Somaliland Development Fund. The proposal emphasizes the need for international support for Somaliland's stable governance and suggests examining temporary assistance for autonomous regions within Somalia, while promoting a democratic model that aligns with local conditions.

title: Rättvisa regler för pensionsålder
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1069 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the reintroduction of short-term study support to enable individuals to combine work with education. The authors argue that this support is essential for lifelong learning and offers opportunities to those who wish to continue their education later in life, which was hindered after the previous center-right government's abolition of the program.

title: Tillgång till internet i riksnormen för försörjningsstöd
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1068 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine ways to reduce accidents at roadworks and increase the use of mobile speed cameras in these areas. It highlights the alarming number of traffic accidents at roadworks, involving both road users and workers, and emphasizes the perceived lack of safety and responsibility among drivers. The authors argue for stricter enforcement of speed limits, more inspections, and educational measures for new drivers regarding road work safety to further enhance worker protection.

title: Importkontroll av skinn
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1067 av Helén Pettersson och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for a comprehensive Swedish strategy regarding Arctic affairs, emphasizing security policy, trade opportunities, environmental protection, indigenous rights, and cultural preservation in the Arctic region. It calls for increased military presence, enhanced icebreaker capacity, and careful consideration of foreign influences, particularly from China and the EU, as well as a focus on sustainable development that balances economic interests with environmental conservation.

title: Friskolors etableringsrätt
summary: The proposal seeks to expand helmet requirements for children riding in bicycle trailers and on electric scooters in Sweden. It advocates for the inclusion of children under 15 years old in the helmet law for bicycle trailers, due to the increasing safety concerns associated with bike traffic. Additionally, it suggests that electric scooters, particularly the more powerful models, should require helmets for all riders regardless of age, given the rise in injuries, especially head injuries, related to scooter accidents.

title: Reformerad arbetsskadeförsäkring
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1065 av Helén Pettersson och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the continuation of expanding alcohol testing units, known as alkobommar, at all Swedish ports receiving foreign ferry traffic. It aims to address the issue of intoxicated truck drivers arriving from ferries and emphasizes the importance of these units for traffic safety by providing a quick and effective means of testing drivers before they enter the road. The motion advocates for a combination of permanent and mobile units to enhance deterrence and contribute to the goal of zero traffic fatalities.

title: Avskaffande av fideikommiss
summary: The motion advocates for prioritizing social and economic rights in the efforts to promote human rights in developing countries. It emphasizes the importance of ensuring basic living conditions for individuals to improve their situations, supports women's empowerment, addresses issues of gender-based violence, and condemns state-sponsored human rights abuses in countries like China. The proposal calls for Sweden to take a stronger stance in international forums, engage more actively for children’s rights, and offer greater support for vulnerable minorities while pushing for a checklist to evaluate democratic practices globally.

title: En hållbar småviltsjakt i de svenska fjällen
summary: The proposal, known as Lex Lotta, seeks to address the issue of violence against women by mandating that authorities self-report their shortcomings in providing support to women who have been victims of violence, particularly after a murder occurs. It highlights the ongoing problem of harassment, assault, and insufficient protection for women living with protected identities and emphasizes the need for improved awareness and accountability in handling cases of domestic violence.

title: Nationell samordning av precisionsmedicin för en jämlik vård
summary: The proposal calls for a comprehensive tax reform in Sweden, aiming to enhance gender equality, reduce economic disparities, and ensure long-term welfare funding. It seeks to address the outdated tax regulations that have resulted in unequal treatment of various income sources, particularly favoring capital incomes, which are shown to disproportionately benefit men. The reform is intended to establish a more progressive tax legislation for a fairer distribution of resources and to meet climate and social goals.

title: Mental hälsa och flickors utbildning i det svenska biståndet
summary: Sverigedemokraterna föreslår en reform av Sveriges biståndspolitik med fokus på att prioritera de minst utvecklade länderna och öka andelen av biståndet som går till humanitärt stöd och flyktinghjälp. Motionen inkluderar förslag om att minska biståndsramen genom en översyn och avveckling av ineffektivt bistånd, skapa ett instrument för att frysa biståndsmedel med bristande kvalitet och villkora biståndet med krav på demokratiska reformer i mottagarländerna. Förslagen syftar till att effektivisera biståndet och säkerställa att det når fram till de mest behövande med fokus på områden där Sverige har särskild kompetens.

title: Kriminalisering av sexköp utomlands
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish parliament to formally recognize the genocidal actions of the Islamic State in Iraq and Syria, as well as the man-made famine in Ukraine during 1932-1933, as genocides. It highlights the systematic persecution of ethnic and religious minorities by the Islamic State and argues that the actions of the Soviet regime in Ukraine constituted state-sponsored genocide, urging that these historical events be acknowledged to honor the victims and prevent future atrocities.

title: Åtgärder för en levande, dynamisk och konkurrenskraftig konstmarknad
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should take proactive steps in the Council of Europe to enhance individual citizens' rights to freely choose their political beliefs and trade unions, combat antisemitism, support Somaliland in forming democratic partnerships, invite Taiwan as an observer, prevent sharia-inspired legislation in Europe, and ensure independent oversight of the European Court of Human Rights to address corruption and bias allegations.

title: Hedersrelaterat förtryck
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish parliament to explore and implement measures such as freezing assets belonging to illegitimate regimes, allowing legitimate folk embassies to take over physical property from illegitimate embassies, and issuing diplomatic ID cards for representatives of these folk embassies, aimed at supporting the democratic opposition in countries like Belarus and Venezuela where human rights are severely violated.

title: Frigivning av Selahattin Demirtaş
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for Sweden to demonstrate strong support for persecuted Christians worldwide, particularly focusing on the situations in Egypt, Pakistan, Nigeria, North Korea, Indonesia, Syria, and Iraq. It calls for Sweden to advocate for international organizations like the UN and EU to exert pressure on the respective governments to ensure the safety and rights of Christian minorities, halt violence against them, and address severe human rights violations.

title: Frigivande av Dawit Isaak
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the imposition of strict sanctions against Cuba, advocate for a unified Cuba policy with the USA and other democratic Latin American countries, and terminate the political dialogue and cooperation agreement between the EU and Cuba. It emphasizes the severe human rights violations and lack of democratic freedoms in Cuba, arguing that the existing EU-Cuba agreement legitimizes the communist regime and neglects the political opposition.

title: Införande av ett tredje juridiskt kön
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1055 av Daniel Vencu Velasquez Castro och Anna Wallentheim (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports an investigation into how ferry traffic to and from Gotland can be treated as a vital part of the national infrastructure plan. It emphasizes the importance of reliable and efficient ferry transport for the economic development of Gotland, suggesting that current and future ferry services need to be maintained at high standards to support both passenger and freight traffic effectively and sustainably. Additionally, it calls for government responsibility in ensuring that Gotland's ferry system is integrated into the overall national logistics system.

title: Könsneutral föräldrabalk
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1054 av Daniel Vencu Velasquez Castro (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government implement a dental care reform aimed at achieving a more equitable dental health system. It is based on the findings of a comprehensive investigation which highlighted significant socioeconomic disparities in dental health and recommended financial reforms, including a high-cost protection model similar to that of general healthcare. The motion argues for treating dental care as integral to overall health and emphasizes the need for a unified health system that fully covers dental services to reduce financial burdens on patients.

title: Arvode till vigselförrättare
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1053 av Gunilla Carlsson och Dzenan Cisija (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize the need for accessible childcare during unconventional working hours, particularly for parents working evenings, nights, and weekends. It highlights that while current legislation mandates daytime childcare for working parents, many municipalities do not provide services for non-standard hours, leaving some parents, especially single parents, without adequate support. The motion calls for an examination of the possibility to improve childcare accessibility to better serve the needs of all working families.

title: Tydliggörande av rutiner kring samverkan mellan skola, socialtjänst och polis
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1052 av Gunilla Carlsson och Dzenan Cisija (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for increased oversight and legislation surrounding algorithms and artificial intelligence (AI) to protect citizens' privacy and uphold democratic principles. It advocates for research into the impact of AI on democracy and individual rights, highlighting the challenges posed by digitalization and the responsibility of technology companies to ensure transparency in their algorithms, which can significantly affect societal dynamics.

title: Skolavslutningar och firanden av högtider med konfessionella inslag i kyrkolokaler
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Tax Agency and the Social Insurance Agency collaborate to include information about housing supplements for pensioners in the tax declaration process, allowing pensioners to apply for the supplement simultaneously. This aims to ensure that more pensioners, who may not be aware of their entitlement to housing supplements, can receive the financial support they deserve, thereby improving the pension system and securing a better standard of living for retirees.

title: Systematiska mätningar av narkotika
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the taxation of global digital advertising and media providers operating in Sweden to enhance competition neutrality in the media industry. It highlights the disparity in tax obligations between these global companies, such as Google and Facebook, and Swedish media firms, which often leads to lower tax contributions and reduced ad revenue for local newspapers, jeopardizing Swedish journalism and democracy. The motion calls for the implementation of a consistent regulatory framework to ensure that all actors on the Swedish advertising market face equal tax conditions.

title: Pornografins skadeverkningar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider establishing a memorial monument for the victims of the Srebrenica genocide and the Balkan wars, recognizing the profound impact these events had on many individuals and families in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the importance of remembrance and reconciliation, noting that the Srebrenica massacre serves as a symbol of the atrocities committed during this period, driven by racism and nationalism. It calls for honoring the victims and providing a space for relatives to mourn, as well as serving as a reminder of the consequences of such ideologies.

title: Adhd-diagnoser hos barn och unga
summary: The proposal from Christian Carlsson (KD) emphasizes the urgent need for improving order and safety in Swedish schools. It suggests amending school law to clarify principals' responsibilities for maintaining safety and study tranquility, implementing a expectations document between schools, students, and parents, introducing order assessments, and enabling schools to have greater disciplinary powers. The motion advocates for a legal structure to facilitate more flexible actions in managing student behavior and emphasizes the importance of parental responsibility in creating a conducive learning environment.

title: Opinionsundersökning nära val
summary: The motion proposes establishing minimum competency levels for student health services in schools and investigating the qualifications necessary for school counselors, with the aim of developing a supplementary education program that leads to the title of licensed school counselor. The aim is to ensure that all students have access to well-trained professionals and to standardize the competencies required across different schools, thereby improving the overall effectiveness of student health services.

title: Vinststopp i skolan
summary: The proposal advocates for a government-led investigation into establishing a cap on the size of childcare groups in preschools, specifically recommending a maximum of twelve children per group for those under three years old. It emphasizes the importance of small groups for fostering secure environments, allowing caregivers to provide better attention and support to each child, ultimately aiming for improved conditions in early childhood education.

title: Jämställd fördelning av ekonomiskt bistånd
summary: The proposal advocates for improved long-term support for cooperative business consulting in Sweden, highlighting the significant role of cooperative businesses in the national economy and their resilience during economic downturns. The motion calls for enhanced resources for Coompanion, an organization that provides guidance to emerging cooperative ventures, due to a rising demand for such advisory services and the decreasing support it has received over time. It emphasizes the need for a diverse range of business forms to promote sustainable economic development across the country.

title: Förstärkt skydd av Vätterns vatten
summary: The motion proposes a review of the tax disparity affecting individuals on sickness and activity compensation in Sweden, specifically aiming to abolish the so-called 'funktionsskatt'. It highlights that those receiving such compensations are excluded from the recently implemented tax reductions for wage earners, resulting in them paying higher taxes. The motion underscores the financial difficulty faced by over 260,000 individuals in this group, advocating for a fairer tax system that does not penalize those with chronic illnesses or disabilities.

title: Vinster i välfärden
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a time limit for the completion of property division processes (bodelning) to protect victims of domestic violence. It highlights the challenges faced by women and children living under these circumstances, stressing that delays in property division can force victims to return to abusive partners due to financial dependency. The motion aims to ensure that perpetrators do not prolong the process to hinder the progress of their former partners and to provide necessary support for victims seeking to rebuild their lives.

title: Nya stambanor
summary: This motion proposes a reform of the school choice system in Sweden and a ban on profit extraction in schools, arguing that market-driven solutions have exacerbated segregation and undermined educational equity. The authors highlight that private schools receive the same funding as municipal schools despite having different responsibilities, leading to inefficiencies and unequal educational outcomes. They advocate for a resource distribution model based on need, stricter requirements for independent schools, and fairer admission practices to ensure equal opportunities for all students. The motion emphasizes the need for society to manage education rather than allowing market forces to dictate its direction.

title: Digital vård
summary: The motion proposes to further develop the Finsam legislation to enhance collaboration among municipalities, regions, the Employment Service, and the Social Insurance Agency, which would enable more comprehensive support for work-related rehabilitation. The intention is to improve the efficiency of the existing partnerships, remove barriers to cooperation, and extend the scope of the Finsam framework to address a broader range of needs, ultimately offering individuals more effective pathways to a stable and improved quality of life.

title: Bättre arbetsmiljö
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1040 av Carina Ödebrink och Azra Muranovic (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for enhanced witness protection in Sweden due to rising fears among potential witnesses who are threatened by criminal elements, particularly organized crime. It calls for long-term solutions to ensure that witnesses can safely come forward without endangering themselves or their families. The motion advocates for a national coordinator to facilitate cooperation among municipalities in providing housing and protection to witnesses, aiming to strengthen public trust in the justice system and resolve more cases of serious crimes.

title: Stöd till våtmarksåtgärder
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1039 av Marcus Wennerström och Inga-Lill Sjöblom (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for constitutional protection of public service media in Sweden to ensure its independence and ability to provide impartial information, maintaining a strong democratic foundation. It asserts that public service plays a crucial role in serving the public interest and should remain free from state and external influences, especially in times of crisis when democracy is vulnerable. The motion emphasizes the importance of a wide-ranging program content to avoid inequalities, as not everyone can afford multiple streaming services, and calls for a broad mandate for public service to continue delivering quality news and entertainment.

title: Bistånd enprocentmålet
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of a comprehensive strategy to support local initiatives and engagement within civil society to improve the health and well-being of the elderly, who face increasing loneliness. It highlights the importance of social connections in preventing mental health issues and suggests that community activities can significantly enhance both mental and physical health among older individuals.

title: Tobaksfri generation 2040
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1037 av Anna Wallentheim och Sofia Skönnbrink (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the marketing of healthcare services, particularly by companies offering telemedicine consultations, should be regulated due to the rise in advertising that contributes to unnecessary healthcare demand and increases public anxiety over common ailments. The motion argues that the current promotional practices complicate the healthcare system and divert attention from patients in need of real medical care, advocating for stricter marketing regulations for these services.

title: Nollvision mot mobbning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports measures to extend the confidentiality of preliminary investigations in criminal cases, particularly to protect witnesses and victims from threats and potential interference until the trial begins. It highlights the risks involved, especially when crimes are committed by criminal networks, and emphasizes the need for legislative review to adapt confidentiality laws accordingly.

title: Tillgänglig och jämlik tandvård
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a state-issued e-identity to ensure secure and reliable identification for individuals, especially during crises when private e-identities may fail. It highlights the growing need for a dependable e-identity system to combat increasing fraud and organized crime related to digital transactions, emphasizing that such a system is crucial for societal infrastructure and safety.

title: Återinförande av estetiska ämnen på gymnasiet
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for Swedish high schools to provide students with knowledge about the Swedish labor market model and rights related to employment. The proposal stems from concerns that students, particularly in vocational programs, feel ill-prepared for the job market and lack understanding of union rights, obligations, and workplace safety issues. It argues that a lack of such knowledge increases the risk of exploitation in the workplace and could negatively impact both individuals and the labor market as a whole. The motion advocates for making labor law education mandatory in high schools to ensure students are better equipped for their future careers.

title: Statligt ansvar vid stora industrietableringar
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1033 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for changes in legislation to enable more accessible support within social services, allowing for simplified assistance assessments in municipalities that choose to adopt this approach. It emphasizes the importance of individualized assessments to ensure quality care, while also promoting the availability of general, easily accessible services to meet various needs such as family support and elderly care. The suggested reform aims to modernize social services and enhance self-determination for individuals by facilitating quick access to necessary support.

title: Rättvis personkretsbedömning
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1032 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act to improve collaboration between various agencies involved in social services, healthcare, and law enforcement. The aim is to allow better sharing of personal information, particularly in cases involving vulnerable individuals such as children, while still ensuring the protection of personal integrity. The motion highlights the challenges posed by current secrecy laws that can hinder necessary interventions for individuals in precarious situations.

title: Fullföljning av satsningen på blåsmusiken
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider investigating the conditions for establishing a protected professional title for childcare workers (barnskötare) to ensure a consistent qualification level in preschools. It emphasizes the need for childcare workers to have pedagogical training at the upper secondary level due to the complexity of working with children's learning and development. The existing situation allows individuals with varying levels of education to hold the title of childcare worker, which could lead to inconsistencies in quality. Therefore, the motion calls for clarity and uniformity in the qualifications required to hold this title.

title: Tydligare beaktande av klimat och miljö i statens offentliga utredningar
summary: The proposal advocates for a legally guaranteed right to childcare during inconvenient working hours, such as evenings, nights, and weekends. It emphasizes the need for accessible and secure childcare options to support parents who work outside of traditional office hours, asserting that the lack of availability forces many parents to rely on family or abandon job opportunities. The motion acknowledges that improved access to childcare can enable both men and women to work full-time, contributing to a sustainable welfare system.

title: Strukturell diskriminering på arbetsmarknaden med särskilt fokus på etnisk bakgrund
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider introducing free work shoes for healthcare personnel, highlighting the importance of proper footwear for the safety and effectiveness of staff in the healthcare sector. The motion builds on the previous fulfillment of a promise to provide free work clothing for elderly care employees, emphasizing the need for equity and improved working conditions.

title: Åtgärder för att motverka problematisk skolfrånvaro
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the law on own accommodation (EBO) to improve integration of immigrants in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for a system that fosters better integration by holding municipalities accountable and introducing stricter requirements, thus promoting equality and participation in society. The aim is to tackle segregation and language barriers while enhancing skills and contributions to the economy.

title: Kommunal vetorätt vid friskoleetableringar
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish Parliament to support the planning and construction of the Ostlänken railway project, emphasizing the need for environmentally sustainable transport infrastructure. It raises concerns about rising costs associated with central stations compared to external ones, arguing that the benefits of central hubs for public transport should be prioritized in decision-making. The motion also highlights the importance of long-term planning, efficient project management, and appropriate training for staff to ensure timely and cost-effective construction.

title: En fungerande och tillgänglig färdtjänst
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations surrounding corporate ownership of medical services, pharmacies, and healthcare centers, emphasizing the need to maintain a separation between medical professionals and profit-making enterprises. It highlights concerns over conflicts of interest when physicians can prescribe medications linked to their own economic interests, which may lead to over-prescription and inappropriate referrals, thereby increasing healthcare costs and risking patient safety. The intention is to adapt existing legislation to address the new business models emerging in the digital healthcare landscape.

title: Permanenta uppehållstillstånd
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1025 av Helén Pettersson och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of a national Öresund agenda aimed at enhancing integration efforts between Sweden and Denmark. It emphasizes the significant economic and social potential of the Öresund region, which has a high concentration of educated individuals and technological innovation. The motion outlines challenges faced in cross-border integration due to regulatory differences, economic barriers, and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. It calls for improved cooperation between the two nations on various matters, including job creation, education, security, and economic growth, while highlighting the importance of addressing cross-border crime more effectively.

title: En sundare och mer hållbar transportbransch
summary: The suggestion proposes a reform of the societal orientation program for newly arrived immigrants in Sweden, emphasizing the need for increased attendance and practical information for integration into society and the labor market. It suggests implementing examinations, increasing the number of hours, and starting the program earlier in the immigration process. The proposal also advocates for making the program mandatory for more groups, creating different courses tailored to various educational backgrounds, establishing a clearer national curriculum, and implementing teacher training for societal communicators to ensure quality education.

title: Återgång till en aktiv politik för statlig närvaro i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1023 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests enhancing trade union consultations regarding labor market interventions, emphasizing the importance of allowing unions to voice their opinions on the Swedish Employment Agency's decisions related to initiatives aimed at integrating the unemployed into the workforce through practices such as internships. It also highlights the need for stronger oversight to prevent employers from exploiting subsidized labor, which could distort competition.

title: Ökad transparens kring fördelningen av länsplanemedel
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1022 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider investigating the feasibility of banning the use of public funds for lobbying activities directed at Swedish decision-makers. It highlights concerns about the misuse of taxpayer money when organizations funded by the state engage in lobbying efforts to influence public policy, creating a potential conflict of interest. The motion advocates for the establishment of regulations similar to those in the UK to ensure responsible handling of taxpayer funds and to prevent interdependencies between lobbying organizations and politicians while allowing the use of private funds for lobbying activities.

title: Inlandsbanan
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1021 av Anna-Caren Sätherberg och Kalle Olsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of allowing compensation for political assignments to be included in the income threshold for dividend distributions under the 3:12 tax rules. This arises from the conflict faced by small business owners who must meet a salary requirement while also receiving public compensation for lost income due to political engagement.

title: Djurförsök inom medicinsk forskning
summary: The motion proposes several measures to combat the rising incidence of sexual offenses in Sweden, including increasing the minimum sentence for normal-grade rape, mandating that all reasonably suspected individuals of sexual crimes be interviewed, and easing the process of expelling non-Swedish citizens who commit such crimes. The motion highlights the alarming rise in reported sexual offenses, particularly among young women, and calls for improvements in investigation procedures to enhance the conviction rate.

title: Incitament för ekonomisk tillväxt i Sveriges kommuner
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag supports the enhancement of property rights in Swedish laws and regulations, highlighting the importance of individual ownership and market-driven progress for societal development. The motion argues that property rights are essential for personal freedom, economic growth, and environmental sustainability, citing historical examples of how strong property rights have driven Swedish prosperity. It expresses concern about recent governmental encroachments on property rights that undermine individual ownership, hinder economic potential, and create bureaucratic obstacles.

title: Ökad polisbemanning på landsbygden
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the training system for chimney sweeps in Sweden, highlighting the impending shortage of qualified professionals due to retirements in the field. The current training program is criticized for its limited capacity and the issue of students enrolling in the program without genuine intent to pursue a career as a chimney sweep, which is impacting the availability of training spots. The motion suggests linking training places to apprenticeship opportunities with employers to better meet labor market needs and ensure a sufficient number of qualified chimney sweeps.

title: Miljöfrämjande grödor för ett hållbart jordbruk
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a readiness tax to finance future military expenditures without compromising welfare services. It argues that increasing defense spending should not detract from the necessary resources for healthcare, education, and social services, especially in the face of challenges such as inflation and a growing demand for welfare assistance. The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining a reliable welfare system alongside a strong defense, advocating for a progressively structured tax to ensure sustainable funding for both sectors.

title: Motorsport och motorhobby
summary: The proposal advocates for a reform of the parental allowance system in Sweden, aiming to individualize the parental insurance to promote gender equality. It emphasizes the need to ensure equal participation between men and women in both parenting and the workforce, addressing the decline in equitable usage of parental leave. The reform is seen as vital for achieving set gender equality goals, combating the wage gap, and fostering an environment where children can spend time with both parents. A clear implementation timeline is suggested to enhance the system's effectiveness and reinforce gender equality in society.

title: Acceptansen för den svenska älgförvaltningen
summary: The proposal advocates for the expansion of infrastructure in the Södertörn region of Stockholm, highlighting its significant economic growth and the anticipated development of housing and jobs by 2030. It emphasizes the need for improved transport systems, including the Tvärförbindelse Södertörn and enhancements to rail and road connections to Stockholm Norvik port, to foster sustainable transport and meet the increasing logistical demands. The suggestion underlines the importance of these projects for traffic safety, economic efficiency, and reduced environmental impact.

title: Kinas behandling av uigurer
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag considers measures to stimulate generational transitions in the housing stock, addressing the issues of limited housing availability and mobility caused by the capital gains tax, which many seniors view as a barrier to moving. The motion highlights that a significant percentage of senior households are deterred from selling their homes due to this tax, suggesting that reducing the tax could facilitate better housing market dynamics.

title: Psykisk misshandel som ny brottsrubricering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider measures to secure daily living for people who require electric wheelchairs or mobility scooters. It highlights the difficulties faced by individuals with disabilities due to a ruling from the Supreme Administrative Court, which affects the availability of housing adaptations for the storage of mobility aids. The motion calls for legislative clarification regarding housing adaptation grants to ensure that those who need wheelchairs can store them safely and conveniently.

title: Vargföryngringar inom renskötselområdet
summary: The proposal aims to combat food waste in Sweden by coordinating efforts between various authorities and stakeholders, establishing clear and measurable targets for reduction, and developing strategic measures for circular food use. The motion emphasizes the importance of both economic savings and environmental protection, advocating for improved utilization of food products and better storage practices. It also highlights the need for education on food management and promotes entrepreneurship focused on sustainable food systems.

title: Acceleration av klimatomställningen
summary: The proposal advocates for the consideration and exploration of a railway link between Uppsala and Enköping, emphasizing the benefits for commuting, environmental sustainability, transportation efficiency, and economic growth. It highlights the potential for reduced travel times, alleviating road traffic, and providing greater access to labor markets, while also underscoring the climate advantages of rail travel compared to bus transportation.

title: Kriminalisering av omvändelseförsök
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1010 av Lawen Redar och Daniel Vencu Velasquez Castro (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider establishing a connection over Lake Mälaren between the municipalities of Håbo and Knivsta, to enhance accessibility and connectivity for the residents. Currently, the absence of a ferry or bridge results in significant travel distances for residents seeking employment, shopping, and healthcare. The suggested connection is expected to improve tourism, reduce commuting times, and support local businesses, thereby promoting environmental sustainability and regional integration.

title: Frige Gui Minhai
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament prioritizes the modernization of the Kinnekullebanan train line between Håkantorp and Herrljunga in its infrastructure planning. It argues that improving this rail line would enhance safety, reduce congestion on the Västra Stambanan, and facilitate better rail connections between Sweden's major cities, Stockholm and Gothenburg. Additionally, the modernization would contribute to the transition to fossil-free transport by allowing for the electrification of the line and improving freight transport efficiency, especially with expected growth in local industry.

title: Trygga rum för alla
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1008 av Daniel Vencu Velasquez Castro (S)
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance the care for women suffering from postpartum psychosis and severe postpartum depression by advocating for specialized mother-and-baby units rather than standard psychiatric care. It suggests a thorough investigation into the rights and access to care for these women and their infants, alongside a directive for the National Board of Health and Welfare to assist regions in developing appropriate treatment strategies. The motion emphasizes the importance of integrating psychiatric and maternity care to ensure the well-being of both mothers and their newborns.

title: Differentiering av skolpengen
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1007 av Gunilla Carlsson och Dzenan Cisija (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates the possibility of allowing girls in preschool and early school stages to be free from wearing veils at school. The authors argue that veils are not a free choice for young girls but tools for indoctrination that sexualize and restrict their freedom. They emphasize the need for schools to promote equality and safeguard children from religious coercion, asserting that a ban on veils is essential to empowering girls to shape their own futures and protecting their right to a carefree childhood.

title: Personer som har förmyndare och utestängs från bank-id
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the consideration of establishing high-speed train connections between Oslo, Gothenburg, and Copenhagen, as part of the EU's TEN-T network. It emphasizes the need for thorough examination of these connections when planning future high-speed rail networks in Sweden, including the potential for double tracks along the route to enhance economic growth and connectivity between major cities in Scandinavia.

title: Fler behöver TBE-vaccination
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1005 av Åsa Westlund och Mathias Tegnér (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for a cultural shift towards sexual liberation in suburban areas of Sweden, emphasizing the need to address issues related to honor-related oppression and the practice of virginity checks, which are seen as symptoms of broader societal problems. It calls for comprehensive sexual education that includes information on reproductive health for both newly arrived immigrants and parents in these areas, aiming to empower women and girls to assert control over their bodies and rights.

title: Orättvisan i karensavdraget
summary: The proposal suggests considering a shorter police training program for individuals with at least three years of relevant academic education in response to the increasing violent crime and insecurity in Sweden. The goal is to strengthen the police force by making it easier for qualified individuals to transition into law enforcement, thereby enhancing the capacity to combat crime. The proposal aims to increase the number of police officers available to address both minor and serious organized crime, while maintaining existing entry requirements for police education.

title: Utökat ansvar för banker vid bedrägerier
summary: The motion proposes clearer regulations and improved oversight regarding the use of overnight accommodations by Swedish parliament members, aiming to prevent misuse of the system as highlighted by recent investigations. It calls for the implementation of administrative checks during applications, clarification of eligibility rules, and the introduction of penalties for members found to be abusing these accommodations, including a requirement to repay any misallocated benefits and pay a punitive fee.

title: Rätt till tolk inom hälso- och sjukvården
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1002 av Helén Pettersson och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of restricting the usage of funds from the welfare system to ensure they are spent on essential goods such as housing, food, and hygiene products, rather than on items deemed inappropriate, such as drugs, alcohol, and overseas transfers for individuals not connected to Sweden. The aim is to ensure that welfare funds are utilized solely for their intended purposes to support recipients' basic needs and maintain societal welfare.

title: Lex Winefinder
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1001 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament urges the government to develop regulations that require mobile and telecom operators to cooperate with law enforcement agencies during criminal investigations, while also ensuring that compensation for such collaboration is reasonable. The aim is to simplify the access to crucial data, such as call logs and location tracking, which are often hindered by high costs and reluctance from the operators. By making cooperation mandatory, the motion seeks to improve the effectiveness of criminal investigations.

title: Militär mobilitet genom Jämtlands län
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:1000 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for the inclusion of 'political opinion' as a ground for discrimination in Swedish discrimination legislation, arguing that it aligns with both the UN and European human rights conventions that prohibit discrimination based on political beliefs. The motion highlights instances of increasing discrimination in Sweden based on political views, suggesting that current legislation fails to protect individuals from such discrimination in various professional contexts.

title: Närmare samarbete för ett starkare Norden
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:999 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of providing expanded and predictable operational support to non-state-owned airports. It emphasizes the importance of air transport in Sweden due to its large and sparsely populated geography, highlighting that the state previously held greater responsibility for maintaining airport infrastructure. The motion criticizes the current situation where many airports are owned by reluctant municipalities and argues for the necessity of effective state financial support to ensure a functioning air transport system for the entire country.

title: Levande samhällen genom boplikt
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:998 av Anna-Caren Sätherberg och Kalle Olsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider an investigation into the possibility of anonymizing the names and personal details of healthcare staff in patient records accessible to individual patients. This is motivated by increasing concerns for the security of healthcare professionals, as there have been instances of patients confronting staff outside their workplace about treatment decisions. The motion argues that while healthcare providers need access to this information for operational reasons, patients should not have direct access to the identifiers of the personnel involved in their care.

title: Införandet av differentierad alkoholskatt i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes the reinstatement of national emergency stockpiles in Sweden for protective gear, medical supplies, strategic medicines, food, and fuel, to better prepare for future crises like pandemics or conflicts. The motion highlights the inadequacies experienced during the COVID-19 pandemic, arguing that a centralized state responsibility is necessary to ensure equitable distribution and secure resources for Swedish citizens during emergencies.

title: Grön samhällsomställning
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government officially recognize electrical hypersensitivity as a disability and ensure that affected individuals receive necessary support and accommodations. The motion highlights the challenges faced by those affected, including the need for radiation-free environments in healthcare settings and the societal impact of electromagnetic radiation. It references previous governmental affirmations and international resolutions advocating for the rights and recognition of those with disabilities due to electrical hypersensitivity.

title: Ett modernt och demokratiskt statsskick
summary: The proposal advocates for a clearer mandate for primary healthcare to focus on preventive health initiatives, emphasizing the importance of lifestyle changes to reduce the risk of diseases such as cancer. It highlights successful preventative health projects in Västerbotten that have led to improved public health outcomes and cost savings in the healthcare system. The motion calls for amending the health and medical care law to explicitly define the responsibilities of primary care in preventive health work.

title: Ett stopp för mäns våld mot kvinnor och barn
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations and compensation for civil officiants appointed by county administrative boards in Sweden. The increasing demand for civil officiants requires improved accessibility and recognition of the responsibilities involved. The current compensation for officiants has not changed in 30 years, leading to disparities and complexity in their roles. The motion calls for the government to initiate a new investigation into these issues.

title: Åtgärder för det samiska folket
summary: This proposal seeks to enhance knowledge and research regarding the rare condition sexsomnia and its implications for how law enforcement and the judiciary handle cases involving this condition in relation to sexual offenses. The motion highlights the increasing use of sexsomnia as a defense in sexual assault cases, raising concerns about the lack of understanding and research in this area. The authors emphasize that the responsibility for actions lies with the perpetrators, regardless of their state during the offense, and argue for a targeted initiative to prevent potential victimization of women and children.

title: Riksdagsledamöternas arvoden och villkor
summary: The motion proposes a series of legislative measures aimed at improving the situation for women living under protected identities in Sweden, including establishing a government inquiry to enhance legal protections, addressing economic challenges they face, enabling them to apply for contact bans independently, modifying laws to prevent the disclosure of their identities due to public access laws, and ensuring that past domestic violence convictions are considered in custody decisions. The overall aim is to provide these women with a safer life free from the fear of their identities being revealed or their safety being compromised.

title: Vardag fri från skadliga kemikalier
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:991 av Andrea Andersson Tay m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament appoints an investigator with a clear mandate to review and update the legislation aimed at limiting the spread of violent pornographic material online. It highlights concerns regarding children's exposure to violent pornography and its impact on their health and perceptions of sexuality, asserting that current laws are outdated in the context of digital access. The motion emphasizes the need for legislative action to protect children and advocates for information campaigns to raise awareness on this issue.

title: Systemfelen i den svenska skolan
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of software to detect and prevent the handling, distribution, or downloading of child pornography classified as sexual abuse material on public sector IT environments in Sweden. It emphasizes the urgent need for public organizations to improve their procedures for addressing child pornography crimes and deploy detection tools as a means to protect children and support law enforcement in prosecuting offenders.

title: Handelspolitik
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:989 av Lorena Delgado Varas m.fl. (V)
summary: The suggestion advocates for the investigation of a support scheme, termed 'freedom capital', aimed at individuals experiencing domestic violence. This would provide financial assistance to help them leave abusive relationships while maintaining economic stability. The proposal emphasizes the importance of economic freedom for achieving gender equality and addresses the financial disparities faced by women, highlighting the need for secure savings to facilitate independence from violent relationships.

title: Kulturarvet
summary: The suggestion proposes to expand the authority of various functions to identify victims of human trafficking in Sweden and grant them a reflection period of 30 days, as stipulated by the Council of Europe’s Convention against Trafficking in Human Beings. The current law limits this right to victims who are involved in legal investigations, which discourages many victims from coming forward. By establishing a legal basis for the reflection period and allowing more professionals, such as regional coordinators, doctors, and psychologists, to initiate it, the proposal aims to enhance protection and support for victims, ultimately facilitating their potential cooperation in legal processes against traffickers.

title: Idrott, friluftsliv och civilsamhälle
summary: Rickard Nordin from the Centre Party proposes the introduction of margin taxation on digital goods and services to align their tax treatment with physical products, thereby preventing double taxation and reducing issues such as black market activity and fraud in private transactions. The proposal aims to modernize the tax legislation in line with the increasingly digital economy.

title: Svensk flyktingpolitik
summary: The motion proposes improvements for individuals requiring guide or assistance dogs in Sweden, urging the government to expand the mission of the Equality Ombudsman to include broader public awareness and prevention of discrimination against these individuals. It highlights the current challenges faced by users of guide and assistance dogs, including access restrictions in various environments where their dogs should be recognized as essential aids rather than pets. The motion also suggests a comparative study with neighboring Nordic countries to understand the lower prevalence of guide dog partnerships in Sweden and to investigate the reasons behind the lack of legal cases related to discrimination in this area.

title: Små systembolag
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of gender equality as a cornerstone for sustainable development in Sweden. It calls for a comprehensive investigation into the costs of inequality, the strengthening of gender budgeting and equal opportunities in education, as well as the implementation of supportive measures for victims of domestic violence and gender-related crimes. It also advocates for various initiatives aimed at improving the safety and educational environment for children and youth, while addressing economic disparities and enhancing women's participation in the workforce.

title: Förlängda öppettider på Systembolaget
summary: The motion proposes various measures to enhance the vitality of rural Sweden, including tax reductions for rural jobs and businesses, support for labor immigration, simplifying regulations, increasing access to risk capital, and promoting sustainable agricultural practices. It also calls for measures to enhance the public procurement process, boost biogas production, and leverage forest resources for carbon storage and job creation. Furthermore, it advocates for reforms in hunting management, fishing regulation, and support for local producers. The motion emphasizes the need for infrastructure improvements, enhanced local autonomy, improved public services, and initiatives to bridge the urban-rural divide in access to healthcare, education, and safety, ultimately aiming for a more equitable and thriving rural environment.

title: Kostnadsutjämning med hänsyn till urbana problem
summary: The motion addresses the significant increase in the cormorant population along the Swedish coast, now estimated at around 200,000, and its detrimental effects on local fish stocks and sustainable fishing practices. The proposal urges the parliament to take decisive actions to reduce the cormorant population to alleviate the pressure on coastal fisheries, which are struggling for survival against larger, unsustainable fishing operations. It highlights the urgent need for regulatory changes, particularly in light of the inadequacy of existing protections and slow response in addressing the ecological impact caused by the cormorants.

title: Återinförande av riksdagens öppnande i Rikssalen
summary: The proposal advocates for a parliamentary investigation into the legalization and regulation of assisted dying in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of individuals having the right to choose how to end their lives, particularly in cases of unbearable suffering with no prospect of recovery. The motion argues that Sweden should consider models from countries like Belgium and the Netherlands, which allow for assisted dying under specific conditions, to ensure that citizens are not forced to seek this option abroad.

title: Avskaffande av straffrabatten
summary: The motion proposes to enhance environmental information in nautical maps for recreational boaters to protect sensitive marine ecosystems. It highlights the absence of marked sensitive bottom areas, which are crucial for marine life, and suggests that the government instruct relevant authorities to provide accessible information to boaters through improved charting, both in print and digital formats.

title: Stopp för villkorlig frigivning för de som återgår till brott
summary: Kerstin Lundgren's proposal addresses the need to strengthen and secure the E4/E20 connections through Södertälje by advocating for the construction of a motorway tunnel under the Södertälje canal. The motion highlights the current vulnerabilities of the infrastructure, particularly the risks associated with accidents and potential disruptions that affect trade and daily traffic. The proposal calls for a reassessment of the strategic infrastructure planning and emphasizes the importance of developing a sustainable transportation network in the Stockholm region.

title: Stärkt trafiksäkerhet för mopedister som kör klass 1-moped
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the construction of wildlife fencing on the most accident-prone roads in Kalmar County, where wildlife accidents have significantly increased, particularly involving deer and wild boars. The authors argue that implementing such fencing is a cost-effective solution to reduce wildlife-related accidents and the associated societal costs. They urge the government to assign this priority to the Swedish Transport Administration.

title: Lärlingsplatser som leder till yrkesexamen
summary: The proposal aims to enhance traffic safety on the Öland Bridge and advocates for the planning of a new bridge or tunnel connecting the mainland to Öland. It highlights the increased risk of accidents on the existing bridge due to growing traffic volumes and higher speeds since its construction in 1972. The motion calls for an investigation into safety improvements and the initiation of construction plans for alternative crossings to ensure the safety of all road users.

title: Sverige som ett samlat elprisområde
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the transition to open source software and open standards within the public sector and communicates this to the government. It emphasizes the benefits of such a transition, including potential cost savings, improved software reliability, and increased user influence. The motion acknowledges the current dependencies on specific providers and licensing agreements as significant barriers to this change, highlighting the need for a principled decision for a gradual shift towards open solutions.

title: Mer häst åt fler
summary: The motion proposes simplifying the regulations governing the use of metal detectors in Sweden, arguing that current restrictions hinder hobbyists from effectively contributing to the preservation of cultural heritage. The authors suggest that the existing regulatory framework is overly strict and counterproductive, as it limits the ability of individuals to find and recover historical artifacts that are at risk of deterioration. They advocate for a reform that aligns better with the goal of protecting and caring for the nation's cultural environment.

title: Värdet av vattenkraftsproduktion
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the evaluation of conditions for establishing ferry traffic between Oskarshamn and Byxelkrok as part of the infrastructure planning. The authors argue that the ferry service, which currently operates only in summer with financial support from local municipalities, would alleviate traffic on the Ölandsbron, which is under significant strain during peak tourist seasons. Additionally, expanded ferry services year-round would enhance commuting options for residents of northern Öland to work in Oskarshamn, potentially fostering local economic growth.

title: För fler veterinärer i Sverige
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support the upgrading of the Stångådalsbanan and Tjustbanan railways and to investigate the feasibility of a new southeast coastal railway. It emphasizes the importance of these rail connections for enhancing regional labor markets, improving commuting opportunities, and addressing the underinvestment in rural infrastructure compared to urban areas. The initiators highlight the socio-economic challenges faced by communities in Kalmar and Östergötland counties due to inadequate rail infrastructure, advocating for immediate government attention to reverse the trend of population decline and improve connectivity.

title: Möjligheter för betald polisutbildning
summary: The proposal advocates for expanding transparency requirements regarding the financing of political parties to include local and regional parties, arguing that increased openness is essential for democracy and citizen oversight. It highlights the inadequacy of current legislation, which only applies at the national level, and emphasizes the need for an investigation to enhance transparency in party financing.

title: Hemvärnets militärhistoriska arv
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive review of the municipal equalization system in Sweden, emphasizing the need to address existing deficiencies and ensure a guaranteed service level across the country. The motion seeks to create incentives for entrepreneurship, job creation, and growth while considering the challenges faced by sparsely populated areas. It suggests that the current tax disparities among municipalities reflect an imbalance in service quality and calls for a reformation to enhance equity and sustainability in local governance.

title: Blekinges och Sveriges skogsnäring
summary: The motion advocates for a regulatory framework ensuring that all relevant public information for citizens is published in easy-to-read Swedish. Emphasizing accessibility as a vital political goal, the proposal highlights that the right to participate in democratic discourse must include everyone, particularly individuals with intellectual disabilities and new Swedes with different mother tongues. It calls for clearer and stronger requirements for easy-to-read text in public documents, ensuring that such information is readily accessible and prominent.

title: En begränsning av strandskyddet för fler bostäder vid vatten
summary: The proposal advocates for the extension of the 'rutavdrag' tax deduction to include all purchased household services from certified providers, aiming to simplify taxation and encourage growth in the service sector. The proponents argue that this extension would help create jobs, convert informal work into formal employment, and stimulate economic activity by allowing for more flexible service offerings aligned with consumer needs.

title: Satsningar på infrastrukturen i Blekinge ger nytta för näringslivet i hela Sverige
summary: The motion proposes the initiation of a national program aimed at improving the health and well-being of children and adolescents in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for increased physical activity and healthier eating habits, particularly addressing issues like obesity and mental health challenges facing youth today. The program is intended to complement existing efforts in schools and sports organizations while reaching out to specific groups in need.

title: Tidigareläggning av byggandet av Sydostlänken
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament modernize the electricity legislation (ellagen) to address the evolving energy landscape characterized by increased competition, the integration of renewable energy sources, and the need for energy storage solutions. The motion suggests that an investigation should be initiated to comprehensively rewrite the electricity law to better reflect the current state and future needs of the energy system in Sweden and its integration with the European electricity market.

title: Kommuner behöver få klara och tydliga möjligheter att bilda kommunala lantmäterier
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate a model to create lower barriers to the housing market, ensuring comparable conditions for different forms of tenancy. It highlights the importance of adequate housing as a basic human need and argues for a unified housing policy that reduces disparities between rental and ownership pathways, thus increasing individual freedom and addressing the housing shortage in Sweden.

title: Gårdsförsäljning av alkoholhaltiga drycker
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of a national security-oriented doctrine aimed at enhancing the use of domestic resources in energy and food supply in Sweden. It highlights the vulnerabilities arising from dependence on foreign energy and food imports, particularly in light of geopolitical tensions exemplified by Russia's actions. The motion emphasizes the need for a self-sufficient energy system that utilizes domestic renewable sources and promotes local food production to mitigate risks associated with external dependencies.

title: Förbud mot och kriminalisering av oskuldsoperationer och oskuldskontroller
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate an investigation to suggest measures aimed at reducing the presence of invasive animal species in nature, particularly addressing issues related to wild boars and Canadian geese that are damaging both residential areas and agricultural production.

title: Sveriges globala röst
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the implementation of recommendations from SOU 2021:60 to modernize and simplify bookkeeping and receipt handling for businesses, allowing for the disposal of paper receipts if they have been digitized. The authors argue that this change would significantly benefit both large and small enterprises in Sweden, which have progressed in digital receipt management, unlike the authorities. They highlight that similar measures have already been adopted in Norway and Finland, suggesting a need for Sweden to adapt its legislation to contemporary business practices.

title: Självbestämmande i livets slutskede – översyn av förutsättningarna för aktiv dödshjälp
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:963 av Janine Alm Ericson och Annika Hirvonen (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the requirement that tenants must consistently engage in VAT-liable activities when renting properties. This change aims to alleviate the difficulties faced by non-profit organizations, especially sports associations, in securing rental spaces due to the complexities of VAT regulations, which can result in financial burdens and even bankruptcy for these entities. The motion highlights the pressing need for more accessible sports facilities and suggests that the parliament can remove this requirement, enabling a broader range of users to access rental properties.

title: Förädling av proteingrödor
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:962 av Emma Berginger och Emma Nohrén (båda MP)
summary: The proposal suggests that the process for appealing decisions regarding detailed plans should not exceed 10 weeks. It highlights the importance of safeguarding the right to appeal while recognizing that lengthy appeals can obstruct various construction projects, leading to significant cost increases. The motion aims to expedite the appeal process to be in line with the existing 10-week timeframe for local municipalities handling building permits.

title: Cyklande på lika villkor
summary: The proposal emphasizes the crucial role of municipalities in local crime prevention efforts and advocates for a legal framework to formalize this responsibility. It calls for municipalities to coordinate and lead crime prevention initiatives, provide support for crime victims, and engage with local communities to combat organized crime effectively. The motion highlights the need for stronger legislative measures to clarify municipal duties and integrate support mechanisms for crime victims.

title: Flyget i en ohållbar tid
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the EBO law, citing its negative impact on newcomers who have faced exploitation by unscrupulous landlords, contributing to a black rental market and increased segregation. The motion argues that recent changes to the EBO legislation were insufficient and calls for a national approach to ensure adequate housing distribution for newcomers across the country.

title: Fordonsintegrerat körkort
summary: The proposal advocates for the immediate legalization of farm sales of alcoholic beverages in Sweden, following a recent investigation that explored the implementation of such sales. The motion highlights the challenges that small breweries and alcohol producers faced during the pandemic and suggests that allowing direct sales could enhance the tourism sector and rural areas. It draws inspiration from neighboring countries like Finland, which have successfully adopted farm sales, and argues that more sales outlets would not necessarily lead to increased consumption or jeopardize the existing retail system.

title: Kamerabevakning av kollektivtrafikkörfält
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support measures to expand and disseminate animal care education, specifically by establishing new programs in locations such as Umeå and Skara. It highlights the increasing need for trained animal caregivers due to the growing pet population and significant deficits in veterinary and animal nursing professionals. The motion urges the government to enhance the availability of training opportunities to meet this rising demand.

title: För bättre och enklare kollektivtrafik
summary: The motion from Kerstin Lundgren advocates for reforms in the management of large predators in Sweden, emphasizing that private livestock owners should not bear the financial burdens of government decisions regarding predator conservation. It calls for the establishment of a system where costs associated with predator management are fairly distributed among taxpayers, as well as for a decentralized viltförvaltning (wildlife management) that empowers local decision-making. The motion also stresses the need for a new wildlife authority to oversee these issues.

title: Stärkta rättigheter för arbetskraftsinvandrare
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Riksdag to ensure that the AP funds do not invest in companies that lobby for fossil fuels. The motion emphasizes the necessity of transitioning from fossil to renewable energy sources to combat climate change and stresses that the handling of pension funds significantly affects both market behavior and environmental outcomes. It argues for strict adherence to sustainability principles and urges the inclusion of the Seventh AP Fund under these regulations, in light of increasing climate lobbying against transitions to renewables.

title: Stärkta rättigheter för flyktingar från Ukraina
summary: The proposal emphasizes the necessity of enhanced digitalization within Sweden to improve interactions between agricultural industries and authorities, making public services digitally accessible, and ensuring a robust digital infrastructure for all citizens. It advocates for comprehensive digitalization in public services, better access to data while safeguarding privacy, updated legislation for a digital economy, the importance of lifelong learning and innovation support, and the government's leading role in establishing standards and structured data practices.

title: Vård efter behov med svensk kontroll
summary: The motion proposes that the collaboration between traffic police and trained vehicle inspectors should be increased to enhance traffic monitoring and ensure compliance with transport regulations. With the growing number of vehicles and transport activities, it emphasizes the need for specialized knowledge in assessing cargo loading, reading tachographs, and conducting inspections, especially as the number of traffic police has decreased. The motion advocates for utilizing specially trained inspectors to conduct these checks, allowing traffic police to focus on other responsibilities while improving the efficiency of road controls.

title: Framtidens krav på jämställdhet – en kommission för förändring
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive evaluation and planning process for the expansion of renewable energy in Sweden, emphasizing early involvement of local governments and fair compensation for landowners impacted by infrastructure projects. It argues for a balanced assessment of climate benefits versus other national interests, and highlights the need for coordinated regional and national infrastructure planning to facilitate a sustainable energy transition.

title: Demokratiutveckling och fattigdomsbekämpning
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:952 av Björn Wiechel och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should initiate an investigation into how existing revenues, particularly from environmental fees or sanctions, can be redistributed to support the cleanup of old, environmentally harmful industrial buildings that currently lack responsible ownership for their maintenance. The aim is to facilitate the demolition and restoration of these sites, promoting environmental health and the potential for new developments.

title: Jämlik transplantationsvård i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:951 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: Martina Johansson (C) proposes that the Swedish government direct Trafikverket to prioritize the development and maintenance of bicycle paths in rural areas. The motion highlights the importance of improving traffic safety for cyclists, particularly as road infrastructure evolves to favor vehicles. The intention is to promote cycling as a cost-effective and environmentally friendly mode of transportation, especially in light of rising fuel costs, while contributing to public health and reducing fossil fuel emissions.

title: Begränsning av cyberbedrägerier
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:950 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government initiate an investigation into allowing differentiated water tariffs based on consumption levels. This is in response to increasing water scarcity in certain municipalities, where restrictions on outdoor watering have been implemented. The author argues that those who consume excessive amounts of water for non-essential uses, such as gardening or filling pools, should pay higher rates compared to those using water for basic necessities like cooking and cleaning. The aim is to encourage responsible water use and help fund necessary infrastructure to support water supply.

title: Barnomsorg på obekväm arbetstid
motion_id: Motion 2023/24:949 av Teresa Carvalho och Johanna Haraldsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that Swedish authorities should review all required permits for businesses, aiming to simplify the application process and reduce administrative burdens, especially for small enterprises. It suggests appointing a coordinator to work with businesses on legislative requirements and exploring differentiated permit requirements based on company size and age. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the need for support and guidance from authorities during applications and inspections to foster better relations and streamline processes.

title: Investeringar och kompetensförsörjning i Västsverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates the National Board of Health and Welfare to develop guidelines for the use of chemotherapy and other high-risk medications at home, emphasizing the need for safe administration to children with cancer. It highlights the current issues of improper dosage and risks to parents when handling medications due to the cessation of customized medication forms by Apoteket Produktion och Laboratorier, which has led to children receiving standard pills instead of more suitable liquid forms.

title: Omlokalisering av statliga arbetstillfällen till Gävleborg
summary: This motion proposes several changes to support the tourism industry in Sweden by advocating for local decisions regarding shore protection, allowing farms to sell products produced on-site, introducing more flexible employment contracts, and calling for an investigation into differentiating regulations based on company size. The intent is to simplify procedures and facilitate growth for businesses in the sector, thereby enhancing tourism and employment opportunities.

title: Begränsning av bankernas räntenettomarginaler
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate how to make delegation processes in healthcare more effective, highlighting the currently problematic personal nature of delegations that ceases when the delegating physician leaves their position. The aim is to ensure that trained healthcare professionals, like nurses, can continue exercising their delegated authority without requiring the delegating physician's presence, thereby improving healthcare delivery and reducing administrative burdens.

title: Bankskatt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports allowing school authorities to purchase pedagogical services and to expand the subjects eligible for remote teaching. The aim is to ensure that every child has a safe education and can achieve passing grades, especially in subjects with limited qualified teachers. By enabling school authorities to hire external teaching staff and increasing the availability of remote education in more subjects, the proposal seeks to enhance the quality of education for students across different schools.

title: Statligt försäkringsskydd till utsatta trossamfund
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should support the investigation into how municipalities can develop a tourism overview plan (TÖP).
