The strategy aims to establish goals and directions for societal efforts in the ANDTS area, emphasizing coordination, prevention, and integrated actions against related issues, including addiction and associated health risks. It incorporates objectives such as reducing access to harmful substances and protecting children and youth from adverse effects, with a commitment to a drug-free society and minimizing drug-related deaths, while addressing inequalities and enhancing cooperation among authorities.

title: Central rättning av nationella prov i skolan
summary: The government proposes legislative amendments aimed at strengthening the rights of crime victims to compensation. The changes include increased levels of compensation for violations, extending the right to compensation for police and other emergency workers, introducing a new form of compensation for surviving relatives, expanding the options for enforcement of compensation claims in favor of victims, and prioritizing claims for damages due to crimes over other unsecured claims during wage garnishment. The amendments are intended to better support victims and reduce the impacts of crime.

title: Ta bort flygskatten för ökad sysselsättning och företagande
summary: The government proposes changes to transparency regulations concerning energy taxation in order to comply with updated EU requirements. The adjustments would expand the data reporting obligations for beneficiaries of tax reductions, particularly for companies in the agricultural and forestry sectors, including details about primary agricultural production. Additionally, new conditions for tax refunds on fuel and electricity are introduced, requiring reporting of beneficiary information for refunds exceeding 15,000 euros per beneficiary within a calendar year. These changes aim to ensure compliance with European Commission rules and are set to take effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Översyn av kemikalieskatten
summary: The proposal aims to establish a new objective for the Sixth AP Fund's investment activities to ensure responsible management through sustainable investments without compromising the overarching goal of high long-term returns. It encourages collaboration between the Sixth and the First to Fourth AP Funds to harmonize reporting on how this responsible management goal is achieved.

title: Kommunernas hantering av övergivna hus
summary: The proposal aims to enhance the effectiveness of the criminal justice system by granting the Swedish Prison and Probation Service the authority to initiate evaluations for converting prison sentences to electronic monitoring with ankle bracelets. This is intended to ensure that such measures meet societal protection standards, reduce the risk of reoffending, and safeguard victims. The proposal includes provisions for issuing specific restrictions on the convicted individuals regarding their movement and utilizes electronic tools for monitoring compliance.

title: Sveriges vattenförbrukning
summary: The Swedish government proposes a tightening of the laws regarding offenses against grave violations by introducing a differentiated punishment scale for serious offenses. The new law classifies offenses as 'grave violations' and 'serious grave violations', with penalties ranging from six months to four years of imprisonment. It also aims to criminalize attempts to commit such offenses, as well as preparations or conspiracies to commit serious grave violations, reflecting a stronger societal stance against these crimes.

title: Stopp för offentliga böneutrop
summary: The government's proposal aims to modernize and strengthen criminal protection against home invasion and unlawful entry. Key changes include a clarification that unlawful entry applies to yards, an increase in maximum penalties for normal offenses from fines to up to one year of imprisonment, and the establishment of new classifications for serious offenses which will carry more severe sentences. Additionally, attempts, preparations, and conspiracies to commit serious home invasion and unlawful entry are proposed to be criminalized.

title: Rättvisa i straffrätten
summary: The proposal suggests new legislation that empowers the Swedish Prison and Probation Service to implement control and support measures for individuals on conditional release or under protective supervision. This includes the ability to temporarily detain those who violate the conditions of their release or supervision. The intention is to quickly address misconduct to minimize the risk of reoffending and assist in societal reintegration, with a review of detention decisions required within 24 hours by the supervisory board.

title: Bekämpning av terrorism
summary: The government proposes to tighten penalties for knife offenses in Sweden, raising the maximum sentence for intentional knife crimes from six months to one year in prison. Additionally, a new penalty scale is introduced for negligent knife offenses, which may include fines or up to six months of imprisonment. The proposed changes also adjust the penalties for aggravated knife offenses, increasing the minimum sentence from zero to six months and the maximum from one year to two years. The proposal includes specific circumstances to consider when determining the severity of a knife crime, broadening the scope of applicable law.

title: Bistånd via ideella föreningar
summary: The Swedish government's communication to the parliament addresses the conclusions and recommendations from the National Audit Office's report on the Residence Act, which was established to accelerate and evenly distribute the reception of newly arrived immigrants across municipalities. The government agrees that the aims of the reform have largely been met, highlighted by shorter waiting times and increased employment levels of immigrants, particularly in municipalities with lower unemployment. Additionally, the report suggests improvements, including the systematic collection of newcomers' professional backgrounds and allowing the Migration Agency to consider the best interests of the child when assigning municipalities for settlement, even beyond their prescribed quotas.

title: En flytt av Sveriges ambassad till Jerusalem
summary: The proposal aims to combat fraud in driving tests and illegal training activities in the transport sector by allowing the government to issue regulations for suspending individuals from driving tests and increasing penalties for illegal educational practices. It also mandates that individuals learning to drive must carry identification during practice sessions, with non-compliance subject to penalties. The proposal is intended to enhance road safety and regulate the transport education sector more effectively.

title: Regelverk för stiftelser och premie- och stipendiefonder
summary: The Swedish government proposes additional legislation to enhance the protection of children in international family matters, particularly in the context of cross-border custody disputes. The legislation aims to improve legal certainty for parents and children involved in such disputes, ensuring that court orders regarding parental responsibility are directly enforceable across EU member states. The proposal includes provisions for better communication between national authorities and mandates that children be allowed to express their opinions in accordance with their age and maturity.

title: Kommunala ordningsvakter
summary: The Swedish government proposes the implementation of equal, inclusive, and appropriate parental regulations for international situations, aimed at ensuring the best interests of the child. The proposal advocates for a new presumption of parenthood recognizing women married to or in partnerships with the child's mother as legal parents under certain conditions. Furthermore, it includes the recognition of foreign court decisions regarding parenthood in Sweden, enhancing equality among parents in same-sex and opposite-sex relationships. The changes are intended to adapt to the evolving definitions of family and parenthood within society, promoting a stable family environment for all children.

title: Ökning av stödet till Ukraina
summary: The government proposes legislative amendments aimed at strengthening the legal process and increasing prosecutions. Key measures include providing reduced sentences for individuals aiding in investigations, enhancing penalties for false accusations, ensuring confidentiality for individuals participating in court proceedings, and imposing stricter penalties for offenses like overreach in legal actions and severe perjury. These changes are suggested to foster greater willingness among witnesses to come forward and to support the effectiveness of the criminal justice system.

title: Utbildning för taxiförarlegitimation
summary: The government proposes amendments to the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act to ensure that information about sound suppressors remains confidential, clarifying the secrecy provisions. These changes are intended to prevent sound suppressors from being misused along with firearms and ammunition, reinforcing the existing legal framework while maintaining public safety. The proposed changes are scheduled to take effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Balkankonferens för handel och försoning
summary: The government proposes an amendment to the Planning and Building Act to enable regional physical planning in Halland County, to improve community planning. This follows similar provisions already in place for Stockholm and Skåne counties, defining the responsibilities of the region in addressing significant environmental issues over multiple municipalities. The proposed changes are to take effect from January 1, 2023, with a requirement for Halland to adopt a regional plan by December 31, 2026.

title: Översyn av möjligheten att införa ungdomskörkort
summary: The proposal aims to combat crime by mandating the registration of prepaid mobile phone cards, which are frequently used in criminal activities. It requires service providers to record subscriber information and verify identities before access to the service is granted. Additionally, it proposes changes to improve the regulations for disclosing electronic communication data to law enforcement, ensuring timely and clear access to necessary information. These measures are intended to enhance the capabilities of law enforcement agencies in their crime-fighting efforts.

title: Ökat handelsutbyte med Kosovo
summary: The proposed legislation seeks to eliminate afterlife support payments for children who are cared for or housed in foster homes or public institutions, arguing that their basic needs are adequately met by public provisions. Additionally, it mandates local authorities to report such cases to the relevant national insurance and pension agencies and clarifies the assessment of work capacity for temporary employees in sickness benefit cases.

title: Längre lastbilar
summary: The government proposes to raise the age limits related to pensions and corresponding welfare systems by one year in 2023, with future adjustments linked to the retirement age starting in 2026. Additionally, correspondingly, age limits in the tax and social contribution systems will also be increased. The proposed legal changes are set to take effect in December 2022 and January 2023 for the pension-related systems, and from December 2025 and January 2026 for the tax-related systems.

title: Möjligheterna att sälja fler statliga bolag
summary: The proposal suggests an increase in the housing allowance for pensioners, raising the consumption support by 200 SEK for unmarried pensioners and 100 SEK for married pensioners. Additionally, it proposes an increase in the minimum amount used for determining fees under the Social Services Act. The changes aim to improve the financial support for pensioners and are set to take effect from August 1, 2022.

title: Upprustning av Inlandsbanan och Kinnekullebanan
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1799 av Magnus Jacobsson och Mathias Bengtsson (båda KD)
summary: The proposal focuses on improving the premium pension system by establishing goals and ensuring a reliable choice environment for pension savers. It introduces a regulatory framework for a procured fund platform that allows pension savers to choose how their funds are invested. Additionally, it proposes the creation of a new authority called the Fondtorgsnämnden, which will manage the fund platform and oversee the procurement of funds, with the suggested reforms set to take effect on June 1, 2022.

title: Underlättande av kommuners medfinansiering av infrastrukturprojekt
summary: The proposal includes a reformed labor law aimed at increasing flexibility, adaptability, and security within the labor market. Key changes involve ensuring terminations by employers are based on substantial reasons, expanding the ability to deviate from employment protection laws via collective agreements, and introducing a new transitional study support program designed to enhance adults' future prospects in the labor market. Additionally, it establishes a basic public transition and competence support for individuals and compensation to employers who fund registered transition organizations.

title: Järnvägarna i Fyrbodal
summary: The proposal aims to implement the EU directive (EU) 2019/1158, focused on achieving a work-life balance for parents and caregivers. It suggests amendments to various laws, including the social insurance code, to reserve 90 days of parental leave for one parent, establish rights for flexible working arrangements for parents and workers caring for relatives, and strengthen protections against discrimination and retaliation in the workplace. The changes are scheduled to take effect starting August 2, 2022.

title: Vägnätet i Fyrbodal
summary: The Swedish government proposes legislative changes aimed at modernizing consumer protection laws in response to EU directives. This includes requirements for clear identification of businesses on online marketplaces, transparent ranking criteria for products, and disclosure of previous prices when a product is advertised as discounted. Additional provisions aim to enhance consumer rights in distance contracts and enable stricter penalties for businesses that violate consumer protection regulations. The proposed changes are set to take effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Enskilda vägar
summary: The government proposes changes to the tax deduction for benefit values of environmentally friendly cars, introducing a standardized reduction based on the car's environmental technology. The proposed reductions are significant, with up to 350,000 SEK for electric and hydrogen cars, and aim to promote low-emission vehicles by excluding hybrids and ethanol cars from the benefits. The changes are intended to simplify the current system, making it more predictable and transparent for companies and reducing administrative burdens.

title: Infrastrukturen i östra Stockholm
summary: The Swedish government proposes a new law to enhance the exchange of information about criminal convictions across EU member states regarding third-country nationals (Ecris-TCN). This includes amendments to several existing laws to align with EU regulations, enabling more effective access to criminal records and compliance with directives that govern information sharing among member states. The government also proposes the establishment of conditions under which other countries may share information about crimes.

title: Infrastruktur på västkusten
summary: The Swedish government proposes amendments to strengthen the legal protections for purchasers and owners of tenant-owner apartments (bostadsrätter). The measures aim to ensure better information provision regarding pre-sale agreements, establish a mandatory reflection period, limit the time frame for lease commencement, require specific entry dates in lease agreements, enhance the financial planning and oversight of housing associations, and enforce equal voting rights among members of these associations.

title: Elkrisens påverkan på Skåne
summary: The Swedish government's communication details Sweden's chairmanship of the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) during 2021, outlining its activities, priorities, and the challenges faced in promoting European security and addressing ongoing conflicts. The document emphasizes Sweden's commitment to core OSCE principles, including respect for human rights and cooperation in resolving regional crises, and highlights significant meetings and decisions made, particularly during the ministerial council held in Stockholm.

title: Fast förbindelse mellan Helsingborg och Helsingör
summary: The proposal includes supplementary provisions to the EU regulation on recovery and resolution of central counterparties, designating the National Debt Office as the resolution authority and allowing the government certain functions under the regulation. It introduces temporary state support measures for central counterparties and outlines procedures for intervention against central counterparties and their management if they violate obligations. The proposal necessitates amendments to several laws, effective from August 12, 2022.

title: En starkare livsmedelsstrategi
summary: The government proposes legislation to increase the differentiation of protected beachfront areas, allowing for more flexible development in rural and low-density areas. This aims to enhance opportunities for local housing and businesses, particularly for small enterprises in tourism and green industries. The proposal includes provisions for reducing the protection area by 25 meters along small lakes and streams, simplifying the process for obtaining dispensations, and ensuring stronger protection in areas crucial for biodiversity. The changes are intended to bolster local influence and accessibility while balancing environmental considerations.

title: Färdigställande av Västkustbanan
summary: The proposal introduced by the government aims to establish new criminal provisions within the Swedish Environmental Code to align with the EU Regulation No. 1257/2013 concerning ship recycling. These provisions will enforce penalties against ship owners and operators of ship recycling facilities who fail to provide correct information or who do not adhere to approved recycling plans. The implementation of these changes is intended to ensure that Sweden meets its obligations under the EU regulation, promoting environmentally responsible ship recycling practices.

title: Ökad kunskap gällande ME/CFS
summary: The proposal outlines amendments to regulations governing professional transportation in Sweden in order to implement the EU Mobility Package. It includes specific directives concerning the posting of drivers within the road transport sector, establishing new requirements for notifying and monitoring the posting of drivers. Companies that post drivers to Sweden must submit a declaration prior to the driver's work commencement, with penalties for non-compliance. The amendments aim to align national legislation with revised EU regulations and introduce sanctions for violations in the transportation sector.

title: Idrott och hälsa i grundskolan
summary: The government proposes that state administrative authorities, municipalities, and regions be required to provide information to the Institute for Human Rights regarding actions taken to ensure human rights within their operations. This obligation excludes court-like committees and certain government bodies. The proposed law aims to enhance transparency and accountability in safeguarding human rights in Sweden.

title: Fler blodgivare
summary: The government proposes changes to improve conditions for commercial radio in Sweden. This includes making advertising regulations more flexible and synchronizing the licensing periods for both analog and digital commercial radio. Additionally, the government suggests extending the duration of licenses for digital commercial radio to ensure they expire simultaneously with those for analog radio. The proposed amendments and the new temporary legislation are set to come into effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Utfasning av djurförsök
summary: The government proposes amendments to the Education Act aimed at strengthening student health services and education for students with intellectual disabilities. Key changes include the requirement for availability of special educators, the introduction of guarantees for early support in specific subjects, renaming special education forms to 'adapted schools', and allowing appeals against decisions for students to repeat a grade. These amendments aim to enhance access to tailored education and integrate health services within the educational framework.

title: Teknisk infrastruktur i glesbygd
summary: This proposition proposes amendments to the Education Act aimed at increasing equality among school governing bodies, ensuring that the funding system for private school operators is clearer, more transparent, and secure. The proposed changes are designed to enhance the equal opportunities of all children and students to receive quality education regardless of the governing body while maintaining the principle of equal conditions. The new regulations will clarify the distribution of resources according to the varying needs of students and consider the local municipalities' responsibilities in funding education.

title: Vissa internationella militära insatser
summary: The proposal aims to amend the Education Act (2010:800) to enhance safety and study environment in schools, thereby improving knowledge outcomes. Key changes include clarifying responsibilities for preventive work, defining the concept of study environment, empowering all staff to take immediate action to ensure student safety, simplifying the process for temporary exclusion, and regulating mobile phone use during lessons. The proposal also enhances oversight by the School Inspectorate and emphasizes the involvement of students in developing school rules.

title: En översyn av regelverket för rätten till tillfällig föräldrapenning
summary: The government proposes amendments to the education law to enhance the preparation of youth and adults for the labor market by aligning educational offerings with labor market needs, improving cooperation among municipalities in providing educational services, and ensuring greater transparency regarding the potential outcomes of different educational programs. Notable changes include mandating collaboration among municipalities for education planning, offering support for transport for students under the age of 16, and requiring that new educational programs address both student demand and labor market needs.

title: Teknikutveckling och äldre
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1781 av Caroline Helmersson Olsson m.fl. (S)
summary: This proposal aims to amend the Education Act to promote a more equitable school choice in Sweden, focusing on reducing school segregation and ensuring a diverse social composition among students in preschool classes and primary schools. It emphasizes the responsibilities of school authorities to actively work towards social diversity and introduces regulated selection criteria for school admissions. Additionally, it strengthens the role of the School Inspectorate in assessing applications for the establishment of independent schools, considering the right to equal education for all students.

title: Sekretesslagstiftning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1780 av Caroline Helmersson Olsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal suggests amendments to the Education Act aimed at increasing oversight of religious elements in independent preschools, schools, and leisure centers with confessional affiliations. It includes provisions for informing parents and students about such elements, ensuring that participation in religious activities is voluntary while delineating confessional aspects from educational tasks. Approval processes for new confessional institutions will be tightened, requiring explicit identification of religious intentions in applications and allowing authorities to request additional background checks for applicants. The proposal intends to safeguard children's rights to a non-biased education while respecting their freedom of religion.

title: Israel och Palestina
summary: The proposal outlines amendments to the Education Act to clarify the conditions under which certain schools, referred to as resource schools, can limit their enrollment to students requiring special support. It specifies that municipalities may restrict education at certain schools to those in need of additional assistance and that placements will be reviewed regularly. The amendments also aim to create a more equitable system regarding additional funding for operations serving students with extensive support needs, due to previously identified inequalities. The new regulations are set to take effect on July 2, 2022.

title: Kooperationens förutsättningar
summary: The government proposes the introduction of a new law regarding entry and exit controls at the Swedish university entrance exam to prevent cheating via electronic devices. This law allows for body searches of participants upon entering or leaving the exam venue. Refusal to comply with these controls results in exclusion from the exam and a two-year ban on future participation. Additionally, security personnel may be deployed to conduct these checks, and new provisions for confidentiality regarding the planning of these controls are introduced.

title: Förtydligande av partipolitiska studentföreningars rätt att nyttja universitetens lokaler
summary: The government proposes amendments to the Income Tax Act and the Act on Yield Tax on Pension Funds to facilitate the transfer of entire insurance portfolios between companies without tax consequences. The changes predominantly aim to allow insurance companies to transfer all occupational pension insurance and other insurance types to another entity while maintaining tax continuity regarding taxed assets. The amendments are set to take effect from July 1, 2022, and will apply to transfers executed within the calendar year 2022.

title: Barns rätt till frihet från reklam på sociala medier
summary: The government proposes a new plant protection law that complements EU regulations designed to safeguard against plant pests. The law aims to improve the protection against pests whose introduction, establishment, and spread could have unacceptable economic, environmental, or social consequences. It includes provisions for control, powers of enforcement, and penalties for violations. Additionally, it introduces national regulations to protect timber production and provides state compensation for costs incurred due to the management of EU-regulated plant pests.

title: Insatser för att motverka den parallella svarta bostadsmarknaden
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1775 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal entails the ratification of a host country agreement between the Government of Sweden and the International Vaccine Institute (IVI), which is intended to establish a European regional office in Stockholm. The agreement outlines the immunities and privileges for IVI and its personnel, including provisions for tax exemptions, social security, and access to healthcare and education for employees and their families residing in Sweden. Additionally, it amends existing legislation regarding international organizations to formally incorporate IVI's status.

title: Återinförande av den kommunala förköpsrätten
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1774 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen the principle of the best interests of the child in social care settings, particularly for children placed under the care of the Law on Care of Young People (LVU). It proposes that care cannot be terminated unless there are significant and lasting changes in the circumstances that warranted the care. Moreover, it mandates regular reviews of the care situation, especially for children placed with foster families for extended periods, and establishes protocols for assessing the need to transfer custody or testing caregivers for substance use when appropriate.

title: Förbehåll om att inte tillåta kärnvapen på svensk mark
summary: The Government has proposed a new law on integrated care and social documentation to replace the current patient data law (2008:355). This law aims to improve information exchange among healthcare and social service providers, facilitating better care for the elderly and people with disabilities. It includes provisions for direct access to patient data by authorized providers, along with measures to strengthen privacy and ensure that children's consent is obtained for their data processing. Amendments to several existing laws related to data protection and social services are also included, with the law set to take effect on January 1, 2023.

title: Stärkt finansiering av och kvalitet på högre utbildning
summary: The proposition proposes amendments to laws concerning environmental criteria for the procurement of vehicles and certain public transport services in order to align with EU directives. Specifically, it aims to establish minimum environmental standards for the vehicles procured by public authorities and to promote the use of clean and energy-efficient road transport vehicles, with specific targets for different vehicle types through set reference periods.

title: Utredning om hälsovarningar på alkoholprodukter
summary: The governmental proposal aims to amend the Electricity Act to align Sweden's electricity network operations with the EU Electricity Directive. Key changes include establishing guidelines for the operation and organization of electrical networks, promoting the use of flexibility services to enhance efficiency, and allowing certain users to connect micro-production facilities without incurring fees. Additional elements involve the development of network development plans and new specifications for connections to the electricity grid, with the amendments scheduled to take effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Utredning av statligt ansvar för järnvägen Halmstad–Nässjö
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1770 av Staffan Eklöf och Eric Westroth (båda SD)
summary: The motion highlights the need for Sweden to conduct a thorough analysis of how organizations receiving core support from Sweden adhere to established goals. It advocates for increased transparency regarding internal costs and calls for action to reduce redundancy and overhead costs by considering mergers of UN agencies. Furthermore, it suggests that the government should be prepared to reduce or terminate funding to organizations that fail to meet Sweden's objectives for its aid.

title: Mellanöstern
summary: The motion from the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for the Swedish government to comprehensively address the recommendations made by the Swedish National Audit Office regarding Swedish aid to multilateral organizations. It emphasizes the need for clearer oversight, improved communication between the government and responsible authorities, and a focused approach to aid especially in light of recent crises. The proposal also underlines the importance of reforming UN organizations to enhance their effectiveness and transparency, advocating for a shift of support to agencies that directly assist refugees and children's welfare, including a reevaluation of aid to Afghanistan.

title: Republiken Kina (Taiwan)
summary: This proposal outlines the implementation of the European Parliament and Council's Directive (EU) 2019/1152 aimed at ensuring clear and predictable working conditions within the European Union. The directive updates previous legislation and imposes new requirements on employers regarding the provision of information about employment conditions to workers. Additionally, it establishes minimum standards for working conditions and allows member states to permit deviations via collective agreements. The proposed changes include amendments to several existing labor laws to comply with the directive's goals, including provisions for informing employees and requirements for employers to respond to certain requests from employees.

title: Rymdstrategi
summary: The Christian Democratic party (KD) proposes a review and expansion of Sweden's anti-terrorism laws to ensure more comprehensive coverage of terrorism-related acts. This includes broadening the definition of relationships with terrorist organizations and activities involving lone-wolf perpetrators. The motion emphasizes the need to criminalize all forms of interaction with terrorist groups due to recent attacks and the ongoing threat posed by unorganized terrorism, advocating for protections for various vulnerable groups affected by extremist violence.

title: Stöd för utsatta kvinnor i utrikespolitiken
summary: The suggestion from the Christian Democrats (KD) proposes a series of measures aimed at enhancing Sweden's security regulations concerning foreign nationals deemed as threats. These measures include imposing harsher penalties for those assisting in the unlawful return of deported foreigners, extending the time frame for the confiscation of communication devices, advocating for diplomatic guarantees to facilitate deportations, and implementing electronic surveillance for individuals who are security threats but cannot be deported. The proposal argues that stronger actions are needed to effectively combat terrorism and extremism.

title: Säkerhetspolitik
summary: This parliamentary proposal advocates for various measures to increase organ donation in Sweden, focusing on enhancing the number of living donors, improving the structure for donations across health regions, and enabling donation after circulatory death (DCD). The motion also emphasizes the need for a consistent approach to managing the donation process in all healthcare regions and supporting the families of deceased donors through better communication and follow-up resources.

title: Säkerhetspolitisk utredning
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes that municipalities have a responsibility to offer additional study time and tutoring for students starting from the primary school level, based on teachers' assessments of needs. It advocates for mandatory summer school for students who do not meet academic standards from an early age, emphasizing the importance of early educational support. The proposal contrasts with the government's voluntary approach and calls for more structured interventions to ensure that students do not fall behind, especially those receiving additional help due to language barriers or other challenges.

title: E-sport
summary: This motion proposes that decisions to delegate authority to automated decision-making functions in municipalities and regions should be made by the municipal council, ensuring transparency and public accessibility regarding this automated process. It emphasizes the need for ethical and principled considerations before implementing such delegation and suggests that the source code of the used software should be publicly available to maintain accountability and security.

title: Fredsprocessen Israel–Palestina
summary: The parliamentary motion proposes several measures to enhance Sweden's capability to manage individuals deemed a security threat, particularly foreign nationals. Key suggestions include making violations of reporting obligations a basis for detention, increasing enforcement of deportations, restricting economic benefits for those with suspended deportation orders, and allowing searches in more locations. The motion emphasizes the importance of these changes in response to heightened terrorist threats and seeks to strengthen legislative tools available to authorities for national security.

title: Utländska uppköp
summary: The proposal advocates for further tightening of penalties related to terrorist offenses and expanding the scope of criminal responsibility for associations with terrorist organizations. While the government has introduced a bill to consolidate anti-terrorism laws, the authors of the motion argue that the proposed increases in sentences are insufficient. They express concerns that Sweden's penalties for terrorist crimes are relatively low compared to other European countries and could position the country as a haven for terrorists, prompting a call for more stringent measures.

title: Vapenlicens och digital teknik
summary: The proposal from the Sweden Democrats aims to enhance the ability of antidoping organizations to collect and manage personal data for research, education, and intelligence work in sports. It argues that such data handling is crucial for combating doping within sports while respecting individuals' rights under data protection regulations. The proposal supports the government's motion on strengthening integrity in antidoping efforts but calls for modifications to prevent restrictions on information handling that could adversely affect the effectiveness of antidoping work, especially concerning the duration for which data can be processed.

title: Afrikas horn
summary: The motion proposes a ban on participation in terrorist organizations and calls for stricter penalties for terrorist offenses in Sweden. It highlights the inadequacies of current legislation related to terrorism and emphasizes the need for comprehensive legal reforms, including an overhaul of the criteria for which groups are considered a part of the population that could be targeted by these laws. The motion also critiques the government's current approach to penalties for terrorist-related offenses as insufficiently stringent.

title: Återinförande av korttidsstudiestödet
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats (SD) addresses the issue of honor-related oppression, proposing the establishment of a specific crime for such acts. It calls for strict responsibility for certain relatives concerning honor-related crimes, urges a review of reporting obligations related to these crimes, and emphasizes the need for the government to follow up on the implementation of the proposed legislation. The motion critiques the government's previous efforts and aims to ensure better legal accountability for those involved in or allowing such oppressive acts to occur.

title: Olyckor vid vägarbetsplatser
summary: The suggestion put forward by SD advocates for additional restrictions on qualified security cases, including the implementation of expulsion orders backed by diplomatic guarantees and extended detention periods for individuals deemed security threats. It also calls for greater government authority in managing these security matters, arguing that existing regulations are insufficient to address current challenges related to security threats and deportations.

title: Arktis
summary: This parliamentary suggestion advocates for stricter minimum sentences for terrorist acts, the criminalization of preparations for travel to commit terrorism or serious crime, and the expansion of legal definitions related to financing terrorism. The proposal emphasizes the importance of protecting democracy against the threats posed by terrorism and extremist violence, arguing that effective legislation is necessary to prevent radicalization and ensure community safety.

title: Ordning i trafiken
summary: The proposal advocates for increased study time and mandatory summer schools starting from 4th grade to enhance educational support for students in need. It suggests that schools be authorized to provide extra study hours outside regular teaching periods, allow principals to mandate summer school if deemed necessary, and eliminate existing bans on evening and weekend classes to improve overall educational outcomes, particularly for students facing challenges.

title: Utveckling av utbyggnaden av alkobommar i alla våra hamnar
summary: The motion proposes continued investigation into the application of legislation concerning qualified security cases, emphasizing the need for stricter penalties for violations. It calls for reforms in the existing laws governing the expulsion of non-citizens deemed security threats, arguing for a broader application of the law and higher minimum and maximum penalties for such violations, especially in cases involving organized attempts to return expelled individuals to Sweden.

title: Demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter i utrikespolitiken
summary: The proposal by Lina Nordquist and other members of the Liberals party seeks a commitment from the government to report back to the parliament on how to increase the number of intensive care beds in response to new regulations aimed at facilitating more organ donations. The motion advocates for the autonomy of individuals over their own bodies regarding organ donation and supports the provision of intensive care to preserve organs for potential transplant, emphasizing the need for adequate healthcare resources to ensure more lives can be saved.

title: Lex Lotta
summary: The motion proposes the criminalization of controlling behavior in the context of honor-related oppression, creating a specific criminal charge of 'fridskränkning med hedersmotiv' (breaching peace with honor motives). It advocates for higher maximum penalties for such crimes and suggests that the statute of limitations for offenses against minors be counted from the time they turn 18, with a focus on improving the legal framework to protect individuals from honor-based violence and oppression.

title: En skattereform
summary: Regeringen föreslår ett förbud mot utvinning av stenkol, brunkol, råolja, skifferolja och naturgas för att främja klimatomställningen och minska negativa miljö- och hälsoeffekter. Samtidigt föreslås skärpta regler för utvinning i alunskiffer och ett undantag för research-relaterad utvinning av olja och naturgas under specifika förhållanden. Lagförslagen syftar till att förnya miljöbalken och minerallagen, med avsikt att trädde i kraft den 1 juli 2022.

title: Sverigedemokraternas biståndspolitik
summary: The proposal aims to amend the Planning and Building Act to streamline and clarify the supervision responsibilities of building committees. It includes provisions to enhance accessibility, prevent accidents related to construction sites, and ensure that temporary building permits lead to the restoration of sites back to their original state once permits expire. Changes are also proposed to empower authorities to address safety concerns related to construction and enhance overall compliance and trust in building regulations.

title: Erkännande av folkmord
summary: The proposal seeks to amend the current law on origin guarantees for electricity to expand it to include guarantees for gas, cooling, and heating. This change is in response to EU directive EU 2018/2001, which mandates that origin guarantees should be available for these energy carriers. The proposal also includes provisions for overseeing the issuing, transfer, and annulment of these guarantees, and establishes conditions for acknowledging guarantees from third countries.

title: Europarådet
summary: The government proposition outlines the implementation of a revised EU regulation aimed at improving cooperation between member states regarding evidence collection in civil matters. It emphasizes the digitalization of processes, requiring that communication between member states be conducted electronically through a decentralized IT system, and introduces video conferencing as the primary method for collecting evidence, while allowing for diplomatic involvement in evidence gathering on foreign territories. The proposed legal changes are set to come into effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Folkambassader
summary: The proposal suggests introducing a new law that would allow nonprofit organizations involved in publicly funded welfare services to register in a special register voluntarily. It aims to facilitate the participation of these organizations in public procurement processes by allowing contracting authorities to reserve the right to participate in certain welfare service procurements specifically for nonprofit organizations. This is intended to enhance the capacity of municipalities, regions, and state authorities to benefit from the competencies and resources of nonprofit organizations.

title: Internationellt stöd till utsatta kristna
summary: The government proposes a new law to enhance the access of law enforcement agencies to financial information and analysis to prevent, detect, and prosecute crimes. This legislation includes amendments to existing laws that govern the handling of personal data by various authorities, thus facilitating cooperation between national financial intelligence units and enhancing the capabilities of crime-fighting efforts through improved financial data access.

title: Kuba
summary: The government of Sweden submitted a report detailing the activities of various committees established by government decisions during 2021. This report includes information about the number of committees appointed and their outcomes, along with specific details regarding individual committees' focus areas and progress.

title: Gotlandstrafiken
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1743 av Hanna Westerén och Laila Naraghi (båda S)
summary: The government presents an overview of actions taken in response to various parliamentary letters to the government during 2021, alongside information about applicable laws and regulations. The report includes measures categorically broken down by relevant departments, judgments about ongoing issues, and updates regarding legislative developments that are under consideration or have been previously addressed.

title: Tänderna är en del av kroppen
summary: This proposal by the Left Party calls for the rejection of the government's proposed new crime of 'honor oppression' and urges for legislation to criminalize controlling and coercive behaviors. The motion emphasizes the need for a broad legal framework that addresses all forms of oppression and recognizes the complexities of honor-related violence, which often disproportionately affects women and LGBTQ+ individuals. The Left Party argues that existing legal measures fail to provide adequate support and protection for victims, advocating for a more comprehensive approach to tackling psychological abuse within intimate relationships.

title: Rätt till förskola på obekväma arbetstider
summary: Vänsterpartiet avvisar regeringens förslag om en samlad straffrättslig terrorismlagstiftning, då de anser att den riskerar att inskränka på personliga rättigheter och rättssäkerhet. De uttrycker oro över den tekniska utvecklingen som möjliggör omfattande datainsamling och övervakning, och betonar vikten av att skydda den personliga integriteten samtidigt som brottsbekämpningens effektivitet bevaras. Partiet förespråkar en balanserad och proportionell lagstiftning som inte undergräver medborgarnas fri- och rättigheter.

title: Insyn, algoritmer och AI
summary: The proposal from Vänsterpartiet advocates for a review of the legal framework governing expulsion decisions in national security cases, suggesting that such decisions be transferred to administrative courts for improved judicial scrutiny and transparency. The motion criticizes the government's current approach, arguing that it undermines individual rights and lacks sufficient legal protection for those facing expulsion due to national security concerns. The party contends that the risk of politicization and insufficient evidentiary standards in such cases pose significant threats to justice and due process.

title: Inkludering av ansökan om bostadstillägg för pensionärer i deklarationen
summary: The Swedish government proposes to provide a financial guarantee to the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) for additional loans to Ukraine amid the ongoing conflict following Russia's invasion. The proposed guarantee amounts to a maximum of 44.7 million euros plus interest, aimed at addressing Ukraine's urgent liquidity crisis and supporting its economic stability.

title: Konkurrensneutralitet mellan medieföretag verksamma i Sverige
summary: The government report outlines the activities of Sweden within the European Union during 2021, detailing the overall development of the EU, its international relations, economic and social cooperation, as well as legal and domestic collaboration. It includes an overview of significant decisions and events within the EU, emphasizing the varied range of topics addressed by the Council's different formations.

title: Minnesmonument över folkmordet i Srebrenica
summary: Sverigedemokraterna (SD) presents a motion to the Swedish parliament aiming to reject certain proposed changes to the Aliens Act concerning labor migration. The motion emphasizes the need for stricter regulations regarding residence permits for those seeking to work or establish businesses in Sweden. It advocates for better assessments for work permits when changing employers and the introduction of financial requirements for family immigration linked to labor migration. The party expresses concerns that the government's proposals may lead to potential abuses and inefficiencies in the immigration system.

title: Ordning och trygghet i skolan
summary: The suggestion by the Christian Democrats (KD) addresses the need for stricter and improved regulations on labor migration in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of following up on proposals that aim to ensure fair labor practices and protect migrant workers from exploitation. The proposal supports a structured approach to labor agreements, a mandatory reporting obligation for employers to report unfavorable changes in employment conditions, and a call for reform to prevent abuses within the current labor migration system. It also seeks to prioritize unemployed residents in Sweden for job opportunities and suggests legislative improvements to better regulate labor migration while maintaining Sweden's reputation as an attractive destination for skilled workers.

title: Skyddad yrkestitel för legitimerad skolkurator
summary: The proposal suggests strengthening and improving regulations regarding labor immigration in Sweden. It advocates for requirements that individuals granted residence permits to seek work must pursue high-skilled jobs, a two-year evaluation of potential misuse of new permissions, and measures to attract entrepreneurs. It calls for stricter controls to prevent abuse of immigration laws, including prohibiting the transition from asylum to work permits, reviewing the validity of further permits for research or studies, and tightening sponsorship requirements for family immigration, along with harsher penalties for human smuggling.

title: Mindre barngrupper i förskolan
summary: The motion proposed by the Liberals seeks to improve regulations regarding labor immigration in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for more supportive measures to ensure that skilled individuals can come to Sweden, aiming to redefine the duration of work permits, clarify definitions of completed studies, address wrongful deportations, and modify the requirements for employment contracts. The proposal also advocates for a longer duration for temporary residency permits aimed at individuals seeking work or starting businesses and highlights the necessity of addressing issues related to employer exploitation within the labor immigration system.

title: Kooperativ företagsrådgivning
summary: The proposal aims to enhance regulations concerning labor immigration to Sweden, advocating for a follow-up in two years to evaluate the effectiveness of recent legislative changes intended to prevent 'competence expulsions'. It suggests avoiding the requirement of an employment contract when applying for work permits and opposes mandatory reporting of foreign workers' employment conditions. The Center Party emphasizes the importance of labor immigration for Sweden's economy and competitiveness, while also addressing concerns about potential abuse in the immigration system, urging for effective measures to ensure proper usage of work permits.

title: Avskaffad funkisskatt
summary: The proposal from the Green Party (MP) suggests improving and tightening regulations regarding labor immigration in Sweden. It includes measures to allow residence permits for job seekers and those wanting to start a business, address issues of 'competence expulsions' where workers are removed for minor infractions, and implement reasonable conditions for work permits related to employment contracts. The party emphasizes the importance of attracting international talent while ensuring strong protections against exploitation.

title: Tidsgräns vid bodelning
summary: The motion from Vänsterpartiet calls for a rejection of the government's proposed changes to labor immigration laws, emphasizing the need for stricter regulations to prevent exploitation of labor migrants. The party advocates for a comprehensive review of residence permit regulations for business activities, systematic employer controls, and a prohibition on a financial requirement for family immigration related to work permits. It argues that the current system has led to wage dumping and that proper enforcement of employment conditions is crucial to protect both labor migrants and the Swedish labor market.

title: Förändrat skolvalssystem och förbud mot vinstjakt i skolan
summary: The motion proposed by the Christian Democrats requests the Swedish Parliament to conduct a thorough review of the pandemic laws and their impacts from both public health and economic perspectives. It suggests that the pandemic laws should be annulled, as the government believes the COVID-19 situation has stabilized, and it calls for a broad public health program to be developed to address the long-term consequences of the pandemic on vulnerable groups. Furthermore, the motion emphasizes the need for new proposals to ensure effective economic recovery for individuals, households, and businesses affected by the pandemic restrictions.

title: Utveckling av Finsamlagstiftningen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should instruct an appropriate authority to conduct a comprehensive communication campaign to emphasize the importance of vaccination against COVID-19. This suggestion comes in light of the current health crisis and the need to avoid further disease spread, securing public health, and emphasizes the protection of individual rights during the ongoing challenges posed by the pandemic. The motion argues for the cessation of temporary COVID-19 laws as the situation stabilizes, but insists on maintaining high vaccination rates through enhanced government efforts in the vaccination program.

title: Stärkt vittnesskydd
summary: The Left Party supports the government's proposal for increased study hours and expanded school holiday programs but requests a delay in the implementation date to July 1, 2023, due to the current strain on schools from the ongoing pandemic and the shortage of qualified personnel. They argue that additional time is needed for school authorities to effectively plan and adapt to these changes.

title: Grundlagsskydd för public service
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a specific criminal category for honor-related crimes, emphasizing the need for stricter legislation to combat honor-related violence and oppression in Sweden. It argues that such practices violate individual freedoms and that the legal framework should be widened to include collective acts of violence. The motion advocates for a stronger societal stance against honor norms and aims to ensure safety and freedom for all individuals, regardless of gender or background.

title: Civilsamhällets roll för äldres hälsa
summary: The motion addresses concerns about the risk of redundant work when both the Public Employment Service and municipalities assess and validate individuals' work capabilities. It argues that many actors assessing the same individual's capabilities can lead to inefficiencies and inconsistencies. The Moderates propose that the government should take responsibility for coordinating these assessments and ensuring that differences in municipal resources do not lead to unequal validation processes across the country. They advocate for improved collaboration among municipalities, the Public Employment Service, and relevant authorities to standardize and quality assure the validation process.

title: Marknadsföring av nätläkare
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the government's legislative proposals regarding the introduction of a new district cooling law, energy measurement in buildings, and amendments to the district heating law. The proposed changes include requirements for the public disclosure of both renewable and fossil-free energy percentages in energy systems, as well as the continuation and expansion of gas consumption measurement in existing buildings to enhance energy efficiency and promote the use of non-fossil energy sources.

title: Förundersökningssekretess
summary: Sverigedemokraterna propose rejecting the government's bill on validation for competence supply and lifelong learning, advocating instead for improved validation of formal education and documented vocational skills. They emphasize the importance of recognizing formal qualifications and express concern that the government's approach may dilute education standards, particularly in sectors like healthcare and education. The motion calls for rigorous assessment of individuals' documented skills, especially for immigrants, to ensure that high standards of language and professional competence are upheld.

title: Statlig e-legitimation
summary: The proposal urges the government to clarify the process by which land surveying authorities evaluate decisions made by community associations regarding changes to share percentages. It advocates for a deadline for approval of these changes and the development of e-services to facilitate faster data exchange between authorities and associations. The Center Party argues that allowing the majority of stakeholders to decide on such changes fosters democracy, expedites handling times, and alleviates workload on governmental agencies, thereby promoting decentralization and efficiency in property management.

title: Arbetsrättsliga kunskaper i gymnasieskolan
summary: The Christian Democrats propose the creation of a digital and efficient process for the land surveying authority's approval of changes to the share ratios in community associations. The proposal aims to increase flexibility and self-determination for these associations in modifying their share ratios, which is seen as a necessity under current regulations. The proposal also emphasizes the importance of adapting compensation rules to avoid hindering the associations' ability to implement necessary changes and calls for a fully digital process including data exchange between authorities and community association systems to improve efficiency and transparency.

title: Lättillgängligare stöd
summary: The proposal aims to increase participation in preschools by requiring municipalities to proactively contact guardians of children who do not have a preschool place, informing them about the purpose of preschool and their child's rights. It also mandates municipalities to reserve preschool places for children who have recently moved to Sweden and to offer these places to those who need better language development in Swedish. This initiative targets children from the age of three and includes annual offers until they turn six, thus promoting early childhood education and addressing socio-economic disparities.

title: Översyn offentlighets- och sekretesslagen
summary: The government proposes a tax reduction for contributions paid to unemployment funds, allowing individuals to deduct 25% of their contributions from their calculated tax. This applies to both Swedish and foreign unemployment funds, with obligations for unemployment funds to provide control data on contributions. The regulations are set to come into effect on July 1, 2022, and will be applicable to contributions made after June 30, 2022.

title: Skyddad yrkestitel för barnskötare
summary: The motion advocates for the adoption of government legislation regarding the implementation of changes to the energy efficiency directive related to heating, cooling, and hot water for household use. It emphasizes the importance of avoiding over-implementation of EU directives and ensuring that the requirements imposed on energy companies are limited to what is necessary. The proposal expresses concern about the rapid timeline for the new regulations and calls for adequate time for energy companies to adapt to the changes smoothly.

title: Lagstadgad rätt till barnomsorg på obekväm arbetstid
summary: The motion proposed by the Christian Democrats (KD) for the Swedish parliament calls for the adoption of legislative changes pertaining to energy efficiency directives, particularly regarding district cooling and heating. The motion emphasizes the necessity of providing sufficient preparation time for the industry to comply with new regulations, suggesting a transition period until January 1, 2023. It advocates for a minimum implementation of the energy efficiency directive to reduce administrative burdens and avoid negatively impacting the existing market.

title: Kostnadsfria arbetsskor för vårdpersonal
summary: The government proposes amendments to the law concerning driver licenses for jet skis, allowing for the temporary seizure and eventual permanent revocation of such licenses if there is sufficient evidence suggesting that the license will ultimately be revoked. Permanent revocation will be based on a final court ruling, an accepted penalty notice, an accepted order for a fine, or a decision for prosecution waiver. The changes are set to take effect on May 15, 2022.

title: Avskaffande av EBO
summary: Regeringen föreslår att lagen om särskilda begränsningar för att förhindra spridning av sjukdomen covid-19 samt lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen ska upphöra att gälla vid utgången av mars 2022, bedömt utifrån en stabil smittskyddssituation. Dessutom föreslår regeringen att covid-19 inte längre ska klassificeras som en allmänfarlig eller samhällsfarlig sjukdom, med ändringar som ska träda i kraft den 1 april 2022.

title: Byggandet av Ostlänken
summary: The government's statement presents its assessment of the observations and recommendations made by the Swedish National Audit Office regarding Sweden's aid to multilateral organizations. The report highlights the need for improvements in the management of core support, stressing that while the handling of bilateral aid through multilateral channels is generally effective, the government could enhance its strategic framework to ensure clearer goals and better risk management. The government acknowledges the audit's findings and outlines measures to strengthen its approach to core support.

title: Regelverket kring bolagskoncerner vid ägande av appläkartjänster, apotek och vårdcentraler
summary: The motion presented by the Sweden Democrats advocates for a comprehensive approach to suicide prevention in Sweden, calling for a national action plan with measurable goals, a national coordinator for suicide prevention efforts, and the establishment of regional crisis centers. It emphasizes the need for a long-term national strategy for mental health and suicide prevention, highlighting the importance of collaboration among authorities and agencies. Additionally, it suggests reinstating mandatory reporting to the Inspectorate for Health and Care in cases of suicide, and ensuring uniform handling of suicide-related emergency calls to improve response effectiveness.

title: Nationell Öresundsagenda
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the establishment of a central fee manager for legal representatives in criminal cases to ensure uniform control over expenditures. It also calls for improved external oversight protocols for prosecutors regarding compensation claims and suggests examining the expansion of the criminal fee schedule due to frequent overruns and limited reimbursement. The motion highlights significant flaws in the current compensation system, as reported by the Swedish National Audit Office, which emphasizes the need for an updated and systematized approach.

title: Reformera samhällsorienteringen
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for greater uniformity and quality in the operations of child welfare services, specifically the child protection houses (barnahus), and enhances the police and prosecutor's efforts against internet-related sexual abuse of children. It critiques the government's insufficient response to the Swedish National Audit Office's findings regarding shortcomings in these areas, arguing for urgent reforms and increased training for police and prosecutors to establish effective strategies against such crimes.

title: Fackligt samråd vid arbetsmarknadspolitiska insatser
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for more effective national suicide prevention efforts, particularly through enhanced support for individuals with substance abuse issues. It suggests that the Public Health Agency be tasked with integrating help for addiction into the national support line, establishing a plan to raise awareness about this support among affected individuals, and implementing mandatory reporting and analysis of suicide incidents. The proposal also calls for educational initiatives in schools focused on mental health, and it underscores the importance of supporting relatives of those affected by suicide, advocating for better governmental strategies in these areas.

title: Förbud mot statligt finansierad lobbning
summary: The proposal aims to amend the Social Services Act to establish a designated care contact for home care services, ensuring that only qualified individuals with proper certifications can serve in this role. It advocates for a review of the boundaries between healthcare and social services to improve care coordination, increase support for home care staff, and implement language requirements within the home care sector. The intent is to enhance the quality and continuity of care for the elderly, particularly those with chronic illnesses, while promoting better collaboration across different health and social service agencies.

title: Politiska uppdrag i 3:12-reglerna
summary: The motion proposes the establishment and implementation of a national action plan to combat violence, abuse, and threats against children and youth, aimed at strengthening suicide prevention efforts. It emphasizes the need for a unified response to calls regarding suicide via emergency services and supports access to rehabilitation for affected children. The motion advocates for the implementation of recommendations from the National Audit Office to enhance the national suicide prevention framework and seeks to ensure children have proper access to mental health support and services.

title: Sexualbrott
summary: This proposal urges the Swedish government to ensure that the Police Authority and the Prosecution Authority implement measures recommended by the National Audit Office to combat internet-related sexual offenses against children. It emphasizes the need for sufficient numbers of trained child interviewers and the establishment of additional child welfare centers across the country, particularly in underrepresented northern regions, to improve the handling and investigation of these serious crimes.

title: Äganderätten
summary: The motion calls for a comprehensive review of the regulations concerning compensation for legal representatives in criminal cases due to a dramatic increase in costs and identified issues of fraud and double billing. The proposal emphasizes the need for a new claims system that incorporates effective control mechanisms to ensure accountability and transparency in public expenditure on legal services, which have seen significant growth without adequate oversight.

title: Beredskapsskatt
summary: The proposal seeks to extend stricter regulations for libraries to also encompass swimming facilities and retail stores, allowing for bans of entry for individuals who have engaged in severe disturbances. It aims to ensure these public spaces remain safe and welcoming, noting a rise in reports of disarray and harassment in such environments. The motion calls for legislative action to provide clearer guidelines for prosecutors to issue entry bans in a wider array of situations.

title: Individualiserad föräldraförsäkring
summary: The motion submitted by the Sweden Democrats proposes that all recipients of home care services should be offered a permanent care contact to ensure quality and continuity in elder care. The motion emphasizes the need for increased staffing, higher standards of care, and the evaluation of compliance with new regulations. It calls for improvements in the competence of care workers, particularly undersköterskor, advocating for strict qualifications and language proficiency, to enhance the overall quality of home care for the elderly.

title: Infrastrukturen på Södertörn
summary: The suggestion aims to enhance the investigation and prosecution of internet-related sexual offenses against children in Sweden. It calls for a review of confidentiality legislation to improve coordination among authorities dealing with such offenses, and advocates for strengthening the availability and quality of children's houses across the country to provide necessary support to affected children.

title: Generationsskifte i bostadsbeståndet
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the regulations concerning compensation for legal counsel in criminal cases to improve cost control and restore public trust in the legal system. The motion highlights concerns over a significant increase in expenditures for legal counsel over the last decade and points out deficiencies in the current oversight and control of these expenses. The Center Party supports the recommendations made by the National Audit Office regarding the revision of the compensation framework, suggesting an expansion of the application of the compensation scale to cover more representatives and extend negotiation time, and emphasizes the government's responsibility in ensuring effective cost control.

title: Friare vardag genom säkrad förvaring av elrullstolar
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to enhance its suicide prevention efforts by directing relevant authorities to gather, make accessible, and continuously update knowledge support regarding suicide prevention. It urges the government to assess the need for new tailored support tools, establish measurable goals for suicide prevention activities, and promptly instruct Ivo and Trafikverket to evaluate their initiatives in line with the National Audit Office's recommendations, as the current efforts have not been sufficiently effective.

title: Politik för minskat matsvinn
summary: The motion calls for urgent actions to implement the recommendations proposed by the Swedish National Audit Office regarding suicide prevention efforts in Sweden. Key measures include reinstating mandatory reporting obligations for healthcare providers in the event of suicides, establishing a 'crash commission' to investigate suicides, and emphasizing the integration of addiction and dependency issues into suicide prevention strategies. The motion advocates for stronger national leadership, increased inter-agency cooperation, and enhanced support systems to combat the rising rates of suicide and improve mental health services.

title: Den saknade järnvägsstumpen Enköping–Uppsala
summary: The government proposes a new law to regulate the processing of personal data in anti-doping work in sports, ensuring compliance with the World Anti-Doping Code and protecting individuals' privacy rights. The law aims to allow authorized actors to handle personal data purposefully while implementing measures to prevent violations of personal integrity. It includes specific provisions regarding data access, duration of data storage, and safeguards against breaches, augmenting the provisions of the EU's General Data Protection Regulation.

title: Binda ihop Uppsala län
summary: The government proposes the introduction of a new crime category, 'honor oppression', within the Swedish Penal Code to combat honor-related violence and oppression more effectively. This new law aims to impose stricter penalties for offenses motivated by a desire to uphold family honor that lead to repeated violations of a person's integrity and severely affect their self-esteem. The proposed punishment ranges from a minimum of one year to a maximum of six years in prison, with the law set to come into effect on June 1, 2022.

title: Modernisering av Kinnekullebanan
summary: The government proposes a new law to replace the existing electronic communication law, implementing the EU directive for a European code of electronic communication. Key updates include the introduction of rules for number-independent interpersonal communication services, regulatory relief for significant market influencers, enhanced user protection through clear information obligations, and penalties for violations of the new law. The new regulations are aimed at fostering competition while improving access and security in electronic communications.

title: Kvinnor med förlossningspsykos
summary: The government proposes a comprehensive new terrorism law to replace existing legislation, streamlining the legal framework for assessing and penalizing terrorism-related offenses. This new law aims to clarify the definitions and scope of terrorist acts, remove specific lists of offenses that qualify as terrorism, and establish stricter penalties for a wide array of crimes classified as terrorist acts. Additionally, it includes provisions for the prosecution of offenses regardless of where they are committed and eliminates the statute of limitations for serious terrorist crimes.

title: Slöjor på flickor
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1695 av Robert Hannah och Juno Blom (båda L)
summary: The proposal aims to enhance Sweden's security measures against qualified threats from foreigners by establishing a comprehensive and effective regulatory framework. It includes provisions for expanded deportation powers, clearer conditions for detention, the use of more coercive measures, and stricter requirements for lawyers representing affected individuals, while maintaining fundamental rights protections.

title: Höghastighetsbana Oslo–Göteborg–Köpenhamn
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1694 av Robert Hannah och Cecilia Rönn (båda L)
summary: The Swedish government proposes amendments to the municipal law to allow municipalities and regions to delegate decision-making authority to automated decision-making functions under certain conditions. This includes ensuring the full application of the Administrative Procedure Act and that automated decisions do not violate other laws. Furthermore, the proposal introduces a new law on proportional representation elections in municipalities and regions to simplify the electoral process and prevent parties from exploiting others' group designations without genuine collaboration. The changes aim to establish a clearer and more applicable legal framework for elections and decision-making in local government.

title: Ett sexuellt kulturskifte i förorterna
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1693 av Robert Hannah och Juno Blom (båda L)
summary: The government's proposal aims to enhance educational support by offering additional study time for students in grades 4-9 who need it. This initiative seeks to strengthen the school's compensatory role and increase the number of students eligible for national programs in upper secondary school. The proposal includes voluntary extra study sessions of at least two hours weekly, supervised by teachers, and an expansion of remedial summer school by an additional 25 hours for students in grade 9 who are at risk of not meeting graduation criteria. These measures intend to provide equitable educational opportunities and improve students' chances for future success.

title: Vidareutbildning av akademiker till polisyrket
summary: The motion from the Left Party advocates for the Swedish government to initiate the establishment of interdisciplinary teams surrounding home care recipients, emphasizing the importance of continuity, personalized care, and coordination. The proposal supports the government's suggestion to appoint a permanent care contact for individuals receiving home care. This initiative aims to address structural deficiencies in elder care, ensure equality in care quality across regions, and enhance the professional competence of the staff, particularly under the title of caregiver. Additionally, the motion highlights the need for educational improvements and a commitment to addressing social issues related to loneliness among the elderly.

title: Övernattningsbostad och straffavgifter
summary: The government proposes to remove the residency requirement for participation in syringe exchange programs in Sweden. Currently, only individuals considered residents of a region that has been granted permission under the Syringe and Needle Exchange Act may participate. This change aims to increase accessibility to syringe exchange services, which are crucial for effective infectious disease control.

title: Välfärdspengar
summary: The proposal outlines new regulations for organ donation in Sweden, focusing on medical interventions before and after death to facilitate donations. It includes provisions for organ-preserving treatments prior to death when necessary, the abolition of the 'close relatives veto' regarding unknown donor intentions, and conditions under which donations may be carried out without the consent of relatives for those unable to understand donation. Additionally, it allows certain medical procedures to begin after death to preserve organs for transplantation, with the aim of improving donor capabilities and thus assisting critically ill patients in need of transplants.

title: Skyldighet för mobil- och teleoperatörer att samverka med rättsvårdande myndigheter
summary: This motion advocates for the Swedish government to establish a comprehensive action plan for suicide prevention, including annual reports on efforts, the implementation of effective methods by the Public Health Agency, and the creation of a standardized procedure for handling suicide threats via emergency services. It highlights the increasing suicide rates, particularly among young people, and calls for greater resources and a systematic approach to address the public health issue of suicide in Sweden.

title: Politisk åsikt som diskrimineringsgrund i svensk diskrimineringslagstiftning
summary: The government proposes stricter and improved regulations for labor migration to Sweden, aiming to prevent the exploitation of migrant workers and to attract and retain international talent.
