Key measures include the introduction of a new residence permit for highly qualified individuals seeking work or to explore business opportunities, requirements for employment contracts to be provided upon application for work permits, and stricter obligations for employers to report changes in working conditions. The proposed measures also include new requirements related to family immigration and an expansion of the definition of human smuggling.

title: Driftsstöd till icke-statliga flygplatser
summary: Vänsterpartiet opposes the government's proposal to implement exclusion orders for individuals from public swimming facilities and libraries, arguing that such measures infringe on personal freedoms and lack proportionality. They advocate instead for employing social workers at vulnerable libraries to better address the underlying social issues contributing to disturbances, highlighting the need for alternatives to punitive measures.

title: Anonymisering av sjukvårdspersonal i patientjournaler
summary: Vänsterpartiet motionerar om att riksdagen ska avslå regeringens förslag (2021/22:119) som ger brottsbekämpande myndigheter rätt att använda våld för att tvinga en person till biometrisk autentisering. De framhåller vikten av att skydda personlig integritet och rättssäkerhet i samband med den teknologiska utvecklingen, och anser att utnyttjandet av tvångsmedel bör omgärdas av striktare villkor. Motionen uttrycker stöd för vissa delar av regeringens förslag men framhäver att våldsutövning för biometrisk autentisering är oacceptabelt.

title: Nationella beredskapslager
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1685 av Eric Westroth och Ann-Christine From Utterstedt (båda SD)
summary: This proposal outlines a new provision in the Swedish Aliens Act (2005:716) that grants the government the authority to establish regulations for the conditions under which residence permits issued to individuals associated with foreign embassies, career consulates, or international organizations may be granted or revoked. The main objective is to clarify the legal framework regarding the issuance and withdrawal of such permits, with the proposed changes set to take effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Information till myndigheter om elöverkänslighet som funktionshinder
summary: The proposal aims to implement changes to the regulations regarding district cooling and energy measurement for residential buildings, aligning with EU directives. It introduces a new district cooling law that mandates measurement and billing for district cooling, alongside requirements for providing energy usage information. Additionally, it calls for revised rules in the district heating law and a new law on energy measurement in buildings, ensuring that tap water usage for household purposes is measured at the apartment level in new residential buildings. The changes are set to take effect from June 1, 2022.

title: Tydligt uppdrag för primärvården att förebygga ohälsa
summary: The government proposal aims to enhance the validation processes in municipal adult education (Komvux) to better align with labor market needs and individual qualifications. Key provisions include a requirement for municipalities to offer initial assessments for individuals seeking validation of their skills, ensuring that students who need validation are provided with it, and clarifying the requirements regarding documentation following validation. This initiative seeks to improve the utilization of existing knowledge among individuals, facilitating better job market integration and lifelong learning opportunities.

title: Arvode för vigselförrättare
summary: The government proposes a more flexible approach for community associations managing common facilities to change their ownership shares, requiring a two-thirds majority vote at a general meeting. Such decisions will gain the same legal effect as decisions made during official proceedings when approved by the land survey authority. This change aims to simplify and reduce costs associated with amending ownership shares, thereby encouraging associations to make necessary adjustments.

title: Sexsomni
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1681 av Helena Vilhelmsson och Anne-Li Sjölund (båda C)
summary: The government proposes amendments to public procurement laws aimed at enhancing the efficiency of judicial review in contract disputes. Key changes include introducing urgency requirements for cases regarding the validity of contracts, shortening the application deadline for challenging non-directly awarded contracts from six months to thirty days, and establishing statutes of limitations for exclusions of suppliers based on offenses. These amendments are intended to streamline the judicial process related to public procurement and are set to come into effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Situationen för kvinnor som tvingas leva gömda
summary: The government's proposal suggests raising the turnover threshold for exemption from value-added tax (VAT) from 30,000 kronor to 80,000 kronor per taxation year. This change aims to simplify the process for smaller businesses by relieving them of the necessity to register and declare VAT if their turnover does not exceed this new limit. The proposal also states that the amendment to the VAT Act will come into effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Moderniserad lagstiftning för att motverka spridning av våldsam pornografi
summary: This proposal suggests lowering the value-added tax (VAT) rate for repairs of bicycles, shoes, leather goods, clothing, and household textiles from 12% to 6%. The aim is to enhance existing incentives within the VAT system to encourage repair and reuse of manufactured goods, rather than purchasing new items, promoting sustainable consumption practices.

title: Detektering av pornografiskt material av barn
summary: The proposal aims to implement the European directive 2019/520/EU regarding electronic toll systems by amending existing legislation. It seeks to enhance interoperability among electronic toll systems across Europe and facilitate cross-border information exchange related to unpaid tolls. Key changes involve updating obligations for various entities involved in electronic toll systems, such as toll collectors and payment service providers. The proposed amendments are intended to take effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Frigörelsekapital
summary: The proposal by the Green Party aims to amend the education law to enhance the role of aesthetic subjects in high school programs, advocating for the introduction of an aesthetic subject worth 50 credits across all national programs, along with an increase in credits for aesthetic subjects in specialized programs. The proposal seeks to ensure equitable cultural education for all students, arguing that the arts and culture are essential for personal development and understanding of the world.

title: Utökad rätt att bevilja reflektionsperiod gällande offer för människohandel
summary: The motion, proposed by members of the Liberal Party, calls for the rejection of the government's proposition to increase opportunities for basic eligibility in vocational programs within high schools. The authors argue that the proposed changes could lead to a devaluation of practical subjects and vocational training while also risking the quality of education for students. They demand that the government revise the proposal to ensure that knowledge requirements for vocational programs are maintained and that the curriculum reform takes place alongside other measures to enhance the attractiveness of vocational education.

title: Vinstmarginalbeskattning på digitala tjänster och produkter
summary: The proposal by Niklas Wykman and others from the Moderate Party calls for the rejection of the government's proposition to tighten the bonus-malus system aimed at accelerating the transition to a fossil-free vehicle fleet. The authors argue that the current system has not met expectations in reducing emissions and that the government's measures have resulted in increased vehicle taxes and higher fuel prices, disproportionately affecting those in rural areas. They advocate for more effective measures and the abolishment of the bonus-malus system, which they consider a flawed tax framework.

title: Förbättrad situation för personer i behov av ledar- eller assistanshund
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1674 av Rickard Nordin och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes the establishment of two-year vocational programs in Swedish upper secondary education, with the option for students to complete a third year to gain basic eligibility for higher education. It emphasizes strengthening the link between students' vocational training choices and labor market needs through improved vocational guidance, addressing concerns that the current educational structure prioritizes theoretical over practical education and fails to attract students to vocational programs. The motion also calls for reform of apprenticeship training to enhance its attractiveness and alignment with labor market demands.

title: Jämställdhet för hållbar utveckling
summary: This parliamentary motion by the Sweden Democrats proposes that the Riksdag reject the government's proposition regarding changes to regulations that would allow data sharing for income studies. The motion emphasizes the need for guarantees on anonymization, consent from individuals, and limitations on the scope of shared personal data, citing concerns over privacy rights and data misuse, particularly when sharing data with the Luxembourg Income Study and external researchers.

title: En levande landsbygd för Sveriges bästa
summary: The suggestion calls for the rejection of the government's proposal regarding the bonus-malus system, which imposes higher taxes on heavier vehicles to subsidize the purchase of environmentally friendly cars. The motion argues that the system ultimately undermines its own goals by providing insufficient incentives for fossil-fuel car owners to switch to renewable energy vehicles. It contends that the scheme disproportionately impacts families in rural areas who require larger vehicles, transferring financial resources from these families to wealthier urban residents. Therefore, the motion advocates for the abolition of the bonus-malus system.

title: Skarv
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes the Riksdag reject the government bill 2021/22:84 to lower energy taxes on gasoline and diesel. They argue that a tax reduction would hinder Sweden's climate goals by increasing emissions in the transport sector. Instead, they call for the government to present measures to reduce emissions from transportation and to create a compensatory support system for those in rural areas who have been disproportionately affected by rising fuel prices and lack alternatives to car travel.

title: Utredning av dödshjälp – rätten att avsluta sitt liv
summary: The proposal advocates for the rejection of a government proposition aimed at temporarily increasing the reduction of employer contributions for individuals aged 19 to 23 during the summer of 2022. Critics from various organizations contend that the proposed measure is an ineffective means to increase youth employment, suggesting that it primarily benefits existing job positions rather than generating new employment opportunities. The leftist party Vänsterpartiet argues that the reduction could harm public finances and has previously proposed eliminating such deductions to strengthen state revenue.

title: Förbättrad miljöinformation i sjökort/båtsportskort
summary: The government proposes a modernization of regulations governing the use of coercive measures, such as seizures and searches, necessary for effective criminal investigations. The changes include new measures like remote searches for electronic documents, the elimination of restrictions on seizing communications between suspects and close associates, and enhanced rights related to judicial review. These amendments aim to adapt legal frameworks to evolving technologies and to ensure justice protections are upheld.

title: Motorvägstunnel under Södertälje kanal och säkrande av förbindelserna E4/E20 genom Södertälje
summary: The government proposes amendments to the Social Services Act requiring that individuals receiving home care services be offered a permanent care contact, unless deemed unnecessary. This aims to ensure that individuals' needs for safety, continuity, personalized care, and coordination are met during the delivery of home care services. The requirement for a permanent contact is set to take effect on July 1, 2022, and from July 1, 2023, only those with the professional title of assistant nurse will be permitted to serve in this role.

title: Viltets ökning i Kalmar län
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1667 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson och Johnny Svedin (båda SD)
summary: The Swedish government's report addresses the Riksrevisionen's findings on the management and compensation for legal representatives in criminal cases. It concludes that there are significant deficiencies in the oversight provided by the courts and the Court Administration over these compensations. The government acknowledges the report and outlines steps it has taken to improve control systems and manage rising costs, although it disagrees with the recommendation to have acted sooner. It highlights ongoing efforts to enhance oversight and efficiency in the compensation system for legal aid.

title: Trafiksäkerheten på Ölandsbron och behovet av en ny förbindelse
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1666 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson och Johnny Svedin (båda SD)
summary: Regeringen presenterar sin bedömning av Riksrevisionens rapport angående polisens och åklagarnas arbete mot internetrelaterade sexuella övergrepp mot barn. Riksrevisionens granskning visar att det finns flera brister i effektiviteten hos myndigheternas arbete, inklusive otydlig styrning, brister i metodstöd och resurser, samt variationer i hur ärenden hanteras över landet. Regeringen instämmer i Riksrevisionens slutsatser och rekommendationer och lovar att vidta åtgärder för att säkerställa en mer enhetlig och effektiv verksamhet vid barnahusen och mellan de berörda myndigheterna.

title: Öppen källkod
summary: The Christian Democrats propose to evaluate and potentially extend the proposed tax deferral period for businesses, improve the design of electricity compensation for households, and ensure that non-state regional airports eligible for support, especially those designated as emergency airports, receive necessary assistance. They express concern that current government proposals do not adequately address the needs of family businesses and healthcare companies regarding short-term work support and criticize the lack of sufficient measures to compensate for high electricity prices faced by households, suggesting their own adjustments for more equitable support.

title: Regelverket för användandet av metallsökare
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1664 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson och Eric Palmqvist (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the inclusion of various housing tenure types in the analysis conducted by municipalities regarding housing needs and demands as part of improving housing market planning. It emphasizes the need for continued analysis of housing needs for specific groups such as the elderly and individuals with disabilities, which some remiss bodies oppose removing from the government's proposals. The aim is to ensure that unmet housing demands are accounted for in municipal guidelines.

title: Färjetrafik mellan Oskarshamn och Byxelkrok
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1663 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson och Johnny Svedin (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the government should promptly investigate and provide suggestions for the permanent implementation of fully digital shareholder meetings for companies and associations in Sweden. The motion supports the temporary legislation introduced during the COVID-19 pandemic, which allowed for postal voting and fully digital meetings, but calls for a thorough review to improve the system and ensure accessibility for all shareholders, particularly those unable to attend in person due to distance or other barriers. The proponents argue that digital meetings offer several advantages, including cost savings and increased participation.

title: Tåginfrastruktur i sydöstra Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1662 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support an investigation into the possibility of permanently allowing digital company and association meetings, following a temporary law originally introduced during the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion emphasizes the benefits of digital meetings, including increased participation and accessibility for shareholders and members located in different geographical areas, potentially leading to more legitimate decision-making. It calls for consideration of security measures for identification and participation verification, along with a safeguard for holding physical meetings if requested by a minority.

title: Öppenhet kring lokala partiers finansiering
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need for the Swedish government to conduct analyses on housing needs for specific groups and the demand for housing, given the widespread shortage of housing across the country. It addresses the importance of allowing municipalities to plan for housing in a way that acknowledges different demographic needs, including young people and the elderly, while warning against increasing state control over local housing policies, which may undermine local self-governance.

title: Översyn av det kommunala utjämningssystemet
summary: The government proposes changes to several laws to implement international regulations regarding radiological damage and damages caused during maritime transport. This includes amendments to the Maritime Code and the Environmental Code to comply with Sweden's accession to the 2004 amendment protocol to the Paris and Supplementary Convention on liability for nuclear damage and to the 2010 HNS Convention, which addresses liability and compensation for damages from the transport of hazardous and harmful substances. The amendments are intended to clarify liability and strengthen environmental protections.

title: Offentlig information på lättläst svenska
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1659 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: The proposal aims to enhance safety at public places such as swimming facilities and libraries by allowing authorities to impose bans on individuals based on assessments of the risk of crime and serious harassment. The law, which will be incorporated into the existing legislation regarding bans on access to stores, is intended to empower responsible entities to ensure a secure environment for employees and visitors, while addressing disturbances or threats that may arise.

title: Certifiering av tjänsteföretag
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1658 av Anders Ådahl och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: The Swedish government acknowledges the findings and recommendations of the National Audit Office regarding the effectiveness of the state's suicide prevention efforts. The report highlights that despite earlier frameworks established in 2008, significant actions to enhance these efforts were only initiated in 2020. The government aims to improve collaboration among various governmental agencies to strengthen suicide prevention work, with forthcoming strategies in mental health and suicide as key initiatives. Continued development and support for local and regional efforts is emphasized to effectively address this public health issue.

title: Nationellt program för förbättrad hälsa hos unga
summary: The motion from the Christian Democrats (KD) addresses the criticisms outlined in the Swedish National Audit Office's report regarding the significant cuts and resource mismanagement at the Migration Agency between 2017 and 2020. The proposal advocates for prioritizing the agency's competence development and calls for a review of the government's support methods for agencies involved in sensitive areas such as asylum processing. The motion highlights the negative consequences of resource reductions on productivity, service, and the agency's ability to meet its objectives, and also raises concerns about potential security breaches resulting from inadequate asset disposals.

title: Modernisering av ellagen
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish government needs to review and strengthen its management and oversight of the Migration Agency's operations following significant cuts made between 2017 and 2020. The proposal highlights concerns over the agency's failure to meet certain goals and inadequate handling of its resources, as reported by the Swedish National Audit Office. It calls for improved follow-up of the agency's compliance with security regulations and its own guidelines to ensure effective service delivery and to mitigate risks associated with the handling of sensitive information.

title: Bostadsförsörjning
summary: Sverigedemokraterna föreslår åtgärder för att förbättra målstyrningen och kompetensförsörjningen inom Migrationsverket efter kritik från Riksrevisionen om brister under omställningen 2017-2020, inklusive personalminskningar och ineffektivitet. Partiet understryker behovet av långsiktig planering, ansvarsfull budgetanpassning och att regeringen tar ansvar för sina beslut som påverkat Migrationsverkets verksamhet.

title: Säkerhetspolitiskt orienterad doktrin för energi och livsmedel
summary: The government proposes additional measures in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, including the temporary elimination of the waiting period for short-time work support, extended event support, and compensation for households facing high electricity prices. It introduces changes to tax deferral laws allowing for a maximum 24-month extension, given that a repayment plan is approved by the tax authority. These measures aim to provide urgent financial relief to households and businesses affected by unforeseen circumstances.

title: Minska förekomsten av invasiva djurarter
summary: The government proposes to reintroduce temporary measures to facilitate the execution of corporate and association meetings, originally implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic. These measures aim to minimize the risk of virus transmission and permit practices like electronic participation and postal voting, which had lapsed at the end of 2021. The proposed law is set to come into force on March 1, 2022, and will expire at the end of the year.

title: Modern bokföring
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1652 av Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och Anders Ådahl (båda C)
summary: This proposal aims to amend Sweden's statistical and privacy laws to allow for the sharing of individual-level data on income, debts, and assets with the Luxembourg Income Study (LIS) for research purposes, while ensuring that the data cannot be directly traced back to individual persons. The changes are deemed necessary for enhancing comparative socio-economic research, with minimal risks to individual privacy.

title: Avskaffat krav om momspliktig verksamhet vid fastighetsupplåtelse
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1651 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Helena Vilhelmsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal by Viktor Wärnick and others from the Moderate Party supports parts of the government's initiative for a new consumer purchase law but raises concerns over the extended burden of proof for businesses from six months to two years. They advocate for an evaluation of the law's impact on Sweden's competitiveness after three years. Additionally, they suggest that in cases of product faults, the business should have the option of taking the least costly corrective action, provided it does not cause inconvenience to the consumer, rather than allowing consumers to choose between repairs or replacement.

title: Tidsgräns för domstolars handläggning av överklagande av detaljplaner
summary: The proposal submitted by the Green Party calls for the Swedish parliament to allow direct allocation in the railway sector based on structural and geographical characteristics, and to conduct a thorough impact analysis of how rising costs for railway companies may affect their competitiveness compared to other modes of transport. Additionally, the proposal advocates for the development of a national rail supply plan that would serve as a long-term strategy for integrating and improving train services across Sweden, similar to models used in Switzerland.

title: Ge kommunerna samlat ansvar för brottsförebyggande arbete
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a dedicated investigation to create legislation specifically addressing the sale and purchase of live animals, emphasizing animal welfare and responsibilities of both buyers and sellers. It argues that existing consumer protection laws are insufficient for live animals due to their unique nature as sentient beings and calls for an evaluation of the new consumer purchase law three years after its implementation to ensure it adequately protects both consumers and animals.

title: Avskaffande av EBO
summary: The motion proposes amendments to Sweden's consumer purchase law to provide a two-year liability period for sellers regarding defects, establish a one-year reversed burden of proof for consumers, and request the Swedish Consumer Agency to create guidance on cooperation in troubleshooting digital environments. It also suggests excluding living animals from the consumer purchase law’s scope, applying the general purchase law instead, reflecting the need for distinct treatment considering the nature of living animals and their welfare.

title: Gårdsförsäljning
summary: The proposal suggests that the purchase of live animals should be exempt from consumer sales law regulations, advocating for an alternative framework that allows for better adaptation to the unique conditions of such transactions. Additionally, it argues for a one-year reverse burden of proof for sellers regarding defects, opposing a two-year period suggested by the government. The motion also criticizes the government's proposal to let consumers choose remedies for defects, claiming it may hinder sustainable practices in the economy.

title: Ny djurskötarutbildning
summary: The motion proposes that the government should return with clearer legislation regarding the grounds for reducing sanction fees within the context of the new rail law, which will replace existing penalties with sanction fees. The authors argue that lack of specificity in the law can lead to arbitrary judgments and inconsistencies in the application of sanctions, stressing the need for well-defined regulations to ensure fair treatment.

title: Ansvar för rovdjursförvaltningen
summary: The motion proposes that the new consumer purchasing law should not apply to the purchase of living animals exceeding one-tenth of the price base amount, as the current legislation does not adequately address the unique circumstances surrounding living animals, especially regarding buyer responsibilities and seller liabilities. It emphasizes that living animals should not be treated as mere goods and calls for a better regulatory framework that prioritizes animal welfare and balances the rights and responsibilities of both buyers and sellers.

title: AP-fondernas investeringar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate the cuts made to the Swedish Migration Agency from 2017 to 2020, as outlined in a critical report by the National Audit Office. The motion highlights that these cuts negatively impacted the agency's ability to meet its objectives, led to increased processing times for asylum applications, and created challenges for effective integration and employee management. The sponsors of the motion argue that a broader investigation is necessary to understand the effects of these cutbacks on both the individuals affected and the agency's work environment.

title: En hållbar digitalisering
summary: The government proposes a temporary enhancement of the reduction in employer contributions for individuals aged 19-23 during the summer months of June, July, and August 2022. This enhancement allows only the old age pension contribution of 10.21% to be paid on wages up to 25,000 kronor per calendar month. The measure aims to support young people entering the job market after the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Trafikpoliser
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1642 av Martina Johansson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: Regeringen föreslår att nationella yrkesprogram i gymnasieskolan ska inkludera de ämnen som krävs för att eleverna ska få grundläggande behörighet för högskoleutbildning, utan att minska fokus på yrkesförberedelse. Samtidigt föreslås att programmens omfattning ska utökas, både i gymnasiepoäng och garanterad undervisningstid. Elever ska dock ges möjlighet att välja bort grundläggande behörighet. Syftet är att göra yrkesprogrammen mer attraktiva och underlätta ungdomars etablering på arbetsmarknaden. De föreslagna ändringarna träder i kraft den 1 januari 2023 och ska tillämpas från höstterminen 2023.

title: Förnybar energiomställning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1641 av Martina Johansson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests implementing a special limitation rule in the Income Tax Act to prevent the trade of loss-making companies and to address tax avoidance related to ownership changes. This rule would deny the right to deduct previous years' losses if those losses were the main reason for the change in ownership, particularly when the acquiring party received no assets beyond cash and receivables from other companies in the same group before the ownership change.

title: Sanering av gamla industrier
summary: The government proposes to tighten the environmental regulation within the bonus-malus system by lowering the threshold for the additional carbon dioxide fee on light vehicles. The lower limit will be reduced from 90 grams of CO2 per kilometer to 75 grams, and the upper limit will be adjusted from 130 grams to 125 grams. These changes aim to enhance the incentive for adopting environmentally friendly vehicles and are set to take effect on June 1, 2022.

title: Bättre tillgång på cykelvägar
summary: The proposal aims to reduce the energy tax on gasoline and diesel fuel by 50 öre per liter, effective from May 1, 2022. This action follows a request from the parliament for the government to present a legislative proposal to lower fuel prices at the pump.

title: Differentierad vattentaxa
summary: The Swedish government has officially withdrawn its proposal, previously submitted as proposition 2021/22:65, which aimed to extend the deadline for allowing repayment of temporary deferments of payments. This withdrawal is communicated to the Parliament.

title: Förenklade tillståndsansökningar och tillsyn
summary: The government proposes amendments to existing laws regarding the cross-border distribution of investment funds, prompted by changes in EU directives. Key changes include requirements for fund managers to offer specific services to non-professional investors in Sweden, provide additional information during cross-border activities within the EEA, and regulate marketing practices. The proposed amendments aim to enhance investor protection and streamline the functioning of fund managers operating across borders.

title: Fler beredningsformer för cytostatika
summary: The government proposes new capital adequacy regulations for very large securities companies in order to align Swedish law with EU regulations. The proposal mandates that these companies implement the capital adequacy framework applicable to credit institutions, thereby ensuring compliance with EU supervision regulations and directives. The aim is to introduce these regulations by April 1, 2022, despite there currently being no very large securities companies in Sweden.

title: Företag inom besöksnäringen
summary: The document pertains to a government meeting held on January 20, 2022, where the Swedish government discusses the report on the operations of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) for the year 2021 and makes necessary corrections to previous records.

title: Delegationer i sjukvården
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instructs the government to investigate the organization of Trafikverket with a focus on improving cost control in infrastructure investments. It highlights serious deficiencies in Trafikverket's planning and procurement processes as revealed by multiple reports from the National Audit Office, emphasizing the need for more effective and transparent management in infrastructure projects to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.

title: Pedagogiska tjänster samt fjärrundervisning
summary: The proposal suggests extending the period during which reduced energy taxes apply as temporary support for Swedish companies affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The Center Party highlights the ongoing economic challenges faced by businesses and advocates for a generous application of support measures, arguing that companies need assurance to plan their operations amidst uncertainties. The suggestion emphasizes the importance of negotiating with the EU for continued assistance beyond current deadlines.

title: Turismöversiktsplan
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1632 av Martina Johansson och Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist (båda C)
summary: The motion proposed by the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) to improve its procurement processes to reduce planning costs and increase efficiency in infrastructure investments. The motion suggests a comprehensive evaluation of Trafikverket's planning and procurement practices, an investigation into its organizational structure for better cost control, and ongoing reporting of cost deviations along with their causes. Additionally, the motion highlights the need for legislative review to facilitate larger infrastructure projects and address the lengthy appeal processes that often delay project execution.

title: Förändrad lagstiftning för jakt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Schools Inspectorate should be responsible for granting permits and overseeing all forms of pedagogical care to ensure higher quality and equality. It suggests that specific requirements, such as proficiency in Swedish for both providers and staff, should be mandatory. Furthermore, it advocates for the inclusion of criminal record checks in the application process, arguing that this is crucial for ensuring the safety of children in such care settings.

title: Harmoniserad hastighet för A-traktor och mopedbilar och förbättrad förarutbildning
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at strengthening the quality and equity of pedagogical care in Sweden. Key suggestions include mandatory proactive vetting for individuals in leadership roles, the requirement for criminal background checks for individuals aged 15 and older present in the care environment, certification in the Swedish language for caregivers, and the establishment of national guidelines for pedagogical care. The motion also advocates transferring oversight of pedagogical care from municipalities to the School Inspectorate to ensure stronger regulatory control and compliance.

title: Mer solenergi
summary: The motion proposes several measures to enhance the quality and accessibility of family day care in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of allowing parents to choose the type of child care that best suits their needs. It suggests that municipalities be mandated to provide family day care options, transfer supervisory responsibilities for this care from local authorities to the School Inspectorate, and ensure adequate support for children with special needs. The motion advocates for a diverse range of childcare alternatives while maintaining high-quality standards across all forms of childcare.

title: Rotavdrag från utlandet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support stronger requirements for pedagogical care, including mandating qualified staff to ensure children's development and preparedness for further learning. It suggests that the government should instruct the Swedish National Agency for Education to define educational qualifications for staff and calls for suitability assessments for existing private providers of pedagogical care. The motion emphasizes the need for high-quality childcare as a right for all children, criticizing existing regulations for being inadequate.

title: Fiber i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1627 av Martina Johansson och Niels Paarup-Petersen (båda C)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government reevaluate infrastructure projects in the national infrastructure plan with a focus on achieving societal goals, particularly climate targets. It calls for improved cost control and transparency regarding infrastructure investments by Trafikverket, including systematic efforts to prevent unnecessary cost increases and public reporting of significant cost escalations. Furthermore, it advocates for an investigation into Trafikverket's organization to enhance cost management in infrastructure projects, highlighting concerns about the agency's current approach and its impact on climate goals.

title: Utvärdering av fastighetsskatten
summary: The proposition aims to enhance municipal housing supply planning by requiring clearer analyses of local housing shortages. It mandates that all municipalities develop guidelines that include an analysis of unmet housing needs, with support from the National Board of Housing, Building, and Planning. This is intended to improve governmental tracking of housing market goals and assist municipalities in effectively managing housing provisions.

title: Bedrägerier mot äldre
summary: The Christian Democrats propose that the Swedish government evaluate the effectiveness of the current business support measures in response to the coronavirus pandemic. They highlight the inadequacy of existing programs, particularly for cultural sectors and civil society organizations, which have been heavily impacted. They express concerns regarding the limitations faced by family-owned businesses and newly established companies in accessing support, urging a broadening of eligibility criteria and improvements in the application process for relief programs.

title: Vidareutveckling av sfi
summary: The Christian Democrats propose that the Swedish government evaluate the sufficiency of the proposed deferment period for tax obligations as part of the government's additional budget measures in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. They advocate for seasonal companies not to be negatively impacted by the deferment options and call for a longer assessment period of up to 36 months instead of the 15 months currently suggested. The motion aims to ensure that businesses, especially family-run and newly established companies, receive necessary support without falling through the gaps of the existing financial measures.

title: Översyn av hjälpmedel och bostadsanpassning
summary: The government proposes an extra budget amendment for 2022 in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, which includes the extension of temporary tax and fee exemptions for free parking benefits until June 30, 2022, and adjustments to the regulations regarding temporary tax payment deferrals. The amendments aim to alleviate the financial strain on individuals and businesses affected by the pandemic, allowing for longer deferral periods for tax payments.

title: Bedrägerier mot äldre
summary: The Swedish government's official response to the Riksrevisionen report regarding the restructuring and budget reductions at the Migrationsverket between 2017 and 2020, acknowledging that the transition was not effectively managed and had adverse impacts on the agency's ability to meet its goals. The government agrees with recommendations to exercise caution when making rapid budget cuts based on uncertain efficiencies but does not support the need for new support mechanisms for asset divestiture or clearer regulations concerning sensitive information management during asset decommissioning.

title: Sparbankers kapitalförsörjning och mindre bankers regelverk
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1620 av Mikael Larsson och Catarina Deremar (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes an overall evaluation of Trafikverket's planning and procurement work to enhance cost control and efficiency in infrastructure investments. It calls for increased transparency by creating a public summary of changes in costs, benefits, and contents of projects. Additionally, it suggests an investigation into Trafikverket's organization to improve cost control practices, addressing concerns raised in a report by the National Audit Office regarding systematic underestimations of project costs.

title: Fler valsedelsbås i vallokalerna
summary: The proposition outlines temporary legislative measures to address the impact of COVID-19 on sick leave management, providing that employees will not need a medical certificate to prove their inability to work due to illness. It also includes amendments to the state budget for 2022, with increased funding for vaccination, testing, and tracing efforts, and financial support for businesses and cultural activities affected by the pandemic.

title: Psykisk ohälsa kan leda till diskriminering
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1618 av Ulrika Heie och Martina Johansson (båda C)
summary: The government proposes a new consumer sales law aimed at modernizing consumer rights in the context of purchasing goods and contracting digital content and services. The law addresses the evolving consumption habits of consumers, including online shopping and the acquisition of digital products, and seeks to enhance consumer protection significantly. Notably, it introduces a two-year period for businesses to be held liable for defects in goods, extending the previous six-month liability. The proposal also includes specific regulations pertaining to the purchase of live animals to ensure consumer and animal welfare. This legislative measure aligns with EU directives on the sale of goods and the provision of digital content and services.

title: Vapenexport till Saudiarabien
summary: The proposal outlines the implementation of the fourth railway package, which aims to update Sweden's railway laws to align with evolving EU regulations. It involves replacing the current railway legislation with four new laws focused on railway market regulations, technology standards, safety measures, and the national railway system. Key changes include enhanced independence for infrastructure managers, expanded roles for the European Union Railway Agency, stricter compliance requirements, and the transition from criminal penalties to financial sanctions for violations.

title: Delad föräldraförsäkring
summary: The motion presented by Pål Jonson and other members of the Moderate and Christian Democrat parties calls for the Swedish government to enhance its national defense capabilities in response to the deteriorating security situation in the region, particularly following Russia's actions in Ukraine. It proposes additional tasks for the current military supply investigation, including the development of a defense industry strategy and improved tracking of military material. The motion emphasizes the importance of adopting a 'design to cost' principle in procurement processes for defense materials to ensure effective resource utilization.

title: Belarus
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of Sweden's signal surveillance laws to better address security challenges, particularly concerning international cooperation in defense intelligence. It emphasizes the importance of incorporating privacy considerations in the forthcoming review and calls for a detailed report on international collaboration in defense intelligence as a part of annual government assessments. The authors contend that enhancing surveillance capabilities is crucial in light of increasing traditional and hybrid threats, including terrorism and cyberattacks.

title: Dalhalla – en nationell sommarscen för Kungliga Operan
summary: The motion proposes two main actions concerning foreign nationals deemed security threats in Sweden: to eliminate obstacles for deportations using diplomatic guarantees and to initiate a new investigation to explore additional measures for community protection against such individuals. The authors emphasize that the current legal framework has taken too long to address safety concerns, leaving dangerous individuals free in society. The proposal also suggests that Sweden should leverage its aid agreements to encourage countries to accept their citizens who are denied residency in Sweden, potentially withholding aid as a consequence.

title: Ekonomiska garantier för avfallsplatser
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1613 av Martina Johansson och Malin Björk (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive primary care reform in Sweden aimed at improving patient continuity and accessibility in healthcare. It criticizes the government's proposal for limiting patient choice and emphasizes the need for a coordinated care team system, digital health services, and timely care access for patients, particularly those with chronic illnesses. The motion advocates for a holistic approach, enhancing options for diverse healthcare providers while ensuring patient rights to choose their healthcare services freely.

title: Lagstiftning för distansarbete
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into how to facilitate the transfer of occupational pensions and suggests removing the requirement for a firm's signatory approval during such transfers. It emphasizes the importance of making pension transfers more accessible, particularly for older insurance policies that carry higher transfer fees. The motion argues that the complexity of the current system discourages individuals from seeking better pension options and highlights the need for regulatory adjustments to increase customer mobility in the pension insurance market.

title: Öresundsmetro
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1611 av Niels Paarup-Petersen och Jonny Cato (båda C)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of evaluating past measures related to temporary economic support for businesses during crises, particularly regarding the handling of short-term work support. The Moderate Party advocates for the government to learn from previous mistakes made in the crisis management process and to implement necessary changes, including potential resource enhancements and adjustments in processing times for support applications.

title: Parkeringsavgifter för elbilar
summary: The motion urges the government to enhance the management of the Swedish Armed Forces to ensure that the production and development of army capabilities are not negatively affected by project management related to essential security interests. The motion highlights criticisms from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding insufficient operational capability development of army forces between 2016-2020 and calls for clearer and more sustainable funding frameworks for military projects.

title: Gårdsförsäljning av öl, vin och cider
summary: The proposal is centered on a healthcare reform aimed at enhancing accessibility, continuity, and patient choice within primary care in Sweden. It calls for rejecting the government's suggested amendment to the patient law, endorsing a specific formulation to ensure that having a designated primary care physician does not restrict a patient's ability to seek care from other providers. Additionally, the proposal advocates for establishing a national listing service to facilitate patient access to healthcare services and emphasizes the importance of sustaining effective compensation systems in collaboration with regional authorities to reinforce patient security and choice throughout the country.

title: Krafttag mot näthat
summary: The motion proposes enhancements to primary healthcare in Sweden by focusing on competence development, information campaigns, and the empowerment of patients. It emphasizes the importance of continuous care, cooperation among healthcare providers, and the need for equitable access to healthcare services. The proposal also advocates for patients' rights in decision-making processes, the introduction of individual care plans, and better working conditions for healthcare staff to improve overall service delivery. Additionally, it calls for a broadening of health promotion activities and underscores the importance of infrastructural improvements, such as broadband expansion, for better healthcare delivery.

title: Tryggare studietid för studenter
summary: The Christian Democrats propose a primary care reform focusing on ensuring patients have a designated physician contact to enhance care continuity and coordination. They stress the need for a well-functioning primary care system, highlighting insufficient resources and legislative gaps that have hindered its development. The motion calls for a national system that guarantees patients' rights to select a named physician and urges the government to implement necessary legal amendments and funding principles to strengthen primary care and patient rights.

title: Screening längre upp i åldrarna
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance Sweden's legal framework in alignment with EU regulations regarding biometric data management. It advocates for a comprehensive analysis of biometric data terminology, the destruction of fingerprint and photograph records upon Swedish citizenship or after a maximum of ten years, and the exploration of extending the retention period for biometric data. The underlying intent is to strengthen border control and national security while ensuring compliance with EU standards and addressing the issues surrounding illegal residency in Sweden.

title: Bygg mer på gamla detaljplaner
summary: The Christian Democrats propose a motion concerning the adaptation of Swedish law to the EU's new entry and exit system, emphasizing several key areas for improvement. They advocate for a clearer definition of biometric data, the retention of biometric data even after initial assessments, the need for an awareness system regarding individuals with re-entry bans, and the registration of entries and exits for permit holders. The proposal aims to enhance security control, prevent illegal immigration, and ensure accurate documentation for immigration processes.

title: En tobaksfri uppväxt
summary: The proposal by the Liberals emphasizes the need for a comprehensive primary care reform in Sweden, which includes guaranteed rights for patients to choose and list themselves with a named family doctor, a national patient listing service, and the implementation of care guarantees extending across regional boundaries. The motion also advocates for limitations on the number of patients that can be listed with a single provider to ensure quality care, the creation of an independent payment system for digital care, and a national target for increasing the proportion of patients with a designated family doctor. Additionally, it highlights the importance of small-scale, community-based healthcare solutions in areas where larger healthcare facilities struggle to establish themselves.

title: Föräldrars tillgång till sina barns journaler
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to provide the parliament with comprehensive financial frameworks for essential security interests related to military projects, ensuring accountability in cases of budget overruns, and outlines the need for the establishment of a publicly funded authority to oversee and monitor total defense operations by the end of 2022.

title: Reformerat lantmäteri
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1602 av Mikael Larsson och Catarina Deremar (båda C)
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats (SD) addresses the ambiguities surrounding the concept of biometrics in Swedish law, advocating for a clear definition to align with EU regulations. It calls for retaining a ten-year retention period for personal data in immigration law, preventing the unnecessary deletion of biometric data, and extending the registration of entries and exits to include third-country nationals with permits. The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining accurate records for law enforcement and immigration purposes.

title: En skola där ingen lämnas efter
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats proposes a national listing system for primary care, a unified compensation system, the removal of restrictions on patients switching care providers, and ensuring that the care guarantee is valid nationwide. The aim is to enhance accessibility and efficiency in healthcare, addressing existing disparities across Sweden and promoting continuity of care for all patients, regardless of their location. The proposal emphasizes the necessity for stronger primary care and improved service delivery to meet public expectations.

title: Sanningskommission för Sveriges agerande kring Dag Hammarskjölds död
summary: The proposal from the Left Party aims to maintain the loan-to-value ratio for residential properties at 75% and increase the over-collateralization requirement from 2% to 5% in secured bond markets. Additionally, it suggests that extensions on the maturity of secured bonds should only be allowed in severe market disruptions when other protective measures for investors are absent. These changes are intended to enhance the financial stability and investor protection within the context of the secured bond market in Sweden.

title: Mandatet för Förenta Nationernas utredning av orsakerna till Dag Hammarskjölds död
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government creates a long-term national economic plan for the education, further training, and continuing education of doctors to ensure adequate staffing levels in primary care. It also calls for enhanced mandates for the National Healthcare Competence Council to address competency needs in primary care, the establishment of individual continuing education plans for each doctor, and the monitoring of patient choice in selecting healthcare providers. Additionally, the motion stresses the need for improved rural healthcare education and the development of models to increase care accessibility in rural areas.

title: Stärkt forskning om arbetsmiljö och arbetsliv
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen the quality and equity of pedagogical care by introducing stricter requirements for providers, ensuring that they prepare children for future education. Measures include guaranteed support for children with special needs, opportunities for staff development, and systematic evaluation of the services. Additionally, local authorities will assess the suitability of individual providers, requiring them to demonstrate compliance with regulations and allowing for oversight to ensure ongoing adherence. The changes are intended to enhance the educational framework for children in pedagogical care.

title: Utvecklad vård och behandlingsmetoder för folksjukdomen hypotyreos
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1597 av Ingela Nylund Watz och Azadeh Rojhan (båda S)
summary: The government proposes a temporary extension of state support for companies that were not in financial distress as of February 29, 2020, but faced difficulties due to the COVID-19 outbreak. This support, in the form of reduced energy taxes, would be available to eligible companies from March 1, 2020, to December 31, 2021, allowing them to receive tax relief under the energy tax law until the end of 2022, provided they apply for deductions or refunds during this period.

title: Ekonomisk rättvisa mellan boendeformer
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for Sweden to prioritize domestic military production over international missions, citing concerns raised by the National Audit Office regarding the balance between these two commitments. It argues that the Swedish Armed Forces should be organized primarily to enhance national defense capabilities, particularly in light of the deteriorating security situation in Europe. The motion calls on the government to ensure that military resources are allocated based on defense needs rather than being divided between international operations and national preparedness.

title: Trygghet för barn och unga när de vistas på Statens institutionsstyrelse (Sis)
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1595 av Åsa Karlsson och Björn Wiechel (båda S)
summary: The directive proposes the establishment of a unified legal framework for electronic communication services and networks in the EU, consolidating several existing directives to improve clarity and coherence. It aims to foster investment in high-speed broadband, ensure effective consumer protection, and address market fragmentation while safeguarding public order and security. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for interoperability and accessibility, particularly for users with disabilities, and responds to the technological advancements in communication networks.

title: Behov av fler kontrollplatser för tunga fordon i Sörmland, inte minst på 55:an
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1594 av Caroline Helmersson Olsson m.fl. (S)
summary: The suggestion proposes the establishment of a new legal framework for the European Union Agency for Railways, aimed at improving safety and interoperability within the railway sector. It emphasizes the need for a centralized approach to vehicle approvals and safety certification, enhancing the agency's role in technical support and coordination of safety measures across member states. The proposal aims to streamline procedures, reduce costs, and ensure that safety standards are maintained at a high level, while promoting a more efficient and integrated European railway area.

title: Säkrad energiförsörjning genom samordning
summary: The proposal outlines the government's budgetary decisions and authorizations for financial management and economic governance for the years 2022-2025, including credit limits for various state funds and investments in public property and financial stability measures. It addresses the allocation of funds across several governmental areas, including state administration, financial markets, and the execution of Agenda 2030 for sustainable development.

title: Ostlänken
summary: The Government's report outlines the assessment of the Swedish National Audit Office's recommendations regarding cost control in infrastructure investments. It highlights systematic underestimation of costs by the Swedish Transport Administration, a lack of transparency in cost revisions, and infrequent reassessment of investment decisions despite cost increases. The government acknowledges these issues and proposes measures to improve cost estimation and transparency, as well as reiterating the importance of systematic evaluations in future project planning.

title: Beståndet av skarv
summary: The document presents the Swedish government's report to the parliament outlining the application of secret coercive measures, including electronic communication monitoring and surveillance, during the year 2020. It details the usage of these measures under various laws set for criminal investigations and provides an assessment of their necessity, legality, and implementation in efforts to combat serious crimes.

title: En strategi för elflyget – kan gynna Skavsta
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Tax Agency (Skatteverket) should be responsible for handling applications for support during short-time work (korttidsarbete) in cases of temporary and serious economic difficulties faced by individual employers, which was previously managed by the Agency for Economic and Regional Growth (Tillväxtverket). Additionally, it includes provisions for handling compensation for costs related to skills development during particularly deep economic downturns, with the support being credited to the employer's tax account.

title: Jämställda pensioner
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1589 av Sofia Amloh och Louise Thunström (båda S)
summary: The government proposes amendments to the rules regarding secured bonds, aligning Swedish law with EU directives to enhance the market for secured bonds and ensure compliance with specific quality standards for investments. Key changes include harmonizing asset categories with EU capital requirements, regulating the extension of secured bond maturities, introducing liquidity buffer requirements, and mandating increased information disclosure for investors. The amendments aim to strengthen the confidence and functionality of the secured bonds market while maintaining existing operational structures and investor protections.

title: Snabbare tillståndsprocess
summary: The proposal seeks to extend the legal rights of policyholders regarding the redemption and transfer of individual life insurance policies, specifically targeting fund and deposit insurance agreements regardless of when they were signed. It aims to ensure that policyholders can redeem or transfer their insurance values, and establishes that fees associated with such transactions should only reflect the direct administrative costs involved. Additionally, the proposal includes amendments to accounting laws to correct references pertaining to insurance reporting.

title: Erkännande av folkmordet Seyfo
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1587 av Magnus Oscarsson och Yusuf Aydin (båda KD)
summary: The Swedish government's written report (2021/22:73) outlines the application of the law on special alien control from July 1, 2020, to June 30, 2021, detailing decisions made regarding deportations in cases related to national security and international terrorism. During this period, eight decisions were made, including three rejections of appeals against deportation orders. The report also discusses the development of international terrorism and Sweden's participation in counter-terrorism efforts, emphasizing the ongoing threats from both far-right and Islamist extremist groups.

title: Erkännande av Jerusalem som Israels huvudstad
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1586 av Magnus Oscarsson och Dan Hovskär (båda KD)
summary: The Swedish government presents an annual report to the parliament detailing the monitoring and assessment of electronic signal interception within defense intelligence activities, as mandated by the 2008 law on signal intelligence. This report provides insights into the operations of the responsible authorities, their compliance with regulations, and efforts to ensure the protection of personal integrity while carrying out these security measures.

title: Frisläppande av Dawit Isaak
summary: The Swedish government has presented a report addressing the effectiveness of the military's efforts to enhance the operational capabilities of army forces during the defense orientation period from 2016 to 2020. The Riksrevisionen's findings indicate that both the government and the Armed Forces have encountered significant inefficiencies in planning, analysis, and implementation, affecting the military's ability to achieve its operational goals. Recommendations for improved steering and accountability have been made, which the government acknowledges and states that some measures have already been initiated. The government is committed to continuous monitoring and alignment of military activities with available resources.

title: Ny utredning om vad som hände Raoul Wallenberg
summary: The Swedish government proposes changes to national law to implement new EU regulations for an electronic entry and exit system aimed at improving border control for third-country nationals. This includes requirements for biometric data collection such as fingerprints and photographs for identity verification. The regulations will enhance security measures and facilitate the identification of individuals who do not meet entry conditions. The new laws, once approved, will come into effect on a date determined by the government.

title: Ett Raoul Wallenbergcentrum/-museum
summary: Sverigedemokraterna (SD) has proposed a motion to extend the applicability of the COVID-19 law, emphasizing the need for parliamentary oversight and proper justification for any limitations on citizens' constitutional rights. They argue against the current delegation of extensive normative powers to the government regarding restrictions that infringe on basic freedoms, advocating instead for a system where any significant constraints must receive parliamentary approval and be based on scientific evidence. The proposal seeks to ensure transparency and proportionality in the government's exercise of such powers.

title: Införandet av ett flerårigt system för svenskt demersalt yrkesfiske
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish parliament to reject the prolongation of the COVID-19 law and temporary infection control measures at serving establishments unless absolutely necessary, advocating for a focus on using vaccine passes instead of broader restrictions. It emphasizes the need for maintaining individual freedoms while managing public health risks due to increased infection rates. The motion promotes a strategy of proportionality in public health measures and suggests that vaccine passes serve as a less intrusive alternative to general restrictions, aiming to minimize economic impact on affected industries.

title: Avveckling av Havs- och vattenmyndigheten
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1581 av Roland Utbult och Lili André (båda KD)
summary: The motion proposes that the government should ensure increased vaccination, testing, and contact tracing in a sustainable and accessible manner throughout the country in response to the ongoing challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. It supports the extension of the current laws aimed at controlling the spread of the virus while emphasizing the importance of transparent communication regarding the government's decision-making process. The motion highlights the need for proactive measures to manage public health and the economy, given the recent increase in infection rates.

title: Skyddsjakt och allmän jakt på säl
summary: The motion proposes that the validity period of the COVID-19 law should be set to two months, ending in March, and emphasizes the need for the government to regularly report on the impacts of the law and analyze its consequences on children's rights. Additionally, it calls for a communication campaign to inform the public about the state's pandemic response and the importance of vaccination, while stressing the balance between effective health measures and protecting civil liberties.

title: Kulturella och kreativa näringar
summary: The proposal advocates for the Tax Agency to extend the tax deferral period by up to 36 months after the initial maximum deferral period ends, addressing the need for long-term repayment plans for businesses struggling due to the pandemic. It argues that a longer repayment time is essential to prevent viable companies from going bankrupt, which would lead to increased unemployment and reduced tax revenue. The motion calls for individual payment plans to be established for cases where tax amounts are significantly high compared to a company's normal profitability.

title: Utredning av kapacitetseffekt för utbyggnad av Västra stambanan
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats proposes extending the tax deferral period for businesses to 36 months, contrasting the government's proposal of 15 months. This extension aims to alleviate liquidity issues faced by many companies due to the COVID-19 pandemic and to prevent the closure of otherwise viable businesses. The motion argues that extended deferral will support businesses in repaying their tax debts while acknowledging the potential impact on government tax collections.

title: Utredning av förutsättningarna för att utöka rotavdraget
summary: The motion proposes extending the previously granted deferral period for tax payments by up to an additional 24 months, in order to provide more support for businesses affected by COVID-19. The authors argue that the government should allow for greater flexibility in repayment plans and suggest that the tax authority's powers to determine these plans should be regulated to ensure fair treatment of businesses, especially smaller ones that continue to face economic challenges.

title: Krav på ljudnivåer från idrottsanläggningar
summary: The suggestion proposes to limit the opening hours and the number of visitors at restaurants due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, and advocates for the expiration of the COVID-19 law and temporary infection control measures by March 31, 2022. It supports the use of vaccination passes as a tool to help mitigate the spread of the virus, maintaining that vaccination should remain voluntary. The proposal also calls for a careful evaluation of the necessity for continued emergency measures as the pandemic evolves.

title: Skolavslutning och firanden av högtider med konfessionella inslag i kyrkolokaler
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support the development of longer and customized repayment plans for companies affected by the ongoing impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic. It highlights the need for flexibility in repayment schedules to adapt to the specific financial situations of businesses, particularly those in the hospitality sector, while ensuring accountability and proportionality in tax regulations.

title: Flytt av ambassaden i Israel till Jerusalem
summary: The proposal aims to reform primary healthcare in Sweden by increasing accessibility, participation, and continuity in care. It emphasizes that patients should receive coordinated and community-based care tailored to their needs and preferences. The government suggests implementing a system for selecting healthcare providers through a patient listing mechanism, limiting changes in providers to twice a year. Additionally, the proposal discusses the establishment of an electronic patient listing system and regional adjustments to ensure efficient operations within primary care services.

title: Statens statistikansvar på alkoholområdet
summary: The Swedish government proposes amendments to confidentiality provisions governing the Justitiekanslern's representation of the state in legal disputes. The changes aim to ensure that the Justitiekanslern can protect the state's rights on equal terms with other authorities, particularly in international arbitration and European Court disputes, where confidential handling of certain information is essential. The proposed new confidentiality clause would permit the Justitiekanslern to apply the same general confidentiality regulations as other authorities in these contexts, with the aim of enhancing the state's ability to meet international obligations. The changes are set to take effect on April 1, 2022.

title: Ökad självförsörjningsgrad av livsmedel
summary: The proposal aims to amend the existing law on financial coordination of rehabilitation efforts to permit members of the boards in coordination associations to participate in meetings remotely. This change intends to align the law with the municipal act regarding remote participation, providing improved efficiency and sustainability in operations through digital meetings. It is proposed that this new provision will come into effect on March 16, 2022.

title: Beredskapslager för livsmedel
summary: The government proposes to extend the validity of the COVID-19 law and the law regarding temporary infection control measures at service establishments until the end of May 2022. Although the epidemiological situation has improved, the ongoing pandemic necessitates continued readiness. The proposal includes removing certain governmental powers related to restrictions and adapting infection control measures at service establishments to align with those laws.

title: Utbyggnad av järnvägen mellan Alingsås och Göteborg
summary: The motion from the Liberals (L) opposes the government's proposition concerning ethical review of clinical drug trials, arguing that it was improperly presented by a transitional government without seeking necessary parliamentary support. The Liberals emphasize the importance of maintaining parliamentary norms and procedures, particularly in the context of recent transitions of power affecting parliamentary oversight. They propose that the government withdraw this proposition and reintroduce it through the newly formed government for proper handling.

title: Väg 46 mellan Falköping och Skövde
summary: The Liberal Party (L) proposes the rejection of the government bill regarding new excise tax directives, arguing that it was inappropriate for a transitional government to present such politically sensitive proposals without consulting all parliamentary parties. They emphasize the importance of adhering to established parliamentary practices and control, warning against an increase in the transitional government's freedom to initiate political actions. The Liberals suggest that the proposal should be retracted and resubmitted by the incoming government.

title: Kapacitetshöjande åtgärder på järnvägssträckan Falköping–Jönköping
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament emphasizes economic and environmental profitability in choosing infrastructure projects for state co-financing of regional public transport. It criticizes the current government's management of infrastructure oversight, highlighting that it has not met parliamentary transport policy goals, particularly in the context of the 'Sverigeförhandling' for urban agreements. The proposal advocates for a sustainable transport system that integrates all modes of transport, with a call for better planning and execution by the government and Trafikverket to prioritize social utility and fossil-free transport solutions.

title: Kroppsvisitation i samband med transporter vid landets förvar m.m.
summary: The motion calls on the government to ensure that the Police Authority improves its communication with crime victims, addressing concerns highlighted in the Swedish National Audit Office report. Currently, only 34% of victims are satisfied with the information provided regarding their cases, which undermines public trust in the justice system. The motion highlights the need for better training and support for police personnel tasked with informing victims and presents four recommendations aimed at enhancing the quality and consistency of the information provided. It criticizes the government's reactive approach and urges for proactive measures to improve the situation.

title: Reglering av nätdoktorers reklam
summary: The motion submitted by Per Bolund and others from the Green Party advocates for a greener forestry policy in Sweden through various measures, including increased funding for environmental protection, the establishment of a new investigation into the current forestry legislation, improved compliance with the environmental code, promotion of innovative business models in forestry, and enhanced support for nature tourism in protected areas. It emphasizes the balance between sustainable forest management and property rights, while calling for strengthened financial resources to ensure effective implementation of necessary reforms.

title: Mer jämställd arbetsmiljö
summary: The motion presented by the Liberals aims to ensure forest protection is based on voluntary measures and to evaluate the effectiveness of these measures by establishing a control station by 2026. It suggests changing the taxation of forestry to provide clearer financial incentives for landowners to participate in conservation, proposes the transfer of up to 85,000 hectares of productive forest land from Sveaskog to the state, and emphasizes the importance of balancing ecological goals with economic interests in forest management.

title: Förbud mot vinster i välfärden
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of property rights in forestry, advocating for voluntary agreements between landowners and authorities regarding land protection and management. It calls for reformulation of environmental goals to make them achievable, a review of the Environmental Code to clarify when exceptions to voluntary agreements are permissible, and the cessation of certain regulations that restrict land use. Additionally, it seeks to facilitate periodic taxation of compensation for forestry disturbances and proposes a new sales program for state-owned forest lands, highlighting the need to maintain ongoing forestry classifications and provide landowners with the right to contest registrations affecting their land.

title: Kommunklivet, en viktig del av omställningen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1563 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes several legislative changes regarding forest management and ownership rights, emphasizing a shift from voluntary measures to more restrictive policies. Key recommendations include a review of environmental goals, the potential for logging in near-mountain areas, and adjustments to compensation models for affected landowners. The motion also suggests ending the inventory of key biotopes, offering compensation to landowners impacted by this, and ensuring that all forms of ownership are eligible for benefits under proposed land sale and compensation programs. The goal is to enhance sustainable growth and biomass availability in forestry while protecting significant forest areas from logging.

title: Förbättring av nattågstrafiken till och från Norrland
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1562 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli m.fl. (S)
summary: The proposal submitted by the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the importance of restoring the principle of 'freedom under responsibility' for forest owners, advocating for a moratorium on formal protection of forests without the owner's consent and ensuring that protective measures are based on the presence of endangered species. The motion seeks clarity in the application of government propositions related to forest protection and emphasizes collaboration between forest owners and authorities, arguing that restrictions on forest utilization should be balanced and not unnecessarily burdensome.

title: Undervisning om folkmordet seyfo
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1561 av Ingela Nylund Watz och Denis Begic (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament calls on the government to urgently address deficiencies in the Police Authority's efforts to inform crime victims. It emphasizes the need to strengthen the victim perspective within the judicial system, ensuring that individuals who have suffered from crimes receive adequate support and information throughout the legal process. The motion highlights the shortcomings identified in the Swedish National Audit Office's report and advocates for immediate action to implement the recommended improvements to support crime victims effectively.

title: Arbetsmarknad som fungerar för alla människor i Sverige
summary: The government proposes a new law that complements the EU regulation on establishing a common digital entry point, aimed at providing information, procedures, and problem-solving services.
