The law will designate competent authorities in Sweden and define their responsibilities regarding the implementation of the digital entry point. This measure is intended to facilitate access to information and services for both individuals and businesses, thereby reducing the administrative burden associated with cross-border interactions within the EU.

title: Bibehållande av rätt till tolk inom vården
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1559 av Matilda Ernkrans och Denis Begic (båda S)
summary: The proposal aims to extend the deferment period for tax payments by a maximum of 15 months, allowing taxpayers to create a payment plan for settled amounts. This adjustment to the 2009 law on tax deferral responds to financial difficulties faced due to COVID-19, offering relief for those with tax debts while establishing a final payment deadline following any extension.

title: Trygghet för skyddsombud
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament rejects the government proposition regarding the right to leave for political assignments in other countries. It argues that such political roles are not essential for Swedish democracy and suggests that any related issues should be resolved through informal agreements or within Nordic cooperation frameworks instead of unilateral liberalization of leave regulations for political assignments abroad.

title: Tryggheten i socialförsäkringssystemen
summary: The proposal aims to amend the Law (2003:460) regarding ethical review of research involving humans by introducing a provision that allows the government to establish transitional regulations necessary for aligning national law with the EU Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 on clinical trials of medicinal products for human use. Two technical corrections are proposed, one regarding the new transitional provisions and another adjusting a legal reference due to a name change in related legislation. These changes are intended to ensure Swedish regulations are consistent with EU requirements.

title: Nya konstitutionella spelregler
summary: Moderaterna propose that the Riksdag reject the government's suggestion to amend the constitutional protections for certain search services within the freedom of speech and press laws. They argue that the government's proposal, which follows a controversial investigation, would potentially weaken constitutional protections and that it has faced significant criticism from several legal authorities and media organizations regarding its clarity and implications for freedom of speech.

title: Främjande av religionsdialog
summary: The proposal advocates for a robust media policy in Sweden, emphasizing the need to enshrine the independence of public service media in the constitution. The supporters argue that a diverse and independent media landscape is essential for democracy, especially in times of crisis when misinformation can spread. It also suggests safeguarding public service funding and operations from political interference by requiring a higher threshold for legislative changes, similar to protections for religious organizations. Overall, the motion aims to enhance the independence and reliability of public service media in ensuring informed citizenry.

title: Främjande av tillkomsten av personalägda företag
summary: The Center Party proposes that the Swedish Parliament reject the government's proposals for amendments to the Freedom of the Press Act and the Fundamental Law on Freedom of Expression, arguing that these changes may restrict the essential rights to freedom of the press and expression. The Center Party emphasizes the significance of these freedoms within the democratic framework and criticizes the proposed limitations on certain search services that disclose personal data related to legal offenses, stating that such changes could infringe on fundamental liberties without a broad consensus in Parliament.

title: Missbruk av förtroendevaldas ersättningar
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1553 av Gustaf Lantz och Petter Löberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests rejecting government restrictions on the constitutional protections for certain search services that disclose personal data about criminal offenses. It calls for the government to clarify the conditions for reviewing public service content online, emphasizing the importance of protecting freedom of expression while balancing it against individual privacy rights. The motion expresses concern about the vagueness of proposed regulations and their potential impact on public access to information.

title: Skärpt kontroll av lobbyister som verkar gentemot riksdagsledamöter
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1552 av Gustaf Lantz och Petter Löberg (båda S)
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats (KD) calls for the Swedish government to enhance the effectiveness of preventative measures associated with sick leave to ultimately reduce long-term sickness absence. The proposal emphasizes improving the collaboration among Försäkringskassan (the Swedish Social Insurance Agency), employers, and primary care, and suggests evaluating the effectiveness of preventative interventions. Additionally, the motion advocates for a more flexible and purposeful compensation system to better facilitate preventive work, addressing issues related to the current structure of the preventative sick leave system, which has not been updated in nearly 30 years.

title: Utvecklade företagsdata för ett starkare näringsliv
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1551 av Markus Selin och Mathias Tegnér (båda S)
summary: The proposal addresses the need for the Swedish government to clarify the responsibilities and mission of Försäkringskassan in preventing sickness absence and work incapacity. It highlights the inadequate prioritization of preventive measures within Försäkringskassan, citing a lack of clear directives from the government over the past seven years. The motion calls for an urgent evaluation of the effects of preventive measures funded by Försäkringskassan to better support the long-term goal of reducing sickness-related work absence.

title: Trygghet för företagare
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1550 av Mathias Tegnér och Jennie Nilsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports more concrete measures to ensure access to orphan drugs for small patient groups, highlighting concerns over the existing governmental regulation that limits accessibility. The authors criticize the government's slow response to the issue and call for immediate action to facilitate access to these vital medications, which are essential for patients' health and well-being.

title: En översyn av kulturhistoriska platser med större allmänt intresse
summary: The suggestion from the Christian Democrats (KD) proposes that the Swedish government should report to the Riksdag by June 1, 2022, on actions taken to implement the Swedish National Audit Office's recommendations regarding the pricing and subsidization of pharmaceuticals. The proposal emphasizes the need for a national strategy and funding for the treatment of rare diseases, ensuring equitable access for patients, and the adaptation of payment models for precision medicine to account for innovative therapies that may have high initial costs but lower overall societal costs due to improved patient outcomes.

title: Förbud mot filtercigaretter
summary: The suggestion from the Sweden Democrats calls for the government to clarify the mission of the Social Insurance Agency (Försäkringskassan) in preventing sickness absence, provide information to relevant stakeholders, and introduce a new benefit called prevention compensation as proposed in a recent investigation. This motion highlights the rising issue of sickness absence due to mental health and strain injuries and argues that preventive measures have not been prioritized, leading to insufficient use of existing compensation options for prevention.

title: Högskolan i Skövde
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1547 av Patrik Björck och Marcus Andersson (båda S)
summary: The motion presented by Ida Gabrielsson and others advocates for increased knowledge among all participants in the sickness absence and rehabilitation process regarding preventive benefits and initiatives available within the social insurance system. It also calls for the government to ensure that the Swedish Social Insurance Agency operates with clear long-term goals to prevent sickness absence and promote rehabilitation, addressing reported inefficiencies and inconsistencies highlighted by the National Audit Office.

title: Vargjakt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government implements the recommendations from the National Audit Office regarding the state's pharmaceutical subsidies, ensuring the development of a national strategy for more effective drug treatments and fostering collaboration between state and regional authorities. It emphasizes the need for transparency and efficiency in resource allocation for pharmaceuticals in order to enhance public health outcomes and accessibility to innovative treatments.

title: Särskilda parkeringstillstånd efter behov
summary: The proposition suggests changes to implement the EU Council Directive 2020/262 regarding excise tax regulations, which includes the introduction of new laws for tobacco tax, alcohol tax, and the European Union's excise tax area. It also includes amendments to existing laws, such as energy tax laws, and proposes to repeal previous tobacco and alcohol tax laws, with the changes set to take effect in early 2023.

title: Beredskapsskatt
summary: The Moderaterna party proposes rejecting the government's proposition for mandatory labeling and registration of cats, suggesting the government first evaluate the effects of existing animal protection laws and address ongoing issues related to the current dog registry. They argue that adding cats to a problematic registry will not solve existing animal welfare problems and highlight the importance of distinguishing owned cats from abandoned ones, to improve protection for the latter.

title: Vuxnas tillgång till bildning genom livet
summary: The suggestion proposed by the Moderate Party advocates for amendments to the constitutional protections regarding freedom of association to counteract criminal organizations and violent extremism. It calls for the government to investigate and implement exceptions that prohibit participation in criminal gangs and all forms of violent extremist groups, regardless of their ideological motivations. The aim is to provide law enforcement authorities with stronger tools to combat organized crime and enhance public safety.

title: Alla barns tillgång till kulturskola
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1542 av Linus Sköld och Ida Karkiainen (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a cohesive education program for newly arrived individuals who have a duty to educate themselves. It calls on the government to evaluate the financial implications of such programs on municipalities, enhance the availability of adult education for high school students needing to complete subjects, and ensure the efficient application of sanctions by the Employment Agency for those failing to meet educational obligations. Furthermore, it advocates for full-time educational activities for those under the education obligation to facilitate better integration into the job market.

title: Individualiserad föräldraförsäkring
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures to strengthen the oversight and enforcement capabilities of the Swedish School Inspectorate in response to serious deficiencies in certain schools. It calls for increased inspections, stricter regulations on temporary operational bans, and clearer guidelines for the involvement of courts in the decisions made by the Inspectorate. Additionally, it seeks to hold individual school leaders accountable for violations and to allow municipalities to reclaim educational funds from operators convicted of financial crimes.

title: Avståndet mellan stat och medborgare
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for clearer criteria regarding the revocation of school approvals under the two-year rule, aiming to ensure that all schools deliver high-quality education. It argues for increased powers for the School Inspectorate to close schools that fail to meet high standards and stresses the importance of equal educational conditions for all students, regardless of the school management. The Center Party calls for more specificity in the legislation concerning the special grounds for intervention, citing concerns raised by various stakeholders.

title: Stärkta förutsättningar för nyindustrialisering
summary: The motion proposes enhancements to the vocational education system in Sweden, addressing the need for better alignment between educational offerings and regional labor market demands. It emphasizes the importance of high-quality education for job opportunities and economic growth, while calling for clearer decision-making processes and accountability from the Swedish Agency for Vocational Education and Training (MYH). The motion urges the government to take action based on the findings of the Swedish National Audit Office, which highlight shortcomings in MYH's responsiveness to regional needs and the transparency of its operations.

title: Dubbelspår på Malmbanan
summary: The Center Party opposes the proposed mandatory identification and registration of cats, arguing that the current voluntary measures are sufficient and that a mandatory system would not provide significant benefits to justify the administrative burden and costs. They emphasize the increased responsibility of cat owners through education rather than regulation, and voice concerns over privacy risks associated with extensive registration of cat owners. The party draws comparisons with existing laws for dogs, asserting that the justification for such a law does not apply to cats due to differing issues related to public safety and disease control.

title: Beredskapslager
summary: The motion proposes that the government should improve the ability of the National Board of Health and Welfare to collect and manage individual-based statistics and create a more cohesive system for indicator-based monitoring of social services, addressing limitations identified by the National Audit Office regarding the effectiveness of current open comparisons in promoting equity and quality in social services.

title: Avskaffat krav på matservering för alkoholtillstånd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider aligning the reporting of payment terms with the fiscal year and conduct an evaluation of the newly proposed law on reporting payment terms for companies with more than 250 employees after its implementation. The Moderates assert that payment adherence to agreed timelines is crucial and express concerns regarding the administrative burden of the proposed reporting schedule. They also highlight criticisms regarding insufficient impact assessments associated with new regulations.

title: Samma skatt på snus som nikotinpåsar
summary: The motion submitted by Johan Forssell and other members of the Moderate Party and Christian Democrats proposes to clarify that individuals who possess a sound suppressor compatible with multiple firearms they are authorized to use can utilize the suppressor with all those firearms without the need for additional permits. This motion follows previous calls to eliminate the special permit requirements for sound suppressors.

title: Självförsörjningsmål
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1534 av Hans Eklind och Yusuf Aydin (båda KD)
summary: Vänsterpartiet avvisar förslaget om att ge Skolinspektionen utökade befogenheter att stänga skolor med offentlig huvudman vid allvarliga brister. Partiet argumenterar för en jämlik och demokratisk skola och menar att skolsystemets problem snarare är en konsekvens av marknadsinriktade reformer. Vänsterpartiet föreslår istället att sådana skolor ska kunna läggas under statlig tvångsförvaltning vid allvarliga missförhållanden, för att säkerställa en långsiktig och likvärdig skolgång för alla barn. Partiet anser att en permanent stängning av kommunala skolor inte adresserar de underliggande problemen i skolsystemet.

title: Nationellt förbud mot böneutrop från religiösa byggnader
summary: The motion calls for an investigation into the revision of association freedom to enable prohibitions against participation in or associations with criminal organizations and violent organizations. It emphasizes the need for timely legal action regarding terrorist-related issues and suggests the formation of a parliamentary committee tasked with reviewing and proposing regulations concerning participation in criminal organizations, as well as addressing the state of organizations that use violence to achieve their goals. The motion is backed by the Sweden Democrats, who highlight the rising organized crime and the necessity for legislative measures.

title: Avskaffad tvångskvotering i föräldraförsäkringen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the right to possess silencers for firearms if a person is eligible to apply for a license for a corresponding weapon. It also advocates for the same rights regarding the possession of ammunition, proposing that individuals should have the right to possess ammunition if they can apply for a license for a suitable firearm. The motion argues that current regulations create unnecessary difficulties for law-abiding hunters and sport shooters, particularly when transitioning between weapons.

title: Permanent sommartid
summary: The motion advocates for a new and more comprehensive report from the government regarding the ongoing relevance of the COVID-19 laws, emphasizing the need for a broader examination of their impacts beyond public health, such as on democracy and the economy. The authors express concern over the government's reliance on a single authority, the Public Health Agency, for guidance on legislation that significantly restricts civil liberties and economic activities.

title: Hälsosamtal från 40 år för alla
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the requirement for a special permit for silencers, arguing that the government's proposal to classify silencers similarly to ammunition does not satisfy the clear request previously expressed by the parliament. The motion highlights potential issues that could arise from the proposed classification, including legal ambiguities and undesirable criminalization related to the ownership and sale of firearms and silencers.

title: Vårdsamverkan över gränsen
summary: The motion submitted by Tina Acketoft and others from the Liberal Party opposes the government's proposition concerning foreign espionage legislation, citing concerns that proposed criminalization could infringe on freedom of speech and information. The Liberals advocate for continued work on providing stronger guarantees for these freedoms, emphasizing the importance of journalistic integrity and public interest over state secrecy. They propose that the government should revise the legislation to ensure clarity, predictability, and protection for individuals exercising their rights to free expression.

title: Oslo–Stockholm 2.55
summary: The proposal from the Christian Democrats (KD) emphasizes the need for a thorough evaluation of the new law on payment terms for businesses, aiming to address the issue of prolonged payment times that can negatively impact smaller companies. The suggested law would require larger companies to report their payment terms to ensure fairness and balance between smaller and larger entities in the market. KD expresses support for the initiative but underscores the importance of minimizing bureaucratic burdens on businesses and proposes an evaluation after three years to assess the law's effectiveness.

title: Finnskogen som världsarv
summary: The Christian Democrats propose to reject the government's bill concerning the mandatory marking and registration of cats, as outlined in the motion 2021/22:4303. Their argument centers on the disproportionate costs and administrative burdens this would impose on cat owners, particularly when alternatives, such as an existing registry maintained by the Swedish Cat Clubs Federation (Sverak), already exist. The proposal is seen as unnecessary given the potential low compliance rates among less responsible cat owners, and the party emphasizes the need for more effective solutions to the problem of homeless and feral cats.

title: Vapenförvaring
summary: The motion proposes a series of amendments to the temporary COVID-19 legislation, advocating for a more immediate parliamentary review of government-issued restrictions, clarifying the language regarding measures to prevent virus spread, and emphasizing the protection of citizens' rights to demonstrate. The Left Party stresses the need for careful assessment of public health and individual freedoms during the ongoing pandemic, especially concerning socio-economic impacts on vulnerable groups, and argues for the removal of certain provisions that restrict gatherings and personal freedoms.

title: Ett starkare Norden
summary: The proposal aims for the Swedish government to follow up and evaluate the effects of new reporting requirements for payment timelines in the business sector, particularly targeting larger companies with over 250 employees. It expresses concerns about the increasing payment timelines that negatively impact smaller businesses' liquidity and growth opportunities, advocating for a system that collects and publishes payment data to promote accountability and foster positive changes in payment behavior among companies. The motion emphasizes the importance of monitoring the effectiveness of these regulations every two years through reporting in the budget proposition.

title: E18
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the ability to shut down schools with serious deficiencies by ensuring that operational bans follow individuals in leadership roles, clarifying the two-year rule regarding business operation exemptions, and strengthening the oversight authority of the School Inspectorate. The authors argue that such measures are essential for holding educational leaders accountable and improving school quality, especially in underperforming and rural schools.

title: Inrättande av en nationell Astrid Lindgren-dag
summary: The proposal put forward by the Sweden Democrats (SD) seeks to reject the government's bill for a comprehensive education program for newly arrived immigrants subject to educational obligations. The SD criticizes the bill for placing further responsibilities on municipalities without addressing existing integration challenges. They argue that the focus should instead be on individual accountability in adapting to the labor market, emphasizing the need for Swedish language instruction and societal orientation. Moreover, concerns are raised about the potential for bureaucratic inefficiencies and financial strains on municipalities due to new regulations that would limit their autonomy in education delivery.

title: Tillkännagivande av mottagare av litteraturpriset till Astrid Lindgrens minne (Alma) i Astrid Lindgrens stad Vimmerby
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the Riksbank Act, advocating for the inclusion of an employment target alongside the inflation target, asserting that both should hold equal weight in monetary policy. It calls for Parliament to have the right to formulate more precise monetary policy goals and recommends an investigation to strengthen regulations concerning the ownership of securities by senior officials within the Riksbank. The motion argues that the current emphasis on inflation has been ineffective in achieving economic stability and that the oversight over the members' securities should be improved to uphold the credibility of the Riksbank.

title: Avancerad specialistsjuksköterska
summary: The motion proposes that the government ensure transparency in the process of the Swedish Agency for Higher Vocational Education (MYH) by requiring that educational providers receive clear and relevant explanations when their applications to join MYH are denied. The proponents argue that providing justification for rejections is essential to prevent conflicts of interest and corruption within MYH, and it would also help applicants understand how they might improve their proposals in accordance with the existing regulations and community needs.

title: Komplettering av lagen om nedskräpning
summary: The government presents its assessment of the observations and recommendations made by the National Audit Office regarding state co-financing of regional public transport infrastructure under the 'Sverigeförhandling' urban agreements. The assessment concludes that the government has not ensured alignment between the state funding and the parliament's transport policy goals, citing deficiencies in the government's preparatory conditions, decision-making processes, and the ability to prioritize effective public transport measures according to socio-economic criteria. Recommendations include ensuring that future negotiations prioritize transport policy objectives, are based on thorough needs analyses, and provide transparent oversight of the implementation of agreed measures.

title: Stöd till folkparker
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should enable municipalities to collaborate with independent school operators to provide emergency placements for students when local schools face serious deficiencies. Although the current government proposal allows for the closure of schools with significant issues, the Liberals argue that the measures are insufficient. They specifically call for solutions to ease municipalities' responsibility in ensuring students receive education if schools are shut down, suggesting that independent school operators be allowed to take on this responsibility.

title: Ledsagning
summary: The motion proposes reforms to improve Försäkringskassan's effectiveness in preventing sick leave, highlighting issues identified by the Swedish National Audit Office regarding unclear mandates and regional disparities in the use of preventive sickness benefits. Liberalerna advocates for a clearer directive for Försäkringskassan to act as a supportive partner in the rehabilitation process and recommends the establishment of an individualized support program to help sick individuals return to work. The proposal emphasizes the necessity for a comprehensive reform effort at Försäkringskassan to restore public trust and enhance service quality.

title: Myndighet i Halland
summary: The motion proposes that the reporting requirements regarding payment terms for businesses should align with the fiscal year and suggests increasing the employee threshold for reporting obligations to 499 employees. Additionally, it calls for an evaluation of the new law regarding payment terms after its implementation to assess its effectiveness in reducing payment delays and supporting small to medium enterprises in Sweden.

title: Utvärdering av kemikalieskatten
summary: The Swedish National Audit Office (Riksrevisionen) has reviewed the effectiveness of the Police Authority's communication with crime victims, identifying significant deficiencies that hinder optimal performance. The report highlights inadequate internal guidance and insufficient analysis aimed at enhancing communication, leading to a risk of victims not receiving all necessary information regarding their cases. In response, the audit office issued several recommendations aimed at improving training, support, and clarity in roles and responsibilities to ensure victims receive the necessary information throughout the judicial process.

title: Ny elproduktion i elområde 3 och 4
summary: The motion proposes rejecting the government's bill for a risk tax on credit institutions, arguing that it would negatively impact jobs, increase costs for consumers and businesses, and undermine the competitiveness of Swedish banks. It criticizes the tax for being poorly designed and likely to cause financial burdens on families and municipalities, especially small and medium-sized ones, while also raising concerns about its compliance with EU state aid regulations and the possibility of distorting competition within the financial sector.

title: Översyn av momssatserna
summary: The proposal aims to enhance voter protection during the voting process by ensuring that a designated voting official is always present when someone is assisting a voter, particularly those with disabilities. Additionally, it suggests implementing a legal confidentiality obligation for individuals who assist voters, thereby safeguarding the secrecy of the ballot. The motion emphasizes the importance of preventing undue influence during voting and advocates for stricter regulations to uphold the integrity of the electoral system in Sweden.

title: Omvänd skattskyldighet
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats proposes several reforms to enhance the electoral system, focusing on the evaluation and potential reform of the ballot system, the introduction of a chairperson for polling officials, and the establishment of rules to ensure order at polling places. It also addresses issues related to campaign propaganda near polling stations, advocates for the transparency of the voting process, and suggests measures to prevent misuse of assistance by voters with disabilities. Additionally, it calls for the implementation of confidentiality obligations for individuals assisting voters.

title: En granskning av public services opartiskhet
summary: The proposal from the Liberals calls for an investigation into alternative ballot systems and emphasizes the necessity of having a ballot officer present when voters receive assistance with their ballots. The motion aims to address current weaknesses in the Swedish election process, including issues related to ballot secrecy and security, particularly for voters with disabilities. Despite government resistance to a broader review of the ballot system, the Liberals argue that a comprehensive reform is necessary given the critical feedback from electoral authorities and the potential for manipulation in the current system.

title: Dubblerat barnbidrag
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes that the Swedish Parliament rejects the government's proposition to introduce new criminal offenses related to foreign espionage, arguing that current laws sufficiently address security concerns without further restricting individual liberties, particularly freedom of expression. They emphasize the importance of maintaining a balanced approach that protects both national security and democratic principles, citing a lack of substantial evidence for the necessity of such new crimes and expressing concern over the potential negative impact on press freedoms.

title: Införande av tjänstemannaansvar
summary: The government proposes a new law granting employees in Sweden the right to take leave from their jobs for political assignments at the local or regional level in another country within the European Economic Area (EEA), Switzerland, or the United Kingdom. This right to leave would be aligned with similar provisions for Swedish political assignments under the Local Government Act.

title: Karensavdraget vid sjukdom
summary: The Christian Democrats (KD) propose that the Swedish government should either exempt Kommuninvest from a new risk tax on credit institutions or provide compensation to municipalities and regions for the negative effects of this tax. They argue that even though the tax targets systemically important institutions, Kommuninvest, which supports public investment projects in various municipalities, should not be subject to this tax as it could hinder public financing and increase costs for essential welfare projects, thus potentially exacerbating financial risks for smaller municipalities.

title: Barngruppernas storlek i förskolan
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1506 av Jim Svensk Larm m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should endorse several recommendations aimed at strengthening the oversight of schools with serious deficiencies. Key suggestions include clarifying what constitutes a serious mismanagement, expanding the Swedish Schools Inspectorate's (Skolinspektionen) role to include improvement-oriented feedback, and increasing the number of inspections, particularly unannounced ones. The motion reflects a broader concern for ensuring quality in Swedish education by enabling firmer action against schools with repeat violations, aligning intervention measures for both municipal and independent schools.

title: Delning av aska vid gravsättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government review the work of Transportstyrelsen concerning vehicle inspection regulations to enhance efficiency and ensure environmental controls are consistent with EU standards. It calls for a thorough investigation into the impact of Swedish environmental requirements compared to EU norms, regular evaluations of the boards of inspection organizations, and adequate oversight of Transportstyrelsen's responsibilities. The motion argues for a more effective regulatory framework to guarantee impartial vehicle inspections and better service availability, particularly in rural areas.

title: Utbyggnad av hållbar elproduktion
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1504 av Dzenan Cisija och Amalia Rud Pedersen (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament exempt Kommuninvest from a new risks tax on credit institutes, as its imposition could disproportionately harm rural municipalities reliant on affordable loans. It also suggests that foreign banks operating in Sweden through loan intermediaries should be subject to the risks tax to ensure fair competition within the credit market. Furthermore, it calls for an investigation into potential circumvention of the risks tax by foreign banks post-implementation.

title: Grundlagsfäst public service
summary: The proposal aims to amend the Freedom of the Press Act and the Fundamental Law on Freedom of Expression, introducing several changes such as expanding the territorial application of the Freedom of Expression Act to include certain satellite broadcasts, strengthening personal privacy protections by limiting the disclosure of personal data regarding criminal offenses, and establishing conditions for monitoring public service companies' program activities on the internet. These amendments are intended to enhance the protection of freedom of expression and press while ensuring individual privacy rights.

title: Öläge
summary: The government proposal aims to strengthen property rights and introduce flexible protection forms for forests, emphasizing voluntary participation in nature conservation. It seeks to promote sustainable forestry growth, enhance biodiversity, and ensure biomass availability while minimizing greenhouse gas leakage. The proposal includes measures for increased compensation for landowners and emphasizes collaboration between authorities and forest owners to improve forest management and conservation efforts.

title: En differentierad ölskatt för bättre konkurrens
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1501 av Joakim Järrebring och Petter Löberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes transferring the responsibility for international knowledge assessments, such as the PISA tests, from the Swedish National Agency for Education to the Institute for Labor Market and Educational Policy Evaluation (IFAU). It aims to enhance the reliability of these assessments following criticisms from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding high exclusion rates of students and insufficient oversight by the current agency. The motion also calls for the government to propose additional measures to ensure the credibility of future assessments.

title: Utvecklingsländers makt över sin egen matproduktion och handel
summary: This motion calls for the Swedish government to address the shortcomings identified in the Riksrevisionen's report on the 2018 PISA survey, including ensuring correct participation in future surveys and transferring responsibility for conducting PISA from the Swedish National Agency for Education to universities. It argues that the 2018 results should be considered invalid due to a high exclusion rate of students, which undermines the reliability of the data and highlights ongoing issues within the Swedish education system.

title: Barns och ungas psykiska hälsa
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1499 av Lili André och Cecilia Engström (båda KD)
summary: The motion presented by the Sweden Democrats (SD) calls for a review of the decision-making process related to the reporting of students excluded from the PISA study due to disabilities and language barriers. They argue that the government has not acted adequately to ensure the reliability of PISA results, criticizes the choice of OECD as the evaluator, and proposes that the responsibility for conducting the PISA studies should return to Swedish universities rather than the current oversight by the Swedish National Agency for Education.

title: Stärkt narkotikaförebyggande arbete i Sverige
summary: The Christian Democrats propose an investigation into transferring responsibility for the international knowledge assessments, such as PISA, TIMSS, and PIRLS, from the Swedish National Agency for Education (Skolverket) back to universities, possibly in collaboration with the Institute for Labor Market and Educational Policy Evaluation (IFAU). This suggestion arises from concerns about the reliability of PISA 2018, where a significant number of students were excluded, leading to criticisms from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the government's oversight and compliance with OECD guidelines.

title: Skyddsjakt på säl och skarv
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to conduct an analysis to restore trust in the Pisa study following significant criticisms highlighted in a report by the National Audit Office regarding the 2018 assessment. The report pointed to issues such as a high percentage of student exclusions and inadequate follow-up by the Swedish National Agency for Education and government. The Center Party emphasizes the importance of reliable international assessments for evaluating educational development and calls for governmental responsibility in maintaining trust in the educational system.

title: Syrisk-ortodoxa kloster och kyrkor i Turkiet
summary: The Left Party argues against the government's proposal to amend the constitution, which would allow for expanded limitations on the freedom of association concerning organizations involved in or supporting terrorism. The party emphasizes the importance of protecting democratic values, civil rights, and personal integrity while ensuring effective measures against serious crime. They advocate for preventing terrorism through social welfare and addressing underlying issues rather than imposing restrictions on freedoms and rights, asserting that the current legal framework is adequate for combating terrorism without infringing on fundamental rights.

title: Återuppbyggnad av Irak och Syrien
summary: This government report assesses the findings of the Swedish National Audit Office regarding Försäkringskassan's effectiveness in preventing sick leave. The report identifies deficiencies in the agency's clarity of mission and regional disparities in the usage of preventive benefits, such as preventive sick pay. It emphasizes the necessity for clearer directives from the government to Försäkringskassan about its responsibilities and to evaluate the outcomes of preventive measures. The government concurs with the audit's observations and outlines steps taken in response to the recommendations.

title: Portal för myndigheters tjänster och webbplatser
summary: The Swedish government has addressed the findings of the National Audit Office regarding the sustainability efforts of the AP funds. The Audit Office concluded that while the sustainability work is generally effective in relation to the funds' mandates, there are recommendations for improvements. Key suggestions include clarifying the Sixth AP fund's mission regarding exemplary management, enhancing annual reporting to better indicate compliance with sustainability requirements, and improving clarity on the overall results of the funds' sustainability initiatives. The government agrees with these recommendations and considers the audit report as concluded.

title: Regelverk om tillåtet antal folkbokförda i en och samma bostad
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should conduct sustainability analyses on a continuous basis and improve the systematic follow-up of sustainability efforts in state-owned companies. Moderaterna and Kristdemokraterna emphasize the need for better governance of these companies and suggest that those without a clear societal mandate should eventually be privatized. The motion highlights shortcomings identified by the National Audit Office regarding the state's management of sustainability in these companies and calls for clearer international guidelines and improved reporting to the parliament on the government's progress towards sustainable development.

title: Ökad skattetransparens
summary: The motion presented by Kristina Axén Olin and others from the Moderate Party opposes the government's proposal to replace the term 'kunskapskrav' (knowledge requirements) with 'betygskriterier' (grading criteria) in Swedish schools. It suggests that 'kunskapskrav' should continue to be used in all grade levels and educational forms where grades are applied, emphasizing the need for knowledge-focused education and suggesting the introduction of centrally and externally assessed national tests to improve grading consistency and combat grade inflation. The proposal advocates for a return to subject grades in upper secondary education and supports the principle of teacher-led assessments aligned with established criteria.

title: Sjöfartsforskning
summary: Sverigedemokraterna propose a series of reforms to improve the handling of immigration cases by the Swedish Migration Agency, including abolishing one-man decisions, tightening identity checks, investigating a national ID center, enhancing staffing competencies, ensuring proper quality assurance and follow-up, and implementing thorough digitalization. They argue that current practices compromise legal certainty and effective immigration control, as highlighted by the Swedish National Audit Office's report.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposed motion emphasizes the need for improving the governance and sustainability practices of state-owned companies in Sweden. It calls on the government to clarify the direction of these companies in alignment with international guidelines and to enhance the evaluation and reporting of their sustainability efforts. It argues that the public benefit should take precedence over profit-making, especially when interests conflict, and advocates for an aggressive state ownership policy that builds a sustainable and equitable society.

title: Bostadssituationen för studenter
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1339 av Amalia Rud Pedersen och Adrian Magnusson (båda S)
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to prioritize identity verification processes for individuals coming to Sweden, particularly in relation to family reunification cases. It emphasizes the need for Swedish authorities to take significant measures to ensure proper identity checks, improve the legal quality of processing these cases, reassess the organizational structure regarding identity verification responsibilities, and enhance information sharing between relevant agencies to combat illegal immigration and protect national security.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om statens insatser mot invasiva främmande arter
summary: The motion by Christian Carlsson and other members of the Christian Democrats (KD) addresses the need for a more equitable grading system in Swedish schools, advocating for subject grades to replace course grades while maintaining clarity regarding knowledge requirements. It highlights the importance of fair merit evaluation for higher education, the necessity of implementing digital and externally assessed national tests to combat grading inconsistencies, and proposes that independent evaluators be involved in the grading process. The motion seeks to ensure that grades accurately reflect students' knowledge and that the education system encourages advanced study without disadvantaging motivated students.

title: Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reject the government's proposition to remove knowledge requirements from the school regulations, asserting that maintaining explicit knowledge criteria is essential for improving educational standards and equity. The Liberals advocate for subject grades in high schools and emphasize the importance of knowledge in both primary and secondary education, arguing that clear standards send a positive signal about the educational mission of schools.

title: Kvalitet i vård och omsorg genom utbyggnad av vuxenutbildningen
summary: Sverigedemokraterna föreslår en reform av betygssystemet i Sverige, där ämnesbetyg införs för att bättre spegla elevers kunskaper. De föreslår att detta ska ske från höstterminen 2023 och att nuvarande kunskapskrav ska bevaras för minimikravet för godkända betyg. Partiet är emot regeringens förslag som innebär förändringar av modersmålsundervisning, där de anser att sådan undervisning bör ske utanför skolans ram, samt att elever inte ska kunna gå in på högre ämnesnivåer utan att ha klarat av grundnivåerna. De betonar behovet av en mer rättvis meritvärdering i samband med det nya systemet.

title: Destinationsutveckling av östra Skåne
summary: The Swedish government proposes to extend the validity of the covid-19 legislation and the temporary infection control measures for serving establishments until the end of January 2022, citing their necessity in managing the pandemic and mitigating negative impacts on affected businesses and societal functions. The government's assessment, supported by the Public Health Agency's evaluation of ongoing infection risks, underscores the importance of these laws in preventing further spread of the virus, especially given the evolving health situation in Europe.

title: Uppdrag åt TLV att fortsätta förhandla om läkemedelsföretagens prissättning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1486 av Heléne Björklund och Adnan Dibrani (båda S)
summary: The government proposes legislation to require municipalities to provide a comprehensive education for newly arrived immigrants subject to educational obligations under the establishment program, aimed at those assessed as unable to enter the workforce due to a lack of education. This program will involve at least 23 hours of instruction per week, focusing on Swedish language and societal orientation, and is intended to equip participants with the knowledge necessary to pursue further education or establish themselves in the labor market.

title: Värnplikts- och civilpliktsutbildningar i Stockholms- och Mälardalsregionen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1485 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The government presents its assessment in response to the National Audit Office's report on drug subsidies, emphasizing the need for improved collaboration between the state, industry, and regions to maximize public health outcomes for the investment in pharmaceuticals. The government acknowledges the audit's recommendations, which include the establishment of better agreements and follow-up mechanisms to ensure effective pricing and subsidization, particularly in light of increased costs and uncertainty regarding new drug treatments. Overall, the government recognizes the importance of ongoing dialogues and strategic frameworks in managing pharmaceutical costs and the accessibility of medications.

title: Familje- och jourhem
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should reassess its contribution to the United Nations stabilization mission in Mali (Minusma) and consider withdrawing by mid-2023 if democratic elections are not scheduled and conducted in Mali during 2022. Additionally, it advocates for a prompt withdrawal if the Malian government contracts the Wagner Group. The motion emphasizes the importance of supporting a democratically elected government and outlines the risks of continued military presence under changing political conditions in Mali.

title: Användning av moderna tester för prostatacancer
summary: The motion calls for Sweden to reassess its military contribution to Mali if democratic elections are not held and to promptly withdraw from Task Force Takuba if the Malian government contracts the Wagner Group. It emphasizes the importance of Swedish participation in international security efforts while also expressing concern about the changing political landscape in Mali due to recent military coups, which may undermine the mandate for military intervention.

title: Bemanningsriktlinjer inom förskolan
summary: The motion, submitted by Hans Wallmark and others, emphasizes the need for Sweden to maintain a close dialogue with France regarding the development and withdrawal of Swedish military efforts in Mali. It calls for clearer objectives, frameworks, and oversight for these international missions and underlines the importance of ensuring that such efforts align with Sweden's national defense needs and international commitments, particularly in combating terrorism and instability in the Sahel region.

title: Reglering av hummerfiske
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1481 av Mattias Jonsson och Adnan Dibrani (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a continued Swedish military presence in Mali, emphasizing the importance of a close dialogue with France regarding the development and phase-out of Swedish operations. It calls for clearer reporting on the objectives and frameworks of the military efforts, with a focus on ensuring national defense needs are met while contributing to international security. The Moderaterna party highlights the critical nature of Sweden's partnership with France in combating terrorism and stabilizing the region, and emphasizes the need for a coherent strategy in Swedish international military operations that reflects national interests.

title: Möjligheten att ta CSN-lån för den som omskolar sig till yrkeschaufför
summary: The suggestion from the Sweden Democrats (SD) advocates for an expansion of tax relief regulations concerning employee stock options to include a broader range of industries. The motion criticizes the government's current exclusion of traditional sectors, arguing that they have shown innovation and should not be denied access to the benefits designed to support talent recruitment and employee motivation. It emphasizes the importance of including innovative companies within these traditional sectors, such as fintech and legal tech.

title: Grundkrav på kollektivavtal
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1479 av Annette Rydell och Heléne Björklund (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for the cessation of Sweden's military contribution to Task Force Takuba in Mali, citing deteriorating security conditions and concerns over the Malian military junta's relationships with Russia and potential paramilitary operations. It emphasizes the need for stabilizing efforts, protection of civilians, and the promotion of human rights while expressing skepticism about the junta's commitment to democratic elections initially planned for early 2022.

title: Skapa en utställning
summary: The proposal advocates for the phased withdrawal of the Swedish military contribution to the United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali (Minusma), suggesting that the withdrawal should be completed by mid-2023. The Liberalerna party acknowledges the need for stabilization efforts and the protection of civilians, yet expresses concerns over Mali's deteriorating security situation, military junta governance, and potential collaboration with Russian paramilitary forces, indicating that Swedish soldiers should not risk being associated with such actors.

title: Stärkning av barnkonventionens ställning
summary: The Liberal Party proposes that the Swedish parliament rejects the government's bill concerning changes to the definition of closely held companies and initiates a comprehensive investigation into the future structure of the 3:12 tax regulations. This investigation aims to simplify the regulatory framework and minimize adverse effects, emphasizing the need for a thorough analysis before legislative changes are made to prevent unforeseen consequences.

title: Konfessionella inslag i skolan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reject the government's proposal for continued Swedish participation in the French military operation Task Force Takuba in Mali. The proponents argue that participation in this offensive mission, rather than humanitarian efforts, prioritizes Swedish interests over the urgent needs of the Malian population, which is facing dire humanitarian crises and instability due to an ongoing conflict and significant human rights violations. The motion emphasizes a need for Swedish foreign policy to focus on long-term development cooperation with Mali instead of military intervention.

title: Politik för de nationella minoriteterna
summary: The motion initiated by Tony Haddou and others from the Left Party calls on the Swedish government to propose measures to significantly reduce processing times for family reunification cases handled by the Migration Agency. It also urges the government to conduct an inquiry into the legal security of the processing of these cases. The motion reflects criticism of the current system's inefficiencies, stating the importance of adhering to human rights principles regarding family unity and the need for improvements in resource allocation and process quality within the Migration Agency.

title: En lagstadgad kulturskola
summary: The government proposes the introduction of new laws criminalizing foreign espionage, which includes acts such as unauthorized disclosure of confidential information related to Sweden's international collaborations that could harm its relationships with other countries or international organizations. The proposal aims to enhance the protection of sensitive data in international peace and security efforts. Additionally, it expands current laws concerning unauthorized handling of secret information and establishes that certain actions stemming from foreign espionage will be considered as crimes against freedom of expression.

title: Höjda ambitioner för svensk parasport
summary: The government has addressed the findings of the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the vocational higher education system, suggesting the investigation of a unified application system for vocational programs to improve efficiency. While the audit determined that the system generally meets parliamentary intentions, recommendations were made for enhanced quality criteria, documentation processes to prevent conflicts of interest, and the effectiveness of the application handling. The government emphasizes developing methods for promoting effective resource usage and better student throughput, particularly among distance learners.

title: Barns och ungas tillgång till kultur
summary: The proposal aims to introduce a new law requiring larger Swedish companies (those with more than 250 employees) to report payment times for purchases from smaller companies (those with fewer than 250 employees). The law seeks to address the trend of increasing payment times, ensuring better conditions for smaller businesses to grow and thrive. Companies will report average agreed payment times, actual payment times, and the percentage of late payments in a publicly accessible register managed by Bolagsverket. Failure to comply can result in sanctions, including fines.

title: Civilsamhällets långsiktiga förutsättningar
summary: The proposal aims to introduce mandatory identification and registration for cats within the existing legislation governing pet oversight in Sweden. It stipulates that cat owners must have their pets marked and registered to assist authorities in distinguishing owned cats from abandoned or feral ones. The Swedish Board of Agriculture would manage the registry and authorities such as the Police and Customs would have direct access to it. Additionally, cat owners may be required to pay a fee for registration, and non-compliance could lead to fines.

title: Rätt till sfi för ukrainska flyktingar
summary: The government proposes amendments to existing laws to align with the new EU regulations on cohesion policy for the period 2021-2027. This includes changes to laws regarding structural support, rural development, territorial cooperation, and local action groups. The amendments aim to enhance the implementation of EU support frameworks and will come into effect on March 1, 2022.

title: Utgiftsområde 7 Internationellt bistånd
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1468 av Janine Alm Ericson m.fl. (MP)
summary: The Swedish government addressed the effectiveness of the Tax Agency's work in taxing the sharing economy based on a review by the National Audit Office. The review concluded that while the agency's efforts have been largely effective, improvements in the clarity of information provided to participants in the sharing economy are needed. The government supports recommendations to enhance guidance on income declaration and to improve internal information management. It also plans to follow the development of a new reporting system for platform-based incomes, which may further streamline the taxation process.

title: Sex- och samtyckeslyft för lärare
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1467 av Annika Hirvonen och Camilla Hansén (båda MP)
summary: The government proposes easing the permit requirements for silencers used with firearms, reclassifying them to be regulated similarly to ammunition instead of firearms. This legislative change aims to simplify the legal framework governing the possession and transfer of silencers, which is set to take effect on July 1, 2022.

title: Lagstiftning om bemannade skolbibliotek
summary: The government has proposed amendments to the Education Act to enhance the effectiveness of school oversight and to ensure consistent measures for both municipal and private school operators in Sweden. The proposal includes enabling the Swedish Schools Inspectorate to prohibit a municipality or region from continuing operations if significant deficiencies identified in previous directives are not remedied. Additionally, the amendments allow for the revocation of approval for private operators if they have not commenced operations within a two-year timeframe or have not maintained operations for two consecutive years. The changes aim to strengthen accountability in the education sector.

title: Förbud mot kärnvapen och krav på Sveriges framtida Natomedlemskap
summary: The Swedish government proposes an amendment to the constitution to expand the opportunities for legal restrictions on union freedoms concerning organizations engaged in or supporting terrorism. This change aims to enable broader criminalization of participating in terrorist organizations and banning such organizations, thereby enhancing Sweden's capabilities to combat terrorism and safeguard national security.

title: Avståndsbaserad skatt på lätt trafik
summary: The government proposes a new law governing Sweden's central bank, Riksbanken, to modernize its legal framework in light of significant economic and regulatory changes since the previous law was enacted in 1989. The proposal clarifies Riksbanken's goals, responsibilities, and powers concerning monetary policy and financial oversight while maintaining its independence. It also details restructuring within the leadership and enhances transparency, accountability, and the consideration of sustainable development in its operations. Additionally, the proposed changes include amendments to relevant parts of Sweden's constitution and parliamentary procedures to strengthen oversight and governance of Riksbanken.

title: Stärkt arbete för fler anläggningar för idrott och rörelse
summary: The proposal advocates for increased Swedish humanitarian support in Mali, focusing on water, sanitation, and agricultural development. It also calls for heightened aid to vulnerable refugees in surrounding regions. Furthermore, it suggests that Sweden should complete its military withdrawal from the UN MINUSMA operation by mid-2023, and it stipulates an immediate termination of participation if Mali establishes cooperation with mercenaries. The motion emphasizes the importance of separating military from civilian humanitarian efforts to ensure effective aid delivery in a context of ongoing conflict and political instability.

title: Fler fristäder och stärkt skydd för demokratins röstbärare
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should completely withdraw its armed forces from the Task Force Takuba operation in Mali by the end of 2022, emphasizing the need to focus on strengthening Sweden's own military capabilities rather than participating in international missions. It also asserts that if the Malian leadership collaborates with mercenaries, Sweden's involvement should cease immediately.

title: Införande av jämlikhetsdata
summary: The Swedish government has submitted a communication to Parliament addressing the findings of the National Audit Office regarding open comparisons in social services. The report indicates that while open comparisons contribute marginally to a more equitable and high-quality social service, there are notable deficiencies in the quality and applicability of the indicators used. The government agrees with the audit's conclusions and plans to strengthen the open comparisons system and enhance support for municipalities in utilizing these comparisons for quality improvements.

title: Värnande av Arktis
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity for government authorities to provide quality service through non-digital channels for individuals who cannot or choose not to use digital services. It advocates for clear requirements and regular assessments of non-digital accessibility in public administration, highlighting that many citizens, particularly the elderly and those with low income, struggle with digitalization. The motion calls for a detailed analysis of the needs of these groups to ensure they receive adequate support and service.

title: Mindre men bättre kött
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1459 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The suggestion proposes to expand the rules governing employee stock options in Sweden, allowing more companies to offer these incentives. The proposal advocates raising the eligibility limits for beneficial tax treatment on employee stock options to 250 employees and a turnover and balance sheet limit of 350 million kronor, aligning with regulations in the United Kingdom. This change aims to facilitate recruitment for small and rapidly growing businesses by making these incentive programs more accessible.

title: Påskynda utbyggnad av dubbelspår längs Nya Ostkustbanan
summary: The proposal by the Moderaterna party seeks to reject the government's suggestion for increased tax reductions on earned income and instead advocates for strengthening the job tax deduction and lowering taxes for pensioners. The motion argues that the proposed tax reduction would not effectively incentivize work, as it applies equally to both workers and those on benefits. The Moderaterna party aims to enhance economic conditions for working individuals, especially low and middle-income earners, and to improve financial support for pensioners through tax reductions.

title: Krav på solceller, solfångare och aktiva tak/väggar på byggnader
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1457 av Marielle Lahti och Nicklas Attefjord (båda MP)
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish parliament to reject a government proposition that suggests a tax relief for the use of employer-provided bicycles for personal use. The critics argue that the proposed tax change does not address a significant problem or a substantial demand from employers or employees and would instead complicate the tax system. The Moderates advocate for broad tax reductions on work rather than introducing specific exceptions, emphasizing that a simpler and fairer tax regime is necessary for compliance and stability.

title: Händelseanalyser vid suicidförsök
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1456 av Ulrika Westerlund och Marielle Lahti (båda MP)
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats (SD) calls for the establishment of common guidelines for non-digital customer service among government agencies, responding to concerns about long telephone waiting times and inadequate service quality for individuals who cannot or do not wish to use digital services. It urges the government to set clearer service standards and create a joint target that limits telephone waiting times to a maximum of ten minutes.

title: Fred i Palestina
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1455 av Jacob Risberg och Bassem Nasr (båda MP)
summary: The government's proposal aims to strengthen voter protection during polling by amending the electoral law. Key changes include transferring responsibility for placing ballots in polling places to electoral committees, requiring the election authority to develop training materials for election officials, clarifying voter privacy during ballot selection, and allowing assistance for voters with disabilities who need help accessing ballots. The proposal emphasizes the importance of free and secret voting and suggests an evaluation of the reforms after the 2022 elections.

title: Cirkulärt byggande
summary: The proposal outlines an increase in taxation for credit institutions, introducing a risk tax that applies if their liabilities exceed a specific threshold of 150 billion Swedish kronor. This tax aims to mitigate the societal costs that could arise from financial crises linked to these institutions. The tax rate will be set at 0.05% for the tax year starting in 2022 and will increase to 0.06% for subsequent years. The regulation also defines how foreign institutions operating in Sweden will be taxed and establishes a framework for calculating the tax based on total debts.

title: Förändrad kommittéförordning med ett funktionsrättsperspektiv
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1453 av Ulrika Westerlund och Nicklas Attefjord (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government enforce stronger requirements for public authorities to provide good service through non-digital channels, in response to a report by the Swedish National Audit Office highlighting inadequate support for individuals who cannot or do not wish to engage digitally. It emphasizes the need for improved accessibility, noting issues such as long wait times on the phone and the exclusion of certain demographic groups, particularly the elderly and persons with disabilities, who struggle with digital identification and online services.

title: Nationell strategi för sällsynta diagnoser
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1452 av Ulrika Westerlund och Annika Hirvonen (båda MP)
summary: The motion from Linda Modig and other members of the Center Party advocates for the evaluation of a proposed consultation order regarding issues affecting the Sámi people, after three years of implementation. The motion emphasizes the importance of clarifying the law's effectiveness, assessing its impact on workloads and processing times, and limiting the consultation order to apply only to the government and its agencies initially, as a means to ensure that the rights and interests of the Sámi community are adequately and effectively represented without unnecessarily increasing administrative burdens.

title: Nollvision för tågstrul i Sörmland
summary: The suggestion by Centerpartiet advocates for a comprehensive reform of the energy declaration system in Sweden to enhance energy efficiency, reduce costs, and improve coordination between national laws and local energy advice services. The proposal emphasizes the need for clearer regulations, effective strengthening of energy-saving measures, and the establishment of ambitious EU energy efficiency goals, arguing that the current system is costly and ineffective in its purpose.

title: Opinionsundersökning nära val
summary: The motion by Larry Söder and others from the Christian Democrats calls for an urgent review of energy declarations for buildings in Sweden, in light of the EU directive on energy performance. It emphasizes the need to evaluate the effectiveness of these declarations as a regulatory tool and assess the added value of municipal energy advisors. The proposal highlights findings from the National Audit Office, noting that current energy declarations have not effectively motivated homeowners to implement energy efficiency measures and calls for improved follow-up and reporting on these initiatives.

title: Skolans arbete mot hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1449 av Mattias Jonsson och Adnan Dibrani (båda S)
summary: This motion from the Christian Democrats (KD) addresses concerns regarding the government's proposals for stricter penalties and a more efficient sanctioning system for animal protection violations. The motion advocates for the decriminalization of minor violations, suggesting that they should be dealt with primarily through compliance tools rather than punitive measures. It emphasizes that fines should be limited to simpler administrative violations and that the monetary penalties should be adjusted to reflect the severity of the offense, thereby promoting better enforcement of animal welfare legislation.

title: Ny reform av skattesystemet
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government should grant as many exceptions as possible to the requirement for energy declarations for properties, based on findings from the National Audit Office's report. It argues that energy declarations fail to encourage homeowners to take energy-efficient actions and suggests further efforts within the EU to reduce the instances in which these declarations are required, while highlighting existing deficiencies in the current system.

title: Säkerställande av folkhögskolornas uppdrag
summary: Moderaterna and Kristdemokraterna propose to reject the new government proposition regarding a consultation order for issues affecting the Sámi people, arguing that significant challenges and shortcomings persist despite the government's amendments. While they support the idea of a consultation order, they contend that the current proposal does not adequately address critical concerns raised by various stakeholders, including insufficient impact analyses and potential administrative burdens. They urge the government to revise the proposal while considering previous frameworks presented in earlier discussions on Sámi policy.

title: Utökad tillträdesrätt för regionala skyddsombud
summary: The suggestion from the Sweden Democrats (SD) calls for the rejection of the government's proposition regarding a new consultation framework concerning issues of particular significance for the Sámi people. While the proposal aims to increase Sámi influence in relevant matters, the SD argues that it fails to adequately balance the state's responsibilities to all citizens and the interests of local communities. They express concerns about the broad scope of the consultation obligations and its potential negative impact on public administration and economic conditions, particularly in rural regions. Additionally, they emphasize that the proposal lacks necessary legal clarity and proper consultation processes.

title: Ett starkare integritetsskydd i arbetslivet
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a new law against severe animal cruelty, advocating for a prison sentence ranging from six months to four years. It suggests that minor violations of animal protection laws be penalized with fines instead of criminal sanctions, and that certain violations deemed too far from the law's protective intent should be exempt from penalties. The proposal emphasizes the need for uniform interpretation and application of the law across the country, ensuring legal certainty for individual animal owners, as well as adequate capacity within law enforcement to address violations. Additionally, it calls for a two-year follow-up and a five-year evaluation of the legislation's effectiveness and implementation consistency.

title: Förbättrad statistik om förskola och fritis
summary: The Liberals propose rejecting government proposal 2021/22:34, which introduces a tax relief for employer-provided bicycles for private use and a tax exemption up to 20,000 kronor for the rental of personal assets. They argue that such tax exemptions complicate the tax system, detracting from the principles of neutrality, uniformity, and transparency. The party emphasizes the lack of a comprehensive analysis of the real impacts of the proposed bicycle benefit and the arbitrary nature of the 20,000 kronor exemption. They claim these changes do not adequately address the needs of all citizens, particularly those in areas where cycling is impractical, and highlight the potential administrative burdens on businesses.

title: Informationsplikt vid försäljning av kulturmärkta hus
summary: The motion proposes the rejection of government bill 2021/22:33, which suggests an enhancement of tax reductions for earned income, sickness benefits, and activity compensation. The Liberals argue for a new employment tax deduction instead, emphasizing the need for sustainable tax cuts that encourage workforce participation and address the financial discrepancies between working and receiving benefits, particularly for low-income earners.

title: En skola utan vinstjakt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should take the initiative to add the World Maritime University to the list in the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act, ensuring transparency for its administrative functions as it will be authorized to issue degrees under the oversight of the International Maritime Organization. The proponents stress the importance of maintaining public access to documents related to administrative activities to uphold democratic principles and highlight the risks of reduced transparency in this case compared to other universities already governed by the act.

title: Fastställande av dagsböter
summary: The government proposes an amendment to the Swedish Constitution that would allow governmental decisions to be validated through methods other than traditional handwritten signatures. This change aims to establish a technology-neutral requirement for the signatures needed to finalize government decisions, thus facilitating digital processing while ensuring high security standards are met. The amendment is intended to come into effect on January 1, 2023.

title: Södertörns högskola
summary: The Swedish government's response to the Riksrevisionen's report on the 2018 Pisa Study indicates that a high number of students were excluded from participation, which has raised concerns about the reliability of the results. The Riksrevisionen concluded that both the government and the Skolverket failed to ensure adequate participation rates and did not take sufficient measures to address issues related to student exclusion. The government shares the view that too many students were excluded but disagrees with some Riksrevisionen assessments regarding the causes. It emphasizes enhancing efforts to improve student participation in future assessments.

title: Förenklade regler för tillfälliga moduler
summary: The proposal suggests an amendment to the insurance business law allowing certain insurance associations, previously operating as support associations, to offer pension insurance for self-employed individuals, despite current restrictions. This change aims to provide a regulatory framework that permits these non-commercial, often older associations to continue their operations and meet the needs of their members, many of whom are or have been self-employed. The proposed law is intended to come into effect on March 1, 2022.

title: Beredskapslager för medicin och medicinsk utrustning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1438 av Monica Haider och Tomas Eneroth (båda S)
summary: The government's letter to the parliament addresses the findings and recommendations of the National Audit Office regarding the re-regulation of the vehicle inspection market. The audit concludes that while some expected results were achieved, adjustments to the vehicle law are necessary to ensure that all board members of inspection companies are properly vetted and that the Transport Agency effectively supervises the inspection market. The government partially agrees with these findings and commits to reviewing the vehicle law and enhancing oversight in the inspection sector.

title: Återfallsförebyggande arbete
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1437 av Monica Haider och Tomas Eneroth (båda S)
summary: The proposal from Vänsterpartiet seeks to enhance the rights and influence of the Sámi people by urging the government to adjust the consultation law to align with the principle of Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC). This includes calling for immediate incorporation of municipalities and regions into the consultation framework upon the law's enactment, without a two-year delay proposed by the government. The goal is to ensure that Sámi communities can actively participate and have a say in decisions affecting their rights and territories, reflecting a commitment to improving their living conditions and recognition as an indigenous people.

title: Ändra civilstånd
summary: The suggestion outlines the findings of the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the government's management of sustainable business practices within state-owned companies. It highlights the need for more systematic follow-up on these companies' activities, clearer communication of applicable international guidelines, enhanced reporting to the parliament, and the introduction of stricter requirements for sustainability reporting. The government acknowledges the audit's recommendations and commits to ongoing improvements to its governance model to enhance accountability for sustainable value creation.

title: Utökad trålgräns
summary: The government proposes amendments to the Education Act aimed at ensuring that grades in the school system more accurately reflect students' knowledge and promote their learning development. Key changes include replacing knowledge requirements with grading criteria across all educational stages and introducing a new principle for grading based on teachers' overall assessments in relation to the set criteria. Subject grades will replace course grades in upper secondary education, with the aim of furthering students' knowledge development.

title: Höjd ambition på fritidshemmen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1434 av Louise Thunström och Paula Holmqvist (båda S)
