summary: The proposal suggests that purchases made by the European Commission or other EU bodies aimed at managing the COVID-19 pandemic should either be exempt from value-added tax (VAT) or entitled to VAT reimbursement. Additionally, an exemption from VAT is proposed for imports by EU bodies for these purposes. The changes are expected to take effect on January 1, 2022, with retroactive application from January 1, 2021.

title: Slopad övre åldersgräns för cellprovtagning och mammografi
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1433 av Louise Thunström och Sofia Skönnbrink (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests an amendment to the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act, enabling confidentiality for personal or economic details of individuals within the commission reviewing the Swedish government's efforts to secure the release of two Swedish citizens abroad. The change aims to protect sensitive information that could cause harm if disclosed. The amendment is intended to take effect on December 15, 2021.

title: Kommunernas möjlighet att påverka etablering av friskolor
summary: The government addresses the observations and recommendations from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the handling of family reunification cases by the Migration Agency. The report highlights that there are significant deficiencies in verifying the identity of applicants and ensuring legal quality in decisions. The government agrees on the necessity for improvements but disputes some of the proposed recommendations, arguing that it is within the agency's responsibility to enhance its internal procedures. While acknowledging the importance of effective information retrieval, the government has initiated an investigation to evaluate the existing rules for data exchange among relevant authorities to streamline the process.

title: Kosovos medborgarskap
summary: The government proposes to amend the extended definition of closely held corporations in the income tax law to prevent circumvention of specific tax rules related to dividends and capital gains. The proposal suggests that a significant shareholder in a business who also controls a trust or another non-shareholder legal entity owning shares must be considered as owning those shares. Additionally, revisions to the 'outsider rule' will clarify ownership, ensuring that entities owned by trusts or non-shareholder legal entities are not classified as owned by outsiders if active shareholders can benefit from them. The new regulations are set to come into force on January 1, 2022.

title: Myndigheter till Halland
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1430 av Adnan Dibrani och Jennie Nilsson (båda S)
summary: The proposed legislation aims to expand favorable tax regulations for employee stock options by increasing the thresholds for companies qualifying for these benefits, from 50 to 150 employees and from 80 million to 280 million kronor in revenue or balance sheet total. Additionally, it includes provisions to allow board members to receive stock options under the same favorable tax conditions. The changes simplify the management of these options and introduce more flexible rules about their transferability within corporate groups. This proposal is classified as state aid and has been approved by the relevant commission.

title: Vägarna kring Ullared
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1429 av Adnan Dibrani och Jennie Nilsson (båda S)
summary: The Swedish government proposes to continue providing armed forces for participation in the United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali (Minusma) until December 31, 2022, contingent upon valid UN Security Council mandates. The mission aims to support the implementation of the 2015 peace agreement, protect civilians, promote human rights, aid humanitarian efforts, and support the political transition in Mali, amidst ongoing security challenges and political instability following military coups in 2020 and 2021. A Swedish contingent of up to 470 personnel is planned, with a potential increase if necessary, and it is anticipated that the withdrawal of forces will begin in 2023 and complete by mid-2024.

title: Besöksnäringen som motor för svenskt välstånd
summary: The Swedish government proposes to deploy a military force of up to 250 personnel to participate in the Task Force Takuba operation in Mali and Niger, until December 31, 2022. This initiative is aimed at supporting local security forces in combating armed extremist groups and contributing to the safety and stability of the region amid ongoing violence and humanitarian crises.

title: Stärkt anhörigstöd för föräldrar till funktionsnedsatta barn
summary: The government proposes a tax relief for bicycle benefits provided by employers for private use, allowing tax to be applied only to the value exceeding 3,000 SEK per tax year. Additionally, it suggests that income from leasing personal assets should only be taxed above 20,000 SEK. The aim is to encourage cycling and rental income while making these benefits more accessible and financially viable.

title: Viseringsfrihet för befolkningen i Kosovo
summary: The government proposes an enhancement of tax reductions for earned income, sickness benefits, and activity compensation, aiming to alleviate tax burdens starting January 1, 2022. This includes a base tax reduction of 2,820 SEK for individuals with earned income above 65,000 SEK annually and significant tax reductions for those receiving sickness and activity compensation, aligning their tax treatments with earned income to encourage financial equity. The adjustments are designed to support households economically post-pandemic.

title: EBO
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1425 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The government presents its assessment of the Swedish National Audit Office's report on public agencies' services for individuals who cannot or do not wish to use digital services. While acknowledging improvements in digital channels, the report highlights ongoing issues with accessibility and service quality in non-digital channels. The Audit Office recommends clearer requirements for public agencies to provide better service to non-digital users. The government agrees with this analysis and emphasizes the importance of ensuring accessible service channels as part of its ongoing efforts to enhance public service delivery.

title: Energi
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1424 av Adnan Dibrani och Jennie Nilsson (båda S)
summary: This proposal seeks to amend the law regulating the issuance of certain academic degrees in Sweden, granting the International Maritime Organization (IMO) the authority to issue degrees through the World Maritime University. It outlines the process for the transfer of this administrative responsibility to an international body and includes a technical correction to existing regulations concerning ethics reviews of human research. The proposed changes are set to come into effect on January 1, 2022.

title: Sopdumpning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1423 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The legislative proposal includes amendments to the Alcohol Tax Act and related taxation laws in Sweden, aiming to align with EU directives on alcohol taxation, simplify handling processes for denatured alcohol, and facilitate certification for alcohol producers regarding tax reductions in other EU countries. Additionally, it proposes adaptations regarding centralized clearance procedures within customs regulations and other minor adjustments in various taxation laws. The changes are set to come into effect on January 1, 2022.

title: Problematiken med att palmolja används i Sverige i så stor utsträckning i livsmedel och kemisk-tekniska produkter
summary: The proposal outlines an agreement between Sweden and Slovenia aimed at preventing double taxation on income and wealth, as well as preventing tax evasion and avoidance. It seeks to replace the existing tax treaty from 1980 with updated standards that comply with international requirements. Key components include enhanced regulations for income earned through pass-through entities, modernized approaches to transfer pricing, and updated information exchange protocols. It also introduces transitional provisions allowing certain individuals to continue under prior tax rules for pensions until they choose otherwise.

title: Stärkt familjerådgivning
summary: The government proposes to abolish the advertising tax by repealing the law (1972:266) concerning tax on advertisements and advertising, in accordance with the Riksdag's prior decision. Additional changes to related tax laws are also proposed, with the changes set to take effect on January 1, 2022.

title: Skarven i Roxen
summary: The motion proposes measures to enhance the evaluation and transparency of research and development (FoU) activities within Swedish state authorities. It emphasizes the need for guidelines to ensure impartiality in FoU processes, improved economic administrative control, and proper follow-up on provided grants. The motion advocates for the establishment of an advisory board comprising national and international experts to oversee FoU evaluations and stresses the critical need for risk analyses to enhance efficiency and accountability in the sector.

title: Tillgängliggörande av bortglömda byggnader av historisk betydelse
summary: The motion proposes to abolish reduced sentences for individuals over 18 years old convicted of serious crimes and to revise the sentencing reductions for those aged 15 to 18. The authors, Kristdemokraterna (Christian Democrats), argue that individuals who are 18 and older should fully accountable for their actions, citing concerns over the government's previous leniencies and the potential for increased crime among minors due to discrepancies in sentencing.

title: Avlivning av djur enligt djurskyddslagen (2018:1192)
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the current system of sentence discounts for young offenders aged 18 to 20 years who commit serious crimes, arguing that age should not be a mitigating factor. The proposal emphasizes the need for a more stringent approach to young adult offenders involved in violent crime, particularly in the context of rising gang-related violence in Sweden. It points out that the government's current proposal still allows for leniency based on age, which the motion's authors believe undermines justice for victims and does not address the severity of the crimes committed by this age group.

title: Produktionsomställning vid samhällskris
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1417 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt och Eric Westroth (båda SD)
summary: The proposal calls for the abolition of the sentence reduction for young adults aged 18 to 21 who commit serious crimes, asserting that individuals in this age group should be held fully accountable for their actions without consideration of their youth. The motion criticizes the current legal framework that allows for leniency based on age and suggests reforms to ensure that young offenders face appropriate consequences for their actions, proposing a re-evaluation of handling juvenile offenders and the introduction of structured changes to the penal code.

title: En svensk ö-politik
summary: The proposal aims to enhance animal welfare legislation in Sweden by introducing stricter penalties for animal cruelty and creating a more effective sanctions system. It suggests the implementation of a new serious animal cruelty offense with a prison sentence of six months to four years for the most severe cases. Furthermore, it proposes that minor violations of animal protection laws be addressed promptly through administrative fines, ranging from 1,000 to 100,000 kronor, rather than criminal proceedings. The changes are intended to improve compliance with existing animal welfare laws and streamline the enforcement process.

title: Lika för alla på bostadsmarknaden
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the automatic penalty discount for young adults aged 18 and older who reoffend. It emphasizes that while young offenders should receive support to abandon criminal lifestyles, those who have reached adulthood must also be held responsible for their actions. The proposal suggests a broader analysis of the current penal system's leniencies based on age, arguing that the existing youth discount, especially for severe crimes, sends a counterproductive message regarding the seriousness of their actions.

title: Nationell Öresundsagenda
summary: The motion by Johan Hedin and others from the Center Party proposes the removal of sentencing discounts for young adults who commit serious crimes, emphasizing that individuals over 18 should be held accountable for their actions like other adults. The Center Party welcomes ongoing legislative changes but urges for a broader application that includes all crimes, particularly those linked to gang violence, rather than limiting it to offenses with a minimum sentence of one year. Additionally, the motion suggests transferring the responsibility for convicted 15-18-year-olds from the State Institutional Board to the Criminal Care Authority, citing concerns over safety and effectiveness in dealing with young offenders.

title: Gotlandstrafiken
summary: The motion by Martin Ådahl and others from the Center Party emphasizes the need for public procurement regulations to be simplified in order to facilitate greater participation of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). It calls for an evaluation of existing legislation's impact on SMEs and highlights concerns that current proposals may inadvertently hinder their ability to compete for public contracts. The motion advocates for regulatory changes that prioritize SMEs' interests, ensuring they can effectively participate in public procurement processes.

title: Gemensamt it-system i vården
summary: The Center Party's motion emphasizes the need for a modern and effective regulatory simplification policy in Sweden to enhance competitiveness, growth, and innovation. It proposes the strengthening of the Regulatory Council, the establishment of an implementation function within the Government Offices, and improved guidance and follow-up regarding regulatory simplification efforts undertaken by authorities. The motion advocates for reducing the regulatory burden on businesses and enhancing customer service within government agencies, highlighting the importance of well-designed regulations that can foster economic development and long-term competitive advantages.

title: Åtgärder för ett mer hållbart och konkurrenskraftigt yrkesfiske
summary: The proposal advocates for an independent review of the distribution of project grants within the framework of the appropriation for crisis preparedness in Sweden, highlighting deficiencies in the existing system revealed by the Swedish National Audit Office. It emphasizes the need for comprehensive reforms to enhance national crisis preparedness, address shortcomings in strategic foresight, coordination, and crisis management, and ensure that project funding does not supplant regular funding. The motion calls for improved processes for grant applications, assessments, and evaluations to achieve long-term results in crisis management.

title: Skärpta insatser mot bidragsfusk
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should direct the Public Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen) to tailor support and interventions specifically for the elderly job seekers, particularly those over 55 years of age. It emphasizes the need for practical training opportunities to help this demographic avoid prolonged unemployment, which has significantly increased in recent years. The motion also advocates for the restoration of previous benefits that allowed older unemployed individuals an extended support duration and improved monitoring of age discrimination in the workplace.

title: Avskaffande av strandskyddet
summary: The motion proposed by the Sweden Democrats calls for the government to take measures against age discrimination in the labor market, particularly focusing on job seekers over 55 years old. It urges the government to ensure equal treatment of discrimination grounds in the employment agency's mandate and to prioritize support for unemployed individuals far from the job market. The motion emphasizes the need for support tailored to the needs of job seekers rather than targeting specific groups, aiming to help those over 55 access their rights to employment assistance effectively.

title: Reformering av socialtjänstlagen
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament endorses a systematic approach to regulatory simplification, empowering the Regulatory Council to have extended mandates. It calls for the government to rapidly propose regulatory easements for businesses and consider competition-enhancing EU implementation as a goal for simplification politics. The underlying motivation is to address the high regulatory burden faced by Swedish businesses, which has reportedly remained unaltered or increased despite political commitments to reduce it.

title: Begränsning av rätten till tolk
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government strengthen its ownership of regulatory improvement efforts by establishing a central coordinating function. It aims to reduce the administrative burden on businesses by 30%, involve the Regulatory Council earlier in the legislative process, allow for the return of inadequate impact assessments, systematically evaluate implemented regulations, and require agencies to report on compliance with regulatory improvement goals. Additionally, it proposes creating an implementation council to review and assess the impact of EU legislation, ensuring minimal costs for businesses in Sweden.

title: Reformer för ökad tillväxt i Stockholmsregionen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports careful monitoring of the effects of proposed changes in public procurement regulations on the ability of non-profit organizations to participate and succeed in procurement contracts. It emphasizes the need for a simpler and more flexible public procurement framework that encourages participation from the non-profit sector, which is viewed as vital for addressing social issues, particularly in providing services to vulnerable groups. The authors argue for enhanced cooperation between public entities and non-profit organizations within the existing regulatory framework while calling for swift government action to establish clear guidelines for these partnerships.

title: Anslutning av Gotland till stamnätet för el
summary: The motion proposes various simplification policies aimed at enhancing the competitiveness, growth, and innovation capabilities of Swedish businesses. Key proposals include ensuring that companies only need to submit information to authorities once, implementing a 'one rule in, two rules out' principle, strengthening the role of the Rule Council, creating a central platform for regulations, and developing a cohesive action plan with measurable goals to reduce regulatory burdens on businesses. The motion emphasizes the importance of improving consequence investigations related to regulations and calls for greater transparency regarding the implementation of EU directives.

title: Tillsyn inom servicenäringen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1404 av Malin Höglund och Crister Carlsson (båda M)
summary: The government presents a response to the Swedish National Audit Office's report on the system of energy declarations for buildings, indicating that the current system lacks effective enforcement and coordination. The government acknowledges the audit's recommendations to improve the system, including reintroducing reporting requirements and considering an investigation into how energy declarations can be enhanced as a tool for energy efficiency. The proposal emphasizes the need for better information dissemination and support for homeowners seeking to undertake energy-efficient upgrades.

title: Kulturskola i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1403 av Camilla Brodin och Cecilia Engström (båda KD)
summary: The government proposes to introduce a new law requiring consultations on matters of significant importance to the Sámi people. This law mandates that the government, public administrative authorities, and local governments must consult the Sámi Parliament before making decisions that could affect the Sámi community. The legislation aims to enhance the Sámi people's influence over their own affairs, ensuring that consultations are conducted in good faith until consensus is reached or deemed unattainable. Certain types of decisions are exempt from this requirement, while others will necessitate a formal consultation process with the Sámi representatives.

title: Tydligare krav på redovisning av innehållet i livsmedel
summary: The proposal suggests enabling temporary employees and assignments on another location to deduct increased living costs similarly to business travel if the assignment lasts no more than one month and the distance from their residence to the workplace exceeds 50 kilometers. This would allow for tax-exempt reimbursements for additional expenses related to temporary employment or duties associated with public services during specific emergencies in Sweden.

title: Ofrivillig ensamhet och isolering
summary: The Kristdemokraterna (Christian Democrats) motion to the Riksdag focuses on a comprehensive housing policy proposal aimed at addressing Sweden's housing crisis. Key measures include reducing interest deductions, streamlining building permit processes, encouraging municipal planning for diverse housing needs, and enhancing support for low-income families through increased housing benefits. The proposal emphasizes a balanced approach to community building, incorporating efficiency in housing production, as well as regulatory adjustments for improved accessibility and affordability in the housing market.

title: Stoppat stöd till dem som vistas olagligt i landet
summary: The motion submitted by the Christian Democrats outlines a budget proposal aimed at addressing various socio-economic issues in Sweden. It includes reforms designed to boost employment, improve healthcare access, enhance safety through law enforcement improvements, and support families. Significant emphasis is placed on increasing job opportunities for long-term unemployed individuals and those with reduced work capacity by introducing financial incentives for employers. The proposal also advocates for tax cuts to support both workers and pensioners, alongside a focus on rural development and community services.

title: Att minska den antimikrobiella resistensen nationellt och internationellt
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1399 av Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity of strengthening Sweden's power system to ensure its robustness and resilience during the transition to fossil-free energy sources. It proposes a comprehensive approach to increase the export of low-climate-impact goods and services, enhance electricity generation capacities, and create conducive regulatory frameworks for sustainable energy production, thereby aiming for energy independence and contributing to global climate efforts.

title: En samlad socialförsäkringsmyndighet
summary: The KD parliamentary motion outlines proposals aimed at enhancing regional development through various initiatives such as increasing vocational training in the tourism sector, validating practical skills, addressing regional regulatory disparities, and improving public services in rural areas, while also emphasizing the importance of local businesses and infrastructure in fostering economic growth and social equity across Sweden.

title: En flexibel föräldraförsäkring
summary: The motion advocates for a reassessment of Sweden's fishing management practices, arguing against the current reliance on Maximum Sustainable Yield (MSY) as the primary guideline. It calls for prioritizing ecological health and sustainable coastal fishing over industrial fishing practices. The motion proposes removing regulatory language that restricts intervention in fishing management, aiming to ensure long-term fish populations and a balanced ecosystem. Overall, this suggests a shift towards a more sustainable and holistic approach to fisheries management.

title: Journalinformation knuten till patienten, inte till regionerna
summary: The motion proposed by Camilla Brodin and others from the Christian Democrats (KD) outlines several initiatives aimed at enhancing the business climate in Sweden. Key proposals include reducing corporate taxes, simplifying VAT for small businesses, creating a regulatory framework that encourages business growth, and improving the bureaucratic processes for businesses. The motion emphasizes the need for swift reforms to counteract the negative impacts of the pandemic on employment and economic activity.

title: Ökad polisnärvaro på landsbygden
summary: The motion proposes a reform of international trade policies to promote a greener and fairer trade system. It emphasizes the need for changes within the WTO, advocating for increased transparency in trade agreements, and seeks to reduce the influence of multinational corporations in negotiations. The motion also calls for targeted support for developing countries and aims to align trade regulations with environmental and social standards, ensuring equitable distribution of global resources.

title: Upprustning av Västerdalsbanan
summary: The proposal from the Christian Democrats (KD) aims to enhance the economic security and quality of life for the elderly in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for a senior-friendly society where older individuals can age with dignity and security. The motion suggests various measures, including increasing the housing allowance for pensioners, reducing taxes on pensions, and promoting policies that encourage longer working lives. Additionally, it addresses the challenges posed by demographic changes and advocates for a shift towards better economic and social support for seniors.

title: Erkännande av Somaliland som en självständig stat
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1393 av Ingemar Kihlström och Magnus Oscarsson (båda KD)
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats (KD) focuses on reforming Sweden's migration policy to create a more controlled, humane, and legally secure process while reducing the number of asylum seekers. It proposes multiple measures, including the abolition of the EBO law, mandatory residency requirements for new arrivals, and improvements in identity verification processes. The motion emphasizes the need to align Sweden's immigration levels with its integration capacity and encourages cooperation with other countries to better manage migration and asylum processes.

title: Förföljelse av kristna minoriteter
summary: The Christian Democrats (KD) propose a series of reforms aimed at reducing sickness absence rates in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of preventive measures in a broad context. They advocate for a social insurance system that enhances individual freedom and family choice, lower sickness benefits rates to discourage long-term sick leave, and improvements in the rehabilitation chain. The motion outlines various initiatives, such as pilot projects for workplace advisors and mentors for long-term sick individuals, as well as suggestions to reevaluate the criteria for sickness benefits and to strengthen support systems for those with disabilities in the labor market.

title: Flytt av Sveriges ambassad i Israel till Jerusalem
summary: The motion proposed by the Christian Democrats aims to enhance integration in Sweden through various measures, including establishing an integration committee, reforming asylum programs, improving housing situations, and mandating participation in Swedish language and civic education for newcomers. The proposal also suggests modifying financial support systems, increasing job opportunities, and emphasizing community cohesion and shared values to prevent segregation and promote a sense of belonging among immigrants.

title: Begränsning av myndigheters offentliggörande och försäljning av personuppgifter
summary: The suggestion aims to enhance Sweden's international aid and commitment to climate justice by maintaining aid levels at a minimum of 1% of GNI, increasing support for conflict prevention, providing climate assistance to impoverished countries, and promoting human rights and gender equality on a global scale. It emphasizes the need for transparency in business practices, sustainable agricultural policies, and the fight against tax evasion and financial exploitation. The proposal underlines the importance of a consistent policy that fosters global justice and ecological sustainability.

title: Gör E6 genom Skåne sexfilig
summary: The motion by the Christian Democrats (KD) proposes a comprehensive equality policy that addresses various issues affecting women's rights and health. It includes measures to improve educational outcomes for boys, enhance women's health care, ensure safe childbirth practices, implement gender-sensitive medical treatments, establish a national research program focusing on women's health issues, and promote information campaigns about mammography. Additionally, it aims to strengthen support systems for parents, increase awareness and prevention against violence, and address discriminatory practices in the workplace.

title: Infrastrukturen kring Ystad hamn och E65
summary: The suggestion aims to tackle school segregation in Sweden by proposing reforms that include abolishing profit-generating companies in the education system, ensuring equitable school choice for all children, increasing state responsibility for school funding, granting all children access to after-school programs, and improving enrollment in preschools, particularly for children from challenging backgrounds. The proposal emphasizes that the current school market exacerbates segregation and that education should prioritize equal opportunities for all children, regardless of their socio-economic status.

title: Ett paket för Skåne – en utbyggd skånsk infrastruktur för framtiden
summary: The proposal advocates for the investigation into whether a single government authority should oversee both the promotion and administrative handling of protected geographical indications and protected designation of origin in Sweden. It highlights the potential for increased Swedish products in the EU's protection system, bolstering market interest and simplifying the export of high-quality food products, while criticizing the current lack of coordination between authorities that has led to diminished interest in applications.

title: Ny trafikplats vid Boråstorpet riksväg 40
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament establish a negative goal for reducing car traffic to necessary levels in order to achieve a 70% reduction in emissions from the transportation sector by 2030. The authors argue that simply encouraging increased public transport, cycling, and walking is insufficient and that proactive measures are needed to decrease car usage, especially in urban areas. The motion highlights the environmental impact of transportation and calls for a shift in traffic policy to prioritize reducing car traffic.

title: Räntetak för effektiv ränta gentemot låntagare
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a memorial for the victims of the Vipeholm experiments, which took place in Sweden during the 1940s and 1950s and involved unethical research methods on patients. The motion emphasizes the importance of remembering this dark chapter in Swedish history, learning from it, and advocating for human rights. It calls on the government to take action in creating this memorial in Lund as a form of restitution for the victims and their families.

title: Modernisering av regelverket för uppkörning på motorcykel
summary: The motion proposes that the title of 'therapist' should be regulated and protected in Sweden, and that the title protection for 'psychologist' should extend to psychologists working outside the healthcare system. It emphasizes the need for legal frameworks to address the issue of unregulated practitioners in mental health care, ensuring that only qualified professionals can offer treatment, thus safeguarding patients from potential harm and ensuring greater trust in mental health services.

title: Slopat fribelopp
summary: The motion advocates for stronger actions against greenwashing practices by businesses. It calls for increased education for companies regarding accurate environmental claims in advertising, enhanced oversight by regulatory bodies, and stricter regulations allowing authorities to impose sharper penalties on businesses that violate marketing laws. The proposal is motivated by a growing concern about misleading environmental claims and the need to support genuinely sustainable companies.

title: Utvärdering av Migrationsverkets hantering av asylsökande afghaner
summary: The proposal calls for a comprehensive evaluation of Sweden's drug laws, particularly the criminalization of personal drug use, advocating for a shift towards harm reduction strategies in drug policy. The motion emphasizes that the current punitive approach is not effective and suggests that an increased focus on treatment and support for individuals with dependency issues is necessary. It cites successful examples from countries like Portugal, which have decriminalized personal use and redirected resources towards social and healthcare solutions. The motion argues for enhanced availability of addiction treatment and harm reduction services across Sweden, ensuring equitable access irrespective of regional differences.

title: Stopp för hädelselagar och dödsstraff för konvertiter
summary: The Christian Democrats propose a series of measures in their motion aimed at protecting the Swedish tax base, reducing the tax burden on individuals and businesses, and enhancing the efficiency of tax-related authorities such as the Tax Agency, Customs Agency, and Enforcement Authority. Their proposals include various tax reductions, the introduction of an entrepreneur account, and potentially lowering VAT rates, as well as improving support mechanisms for pensioners and small businesses, ultimately aiming to create a more favorable climate for work and investment.

title: Skydd för gemensam egendom
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1380 av Niklas Karlsson och Joakim Sandell (båda S)
summary: The proposal from the Christian Democrats (KD) seeks to adjust the budget allocations for 2022 concerning general grants to municipalities, emphasizing the need for increased funding to support welfare services. It advocates for the exclusion of Kommuninvest from the risky tax imposed on larger credit institutions, arguing that this would prevent higher costs for essential welfare projects in municipalities. The motion also outlines various financial alterations, asserting that adequate resourcing and effective governance are crucial for strengthening the welfare sector in the wake of challenges exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: En offensiv storstadspolitik
summary: Kristdemokraterna proposes various measures aimed at enhancing Sweden's societal economy and financial management, including the development of a quality of life index within official statistics, improved transparency in public wage statements regarding taxes and fees, and the establishment of more service offices to better serve rural populations. The proposals also suggest strengthening resources for combating money laundering and addressing socioeconomic challenges faced by municipalities, alongside fostering a national fund for social outcome contracts. Overall, the motion emphasizes both an efficient market economy and a commitment to ethical governance and social welfare.

title: Stärkt kunskap om kvinnors hälsa och kvinnorelaterade sjukdomar
summary: The motion outlines a comprehensive approach to enhance Sweden's climate policy, focusing on boosting exports of low-impact goods and services, emphasizing the principle that polluters should pay, and developing regulatory frameworks to facilitate climate transitions. It advocates for prioritizing state support for technological advancements, implementing stringent regulations for fossil fuel subsidies, and ensuring that Sweden adopts efficient processes for permitting new climate-related investments. Furthermore, it calls for increased collaboration with the EU on energy policies to support the transition to fossil-free sources, the elimination of fossil fuels from various sectors, and the promotion of sustainable practices in agriculture and transport.

title: Högkostnadsskydd inom tandvården
summary: The Kristdemocrats propose a series of measures aimed at enhancing job opportunities and increasing participation in the labor market, which includes doubling job tax deductions for specific groups, increasing subsidies for new start jobs, and implementing temporary support programs for the unemployed. Key reforms include adjusting the job allowance system, creating opportunities for youth and immigrants, and presenting initiatives to lower barriers for marginalized workers and those with disabilities, in order to foster a more inclusive and effective labor market.

title: En nationell hjälpmedelsstrategi
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive strategy to enhance Sweden's civil defense and crisis preparedness, addressing climate change impacts, cybersecurity in both public and critical private sectors, and the strengthening of healthcare services during crises. It advocates for the inclusion of support for free media in aid packages, national strategies to combat disinformation, improving water security, promoting domestic food production, and investing in renewable energy infrastructure. The motion emphasizes the importance of collaboration at both national and international levels to counter various modern security threats, including terrorism and misinformation, while also reinforcing the need for a resilient civil society and public services.

title: Den demokratiska kontrollen över bilbesiktningen
summary: The proposal aims to combat dog smuggling by introducing measures such as mandatory identification for all dogs in the EU, the establishment of a centralized EU dog registry for traceability, and the prohibition of entire litters of puppies from being imported into Sweden. It emphasizes the ethical need to treat animals with the care they require and calls for legislative changes to recognize animals as more than mere goods, advocating for a comprehensive review of animal sales regulations.

title: Färdtjänst till och från idrottsträning
summary: The Christian Democrats (KD) propose a comprehensive energy policy aimed at ensuring a secure and sustainable energy supply for Sweden by the year 2045. The proposal includes increasing electricity capacity to meet a projected demand of at least 300 terawatt-hours, establishing an energy commission, transitioning from a goal of 100% renewable electricity to achieving 100% fossil-free electricity, enhancing nuclear power, and improving network capacities. The KD emphasizes the need for long-term stability in energy policy to support economic growth and industrial competitiveness while advocating for a diversified energy mix inclusive of nuclear energy to address climate goals.

title: Barns rätt till frihet från alkoholreklam på sociala medier
summary: The Christian Democrats propose a comprehensive approach to reform the criminal justice system in Sweden, emphasizing zero tolerance for drugs in prisons, enhancing rehabilitation services, combating radicalization, and improving conditions within the correctional facilities. The motion includes measures to increase prison capacity, adjust penalties for young offenders, and strengthen the role of correctional facilities in preventing extremism. Additionally, it addresses the need for better communication management, improved security protocols, and international collaboration for serving sentences abroad.

title: Regnbågsblod
summary: The motion addresses the issues surrounding the free movement and welfare of vulnerable EU citizens in Sweden, particularly focusing on Romanian and Bulgarian citizens. It proposes measures to enhance the management of their residency, including the registration of EU citizens who stay longer than three months, the allocation of EU social fund money directly to NGOs assisting Roma populations in their home countries, and empowering municipalities to enforce local ordinances to maintain public order. The motion also calls for increased sanctions against EU countries that violate minority rights and harsher penalties for human trafficking.

title: Utbyggnad av järnvägen Skånebanan till dubbelspår Helsingborg–Hässleholm–Kristianstad
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats (KD) outlines budget proposals for the Swedish legal system in 2022, emphasizing the need for increased funding across various judicial and law enforcement agencies. It calls for additional resources to strengthen the capacity of the police and judicial authorities, addressing issues such as youth courts and the prosecution service, to combat rising crime rates and enhance the efficiency of the criminal justice system. The proposal includes significant financial allocations aimed at increasing personnel, improving operational capabilities, and ensuring a robust legal framework to uphold public safety and confidence in the rule of law.

title: Krav på kollektivavtal vid offentlig upphandling
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1370 av Rose-Marie Carlsson och Jamal El-Haj (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes several measures to strengthen Sweden's response to terrorism, including enhancing local prevention efforts against recruitment and radicalization, implementing electronic monitoring for individuals at risk of evasion from deportation, and establishing democratic conditions for civil society funding. It also advocates for closer collaboration between defense and police in critical situations, expediting legislation against associations with terrorist organizations, prohibiting foreign financing of extremism, tightening laws on paramilitary training, addressing treason, and allowing signal intelligence to be used in investigations.

title: Åtgärder för att bryta segregationen
summary: The motion proposes significant increases in police resources and personnel in Sweden, emphasizing the need for more police presence in crime-affected areas and the implementation of policies to improve collaboration between police, military, and local communities. It suggests hiring 10,000 additional police officers, shortening training duration, and enhancing police capabilities to combat organized crime and ensure public safety through proactive measures and technological advancements.

title: Överväga ett starkare skydd för Vätterns vatten
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats (KD) proposes a series of legislative changes aimed at strengthening responses to crime in Sweden. It includes measures such as reducing leniency in sentencing for young offenders, imposing stricter penalties for serious criminal acts committed by organized crime networks, and reforming the handling of various crimes including drug-related offenses, human trafficking, and online harassment. The motion emphasizes the need for a more robust criminal justice system to ensure the safety and security of citizens.

title: Begravningsverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes the initiation of preparations for the expansion of National Road 40 between Jönköping and Ulricehamn, aiming to create a continuous motorway between Stockholm and Gothenburg. This expansion is expected to enhance traffic safety, reduce travel times, and meet the logistical needs of businesses. A study indicates significant socio-economic benefits from this infrastructure project, which would also improve connectivity between various regions, facilitate recruitment, and promote growth in the Jönköping area and surrounding localities.

title: En ny svensk Israelpolitik
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1366 av Mikael Oscarsson och Magnus Oscarsson (båda KD)
summary: The motion seeks to enhance support for crime victims in Sweden by proposing a review of public funding for victim support services, increasing contributions to the Crime Victim Fund, ensuring mediation regardless of the offender's age, and appointing a national coordinator for mediation. It also suggests the use of crime damage indexes for police work, improving follow-up on internal police objectives, increasing access to surveillance technology, and mandating municipalities to finance victim support. Additionally, the proposal calls for reviewing compensation amounts for victims, improving the quality of victim support, and establishing support centers for young victims, along with reforms in the treatment of anonymous testimony in court and updating confidentiality rules for child victims. The motion emphasizes placing victims' rights and perspectives at the core of the justice system.

title: Erkännande av e-sport som sport
summary: Kristdemokraterna presents a proposal for the 2022 budget emphasizing an increase in funding for an asylum program that mandates language and community orientation training for asylum seekers. The party also suggests reallocating funds from various government expenditures and proposes enhancements for the Integrity Protection Agency to strengthen data privacy and combat online hate. Additionally, they advocate for a reform of Sweden's public honors system to acknowledge citizen contributions and propose a constitutional court for effective legislative review and protection of democracy.

title: Näringslivets sponsring av kultur
summary: The motion proposes to continue the reconstruction of the national road 26/47, specifically prioritizing the segments from Mullsjö to Slättäng and from Månseryd to Hedenstorp, in order to eliminate traffic hazards and improve safety and accessibility. The proposal highlights the urgent need for these improvements given the increasing traffic and rising rate of accidents on the current roads, which lack sufficient infrastructure. The planned upgrades include widening the road, adding median separation, and enhancing the overall traffic capacity.

title: Effektmål för innovationer
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a dedicated agency to combat welfare fraud in Sweden, aimed at ensuring correct payments from welfare systems and preventing financial misconduct. The proposal includes significant oversight of welfare payouts at all levels (state, regional, municipal), reforms in confidentiality regulations to allow better data sharing among agencies, and the use of AI for analyzing transactions related to suspected fraud. The motion also recommends stricter identification verification and the ability to freeze payments in cases of suspicion, alongside initiatives to enhance cooperation between various governmental bodies in preventing welfare fraud.

title: Arbetsmarknadspolitiska insatser i form av utbildningar
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive increase in funding for environmental protection and nature conservation in Sweden for 2022. It seeks to allocate additional resources to the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency, enhance efforts to combat over-fertilization, improve outdoor recreation infrastructure, and ensure safe drinking water supply. The motion emphasizes international environmental cooperation and funding for climate initiatives, while proposing cuts to certain nature protection areas and climate investments. Overall, the Moderates advocate for a proactive approach to address climate change through technological advancement and sustainable practices.

title: Åtgärder för att förhindra utbredning av livmoderhalscancer
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1361 av Sanne Lennström och Sofia Skönnbrink (båda S)
summary: Moderaterna presenterar en motion till riksdagen som föreslår olika åtgärder för att öka stöd till jordbruk, livsmedelsproduktion och skogsbruk i Sverige. Förslagen omfattar minskade anslag för vissa skogsrelaterade åtgärder, ökade resurser för att hantera viltskador och växtskadegörare, samt förbättringar inom livsmedelskontroll och jordbrukets konkurrenskraft. Motionen syftar till att främja en hållbar utveckling och att öka produktionen inom de gröna näringarna, med särskild vikt vid att minska regelbördan och öka investeringarna i landsbygdsutveckling.

title: Energipolitik för hela landet
summary: This motion proposes a comprehensive budget plan aimed at revitalizing Sweden's economy and social structure in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. It outlines a series of reforms focusing on education, integration, climate policy, and support for enterprises. Key elements include a commitment to improving school standards, addressing integration challenges, transitioning to sustainable energy solutions, and fostering a business-friendly environment. The motion emphasizes the need for governmental accountability while addressing issues of inequality and societal division exacerbated by recent crises.

title: Avgiftsfritt TBE-vaccin för barn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament allocate funds for a paid police education program, aimed at making policing a more appealing career choice. It suggests that students in police training would have their educational loans forgiven, thereby incentivizing recruitment and retention in the police force. The funding request includes 50 million SEK for 2023 and 100 million SEK from 2024 onward, with the aim to implement the legislation necessary for this reform by 2023.

title: Stärkt förlossningsvård
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1358 av Sanne Lennström och Sofia Skönnbrink (båda S)
summary: The suggestion proposes significant increases in funding for Sweden's educational system, aimed primarily at enhancing teaching quality and increasing instructional time in primary education. Key measures involve expanding the school day by one hour starting from grade one, allowing funding from the existing school grant program to be applicable for younger students, and increasing budgets for various educational authorities to improve oversight and teacher training. The proposal seeks to ensure equal educational opportunities while addressing issues related to student performance and qualifications, particularly in underprivileged areas.

title: Förtydligande av vallagen
summary: The motion presented by Kristina Axén Olin and others aims to enhance the quality of education in Swedish primary schools by focusing on knowledge and learning. It proposes various reforms, including clearer educational requirements, active school choice, increased instructional time, mandatory summer schools for struggling students, and improved support systems for all students. The measures emphasize the need for rigorous standards, accountability, and accessibility to ensure that all children can reach their full potential. Additionally, the motion calls for the state to take over schools with inadequate educational quality and advocates for training programs addressing bullying and teacher safety.

title: En stark arbetslöshetsförsäkring
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support the continued development of nuclear power in Sweden, emphasizing its role in achieving a 100% fossil-free energy goal by 2040. The motion argues that with rising electricity demand, maintaining a balanced energy system necessitates the inclusion of all fossil-free power sources, including nuclear, to ensure reliability amid increasing reliance on weather-dependent sources like wind power. The proponents express concerns about potential dependencies on fossil gas and the geopolitical risks related to imported gas from Russia, advocating for a shift towards bolstering nuclear power capabilities in Sweden.

title: Avskaffat karensavdrag
summary: This parliamentary suggestion aims to improve the quality and accessibility of adult education and Swedish for Immigrants (SFI) in Sweden. Key proposals include lowering the age limit for adult education, ensuring all individuals without a high school diploma have access to complete their education, implementing a unified grading system, and introducing performance-based funding for educational providers. Additionally, the suggestion emphasizes the need for enhanced oversight of adult education programs, the establishment of individual performance plans for SFI students, and clearer objectives for SFI courses to facilitate labor market integration.

title: Stärkt skydd för Natura 2000-områden
summary: The motion aims to enhance the quality of preschool education in Sweden through various measures, including improving the implementation of the preschool curriculum, increasing the competence of preschool teachers, and ensuring equitable access to preschool services. Key proposals include making language preschool mandatory for children in need, assessing children's language development from the age of three, integrating special education teachers into preschool teams, and establishing measurable learning objectives. The motion also highlights the importance of preschool education for children from underrepresented backgrounds and calls for better oversight and accountability for all preschool providers.

title: Jämlik fördelning av högre utbildning över hela landet
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to take urgent action to demand the release of political prisoners and Swedish citizens, specifically Dawit Isaak, Gui Minhai, and Ahmadreza Djalali, who are currently imprisoned under inhumane conditions. It urges Sweden to advocate for strong demands from the EU and UN regarding human rights in Iran and Eritrea in relation to trade and aid agreements, emphasizing the need to condition support on the respect for human rights and the rule of law.

title: Ödrift
summary: This parliamentary motion by the Christian Democrats proposes a comprehensive public health policy aimed at enhancing health awareness and promoting physical activity among various population groups, especially children. Key proposals include national health information campaigns, a leisure card for children, a national action plan against childhood obesity, and improved regulations on dietary supplements. The motion emphasizes the need for preventive health measures to address health inequalities and enhance overall public health, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the importance of health behaviors.

title: Älvdalska
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats (KD) outlines a comprehensive funding proposal for healthcare and social care in Sweden for 2022, aiming to address various issues within these sectors including medication cost support for children, strengthening primary and maternal care, enhancing mental health services, and increasing the capacity of the healthcare system overall. The motion advocates for a national care brokerage to reduce waiting times and proposes several budgetary adjustments to improve healthcare accessibility and quality.

title: Stärkt kompensation till den lokala bygden vid vindkraftsutbyggnad
summary: The suggestion by the Christian Democrats emphasizes the need to enhance and regulate the role of pharmacies and pharmacists within the healthcare system. It calls for measures such as improving access to medications in rural areas, exploring remote pharmaceutical presence, facilitating self-care, and establishing a national health data infrastructure. Additionally, it advocates for a systematic evaluation of medication treatments and better integration of pharmacies in preventive healthcare to increase efficiency and patient safety.

title: Statlig identifieringstjänst
summary: The motion proposed by the Christian Democrats emphasizes the need for an improved elderly care policy in Sweden, advocating for strengthened municipal health services, ensuring continuous care for elderly patients, and providing better working conditions for staff. It includes provisions for an elderly housing guarantee for those over 85 without the need for means testing, increased availability of healthcare professionals, and various initiatives aimed at enhancing the quality of life for the elderly, including improved nutrition, support for caregivers, and a robust vaccination program.

title: Norrland som Sveriges och EU:s tillväxtzon
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1348 av Lars Isacsson och Sofie Eriksson (båda S)
summary: The Christian Democrats propose the establishment of a new asylum program that includes language education and societal orientation for asylum seekers, the abolition of the Gender Equality Agency, and the implementation of various measures to support threatened women and combat honor-related violence. They suggest a national support line, increased funding for women’s shelters, and an intensified crackdown on prostitution and human trafficking. Additionally, they advocate for an individualized Swedish for Immigrants (SFI) language program for parents on parental leave and the creation of a delegation for equality to enhance gender equality efforts.

title: Infrastrukturmotion Dalarna
summary: The motion proposed by Kristdemokraterna focuses on reforming the Swedish healthcare system to ensure patient-centered care that addresses individual needs. It emphasizes the state's primary responsibility for healthcare, the establishment of a national healthcare brokerage, and enhancements in primary care services, including the need for more general practitioners and nurses. The motion also details the need for better resource allocation, increased patient empowerment, streamlined medical processes, and specific health initiatives aimed at improving services for various demographics, particularly women and vulnerable populations.

title: Säkerhet i drift och underhåll av elnät
summary: The KD party's motion proposes various reforms aimed at strengthening the Swedish social services with a focus on children's welfare and enhancing the competence of social workers. Key proposals include establishing a national social services knowledge center, implementing the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child as Swedish law, increasing support for foster homes, and improving measures against child neglect and gang crime. The motion also calls for enhanced cooperation among relevant authorities and the introduction of programs to support parents and families in need.

title: PR-byråer och konsulter i riksdagen
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats emphasizes the vital role of families in a child's life and society, calling for various measures aimed at strengthening family support systems. It proposes reviewing political decisions for their impact on families, enhancing parental leave options, protecting parental income during leave, and ensuring flexible childcare services. The motion advocates for economic support for families to alleviate child poverty, address mental health issues among children, and promote the welfare of children in various family structures. It highlights the need for a robust family policy as a means to resolve broader societal challenges.

title: Likvärdighet i hela landet
summary: The KD proposal outlines several measures aimed at enhancing the rights and living conditions of individuals with disabilities in Sweden. Key points include advocating for improved statistics on human rights for people with disabilities, ensuring accessibility to media and societal information, addressing the needs of these individuals in digitalization, and reinforcing their self-determination and support within the care system. The proposal also calls for thorough investigations into personal assistance needs, family support mechanisms, and ensuring that criminality related to assistance funding is effectively addressed. Overall, the aim is to create a more inclusive and equitable society for all citizens, focusing particularly on those with disabilities.

title: Statliga servicekontor i hela Sverige
summary: The motion proposed by the Christian Democrats emphasizes the importance of strengthening civil society in Sweden. It calls for measures to ensure that the unique characteristics and significance of civil society are considered in governmental investigations and regulations, the evaluation of policies regarding social enterprises, improvements in statistical reporting of civil society's role in public procurement, and the possibility of creating a state investment fund for the non-profit sector. The proposal highlights the critical role of civil society during the pandemic and suggests that government support and consideration are essential to enhance its capacity and influence in various societal areas.

title: Bredband i hela Sverige
summary: The motion presented by the Christian Democrats outlines a comprehensive plan to improve education and childcare in Sweden, emphasizing smaller group sizes in preschools, increased staffing levels, and a focus on Swedish language skills. It suggests measures for teacher training, including changes to educational requirements and the introduction of new certification programs, while advocating for a curriculum that is evidence-based. The proposal also addresses issues of equity and access in education, such as promoting informed choices in childcare and improving the quality of education in rural areas, alongside safeguarding children's rights and addressing cultural challenges within educational settings.

title: Riskkapital och bankkontor på landsbygden
summary: The Christian Democrats (KD) propose a review of funding and tax regulations in the cultural sector, including harmonization of VAT rates and transferring financial responsibility for folk high schools to the state. The motion emphasizes the importance of supporting education, cultural heritage, and the civil society, advocating for measures such as promoting school libraries, enhancing cooperation between leisure and sports organizations, and developing models for cultural collaboration. The proposal also highlights the significance of public service media and the need for financial incentives for private contributions to culture.

title: Elpriser
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1340 av Lars Mejern Larsson och Mikael Dahlqvist (båda S)
summary: The Christian Democrats propose a comprehensive motion aimed at enhancing the quality and accessibility of higher education and research in Sweden. Key elements include a review of state research funding allocations based on quality processes, transparent reporting on the use of base funding by educational institutions, and the establishment of new funding models to meet the needs of both universities and colleges. Additionally, the motion seeks dedicated funding for young researchers, improvements in conditions for doctoral students with disabilities, and national research programs focusing on women's and elderly health. The overarching goal is to strengthen Sweden's position as a leading knowledge and innovation nation while ensuring inclusivity in higher education.

title: Skärpta hållbarhetskrav på AP-fonderna
summary: The Christian Democrats propose a series of measures to enhance the study support system in Sweden. Key recommendations include abolishing the income limit for students (fribelopp), increasing the age limit for student loans, providing deferred loan repayments during further studies, and adjusting the length of study funding for higher education. Additionally, there is a call to reassess the extra additions to student grants to better support economically vulnerable families. Overall, these suggestions aim to improve accessibility and flexibility of education financing, particularly in light of changing job market dynamics.

title: Trafikljusstyrning för utryckningsfordon
summary: The Kristdemocrats (KD) propose a comprehensive strategy targeting the prevention of alcohol, narcotics, doping, tobacco, and gambling (ANDTS) issues in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the need for a clear ANDTS strategy, stronger public health initiatives, and coordination within the government to combat the negative effects of substance abuse. It calls for the establishment of a national competence center for ANDTS prevention, the reinforcement of preventative measures, and the promotion of a restrictive alcohol policy while maintaining the monopoly of the Systembolaget. It also firmly opposes the decriminalization and legalization of narcotics, advocating for a drug-free society accompanied by effective treatment options for addiction.

title: Undernäring bland äldre
summary: This motion by the Christian Democrats proposes multiple measures aimed at improving mental health services in Sweden, particularly in light of the pandemic's impact. It includes calls for comprehensive mental health strategies for children and youth, enhanced school health services, increased funding for psychiatric care, and better integration of support systems for individuals facing mental health challenges. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of collaboration across various sectors to tackle the rising mental health issues in society.

title: En reglerad arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The proposal outlines several reforms to Sweden's international aid policy, emphasizing the need for a results-oriented approach that evaluates the effectiveness of aid against urgent domestic needs. Key recommendations include transitioning to a four-year budget framework, increasing humanitarian aid, and conditioning assistance based on recipient countries' commitment to democracy and anti-corruption efforts. The proposal aims to promote sustainable development through trade rather than aid and stresses the importance of high standards for accountability and outcomes in Sweden's foreign assistance efforts.

title: Sjukersättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support the development of national guidelines for the treatment of children in particularly vulnerable situations when emergency services are called. It emphasizes the need for child-centered responses in violent situations, recognizing the psychological impact of experiencing violence on children. The motion highlights existing discrepancies in how different municipalities handle such situations and calls for improvements at the societal level to ensure children's rights and safety are prioritized according to the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

title: Bostadsbyggande i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1333 av Matilda Ernkrans och Karin Sundin (båda S)
summary: Betty Malmberg's motion emphasizes the need for improved quality in regulatory impact assessments for legislation affecting businesses. The proposal seeks to enhance the existing framework by calling for a review of Sweden's regulatory impact assessment processes, based on findings from the Regulatory Council which indicates that a significant percentage of these assessments do not meet quality standards. The motion advocates for earlier evaluations in the regulatory process, the introduction of assessment requirements for EU proposals, and the use of digital tools to standardize these processes, along with an objective review to ensure their efficiency and effectiveness.

title: Demokratisk kontroll av skolor
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1332 av Ida Ekeroth Clausson och Sanna Backeskog (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes various measures to enhance choice in welfare services in Sweden, advocating for a national framework for healthcare and social services that allows individuals to choose their providers, thereby increasing competition and quality. Key proposals include a review of regulations for a national elder fund to enable broader selection of care services, creation of a national search area for high school choices, and easing regulations for private schools. It argues that expanding choice is crucial for meeting citizens' increasing demands for quality in welfare services.

title: Återinförande av avdragsrätten för fackföreningsavgift
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1331 av Jim Svensk Larm m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen freedom of speech online by considering a sanctions system for major social media platforms that censor or ban users for expressing opinions permissible under Swedish freedom of speech laws. The argument emphasizes the vital role of freedom of expression in democracy and highlights the problematic trends of arbitrary censorship on social media, particularly targeting legitimate political discourse. It suggests that private platforms, due to their significant influence, should be held accountable and cautions against any manipulation of democratic processes by these entities.

title: Förbud mot vinstuttag ur svensk skola
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1330 av Jim Svensk Larm m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament condemns the state-sanctioned mass abuses against Uighurs, Falun Gong practitioners, Christians, and other minorities in China. It suggests ending the 'mutual legal assistance in criminal matters' agreement with Hong Kong, calls for an independent international investigation into the human rights violations in Xinjiang, and urges for sanctions against those responsible for these violations while urging the government to communicate these positions to the Swedish government.

title: Ätstörningsvården
summary: The proposal outlines several recommendations for enhancing the usage and management of peatland in Sweden, advocating for simplified permit procedures for peat extraction on already drained lands, reclassifying such areas for agricultural use, and promoting collaboration between landowners, producers, and authorities on post-harvest treatment. It emphasizes the economic and ecological benefits of sustainable peat management, including its role in carbon binding and as a renewable energy source, and suggests that policies should evolve to better support domestic agricultural production while considering the environmental impact of drained peatlands.

title: Stärkt rätt till en rökfri boendemiljö
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1328 av Linnéa Wickman och Anna Wallentheim (båda S)
summary: The proposal from the Center Party requests the Swedish Parliament to allocate funds for economic security for families and children for 2022, while rejecting several governmental legislative proposals aimed at modifying the social insurance code, parental leave law, and other related laws. The Center Party advocates for a simpler and clearer parental insurance system that promotes gender equality in parental leave usage and suggests revising the housing allowance to better support economically vulnerable families, addressing issues related to its current implementation that may cause financial instability for parents due to varying living arrangements.

title: Kraftvärme
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1327 av Lars Isacsson och Peter Hultqvist (båda S)
summary: The motion by the Center Party proposes adjustments to the budget for 2022 in the area of economic security for the elderly, focusing on the pension system established in 1999. The proposal aims to modify allocations based on the principles of the current pension system while pushing for a long-term sustainable solution that honors its principles. It suggests raising the retirement age and improving working conditions and retraining opportunities to allow individuals to work longer. Additionally, changes are proposed regarding the guarantee pension for immigrants with refugee status and adjustments to various pension-related funds, reflecting a significant budgetary maneuvering.

title: Teckenspråk
summary: The Center Party proposes a budget allocation for 2022 aimed at enhancing economic security for individuals with sickness or disabilities, advocating for early interventions and rehabilitation to prevent long-term sickness absence. They criticize proposed changes to the social insurance legislation that could undermine the existing system and emphasize the need to support individuals in regaining their working capacity while allowing for flexible conditions regarding their benefits. The proposal includes specific financial adjustments compared to the government's recommendations.

title: Ökad säkerhet på tågperrongerna
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1325 av Carita Boulwén och Johnny Svedin (båda SD)
summary: Centerpartiet proposes to allocate the budget for migration in 2022, emphasizing a migration policy that balances humanitarianism with order and efficiency. The plan includes enhancements to the asylum process, an increase in the number of quota refugees accepted, and reforms to the integration system for asylum seekers. The proposal also calls for improved mechanisms for the return of those whose asylum applications are denied, while maintaining the current structure for labor migration to ensure economic growth and competitiveness.

title: Nationella riktlinjer för vård och behandling av barn och unga vid psykisk ohälsa
summary: Centerpartiet proposes maintaining Sweden's international development assistance at one percent of the country's Gross National Income (GNI) for 2022. The motion emphasizes the importance of leveraging this aid to attract greater investments from other sectors, including businesses and civil society, in order to achieve the global sustainable development goals outlined in Agenda 2030 and the Paris Agreement. Centerpartiet seeks to focus Swedish aid on three thematic areas: sustainable jobs, climate transition and green energy, and democracy and the rule of law, aiming for an effective and cooperative approach at both national and EU levels.

title: Översyn av färdtjänsten
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes an increase in funding for Sweden's defense and crisis preparedness in response to changing security conditions. The Center Party suggests that military spending be increased to 2% of GDP by 2030, aligning with prior defense assessments. The motion emphasizes the importance of improving Sweden's defense capabilities and international collaborations, including potentially adopting a NATO option. It also underscores the significance of enhancing civil defense funding to support municipalities and further strengthen national resilience against threats.

title: Färdigställande av riksväg 40 till dubbelfilig väg
summary: The Center Party proposes a budget allocation for international cooperation in 2022, emphasizing Sweden's active role in promoting peace, security, and democracy globally. The motion advocates for long-term and strategic engagement through diplomacy, trade, and military efforts while calling for accountability and conditions regarding democracy and human rights in international projects financed by Swedish contributions. Additionally, the proposal highlights the importance of strengthening Nordic cooperation and addressing global challenges like corruption and climate change.

title: Modernisering av regler för A-traktorer
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for significant investments in Sweden's justice system to ensure effective law enforcement and protection of citizens' rights. It highlights the importance of a locally present police force that can handle both minor and serious crimes, and it calls for an increase in police resources, improved working conditions, and measures to enhance public trust in law enforcement. Additionally, it addresses issues like domestic violence, organized crime, and the need for better support for victims, particularly women and children. The proposal advocates for a structured and responsive justice system that upholds safety and security across all areas of Sweden.

title: Plan för att fasa ut djurförsöken inom forskning och utbildning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1320 av Jytte Guteland och Sofia Skönnbrink (båda S)
summary: The suggestion proposes an allocation of budgetary funds for 2022 within the areas of tax, customs, and enforcement. It emphasizes the importance of a functioning tax system and payment framework to support the economy, ensuring fairness, transparency, and legality. The proposal advocates for improved operations of the Swedish tax authority, customs authority, and enforcement agency, including increased resources to combat smuggling and enhance competitiveness for Swedish businesses. It supports lower taxes and simplified regulations to encourage entrepreneurship while reinforcing the need for robust border control measures against organized crime.

title: Jämlik välfärd i hela landet
summary: The motion presented by the Center Party proposes a budget for the year 2022 that emphasizes the need for effective management and administration of Sweden's democratic institutions, celebrating 100 years of universal suffrage. It calls for increased funding to support various government operations, including simplification of regulations, minority policies, and media support. The proposal advocates for a transparent and efficient functioning of democratic processes, highlighting the importance of adapting and reinforcing democratic institutions in a changing world.

title: Sveriges klimatpolitik
summary: Centerpartiet proposes adjustments to the budget for 2022 within the area of community economy and financial management, focusing on increased financial stability. They emphasize the importance of access to financial services for households and businesses, while proposing reductions in funding for certain agencies to redirect resources to other priority reforms. A new fund for financial cooperation between municipalities is also proposed to lower borrowing costs, especially in light of concerns regarding the risks tax impact on local financial institutions.

title: Feministisk utrikespolitik
summary: This motion advocates for a modern state governance in Sweden by proposing the abolition of the monarchy and its associated privileges, such as the monarch's immunity from prosecution and restrictions on royal family marriages. The motion stresses that Sweden should be an equal society where representation is based on democratic processes rather than hereditary privilege, arguing that a true democracy cannot coexist with a hereditary head of state.

title: Stärkning av polisens förebyggande arbete
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national gang commission under the National Operations Department (NOA) to address the escalating issues of gang-related crime in society. It highlights the severe impact of organized crime on various demographics and the challenges faced by law enforcement in dismantling criminal hierarchies. The commission would focus on supporting gang members wishing to leave these organizations, as well as coordinating preventive efforts. Additionally, it calls for monthly risk allowances for police officers working under this commission.

title: Kriminalisering av kontrollerande beteenden och psykisk misshandel
summary: The motion proposes the development of a national strategy to transform vulnerable areas in Sweden into safe and secure neighborhoods by 2030, emphasizing the importance of local perspectives and necessary governmental resources and coordination.
