The document highlights the challenges faced by residents of these areas, including low socioeconomic status, high dependency on social benefits, limited educational opportunities, and a prevalence of parallel societal structures and crime. The aim is to ensure equitable conditions and improve integration and opportunities for residents while significantly reducing unemployment and enhancing police presence and legal protections.

title: En grön investeringsbank
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1314 av Mathias Tegnér och Markus Kallifatides (båda S)
summary: Centerpartiet föreslår en ökning av anslagen för energiåtgärder i syfte att stärka Sveriges övergång till ett mer hållbart och förnybart energisystem. Förslaget inkluderar investeringar i teknologi för energilagring, batterier och vätgas, samt en minskning av vissa anslag som bedöms mindre prioriterade. Partiet lyfter fram behovet av att förbättra överföringskapaciteten i elnätet och underlätta byggandet av havsbaserad vindkraft för att möta den ökande efterfrågan på elenergi, vilket också syftar till att göra Sverige oberoende av globala energimarknader och skapa fler arbetsplatser.

title: Klimatperspektiv i finanspolitiken
summary: Centerpartiet proposes significant investments in Sweden's transportation and communication infrastructure for 2022, emphasizing the importance of a well-functioning transport system for economic growth and environmental sustainability. The proposal includes enhancing rail services, promoting electric transportation, improving cycling infrastructure, and ensuring equitable access to transport services for all genders and those with disabilities. Additionally, it highlights the need for better management and funding structures for private roads and encourages innovation in both maritime and aviation sectors to reduce climate impact. The plan aims to ensure accessibility across the country while adhering to ambitious climate goals.

title: Rätten till abort
summary: The Center Party proposes adjustments to the budget for the agricultural, rural, and food sectors, emphasizing the importance of strengthening the competitiveness of Swedish agriculture and addressing issues such as climate adaptation, biodiversity, and sustainable practices. The motion advocates for increased funding in areas such as support for rural programs and initiatives to improve animal welfare and prevent wildlife damage, while also calling for reforms to reduce bureaucratic obstacles in the agricultural sector.

title: Kvinnor som lever under hot
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1311 av Alexandra Völker och Azadeh Rojhan (båda S)
summary: Centerpartiet proposes a budget motion aimed at enhancing Sweden's business sector by allocating funds for various reforms including improvements in infrastructure, education, and taxation, while also advocating for increased investment in the extraction of critical metals to support the green transition. The motion emphasizes the importance of simplifying regulatory processes to make it easier for businesses, particularly in the tourism and construction industries, to operate effectively.

title: Samordnad vård för personer med sällsynta hälsotillstånd
summary: Centerpartiet proposes an adjustment of budget allocations for public contributions to municipalities for the years 2022 to 2024, emphasizing the importance of providing municipalities with adequate funding to support essential public services such as education, healthcare, and transportation. The proposal outlines specific increases and decreases in funding amounts based on various policy decisions, including compensation for the effects of proposed changes to welfare benefits and tax regulations.

title: Nationella riktlinjer för förlossningsvården
summary: The motion by Helena Lindahl and others calls for several initiatives to bolster Sweden's basic industries, including identifying obstacles, enhancing skills supply, improving infrastructure, streamlining permit processes, and ensuring sustainable extraction of resources. It advocates for a national strategy to increase port capacity, support for the energy transition to a fully renewable system by 2040, and a reevaluation of the regulatory framework affecting mining and environmental permits. The proposal aims to strengthen Sweden's industrial competitiveness while addressing labor market skills gaps and enhancing transport efficiency.

title: Järnväg genom Skaraborg
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1308 av Ida Ekeroth Clausson och Marcus Andersson (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for increased funding and support for cultural, media, and sports sectors in Sweden, particularly in the aftermath of the pandemic. It highlights the importance of accessibility to cultural life for all citizens, the strengthening of minority languages, and the necessity for independent news coverage. Additionally, the proposal aims to develop a national culture plan and enhance the role of local regions in cultural policy. It also addresses issues of gender equality in sports and improving participation for individuals with disabilities.

title: Samordning av infrastrukturen i Skaraborg
summary: The motion proposes a series of reforms focused on improving the Swedish labor market in light of the COVID-19 pandemic's impact, particularly on vulnerable groups such as the long-term unemployed and newcomers. It calls for the rejection of government proposals regarding unemployment insurance amendments, increased funding for labor market initiatives, and reforms to employment regulations and match-making services to facilitate employment opportunities and reduce labor market segmentation. The overarching goal is to create a more inclusive and flexible labor market with lower barriers to entry, especially for young and newly arrived individuals, while better preparing workers for the demands of the modern workforce.

title: Förköpslagen
summary: The Center Party proposes a budget allocation for healthcare, social services, and preventive measures, emphasizing the importance of accessibility, quality, and individual needs in the health system. They aim to address existing disparities in healthcare access and promote a better integration of services to improve overall public health, particularly in light of recent challenges brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic. The proposal highlights the need for increased funding to ensure comprehensive healthcare for all, including enhanced support for mental health and measures aimed at addressing societal challenges due to the pandemic.

title: Forskning om och behandling av lipödem
summary: The suggestion presented by the Center Party emphasizes the need for increased funding and support for gender equality initiatives and the integration of newly arrived immigrants in Sweden. It advocates for measures to combat men's violence against women, improve funding for women's shelters, enhance the role of the Equality Agency, and ensure a stable financing model for shelters. The motion also calls for reforms in establishment policies for newcomers, improved Swedish language education, and closer collaboration with civil society to facilitate integration. Additionally, it highlights the importance of utilizing the skills of immigrants, particularly women, in the labor market, and suggests that educational strategies should be strengthened to better support newly arrived children in schools.

title: Inga dödsfall på jobbet
summary: The suggestion advocates for increased funding and reform in Sweden's education system to improve the quality of education, ensure that every student has access to necessary resources for successful learning, and strengthen the connection between education and the labor market. It emphasizes the need for improved vocational training, better teacher support, and increasing pre-school enrollment to provide equal opportunities for children from disadvantaged backgrounds. The proposal also calls for enhancements in school administration, the digitalization of processes, greater focus on mental health resources, and measures to ensure transparency and quality in educational institutions.

title: Regional utveckling
summary: The Center Party proposes adjustments to the financing of study support in Sweden to increase the number of people entering the job market by making the student support system more flexible. They suggest that the Ministry of Education should encourage students to complete their studies earlier and accommodate those with lower study paces, while also allowing older individuals to access study funds for retraining and education. They emphasize the need for better education-workforce alignment to improve the matching in the labor market.

title: Den ökande hemlösheten
summary: Centerpartiet presents a motion to the Swedish Parliament proposing an increase in funding for environmental and nature conservation initiatives. The motion emphasizes the pressing climate crisis and advocates for a bold environmental policy that promotes innovation, circular economies, and biodiversity preservation. It outlines specific allocations for various environmental efforts and stresses the importance of involving a diverse range of actors, including local communities and businesses, in managing natural resources sustainably. The proposal aims to maintain Sweden's leadership in environmental innovation while addressing climate change effectively.

title: Regelverk kring blodgivning
summary: The proposal from the Center Party seeks approval for budget allocations in 2022 focused on regional development, emphasizing the importance of enhancing local and regional competitiveness for sustainable growth. It advocates for regional needs to guide policy and for regional authorities to manage development funding rather than centralized control. The motion also highlights the necessity of accessible commercial services in rural areas and proposes adjustments to regional business support systems to better serve small enterprises while promoting sustainability and gender equality.

title: Ansvarsfullt producerad palmolja
summary: The proposal from the Center Party addresses the urgent need for increased housing supply in Sweden, highlighting the significant housing shortages reported by municipalities. It recommends various reforms to facilitate new construction, including reducing bureaucratic obstacles, improving regulatory frameworks, and adapting to local conditions. The proposal also emphasizes the importance of digitalization in the planning processes, the need for innovative housing solutions in rural areas, and the establishment of a modern social housing policy to ensure access for vulnerable populations. Additionally, it calls for climate-smart building practices in line with Sweden's environmental goals.

title: En rättvis väg genom krisen – Vänsterpartiets budgetmotion för 2023
summary: The Center Party proposes a budget plan for 2022 that focuses on liberal reforms to combat unemployment, enhance integration, accelerate climate transition, improve conditions in rural areas, and address gang crime. Key initiatives include tax reductions for businesses and low-income earners, increased support for green investments, enhanced presence of police in vulnerable areas, and measures to ensure gender equality. The aim is to restore economic growth post-pandemic and provide opportunities for all citizens regardless of their location.

title: Översyn av skattesystemet för ökad jämlikhet och starkare välfärd
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1297 av Sanna Backeskog och Linnéa Wickman (båda S)
summary: The motion calls for an expansion of safe havens, known as fristäder, for artists, authors, and journalists in Sweden due to the ongoing threats to freedom of expression globally. It highlights the current limitations and need for increased support for cultural workers facing persecution, advocating for the government to take action to enhance the number of these safe spaces from the current 25, partnering with various organizations in civil society.

title: Krav på kontanthantering
summary: The motion MP2701 proposes several initiatives to enhance the cultural landscape in Sweden, including increasing the number of safe havens for artists and journalists, ensuring access to cultural schools and staffed school libraries for all students, safeguarding public service media in the constitution, combating hate and threats in public discourse, supporting media literacy against disinformation, and enhancing film production incentives. These measures aim to strengthen freedom of expression, protect cultural creators, and foster a vibrant democratic society.

title: För jämställda villkor – arbetsskor till omsorgs- och förskolepersonal
summary: The proposal suggests that the wreck of the ship Gribshunden, which sank in 1495 and is considered the best-preserved medieval shipwreck, should be recognized as a national heritage site. It calls for state support to establish a permanent museum dedicated to Gribshunden, thereby enhancing research opportunities and attracting tourism to Blekinge. The motion emphasizes the importance of preserving the wreck and highlights its potential historical and economic benefits for the region.

title: Översyn av äldre lagar med hänsyn till barnkonventionen
summary: Moderaterna propose increased budget allocations for the Swedish Tax Agency and the Customs Agency, arguing that a national population census is essential for addressing issues related to organized crime, welfare fraud, and mismanagement in population registration. They request additional funding for the Tax Agency to facilitate the census and for the Customs Agency to enhance its oversight and law enforcement capabilities against smuggling and other criminal activities.

title: Minkarnas rätt till ett gott liv
summary: The motion proposed by Elisabeth Svantesson and others seeks to increase the funding for the Konjunkturinstitutet by 10 million kronor in the 2022 budget. This increase aims to enhance the institute’s capacity to provide effective economic analyses that support environmental and climate policy decisions, ensuring a more cost-effective and impactful approach to addressing climate change.

title: Demokratisk kontroll för jämlik tandvård
summary: The Moderates propose increased funding for municipalities in Sweden, emphasizing the need for long-term financial support to address the challenges of an aging population and integration of immigrants. The proposal includes additional resources for healthcare, language screening in child healthcare, language preschools for newly arrived children, and extended school hours to improve education quality. The suggested financial adjustments aim to strengthen welfare services without raising taxes, with specific funding allocations for each initiative outlined for the years 2022 to 2024.

title: Borttagande av den övre åldersgränsen för mammografi
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1291 av Sanna Backeskog och Jim Svensk Larm (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for a comprehensive review of the education system for children with disabilities to combat discrimination, the establishment of a national action plan to ensure every child's right to education, and the reconsideration of legislation regarding compensation for missed schooling. It emphasizes the importance of fulfilling the rights outlined in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, specifically highlighting the challenges faced by children with disabilities in accessing education, which can lead to significant societal costs and personal suffering.

title: Bekämpning av översvämningsmyggen vid nedre Dalälven
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of legislation that allows employees subjected to bullying in the workplace to seek legal redress, as well as the establishment of an ombudsman to address incidents of degrading treatment. It highlights the lack of legal recourse currently available for adults facing workplace bullying that does not fall under existing discrimination and harassment laws, leading to severe mental and physical health impacts. The authors argue that these measures are necessary to provide support and protection for victims, enabling them to report and seek compensation for their experiences.

title: Riktlinjer om chefsutbildning för bättre äldreomsorg
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1289 av Sanna Backeskog och Sanne Lennström (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests that producers be mandated to disclose the expected lifespan of their products to consumers, enhance consumer protection through an extended warranty period linked to this lifespan, and advocate for higher sustainability standards in upcoming EU regulations regarding product passports. This aims to empower consumers with better information and promote product durability for environmental benefits.

title: Lagstiftning om ekocid
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1288 av Anna Vikström och Mathias Tegnér (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to enhance Nordic cooperation in various areas, including improving railway infrastructure between Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland, strengthening defense collaboration, initiating discussions for a common currency union among Sweden, Denmark, and Norway, facilitating school attendance for children moving across borders, enhancing understanding of Scandinavian languages, and improving access to public service media across the countries.

title: Certifiering och regelverk för begravningsbranschen
summary: The motion by Camilla Hansén and Anna Sibinska from the Green Party proposes a comprehensive policy for the Sami people, including the establishment of a political road map, a truth commission, the repatriation of Sami remains, compensation for natural resource use, a structured consultation process, an overview of the Sametinget's structure, strengthened Sami rights to land and water, a new reindeer husbandry investigation, and increased investment in language and culture. The motion emphasizes the historical injustices faced by the Sami, the need for reparative measures, and aims to enhance the visibility and support for Sami rights and welfare within Swedish society.

title: Bemanningsföretagens effekter på den svenska sjukvården
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the establishment of a new corporate form, known as benefit corporations, that balances profit-making with social and environmental contributions. It emphasizes the importance of businesses taking responsibility for societal well-being and outlines the need for legislative changes to support companies aiming for dual objectives of profitability and community benefits. The motion references successful examples from other countries to illustrate the potential benefits of such corporations in Sweden.

title: Kriminalisering av oskuldsoperationer
summary: The proposal advocates for securing access to folk education throughout Sweden and calls for a national initiative to support study associations and folk high schools. It emphasizes the importance of folk education as a voluntary and inclusive movement that fosters individual development, community building, and cultural participation. The motion expresses concern over decreasing support for folk education in some municipalities and urges government action to enhance accessibility for all, especially for marginalized groups and those facing educational barriers.

title: Barnsäkerhet i bil
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to empower the Children and Students Ombudsman to provide support to students facing all types of harassment and discrimination in schools. It highlights the challenges faced by students who experience sexual harassment, suggesting that current oversight by the Discrimination Ombudsman and the Schools Inspectorate leads to unequal protections. The motion calls for a unified approach to enhance students' rights and ensure that all forms of discrimination are addressed adequately.

title: Pensionssystemet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the provision of special support for Swedish universities to offer tuition-free distance education aimed at students in developing countries. This initiative seeks to enhance international collaboration, improve access to higher education, and align with Sweden's goals for sustainable development and internationalization in higher education.

title: Utgiftsområde 10 Ekonomisk trygghet vid sjukdom och funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the introduction of national minority languages as a subject in schools, aiming to strengthen the language rights of Sweden's national minorities. This comes in response to repeated criticisms from the Council of Europe regarding Sweden's insufficient implementation of international obligations to protect and develop minority languages and cultures. The proposal includes a specific allocation of teaching hours in the school curriculum to improve accessibility and encourage the learning of these languages, addressing the historical assimilation policies that have adversely affected minority cultures.

title: Utgiftsområde 9 Hälsovård, sjukvård och social omsorg
summary: The proposal by Mats Berglund advocates for the modernization and individualization of parental insurance in Sweden, aiming to create a more equitable parental leave system that aligns with the findings of the 2017 parental insurance investigation. It suggests implementing a model where parental leave is concentrated earlier in a child's life, with shared parental days designed to encourage a more equal distribution of leave between parents. The motion seeks to adapt parental insurance to today's diverse family constellations and the evolving labor market, while also suggesting the inclusion of more individuals under the definition of 'parent.'

title: Utgiftsområde 21 Energi
summary: Miljöpartiet proposes a series of ten initiatives aimed at strengthening democracy in Sweden, including lowering the voting age to 16, introducing national citizen initiatives, increasing transparency in lobbying, and ensuring that independent schools adhere to public access principles. The motion emphasizes the importance of youth participation in democracy, enhancing the protection and security of elected officials, and fostering a more inclusive political environment. It also advocates for stronger support for public service media and human rights institutions.

title: Utgiftsområde 22 Kommunikationer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports initiatives for enhancing education on sustainability, environmental awareness, and outdoor activities in schools. It emphasizes the importance of equipping children with knowledge and skills for sustainable living, ensuring all children have access to nature, and leveraging outdoor education as a pedagogical resource. The motion calls for a review of curriculum frameworks to strengthen the inclusion of environmental and biological diversity topics in education and encourages outdoor learning opportunities for all students.

title: Utgiftsområde 7 Internationellt bistånd
summary: The motion proposes the mandatory origin labeling of flowers and calls for an investigation into the environmental and climate impact of imported flowers. It suggests that the same regulations concerning pesticide use for edible crops should also apply to flowers, highlighting the challenges of sourcing sustainable flowers and the environmental issues associated with current practices in flower production, particularly regarding imports and chemical usage.

title: Utgiftsområde 5 Internationell samverkan
summary: The motion proposes that all personnel working with vulnerable groups, including the elderly and individuals with disabilities, should be required to present a criminal record check before employment. It emphasizes the need for a new law to ensure background checks for home care workers to protect these groups from potential theft and abuse, thereby enhancing trust and safety in the caregiving relationship.

title: Utgiftsområde 24 Näringsliv
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament acknowledges the need to reduce the demand for fossil-based plastic products by promoting biobased and recycled alternatives, and encourages the dissemination of knowledge about the 'Jakten på plasten' project to all municipalities. It emphasizes the urgent need to address climate emissions from plastic throughout its lifecycle, suggesting measures such as potential taxation on fossil plastics and increased efforts at the municipal level to improve recycling and reduce plastic waste.

title: Utgiftsområde 19 Regional utveckling
summary: The proposal advocates for improved conditions for Swedish parasport by ensuring equal access and resources for individuals with disabilities. It highlights challenges such as transportation barriers and the lack of information on accessible sports facilities. The Green Party urges the government to allocate a fairer share of sports funding to parasport, arguing that increasing investment will enhance performance and participation, ultimately benefiting society by fostering employment and reducing care needs for individuals with disabilities.

title: Utgiftsområde 17 Kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid
summary: The motion presented by Annika Hirvonen and other members of the Green Party (MP) focuses on measures to combat honor-related violence and oppression. It proposes research initiatives, cost evaluations of such violence, market measures for women, training for professionals, improvements in social services, criminalization of virginity testing, and the reinforcement of legal penalties for violations of restraining orders. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for authorized interpreters, the establishment of democratic conditions for financial support, improvements in the Immigration Agency's handling of asylum cases, and international efforts to counteract honor-related violence and oppression.

title: Utgiftsområde 13 Jämställdhet och nyanlända invandrares etablering
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a national center for the care of victims of sexual crimes in Sweden, aiming to address the current shortcomings in specialized care and support for these individuals. The motion highlights Sweden's commitment to the Istanbul Convention, which mandates offering specialized care to victims, and notes the existing gaps in treatment availability and expertise. The center would focus on developing treatment methods, creating guidelines, and disseminating knowledge across regions to ensure that victims receive the necessary support for recovery.

title: Förarbevis för övriga motordrivna fordon
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should include parental leave days paid at the basic level in the reserved time during which one parent cannot transfer their right to parental leave to another person. The aim is to promote gender equality in parental leave usage, especially among groups such as students and newly arrived immigrants who currently do not benefit from these reserved days due to a lack of income-based parental benefits.

title: Ny landsväg för lastbil, sträckan Malmö–Helsingborg
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to strengthen the human rights of intersex individuals within Swedish healthcare. It proposes several key actions, including enhanced training for healthcare personnel on intersex issues, prohibiting non-consensual medical interventions, ensuring access to personal medical histories, and investigating the introduction of a third legal gender. The aim is to improve understanding and reduce stigmatization of intersex variations in society.

title: Kontroll av utgående gods, fordon och transporter
summary: The proposal calls for a national initiative to enhance the status of humanities in Swedish education and research, highlighting the decline in funding and support for this field compared to sciences and medicine. It emphasizes the need for increased public investment and a redistribution of research funding to foster better research environments in humanities. By strengthening humanities, the proposal aims to ensure that they can address societal challenges, particularly in relation to climate change and public health, thus integrating them into broader scientific dialogues and fostering a more holistic view of knowledge production.

title: Utökade handelsförbindelser och utbyte med Taiwan
summary: Sverigedemokraterna (SD) proposes to reject the government's budget adjustments for international aid and investment support, arguing that the increasing costs of international aid and the investment support for residential projects distort the housing market without effectively increasing housing availability. They suggest a lower budget for international aid and oppose the government's proposed increases in funding for both areas.

title: En levande och välmående skärgård
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1268 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The motion advocates for enhancing the quality of higher education in Sweden by prioritizing the student perspective, improving the social study environment, increasing student influence, clarifying the role of student health services, raising government support for students, and abolishing tuition fees for international students. It also calls for reforms in student welfare, ensuring equitable access to resources across universities, and strengthening the teaching and research staff's job security. The goal is to foster a supportive academic environment that allows students to focus on their studies and improve educational outcomes.

title: Ökad transparens i utskott och tydliggörande av handlingar
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1267 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a governmental system to provide financial support for individuals who require specially designed bicycles due to disabilities. It emphasizes the importance of physical activity for well-being and health and highlights the current inadequacies in support systems for individuals with disabilities. The motion suggests creating opportunities for users to try, borrow, or rent these specialized bicycles, citing the need for more inclusive transportation methods and comparing this need to existing support for vehicles. It calls for an expedited study to determine costs and health benefits associated with such a bicycle support system.

title: Förtroendevaldas närvaro och arvodessystemet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1266 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The motion aims to enhance the legal protection of the National City Park in Stockholm by ensuring that the County Administrative Board's management and development plan has legal authority, increasing oversight of the park, requiring environmental impact assessments for any actions that may harm the park, and considering alternative protection measures if the current laws are not respected.

title: Löpande och transparent redovisning av korruptionsärenden vid svenska utrikesmyndigheter
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1265 av Markus Wiechel och Alexander Christiansson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive plan to reduce food waste in Sweden by 50% by 2030, including new targets for food waste collection and treatment. It emphasizes the need for increased biogas production from food remnants, enhanced public health initiatives to tackle metabolic food waste, and the establishment of strict temperature standards for food refrigeration. These measures aim to mitigate climate impact, improve public health, and enhance resource efficiency.

title: Kunskaps- och säkerhetskrav för framförandet av vissa fritidsbåtar
summary: The motion proposes a national plan to ensure equal healthcare free from racism and discrimination, urging that discrimination be designated as a specific oversight area for patient committees and Ivo. It also advocates for the inclusion of anti-discrimination content in all healthcare training programs and emphasizes the need for research on racism within the healthcare sector, addressing the documented cases of racism faced by patients and healthcare staff with foreign backgrounds.

title: Nationellt register för parkeringstillstånd för personer med nedsatt rörelseförmåga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament instructs the government to set a deadline for phasing out the use of carbon dioxide stunning for pigs and fish, as well as electric water stunning for birds during slaughter. It emphasizes the need for more research on humane stunning methods that reduce stress and suffering for these animals, highlighting the inadequacies of current methods and reiterating the importance of improving animal welfare in the slaughter process.

title: Ökat stöd för veteraner
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1262 av Markus Wiechel och Björn Söder (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes several measures to regulate the gambling market and enhance protections for individuals with gambling addiction. Key suggestions include improving the Spelpaus system by introducing a cooling-off period, enhancing funding for organizations supporting gambling addiction, implementing stricter regulations against unlicensed online gambling companies, enforcing consumer protection and responsibility for gambling operators, and increasing local collaboration between various support services to better assist those affected by gambling issues.

title: Granskning av svenskarnas användning av känslig teknik
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1261 av Markus Wiechel och Björn Söder (båda SD)
summary: The motion presented by Elisabeth Falkhaven and Maria Gardfjell aims to create a new system for distributing fishing quotas in the Baltic Sea, focusing on enhancing local economies in coastal communities, prioritizing human consumption of fish, increasing access for new fishers, and promoting sustainable fishing practices. The proposal also includes stopping allowances for larger industrial trawlers near the coasts, moving the trawling boundary to twelve nautical miles, and implementing ecosystem-based management measures, all in response to the declining fish populations and ecological health of the Östersjön.

title: Förbud mot hållande av elefanter, stora kattdjur och delfiner på djurparker
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1260 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to support the establishment of a global disarmament treaty aimed at halting the extraction and production of fossil fuels. It highlights the urgency of addressing climate change, as indicated by various global actors and organizations, and emphasizes the necessity for international cooperation to facilitate a fair and swift transition away from fossil fuels, which is crucial to meet climate targets set by the Paris Agreement.

title: Självbestämmande i livets slutskede – utred förutsättningarna för aktiv dödshjälp
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1259 av Janine Alm Ericson m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion advocates for increased awareness and knowledge about the climate benefits of organic farming, emphasizing its lower nitrogen input and lack of newly produced reactive nitrogen. It calls for a relevant authority to investigate these advantages, highlighting that organic farming practices result in reduced emissions compared to conventional methods and are essential for future food security.

title: Mer kunskap om miljö, hållbarhet och biologisk mångfald i skolan
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of improving the compensation model for farmers with livestock near wolf territories. It suggests providing continuous financial support to these farmers, compensating actual income losses due to livestock attacks, and covering extra veterinary costs. The aim is to encourage the maintenance of livestock in areas affected by predators while considering the complexities of current compensation systems that vary across regions.

title: Förbud mot utvinning ur alunskiffer
summary: The proposal advocates for the integration of regenerative agricultural practices in Swedish farming by 2035, aiming to produce food sustainably while reducing pollution, greenhouse gas emissions, and enhancing biodiversity. Key components include establishing a framework for measuring carbon storage in agricultural land, compensating farmers for increased carbon capture, providing education and support for adopting regenerative methods, and collaborating with various stakeholders. The motion emphasizes the importance of sustainable food systems in addressing climate change and biodiversity loss and calls for adjustments to the national food strategy to promote sustainable practices.

title: Möjlighet för fler att åka tåg i Mälardalen och Värmland
summary: The proposal advocates for the implementation of a speed enforcement system in Sweden similar to that used in Norway, suggesting that speed cameras should be deployed on the country's busiest roads and that average speed checks between two cameras should be used to impose fines. The motion argues that reducing speed limits can significantly decrease road fatalities and emissions, with the potential to save lives and reduce carbon dioxide emissions significantly if all drivers adhered to speed regulations.

title: Idéburna skolor och pedagogisk mångfald
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1255 av Camilla Hansén och Amanda Lind (båda MP)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of independent child advocates in Sweden, enabling children to have a designated support person when addressing their rights and complaints within the social services and other institutions. The motion emphasizes the importance of children having private meetings with social workers without parental presence to ensure their voices are heard. It addresses the current shortcomings in the support systems for children facing rights violations, referencing international standards and asserting the need for legal changes to make independent advocacy accessible for all children in various vulnerable situations.

title: Matbudens användning av mopeder
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive mineral policy aimed at reducing climate emissions, enhancing recycling and reusing metals and minerals, protecting indigenous Sami rights and the environment, and tightening regulations on mining companies to ensure economic responsibility. It advocates for Sweden to be a strong voice in the EU for due diligence laws concerning human rights and environmental protection, as well as pushing for stricter regulations on conflict minerals. The motion emphasizes the need for innovation and legislative measures to support sustainable practices and cooperation with producer countries to respect human rights and environmental standards.

title: Värna Vättern
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1253 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establish targets for reducing consumption-based greenhouse gas emissions, along with relevant policy measures and actions. Current climate goals only address territorial emissions within Sweden, but nearly two-thirds of emissions come from household consumption. To meet international climate commitments and limit warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius, it is essential to reduce consumption-based emissions significantly. The motion emphasizes the importance of investing in technology, promoting resource-efficient consumption, and developing national strategies to combat climate impact both domestically and internationally.

title: Inkludering av de vilda djuren i djurskyddslagen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1252 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen the coordination and follow-up of agency collaboration against organized crime in Sweden. It emphasizes utilizing various supervisory areas, such as environmental and health inspections, as tools to identify organized crime. Moreover, it advocates for enhancing efforts against welfare fraud, prioritizing anti-money laundering initiatives, and incorporating local experiences into broader anti-crime strategies. The motion highlights the need for a holistic approach in combating organized crime, not only through law enforcement but also through bureaucratic resources.

title: Förvildat Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1251 av Rebecka Le Moine och Marielle Lahti (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes measures to combat over-indebtedness in Sweden, particularly among young individuals, by reducing consumer loans. It highlights the growing issue of debt from consumption loans, driven by aggressive marketing targeting low-income groups. The motion calls for stricter regulations to protect consumers from being lured into taking loans they cannot afford, including the exploration of a debt registry to better manage credit risks.

title: Riksdagsledamöternas arvoden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate altruistic surrogacy to ensure that children born through such arrangements have legal recognition and do not risk being in situations where they lack a legal parent. The Green Party emphasizes the complex social and legal dimensions of surrogacy, stating that a thorough examination of how altruistic surrogacy could be structured in Sweden is necessary, while also reinforcing their previous stance against commercial surrogacy and advocating for legal clarity for children born via surrogacy abroad.

title: Hyresrätt och allmännytta
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1249 av Malcolm Momodou Jallow m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes to expedite the review of Sweden's fiscal policy framework in light of urgent climate change challenges and the underfunding of welfare services. It argues that significant investments in infrastructure, energy systems, and new technologies are essential to combat climate change and that the current framework restricts state borrowing capabilities needed for these investments. The authors urge that the review, originally scheduled for 2025, should happen sooner to better align financial policy with the pressing climate and welfare needs of the country.

title: Djurskydd
summary: The motion suggests a review of the financing mechanisms for water, sewage, and electricity networks in Sweden to ensure the maintenance and necessary upgrades of these critical infrastructures. It highlights the current state of disrepair, the urgent need for increased investment, especially in rural areas, and the challenges posed by regulatory frameworks and workforce shortages. The motion calls for the government to acknowledge the need for a strategic approach to funding these infrastructures to avoid degrading quality of essential services, particularly in light of climate change.

title: Minskad övergödning
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should actively advocate for forest protection both domestically and globally, urging the government not to sign the Mercosur agreement while deforestation and human rights violations persist. It calls for a phase-out of imports of risk crops like palm oil and soy, promoting a sustainable food system, and for Sweden to support international initiatives aimed at biodiversity and sustainable forestry practices. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for public procurement processes to better contribute towards biodiversity goals.

title: Hållbart skogsbruk för biologisk mångfald och klimatet
summary: The motion focuses on strengthening the Swedish state's responsibility for the integration of newly arrived refugees and migrants by individualizing the establishment process and clarifying the settlement law. It emphasizes that many newcomers face significant challenges that require tailored support to achieve self-sufficiency, including language education and access to mental and physical health resources. Furthermore, it highlights the inadequacy of the current integration program and calls for the state to assume full financial responsibility for the establishment process, ensuring that municipalities receive appropriate support to manage these costs effectively.

title: Ordning och reda på arbetsmarknaden
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for stricter guidelines and improved monitoring for the design of playgrounds at schools and preschools, ensuring access, quality, and availability of environments that promote children's physical activities. It advocates for enhanced children's influence in physical planning, increased state support for outdoor organizations, preservation of nearby nature, reforms in traffic management by Trafikverket, changes in parking norms to support active mobility, and the establishment of car-free zones around schools to enhance children's safety and encourage walking and cycling.

title: Utgiftsområde 2 Samhällsekonomi och finansförvaltning
summary: The motion MP2801 proposes comprehensive measures to address the climate emergency in Sweden, including the establishment of a scientifically based national carbon budget, strengthening of environmental regulations, phasing out fossil fuels, promoting green job creation, and developing strategies for renewable energy sources such as wind, solar, and biogas. It emphasizes the need for significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions and aims to ensure that economic policies align with national climate goals and sustainability efforts.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The motion emphasizes the need to combat age discrimination and ageism in Sweden, calling for increased oversight by the Equality Ombudsman on measures to prevent age-related discrimination. It proposes a series of initiatives aimed at enhancing the quality of life for the elderly, including revisions to screening programs for diseases, improved access to education and work, greater digital participation, and support for various community services and resources aimed at seniors. The overarching goal is to foster an inclusive society where older individuals can live fulfilling lives and continue contributing their skills and experiences.

title: Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: The motion proposes a reevaluation of the police's approach to managing football events in Sweden, advocating for a shift from punitive measures to a more dialogue-oriented strategy. It emphasizes the importance of building trust and cooperation among supporters, clubs, and law enforcement to ensure safety at events and to preserve the vibrant supporter culture. The authors argue that current methods of collective punishment are counterproductive and erode respect for law enforcement, ultimately jeopardizing security at sporting events.

title: Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish parliament to implement regulations that promote the longevity of products and to investigate incentives for high-quality repairs of environmentally detrimental product categories. It suggests extending the burden of proof in consumer rights from six months to two years, emphasizing the need for stronger regulations and incentives for sustainable design and repairability, in line with efforts seen in other countries such as France and Austria.

title: Utgiftsområde 20 Allmän miljö- och naturvård
summary: The motion MP1701 proposes a comprehensive national strategy for the management of water resources and sustainable water supply in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for political guidance, increased cooperation between municipalities, and better regulation of water management. The motion also outlines the importance of climate adaptation, pollution prevention, and public engagement in water management practices. Specific suggestions include enhancing funding for water infrastructure, implementing monitoring systems for water quality, and fostering innovation in water technologies.

title: Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
summary: The motion outlines a comprehensive strategy for improving animal welfare post-pandemic. It includes proposals for a global declaration on animal welfare, a ban on the trade of live wild animals, a regulatory framework against routine antibiotic use in farming, and various measures to strengthen enforcement of EU animal welfare legislation. Additionally, it advocates for stricter conditions for animal transport, promoting the transport of meat over live animals, and increasing resources for animal protection agencies. The motion emphasizes enhancing animal rights, improving conditions for livestock, and ensuring ethical treatment in research.

title: Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
summary: The proposal suggests updating Sweden's food strategy to better align with the EU's 'From Farm to Fork' strategy, emphasizing sustainability, climate change mitigation, and public health. It highlights the need for a holistic approach that incorporates the perspectives of various stakeholders, including young consumers, while intensifying the focus on a circular economy and resource efficiency in the food supply chain. The revision aims to ensure that consumers and producers share responsibilities for sustainable practices, thereby enhancing Sweden's role in global food systems and addressing national and international challenges in food production and consumption.

title: Utgiftsområde 8 Migration
summary: The proposal advocates for the promotion of remote work by government authorities to enhance employee well-being, support climate goals, and facilitate rural development. It suggests initiating a 'distansrevolution' through collaboration among the state, businesses, and organizations to expand job opportunities in rural areas, improve access to public employment, and convert vacant buildings into coworking spaces. Additionally, the motion highlights the environmental benefits of reducing business travel through digital meetings, aiming to establish a more flexible and sustainable labor market.

title: Utgiftsområde 12 Ekonomisk trygghet för familjer och barn
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive effort to adapt Sweden's forests to climate change, emphasizing the need for strategies that enhance the forest's role as a carbon sink while ensuring sustainable timber production. It advocates for an increase in selective logging practices and stresses that preparation is crucial to mitigate negative impacts from climate change, such as wildfires and pests. The motion calls for the Swedish Forest Agency to lead systematic climate adaptation efforts and to promote practices that support biodiversity and environmental considerations in forest management.

title: Omställning till förnybar energiförsörjning
summary: The proposal from Johan Forssell and others aims to strengthen Sweden's justice system by increasing funding and resources for various law enforcement agencies, including the police, the Security Police, the Prosecutor's Office, and the Prison and Probation Service. Key suggestions include raising police salaries, providing paid police training, increasing visible police presence, enhancing technical capabilities, expanding surveillance resources, and boosting funding for crime prevention initiatives and rehabilitative programs for former gang members. The motion emphasizes the urgency of addressing the growing crime rates, particularly gang-related violence, and aims to create a safer society through enhanced policing and community safety measures.

title: En hälso- och sjukvård för jämlikhet och jämställdhet i hela landet
summary: The motion proposed by Karin Enström and others from the Moderate Party seeks increased resources for the Swedish Parliament and the Government Office to improve legislative preparation, combat gang crime, strengthen individual rights and independent courts, establish a cap on welfare benefits, abolish general shoreline protections, and enhance the security of religious communities. The motion highlights the urgency of addressing these issues due to the increasing threat of organized crime and extremism, while enhancing parliamentary oversight of government actions.

title: Transporteffektivt och hållbart samhälle
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate and implement an age limit for irreversible medical interventions related to gender dysphoria in children and young adults. It emphasizes the need for a better understanding of treatment processes due to a significant increase in diagnosed cases and calls for strengthened evidence-based care. Additionally, the motion urges the government to analyze the use of pubertal suppressants and cross-sex hormones, ensuring they are backed by scientific research, and to study psychological treatment experiences in Finland regarding gender dysphoria.

title: En funktionsrättspolitik för trygghet och delaktighet
summary: The motion presented by Fredrik Malm seeks to end the economic collection of the Eritrean diaspora tax in Sweden, which mandates Eritreans to pay a 2% tax on their income to the Eritrean authoritarian regime. This proposal highlights issues of human rights abuses in Eritrea and the potential linkage of these funds to terrorism and human trafficking. It calls for the Swedish government to cease this practice, investigate changes to legislation, and utilize diplomatic channels to pressure the Eritrean government.

title: Ett hållbart småföretagande
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1231 av Lorena Delgado Varas m.fl. (V)
summary: Fredrik Malm from the Liberal Party proposes a reform of the burial fee system in Sweden, suggesting that this fee should be integrated into the officially determined tax collection. The current uniform burial fee, implemented since 2016, is critiqued for being essentially a tax rather than a fee, as it does not correspond to the services provided to the payer. Malm highlights issues with cost transparency and efficiency under the current system, calling for improvements such as the possibility to appeal fee decisions, instituting spending caps, and allowing municipalities to manage burial services to enhance effectiveness.

title: Svensk flyktingpolitik
summary: The proposal put forth by the Moderate Party emphasizes the need for increased funding for infrastructure maintenance and development in Sweden's transport sector for 2022. It advocates for specific financial support for road maintenance, railway upkeep, regional airports, and public transportation, reflecting a strategic focus on enhancing the overall functionality and sustainability of the country's transport infrastructure. It positions this approach as essential for economic competitiveness and job creation while rejecting the government's current plans in favor of a more comprehensive investment strategy. The proposal highlights the urgency of improving infrastructure amid recent challenges and aims for a balanced approach to transport across various modalities.

title: En förbättrad och jämlik barnhälsa
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national goal to increase the self-sufficiency rate in Sweden, highlighting the importance of labor market participation for immigrants. It calls for an investigation into how such a goal could be structured, emphasizing the need for accurate metrics to assess self-sufficiency beyond traditional employment statistics, which may not fully represent the economic integration of foreign-born individuals.

title: En fungerande sjukförsäkring
summary: The motion proposes enhancing the connection between final grades and national tests in primary schools in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of standardized assessment for ensuring fairness and equality in grading. It suggests investigating the design and implementation of national tests to better inform grading practices and reduce grade inflation, which is seen as a significant issue despite the expectation that grades reflect student learning. The proposal calls for a system where national test results help establish a framework for average grades, thereby increasing consistency across schools.

title: Ekonomisk familjepolitik
summary: The motion proposes that only individuals with basic healthcare and nursing education and sufficient Swedish language skills should be permanently employed in elderly care. It highlights the growing risk of staff shortages in the sector and the importance of both educational requirements and language proficiency to ensure high-quality care. The motion suggests implementing national language tests and establishing clear definitions for required qualifications in elderly care.

title: Vissa kulturpolitiska frågor
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of strengthening Nordic cooperation by promoting the use of Scandinavian languages, enhancing access to Nordic public service's digital TV services, integrating Nordic labor markets and economies, and advancing defense collaboration, including a roadmap for Sweden's potential NATO membership. It highlights the need for closer ties between the Nordic countries to address mutual challenges and enhance security.

title: Biståndsbudgeten
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1225 av Lotta Johnsson Fornarve m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes the enhancement of the railway connection between Stockholm and Oslo via Västerås, emphasizing the importance of adding four tracks on the Mälarbanan and double tracks between Kolbäck and Hovsta. This would enable a travel time of under three hours between the two capitals, improving regional connectivity in Mälardalen and facilitating increased passenger capacity and speeds. The proposal also highlights the economic viability of the project and the potential environmental benefits, urging the government to take necessary steps for its implementation.

title: Idrottspolitiska frågor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support the adaptation of Hjulstabron to allow larger vessels to pass through, emphasizing the advantages of shifting freight from land to maritime transport. This change would significantly reduce climate impacts from transport and alleviate pressure on the road and railway networks. The motion highlights the ongoing Mälar project aimed at enhancing shipping capacity in Västerås and Köping, asserting that without adjustments to Hjulstabron, the benefits of substantial investments in related infrastructure may not be fully realized.

title: Vindkraft i fjällmiljö
summary: The proposal advocates for prioritizing upgrades to the Bergslagspendeln rail service connecting Västerås and Ludvika via Fagersta. It emphasizes the importance of this transportation route for residents and businesses in northern Västmanland and southern Dalarna, highlighting that current travel times are long and unreliable, leading many to opt for car travel. The motion calls for necessary improvements to the track and infrastructure to increase service frequency and reduce travel times, aligning with a regional goal to shift from hourly to quarter-hourly services in some areas.

title: Gammelskog för kvalitetsvirke
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need to accelerate the expansion of the E18 highway between Köping and Västjädra to motorway standard. This expansion is deemed critical for enhancing regional development, traffic flow, and safety, as the existing route currently faces high traffic congestion and frequent accidents. The completion of this segment would facilitate uninterrupted travel from Örebro to Stockholm and alleviate pressure on local roads in Köping, which are not designed for heavy traffic. The motion seeks to urge the government to expedite this long-awaited project.

title: Ökad jakt på skarv
summary: The motion proposes changes to employment protection laws in Sweden to allow employers greater flexibility in managing personnel, including the ability to exempt more employees from termination order and reduce the burdens of proving just cause for dismissals due to personal reasons. It argues that the current framework is overly rigid and hinders hiring, particularly for small businesses, and calls for the government to explore new regulations that would allow for easier and less costly terminations while still providing some compensation to dismissed employees.

title: Restriktivitet vid exploatering av vindkraft i skärgårdar
summary: Moderaterna propose a comprehensive reform plan for Sweden's healthcare and eldercare systems, emphasizing increased patient influence, timely access to high-quality care, and a focus on women's health issues. Key suggestions include removing waiting lists, introducing a national patient data ownership policy, creating a system for continuity of care for vulnerable patients, and enhancing the quality of medical expertise in eldercare. The motion also suggests a private provider involvement to reduce queues and improve service accessibility, while aiming for a digitized and efficient healthcare system that prioritizes preventive measures and equal access to treatments.

title: Förvaltning av fäbodmiljöer
summary: The proposal by the Christian Democrats emphasizes the need for sustainable fishing practices in Sweden. It includes suggestions to close important fish spawning areas to fishing during breeding seasons, streamline regulations within the fishing industry, promote the rejuvenation of the fishing workforce, and reassess the structure of relevant government agencies. The motion seeks to balance ecological sustainability with the interests of professional and recreational fishermen, as well as the coastal community, while advocating for the development of fish tourism and the management of fish quotas based on scientific recommendations.

title: Hållbart och livskraftigt fiske i Östersjön
summary: In this budget proposal for 2022, the Moderaterna party emphasizes reforms aimed at increasing self-sufficiency and employment while addressing crime and environmental sustainability. The proposal includes measures to reduce taxes on labor, improve incentives for hiring long-term unemployed individuals, and implement stricter penalties for gang-related crimes. Additionally, it focuses on advancing renewable energy sources, particularly nuclear power and biogas, to ensure a stable energy supply for industries, while also aiming to strengthen the justice system and uphold democratic values amidst societal challenges.

title: Åtgärder med syfte att stoppa våldskulturen
summary: The motion outlines a comprehensive strategy aimed at strengthening Sweden's civil preparedness, defense capabilities, and international collaboration in the face of increasing global threats, particularly from authoritarian regimes. It emphasizes the need for improved organization and legislation to tackle hybrid threats, enhance the supply chain resilience, and invest in advanced technologies. Furthermore, it highlights the importance of establishing a national security council and enhancing Sweden's role within the EU and NATO to ensure national security and promote a rule-based international order.

title: Ett modernt och demokratiskt statsskick
summary: The motion proposes that rural issues should be prioritized more significantly in the government's work and suggests the establishment of a new rural authority in Lycksele. The author argues that current governmental decisions fail to adequately address the unique challenges and strengths of rural areas, as political decision-making predominantly represents urban interests.

title: Bostadspolitik, planering och byggande
summary: The motion proposes significant reforms to adult education in Sweden, including the introduction of a free school system for adult education with oversight from the School Inspectorate, enhanced quality monitoring, a results-based compensation system, the encouragement of private companies to provide vocational training, and the municipalization of vocational education. It aims to connect adult education more closely with the labor market to meet the evolving needs of the workforce, especially for older individuals and recent immigrants.

title: Åtgärder för de nationella minoriteterna och minoritetsspråken
summary: Moderaterna föreslår en rad reformer inom utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv, inklusive att stärka arbetslöshetsförsäkringen som en omställningsförsäkring, tidsbegränsa aktivitetsstödet, förstärka nystartsjobb och anställningsstöden för personer med funktionsnedsättning, samt avveckla extratjänster och Myndigheten för arbetsmiljökunskap. Förslagen syftar till en mer kostnadseffektiv arbetsmarknadspolitik och en minskning av bidragsberoende, vilket de anser är avgörande för att fler ska komma i arbete.

title: Utgiftsområde 25 Allmänna bidrag till kommuner
summary: The proposal from Mats Green and others in the Moderate Party suggests increased funding for the National Center for Women's Peace and women's shelters to enhance their support capabilities, while also recommending the discontinuation of the Delegation against Segregation, citing a preference for reforms that promote employment and education instead of creating more agencies. The overall budget recommendation for equality and the integration of newly arrived immigrants is presented with specific funding allocations and adjustments compared to the government's proposal.

title: Utgiftsområde 26 Statsskuldsräntor m.m.
summary: The motion proposes to introduce stricter minimum sentences for rape, enhance the process for deporting non-citizen offenders, ensure that all reasonably suspected individuals of sexual crimes are questioned, establish specialized units for sexual crime investigations across police regions, and facilitate the installation of surveillance cameras in public spaces to aid in investigations. The motion highlights a sharp increase in sexual crime rates and emphasizes the need for systemic reforms to protect women's safety and improve crime resolution rates.

title: Utgiftsområde 3 Skatt, tull och exekution
summary: The proposal outlines a comprehensive strategy to reform integration policies in Sweden, emphasizing the need for measurable integration goals, increased language proficiency requirements, and restrictions on welfare benefits for non-contributing newcomers. It advocates for a structured integration approach that includes a national curriculum for community orientation for immigrants, mandatory language training, and enhanced eligibility criteria for permanent residency. The initiative seeks to address the challenges of immigrant integration, which include economic dependency and social exclusion, while promoting a more cohesive society.

title: Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
summary: The motion proposes a series of measures aimed at enhancing gender equality in Sweden, including the development of public statistics on ownership, revisions to parental insurance for self-employed parents, greater flexibility in transferring parental leave days, and measures to address women's health issues related to the work environment. It also calls for further support in childcare during non-traditional hours, improved pay equity and working conditions in public care sectors, and emphasizes the importance of individual responsibility and legal measures against discrimination.

title: Programmering som ett eget obligatoriskt ämne
summary: The motion presented by Ulf Kristersson and others proposes a series of measures aimed at combating organized crime and enhancing public safety in Sweden. It includes suggestions for harsher penalties for gang members, the introduction of visitation zones, the criminalization of gang membership, increased police surveillance capabilities, and policies to ensure the expulsion of foreign criminals. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for active participation from all relevant authorities in crime prevention efforts and aims to strengthen the overall capacity of the police and judiciary to effectively address rising crime rates.

title: Livskraftig skånsk landsbygd
summary: The motion proposes measures to enhance Sweden's climate and energy policies, emphasizing the importance of increasing the climate benefits of Swedish exports and advocating for a global minimum price on carbon emissions. It also suggests strengthening international cooperation for emission reductions, increasing climate-related aid to poorer countries, reforming environmental permit processes, and promoting sustainable practices in forestry and energy production, including nuclear and renewable sources.

title: Redovisning av skattepengar
summary: The motion proposes several amendments to Sweden's procurement laws to simplify and improve public procurement processes, including changing the language from 'should' to 'must' in various sections to enforce stricter compliance. It emphasizes the need for better integration of non-profit entities in procurement, the requirement for comprehensive labor rights protections for all contracts, and the rejection of abnormally low bids. The motion advocates for a more balanced approach to public procurement, highlighting the necessity of ensuring that social, environmental, and labor considerations are taken into account, particularly for procurements below certain thresholds.

title: Export av snus i Europeiska unionen
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament actively works to increase physical activity in schools, highlighting the numerous health benefits associated with regular exercise among children and youth. The motion cites research indicating that only a small percentage of children meet the recommended daily physical activity levels, emphasizing the importance of physical activity during formative years for health and academic performance. The motion references successful examples of schools that have incorporated increased physical activity into their routines and calls for governmental acknowledgment of the need for such initiatives.

title: Att synliggöra osynliga skatter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing outreach educational initiatives and folk education to accelerate and ensure fairness in Sweden's climate transition. It emphasizes the need for inclusive policies that support individuals, especially those with lower educational backgrounds, to participate in the green transformation. The motion highlights the government's existing climate goals and the importance of providing resources for educational programs that enable individuals to adapt to new green job opportunities, ultimately fostering a broadly supported movement for climate resilience.

title: Tågstopp Finnslätten, Västerås, Västmanland
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider reviewing the legislation regarding the possibility of extending confidentiality during pre-trial investigations to mitigate risks to witnesses and victims, particularly in cases involving criminal networks, where leaks may jeopardize the integrity of the investigation and the pursuit of a fair trial.

title: Mängdrabatt
summary: The motion proposes measures to combat school segregation in Sweden, highlighting the failure of the current decentralized school system to achieve equal educational opportunities. It suggests overhauling school placement regulations and implementing a national school choice system managed by the Swedish National Agency for Education. The motion also discusses the negative impacts of frequent school changes on students and proposes a 'choice period' to improve planning for school administrators. It calls for prohibiting the transfer of funding between municipalities to ensure that local taxes intended for education remain within the community, as well as equalizing funding for municipal schools that must maintain readiness for all local children.

title: Livsmedelsstrategi
summary: The motion advocates for the implementation of measures proposed in the investigation 'En likvärdig skola' to address issues of school segregation and equality in education in Sweden. It highlights the declining equality in schools, particularly in socioeconomically disadvantaged areas, and asserts that every student should have the best opportunities for learning and development. The motion notes recent government funding aimed at increasing educational equity but calls for further action to tackle school segregation and improve overall educational outcomes.

title: Översyn av statsbidraget för habiliteringsersättning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1201 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a restructuring of Sweden's housing policy in light of an acute housing crisis, emphasizing the need to reform subsidies that have proven to be ineffective. It calls for a reduction in financial support for energy efficiency improvements in multi-family homes and the discontinuation of investment support for rental and student housing. Additionally, the motion advocates for increased funding for Lantmäteriet to expedite processing times and a reduction in funding for the Boverket. The overall goal is to streamline housing construction processes and lessen governmental subsidies.

title: Utvecklingskraft över hela landet – universitetens särskilt avsatta medel för innovationskontor
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1200 av Malin Larsson och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests various measures aimed at enhancing healthcare, particularly emphasizing the elimination of patient waitlists and strengthening care guarantees for cancer patients and children in need of psychiatric care. It calls for systematic efforts to improve cancer treatment and healthcare accessibility, introduce fixed doctors and care teams for the most vulnerable patients, develop a patient data reform for coordinated health records, and ensure national standardization of quality registers. Additionally, it highlights the need for increased funding for innovative medicines and a national strategy to combat communicable diseases, including HIV/AIDS.

title: Digitala fakturor
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1199 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats calls for enhanced oversight and structural changes to the project funding under the Crisis Preparedness allocation, following severe criticism from the Swedish National Audit Office regarding the misallocation of resources. The motion emphasizes the necessity of permanent financing for crisis preparedness and civil defense, as current project grants are often used to support basic operations rather than targeted projects. The proposal urges the government to correct these shortcomings to ensure long-term effectiveness in crisis management.

title: Tillgång till internet i riksnormen för försörjningsstöd
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1198 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The suggestion proposes a series of funding adjustments and initiatives within the cultural sector for 2022, focusing on children's literature, digitalization of libraries, production incentives for Swedish film, and support for outdoor activities. Additionally, it includes recommendations for reducing funding for state museums to reinstate entrance fees for adults, as well as cuts to folk education funding. The motion emphasizes the importance of cultural engagement and education in fostering democracy and social cohesion.

title: En aktiv arbetsmarknadspolitik i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1197 av Peter Hedberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive examination of Sweden's parental leave policies to promote gender equality in the sharing of parental leave days. It includes recommendations for adapting the parental insurance system to accommodate the needs of entrepreneurs and students, ensuring equitable benefits for all parents, and informing them about the long-term economic impacts of their choices. Additionally, it suggests limiting basic parental benefits to 365 days and increasing the availability of simultaneous parental leave days to enhance shared parenting responsibilities.

title: Initiativ Gryning
summary: The proposal outlines the 2022 budget allocations for economic security for families and children, emphasizing a reduction in certain benefits such as parental insurance and maintenance support. The Moderates argue for a decreased focus on family leave benefits to address pressing national challenges, advocating instead for increased working hours and rejecting government proposals for enhanced parental leave options. Overall, the budget seeks to maintain a robust childcare system while reallocating funds to prioritize employment.

title: Begränsad arbetskraftsinvandring och arbetsmarknadsprövning
summary: The proposal by the Moderate Party seeks to adjust the budget for economic security during illness and disability, emphasizing a reduction in government funding by reintroducing the upper time limit for sick leave and promoting reform to encourage individuals with work capabilities to return to the job market. It argues for a balance between providing necessary support to those unable to work and reducing state expenditures associated with long-term sick leave.

title: Ett demokratiskt statsskick
summary: The proposal from the Moderaterna party aims to tighten Sweden's immigration policy by increasing the number of detention places for asylum seekers and establishing a 30-day processing guarantee for work permits. It argues for a reduction in annual asylum applications to approximately 5,000, ensuring a consistent migration policy aligned with EU standards. The motion requests additional funding for 2022 to facilitate these changes and improve the efficiency of the Migration Agency in managing immigration processes.

title: Långsiktiga förutsättningar för science parks
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1193 av Teresa Carvalho och Fredrik Lundh Sammeli (båda S)
summary: The motion presents proposals for the allocation of funds in 2022 under the budget area of economic security in old age, with a focus on establishing qualifications for the guaranteed pension. It suggests the removal of an existing exemption that allows refugees and protected individuals to have their time abroad counted towards pension qualifications. This change is expected to lead to a reduction in guaranteed pension funding, with a corresponding increase in funding for elderly support for those affected.

title: Fler vägar till jobb och bättre studiefinansiering
summary: The proposal outlines a series of recommendations aimed at enhancing Sweden's defense and crisis preparedness for the years 2026-2030. It advocates for long-term financial planning for the defense sector, increased funding for military capabilities including cybersecurity, and the establishment of a law to support civilians who have served internationally. The motion emphasizes the need for enhanced funding for research and technology development within defense and cooperation with civilian sectors. It also calls for greater transparency in budgeting practices regarding defense projects.

title: Ungdomsförbund i skolan
summary: The proposal from the Moderaterna party seeks to increase funding for regional development efforts by 150 million kronor for 2022 and onwards, specifically aimed at supporting gas stations in sparsely populated areas to meet new regulatory requirements.
