The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining essential services in rural areas and aims to ensure that individuals and businesses can thrive regardless of their location within Sweden.

title: Strategiska Östersjöhamnar
summary: The proposal from Lars Hjälmered and others from the Moderate Party advocates for increased funding for the Swedish business sector in 2022, specifically allocating more resources to enhance the work of the Regulatory Council for simpler business regulations and to strengthen the Swedish Companies Registration Office in efforts against economic crime. Additionally, it requests the rejection of the government's proposed increased funding for business transformations aimed at addressing environmental changes. The overall goal is to improve conditions for Swedish companies, ensuring competitiveness and innovation in a post-pandemic economy.

title: Barnomsorg på obekväm arbetstid
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1189 av Teresa Carvalho och Johanna Haraldsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal from the Moderaterna party seeks to reallocate government funding for energy-related initiatives in 2022. Key aspects include increasing the budget for energy research by 250 million SEK to enable the development of next-generation nuclear power and establishing a research center at a university. Additionally, the proposal includes rejecting funding for infrastructure for electrified transport and support for biogas, redirecting these funds to promote electric vehicle charging stations instead. The initiative aims to address the growing demand for clean energy in Sweden and improve the stability of electricity supply.

title: Internationell solidaritet – en stark röst för hbtq-plus-personers rättigheter
summary: The proposal outlines the Liberal Party's budget plan for 2022, focusing on equitable funding for municipalities to ensure consistent quality of welfare services, including healthcare and social services, across the country. It suggests various financial adjustments, such as increases and decreases in funding based on specific policy changes, aiming to balance the economic conditions of municipalities and improve service delivery, especially for newly arrived immigrants and vulnerable groups.

title: Översyn av parkeringslagstiftningen
summary: The suggestion from the Liberal Party (L) advocates for reforms to enhance state support for civil society organizations in Sweden. It calls for measures to simplify regulations, increase funding stability, and reduce bureaucratic burdens on these organizations. Furthermore, it emphasizes the importance of maintaining civil society as a fundamental element of democracy, encouraging autonomy and independence from state control. The motion also seeks to address barriers faced by smaller non-profit entities in the welfare sector and proposes a thorough review of the tax system to better support civil society's operational capacity.

title: Om Strömsholms kanal
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1186 av Olle Thorell och Sofie Eriksson (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for a modernized media policy in Sweden that emphasizes individual and citizen perspectives in media objectives, supports press independence, strengthens local journalism, and ensures that state media guidelines promote fair competition with local news outlets. It calls for reforming media support systems to be more rights-based and minimizing political influence, ensuring the sustainability and freedom of the press, particularly in light of challenges posed by digital transformation and global media giants.

title: Ett nytt karensavdrag för vanliga löntagare
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1185 av Olle Thorell och Lena Johansson (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for reforms to revitalize the Swedish sports movement post-pandemic, including improving long-term conditions for sports associations, increasing accessibility for individuals with disabilities, ensuring the availability of sports facilities in urban planning, and addressing noise regulations that hinder sports activities. It highlights the importance of a strong and responsible state support for sports and calls for a collective effort to strengthen the role of sports in society, while also advocating for the inclusion of sports in school curricula.

title: Ordningsvakter
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of higher education in Sweden, emphasizing the establishment of high standards for education quality, lifelong learning, and ensuring career paths for young researchers. The Liberal Party seeks to introduce a new overarching goal for higher education, enhance internationalization efforts, improve working conditions for students and researchers, and propose new research funding initiatives, including a Nobel scholarship. The aim is to position Sweden as a leading knowledge nation with a strong focus on quality, accessibility, and investment in education and research.

title: Introduktionsstöd för nya elektrobränslen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1183 av Malin Larsson och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The suggestion proposes a comprehensive reform of Sweden's adult education system aimed at enhancing quality and equity. Key reforms include the introduction of a national funding model, expansion of vocational training, improved conditions for teachers, and measures to support immigrant language education. The motion advocates for accessible and flexible adult education opportunities, integrating job preparedness into language training, and ensuring all adults have the right to basic education. It emphasizes the need for a structured educational framework that supports lifelong learning and addresses knowledge gaps exacerbated by recent challenges, including the pandemic.

title: Begränsning av bemanningsföretagen i vården
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1182 av Peder Björk och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal focuses on enhancing LGBTQ+ rights and competencies within Swedish society, advocating for improved healthcare, education, legal frameworks, and social services that respect and recognize diverse sexual orientations and gender identities. Key suggestions include promoting LGBTQ+ awareness in welfare services, revising blood donation guidelines, increasing access to PrEP medication, and exploring legislation to protect LGBTQ+ individuals from discrimination while ensuring their rights are safeguarded both nationally and within EU contexts.

title: Den kyrkoantikvariska ersättningen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1181 av Inga-Lill Sjöblom och Ardalan Shekarabi (båda S)
summary: This proposal advocates for a comprehensive cultural policy in Sweden that emphasizes freedom, diversity, and quality in cultural expression. It suggests numerous initiatives including broader financing for the arts, enhanced international cultural collaboration, and increased accessibility to culture. The motion proposes that state support for culture should facilitate long-term artistic freedom and creativity while ensuring engagement with Sweden's diverse heritage and promoting high-quality artistic expression. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of cultural freedom in fostering democratic values and encourages public institutions to seek new audiences and support various cultural forms.

title: Enhetlig skatt vid förvärvsinkomst
summary: The proposal from the Liberals focuses on creating an effective school system prioritizing knowledge and education, advocating for targeted investments in schools in disadvantaged areas, counteracting educational segregation, and re-establishing state control over primary and secondary education. Key measures include the introduction of a national school voucher system, enhancing the attractiveness of the teaching profession, prioritizing the Swedish language in preschools, and acknowledging practical skills in education. The document emphasizes the need for high-quality education to combat social issues like unemployment and outsider status.

title: Ökad polisiär närvaro
summary: The committee motion proposes a series of measures aimed at modernizing and liberalizing Sweden's healthcare system, emphasizing patient choice, equality, and improved accessibility. Key suggestions include creating a new framework for healthcare legislation, establishing flexible age limits for transferring from pediatric to adult care, increasing primary care resources, and promoting health as a goal in integration policies. The motion advocates for fewer administrative burdens, improved patient involvement, and a stronger emphasis on equality and integration of care services.

title: Rot och rut utomlands
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1178 av Eva Lindh och Johanna Haraldsson (båda S)
summary: The suggestion proposes legislative measures to allow altruistic surrogacy in Sweden and addresses various issues surrounding family law, including parental rights for children born through surrogacy and embryo donation, equal rights for same-sex couples in adoption, and regulations on financial aspects of such arrangements. It advocates for a state inquiry into these matters to establish legal frameworks that protect both the child's rights and the rights of surrogate mothers.

title: Inga nya stupstockar i sjukförsäkringen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1177 av Olle Thorell och Lena Johansson (båda S)
summary: This parliamentary motion advocates for a liberal foreign policy in Sweden, emphasizing democracy as the overarching goal. It calls for vigilance against the use of temporary pandemic restrictions by authoritarian regimes and insists on Sweden's consistent stance against human rights violations. The motion also proposes that Swedish embassies in dictatorships serve as safe havens for democracy activists, and underscores the importance of enhancing women's and LGBTQI rights globally. Furthermore, it seeks to implement stricter criteria for membership in the UN Human Rights Council, urging the exclusion of dictatorial nations and a stronger commitment from the EU in promoting democratic values and human rights internationally.

title: Bergslagspendeln
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive Swedish policy towards Russia, advocating for stricter sanctions, the introduction of a Swedish Magnitsky Act, and a unified EU stance against the Russian aggression in Ukraine and against Belarus. It emphasizes the importance of supporting civil society in both Russia and Belarus, recognizing the authoritarian shift in Russia, the treatment of opposition, and the need for a coordinated European response to disinformation and cybersecurity threats. The motion calls for a strategic framework for Sweden's relationship with Russia and more robust efforts to counteract Russian influence and aggression.

title: Kroppskameror för ökad trygghet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1175 av Dennis Dioukarev och Jimmy Ståhl (båda SD)
summary: This motion proposed by the Liberals aims to enhance housing policies in Sweden to ensure greater accessibility and inclusivity, addressing critical issues such as homelessness, social housing allocation, and the facilitation of housing transitions. It advocates for various measures including improved municipal powers, strategies to combat homelessness, enhanced monitoring by Socialstyrelsen, and the introduction of policies to support first-time homebuyers and marginalized communities in housing markets. The overarching goal is to create a more flexible, effective, and equitable housing market that empowers individuals to make significant life decisions.

title: Nationellt stöd för infrastruktur av riksintresse
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1174 av Marianne Fundahn och Per-Arne Håkansson (båda S)
summary: The proposal outlines a vision for a more integrated and cooperative European Union (EU) focused on strengthening climate action, enhancing economic cooperation, and addressing cross-border crime. It advocates for measures such as a European carbon tax, modernization of agricultural policies, and the adoption of the euro as Sweden's currency. The motion emphasizes the need for an effective collaborative response to global challenges like climate change, enhances the role of EU institutions, and calls for a common immigration policy while confronting issues posed by authoritarian movements within Europe.

title: Utred behörighetskrav för lätt mc
summary: The motion proposes a liberal approach to Swedish development aid, emphasizing democracy as a central goal, with strict requirements for recipients regarding human rights and governance. It advocates for a feminist agenda within aid, prioritizing humanitarian efforts, and ensuring that aid supports democratic reforms and respects women's rights, including reproductive health. The motion further proposes enhanced transparency and accountability in aid distribution and calls for Sweden to support democratic initiatives even in wealthier nations.

title: En samlad klövviltsförvaltning
summary: The proposal from the Liberals includes a comprehensive budget for education and university research, allocating substantial funds to address learning loss due to the pandemic. Key initiatives involve increasing funding for schools, elevating spending on teaching materials, supporting early childhood education, and enhancing teacher salaries, especially in disadvantaged areas. Additionally, the motion rejects several government cuts, proposes an increase in fees for childcare, and aims to expand vocational training options, all while planning for the transition of schools to state management.

title: Progressiva böter vid fortkörning
summary: The proposal suggests a series of measures aimed at improving higher education in Sweden. It advocates for various short courses that can be combined with work and offered remotely, clarification of roles for rectors and governing boards of institutions, and a national coordination of universities and educational places. Other suggestions include evaluating the governance of educational institutions, enhancing quality assessments, establishing a national ranking system for academic programs, and reassessing support regulations for students requiring special assistance. The proposal emphasizes the need for increased collaboration between institutions and better management of resources to adapt to the labor market's demands.

title: Ett samlat ansvar för vatten
summary: The proposal outlines a comprehensive strategy to enhance Sweden's research and innovation landscape by prioritizing defined research areas, particularly space research, and fostering collaborations between educational institutions. It emphasizes the need for clear criteria for university status, increased funding for research under EU programs, and a focus on academic freedom. The motion calls for a reevaluation of doctoral programs and the evaluation of previous laws regarding foreign researchers. Overall, the goal is to maintain Sweden's competitiveness globally through excellence in research and development.

title: Skånes Dansteaters potential som nationell institution för dans
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1169 av Per-Arne Håkansson och Rose-Marie Carlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the responsibilities and authority of school principals in Sweden by establishing new training programs for current and future principals, adjusting existing educational requirements, and allowing independent principal training institutions. The aim is to improve leadership in schools to ensure better educational outcomes, particularly in underserved areas, while suggesting a comprehensive upgrade in principals' professional development.

title: Producentavgift för sockersötade drycker
summary: The motion aims to strengthen the Swedish upper secondary education system by implementing clearer knowledge requirements, standardized and centrally graded national tests, and a standardized graduation exam. It also advocates for increased teaching time, the introduction of a common foundation year, and the establishment of programs that address bullying and harassment. Additionally, the motion seeks to ensure heightened accountability among school leaders and improve the match between education and labor market needs, ultimately fostering a more equitable and effective educational environment.

title: Hela Sverige ska växa och utvecklas
summary: The motion proposes various initiatives to enhance research and preparedness for viral infections in Sweden, particularly those with pandemic potential as identified by the WHO. It highlights the need for increased funding for antiviral medications and vaccines, the establishment of a national research program, and the creation of a national institute for virology. The aim is to mitigate the healthcare burden and societal costs of viral infections while improving the country’s response to potential future pandemics.

title: Tryggare anställningar och en hållbar arbetsmiljö
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1166 av Leif Nysmed och Lars Mejern Larsson (båda S)
summary: This parliamentary motion aims to reform and enhance the teacher training program in Sweden with a focus on increasing the quality and attractiveness of the profession. Key proposals include tightening admission requirements, shortening training periods for certain candidates, reducing documentation burdens, and improving ongoing professional development. The motion emphasizes the need for a science-based knowledge perspective in teacher education and suggests consolidating teacher training programs to fewer institutions to improve outcomes. Additionally, it calls for measures to recruit retired teachers and increase training opportunities in Swedish as a second language for immigrants.

title: Yrkeshögskoleutbildningar
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1165 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: Motion M136 proposes a series of measures to strengthen the connection between education and the labor market in Sweden, including enhancing career guidance in schools, establishing a national digital career guidance platform, improving internship (prao) opportunities, modernizing regulations for summer jobs, and advocating for tax relief for companies investing in employee education. The aim is to address the disconnect between youth and employment, thereby improving the chances for young people to make informed educational choices that align with labor market needs.

title: Förstärkt skydd för personuppgifter
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a general and mandatory unemployment insurance system that is fully state-managed. It aims to replace the current work requirement with an income-based condition and strengthen security for entrepreneurs within the insurance framework. The proposal emphasizes the importance of a modern safety net that supports job transitions and ensures fair treatment for all workers, regardless of their employment status, while enhancing the connection between contributions and coverage.

title: En skattereform för ökad jämlikhet
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive approach to combat honor-related violence and oppression in Sweden. It includes measures such as mapping the extent of this violence, improving knowledge in various sectors, establishing a national center for missing children, enhancing preventative information, and fortifying legal frameworks to protect victims. The motion emphasizes individual freedoms over collective honor, aiming to ensure that all people, regardless of gender or background, have the right to autonomy in their own lives. It outlines various initiatives for the government to support, including education, law enforcement, and societal awareness.

title: Nationella mål för jämlikhet
summary: The proposal submitted by Johan Pehrson and others aims to enhance Sweden's efforts against terrorism and violent extremism. Key suggestions include transferring the Centre against Violent Extremism to the Police Authority, improving knowledge and guidance related to extremism overlapping with organized crime, strengthening regional coordination against radicalization, establishing long-term support structures for individuals at risk of radicalization, tightening democratic conditions for state and municipal funding, boosting powers for the School Inspectorate regarding independent schools, and increasing penalties for terrorism-related crimes. The proposal underscores the necessity of protecting democracy from the threats posed by terrorism and violent extremism.

title: Skydd för personliga data
summary: The motion proposes various measures to strengthen working conditions in the care and support sectors, emphasizing improved leadership, optimized professional roles, validation of foreign qualifications, and communication skills in Swedish. It advocates for a national standard in training and development for healthcare professionals, continuous education, and support for research and innovation in social services. The motion aims to enhance the sustainability of care professions, reduce administrative burdens, and secure better pay and career development for employees in the sector.

title: Ökad satsning på cybersäkerhet
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for long-term sustainable management of marine environments, focusing on the Baltic Sea. It advocates for increased research on oxygenating dead seabeds, enhancing cooperation among Baltic Sea countries to reduce eutrophication, and supporting sustainable fishing practices through various measures including limiting harmful fishing methods and promoting eco-friendly consumption. Moreover, it discusses the importance of protecting marine ecosystems, improving water quality, and addressing pollution from maritime activities, particularly concerning the impacts of scrubbers used in shipping.

title: Muddring av farleden till Fiskebäckshamn
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1159 av Dennis Dioukarev och Jimmy Ståhl (båda SD)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for enhanced conservation efforts for biodiversity and natural environments in Sweden, advocating for targeted information campaigns about the right to access nature, measures to protect ecosystems, endangered species, and the establishment of continuous protected areas. It also calls for actions against invasive species, the development of biodegradable pesticides using EU agricultural research funds, and stricter regulations on pesticide use, alongside initiatives to improve agricultural practices that bolster biodiversity without sacrificing productivity. The motion underscores the importance of open landscapes and habitat preservation for pollinators, promoting ecological management practices in agriculture.

title: Kryssningskaj vid Röda Sten
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1158 av Dennis Dioukarev och Jimmy Ståhl (båda SD)
summary: The motion presents a comprehensive proposal aimed at improving the lives of older adults in Sweden, addressing issues such as age discrimination, employment opportunities, access to healthcare, and mental well-being. It calls for investigations into various aspects such as the strengthening of anti-discrimination laws, the establishment of a dedicated research institute on elderly issues, the removal of age limits in healthcare, and strategies to combat loneliness among seniors. The motion emphasizes the importance of recognizing older individuals as valuable members of society rather than a burden, advocating for their rights and capabilities.

title: Göteborg som experimentstad för ny teknik
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1157 av Dennis Dioukarev och Jimmy Ståhl (båda SD)
summary: The motion presents a comprehensive proposal to reform Sweden's pharmacy and medication policy, focusing on improving patient safety, environmental considerations, and the accessibility of medications. Key suggestions include the introduction of a hybrid prescription model, enhanced roles for pharmacists in patient care, improvements in patient education regarding medication use, and increased national coordination on pharmaceutical matters. The motion also emphasizes the importance of environmental sustainability in pharmaceutical practices and advocates for legislation that better addresses patient needs regarding medication packaging and administration.

title: Förbifart Göteborg
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1156 av Dennis Dioukarev och Jimmy Ståhl (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposed by Lina Nordquist and others from the Liberal Party addresses the need for enhanced policies to support individuals with disabilities in Sweden. It includes suggestions to broaden legal protections against crimes targeting disabled individuals, improve accessibility in various public sectors, and ensure coordinated care and support through enhanced cooperation between governmental agencies. The overarching goal is to secure equal rights and support for people with disabilities, in alignment with human rights principles and to mitigate the impacts of socioeconomic challenges, especially highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Brukaravgifter i stället för trängselskatt
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1155 av Dennis Dioukarev och Jimmy Ståhl (båda SD)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the integration of public health issues across all societal sectors in Sweden, advocating for a national strategy that addresses health inequalities, improves mental health support, and bolsters family care services. It suggests the establishment of various health-related measures such as national guidelines, enhanced workplace health services, and provisions for youth and families affected by illness or addiction, aiming to promote overall wellbeing among diverse populations.

title: Fast förbindelse Göteborg–Öckerö
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1154 av Dennis Dioukarev och Jimmy Ståhl (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to apply for membership in NATO as a response to increasing military threats, particularly from Russia. It emphasizes the importance of collective defense and argues for Sweden's active role in promoting democratic values within NATO. The motion highlights the need for a strategic shift in Swedish defense policy to ensure national security and foster stability in the Baltic region, suggesting that NATO membership is essential for protecting Swedish liberty and democracy.

title: En arbetsskadeförsäkring i behov av förändring
summary: The motion presented by Johan Pehrson and others from the Liberals calls for a comprehensive strategy to combat gang-related crime and provide support for at-risk youth. It emphasizes the need for early interventions for children, legal regulations to strengthen the social services' preventive efforts, and stricter measures against criminal recruitment of minors. The proposals aim to enhance collaboration among schools, law enforcement, and social services while ensuring harsher penalties for crimes involving minors. The overarching goal is to safeguard children and restore order in communities affected by gang violence.

title: En trygg familjepolitik med barnet i centrum
summary: The motion seeks to enhance Sweden's law enforcement capabilities by expanding the police force across the country, improving working conditions for police officers, and increasing police visibility in local communities. It also includes various measures ranging from strengthening the legal framework for dealing with crime, enhancing cooperation between police and municipalities, and adjusting the laws surrounding drug offenses and other criminal activities.

title: En trygg och human sjukförsäkring med individen i centrum
summary: The motion proposes various legislative measures to combat violence against women, including increased minimum sentences for rape and sexual assault, extended prescription periods for sexual crimes, and improved support and protection for victims. It also emphasizes the need for preventive measures, such as training for police and healthcare providers to recognize signs of abuse, and advocates for the provision of safe housing for victims, particularly women and children, as well as better funding for support services.

title: Tillståndsplikt för utförande av laserbehandling
summary: The suggestion proposes various measures aimed at strengthening children's rights in Sweden, including mandatory specialized training for those interacting with children, promoting adherence to the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, ensuring proper oversight and support for children in social services, and enhancing protections against violence. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the importance of child participation in decisions affecting them and calls for legislative reforms to safeguard children's rights effectively.

title: En trygg och värdig pension
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to implement Magnitsky sanctions against individuals in the Chinese Communist Party responsible for human rights abuses in China, enhance EU efforts to hold these individuals accountable, and support democratic movements in Hong Kong. It emphasizes the need for Sweden to take a stronger stance against Chinese oppression, promote the rights of minorities, support civil society actors in China, reassess legal agreements with Hong Kong, and recognize Taiwan's right to self-determination.

title: En tryggare merkostnadsersättning och anhörigstöd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament officially recognizes Taiwan as a country rather than a province, promotes Taiwan's participation in the United Nations and its agencies, advocates for expanded bilateral cooperation between Sweden and Taiwan, and recommends the establishment of a 'House of Sweden' in Taipei. Additionally, it calls for widening the mandate of Business Sweden in Taipei and pushing for free trade agreements between the EU and Taiwan. The motion emphasizes Taiwan's democratic values, economic stability, and importance as a global actor.

title: Krafttag mot välfärdsbrottslighet och felaktiga utbetalningar
summary: This parliamentary motion aims to enhance workplace safety and well-being in Sweden by proposing various initiatives, including a focus on preventing mental health issues, improving reporting mechanisms for harassment, and increasing inspections at high-risk workplaces. It emphasizes the responsibility of both employers and employees in maintaining a safe work environment, the importance of supportive resources for workers, and the need to adapt existing labor laws to better address remote work and its challenges. The proposal highlights the necessity for a comprehensive approach to workplace safety that includes psychological health and addresses structural inequalities.

title: Flytt av fordon
summary: The motion calls for a comprehensive review of the tax system in Sweden, specifically targeting small and medium-sized enterprises and individual entrepreneurs. It includes proposals to evaluate and reform various tax regulations to improve conditions for businesses, enhance legal certainty, and support job creation, particularly for immigrants facing high unemployment rates. The Liberal party emphasizes the necessity of a more supportive tax environment to foster entrepreneurship and acknowledges the urgent need to simplify regulations, thereby making it easier for new businesses to thrive.

title: Jakt på vildsvin
summary: The proposal advocates for a thorough review and modernization of the Nordic tax agreement, established in 1998, which is essential for the rights and taxation of individuals working and commuting across Nordic borders. It highlights existing issues faced by cross-border commuters, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, and points to the need for clearer information and streamlined administration to reduce uncertainty and ensure fair taxation practices. Additionally, the proposal addresses specific challenges faced by Swedish sailors and calls for reforms in several tax areas to enhance Sweden's competitive edge.

title: Vargfrågor
summary: The motion proposes improved regulations for investment savings accounts (ISK) in Sweden, emphasizing the negative impacts of raising taxes on these accounts. The authors advocate for clearer regulations that remove barriers to participation in new emissions and simplify the understanding of the rules for ordinary savers. They argue for the inclusion of unlisted assets in ISK and highlight the importance of investing for both individual freedom and economic growth, particularly the role of small and medium enterprises in job creation.

title: Idrottspolitiska frågor
summary: The motion proposed by Johan Pehrson and others aims to establish a liberal integration policy in Sweden, focusing on measurable goals for integration, improving educational structures for newcomers, enhancing labor market integration, and fostering equal opportunities and rights among all individuals, particularly newcomers and women. The proposal emphasizes the importance of language skills, personal responsibility in securing one's livelihood, and the necessity of pinpointing social issues in budgetary considerations.

title: Spelmarknadspolitik
summary: The proposal by the Liberal party advocates for improved support and opportunities for individuals with disabilities to achieve self-sufficiency through employment. It includes a call for a review of Samhall AB's purpose and operations to return to its foundational mission of providing meaningful employment for people with physical and intellectual disabilities. Additionally, it suggests the establishment of a job check system to simplify support for job seekers with disabilities and emphasizes the importance of early career guidance and higher expectations from educators and employers towards these individuals.

title: En tillgänglig sjukvård i världsklass
summary: The motion presented by Roger Haddad and others focuses on advancing liberal feminist policies to achieve equal rights and opportunities for all genders in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of integrating gender equality into various sectors, addressing wage disparities, combating involuntary part-time work, and enhancing women's ownership and economic independence. The motion calls for governmental recognition and action in areas such as education reform, healthcare equity, and rights protection, including issues surrounding sexual violence, human rights for women, and reproductive rights, such as abortion.

title: Konservering av fornminnen för framtida generationer
summary: The Liberal Party proposes adjustments to the 2022 budget for cultural and recreational activities, including a targeted support of SEK 20 million for scouting organizations significantly affected by the pandemic. They reject the government's plan to increase the number of places in folk high schools, leading to savings of SEK 300 million in the budget. Additionally, the proposal includes a 20% reduction in the annual standard adjustment for certain government agencies to improve efficiency.

title: Gemensam databas för besiktigade fordon inom EU
summary: The Liberal Party's motion emphasizes the importance of housing policy for enhancing individual freedoms and choices by ensuring a functioning housing market. The motion proposes increased funding for Boverket to develop a new overcrowding standard while rejecting proposed subsidies for energy efficiency in apartment buildings as ineffective. Additionally, the party suggests abolishing investment support for rental housing and student accommodations, which will lead to significant budget savings. It also calls for a reduction in annual price and wage adjustments for certain government agencies to increase administrative efficiency.

title: Motion om maxtak för personbilar
summary: The proposal from the Liberals seeks to allocate funds for the year 2022 within the area of regional development, specifically increasing funding for establishing a national board for validation and enhancing regional validation structures. The suggested budget adjustments include an increase of 4 million SEK annually for the national board and 22 million SEK annually for regional structures.

title: Aktiemarknaden
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1137 av David Perez och Dennis Dioukarev (båda SD)
summary: The Liberals propose adjustments to Sweden's 2022 budget in the area of environmental and nature conservation, specifically targeting funding allocations for various environmental initiatives. Key proposals include rejecting government support for organizations managing nuclear waste applications, increasing funding for the Klimatklivet initiative to enhance electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and reducing the climate bonus to address budget imbalances. The party also aims for significant carbon dioxide capture targets by 2030 and 2035, while eliminating certain government funding for education related to climate adaptation and suggesting a reduction in state administrative costs.

title: Förbud mot muslimska friskolor
summary: The Liberals propose various funding adjustments in the energy sector for the 2022 budget, including increased allocations for electricity preparedness, interest-free loans for grid expansion, and investments in fossil-free aviation. They seek to enhance the efficiency of energy production while cutting funding for specific initiatives they deem ineffective, resulting in overall budget changes aimed at promoting sustainable energy solutions.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal put forward by the Liberals outlines a budget for 2022 focused on transportation and communication infrastructure. It includes a total of 1.6 billion kronor for infrastructure improvements, such as adapting roadways for longer trucks and enhancing broadband access. Additionally, the proposal suggests a 20% reduction in the annual price and wage adjustment for certain state agencies to promote efficiency in the public administration.

title: Förbud mot icke-medicinsk omskärelse
summary: The proposal by the Liberals suggests the introduction of a subsidy for fossil-free fuels in the agricultural sector, amounting to 150 million kronor, which would be offset by phasing out the existing subsidy for diesel. Additionally, the proposal calls for a 20% reduction in annual price and wage adjustments for certain government agencies to enhance administrative efficiency.

title: Förbud mot halal- och koscherslakt
summary: The proposal from the Liberals outlines a budgetary motion for the year 2022 concerning expenditure in the business sector. It specifically suggests reducing the annual adjustment for price and wages by 20% for certain government agencies within expenditure area 24, aiming to enhance efficiency in public administration. The motion includes a detailed table of adjustments for various agencies and underscores the party's commitment to optimal resource allocation.

title: Avveckling av svensk minknäring
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a Sweden-friendly tax and collection policy aimed at enhancing welfare, security, and entrepreneurship. It outlines the need for a competitive income tax system, suggests reforms to address inconsistencies in tax regulations, such as income tax versus pension taxation, and proposes the introduction of tax deductions to foster savings and mitigate over-indebtedness. Additionally, it seeks to streamline various tax categories, promote business competitiveness, and enhance transparency in tax administration.

title: Slöjförbud i den svenska för- och grundskolan
summary: The proposal from the Liberal Party suggests adjustments to the budget for 2022 concerning study support (utgiftsområde 15). It aims to reduce the annual price and wage adjustment by 20% for certain authorities to increase the efficiency of the government administration. Specific budget figures for various components of study support are provided, with a total proposed budget of approximately 27.8 billion kronor, reflecting a minor reduction in funding for certain areas.

title: Krafttag mot det illegala gatuspelet
summary: The proposal by the Liberals outlines a revised budget for 2022 focusing on Labor Market and Labor Life, suggesting significant cuts to government spending on various labor-related programs, including administrative costs of the Employment Agency and unemployment insurance. The Liberals advocate for a reduction in expenses associated with job training programs and the rejection of government initiatives for temporary job creation, while proposing increases in funding for new start jobs. Overall, the motion reflects a conservative approach to labor funding, aiming to increase efficiency in government expenditures.

title: Nationell djurskyddspolis
summary: The Liberal Party proposes to increase funding for initiatives addressing honor-related violence and violence against women by 70 million kronor annually for 2022-2024, along with 10 million kronor per year to combat violence in young relationships. The proposal also includes cuts to the government's support for gender equality integration in universities by 5 million kronor annually. Additionally, the Liberals suggest a 20% reduction in the annual indexation of certain agencies to enhance the efficiency of government administration.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The suggestion from the Liberal party proposes amendments to the budget for 2022 regarding economic support for families and children, including the rejection of the government's family week proposal, which would reduce expenditures significantly. They recommend increasing funding for unemployment insurance while maintaining other existing benefits, ultimately resulting in a total budget adjustment in this area.

title: Producentavgift på andelen socker i sockersötade drycker
summary: The proposal presented by the Liberals seeks to amend the calculation of the guarantee pension by disallowing immigrants from counting certain years spent abroad, aiming to reduce expenditures by 800 million kronor annually from 2022 to 2024. Additionally, it predicts a rise in costs for elderly support by 300 million kronor. To foster efficiency in government administration, it suggests a 20% reduction in the standard annual price and wage adjustment for certain agencies within the area of economic security in old age.

title: Lobbyistlagstiftning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1126 av Mattias Vepsä och Lawen Redar (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes adjustments to the budget for economic security during illness and disability, primarily focusing on reducing expenditures in the area by implementing a new waiting day for sickness benefits, reintroducing a time limit for sickness insurance, and rejecting various government proposals aimed at increasing support. The suggestions aim to save significant funds in the upcoming years by modifying the existing regulations surrounding sickness and disability benefits, while also attempting to improve efficiency within the state administration.

title: Politik för Sveriges arbetarkvinnor
summary: The proposal by the Liberal Party aims to allocate funding for healthcare, social services, and social welfare for 2022, emphasizing patient-centered care, the resolution of pandemic-related healthcare backlogs, and the enhancement of personal assistance programs. It suggests specific financial allocations to address postponed healthcare services due to COVID-19, increase hospital beds, expand home visits for child healthcare, and enhance funding for personal assistance, while also opposing short-term government measures. Additionally, it proposes reducing annual adjustments to certain government agency budgets to increase administrative efficiency.

title: En hållbar besöksnäring
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1124 av Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist m.fl. (C)
summary: The proposal from the Liberals (L) suggests a budget allocation for 2022 within the migration expenditure area, advocating for a 20% reduction in the annual price and wage adjustment on certain governmental agencies in order to increase the efficiency of state administration. The budget proposal includes specific allocations for various migration-related activities and agencies, with a notable decrease in funding for court reviews in immigration cases.

title: Den svenska basindustrin
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1123 av Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist m.fl. (C)
summary: The motion proposed by Joar Forssell and other members of the Liberal Party suggests that the Swedish parliament allocate the 2022 budget for international aid without the proposed increases to the Folke Bernadotte Academy, redirecting those funds to the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida) instead. The proposal details budgetary allocations for various organizations involved in international aid.

title: Regelförenkling för bättre styrning och service och ökat företagande
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1122 av Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist m.fl. (C)
summary: The proposal from the Liberals advocates for continued financial support for Sweden's defense and crisis preparedness in light of increasing geopolitical tensions. It emphasizes the importance of a strong military and international cooperation, specifically recommending Sweden's accession to NATO. Additionally, the proposal suggests increased funding for the Coast Guard to combat organized crime and for the Radiation Safety Authority to support nuclear reactor operations.

title: Fler företag, fler jobb och stärkt konkurrenskraft i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1121 av Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist m.fl. (C)
summary: The motion proposes adjustments to the budget for 2022 concerning the area of international cooperation, emphasizing a reduction of 20 percent in the annual price and wage adjustment for certain government agencies. The specific budget allocations are outlined in a table, which details funding for peace and security-promoting activities, among other initiatives.

title: Nordiskt samarbete
summary: The Liberals propose an increase in funding for Sweden's justice system to address the rising incidents of gun violence and crime. They emphasize the need for long-term investments in law enforcement, higher police salaries, and local security measures to enhance public safety and confront criminal gangs. The motion outlines a budget increase of 7.6 billion SEK for the years 2022–2024 to support various justice system agencies and recommends funding for local security personnel in municipalities. Overall, the Liberals advocate for significant resource allocation to improve police presence and effectiveness in combating crime in Sweden.

title: Det kontantlösa samhället
summary: The Liberal Party's motion proposes adjustments to the budget for the year 2022 within the area of taxes, customs, and execution, specifically advocating for an increase of 48 million kronor to strengthen the Swedish Customs Agency's crime prevention efforts, while also suggesting a 20% reduction in the standard annual adjustment for certain agencies to enhance the efficiency of government administration.

title: Digitalisering
summary: The proposal from the Liberal Party (Liberalerna) outlines a budget alternative for 2022, suggesting a 20% reduction in the annual price and wage adjustment for certain government agencies within the expenditure area of public economics and financial management. The motion includes detailed accounting for various agencies' budget allocations and aims to enhance the efficiency of state administration.

title: Förstärkning av barns rättsskydd mot olika former av sexuellt utnyttjande
summary: The proposal by the Liberals suggests a budgetary allocation for 2022 that reinforces democratic institutions and addresses specific societal issues. It includes increased funding for the Parliamentary Ombudsmen and regional administrations to aid in forecasting electricity needs and combating honor-related violence. The proposal also advocates for a proportional funding adjustment for the Institute for Human Rights, an increase in funding for the inclusion of Roma communities, and a reduction in standardized price and wage indexation for certain government agencies to improve efficiency.

title: Swishtjänst för hela Europeiska unionen
summary: The proposal outlines a comprehensive budget plan by the Sweden Democrats that addresses several key issues stemming from the COVID-19 pandemic, including economic recovery efforts, reduction of healthcare backlogs, the fight against gang crime, pension reforms, and strengthening the welfare state. The plan emphasizes increased funding for various sectors, the importance of reducing crime, and enhancing social support systems to ensure a secure future for all citizens.

title: Införande av registrering av testamenten och framtidsfullmakter
summary: The motion proposes measures to improve traffic safety for A-tractors due to a significant increase in their use and a concurrent rise in accidents associated with them. The proposal emphasizes the need for legislative action, such as the introduction of seatbelt requirements and restrictions on the number of passengers in Atractors, to curb the alarming trend of accidents, particularly affecting young people in rural areas. The motion is driven by statistics indicating a drastic rise in both the number of Atractors and related injuries since regulatory changes have made it easier to convert regular vehicles into Atractors.

title: Sista etappen av vägförbättrande ombyggnation av väg 181
summary: The proposal suggests abolishing the quota system within Sweden's parental insurance, which currently reserves specific days for each parent. The motion argues that this system limits families' flexibility in planning their parental leave according to their individual circumstances, potentially reducing valuable time with children. By eliminating the quota, families would have the freedom to utilize parental leave days as they see fit, allowing for better adaptation to their unique situations.

title: Skadeståndsansvar för kommunerna när barn vanvårdas
summary: The motion proposes a review of Chapter Five of the Penal Code regarding defamation, highlighting concerns about its current vague wording that potentially infringes on freedom of speech. It cites a notable court case where a politician was acquitted in a defamation suit, arguing that the existing legislation allows for civil lawsuits that threaten public debate and freedom of expression. The suggested review aims to modernize and clarify the legal text to better balance the protection of individuals from defamation while safeguarding public discourse.

title: UNRWA
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of mandatory knowledge and safety requirements for operating certain recreational boats in Sweden, including the implementation of a driving license for specific boat sizes and speeds, an age limit for operation, and regulations on required boat equipment. The goal is to enhance safety on the water, reduce risks of accidents, and promote responsible boating practices without overly restricting recreational boating opportunities.

title: Eftersupning
summary: The proposal suggests that the research deduction should be better tailored to accommodate small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to enhance Sweden's economic competitiveness and foster the transition towards more climate-friendly innovations. It emphasizes the importance of SMEs in driving research and development (R&D) through the existing tax deductions, which are currently difficult for these companies to fully utilize due to complex regulations. The motion calls for a review of the rules governing research deductions to ensure that both large and small companies can benefit from them.

title: Slopande av de fasta stegen i sjukförsäkringen
summary: The motion advocates for allowing professional representatives, including those using digital platforms, to transport waste and unwanted items to recycling centers or for resale, equal to the rights of private individuals. It also proposes the establishment of a specialized digitalization agency to review and recommend changes to legislation that hinders the development of digital services. The authors argue that existing laws are outdated and that prohibitions against popular services, like Tiptapp, do not yield environmental benefits, suggesting a need for modernized tax legislation for platform services.

title: Åtgärder för ett mer transparent skattesystem
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1109 av Hans Eklind och Yusuf Aydin (båda KD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the abolition of border controls between Sweden and Denmark, emphasizing the importance of Nordic cooperation and free movement in maintaining prosperity and freedom. It argues that current border controls hinder social and economic interactions, cost the country significantly, and oppose the spirit of European integration. The motion calls for a return to the principles established in the Nordic passport union of 1954, highlighting the detrimental effects of isolationist policies.

title: Kriminalvården
summary: The motion proposes establishing structural measures for circular food production systems in Sweden, emphasizing the need for innovation and collaboration to address global food security and environmental challenges. It advocates for the government to direct Tillväxtverket to investigate the development of a center for circular food production systems, encouraging sustainable practices that could enhance Sweden's competitiveness in food production and align with national food strategies.

title: Undervattensjakt
summary: The proposal seeks to task Trafikverket, in collaboration with Inlandsbanan AB and the business community, with reviewing and improving the future functionality of Inlandsbanan, ensuring it meets Swedish normal standards and integrates with other rail networks. The aim is to support new and growing businesses, create jobs, address the current capacity issues in the railway system, and contribute to global climate goals. The motion emphasizes the strategic importance of Inlandsbanan for both economic growth and defense readiness.

title: Skärpt sexualbrottslag
summary: The motion proposes a national action plan to combat gambling addiction, emphasizing the need to curb aggressive marketing by gambling companies and improve support services for those affected by gambling problems. It highlights the rising number of individuals facing gambling-related issues, worsened by a lack of knowledge and resources among municipalities and regions. The motion calls for stricter regulations on gambling marketing, risk classification of games, and coordinated efforts among authorities to prevent the worsening gambling crisis.

title: All blåljuspersonal ska ha tjänstemannastatus
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider requiring connecting tickets in the procurement of transport policy-motivated air traffic. This suggestion aims to improve accessibility and stability in air travel, especially after the pandemic's disruptions. It emphasizes the need for reliable connections to ensure that passengers are not left with the risk of missed or delayed flights, thereby enhancing the overall travel experience and supporting regional airports.

title: Den svenska vargstammen
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for enhancing the electric grid infrastructure in Norrbotten and northern Västerbotten to support the region's transition to a fossil-free society and accommodate increasing energy demands from new industrial establishments such as data centers and green steel production. It calls on the Parliament to ensure that municipalities and regions can participate in the long-term planning of the electric network, addressing current limitations and future needs for sustainable energy supply and industrial growth.

title: Nedskräpning av haven
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should urgently explore financing solutions for the construction of the Norrbotniabanan railway, including potential state loans and a repayment model similar to that of the Botniabanan project. It emphasizes the necessity of accelerating the planning process to complete the railway that is vital for regional development, industrial needs, and connectivity with Europe, and requests that the government facilitate discussions and find solutions for this important infrastructure project.

title: Lex Rebecka
summary: The motion advocates for government authorities to protect valuable farmland during planning processes, highlighting the significant loss of 84,000 hectares of arable land over the past decade, particularly in Skåne. It emphasizes that despite the government's own food strategy recognizing productive farmland as a critical resource, government agencies like the Correctional Service are planning to establish facilities on prime agricultural land instead of utilizing less productive areas. Hence, it calls for the government to ensure that its agencies act responsibly toward preserving this essential resource.

title: Svenskt flyg
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take actions to improve the traffic situation on Dragongatan in Ystad due to increasing traffic from Ystad port, which is a major hub for ferry traffic to Poland and Bornholm. The motion emphasizes the importance of enhancing transportation routes to accommodate the expected growth in both freight and passenger traffic, ensuring safety and accessibility as the port's capacity expands.

title: Dubbelspårig järnväg mellan Oslo och Göteborg
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of privatizing parts of the Lantmäteriet's operations to improve efficiency and reduce processing times for land-related services, which are crucial for rural businesses. The motion highlights current issues with long waiting periods and high costs associated with Lantmäteriet's services, particularly during property transactions and regulations. By allowing private actors to handle certain tasks, it aims to free up resources for Lantmäteriet's core functions.

title: Säkrare trafik med A-traktorer
summary: The motion proposed by the Sweden Democrats aims to allocate budget funds for energy in 2022, emphasizing the importance of competitive energy prices and reliability for both households and businesses. The proposal advocates for increased funding for energy research, particularly in nuclear power and renewable energy, with a goal of reducing dependency on fossil fuels while enhancing self-sufficiency and international cooperation in energy production. Key initiatives include support for fourth-generation nuclear reactor research and withdrawal of subsidies for certain renewable energy sources deemed ineffective.

title: Säkrare övningskörning
summary: The proposal seeks to urge the Swedish government to analyze whether compensation is provided to affected landowners when there are restrictions on their rights related to health, environmental, or security reasons, specifically in relation to fishing rights along Torne River. It highlights the need for such compensation especially for landowners along the Torne River who are currently prohibited from fishing for two months each year without compensation while fishing permits are still sold for the same area, thus emphasizing the importance of property rights and the need for equitable treatment in the wake of governmental restrictions.

title: Hårdare tag mot huliganism
summary: The motion drafted by Linda Modig aims to improve the infrastructure for the mining industry in Norrbotten by proposing investments in double-tracking the Malmbanan railway and enhancing traffic safety measures on the Europaväg E10 between Töre and Narvik. The proposal emphasizes the importance of Malmbanan for transporting goods and people, advocating for increased capacity at Luleå port to support the shipment of iron ore and ensuring traffic safety along key transport routes to handle growing demand from the mining sector.

title: Rätten att själv bestämma över sin kvarlåtenskap
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1096 av Alexandra Anstrell och Mats Green (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a new support area division for national subsidies aimed at milk production in Sweden, particularly addressing the challenges faced by farmers in Norrbotten. It highlights the rapid decline of dairy farms in the region and emphasizes the need for active measures in agricultural policies to enhance local food production and improve competitiveness against neighboring Finland. The motion advocates for more tailored subsidy classifications that consider various local conditions affecting dairy farming, arguing that the current support structure does not adequately address these factors.

title: Flickors frihet i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government revisits legislation to ensure that individuals in Sweden have access to adequate assessments of their driving suitability, particularly after experiencing a stroke or TIA. The motion highlights the challenges faced by stroke survivors in obtaining timely evaluations and the inconsistencies in the process across regions. It calls for comprehensive measures to enhance the validity of driving assessments to support individuals' independence and safety on the roads.

title: Polisens karriärmöjligheter
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1094 av Alexandra Anstrell och Maria Stockhaus (båda M)
summary: This motion proposes several measures to improve the efficiency of Sweden's mining permitting process, including increasing resources for relevant authorities, modernizing the Minerals Act, and concentrating environmental assessments to a single county administrative board. The motion argues that legal uncertainties have negatively impacted Sweden's attractiveness as a mining nation and emphasizes the importance of addressing EU demands for critical raw materials. It highlights the need for a comprehensive review of permitting procedures to facilitate sustainable mining practices while ensuring legal safety and governmental accountability.

title: Idrottssveriges möjligheter att bedriva elitverksamhet för ungdomar
summary: The proposal advocates for changing the current regulations regarding eel fishing licenses in Sweden, allowing these licenses to be transferable between individuals. It highlights the serious conservation status of the eel, emphasizing the importance of maintaining small-scale fishing and cultural heritage while arguing that the inability to transfer permits may threaten the viability of existing eel fishing businesses.

title: Det kommunala vetot vad gäller vindkraftsetableringar
summary: The motion by Kristina Yngwe proposes reforms to modernize the work of the Swedish Parliament to better accommodate members who are also parents, particularly those who travel long distances. It suggests exploring changes that would reduce the number of overnight stays in Stockholm, such as scheduling votes earlier in the week and allowing hybrid attendance for committee meetings. Additionally, it calls for a longer parliamentary session and better public communication regarding the role of parliamentarians outside Stockholm.

title: Frivillig sekretess för skyddsjaktsansökare
summary: This motion proposes a review of the tax system to enhance transparency and requires clearer reporting of labor costs, emphasizing the importance of small and medium-sized enterprises in job creation and economic growth. The motion highlights that current labor cost structures are not well understood by the public and aims to clarify them to foster a better business environment.

title: Handel med sälprodukter
summary: This parliamentary motion advocates for various measures to address animal rights-related crime in Sweden, calling for the introduction of a specific crime code for such offenses, changes to privacy laws to protect victims from harassment, strengthening European police cooperation against related crimes, and providing state auditors to intervene in cases of threats against private auditors. It also emphasizes the need for better protection for those engaged in legal hunting activities from threats and harassment, underlining the severity of animal rights extremism as a societal and democratic issue.

title: Sprinklers i Södra länken i Stockholm
summary: The proposal aims to address the increasing rates of sickness absenteeism, particularly among women, by suggesting a range of reforms to Sweden's social insurance system. It includes increasing preventive sick pay use, addressing gender imbalances in sickness benefits, introducing more benefit levels, clarifying the responsibilities of the Swedish Social Insurance Agency, and facilitating a smoother transition back to work for those recovering from illness or disability. The proposal highlights the complexity of the current system and seeks to implement measures that promote early intervention, better coordination, and support for individuals to return to work sustainably.

title: Utfasning av djurförsök
summary: The proposal addresses the need for enhanced information campaigns directed at young adults, parents, and entrepreneurs regarding the significance of lifetime income for pensions. It emphasizes clearer regulations on municipal responsibilities for ensuring the living standards of retirees and calls for a review of costs and compensations for the elderly. The Center Party advocates for measures to promote equitable pensions, including the equal sharing of pension points between parents during child-rearing years and adjustments to benefit structures to reduce the pension gap, particularly for women.

title: Sänkt förseningsavgift vid mindre skattebetalningar
summary: The motion proposes comprehensive reforms to enhance the quality of healthcare and eldercare in Sweden. It includes establishing maximum staff-to-manager ratios in welfare services, mandatory leadership training for healthcare managers, and mandatory training for staff in eldercare. The motion calls for the introduction of a national system for small-scale health services, better support for caregivers, and improved health data management. It also emphasizes the need to address inequalities in healthcare access, increase the number of specialists, and implement a digital ecosystem for healthcare management, among other measures aimed at ensuring equitable, high-quality care for all citizens.

title: Översyn av förtalslagstiftningen
summary: The proposal put forth by the Christian Democrats emphasizes the need to strengthen Sweden's defense capabilities in response to a deteriorating security situation in the region, particularly due to increasing aggression from Russia. It outlines a plan to significantly raise defense budgets, incorporate Sweden into NATO, enhance military cooperation within the EU, and improve Sweden's crisis readiness and ability to engage in international military efforts. The motion calls for concrete actions to reinforce military, cybersecurity, and civil defense sectors, as well as implement national supply preparedness initiatives.

title: En effektiv offentlig förvaltning
summary: The motion proposes a budget adjustment for 2022 focusing on the governance of the Swedish state. It aims to strengthen democracy, restore the Swedish civil service tradition, and address key financial allocations including increased funding for the Royal Court and Sametinget, while reducing party support and gradually phasing out media operating support over five years. The proposal emphasizes efficiency in decision-making within the government and parliament, and it advocates for enhanced resources for integrity protection and civil defense.

title: Värdet av vattenkraftsproduktion
summary: The proposal from the Sweden Democrats suggests an annual budget increase of 5 million kronor for the Finansinspektionen's innovation center to enhance financial oversight and adapt regulations to rapid innovations in the fintech sector. The motion underscores the need for maintaining effective supervision of the financial market to avoid outdated regulations and ensure financial stability, especially in light of recent market stresses exacerbated by the pandemic.

title: En moderniserad alkohollag
summary: Sverigedemokraterna proposes a reallocation of budgetary resources within Switzerland's expense framework for taxes, customs, and execution, aiming to counteract rising crime and support welfare financing through increased enforcement and modernization efforts at the Tax Agency and Customs Agency, alongside enhanced interagency collaboration against crime.

title: Fler lärlingsutbildningar som leder till yrkesexamen
summary: Sverigedemokraterna föreslår en omfattande reformering och finansiering av rättsväsendet i Sverige för att möta den ökande kriminaliteten och otryggheten. Förslagen inkluderar kraftiga resursökningar för Polismyndigheten, rekrytering av fler poliser, förbättrade lönestrukturer samt investeringar i tekniska lösningar och administrativ personal. Dessutom föreslås olika åtgärder för att stödja brottsoffer och effektivisera rättssystemet, inklusive en statlig skadeståndsgaranti och anonyma vittnesmål i rättegångar.

title: Förenklande av bostadsbyggande i attraktiva strandnära lägen
summary: The Sverigedemokraterna propose increased financial allocations to enhance Sweden's international collaboration, particularly in the Nordic context, to improve language understanding and cultural exchange. They emphasize the need to restore Sweden’s international reputation that has been negatively impacted during the COVID-19 pandemic and address rising crime. Their plan includes specific funding for the Swedish Institute's initiatives targeting female leadership in the MENA region and strengthening the expertise of the Inspectorate for Strategic Products.

title: Återinförande av riksdagens öppnande i Rikssalen
summary: The motion proposed by the Sweden Democrats calls for an increase in defense spending to bolster Sweden's total defense capabilities in response to deteriorating security conditions in the region, particularly influenced by developments in Russia. The proposal includes plans for long-term defense budgets, enhanced troop recruitment and training, a focus on domestic defense rather than extensive international missions, and improved military material procurement and technological development. Additionally, it emphasizes the need for effective crisis preparedness and coordination among relevant authorities.

title: Om straffrabatt och villkorlig frigivning för de som återgår till brott
summary: Sverigedemokraterna har föreslagit en ny inriktning av Sveriges internationella bistånd med fokus på att tillgodose akuta behov i Sverige samt att skära ner på biståndet till internationella organisationer. Förslaget innebär att medel ska omfördelas för att prioritera humanitära insatser, särskilt för flyktingar, och att biståndsramarna ska minskas och koncentreras till färre projekt och mottagarländer. Detta svarar mot de pågående utmaningarna efter coronapandemin och kritiken kring biståndets effektivitet och korruption.

title: Elpriser
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats advocates for a comprehensive reform of the country's migration policy aimed at increasing control and reducing immigration levels. The motion emphasizes the need for stricter regulations, enhanced self-sufficiency requirements for immigrants, and an effective asylum process by establishing transit centers. The party seeks to shift the focus towards servicing Sweden's interests and addressing challenges posed by increased migration, including economic strain and social segregation. It calls for phasing out current policies that facilitate immigration from distant countries and urges for a suspension of citizenship applications until new, stricter laws are in place.

title: Rullande väghinder
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1077 av Lars Mejern Larsson och Mikael Dahlqvist (båda S)
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats aims to enhance the quality and accessibility of healthcare in Sweden by advocating for increased funding and improved organizational structures. It emphasizes the need for timely patient care, improved mental health services, and a national strategy to address long COVID and suicide prevention. The party seeks to implement various measures including mandatory health checks for asylum seekers, removal of waiting lists, and ensuring free inpatient care for seniors, all aiming to provide equitable and high-quality healthcare for all citizens.

title: Nolltolerans mot hederskulturens brott
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats seeks to reform the economic security system for individuals unable to support themselves due to illness or disability. Key suggestions include more equitable assessments for sickness and activity compensation, improved rehabilitation processes, a stronger focus on mental health, and changes to the employer's sick pay responsibility for small businesses. The aim is to establish a more humane and flexible economic safety net that caters better to individual needs and circumstances, particularly in light of increasing needs arising from mental health issues exacerbated during the pandemic.

title: Folkbildningsrådet
summary: The motion proposed by Linda Lindberg and others from the Sweden Democrats (SD) focuses on improving the economic security of elderly citizens in Sweden, particularly those receiving pensions. It highlights the inadequacies in the current pensions system, which affects many pensioners, especially women, who struggle to meet living expenses. The proposal calls for increasing the basic pension guarantee by 300 SEK per month and removing a qualification rule that limits full access to pension benefits for those with insufficient residency in Sweden, thereby aiming to alleviate poverty among retirees.

title: En trygg demokrati
summary: Sverigedemokraterna (SD) proposes to enhance Sweden's family economic policy by increasing various benefits and supports for families with children. Key suggestions include the introduction of a barndomsgaranti to ensure children grow up in safe environments, expanding parental leave days, granting pregnant women ten days of pregnancy benefits, and raising housing allowances to reduce child poverty. Additional proposals aim to establish a one-time grant for first-time mothers and to enhance access to parental allowances to foster equality among parents during early childhood.

title: Likformig bedömning av personröster
summary: Sverigedemokraterna proposes a budget allocation for 2022 to address issues related to gender equality and the integration of newly arrived immigrants. The motion emphasizes the need for effective measures against both discrimination and segregation while challenging the current policies that they believe exacerbate societal divides. The party advocates for reforms that promote individual responsibility and integration based on shared societal values, rejecting special provisions for immigrants as counterproductive, and suggesting cuts to various support programs, including the halving of the budget for the Discrimination Ombudsman. Furthermore, they stress the importance of enhancing resources for supporting victims of gender-based violence, particularly in light of increased reports linked to the pandemic.

title: Internationellt elituniversitet i Stockholm
summary: The motion presented by the Sweden Democrats outlines proposed budget allocations for the labor market and working life sector, emphasizing the need to address the increased unemployment and mental health issues arising from the pandemic. It calls for reforms in labor market policies, including a shift towards state-controlled unemployment insurance, increased support for small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhanced training and apprenticeship opportunities. The motion also highlights the importance of improving workplace safety and addressing the challenges faced by individuals with disabilities in the job market.

title: Privatekonomi i alla skolformer
summary: The suggestion by the Sweden Democrats proposes to maintain and enhance the generous study support system in Sweden, emphasizing the need to address labor shortages by increasing study grants for education programs in high demand and introducing debt forgiveness for teachers in rural areas. The party argues against the current system's perceived inequalities and proposes reallocating funds to enhance support where it is deemed necessary for societal benefit, while also suggesting the elimination of study start support, which primarily benefits newcomers.

title: Den dolda momsen för utbildningsföretag
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:1070 av Alexandra Anstrell och Maria Stockhaus (båda M)
summary: Sverigedemokraterna föreslår en rad åtgärder för att förbättra utbildningssystemet i Sverige, inklusive ökad personaltäthet i förskolan och grundskolan, avskaffande av karensavdrag för skolpersonal, samt förbättrad studie- och yrkesvägledning. Motionen adresserar problem som bristande resurser, sjunkande undervisningskvalitet, och ökad otrygghet i skolorna, och efterfrågar mer finansiellt stöd till skolor samt stärkt insyn och reglering genom Skolinspektionen. Utbildningens kvalitet ska också säkerställas genom satsningar på högre utbildning och yrkeshögskolor.

title: Hästföretagares betydelse
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats suggests a long-term increase of 3 billion kronor annually to the municipal equalization system to help municipalities maintain good welfare services and manage rising operational demands post-pandemic. This funding aims to mitigate the adverse financial impacts towns and regions are facing due to decreased revenue and increased costs, ensuring sustainable public services without adding to local debt burdens.

title: Stärkt trafiksäkerhet för ungdomar som kör moped
summary: The suggestion proposes increased funding allocations for various initiatives aimed at enhancing Sweden's competitiveness and innovation in the business sector. It emphasizes the need for a supportive regulatory environment and highlights initiatives such as simplified administrative processes for businesses, increased support for growth and research in geological sciences, and the establishment of a new funding system for entrepreneurs currently employed, allowing them to pursue their business ideas while receiving financial support equivalent to unemployment benefits.

title: Stärkt infrastruktur i Blekinge
summary: The proposal advocates for increased funding and policy changes to support the agriculture, forestry, and food sectors in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for improved profitability in farming, urging tax cuts and regulatory simplifications to enhance competitiveness. The suggestion includes measures such as establishing a national control function against food fraud, promoting sustainable practices in forestry, and investing in animal welfare and health. Overall, the proposal seeks to revitalize rural areas and enhance food security in Sweden.

title: Byggandet av Sydostlänken
summary: The motion presented by Jimmy Ståhl and others from the Sweden Democrats outlines a comprehensive proposal for funding and priorities in transport infrastructure in Sweden for 2022. It emphasizes the need for significant investments in both road and railway networks, addressing current deficiencies in maintenance and capacity.
