summary: The motion proposes several tax relief measures to enhance employment and integration in Sweden, including tax deductions for companies investing in employee training, increasing the ceiling for the RUT tax deduction, and lowering taxes on labor. It aims to make work more financially attractive, particularly for low-income individuals and women, to improve gender equality and raise overall economic participation. The motion also suggests reviewing the administrative burdens of the personnel register for the restaurant industry and adjusting tax regulations for virtual goods to accommodate the growth of the digital economy.

title: Pilotprojekt i Göteborgs södra skärgård för att utveckla parkeringsarkar
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:815 av Jimmy Ståhl och Dennis Dioukarev (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes a series of measures aimed at reforming Sweden's vehicle and environmental tax policies, including the abolishment of the current bonus-malus system, reductions in taxes on gasoline and diesel, re-evaluation of the aviation tax, and adjustments to the taxation of various vehicle types. It emphasizes the need for a fairer tax system that does not disproportionately burden individuals reliant on cars, especially in rural areas. Furthermore, the motion seeks to address issues with current waste and chemical taxes, advocating for their elimination due to their negative impact on businesses and limited environmental benefits.

title: Åtgärder för att minimera risken för hemmasittande och motverka elevers psykiska ohälsa
summary: The proposal calls for a comprehensive review to strengthen the Customs Agency's role as a law enforcement body in Sweden, including enhanced powers to search vehicles, detain individuals with suspected stolen goods, conduct systematic checks, and collaborate with police and other agencies to combat organized crime and terrorism. It also recommends investigating illegal alcohol imports and improving the agency's capabilities in tackling money laundering, suggesting that customs officials should be better equipped to support police operations and carry firearms for protection.

title: Utredning av porrens konsekvenser
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:813 av Åsa Eriksson och Eva Lindh (båda S)
summary: The motion presented by Niklas Wykman and others calls for a comprehensive approach to reduce fraud and criminal activities linked to demographic and identity manipulation in Sweden. It proposes a nationwide census to improve the accuracy of population data, stricter identification requirements for individuals with coordination numbers, enhanced capabilities for the Swedish Enforcement Authority to collect debts from criminals, and greater cooperation between various government agencies to ensure accurate benefit disbursements. The intention is to strengthen the integrity of Sweden's welfare system and combat the rise of parallel societies fueled by welfare fraud.

title: Rätten till ledsagarinsatser för personer med svår synnedsättning, blinda och dövblinda
summary: The motion proposes several measures to strengthen the sexual integrity of children under eighteen in Sweden, including the introduction of a 'byxskyddslag' (age of consent protection law) to prevent adults from exploiting young people in sexual situations. It calls for the government to develop a concrete action plan against sexual abuse of children, establish a commission to investigate the effectiveness of child protection measures, and expedite legal processes related to child sexual abuse cases. The motion highlights alarming statistics on sexual abuse against children, urging immediate action to ensure their safety and rights.

title: Järnvägstrafik mellan Sverige och Finland
summary: The motion proposes making sex and relationships education a mandatory part of teacher training in Sweden, ensuring that all teacher candidates receive adequate training in this area. It calls for the Swedish National Agency for Education (Skolverket) to follow and develop this subject in schools, guarantees equal access to education for youth in care homes, and emphasizes the importance of integrating sex and relationships education into language introduction programs and Swedish for immigrants courses. The aim is to improve the quality of education and address gaps in sexual health education, particularly for vulnerable groups.

title: En mer effektiv innovationspolitik
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:810 av Åsa Eriksson och Jennie Nilsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to increase the use and registration of defibrillators in Sweden to improve survival rates for individuals experiencing sudden cardiac arrests outside of hospitals. Currently, many available defibrillators are not utilized, leading to low survival rates despite the potential for improved outcomes when these devices are employed quickly. The proposal emphasizes the need for greater registration of defibrillators in a national register and the establishment of public awareness campaigns, similar to successful initiatives in the Netherlands.

title: Bättre förutsättningar för jordbrukare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandate the Swedish Council for Higher Education to ensure that students with neuropsychiatric disabilities receive necessary accommodations during the higher education entrance examination (högskoleprovet). The proposal emphasizes the importance of fair assessment based on knowledge and skills rather than environmental factors, advocating for measures such as extended exam times and alternative settings to enhance accessibility for these students.

title: Stärkt samförvaltningsmodell av fisket i Bottenviken
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:808 av Ida Karkiainen och Fredrik Lundh Sammeli (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that a governmental authority should take over the responsibility of distributing and auditing state grants for folkbildning (folk education) instead of the Folkbildningsrådet. It seeks to ensure transparency and compliance with democratic values by investigating whether the Folkbildningsrådet should be subject to public disclosure laws, enhancing its capabilities to identify and address financial irregularities, and preventing funding from reaching organizations that promote anti-Semitic, undemocratic, or gender-discriminatory practices.

title: Kriminalisering av omvändelseförsök
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:807 av Fredrik Lundh Sammeli och Johan Büser (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that municipalities and regions be granted the authority to issue permits and manage the deployment of security guards in areas experiencing public disorder, such as streets or squares with significant crime issues. It highlights community concerns regarding the insufficiency of police resources to address these challenges and suggests that local authorities should have the ability to use security guards with necessary powers to maintain order effectively. The proposal aims to enhance local flexibility in responding to crime and public safety issues.

title: Biståndspolitik – en nyckel i fattigdomsbekämpningen
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament enhances the oversight of public service media (SVT, SR, UR) to ensure impartiality and factual accuracy, given that public funding obligates strong accountability standards. The authors criticize the current review body for lacking power and suggest that measures are needed to restore public confidence in media neutrality, especially as trust in public service has diminished. They call for the consideration of sanctions for violations of standards to reinforce public trust and legitimacy.

title: Myndigheters regionalpolitiska ansvar
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the laws regarding hate speech against ethnic groups in order to clarify and possibly update the legal framework to better reflect contemporary society and discussions. It argues for protecting all groups, including the majority population, while also ensuring that individuals can engage in legitimate discussions about sensitive topics such as religion. The authors highlight the vagueness in the current laws and suggest that a new review is necessary to codify existing legal practices.

title: Dawit Isaak måste friges och det fria ordet måste värnas
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:804 av Helén Pettersson och Fredrik Lundh Sammeli (båda S)
summary: This proposal calls for the abolition of the Gender Equality Agency, arguing that it was established without a thorough analysis of necessity and that reducing the number of agencies is essential for prioritizing taxpayer welfare and community services.

title: Utbyggd infrastruktur i Skåne och ordning och reda på våra vägar
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should pass legislation making it a criminal offense to cheat during driver's license tests. The motivation highlights the importance of ensuring that all drivers possess the necessary skills and knowledge, arguing that the current lack of legal repercussions for cheating poses a significant threat to road safety. The motion references recent cases where individuals caught cheating were acquitted due to insufficient legal frameworks to address the offense.

title: Avskaffande av den allmänna motionstiden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament explore the possibility of allowing farm sales of locally produced alcoholic beverages. The goal is to create better conditions for small-scale producers to enter the market, countering the current alcohol monopoly that hinders their ability to expand. By allowing farm sales, it is argued that local rural economies would thrive, providing additional income opportunities for farmers and promoting environmentally friendly consumption patterns through reduced transport. The motion stresses that the restrictive alcohol policy can still be maintained while facilitating this type of sales.

title: En jämlik klimakterievård i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:801 av Louise Thunström och Paula Holmqvist (båda S)
summary: This proposal aims to update Sweden's alcohol legislation by extending the operating hours for restaurants and bars to 5 AM across all municipalities, ensuring uniformity in their interpretation of the law. It also calls for a review of the alcohol serving limits at microbreweries, enabling them to better accommodate tasting experiences. The suggestion highlights the need for a modernized regulatory framework that reflects societal changes and reduces unnecessary complexity.

title: Säkrad tillgång till läkemedel – i hela landet
summary: The motion proposes to allow the sale of beer and wine in rural stores across Sweden to improve accessibility for residents outside urban areas, potentially enhancing the profitability of these stores and benefiting local consumers. This initiative aims to create more equitable conditions in the market by enabling rural shops to offer a wider range of products similar to those available in cities. The motion suggests a pilot program in select regions to assess the feasibility of implementing a licensing system for these sales in rural areas.

title: Återförande av ansvaret för att föreslå ny statsminister för riksdagen till statschefen
summary: This proposal advocates for the cessation of fuel tax increases in Sweden, highlighting the financial burden on citizens who struggle to afford rising gasoline prices. The motion underscores the importance of enabling citizens, particularly those in rural areas, to have the necessary tools and conditions to transition to renewable energy without facing undue hardship.

title: Bevarandet av ålfiske
summary: The motion suggests that Sweden should ensure a year-round supply of dispatchable energy to address the increasing demand for electricity and the resulting capacity shortage in power grids, which impeded industrial investments and urban growth. It highlights the transition of Sweden's energy system, where renewable energy sources like wind power are becoming more prevalent while dispatchable sources like nuclear power are being phased out, leading to concerns about energy security, especially during cold winter days.

title: Rätt att framföra lätt motorcykel med körkortsbehörighet B
summary: The motion advocates for improved collaboration among various organizations that assist entrepreneurs in starting new businesses. It highlights the confusion created by the existence of multiple state, municipal, and private entities with similar goals, which can lead to competition rather than cooperation. The proposal calls for the government to clarify the roles and responsibilities of these organizations to streamline support for both new and existing businesses seeking capital or advice, particularly in the context of specific regions like Gästrikland.

title: Upphörande av bidrag till islamistiska Muslimska brödraskapets underorganisationer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament takes action to ensure the preservation of sprat in the Baltic Sea by implementing effective measures to protect the species, highlighting concerns from local fishermen about overfishing and the need for a temporary fishing ban in a designated area during the winter months to allow sprat populations to recover.

title: Uppåkra Arkeologiska Center
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish Parliament to consider the possibility of training more police dogs to enhance public safety, emphasizing that visible police presence, including the use of trained dogs, is vital in combating increasing violent crime and ensuring citizens feel secure in their communities.

title: Förbud mot plågsamma bedövningsmetoder vid slakt
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:794 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to set concrete goals to increase the percentage of female entrepreneurs in Sweden, emphasizing that, despite a rise in female entrepreneurship, it remains disproportionately low. The motion argues that government policies should encourage business in the welfare sector, which predominantly employs women, instead of imposing limitations that could hinder their progress. It highlights the need for political rhetoric that supports female entrepreneurship and urges government action to stimulate and promote women's business ownership.

title: Skattetrappa för företagare
summary: The motion proposes improved integration of newly arrived immigrants into the Swedish labor market by encouraging municipalities to adopt successful strategies used in areas like Solna. It emphasizes the importance of individual support, active participation in language and community programs, and collaboration among various stakeholders, including the Employment Agency, to enhance employment outcomes for foreign-born individuals.

title: Kommunalskatt för delårsboende
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should review the possibilities of connecting more government services to the State Service Center, which aims to reduce costs and improve efficiency for state authorities while creating jobs in Gävleborg. The motion highlights the importance of effective use of tax money and the need for the government to consider this initiative.

title: Postnords aktier i Strålfors
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament (Riksdagen) instruct the government to consider publishing crime statistics on a county (län) basis rather than by regions. The author argues that this is crucial for understanding crime trends in specific areas, as the current system aggregates data over larger regions, making it difficult for local authorities and citizens to gauge crime rates accurately in their respective counties.

title: Syresätt svenskt vattenbruk och stärk svensk livsmedelsförsörjning
summary: The motion proposes a reduction in alcohol tax and value-added tax (VAT) for alcoholic beverages produced by microbreweries in Sweden, aiming to support the growing number of these smaller producers. It emphasizes the need for legislative changes to enhance the competitiveness of microbreweries by allowing them to sell their products more affordably, thereby promoting local production.

title: Förbud mot statligt finansierad lobbning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support measures to reduce the number of personal injuries among cyclists, highlighting a significant increase in such incidents since 2010. It emphasizes the need for a zero-vision approach to cycling accidents and suggests various interventions, including promoting helmet use, ensuring safe cycling paths, and advocating for winter tire use on bicycles. It also points out the challenges in accurately tracking the data on cycling injuries due to underreporting.

title: Stranderosion
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:788 av Emma Ahlström Köster m.fl. (M)
summary: This motion proposes increasing the speed limit for A-traktorer to match that of moped cars to enhance traffic safety and promote driving experience among young people. It argues that A-traktorer, being safer in terms of crash safety than moped cars, should be allowed to operate at higher speeds if safety measures like seatbelt requirements and annual inspections are implemented.

title: Om utredning av faderskap vid samboförhållande
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:787 av Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström och Ulrika Heindorff (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a student debt cancellation program that incentivizes young graduates to relocate and work in rural areas and small towns in Sweden. Drawing inspiration from a similar model in Norway, the proposal suggests that individuals who live and work in specified municipalities could have portions of their student loans forgiven, thereby mitigating recruitment challenges faced by businesses outside urban centers and encouraging a more balanced population distribution across the country.

title: Åtgärder för fler poliser i Fyrbodal och Sverige i stort
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider creating more flexibility in driving and rest time regulations for the transportation industry, highlighting that current strict regulations lead to widespread non-compliance and negatively impact fair competition. It advocates for a revised framework that accommodates unforeseen circumstances while ensuring compliance through increased inspections.

title: Utveckla den maritima besöksnäringen
summary: The motion proposes a review of the ban on studded tires in Sweden, arguing that studded tires are the safest option for winter driving according to studies, as they can reduce the risk of accidents significantly. It highlights that concerns regarding particulate emissions from studded tires may be overstated and that other sources contribute more to pollution. The motion emphasizes the importance of traffic safety and questions the appropriateness of existing or proposed bans on studded tires, suggesting that such regulations may compromise safety standards in the country.

title: Skarvens påverkan i Stockholms skärgård och resten av Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider requiring police to report the type of tires used by drivers involved in traffic accidents, as there is a significant increase in the risk of fatality when using non-studded tires compared to studded tires. The aim is to provide better data for policymakers to make informed decisions regarding road safety and to assist in achieving the government's zero vision for traffic fatalities.

title: Nationell vattenstrategi
summary: The motion by Lars Beckman calls for a review of the procurement process for transportation services for disabled individuals, specifically focusing on the need for clearer quality requirements related to traffic safety. The proposal highlights deficiencies in the current procurement standards employed by the Swedish National Agency for Student Aid (CSN) compared to those in other regions, such as Stockholm and Gävleborg, which have established comprehensive safety requirements. The motion urges the government to ensure that high safety standards are enforced in public transportation procurement to protect the most vulnerable youth reliant on these services.

title: Utbyggnad av den civila beredskapen
summary: The motion proposes that individuals who commit crimes while seeking asylum in Sweden should be denied residency and face deportation as a general rule. The authors argue that Sweden should not serve as a sanctuary for criminals and that the government should initiate a legislative review to establish clear guidelines for handling asylum seekers who engage in criminal behavior.

title: Att skydda barn från kriminella gäng
summary: Lars Beckman proposes that the Swedish parliament support increased assistance for innovators and inventors, as many promising ideas fail to reach commercial viability, hindering job creation and entrepreneurship. He highlights the need for better long-term support mechanisms for small entrepreneurs, suggesting the establishment of a startup grant that would replace unemployment benefits for a period of 6 to 24 months, provided that there is a robust control system in place to avoid unhealthy competition with existing businesses. He urges the government to initiate an investigation into improving support for innovators and inventors in Sweden.

title: Försvaret på Gotland
summary: This motion proposes a review of the car subsidy for individuals with disabilities, emphasizing that the current requirement for applicants to be able to drive a vehicle themselves limits the independence of many. It argues that individuals with disabilities often have personal assistants who could drive, and eliminating this requirement could reduce societal costs and enhance participation and independence for those affected.

title: Kriminalvårdsanstalt i Åmål
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:779 av Johan Hultberg och Ann-Sofie Alm (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to facilitate the establishment of data centers in Sweden by advocating for the opening of district heating networks to utilize waste heat from these centers. It suggests that the current regulated monopoly on district heating limits access for external heat producers and calls for the implementation of recommendations from the TPA inquiry, which aims to promote competition within the sector. The goal is to enhance competitiveness for investments and improve environmental profiles by allowing the sale of waste heat.

title: Naturens rättigheter
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:778 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion advocates for the preservation of the LSS (Law on Support and Service for Persons with Certain Functional Impairments) and the right for individuals with personal assistance needs to choose their service providers. It highlights the struggles faced by people with serious disabilities in retaining their assistance since 2014, citing significant reductions in support and alarming statistics from RBU, indicating that many individuals are denied essential daily support due to cutbacks. The proposal calls on the government to recognize and address these issues.

title: Det industriella trålfisket i Östersjön
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:777 av Kjell Jansson och Fredrik Ahlstedt (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government takes measures to reduce the population of cormorants and seals in coastal areas, due to their negative impact on the ecological balance and local fisheries. It stresses that the overpopulation of cormorants disrupts the food chain, harming fish populations, while seals also pose significant challenges to commercial fishing. The motion calls for urgent actions to mitigate these species' presence to protect biodiversity and local economies.

title: Äganderätt och miljöundantag
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of revoking Swedish citizenship, particularly for those who have committed serious crimes against the state. It suggests that current laws protect citizenship rights and that amendments to the constitution may be necessary to proceed with such measures. The proposal references international examples and emphasizes that revocation should not result in statelessness.

title: Skarpare direktiv vad gäller myndigheterna och äganderätten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider allowing the sale of pepper spray for personal protection, particularly in light of rising sexual assaults and low police presence during certain times. It argues that similar measures in other countries have provided individuals, especially women, with means to protect themselves against violence and enhance their sense of security while out in public.

title: Miljöbalken och äganderätt
summary: The motion proposes to the Swedish Parliament that the processing time for serious hunting crimes should be increased to ensure greater legal certainty for hunters in Sweden. The motion cites a specific case where an individual was suspected of a serious hunting crime for three years, resulting in the confiscation of his weapon and significant personal distress. The author argues that investigations should be expedited and expresses concerns over the handling of such cases by law enforcement and the judicial system.

title: Bluffakturor och konsekvenser för företag och enskilda av otillräckliga krav för inkassoverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of further restricting the ability to sell lottery tickets on credit, as current exceptions are believed to lead to increased debt among vulnerable groups. The backdrop of the motion includes concerns about lottery sales by the Social Democrats' A-lotteries, which have allegedly engaged in substantial credit sales, including to individuals with payment defaults, resulting in a significant number of people facing debt enforcement actions. The authors argue for a review of the exemption in the lottery law to better combat gambling addiction.

title: Införande av s.k. declaration of interest för offentligt anställda
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of introducing a national ban on begging, arguing that such legislation would reflect a clear societal stance against begging and poverty. The proponent emphasizes the importance of not reinforcing societal divisions and advocates for equal treatment and improved regulations to support those in vulnerable situations.

title: Tillåtande av gårdsförsäljning av alkohol
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:771 av Anna af Sillén och Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to restrict public access to the vehicle registry in Sweden to combat organized crime by preventing criminals from easily accessing information about vehicle ownership and locations. It argues that the current system inadvertently aids criminal activities by allowing easy identification of potential targets. The motion also calls for the closure of an investigation into creating a wealth registry, citing concerns that it could facilitate criminal behavior.

title: Ökad transparens gällande skatter
summary: The motion advocates for maintaining a robust community service and access to postal and package services throughout Sweden. It highlights concerns raised by businesses about the negative impact of ongoing reductions in the nationwide postal service, particularly the introduction of every-other-day delivery by Postnord and the proposed lowering of delivery standards. The proposal emphasizes the critical need for reliable postal and package distribution for business operations in order to facilitate timely communication and transactions.

title: Tryggheten på landsbygden
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to urgently collaborate with the private radio industry to establish directives for a forthcoming investigation into the future of Swedish radio. The motion highlights the risk of reduced availability and diversity in broadcasting if immediate measures are not taken, particularly given rapid technological changes and competition from international players in the advertising market. It calls for clarity in platform regulation to encourage investment in digital radio and to safeguard the future of licensed Swedish radio.

title: Kortare arbetstid
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:768 av Rebecka Le Moine och Marielle Lahti (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examines the taxation of company cars to ensure that it is reasonable and in line with the EU average. It highlights concerns regarding rising benefit values and vehicle taxes that disproportionately affect businesses, particularly small enterprises, and their employees. The motion argues that high taxes hinder disposable income and can potentially lead to increased traffic safety risks. It advocates for a favorable taxation regime that encourages frequent updating of vehicle fleets, benefiting both the automotive industry and households.

title: Utredning om basinkomst
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:767 av Rebecka Le Moine och Marielle Lahti (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament declare that a property tax should not be reintroduced in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of the new property valuation increases for homeowners, particularly in light of political pressures to bring back the tax. The motion argues that a property tax is immoral as it imposes financial burdens on homeowners without providing income, especially affecting elderly pensioners on fixed incomes.

title: Förutsättningar att gå och cykla till Öland
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:766 av Daniel Helldén och Annika Hirvonen (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the necessity of a professional competence certificate for individuals repairing heavy vehicles used in commercial traffic. It highlights that while drivers of such vehicles require certification to operate them, those performing maintenance and repairs do not need to demonstrate their qualifications. The aim is to enhance safety by ensuring that only qualified personnel conduct repairs, thereby reducing risks of accidents and damage.

title: Reformering av penningsystemet
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the redistribution of the child allowance in Sweden by shifting funds from the additional allowance for families with multiple children to an increased allowance for the first child. The aim is to provide better financial support for families investing in their first child, arguing that families with more children can often reuse items from previous children, thus benefiting more from support directed at first-time parents.

title: Lidandet inom kycklinguppfödningen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:764 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of offshore wind power in Sweden to be conducted with local acceptance, ensuring no negative impact on the surrounding environment, and confirming clear climate benefits. It highlights that a proposal from the Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management is under review, which designates suitable areas for such wind farms, primarily along the coast of Gästrikland. The motion calls for alignment with practices in other countries, like Germany and England, that maintain a distance of at least 40 km from land to mitigate local environmental impacts.

title: Avveckling av minkfarmarna
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:763 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: Lars Beckman proposes that the Swedish Parliament should mandate stricter recycling requirements for wind turbine components, particularly focusing on the composite materials of rotor blades, which are currently frequently disposed of or incinerated due to existing recycling challenges. He emphasizes the need for development in recycling methods and highlights the ongoing expansion of wind energy in Sweden without clear strategies for managing end-of-life turbine parts.

title: En bostadspolitik för fler
summary: The motion proposes that local residents who may be affected by the construction of wind power plants should have a decisive influence on whether such installations are allowed to be built near their homes. The author argues that current dialogues with local communities do not adequately consider their opinions regarding the environmental impact of wind farms, and emphasizes the need to strengthen protections for residents' living conditions.

title: Minskat matsvinn
summary: This motion advocates for the assurance of the ability to deposit and withdraw cash across Sweden, in light of the diminishing options available due to the termination of agreements with local cash handling representatives. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining cash access for businesses, particularly in rural areas, to avoid increased costs and protect local economic viability.

title: Ökat stöd för klimatanpassning i bebyggd miljö
summary: Lars Beckman (M) proposes that the Swedish government require municipalities to offer Swedish language courses for immigrants (SFI) during evenings and weekends, enabling foreign-born entrepreneurs to balance language learning with their business endeavors or employment. This initiative aims to support integration and job creation in Sweden, particularly in Gävleborg, by addressing barriers to language education that could facilitate entrepreneurship.

title: Laholmsbukten som marint skyddsområde
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes various measures to strengthen civil society, sports, and outdoor activities in Sweden post-coronavirus pandemic. Key proposals include investigating the pandemic's effects on civil society, broadening tax deductions for donations to non-profit organizations, and enhancing partnerships between non-profits, public organizations, and businesses. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the importance of equal access to sports for children and youth, including those with disabilities, and suggests government support for community initiatives, educational programs, and inclusive recreational activities.

title: Utveckla Viskadals-, Halmstad–Nässjö- och Markarydsbanorna
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:758 av Jan Riise och Nicklas Attefjord (båda MP)
summary: This parliamentary suggestion emphasizes the need for a comprehensive simplification of regulations to enhance governance, service, and promote entrepreneurship in Sweden. It advocates for the permanent adoption of regulatory easements implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic, the establishment of control stations within government agencies for systematic evaluations, and a reduction in bureaucratic burdens on small enterprises. Additionally, it highlights the importance of effective leadership in regulatory processes, the use of digitalization to facilitate transparency, and the necessity for follow-up on the implementation of prior regulatory studies. It calls for a specific focus on measuring the impact of regulatory work, alongside potential legislative changes to improve the business environment.

title: Verksamheter som bedrivs enligt LSS
summary: The parliamentary motion primarily focuses on a comprehensive reform of the criminal justice system in Sweden, advocating for stricter penalties for various crimes, including narcotics and violence, while also emphasizing crime prevention measures and improvements in police resources and inter-agency collaboration. It calls for an increase in police presence, more efficient processing of criminal cases, expanded investigative powers, and enhanced support for victims of crime, as well as the establishment of new legislation for organized crime.

title: Förbättrad tillgång till könsbekräftande vård
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish parliament consider simplifying regulations for legitimate gun owners, emphasizing the need for a clearer legal framework for law enforcement to ensure fair treatment. It argues against stricter regulations that impact legal gun users, such as sport shooters and hunters, as a response to gun crimes. The proposal highlights the importance of differentiating between lawful gun owners and criminals, advocating for police resource allocation and competence to address illegal gun possession without penalizing compliant citizens.

title: Bättre vård vid endometrios
summary: The motion proposes a clarifying amendment to the firearms regulation to specify that the suitability of hunting weapons should be assessed based on the intended shooting discipline indicated by the sports shooter. It argues that the current system, where both the Nature Conservation Agency and the police can provide conflicting assessments on firearms permits, creates unnecessary complications for gun owners and authorities. The motion advocates for the police not to evaluate the suitability of hunting weapons since this responsibility already lies with the Nature Conservation Agency.

title: Narkotikastrafflagen
summary: Lars Beckman suggests that the Swedish government should task the National Audit Office with developing proposals for common digitalization areas for municipalities and regions, in collaboration with the Swedish Association of Local Authorities and Regions (SKR). He argues that while the private sector has seen significant benefits from digitalization, the public sector lags behind, resulting in inefficiencies and increased taxpayer burden. Beckman highlights the need for a coordinated effort to digitize public services, especially in rural areas facing decline, and proposes the creation of an investment fund to support these initiatives.

title: Nationellt kunskapscentrum för matallergi
summary: The motion proposes that the government ensure that government agencies comply with existing legislation regarding salary mapping to address gender-based wage disparities. It highlights that many large state authorities have failed to conduct the required salary mappings, which is a legal obligation, and emphasizes the importance of government agencies fulfilling their legal responsibilities as models for other employers.

title: Barns medverkan i statens offentliga utredningar
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:752 av Nicklas Attefjord och Ulrika Westerlund (båda MP)
summary: The motion calls for a review of the discrimination law in Sweden, specifically addressing the disproportionately high fines that can be imposed for discrimination. The proposers argue that these fines often do not align with penalties for other types of offenses under Swedish law and suggest that the conditions and sizes of such fines should be reassessed.

title: Säkerställa att kontanter kan användas som betalningsmedel
summary: The proposal advocates for the nationalization of unemployment insurance funds (a-kassor) in Sweden, making membership compulsory for all citizens, similar to the healthcare insurance system. It argues that the current system lacks equality and efficiency, as evidenced by discrepancies in sanction rates among different funds. The motion emphasizes the need for equal treatment and security for individuals and suggests that a nationalized, obligatory system would help restore public trust and ensure everyone has access to unemployment protection, especially highlighted by the recent COVID-19 crisis.

title: Reglering av försäljningen av lustgas i berusningssyfte
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:750 av Nicklas Attefjord och Katarina Luhr (båda MP)
summary: The proposal calls for the government to develop a strategy for remote work in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. It emphasizes the benefits of increased telecommuting, including environmental advantages from reduced travel, the potential for population redistribution to rural areas, and the need for improved broadband infrastructure. The motion also suggests incentivizing companies to support remote work and highlights the importance of addressing workplace safety and equipment ownership issues.

title: Lokal ekonomi för en levande landsbygd
summary: This motion proposes the discontinuation of extra jobs, which are a government employment initiative, due to their minimal effectiveness and the potential for unfair competition with private businesses. The author argues that the program has not led to significant employment outcomes and that its continuation results in misallocation of public funds, contradicting existing regulations intended to prevent competition with private sector jobs.

title: Förbättrade förutsättningar för arbetsintegrerande sociala företag
summary: The motion proposes a pilot program in Gävleborg County for a new labor market reform involving 'mini-jobs', which would allow individuals to work part-time for modest pay. This initiative aims to address structural unemployment in Sweden, particularly among immigrants, by lowering barriers to entry into the labor market. The proposal suggests collaboration with labor market stakeholders to design and evaluate the program, with the goal of transitioning individuals from welfare dependency to employment and improving integration efforts.

title: Boplikt för att stärka landsbygden
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the National Secretariat for Gender Research in Sweden, arguing that gender research lacks scientific merit and is predominantly based on opinions and political views. The motion further suggests that government support for gender studies should be discontinued, and that any relevant gender issues should instead be addressed within existing research frameworks.

title: Yttre portar för att skydda Göteborg mot översvämningar och höjda havsnivåer
summary: The proposal seeks to abolish state funding for gender studies, arguing that the field has diverged from its original intent of promoting gender equality and has instead transformed into an isolated arena that fosters peculiar views rather than scientific inquiry. The motion suggests that relevant gender issues should be integrated into broader research disciplines instead of being treated as a separate topic, which the authors believe has led to a lack of critical scrutiny and alienation from other academic fields.

title: Reglering av spelmarknaden och ökat skydd för personer med spelberoende
summary: The motion proposes a long-term plan for tax reductions in Sweden, emphasizing the need to investigate ways to lower the tax burden on citizens. The authors argue that Sweden has one of the highest tax pressures globally and that many citizens feel they do not receive adequate services in return. The motion highlights various societal concerns such as crime, long wait times in healthcare, poor educational outcomes, and deficiencies in elder care, asserting that political priorities need to shift towards welfare, policing, and defense. The authors advocate for a structured approach that enforces annual budget reductions to align with OECD averages, thereby allowing for tax cuts and better allocation of resources.

title: Benefit corporations – eller hållbara företag till gagn för samhälle och miljö
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of replacing the current bonus-malus system with a more balanced, competitive, and fair vehicle taxation model. It argues that Sweden is over-implementing EU directives by setting stricter taxation based on WLTP values, particularly impacting motorhome owners who may face significantly higher costs. The proposal emphasizes the importance of domestic tourism and asserts that the current taxation policy unfairly penalizes certain vehicle types and threatens jobs and growth in the tourism sector.

title: Reglering och skydd av yrkestitlarna terapeut och psykolog
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:743 av Nicklas Attefjord och Amanda Lind (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government review the regulations governing authorities to ensure they focus on their core duties of exercising authority rather than engaging in political advocacy. Proponents argue that government agencies should not partake in opinion formation as it threatens their impartiality and undermines public trust.

title: Ökad kunskap om sjukdomen EDS
summary: The motion proposes to create legislation that prohibits regions and municipalities in Sweden from providing planned healthcare and welfare support to individuals who are residing in the country illegally. It argues that allowing such healthcare undermines Swedish immigration policy, highlighting that certain regions are currently offering extensive healthcare services to undocumented migrants, which the author considers inappropriate.

title: Syskon till barn med omfattande funktionsnedsättningar
summary: The motion advocates for improving winter road maintenance across Sweden to prevent serious traffic accidents caused by inadequate anti-slip measures. The proposal emphasizes the importance of state responsibility in ensuring safe road conditions year-round and highlights recent incidents, particularly on the E4 in Gävleborg, where poor winter maintenance has been linked to multiple traffic accidents and fatalities. The motion calls on the government to take decisive action to ensure effective winter road management.

title: Rätt för personer med funktionsnedsättning att få delar av studielånen avskrivna
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish parliament to consider preventing authorities from transferring roads to private individuals who oppose such transfers. It highlights the poor condition of roads in northern Sweden, as reported by the consumer organization Motormännen, and emphasizes the need for adequate road maintenance funded by the government. The proposal argues that all regions, especially rural areas, should have access to quality roads to ensure mobility and quality of life for residents.

title: Forskningen om sjukdomen ALS och patienternas rätt till assistans
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:739 av Nicklas Attefjord och Ulrika Westerlund (båda MP)
summary: Lars Beckman proposes a review of the legislation regarding street maintenance, focusing on the health risks associated with homeowners being responsible for the upkeep of public walkways. The motion highlights the varying quality of snow removal and ice prevention by homeowners, which can endanger pedestrian safety, particularly for the elderly. It cites reports indicating that poor maintenance is a leading cause of pedestrian accidents and suggests that municipalities should clarify their responsibilities to prevent safety hazards on the streets.

title: Västsverige behöver moderna järnvägar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the divestment of the state's ownership in Arento AB, a public company involved in renting out machinery, tools, and vehicles. The argument presented highlights that Arento operates in a highly competitive market alongside private companies, questioning the necessity of state involvement in such rental services. It is suggested that selling Arento would eliminate unfair competition with the private sector and align the market dynamics appropriately.

title: Fri väg för förare av utryckningsfordon
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of adequate road lighting across Sweden, particularly in rural areas where many streetlights have been turned off, leading to increased darkness and safety concerns for residents. The proposal calls for a review of the country's road lighting to ensure that residents, especially in the countryside, have well-lit roads to enhance safety and comfort.

title: En översyn av rättegångsbalkens tidsbegränsning för husrannsakan
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:736 av Martin Melin och Lina Nordquist (båda L)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers raising the maximum allowable speed on highways to 140 kilometers per hour, arguing that increased speed does not necessarily compromise safety. It references a report indicating that accidents have not increased following similar past changes in speed limits, advocating for the development of roads and higher speed limits as a part of this policy.

title: En infrastruktur för framtiden i Halland
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider changing the mandated dates for switching from winter to summer tires to better accommodate the diverse climatic conditions across the country. Currently, the law requires the change by April 15, which has led to dangerous driving conditions in certain years when late snowstorms occur. The suggestion emphasizes the need for a more flexible date, such as the end of April or even later for northern Sweden, to enhance safety and reduce pressure on tire changing services.

title: Bättre utbildning och säkerhet för A-traktorer och mopedbilar
summary: The proposal advocates for the possibility of allowing individuals with a B driver's license to operate light motorcycles in order to reduce congestion in urban areas and facilitate commuting. It suggests that improved safety measures and a new EU directive provide a timely opportunity for this change, which aligns with Sweden's broad political support for traffic safety initiatives.

title: Stockholm som försöksregion för en modern narkotikapolitik
summary: The proposal seeks to expand the E4 highway between Gävle and Söderhamn to a four-lane road, addressing ongoing traffic disruptions caused by its current two-lane configuration. This change is presented as necessary for improving traffic flow and safety for both motorists and emergency vehicles, as the existing conditions lead to significant delays and accidents.

title: Individualiserad bröstcancerscreening
summary: The motion proposes exploring the possibility of increasing the track capacity on the Gävle–Härnösand railway line to provide better transportation infrastructure, which is deemed essential for growth in Sweden. By addressing the current bottleneck of single-track dependency, the proposal aims to facilitate smoother transport for businesses and improve commuting options for residents, thereby enhancing the overall connectivity between cities and the job market in the northern region of Sweden.

title: Frihet för hbtqi-personer
summary: This proposal advocates for the dismantling of unnecessary government agencies in Sweden to ensure effective management of tax revenues and maintain welfare without raising tax rates. It suggests shrinking or completely abolishing specific bodies, including the National Secretariat for Gender Analysis and the Agency for Cultural Analysis, while emphasizing ongoing evaluation of all state agencies.

title: Dalarnas län i elprisområde 2
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to review the impact of fee increases imposed by the Livsmedelsverket (Food Agency) on small-scale food production in Sweden. It highlights the significant financial strain these increased fees have placed on local food producers, who are already operating with narrow profit margins. The motion argues that these higher fees contradict the government's official food strategy aimed at promoting local and organic food production.

title: Förbättrade förutsättningar för storskalig kärnkraft
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Tax Agency (Skatteverket) should include the employer contribution (arbetsgivaravgiften) on the annual final tax statement. The aim is to enhance transparency in the tax system by clearly outlining all taxes and fees paid by citizens, thereby fostering public understanding and legitimacy of the tax system. This measure is positioned as part of a broader tax review to ensure clarity regarding contributions to social insurance and general state revenue.

title: Återställning till de tidigare stegen i hastighetsgränserna
summary: The motion proposes to reconsider Sweden's taxation system, specifically advocating for a reduction in the second-highest marginal tax rate in the world. It argues that the high marginal tax rate disincentivizes work, career advancement, and education, and negatively impacts talent retention, which could lead to decreased economic growth and lower tax revenues in the long term.

title: Kemikalieinspektionens placering
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:727 av Robert Hannah och Helena Gellerman (båda L)
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the state monopoly held by Systembolaget on the sale of stronger alcoholic beverages in Sweden. It argues that this unique arrangement restricts individual freedoms, limits market growth, and stifles opportunities for small-scale producers in the alcohol industry. The motion advocates for a more modern and free market approach, allowing multiple sellers to operate beyond a single state-owned entity.

title: Namnändring av Göteborg-Landvetter flygplats till Landvetter Torgny Segerstedt flygplats (Airport)
summary: The proposal discusses the implementation of private health insurance options to alleviate the burden on public healthcare and improve access to medical services. It emphasizes the issue of workplace health problems, particularly attributed to public employers, and suggests that allowing tax deductions for expenses related to private health insurance would incentivize more employers to provide these options. The motion argues that increasing the uptake of private health insurance would ultimately benefit the public healthcare system by reducing wait times.

title: Utomrättsliga kvinnoförnedrande eller hedersrelaterade rättegångar och avtal
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should develop the travel deduction system to support commuting and enhance job opportunities across the country. It argues that the current travel deduction is essential for the economy, especially for households that depend on it for their daily travel expenses. The motion criticizes a recent recommendation by the Travel Deduction Committee to abolish the existing system and replace it with a distance-based reduction, which could negatively affect up to 300,000 individuals, particularly those in rural areas who have limited public transport options. The author advocates for reinvesting in the travel deduction to reflect the true costs of modern commuting.

title: Vitbok om svenska samhällets brott mot hbt-personer
summary: Lars Beckman proposes that the Swedish government instruct relevant authorities to take necessary actions to reduce the wolf population in Sweden, emphasizing the urgent need for action to protect livestock and allow people to live and work in rural areas. He criticizes the current policies for inadequately managing the wolf population and argues that the state must ensure a balance between human interests and wildlife conservation, prioritizing human safety and livelihoods over that of wolves.

title: Avskaffade spärrar för personval
summary: The proposal emphasizes the significance of foreign-born entrepreneurs in Sweden, particularly in creating jobs and facilitating integration through small businesses. It highlights the need for better support systems, including language education, financing assistance, and information access, to make it easier for foreign-born individuals to establish and run businesses. The motion calls for governmental recognition of these entrepreneurs and the implementation of measures to streamline the process of entrepreneurship for immigrants.

title: Ökad tillgänglighet för assistans- och ledarhundsförare
summary: Lars Beckman proposes that the Riksdag, government, and state authorities should implement comprehensive tax reporting on pay slips, displaying the full tax burden including employer contributions, to enhance public understanding of taxes paid by employers, which are often not visible in individual pay slips.

title: Digitalt bank-id för personer med funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the modernization, simplification, and improvement of the regulations regarding voluntary tax liability for commercial property rental (hyresmomsen). It highlights the existing barriers that prevent organizations and privately operated services from accessing premises, resulting in vacant properties. The current regulations are deemed outdated and overly complex, especially exposed during the pandemic when properties were repurposed for urgent needs. The motion advocates for expanding the voluntary hyresmoms options, which could ease the regulatory burden and broaden the tax base without additional costs to the municipal budget.

title: Skinn till jägare och samebyar vid skyddsjakt
summary: The proposal calls for urgent action to address the issue of approximately 23,000 toxic barrels dumped at sea between Sundsvall and Gotland, which contain mercury-laden catalyst mass. The barrels were disposed of in the 1950s and 1960s, with significant portions found to be dissolving, posing an environmental risk as it is estimated that around 10 tons of mercury may be released into the Baltic Sea. The motion emphasizes the need for the government to take responsibility for the cleanup and management of these hazardous materials.

title: Statens ansvar för rovdjursskador
summary: The motion proposes that the government should ensure fair legislation so that a previous car owner is not held financially responsible for a climate bonus if their vehicle is exported. The current proposal from the Ministry of Environment suggests that the purchaser of a climate bonus car would be liable for the bonus for up to five years after sale if the car is de-registered and exported, which could deter potential buyers due to financial uncertainties. The motion suggests instead a yearly decreasing bonus payment to provide transparency and maintain incentives for keeping the vehicles in Sweden.

title: Omedelbart omhändertagande av djur i vissa situationer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament sets concrete goals to significantly reduce regulatory burdens annually. It argues that a thriving business environment leads to increased resources for public welfare and crucial services. The motion highlights that small and medium-sized enterprises create four out of five jobs in Sweden, significantly contributing to municipal tax revenues. It points out that the regulatory burden has increased dramatically over time, adversely affecting business competitiveness and leads to a lack of trust in government efforts to streamline regulations.

title: Delårsskatt vid säsongsboende
summary: Lars Beckman proposes that the Swedish parliament recognize the importance of hydropower and encourage the government to ensure that more of the economic benefits from these resources remain in Northern Sweden. He advocates for the relocation of Vattenfall's headquarters outside Stockholm to enhance regional development and suggests that a portion of the profits from hydropower should be utilized to foster entrepreneurship and infrastructure improvements in the local regions, emphasizing the need for a fair distribution of resources generated in Northern Sweden.

title: Förbättrade villkor för cirkulär ekonomi och återbruk
summary: The motion addresses concerns about unhealthy competition arising from state-run entities that compete with private businesses in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of private companies and their contributions to social welfare, including funding public services such as schools and healthcare. The proposal calls for the government to reassess its role in markets, particularly in overseeing and potentially divesting state operations that disrupt fair competition, exemplified by state-funded veterinary clinics competing with private practices. The motion advocates for separating the state's regulatory responsibilities from commercial activities.

title: Fler cykelvägar i anslutning till järnvägsspår
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should instruct the National Board of Housing, Building and Planning (Boverket) to investigate changes to the Planning and Building Act, allowing older detailed plans to have a different legal status. This would enable greater flexibility in building permits and facilitate more construction by addressing outdated regulations that hinder development and utilizing building rights that are currently ignored due to outmoded plans.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support the development of Dalhalla as a national summer stage for the Royal Opera, aiming to promote the spread of opera across the country and enhance access to cultural experiences for all citizens. The proponents emphasize the importance of culture in society, the need for a new model of national cultural policy that includes regional participation, and the potential benefits of leveraging Dalhalla's unique venue to attract talent and boost tourism.

title: Fler Öresundsförbindelser
summary: The motion proposes a change to the Swedish Parenthood Act to allow children to have more than two legal parents, recognizing the evolving nature of families, especially for many LGBTQ parents. It argues that current legislation does not reflect the reality of modern family structures, where children may have multiple adults who play significant roles in their upbringing. The proposal highlights the importance of establishing clearer legal recognition of these relationships to provide stability and predictability for both children and their caregivers.

title: Nationell strategi mot stranderosion
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of allowing grocery stores to sell alcoholic beverages with an alcohol content of up to 5.5% and enabling small breweries to sell their craft beers, drawing inspiration from Finland's recent reforms. These changes aim to promote consumer freedom, create better conditions for private retailers, and support small producers while maintaining a state alcohol monopoly. The motion highlights the benefits seen in Finland following similar adjustments and advocates for a similar approach in Sweden to enhance market dynamics and individual liberties.

title: Konkurrenskraftiga villkor för svensk turistnäring
summary: The proposal advocates for the right to vote in general elections to be granted to all individuals who turn 18 during the calendar year of the election, rather than requiring them to be 18 on election day. The motion cites research indicating that 18-year-olds typically have higher voter turnout rates due to being in school, where they learn about democracy and elections, and argues that aligning voting rights with the birth year cohort would promote greater democratic participation.

title: Underlätta steget att starta nytt företag
summary: The proposal aims to establish a rural Attefalls reform by increasing the tax-exempt allowance for rental income to facilitate the construction of new housing in rural areas, addressing the acute housing shortage faced in many municipalities. The motion emphasizes the need for regulatory changes to convert unused agricultural buildings into residential units, thus promoting a more efficient use of existing structures. It highlights the growing trend of moving to the countryside, worsened by the pandemic, and argues that new rental apartments are essential for the local population.

title: Effektivare handläggning av bilstödet för anpassning av fordon
summary: The motion from Lars Thomsson proposes the establishment of a fully green flight route between Visby and Bromma, aimed at utilizing biofuels and electric aircraft. It also suggests earmarking the flight tax revenue to cover the extra costs associated with biofuels. This initiative comes in response to the pandemic's impact on the aviation industry and aims to address increasing demands for climate-friendly travel solutions, as well as supporting the growing population of Gotland.

title: Digital plattform för gymnasieskolan
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a general hunting season for the cormorant in Sweden due to its increasing population, which negatively impacts fish stocks, recreational areas, and local ecosystems. The authors argue that the unregulated growth of the cormorant population poses a threat to local fisheries and an affront to those undertaking conservation efforts for fish species such as pike and perch. They believe that implementing a general hunting season is necessary to restore confidence in hunting regulations and address the adverse effects caused by the cormorant's proliferation.

title: Skilda valdagar
summary: The proposal advocates for a swift adjustment of regulations concerning land drainage in Sweden to address the acute issues of drought and water scarcity, particularly in southeastern regions where the climate is becoming drier. It highlights the need for greater regional flexibility in managing water resources while balancing the risks of floods and droughts. The motion calls for the establishment of both temporary and long-term water retention measures, emphasizing the challenges posed by current legislation that predominantly focuses on drainage and fails to accommodate necessary water conservation practices.

title: Stasiarkiv
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should support the installation of pornographic filters on all public computers, tablets, and networks in preschools and schools to protect children from exposure to violent pornographic content. It argues that current measures are insufficient, as children are increasingly encountering pornography online, often without parental control. The motion emphasizes the need for equality in sexual education and aims to provide a safer environment for children by filtering out harmful content while allowing access to necessary educational materials.

title: Reformering av utnämningsmakten
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should increase its climate aid in international negotiations and improve support for rural development with a focus on gender equality and women's entrepreneurship. It emphasizes the differentiated impact of climate change on men and women, particularly how impoverished women and children are at risk of becoming climate refugees. The motion argues for equal rights and access to resources for women in agriculture and suggests that increased climate funding and land ownership rights for women would significantly reduce hunger and improve food security. It also highlights the link between inequality and conflict, proposing that Sweden should advocate for these issues on an international level.

title: Namnbyte på särskilda operationsgruppen till drabantkåren
summary: The proposal advocates for the promotion of a diverse cultural life across Sweden, emphasizing the importance of integrating new digital cultural expressions alongside traditional forms. It calls for an investigation into the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on cultural sectors, better accessibility, decentralization of cultural policies, and improved funding sources for creative industries. Additionally, it proposes the establishment of a national culture capital year and emphasizes the need for greater international cultural exchange and protection of artistic freedom.

title: Bättre rehabilitering för långtidssjuka
summary: This motion proposes to equalize the treatment of the equestrian industry with other agricultural activities in Sweden by ensuring that horse-related operations receive similar support and rights under existing laws. It suggests reviewing compensation and farm support, adapting legislation regarding fencing and construction for horses, and improving the legal recognition of horse businesses. Additionally, the motion advocates for better management practices for horse welfare and to assess horse trading under consumer protection laws to ensure live animals are treated fairly in transactions.

title: Utbildning och omställning för fler
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the regulations governing the staffing of smaller commercial vessels in Sweden, including expanding the definition of 'internal waters' and allowing the foreign qualification 'Master of Yachts' for use on Swedish-flagged boats. Additionally, it suggests updating the definition of the smallest professional vessels from the outdated concept of tonnage to a length of 24 meters, aiming to facilitate effective maritime operations and align with international standards.

title: Infrastruktur i Jönköpings län
summary: The proposal suggests that the maximum allowed speed for motor vehicles equipped with a braked trailer should be increased to 90 km/h on motorways and highways. The motion argues that the current speed limit of 80 km/h creates traffic issues and safety risks, particularly during the summer when caravan traffic increases. By aligning the speed limits for cars towing trailers with those for heavy trucks, the proposal aims to improve traffic flow, reduce overtaking situations, and enhance road safety.

title: Jönköping University som universitet
summary: This motion proposes to investigate the conditions under which languages other than Swedish can be used in government operations. It highlights that many residents and officials are fluent in multiple languages, and allowing communication in a shared language could reduce misunderstandings and inefficiencies that arise from mandatory interpretation. It suggests that if both the government official and the individual involved prefer to communicate in a language they both understand, this should be permitted during official procedures.

title: Vinstjakten i skolan
summary: The proposal aims to facilitate the return to work for long-term sick leave individuals by recommending the government to investigate the development of a special high-risk protection and to remove the 25% step in sick leave for a more flexible system. It emphasizes the importance of allowing employees to plan their working hours in collaboration with their workplace, based on their capabilities and the nature of the job, to enhance the chances of successful reintegration into the workforce.

title: Byggandet av nya stambanor
summary: The motion proposes several revisions to family law in Sweden, aiming to establish a more modern and equitable legal framework for cohabiting couples and families. Key proposals include allowing common residences to be classified as joint property, eliminating divorce application fees, creating a voluntary registry for future authorizations, and reviewing parental status regulations for non-traditional family structures. The motion also seeks to enhance the rights of adopted children and ensure that children's welfare is prioritized in custody cases, as well as improve the processes related to social services and support for families.

title: Förstärkt skydd av Vätterns vatten
summary: The motion proposes to increase the operational subsidies for municipal airports that have state-contracted air traffic, highlighting the financial struggles these airports face in maintaining operations due to decreased subsidies, rising costs, and limited passenger numbers. The authors argue that many local municipalities cannot bear the financial burden and risk closing their airports, which are crucial for transportation accessibility, especially in less populated regions.

title: Äldreomsorgen
summary: This motion proposes a series of measures aimed at improving the treatment and safety of motorcyclists in Sweden. It calls for a clarification of the principle of equal treatment in regulations affecting road maintenance and development, an investigation into liability legislation concerning motorcyclist safety, and the establishment of clearer oversight for personal safety equipment. Additionally, it suggests that motorcycle use should be promoted, including allowing motorcyclists to use bus lanes and relaxing restrictions on certain two-wheeled vehicles to be driven with standard car licenses. The motion highlights the need for better safety measures and accountability to reduce risks for motorcyclists while encouraging their integration into the traffic system.

title: Förstärkning av kvinnojourerna
summary: The motion proposes extending the storage time for frozen embryos resulting from IVF treatments, currently limited to five years, to allow individuals more time to potentially use these embryos without needing to undergo new IVF procedures. This change is suggested based on advancements in medical technology and findings from various reports recommending a reassessment of the existing time limit.

title: Omlokalisering av myndigheter
summary: The motion presents a comprehensive proposal to enhance Sweden's migration policy, emphasizing the importance of adhering to democratic principles and human rights during EU agreements with third countries. It advocates for an increase in the number of quota refugees, a review of social security qualifications for refugees, a new EU migration pact ensuring shared responsibility among member states, consistent asylum processing, and measures to improve the asylum process's legality and efficiency. Furthermore, it addresses issues related to family reunification, competency expatriations, and the prevention of abuse within labor migration, ultimately aiming for a humane and orderly migration framework.

title: Musikskola
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should consider changing the taxation framework for microbreweries to better support small-scale food and beverage production. It argues that current market conditions and tax structures disadvantage smaller brewers compared to larger ones, leading to limited market share and growth potential. The motion advocates for the introduction of a differentiated alcohol tax similar to models used in other EU countries to enhance competitiveness and support small businesses, especially in rural areas.

title: Arbetsmiljöarbete
summary: The motion addresses the critical issue of violence in intimate relationships, proposing a series of measures aimed at improving law enforcement responses, increasing the conviction rates of such crimes, and enhancing support for victims. Key proposals include increasing minimum and maximum prison sentences for severe offenses, ensuring nationwide access to specialist investigators, improving training for professionals interacting with victims, and establishing protective measures for those reporting abuse. The motion emphasizes the need for urgent and comprehensive action to tackle this serious societal problem, particularly highlighting the impacts of the recent COVID-19 pandemic on the prevalence of such violence.

title: Jämställt ekonomiskt bistånd
summary: The motion proposes several measures aimed at strengthening the independence and access to journalism in Sweden. It calls for oversight on foreign investments in Swedish media, enhanced support for journalists facing threats and harassment, public funding for security measures for small media companies, and better distribution of postal services for newspapers to ensure local news access. It emphasizes the vital role of public service media and advocates for its independence from political influence while ensuring greater availability of its content for public use.

title: Forskning om kvinnors hälsa
summary: The proposal calls for a comprehensive review of the social work education system in Sweden to ensure that social services staff have the necessary qualifications and training to provide fair and effective services. It emphasizes the need for specialization within the socionom education, regular training opportunities, and an evaluation of the requirements for decision-making roles within social services. The motion also suggests the establishment of clearer guidelines for child welfare decisions, the creation of a national register for foster homes, and the enhancement of collaboration between various care providers to improve the support for children in government care.

title: Nationellt inflytanderåd för barn och unga
summary: The motion proposes several reforms aimed at strengthening Sweden's economy by improving the conditions for small businesses and entrepreneurs. Key proposals include reducing taxes on job creation and entrepreneurship, simplifying ownership regulations, facilitating access to deductions for wellness expenses, and enhancing job incentives. Additionally, it suggests streamlining permit processes, increasing funding for research and development, promoting open data, and ensuring public procurement supports open-source solutions. The motion also addresses climate goals and encourages sustainable practices in business, while aiming to bolster competition and reduce bureaucratic hurdles.

title: Reformering av sjukvårdssystemets finansiering
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen public health in Sweden from childhood through old age by enhancing school health services with more competencies, incorporating health education into training programs for school principals, clarifying the responsibilities of school leaders regarding student health and physical activity, and increasing physical activity during the school day. It also seeks improved preventive measures against childhood obesity, equitable access to health services for youth, national guidelines for managing lifestyle diseases, and better access to vaccination and screening for older adults, as well as initiatives for mental health support and community health improvement.

title: Norrtälje en del av Stockholmsregionen
summary: This motion aims to strengthen and protect liberal democracy in Sweden through a series of proposals that include establishing advanced public leadership training, enhancing judicial independence, supporting the role of opposition in legislation, and addressing issues related to media freedoms, discrimination, and civil society organizations. Specific suggestions include improving safety for journalists, updating laws concerning party financing, formalizing practices in the parliament, and tackling hate crimes. The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining democratic values in the face of rising authoritarianism and other contemporary threats.

title: Statligt helhetsansvar för kompetensförsörjningen inom energibranschen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament advocate for the expedited completion of the double-track expansion of the West Coast Railway between Gothenburg and Malmö. The existing single-track limits the number of trains and therefore passenger capacity, while the full expansion is expected to significantly increase train frequency, leading to shorter travel times, improved punctuality, and enhanced accessibility. This development is seen as essential for regional growth, public transport efficiency, and reducing environmental impact by shifting freight from roads to rail.

title: En skola fri från avgifter
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:685 av Mattias Vepsä och Yasmine Bladelius (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for the continuation of efforts to establish a fixed connection between Helsingborg and Helsingör to enhance the integration and growth of the Öresund region, which has a significant population and economic impact. The proposal highlights the need for improved infrastructure to alleviate traffic congestion, increase labor market integration, and boost access to education and tourism. The authors argue that the project can be self-financed through user fees and is crucial for the region's future and competitive strength.

title: En jämlik skola för alla
