Separate election days are believed to provide voters with better opportunities to engage with relevant local issues, ultimately enhancing the quality of democratic debate.

title: Transparens och rättssäkerhet vid tjänstetillsättningar i kommuner och regioner
summary: Stefan Olsson (M) proposes changes to the transparency and legal certainty of appointments in municipalities and regions, advocating for amendments to the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act. The motion highlights the current lack of transparency in the hiring processes of senior officials, particularly those involving recruitment firms, which are not subject to public disclosure. This proposal suggests allowing certain documents to be withheld to improve fairness and encourage high-quality candidates to apply without jeopardizing their current job positions.

title: Småskalig livsmedels- och djurproduktion
summary: Jan Ericson's motion advocates for the Swedish parliament to examine how regulations can be simplified to support small-scale food and animal production. The motion highlights the challenges faced by smaller agricultural units due to bureaucratic rules, energy costs, and licensing fees, which favor larger operations. It argues that promoting small-scale farming could be more environmentally sustainable, better for animal welfare, and beneficial for national preparedness, while also preserving the landscape.

title: Minskning av Trafikverkets makt över kommunernas planarbete
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider reducing the authority of the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) over municipal planning processes. It argues that Trafikverket imposes unreasonable and costly requirements on municipalities, which hinder their ability to develop new housing areas, especially in rural and smaller towns. The motion emphasizes that individuals should have the freedom to settle in smaller towns without being dependent on public transport or extensive infrastructure for walking and cycling. It advocates for municipalities to manage planning in collaboration with local residents.

title: Samordning av villkor för statsråd och riksdagsledamöter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the potential for harmonizing the rights and benefits of government ministers and members of parliament, as they currently have different regulations regarding income guarantees and housing. The aim is to create a smoother transition between the roles of members of parliament and government ministers by establishing more consistent rules around pensions, housing allowances, and income guarantees.

title: Det rullande kulturarvet
summary: The motion advocates for the protection of Sweden's rolling cultural heritage, comprising various older vehicles such as cars, boats, trains, and planes, which are threatened by regulations poorly adapted to their needs. It highlights issues faced by importers and owners of vintage vehicles, including misclassification as hazardous waste by authorities and stringent requirements that hinder maintenance and restoration. The motion calls for a comprehensive review of existing regulations and encourages government collaboration with relevant organizations to create exceptions that support the preservation and showcasing of this cultural heritage.

title: Pant på batterier
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the feasibility of establishing a national deposit system for batteries in Sweden, inspired by a similar initiative in Norway. This system aims to increase the recycling rate of batteries, reduce environmental damage caused by improper disposal, and conserve valuable natural resources that are often harmful to the environment when discarded incorrectly.

title: Skydd av yttrandefriheten på sociala medier
summary: The proposal advocates for the protection of freedom of speech on social media platforms, emphasizing the need for fair practices that prevent arbitrary account suspensions and provide users with a mechanism to challenge such actions. The motion highlights the risks of political bias in content moderation and the importance of ensuring that users can easily report issues related to infringement on their rights, while also calling for clear contact points within social media organizations to resolve disputes and maintain transparency.

title: Skärpta straff för miljö- och klimatrelaterad kriminalitet
summary: The motion proposes an examination of the penalties for environmental and climate-related crimes in Sweden, highlighting recent actions by climate activists that have posed risks to public safety and caused damage to society. It argues that the current sentences for these crimes are disproportionately lenient compared to the harm and risks they pose, suggesting that these penalties should be increased.

title: Nationell folkräkning och biometriska id-handlingar
summary: The motion proposes a national census and the implementation of biometric identification to address issues related to individuals holding multiple identities who exploit social benefits and engage in fraudulent activities. It highlights the inadequacies in current identification systems and calls for mandatory personal verification of identity for individuals receiving benefits, suggesting that those who fail to comply would have their benefits revoked.

title: Tillträde för personer med assistanshund
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes that individuals who rely on assistance dogs should receive stronger legal protections in Sweden. Currently, while assistance dogs are accepted in many public places, there are inconsistencies that can lead to discrimination against their handlers. The motion advocates for the establishment of clear legislation similar to that in Norway, ensuring that individuals with assistance dogs can access public areas without fear of exclusion.

title: Tekniska specifikationer för småhus
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament consider making technical specifications for small houses nationally valid after approval from any chosen municipality. It argues that the current process requires extensive review by municipal officials for each building permit, even for identical houses previously approved by other municipalities. Implementing a licensing system would streamline approvals and reduce costs for both builders and customers by eliminating redundant paperwork and allowing a lower building permit fee for licensed constructions.

title: Avskaffa tvånget att anlita kontrollansvarig vid uppförande av småhus
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the requirement for hiring a responsible inspector during the construction of single-family houses, arguing that the current obligation contributes to unnecessary bureaucracy and costs that hinder the building of new homes. The motion emphasizes the idea that hiring such assistance should be voluntary and not mandatory, comparing it to voluntary hiring of a final inspector.

title: Den svenska krisberedskapen
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to review and strengthen Sweden's crisis preparedness in light of recent events such as the COVID-19 pandemic and geopolitical tensions, particularly Russia's actions in Ukraine. It highlights existing gaps in the country’s ability to provide essential resources like food, fuel, and medical supplies during a crisis. The motion calls for robust reserve systems and production capacities, along with appropriate contingency plans from governmental bodies, municipalities, and regions to enhance national resilience against future crises.

title: Dolda hyresavgifter
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:287 av Gustaf Göthberg och Marie-Louise Hänel Sandström (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to improve transparency regarding hidden rental fees paid by tenants to the Tenant Association in Sweden. It advocates for a review and modernization of the Swedish rent regulation system, suggesting that the contribution to the Tenant Association should be separated from the rent and managed through direct payments, without the landlord acting as an intermediary. The signatories argue that the current system erodes trust between parties in the housing market and emphasize the need for alternative financing methods for rent negotiations.

title: Insyn i barns läkemedelslista
summary: The proposal suggests increasing the age limit for a child's own responsibility regarding their medication list to 18 years. Currently, after turning 13, parents lose digital access to their child's medication details due to a new interpretation of the law. The motion argues that parents should continue to oversee their children's medications to ensure proper treatment and minimize risks, especially for younger children who may struggle to manage their prescriptions effectively. The motion asserts that parental involvement is crucial until the child reaches the age of majority.

title: Upphandling av kollektivtrafik
summary: The proposal by Mirja Räihä emphasizes the importance of establishing procurement requirements for public transport to protect the job security and working conditions of employees. It advocates for mandates that ensure personnel can transfer to new employers without facing worse employment terms and calls for compliance with collective agreements. Additionally, it highlights the need for regulatory authorities to require whistleblower protections to improve safety and operational quality in the public transport sector.

title: Hållbar energiförsörjning
summary: Hanna Westerén's motion emphasizes the need for ensuring a sustainable electricity supply in Sweden, particularly focusing on the establishment of a third power cable to Gotland. The proposal advocates for creating a secure and resilient energy infrastructure to support renewable energy sources, enhance job opportunities, and contribute to ecological sustainability and local economic growth. It highlights previous government initiatives aimed at making Gotland a model for a fully renewable energy system and underscores the importance of addressing energy supply security for both local businesses and the national interest.

title: Rätten till modersmålsundervisning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should ensure the right to mother tongue instruction for all children. It highlights concerns regarding the existing framework where such instruction is minimal and often deemed detrimental to integration and Swedish language development. The author argues that mother tongue education, often reduced to just one hour per week, is beneficial for language development and should be recognized and supported as an essential part of the educational curriculum.

title: Åtgärder för ett långsiktigt hållbart fiske i Östersjön och Bottniska viken
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:282 av Peder Björk och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to consider additional measures for sustainable fishing and improved marine environments in the Baltic Sea and Gulf of Bothnia. It highlights the importance of sprat for the ecosystem, Swedish fisheries, and coastal communities, and emphasizes the need for Sweden to continue advocating for healthy seas and sustainable fishing quotas within the EU. The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining fish populations, vibrant waters, and thriving coastal communities for future generations.

title: Nämndemännens villkor
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:281 av Peter Hedberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the working conditions and compensation for jurors in Sweden, emphasizing the need to attract younger individuals to the role and to ensure fair remuneration that reflects inflation and the general wage development. It highlights concerns regarding safety, given the increasing criminality, and calls for enhanced support and security measures for jurors. The aim is to strengthen public trust in the judiciary and maintain a democratic society.

title: Hjulstabron
summary: The proposal advocates for the review and completion of the new Hjulstabron bridge to enhance transportation efficiency in the Stockholm-Mälarregion, which is experiencing rapid growth. It emphasizes the need for improved infrastructure to facilitate the transfer of goods from road to water transport, ensuring competitive neutrality among different transport systems and addressing the existing disadvantages faced by inland shipping. The completion of Hjulstabron is positioned as critical for maximizing the effectiveness of significant investments made in the region's logistics and transport capabilities.

title: Renhållningsavgift
summary: In this motion, Åsa Eriksson proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the current regulations concerning waste fees, following reports from Västmanland where property owners of uninhabitable houses are being charged double waste fees despite not generating waste. The motion argues that this situation discourages the preservation of culturally significant buildings and threatens the social fabric of rural communities. The proposal includes suggestions for legislative changes to exempt these properties from waste fees to support the maintenance of older structures.

title: Avskaffande av fideikommiss
summary: The motion proposes the complete abolition of the fideikommiss system in Sweden, which currently allows for exceptions that enable discrimination against women in matters of inheritance. The motion's author argues that the system is outdated, rooted in feudal traditions, and contrary to modern values of equality. Pettersson emphasizes that preserving cultural heritage should not come at the cost of perpetuating discriminatory practices, advocating for a definitive end to the system without any exceptions.

title: Ersättning vid jobbpendling
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:277 av Isak From och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to introduce a distance-based tax reduction for work-related travel that is neutral concerning the mode of transport used. This aims to alleviate the financial burdens of commuting, particularly for workers in rural areas adversely affected by rising fuel prices and limited public transport options. The proposal highlights the need for a revised tax deduction system that is fairer and more environmentally considerate, as well as addressing disparities between urban and rural commuters.

title: Klövviltsförvaltning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:276 av Isak From och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests the joint management of all wild ungulates in Sweden, recommending equal representation of hunters and landowners in decision-making bodies, with the appointment of an independent chairperson. The authors advocate for sustainable management practices that account for ecological conditions and the importance of a balanced elk population to minimize damage to forestry while also ensuring the preservation of elk as a national symbol and resource.

title: Demokratiutveckling och fattigdomsbekämpning
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:275 av Björn Wiechel och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to strengthen its commitment to democracy development and poverty alleviation through support for international efforts, contributing to organizations fighting for democracy and providing resources and knowledge to combat poverty. It emphasizes Sweden's historical role in promoting peace and democratic values globally through trade, aid, and foreign policy.

title: Onlineplattformar och det straffrättsliga regelverket
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the criminal law framework governing global online platforms due to the challenges they pose to democracy, including misinformation, cyber threats, and hate speech. It emphasizes the need for platforms to be held accountable while ensuring that regulations do not infringe on freedom of expression. The motion suggests that online platforms should inform users about data usage, notify them when illegal content is removed, and align with national criminal regulations.

title: Stoppa vinstuttaget ur svensk skola
summary: The motion proposes to regulate and prevent profit extraction from Swedish schools, arguing that the current system has exacerbated inequality and undermined the quality of education. It highlights the growth of profit-driven private schools, the substantial profits they generate, and the adverse effects this model has had on equal educational opportunities. The motion calls for a review of the governing frameworks that allow such practices and aims to promote a more equitable school system.

title: Avdragsrätt för fackligt medlemskap
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:272 av Leif Nysmed och Lars Mejern Larsson (båda S)
summary: This proposal suggests the reintroduction of tax deductions for membership in trade unions, which were previously abolished in 2007 and have fluctuated since then. The motion emphasizes the importance of a strong labor market model and aims to create economic incentives for union membership, thereby fostering equality among labor market parties.

title: Stärkning av folkbildningen
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the role of folkbildning (popular education) in Sweden, emphasizing its importance to civil society and the knowledge economy. It highlights the challenges faced by folkbildning, particularly in terms of funding, exacerbated by the pandemic's impact. The motion calls for increased government funding, more educational opportunities, and support for folk high school teachers and pedagogies, asserting that folkbildning should be seen as essential for lifelong learning for all.

title: Utökade möjligheter för polisen att eftersöka personer
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:270 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament grant the police extended powers to conduct secret surveillance in order to locate individuals who do not appear for the enforcement of their prison sentences. It addresses a legislative gap that prevents police from pursuing convicted individuals who have not committed new crimes but have evaded justice. The motion highlights a specific incident where this limitation hindered law enforcement and calls for measures to improve the police's ability to locate wanted individuals, including the use of real-time tracking and cooperation with other countries.

title: Förbättrat regelverk för att underlätta för barnfamiljer
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:269 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to review the possibility of providing compensation for parents who need to accompany children under 18 years old to dental and medical appointments. The authors argue that the current legislation, which has remained largely unchanged for 40 years, does not adequately address the challenges families face in balancing work and family life, especially in rural areas where access to healthcare providers is limited. The motion advocates for modernizing the temporary parental allowance system to support families more effectively.

title: Regelverk för epatraktorer
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:268 av Malin Larsson och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the regulations governing A-tractors (epatraktorer), highlighting their importance for rural youth mobility while addressing safety concerns due to rising accident rates. It suggests raising the maximum allowed speed of A-tractors to match that of certain mopeds, implementing seatbelt requirements, preventing speed modifications, and reevaluating penalties for violations, particularly for young drivers and their guardians.

title: Campusförlagda utbildningsplatser på Mittuniversitetet i Sundsvall
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:267 av Peder Björk och Malin Larsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the development of campus-based educational spaces at Mittuniversitetet in Sundsvall to enhance educational opportunities and retain students in the region. It emphasizes the importance of education and research for Sweden's growth and competitive edge, calling for increased investment in higher education to ensure that all youth, regardless of background, have the opportunity to pursue university studies locally. The initiative aims to address future workforce needs, particularly in welfare and green industry sectors, and reinforces the significance of lifelong learning.

title: Stärkt försvarsförmåga i Västernorrland
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:266 av Peter Hedberg och Malin Larsson (båda S)
summary: This motion advocates for strengthening the total defense capabilities in Västernorrland, highlighting its strategic importance in the context of deteriorating security conditions in Europe, particularly due to Russian actions. It calls for the government to ensure the continued development and competency of the I 21 regiment, utilize nearby maritime resources, activate civil conscription, and provide qualified training to support critical societal functions during crises. The motion emphasizes Västernorrland's potential contributions to Sweden's total defense, particularly in the civilian sector.

title: Kulturskolan
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider regulating cultural schools (kulturskolan) by law to ensure equal access for all children, regardless of their socioeconomic status. It highlights the importance of cultural education for children's health and development and notes the disparities in availability and fees across different municipalities. The motion advocates for establishing standards and goals for cultural schools, including teacher qualifications, to enhance the quality and accessibility of cultural education across the country.

title: Säkerställande av rätten till arbetshjälpmedel
summary: This motion emphasizes the need to ensure the right to work-related assistive devices for individuals with disabilities, highlighting that such support is crucial for their equal opportunities in the labor market. It discusses difficulties encountered following a court ruling in 2018 that has made it harder for individuals to obtain funding for assistive devices. The motion calls on the government to review the implications of this ruling and consider potential legislative changes to facilitate access to these essential aids.

title: Organiserad rastverksamhet i skolan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should endorse the implementation of a national initiative to promote organized recess activities in schools. It highlights the growing importance of well-planned breaks for children's health and well-being, pointing out that organized recess can lead to improved social interactions and reduce bullying. The motion calls for a coordinated national effort to establish organized recess activities, including appointing a national recess coordinator and providing resources to municipalities for planning these activities.

title: Ökade möjligheter för kommunerna att bidra i det myndighetsgemensamma arbetet mot organiserad välfärdsbrottslighet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:262 av Ingela Nylund Watz och Anna Vikström (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the municipalities' role in combating organized crime targeting publicly funded services, emphasizing the need for increased collaboration between authorities. It highlights the growing issue of welfare fraud and emphasizes that organized crime has exploited gaps in the welfare system, creating a significant challenge. The motion calls for a focus on enabling greater information sharing and cooperation among municipal and state authorities to effectively prevent and address these crimes.

title: Föräldrapenning för tvillingföräldrar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament review and improve the parental insurance conditions for parents of twins. It highlights the challenges faced by twin parents during parental leave and argues that their current benefits, which total 480 days plus an additional 180 days (of which only 90 are at the sickness benefit level), are insufficient to support the care of two newborns. The motion advocates for more days of parental leave at the sickness benefit level and the possibility to transfer parental benefits to third parties to better accommodate different family structures.

title: Politiska vildar
summary: The motion proposes a review of the municipal law to address the issue of elected representatives who switch parties and continue to serve as political independents, which can disrupt the influence of their original parties in local governance. It suggests that parties should have significant control over the resignation process of representatives who change affiliation during their term.

title: Reserverat barnbidrag vid vårdnadstvister
summary: The suggestion proposes reserving child allowances in cases of custody disputes between parents. It aims to ensure that both parents have access to financial support for child-related expenses during the dispute period. Under the proposal, half of the allowance would be reserved until the custody decision is made. If the mother retains sole custody, the reserved funds would be returned; otherwise, they would be disbursed to the father if he gains custody.

title: Järnvägsförbindelse mellan Helsingborg och Linköping via Jönköping
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:258 av Mikael Eskilandersson och Angelica Lundberg (båda SD)
summary: The proposal calls for the planning and construction of a new railway line connecting Helsingborg and Linköping via Jönköping, addressing the current lack of direct railway access for several towns along the E4 in southern Sweden. The authors argue that improved railway infrastructure is essential for enhancing competitiveness in the global economy, facilitating attractive freight and passenger transport, and aiding regional connectivity for commuting and business operations. The motion emphasizes the need for prioritizing this project in future infrastructure plans.

title: Nya bestämmelser gällande däck
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a ban on the use of studless friction tires during summer months and calls for an investigation into the implementation of an age limit for vehicle tires. It argues that friction tires, often misclassified as all-season tires, pose significant safety risks when used in summer conditions due to decreased grip and increased stopping distances, resulting in a higher risk of accidents. The motion emphasizes the importance of proper tire regulations to enhance road safety and suggests that a tire's age should also be considered in safety assessments.

title: Järnvägsförbindelse mellan Jönköping och Göteborg
summary: The motion proposes the planning of a new railway connection between Jönköping and Göteborg to enhance competitive conditions for goods and passenger transport. It highlights the absence of a direct railway route along the existing road between these locations, which necessitates longer travel times and inconvenient transfers. The proposal emphasizes the potential benefits for commuting and labor supply, particularly for the industrial needs of Jönköping, and calls for prioritizing this railway extension in future infrastructure plans.

title: Ohälsosamma livsmedels påverkan på folkhälsan
summary: The proposal from Angelica Lundberg of the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the need to reduce the consumption of unhealthy foods to improve public health in Sweden. It highlights the rising rates of diseases such as obesity, diabetes, and mental health issues among children and adolescents, advocating for a government initiative to promote healthier dietary choices and make nutritious foods more accessible and affordable compared to unhealthy options.

title: Motverkande av ungas tobaksrökning
summary: The motion proposes gradually raising the legal age for purchasing cigarettes to prevent youth smoking. It suggests making it illegal to buy, sell, or give cigarettes to individuals under the new age limit, similar to current alcohol regulations. The motivation emphasizes the health hazards of smoking, the impact on public health, and the need to reduce tobacco consumption among younger generations to aim for a 'non-smoking generation'.

title: Höjd åldersgräns för könsbyte
summary: The proposal suggests raising the legal age for gender transition from 18 to 25 years. It argues that individuals under 25 lack the necessary emotional and intellectual maturity to make irreversible decisions regarding their gender identity. The motion cites an increase in young girls seeking gender transition and reports of regret and mental health issues following such procedures. It emphasizes the need for a thorough understanding of the consequences before undergoing such significant changes and calls for expanded mental health support for young people.

title: Utredning av möjligheten att avskaffa plastpåseskatten
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of abolishing the plastic bag tax, which was introduced in 2020 as part of a coalition agreement. The tax has faced significant criticism for being ineffective in reducing waste and for disproportionately affecting eco-friendly alternatives, while allowing other non-recyclable plastic bags to remain tax-exempt. Proponents argue that the negative environmental impact and economic consequences of the tax, including job losses and increased emissions due to heavier paper bags, warrant its removal.

title: Ökat antal dubbeldagar i föräldraförsäkringen
summary: The suggestion advocates for increasing the number of 'dubbeldagar' or dual days in parental leave, allowing both parents to take parental benefits simultaneously for their child. The proposal emphasizes the benefits of shared parental leave during the early stages of a child's life, promoting family bonding and accommodating unique family circumstances. It calls for removing the current limit of 30 dual days, enabling families to allocate existing parental leave days according to their specific needs and situations.

title: Låsta föräldradagar vid vårdnadstvister
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:250 av Angelica Lundberg och Mikael Eskilandersson (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that parental leave days should be locked during custody disputes to ensure that both parents can bond with their newborn children. Currently, in custody cases involving unmarried parents, the mother retains all parental leave days, potentially depriving the father of important bonding time once a custody decision is made, which can take years. The motion aims to reserve half of the parental leave days until custody is resolved.

title: Bättre ekonomi för värnpliktiga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate index adjustments to the daily allowances for conscripts and consider increasing the compensation provided to them when not on duty. Furthermore, it requests an examination of compensation for conscripts during active service. The Left Party emphasizes the importance of fair compensation reflecting both the training and tasks performed by the conscripts, as well as the need for allowances to keep pace with inflation and societal cost increases.

title: EU:s migrationspolitik
summary: This motion emphasizes the need for Sweden to advocate for a humane migration policy within the EU that upholds asylum rights and basic human rights. It calls for Sweden to participate in the temporary redistribution of asylum seekers, push for cooperation with nations seeking to implement welcoming migration policies, and reform EU migration legislation to facilitate easier access to asylum while ensuring that the principles of asylum and international law are respected.

title: Försvarsmakten, klimat och miljö
summary: The motion by Nooshi Dadgostar and others proposes a range of initiatives for the Swedish Armed Forces to take a stronger role in addressing climate change and environmental issues. It urges the government to sign the UN treaty prohibiting nuclear weapons, enhance the environmental responsibilities of the Armed Forces in their operations, and consider the establishment of an independent authority for health and environmental oversight within the military. The motion emphasizes the need for the Armed Forces to coexist harmoniously with climate initiatives while ensuring national security and proposes various actions, including investigating the environmental impact of military exercises and re-evaluating exemptions from environmental assessments.

title: Konsumenternas ställning på de finansiella marknaderna
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen consumer protection in the Swedish financial market by implementing measures such as introducing a Finnish model for mortgage loans to enhance competition, compelling banks to provide annual cost summaries to consumers, ensuring acceptance of cash deposit by banks, and examining regulations concerning high-frequency and algorithmic trading. It highlights existing challenges like low consumer trust, insufficient transparency, and the complexities involved in comparing financial products.

title: Våld och vårdnad
summary: The proposal calls for a comprehensive review and revision of custody regulations in Sweden to improve the safeguarding of children's rights in custody disputes. Key recommendations include establishing special competencies for judges in family law, ensuring police intervention in custody enforcement is only permitted in cases of clear danger to the child, mandatory creation of child protocols in custody matters, and granting children their own legal representative in custody cases. Additionally, it is proposed that shared custody should not be decided against a parent's will in cases of violence, and that waiting periods for divorce should be removed to facilitate equitable asset division.

title: Polisen
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes several measures to strengthen the capacity and effectiveness of the Swedish Police Authority. The motion advocates for improved strategic planning, enhanced local policing, and increased administrative support to alleviate the burden on police officers. It suggests the establishment of a police task force to align police capabilities with societal developments, modernize IT support for officers in the field, and improve the physical and psychosocial work environments of police personnel. The initiative aims to increase public trust in the police, primarily through the appointment of a police ombudsman and measures to ensure the safety of officers in service.

title: Möjlighet att avskaffa flerbarnstillägget
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:243 av Angelica Lundberg och Markus Wiechel (båda SD)
summary: This motion proposes to investigate the possibility of abolishing the multiple child supplement (flerbarnstillägget), which provides additional financial support to families with more than one child. The authors argue that this supplement has decreased efficiency in targeting economic standards and call for its removal, citing concerns about cost, social integration, environmental impact, and the adequacy of existing child benefits.

title: Översyn av tillsatser i mat
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the effects of food additives to ensure consumer safety. It emphasizes the need for increased oversight of certain additives, particularly their combined effects, and advocates for a precautionary principle in the approval of new additives, which should not be approved in Sweden until their safety has been thoroughly evaluated. The motion also highlights the lack of reassessment of additives approved decades ago, despite changes in consumption patterns and emerging health studies.

title: Schemalagda skolmåltider
summary: The motion proposes that scheduled school meals should be integrated into the school day, emphasizing their importance for students' health and learning abilities. It argues that many children lack access to nutritious food at home, which can lead to long-term negative effects. The motion highlights that having meals outside regular class time can disrupt the eating environment and that a pedagogical approach to lunch, where children and teachers eat together while learning about nutrition and food production, should be implemented to ensure basic knowledge of healthy eating habits.

title: Återvändandearbetet vid avslagsbeslut
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to intensify the efforts for the return of foreigners who have received a final rejection of their asylum applications. It argues for a regulated migration process to maintain Sweden's welfare state, asserting that illegal residency following a rejection leads to problematic shadow societies and increased crime. The motion calls for improved diplomatic efforts to establish effective repatriation agreements with countries of origin.

title: Skärpta och utökade befogenheter vid förvar av utlänningar
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for stricter and expanded powers for detention personnel in Sweden concerning the handling of foreign nationals in detention centers. It argues that the current regulations are inadequate to maintain order and security due to increased migrant flows, drug issues, and challenges in executing returns to their home countries. The proposal seeks to enhance the legal framework to allow for constant searches of detainees and their living spaces, as well as to mitigate visitors' ability to smuggle contraband, aiming to improve overall safety and compliance in these facilities.

title: Överföring av skolhälsovården till regionalt ansvar för en sammanhållen vård
summary: The motion proposes transferring school health care responsibilities to regional authorities to ensure a unified healthcare system. It argues that the current division of responsibilities between municipalities and regions disrupts continuity of care for children and young people, leading to inferior healthcare outcomes. The proposal emphasizes the need for consistent and quality health care that follows the individual from pre-school through their schooling years, improving both individual well-being and system efficiency.

title: Särskild prövning till särskola
summary: The motion proposes to examine the possibility of introducing a special assessment process for children seeking admission to special schools, addressing the rigid criteria that currently create exclusion for many students with borderline disabilities. It emphasizes the need for a more individualized approach in the education system to ensure that all children, even those with non-diagnosed challenges, have the opportunity to receive education tailored to their needs, thereby reducing social exclusion and improving educational outcomes.

title: Säkrad kompetens i bristyrken
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of popup training programs by universities and colleges in regions facing labor shortages in specific fields. The motion emphasizes the importance of local training opportunities to attract residents and students to pursue education close to home, thereby increasing the likelihood of employment in the region post-qualification. It highlights the example of a shortage of social workers in Sörmland and suggests that localized training will effectively address competency gaps compared to broader educational offerings.

title: Nationella prov för särskolan
summary: This motion proposes the introduction of national standardized tests for students in special schools in Sweden. The aim is to ensure that all children, regardless of their educational setting, have access to a qualitatively guided education and equitable assessment of their knowledge. Currently, national tests are available for regular schools, but special schools lack this opportunity, leading to unfair differentiation in assessments. Implementing such tests for special schools would provide a standardized measure of academic performance and uphold the principle of equal treatment in education.

title: Obligatoriskt PCR-prov vid utvisning
summary: The motion proposes mandatory PCR testing for individuals facing deportation from Sweden, arguing that current regulations allow some individuals to exploit the system by refusing to take the test, which delays their return to their home countries. The author contends that making PCR tests compulsory in such circumstances would expedite the process of deportation and prevent individuals from hindering Swedish law by refusing to comply with testing requirements.

title: Pausa pensionsutbetalningar
summary: The motion advocates for the ability of individuals to pause all pension disbursements upon request, addressing the challenges posed by an evolving labor market and the increasing number of seniors seeking to re-enter the workforce. As the current pension system does not allow for the pausing of certain pension payments, this proposal seeks to eliminate a legislative technicality that hinders individuals from balancing work and pension income, promoting both personal financial flexibility and the return of skilled labor to the economy.

title: Inverterat flerbarnstillägg till barnbidraget
summary: The motion proposes to invert the current scaling of the child allowance system in Sweden, suggesting that the payment should be higher for the first child and decrease for subsequent children. This change reflects the belief that the first child incurs the most initial expenses while subsequent children have lower ongoing costs. The motion calls for a comprehensive review of the child allowance system to implement this inverted structure.

title: Hinder för fusk med assistansersättningar
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establishes guidelines for systematic controls of assistance payments to prevent fraud. The motion highlights the threat of economic crime to the welfare system, emphasizing the need for thorough investigations and collaboration among authorities to combat fraudulent activities that financially drain the system. It advocates for a digital system with built-in controls to deter potential fraud, suggesting that every instance of criminal activity should be prosecuted while ensuring that the welfare system is not vulnerable to exploitation.

title: Delad pensionsavsättning under föräldraledighet
summary: The motion calls for the possibility of shared pension contributions between parents during parental leave. It emphasizes the importance of allowing families to decide how to divide parental leave in a way that best suits their needs, as unequal distribution can lead to significant long-term financial consequences, particularly in terms of pension savings. The motion advocates for a more equitable approach to pension provision that reflects the shared responsibility of both parents for their child's early years.

title: Barnbidrag utifrån behov
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the feasibility of means-testing child allowances, which are currently given as a universal benefit regardless of parents' income. The suggestion highlights that the original intention of the allowance was to ensure a good standard of living for all children, and calls for a review to align the distribution of benefits with economic circumstances.

title: Tryggheten för väktare och annan bevakningspersonal
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish government to investigate measures aimed at enhancing the safety and working conditions for security guards and other surveillance personnel, particularly in light of increasing incidents of violence and threats they face while on duty. The motion highlights the vulnerabilities of security personnel, especially those working alone, and emphasizes the need for better protections and a safer work environment amidst rising crime rates.

title: Insatser mot missbruk av förkomna pass
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate measures to curb the misuse of lost passports, highlighting that despite previous legislation aimed at reducing the frequency of lost passports, the problem has worsened, with tens of thousands of passports disappearing annually. The motion emphasizes the risks to the legitimacy of Swedish identification documents and the increasing wait times for obtaining new passports, calling for further actions to make it more difficult for individuals to exploit the current system.

title: Åtgärder mot lootlådor och andra lotteriliknande moment inom dataspel
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government should investigate the regulation of loot boxes and other lottery-like elements in video games, as these features are increasingly common and can lead to gambling-like behavior among children and adolescents. The author expresses concerns about the exposure of minors to gambling concepts through these elements, advocating for clarity in existing legislation to protect young players and ensure that similar rules apply across all platforms and technologies.

title: Arbetsmiljö och arbetsmarknad för nattarbetare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate improvements and measures regarding the working conditions and labor market for night workers. It highlights the challenges faced by night workers, including difficulties in accessing childcare services and the impact of irregular working hours on family life and well-being. The proposal emphasizes the need to assess the health implications of night work and suggests that employers should consider work time reductions to facilitate better living conditions for night workers.

title: Insatser mot djurrättsextremisters brottslighet
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate measures to combat crimes associated with animal rights extremists, particularly in relation to hunting activities. The motion highlights the long-standing tradition of hunting in Sweden, detailing the societal benefits provided by hunters, such as wildlife management. It emphasizes the increasing incidents of criminal acts targeted at hunters and their properties, perpetrated by activists aiming to deter hunting practices. The proposal asserts the need for more thorough investigations into these crimes and protective measures for those affected, including hunters and farmers.

title: Bedrägerier med personnummer
summary: The motion addresses the increasing prevalence of fraud involving personal identification numbers (personnummer) in Sweden, highlighting the vulnerability of citizens, especially the elderly, to such crimes. The proposal urges the government to investigate measures to better protect these personal numbers from criminal exploitation, thereby enhancing the safety of Swedish residents.

title: Beslut inom sex månader för småföretagare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandate public authorities to make decisions regarding small businesses within six months of application. If the decision is delayed beyond this timeframe, the business owner should receive a specific compensation for the wait. The motion emphasizes that timely decisions are essential for small business development and contribute to job creation and tax revenue, thereby supporting the welfare system. It calls for the government to implement recommendations from the SOU 2021:60 report to facilitate smoother decision-making for small businesses.

title: En uppdaterad livsmedelsstrategi
summary: The motion proposes an updated food strategy to enhance Swedish food production and self-sufficiency, emphasizing the need for clear goals and implementation across various governmental levels. It highlights the importance of adapting the strategy to current conditions, ensuring fair compensation for farmers, and promoting understanding of Swedish food production within society. The motion calls for immediate action from the government to initiate this update to guide efforts through 2030 and beyond.

title: Demokratiutvecklingspengar till föreningsrörelsen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports allocating funding to the civic movement to enhance democracy. It emphasizes the importance of democratic development in Sweden, highlighting the historical role of various organizations in promoting democratic values. The motion calls for the government to investigate how financial resources can empower these organizations to further educate the public about democracy and strengthen its foundations, especially in light of global threats to democratic systems.

title: Klassning av miljöfarligt avfall
summary: Mikael Larsson from the Center Party proposes a revision of the classification of hazardous waste in Sweden to ensure equal treatment for both private individuals and businesses. He argues that inconsistencies in the current regulations lead to unnecessary costs for farmers and other small business owners when dealing with hazardous waste, such as color cans used in livestock farming. The motion calls for clearer regulations within the Environmental Code that would align the classification of hazardous waste for consumers and businesses alike, making it easier for small enterprises to dispose of their waste while still maintaining environmental considerations.

title: Sekretess inom djurskydd
summary: This motion advocates for stronger confidentiality measures within the context of animal protection in Sweden. It argues that while transparency is important, the handling of animal welfare cases should be managed by professionals at the county administrative boards, rather than being subject to public requests for documents. It highlights concerns that public access to such documents might lead to harassment of farmers, potentially undermining animal welfare. The proposal calls for the government to investigate how to enhance confidentiality to protect both animal welfare and the interests of farmers.

title: Övervakningsorgan för illegala penningflöden
summary: Mikael Larsson proposes the establishment of a new overseeing body to monitor and combat illegal financial flows associated with criminal activities and terrorism financing. This organization would enable banks worldwide to share customer information and payment flows, creating a standardized approach to customer due diligence. By fostering international cooperation among national authorities and financial institutions, the aim is to effectively prevent and detect illegal payments while adhering to confidentiality regulations.

title: Utveckling av gymnasieskolans program med inriktning ekonomi mot ekonomisk redovisning
summary: Mikael Larsson's motion proposes the development of the high school economics program in Sweden to include a greater focus on accounting, in response to a shortage of accounting consultants in the country. The motion highlights the need for improved education at the high school level to prepare students for vocational training in accounting, thus ensuring better advisory services for businesses and encouraging entrepreneurship in the field.

title: Naturbruksskolorna och de gröna näringarna är framtiden
summary: The motion proposes enhancing Swedish agricultural education through robust nature-based schools to secure the future of food production in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for quality training for the next generation of farmers in response to the vulnerabilities exposed by recent climate events and increased interest in local food production post-COVID-19. The motion calls for government support to ensure accessible nature-based education across the country, covering various sectors including agriculture, forestry, and horticulture.

title: Ersättning för markinlösen
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to increase compensation for landowners who are compelled to sell or halt the use of their land due to state projects, such as infrastructure development or conservation efforts. It argues that the current compensation is often insufficient to cover lost income from agricultural or forestry production. The proposal emphasizes the importance of ensuring that compensation values keep pace with price developments and requests an investigation into a revised compensation model.

title: Bildande av naturreservat
summary: Mikael Larsson (C) proposes the establishment of new nature reserves in Sweden, emphasizing the necessity for thorough analysis and updated management plans for existing reserves. He highlights the discrepancies in the current understanding of protected natural areas and urges the government to halt the creation of new reserves until management plans are available and costs are clarified.

title: Småföretagarlots
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a 'small business guide' (småföretagarlots) to assist small business owners in Sweden in navigating and accessing various government support programs. It highlights the importance of supporting approximately 800,000 small entrepreneurs who contribute significantly to the economy and employment. The suggested guide would serve as a resource for small business owners, helping them identify available support and facilitating their development, particularly in the aftermath of challenges posed by the pandemic. The proposal calls on the government to investigate funding and placement options for these guides within local or regional bodies.

title: Avverkningsanmälan och dess offentlighet
summary: The motion proposes that the government reviews the public accessibility of logging notifications submitted by forest owners to the Swedish Forest Agency. The author argues that the current public disclosure leads to harassment of private forest owners by organizations and individuals who may not share their interests, likening it to 'animal rights terrorism'. The motion emphasizes that such details should be treated as trade secrets until logging commences to protect the forest owner's rights and business interests.

title: Bekämpning av ogräsen stånds och renkavle
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support government action to combat two problematic weeds, stånds and renkavle, which negatively affect agriculture and food production. The motion calls for the government to task relevant authorities, such as Jordbruksverket and Trafikverket, with developing a strategy for controlling these weeds, particularly in areas where the state is responsible for maintenance, in order to begin implementation in the 2023 growing season.

title: Höjd ålder för a-kassan
summary: The motion proposes to raise the eligibility age for unemployment benefits (a-kassan) from 65 to 66 years, allowing individuals, especially small business owners and self-employed persons, to maintain their membership in a-kassan until they choose to retire, potentially up to 67 years or older. The need for this change is emphasized by the increasing age of retirement and the longer working lives of Swedes.

title: Omprövning av beslut om viltvårdsförvaltningen
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:208 av Helena Lindahl och Anne-Li Sjölund (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reconsiders the decision regarding wildlife management and seeks to engage with the EU to reinstate a model where the Swedish Hunters' Association receives funding for its wildlife management tasks. The proposal criticizes the previous government's decision to outsource these responsibilities and highlights concerns over potential misallocation of the wildlife fund, which is financed by hunters' fees. Advocates for a dedicated wildlife authority to streamline the management process and ensure that funds are used appropriately.

title: Utbyggnation av stamnätet i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:207 av Helena Lindahl och Anne-Li Sjölund (båda C)
summary: The proposal by Helena Lindahl and Anne-Li Sjölund advocates for the expansion and investment in Sweden's national electricity grid to facilitate job growth and accommodate future energy-intensive industries, particularly in northern regions. It emphasizes the need to halve the time required for approval processes and to ensure that capacity expansions not only meet current forecasts but also allow for future demands. The suggestion highlights the challenges faced by municipalities, particularly Robertsfors, in attracting new investments due to existing infrastructure constraints.

title: Åretruntfärja till Holmön
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament urges the government to ensure the procurement of a ferry to operate year-round between Umeå and Holmön. It highlights ongoing communication issues faced by Holmön's residents, which have not been resolved despite previous inquiries to infrastructure authorities. The current reliance on seasonal ferry service and limited alternatives, like helicopters, complicates commuting and imposes challenges for local businesses. The motion emphasizes the need for a sustainable and permanent transportation solution to prevent a decline in the island's population and economic vitality.

title: Tillägg och förtydligande i fastighetslagen angående hänsyn till landsbygdens lokala behov
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should review the possibility of adding clauses to the property law to address the local needs of rural areas. It highlights the issue of empty houses in the countryside and the efforts made by municipalities to encourage people to move into vacant properties to boost rural development. The motion emphasizes the need for clearer regulations in property law to prevent local authorities from misinterpreting existing laws, which often hinders rural settlement and growth.

title: Elektrifiering av Västerbottenbanan – Tvärbanan i Västerbotten
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports exploring funding for the electrification of the Tvärbanan railway in Västerbotten. Currently, parts of the railway rely on diesel locomotives, which contribute to emissions and hinder competitiveness. Electrification is expected to provide significant environmental benefits, efficiency improvements for goods transport, and enhanced competitiveness for Swedish industry, especially in the context of increasing transport needs due to regional industrial growth and security collaborations with NATO countries.

title: Likvärdig stödområdesindelning för det nationella stödet och kompensationsstödet för norra Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to review the current support area classifications for national and compensation support in northern Sweden to ensure a more equitable distribution of aid to farmers, particularly addressing concerns that certain farmers in Umeå and Skellefteå municipalities are negatively impacted by the existing classification. It argues that the adjustments made based on temperature measurements have led to disparities that disadvantage some farmers, creating 'islands' of reduced support amidst regions of higher agricultural viability. The motion emphasizes the importance of supporting local agriculture for sustainability, food security, and resilience, especially in light of recent challenges faced by farmers due to rising costs and external conflicts like the war in Ukraine.

title: Proportionalitet gällande återbetalning av lönebidrag
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should examine the possibility of implementing proportionality regarding the repayment of wage subsidies as outlined in the legislation for individuals with disabilities who have reduced work capacity. This follows a case where a minor company faced bankruptcy and lost two employees due to a significant repayment demand from the Employment Service following an administrative error, emphasizing the need for more nuanced assessments by authorities to prevent unjust financial repercussions for businesses.

title: Varumärkesvård och uppförandekod för statliga bolag
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:201 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The proposal aims to instruct state-owned companies to continuously work on brand management, develop and follow an ethics code, and foster trust with customers and citizens. Given that the Swedish government is a significant shareholder with 46 state-owned corporations, the goal is to ensure these companies operate effectively and transparently while aligning with sustainability criteria. Improved communication and responsible practices are emphasized to build confidence among stakeholders.

title: Begränsad jakt på högdräktiga älgkor
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:200 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations concerning the hunting of heavily pregnant moose cows, suggesting limitations due to ethical concerns raised by hunters and the potential stress that such hunting can cause, which may lead to miscarriages. While acknowledging issues of moose damage to forests that necessitate hunting, the authors argue that it is unreasonable and unethical to allow hunting of heavily pregnant individuals.

title: Lantmäteriets kostnader på landsbygden
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:199 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate and review the costs associated with Lantmäteriet's fees for rural municipalities. The authors argue that high costs and long processing times for land subdivision hinder development in rural areas, discouraging population growth and housing construction. They emphasize that exorbitant fees can sometimes equal the value of the property itself, leading to a stagnation in the sale of attractive locations and the deterioration of properties.

title: Säkra vägar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government ensure that the quality of road infrastructure remains acceptable to prevent speed reductions. It highlights the importance of maintaining roads for accessibility, particularly in rural areas, and argues that declining road standards negatively impact local businesses and accessibility to community services.

title: Regionalisering av fastighetsskatten på vatten- och vindkraft
summary: The motion proposes to regionalize property taxes on energy-producing facilities, specifically hydropower and wind power, to ensure that areas generating electricity receive a fairer return and can better support local services and development. It argues that current arrangements disproportionately benefit the state while leaving rural areas with limited compensation and financial burdens due to low tax revenues and sparse populations. The proposal draws on Norway's model of compensating municipalities for environmental impacts, aiming to foster optimism and growth in regions affected by energy production.

title: Översyn av regelverket för AM-körkort
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations for AM driving licenses to improve traffic safety, suggesting the introduction of separate AM licenses for two- and four-wheeled vehicles and the establishment of clearer conditions for which vehicles can be registered as A-tractors. It also calls for a reassessment of speed limits and safety requirements for moped cars and A-tractors, highlighting the inadequacies in current training and testing related to the vehicles allowed under the AM license.

title: Civilpliktsutbildning
summary: The motion proposes to establish Sandö as an educational hub for a reintroduced civil service in Sweden, highlighting its strategic importance in light of current security concerns following Russia's actions in Ukraine. The motion emphasizes the need for civil service to support Sweden's total defense efforts and provides a non-military alternative for individuals wishing to contribute. It argues that Sandö is well-equipped with existing resources and infrastructure to facilitate this initiative.

title: Eftergymnasial utbildning för personer med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate an investigation to assess and improve access to post-secondary education for individuals with intellectual disabilities. It highlights the need for a comprehensive review of study financing, educational design, and logistical support for these students, as previous investigations have not adequately addressed these issues. Furthermore, the motion calls for the development of a clear funding model for educational institutions to support individuals with intellectual disabilities in pursuing further education.

title: Ny broförbindelse till Alnö
summary: The proposal advocates for the construction of a new bridge between Alnö and the mainland to address escalating traffic needs and safety concerns. Given the significant increase in traffic since the existing bridge's completion in 1964, the current infrastructure is inadequate for the near 9,000 residents and seasonal population surge, which often causes safety hazards for pedestrians and cyclists and restricts emergency vehicle access during incidents.

title: Förstärkning av kommuners ekonomi genom turistavgift
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:192 av Anna-Caren Sätherberg och Kalle Olsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should consider allowing municipalities to introduce a tourist fee to strengthen their economies. This fee would help local governments manage the increased infrastructure and service demands resulting from tourism, while also boosting investments in local services and promoting regional development. By implementing a charge on accommodation, similar to models used in Europe and the United States, municipalities could generate significant revenue to support necessary community services and enhance the visitor experience.

title: Cyklar på cykelbanan
summary: The motion proposes to prohibit all types of mopeds from using bicycle lanes within detailed planning areas, responding to growing concerns among cyclists about safety and the risk of moped-related crimes, particularly moped thefts. It argues that this prohibition would create a safer environment for cyclists and establish clearer regulations regarding vehicle usage on bicycle paths.

title: Möjlighet till lägre reavinstskatt vid försäljning av privatbostad
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of lowering the capital gains tax on the sale of private residences, particularly to facilitate housing mobility among older individuals who are often reluctant to downsize due to the current high tax rate of 22%. The suggestion includes a potential reduction to 11% for properties owned for a minimum of five years, aiming to alleviate financial burdens and stimulate the housing market by encouraging movement into smaller accommodations.

title: Snabbspår gällande skyddsjakt på varg
summary: The proposal advocates for a faster process for granting permits for protective hunting of wolves, due to the increasing wolf population in southern Sweden, which is causing significant challenges for livestock herders and hunters. It suggests establishing a system to allow protective hunting within 24 hours after a confirmed attack, to better manage problem wolves and alleviate issues for affected animal owners.

title: Utökad jakttid på räv
summary: The proposal suggests extending the hunting season for foxes in designated counties, arguing that the previous reduction of hunting time from March 15 to February 28/29 negatively impacts Swedish cultural heritage, hunting practices, and wildlife management, as foxes are significant predators.

title: Vårjakt på råbock
summary: The motion proposes to prohibit the spring hunting of roe deer throughout Sweden, arguing that the previous decision to allow this practice has led to unsustainable hunting pressure, particularly in southern Sweden, where the deer population is already under strain from intense hunting activities. The motion emphasizes the need for better management of the roe deer population to prevent further decline in quality.

title: Främja demokrati i Iran
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:186 av Nima Gholam Ali Pour (SD)
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes measures for Sweden to promote democracy and human rights in Iran, emphasizing support for the Iranian people's struggle against the oppressive regime. It calls for sanctions against Iranian leaders responsible for human rights abuses, the closure of the Iranian embassy in Sweden, and the establishment of a UN committee to investigate violations. Additionally, it seeks to prevent the Iranian regime's propaganda by limiting diplomatic relations and advocates for secure communication channels for Iranians amid government internet blackouts.

title: Utredningen om fler fasta förbindelser över Öresund
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:185 av Jörgen Grubb och Nima Gholam Ali Pour (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes expanding the investigation into transportation capacity and redundancy across the Öresund Strait to include broader societal effects such as regional growth. It emphasizes the importance of a new traffic connection, specifically the Öresund Metro, to enhance job opportunities, trade, and tourism, thereby strengthening the Öresund region's economic significance. The motion stresses the necessity of cooperation with Denmark to ensure the project's feasibility and highlights benefits such as increased transport capacity for both freight and passenger services, integration of labor markets, and improved connections to the European continent.

title: Markåtkomst för cykelvägar på landsbygd och utanför tätort
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:184 av Daniel Helldén och Jacob Risberg (båda MP)
summary: The proposal seeks to amend the road law to ensure equal land access for bicycle paths in rural areas and outside urban centers, similar to that which currently exists for motor vehicle roads. It emphasizes the need for improved cycling infrastructure to increase cycling accessibility, enhance public health, and reduce environmental impact. The authors argue that existing legal definitions hinder the development of independent and logical cycling routes and that the state should take greater responsibility in developing cycling networks, as has been done for motorways. The suggestion calls for prompt legislative action to facilitate the establishment of standalone bicycle paths.

title: Vägrenarnas potential för den biologiska mångfalden
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:183 av Daniel Helldén och Rebecka Le Moine (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of mowing principles for the management of the national road network's roadside areas to enhance and protect biodiversity. It urges the government to direct the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) to actively maintain road margins in a way that supports biodiversity, allocate necessary funding, establish a monitoring program for biodiversity actions, and collaborate with the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) to create an easily accessible knowledge bank for planners. The motion underscores the importance of roadways as potential corridors for plant and animal species, emphasizing that properly managed roadside areas can contribute significantly to a richer landscape and greater biological diversity.

title: Stärkande av cyklingens potential och ställning som transportsätt på landsbygden
summary: The motion by Daniel Helldén proposes the implementation of service-related cycling infrastructure in rural areas to enhance cycling as a mode of transport. It argues that cycling is a resource-efficient and environmentally friendly transportation option that has diminished due to inadequate road conditions. The proposal emphasizes the need for separate cycle lanes to ensure safety and suggests specific measures, including a 1.5-meter rule between vehicles and cyclists, to encourage cycling development and improve the local community's mobility and flexibility.

title: Stärk demokratin och de mänskliga rättigheterna
summary: The motion suggests several measures to strengthen democracy and human rights in Sweden, including appointing a new power investigation, lowering the voting age to 16, improving voter participation, introducing a national citizen initiative, enhancing media literacy, and increasing protections against hate and threats. It encompasses various proposals aimed at improving transparency, protecting individual rights, and ensuring democratic engagement across different societal sectors.

title: Utredning om Allmänna arvsfondens verksamhet och framtid samt hur medel ur fonden ska fördelas
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the functions and future of the General Inheritance Fund, specifically focusing on the transparency of its operations and the distribution of its resources. It argues that while some organizations benefiting from the fund have a positive impact on society, others, particularly those with questionable value systems or political affiliations, should not receive support. The motion calls for the Riksdag to take a clear stance on the fund's management and the criteria for its resource allocation to ensure alignment with democratic principles.

title: Ändrad placering av ledamöter i plenisalen
summary: The motion proposes that the seating arrangement of members in the parliamentary chamber should be based on party affiliation rather than electoral constituencies. The author argues that this change would facilitate communication within party groups and streamline voting processes, addressing the lack of debate surrounding previous motions on this topic. The suggested change is expected to have minimal cost implications.

title: Villa Bonnier som talmansbostad
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the feasibility of converting Villa Bonnier into the official residence and representation location for the Speaker of Parliament. The proposal argues that, unlike the Prime Minister, the Speaker currently lacks an official residence suitable for representation, and highlights the historical context of the property's donation to the state.

title: Riksmötets öppnande i Rikssalen
summary: The motion proposes the reintroduction of the ceremonial opening of the parliamentary session in the Rikssalen, the traditional venue used until 1974. It argues for the importance of honoring Swedish traditions and the monarchy's role in representing the country's history and culture, suggesting that returning the ceremony to its historical location would strengthen public perceptions of both the monarchy and the parliament.

title: Erkännande av Jerusalem som Israels huvudstad
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament formally recognize Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and relocate the Swedish embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. It argues that historical agreements and international law support this recognition, citing the Balfour Declaration and the San Remo Conference, while pointing out that Jerusalem has been the capital of Israel since 1949 and has remained under Israeli control since the 1967 war.

title: Minnesdag tillägnad kommunismens offer
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a Swedish memorial day dedicated to the victims of communism, similar to the International Holocaust Remembrance Day. It argues that communism has caused a greater number of deaths than national socialism and calls for the government to advocate for a global day of remembrance for communism's victims at the United Nations, emphasizing the need to educate future generations about the atrocities committed under this ideology.

title: Strategi för inlemmande av Taiwan i internationella organisationer
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish government develop a clear strategy aimed at integrating Taiwan into various international organizations, following a previously expressed interest from Sweden and the EU for Taiwan's participation. The motion emphasizes the importance of establishing a concrete plan, as the previous government lacked a detailed approach despite its supportive stance.

title: Verka för att Taiwan tillåts delta i WHO
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to actively support Taiwan's participation in the World Health Organization (WHO), emphasizing Taiwan's valuable experience and contributions during health crises, such as the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion highlights Taiwan's consistent exclusion from WHO meetings and calls for global collaboration to effectively address future health challenges.

title: Upphörande av bistånd till den palestinska myndigheten
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament cease all direct or indirect aid to the Palestinian Authority, citing concerns over corruption, lack of transparency regarding the use of aid funds, and the Palestinian Authority's failure to acknowledge Israel's right to exist. The motion argues that Swedish financial assistance is ultimately helping to sustain governance that promotes anti-democratic practices and antisemitism, and thus should be withdrawn in favor of a more responsible allocation of taxpayer money.

title: Värnande av kontanter
summary: The motion proposes that cash should always be accepted as a payment method in stores, emphasizing the growing issue of cashless shops that exclude a significant portion of the population, particularly the elderly and disabled. As the use of cash declines, the motion highlights concerns over Sweden's crisis preparedness and advocates for legislative changes to ensure that businesses are required to accept cash payments.

title: Förbifart Västerås
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:170 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt och Angelica Lundberg (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider an investigation into improving the traffic situation in Västerås. It highlights the issues caused by the E18 highway, which has been undergoing renovations, leading to increased congestion and safety risks. The proposal suggests that an additional bypass should be evaluated to alleviate traffic congestion, especially with the anticipated growth in population and establishment of new residential and business areas.

title: Stockholm-Västerås flygplats som beredskapsflygplats
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:169 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt och Angelica Lundberg (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag considers designating Stockholm-Västerås Airport as a preparedness airport, highlighting its strategic importance for emergency response, organ transport, and historical significance during crises such as the 2014 forest fire. The motion emphasizes public support for the airport's continued operation and potential for future development.

title: Borttagande av fribeloppet för studiemedel
motion_id: Motion 2022/23:168 av Nima Gholam Ali Pour (SD)
summary: The proposal suggests removing the income ceiling for student financial aid (studiemedel), known as fribeloppet, citing its negative impact on students working in the hospitality sector who face challenges balancing work and study. The motion argues that the reintroduction of this income limit has hampered students' ability to earn income and gain work experience while causing staffing shortages in businesses recovering post-pandemic. Eliminating the income ceiling would allow students to work more extensively and help businesses with their workforce needs.

title: Godkända betyg i kärnämnena
