The motivation emphasizes the significance of the Church of Sweden in shaping Swedish culture and warns that ongoing secularization may threaten the maintenance of these historic buildings.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:162 Elevhälsa och stärkt utbildning för elever med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes to investigate various measures to enhance the accessibility of cultural heritage related to Sweden's national minorities, such as the Sami, Tornedalians, Swedish Finns, Jews, and Roma. It suggests exploring alternative ways to incorporate minority languages in the welfare sector, ensuring the survival and status of the South Sami language, and establishing a joint Sami language center in collaboration with other Nordic countries with Sami populations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:159 Dimensionering av gymnasial utbildning för bättre kompetensförsörjning
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes several changes to enhance the tax reduction system for donations to non-profit organizations in Sweden. The motion calls for an investigation into increasing the limit on donation tax reductions, expanding the categories eligible for such reductions, allowing legal entities to receive tax deductions for their donations, and simplifying the administrative burden on recipients. The purpose is to strengthen the independence and financial stability of civil society organizations, encouraging private donations and reducing reliance on government funding.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:156 Resursskolor och tilläggsbelopp för särskilt stöd
summary: The motion by the Sweden Democrats (SD) proposes a comprehensive investigation to modernize the public service system in Sweden, focusing on consolidating public service companies into a single entity, reforming financing methods, and enhancing cooperation between Nordic countries. The motion emphasizes the need for public service to maintain impartiality and high-quality reporting, addressing criticisms regarding the current state of public service content and its alignment with the needs of the population. Additionally, it suggests the implementation of measures for better accountability and transparency in public service operations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:178 Barnets bästa när vård enligt LVU upphör – lex lilla hjärtat
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment and enhancement of educational and research frameworks for the Sámi culture in Sweden, specifically by developing the existing Vaartoe/CeSam research center into a national Sámi research center and designating a national university focused on Sámi culture and languages. The motion underscores the importance of preserving the Sámi language and culture in light of historical challenges and declining speaker numbers, aiming to secure these elements for future generations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:177 Sammanhållen vård- och omsorgsdokumentation
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4555 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes several initiatives aimed at improving the Swedish performing arts education and industry. It calls for a national review and quality assurance of performing arts programs, support for the Riksteatern to enhance its operations, an investigation into the working conditions of freelancers, and recommendations to improve incentive structures for private funding in the arts sector. The motion emphasizes the need for a balance between educational offerings and labor market demands, ensuring that Swedish artists can compete internationally and have secure employment.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:157 Tydligare krav på fristående förskolor, skolor och fritidshem med konfessionell inriktning
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive evaluation of the Swedish gambling market regulation five years after its implementation, focusing on measures to protect consumers, particularly minors, from gambling-related issues. It includes calls for stricter regulations on game marketing, risk classification for different types of games, and the implementation of B2B licenses to combat illegal gambling operations. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring consumer protection and maintaining the financial viability of non-profit organizations reliant on lottery revenues while critiquing the current lottery system that allows political parties to benefit financially.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of balancing a living language with the need for uniform communication among the population in Sweden. It suggests that the government mandate the Language Council to provide guidelines ensuring linguistic uniformity while recognizing diverse linguistic expressions. The motion advocates for Swedish to be designated as the official language of Sweden and argues for amendments to the language law to include Braille, ensuring access to language for visually impaired individuals.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:171 Tryggare bostadsrätt
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4552 av Viktor Wärnick m.fl. (M, L)
summary: The Sweden Democrats propose that the application of regulations concerning proper place name practices be tightened, arguing against the recent removal of Swedish place names from mountain maps, which they believe contributes to the erasure of the memory of Swedish-speaking inhabitants. They emphasize the need for both Swedish and Sámi names to coexist on maps, citing confusion among tourists and emergency services as a consequence of the current naming policies, and call for the government to roll back recent changes made by the mapping authority.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:192 Skärpta straff för knivbrott
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a 'Swedish Cultural Heritage Year' to promote and celebrate the various forms of traditional and folk culture in Sweden. This initiative aims to revitalize the cultural policy debate and strengthen a collective national identity by highlighting different aspects of Sweden's cultural heritage, drawing inspiration from the multicultural year in 2006 that celebrated foreign cultures in the country.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:186 En stärkt rättsprocess och en ökad lagföring
summary: This motion presented by the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the belief that state support for religious communities is not essential for maintaining religious freedom. It argues for a special status for Christianity in Swedish culture and proposes that state support should only be a supplement to funding from member fees. The motion suggests introducing exclusion criteria for funding to prevent support from going to extremist organizations and advocates for a ban on donations from foreign entities that oppose democracy and human rights. Additionally, it calls for enhanced monitoring of recipients of state support to ensure compliance with Swedish democratic values.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:183 Registrering av kontantkort – förbättrad tillgång till uppgifter för brottsbekämpande myndigheter
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish government to take greater interest in the Uppåkra Archaeological Center, highlighting its significance as the largest and richest Iron Age settlement in Scandinavia. The motion seeks to allocate increased resources to further develop and promote the excavation site, which has revealed a large number of artifacts and holds historical importance not only for the Skåne region but for Northern Europe as a whole.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:172 Nya regler om informationsutbyte om brottmålsdomar i EU
summary: The motion put forth by the Sweden Democrats calls for stricter regulations and oversight to prevent public funding from being allocated to extremist organizations. It specifically targets organizations linked to the Muslim Brotherhood and seeks to ensure that any body receiving financial support adheres to democratic values. The proposal emphasizes the need for investigations into organizations that no longer meet the criteria for funding and aims to hold accountable those that support activities contrary to Swedish democracy or contribute to radicalization and crime.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of safeguarding and strengthening property rights in Sweden, asserting that any expropriation or restriction of private land usage should be based on specific factual conditions and clear legal texts. It advocates for utilizing publicly owned land for public purposes and calls for better protections for landowners, especially in matters related to forestry and land usage regulations. The motion further urges the government to enhance the involvement of landowners in decision-making processes and establish clearer legal frameworks to ensure fair and prompt compensation for any restrictions to their property rights.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:194 Ett modernare straffrättsligt skydd mot hemfridsbrott och olaga intrång
summary: The motion aims to intensify efforts to restore the Baltic Sea, addressing environmental issues exacerbated by pollution and eutrophication. It proposes various measures including the promotion of structural liming to reduce nutrient leakage from agriculture, advocating for a quota on non-virgin phosphorus and nitrogen at the EU level, and enhancing regional cooperation through HELCOM. Additionally, the motion emphasizes the need for increased research on effective methods to minimize nutrient input from agriculture and suggests that structural drainage may receive state support. It also proposes addressing plastic pollution and calls for a holistic strategy to reduce plastic usage in marine environments.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:196 Ökad kontroll vid verkställighet av fängelse med fotboja
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to increase efforts in preserving and developing agricultural heritage, including traditional pastures, old crop varieties, and endangered livestock breeds. It calls for financial incentives for the restoration of nature and cultural environments in the agricultural landscape, protection of grasslands, and securing the legacy of Finnish cultural landscapes. Additionally, the motion seeks to establish protected designations for Swedish food products and a balanced approach in the implementation of the EU's Water Framework Directive to safeguard both water quality and cultural heritage.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:195 Skärpt straff för gravfridsbrott
summary: The suggestion seeks to reclaim control over hunting and wildlife management from the EU, calling for reforms to directives to better align with national and regional conditions. It proposes establishing an independent authority for wildlife and hunting, enhancing decision-making autonomy within wildlife management delegations, and increasing protection for reindeer husbandry against predatory animals. Additional measures include enforcing maximum population limits for wolves and bears, evaluating management effectiveness, and promoting the sale of wild game meat. The motion also addresses the rights of organizations concerning hunting and wildlife policy, advocating for restrictions on their ability to intervene in decisions relating to hunting licenses.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:181 Justerade åldersgränser i pensionssystemet och i kringliggande system
summary: The proposal seeks to enhance and protect the equestrian industry in Sweden through various measures such as converting unused roads into safe riding paths, preserving historical grazing areas, developing a fodder contingency plan for crises, establishing a national animal welfare police, ensuring daily outdoor movement for horses, rejecting harmful legislative proposals, and creating a national riding trail from north to south to promote equestrian tourism.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:179 Ett bättre premiepensionssystem
summary: The proposal outlines various measures aimed at strengthening animal welfare in Sweden. It advocates for the development and preservation of Swedish animal production, evaluation of current animal welfare laws for improved flexibility, and the establishment of monitoring systems for animal care. Key suggestions include implementing a licensing requirement for circuses, enforcing surprise inspections, introducing a positive list for animals allowed in circuses and as pets, and enhancing the qualifications of those overseeing animal welfare. Additionally, it calls for the prohibition of the import of poorly raised animals and promotes research into alternative methods of anesthesia. The overall objective is to enhance animal protection while ensuring that Swedish agriculture remains competitive.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion emphasizes maintaining and enhancing the Swedish model for forestry, advocating for established regulations under the Swedish Forest Agency, and ensuring that privately owned forests remain privately held. Additionally, it calls for research investment in modern timber construction and forest management, quicker administrative processes for forestry activities, and a focused national policy that limits EU influence over Swedish forestry management.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:186 En stärkt rättsprocess och en ökad lagföring
summary: The motion by the Sweden Democrats calls for a comprehensive approach to climate policy that emphasizes global collaboration and accountability, particularly targeting major polluters like China. It advocates for a stricter stance in international negotiations, the establishment of a global carbon tax, and the importance of utility-cost analyses in developing Sweden's climate strategies. The motion stresses the need for Sweden to adapt its climate goals to economic realities, ensuring that measures do not hinder industrial competitiveness while arguing against overly ambitious unilateral emissions targets. It also highlights the significance of energy research and technological development as means to effectively reduce emissions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:192 Skärpta straff för knivbrott
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for improved conditions and support for Swedish agriculture, advocating for the implementation of EU directives favorably towards rural industries, enhanced national decision-making in agricultural policies, and the introduction of environmental support for biodiversity and food self-sufficiency. It urges a review of regulations related to land use, an increase in agricultural crisis preparedness, support for export and innovation in the sector, and improved regulatory compliance, with an overall aim to enhance the competitiveness and sustainability of Swedish agriculture in a changing European landscape.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:194 Ett modernare straffrättsligt skydd mot hemfridsbrott och olaga intrång
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for Sweden to intensify its efforts in the EU for establishing standards for packaging materials and implementing producer responsibility for textiles to promote recycling. It addresses reducing food waste through better measurement systems and information campaigns, supporting biogas production, fostering the sharing economy, and ensuring regulations for synthetic fuels do not inhibit their use. Overall, the motion advocates for sustainable practices and efficient resource management within the framework of a circular economy.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:195 Skärpt straff för gravfridsbrott
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen regulations surrounding metal scrap trade in Sweden by introducing a cash ban for transactions, implementing traceability requirements, enforcing licensing for scrap dealers, imposing harsher penalties for dealing with stolen metal, and enhancing the customs authority's role in preventing the export of stolen scrap. The motion highlights the economic impact of metal theft, particularly copper, on various sectors, including transportation and cultural heritage, and calls for comprehensive measures to curb organized crime in this area.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:191 Riksrevisionens rapport om bosättningslagen
summary: The motion presents a comprehensive approach to enhance rural development in Sweden by proposing various measures to improve conditions for entrepreneurship, market access, and community services in rural areas. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining strong support for local businesses, simplifying regulations for small-scale industries, and ensuring effective infrastructure, while advocating for a balanced approach that considers both regional and national interests.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:156 Resursskolor och tilläggsbelopp för särskilt stöd
summary: The motion from the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the importance of a market-driven and innovation-friendly economic policy to support both new and existing businesses. It advocates for reducing regulatory burdens, ensuring competitive energy prices, simplifying taxation to enhance competitiveness, and improving capital availability for growing enterprises. The party argues for prioritizing education in scientific fields to equip the workforce with necessary skills and calls for better infrastructure to facilitate business operations. It also highlights the significance of promoting free trade for Sweden's export-dependent economy.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:157 Tydligare krav på fristående förskolor, skolor och fritidshem med konfessionell inriktning
summary: This proposal emphasizes the importance of tourism and the visitor economy in Sweden, advocating for government support and simplification of regulations for the sector. It suggests a clear mandate for authorities to promote the tourism industry, calls for the removal of outdated regulations such as the dance permit requirement, and proposes replacing the current hotel licensing system with a simplified notification obligation. The motion also recommends assessing existing administrative procedures and harmonizing VAT rates associated with tourism, while opposing proposed taxes on single-use items. Additionally, it urges increased marketing efforts by Visit Sweden and highlights the significance of robust infrastructure for tourism.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:198 Stärkt rätt till skadestånd för brottsoffer
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats emphasizes the need for increased consideration of cultural heritage during land exploitation. It calls for the government to initiate an investigation into incentives and penalties for commercial actors who violate protections for sensitive cultural environments, ensuring that both public and private entities adhere to standards that preserve cultural significance. The proposal addresses a perceived lack of awareness and expertise regarding heritage preservation among municipalities, advocating for enhanced funding and competence in local administrations to protect and maintain cultural landscapes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:155 In- och utpasseringskontroller vid högskoleprovet
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish government to enhance the education system's role in increasing public knowledge about 'allemansrätten', the Right of Public Access in Sweden. It emphasizes the importance of this right for individuals, tourism, and nature conservation. Despite existing efforts by various organizations and a presence in school curricula, there remains a public lack of understanding about allemansrätten, which warrants a review of how schools can more effectively promote this knowledge.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish state to take responsibility for co-financing the expansion of Spårväg City, a vital investment in public transport for Stockholm. It highlights the significance of this project amidst increasing housing and job development in the Norra Djurgårdsstaden area, emphasizing the need for sustainable transport solutions. The motion points to current challenges, including fiscal policies and housing market constraints, that threaten the timely realization of this infrastructure project, arguing that state funding is essential to ensure its success and sustainability.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:174 Ett moderniserat konsumentskydd
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4530 av Larry Söder m.fl. (KD, M)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a regulatory guillotine process in Sweden, aiming to alleviate the regulatory burden on small businesses. It suggests a systematic review of existing regulations to determine their necessity, legality, and friendliness to businesses, allowing for the removal or revision of those that do not meet the criteria. The motion highlights the importance of fostering a favorable environment for entrepreneurship and innovation, drawing on examples from other countries that have successfully implemented similar processes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:168 En ökad differentiering av strandskyddet
summary: Ida Drougge proposes that the Swedish Tax Agency be tasked with collecting information about organ donation during the tax declaration process. This initiative aims to simplify the process for individuals to express their preferences regarding organ donation, potentially increasing the number of registered donors, and ultimately addressing the shortage of organs and tissues for transplantation that results in preventable deaths.

title: Hittegods i kollektivtrafiken
summary: The motion argues for a review and amendment of Sweden's defamation laws, highlighting that women who report their abuse can face harsher penalties than their abusers. Currently, defamation prosecutions do not consider the truthfulness of the statements made, leading to situations where victims risk legal repercussions for sharing their experiences. The motion emphasizes the need for legal reforms to protect victims of violence and ensure they can speak out without fear of defamation charges.

title: En ny lag om företagsrekonstruktion
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Riksdag eliminate the tax assessment of properties, arguing that the tax has been unpopular and that its potential reinstatement as a property tax would unfairly burden ordinary citizens. The motion emphasizes that Sweden has a high ongoing taxation of housing and asserts that abolishing the tax assessment would prevent the return of property taxes. The motion posits that alternative methods for property value assessments exist and that removing the tax assessment aligns with the public's opposition to property tax.

title: Certifierade byggprojekteringsföretag – en mer förutsägbar byggprocess
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate and clarify the definition of fees and reclassify those fees that are effectively taxes. The aim is to ensure transparency in how these charges are labeled, as the current distinction between fees and taxes is often unclear, leading to potential mislabeling and public misunderstanding. The motion argues that fees should correspond proportionally to the costs of the services provided, and if they exceed these costs, they should be considered taxes.

title: Tidigt kommunalt ställningstagande till vindkraft
summary: Ida Drougge (M) proposes that the Swedish government sell its stake in the airline SAS, arguing that the state’s ownership is unnecessary in a competitive market where private companies already operate. The motion highlights that state-owned entities can distort market dynamics and that it is inappropriate for the government to both oversee and compete in the same market.

title: Vägar till hållbara vattentjänster
summary: The motion proposes increasing the number of toilet waste disposal stations in the Swedish archipelago to comply with the 2015 toilet disposal law, which prohibits recreational boats from dumping toilet waste in Swedish waters. The aim is to reduce environmental pollution and eutrophication in water bodies, particularly the Baltic Sea. The current infrastructure is inadequate, with only about 320 stations available, leading to calls for more stations and improvements in the existing app used for locating disposal options.

title: Tydligare bestämmelser om ersättning vid avslag på ansökningar om tillstånd till avverkning i fjällnära skog
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider selling SBAB, a state-owned bank, arguing that its role in the private mortgage market is unnecessary and that state ownership creates a conflict of interest in a heavily regulated market. The motion emphasizes the need for the state to avoid direct involvement in private markets unless deemed essential.

title: Snabbare och enklare verkställighet av myndighetsbeslut
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the decriminalization of late submissions of annual reports within companies, arguing that the current criminal penalties are disproportionate compared to the nature of the offense. The authors suggest that a more effective approach would involve implementing a system of increased fines based on company turnover that escalate with the duration of the delay, as well as immediate feedback to encourage timely compliance. This change aims to create a structure that encourages businesses to submit their reports on time while recognizing that many entrepreneurs do not intend to disregard the regulations.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om Ekobrottsmyndighetens arbete mot den organiserade ekonomiska brottsligheten
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament should investigate the possibility of allowing companies to offset past losses against previous profits within the corporate tax system, known as 'carry back'. This change aims to provide financial relief for businesses that have suffered losses during the COVID-19 pandemic by enabling earlier access to tax refunds on previous profitable years. The motion emphasizes the importance of adapting tax policies to better support companies now and in the future, referencing similar practices in other countries that have adopted this system as a means to bolster domestic industries.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:190 Åtgärder mot fusk vid förarprov och mot illegal utbildningsverksamhet på transportområdet
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a knowledge center focused on intellectual property rights, an agency to assist Swedish companies and inventors facing intellectual property infringements, the investigation of an insurance solution for those involved in infringement disputes, and the exploration of a cap on litigation costs in patent disputes. The aim is to support and protect Swedish inventors and innovations, enhancing their ability to commercialize their creations and compete internationally.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:175 Genomförande av balansdirektivet
summary: The suggestion involves a series of proposals aimed at reforming state ownership of companies in Sweden, emphasizing a reduction of state influence in certain sectors by divesting from companies like Lernia AB, restructuring Postnord AB, and reassessing the roles and financial goals of state-owned entities like SJ AB and Vattenfall AB. It calls for the removal of gender quotas in corporate boards of state-owned companies, criticizes the current operational direction of Telia Company AB, and seeks to split Svenska Spel AB into two distinct entities for better market regulation and focus on public health concerns.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: This parliamentary motion proposes a comprehensive evaluation of the regulations governing anti-competitive public selling activities in Sweden. It calls for the government to grant the Swedish Competition Authority (Konkurrensverket) decision-making powers concerning competition-limiting public sales and to undertake a thorough assessment of the new framework for competition damage fees after five years of implementation. Furthermore, it emphasizes the need to separate the investigative and decision-making functions within the Authority to enhance efficiency and ensure fair competition, particularly for small and medium enterprises hindered by bureaucratic challenges and unfair competition from public entities.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:191 Riksrevisionens rapport om bosättningslagen
summary: The motion proposes various measures aimed at promoting sustainable growth for businesses and citizens across all regions of Sweden, with a focus on strengthening regional economies and infrastructure. Key proposals include increasing revenue for regions through the regionalization of property taxes, improving transportation infrastructure, and ensuring better access to public services and broadband internet in rural areas. The motion emphasizes the need for an active role of the state in enhancing conditions for regional growth while addressing the challenges of depopulation and urbanization.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:176 Flexibilitet, omställningsförmåga och trygghet på arbetsmarknaden
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review and enhancement of Sweden's mineral policy to strengthen the mining industry. It calls for improved infrastructure to support mining needs, stable energy supply, augmented educational programs aligned with the industry, advancements in research and development, new measures to encourage mineral exploration, and simplified regulatory processes to facilitate mining operations. The motion emphasizes the importance of mining for the Swedish economy and seeks to reinforce its global competitiveness while addressing environmental and land use conflicts.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:174 Ett moderniserat konsumentskydd
summary: The motion proposes the modernization of copyright laws in Sweden to adapt to the digital age and ensure a balance between protecting creators' rights and promoting a free internet and expression. Key suggestions include assessing copyright terms, simplifying the legal availability of copyrighted works, examining the impact of stricter penalties for copyright infringement, and implementing more flexible limitations on copyright for private use and fair use, particularly in relation to artistic and critical expressions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:189 Ökad rättssäkerhet och snabbare verkställighet i internationella familjemål
summary: The motion proposes various measures aimed at reducing bureaucracy and regulatory burdens on Swedish businesses. Key recommendations include relocating the Regulatory Council to the Prime Minister's Office, instituting a stop function for regulations lacking sufficient impact assessments, and enhancing the use of the proportionality principle in regulatory analysis. The motion emphasizes the need for systematic efforts to alleviate administrative costs for companies, facilitate a more effective regulatory process, and potentially implement a post-payment requirement for supervision fees.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:188 Jämlika regler om föräldraskap i internationella situationer
summary: The motion discusses the need for improved government venture capital funding, prioritizing smaller, newly established growth companies and ensuring public funding does not compete with private venture capital. It proposes a comprehensive overview of business policy initiatives, evaluating public support for industries, and reducing the presence of 'grant entrepreneurs.' Furthermore, it advocates for a special fund for expansion loans in depopulated areas, enhancing employee stock options in startups, and increasing investor deductions to encourage investments in smaller firms. The proposal emphasizes the importance of evaluating the effectiveness of public funding to foster innovation and support economic growth.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:171 Tryggare bostadsrätt
summary: The proposal aims to improve conditions for small businesses in Sweden by addressing bureaucratic obstacles, reducing costs, and increasing support for entrepreneurship. Key recommendations include simplifying tax collection processes, introducing start-up grants, extending leave for entrepreneurial activities, and reviewing regulations that hinder small companies. Furthermore, it advocates for tax reductions, enhancing local training programs, and improving accessibility to public procurement for smaller enterprises, alongside measures to combat crime affecting business owners and enhance social security for self-employed individuals.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:188 Jämlika regler om föräldraskap i internationella situationer
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish government require municipalities and the state to disclose actual calculations and underlying data for the size of fees charged, as well as the costs associated with the services provided in exchange for these fees. The motion argues that many fees may not reflect the costs of the services they relate to, effectively acting as taxes instead. By mandating transparency in fee calculations and service provision, the proposal aims to ensure fair pricing and reduce potential abuse, ultimately contributing to a more self-regulating system.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:166 Genomförande av mobilitetspaketet
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the tax equalization system in Sweden to ensure fairer economic conditions for municipalities. It emphasizes the need for the state to compensate municipalities that require assistance without pitting them against each other, while also allowing the state to withhold equalization funds from those municipalities that fail to manage their finances responsibly. The goal is to eliminate perverse incentives created by the current system that reward poor financial governance and to refocus the equalization on factors municipalities cannot influence, like demographics and geographical challenges.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:184 Regional fysisk planering i Hallands län
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4517 av Momodou Malcolm Jallow m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes to make taxes visible on receipts for various consumed goods, including a breakdown of point taxes and subsidies, to enhance transparency for consumers. It suggests that by displaying the amount and nature of taxes and subsidies on receipts, individuals can better understand the cost they incur, promote fairness, and hold responsible parties accountable for budget management. Real-world comparisons, especially in healthcare and education, are highlighted as beneficial outcomes of this transparency.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:157 Tydligare krav på fristående förskolor, skolor och fritidshem med konfessionell inriktning
summary: The proposal for an 'Östlig förbindelse' emphasizes the importance of developing an eastern connection in the Stockholm region to alleviate severe traffic congestion caused by rapid population growth. It argues that while the project may initially increase carbon emissions, it would improve overall traffic flow, reduce travel times, and support sustainable urban development with eco-friendly public transport options. The proposed public funding is presented as a necessary investment to maintain Stockholm's growth and economic stability, allowing the city's residents to retain more of the value generated by their contributions to housing development.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:171 Tryggare bostadsrätt
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4515 av Momodou Malcolm Jallow m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should evaluate how the subjects of crafts, visual arts, music, and home economics can be modernized to better prepare students for the future job market. It emphasizes the need for a review of curricular content and teaching methods in these areas, advocating for a greater focus on contemporary tools and skills such as 3D printing, sound production, digital design, and personal finance, while also considering the integration of related disciplines to enhance educational effectiveness.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:174 Ett moderniserat konsumentskydd
summary: The motion proposed by Ida Drougge emphasizes the importance of introducing the 'Ung Företagsamhet' course in all Swedish upper secondary schools, allowing students the opportunity to learn about entrepreneurship and business operations hands-on. The course, tied to a non-profit educational organization, has been shown to significantly boost the entrepreneurial prospects and income of participants. However, participation rates vary widely across different programs and schools, necessitating efforts to ensure all students, regardless of their academic track, can access this valuable educational experience.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:162 Elevhälsa och stärkt utbildning för elever med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes to enhance public transport safety in Sweden by increasing police presence, potentially reintroducing specialized police units and prosecutors for graffiti crimes, and improving the use of surveillance technology to combat crime in public transport settings. It underscores the rising concerns about safety and criminality in society, stressing that insecurity limits personal freedom and leads to greater costs in safety measures and healthcare. The proposal suggests that re-establishing a dedicated police force for the subway and employing more technology could help mitigate the escalating crime rates and improve public confidence in using transportation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:159 Dimensionering av gymnasial utbildning för bättre kompetensförsörjning
summary: The suggestion proposes a review and alteration of the congestion tax regulations for residents of Ropsten and Lidingö, arguing that the current tax structure discourages public transport use due to high costs associated with parking and taking the subway. Furthermore, it advocates for exemptions from the congestion tax for those who park at Ropsten to switch to public transport, as well as for carpooling situations that do not contribute to congestion. The motion also references similar exemptions granted in Gothenburg and highlights that the issue has been deemed resolvable by relevant authorities, urging the government to reconsider its stance.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:168 En ökad differentiering av strandskyddet
summary: The motion proposes to investigate and suggest ways to make the Swedish tax system more transparent, emphasizing the importance of public awareness regarding the extent of taxes and their impact on personal finances. It suggests that making employer contributions more visible on pay slips and clearly labeling various taxes in public places can enhance tax awareness without imposing additional burdens on businesses. The motion references the Danish taxation model as an example and argues that a better understanding of taxes is essential for democracy.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:160 Skolans arbete med trygghet och studiero
summary: The proposal advocates for a transparent tax system in Sweden, suggesting that the government should require reporting of tax details by the state, municipalities, and regions. It highlights the lack of awareness among citizens regarding their tax payments and aims to enhance democratic engagement by making tax information accessible through personal bank accounts. The motion argues for a clearer understanding of taxation and its distribution, proposing that citizens should directly see how much tax they pay and how it is spent, potentially promoting accountability and informed public discourse.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:178 Barnets bästa när vård enligt LVU upphör – lex lilla hjärtat
summary: The motion advocates for the sale of Sveaskog, the state-owned company that is the largest forest owner in Sweden, as the author argues that the state should not operate in a competitive private market unless necessary. It suggests that sustainable forestry should be managed through legislation and oversight rather than through government ownership, proposing that the ownership of Sveaskog should be sold in smaller portions to enable private ownership.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:148 En ny växtskyddslag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament initiates an investigation into the possibility of converting employer contributions into income tax, aiming to enhance the visibility of this hidden tax for citizens. The author argues that employer contributions are significant and misleading as they are not clearly identifiable as taxes. Converting these contributions into income tax could make the tax system more transparent for workers by deducting it directly from salaries, thereby reflecting the true tax burden.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:166 Genomförande av mobilitetspaketet
summary: The motion proposes a review of current regulations regarding driving licenses that allow smaller, lighter cars with poorer braking systems to tow larger and heavier trailers than safer, larger vehicles. The motion argues that this situation is unsafe and encourages the use of older, less safe cars for towing, despite the advantages of larger vehicles. It suggests that the government should instruct the Transport Agency to explore allowing four-wheel drive and higher-capacity vehicles to tow heavier trailers, enhancing road safety.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:181 Justerade åldersgränser i pensionssystemet och i kringliggande system
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider allowing more than two legal guardians for children to reflect the modern family structures where many children grow up in multiple family settings. The motion highlights the challenges faced by additional caregivers in legally acting as guardians without undergoing adoption, which can be a complex and often undesirable process. The aim is to adapt legal frameworks to better match children's realities.

title: Insatser på plan- och byggområdet med anledning av invasionen av Ukraina
summary: The motion proposes that digital mass disturbances—defined as coordinated, anonymous online actions meant to harass, demean, or threaten individuals—should receive their own legal classification and associated penalties. It emphasizes the unique nature of online interactions, where anonymity can amplify harassment and hate speech, particularly against public figures. The motion argues for updating the legal framework to ensure that such digital offenses are treated with the same seriousness as similar actions in physical spaces.

title: Ändrade övergångsbestämmelser när det gäller medicintekniska produkter för in vitro-diagnostik
summary: The suggestion proposes a review of the political representation system in Sweden to address the issue of elected representatives who leave their parties during their mandate period. Currently, such representatives, known as 'political wanderers,' can remain in their positions and potentially represent another party, thereby disrupting the political balance established by the voters. The proposal emphasizes that mandates should be tied to the parties chosen by the citizens during elections, and if a representative leaves their party, their mandate should end.

title: Hårdare regler för nya nikotinprodukter
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should engage in global cooperation to reduce overfishing and advocate for a sustainable international fishing framework. It highlights the destructive impact of trawling on marine ecosystems, with specific emphasis on Chinese fishing practices that have severely depleted fish stocks in various regions. The motion calls for Sweden to take an active role within the European Union and other international bodies to promote responsible fishing practices and combat illegal fishing.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:153 Genomförande av elmarknadsdirektivet när det gäller nätverksamhet
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4505 av Arman Teimouri (L) och Carl-Oskar Bohlin (M)
summary: The motion suggests that sole proprietorships owned by real estate agents should only pay an annual fee to the Swedish Real Estate Agents Inspection (FMI) instead of incurring additional fees as a business. The proposal highlights the financial burden on small businesses due to duplicate fees for registration and emphasizes the importance of effective oversight of real estate practices to protect buyers and sellers. The motion advocates for a fairer regulatory approach for sole proprietors by exempting them from the business fee unless additional agents are employed.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:187 Genomförande av ändringar i direktivet om miljökrav vid upphandling av bilar och vissa kollektivtrafiktjänster
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4504 av Anders Åkesson och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes to redefine electric scooters as motorized vehicles rather than bicycles, thereby clarifying responsibilities for operation, parking, and storage. It seeks to empower municipalities to mandate approved parking spots for scooters, limit their numbers, and enhance user accountability through a registration or licensing system to reduce traffic violations and improve safety in urban environments.

title: Utvecklingen på it-området när det gäller integritet och ny teknik
summary: Hans Rothenberg's motion suggests that the Swedish parliament should endorse increased investments in the German language within the Swedish education system. The motion emphasizes Germany's significant role as Sweden's top export market and a leading industrial nation in Europe. It argues that enhancing German language skills is crucial for Sweden's competitiveness and cultural connections within Europe, particularly in light of Germany's status as the largest language in the EU following the UK's exit.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:135 Idéburen välfärd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take urgent action to reduce the long processing times at Lantmäteriet, responsible for land and property management, which currently can take up to a year for property division and up to a year and a half for fragmentation. These delays are seen as a hindrance to new construction in Sweden, where there is a significant housing shortage. The motion calls for an initiative to explore the inclusion of more operators in the sector to enhance efficiency and proposes legislation to establish processing times similar to those enforced on municipalities under the Planning and Building Act.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:135 Idéburen välfärd
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should review the supervision costs associated with service industries and unmanned stores to establish a differentiated fee structure. This is aimed at supporting smaller retailers in rural areas, which face increasing competition from larger shopping centers. The motion emphasizes the need for a policy that helps sustain local commerce and ensure that small shops can survive amidst changing shopping behaviors.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:135 Idéburen välfärd
summary: The motion proposes a review of career advancement opportunities for police officers in external service, highlighting the need for skilled officers to have pathways for promotion without being removed from fieldwork. It draws a parallel to the education sector, where systems allow teachers to advance while remaining engaged with students, suggesting similar opportunities for police to enhance visibility and specialization in their roles.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:153 Genomförande av elmarknadsdirektivet när det gäller nätverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the safety and security of individuals applying for protection hunting by allowing their personal information to be subject to voluntary confidentiality. This proposal highlights the increasing threats and harassment faced by these individuals, discouraging them from applying for protection hunting due to fear for their personal safety and that of their families and pets. The motion underscores the importance of protecting these applicants in their societal role, especially considering the rising violence from militant animal rights activists.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:150 Förbud mot utvinning av kol, olja och naturgas och skärpta regler för utvinning i alunskiffer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should reaffirm the importance of maintaining the municipal veto regarding wind power establishments, allowing local governments to have a say in developments that significantly impact their landscapes and environments. This proposal argues that the municipal veto is essential for local planning autonomy and protecting community interests from extensive environmental changes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:135 Idéburen välfärd
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4498 av Janine Alm Ericson m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should advocate within the EU to lift the prohibition on the trade of seal products, allowing Swedish seal hunters to sell seal meat, skins, and oil, which are currently prohibited. The author argues that it is both ethically wrong and a waste of resources to hunt seals without utilizing the animal, and that lifting the trade ban would help address resource management issues in the Baltic Sea while also enabling more people to access seal meat and products.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:153 Genomförande av elmarknadsdirektivet när det gäller nätverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports measures to expedite the processing of asylum cases, particularly for those applicants who commit crimes or misrepresent their age. It argues that a quicker handling of such cases would send a clear message about the responsibilities of asylum seekers and would alleviate the burden on social services, focusing resources on supporting genuinely vulnerable individuals.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:135 Idéburen välfärd
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament initiate an investigation to clarify how legislation allowing altruistic surrogacy can be implemented in Sweden. The motion emphasizes the importance of expanding opportunities for involuntarily childless individuals to become parents while ensuring that children's best interests are prioritized. It also highlights the ethical and legal complexities surrounding surrogacy and advocates for a careful, informed approach that respects individual autonomy and prevents coercion in decision-making.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:149 En effektivisering av byggnadsnämndens tillsyn
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider implementing a general permit requirement for both public and private providers conducting activities under education, social services, LSS (Act concerning Support and Service for Persons with Certain Functional Impairments), and healthcare legislation. The motion emphasizes the importance of equal access to high-quality welfare services regardless of individual circumstances, and advocates for transparency and oversight in the welfare system to ensure consistent quality standards across all service providers.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:153 Genomförande av elmarknadsdirektivet när det gäller nätverksamhet
summary: The proposal suggests amendments to the Social Services Act to allow municipalities to offer home care and other social services without the need for a means-tested assessment, following the streamlined application process used in Linköping. This would enable seniors and others to easily access necessary support services, thereby reducing barriers to assistance and improving service delivery across social welfare areas.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:155 In- och utpasseringskontroller vid högskoleprovet
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4493 av Ilona Szatmari Waldau m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal urges the government to ensure full funding for the Södertörn Link to improve traffic flows in southern Stockholm County. It highlights the increasing need for this infrastructure, which has been planned since the 1960s, due to growing populations and heavy transport traffic through residential areas. The motion advocates for swift governmental action to alleviate current traffic congestion and the related dangers to public safety.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:151 Genomförande av arbetsvillkorsdirektivet
summary: The motion proposes a fundamental reform of the Swedish school system by introducing a three-term structure instead of the current two-term system. The justification for this change is based on the negative impacts of long summer breaks, especially on children from disadvantaged socio-economic backgrounds, who may lack stimulating summer activities. The motion advocates for an investigation into the feasibility of this reform, citing examples from the British school system.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:135 Idéburen välfärd
summary: The motion proposes that all young people in Sweden should have the opportunity to learn more about personal finance, prompting the government to create possibilities for the inclusion of personal finance education in all forms of schooling. The motivation highlights a significant interest among high school students for increased personal finance education, citing research that shows many young people lack essential financial knowledge. The motion emphasizes the societal importance of equipping youth with financial skills to make informed decisions and avoid future debt.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:175 Genomförande av balansdirektivet
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to push for the abolition of the European Union's ban on the export of Swedish snus. Proponents argue that allowing snus exports would reduce tobacco-related deaths in Europe by offering a less harmful alternative to smoking, align with free trade principles, and could significantly boost Sweden's economy by increasing export revenues and job creation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:186 En stärkt rättsprocess och en ökad lagföring
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4489 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal suggests establishing a national council composed of experts to focus on exponential technologies and other critical technology areas. The motion emphasizes the rapid development of information-based technologies and their cumulative effects, advocating for a holistic approach to manage technological progress in sectors such as healthcare, energy, and education.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:180 Höjt bostadstillägg till pensionärer och höjt minimibelopp vid fastställande av avgifter enligt socialtjänstlagen
summary: The motion advocates for a growth-oriented industrial policy in Sweden, proposing the establishment of an industrial commission, a reorientation of energy policy, increased incentives for private investment in small businesses, and targeted support for industry in rural areas. It emphasizes the need for enhanced education in scientific subjects, the introduction of apprenticeships, and an increased focus on research aligned with industrial needs. Additionally, it calls for a reform of the tax system to improve international competitiveness, prioritization of industrial conditions in infrastructure planning, regulatory simplifications, and proactive assistance in environmental permitting processes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:182 Efterlevandestöd för barn som får vård eller boende bekostat av det allmänna
summary: The proposal presents a comprehensive strategy for Sweden's energy policy, emphasizing the need for a reliable and sustainable energy supply. It advocates for the removal of specific renewable energy targets in favor of a fossil-free goal, the promotion of nuclear energy, enhanced energy efficiency, and improved management of water and wind power resources. It also calls for increased regulatory efficiency in electricity infrastructure and reevaluation of market structures to ensure economic viability and environmental responsibility.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:149 En effektivisering av byggnadsnämndens tillsyn
summary: The motion outlines a proposal for Sweden's trade policy aimed at enhancing growth through increased market competition, non-distorting trade practices, and strengthened export capabilities. It emphasizes the importance of open and free trade, advocating for fair competition both domestically and globally, and encouraging trade agreements that prioritize Swedish economic growth. The motion also addresses the need for evaluating long-term import needs, scrutinizing foreign investments, and maintaining strong trade relations with key partners such as the EU, USA, and Taiwan, while opposing China's detrimental practices in international trade.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:151 Genomförande av arbetsvillkorsdirektivet
summary: The motion proposes a series of initiatives aimed at simplifying and expediting the environmental permitting process in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for proactive engagement from authorities to assist businesses in obtaining environmental permits, promoting the use of amendment permits as the default practice, and seeking early assessments of environmental impact reports. Additionally, it outlines the necessity for harmonizing Swedish environmental legislation with EU directives to avoid excessive regulatory burdens that could hinder industrial development. The motion addresses concerns related to lengthy permitting processes that affect various industries, particularly mining and energy, asserting that a more efficient system is crucial for sustainable economic growth.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:186 En stärkt rättsprocess och en ökad lagföring
summary: The motion proposes prioritizing Swedish basic industry in energy policy, improving conditions for the steel industry in infrastructure planning, enhancing educational efforts related to the industry's competency needs, directing funding towards metallurgical education and research, and expanding research and development within the steel industry. The document argues that Sweden's steel industry is crucial for the economy and must remain competitive through innovations, a robust energy policy, and well-planned infrastructure, especially regarding transportation and education for new technologies.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The sworn motion by the Sweden Democrats outlines several proposals aimed at combating crime directed at business owners, particularly in retail. It calls for easier access to permits for surveillance, an investigation into enhancing safety for shop owners, and a zero-tolerance policy against the misuse of shell companies. Other recommendations include establishing a government-administered warning list for fraudulent invoices, offering businesses support in contesting incorrect bills, and strengthening law enforcement measures against organized crime and theft related to businesses. The motion emphasizes the need for a more secure environment for entrepreneurs, particularly in high-crime areas, while seeking legislative changes to bolster cooperation among authorities in addressing these issues.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:195 Skärpt straff för gravfridsbrott
summary: The proposal from the Sweden Democrats aims to combat welfare fraud and inaccurate payments through several measures, including the implementation of biometric data for secure payment verification, the establishment of a new agency to prevent welfare fraud, and stronger consequences for severe fraud. The motion highlights the increasing rates of fraud and mistakes in welfare payments, emphasizing the need for tighter controls and resources to maintain public trust in the welfare system.

title: Betaltjänster – några förtydliganden
summary: The motion proposes several amendments to the support systems for individuals with disabilities and their caregivers, including extending transitional provisions for the change from disability compensation to cost compensation, incorporating assistance needs into compensation for adults with disabilities, adjusting the upper age limit for cost compensation, and increasing the possibilities for compensation for caregiving of relatives. It highlights the challenges faced during the transition due to long processing times and urges the government to ensure timely decisions and enhance legal security for those affected.

title: Ett års förlängd giltighetstid för undersökningstillstånd
summary: The proposal by the Sweden Democrats advocates for various reforms to enhance the pension system, aiming to provide a secure and dignified retirement for all individuals. Key suggestions include raising the basic pension guarantee, increasing contributions to pensions through changes in employer taxes, strengthening options for private pension savings, addressing gender disparities in pensions, and removing the recent pension age reforms. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring all pensioners live without financial stress, particularly women who often face lower pensions due to part-time work and caregiving responsibilities.

title: Effektivare verktyg i utsökningsförfarandet
summary: The suggestion from Sweden Democrats (SD) focuses on major reforms to create a more humane, secure, and flexible sickness insurance system centered on the individual. Key proposals include establishing a parliamentary committee to develop a long-term national strategy, enhancing the quality of investigations related to sick leave, tailoring the levels of sickness compensation to better fit individuals' needs, and preventing fraudulent claims. The motion emphasizes the need for improved rehabilitation support, particularly for individuals experiencing mental health issues, and advocates for a system that facilitates gradual return to work without arbitrary time limits or financial penalties for those affected by illness.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:132 Förskola för fler barn
summary: The motion by the Sweden Democrats focuses on creating a safe family policy that prioritizes children's needs, advocating for various reforms such as legal rights for both parents during maternity visits, an expanded and humane maternity benefit, a more tailored child allowance, and flexible parental insurance. The proposal also highlights the necessity to support single parents and first-time mothers while promoting financial security within families, aiming to reshape family policies for greater inclusivity and better economic situations for all families, particularly those with multiple children.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:132 Förskola för fler barn
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4480 av Fredrik Christensson och Niels Paarup-Petersen (båda C)
summary: This proposal suggests the establishment of an investigation into the current state of the work injury insurance system in Sweden, advocating for a review of existing regulations, particularly concerning illnesses due to infectious diseases and enhancing preventive workplace safety measures. It highlights the need for more accessible assessment processes, citing increased challenges in obtaining approvals for work-related injuries, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, and calls for reforms to ensure compensation and support for affected workers while considering the importance of gender parity in the workforce.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:162 Elevhälsa och stärkt utbildning för elever med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning
summary: The suggestion proposes to map and analyze the cost development of social insurance based on citizenship and to conduct an investigation into limiting residence-based benefits in social insurance to Swedish citizens and EU/EES citizens. The initiators argue that a strong link between citizenship and national identity is crucial for societal cohesion and that raising the requirements for citizenship would enhance its value. They express concerns about the financial burden of social insurance on third-country nationals and suggest that limiting these benefits could decrease immigration from those areas and improve labor market integration.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:132 Förskola för fler barn
summary: The motion aims to improve infrastructure in Halland by proposing the completion of the Västkustbanan railway with dual tracks, prioritizing various road and port infrastructure projects, and ensuring enhanced air traffic capacity. Key proposals include reinvestment in Halmstad–Nässjö railway and obtaining a fixed connection between Skåne and Själland, all intended to enhance transport efficiency, support regional growth, and promote sustainable transportation. The proposal emphasizes the national importance of Halland's infrastructure for economic competitiveness in Sweden.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:135 Idéburen välfärd
summary: The motion advocates for maintaining copper networks under state control until adequate alternatives for telecommunication and data transfer are fully operational. It emphasizes the importance of preserving essential infrastructure in both urban and rural areas, citing concerns about the premature dismantling of these networks and the insufficiency of existing mobile networks to serve all users adequately.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:132 Förskola för fler barn
summary: The motion addresses the detrimental effects of public entities engaging in commercial activities that compete with private businesses. It calls on the government to acknowledge the need for policies to guide municipalities, regions, and authorities in conducting their operations, ensuring that competition remains fair and not hindered by public sector involvement. The motion emphasizes the economic risks faced by private companies compared to public entities that can cover deficits using taxpayer money.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:132 Förskola för fler barn
summary: The motion proposes lowering the age of criminal responsibility in Sweden to better protect children from being recruited into criminal groups and to strengthen the societal response to serious crimes committed by younger individuals. The author argues that the current age threshold of 15 years is outdated and does not reflect modern societal challenges, as younger individuals are increasingly involved in serious criminal activities. The motion emphasizes the need for legislative action to adapt to these changes and enhance public safety.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:150 Förbud mot utvinning av kol, olja och naturgas och skärpta regler för utvinning i alunskiffer
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to take urgent action to retrieve children who have been taken abroad and are at risk of being subjected to forced marriages or honor-related oppression. It highlights the lack of adequate tracking of missing children during summer vacations and the need for a comprehensive annual report from municipalities. The proposal includes increasing penalties and enabling travel restrictions for children suspected of facing honor-related crimes, while strongly urging the government to allocate necessary resources to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to facilitate the repatriation of affected children living in harmful conditions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:150 Förbud mot utvinning av kol, olja och naturgas och skärpta regler för utvinning i alunskiffer
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of addressing involuntary loneliness, particularly among the elderly, and proposes measures to increase social interaction through more meeting places and opportunities for shared meals. It highlights that involuntary loneliness can lead to deteriorating health conditions and stresses the need for social activities and outreach initiatives, drawing inspiration from successful strategies implemented in the UK.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:195 Skärpt straff för gravfridsbrott
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4472 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes the abolition of the advertising tax on analog outdoor advertising, arguing that the current taxation creates unfair competition between different forms of advertising. The author points out that digital signs are tax-exempt while analog outdoor advertising is subject to a tax of 7.65%. This discrepancy is seen as detrimental to infrastructure investments funded by outdoor advertising, which could ultimately save taxpayers money. The motion calls for the Riksdag to support the idea of abolishing this tax and to communicate this to the government.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:115 Verksamheten i Europeiska unionen under 2021
summary: The motion proposes the development of a national agenda for the Öresund region to enhance integration between Sweden and Denmark, highlighting the region's economic significance and the need to address existing barriers that hinder movement and collaboration. It emphasizes the importance of cooperation in areas such as job creation, education, security, and growth, while also calling for legislative harmonization and improved communication for citizens of both countries.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:151 Genomförande av arbetsvillkorsdirektivet
summary: The motion suggests that Swedish authorities should be decentralized from major cities to ensure a presence throughout the country, asserting that this would help retain young, educated individuals in rural and less populated areas. It criticizes the current government efforts as insufficient and emphasizes the need for well-functioning agencies to remain and develop outside urban centers to prevent further rural depopulation and imbalance between urban and rural regions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:183 Registrering av kontantkort – förbättrad tillgång till uppgifter för brottsbekämpande myndigheter
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4469 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: Lars Püss (M) proposes that the Swedish parliament hold Trafikverket accountable for its repeated failures to adhere to budget limits and improve cost estimations for large infrastructure projects. The motion highlights past instances of significant budget overruns as documented by the National Audit Office and calls for political measures to address Trafikverket's ongoing dysfunction and improve its operational effectiveness.

title: Stärkt rätt till personlig assistans – grundläggande behov för personer som har en psykisk funktionsnedsättning och ökad rättssäkerhet för barn
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to actively work on reducing both national and global antibiotic resistance, emphasizing the urgent need to combat this growing health crisis which currently leads to hundreds of thousands of deaths annually. It highlights the importance of international cooperation and the necessity for a comprehensive global surveillance program to monitor antibiotic resistance, particularly as Sweden has historically played a leading role in this area.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:150 Förbud mot utvinning av kol, olja och naturgas och skärpta regler för utvinning i alunskiffer
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4468 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes to facilitate deeper collaboration between student health services, child and adolescent psychiatry (BUP), and social services to address the increasing mental health issues among young people aged 10-17. The current long waiting times for assistance from BUP are highlighted as a significant concern. The Moderates party emphasizes the role of schools in early intervention and preventive measures against mental health issues, advocating for uniform definitions and guidelines to improve cooperation among involved parties.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:150 Förbud mot utvinning av kol, olja och naturgas och skärpta regler för utvinning i alunskiffer
summary: The motion proposes measures for sustainable fishing in the Stockholm region, advocating for the relocation of the trawling limit to twelve nautical miles from the Swedish coast to protect essential fish stocks like herring and pike. It highlights the ecological and economic challenges posed by large-scale industrial fishing and suggests a shift towards small-scale coastal fishing, which could yield significant economic benefits while promoting marine biodiversity.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:147 Ursprungsgarantier – genomförande av det omarbetade förnybartdirektivet
summary: This motion proposes that women experiencing perinatal psychosis or severe postpartum depression should receive specialized care in dedicated 'mother-baby units' rather than standard psychiatric facilities. It calls for an investigation to assess the care these women and their infants currently receive and urges the National Board of Health and Welfare to support regional efforts in providing appropriate care. The motion highlights existing shortcomings in maternal mental health care, stressing the need for a system that allows mothers to stay with their infants during treatment, thereby improving recovery outcomes.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2022 - Åtgärder för att stärka rikets militära försvar och kompensation till hushållen för höga elpriser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate and map how to equalize funding support between girl-dominated and boy-dominated sports activities. It emphasizes that girls generally receive less funding than boys for sports and physical activities, and encourages an examination of how community support for sports meets the preferences of both genders more equitably. The motion points out that certain activities favored by girls, such as dance and gymnastics, are often underfunded compared to those preferred by boys, like football and ice hockey.

title: En samlad strategi för alkohol-, narkotika-, dopnings- och tobakspolitiken samt spel om pengar 2022–2025
summary: The proposal suggests introducing a citizen proposal right (folkmotion) to the Swedish Parliament and local governance bodies, allowing citizens to influence political decisions more directly between elections. The motion highlights the need for a governmental investigation to develop the mechanism for implementing this citizen proposal right, while also advocating for the removal of the existing citizen proposal system in local law. The goal is to enhance democratic engagement and responsiveness by enabling citizens to submit motions with support from a certain percentage of voters.

title: Stärkt rätt till skadestånd för brottsoffer
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of high-speed train connections between Oslo, Gothenburg, and Copenhagen, urging the Swedish Parliament to support integrating these routes into the EU's TEN-T network. The motion emphasizes the importance of efficient, environmentally-friendly transportation links for economic growth and calls for a thorough analysis of the feasibility for double tracks along this railway route. It argues that improved train connectivity would enhance regional development and reduce economic vulnerability, particularly for the western Swedish labor market.

title: Ändrade transparensregler inom energibeskattningen
summary: The motion proposes to prohibit conversion therapy practices aimed at changing the sexual orientation or gender identity of LGBTQ+ individuals, affirming that such practices are damaging and ineffective as recognized by various health organizations. It suggests criminalizing these therapy practices and withdrawing state funding from organizations that perform or promote conversion therapy. The motion emphasizes the importance of protecting LGBTQ+ individuals, particularly youth from conservative backgrounds, and aligns Sweden with other nations that have already implemented such bans.

title: Ett nytt mål för Sjätte AP-fondens placeringsverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish curriculum should include education about the Seyfo genocide, which occurred during the collapse of the Ottoman Empire, resulting in the deaths of over one million Armenians, Pontic Greeks, and Assyrians/Syrians. It emphasizes the importance of recognizing this historical event to understand its implications for modern history and the persecution of minorities, comparably significant to the Holocaust. The motion argues that awareness and acknowledgment of Seyfo are crucial for education, reconciliation, and the promotion of democracy.

title: Ökad kontroll vid verkställighet av fängelse med fotboja
summary: The motion proposes relocating the Swedish Chemical Agency from Sundbyberg, Stockholm, to Gothenburg to enhance the regional presence of government authorities and leverage the existing expertise in the chemical sector within the city. The authors argue that this move would benefit both Gothenburg's labor market and the agency itself, providing a greater base of competence and wider networks while addressing the current imbalance of public agencies concentrated in Stockholm.

title: Skärpt straff för gravfridsbrott
summary: The proposal advocates for a new initiative named after Selma Lagerlöf to enhance the quality of textbooks in Swedish schools. It calls for a national competition inviting prominent authors to develop new, inspiring textbooks across various subjects for different educational levels, emphasizing the importance of good learning materials in fostering students' desire to learn. The initiative seeks government funding but aims for the execution to maintain distance from direct political influence, potentially through an academic institution or teachers' unions.

title: Ett modernare straffrättsligt skydd mot hemfridsbrott och olaga intrång
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament mandates that the responsibility for ongoing assessment of Swedish for immigrants (SFI) students lies with the municipalities, and this should be included in the Education Act. Additionally, the motion calls for the Swedish National Agency for Education to develop course plans for sign language education for second language teachers within adult education. This initiative aims to address the needs of SFI students who have hearing impairments, ensuring they receive proper screenings and educational support, as well as providing structured sign language courses to facilitate their learning and integration into society.

title: Tillfälligt omhändertagande av villkorligt frigivna och skyddstillsynsdömda
summary: The proposal suggests allowing temporary exceptions to the Swedish shoreline protection law to facilitate events, as highlighted by the experience of Kristianstad, which needs such flexibility for a major sports event that attracts around 100,000 participants.
