The motion emphasizes the importance of balancing the necessity of shoreline protection with the need for public access and the facilitation of outdoor and health-promoting activities, advocating for amendments that allow for temporary permits without compromising the environment during high-density usage times.

title: Skärpta straff för knivbrott
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a new power inquiry to analyze changes in power dynamics in Swedish society since the turn of the millennium, particularly in light of the pandemic's impacts on governance and democracy. It highlights concerns about the potential long-term effects of governmental powers exercised during the pandemic and emphasizes the need for a thorough examination of who holds power and how it is distributed in an increasingly globalized and digital world.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om bosättningslagen
summary: The motion proposes the creation of a white paper detailing the historical treatment of LGBTQ+ individuals in Sweden, similar to past efforts regarding the treatment of Roma. It aims to address the state-sanctioned oppression faced by LGBTQ+ people, from criminalization of same-sex acts to restrictions on gender identity. The author argues that this initiative would enhance understanding of the fight for LGBTQ+ rights in Sweden and reposition the country as a global advocate for these rights.

title: Åtgärder mot fusk vid förarprov och mot illegal utbildningsverksamhet på transportområdet
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government assign the authority 'Forum för levande historia' to assist municipalities interested in establishing 'snubbelstenar' (stumbling stones) to honor victims of Nazism. It highlights the importance of documenting the historical presence of the victims to ensure proper placement of these memorial stones, and underscores the role of the agency in promoting democracy, tolerance, and human rights.

title: Ökad rättssäkerhet och snabbare verkställighet i internationella familjemål
summary: The motion proposes the repeal of the law prohibiting advertising for infant formula and supplement nutrition. The author argues that the existing restrictions on marketing infringe on freedom of expression and do not account for parents who cannot breastfeed due to medical reasons. Allowing advertising would enable parents to make informed choices about infant nutrition without government interference, ensuring that companies can reach consumers who are interested in these products.

title: Jämlika regler om föräldraskap i internationella situationer
summary: Robert Hannah proposes that Sweden should advocate for the establishment of a UN convention on cyber warfare to protect individuals, businesses, and states from cyber attacks both in peacetime and wartime, emphasizing the need for clear rules and safeguarding of civil rights against the misuse of cyber capabilities.

title: En stärkt rättsprocess och en ökad lagföring
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to establish new authorities outside of the Stockholm region, specifically advocating for more government agencies to be located in other metropolitan areas like Gothenburg and Malmö. It highlights the disproportionate concentration of agencies in Stockholm, which limits opportunities for qualified personnel in other regions and calls for a more equitable distribution of government jobs across the country.

title: Sekretess för ljuddämpare
summary: The motion advocates for the protection of individual privacy in online data collection, urging the Swedish Parliament to increase penalties for companies that improperly gather personal information. It emphasizes the need for stronger data protection laws, ensuring that consumers have control over their personal data, can make informed choices about data sharing, and are able to access and delete their information easily. The proposal highlights the importance of safeguarding privacy rights in the digital age.

title: Regional fysisk planering i Hallands län
summary: The suggestion advocates for Sweden to prioritize the survival of religious minorities in the Middle East as a key foreign policy issue. It calls for action through the EU, UN, and other international organizations to ensure the protection and rights of these groups, highlighting the historical context of religious diversity in the region and the increasing intolerance and persecution faced by minorities such as Christians, Yazidis, and others over the last century.

title: Registrering av kontantkort – förbättrad tillgång till uppgifter för brottsbekämpande myndigheter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament prioritize the modernization of the Kinnekullebanan railway line, which is over 100 years old and currently has inadequate safety and operational standards. The modernization would improve the line's condition and significantly alleviate congestion on the Västra stambanan, enhancing communication between Sweden's two largest cities, Stockholm and Gothenburg, and improving train connections in western Sweden.

title: Efterlevandestöd för barn som får vård eller boende bekostat av det allmänna
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament establish a national memorial day on April 24 to commemorate the Seyfo/Armenian genocide, similar to the observance in France since 2019. The motion highlights the importance of acknowledging this historical event, particularly in light of Turkey's ongoing denial of the genocide, and points out that this day has been chosen by the affected communities for annual commemorations.

title: Justerade åldersgränser i pensionssystemet och i kringliggande system
summary: Robert Hannah proposes that Landvetter Airport be renamed to Landvetter Torgny Segerstedt Airport, arguing that this would honor the legacy of the influential journalist Torgny Segerstedt, who was known for his courageous stance against totalitarianism and his advocacy for individual freedom. The proposal emphasizes the importance of remembering historical figures who have fought against oppression, especially in light of rising xenophobia and right-wing extremism today.

title: Höjt bostadstillägg till pensionärer och höjt minimibelopp vid fastställande av avgifter enligt socialtjänstlagen
summary: The proposal suggests simplifying the regulations for restaurant alcohol serving rights, arguing that the existing laws impose excessive requirements on restaurant owners that do not align with modern dining experiences. The motion emphasizes that state control over food offerings should be minimal and that basic food service should suffice for alcohol service.

title: Ett bättre premiepensionssystem
summary: Robert Hannah from the Liberal Party proposes the abolition of the candidate thresholds in personal elections for the Swedish Parliament, municipal councils, regional councils, and the European Parliament. The current thresholds require candidates to receive a minimum of 5% of their party's votes in their electoral district to be eligible for election through personal votes. Hannah argues that this system limits the power of individual voters and the independence of elected representatives, suggesting that removing these barriers would empower the electorate and promote independent thinking among politicians.

title: Flexibilitet, omställningsförmåga och trygghet på arbetsmarknaden
summary: The motion advocates for the protection of consumer rights to pay with cash and the ability of businesses to handle cash, emphasizing the challenges faced by rural areas and the archipelago. It highlights the importance of cash in a digitized society, especially for individuals without internet access or banking options. The proposal suggests that regulations regarding cash withdrawal and deposit locations should account for geographical challenges to ensure equitable access for all, particularly in remote areas.

title: Genomförande av balansdirektivet
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of agricultural land and food security in the Stockholm region, which faces challenges due to limited agricultural output and increasing urbanization. It advocates for recognizing and incorporating the significance of agriculture in municipal planning processes and suggests conducting a trial of substitute services for farmers to enhance their social security and attract younger individuals to the profession. By implementing these measures, the motion aims to address the region's vulnerability regarding food supply and sustain local agricultural production amidst growing competition for land use.

title: Ett moderniserat konsumentskydd
summary: This motion emphasizes the importance of the horse industry in the Stockholm region, highlighting its contributions to open landscapes, employment, public health, and youth activities. It advocates for the horse industry to be treated similarly to other agricultural sectors to facilitate its development, including proposals for compensation for landscape maintenance and improved regulations for horse manure management. The motion also calls for collaboration between authorities and the horse industry to address environmental challenges.

title: Ändrad nedsättning av förmånsvärdet för miljöanpassade bilar
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment and improvement of the system for guardians assigned to unaccompanied minors in the asylum process in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for timely appointments of guardians, who should represent the children's legal interests and ensure their rights are upheld according to both national and international regulations, including the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The motion calls for clearer guidelines and regulations regarding the roles and responsibilities of guardians to ensure a swift and effective process for these vulnerable children.

title: Nya regler om informationsutbyte om brottmålsdomar i EU
summary: The motion proposes renaming Arlanda Airport to Raoul Wallenberg Airport to honor the legacy of Wallenberg, a prominent figure known for his humanitarian efforts during World War II, particularly for saving thousands of Hungarian Jews from the Holocaust. Renaming the airport is argued to be a way to commemorate Wallenberg's impact on humanity and to promote themes of solidarity, openness, and tolerance in the face of rising anti-immigrant sentiments in Europe. The motion emphasizes the importance of remembering individuals who made significant contributions to humanity and suggests that the airport's name would serve as a global symbol of Wallenberg's heroism.

title: Tryggare bostadsrätt
summary: The motion proposes to limit the financial support provided to the Swedish royal family, specifically by reducing the apanage and establishing clear regulations on its distribution. It suggests exploring the possibility of granting the head of state a salary equivalent to that of the Prime Minister instead of an apanage system, arguing that taxpayers' money would be better spent on social services rather than royal expenses.

title: Sveriges ordförandeskap i Organisationen för säkerhet och samarbete i Europa (OSSE) under 2021
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the elimination of preliminary taxation for businesses, suggesting that companies should be taxed based on actual income rather than estimated income. The author argues that this change would bring clarity for both businesses and authorities, reduce bureaucracy and administrative costs for taxpayers, and make the tax system more functional during crises, such as the recent pandemic, when many businesses suffered significant income losses.

title: Kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om återhämtning och resolution av centrala motparter
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to investigate whether same-sex couples face discrimination from Swedish adoption agencies during the adoption application process. Additionally, it calls for the government to ensure that adoption agencies facilitate adoptions from countries that legally accept same-sex couples as adoptive parents. The motion argues that, despite the legal right to adopt, same-sex couples are often unfairly prioritized behind heterosexual couples in practice, limiting their opportunities to adopt.

title: En ökad differentiering av strandskyddet
summary: The proposal advocates for raising the minimum penalty for possession of hand grenades, arguing that they should be classified as weapons rather than explosives due to their dangerous nature and increasing illegal use among criminals. The motion seeks to eliminate fines from the penalty framework, emphasizing that the current low penalties do not effectively deter criminal activity involving these weapons and calling for a legislative response that reflects the seriousness of the issue.

title: Straffbestämmelser till EU:s förordning om fartygsåtervinning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for preventive measures in areas classified as risk zones, highlighting the ongoing issues of serious crime, silence culture, and elements of extremism in these neighborhoods. There is concern that the number of such areas is not decreasing, and that the police's current resource allocation may overlook emerging risk areas. The suggestion advocates for a comprehensive approach where police collaborate closely with municipalities to address these challenges and work towards preventing crime and social exclusion.

title: Genomförande av mobilitetspaketet
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for quality assessment and oversight of police education in Sweden, advocating for a review of the curriculum and admission requirements to ensure high standards. The proposal suggests that instead of lowering entry requirements to attract more students, efforts should be made to enhance the attractiveness of the policing profession to draw the right candidates. The motion calls for the government to take responsibility for this oversight, ensuring consistent quality across various educational institutions offering police training.

title: En skyldighet att lämna uppgifter till Institutet för mänskliga rättigheter
summary: The proposal calls for increased powers for municipalities to intervene in environmentally hazardous waste management, addressing issues where non-compliant companies exploit loopholes to transfer waste between municipalities, thereby prolonging unauthorized storage periods. This is cited as a significant environmental concern, as well as being linked to organized crime in waste management. The motion suggests a review and development of municipalities' regulatory tools to ensure stricter management of waste storage and movement to protect the environment and public health.

title: Bättre villkor för kommersiell radio
summary: The motion from Malin Danielsson emphasizes the need to improve the conditions for individuals with visual impairments to use guide dogs in more situations. It highlights the freedom that guide dogs provide and points out the discrimination faced by guide dog users in accessing various public places. The proposal calls for legislative action to strengthen these rights and ensure better accessibility for guide dog handlers in society.

title: Elevhälsa och stärkt utbildning för elever med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes investments in infrastructure to accommodate the strong growth in Södertörn, focusing on the construction of the Tvärförbindelse Södertörn, a new road passage over the Södertälje Canal, and the establishment of a transit hub at Flemingsberg. The motion highlights the necessity for improved transport solutions in the region to support both business expansion and sustainable transport initiatives, focusing on enhancing traffic safety and efficiency for heavy goods and public transportation.

title: Ökad likvärdighet för skolhuvudmän
summary: The motion proposes designating Stockholm as the national innovation area to foster greater flexibility in regulations for urban development, infrastructure, and adult education, thus promoting innovation and sustainability in the region. It emphasizes the need for pilot projects in adult education, infrastructure assessments, and sustainable management of marine resources, while advocating for a cohesive digital infrastructure to support welfare services. The proposal aims to enhance the city's attractiveness for high-skilled professionals by reforming immigration laws and addressing housing needs, ultimately contributing to the economic growth and global competitiveness of Stockholm.

title: Skolans arbete med trygghet och studiero
summary: This parliamentary motion calls for increased research and development of a comprehensive aftercare program for women following pregnancy and childbirth. It emphasizes the need to address injuries sustained during childbirth that may lead to long-term health issues, such as rectus diastasis, and advocates for standard ultrasound examinations to detect these conditions. The motion also highlights the lack of statistical data on such injuries due to missing diagnoses in medical registries, urging the government to investigate the development of a more robust follow-up care system.

title: Dimensionering av gymnasial utbildning för bättre kompetensförsörjning
summary: The motion calls for the establishment of a truth commission and an official apology from the Swedish state for the abuses that occurred at Vipeholm Hospital, highlighting the dark history of certain groups suffering under the concept of 'the people's home'. The proposal emphasizes the importance of recognizing these historical injustices to honor the victims and prevent similar future abuses in collectivist projects.

title: Ett mer likvärdigt skolval
summary: The motion advocates for measures to facilitate access to banking services for non-profit organizations, highlighting the difficulties that both newly established and existing local associations face when trying to open bank accounts. It stresses the need for clearer guidelines for banks, given the variability in the statutes of non-profits, and calls on the government to address the banking sector's lack of interest in serving these organizations effectively.

title: Tydligare krav på fristående förskolor, skolor och fritidshem med konfessionell inriktning
summary: The motion proposes the investigation of a repair deduction (REP-avdrag) aimed at making repairs more affordable compared to buying new items. The intention is to foster a circular economy by discouraging a throwaway culture and encouraging manufacturers to produce durable products. By making repairs cheaper, it is expected to benefit small businesses and could also facilitate demands on manufacturers to provide reasonably priced spare parts.

title: Resursskolor och tilläggsbelopp för särskilt stöd
summary: The proposal suggests the introduction of a tax-exempt home office allowance, known as 'jobbahemmabidrag', to support employees working from home post-pandemic. This financial support would encourage ergonomic improvements in home workspaces, thereby preventing work-related injuries and promoting public health. The proposed allowance would be capped at 10,000 SEK every three years to assist with the purchase of items like office chairs and adjustable desks.

title: In- och utpasseringskontroller vid högskoleprovet
summary: The motion aims to support the restaurant industry by proposing the allowance of insignificant alcohol serving to the public without strict regulations, the elimination of requirements for food service in alcohol-serving establishments, and the removal of restrictions on operating hours in the alcohol law. It argues that these changes would reduce bureaucratic barriers, enhance profitability, and contribute to a more vibrant nightlife while having minimal impact on public health and safety.

title: Innebörden av begreppet helt försäkringsbestånd
summary: This motion proposes the introduction of sunset clauses for surveillance camera operations in order to ensure that any monitoring of individuals is justified by clear evidence of its effectiveness. It argues that current surveillance methods compromise individual privacy and that their supposed benefits, such as crime reduction, have been largely unproven. The motion advocates for the regulation of camera surveillance to ensure it is conducted in a legally sound manner, requiring periodic review of its necessity and effectiveness.

title: En ny växtskyddslag
summary: The proposal advocates for transferring the regulation of smoking restrictions to municipalities, arguing that the current national smoking ban has disproportionately affected restaurant owners and undermines individual freedom. It suggests that local authorities should make decisions based on specific community needs rather than a one-size-fits-all national law. The motion emphasizes the need for regulatory simplifications to support the struggling restaurant industry post-pandemic, while also highlighting the ineffectiveness and economic impact of the existing smoking ban.

title: Värdlandsavtal mellan Sverige och Internationella vaccininstitutet
summary: The suggestion advocates for the reintroduction of previous blood alcohol concentration limits for boating, arguing that the current laws are overly restrictive compared to other countries like Norway and Finland, which maintain lower limits while experiencing fewer accidents. It calls for the government to reconsider the current maritime alcohol regulations, emphasizing the need for evaluation and potential amendments.

title: Barnets bästa när vård enligt LVU upphör – lex lilla hjärtat
summary: Lina Nordquist proposes an examination of the property tax system for hydropower in Sweden, arguing that while hydropower is a renewable energy source, its historical exploitation has resulted in significant local environmental damage. The motion suggests that part of the revenue from this tax, which currently goes to the central government, should be returned to the municipalities affected by hydropower operations to compensate for negative impacts on local industries such as tourism, fishing, agriculture, reindeer husbandry, and forestry.

title: Sammanhållen vård- och omsorgsdokumentation
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government evaluate the costs associated with wildlife damage caused by predators and explore a new compensation model for farmers and dog owners affected by these damages. The motion emphasizes the need for equitable management of compensation applications across the country, particularly highlighting the challenges faced by farmers during the pandemic. It calls for state responsibility in addressing these costs related to state-managed wildlife.

title: Genomförande av ändringar i direktivet om miljökrav vid upphandling av bilar och vissa kollektivtrafiktjänster
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should call on the government to review the regulations surrounding the immediate seizure of animals in urgent situations, emphasizing the need to reinstate a previous provision from the old animal welfare ordinance, which allowed authorities to act promptly even if decisions were under appeal. The removal of this provision in the new animal welfare ordinance has led to complications and increased costs for individuals and entities involved in animal care, negatively affecting animal protection in the country.

title: Genomförande av elmarknadsdirektivet när det gäller nätverksamhet
summary: The motion proposes a review of the responsibility for school transportation for children whose guardians live in different municipalities. It highlights that current regulations are rigid and often do not accommodate the rights of children to access school from both parental homes, especially when these homes are near municipal borders. The proposal advocates for a more flexible approach that allows for school transportation from locations close to municipal boundaries, ensuring that children's rights to education are upheld.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:144 Riksrevisionens rapport om svenskt bistånd till multilaterala organisationer
summary: The motion proposes to review the possibilities of allowing seasonal residents in Sweden to pay taxes in the municipalities where they spend part of the year, addressing the fiscal challenges faced by these communities. It highlights the current tax system's inadequacies in reflecting the actual residency and demographic changes driven by seasonal living arrangements, which often burden local services and infrastructure without adequate compensation. The authors suggest that residents could pay taxes in more than one locality, ensuring that communities with significant seasonal populations receive appropriate revenue to support the necessary services and infrastructure.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:144 Riksrevisionens rapport om svenskt bistånd till multilaterala organisationer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament allows the county administrative boards to decide that the skin of animals hunted during protective hunting should be given to the hunting rights holder, similar to regulations under licensed hunting. This change aims to acknowledge the efforts and risks taken by hunters during protective hunting while noting that the county boards generally have no interest in the skins of hunted large predators.

title: Genomförande av arbetsvillkorsdirektivet
summary: Nina Lundström of the Liberal Party proposes the development of a 'demokratikanon', a collection of important texts and ideas that have shaped Swedish democracy, to be created by a group of experts from various fields. This initiative aims to enhance understanding of democratic values, human rights, and the historical struggles for equality and freedom, particularly in light of the upcoming centenary of women's suffrage in Sweden. The proposal emphasizes the importance of educating future generations and new citizens about the foundational ideas of democracy and warns against the rise of anti-democratic forces worldwide.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:133 En samlad straffrättslig terrorismlagstiftning
summary: This motion by Nina Lundström proposes several changes to traffic regulations to improve cycling safety and efficiency in Sweden. Key proposals include allowing right turns at red lights for cyclists, implementing all-green traffic signals for cyclists at intersections, regulating the use of e-scooters on designated bike paths, and using colored pavement on bike lanes to enhance visibility and awareness among all road users. The motion emphasizes the need for the government to clarify legal matters surrounding these proposals to enhance traffic safety.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:131 Nytt regelverk för kvalificerade säkerhetsärenden
summary: The motion advocates for improved access to land for bicycle infrastructure by revising current laws and regulations that limit the construction of cycling paths. It emphasizes the need for a functional connection between bicycle routes and existing roadways, the necessity of establishing cycling paths alongside two-plus-one roads, and promoting combined travel solutions involving cycling and public transport, particularly in regions with lower population density. The proposal calls for the government to take action in facilitating these changes for enhanced cycling infrastructure and sustainable mobility.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support government actions to ensure access to high-speed broadband for all residents in the Stockholm region. It emphasizes the need for coordinated efforts to overcome barriers to cost-effective broadband expansion, strengthen the role of consumers, and improve collaboration among state, municipalities, and regions to address geographical challenges in access to broadband services. The motion also highlights the importance of a reliable digital infrastructure for fostering growth and maintaining competitiveness in digital services across urban and rural areas.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:128 Nya regler för organdonation
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the need for a strategy to reduce the wild boar population in the Stockholm region, which is reportedly increasing by 25-30% annually. The motion emphasizes the damage caused by wild boars to agriculture and traffic safety and suggests that hunters should be incentivized to manage the population effectively. It also raises concerns about the potential spread of African swine fever and advocates for preventive measures and a system for reporting damage caused by wild boars.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:111 Mer tid till lärande – extra studietid och utökad lovskola
summary: The motion proposes a review of the 1963 law concerning the abolition of fideicommiss, with a focus on eliminating the extension of the fideicommiss certificate and other associated provisions. The motion argues that fideicommiss creates problematic inheritance distributions and perpetuates advantages for certain family members, particularly male heirs. It highlights the need for legislative change to accelerate the dissolution of existing fideicommisses to enhance property development opportunities, especially in areas like the archipelago, and to ensure fair inheritance practices.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:125 Val och beslut i kommuner och regioner
summary: The motion proposes to amend existing legislation to allow the conversion of rental apartments into owner-occupied apartments (ägarlägenheter) during renovations. It recommends repealing the requirement for a minimum of three apartments to establish ownership and argues that such changes are necessary to increase the variety of housing options and enhance consumer choice in the rental market, which is currently dominated by large property management companies.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:131 Nytt regelverk för kvalificerade säkerhetsärenden
summary: The motion calls on the Swedish Riksdag to support the protection of women's freedom and their right to sexual and reproductive health, emphasizing the importance of accessible and safe abortion services both domestically and internationally. It highlights the global threats to women's rights, including restrictive abortion laws in various countries and the need for Sweden to adopt a feminist foreign policy to advocate for these rights worldwide. The motion critiques current debates in Sweden regarding the right to refuse participation in abortion procedures by healthcare personnel, framing it as a significant step back for women's rights.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:133 En samlad straffrättslig terrorismlagstiftning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support efforts to enhance traffic safety measures on Route 225 in Stockholm County, in light of increased traffic due to the development of the Norvik port. The motion highlights the anticipated rise in heavy truck transport and the current inadequacies of the road infrastructure, which poses risks to pedestrians and cyclists, particularly children accessing bus stops and schools. It emphasizes the need for immediate action and better planning for national infrastructure to accommodate this increase in traffic.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:139 Stärkt integritet i idrottens antidopningsarbete
summary: The motion addresses the environmental responsibilities of hydropower in relation to biodiversity and fish migration routes. It calls on the Swedish Parliament to acknowledge the environmental effects of hydropower and advocate for measures that protect biodiversity, in accordance with EU water directives. The proposal emphasizes the need for an evaluation of the National Prpvision Plan for hydropower and suggests that while hydropower is an essential renewable energy source, its current environmental impact must be critically assessed to ensure sustainable practices moving forward.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:133 En samlad straffrättslig terrorismlagstiftning
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of the territorial principle alongside the current right of blood (hereditary principle) in determining citizenship for children born in Sweden. It argues that children born and raised in Sweden should automatically receive Swedish citizenship, aligning with the principle of the child's best interests, rather than basing their citizenship solely on their parents' nationality. This would enhance equal rights and opportunities for all children born in Sweden.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:138 Ett särskilt brott för hedersförtryck
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the initiative to halt industrial trawling at Svenska Högarna and work towards relocating the trawling border further out to twelve nautical miles from the coast. This is aimed at protecting the area's marine environment, which is recognized as a nature reserve and is subject to various environmental protection laws and international conventions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:131 Nytt regelverk för kvalificerade säkerhetsärenden
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of protecting urban forests in the Stockholm region for air quality, climate change mitigation, and biodiversity conservation. It outlines the need for government intervention to safeguard valuable forests, implement protective measures against pests like the spruce bark beetle, and promote public access to natural areas for recreation and health benefits. The motion calls for clearer governmental actions regarding forest management and the responsibilities of landowners in addressing pest invasions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:133 En samlad straffrättslig terrorismlagstiftning
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support effective legislation to combat dog smuggling, which causes significant suffering to the animals involved and poses risks of introducing rabies and other diseases into the country. The motion highlights the financial connection between dog smuggling and organized crime, citing a recent increase in intercepted smuggled dogs. The author argues that strong laws are essential for preventing animal suffering, combating serious organized crime, and protecting public health regarding pets in Sweden.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:111 Mer tid till lärande – extra studietid och utökad lovskola
summary: The motion proposes a review of conditions to make it more advantageous for companies based on circular economy and reuse. The aim is to enhance recycling efforts to mitigate climate impact by easing the establishment and operation of businesses focused on reuse. This includes evaluating circular business models, revising current regulations, providing municipalities with knowledge to support reuse in various sectors, and potentially reducing VAT on certain second-hand items. The overall goal is to develop a national strategy for circular economy similar to those in the Netherlands and Finland.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:131 Nytt regelverk för kvalificerade säkerhetsärenden
summary: The proposal advocates for the examination of the feasibility of a complementary railway link, called Aroslänken, between Uppsala and Enköping. This connection aims to facilitate train travel for commuters, reduce travel times compared to current options, support local businesses, enhance labor mobility, and contribute to environmental sustainability by promoting train use over car travel. The proposal emphasizes the positive impacts on regional connectivity, efficiency, and climate considerations.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:128 Nya regler för organdonation
summary: Lina Nordquist (L) proposes that the Swedish Parliament should reserve space for bicycle paths alongside existing and planned railway lines. The motion highlights the benefits of cycling for the climate, recreation, commuting, and public health, advocating for improved infrastructure that allows cyclists to avoid vehicular traffic and use direct routes. The motion suggests a future-oriented transportation policy, emphasizing the role of the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) in implementing these bicycle paths and ensuring proper planning during railway construction.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:138 Ett särskilt brott för hedersförtryck
summary: The proposal advocates for the construction of a bridge or ferry across Lake Mälaren to connect the municipalities of Håbo and Knivsta. Currently, residents face long travel times due to the lack of such a connection, impacting accessibility to jobs, services, and tourism. The motion emphasizes the potential benefits of reducing travel time, boosting local businesses, enhancing environmental sustainability, and promoting tourism in the region.

title: Förbud mot utvinning av kol, olja och naturgas och skärpta regler för utvinning i alunskiffer
summary: The proposal aims to enhance Sweden's entrepreneurial spirit through the introduction of more high school programs that foster insights into business creation. It calls for the Swedish Parliament to support initiatives encouraging youth entrepreneurship by instructing the Growth Agency to develop a certification process for local advisory actors and to undertake an investigation into the unemployment insurance regulations that currently restrict individuals on unemployment benefits from starting their own businesses.

title: En effektivisering av byggnadsnämndens tillsyn
summary: The proposal suggests researching the possibility of introducing a shorter police training program for individuals with a relevant three-year academic education. This initiative aims to address the increasing severe violence and insecurity in Sweden by enhancing the police force's capabilities to combat crime effectively. The suggestion emphasizes the need to attract more candidates to the police profession by easing the requirements for those already educated in relevant fields, similar to existing pathways for teachers. It asserts that a shorter training program could increase the number of applicants and strengthen law enforcement.

title: Ursprungsgarantier – genomförande av det omarbetade förnybartdirektivet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate ways to facilitate the recognition of foreign gymnasium education for Swedish youth, particularly in language studies, and to allow students to take their school funding with them when studying abroad. This initiative aims to enhance intercultural competence and prepare students for international careers, acknowledging the increasing need for such skills in a globalized world.

title: Effektivare bevisupptagning inom EU
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national digital platform for upper secondary education in Sweden, which would provide students with access to the best educators who would explain various components of the curriculum. This initiative aims to alleviate the workload of teachers and create a more equitable learning environment by making high-quality educational resources easily available, thereby allowing for more individualized instruction and supporting students during remote learning periods, especially highlighted by the consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Idéburen välfärd
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the Swedish tourism VAT to create a more uniform tax structure aligned with Nordic neighbors, enhancing competitiveness in the tourism industry which is vital for both urban and rural economies. It emphasizes the importance of equal competition conditions within the EU and aims to standardize VAT rates for similar tourism activities.

title: Bättre tillgång till finansiell information i brottsbekämpningen
summary: Helena Gellerman's motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament transfer the administration of the car subsidy for individuals with disabilities to another authority to ensure more effective processing. The motion highlights the challenges faced by individuals with varying degrees of disabilities, particularly the inadequacies of public transportation and the complexities of the current car subsidy system. Despite previous reforms, the administration has resulted in higher costs and fewer beneficiaries. The motion calls for government action to improve the situation.

title: Kommittéberättelse – kommittéernas verksamhet under 2021
summary: The proposal advocates for the elimination of value-added tax (VAT) on internal services within civil society organizations in Sweden. It highlights the challenges posed by the current VAT regulations, which create disparities based on the legal structure of organizations. The motion argues that the existing system is arbitrary, hampers the development of civil society, and ultimately burdens participants financially. By abolishing the internal VAT, the suggestion aims to establish a neutral tax system that supports the diverse structures of civil society organizations.

title: Riksdagens skrivelser till regeringen – åtgärder under 2021
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish Armed Forces to take responsibility for ensuring access to clean drinking water, particularly in light of contamination from PFAS chemicals. It highlights the environmental and health risks posed by these substances and the ongoing legal disputes between municipalities and the Armed Forces regarding the costs of decontamination. The proposal calls for a clearer mandate for the Armed Forces to support efforts in securing clean water supplies.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:138 Ett särskilt brott för hedersförtryck
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4446 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament increase its support for the Unifier mission in Ukraine, which is focused on training and educating Ukrainian security forces in response to ongoing conflicts since 2014. The motion argues that Sweden should take a more proactive role to demonstrate its commitment to Ukraine's independence and stability, advocating for parliamentary oversight on Sweden's military contributions to enhance their significance.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:133 En samlad straffrättslig terrorismlagstiftning
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4445 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: Maria Nilsson proposes that the Swedish government develop a strategy to combat medication shortages, highlighting a recent crisis regarding Qlaira, a medication for endometriosis, which is expected to be unavailable until the following summer due to a shortage of active substance. The motion emphasizes the importance of addressing not only the immediate issue of medication shortages but also the broader implications for women's health and the need for effective treatment options for conditions like endometriosis.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:131 Nytt regelverk för kvalificerade säkerhetsärenden
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4444 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament initiate an investigation to ensure legal clarity and fairness regarding the use of parking apps, following the increasing use of such apps as traditional parking meters are being removed. The current legislation surrounding parking fees and enforcement is not fully compatible with the functionality and accessibility of parking apps, which necessitates a review to align the legal framework with modern parking practices.

title: Extra ändringsbudget för 2022 - Garanti till Internationella återuppbyggnads- och utvecklingsbanken för lån till Ukraina
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiates an investigation aimed at developing proposals for safer urban planning in the future. It highlights the impact of fear on individual behavior and public safety, particularly the concerns surrounding poorly lit and isolated areas such as underpasses, which have been linked to increased feelings of insecurity, especially among women. The motion emphasizes the need to address the state's role in ensuring women's safety in public spaces.

title: Verksamheten i Europeiska unionen under 2021
summary: The motion proposes a revision and renewed focus on the strategy for Roma inclusion, aiming to ensure that Roma individuals born by 2032 have equal opportunities as non-Roma individuals. It highlights the historic discrimination and ongoing issues such as poor health and high unemployment rates within the Roma community, exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion emphasizes the need for increased political commitment at all governmental levels to revitalize the efforts towards Roma inclusion.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:134 Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government develop a comprehensive strategy regarding Russia, similar to the previous strategy created for China. It argues that the current Swedish policy towards Russia requires revision, as there is a tendency to assume that Sweden and Russia can cooperate on shared interests without recognizing Russia's self-serving agenda. The motion emphasizes the importance of analyzing Russia's ambitions and their immediate implications for Swedish security, stating that Sweden should not allow external agendas to dictate its actions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:134 Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a hybrid threats ambassador in Sweden to enhance the country's response to various cyber threats and hybrid warfare tactics. It draws on recent instances of cyberattacks affecting both private enterprises and government institutions in neighboring countries, particularly focusing on the need for coordinated international efforts and collaboration among Swedish authorities to address these vulnerabilities.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:134 Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4441 av Maria Malmer Stenergard m.fl. (M)
summary: Maria Nilsson proposes the establishment of a 'cybersolidarity pact' to enhance collective security among democracies against the rising threat of cyberattacks, particularly from state actors such as China, Russia, and Iran. The motion highlights the significance of addressing attacks in the 'gray zone,' which blur the lines between war and peace, and calls for increased cooperation and response mechanisms to deter potential aggressors by raising the costs of their actions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:134 Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should take the initiative at international organizations, such as the UN, OSCE, and EU, regarding accountability for private armies, highlighting the growing role of such entities in contemporary conflicts. It emphasizes the need for a framework to address the challenges posed by private military groups like Russia's Wagner, which operate with a hidden agenda and complicate the enforcement of international law and accountability for war crimes.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:134 Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4439 av Jonny Cato och Martina Johansson (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament undertake a study on the feasibility of implementing a sponsorship system for refugee reception based on the Canadian model. This system would allow entities such as organizations or groups of individuals to commit to supporting the welfare of asylum seekers for a defined period. The motivation for this proposal stems from the need for improved integration of newcomers in Sweden and the hope for a long-term political agreement on migration policy amidst polarizing discussions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:134 Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: This motion proposes to the Swedish Parliament to investigate and implement investments in infrastructure to enhance growth in Halland and the surrounding regions of West and South Sweden. The proposal emphasizes the need for improved road and railway transport systems to support local commuting, trade, and sustainable goods transport. It highlights Halland's strategic position in the growth corridors of Oslo–Copenhagen and the Gnosjö region, advocating for immediate upgrades to existing railway lines, the construction of new stops for commuter trains, as well as the overall improvement of roadways to facilitate the increasing regional development and economic cooperation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:134 Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The suggestion proposes that the responsibility for student health services should be centralized under regional healthcare authorities to ensure better mental and physical health support for students. It emphasizes the urgent need for improved school health services, increased resources, and collaboration among various stakeholders to address the rising mental health issues among youth. The motion advocates for a holistic approach that encompasses preventive care and the involvement of multiple professional teams to provide timely assistance to students, ultimately aiming to create a healthier school environment.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:137 Upphävande av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4436 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: Bengt Eliasson from the Liberal Party highlights the increasing prevalence of mental health issues among children, youth, and working-age adults in Sweden. With over 190,000 children and up to a million working-age individuals affected, the economic burden of mental health problems is estimated at over 70 billion kronor annually. Eliasson argues that more must be done to address the mental health crisis, including improving care structures, increasing resources, and initiating new treatment methods. He calls for the state to assume greater responsibility in combating this growing issue.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:137 Upphävande av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The motion proposes the continued development of a fixed connection between Helsingborg and Helsingör to alleviate congestion on the existing Malmö-Copenhagen bridge and support sustainable growth in the Öresund region. It argues for the infrastructure's importance in enhancing trade and regional integration, enabling better access to job markets, education, and other services. The project is estimated to cost around 40 billion SEK, with the potential for self-financing through tolls, and aims to incorporate environmentally friendly technologies for transportation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:111 Mer tid till lärande – extra studietid och utökad lovskola
summary: Allan Widman's motion proposes an investigation into lowering the age of criminal responsibility in Sweden, arguing that many youths under 15 are involved in criminal activities yet are not held legally accountable. The proposal cites a significant number of juvenile offenders and argues that earlier legal intervention may help prevent lifelong criminal behavior. Widman emphasizes that raising awareness of legal consequences among young individuals could benefit society, strengthen the position of victims, and improve overall crime resolution rates.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:138 Ett särskilt brott för hedersförtryck
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament expresses its support for measures to address the increasing number of A-tractors and the associated rise in accidents involving these vehicles. It highlights the rapid growth of A-tractors on the roads and the alarming increase in personal injuries, notably a 567% rise from 2019 to 2020. The motion argues that the presence of A-tractors, which operate at a maximum speed of 30 km/h, alongside standard vehicles on roads with speed limits over 70 km/h, significantly reduces traffic safety due to the disparity in speeds and dangerous situations that arise. The proposal calls for restrictions on where A-tractors can be driven to mitigate these risks.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:123 Validering för kompetensförsörjning och livslångt lärande
summary: The motion proposes a revision of the national tax equalization system to better address the unique challenges faced by the Stockholm region. It argues that current economic conditions for municipalities vary significantly, leading to unequal support for essential services such as education and healthcare. The motion emphasizes the need for a predictable financial framework that allows all municipalities to meet their obligations effectively, particularly in light of demographic shifts and other structural factors. It calls on the government to recognize the distinct needs of the Stockholm region in the tax equalization discussion.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:124 Genomförande av ändringar i energieffektiviseringsdirektivet om värme, kyla och tappvarmvatten för hushållsbruk
summary: The motion proposes to protect large carnivore populations in Sweden by emphasizing the need for scientific assessments to guide decisions regarding their management and to combat illegal hunting. It advocates for a sustainable coexistence between humans and predators by implementing preventive measures for livestock protection, enhancing public acceptance, and ensuring government accountability for damages caused by wildlife. The motion also highlights the importance of regional management strategies and collaboration among various stakeholders to effectively address conflicts and illegal hunting.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:123 Validering för kompetensförsörjning och livslångt lärande
summary: This motion proposes to the Swedish Parliament that the government should reinforce the right of public access (allemansrätten) and improve rural land and coastal protections in the Stockholm region. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining high natural and cultural values for recreation and habitation, suggesting reforms to enhance accessibility while protecting natural areas, and calls for a review of existing regulations to ensure sustainable development in rural areas and archipelagos. The motion advocates for the integration of nature and recreational areas into urban planning and the protection of historical cultural perspectives.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:122 Ändring av andelstal i gemensamhetsanläggningar
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4429 av Ola Johansson och Anders Åkesson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a mandatory minimum distance of 1.5 meters for motor vehicles when overtaking cyclists to improve traffic safety and reduce the risk of accidents. It calls on the government to investigate and introduce this distance regulation, highlighting that similar laws exist in several European countries and emphasizing the importance of safe overtaking practices.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:122 Ändring av andelstal i gemensamhetsanläggningar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of allowing surrogacy arrangements both in Sweden and abroad. It emphasizes the need for a clear regulatory framework to address potential conflicts between intended parents and biological mothers, ensuring children's rights and citizenship. Additionally, it calls for simplifying the process of establishing parenthood following surrogacy abroad and strengthening the rights of children born via surrogacy outside of Sweden.

title: Förskola för fler barn
summary: The motion aims to strengthen Sweden's position in the digital sector by advocating for enhanced education and research in video game development, introducing programming as a distinct subject in primary schools, and developing the existing R&D tax deduction into an Innovation Deduction to foster competitiveness in new creative and digital industries.

title: Skattereduktion för avgift till arbetslöshetskassa
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden to intensify efforts to strengthen the human rights of LGBTQI individuals globally in response to rising threats, harassment, and anti-LGBTQI rhetoric across Europe and beyond. It highlights the responsibility of Sweden to support LGBTQI rights defenders and urges the government to take more decisive action against the suppression of individual freedoms related to sexual orientation.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:124 Genomförande av ändringar i energieffektiviseringsdirektivet om värme, kyla och tappvarmvatten för hushållsbruk
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4427 av Mattias Bäckström Johansson m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a fast-track process at the Swedish Migration Agency specifically for expatriate Swedes returning to Sweden with their families. The aim is to reduce the lengthy processing times, which can often extend to several years. The motion emphasizes the need for expedited handling of applications, particularly for foreign partners of returning Swedes, to ensure they receive permanent residency status promptly.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:124 Genomförande av ändringar i energieffektiviseringsdirektivet om värme, kyla och tappvarmvatten för hushållsbruk
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of the Swedish model of 'freedom under responsibility' for Swedish forest owners, highlighting the significant role of forests in Sweden's economy, climate efforts, and rural development. The author stresses that both environmental and production goals should continue to hold equal weight in forestry management.

title: Omhändertagande och återkallelse av förarbevis för vattenskoter
summary: The proposal calls for a swift investigation into the necessary changes to address noise disturbances caused by motorists playing loud music, which has been reported to negatively impact residents' quality of life. It emphasizes the need for enhanced police powers to effectively manage the growing issue of high-volume music from vehicles that disrupts community peace, especially affecting sleep patterns of residents.

title: Upphävande av covid-19-lagen och lagen om tillfälliga smittskyddsåtgärder på serveringsställen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament instruct Statskontoret to conduct a review of the government's authorities with the aim of identifying opportunities for merging and abolishing agencies to enhance efficiency and reduce state costs.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om svenskt bistånd till multilaterala organisationer
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a harm reduction perspective in the national strategy for alcohol, narcotics, doping, and tobacco (ANDT), emphasizing the importance of differentiating between types of tobacco use. It highlights the positive trends in reducing tobacco use, particularly smoking, and argues that promoting less harmful alternatives, such as snus and heated tobacco products, can contribute significantly to achieving a smoke-free Sweden. The motion calls for the government to incorporate this perspective in the upcoming ANDT strategy, reinforcing the need for a comprehensive approach towards improving public health.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:107 Riksrevisionens rapport om statens suicidpreventiva arbete
summary: The motion proposes to facilitate greater participation of smaller companies in public procurement processes by encouraging the division of larger contracts, improving information dissemination about procurement procedures, and ensuring that food purchased by public institutions meets Swedish legislation. The aim is to enhance competition and quality in public procurement, particularly for local businesses, and to provide clearer guidelines for compliance and improved follow-up on food deliveries.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:109 Riksrevisionens rapport om ersättning till rättsliga biträden i brottmål
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers making the national vaccination program mandatory for all children, in light of declining vaccination rates and the risks of disease outbreaks. It highlights the importance of vaccinations for preventing the spread of contagious diseases and protecting public health, especially during the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. The authors argue that societal action is necessary to address the growing opposition to vaccinations fueled by misinformation.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:105 Riksrevisionens rapport om polisens och åklagarnas arbete mot internetrelaterade sexuella övergrepp mot barn
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden implement individualized risk assessments to allow more people to become blood donors, addressing the current blood shortage in the country. The motion highlights that existing criteria for blood donation, especially regarding the LGBTQ+ community, need to be updated to reflect contemporary medical knowledge and social dynamics. It argues that automatic classifications based on sexual behavior should be replaced with individual evaluations to improve donor availability and promote safety.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:107 Riksrevisionens rapport om statens suicidpreventiva arbete
summary: The motion proposes establishing a stable primary care contact for patients in Sweden, emphasizing the need for continuity and quality in healthcare. It highlights the current inequities in the healthcare system and argues against the reliance on temporary physicians, advocating for a system where patients consistently see the same healthcare provider to improve treatment and care, especially for the elderly and those with chronic conditions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:116 En fast omsorgskontakt i hemtjänsten
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4421 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament endorse follow-up measures for national guidelines regarding the treatment of endometriosis, consider establishing a national quality registry for the condition, and improve education and awareness about endometriosis among healthcare providers and in medical training. The aim is to address the significant health challenges faced by women suffering from endometriosis, where diagnosis and treatment can often take several years, leading to worsened symptoms and complications such as infertility.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:107 Riksrevisionens rapport om statens suicidpreventiva arbete
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4420 av Camilla Waltersson Grönvall m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need to improve mental health care in Sweden, particularly focusing on open psychiatric care and early intervention to prevent mental health issues. It highlights the negative impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on mental well-being and calls for increased accessibility, evidence-based treatment, and better cooperation between municipalities and counties. The proposal underlines the importance of allowing individuals, especially children and young people, to receive timely support and to prevent long-term mental health problems by advocating for improved treatment models and patient choice in their care.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:105 Riksrevisionens rapport om polisens och åklagarnas arbete mot internetrelaterade sexuella övergrepp mot barn
summary: The motion proposes a change in legislation allowing parents access to their children's medical records and prescriptions once the children turn 13 years old. The current law prevents parents from viewing their children's health information through the 1177.se portal after this age, despite parents bearing custodial responsibilities until the children reach 18. The motion argues that this inconsistency in the law is unreasonable and seeks to ensure that parents can effectively manage their children's healthcare.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:109 Riksrevisionens rapport om ersättning till rättsliga biträden i brottmål
summary: The proposal advocates for a reformed approach to public procurement in Sweden, emphasizing the need to focus on the functionality of products and services rather than merely the lowest price. This approach aims to increase the value for taxpayers' money by encouraging authorities to make more strategic purchasing decisions that align with community needs and enhance service quality, particularly in sectors such as healthcare, housing, and food provision. The motion highlights the economic potential of optimizing procurement processes to ensure that public funds achieve the best possible outcomes.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: This motion proposes a comprehensive approach to combat illegal labor in Sweden. It suggests that the government should enhance the Tax Agency's capabilities to tackle tax evasion related to illegal employment and develop an action plan to address this issue. Additionally, it calls for a review of penalties associated with the exploitation of illegal labor and for examining measures taken by other EU countries to manage similar challenges. The motion highlights the seriousness of tax evasion by unscrupulous companies and the impact on legitimate businesses.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:108 Tillträdesförbud till badanläggningar och bibliotek
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a certification process for the title of 'licensed personal trainer' in order to ensure that individuals hiring a personal trainer can be confident in their qualifications and knowledge. The motion emphasizes the importance of proper training and guidance in maintaining health and wellness, and highlights the potential risks of unqualified advice from personal trainers. It calls for an investigation to determine the necessary qualifications for this licensed title.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:116 En fast omsorgskontakt i hemtjänsten
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for increased security in the Stockholm region by advocating for stricter penalties and the elimination of sentencing discounts, alongside the necessity for more police in vulnerable areas. It calls for an investigation into measures against young offenders and proposes expanded opportunities for surveillance to enhance public safety. It also highlights the importance of improving the quality and evaluation of preventive programs used by social services to effectively address the rising crime rate and insecurity faced by residents and businesses.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:105 Riksrevisionens rapport om polisens och åklagarnas arbete mot internetrelaterade sexuella övergrepp mot barn
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining competence requirements in educational programs to ensure a well-qualified workforce, particularly in vital sectors like welfare. It warns against the temptation to relax these standards in response to a demand shortage in certain professions, arguing that such actions can devalue professions and lead to a loss of essential skills. The motion reflects on historical instances where lowered requirements led to negative consequences, advocating for a commitment to uphold high standards in education and training.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:109 Riksrevisionens rapport om ersättning till rättsliga biträden i brottmål
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of providing information about various vocational paths and their connection to job opportunities, particularly during the early years of primary school. It calls for improved training for career counselors and the inclusion of modern insights into different professions, in collaboration with the labor market, to better prepare students for making informed choices about their future education and careers.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:107 Riksrevisionens rapport om statens suicidpreventiva arbete
summary: The motion advocates for improved conditions for individuals with disabilities, urging the government to annually report developments related to the rights and inclusion of these individuals, based on the principles outlined in the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. It emphasizes the need for a cohesive national approach that reduces disparities in healthcare access, financial assistance, and transportation services while encouraging full participation in society and the labor market. The proposal also highlights the importance of personal assistance and calls for the restoration of previous rights concerning disability support.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:107 Riksrevisionens rapport om statens suicidpreventiva arbete
summary: The motion proposes to establish a basic education in health and healthcare for self-care within the framework of Swedish for Immigrants (sfi) programs. This aims to equip newly arrived immigrants with essential knowledge regarding health issues, especially since many come from conflict areas where health education is lacking. By improving understanding of self-care and health maintenance, the proposal seeks to alleviate pressure on the healthcare system and empower parents to support their children's health.

title: Stärkt integritet i idrottens antidopningsarbete
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should take further actions to ensure equal conditions for private operators within the welfare sector, aligning them with those of publicly operated entities. The authors emphasize the importance of private actors in meeting the growing welfare needs in the Stockholm region, highlighting that a significant portion of healthcare and education services are already provided by private entities. The motion calls for a comprehensive review of legislation affecting private welfare actors, advocating for better transparency in compensation, inclusion of private entities in state funding initiatives, and establishment of clear quality criteria.

title: Ett särskilt brott för hedersförtryck
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a fair taxation account system where amounts under 100 kronor are neither paid out nor paid in throughout the year. It argues that allowing both surpluses and deficits under this threshold to remain on the account would reduce administrative burdens and costs for the tax authorities, while also enhancing fairness in the treatment of taxpayer funds.

title: Genomförande av direktivet om inrättande av en europeisk kodex för elektronisk kommunikation
summary: The motion highlights the need for improved diagnosis support for doctors regarding ME/CFS (myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome) and calls for better education on the condition to be included in medical training. It emphasizes the challenges faced by patients in receiving appropriate care and the significant societal costs associated with prolonged sickness and inadequate support from the healthcare system.

title: En samlad straffrättslig terrorismlagstiftning
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of a Nordic coordination of air ambulance services to improve collaboration and share experiences across Sweden, Norway, Finland, and potentially Denmark. It highlights current disparities in service delivery within Sweden's nine air ambulance bases and aims to enhance service quality, reduce costs for local authorities, and increase patient safety through systematic cooperation.

title: Nytt regelverk för kvalificerade säkerhetsärenden
summary: The motion advocates for an assessment of food provision for individuals of all ages with dysphagia and proposes improvements to meal quality in welfare services as part of a food strategy. It underscores the importance of individualized, nutrient-rich meals for the elderly to combat undernutrition and enhance their quality of life, calling for increased collaboration between healthcare and food preparation staff. The motion also emphasizes the need for better procurement processes that prioritize taste and preferences over low costs, suggesting that public procurement should focus on quality to improve the meals provided in public institutions like schools, hospitals, and elderly care facilities.

title: Val och beslut i kommuner och regioner
summary: The proposal advocates for an evaluation of the formation of the Västra Götalandsregionen to learn from past mistakes prior to creating new regions. It suggests compensating municipalities affected by the state's failure to uphold agreements made during the formation of the region and calls for an investigation into whether regions and counties are the most effective governance method.

title: Mer tid till lärande – extra studietid och utökad lovskola
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a distinct agriculture and forestry committee within the Swedish Parliament to better address and prioritize agricultural and forestry issues, as opposed to the current dual focus on environmental matters which may overshadow these economic areas. The motion highlights the importance of increasing Swedish food production to drive job growth and meet future food demands, arguing that a dedicated committee would facilitate a more balanced approach to both environmental and agricultural policies.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:116 En fast omsorgskontakt i hemtjänsten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should take overarching responsibility for organizing and coordinating all aspects of medical education to ensure that the national need for medical professionals, including basic training placements and specialist training positions, is met. The motion highlights the current shortage of specialist doctors affecting healthcare quality, patient safety, and working conditions, arguing that a nationally responsible body is essential for addressing these issues effectively.

title: Borttagande av bosättningsprincipen vid sprututbyte
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to assign the Transport Administration to allow signage that warns of ongoing hunting and the presence of loose hunting dogs along state roads, and considers the addition of flashing lights on these signs for increased visibility. The motion aims to reduce the number of hunting dogs killed or injured in traffic by improving awareness among drivers, while acknowledging the cultural significance of loose hunting in Sweden.

title: Nya regler för organdonation
summary: The motion proposes changes to hunting regulations in Sweden to allow for nighttime hunting using both fixed and mobile lighting, as well as electronic image enhancers and thermal cameras, targeting species such as red fox, badger, and raccoon dog. The proponent argues that these changes are necessary for effective predator control, which is essential for maintaining biodiversity and sustainable wildlife management, and would reduce risks associated with hunting in low visibility conditions.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:107 Riksrevisionens rapport om statens suicidpreventiva arbete
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should allow the use of hunter IDs from the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency to be the sole form of identification for wildlife cameras and traps. This change is suggested to simplify compliance with current regulations and enhance the protection of hunters by mitigating the risks associated with potential threats from the public, particularly in light of increased violence against hunters. The motion calls for a statutory framework that streamlines the identification process while maintaining a level of public awareness regarding camera surveillance.

title: Skärpta och förbättrade regler om arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The motion proposes to reduce the late payment fee for congestion taxes, arguing that the current penalty of 500 kronor for a delayed payment of as little as 10 kronor is excessive and unfair. The author highlights that the congestion tax has become an accepted part of Swedish traffic management, but the disproportionate late fee lacks public acceptance and fairness, especially when compared to standards in business transactions.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:108 Tillträdesförbud till badanläggningar och bibliotek
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4408 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion advocates for the implementation of the Östlig förbindelse project in Stockholm County to improve the traffic system, which is currently vulnerable and overstressed. Additionally, it emphasizes the necessity of installing required fire safety measures on the Södra länken to minimize disruptions during peak hours. The proposal aims to enhance transportation capacity and support economic growth in the region by creating a more resilient traffic infrastructure.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:119 Modernare regler för användningen av tvångsmedel
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4407 av Linda Westerlund Snecker m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes making the general vaccination program compulsory for children in Sweden, addressing the rise of vaccine skepticism and misinformation. It suggests evaluating sanctions for parents who refuse vaccinations for their children, combating disinformation regarding vaccines and healthcare, and allowing vaccinations if only one guardian consents. Additionally, the motion advocates for legislation to create vaccination passes for those vaccinated against COVID-19 to facilitate a return to normalcy.

title: Återkallelse av uppehållstillstånd som har meddelats av Regeringskansliet för personer med anknytning till utländska beskickningar, karriärkonsulat eller internationella organ
summary: The motion proposes a review of measures to prevent the misuse of the attefalls regulations, which were designed to facilitate housing construction in existing residential areas. Although these regulations have contributed positively to the housing market, there have been unintended consequences that allow for the development of multiple homes in areas designated for single-family houses. This can overwhelm local infrastructure and disrupt community planning, particularly affecting the availability of daycare and school placements. The author argues that the government should ensure the regulations are not exploited beyond their original intent.

title: Genomförande av ändringar i energieffektiviseringsdirektivet om värme, kyla och tappvarmvatten för hushållsbruk
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish state should take a leading role in developing and establishing digital standards for both municipal and state administration to enhance digitization efforts. It emphasizes the need for shared and open standards to improve interoperability and data exchange, thus increasing efficiency and service quality in the public sector. The motion also suggests exploring co-financing solutions between the state and the municipal sector to support this initiative, highlighting the importance of a coordinated digital strategy for future welfare services.
