The proposal aims to enhance accessibility to driving education, improve traffic safety, and ultimately increase employment opportunities for youths.

title: Utvidgade regler om lättnad i beskattningen av personaloptioner i vissa fall
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the gradual reduction of mortgage interest deductions in Sweden, arguing that these deductions contribute to rising housing prices and inflate the housing bubble. It suggests reallocating resources to lower other taxes instead, without negatively impacting home ownership. The motion calls on the government to initiate a review to assess how to phase out interest deductions while compensating with other tax reductions.

title: Svenskt deltagande i Förenta nationernas stabiliseringsinsats i Mali
summary: The motion proposes an immediate review of the possibility to lower gasoline and diesel taxes in Sweden, arguing that high fuel taxes disproportionately impact those who rely on cars for transportation due to the country's geography and sparse population. It emphasizes the need for affordable fuel to maintain competitiveness and quality of life across all regions of Sweden, particularly highlighting the necessity of transport for work, errands, and healthcare access.

title: Fortsatt svenskt deltagande i militär insats för stärkt säkerhet i Mali
Skattelättnad för cykelförmån och skattefri uthyrning av personliga tillgångar
summary: The proposal advocates for the Nordic countries to establish a unified approach to crisis management and preparedness in response to challenges highlighted during the pandemic. It emphasizes the importance of cooperation among Nordic nations, which has historically led to economic exchange and close ties, and seeks to prevent the disjointed responses experienced during COVID-19 that negatively impacted trade, tourism, and health outcomes in Sweden.

title: Förstärkta skattereduktioner för förvärvsinkomster, sjukersättning och aktivitetsersättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should support an investigation into the reintroduction of indeterminate imprisonment, known as 'förvaringsstraff', for habitual offenders and those posing a significant risk of reoffending. The author argues that the current rise in gang-related crime and violence necessitates stronger societal responses and that such a punishment could incentivize good behavior during incarceration and facilitate a transition to lawful living.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om myndigheters service till enskilda som inte kan eller vill vara digitala
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament requires all staffed stores to accept cash payments. It argues that cash is essential for ensuring consumer security during power outages and other crises when electronic payment systems may fail. The motion highlights that certain groups, including the digitally inexperienced, the homeless, and some elderly individuals, rely on cash transactions. It also emphasizes the necessity of cash for learning the value of money and protecting against vulnerabilities in digital payment systems, suggesting that Sweden should adopt measures similar to those in Denmark and Norway regarding cash acceptance.

title: Överlåtelse av förvaltningsuppgift till Internationella sjöfartsorganisationen att genom Världssjöfartsuniversitetet utfärda examina
summary: The suggestion advocates for urgent measures to prevent the export of stolen goods from Sweden, highlighting the ease with which such items are currently sent abroad. It points to the ineffectiveness of existing controls by the Customs Authority and emphasizes the need for immediate action to address the issue, suggesting improved inspections and regulations with shipping companies to deter criminal activities.

title: Ändrat alkoholskattedirektiv och vissa andra ändringar
summary: This motion proposes to swiftly investigate how to increase the number of police officers in active duty and trained security guards to enhance public safety in urban areas. It highlights the growing feeling of insecurity due to crime, noting that while preventive measures are important, immediate law enforcement presence is crucial, especially in vulnerable areas. The proposal suggests a quick pathway to bolster the police force, including a review of resource allocation to ensure more officers are on duty and possibly increasing the workforce through expedited training programs. It also advocates for state support to help municipalities employ additional security personnel.

title: Skatteavtal mellan Sverige och Slovenien
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a reliable and stable system for personal pension savings, emphasizing the inadequacy of the current pension system which leaves many individuals with low pensions despite full-time work. It points out the increase in pensioners living in poverty and underscores the importance of favorable conditions for personal savings, recalling successful past arrangements that incentivized such savings through tax benefits. The motion calls for immediate government action to enhance personal pension savings options to improve future pension benefits for individuals.

title: Avskaffad reklamskatt
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden's government should allow the revocation of residence permits under certain conditions, particularly if individuals who have been granted asylum return to their home countries without just cause, thereby questioning the validity of their asylum claims. It argues that stricter assessments by the Migration Agency would foster greater acceptance of genuine asylum seekers.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:7 Riksrevisionens rapport om statliga myndigheters FoU-verksamhet
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4237 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate ownership taxes to make them more competitive. It emphasizes the importance of investment capital taxation in determining the scale of investments and ownership of companies, citing Sweden's historical challenges in corporate ownership due to unfavorable tax conditions. The motion advocates reducing capital income taxes to boost domestic investment and employment, referencing studies that suggest such reductions could lead to significant economic benefits including increased employment and GDP growth.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:17 Slopad straffrabatt för unga myndiga vid allvarlig brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a preparedness commission directly under the Prime Minister to address gaps in Sweden's preparedness for various crises, highlighted by recent global events and the COVID-19 pandemic. The commission would focus on military defense, pandemic preparedness, food and medicine storage, and the development of local production capabilities. Key tasks would include restoring general conscription, increasing food and medical supply storage for at least one year, establishing field hospitals, and preparing the industry for potential wartime production, along with setting deadlines for these initiatives.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:17 Slopad straffrabatt för unga myndiga vid allvarlig brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes to make access to the Swedish Transport Agency's vehicle register more difficult in order to prevent car thefts and related criminal activities. It argues that while transparency has its benefits, the current system exposes owners to risks, as criminals can easily obtain owner information to threaten or steal vehicles. The motion suggests that the government should investigate effective restrictions to enhance crime prevention regarding vehicle ownership data.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:17 Slopad straffrabatt för unga myndiga vid allvarlig brottslighet
summary: Lars Jilmstad's motion calls on the government to take action against skewed competition arising from public entities competing with private businesses. He argues that such unfair competition harms individual entrepreneurs and the overall economy, particularly affecting smaller companies. The motion highlights the need to strengthen regulations that were established in 2010, which aimed to prevent such competition, and suggests that the Competition Authority should be granted the authority to make decisions on cases of restrictive public sales operations without needing judicial intervention. The goal is to ensure fair competition as a cornerstone of an effective market economy.

title: Brott mot djur - skärpta straff och ett mer effektivt sanktionssystem
summary: The motion proposes an investigation to limit the right to free interpretation services in Sweden, arguing that prolonged access to these services contributes to poor integration and significant costs for taxpayers. The authors highlight issues where individuals, despite having lived in Sweden for many years, fail to learn the Swedish language and often miss appointments, adding unnecessary expenses for various authorities. They suggest implementing a personal fee for those who miss scheduled meetings with interpreters.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:17 Slopad straffrabatt för unga myndiga vid allvarlig brottslighet
summary: The proposal is to initiate an investigation into the possibility of implementing a ban on hijabs in pre-school and elementary schools in Sweden, in order to combat perceived gender oppression and promote equality, stating that girls should not be forced to wear hijabs due to societal pressures or cultural practices.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:17 Slopad straffrabatt för unga myndiga vid allvarlig brottslighet
summary: The motion proposes that municipalities and regions should be required to indicate the country of origin for meat and other ingredients used in meals served by public kitchens, similar to the requirements placed on private restaurants and food stores. This measure aims to provide students and care recipients with information about the provenance of their food.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:5 Ett förenklat upphandlingsregelverk
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should task the Swedish Board of Agriculture with implementing recommendations from the Competitiveness Inquiry (SOU 2015:15). This includes creating new guidance for permit assessments in animal production, streamlining the approval process, reducing the number of environmental assessment delegations, and potentially eliminating consultation requirements for less environmentally impactful activities. The aim is to cut costs and time spent on permit processes while promoting uniform legal applications.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:3 En förenklingspolitik för stärkt konkurrenskraft, tillväxt och innovationsförmåga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports increasing the self-sufficiency rate of food production in Sweden, as it has decreased significantly over the years, leaving the country vulnerable during crises. It suggests measures to enhance competitiveness and profitability for Swedish agriculture, classify it as critical infrastructure, reduce taxes and bureaucracy, and promote exports of surplus food products. The goal is to ensure a sustainable, long-term improvement in food production and self-sufficiency in Sweden.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:6 Riksrevisionens rapport om projektbidrag från anslag 2:4 Krisberedskap
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4229 av Pål Jonson m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposes the evaluation and potential dissolution of the Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management, suggesting that its responsibilities be transferred to the Swedish Board of Agriculture or the new Wildlife Agency. The rationale is to reduce overlap and inefficiency among government agencies, as the current division of responsibilities related to fishing issues leads to confusion and ineffective management.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:13 Riksrevisionens rapport om arbetssökande över 55 år
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4228 av Mats Green m.fl. (M, KD)
summary: The motion proposes a review and potential modification of the pasture requirement for dairy cows in Sweden. The aim is to enable Swedish farmers to access EU pasture support by removing the national legal obligation for pasture. This change would allow farmers greater flexibility in deciding when and under what conditions their cows can graze, thereby reducing health risks to the animals and minimizing the need for antibiotics, ultimately improving animal welfare and competitiveness in the EU market.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:13 Riksrevisionens rapport om arbetssökande över 55 år
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4227 av Ann-Christine From Utterstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports initiatives to generally shorten the processing times for environmental permits, which currently can take between 5 to 10 years or more. The long waiting periods are seen as a deterrent for investments and expansions in industries such as mining and manufacturing, potentially leading to fewer jobs and reduced competitiveness compared to other countries. The motion calls for the government to evaluate and implement measures that would decrease the duration, cost, and uncertainty associated with these permit processes.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:3 En förenklingspolitik för stärkt konkurrenskraft, tillväxt och innovationsförmåga
summary: This parliamentary motion advocates for the state to take responsibility for coastal erosion caused by the sea and suggests a review of the regulations governing beach nourishment. It calls for simplification of the procedures involving multiple authorities and proposes that municipalities should not bear the entire costs associated with returning sand from the sea to eroded beaches. The motion emphasizes the importance of coastal areas to communities, economy, and ecology, and highlights the need for a coordinated approach to address erosion, which is increasingly threatening both infrastructure and natural habitats.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:3 En förenklingspolitik för stärkt konkurrenskraft, tillväxt och innovationsförmåga
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of legislation that permits the sale of alcoholic beverages directly from producers at their farms in Sweden, aligning with previous parliamentary decisions. It emphasizes the need for such a law to support local economies, especially in Skåne, where there are numerous microbreweries and vineyards. Drawing comparisons with the successful farm sales system in Finland, the motion argues that allowing direct sales would enhance tourism and local business, contributing positively to regional economies and sustainability.

title: med anledning av prop. 2021/22:5 Ett förenklat upphandlingsregelverk
summary: The proposal suggests investigating user-financing options for improving the railway connection between Oslo and Stockholm, aiming to reduce travel time significantly from the current five hours to three hours. By enhancing existing infrastructure and possibly adding a few new links, the initiative seeks to facilitate more train travel, which would lead to decreased carbon emissions and promote regional growth. It emphasizes the economic interdependence between Sweden and Norway and calls for governmental collaboration to develop a quicker connection.

title: med anledning av skr. 2021/22:3 En förenklingspolitik för stärkt konkurrenskraft, tillväxt och innovationsförmåga
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports efforts to improve mobile phone coverage across the country, highlighting the essential need for reliable mobile communication for both residents and businesses, especially in rural areas. It suggests that mobile operators should collaborate more by sharing each other's infrastructure to enhance coverage in underserved regions without overloading the network.

title: Riksrevisionens rapport om systemet med energideklarationer
summary: The proposal seeks to establish clear criteria for what constitutes a winter tire for vehicles, arguing that current regulations are insufficient as they only focus on tread depth and studded properties, without considering the necessary rubber material for effective performance.

title: En konsultationsordning i frågor som rör det samiska folket
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support the removal of abandoned vehicles from private property and propose to the government that municipalities or the state take responsibility for their removal if a police report has been filed and the vehicle remains unclaimed for a week. The motion highlights the burdens placed on landowners and road associations, who often have to deal with vehicles left on their property, sometimes without knowing the owner or the vehicle's history.

title: Förenklade regler om tjänsteställe och skattefri ersättning vid tillfälliga anställningar och uppdrag
summary: The motion proposes the digitalization of the permit handling process for mobile cranes to improve efficiency and reduce complications in obtaining necessary permits for transportation. It highlights the importance of mobile cranes in the construction industry and the current challenges faced by companies in navigating the permit system, which is complex and varies by municipality. The motion calls for swift action from the government to implement a digital solution, thereby enhancing competition and productivity in the sector.

title: Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
summary: The motion proposes to simplify domestic adoption processes in Sweden to provide more children in unstable family situations with the opportunity for a secure upbringing. It emphasizes that children who have been in foster care for long periods, particularly those with biological parents deemed unable to care for them, should be considered for adoption. The authors argue that the current system prioritizes parental rights over the well-being of children and call for reforms that place the child's perspective at the center of adoption policies, ensuring that more children can be adopted and grow up in stable family environments.

title: Hela Sverige ska fungera – Kristdemokraternas budgetmotion för 2022
summary: The motion proposes easing regulations on Sweden's shoreline protection to facilitate increased residential construction, addressing the growing population's housing needs. It argues that the current protection hinders municipalities from developing new areas for housing and suggests reverting to a maximum protection zone of 100 meters while also advocating for a comprehensive review of shoreline protection rules to allow for more exceptions.

title: Ingen klimatomställning utan ett starkt kraftsystem
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament enable civil officiants to officiate weddings for Swedish couples in neighboring Nordic countries and to modernize the relevant 1904 law to facilitate this. It also calls for a review of the conditions and compensation for civil officiants, considering the increasing demand for unconventional wedding locations, such as ferries or cross-border sites, and the need for fair remuneration due to the longstanding stagnation of payment rates.

title: Utgiftsområde 19 Regional utveckling
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament encourages the government to review directives for the Fortifications Agency to enhance cooperation and dialogue, thereby allowing sports organizations and associations greater access to defense-owned land for training and competitions. The motion emphasizes the importance of sports for community engagement and suggests that the current restrictions and economic requirements imposed on sports organizations by the Fortifications Agency are prohibitive, suggesting a need for more accessible terms similar to those provided for other public sports facilities.

title: Implementering av mål för ett hållbart fiske
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the port of Gothenburg, Sweden's largest and most significant port, by urging the government to consider measures to ensure competitive logistics. It emphasizes the port's crucial role in both local and national economies, particularly for Swedish industry, and highlights the need for infrastructure investments, including deepening shipping channels and improving transportation links. The motion also underlines the importance of adapting to challenges highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic and ensuring that Sweden maintains direct shipping access to major markets in North America and Asia.

title: Utgiftsområde 24 Näringsliv
summary: The suggestion proposes that municipalities be required to clearly report in their annual accounts how expenditures are allocated between statutory and voluntary services. This aims to enhance transparency regarding the use of taxpayers' money, allowing citizens to easily see how funds are distributed and prioritized by local governments.

title: Utgiftsområde 11 Ekonomisk trygghet vid ålderdom
summary: The motion proposes to enhance the resources and powers of the Customs Agency to better prevent the importation of illegal goods, such as drugs, weapons, and dangerous medicines, as well as to control the export of stolen property from Sweden. The motion highlights the current lack of visibility and control at border crossings and emphasizes the need for increased customs and border enforcement.

title: Utgiftsområde 8 Migration
summary: Motion M1315 proposes a reduction in the beer tax for small breweries in Sweden, arguing that the current tax structure disadvantages local producers compared to imported beer and smaller breweries in other EU countries. The motion emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to leverage EU allowances for lower taxes on small scale beer production in order to improve competitive conditions, increase growth, and create jobs in the domestic market.

title: Utgiftsområde 10 Ekonomisk trygghet vid sjukdom och funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers reducing the diesel tax for Swedish transport companies to align it with levels in other EU countries or even lower. This reduction is intended to improve the competitiveness of Swedish transport firms, which currently face challenges from both illegal operations and foreign competitors with lower fuel and labor costs. The motion argues that the previous government's tax increases have further hindered the competitiveness of these companies. By lowering the diesel tax, it is hoped that Swedish transport companies can compete on an equal footing, leading to increased job creation within the country.

title: Integration och samhällsgemenskap
summary: The motion proposes an increase in the car travel deduction in Sweden to better align with the actual costs incurred by car owners, arguing that the existing rate has not kept pace with rising expenses like fuel, insurance, and maintenance. It emphasizes the necessity of cars in a sparsely populated country and advocates for a comprehensive review of the deduction to support individuals who rely on personal vehicles for commuting.

title: Bistånd för klimat och rättvisa
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government take national action against animal rights extremism by instructing the police to focus on this issue and by establishing a specific crime code for offenses related to animal rights. The motion argues that there has been an increase in violent attacks by militant animal rights activists against farmers, including intrusions, property damage, and threats, creating a climate of fear in rural areas. The proposal emphasizes the need for stronger legal consequences and better national coordination to protect democracy and the rights of individuals and businesses affected by such extremism.

title: Jämställdhet och diskriminering
summary: The motion proposes to amend Swedish firearms legislation to facilitate the storage of ammunition that is of a different caliber than what is permitted by an individual's weapons license. It highlights challenges faced by hunters, particularly when borrowing rifles for hunting trips, as they currently risk violating the law if they bring home ammunition from a borrowed weapon. The change aims to allow for greater convenience and safety in hunting practices, by permitting the purchase of more affordable ammunition for practice shooting when borrowing rifles.

title: Motverka skolsegregationen
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4209 av Annika Hirvonen och Leila Ali-Elmi (båda MP)
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the municipal equalization system to enhance the financial capabilities of rural municipalities. It advocates for the state to take over responsibility for financing this equalization, addressing concerns that the current system disproportionately benefits certain urban areas, like Malmö, while hindering growth in others. The proposal emphasizes the necessity of equitable financial support to ensure that both rural and growing municipalities can meet their infrastructure and welfare needs, thus supporting overall national growth.

title: Mångfaldsmat – mat med skyddad ursprungsbeteckning och skyddad geografisk beteckning
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4208 av Maria Gardfjell och Anna Sibinska (båda MP)
summary: The motion suggests that libraries in Sweden should categorize books by country and language according to the first letter of the country's name, rather than using outdated abbreviations such as 'BKS'. The proponents argue for the independent classification of languages, like Croatian, to improve accessibility and clarity for library users.

title: Mål om minskad biltrafik
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4207 av Axel Hallberg och Lorentz Tovatt (båda MP)
summary: The proposal advocates for a regular review and comparison of industry-specific costs and regulations in Sweden and its competitor countries to ensure that Swedish companies maintain their competitiveness and protect jobs. The motion emphasizes the importance of being aware of changes in foreign regulations and tax policies that affect competition, suggesting that timely adjustments to Sweden's own rules and taxation are necessary to support domestic industries facing global competition.

title: Minnesmärke för Vipeholmsexperimentens offer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of allowing individuals other than parents to open bank accounts for children and youths. This would enable contributions from relatives or guardians that could remain inaccessible until the child turns 18, thereby facilitating savings specifically for their future use.

title: Reglering och skydd av yrkestitlarna terapeut och psykolog
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of uniform decision-support tools for symptom-based diagnoses, ensuring consistent assessments across Sweden. It particularly emphasizes the newly implemented rules in sick leave regulations, which allow for postponing ability assessments for individuals with conditions like ME/CFS and post-COVID, to support their recovery and return to work.

title: Stoppa s.k. greenwashing – stöd seriösa företag
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4204 av Amanda Palmstierna och Lorentz Tovatt (båda MP)
summary: This motion proposes that Swedish authorities and their inspectors should have a dual mandate: not only to ensure businesses comply with laws and regulations but also to provide helpful advice and suggestions for improvement. It argues that current practices are often one-sided, focusing solely on control without guidance. The motion also advocates for better coordination among various inspectors to reduce the burden on companies, citing a German model of independent monitoring as a potential solution for efficiency.

title: Utvärdera narkotikastrafflagen och stärk de skademinimerande insatserna
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4203 av Nicklas Attefjord och Rasmus Ling (båda MP)
summary: The motion suggests that the Riksdag should require decision-making authorities to clearly outline what would be necessary for a construction project near water to proceed, even if an initial application is denied. Additionally, it proposes the development of specific checklists detailing the requirements for building in such areas, aiming to enhance transparency and predictability for applicants.

title: Utgiftsområde 3 Skatt, tull och exekution
summary: The motion proposes a review of the laws governing who has the legal right to appeal in planning and building permit processes, aiming to strengthen property rights. It suggests that only landowners and property owners should have the right to appeal decisions, as allowing non-stakeholders, such as organizations and individuals without ownership, to contest decisions is seen as undermining property rights. The motion also argues that if organizations are allowed to appeal, they should bear their legal costs since they are not stakeholders in the process.

title: Utgiftsområde 25 Allmänna bidrag till kommuner
summary: The motion proposes removing the requirement for a detailed development plan for the construction of up to five houses in rural areas. It argues that the planning process is often time-consuming and costly, primarily burdening the builders while local municipalities typically handle the planning. The motion suggests that in rural areas, where fewer parties are affected, the necessity for such plans should be reconsidered to facilitate new housing construction.

title: Utgiftsområde 2 Samhällsekonomi och finansförvaltning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reviews how to better consider high electricity prices in the housing supplement for pensioners and to explore the introduction of temporary economic support for pensioners during periods of high electricity prices. The motion highlights the significant economic impact that rising electricity costs have on pensioners, particularly during colder months, and critiques the government's current approach to energy production and pricing.

title: Liberal klimatpolitik – omställning i en växande ekonomi
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into whether the housing supplement for pensioners can be better adjusted to follow the development of housing costs. The focus is on ensuring that pensioners, particularly those with lower incomes and living alone, can access safe and suitable housing as they age. Current regulations do not adequately cater to rising housing costs, creating barriers for seniors who may struggle to remain in or relocate to accessible accommodations.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of the agricultural sector in Skåne and proposes various measures to enhance its productivity and competitiveness. It calls for simplifications in the regulations surrounding the sale of wild boar meat, improved cooperation between agencies and local businesses, and encourages investment in agricultural infrastructure and innovation. Furthermore, the proposal highlights the need for ongoing support for rural communities as viable living and working spaces, promoting tourism and local food production as significant growth areas in the region.

title: Det civila försvaret och krisberedskapen
summary: The suggestion advocates for the creation of a concrete action plan to enhance competitiveness within the plant-based food sector in Sweden, responding to increasing demand driven by climate, transport, and public health considerations. The proposal highlights the potential for growth in domestic production and exports of plant-based products, emphasizing collaboration between government agencies and the private sector to develop strategies that support research, innovation, and infrastructure improvements in the industry.

title: Åtgärder för att minska hundsmugglingen
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the conditions for continuing forest production, particularly in light of recent challenges faced by the forestry sector in Västmanland following devastating fires and ongoing environmental debates. It emphasizes the importance of sustainable forest management for economic contribution, biodiversity, and climate change mitigation, while highlighting the barriers posed by conservation efforts and wildlife management that hinder production.

title: Utgiftsområde 21 Energi
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations concerning tax deductions for home offices to facilitate both employees and self-employed individuals. Currently, while businesses can deduct costs for office spaces, individual and smaller business owners face restrictions on their deductions for home office spaces. The motion highlights the challenges posed by the current rules, especially in the wake of increased remote work due to the pandemic, which has made home offices more relevant and necessary. The proposal aims to modernize the regulations to better support home-based work arrangements.

title: Kriminalvården
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should be obligated to conduct referendums, allowing voters to have the power to force such votes on significant issues if 5% of the electorate requests it. This change aims to enhance democracy by ensuring that voter preferences can directly influence legislative decisions, even against the wishes of elected representatives. The motion also suggests that local referendums can only be halted if 4/5 of the local council votes against it, thereby reducing the chances of dismissing voters' demands.

title: Fri rörlighet och fattiga EU-medborgare
summary: The motion proposes a reduction in the base salaries of members of the Swedish Parliament (riksdag), suggesting that the compensation system for committees and the EU committee be reviewed. It argues that while a high salary is important for attracting competent representatives, the current number of parliamentarians relative to the population allows for a reasonable decrease in the basic salary to facilitate a fair distribution of compensation based on responsibility and workload.

title: Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: The proposal calls for a government ban on unmonitored railway crossings to enhance safety for road users. It emphasizes the risks associated with such crossings, particularly due to silent high-speed trains that can catch pedestrians off-guard, leading to fatalities. To support the goal of zero traffic deaths, the motion advocates for the replacement of unmonitored crossings with ones that are supervised by signals and barriers.

title: Terrorism
summary: The motion proposes that the responsibility for food safety inspections should be taken away from the municipalities and centralized to the state authority. This is suggested to ensure a uniform and competent food control system, as not all municipalities are equipped to handle these responsibilities effectively.

title: Tydliga reaktioner mot brott
summary: This motion calls for the integration of Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry (LULUCF) into Sweden's internal EU commitments, aligning with the agreements made under the Kyoto Protocol's second commitment period. The proposal argues that the current EU stance, which excludes LULUCF from national emissions commitments, undermines the intention of sustainable forest management, requiring a costly bookkeeping system without creating incentives for improvement. The motion aims to incentivize sustainable forestry practices while protecting Swedish jobs and competitiveness.

title: Utbyggnad av riksväg 40
summary: The motion proposes to improve compensation opportunities for the relatives of crime victims who suffer financial burdens due to police cordons and other coercive measures during investigations, such as murder cases. It highlights that families often incur substantial ongoing costs related to their properties, such as taxes and utility bills, while access is restricted during investigations. The motion argues that the state has an interest in protecting crime victims to maintain public trust.

title: Brottsoffer
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the prevalence of accidents caused by cyclists using mobile phones while cycling. Additionally, it suggests extending the existing ban on holding a mobile phone while driving motor vehicles to include bicycles, aiming to enhance road safety and reduce traffic hazards associated with mobile phone use among cyclists.

title: Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a common Nordic digital payment platform to enhance cross-border transactions and cooperation among the Nordic countries. It emphasizes the need for integrated financial systems that communicate across national boundaries, which would facilitate commerce and personal transactions. The proposal stems from the disruptions caused by the pandemic and aims to strengthen regional integration, asserting that a unified payment system would benefit the 27 million residents of the Nordic region.

title: Ombyggnation av riksväg 26/47
summary: The motion advocates for a unified age limit for purchasing alcohol in Sweden, proposing that individuals aged 18, who are considered adults for various significant decisions, should also have the right to buy alcohol at Systembolaget. The current system, which requires young adults to purchase alcohol in bars instead, is deemed illogical and exposes them to risks from illegal alcohol sales and organized crime. The motion suggests that aligning the age limit with the responsibilities afforded to 18-year-olds is necessary for rational lawmaking.

title: Välfärdsbrottslighet
summary: The motion calls for a review of the living conditions of elderly individuals within Swedish elder care, emphasizing the need for a consistent definition of 'reasonable living standards' to ensure that all elderly people are afforded a dignified aging process. The author, Cecilie Tenfjord Toftby, argues that the current interpretation varies by municipality, leading to insufficient support for the elderly, which has been starkly highlighted during the COVID-19 pandemic. The proposal stresses the importance of legislative clarity to guarantee that dignity in aging becomes a universal right across Sweden.

title: Utgiftsområde 20 Allmän miljö- och naturvård
summary: The proposal advocates for reforms aimed at strengthening business operations in Sweden, specifically highlighting the importance of enhancing the competitiveness of the Port of Gothenburg and addressing issues such as high taxes, regulatory complexity, and inflexible labor and housing markets that hinder growth. The suggestion emphasizes that a robust business environment is vital for job creation and contributes significantly to public welfare funding. It calls for government actions to improve infrastructure and support Swedish industries in maintaining competitiveness in a global market.

title: Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: The motion proposes allowing individuals greater freedom in choosing their church affiliation within the Swedish Church, enabling members to belong to a congregation based on personal connections and engagement rather than geographical location. This change aims to address the diverse personal reasons for seeking association with different congregations, including relocation or emotional ties to another community.

title: Ny start för Sverige – Liberalernas budgetmotion för 2022
summary: The motion proposes to amend hunting laws in Sweden to reconsider the status of wolves in order to address issues related to livestock attacks and hunting regulations. It suggests removing wolves from the category of threatened and specially protected wildlife, thereby allowing for their management similar to other game species like moose. The proposal also seeks to ensure that mistaken killing of a wolf does not incur severe penalties, which it argues is not proportionate given the current wolf population exceeding government targets.

title: Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4180 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that any restrictions placed on property rights and decision-making authority regarding land should result in compensation for affected property owners. It argues that strengthening property rights is essential, as current practices by the state and local authorities often impose restrictions without financial reimbursement, which the motion equates to a form of theft. The motion emphasizes that society should bear the costs of protecting areas of public importance, rather than imposing these costs on individual landowners.

title: Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4179 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes that Swedish farmers should not face double economic penalties for the same offense by ensuring that if a farmer is penalized under national law, they should not face further financial penalties through the withdrawal of EU subsidies. The motion advocates for the Swedish government to assert this position within the EU to prevent unjust double punishment for farming errors.

title: Stärk kvaliteten i grundskolan
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4178 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion advocates for the protection of landowner rights in the forestry sector in Skåne, emphasizing the importance of sustainable forest management and the need to enhance the role of private property rights. It highlights concerns over EU regulations potentially undermining Swedish decision-making in forestry practices and calls for more flexibility in national forest policy to accommodate the diverse climatic and geographic conditions in the region. The motion also seeks to amend regulations related to the use of foreign tree species to promote sustainable forestry in harmony with changing climate conditions.

title: Möjliggörande av mer kärnkraft i Sverige
summary: The motion addresses the urgent shortage of veterinarians in Sweden, emphasizing the need for immediate action to ensure sufficient availability of veterinary services for farmers. It argues that without an adequate number of veterinarians, the animal production sector cannot grow, leading to increased costs for farmers and unacceptable delays in animal treatment. The motion calls on the government to take responsibility and find solutions to the recruitment challenges facing the veterinary profession.

title: Högre kvalitet i vuxenutbildning och sfi
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4176 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to retain the use of lead in ammunition for hunting and shooting, arguing that existing restrictions are sufficient and do not unnecessarily hinder hunters and shooters. It emphasizes that lead ammunition has proven effectiveness and safety, particularly in hunting and shooting sports, and warns against the transition to untested alternatives, which could compromise performance and safety. The motion also calls for Sweden to defend its interests in discussions with the EU regarding these regulations.

title: Stärk kvaliteten i förskolan
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4175 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion proposes a review of environmental laws in Sweden to allow for the reuse of excavated materials such as rock and fill during infrastructure projects, rather than transporting them to landfill. The aim is to reduce costs, minimize environmental impact from increased truck traffic, and utilize materials available at the construction site, reflecting practices from earlier road construction methods.

title: Fängslade och försvunna – Dawit Isaak, Ahmadreza Djalali och Gui Minhai m.fl.
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4174 av Amineh Kakabaveh m.fl. (-, M, L, C, MP, KD, S, V)
summary: The motion calls for a review of the supervisory work carried out by county administrations in Sweden regarding illegal hunting, particularly concerning the collection of information about suspected illegal wolf hunters from the public. The proposer argues that it is inappropriate for government authorities to create secret registers of individuals based on anonymous tips, as this undermines legal principles and the rights of unaccused citizens. Instead, any suspicions should be directed to the police for proper investigation and oversight.

title: En folkhälsopolitik att lita på
summary: The motion proposes to review the penalty scale for hunting offenses related to wolves, suggesting that it should be aligned with that of other licensed game animals. The proposal argues that current penalties for mistakenly killing a wolf are excessively high and should be more consistent with penalties for similar offenses involving other game species, stressing the need for fairness for those protecting their livestock and pets.

title: Utgiftsområde 9 Hälsovård, sjukvård och social omsorg
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations governing wastewater fees to allow for more flexibility and differentiation in the fee structure, particularly enabling rural associations to avoid fixed fees and pay only variable fees. This change aims to facilitate construction and habitation in rural areas while ensuring affordable access to wastewater services.

title: Apotek och läkemedel – en självklar del av hälso- och sjukvårdskedjan
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should consider eliminating the requirement for individuals to leave food waste for collection, arguing that the current system is costly and environmentally unfriendly. Instead, it advocates for a voluntary approach whereby individuals who wish to manage their food waste can do so, particularly focusing on educating the public about minimizing food waste and using composting methods, especially in rural areas where residents can manage their waste more sustainably.

title: En äldrepolitik att lita på
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament reconsiders the name of the electoral district currently known as 'Västra Götalands läns östra' and reinstates the traditional name 'Skaraborgs valkrets'. The motion emphasizes the historical significance and local identity associated with the name Skaraborg, arguing that the change back to the traditional name would better reflect the region and satisfy local residents' sentiments.

title: Utgiftsområde 13 Jämställdhet och nyanlända invandrares etablering
summary: The motion proposes to reduce the wolf population in Västmanland due to the challenges posed by the increasing number of wolves, which have led to conflicts with livestock and concerns among local residents. The motion highlights the inadequacies in wildlife management and argues for a decrease in the wolf population to improve local acceptance of wildlife policies and reduce the strain on communities heavily impacted by wolf activity.

title: En hälso- och sjukvård att lita på
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment and facilitation of a pilot area for modern transportation solutions in Sweden's larger cities, emphasizing the importance of innovative transport methods such as electric and autonomous vehicles. It suggests carrying out large-scale tests to enhance infrastructure and urban mobility, while addressing regulatory limitations that hinder progress in the transport sector. The proposal emphasizes the potential benefits for the economy, public transport, and the importance of keeping pace with technological developments in other countries.

title: En socialtjänst att lita på
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4167 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should enhance the decision-making power of wildlife management delegations and review their purpose to ensure local representation in wildlife management decisions. It argues that the current delegations have not effectively addressed local concerns regarding increasing wildlife populations and conflicts among residents, landowners, and hunting groups. The motion calls for a clearer definition of the delegations' mandate and seeks to better align their decisions with the interests of the local communities affected by wildlife management.

title: Utgiftsområde 12 Ekonomisk trygghet för familjer och barn
summary: The motion proposes measures to expand the use of longer and heavier trucks (up to 74 and 90 tons) in Sweden to reduce fuel consumption and emissions. It argues that efficient road transport is crucial for the country due to its geographical size and reliance on trade. The proposal includes urging the government to implement regulatory changes for greater use of heavier trucks, consider trials for even heavier vehicles, and investigate the extension of truck lengths, emphasizing environmental benefits and increased transport efficiency.

title: En funktionshinderspolitik att lita på
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government increase its responsibility in managing and protecting state-owned forests from the spread of the spruce bark beetle, which is causing significant damage to both public and private forests in Sweden. The motion highlights the economic implications and the negative impact on Sweden's climate as growing forests play a crucial role in carbon dioxide absorption. The author argues for a sense of urgency in taking measures to prevent further destruction of forests, suggesting that the state should uphold the same obligations as private forest owners regarding the removal of infected trees.

title: Politik för ett stärkt civilsamhälle
summary: Lars Hjälmered proposes a national preparedness plan for fuel supply aimed at ensuring reliable transportation and mobility during crises or wars. The motion emphasizes the importance of efficient transport systems for the economy and daily life, highlighting lessons learned from the COVID-19 pandemic regarding crisis preparedness. The plan should consider factors such as trade relations, domestic production, storage, and logistics to maintain fuel supply for both civil and military needs, thereby reducing Sweden's vulnerability in times of crisis.

title: Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
summary: This motion advocates for the promotion of trade in Swedish seal products, emphasizing the historical significance of seal hunting in Sweden for communities reliant on seal-derived resources. It argues that the current restrictions on seal hunting and the subsequent trade have negatively impacted the management of seal populations and pose threats to fish stocks. The motion calls on the government to actively pursue a Swedish exception to international trade bans on seal products, allowing for sustainable hunting practices to protect both seal populations and fishing interests.

title: Utgiftsområde 17 Kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid
summary: The motion proposes a national strategy for the expansion of charging infrastructure and electric roads in Sweden, emphasizing the importance of efficient transportation for individuals and businesses. It highlights the rapid development of electric vehicles and the need for sufficient charging facilities at various locations. The motion stresses that the government should take a strategic role in facilitating the deployment of electric roads and coordinating charging infrastructure efforts to support the transition to electrification, while also addressing existing energy challenges in the country.

title: Forskning och högre utbildning av internationellt hög kvalitet i hela landet
summary: The proposal suggests that Sweden should adopt the 'kulgevärsmetoden', a method for slaughtering animals that allows them to be stunned and bled on the farm, thus minimizing stress associated with transport to a slaughterhouse. Furthermore, it emphasizes the need for Sweden to advocate within the EU for the implementation of this method, which is already utilized successfully in countries like Germany and Denmark.

title: Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
summary: This motion proposes stricter penalties and measures to combat organized car theft and auto parts theft in Sweden. It highlights the evolving nature of vehicle theft, suggesting the use of technology such as vehicle monitoring and tracking systems, as well as greater cooperation with customs and international authorities. The motion also addresses the significant increase in auto parts theft and emphasizes the need for law enforcement to treat such incidents as part of broader organized crime rather than isolated cases.

title: Alkohol, narkotika, dopning, tobak och spel om pengar
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider extending the RUT tax deduction to include home delivery services for groceries. The rationale behind this motion is to facilitate safer shopping during pandemic conditions and to promote convenience in everyday life, allowing residents to use the deduction for receiving food deliveries to their homes.

title: Psykisk hälsa
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4158 av Acko Ankarberg Johansson m.fl. (KD)
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish government to empower the police with necessary tools to combat gang-related violence effectively. Highlighting the alarming rise in shootings and gang crime across Sweden, particularly in southern cities like Malmö and Helsingborg, the motion stresses the urgency for action to protect innocent lives and calls for measures such as proactive surveillance of gang members and the establishment of stop-and-search zones.

title: Utgiftsområde 7 Internationellt bistånd
summary: The motion proposes to investigate how the tax system in Sweden can be restructured to effectively encourage private pension savings among a broad group of wage earners. It notes the decline of public pensions and highlights the necessity for individuals to save privately for retirement, given that the public pension system currently does not provide adequate financial security. The motion advocates for the reintroduction of incentives for private pension savings through a modern tax deduction, without necessarily replicating previous models, and suggests looking at successful examples from other countries.

title: Bemötandet av barn i särskilt utsatta situationer
summary: The motion addresses the increase in youth crime in Sweden, focusing on unreported offenses and gang-related activities. It emphasizes the need for enhanced police efforts to prevent young individuals from engaging in criminal behavior, highlighting the importance of early intervention to protect vulnerable youth from gangs, and advocating for witness protection to ensure accountability. The proposal calls for governmental recognition of the issue and encourages necessary actions to mitigate the rising trend of youth involvement in serious crimes.

title: Reglers konsekvenser för företag bör ses över
summary: The motion proposes an expanded collaboration between Sweden, Denmark, and Norway regarding their embassies, representations, delegations, and consulates. It suggests that this cooperation can enhance efficiency and reduce costs by allowing Nordic countries to share resources, particularly in areas where they currently have overlapping diplomatic efforts. The motion emphasizes the similarities between these countries' political systems and cultures, advocating for the establishment of a more integrated foreign representation to better serve their mutual interests.

title: Ökad valfrihet i välfärden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament clarify the governance of state authorities, agencies, and companies to prevent political influence and communication from these institutions. It highlights concerns about state-owned enterprises, specifically mentioning Systembolaget, which allegedly engaged in political propaganda against the sale of alcohol by farms. The motion calls for a review of the regulations governing the political activities of state entities to ensure they remain non-political.

title: Yttrandefrihet på nätet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should improve the regulation surrounding the government's implementation of decisions made by the Parliament. It suggests that the government must report back within two months with a timeline for how they will address these decisions, ensuring that the will of the Parliament and the public is respected and acted upon in a timely manner.

title: Hongkong och Xinjiang
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the support system for political secretaries in order to increase individual members' influence over the allocation and utilization of this support. It highlights the varying demands of parliamentary work depending on the member's constituency and suggests that members should have greater autonomy in determining the assistance and resources available for their political duties.

title: Mer positiv politik för torvbruk på redan dikade marker
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of reintroducing an expanded civil servant liability, emphasizing the need for clear sanctions and consequences for civil servants who deviate from regulations or act on personal agendas. The objective is to ensure public trust in civil servants' adherence to laws and regulations, thereby enhancing legal certainty for all citizens in their dealings with government authorities.

title: Utgiftsområde 12 Ekonomisk trygghet för familjer och barn
summary: The suggestion proposes that the government should enforce stricter requirements on Swedish authorities to adhere to processing time regulations set by Swedish and European legislation. It emphasizes the need for clarity on legal compliance and accountability for authorities that fail to meet these deadlines, which has negatively impacted businesses financially. The proposal particularly points out issues with the Swedish Chemical Agency and the Police Authority regarding their delayed responses, causing economic harm to businesses and urging the government to act to rectify these inefficiencies.

title: Utgiftsområde 11 Ekonomisk trygghet vid ålderdom
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a legislative office within the Swedish Parliament to assist a majority in the Riksdag in legislating directly, thereby circumventing delays often caused by the government in implementing parliamentary decisions. The author argues that the government frequently fails to act on parliamentary requests and that a dedicated legislative support structure is necessary to ensure that decisions made by a parliamentary majority are executed promptly and effectively.

title: Utgiftsområde 10 Ekonomisk trygghet vid sjukdom och funktionsnedsättning
summary: The motion proposes a review of legislation concerning the retention of improperly taken images stored on cloud services, highlighting concerns that sexual offenders can keep such images of their victims, thereby hindering criminal investigations and enabling extortion threats, particularly against young and vulnerable individuals. The motion calls for legislative changes to enhance protection for victims of these crimes.

title: Utgiftsområde 8 Migration
summary: The motion proposes a review of the rules regarding the payment of interpreter costs in order to increase the co-financing ratio for individuals needing interpretation services. It argues that while the right to an interpreter is fundamental for effective communication in healthcare, social services, and the justice system, the burden of costs should not fall solely on the public sector, especially for individuals who have had sufficient time to learn Swedish. The proposal aims to incentivize language learning and reduce state expenditure on interpretation by shifting some costs to those who are capable of acquiring the language.

title: Utgiftsområde 7 Internationellt bistånd
summary: The motion proposes that all students in Sweden should receive education in entrepreneurship during their school years to foster a culture of business creation and support future entrepreneurs. It emphasizes the importance of promoting entrepreneurship as a means to ensure economic growth and job creation, suggesting that the government investigate the expansion of the 'Ung Företagsamhet' program to all high schools and educational lines.

title: Utgiftsområde 6 Försvar och samhällets krisberedskap
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of centralizing the grading of national school tests. This change aims to alleviate the workload of teachers and school staff while ensuring a more uniform assessment of student responses. It is suggested that centralized grading would provide valuable information to subject teachers when assigning grades.

title: Utgiftsområde 5 Internationell samverkan
summary: The motion advocates for the integration of gender equality principles across all governmental agencies and organizations in Sweden, asserting that the efforts towards equality should not rest solely with the reconvened Gender Equality Agency. Instead, the proposal emphasizes that all agencies must take responsibility, with gender equality being a prioritized issue in every governmental directive. It calls for structural changes and a cultural shift within organizations to address wage disparities and other inequalities affecting women.

title: Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review the possibility of including all age groups in screening examinations for diseases. It emphasizes that current age limits in screening programs for conditions such as breast and cervical cancer are based on an insufficient evidential basis, which may lead to discrimination against older individuals. The authors argue that screening can reduce suffering and mortality regardless of age, and that the absence of evidence demonstrating harm should not justify excluding older populations from these health interventions.

title: Utgiftsområde 3 Skatt, tull och exekution
summary: The motion advocates for increased flexibility for the Swedish Armed Forces in selecting defense materials by reducing constraints imposed by existing procurement regulations such as LOU. It argues that these limitations hinder the military's ability to procure the best equipment necessary for national security and calls for a thorough review of procurement rules to enhance the Armed Forces' autonomy in decision-making.

title: Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate ways to better support and facilitate the efforts of collectors in preserving and showcasing their collections. It emphasizes the importance of this work in maintaining cultural heritage and suggests that the government should create a more supportive environment for collectors by easing regulations and providing assistance in displaying their collections.

title: Utgiftsområde 2 Samhällsekonomi och finansförvaltning
summary: The motion proposes enhancing the attractiveness of certain professions, particularly focusing on increasing the availability of part-time firefighters who are also trained home care workers. It highlights the potential benefits of utilizing existing home care staff in emergency situations to respond quickly to incidents such as traffic accidents and medical emergencies. The proposal aims to improve resource efficiency in municipalities by encouraging collaboration between home care and emergency services, while addressing staffing challenges due to an aging population.

title: Dags för ett modernt statsskick
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4139 av Alireza Akhondi m.fl. (C, S, L)
summary: Sten Bergheden's motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review and clarify the regulations surrounding weapon collections to support and facilitate the important cultural work of collectors in preserving and maintaining various types of weapons. The motion emphasizes the difficulties that collectors face due to unclear rules, which hinder their ability to expand their collections and may even force them to sell or destroy weapons they own. The proposal aims to encourage greater support for collectors who contribute to preserving a significant cultural heritage.

title: Inrätta en nationell gängkommission under Noa
summary: The motion proposes a revision of Sweden's crisis preparedness measures following the drought of 2018, emphasizing the need for a faster and more effective response plan for future drought emergencies based on lessons learned from the previous crisis.

title: Nationell strategi för att omvandla utsatta områden till trygga och säkra boendemiljöer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should encourage the government to conduct a review aimed at facilitating and providing incentives for the recruitment of more part-time firefighters, addressing the current difficulties in staffing and the closure of smaller fire stations due to a lack of personnel.

title: Utgiftsområde 21 Energi
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate and plan for larger stockpiles of protective equipment, medications, and medical supplies, in response to vulnerabilities highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic. The author emphasizes the need for improved preparedness for unexpected crises, arguing that Sweden's current supply levels are inadequate and require immediate attention.

title: Utgiftsområde 22 Kommunikationer
summary: The motion proposes a review of a municipality's ability to deny connections of sprinkler systems to municipal water networks, particularly for senior housing. With an aging population and the increasing need for safe living conditions for the elderly, the proposal highlights current construction regulations mandating sprinkler systems in new buildings. It argues that restrictive municipal water network policies result in higher costs for installing alternative firefighting measures, potentially deterring the construction of new senior housing and leaving older individuals in less secure living arrangements.

title: Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Riksdag consider requiring banks to ensure adequate cash handling services across the country for businesses, associations, and private individuals. It emphasizes the importance of cash accessibility, particularly in rural areas where digital payment options may be inadequate. The motion argues that the decline of bank branches and ATMs negatively impacts local communities and businesses, necessitating a regulatory response to guarantee cash availability without prohibitive fees.

title: Utgiftsområde 24 Näringsliv
summary: The motion proposes the immediate repeal of the plastic bag tax in Sweden, which was introduced on May 1, 2020. The tax, set at 3 kronor per bag and 30 öre for fruit and vegetable bags, was expected to generate tax revenue of 2.1 billion kronor, but this has not materialized. The motion argues that the tax has led to an increase in the import of less environmentally-friendly plastic bags from China, which are produced under poorer conditions. The author contends that it is misguided to tax Swedish recycled plastic bags in favor of importing inferior alternatives, thus calling for the abolition of the tax for the benefit of both the climate and consumers.

title: Utgiftsområde 25 Allmänna bidrag till kommuner
summary: The motion suggests that the Swedish Parliament evaluate the economic and environmental impacts of the plastic bag tax, as the anticipated revenue of 2.1 billion SEK has not been realized. It argues that importing plastic bags from China undermines both the economy and the environment, especially when Sweden has the capability to produce eco-friendly bags locally using recycled materials. A review of the effects of the tax is deemed necessary after almost a year of its implementation.

title: Den svenska basindustrin
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the possibility of reducing or eliminating VAT on wooden houses to encourage their construction, thereby increasing carbon sequestration and contributing to climate efforts. It argues that taxing environmentally beneficial wooden houses is unreasonable and advocates for measures to promote greater use of timber products in building.

title: Utgiftsområde 17 Kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid
summary: The motion proposes an extension of the anti-money laundering law to include property insurance, aimed at combating criminal activities that convert illegal earnings into legitimate income. By targeting insurance claims related to stolen or damaged high-value assets, the suggestion seeks to prevent criminals from exploiting the insurance system to launder money, thereby reducing costs for insurance companies and disrupting criminal networks.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive investigation into Swedish bureaucracy with the aim of reducing processing times and costs associated with bureaucratic systems. It argues that Sweden's bureaucracy stands out negatively compared to similar countries and suggests that the current inefficiencies lead to increased operational costs and delays. The motion calls for policy changes to streamline procedures, consolidate agencies, reduce office space needs, and improve overall efficiency in government operations.

title: Utgiftsområde 9 Hälsovård, sjukvård och social omsorg
summary: The proposal suggests the abolition of the tax on household services (RUT services) for seniors aged 65 and older. It argues that while demand for these services is high among the elderly population, financial constraints often prevent them from accessing such help. Eliminating the tax could make these services more affordable and increase their availability, thereby enhancing the quality of life, independence, and safety for seniors. Additionally, the proposal highlights the potential for job creation in the service industry given an increase in demand for RUT services.

title: Utgiftsområde 13 Jämställdhet och nyanlända invandrares etablering
summary: The motion proposes an overhaul of the control function of shooting ranges in Sweden by transferring the responsibility for oversight and approval of both civilian and military ranges from the police to the Fortifications Agency (Fortifikationsverket). This change is suggested in light of the police's resource limitations and aims to establish a centralized system for managing shooting ranges that can be utilized in emergencies and maintaining an updated record of their condition. The proposal implies that the Fortifications Agency could charge shooting clubs for inspections, which would not impact the state budget.

title: Utgiftsområde 16 Utbildning och universitetsforskning
summary: The motion proposes several measures to facilitate job readiness and housing for youth, including the introduction of internships in all high school programs, enhancing job-focused career guidance in schools, and implementing a tax deduction for young people saving for their own housing. These initiatives aim to strengthen the connection between education and the labor market, while also providing financial incentives for young workers.

title: Utgiftsområde 15 Studiestöd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider allowing activities such as hunting and sport shooting to be included under the wellness benefits available to employees, arguing that these activities contribute to both physical and mental health, similar to other accepted forms of wellness activities. It calls for a broader interpretation of wellness activities to encompass various forms of physical training that occur outside traditional gym settings.

title: Utgiftsområde 20 Allmän miljö- och naturvård
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament consider the possibility of introducing a tax deduction for individuals who obtain a bus or truck driving license, provided it leads to employment as a driver. The rationale is to make it financially easier for youth to obtain their licenses, thereby increasing the number of qualified bus and truck drivers in Sweden and supporting mobility and job opportunities across the country.

title: Utgiftsområde 19 Regional utveckling
summary: The motion proposes to reduce the VAT on dance concerts from 25% to 6%, aligning it with the lower VAT rate applied to other concerts and sports events. The rationale is that lowering the tax would encourage participation in dance activities, which are beneficial for public health and social interaction. The motion argues that the current higher tax rate unfairly disadvantages those attending dance concerts.

title: Utgiftsområde 18 Samhällsplanering, bostadsförsörjning och byggande samt konsumentpolitik
Centerpartiets budgetmotion 2022
summary: The motion advocates for enhancing the capability of the Swedish Home Guard to operate effectively in darkness, highlighting the importance of night combat proficiency within the broader context of increasing the Swedish military's overall readiness and strength following years of cuts and inactivity. It emphasizes the urgent need to address the current shortfall in nighttime operational capacity among a significant portion of Home Guard units.

title: Motionen utgår
summary: The motion proposes ensuring the independence and self-sufficiency of public service broadcasters in Sweden, stating that they should not compete with commercial entities. It advocates for a clarification and streamlining of the public service mandate, emphasizing a focus on public information such as news, factual programming, societal debates, and science rather than large entertainment productions. The motion suggests that the public service mission should be modernized to adapt to the growing diversity of commercial media while being flexible in terms of distribution channels.

title: Fristäder för kulturarbetare och journalister
summary: The proposal suggests implementing specialized gender equality education within the societal introduction program for newly arrived immigrants in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for effective integration by teaching the values and norms that characterize Swedish society, particularly regarding gender equality, as many immigrants come from backgrounds where gender oppression is prevalent. The motion advocates for making societal orientation truly mandatory, with an examination component included, to ensure that gender equality is a significant focus in the integration process.

title: Ett fritt och föränderligt kulturliv i pandemins spår
summary: The motion proposes introducing a requirement for completed SMO training for anyone wishing to become a full-time firefighter in Sweden. The author argues that just as professions in healthcare, education, and policing require formal qualifications, so too should firefighters. Currently, the decision on the educational prerequisites for firefighters lies with individual municipalities, which could potentially lead to unqualified individuals being hired. The motion aims to ensure a standardized level of training, thereby enhancing the quality and status of the firefighting profession.

title: Gribshunden
summary: The motion emphasizes the increasing shortage of skilled labor for vital infrastructure projects in Sweden, particularly in the Stockholm-Mälar region, which is hindering the progress of major developments such as housing and transportation. It highlights that the lack of professionals, including civil engineers and construction workers, is exacerbated by issues like potential electric grid capacity shortages and uncertainties surrounding cement availability. The submission warns that this skills gap could result in significant economic losses amounting to up to 25 billion kronor over the next decade, as well as a loss of tax revenue due to delayed projects.

title: Utgiftsområde 3 Skatt, tull och exekution
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a fee for bomb shelters to increase the number of inspections conducted on these facilities. Currently, there are significant deficiencies in the maintenance of the approximately 65,000 bomb shelters in Sweden, which undermines their effectiveness during potential crises. The author argues that this fee would allow for improved oversight without imposing additional costs on the state, ensuring better protection for the civilian population in the event of an emergency.

title: Utgiftsområde 2 Samhällsekonomi och finansförvaltning
summary: This motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support Ängelholm-Helsingborg Airport in receiving state funding, citing the adverse effects of the pandemic on regional airports' operations. The authors argue that, unlike other regional airports, Ängelholm-Helsingborg was excluded from government crisis support despite its economic significance and past financial viability. They emphasize the airport's importance for local businesses, tourism, employment, and vital community services, urging the government to take action to ensure its survival and integration into future funding plans for regional airports.

title: Utgiftsområde 25 Allmänna bidrag till kommuner
summary: This parliamentary motion suggests that the Swedish government should propose the construction of monitored transport centers to address the needs of heavy vehicle drivers who require sanitation facilities and rest areas. It also proposes that the police enforce penalties for illegally parked heavy vehicles and undocumented stays in the country, aiming to improve logistics, safety, and working conditions for professional drivers, as well as to combat illegal traffic in Sweden.

title: Alla barns rätt till utbildning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of establishing precedential court rulings, which would provide clarity in legal interpretations, especially concerning ambiguous legislative frameworks. The author argues that such precedents would aid in making consistent decisions in regulatory matters without overburdening individual businesses and citizens, as the legal processes would be detached from specific cases. This approach aims to alleviate uncertainties and costs faced by individuals and businesses involved in legal disputes.

title: Vuxenmobbning i arbetslivet
motion_id: Motion 2021/22:4112 av Nicklas Attefjord och Leila Ali-Elmi (båda MP)
summary: This parliamentary motion emphasizes the urgent need to combat increasing antibiotic resistance, which poses a significant threat to global health. It highlights the historical significance of antibiotics, the current crisis caused by multi-drug resistant bacteria, and the escalating numbers of deaths and healthcare costs associated with this issue. The motion calls for comprehensive actions across multiple sectors, including healthcare, agriculture, and industry, to promote responsible antibiotic use, accelerate the development of new antibiotics, and establish a national action plan to address the growing challenge of antibiotic resistance effectively.

title: Förläng livet på prylarna och planeten
