It addresses the need for systemic changes in youth care facilities and calls for the abolition of the crime of exploitation of children for purchasing sexual acts, advocating for enhanced protections aligned with international child protection standards.

title: Indexering av nämndemäns arvoden
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2058 av Mats Wiking och Jonathan Svensson (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into the possibility of indexing the compensation rates for lay judges (nämndemän) in order to ensure that their earnings keep pace with inflation and changes in the currency's purchasing power. It highlights that the compensation for lay judges has remained unchanged for long periods, leading to a depreciation of its value, and suggests that annual indexing could provide a more effective compensation management strategy.

title: Stopp för flödesbaserad kapacitetsberäkning på elmarknaden
summary: Niels Paarup-Petersen proposes that the Swedish Parliament pauses or stops the implementation of flow-based capacity calculations in the electricity market, set to begin on October 29, 2024. The proposal highlights widespread criticism from market actors, consumers, and producers, who argue that the new system could lead to increased electricity prices, as evidenced by recent test runs. The author emphasizes the need for thorough analyses and a reevaluation of the current system to prevent further economic harm to consumers in southern Sweden.

title: För ett tryggare Malmö och Sverige
summary: This proposal from Niels Paarup-Petersen (C) calls for a series of measures aimed at enhancing safety in Malmö and Sweden, including stricter regulations on car ownership to combat organized crime, improved identification processes for vehicle ownership transfers, and increased support for municipalities in their efforts against gang-related activities. It emphasizes the need for coordinated actions among various authorities to tackle the roots of crime in society, including education and social services, while also proposing legislative amendments to enhance law enforcement capabilities and protections for witnesses and victims.

title: AI:s betydelse för framtidens arbetsmarknad och skola
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of an inquiry to map the needs and conditions for future education and a learning work life in light of AI's impact on the job market. It includes suggestions for ongoing data collection concerning work organization and new business models, as well as establishing a right for companies to write off investments in human capital similar to physical capital. The aim is to address changing skill requirements and enhance the current educational system to better adapt to the evolving job landscape shaped by technological advancements.

title: Stöd till barn på skyddat boende
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of support for children residing in sheltered accommodations, acknowledging that around half of those living in such facilities are children who accompany their mothers fleeing domestic violence. The motion highlights the lack of dedicated support for these children, who are often overlooked in the current system, and emphasizes the need for counseling and trauma support during and after their stay in secure housing. It calls for legislative changes to ensure children's rights to assistance, thus emphasizing the critical importance of addressing the needs of vulnerable children in these situations.

title: Trafikljus för minskad olycksrisk
summary: The motion advocates for safer traffic measures by suggesting the implementation of traffic lights that flash green three times before changing to yellow, as seen in Austria. This approach aims to reduce the risk of accidents and aligns with Sweden's vision of zero fatalities in traffic.

title: Endometrios
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for increased awareness and understanding of endometriosis, its symptoms, and effects, urging the government to ensure proper diagnosis and treatment for affected individuals. It highlights the challenges young girls face, such as missing school due to the illness, and calls for improved healthcare protocols within primary care and school health services to facilitate early and accurate diagnosis and management.

title: Gårdsförsäljning och alkoholhaltiga drycker
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2051 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion advocates for the implementation of farm sales of alcoholic beverages in Sweden, suggesting a review of existing restrictions related to these sales and the associated food requirement. It highlights the potential economic benefits for local tourism and businesses, drawing on examples from southern Europe where such practices have been successful. The motion also argues for the simplification of regulations surrounding serving areas to promote local producers and enhance culinary tourism.

title: Levande fiske i Skåne
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2050 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of maintaining small-scale and self-sustaining fishing in Skåne, advocating for government support to ensure these practices continue along the coast. It argues for clearer mandates for regulatory bodies to allow such fishing without prohibition, highlighting the cultural and historical significance of fishing in the region. The motion calls for evidence-based fishing regulations and more sustainable practices that respect local traditions while also addressing conservation concerns. It suggests learning from Denmark's approach to integrate various interests in fishing management.

title: Indelning av länder och språk på bibliotek
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2049 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson och Mats Sander (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for a reform in how libraries classify and organize books by language and country. Specifically, it suggests that books related to Bosnia, Croatia, and Serbia should be cataloged under their respective initial letters (B for Bosnia, C for Croatia, etc.) rather than the outdated acronym BKS. The motion emphasizes the importance of accurately reflecting the independence of these nations and facilitating easier access for patrons by implementing a logical alphabetical system.

title: Bodelning som drar ut på tiden
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to support an investigation into how to make the property division process during divorces more efficient and faster, as current lengthy procedures can lead to financial difficulties for individuals, particularly women, involved in these processes. The motion aims to address the issue of prolonged divorce settlements that can take years and urges the government to consider legislative changes to expedite these processes.

title: Borgerlig vigselförrättare
main_author: Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson och Mats Sander
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2047 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson och Mats Sander (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the review of the possibility for civil marriage officiants to perform marriages for Swedish citizens in neighboring countries, as well as the conditions under which civil marriage officiants operate. This would facilitate Swedish couples wishing to marry abroad, particularly in contexts where they have personal connections, such as on ferries or in specific locations. Additionally, it calls for a reassessment of the compensation for civil marriage officiants, which has not been updated for a long time.

title: Uppföljning och utvärdering av Arbetsförmedlingens inköp
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2046 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson och Ludvig Ceimertz (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers the possibility of having an independent body take over the role of the Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen) in monitoring and evaluating contracted services. This change aims to mitigate conflicts of interest and ensure objective assessments of both the Employment Service's work and the services provided by private contractors.

title: Skogsnäringen i Skåne
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2045 av Ann-Charlotte Hammar Johnsson m.fl. (M)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of sustainable forestry in Skåne and advocates for a comprehensive review of the region's unique conditions to optimize forest management practices for climate benefits. It argues that actively managed forests sequester more carbon than unmanaged ones and stresses the need for national control over Swedish forest policy, particularly in consideration of local biodiversity and economic growth. The motion calls for increased research into a broader range of tree species suitable for the changing climate, as well as exploring new economic opportunities associated with forestry and tourism.

title: Synligare skatter
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2044 av Anna af Sillén och Jesper Skalberg Karlsson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports giving the Swedish Tax Agency a mandate to enhance public awareness regarding the positive effects of the job tax deduction and to clarify the size of employer contributions for employees. It emphasizes that increased information about the financial benefits of employment can lead to higher employment rates and calls for transparency surrounding employer contributions, which are currently underreported and undervalued in the workforce. This aims to improve understanding of the overall tax burden on salaries, thereby benefiting both the economy and democratic transparency.

title: Minska skarvens negativa påverkan på naturområden samt möjlighet att driva verksamhet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2043 av Ann-Sofie Lifvenhage och Anna af Sillén (båda M)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament take measures to reduce the population of the cormorant, an invasive species negatively impacting natural areas and local businesses, particularly along the Sörmland coast. The authors argue that the increasing cormorant population has detrimental effects on fishing, tourism, and the overall attractiveness of the coastal areas, while also affecting property values. They call for Sweden to work towards changes in EU regulations and advocate for increased hunting and egg treatments to mitigate the issue.

title: Tryggheten på landsbygden
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2042 av Anna af Sillén och Adam Reuterskiöld (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes measures to enhance safety in rural areas of Sweden, addressing issues such as low police presence and rising crime rates, particularly related to property crimes. It calls for increased governmental responsibility in crime prevention, stricter penalties for severe thefts, and better enforcement against cross-border theft. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of respecting property rights and suggests that regulations regarding land ownership and use should be more favorable to individuals. The motion highlights the necessity for the state to uphold laws that protect citizens' safety and property rights.

title: Stopp för tvångsanslutning av välfungerande enskilda avlopp
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2041 av Anna af Sillén och Adam Reuterskiöld (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes a review of legislation regarding mandatory connections of functioning private sewage systems to municipal systems, arguing that current regulations impose stricter environmental requirements on individuals and businesses than on the state. It emphasizes that homeowners with compliant systems should not be forced to connect to already burdened municipal systems, advocating for equal environmental standards and the importance of allowing property owners to manage their own sewage solutions.

title: Sänkta kostnader för företag stärker Sveriges välfärd och konkurrenskraft
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2040 av Anna af Sillén och Mats Green (båda M)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of reducing costs for businesses in order to enhance Sweden's welfare and competitiveness. It calls on the parliament to assess possibilities for lowering hiring costs and increasing transparency in employer contributions. Highlighting the significant burden of employer taxes, particularly the general wage tax, the motion argues for reforms to create a more favorable environment for job creation that supports the country's economic growth and social welfare.

title: Strandskyddet och äganderätten
summary: Kjell Jansson's motion advocates for a reform of the existing coastal protection laws in Sweden to enhance property rights and facilitate housing development, particularly in coastal areas. The motion argues that the current regulations restrict landowners' ability to build on their properties and impede municipalities from developing attractive waterfront areas. It calls for a more balanced approach to legislation that would prioritize property owner's interests while still protecting nature where necessary. Jansson suggests that municipalities should manage coastal protections and that the appeal process for land use decisions should be transferred to environmental courts to reduce delays.

title: Det industriella trålfisket i Östersjön
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to consider investigating the possibility of halting industrial trawling in the Baltic Sea, particularly due to the significant decline in fish stocks, especially sprat, attributed to excessive commercial fishing practices by Danish trawlers. The motion highlights the risk of the depletion of fish resources in the Stockholm archipelago within the next two decades if no action is taken.

title: Körkortskrav på skotrar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2037 av Kjell Jansson och Crister Carlsson (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of removing the requirement for a motorcycle license for scooters with an engine capacity of a maximum of 125 cc in Sweden, as these scooters are becoming increasingly popular and are typically allowed to be driven with a car license in other EU countries.

title: Stärkt rättssamhälle och äganderätt
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into the legal and economic conditions for individuals to receive compensation for their legal costs when they take legal action against government authorities. It emphasizes the importance of private property rights as fundamental to democracy and argues that current practices undermine trust in the legal system by requiring individuals to bear their own costs, even when they win against public institutions.

title: Äganderätt och miljöundantag
summary: This motion advocates for strengthening the weakened Swedish property rights by reviewing and clarifying the environmental exemption in the constitution. The author argues that the current interpretation often undermines private property rights and threatens democracy, suggesting that government actions referencing environmental reasons frequently lead to lack of compensation for property owners affected by expropriations. The proposal calls for stricter application of environmental protection measures and increased compensation for property owners in instances of intrusion due to these regulations.

title: En mer ändamålsenlig bullerlagstiftning genom bullerservitut
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review and reform of Sweden's noise legislation to adapt to modern housing needs and construction methods. Key suggestions include equalizing noise limits for different sources based on levels and frequencies, implementing noise servitudes to facilitate construction near noise sources, and introducing noise declarations to enhance individual accountability. The proposal argues that current regulations hinder housing development near areas with existing noise pollution, despite advancements in building technology that allow for better noise management.

title: Bluffakturor och konsekvenser för företag och enskilda av otillräckliga krav för att få bedriva inkassoverksamhet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2033 av Mats Green och Anna af Sillén (båda M)
summary: This motion proposes that the Parliament investigates the requirements for starting and operating debt collection businesses in Sweden to combat the increasing issue of fraudulent invoices that significantly impact businesses. The motion highlights the need for stricter regulations and oversight to prevent criminal elements from exploiting the debt collection process, which has become increasingly prevalent due to insufficient criteria for obtaining licenses in this sector. The authors argue for enhanced collaboration between institutions to protect legitimate businesses and individuals from fraudulent practices.

title: Skarpare direktiv vad gäller myndigheterna och äganderätten
summary: This motion proposes a review of the regulations governing Swedish authorities to strengthen the weakened ownership rights by establishing clearer directives that respect the protection of property rights in government operations. The motion argues that the current challenges to private ownership threaten democracy and asserts that the implementation of property protection has declined, necessitating more definitive requirements in government regulations to ensure adherence to ownership rights.

title: Införande av s.k. declaration of interest för offentligt anställda
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a 'declaration of interest' for publicly employed individuals in Sweden. This initiative aims to address concerns about personal activism in public service, which could lead to conflicts of interest. By requiring public employees to disclose their personal engagements that may impact their official duties, the motion seeks to enhance transparency, strengthen the rule of law, and increase public trust in governmental institutions.

title: Miljöbalken och äganderätten
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the weakened ownership rights in Sweden by considering a review and changes to the Environmental Code and species protection regulations, citing concerns that current legislation undermines private property rights, which are essential to democracy.

title: Art- och habitatdirektivet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review the possibility of establishing a compensation system for land confiscated under the EU's Habitats Directive and the Swedish Species Protection Ordinance. It argues that while Sweden must adhere to EU regulations, the current interpretation that allows for the confiscation of land without compensation is unfair to landowners, particularly in cases where land use is halted by regulatory measures.

title: Rätt till delaktighet och överklagan för markägare
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2028 av Mats Green och Adam Reuterskiöld (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes strengthening property rights in Sweden by ensuring landowners' participation, influence, and the right to appeal decisions affecting their property. It argues that the current trends undermine private ownership and democracy, highlighting that land can be designated for various uses without landowner consultation or the right to appeal, creating uncertainty about future land use. The motion emphasizes the importance of involving landowners early in the decision-making process.

title: Viltförvaltningsdelegationernas mandat och sammansättning
summary: Mats Green proposes that the Swedish parliament empowers local wildlife management delegations to be the highest decision-making authority in wildlife management, emphasizing the importance of local self-determination. The motion suggests reverting to the previous composition of these delegations, which currently favor environmental interests over hunting and landowner interests, thereby creating an imbalance. Green argues that this shift will enhance local engagement and trust in decision-making processes regarding wildlife management.

title: Återvinning av glykol
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should consider implementing requirements for the recycling of glycol, highlighting the absence of such regulations despite the existence of a unique method in Jönköping for effectively purifying and recycling used glycol. This method is environmentally friendly, minimizes waste, and promotes the sustainable reuse of glycol, which is derived from finite resources like crude oil. The motion emphasizes the environmental benefits of recycling glycol over incineration, which is less efficient and more harmful to the atmosphere. It draws on EU waste directives to advocate for prioritizing waste prevention, reuse, and material recovery.

title: Specifika krav för skydd av natur
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen Swedish property rights by establishing specific requirements for the protection of nature, particularly on privately owned land. It argues that ownership is fundamental to democracy and that any encroachments on landowners' rights must be clearly justified, rather than based on vague or arbitrary guidelines. The motion emphasizes the need for precise reasoning behind decisions that affect land use and ownership to protect individual rights.

title: En stärkt svensk sjöfartsnäring
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of a functional Swedish shipping industry for the nation's economy, highlighting its critical role in export and import activities as well as its impact on the tourism sector. It points out the declining trend of the Swedish merchant fleet and calls for government action to enhance competitiveness through measures such as adjusting the tonnage tax and ensuring support for Swedish-flagged vessels, particularly in light of potential crises where national defense might require access to these ships.

title: Stärkt sydsvenskt försvar
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the defense capabilities in southern Sweden in response to the deteriorating security situation in the Baltic Sea region due to Russia's actions, particularly following its invasion of Ukraine. It calls for enhanced military presence and readiness, improved infrastructure for military mobility, and a focus on both military and civil defense measures. The suggestion emphasizes the importance of NATO membership for collective security and proposes an increase in defense funding to ensure preparedness for potential conflicts.

title: Ökad transparens i tillståndsprocesser
summary: The motion proposes increasing transparency in the permit processes in Sweden, which can include various permits such as building permits, alcohol-serving permits, and environmental permits. The proposal highlights the lengthy processing times which lead to significant costs for businesses, and it suggests implementing a system where parties involved are regularly updated on the status of their applications, specifically within six months of submission, and subsequently every six months until a final decision is made. This is aimed at improving trust in the system and reducing the perception that cases are stalled.

title: Tillgängliggörande av textmaterial i Kungliga biblioteket
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into how text data from the Royal Library and the National Archives can be made accessible for training AI models, while considering any limitations that may apply. The motion highlights the importance of having high-quality, culturally relevant training data for AI models used in Swedish public administration and proposes that this initiative could enhance Sweden's competitiveness in AI development within Europe.

title: Säkerställande av långsiktig finansiering av forskningsprogram av strategisk betydelse
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers investigating how to maintain and further develop knowledge centers in education and academic research that have been established through large private research initiatives after the cessation of private funding. The motion emphasizes the importance of these initiatives, such as the Wallenberg research programs, in sustaining Sweden's long-term competitive advantage in strategic areas like artificial intelligence and quantum technology, and calls for a state strategy to retain research capabilities and talent in the face of shifting funding landscapes.

title: Tillsyn av landets förskolor
summary: The motion proposes that the oversight of independent preschools in Sweden should be reviewed and potentially transferred from local municipalities to the national School Inspection Authority. The current system, where municipalities are responsible for supervising both their own preschools and independent ones, raises concerns about fairness and competence in oversight due to possible conflicts of interest and varying political influences across different municipalities.

title: Ett Skåne fritt från varg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider the possibility of making Skåne wolf-free due to increasing wolf populations and associated issues affecting livestock farming, including numerous livestock attacks and economic distress for farmers. It highlights the historical absence of wolves in Skåne since the 1800s and argues that their presence poses threats to both domestic animals and human safety, urging a review of the situation with a focus on protecting local farmers and unique wildlife in the region.

title: Föräldraansvar vid vårdkontakt för 13-åringar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2017 av Ludvig Ceimertz och Caroline Högström (båda M)
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the current regulations that limit parental access to their children's medical information and involvement in healthcare decisions once a child turns 13. It suggests that parents should have greater ability to assist their children with medical contacts and calls for the option to conceal certain parts of medical records from parents, especially in sensitive areas such as sexual and reproductive health, to ensure that children's privacy is respected while still allowing for parental support.

title: Stärkt kommunal rätt att anordna lokal kollektivtrafik
summary: Charlotte Nordström's motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider clarifying legislation to empower municipalities to organize local public transport where regional services are insufficient. The motion emphasizes the importance of public transport for achieving climate goals, enhancing community utility, and supporting local economies, particularly in rural areas. It is argued that allowing municipalities to manage their own transport systems would promote sustainable development and improve accessibility for residents.

title: Ungas ställning på bostadsmarknaden
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen the position of young people in Sweden's housing market by advocating for government initiatives such as investment support for student housing, ensuring students' rights to a good living environment, and opposing market rents. It emphasizes the urgent need for a proactive housing policy to facilitate access to affordable housing for students and young people, responding to ongoing concerns about the housing crisis they face.

title: Psykisk ohälsa bland unga
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review aimed at combating the rising mental health issues among the youth in Sweden. It emphasizes the urgent need to address the growing incidences of anxiety and depression, exacerbated by various factors such as school stress, social media pressures, and job market instability. The authors argue that the current situation constitutes an epidemic affecting all social strata and call for improved resources and support systems within schools to facilitate earlier detection and quicker assistance for affected young individuals.

title: Betyget F
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2013 av Adrian Magnusson och Marianne Fundahn (båda S)
summary: The proposal aims to investigate the possibility of abolishing the failing grade (F) in compulsory school, arguing that the current grading system contributes to high rates of students lacking eligibility for high school and induces significant psychological stress. It highlights that a considerable number of students are unable to continue their education due to not achieving passing grades, particularly emphasizing the negative effects on low-performing students and those with various difficulties. The motion advocates for a system that better supports all children and reflects on historical practices where failing grades were not implemented.

title: Järnvägsförbindelser till kontinenten
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2012 av Adrian Magnusson och Marianne Fundahn (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of maintaining railway connections to the continent for the transportation of goods, noting the reliance on the Öresund Bridge for moving 7 million tons annually. It argues that long-term disruptions could significantly impact the flow of goods, and while alternatives exist through railway ferries in Trelleborg and Ystad, these require substantial investment and compatible vessels. The motion calls on the government to take greater responsibility for ensuring these vital transport links.

title: Mer forskning om kvinnosjukdomar – för en jämställd hälsa
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2011 av Jessica Rodén och Petter Löberg (båda S)
summary: The motion calls for increased research funding for women's health-related diseases and the implementation of mandatory studies on these conditions in medical and nursing education programs. This proposal aims to address the existing disparities in healthcare treatment between genders, highlighting that women have historically received lower priority in medical research and treatment. The authors argue for a gender-sensitive approach to healthcare to ensure equitable treatment and access to quality care for all patients.

title: De statliga bolagens medlemskap i Svenskt Näringsliv
summary: The motion suggests that state-owned companies in Sweden should withdraw their membership from Svenskt Näringsliv, a central organization for business representation that engages in political advocacy, and instead join a non-political employers' organization. Additionally, it calls for the government to implement measures requiring state-owned enterprises to disclose their organizational memberships and the financial contributions made to each organization annually. The rationale provided emphasizes the importance of impartiality and objectivity in state operations, arguing that memberships in Svenskt Näringsliv conflicts with these government values.

title: Vapenvila i Gaza, sanktioner mot bosättarrörelsen och frysning av handelsavtalet mellan Israel och EU
summary: The motion calls for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza, the freezing of the trade agreement between the EU and Israel, and the imposition of sanctions against Israeli settlers and a ban on their goods in the EU. It emphasizes the humanitarian crisis resulting from the ongoing conflict, particularly affecting civilians in Gaza and the West Bank, and condemns the indiscriminate violence against non-combatants. The proposal argues that Israel's actions undermine the possibility of a two-state solution and calls for increased pressure from the international community to restore peace and uphold international law.

title: Infrastruktur i Västsverige
summary: This motion advocates for the development of sustainable infrastructure in Western Sweden, emphasizing the need for a green transition that prioritizes both environmental concerns and human well-being. It highlights the region's historical significance in international trade through its ports and waterways, and calls for strategic investments to modernize ports, enhance transportation connections, and build a resilient infrastructure that supports economic growth while reducing environmental impact.

title: Destinationsutveckling av östra Skåne
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of eastern Skåne as a destination, highlighting its untapped potential compared to the more prosperous western part of the region. It points out the demographic challenges faced by eastern Skåne, including an aging population and declining municipalities, alongside recent cutbacks in healthcare and public transport. The motion calls for increased investments in infrastructure, tourism, and overall development to enhance growth and connectivity in eastern Skåne, benefitting not only the region but also Sweden and the wider Baltic Sea area.

title: Långsiktiga förutsättningar för mänskliga rättigheter
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:2006 av Carina Ståhl Herrstedt m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should clarify the conditions under which standardized parental deductions should be applied in the context of personal assistance for individuals with significant disabilities. It also suggests initiating work to draft legislation that ensures all types of support for basic needs qualify for personal assistance. The motion emphasizes the importance of personal assistance as a fundamental human right and calls for measures to address the current shortcomings of the parental deduction system, which has inadvertently limited access to necessary support for children.

title: Ett fritt och konkurrenskraftigt jordbruk
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate opportunities for regulatory simplifications and deregulations in agriculture, as well as the possibility of reducing taxes to create better economic conditions for the sector. It highlights the importance of a thriving agricultural sector for food security, sustainability, and environmental considerations, and suggests that supportive policies should focus on enabling competition rather than reliance on subsidies. The motion also calls for adjustments in animal welfare regulations to align better with EU standards.

title: Politisk strejk
summary: The motion calls for the parliament to consider limiting the possibility of political strikes, which are strikes motivated by political circumstances rather than labor conditions. The proposer argues that it is unjust for employers to suffer productivity losses and economic harm due to political actions unrelated to their workplaces, emphasizing that political strikes lack connection to employment conditions.

title: Avskaffande av den statliga inkomstskatten
summary: The proposal advocates for the abolishment of the state income tax in Sweden, suggesting a tax reform based on a flat income tax system. It argues that the current progressive tax system is unjust and places a burden on workers, particularly those whose income marginally exceeds a threshold, thus proposing that a flat tax could be self-financing and potentially increase overall tax revenues.

title: Överklagandeprocesser
summary: This motion proposes a reform of the appeals process in Sweden to streamline and expedite planning and building procedures, which are currently seen as cumbersome and slow. Key suggestions include limiting the rights to appeal to adjacent property owners, establishing time limits and guarantees for handling appeals, and reducing the number of instances where appeals can be made. Additionally, it advocates for reforming the planning and building legislation to simplify requirements and decrease the potential for misuse that slows down construction projects.

title: Omkörningsförbud för tung trafik
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the conditions for implementing a general overtaking ban for heavy traffic on Swedish roads, particularly focusing on expanding existing restrictions along highways. The aim is to improve traffic flow on motorways and reduce disruptions caused by heavy vehicles overtaking each other at lower speed limits, especially as speed limits increase.

title: En pension att kunna leva på
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate how to significantly reduce taxes for pensioners, specifically through a higher and uniform basic deduction. The advocate highlights the financial struggles faced by many pensioners, emphasizing that high taxes contribute to their difficulties in affording essentials and that a reduction could enhance their quality of life. The motion aims to ensure that pensioners can live with dignity after years of contributing to society.

title: Trafiksäkerhetsåtgärder längs väg 226, Huddingevägen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament takes action to improve traffic safety measures along Road 226, Huddingevägen, which has been deemed unsustainable and dangerous for pedestrians and cyclists. The motion highlights the need for urgent upgrades, especially following a tragic accident involving a young girl. It calls for the government to instruct the Swedish Transport Administration to address these safety issues with necessary investments, in light of anticipated traffic increases due to local expansion.

title: Trafiksäkerhet för jakthundar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Traffic Authority be tasked with allowing signs warning of ongoing hunting and loose hunting dogs to be exempt from current regulations that prohibit signage along state roads. Additionally, it suggests considering the use of flashing lights on these signs to alert drivers to reduce speed in areas with potential hazards from hunting dogs. The motivation highlights the importance of protecting hunting dogs from traffic accidents and emphasizes the necessity of balancing wildlife populations while ensuring road safety.

title: Märkning av åtelkameror och fällor med jägar-id
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should consider allowing game cameras and traps to be labeled solely with the hunter ID provided by the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency, in order to fulfill legal notification requirements. The motion emphasizes the increased risks faced by hunters, including threats and violence, suggesting that this change would enhance privacy and security while still informing the public about monitoring activities in the area.

title: Förseningsavgiften för sent inbetald trängselavgift
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should review and reduce the penalty fee for late payments of congestion charges, which is currently viewed as excessive, particularly for minor amounts owed. The motion argues that the current penalty can be disproportionately high compared to the actual fee and calls for the government to present a plan for these changes.

title: Etablerandet av en ny myndighet för jakt- och viltförvaltningsfrågor
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a new authority dedicated to hunting and wildlife management in Sweden, arguing for a more unified approach to these issues currently split among different agencies. It emphasizes the need for digitalization and automation in the processes for weapon licensing and the control of imported weapons, aiming to improve efficiency and trust in governmental institutions among hunters.

title: Förvaltningen av den svenska vargstammen
summary: The motion proposes measures for the management of the Swedish wolf population, urging the government to implement a targeted approach that allows for increased licensed hunting in areas heavily impacted by wolves, as well as stipulating that county administrations should have the authority to enact protective hunting of non-shy wolves. It emphasizes the importance of hunting in Swedish culture and wildlife management, addressing current discrepancies between parliamentary decisions and the actions of responsible authorities.

title: Östlig förbindelse och Södra länken
summary: The proposal advocates for the construction of the Östlig förbindelse to enhance the traffic system in Stockholm County and for the Södra länken to be equipped with necessary fire safety measures to prevent closures during peak traffic hours. It highlights the urgency of addressing Stockholm's traffic issues, asserting that a more resilient and capacity-enhanced transport network is essential for the region's growth and economic prosperity.

title: Bostadspolitik, planering och byggande
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive reform of Sweden's housing policy, emphasizing housing as a social right and advocating for a new national strategy to ensure affordable housing for all. It calls for increased government intervention, including the establishment of a state construction company, financial incentives for building rental apartments, and a review of existing housing laws to promote social equity and address homelessness. The motion also highlights the importance of sustainable building practices and the need for a balanced approach to various forms of housing tenure, emphasizing the urgency of addressing the current housing crisis and increasing construction in rural areas.

title: Underlätta småhusbyggande genom att se över tillgänglighetskraven
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider reviewing accessibility requirements in the construction of small houses to facilitate building and address current housing shortages. The motion emphasizes the need for more flexible regulations that would reduce costs and enable more small houses to be constructed, particularly in areas where current accessibility rules are hindering development. The aim is to create better conditions for housing development to meet the population's desire for small house living.

title: Utveckling av infrastrukturen i stråket Göteborg–Oslo
summary: The proposal emphasizes the urgent need to develop and enhance the railway infrastructure between Gothenburg and Oslo, including the exploration of private financing options for the expansion. Key suggestions include the progressive implementation of a railway development plan, the establishment of a Nordic council for infrastructure, and the creation of models for cross-border rail traffic. The aim is to improve transport capacity, reduce transit times, and enhance overall infrastructure robustness to mitigate vulnerabilities highlighted by recent landslides affecting vital transport routes.

title: Hyresrätt och allmännytta
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1989 av Malcolm Momodou Jallow m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion presented by Malcolm Momodou Jallow and others from the Left Party aims to strengthen the rights and protections of tenants in Sweden, addressing issues such as the prevalence of unfair rental practices, the impact of renovations on existing tenants, and the need for more robust public housing options. The initiative proposes a range of legislative changes, including the reintroduction of a purchaser law to screen new landlords, stricter regulations against short-term rentals that threaten long-term tenancy, and enhanced support for tenants during building renovations. The proposals reflect a broader commitment to ensuring equitable housing policies that support vulnerable populations and mitigate the pressures of housing speculation.

title: Stödet till idrottsrörelsen ska vara fortsatt starkt
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of continued strong support for the Swedish sports movement, highlighting its role in enhancing public health, fostering social connections, and providing meaningful leisure activities for children and youth. It stresses the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on participation rates, especially among young people, and argues that sustained government funding is crucial for sports associations to offer accessible programs and to maintain a vibrant voluntary sector, which is essential for societal values.

title: Regionala flygplatser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates measures needed to secure and develop regional airports in Sweden, emphasizing their importance for business operations, especially following the disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. The motion highlights the need for reliable transportation links for the economy and national defense, and calls for government action to support the sustainability of these airports amid growing concerns about their future viability. Furthermore, it suggests considering the establishment of a national aviation authority to improve coordination and address various related issues across different government departments.

title: Stöd till svenska veteraner som stridit för Ukraina
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the possibilities for how the Swedish state can support soldiers who have fought for Ukraine and their families. It highlights the historical context of Sweden's support for Ukraine since its invasion by Russia and emphasizes the need for special assistance for returning veterans to help them reintegrate into civilian life and address potential psychological trauma.

title: Övningskörningsskyltar
summary: The proposal advocates for the investigation into the possibilities of standardizing learner driver signs across the EU and Nordic countries. The current Swedish sign 'ÖVNINGSKÖR' may not be understood by non-Swedish speakers, potentially affecting road safety. By adopting a more universally recognized sign, like the 'L' used in countries such as Norway and the UK, the intention is to enhance traffic safety, particularly for young and inexperienced drivers.

title: Värnande av demokratin
summary: The motion proposes several measures to strengthen democracy in Sweden, including the consideration of a constitutional article prohibiting changes that contradict democratic principles and human rights, enhancing the independence of the judiciary, and upgrading the electoral law to a semi-constitutional status to protect it from easier amendments. The aim is to ensure that fundamental rights remain safeguarded against potential future abuses by a simple majority in the parliament.

title: Trygga köp av hundburar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament review and update the animal welfare law and the recommendations from the Swedish Board of Agriculture regarding the safety of dog transport crates. The aim is to establish a national standardization of crash tests for dog crates and to consider creating such standards at the EU level. The proposal emphasizes the importance of ensuring the safety of dogs during transport in vehicles and highlights the need for modernized guidelines based on current research, as existing recommendations have not been updated in over thirty years.

title: Säkerställd tillit till svenska valresultat
summary: This proposal focuses on ensuring uniformity in the evaluation of personal votes by county administrative boards in Sweden. It suggests that personal votes should be documented similarly to party votes to enhance transparency and reliability. The proposal addresses concerns about inconsistencies in how personal votes have been invalidated, potentially undermining voter confidence and the democratic process. It argues for greater accountability and standardized criteria to avoid arbitrary decisions that could affect election outcomes.

title: Dubbelspår genom Fyrbodal
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the benefits of establishing a double railway track through Fyrbodal to improve transportation between Norway and Sweden. The motion emphasizes the importance of reducing border barriers for businesses and enhancing safety by diverting heavy traffic from public roads. Additionally, it highlights the environmental advantages of rail travel and aims to create a more connected labor market in the region, ultimately boosting welfare and Sweden's GDP.

title: En skärpt lag mot sexualbrott
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen Sweden's sexual offenses law to provide better protection for children against digital sexual abuse. It suggests a review of current legislation to consider the age of the victim in sentencing and to increase penalties for offenders who exploit children digitally. Additionally, it calls for equating severe posing offenses involving penetration with aggravated rape, in order to close existing legal gaps and ensure a more robust legal response to these crimes.

title: Minskning av den svenska vargstammen
summary: The motion proposes a reduction of the Swedish wolf population, citing concerns about inbreeding, livestock predation, and public safety. The author argues that the current high concentration of wolves poses a threat to rural livelihoods and Swedish food production. To promote coexistence, the author suggests that hunting should be permitted to instill fear of humans in wolves, allowing farmers to protect their livestock.

title: Enklare för utlandssvenskar att rösta
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates ways to simplify the voting process for Swedish citizens living abroad, with the aim of strengthening democracy. It highlights the low voting participation among expatriates and suggests improvements, such as making registration clearer and voting procedures more accessible, to enhance electoral participation.

title: Upprustning av vägnätet i Fyrbodal
summary: The motion emphasizes the urgent need to upgrade the road network in Fyrbodal, particularly highlighting the poor maintenance of roads in Dalsland, which affects local industry and tourism. It argues that good communication and reliable infrastructure are essential for the region's development and suggests that the government should increase funding for road repairs to ensure safe travel for residents and tourists alike.

title: Fotografering av skyddsobjekt
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of extending the prohibition on photographing protected objects to include built-in cameras in vehicles, considering the advancements in technology that allow modern vehicles to capture and transmit images, which could pose risks to national security.

title: Rena hav är allas ansvar
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider a national responsibility for cleaning up international debris along the western coast's beaches, and urges the government to advocate for a joint European effort to remove plastic from the oceans and shores. It highlights the severe pollution issues faced by small municipalities in Bohuslän, which have limited resources but bear the brunt of plastic waste that washes ashore, often relying on volunteer efforts for cleanup. The motion calls for sustainable solutions and significant state and EU support to manage and prevent marine littering, framing it as a critical survival issue for marine ecosystems.

title: Lex Rebecka – en psykiatrivård som räddar liv
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen mental health services in Sweden by adopting a salutogenic approach to care, aiming to reduce the number of suicides. It emphasizes the need for timely interventions for at-risk individuals, exploring alternatives to medication and ensuring proper follow-up on treatments. The motion advocates for revisions to psychiatric care guarantees, enabling patients to access timely care from various providers, and shares the tragic story of Rebecka, whose life was lost due to inadequate mental health support, underscoring the importance of systemic changes to prevent future tragedies.

title: Lex Rebecka – våga leva
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review and reform of support structures for the families of suicide victims in Sweden, named 'Lex Rebecka', aiming to enhance care and ensure equitable access to support services across the country. It suggests that the government should facilitate immediate assistance from Försäkringskassan to bereaved families, implement follow-up care, establish POSOM teams in every municipality for preventive measures, and provide continuity of contact for young adults transitioning to adult psychiatric care.

title: Hedersförtryck mot unga hbtqi-personer
summary: The motion advocates for intensified efforts to combat honor-related oppression targeting young LGBTQI individuals in Sweden. It highlights the increasing visibility of such issues under the current government and emphasizes the importance of awareness and legislative measures to protect these vulnerable groups from familial coercion and violence. The proposal calls for comprehensive knowledge dissemination among various institutions, including schools and healthcare services, to ensure proper support for LGBTQI youth affected by honor-related violence.

title: Lokal polisnärvaro
summary: The suggestion advocates for an increased local police presence in Sweden, proposing that the Parliament support the government in considering the establishment of more police stations, particularly in areas currently underserved by law enforcement. The motion highlights a need for enhanced safety and crime prevention, as the number of police officers increases and emphasizes that improved access to local police can foster community relations and overall security.

title: Körkort som nationell id-handling
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament supports the idea of upgrading driver's licenses to serve as national ID cards, thereby facilitating easier travel for Swedish citizens within the Schengen area. The current requirement for passports or special national ID cards complicates mobility, and the motion argues that allowing driver's licenses as valid forms of identification would enhance the rights of Swedish citizens as EU citizens by simplifying border crossings.

title: Fortsatt modernisering av svensk alkoholpolitik
summary: The motion proposes a modernization of Sweden's alcohol policy, advocating for the eventual abolition of the retail monopoly represented by Systembolaget. It argues that Swedish alcohol policy is out of sync with other European countries and Nordic neighbors, suggesting that the existing monopoly may no longer be justifiable given the changes in alcohol consumption patterns and societal attitudes since its establishment in 1955. The proposal includes measures such as expanding the operating hours of Systembolaget and allowing the sale of alcoholic beverages in grocery stores, aligning Sweden more closely with the practices of neighboring countries.

title: Omvändelseterapi riktad mot hbtqi-personer
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider a ban on conversion therapy aimed at LGBTQI individuals, highlighting the need for legislative action in light of the previous government's inconclusive investigation. The author argues that exposing individuals to attempts to 'cure' their sexual orientation or gender identity constitutes abuse and should be explicitly prohibited. The motion references broader EU efforts to outlaw conversion therapy as a model for Sweden to follow.

title: Särskild måttfullhet vid marknadsföring av spel genom telefonförsäljning
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider investigating a law to implement 'particular moderation' in the marketing of gambling through telephone sales. It highlights concerns over unethical marketing practices that can lead to gambling addiction, particularly affecting vulnerable populations such as the elderly. The aim is to ensure that such marketing is conducted ethically, allowing consumers to fully understand their purchases and the implications involved.

title: Inga köer för att rösta
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government ensure there are no queues for voters during elections, following complaints from the 2022 election where many voters had to wait in line. The motion highlights the negative impact of long queues on voter participation, as noted in a survey indicating that four out of ten voters experienced this issue. It calls for the government to instruct the electoral authority to implement measures to prevent such delays in future elections.

title: En patientsäkerhetslag på patientens sida
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a patient safety law focused on safeguarding patient rights and ensuring proper healthcare delivery. It highlights the need for greater compliance with existing patient safety regulations and advocates for simplifying and strengthening patients' ability to voice complaints about healthcare services. The motion points out that around 100,000 patients experience healthcare-related injuries annually, which puts excessive strain on the healthcare system. It emphasizes the importance of following patient rights laws to enhance patient safety and overall healthcare quality.

title: Förbättrad psykisk hälsa för transpersoner
summary: This motion proposes improvements to mental health support for transgender individuals in Sweden. It emphasizes the need for further development of the modernized Gender Recognition Act, particularly in regards to parenting rights and legal complexities. The motion highlights the alarming rates of poor mental health and suicide among transgender individuals, especially youth, caused by discrimination and lack of understanding in society, including in schools and healthcare. It calls for increased knowledge, a gender-neutral presumption of parenthood, and greater distinction between social and medical gender in healthcare. The overall aim is to ensure that transgender individuals do not face discrimination based on their gender identity.

title: Patentintrångsförsäkring för svenska innovationer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider establishing a patent infringement insurance scheme to support innovators facing patent violations by large companies. Currently, individual inventors have limited means to legally defend their patents, often leading to financial losses and hindering innovation. The suggested insurance would provide professional and financial assistance during legal processes, potentially deterring large companies from infringing on patents and enhancing the overall climate for innovation in Sweden.

title: Förfalskade läkemedel
summary: The motion highlights the growing issue of counterfeit medicines in Sweden, emphasizing the risks posed to public health, patient safety, and trust in the healthcare system. It calls for the government to develop strategies to prevent counterfeit drugs from entering the Swedish distribution chain, particularly through online purchases, given the limited current monitoring and controls.

title: Placering i plenisalen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider changing the seating arrangement of its members in the plenary hall to enhance debate and engagement. Currently, members are seated primarily according to electoral districts, followed by years of service and age, which the proposal argues is outdated. It suggests that seating by party affiliation, as practiced in many countries, would foster a more dynamic debating environment. The motion advocates for a trial period for this new arrangement, highlighting that it could be implemented without construction costs.

title: En rättssäker folkbokföring
summary: This motion calls for an overhaul of the population registration rules in order to improve their reliability and prevent misuse. It highlights the increasing mobility of individuals, particularly young people, and the complications that arise from current regulations which allow individuals, including criminals, to register at addresses without the knowledge of the actual residents. The proposal aims to address issues leading to potential negative impacts on law enforcement and ensures that only those who genuinely reside at an address are recorded as such.

title: Uppdatering av regelverket kring stickåret vid fastighetsförsäljning
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the conditions, both public financial and otherwise, for establishing a more relevant benchmark year for property sales, aiming to simplify and facilitate property transactions. It argues that the current benchmark year of 1952 has become outdated, as most properties sold in Sweden reference a clear purchase price, making the existing system unnecessarily complex and administratively inefficient. The motion suggests that updating the benchmark year would better reflect today's economic situation and ease tax calculations related to property sales.

title: Suicidprevention vid överskuldsättning
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament instructs the government to investigate extending or altering the mandate of the Enforcement Authority (Kronofogden) to reduce suicide risks among individuals in debt. It emphasizes the serious economic and personal consequences of over-indebtedness, highlighting the heightened suicide risk faced by those with ongoing cases with Kronofogden. The motion advocates for early preventive actions and better coordination among diverse societal actors, including the healthcare sector, to support individuals dealing with both over-indebtedness and related mental health issues.

title: Konsumtion av frukt och grönt
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament encourage the consumption of fruits and vegetables, particularly among children and youth, by exploring various incentives. It emphasizes the importance of a balanced diet for promoting good health and preventing diseases, noting the alarmingly low levels of fruit and vegetable consumption among these age groups. The motion highlights the significant role that fruits and vegetables play in combating obesity and other chronic diseases, and suggests that societal measures are necessary to improve dietary habits, especially in light of recent price increases in these foods.

title: Översyn av avkastning från Akademiska Hus
summary: The proposal advocates for a review of the returns from Akademiska Hus, a state-owned company managing properties used by universities and colleges in Sweden. It highlights the financial challenges faced by higher education institutions due to rising rental costs, which have increased by an average of 14 percent in the past two years due to inflation. The motion emphasizes the need for effective use of resources to maintain high-quality education and research, proposing that a review will ensure that funding for education and research is not diminished by these rental costs, thereby supporting the long-term sustainability and international competitiveness of Sweden's higher education sector.

title: Förbättrad elevhälsa i grundskolan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports the investigation into improving student health in primary schools, addressing the rising issue of decreased physical activity among children and youth. The motion highlights the negative impact of sedentary lifestyles on health and learning outcomes, emphasizing the need for more physical activity as a way to enhance educational quality. The motion argues for aligning school physical activity offerings with international recommendations to ensure that children meet daily activity levels, advocating for government measures to promote sports and exercise within the education system.

title: Stockholms stad – uppfinnandets och innovationens huvudstad
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1954 av Kristina Axén Olin m.fl. (M)
summary: The proposal advocates for the government to consider measures that enhance Stockholm's capacity as a center for invention and innovation. It emphasizes the importance of a conducive culture for creativity, the need for better legal support against patent infringements, and a strategy to increase the number of female inventors. The aim is to strengthen Sweden's competitiveness by fostering a thriving innovation climate in Stockholm, which already possesses significant educational resources and a vibrant business environment.

title: Åtgärder för fler personer i arbete efter 60 år
summary: The motion proposes measures to increase the participation of individuals over 60 in the labor market in Sweden, highlighting the need for an adjustment in the support provided by the Employment Service to help this age group find new employment. It emphasizes that while the retirement age may rise, it should not negatively impact the pensions or social security of older citizens, who often face challenges in re-entering the workforce after job loss.

title: Kortare handläggningstider hos statliga myndigheter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports an initiative to review and shorten processing times at state authorities, advocating for a guarantee that all cases are resolved within two months. It emphasizes the need for timely decisions to reduce uncertainty for both citizens and businesses, encouraging state agencies to adopt clear and efficient timeframes similar to those already practiced by some municipalities.

title: En patientsäkerhetslag på patientens sida
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a patient safety law that prioritizes the rights and safety of patients in the healthcare system. It aims to ensure that healthcare services are provided fairly and based on individuals' needs while reinforcing patient rights and simplifying the process for patients to file complaints about their care. The motion highlights the inadequate enforcement of existing patient laws and seeks to improve compliance to reduce the incidence of healthcare injuries, which annually affect approximately 100,000 patients in Sweden.

title: Ett förenklat momssystem
summary: The motion proposes the implementation of a simplified VAT system in Sweden to enhance transparency and reduce the administrative burden on businesses. It highlights the complexity and lack of clarity in the current VAT structure, which features multiple rates for different goods and services, leading to confusion for consumers and entrepreneurs. The suggestion calls for the government to initiate an investigation into the proposed changes to create a uniform VAT system, emphasizing its importance for state finances and the need for thorough examination before any alterations are made.

title: Egen bostad för unga med sparande
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of a tax-deductible savings scheme aimed at helping young individuals secure their first home amidst a housing crisis. The motion emphasizes the need for additional measures beyond new construction to enable youth access to the housing market and highlights the challenges young adults face due to existing financial barriers, such as the loan-to-value ratio requirements. It suggests adopting a model similar to Norway's housing savings scheme to assist young people in achieving homeownership.

title: Ökad transparens i skattesystemet
summary: The motion proposes increased transparency in the taxation system, suggesting that all employees should receive detailed information about their salaries, including both gross income and the employer's associated costs, such as employer contributions and insurance costs. This aim is to enhance understanding and legitimacy of the tax system among workers.

title: Stöd till barn med dyslexi
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national plan to support children with dyslexia, highlighting the inconsistency in the availability of resources across schools. It emphasizes the need for better teacher training on dyslexia, timely diagnosis, and the provision of necessary assistive tools, while advocating for personal prescription of aids and the implementation of educational support centers throughout the country. The goal is to ensure that all children with dyslexia receive tailored assistance based on their needs, free from skepticism about their requirements for support.

title: Åtgärder för att minska hat mot hbtq-personer
summary: The motion proposes measures to reduce hate against LGBTQ individuals, emphasizing the need for a strong societal stance against hate speech and violence. It calls for the freezing and reclaiming of public funds allocated to organizations that promote such hatred and insists that public entities monitor funding to ensure compliance with anti-discrimination laws. Furthermore, the proposal insists that any group found to violate hate speech laws should be held financially accountable.

title: Utgiftsområde 2 Samhällsekonomi och finansförvaltning
summary: The proposal from the Left Party outlines specific budget allocations for 2025 regarding Sweden's economic governance and finance management. It suggests abolishing the current Financial Policy Council due to perceived ineffectiveness and proposes replacing it with a new interdisciplinary institute, the Stockholm Institute, which would enhance the public discourse around economic policies. Additionally, it advocates for increased funding for the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority to combat money laundering and opposes proposed budget cuts to the government service center, while introducing new budget allocations for a climate investment agency to support green initiatives.

title: Utgiftsområde 13 Integration och jämställdhet
summary: Vänsterpartiet proposes a budget allocation for 2025 in the area of Integration and Gender Equality, suggesting significant increases in funding for various initiatives, including support for municipalities dealing with refugee reception and additional measures to combat discrimination and bolster gender equality. The motion calls for a total increase of 1.569 billion kronor compared to the government's proposal, focusing on enhanced support for women's organizations and services catering to vulnerable groups.

title: Utgiftsområde 8 Migration
summary: The Left Party (Vänsterpartiet) proposes a budget for migration in 2025 that diverges from the government's proposal, suggesting an overall reduction of 110 million kronor for the Migrationsverket while advocating for an amnesty for unaccompanied minors and an increase in daily allowances for asylum seekers. The proposal includes various changes to financial allocations in specific areas, including reductions in support for increased detention places and voluntary repatriation initiatives, ultimately suggesting an increase in funding for asylum seeker support measures.

title: Utgiftsområde 14 Arbetsmarknad och arbetsliv
summary: Vänsterpartiet presents a motion to the Swedish Parliament proposing increased financial allocations for the 2025 budget in the area of labor market and employment. The motion calls for significant funding increases in multiple areas, including labor mediation, unemployment benefits, and active labor market programs, emphasizing a need for a stronger public role in employment services and several specific reforms to enhance unemployment insurance. The proposal aims to address rising unemployment and ensure equal access to services across the country.

title: Utgiftsområde 3 Skatt, tull och exekution
summary: The proposal outlines a budget allocation for 2025 related to the Tax Agency, Customs Agency, and the Enforcement Authority, emphasizing an increase in funding for the Customs Agency. The Vänsterpartiet requests an additional 100 million kronor to enhance the Customs Agency’s capabilities in response to rising organized crime and the need for digitalization and improved security measures, beyond the government's proposed increase.

title: Utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet
summary: Vänsterpartiet föreslår en omfördelning av anslag inom utgiftsområde 4 Rättsväsendet för att öka resurserna till brottsförebyggande åtgärder, särskilt i politiskt eftersatta områden genom skapandet av trygghetszoner. Förslaget inkluderar även ökade medel till tullverksamheten för att bekämpa organiserad brottslighet och ett femicidpaket för att hantera mäns våld mot kvinnor, samt en höjning av inkomsttaket för rättshjälp för att öka tillgången till rättslig prövning. Totalt föreslås en satsning om 500 miljoner kronor för 2025.

title: Utgiftsområde 23 Areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel
summary: Vänsterpartiet föreslår en ökning av anslagen inom utgiftsområde 23, som omfattar areella näringar, landsbygd och livsmedel, för att främja miljövänliga skogsbruk, stödja djurhälsovård och bevara biologisk mångfald. Motionen föreslår ökade medel för flera program som stöder både ekosystem och lantbrukares verksamheter, samt åtgärder för att öka tillgången till lokala slakterier och förbättra djurvälfärden. Totalt föreslås en ökning av anslagen med 1 552 miljoner kronor jämfört med regeringens förslag för 2025.

title: Utgiftsområde 20 Klimat, miljö och natur
summary: The proposed motion by the Left Party advocates for an increase in the budget for climate, environment, and nature for 2025, with specific allocations to various sectors such as conservation, environmental monitoring, and climate adaptation. The suggested increases aim to address funding shortages in nature conservation efforts, enhance environmental monitoring, and support extensive climate and biodiversity goals, following the guidance of national and EU commitments. The proposal includes new funding for initiatives like urban greening, PFAS purification, and research for climate transition.

title: Utgiftsområde 1 Rikets styrelse
summary: The Left Party proposes a comprehensive budget amendment for 2025, advocating for reductions in various governmental allocations, including a 15% decrease in funds for the royal court and a 120 million kronor reduction in parliamentary remuneration. It seeks additional funding for the Sámi Parliament to support Sámi language preservation and education, while also proposing increased resources for animal welfare, media support, and measures for national minorities and the Roma community. The proposal emphasizes accountability and resource allocation in times of economic downturn and aims to strengthen minority rights and cultural preservation.

title: Utgiftsområde 17 Kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid
summary: Vänsterpartiet föreslår en ökning av anslagen för kulturs sektorn 2025 med totalt 2,367 miljarder kronor, fördelade över flera verksamheter såsom stöd till kulturutövare, ökade resurser för kulturskolor och stöd till ideella krafter. Förslagen syftar till att förbättra tillgång och kvalitet inom kultur, medier, trossamfund och fritid, med betoning på stöd till nationella minoriteter och lokal kulturverksamhet, samt förstärkt finansiering för folkhögskolor och studieförbund. Vänsterpartiet vill även införa en digitaliseringssatsning för kulturarvsinstitutioner och särskilda insatser inom folkbildningen.

title: Åtgärder för de nationella minoriteterna och minoritetsspråken
summary: The motion proposed by Nooshi Dadgostar and others focuses on enhancing the rights and protection of national minorities and minority languages in Sweden. It calls for various actions, including stronger constitutional protections for national minorities, the establishment of a discrimination basis based on language, permanent funding for language centers, the creation of information centers for all national minorities, and the formation of a truth commission for Roma and Travellers. The proposal aims to address historical injustices, promote minority languages, and ensure inclusive policies for the national minority population, including Sami, Sverigefinnar (Finnish Swedes), Tornedalians, Roma, and Jews.

title: Konstitutionella frågor
summary: The motion proposes several recommendations to strengthen democracy and individual rights in Sweden, including a push for a democratic republican system in place of the monarchy, proposals for attaching the salaries of parliament members to a price base amount, requiring a qualified majority for constitutional changes, enhancing the protection of shared property, public service, sensitive personal data, and the right to abortion, as well as introducing a third legal gender to recognize the rights of non-binary individuals.

title: Idrott och friluftsliv
summary: The motion proposes several initiatives aimed at enhancing sports and outdoor activities in Sweden. It calls for the government to establish funding for municipalities and organizations for sports facilities, including investments for spontaneous sports areas and playgrounds. It advocates for the inclusion of 'sports' in national planning laws, increased financial support for sports in socioeconomically vulnerable areas, and a focus on ensuring accessibility in sports for individuals with disabilities. Furthermore, the motion seeks to enhance the role of the Swedish National Agency for Education in promoting outdoor life in schools and calls for a review of transport regulations to ensure that individuals can transport sports equipment without hindrance.

title: Språk och litteratur
summary: The motion proposed by Nooshi Dadgostar and others from the Left Party emphasizes the importance of language rights and proposes several reforms to strengthen mother tongue support in various educational settings. This includes implementing a right to mother tongue support in preschool, enhancing the right to study guidance in native languages, improving mother tongue instruction for unaccompanied minors, and ensuring accessibility to literature in sign language, among other suggestions aimed at enhancing linguistic diversity and equality in education.

title: En skola och förskola som ger framtidstro
summary: The proposal aims to ensure a more equitable and accessible education system in Sweden by removing fee exemptions in schools, regulating private school funding, enforcing transparency in school operations, and addressing discrimination and support for students with special needs. It also advocates for public resources to be used solely for educational purposes and for the elimination of profit-driven motives within the education sector, emphasizing the need for an inclusive, public-centered approach to education that benefits all students.

title: Svensk flyktingpolitik
summary: The motion presented by Tony Haddou and others from the Left Party emphasizes a comprehensive overhaul of Sweden's refugee policy, advocating for repealing recent changes to the Aliens Act, reverting to previous legislation, and establishing better protections for asylum seekers, particularly children, women, and LGBTQ+ individuals. It calls for an expansion of family reunification rights, increased quotas for refugees, and improved living conditions for those seeking asylum or temporary protection. The proposal asserts the need for a non-authoritarian, rights-based approach in line with international conventions and aims to shift towards a more humane and welcoming refugee policy in Sweden.

title: Rättsväsendet
summary: The Vänsterpartiet proposes a comprehensive reform of the Swedish justice system, including the establishment of safety zones in politically neglected areas, a national commission to address shootings and gang violence, and measures to increase diversity and trust in policing. The motion emphasizes the importance of addressing root causes of crime, reducing prison populations through more effective rehabilitation programs, and ensuring children's rights in legal processes. Additionally, it calls for better evaluation and sharing of effective crime prevention methods, national strategies for local projects, and significant improvements in the handling of youth in the justice system.

title: Hållbart och rättvist fiske
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1928 av Andrea Andersson Tay m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes a series of initiatives aimed at promoting sustainable and equitable fishing practices in Sweden.
