The authors argue that the current system has led to increased inequalities and has prioritized shareholder profits over the rights of citizens to receive adequate services. They call for legislation to ensure that public funds designated for welfare do not benefit profit-seeking entities and advocate for reforms reflecting practices in other Nordic countries.

title: Förbud mot omvändelseförsök
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1669 av Daniel Vencu Velasquez Castro m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament initiate an investigation into how to implement a ban on conversion therapy, citing research that links these practices to negative outcomes, particularly for LGBTQ+ individuals. The motion references support from various international bodies for prohibiting such practices, highlights the existing lack of legal protections in Sweden, and stresses the urgency for action given that several European countries have already enacted similar bans.

title: Tandvård för ungdomar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1668 av Sofia Skönnbrink och Aida Birinxhiku (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for the retention of free dental care for youths up to 23 years old and to maintain the current age limit of 24 years for government dental support. The authors argue that social justice should ensure that financial situations do not dictate access to necessary dental care. They express concern over proposed legislative changes that could reduce access to dental care, particularly affecting young adults who are still in vulnerable stages of their lives.

title: Kommersiell service på landsbygden
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1667 av Gunilla Svantorp och Sofia Skönnbrink (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the regulations concerning operational and investment support for commercial services in rural areas to ensure fair competition among different organizational forms. It highlights the current disadvantage faced by consumer cooperatives, such as Coop, compared to individual traders regarding eligibility for funding, which affects their ability to maintain operations. The authors argue that equal support opportunities are crucial for preserving services in rural regions and preventing environmental harm due to increased travel distances when shops close.

title: Högkostnadsskydd för tandvård
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1666 av Gunilla Svantorp och Sofia Skönnbrink (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for the implementation of a high-cost protection system for dental care based on recommendations from a previous dental care investigation. It highlights the importance of good dental health for overall well-being and addresses the disparities in dental health among socioeconomically weaker groups. The proposal emphasizes reducing economic barriers to dental care, especially for vulnerable populations, in order to meet public health goals related to health equity.

title: Ökat skydd av föräldrars SGI
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into extending the protection of the sickness benefit qualifying income (SGI) for parents on parental leave from the current limit of two years to three years. This change aims to reduce stress for parents, particularly fathers, who feel pressured to use their parental leave days quickly due to the existing rules. The motion highlights the importance of the parental role during the child's early years for the development of secure attachment.

title: Utökat friskvårdsbidrag
summary: The motion proposes an expansion of the wellness grant in Sweden to include the purchase of fitness equipment and training shoes, aiming to promote physical activity and combat rising mental health issues and absenteeism in the public sector. The motion emphasizes the importance of utilizing the wellness grant more effectively to support employees in maintaining their health.

title: Obligatoriska synkontroller vid körkortsförnyelse för ökad trafiksäkerhet och trygghet
summary: The proposal advocates for the introduction of mandatory vision tests for individuals renewing their driving licenses to enhance traffic safety and personal security on the roads. It highlights concerns regarding the declining vision of many drivers, which may put them at risk if they were to apply for a license today. The motion points out that while professional drivers are required to undergo vision tests every five years, private drivers currently only test their vision at the initial license application, typically in their teens. The motion supports regular check-ups after the age of 45 to ensure drivers' visual capabilities are maintained, emphasizing the potential health benefits and the need for early detection of vision-related issues.

title: Jämställda pensioner
summary: The proposal suggests that earned pensions, including premium pensions, should be equally divided between spouses and partners with common children. This aims to address the economic disparities faced by parents, particularly in the context of taking parental leave and its impacts on pensions. The motion also seeks to expand the number of 'child years' that allow parents to accrue pension benefits while reducing work hours for child care, thereby promoting greater equality in financial outcomes for families and mitigating the negative effects of the current system on gender equality.

title: Möjlighet till utökat uttag av dubbeldagarna
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of removing the limitation on the number of 'double days' in Sweden's parental leave system, which allows parents to take leave simultaneously. Initiated by the Christian Democrats, this change aims to increase flexibility for families and enhance the positive effects on health, particularly for new mothers. The motion argues that families should have the autonomy to decide how to use parental benefits without restrictions on the number of double days.

title: Rätten till förskola under sjukskrivning
summary: This motion proposes to amend the Education Act to establish a child's right to attend preschool during a parent's long-term illness. Currently, there is no clear regulation on this matter, leading to varying interpretations by municipalities. The motion argues that, similar to provisions for parents on parental leave or unemployed, children of long-term sick parents should have guaranteed access to preschool to support both the child's social needs and the parents' capacity to manage their situation.

title: Höjd ersättning till familjedaghem
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into raising the tax-free compensation limit for family day care providers in Sweden, noting a significant decline in the number of caregivers over the years. The motion highlights the importance of small child groups for children's development and suggests that increasing the number of family day care homes could alleviate pressures on preschool group sizes while also providing parents with more choices. The Kristdemocratic Party (KD) believes that adjusting the compensation would improve the economic viability of family day care, thus benefiting both children and municipalities.

title: Ökade resurser till barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1658 av Matilda Ernkrans och Denis Begic (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to increase resources for child and adolescent psychiatry to ensure that children and young people can receive the necessary help for mental health issues. It highlights the significant rise in demand for mental health support among youth and the resulting long waiting times. By allocating more resources, the motion aims to enhance care quality by hiring additional staff and increasing available treatment spaces, thereby facilitating quicker interventions and preventing long-term psychological problems.

title: Kriminalisering av det ekonomiska våldet
summary: The motion proposes the investigation and implementation of measures to criminalize economic violence, establish legislation for economic consent, introduce time limits for property division after separation, increase financial support for legal assistance, remove waiting periods in divorces involving violence, and impose stricter requirements on loan institutes regarding personal meetings and notifications. It aims to improve the legal framework surrounding economic abuse, particularly against women, and enhance their financial independence and protection.

title: Plats på folkhögskolor för personer med funktionsnedsättning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to reconsider funding cuts to folk high schools, which have negatively impacted educational opportunities for individuals with disabilities. The motion argues that these schools play a crucial role in providing personalized education for those facing difficulties in traditional education systems, and highlights the importance of adequate funding to maintain the necessary support and resources for these individuals.

title: Subventioner för pensionärers friskvårdsaktiviteter
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should explore opportunities to subsidize wellness activities for pensioners, arguing that such initiatives could improve health outcomes among the elderly, reduce healthcare costs, and address issues of inequality as many seniors currently cannot afford these activities due to financial constraints.

title: Prioritering av riksväg 50 mellan Lindesberg och Kopparberg samt söder om Askersund
summary: The motion proposes prioritizing the upgrade of national road 50 between Lindesberg and Kopparberg, as well as south of Askersund, to enhance its capacity and safety. It underscores the road's significance for both regional development and national cohesion, addressing concerns about increased traffic, existing safety risks, and environmental impacts. Given the changing security situation in Europe, the motion emphasizes the need for a robust transport infrastructure that can support both civilian and strategic transport, especially in crisis scenarios.

title: Anhöriginvandrares isolering
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament take action to break the isolation of family-reunited immigrants, particularly focusing on the significant number of foreign-born women who are economically inactive despite their educational qualifications. It emphasizes the need to include family-reunited immigrants in established integration programs to improve their access to the labor market and social services, thereby addressing their vulnerability to long-term economic inactivity.

title: Kvalitetssäkrad modersmålsundervisning
summary: The proposal advocates for quality assurance in mother tongue education for students with foreign-born parents, highlighting its cognitive, educational, and personal benefits. It notes that a strong mother tongue aids in learning a second language and addresses the need for better resources and training for mother tongue teachers, particularly to support language development in both mother tongue and Swedish education.

title: Upprustning av miljonprogrammet
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the conditions for upgrading Sweden's million program housing, emphasizing the significant need for renovation of over half of the apartments built between 1965 and 1974. It highlights the financial challenges for tenants facing rent increases and the negative impact of deteriorating living conditions on health, particularly among children. The motion advocates for state credit guarantees for renovations, regulatory simplifications for transformations, and the possibility of tax deductions for rental properties to improve living standards and promote equality in vulnerable areas.

title: Motverkande av diskriminering i Sverige
summary: The motion presented by Lawen Redar (S) advocates for stronger measures to combat discrimination in Sweden, urging the government to enhance the legal framework and increase compensation for victims. It highlights the inadequacies in current enforcement and processing of discrimination complaints by the Discrimination Ombudsman, emphasizing the need for better support and protection for individuals facing discrimination based on ethnic origin and disability.

title: Åtgärder mot sexköp
summary: The motion proposes measures to combat sex purchasing in Sweden by advocating for stricter penalties for sex buyers, clarifying police responsibilities regarding sugar dating and minors, and enhancing outreach efforts to support victims of sex crimes. The proposal emphasizes the alarming extent of human trafficking and sexual exploitation, particularly affecting vulnerable groups such as women and minors, and stresses the need for a coordinated national approach to effectively address these challenges.

title: Skärpt reglering av ombildningskonsulter
summary: The motion proposes to enhance legal protections for consumers dealing with property conversion companies and consultants, particularly in the real estate sector. It highlights the economic risks associated with converting rental properties into condominiums and the unethical practices that have been reported, such as misleading promises of financial benefits and lack of transparency. The motion urges the government to review regulations surrounding the conversion process to combat unscrupulous actors and ensure the financial safety of consumers.

title: Minskad vargstam
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish Parliament to support measures aimed at reducing the wolf population in Sweden, highlighting ongoing concerns from rural areas, especially in Skaraborg, regarding the impact of wolves on livestock and the need to achieve the established goal of maintaining a wolf population between 170 and 270 individuals.

title: Statlig service och närvaro i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1646 av Ida Ekeroth Clausson m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government ensure the presence of state services across all municipalities in Sweden. It argues that a strong state presence is essential for national cohesion, local development, and public trust in authorities. The motion highlights the decline in public service availability in many areas and emphasizes the need for equal access to services, regardless of location. It calls for the continuation of efforts to relocate state operations and establish local service offices initiated by the previous government.

title: Bättre förutsättningar för fjällräddarna
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1645 av Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och Anders W Jonsson (båda C)
summary: The suggestion advocates for improved conditions for mountain rescuers in Sweden, particularly emphasizing the need for tax deductions for their vehicles used in public service and potential investment support for maintaining and upgrading their equipment. Given the increasing popularity of hiking, especially among inexperienced hikers, it is crucial to ensure that mountain rescuers have the necessary resources and recognition for their voluntary efforts to enhance safety in mountainous areas.

title: Inlandsbanan
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1644 av Anders W Jonsson och Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist (båda C)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament mandates Trafikverket, in collaboration with Inlandsbanan AB and the business sector, to assess the future role of Inlandsbanan with a focus on integrating it into the Swedish standard rail network. The goal is to create conditions for new and growing businesses, address the critical capacity shortages in the railway system, and contribute to global climate goals. An enhanced Inlandsbanan could improve transport efficiency, provide a strategic advantage for resource transportation, and support tourism and defense needs.

title: Beskattning av naturvårdsavtal
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1643 av Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist och Anders W Jonsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the consideration of allowing compensation for nature conservation agreements to be deposited into a forest account. Nature conservation agreements, which take place between the Swedish Forest Agency and landowners, aim to preserve valuable natural areas. Currently, compensation received by landowners is subject to immediate taxation, which can be high due to restrictions on land use. The motion suggests that allowing full allocation of this compensation to a forest account would encourage landowners to enter into such agreements and align with previous governmental intentions regarding taxation and conservation support.

title: Företagskredit
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1642 av Anders W Jonsson och Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes to equalize the risk of entrepreneurship across different regions of Sweden by addressing the disparities in creditworthiness based on location. It suggests that companies in rural areas often face stricter lending conditions compared to those in urban areas, leading to an increased risk for entrepreneurs to secure financing. The motion calls for an investigation into allowing these companies to utilize retained and untaxed profits as part of their investment, aiming to create a more equitable lending environment that supports business development regardless of location.

title: Förenklade klimatutmaningar i jordbruket
summary: The motion proposes facilitating investments in agriculture to address climate challenges while acknowledging the importance of food production. It emphasizes the need for clearer protections for existing irrigation ponds and the allowance for new ponds, particularly in areas like Southern Öland, to enhance water supply for food production amidst climate variability, without compromising valuable farmland.

title: Utredning om att införa euron som svensk valuta
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of adopting the euro as Sweden's currency, evaluating two exchange rate levels: 9.50 SEK/EUR and 10.50 SEK/EUR. It emphasizes the need to consider the economic effects and consequences of such a transition, including the potential advantages and disadvantages of adopting the euro compared to retaining the Swedish krona. The proponent argues that adopting the euro could provide financial stability and predictability for businesses and individuals in Sweden.

title: Statligt övertagande av Ängelholm-Helsingborgs flygplats
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1639 av Per-Arne Håkansson och Niklas Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for the state takeover of Ängelholm-Helsingborg Airport, emphasizing its crucial role in the regional and national transport infrastructure, economic competitiveness, and preparedness. It addresses the challenges faced by the current multi-municipal ownership and the need for federal support to sustain regular air traffic and invest in the airport's future operations.

title: Frigivande av Gui Minhai
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support efforts to secure the release of Gui Minhai, a Swedish-Chinese publisher and author who has been imprisoned in China for political reasons since his kidnapping in 2015. The motion emphasizes the need for continued awareness and diplomatic pressure on the Chinese government to address human rights violations in Minhai's case, asserting that he remains a Swedish citizen despite claims to the contrary by Chinese authorities.

title: Frigivande av Dawit Isaak
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the call for the release of Dawit Isaak, a Swedish-Eritrean journalist imprisoned in Eritrea for 23 years without any formal charges or trial. The motion emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to take necessary actions to raise awareness of his case and secure his release, especially given the ongoing concerns regarding his human rights and the lack of consular access.

title: Åtgärder för en levande, dynamisk och konkurrenskraftig konstmarknad
summary: The motion proposes a review of the tax regulations to stimulate a vibrant, dynamic, and competitive art market in Sweden. It highlights the historical evolution of the art sector and underlines the challenges faced by artists in today’s market, emphasizing the need for public support to ensure the survival and growth of Swedish art. The proposal includes making primary market art tax-deductible, harmonizing VAT rates for art, and providing financial assistance to galleries to promote Swedish artists internationally.

title: Språkkrav i välfärden
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of language requirements within the welfare sector in Sweden, emphasizing the critical role of communication skills for workers in child care and elder care. It highlights the current deficiencies in language competencies that adversely affect work environments and the quality of care provided. The proposal calls for secure funding to support comprehensive language training and education for employees, particularly those in jobs requiring high interaction levels, and emphasizes the need for stable employment conditions to facilitate this training.

title: Motverkande av hedersförtryck genom utvidgat utreseförbud
summary: The proposal by Lawen Redar (S) aims to combat honor-related oppression in Sweden by expanding the travel ban to include a broader range of circumstances, specifically targeting practices such as female genital mutilation, punishment and re-education trips, and coercive measures against LGBTQ+ individuals. This motion highlights the prevalence of honor-based violence and restrictions affecting a significant number of young people and calls on the government to implement a nationwide awareness campaign regarding these extended travel prohibitions.

title: Förbud mot vinstdrivande förskolor
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of a ban on profit-driven preschools in Sweden, emphasizing the need for high-quality early education, particularly for children from less favorable backgrounds. The motion highlights concerns about the varying educational qualifications of staff in municipal versus private preschools and criticizes the increasing presence of foreign-owned and publicly traded preschool companies, arguing that profit motives undermine children's right to quality education and promote inequality in the preschool system.

title: Statlig kontroll över validering
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support the allocation of earmarked resources to educational institutions for the validation of foreign qualifications and experiences. It emphasizes the importance of validating the skills and knowledge of immigrants, as many struggle to integrate into the labor market despite high demand for workers. The motion highlights the need for better statistical tracking and evaluation of validation outcomes, aiming to increase employment and productivity in Sweden.

title: Svenska som huvudspråk i förskolan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament consider making Swedish the primary language in preschools, while still allowing for the support of children with other mother tongues to develop both their Swedish language skills and their native languages. The motion emphasizes the importance of Swedish as a common societal language and aligns with the educational goals of promoting human rights and democratic values.

title: Stärkning av barnskötaryrket
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the role of child care workers (barnskötare) in preschools by advocating for their recognition in education laws and ensuring adequate training and qualifications. It highlights the importance of child care workers in children's development, especially for those with a mother tongue other than Swedish, and recommends amending the Education Act to include provisions for child care workers' roles and training requirements.

title: Lärdomar av Polismyndighetens och Kronofogdens arbete i Örebro län
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament endorses a structured nationwide effort to combat the recruitment of children and youth into criminal gangs, based on successful initiatives observed in Örebro County. It emphasizes the need for government action to ensure consistent strategies across Sweden in order to dismantle organized crime's exploitation of vulnerable populations and to financially undermine gang operations.

title: Utökning av det fackliga biståndet för att bekämpa orättvisor och motverka exploatering av arbetare
summary: The motion proposes to increase the budget for union aid to combat injustices and prevent the exploitation of workers globally. It criticizes the government's decision to reduce aid funding and highlights the importance of union support in promoting workers' rights, negotiating better working conditions, and providing humanitarian assistance during crises. The motion argues that strengthening unions and workers' rights benefits society as a whole by fostering democracy, social justice, and improved living conditions.

title: Statligt utredningsansvar gällande förekomster av arter i skogen
summary: The motion proposes that the state, rather than individual forest owners, should bear the responsibility for investigating the presence of species in forests. It argues that recent changes to regulations have created unreasonable financial burdens and legal uncertainties for forest owners associated with documenting environmental impacts prior to logging. The motion calls on the relevant authorities, such as the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency and the Forestry Agency, to clarify state responsibility in these investigations and communicate this to the government.

title: Säkrat nattåg mellan Göteborg och Umeå samt Göteborg och Duved
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1625 av Helena Lindahl och Anne-Li Sjölund (båda C)
summary: The motion advocates for a review of the possibility of state procurement for SJ's night trains between Gothenburg and Umeå, as well as between Gothenburg and Duved, in light of SJ's decision to discontinue these routes due to unprofitability. The motion highlights the negative impact on travelers who would face inconvenient transfers in Stockholm and emphasizes the need for state support to maintain these services, ensuring sustainable transportation solutions throughout Sweden.

title: Arbetsvillkor för minderåriga
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament investigate and simplify the rules regarding the types of work that minors can perform. This aims to enhance young people's chances of entering the job market early, particularly in light of high youth unemployment rates. The motion highlights the inconsistencies in current labor regulations for minors, which discourage employers from hiring individuals under 18, and calls for the removal of unreasonable barriers to improve employment opportunities for this age group.

title: Stopp för oseriösa företag som utför tjänster i privatpersoners hem
summary: The motion advocates for a review of relevant regulations to address gaps that allow untrustworthy companies to operate in the home service market. It emphasizes the need to strengthen consumer trust and security when hiring service providers, as many customers face difficulties in addressing unsatisfactory service experiences and feel uncomfortable reporting issues due to potential threats or misunderstandings.

title: Innovation på finansmarknaden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports a directive to the Financial Supervisory Authority (Finansinspektionen) to promote innovation in the financial market. It highlights that while Sweden has many rapidly growing companies in the digital finance sector, existing regulations tailored primarily for larger actors hinder the entry of new players. The motion advocates for improving the authority's knowledge of new business models to streamline the approval process for startups and enhance Sweden's innovation capacity in the financial sector.

title: Osteopati
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should review the conditions for osteopathy to become a regulated profession with legal recognition. Currently, osteopathy is not officially recognized in Sweden despite a significant number of practitioners and treatments. This lack of regulation leads to concerns about unqualified practitioners, which poses risks to patient safety. The motion advocates for establishing a legal framework to protect the title of 'osteopath' and ensure professional standards, aligning Sweden with other Nordic countries that have already implemented such measures.

title: Kyrkans osunda konkurrens på begravningsmarknaden
summary: The motion addresses the issue of unhealthy competition in the burial market due to the increasing presence of church-operated funeral homes that compete with local family-owned businesses. It highlights the advantages that church-operated firms have, such as access to burial sites and preferential scheduling, leading to ethical concerns and market distortions. The motion calls for government action to revise funeral law to ensure fair competition, as proposed by the Swedish Competition Authority, while acknowledging the unique role of the Church of Sweden.

title: Bistånd för global hälsa
summary: This motion emphasizes Sweden's leadership role in global health by strengthening its financial support to the Global Vaccine Alliance (Gavi) and enhancing collaboration with the private sector to develop sustainable solutions to immunization challenges. It calls for increased investments aimed at building resilient health systems to prevent future pandemics and health threats, underscoring the interconnectedness of global health and the necessity for continued Swedish engagement in international health initiatives.

title: Ansvar för barn till föräldrar som förolyckas
summary: The proposal suggests that parents should have the authority to decide who will take care of their children in the event of both parents' death, with intervention from authorities only allowed if there are strong reasons against the parents' choice. The motion advocates for legal recognition of parents' wishes regarding guardianship and emphasizes the need for swift and effective documentation comparable to the process of naming their child, ensuring that families have control over their children's future rather than the state.

title: Turismöversiktplan
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1617 av Martina Johansson och Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a tourism overview plan (TÖP) by municipalities in Sweden. It calls for the government to mandate municipalities to create TÖPs to enhance planning for tourism growth, which is currently not a formal requirement. Additionally, the motion suggests that Trafikverket (the Swedish Transport Administration) should incorporate tourism considerations into its utility evaluation calculus, acknowledging the importance of tourism for local economies and the need for better transportation links to tourist attractions.

title: Gränsöverskridande alkoholtillstånd
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1616 av Martina Johansson och Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government investigate the possibility of allowing alcohol permits approved in one municipality to also be valid in neighboring municipalities. The motion emphasizes the need for regulatory simplification to support small business owners, particularly in the restaurant sector, which is vital for job creation. By streamlining the permit process, it aims to reduce administrative burdens on both businesses and local governments, thereby facilitating the growth and development of enterprises.

title: Ökad möjlighet till licensjakt på varg i tamdjurstäta län
summary: The motion proposes to increase the opportunities for licensed wolf hunting in livestock-dense counties in Sweden. It emphasizes the need to listen to livestock breeders who express frustration over the damage caused by wolves, which can lead to stress and injury to livestock. The proposal suggests that licensed wolf hunting should coincide with the moose hunting season to enhance efficiency and flexibility in managing wolf populations.

title: Förbättrad möjlighet till mer biogasproduktion i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes to improve the possibilities for increased biogas production in Sweden, emphasizing its role as a domestic fuel that can sustain agricultural production, especially during crises. It highlights the environmental benefits of biogas, including significant CO2 reduction and availability of nutrient-rich fertilizer. The motion criticizes the slow development of biogas production due to complex decision-making processes and a lack of political commitments, suggesting that enhanced support and competitiveness for biogas against other fuels are necessary to promote its adoption in farming.

title: Urholkning av äganderätten
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity of safeguarding property rights, arguing that they are fundamental for agriculture and forestry, which are crucial for Sweden's rural prosperity. It calls for clear compensation regulations for landowners in cases of expropriation, the establishment of management agreements when nature reserves are created, and measures against the commercial misuse of public access rights. The proposal aims to ensure that landowners are recognized as the best stewards of their land and that their interests are considered in outdoor recreational activities.

title: Ranstad
summary: The suggestion calls for the Swedish government to assign the Swedish Geological Survey (SGU) the responsibility for environmental monitoring in Ranstad, addressing concerns about potential environmental impacts from a former uranium extraction facility. Additionally, it proposes that SGU explore the acquisition of land that requires protection to prevent any future adverse effects. The motion highlights ongoing community anxiety regarding environmental risks and advocates for state intervention due to historical government involvement in uranium mining.

title: Begränsad jakt på högdräktiga älgkor
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1611 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament review and implement restrictions on hunting pregnant moose cows, in response to ethical concerns raised by hunters. The motion identifies the necessity for managing moose populations due to damage to forests, while also raising issues about the stress caused to pregnant animals during hunting, including the risk of them aborting their fetuses. The motion calls for a balance between effective hunting practices and ethical considerations.

title: Nya Ostkustbanan: Dubbelspårsutbyggnad mellan Gävle och Härnösand
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to support the construction of a double-track railway, known as the New Ostkustbanan, between Gävle and Härnösand, emphasizing the need for swift progress to complete the project by 2035. It highlights the importance of modernizing the rail infrastructure in northern Sweden to facilitate efficient transport for both goods and passengers, alleviate congestion, and support regional economic growth, particularly in light of anticipated increases in freight transport. The motion insists that this railway development aligns with EU transport policies and should prioritize securing funding for its completion.

title: Dansbandsmomsen
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of abolishing the so-called dance band tax, which imposes a 25% VAT on dance events while concerts face only a 6% VAT. The authors argue that the distinction between concerts and dance events is unclear, as many concerts involve dancing, and they emphasize the social and health benefits of dancing. They believe that a uniform VAT rate would promote dancing and public health more effectively.

title: Lantmäteriets kostnader på landsbygden
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1608 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates and reviews the fees charged by Lantmäteriet for rural municipalities. The authors argue that high costs and long processing times for land division hinder rural development, prevent residents from moving in, and deter the construction of new housing. They highlight that the costs can equal or exceed property values, making land division unaffordable. Consequently, attractive properties remain unsold, and some owners let their properties deteriorate instead of selling. The proposal aims to enhance growth in rural areas by reassessing these fees.

title: Momsbeskattning på travsporten
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1607 av Anne-Li Sjölund och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The proposal aims to ensure that owners of competing trotters continue to be classified as taxable persons for VAT purposes by instructing the Swedish Tax Agency to apply VAT legislation accordingly. The motion argues that a recent interpretation by the agency, which questions the VAT liability of horse owners based on their competitive activities, could lead to a 25% cost increase for the trotting industry. The motion emphasizes that regular competition qualifies as economic activity and highlights the potential economic consequences of misclassifying such activities, including loss of revenue for the state and diminished industry viability.

title: Förverkligande av Norrbotniabanan
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to expedite the financial and logistical planning necessary to complete the Norrbotniabanan railway project, which is essential for improving infrastructure in northern Sweden. It suggests that the state should explore alternative funding solutions, including borrowing through Riksgälden, and give the Norrbotniabanan AB company a mandate to collaborate with Trafikverket for effective project execution. The motion emphasizes the importance of timely completion to support growing industries in the region and proposes establishing a deadline for the project's completion.

title: Tydligt uppdrag för primärvården att förebygga ohälsa
summary: The proposal asserts that the primary healthcare sector should have a clear responsibility for preventive health initiatives, reflecting the need for an emphasis on preventing diseases linked to lifestyle choices. It cites positive outcomes from existing pilot projects in Västerbotten that show how community collaboration in preventive healthcare can lead to better health outcomes while reducing healthcare costs. The motion calls for an amendment to the health and medical services law to clarify this responsibility.

title: Tidsgräns för domstolars handläggning av överklagande av detaljplaner m.m.
summary: The motion proposes that appeals against detailed plans should be resolved within a maximum of ten weeks to prevent delays in construction projects and associated cost increases. The aim is to expedite the handling of appeals while still respecting the right to appeal, as currently, municipalities have ten weeks to process building permits.

title: Valkretsnamn
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1603 av Ulrika Heie och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should review and rename electoral constituencies that were changed for bureaucratic reasons, ensuring that they reflect names familiar to the voters based on geographic associations. Specifically, it suggests implementing these changes before the upcoming 2026 election to foster a stronger connection between voters and their constituencies.

title: Förbättrad situation för personer i behov av ledar- eller assistanshund
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1602 av Rickard Nordin och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes improvements for individuals with guide or assistance dogs in Sweden, emphasizing the need to expand the mandate of the Discrimination Ombudsman to provide broader information on rights and regulations, as current access issues remain prevalent across various environments. It highlights the inadequate understanding among service providers about the legal protections for assistance dog users and suggests examining the disparity in guide dog usage compared to neighboring Nordic countries, coupled with a push for increased legal action against discrimination in this area.

title: Psykisk ohälsa och diskriminering
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1601 av Martina Johansson och Ulrika Heie (båda C)
summary: The motion addresses the increasing prevalence of mental health issues in Sweden and the associated discrimination faced by individuals suffering from such conditions. It proposes that the government take action to enhance research, improve accessibility, expand societal support, and ensure individualized communication for those with mental health challenges. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of participatory approaches in interventions and calls for the development of action plans based on identified needs.

title: Undervisning om folkmord
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1600 av Denis Begic och Ingela Nylund Watz (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of incorporating education about the Seyfo genocide in 1915 and the Srebrenica genocide in 1995 into the curriculum to foster understanding of human rights and global history. It advocates for a broader inclusion of other genocides and ethnic cleansing events, such as the Holocaust and Rwanda, to provide a comprehensive grasp of the mechanisms leading to such tragedies and prevent them in the future. The motion also suggests the development of digital educational resources to enhance accessibility for teachers and students across Sweden and encourages international cooperation to promote education on genocides and human rights.

title: AI i utbildningssystemet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate how knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) can be integrated into the primary education system, enabling students and teachers to use AI responsibly and critically. The motion emphasizes the urgent need to adapt the education system to the transformative impact of AI, arguing that without proper integration, there is a risk of creating a digital divide that disadvantages socioeconomically weaker students. The proposal highlights the school’s compensatory role in ensuring equal opportunities for all students to thrive in a digital economy.

title: Kriminalisering av underlåtenhet att avslöja äktenskapstvång och barnäktenskapsbrott
summary: The proposal advocates for investigating the criminalization of failing to disclose instances of forced marriage and child marriage crimes in Sweden. It highlights the prevalence of honor-related violence and oppression that affects a significant number of young people, particularly women. The motion aims to expand the criminalized scope to better combat these issues and enhance protections for vulnerable individuals.

title: Kriminalisering av omvändelseförsök
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1597 av Lawen Redar och Daniel Vencu Velasquez Castro (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to criminalize conversion attempts aimed at LGBTQ+ individuals, emphasizing that such attempts violate personal identity and can lead to psychological harm. The rationale includes international calls for such legislation and existing prohibitions in several countries. Despite a recent investigation suggesting that current laws cover many related offenses, the motion argues that explicit criminalization is necessary to provide a clear legal stance against harmful practices, prevent potential abuses, and protect vulnerable individuals from societal stigmatization.

title: Införande av aktivitetsplikt i försörjningsstödet
summary: The proposal suggests the introduction of an activity requirement in social assistance programs to combat long-term reliance on financial support. It emphasizes the need for individuals receiving aid, particularly those unemployed, to engage in activities that enhance their employability and integration into the labor market. This is aimed at limiting prolonged dependency, addressing health issues associated with inactivity, and supporting the social and linguistic integration of immigrants. The proposal highlights the importance of collaboration between government agencies and local employment initiatives.

title: Förstärkt skolplikt
summary: The motion proposes the investigation of enhanced school attendance requirements in Sweden, addressing concerns over ambiguities in existing exemptions from mandatory schooling. It highlights issues such as the lack of oversight from relevant authorities and the risk of children being unaccounted for during school breaks, potentially leading to harmful practices like forced marriages. The motion suggests that an increased focus on school attendance is necessary to protect children's rights to education.

title: Inkludering av viss vård som utförs av optiker i högkostnadsskyddet
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the inclusion of certain healthcare services provided by optometrists in the high-cost protection scheme for outpatient care in Sweden. It highlights the vital role optometrists play in identifying and managing eye health issues and argues that extending coverage to include optometric care could alleviate the burden on ophthalmologists and improve patient access to healthcare, particularly for vulnerable groups, such as the elderly. By recognizing the capabilities of optometrists, the proposal aims to create a more equitable healthcare system and enhance overall eye health across the population.

title: Nej till surrogatmödraskap
summary: Mikael Oscarsson from the Christian Democrats proposes that surrogacy should not be allowed in Sweden, advocating for a ban on surrogacy arrangements both domestically and for Swedish citizens abroad. The motion emphasizes the ethical and moral issues surrounding surrogacy, highlighting the exploitation of economically vulnerable women and the inherent risks to their health, both physically and psychologically. It argues that surrogacy commercializes women's bodies, perpetuates inequality, and undermines children's rights, calling for the government to reinforce existing prohibitions against surrogacy and related practices.

title: Utbyggnad av E6 genom Skåne
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1592 av Per-Arne Håkansson och Niklas Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes an expansion of the E6 motorway in Skåne to a three-lane road in multiple sections to accommodate increasing traffic demand, both for commuters and freight, particularly due to projected increases from the Fehmarn Belt tunnel. It emphasizes the importance of an efficient transport infrastructure for regional and national connectivity, as well as the need for additional studies and actions to address traffic congestion issues and enhance road functionality.

title: Högre bidrag till rovdjursavvisande stängsel (RAS)
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1591 av Ewa Pihl Krabbe och Per-Arne Håkansson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should reconsider the conditions for receiving compensation for predator-deterrent fencing (RAS), suggesting that these conditions be expanded to cover all types of grazing land and all enclosed domesticated animals. It calls for an increase in the flat-rate compensation to a more reasonable level in relation to material and labor costs and recommends an increase in the fund for wildlife damage to meet the needs of livestock holders in protecting their herds.

title: Utbyggd geriatrik för ett gott åldrande i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1590 av Ewa Pihl Krabbe och Per-Arne Håkansson (båda S)
summary: This motion proposes the expansion of geriatric care across Sweden in response to the increasing elderly population and the current lack of hospital care facilities for seniors. It highlights the urgent need for more geriatric beds, particularly in Skåne, where the number is significantly below the EU average. The motion also emphasizes the importance of improving the quality of care for the elderly, including better management of chronic conditions and enhancing the overall quality of life. It calls for increased support from the state in terms of funding and monitoring to ensure an equitable distribution of geriatric services throughout the country.

title: Ett slutligt avskaffande av EBO
summary: The proposal advocates for the elimination of the right for asylum seekers to choose their own housing (EBO), asserting that this practice has adversely affected municipal planning for integration, schools, job markets, and housing policies, contributing to increased segregation. The motion highlights the concentration of asylum seekers in a few municipalities with socio-economic challenges and compares Sweden's policy to Norway's, where housing placement is state-controlled to promote better integration outcomes.

title: Införande av en moderniserad förköpslag för kommuner vad gäller samhällsviktig och strategisk mark
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a modernized pre-emption law for municipalities concerning socially important and strategic land. This law aims to enhance municipalities' ability to conduct strategic land acquisitions, which was previously facilitated by a similar law until it was repealed in 2010. The new pre-emption rights are intended to provide municipalities with tools to combat segregation and develop more equitable housing standards across the country.

title: Ökning av allmännyttans andel av det totala bostadsbeståndet
summary: The motion proposes increasing the share of public housing in Sweden's total housing stock to address rising production prices and household debt issues that threaten macroeconomic stability. It suggests introducing state credit guarantees to support the creation of affordable rental housing in socioeconomic areas lacking such options, as well as investigating how to elevate the proportion of public housing.

title: Ett Sverige utan utsatta områden
summary: The motion proposes a housing policy aimed at combating segregation in Sweden, with the goal of eliminating 'vulnerable areas' characterized by high levels of socio-economic challenges. It highlights the increasing residential segregation since the 1990s, driven by growing economic disparities and migration. The motion calls for coordinated efforts among the state, regions, and municipalities to enhance physical development and create a mix of housing in both vulnerable and socio-economically strong areas, thereby fostering social cohesion and addressing the underlying issues of segregation and parallel societies.

title: Minskade anslag till studieförbunden släcker lamporna på landsbygden
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament analyze the consequences of reduced state funding for study associations, which are essential for community development and democracy across Sweden. With a proposed cut of 250 million SEK for 2024 and further reductions expected, the motion stresses that these financial constraints will severely limit the activities of study associations, particularly in marginalized and rural areas, jeopardizing cultural programs and access to education for individuals with low income.

title: Åtgärder för att förhindra att fastigheter blir verktyg för gängkriminalitet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1584 av Karin Sundin och Matilda Ernkrans (båda S)
summary: The proposal aims to address gang-related crime in Sweden by urging the government to review legislation and implement measures to prevent properties from being used as tools for criminal activities. The motion highlights the urgent need for stricter regulations around property ownership and rental, enhanced background checks for property buyers, and increased powers for authorities to confiscate properties linked to gang activities. The objective is to reclaim control over neglected or abandoned properties to restore safety in communities plagued by gang crime.

title: Inlandsbanan
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1583 av Isak From och Björn Wiechel (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of the Inlandsbanan railway for both passenger and freight transport, highlighting its potential role in sustainable transportation and national security amidst growing concerns. It calls for necessary investments to upgrade the railway to improve its functionality, thereby supporting the northern Swedish economy, especially the forestry industry. The motion urges the government to acknowledge these needs and explore alternative funding sources, including EU support, to enhance the railway's capacity and integration with the national network.

title: Infrastruktur ur ett öst-västligt utvecklingsperspektiv
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament supports a comprehensive study of infrastructure planning to enhance east-west connections in Northern Scandinavia, specifically between Vasa and Mo i Rana. It emphasizes the need for collaboration with EU, Norway, Finland, and NATO to improve transport corridors, ensuring security and economic growth, particularly in light of geopolitical tensions. The motion advocates for strategic enhancements in infrastructure to boost trade, connectivity, and prepare for military logistics, thereby benefiting both regional development and resilience.

title: Inrättande av ett pris för att uppmärksamma och motarbeta byråkrati hos myndigheter
summary: The proposal aims to establish an annual 'Bureaucracy Prize' to highlight and counteract instances of bureaucracy within governmental agencies that hinder citizens' rights and welfare. The initiative seeks to raise awareness of absurd and unfair bureaucratic practices, foster pressure for reform, and ensure that government regulations are clear, effective, and just. Citizens, organizations, and representatives from civil society would nominate cases, with a jury selecting the most notable example each year. The government would receive annual reports on nominated cases to consider necessary regulatory changes.

title: En arbetsmarknad som skapar ekonomisk självständighet för kvinnor
summary: Karin Sundin's proposal emphasizes the need for a more equitable labor market in Sweden that promotes economic independence for women. It calls for stricter requirements for public employers and publicly procured companies to adopt full-time work as the standard, to track sick leave and implement action plans, and to examine the possibility of abolishing the waiting period for sick leave compensation. This motion addresses the significant gender disparities in employment, income, and pension rights, highlighting the necessity for structural changes to provide women with equal opportunities in the workforce.

title: Stressrelaterade sjukdomar och sjukskrivningar för yrkesverksamma inom vård- och omsorgsyrken
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish parliament to adopt a national action plan aimed at combating sick leave due to stress-related illnesses among professionals in the healthcare and social care sectors. It highlights the increasing rates of stress-related health issues, particularly among women, and emphasizes the negative impact of recent austerity measures and cuts in public services on the work environment. The proposal argues for improved working conditions and adherence to labor laws to ensure sustainable care services in the future.

title: Utförsäljningen av välfärden
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1578 av Björn Wiechel och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal aims to halt the establishment of criminal actors within the welfare system, expressing concern over the privatization and commercialization of public services following the implementation of the Freedom of Choice Act (LOV). It argues that this has led to increased costs, poor coordination, and a significant presence of criminal gangs in the welfare sector, threatening the integrity of social services and community resources. The motion calls for a legislative change to restore control over ownership and establishment processes within the welfare system to prevent criminal exploitation.

title: Nattågstrafiken mellan norra Sverige och Göteborg
summary: The motion advocates for the reinstatement and enhancement of night train services between northern Sweden and Gothenburg, emphasizing its importance for regional connectivity, economic development, and environmental sustainability. The proposal highlights that efficient transportation is vital for tourism and local employment, particularly in northern regions known for their natural attractions. It calls on the government to consider procurement of night trains to ensure reliable and accessible transport options, underscoring the potential social and economic benefits of maintaining these services.

title: Säkra bostadsbyggandet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1575 av Åsa Karlsson och Björn Wiechel (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take measures to enhance state involvement in housing policy to address the urgent need for new housing, particularly in northern Sweden where a burgeoning green industry requires a larger workforce. The motion suggests that the government should implement active measures such as investment support and state loan guarantees to encourage construction companies to build more housing. It also advocates for expanding the mandate of the Norrlandsfonden to include providing credits for housing production in growth areas.

title: Mäns våld mot kvinnor
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1574 av Åsa Karlsson och Björn Wiechel (båda S)
summary: The motion calls for the Swedish Parliament to take decisive action against men's violence towards women, highlighting the varying forms of abuse including psychological, digital, material, economic, and physical violence. It emphasizes the alarming statistics of lethal violence against women by partners, the low prioritization of this issue, and the significant prevalence of unreported cases. The motion stresses the need for comprehensive efforts at all levels of decision-making to combat this violence and to ensure the protection and support for affected women and children.

title: Utbyggnad av stamnätet i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1573 av Helena Lindahl och Anne-Li Sjölund (båda C)
summary: The motion advocates for the expansion of Sweden's power transmission network to facilitate investments and job creation in regions like Robertsfors. It calls for clear directives to Svenska kraftnät to improve transmission capacity nationwide, emphasizing the need for faster permit processes and investments that accommodate future electrification demands due to the growing interest in green industry in northern Sweden.

title: Nödvändigheten av en åretruntfärja till Holmön
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should explore the possibility of securing year-round ferry services between Umeå and Holmön, due to ongoing communication issues that have persisted despite previous government inquiries. The current transport methods, including seasonal ferry service and limited helicopter access, are insufficient for residents and local businesses, creating significant challenges for commuting and economic sustainability on the island. The motion aims to address these longstanding problems by urging the government to take action.

title: Elektrifiering av Tvärbanan i Västerbotten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support the examination of funding options for the electrification of the Tvärbanan railway in Västerbotten. Currently, only part of the railway is electrified, resulting in significant reliance on diesel locomotives and road transport. The electrification is expected to improve environmental and cost efficiency, doubling freight capacity and facilitating transportation in light of increasing industrial activity in northern Sweden.

title: Likvärdig stödområdesindelning för det nationella stödet och kompensationsstödet för norra Sverige
summary: The motion proposes a review of the support area division for national and compensation aid to farmers in northern Sweden, specifically addressing the uneven distribution of support that negatively impacts farmers in Skellefteå and Umeå. It suggests that the area division should reflect varying agricultural conditions, ensuring that farmers with poorer circumstances receive adequate support. The proposal highlights the challenges faced by these farmers due to recent support changes and emphasizes the importance of supporting local agriculture for sustainability and food security.

title: Den nordsvenska brukshästen
summary: The motion proposes measures to ensure the survival, usability, and development of the North Swedish horse in Sweden. It highlights the cultural and practical significance of the breed, which has seen a decline in numbers due to changing agricultural practices and increased mechanization. The motion calls for the government to create a national development strategy and take additional actions to support breeding and promote the horse's usefulness in various areas, including tourism and agriculture.

title: Information om vilka fordon en person äger
summary: The proposal suggests that access to information about what vehicles a person owns should be restricted solely to relevant authorities in order to combat crime and enhance public safety. It emphasizes that current easy access to such data online facilitates criminal activities, especially in rural areas, leading to increased insecurity. The motion calls for the government to implement this change.

title: Rotavdrag för renovering av fönsterbågar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1567 av Daniel Bäckström och Mikael Larsson (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament review the conditions for allowing tax deductions (rotavdrag) for the renovation of window frames that are removed from a construction site and restored in a workshop, rather than directly on-site. The current regulations limit craftsmen's options and do not adequately support cultural preservation, particularly for old buildings. The authors argue that permitting such deductions would benefit entrepreneurs, cultural heritage, and property owners.

title: Åtgärder för minskad vargstam
summary: The suggestion proposes urgent actions to reduce the wolf population in Sweden by establishing regional management plans and setting a lower reference value for the population at 170 individuals, in line with previous parliamentary decisions. It emphasizes the need for tailored management due to increasing socio-economic impacts on rural communities, such as threats to livestock and hunting. The proposal calls on the government to act in accordance with legislative resolutions for effective wolf management.

title: Älgförvaltning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish Parliament to monitor the implementation of moose management policies and take necessary measures to ensure that these practices align with established intentions. Recent reports indicate a decline in both the moose population and the number of moose harvested, raising concerns about the sustainability of moose management and hunting practices in Sweden. The motion advocates for continued local influence over moose management while stressing the urgency to adapt policies in response to the troubling trends observed.

title: CE-märkning av virke
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1564 av Daniel Bäckström och Helena Lindahl (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament reviews existing regulations regarding CE marking of timber to facilitate increased use of construction timber sourced from private forests, aiming to ease the burden on smaller sawmills and forest owners seeking to build homes with their own sawn wood.

title: Snöröjning av enskilda vägar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1563 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The proposal seeks to instruct Trafikverket to adjust their procurement processes for snow removal to better accommodate both state and individual road associations in Sweden, particularly in rural areas affected by inadequate snow plowing. It highlights the negative impacts of current procurement practices that have led to delays and excessive costs, compromising essential services such as emergency response during winter months.

title: En reformerad allbolag
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1562 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: This motion proposes a reform of the law governing publicly owned housing companies in Sweden (allbolagen) to facilitate housing construction in smaller communities by municipal housing companies. The current interpretation of the law prioritizes business considerations to the extent that it hampers the ability to build in less populated areas, exacerbating urbanization and regional disparities. The motion advocates for modifications to the law to enhance the social responsibility and market-complementary role of these companies by allowing for longer depreciation periods and lower return requirements for new constructions in rural areas.

title: Förkortad handläggningstid för avverkningsanmälan
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1561 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes reducing the processing time for logging notifications to three weeks in order to efficiently manage timber resources following natural disasters, such as the significant damage caused by storm Hans. It argues that the current six-week rule is overly lengthy and suggests that looking at practices in neighboring Finland, where the waiting period is shorter, might provide a viable model for improvement.

title: Ökat driftsbidrag till kommunala flygplatser med statligt upphandlad flygtrafik
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1560 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament support an increase in economic operating grants for municipal airports with state-subsidized air traffic. The authors argue that these airports struggle to achieve self-sufficiency due to limited operations and rising costs, resulting in municipalities having to provide significant financial support. They highlight the importance of maintaining these airports for good transportation access, especially in less accessible regions, and call on the government to recognize and address the funding needs of these airports.

title: Krafttag för helhetssyn vid tillståndsprövning
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1559 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The motion advocates for an overhaul of the regulatory framework governing permit evaluations, emphasizing a comprehensive view that includes all three pillars of sustainability. It calls for the government to consider proposals from the Environmental Authority Inquiry aimed at improving environmental work efficiency, and suggests allocating additional resources to relevant authorities to reduce processing times for permit applications. The aim is to enhance the efficiency and predictability of the permitting process, particularly for the mining and mineral sector, which is significant for job creation and sustainable development in Sweden.

title: Utveckling av polisens brottsbekämpande och förebyggande arbete på landsbygden
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1558 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to enhance the police's crime-fighting and preventive efforts in rural areas, addressing concerns about rising violent crime, such as gang shootings and recruitment of children into drug trafficking. It highlights the significant decrease in police presence in rural communities since 2000, with many police stations closed and insufficient local policing, leading to feelings of insecurity among residents. The motion calls for increased police patrols, reopening of local stations, extended operating hours, and specialized investigators to tackle rural-specific crimes.

title: Väsentlig lättnad av den statliga skatte- och regelbördan för svenskt jordbruk
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1557 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The proposal calls for a significant reduction in the state tax and regulatory burden on Swedish agriculture to foster rapid growth in the sector. It emphasizes the importance of increasing domestic food production for national preparedness, arguing that current low profitability leads to declining numbers of farms. The authors assert that by improving profitability through reduced burdens, more individuals would be inclined to engage in farming, thereby decentralizing food production.

title: Berörda kommuners och regioners del av vind- och vattenkraftens värden
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1556 av Helena Lindahl och Daniel Bäckström (båda C)
summary: The proposal suggests that municipalities and regions affected by hydropower and wind power should retain a fair share of the values generated by these resources. It argues that currently, these areas receive minimal compensation for the environmental impacts of energy production, despite being significant contributors to Sweden's energy supply. The motion calls for the establishment of a long-term system to ensure those affected by energy infrastructure receive appropriate compensation, promoting equitable regional development in Sweden.

title: Utredning av förutsättningarna för att utöka rotavdraget
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the conditions for increasing the 'rotavdrag' (deduction for renovation costs) to 50% of labor costs. It argues that the original 50% deduction successfully reduced black market labor, increased tax revenues, and promoted jobs within proper labor conditions. The motion highlights that reducing the rotavdrag to 30% has negatively impacted property owners' ability to renovate legally and could lead to a resurgence in the use of black labor. It advocates for restoring the rotavdrag to its original level to stimulate demand for legitimate handyman services and to ensure fair competition in the construction market.

title: En ändamålsenlig arbetskraftsinvandring
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for a sustainable labor migration policy in Sweden that addresses the skills shortages in municipalities, regions, and businesses. It suggests establishing a wage floor based on the median salary to control labor immigration while allowing free immigration for positions paying above this threshold. The proposal also includes a call for a review of the labor immigration rules after 3-5 years of implementation and expresses concerns over potential conflicts with the Swedish labor market model. Additionally, it highlights the importance of combating crime and fraud related to labor migration to maintain public trust.

title: Flexiblare sjukförsäkring
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1553 av Cecilia Engström och Camilla Rinaldo Miller (båda KD)
summary: The proposal aims to reform the Swedish sickness insurance system by replacing the fixed compensation levels of 25, 50, 75, and 100 percent with a personalized percentage for sickness benefits that better reflects an individual's actual working capacity. This change is intended to provide greater flexibility, facilitate a smoother return to work, and address the challenges faced by both employees and employers in matching work capabilities with existing bureaucratic structures. The proposal suggests a system where benefits can range from 20 percent to 100 percent, based on medical assessments and discussions with employers, drawing inspiration from successful flexible systems in other European countries.

title: Cyklar på cykelbanan
summary: The proposal aims to ban all types of mopeds from using bike lanes in urban areas to enhance safety and security for cyclists, who have reported increased fears of being robbed by moped riders. By prohibiting mopeds, the motion seeks to ensure clear regulations on who can travel on bike lanes.

title: Möjlighet till lägre reavinstskatt vid försäljning av privatbostad
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of lowering the capital gains tax on the sale of private residences in Sweden. The proponent argues that the current capital gains tax of 22% discourages homeowners, especially seniors, from downsizing to more suitable accommodations. A suggested solution is to reduce the tax to 11% for homes owned for at least five years, thereby facilitating housing mobility and addressing the housing shortage.

title: Förarbevis för övriga motordrivna fordon
summary: The motion proposes that a driving permit be required for operating various motorized vehicles, such as electric bicycles, scooters, and skateboards, similar to the existing regulations for moped class 2, which includes a minimum age requirement of 15 years. The rationale behind this proposal is the increasing number of these vehicles on public pathways, often operated at speeds over 20 km/h, contributing to serious accidents that could potentially have been avoided with proper training and licensing.

title: Testa körkortsinnehavare från 70 år
summary: The proposal suggests that all drivers aged 70 and older should undergo periodic testing of their visual, auditory, cognitive, and reaction abilities every five years to retain their driving licenses. This measure aims to reduce traffic accidents caused by age-related declines in these abilities, despite acknowledging that younger drivers are more frequently involved in accidents.

title: Ny landsväg för lastbil sträckan Malmö–Helsingborg
summary: The proposal requests the parliament to investigate the possibility of constructing a new road specifically for heavy truck traffic between Malmö and Helsingborg, due to persistent traffic issues and accidents on the existing E6 highway. It argues that a separate road would help alleviate congestion and reduce the danger posed by the speed difference between trucks and other vehicles, ultimately improving traffic flow and safety.

title: Beskattning av snus
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1547 av Jörgen Grubb och Patrik Jönsson (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes an investigation into freezing the tax on snus and eliminating the indexation of the current tax rate, arguing that snus poses less health risk compared to cigarettes and contributes more in tax revenue than the societal costs it incurs. The motion advocates for lowering the tax on snus to encourage its usage over cigarettes as a public health measure.

title: Barsebäcks kärnkraftverk 2.0
summary: The motion proposes the construction of a new modern nuclear power plant in Barsebäck to meet the increasing electricity demands in Skåne for the next 50 years. It argues that the region has been facing an electricity supply crisis, primarily due to the closure of the previous nuclear facility and a lack of local energy sources. The proposal emphasizes the need for reliable energy production to support local industry and population growth, citing previous energy shortages as evidence of the urgent requirement for the new facility.

title: Samordning av namnvalsedlar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1545 av Jörgen Grubb och Michael Rubbestad (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that all municipalities in Sweden should handle party and name ballots in a consistent manner to eliminate issues that have arisen during elections regarding the availability of name ballots. The authors argue that current procedures disproportionately affect smaller parties and lead to confusion among voters, potentially undermining the democratic process. They recommend that municipalities take responsibility for distributing and overseeing name ballots, as some already do, to ensure that all voters can access the ballots they desire on election day.

title: med anledning av prop. 2024/25:8 Bolag och brott
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should urgently reintroduce auditing requirements for more limited companies, raise the minimum allowed share capital to 75,000 kronor, and allocate additional resources to the Companies Registration Office (Bolagsverket). The motion emphasizes the need to combat economic crime facilitated by corporations, which poses risks to public trust and financial stability. The Social Democrats argue that these measures would strengthen regulatory oversight and prevent companies from being misused for criminal activities.

title: Kvinnors företagande
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need to measure and follow up on women's entrepreneurship and their access to venture capital in Sweden. It highlights the significant underrepresentation of women as business owners and calls for government action to improve conditions for women's entrepreneurship, including clearer regulations and better access to risk capital. The motion urges relevant government authorities to address these issues and enhance the support for women's participation in the business sector to boost economic growth and equality.

title: Markeringen i belastningsregistret gällande sexualbrott mot barn
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1542 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint och Jennie Wernäng (båda M)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of maintaining the marking of sexual offenses against children in the criminal record for a longer period. The motion highlights the increasing incidents of sexual abuse among children and argues for the necessity of protecting children's rights over the potential discomfort of offenders. It emphasizes the importance of background checks for individuals seeking work in child-related fields, particularly in light of the potential risk of reoffending associated with such crimes.

title: Ökning av antalet anläggningar i Sverige
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Riksdag should support initiatives to assess new investment needs and financing methods for sports facilities in municipalities, addressing the urgent requirement for renovations and new constructions to enhance public health and social inclusion. The motion points out that many sports facilities were built in the 1970s and are now outdated, emphasizing the necessity for financial backing to ensure these facilities can be upgraded to meet current demands and promote health.

title: Våld och sexuella övergrepp mot barn med funktionsnedsättningar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:1540 av Marléne Lund Kopparklint m.fl. (M)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to consider implementing knowledge-enhancing measures regarding violence and sexual abuse against children with disabilities. It highlights the vulnerability of these children, as well as the deficiencies in the current societal safety net. The motion emphasizes the need for increased awareness among professionals and decision-makers in all areas that interact with children, suggesting that training on these issues should be mandatory for relevant professions, especially within healthcare.

title: Vapenlagen för jakt- och sportskyttar
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament examine the extent to which the police can interpret the appearance of firearms during licensing for hunters and sport shooters.
