summary: The proposal suggests an investigation into amendments to the 3:12 rules governing the taxation of closely held companies in Sweden, aiming to eliminate loopholes and ensure equitable taxation. The motion argues that the current regulations disproportionately benefit certain taxpayers, thereby exacerbating income inequality and undermining the sustainability of public finances. The motion calls for the government to review these regulations to better align tax laws with principles of fairness.

title: Pantsystem för textilier
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:774 av Johan Büser och Gunilla Carlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a system of incentives and requirements for sellers and consumers of textiles to promote the return and reuse of these materials. It highlights the environmental issues caused by the production and disposal of textiles, suggesting that a deposit system could help reduce the negative impact on climate and promote sustainability.

title: Giftfria mensskydd
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the investigation into establishing limit values for metals and harmful substances in menstrual products, in light of reports showing the presence of toxic metals such as arsenic, lead, and cadmium in these products. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring the safety of menstrual products for public health, particularly for women, who make up a significant portion of the population that uses these products, arguing that current regulations are insufficient to protect consumers.

title: Statens finansiella ansvar vid fördyringar av statliga infrastrukturprojekt
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:772 av Mattias Jonsson och Johan Büser (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish Parliament to review the financial responsibilities of Trafikverket regarding state-funded infrastructure projects, particularly in the context of cost overruns and delays, using the Västlänken project in Gothenburg as a key example. The authors argue that despite the significant financial burden already placed on local communities through taxes, the ultimate responsibility for funding such vital infrastructure lies with the state, necessitating the establishment of new regulations to ensure the project's completion.

title: Likvärdiga förutsättningar för tandvårdsaktörer
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:771 av Peter Hedberg och Anna-Belle Strömberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal seeks to establish equitable conditions for dental care providers in Sweden, emphasizing the need for private dental practitioners to contribute to the public health mandates, particularly in child and emergency dental care. It argues that while private dental care enjoys high profitability and benefits from government subsidies, they should also be held accountable for serving the population's needs. The motion calls for binding requirements for private providers to support regional healthcare responsibilities to qualify for state funding, thereby ensuring fair access to dental care for all citizens.

title: Samhalls uppdrag
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:770 av Peter Hedberg och Anna-Belle Strömberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should present necessary changes regarding Samhall, which was originally established to provide meaningful employment for individuals with difficulties in the regular job market. The authors argue that Samhall has shifted from a protective work environment to one that resembles a staffing agency, neglecting the needs of individuals with disabilities. They call for a return to focusing on the individual needs of employees, particularly those with severe challenges, rather than prioritizing customer demands and profit interests.

title: Invasiva arter
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:769 av Peter Hedberg och Anna-Belle Strömberg (båda S)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support efforts to increase awareness among property owners and the public about invasive alien species, emphasizing the need for effective measures to prevent their spread. The motion highlights the serious ecological and economic threats posed by these species, which can outcompete native species and damage ecosystems in Sweden. It calls for a collective effort to enhance knowledge and understanding of how to prevent and combat these species, stressing the responsibility of property owners to act if invasive species are present on their land.

title: AI och demokratins grunder
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:768 av Peder Björk och Anna-Belle Strömberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament conduct an investigation into the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on human rights and democracy, highlighting the potential threats and opportunities posed by AI across various sectors. It emphasizes the need for municipalities and regions to effectively leverage AI while expressing concerns about discrimination and misinformation risks. The motion also calls for the national government to explore how it can support localities with necessary resources and infrastructure to address these challenges and harness AI's benefits.

title: Tillträdesförbud till butiker måste fungera i praktiken
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:767 av Peder Björk och Anna-Belle Strömberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers changes to the law regarding access bans in stores to enhance its effectiveness in preventing repeat offenses, particularly in light of increasing instances of shoplifting and harassment affecting store employees. The current law is seen as insufficient in deterring habitual offenders who disregard access bans, requiring a reassessment to uphold the law's intended protective purpose.

title: Ökad skyldighet för banker att förebygga och motverka bedrägerier
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:766 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to increase the obligations of banks to prevent and counteract fraud in order to enhance the security of the financial system and rebuild trust among citizens and businesses. It highlights the significant rise in fraud cases due to the rapid digitalization and urges banks to implement advanced systems for monitoring transactions and identifying fraud risks. Additionally, the proposal suggests that banks be held accountable for reimbursing customers for losses incurred due to insufficient preventive measures against fraud.

title: Jämlik transplantationsvård i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:765 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for the establishment of a unified national system for organ donation and transplantation in Sweden to ensure equal access to life-saving healthcare regardless of geographical location. It highlights the current inequalities in waiting times and access to donor organs across different regions, suggesting that a cohesive national framework would optimize organ use and administration, ultimately improving the healthcare system.

title: Förbifart Örnsköldsvik och anpassad statlig väginfrastruktur i Västernorrland behövs för gröna industrisatsningar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:764 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion emphasizes the need for improved infrastructure, specifically new road connections, to support the growth of green industry in Västernorrland, Sweden. It highlights the region's potential for economic development through sustainable industrial investments and stresses that modernizing transportation will enhance both the economy and public health by reducing pollution and improving safety. It argues against the expectation that local municipalities should fund these essential state infrastructure improvements, which are vital for job creation and sustainable growth.

title: Organdonation
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:763 av Anna-Belle Strömberg och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The proposal aims to simplify the process for citizens to register as organ donors in Sweden, particularly by allowing individuals to indicate their interest in organ donation on their tax declaration forms. With a shortage of available organs leading to deaths on waiting lists, the motion underscores the need to lower barriers for registration and increase public awareness about organ donation, leveraging recent legislative changes to boost donor registrations.

title: Barns rättigheter före föräldrarnas
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:762 av Heléne Björklund och Magnus Manhammar (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for prioritizing children's rights above parents' rights to contact when there is a risk to the child's physical or mental health. It emphasizes that despite the integration of the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child into Swedish law in 2020, children's best interests are often overlooked, citing tragic examples. The proposal calls for legal changes to ensure that children's safety and well-being are always prioritized in custody and visitation decisions.

title: Inrättande av en nationell arbetsgrupp för samexistens mellan vindkraft och Försvarsmaktens intressen
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a national working group focused on ensuring coexistence between wind power development and the interests of the Swedish Armed Forces. It highlights the increasing energy needs in southern Sweden and the potential for offshore wind power as a sustainable solution. The motion seeks to address conflicts that arise between energy projects and defense considerations, urging the government to evaluate the possibility of creating a working group similar to those in neighboring countries to foster collaboration and mitigate investment delays.

title: Sydostlänkens vikt för bättre infrastruktur i Blekinge och för Sveriges motståndskraft
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:760 av Heléne Björklund och Magnus Manhammar (båda S)
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of the Sydostlänken railway for enhancing the infrastructure in Blekinge and improving Sweden's resilience against disruptions. It highlights the potential benefits for both freight and passenger transport, the integration of Blekinge with southern Småland and Skåne, and the creation of a climate-efficient transport corridor. The motion cites the support from the local business community, including major companies like Volvo and Ikea, for the development of this infrastructure project, which is deemed economically beneficial and vital for increasing regional competitiveness.

title: Främjande av vaccinering mot TBE i riskområden som Blekinge
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate the possibility of providing financial support to encourage more individuals in TBE risk areas, such as Blekinge, to receive vaccinations against the disease. It emphasizes the severity of TBE and the associated costs of vaccination, framing the issue as one of equality and public health as the incidence of the disease increases in these regions.

title: Arbetsförmedlingen ska finnas i hela landet
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity for the Swedish Public Employment Service (Arbetsförmedlingen) to be accessible in every municipality across the country, highlighting that many individuals, particularly in rural areas, feel overlooked as public services diminish. It points out the challenges posed by technological advancements, which may leave some citizens unable to access essential services. The proposal calls for the government to ensure that at least one office of Arbetsförmedlingen is established in every municipality to enhance local labor market knowledge and better connect with regional and local business actors.

title: Rut och rot enbart inom Sverige
summary: The motion proposes changes to legislation to prohibit the use of ROT and RUT tax deductions for services utilized outside Sweden. It argues that current laws allow Swedish citizens with vacation homes abroad to claim deductions while hiring local contractors, which is seen as an inefficient use of taxpayers' money. The proposal suggests that these funds could instead be better allocated towards improving the Swedish healthcare system and infrastructure.

title: Ett arbetsliv fritt från våld
summary: The motion proposes that the government work towards creating a workplace free from violence and to ratify ILO Convention 190, which aims to combat violence and harassment in the workplace, particularly focusing on the experiences of workers in caregiving professions who are often subjected to violence. It highlights the need to recognize and address the prevalence of violence in various professions, noting that many incidents go unreported, especially in the care sector, and calls for legislative actions to ensure a safer work environment.

title: Ungdomsförbundens självklara rätt i skolan
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament should support measures to allow political youth organizations to visit middle and high schools annually, ensuring that all students have equal opportunities to engage with youth politicians. The motion highlights the decreased opportunities for youth to interact with political representatives due to changes in education laws, which have led to inconsistencies across schools. It emphasizes the importance of fostering democratic engagement among young people to counteract growing polarization and ignorance in society.

title: Tullverkets möjligheter till brottsbekämpning
summary: The proposal suggests that the government should take measures to expand the Customs Agency's powers to include indirect crime fighting, similar to the regulations governing the Coast Guard. It emphasizes the importance of collaboration among all agencies in preventing and combating crime, particularly in light of the current alarming crime trends. The proposal identifies a gap in the current legislation that does not permit the Customs Agency to conduct investigations or enforce prohibitions against the movement of goods related to smuggling.

title: Pausa det storskaliga fisket efter sill och strömming i Östersjön
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:753 av Peter Hedberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes a pause on large-scale fishing for sprat and herring in the Baltic Sea to protect the ecosystem, which is at risk due to overfishing. The authors argue that most of the catch is processed into fishmeal for animal feed, rather than for human consumption, and emphasize the ecological and economic benefits of promoting small-scale fisheries that contribute to local food production.

title: Underlätta ingripanden mot nedgångna fastigheter
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:752 av Peter Hedberg och Peder Björk (båda S)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate legislation and possibilities to enable interventions against dilapidated properties, particularly in rural areas and smaller towns where abandoned houses negatively impact neighbors and the local environment. The motion emphasizes the need for a more efficient process for municipalities to take action against negligent property owners to improve living conditions and aesthetics in affected areas.

title: Tillgänglighet för äldre
summary: The motion emphasizes the necessity for the government to explore further options for ensuring that elderly individuals can access community services without relying on digital tools. It highlights the challenges faced by older citizens who are often unable to manage digital communication and calls for a comprehensive approach to enable their engagement with authorities and society.

title: Lagstiftning om att alla livsmedelsförpackningar inom EU ska visa produktens klimatavtryck på förpackningen
summary: The motion proposes that all food packaging within the EU should display the product's climate footprint, highlighting the need for such labeling to help consumers reduce their climate impact. It argues that since food accounts for a significant portion of global greenhouse gas emissions, mandatory disclosure of carbon dioxide equivalents (CO2e) on food packaging should be enacted, similar to nutritional information. The motion encourages the Swedish government to advocate for this legislation at the EU level and to ensure that it facilitates easy and low-cost compliance for businesses.

title: Stärkta incitament för att bygga i trä
summary: The motion advocates for the exploration of incentives to promote timber construction in housing, emphasizing its role in carbon sequestration and its potential to contribute to climate goals. It highlights the historical underutilization of timber in urban environments and calls for the government to implement a range of measures to enhance the appeal of building with wood.

title: Begränsning av bankernas räntenettomarginaler
summary: This proposal advocates for measures to limit the significant profit margins that Swedish banks can apply on interest rates, in light of their substantial recent profits amid rising costs for households and businesses. The motion highlights concerns about the banks' delayed response to increase interest rates on customer deposits compared to lending rates, raising questions about their responsibility towards society. It emphasizes the need to improve competition and consumer mobility in the banking market to alleviate financial burdens on the public.

title: Jämlik välfärd i hela landet
summary: The motion advocates for a reconsideration of how resources are distributed to municipalities in Sweden to ensure equitable access to welfare services across the country. It highlights the existing disparities among municipalities in terms of geographic and demographic challenges that affect their ability to provide essential services. The proposal emphasizes the state's responsibility to support a fair allocation of resources to address these inequalities and ensure that all residents, regardless of their location, can expect adequate welfare services.

title: Statliga arbetstillfällen till Gävleborg
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament supports the investigation of the conditions for prioritizing the relocation of state jobs to Gävleborg, based on recommendations from the parliamentary countryside committee. It emphasizes the historical opportunity for stronger collaboration among local, regional, and state levels, with a focus on increasing state presence in the region to foster development and address urbanization effects. The proponents highlight logistical advantages and increased employment opportunities that could arise from establishing a government agency in Gävleborg.

title: Västra stambanans renovering
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:745 av Fredrik Olovsson och Caroline Helmersson Olsson (båda S)
summary: The motion addresses the renovation of the Västra stambanan railway line, criticizing the current plans by Trafikverket that are deemed inefficient and outdated. It argues that the proposed work methods would severely reduce the line's capacity for an extended period, highlighting the existence of superior equipment and methods within the state's railway maintenance company that could expedite the process. The motion calls on the government to prioritize the perspective of travelers in the renovation plans.

title: Nytt skatteavtal med Portugal
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the creation of a new tax treaty with Portugal, which aims to avoid double taxation and mitigate tax evasion. It highlights issues that arose from Portugal's 'non-habitual resident' regulations, which led to some pensions being exempt from taxation in both countries. Despite a previously negotiated protocol to amend the tax treaty that was not ratified by Portugal, the motion suggests that recent changes in Portugal's tax regulations may provide a favorable context for negotiating a new agreement.

title: Säkrad övergång mellan aktivitetsersättning och sjukersättning
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:743 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion aims to ensure a secure transition between activity compensation (aktivitetsersättning) and sickness compensation (sjukersättning) to prevent individuals from falling through the cracks in the social support system. It highlights the challenges faced by those who have received activity compensation and may end up without the necessary support as they age into eligibility for sickness compensation, especially in light of changes in medical assessment practices.

title: Kostnadsfri tandvård för unga
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:742 av Åsa Karlsson och Helén Pettersson (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to maintain free dental care for individuals up to 23 years old and to preserve the annual dental care subsidy for those aged 24 to 29. It argues that dental health is significantly impacted by socioeconomic factors, and that free dental care increases access and equality in dental health for young adults. The motion emphasizes the importance of addressing disparities in dental health and suggests that state-sponsored dental care can help reduce these differences.

title: Mittuniversitetet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:741 av Peder Björk och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports strengthening education possibilities at Mittuniversitetet to better prepare individuals for global competition and ensure regional development. It emphasizes the importance of education and research in fostering growth and welfare, and advocates for increased investment in educational opportunities that keep students in the region. The authors highlight the role of Mittuniversitetet in providing high-quality education linked to local labor market needs, especially in light of the growing demand in welfare and green industries.

title: Stärkt transparens och flexibilitet i planeringen av infrastruktur
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:740 av Peder Björk och Peter Hedberg (båda S)
summary: This motion advocates for improved transparency and flexibility in infrastructure planning to ensure that allocated financial resources for new investments are clear and that development opportunities are safeguarded. It emphasizes the need for an efficient infrastructure system to support the growth of the green industrial revolution in Sweden, particularly in response to the changing demands of industry and municipalities. The authors argue that current rigid planning processes and substantial project backlogs hinder rapid responses to new infrastructural needs, which could impact job creation and significant investments.

title: Svensk satsning kring fusionsenergi
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the development of fusion energy as a potential solution to the energy challenges facing the country. It argues for investment in research and international collaboration to advance fusion technology, highlighting its advantages over current nuclear fission, such as minimal waste and greater safety. The proposal emphasizes the need for Sweden to take a proactive role in becoming a leader in sustainable energy practices, positioning fusion energy as a critical component of its energy policy moving towards a fossil-free future.

title: En nationell hjälpmedelscentral
summary: The proposal suggests that the Riksdag should investigate the creation of a national standard and assistive technology center to ensure equitable access to assistive devices across Sweden, addressing existing disparities based on regional availability. It emphasizes the need for clearer regulations on the provision of assistive devices to guarantee that the right to such support does not depend on one's place of residence.

title: Satsning på cykelbanor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the integration of bike lanes into the infrastructure planning for highways, aiming to prioritize cycling over cars in urban areas while promoting healthier lifestyles and reducing fossil fuel dependency. It suggests a goal for 10% of all roads to have bike lanes by 2028, 30% by 2035, and 40% by 2040, while also highlighting the importance of cycling for tourism and public health.

title: En parkeringsapp för hela landet
summary: The proposal advocates for the establishment of a national parking app to streamline the payment process for parking fees across Sweden. The author argues that the current reliance on multiple local apps from private parking companies is inconvenient for users, especially when traveling to different cities. A centralized app managed by the Swedish Transport Agency would allow all parking companies to connect and improve the user experience for motorists.

title: Standardiserade riktvärden för luktföroreningar i Sverige
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament consider establishing standardized values for odor pollution in the country, as there are currently no general regulations for industrial odors. The motion highlights that complaints about odors occur at lower frequencies than previously deemed acceptable, indicating a need for updated standards that reflect current circumstances. By referencing standards from other European countries and the EU, the motion aims to address this environmental issue more effectively.

title: Utökning av vaccinationsprogrammet för barn så att det också gäller TBE-vaccin
summary: The proposal suggests expanding the childhood vaccination program in Sweden to include the vaccine against tick-borne encephalitis (TBE), highlighting the importance of enabling children to enjoy the outdoors without the risk of contracting this serious illness. It emphasizes that the current cost of vaccination is a barrier for families, and identifies successful regional initiatives providing free vaccinations as a model for national implementation.

title: Vargföryngringar inom renskötselområdet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament recognizes the challenges faced by reindeer herding in relation to wolf reproduction in the area. It highlights the significant harm caused by wolves to reindeer herding, not only through direct predation but also by causing stress to herds. The motion argues for the need to consider the sustainability of reindeer herding in policymaking regarding wolf populations, suggesting that coexistence between the two is fundamentally incompatible.

title: Acceptansen för den svenska älgförvaltningen
summary: The proposal advocates for the preservation of the current regulations in Swedish moose management, specifically calling to maintain the rutting pause and emphasizing the ethical considerations surrounding moose hunting. It argues against increasing hunting periods and eliminating the rut pause, stressing the importance of maintaining public trust and ethical hunting practices, while also addressing impacts on biodiversity and land use.

title: Avskaffande av fideikommiss
summary: The motion advocates for the complete abolition of the fideicommiss system in Sweden, which currently permits exceptions that disproportionately affect women's inheritance rights. The proposal argues that this outdated system is a remnant of a feudal society and is incompatible with modern values of equality. It emphasizes that allowing this system to persist undermines Sweden's commitment to gender equality and suggests that alternative solutions should be sought for preserving cultural heritage without discriminatory practices.

title: Nollvision mot barnfattigdom
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:730 av Yasmine Bladelius och Hanna Westerén (båda S)
summary: This motion proposes a 'zero vision' initiative aimed at eradicating child poverty in Sweden through a comprehensive review of the economic family policy. It emphasizes the importance of equal opportunities for children and highlights the severe impact of economic hardship on their development and self-esteem. The motion calls for significant measures, such as increasing child allowances and ensuring free access to education and extracurricular activities, to alleviate the situation of children growing up in economically vulnerable households.

title: Stoppande av kriminaliteten inom offentlig upphandling
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:729 av Amalia Rud Stenlöf och Mattias Jonsson (båda S)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government should return to the parliament with proposals for coordinated registry checks to prevent criminal activities in public procurement. It highlights the significant volume of taxpayer money involved in public contracts and the presence of criminal enterprises in this sector. The authors emphasize the need for stronger political decisions and oversight to ensure that public funds do not support illegal operations.

title: Långsiktigt hållbar energiförsörjning
summary: Hanna Westerén's motion emphasizes the need for a long-term sustainable energy supply in Sweden, specifically highlighting the importance of securing reliable energy access for the island of Gotland. The proposal advocates for the government's commitment to enhancing energy infrastructure, including the construction of a third undersea cable to connect Gotland to the mainland, which would support renewable energy sources and bolster the region's economic growth and defense readiness.

title: 70 procent av slutlönen i pension
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:727 av Helén Pettersson och Isak From (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes to reform the pension system to ensure that all retirees receive at least 70% of their final salary as pension. It highlights the decline in the compensation level from 61% to 45%, particularly affecting women, and argues for a comprehensive review of the system to prioritize retirees' benefits. The motion asserts that the current system does not meet its promises and calls for higher contributions to the pension scheme and improvements to ensure adequate living standards for all pensioners.

title: Översyn av arbetsskadeförsäkringen
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:726 av Helén Pettersson och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to support the implementation of measures to modify the work-related injury insurance system to ensure greater gender equality. It highlights the current discrepancies in the approval rates of claims between men and women, with women receiving approval at a significantly lower rate. The motion references previous investigations indicating the insufficient attention to risk factors in female-dominated job sectors and advocates for an overhaul to create a more equitable insurance framework.

title: Rätt till tolk inom hälso- och sjukvården
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament affirm the right to interpreter services within healthcare, emphasizing that the proposed limits on publicly funded interpreters contradict existing patient rights laws. The motion argues that effective communication is essential for both patient understanding and the provision of qualified medical care, and that access to interpreters is crucial to prevent discrimination and misdiagnoses.

title: En hållbar småviltsjakt i de svenska fjällen
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to ensure sustainable small game hunting in the Swedish mountains, recognizing the significance of hunting and wildlife management for both local communities and tourism. It addresses legal uncertainties arising from a recent court ruling on land rights in relation to hunting and fishing, advocating for a clear framework that balances the rights of indigenous Sami communities with public access for both locals and non-locals. The suggestion calls for measures to prevent overhunting and highlights the importance of hunting as a recreational activity contributing to quality of life.

title: Förbättrade möjligheter för skyddsombud
summary: The motion proposes to strengthen the rights and capabilities of workplace safety representatives (skyddsombud) across all workplaces in Sweden. It highlights the alarming rate of workplace fatalities in 2023 and points out the disparities in reported accidents between genders. The motion suggests that despite Sweden's robust labor market framework, many workplaces neglect the safety and security of workers. It calls for legal measures to ensure that safety representatives can operate effectively, accessing workplaces freely and without threats, while also proposing to increase penalties for those obstructing their duties.

title: Reformering av Gotlandstillägget
summary: The motion proposes a review of the Gotland supplement to ensure fair competition in the transport sector and strengthen supply preparedness for Gotland. It highlights the importance of good communications for the island's economy, particularly its vital food production that heavily relies on cost-effective transportation to the mainland. The current system, which includes the Gotland supplement and price regulation, is criticized for lack of transparency and effectiveness, as it fails to adequately compensate local businesses facing rising transport costs. The motion suggests exploring alternatives such as raising, abolishing, or introducing direct state support for Gotland's freight transport to foster better competition and transparency.

title: Ö-faktor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament urge the government to review the funding conditions for the welfare needs of Region Gotland, which faces unique challenges due to its geographical isolation as the only island region without a land connection. The motion highlights the increasing costs of healthcare on Gotland and the need for sustainable financing solutions, as the current system does not adequately address the specific circumstances faced by this region, leading to potential inequalities in healthcare provision.

title: Jämlik tandvård
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:720 av Hanna Westerén och Åsa Karlsson (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for increased efforts to achieve equitable dental care in Sweden, highlighting the socio-economic barriers individuals face in accessing dental services, particularly among low-income retirees. It argues that untreated dental issues can lead to broader health problems, suggesting that dental care should be more affordable and accessible. The proposal builds on previous government initiatives while calling for further reforms, including the establishment of a high-cost protection system for dental care.

title: Entreprenörskap och innovation i socioekonomiskt eftersatta områden
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to investigate the feasibility of establishing targeted programs to promote entrepreneurship and innovation in socioeconomically disadvantaged areas. It highlights the importance of these initiatives in driving economic growth, creating jobs, and fostering social inclusion, while addressing existing challenges such as limited access to capital, networks, and education in these regions. By leveraging successful international examples and building on existing support structures, the proposal aims to develop tailored solutions that can uplift these communities and promote long-term economic development.

title: Nationell strategi för skärgården och skärgårdskommunerna
summary: The motion proposes the development of a national strategy for the archipelago and archipelago municipalities in Sweden, focusing on climate adaptation, community services, and sustainable tourism. It highlights the importance of the archipelago as a vital natural resource and its contribution to the economy through tourism and local industries. The motion calls for specific measures to ensure sustainable development, improve infrastructure and community services, and promote eco-friendly tourism practices. It emphasizes the urgency of addressing the challenges posed by climate change, including rising sea levels and erosion, through collaborative efforts among various stakeholders.

title: Slopande av den övre åldersgränsen inom LSS
summary: This motion proposes the removal of the upper age limit for personal assistance under the LSS (Support and Service for Persons with Certain Functional Impairments) in Sweden, allowing individuals to apply for assistance throughout their lives and request additional assistance hours as needed. The current limit, set at 66 years, prevents those above this age from seeking increased support despite potential changes in their needs, which the proposer argues is detrimental given the aging population and longer work lives. The proposal aims to ensure that individuals can maintain an active life with appropriate support, rather than being forced into inadequate housing solutions.

title: Dubbelspårig järnväg på Ostkustbanan
summary: The proposal advocates for the development of a double-track railway on the Ostkustbanan to alleviate current bottlenecks affecting the entire railway network. It argues that this expansion is vital for improving economic development by facilitating faster, simpler, and cheaper transport of both people and goods, thereby promoting growth and sustainability across Sweden.

title: Speciallärarutbildningen inom konduktiv pedagogik
summary: The proposal suggests that the government should investigate the possibility of creating a new direction for the special teacher training program in conductive pedagogy, which focuses on movement and physical activity for people with mobility impairments. The motion emphasizes the importance of movement for health and academic outcomes, highlighting a gap in current Swedish higher education offerings related to this pedagogical approach.

title: Reviderande av de nationella riktlinjerna för vård och omsorg vid demenssjukdom
summary: The motion proposes a revision of national guidelines for dementia care and support, specifically emphasizing the need for improved recognition and treatment of individuals with Down syndrome, who are at a higher risk of developing Alzheimer's disease at an earlier age. It advocates for ensuring that these individuals receive proper dementia investigations, diagnoses, and treatment in alignment with national guidelines, alongside enhancing knowledge within the healthcare sector.

title: Avgiftsfri TBE-vaccinering för barn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government investigate the possibility of offering tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) vaccinations free of charge for all children in Sweden. The rationale is based on the increasing spread of TBE virus in Sweden and the financial burden on families in regions where vaccinations are not provided for free, highlighting the need for equitable access to this important health service.

title: LSS och förhandsbesked
summary: The motion proposes to amend the law concerning the support and services for certain disabled individuals (LSS) by mandating that municipalities provide a preliminary decision within 21 days of receiving an application. This change aims to facilitate smooth transitions for individuals with significant disabilities when moving between municipalities, ensuring they receive timely care and services.

title: En likvärdig kvalitet på det statliga vägnätet i hela Sverige
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate alternatives to improve the quality of the state road network across Sweden, as more than 10% of state roads are in poor condition. With a current maintenance debt estimated at 20-23 billion SEK, and projections indicating it could rise to nearly 42 billion SEK by 2030 without increased funding, the motion highlights the disparities in road quality, particularly in northern regions. It argues that a uniform standard of road maintenance is essential for equitable societal service and infrastructure across the country.

title: Möjlighet att konfiskera fordon
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate granting the police the authority to confiscate vehicles from individuals engaged in what is classified as 'reckless driving', similar to a law enacted in Denmark. This initiative aims to enhance road safety by removing vehicles from those who pose a danger on the roads, including criminal elements, thereby potentially reducing fatalities and promoting preventative measures.

title: Slopat krav på anmälan av danstillställning
summary: The motion proposes abolishing the requirement for restaurants and nightclubs to notify the police about dance events, arguing that this regulation is outdated and burdensome. The motion highlights that while the previous system required a single annual permit, the current requirement for notifying each dance event alongside additional documents is considered overly complicated and reminiscent of bureaucratic red tape. It calls for the removal of this requirement to ease regulations for business operators in the hospitality industry.

title: Avskaffande av kravet på matservering för att få servera alkohol
summary: The motion proposes to abolish the requirement for food service in order to serve alcohol in Sweden. Currently, establishments serving alcohol must also offer a varied selection of prepared food, which can limit business opportunities and create confusion regarding compliance. The motion argues that the existing regulations lead to food waste and hinder innovative business ideas, advocating for the removal of these restrictions to enhance flexibility for businesses such as bars and theaters.

title: Återetablering av Söderhamns flygflottilj
summary: This proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of re-establishing the Söderhamn air base due to increased security concerns stemming from geopolitical tensions, particularly the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and the need for enhanced national defense. It highlights the ongoing military buildup and the importance of preparedness in the event of conflict, noting the historical significance of the air base for both defense and local employment.

title: Fler personer med en funktionsnedsättning i arbete
summary: The proposal advocates for an investigation into how companies can be better supported to hire individuals with disabilities, emphasizing the goal of achieving equal employment opportunities regardless of disability status. The motion highlights the significant employment gap faced by persons with disabilities, particularly those with reduced work capacity, and underscores the need for measures that would enhance their participation in the labor market.

title: Överpriser på konsertbiljetter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament take measures to prevent inflated prices on concert tickets in the secondary market. It highlights the challenges and risks faced by fans when purchasing resale tickets, including the potential for counterfeit tickets and financial losses if events are canceled. The motion draws attention to other European countries that have implemented laws against reselling tickets above face value and advocates for similar regulations in Sweden.

title: Motverka skarven i Gävleborg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament considers allowing public hunting of the cormorant to mitigate its impact on the coastal region of Gävleborg. The cormorant's rapid spread has detrimental effects on small-scale fishing and local vegetation, significantly impacting the community and tourism in the area. The motion calls for a combination of hunting and other measures to protect the unique coastal environment from the adverse effects of the cormorant.

title: Nationellt ledsagarintyg
summary: The proposal advocates for the creation of a national escort certificate that would be free for individuals with disabilities. The aim is to facilitate their participation in social activities and events without the burden of needing multiple proof documents. It seeks to standardize requirements across venues and improve accessibility, promoting spontaneous and convenient involvement in community life.

title: Fyrfilig E4 genom Gävleborg
summary: The motion proposes the investigation of the possibility to construct a four-lane E4 highway throughout Gävleborg, emphasizing its importance for freight transport, passenger traffic, and emergency services, particularly ambulance transport. The existing road infrastructure is criticized for its accident risk, especially the stretch between Söderhamn and Gävle, which currently features a 2+1 lane system. The proposal argues that improving the road would enhance the regional attractiveness and support local development, particularly for tourism during high-traffic holiday periods.

title: Utredning om hur utländska fordon utan vinterdäck kan stoppas och nekas att köra in i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into how foreign vehicles without winter tires can be prohibited from entering Sweden. It highlights concerns from the Swedish trucking industry regarding the safety risks posed by foreign trucks lacking the proper winter tire equipment, which can lead to accidents, traffic disruptions, and increased costs for society. The proposal calls for ensuring that foreign vehicles comply with Swedish winter tire regulations, advocating for a zero-tolerance policy on non-compliance.

title: Införande av en avgift för att överklaga ett bygglov
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament investigate the introduction of a fee for appealing building permits. The motion argues that some appeals are made without a valid basis and that imposing a fee could deter frivolous appeals, thereby streamlining the process while maintaining legal security.

title: Värna det småskaliga fisket
summary: The proposal advocates for the investigation of measures to protect small-scale fishing in Sweden, highlighting its potential to provide jobs and sustainable food sources while facing challenges from large-scale industrial fishing. It emphasizes the environmental benefits of small-scale fishing compared to the harmful practices of bottom trawling, which negatively impact marine ecosystems and contribute to overfishing. The motion calls on the government to support the development of local fisheries as a sustainable alternative.

title: Samordningsansvar gällande funktionshindersperspektiv och tillgänglighet i krisberedskapen
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency (MSB) should be given a coordinating responsibility regarding the perspective of disabilities and accessibility in crisis preparedness. It emphasizes the necessity of including individuals with disabilities in emergency and evacuation plans, citing the war in Ukraine as evidence of their increased vulnerability in crises. The motion calls for improved collaboration among total defense authorities to address the needs of people with disabilities during extraordinary events or wars.

title: Miljötillsyn
summary: The motion calls for an investigation into the regulation of environmental supervision fees to ensure that companies are not disadvantaged based on their location in different municipalities. The aim is to promote fair competition among businesses while adhering to the goals of the Environmental Code, which seeks sustainable development, the protection of health, and the preservation of biodiversity.

title: En sänkning av åldersgränsen för inköp av alkoholhaltiga drycker till 18 år
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:696 av Eric Palmqvist och Ann-Christine Frohm (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for lowering the legal age for purchasing alcoholic beverages in Sweden from 20 to 18 years, arguing that this aligns with the rights and responsibilities of adulthood, such as voting and driving. The motion references the historical context of Swedish alcohol policy, emphasizing that the current 20-year limit is out of step with practices in the EU and suggests that it has become ineffective as a measure to control alcohol consumption among youth. It calls for harmonization with European norms to reduce confusion and support young adults visiting Sweden.

title: Betalningsansvar för outnyttjade tolktjänster
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament conduct a review of the regulations governing the ability to charge individuals for unused interpretation services, particularly in light of the rising costs to the state associated with these services. It argues that individuals over 18 years old should be held financially responsible if they fail to attend appointments where interpretation has been arranged without valid reasons. The aim is to reduce public expenses related to interpretation services, while emphasizing personal responsibility for learning Swedish.

title: Svenska flaggan från Riksdagshuset som gåva till allmänheten
summary: The motion proposes establishing a framework for the donation of the Swedish flag that flies atop the Riksdag building to the public. It highlights the historical significance of the flag as a symbol of national unity, democracy, and freedom, suggesting that such donations would enhance citizens' connection to the flag and foster pride in national identity, similar to practices in other countries like Canada.

title: Utredning om förutsättningarna för en regionalisering av fastighetsskatten för elproduktions- och industrifastigheter
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the feasibility of implementing a regional property tax for electricity production and industrial properties in order to address the economic challenges faced by less populated municipalities in Sweden. It argues that current tax revenue systems inadequately capture the value generated by these industries, leading to financial strain on local communities. The proposal suggests that regionalizing the property tax could allow regions to retain more of the tax revenue, thus providing a more stable and predictable income source, ultimately benefiting rural areas and enhancing their service capabilities.

title: Ledamotsrum på landets länsstyrelser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament allows its members to book 'member rooms' at the county administrative boards in their electoral districts, facilitating a neutral space for meetings with constituents and interest organizations. This initiative aims to enhance democratic engagement by providing lawmakers a dedicated location to work outside their homes or party premises, addressing the current lack of such spaces.

title: Utbildningskrav för piloter som flyger fallskärmshoppare
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the necessity of requiring formal training for pilots flying with skydivers, in response to a tragic accident in 2019 in Umeå which resulted in nine fatalities. The motion highlights the current lack of specific training requirements for these pilots and emphasizes the safety risks involved, suggesting that a formalized education could lead to increased safety standards for both pilots and skydivers.

title: Åldersbegränsning av däck
summary: The proposal suggests investigating the possibility of implementing an age limit for tires to enhance road safety by preventing the use of excessively old tires. It emphasizes the importance of tire condition in vehicle safety, highlighting the risks posed by aging tires, such as diminished performance and increased likelihood of failure. The motion also calls for measures to ensure compliance and set penalties for violations, thereby aiming to reduce traffic hazards associated with outdated tires.

title: Förbättrad möjlighet till vila för vägtrafikanter
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports measures to enhance the availability and safety of rest areas along the national road network, as many drivers feel that these locations are currently unsafe and overrun by unauthorized activities. The motion urges the government to direct the Swedish Transport Administration to inventory rest areas and take necessary actions to ensure they are used for their intended purposes, allowing drivers to rest and access facilities.

title: Besiktningsgaranti
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish parliament investigate the implementation of a vehicle inspection guarantee to ensure that vehicle owners can access timely inspection services across the country, particularly in underserved areas. This guarantee would aim to facilitate vehicle inspections within a set timeframe and distance, allowing owners to continue using their vehicles without penalty while waiting for an appointment. The need for such a guarantee arises from the dwindling availability of inspection stations in certain regions, making it difficult for owners to comply with legal requirements.

title: Synskadade och valsystemet
summary: This motion advocates for improvements in Sweden's electoral system to ensure that visually impaired individuals can exercise their right to vote more effectively and privately. The proposer argues that current measures, which require assistance for personal voting and limit options for smaller parties, hinder the democratic principle of universal suffrage. The motion calls for the parliamentary committee reviewing the electoral system to prioritize the needs of visually impaired voters and implement necessary technological solutions to enhance their voting experience.

title: Hörselskadade och riksdagen
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament, recognizing the challenges faced by hearing-impaired individuals in participating in political debates, should make sign language interpretation a standard practice during parliamentary sessions, rather than an exception. This aims to ensure that hearing-impaired citizens can engage more fully in the political process and not feel excluded.

title: En ersättningsmodell som stimulerar privattandläkare att etablera sig där behoven är som störst
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into how compensation models for private dentists in Sweden can be restructured to encourage their establishment in areas facing dental care shortages, particularly in rural regions. It highlights the disparity in access to dental care between urban and rural areas, where many residents struggle to receive timely treatment due to a lack of available dentists. The goal is to create a more equitable dental care system across the country without infringing on the right to establish practice.

title: Svenska flaggan som gåva från riksdagsledamöter till allmänheten
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a regulatory framework allowing members of the Swedish Parliament to donate the Swedish flag to the public. This initiative aims to enhance national pride and symbolic representation of democracy, following similar practices in other countries like Canada. It emphasizes the flag's historical significance and its role as a unifying symbol for the nation.

title: En grundlig översyn av miljöbalken
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of Sweden's Environmental Code to address the challenges posed by lengthy and unpredictable environmental permitting processes, which are seen as hindering crucial industries, including mining and energy infrastructure. It argues that these delays not only impede national self-sufficiency in metals and minerals but also affect the defense capabilities of the country. The motion calls for an investigation to create a better balance between societal interests and environmental protection while facilitating quicker governmental response to permits impacting national security.

title: Regelverk för kommunala konkurser
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a regulatory framework to address the financial insolvency of municipalities in Sweden. It highlights the increasing economic challenges faced by many municipalities, especially in rural areas, due to rising costs, declining revenues, and an aging population. The motion suggests that a clear set of regulations is necessary to determine state responsibilities, conditions for municipal bankruptcy, and the handling of municipal assets. Such a framework is expected to improve municipalities' credit ratings and lower borrowing costs, benefiting both local governments and taxpayers.

title: Lättnader i reglerna för skyddsjakt på gäss
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the current legislation regarding the protection and hunting of Canada geese, Greylag geese, and the White-fronted goose in Sweden. It suggests that the criteria for allowing protective hunting should be reconsidered to facilitate easier approval under the premise of public health and safety. The motion also advocates for limiting the population of Canada geese, which are considered non-native, and seeks to secure a national exemption from the EU's protection of the White-fronted goose due to its increasing numbers in Sweden. The overarching aim is to balance human activities with wildlife management.

title: Parkering mot färdriktningen
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:680 av Eric Palmqvist och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of allowing parking against the direction of travel. It emphasizes the challenges faced by electric and hybrid vehicle owners, particularly in urban environments where the placement of charging stations complicates the charging process. The motion notes that many European countries permit such parking, suggesting that Sweden should adapt its regulations in line with this norm to accommodate the growing need for charging infrastructure.

title: Utredning om sänkt fordonsskatt på dieseldrivna personbilar och lätta lastbilar
summary: The proposal aims to investigate the possibility of reducing vehicle taxes on diesel-powered passenger cars and light trucks that meet Euro 6d-Temp or newer standards, as well as to evaluate the counterproductive effects of the so-called malus tax and its potential abolition. The motion criticizes the previous bonus-malus system for creating an unjust tax burden that favors electric cars while disadvantaging diesel vehicles, which are argued to be more efficient and capable of rapid emissions reductions through the use of alternative fuels. The author stresses the need for a tax structure that promotes the adoption of environmentally friendly vehicles rather than hinder it.

title: Fast förbindelse Göteborg–Öckerö
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish government to consider the regional infrastructure needs by advocating for a fixed connection between Öckerö and Göteborg. It highlights the longstanding traffic issues in Torslanda, particularly the bottlenecks created by reliance on ferry services, which are exacerbated during summer months. The motion cites the Traffic Agency's conclusion that a bridge would offer higher societal and economic benefits compared to continued ferry traffic, thus aiming to improve daily commutes, support tourism, and enhance job opportunities for residents.

title: Identifierande av barnfattigdom
summary: The proposal calls on the Swedish parliament to recognize and identify child poverty in vulnerable areas and to allocate increased psychological, police, and social resources to these regions. It argues against the notion that poverty has been eradicated in Sweden, highlighting the severe living conditions faced by many children, which contribute to criminal behavior. The proposal emphasizes the need for intervention and support to address the roots of child poverty and its associated social issues.

title: Ett rättvist pensionssystem
summary: The proposal advocates for a fair pension system in Sweden, calling for mandatory pension agreements for all employers to provide occupational pensions, increasing the premium pension rate to four percent to enhance the general pension to 20%, and promoting collaboration between the government, employers, and trade unions to protect pensioners' rights. The motion underscores the current inadequacies of the pension system, which leaves many retirees in poverty, and emphasizes the need for a system that ensures economic stability and dignity for all pensioners.

title: Regemente i Gävleborg
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:675 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion advocates for the establishment of a military regiment in Gävleborg County to enhance Sweden's defense capabilities, given the region's historical connection to military training. It emphasizes the importance of this initiative for the protection of the Swedish coast and encourages the government to consider the potential locations and types of regiments suitable for the area.

title: Polisens rätt till användning av kommunala informationstavlor
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:674 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the police be granted the right to use municipal information boards to disseminate urgent public information, such as alerts about wanted vehicles or missing persons, similar to the Amber Alert system used in the USA. The proposal emphasizes the potential effectiveness of both digital and analog information boards in reaching the public, thereby enhancing cooperation between law enforcement and the community. It calls for the government to develop a national strategy regarding this use while considering privacy concerns.

title: Obligatoriskt med larmbågar eller metalldetektor vid akut- och psykiatrimottagningar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:673 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider implementing mandatory security measures, such as alarm gates or metal detectors, at acute and psychiatric care facilities. The intention is to enhance safety for both patients and staff by preventing weapons and knives from being brought into these premises, addressing current concerns about threats and violence, including those stemming from terrorism. The proposal argues that these measures could ultimately reduce barriers to accessing care for individuals who may feel unsafe otherwise.

title: Obligatorisk utbildning i VMA-systemet för elever i grund- och gymnasieskola
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:672 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider implementing mandatory and recurring education on the VMA (Important Message to the Public) system in primary and secondary schools. This initiative aims to improve public awareness of the system, especially in the context of heightened security concerns following recent events such as the war in Ukraine. By educating students on the signals of the VMA system, the motion seeks to strengthen the readiness and understanding of emergency procedures among the younger population.

title: Möjligheten att svänga höger vid rött ljus
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:671 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider allowing vehicles to turn right at red traffic lights, similar to practices in the United States. This change aims to improve traffic flow, especially during times of low traffic, while ensuring that safety measures are implemented, such as stopping first before making the turn.

title: Höjd hastighetsgräns för personbil med släp
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:670 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should review and consider increasing the speed limit for passenger cars towing trailers from the current maximum of 80 km/h, arguing that improvements in vehicle and road safety over the years justify such a change. The authors believe that raising the speed limit to 90 km/h or higher would enhance traffic flow and reduce overtaking incidents on the road, citing the practices in Germany and Austria as comparisons.

title: Halverad moms på skolmaterial inför skolstart
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:669 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider halving the VAT on school materials in order to alleviate financial burdens on families as they prepare for the school year. This recommendation arises from concerns about the increased costs of essential items for children, especially in the context of recent economic hardships faced by many families. The motion emphasizes the importance of ensuring that all children have access to a good education without being disadvantaged by their parents' financial situation.

title: Förändringar i kommunallagen för bättre protokollföring
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:668 av Mattias Eriksson Falk m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes amendments to the Municipal Act in Sweden to enhance the documentation of decisions within local governance. It suggests ensuring that written reservations and statements are included directly in the main protocol instead of as separate attachments, thus improving transparency and allowing minority voices in decision-making processes to be clearly recorded. This change aims to strengthen democratic influence and ensure that all perspectives are visible in official records.

title: Förändrade regler i kommunallagen för beslut om extra val till fullmäktige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:667 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government amend the municipal law to allow local councils to call for extra elections three months after their first meeting, similar to the rules applicable to the national parliament. The authors argue that local councils should have the same electoral flexibility as the national level, requiring a two-thirds majority for such decisions.

title: Förändrat regelverk i kommunallagen för lägsta antal ledamöter i kommun- och regionfullmäktige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:666 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes changes to the local government act regarding the minimum number of representatives in municipal and regional councils. It argues for more flexibility in determining the number of council members, suggesting that larger municipalities and regions should have the option to reduce their number of representatives as desired, rather than being limited by current regulations.

title: Domstolars placering i statligt ägda fastigheter
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:665 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that Swedish courts be located in properties owned by the state to ensure full control and accessibility for critical public services. The authors argue that having state ownership of court premises is essential for maintaining effective access and minimizing unwanted associations with privately owned properties.

title: Dubbelspår Gävle–Ockelbo
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:664 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider assigning Trafikverket to construct a double track on the railway line between Gävle and Ockelbo. This development is seen as crucial for improving communication and connectivity across Sweden, particularly to enhance the efficiency and reliability of passenger and freight transport along this vital route.

title: Dubbelspår på sträckan mellan Ockelbo och Mo
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:663 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider planning, designing, and funding the expansion of a double track railway between Ockelbo and Mo. Advocates argue that this upgrade could enhance transportation efficiency, promote business investments by providing reliable transport solutions, and encourage rail travel as an environmentally friendly alternative to cars, aligning with Sweden's climate goals.

title: Dubbelspår på sträckan mellan Söderhamn och Kilafors
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:662 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the government should consider assigning Trafikverket the task of constructing a double track railway between Söderhamn and Kilafors. This development aims to enhance the railway network's capacity, ensuring better communication links between Eastern and Western Gävleborg, particularly allowing for train rerouting during disruptions on the existing lines.

title: Ett tydligare regelverk för skolornas studie- och yrkesvägledning
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:661 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes a review of the current regulations for study and career guidance in schools to establish a clearer and more uniform framework that ensures high quality and accessibility for all students. It advocates for the introduction of national guidelines that clarify the responsibilities of schools and the rights of students, including requirements for the competency and availability of guidance counselors, aiming to enhance informed decision-making among students regarding their educational and career choices.

title: Fler poliser som kör motorcykel i tjänsten
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:660 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider instructing the Police Authority to train more police officers to operate motorcycles in the line of duty. The initiators argue that motorcycles allow for greater mobility and responsiveness in various environments, which is essential for maintaining public safety and security.

title: Förbud mot att ställa frågor till ordförande i region- och kommunfullmäktige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:659 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider amending the local government act to establish a ban on posing questions to the chairperson in municipal and regional councils. This is in response to instances in Gävleborg where such questions have been raised, which the authors believe disrupts the structured handling of business in councils.

title: En uppdaterad kommunallag i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:658 av Mattias Eriksson Falk m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes updates to the Swedish Local Government Act to enhance the neutrality of local council chairpersons by allowing them to abstain from voting, similar to the role of the Speaker in the national parliament. This change aims to ensure a more inclusive political debate by allowing smaller parties to hold the chairperson position without losing a vote, thereby improving democratic engagement in local governance.

title: Dubbelspår mellan Sandviken, Storvik och Hofors
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:657 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider initiating and funding the expansion of a double track railway between Sandviken, Storvik, and Hofors. This infrastructure investment aims to enhance traffic capacity, promote sustainable transportation by increasing commuting options, and support economic growth by benefiting businesses reliant on efficient logistics. The proponents argue that this development could lead to job creation and a stronger economy by reducing costs for entrepreneurs.

title: Ansvaret för räddningstjänsten
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:656 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the responsibility for fire services in Sweden should be transferred from municipalities to regional authorities. The authors argue that smaller municipalities struggle to maintain adequate fire services due to economic constraints and that coordinating fire services with other emergency services, like ambulances, would create operational efficiencies. They urge the government to legislate this change while ensuring that fire stations are maintained in smaller communities.

title: Införande av svarta lådor vid operationer inom hälso- och sjukvården
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:655 av Mattias Eriksson Falk m.fl. (SD)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of black boxes in surgeries within the Swedish healthcare system to enhance patient safety, provide follow-up opportunities, and clarify events during any complications that may arise during operations. It urges the government to consider returning to parliament with proposals that align with the motion's intentions.

title: Amber alert i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:654 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should investigate the possibility of implementing the AMBER Alert system in Sweden, which is a rapid public alert system used in the United States to notify citizens about child abductions. The system aims to enhance community safety and awareness by disseminating urgent alerts through various media, ensuring prompt action in the event of a child's abduction.

title: Ny lag om tvingande vård av vårdnadshavare
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:653 av Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the investigation of a new legislation that would enable mandatory care for guardians in order to strengthen the social services' ability to ensure the well-being of children and young people. It argues that current voluntary support measures often fail to protect vulnerable children from unsuitable environments when parents are unable to provide adequate care. The proposed law would make treatment and support for parents compulsory in cases concerning the development and safety of children.

title: Digitalt högkostnadsskydd inom hälso- och sjukvården
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:652 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: This motion proposes the establishment of a digital high-cost protection system within healthcare, enabling citizens to register visits digitally. The system would ideally be accessible through existing platforms like 1177 and would require bank-ID for access. The motion emphasizes that this digital solution should complement the existing paper-based high-cost protection system, rather than replace it. Furthermore, it suggests that the government initiate an investigation to explore how such a digital system can be implemented and to recommend any necessary legal changes.

title: Byta färg på passböckerna i Sverige/EU
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:651 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government work towards changing the color of Swedish passports to blue, similar to the color previously used in Sweden, instead of the current burgundy shade used within the European Union. The motion argues that the change may require amendments to both Swedish and EU legislation.

title: Belysning på E16 mellan Gävle och Valbo
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:650 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the Swedish government to instruct Trafikverket to enhance the lighting on the E16 road between Gävle and Valbo to improve traffic safety. It emphasizes the importance of adequate lighting for visibility and thereby increasing safety for drivers, especially on the stretch currently lacking proper lighting despite heavy traffic and sharp curves.

title: Framtagande av ett särskilt trygghetsprogram för Gävleborgs län
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:649 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a special safety program for Gävleborg County to address crime and enhance public safety, particularly in vulnerable areas. It calls for collaboration between the County Administrative Board, municipalities, police, fire services, civil society, and other relevant stakeholders to develop the program. The focus will be on crime prevention and increasing safety perceptions, along with fostering cooperation among various authorities and encouraging residents' involvement in safety efforts.

title: Adoptera en motorväg och bidra till upprustning av vägsystemet i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:648 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider implementing a system similar to the 'adopt-a-highway' initiative used in the United States, allowing organizations, businesses, and individuals to financially contribute to the maintenance and improvement of highways in Sweden. In exchange for their contributions, they would receive recognition through signs along the road, fostering community engagement and generating additional funding for the road infrastructure.

title: Fyllnadsval för att förhindra tomma stolar i kommun- och regionfullmäktige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:647 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should introduce supplementary elections to fill vacancies in municipal and regional councils, ensuring full representation and effective decision-making during the entire term. The authors argue that unfilled positions weaken democracy, and a well-designed system for these elections could enhance citizens' trust in the political system while balancing administrative efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

title: Förbud mot att interpellera ordförande i region- och kommunfullmäktige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:646 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider amending the Local Government Act to prohibit the ability to interpellate or ask questions of the chairpersons in municipal and regional councils. The suggestion arises from instances in Gävleborg where such interpellations occurred, despite them not typically being directed at the chair. The authors argue that prohibiting these questions would establish a clearer structure for handling matters in councils.

title: Förbättrad belysning längs väg 562
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:645 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider initiating and funding a project to improve lighting along road 562 between Björke and Hamrångefjärden, citing safety concerns for both local residents and businesses, especially during darker months when road conditions can be hazardous. Improved lighting is expected to enhance traffic safety and facilitate transportation, thereby promoting local tourism and economic activity.

title: Förbättrad belysning längs väg 303 mellan Hagsta och Ockelbo
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:644 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider and fund a project to improve the lighting along road 303 between Hagsta and Ockelbo. The authors emphasize the importance of this road for regional development and stress that the current inadequate lighting poses safety risks for road users. They argue that better lighting will enhance traffic safety and reduce the likelihood of accidents, making the road feel more secure for all travelers, whether they are driving, cycling, or walking.

title: Förlängt barnbidrag när ett barn avlider
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:643 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government consider extending the child allowance for a period of time after the death of a child, recognizing the financial and emotional burdens that parents face during such a traumatic event.
