The current regulation halts the child allowance immediately after a child's passing, which can exacerbate the financial hardships of grieving parents, particularly in cases where they may also be unable to work due to their mental state. The proposal suggests a possible extension of the allowance for six to twelve months following the child's death.

title: Förskoleavgiften under sommarstängt
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:642 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should consider legislative changes to prevent municipalities and private preschool providers from charging fees during the summer months when regular preschool activities are closed, arguing that it is unreasonable to pay full fees when children are at home.

title: Stärkt lagstiftning till skydd för tjänstehundar och tjänstehästar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:641 av Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes enhanced legislation to protect service dogs and service horses in Sweden, highlighting that current laws provide insufficient safeguards. It argues that improved legal protections are necessary for these animals to effectively support police and other authorities in their duties, specifically advocating for legislation that offers special protections against violence directed at service animals.

title: Heltidsarbete som norm inom offentlig sektor
main_author: Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:640 av Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for a legislative change to ensure that public sector employees have the right to full-time work, addressing the issue of involuntary part-time work that adversely affects wage growth, career prospects, and future pensions. It highlights the gender disparity in part-time work, emphasizing that this issue disproportionately affects women, thus framing it as a significant equality concern. The motion calls for the government to investigate this matter while noting that collective bargaining has so far been ineffective in resolving the issue.

title: Drogtester i skolan för att motverka missbruk
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:639 av Roger Hedlund och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes to investigate legal changes that would allow for drug testing in schools aimed at combating substance abuse among youth. It highlights the widespread issues of drug misuse in society and argues that early identification of drug users can prevent further social consequences and reduce the financial burden on social services. The proposal also suggests that implementing drug testing could create a positive social pressure among students to discourage drug use.

title: Möjlighet för domstol att återkalla uppdrag som ledamot eller ersättare i kommun- och regionfullmäktige vid allvarlig brottslighet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:638 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should introduce legislation allowing courts to revoke the mandates of members or substitutes in municipal and regional councils in cases of serious criminal offenses. Currently, there is no equivalent provision for local council members, allowing individuals convicted of serious crimes to retain their positions. The motion calls for changes to the municipal law to address this issue.

title: Möjlighet för stadssamhällen att formellt ändra benämning från kommun till stad
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:637 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government revisit current laws to allow municipalities to formally change their designation from 'kommun' to 'stad', drawing on a similar provision in Finnish law. The authors suggest a trial period for this change, positing that while it does not affect legal obligations, it could enhance the administrative identity of certain municipalities that meet specific criteria.

title: Legitimation för persontransporter med buss
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:636 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of a requirement for drivers of passenger transport buses in Sweden to carry and display identification to enhance security for both passengers and drivers. This would establish a standard similar to the existing requirement for taxi drivers, ensuring that passengers can easily verify the driver's identity and qualifications.

title: Kunskap om odling i grundskolans läroplan
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:635 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes the integration of mandatory practical gardening education into the elementary school curriculum to enhance students' understanding of agriculture and nature, as well as to promote healthy eating habits. Evidence from other countries indicates that such programs can improve students' learning outcomes and well-being.

title: Förbättrad belysning längs väg 272 mellan Årsunda och Österfärnebo
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:634 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish government to consider assigning the Swedish Transport Administration the task of improving the lighting along route 272 between Årsunda and Österfärnebo, to enhance road safety for motorists, cyclists, and pedestrians, especially in areas where visibility is poor due to curves and the proximity to smaller communities.

title: Komplettering av kommunallagens bestämmelser om ledighet från anställning för förtroendevalda
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:633 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government revisit and amend the local government act to include provisions for mandatory weekly rest for elected officials, arguing that the current focus on daily rest is inadequate and can lead to negative effects, particularly when individuals hold political roles alongside demanding jobs.

title: Inrättande av ett utskott för kommunala och regionala frågor
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:632 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests the establishment of a parliamentary committee specifically focused on municipal and regional issues in Sweden. This committee would enhance the scrutiny of legislation and decisions affecting local and regional governance, ensuring that they are well-informed and address the unique needs of these levels of administration. Additionally, the committee aims to improve coordination between national policies and local/regional administrations for better implementation of political decisions.

title: Införande av obligatorisk relegering vid upprepad mobbning i skolor
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:631 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for mandatory expulsion from school for students who are found to have bullied others on three separate occasions. The motion highlights the serious issue of bullying in schools, citing a significant number of students affected and the detrimental consequences of bullying, including increased absenteeism and mental health issues. It calls for a stronger stance against habitual bullies while also ensuring that expelled students receive support to improve their behavior. The motion emphasizes that expulsion should be a last resort, following unsuccessful interventions and that a clear policy regarding the implementation of such expulsions should be developed.

title: Införande av bestämmelser om synnerligen grovt rattfylleri
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:630 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes the introduction of legal provisions for a new category of offense called 'synnerligen grovt rattfylleri' (particularly serious drunk driving), to reflect the increased risk associated with higher blood alcohol content. The motion advocates for a distinct legal framework for severe cases while suggesting that the threshold for regular grov rattfylla be lowered from 1.0 to 0.5 promille. The aim is to enhance the societal and legal stance against dangerous driving behaviors.

title: Möjlighet för kommunerna att arvodera nattvandrare skatte- och avgiftsfritt
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:629 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for allowing municipalities to compensate night walkers with tax-free payments, in order to encourage more people to engage in this community safety initiative. The motion emphasizes the vital role night walkers play in preventing crime and enhancing the safety of young individuals, especially in areas with high social unrest, by providing a supportive presence during evenings and nights when local police are occupied with serious crime.

title: Höjd nivå på penningböter vid överskridande av hastigheten vid område för exempelvis pågående vägarbete
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:628 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests increasing the financial penalties for speeding violations in construction zones where workers are present. It aims to improve safety and working conditions for road construction workers by treating infringements in these areas as more serious than similar violations elsewhere, similar to established practices in several U.S. states. The motion calls for the government to draft legislation to enforce these heightened fines and establish clear guidelines for implementation.

title: Möjlighet för fler att genomgå grundutbildning inom Försvarsmakten
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:627 av Mattias Eriksson Falk och Roger Hedlund (båda SD)
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support increasing access to military basic training within the Swedish Armed Forces. It emphasizes the need for reforms to facilitate more citizens to undertake this training, particularly by revising the compensation structure to encourage individuals to transition from civilian jobs to military service, thus strengthening national security amid increasing geopolitical threats.

title: med anledning av skr. 2023/24:163 Nationell säkerhetsstrategi
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden's National Security Strategy should integrate clearer objectives for reducing emissions both domestically and globally, as well as for climate adaptation, in light of climate change being recognized as an existential threat to humanity. It calls for the government to follow up on the strategy with concrete actions proportional to the seriousness of the threat posed by climate change.

title: med anledning av skr. 2023/24:153 Riksrevisionens rapport om Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: The proposal emphasizes the importance of security in the management of personal data associated with the Allmänna arvsfonden (General Inheritance Fund) and suggests broadening its target groups. It calls for an investigation into enhancing the fund by utilizing real estate left by deceased individuals without heirs, to better support community projects. The proposal is in response to concerns raised by the Swedish National Audit Office about the fund's effectiveness and safety against misuse. The proposers argue that the fund is vital for supporting various community initiatives and advocate for improved management and oversight.

title: Återinförande av persontrafik på tågen genom Sörmland
summary: The motion proposes the reinstatement of passenger train services on the railway line from Oxelösund to Eskilstuna, passing through Sörmland. It argues for the benefits of connecting smaller towns and improving rural accessibility. The proposal highlights that necessary infrastructure investments are manageable, given previous enhancements and the existence of plans that would enable passenger services without incurring significant new costs. The anticipated travel time would be reduced compared to current bus services, benefiting the environment and local communities.

title: Återinförande av svart stork i Sverige
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:623 av Rebecka Le Moine m.fl. (MP)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency to develop a plan for the reintroduction of the black stork, a species that is considered nationally extinct. The motion emphasizes the responsibility Sweden holds under the biodiversity convention to reintroduce native species, the improved conditions for the black stork since its extinction, and the significant role that zoos can play in this process. Additionally, the motion advocates for the restoration of wetlands, which is essential for the black stork's habitat and offers broader climate and biodiversity benefits.

title: Från psykofarmaka till psykoterapi: en väg mot bättre psykisk hälsa
summary: The proposal advocates for a holistic and person-centered model of care for mental health, emphasizing the prioritization of psychotherapy as the first line of treatment for non-acute mental health issues, and granting patients the right to choose their own psychotherapist. This approach aims to tailor treatment to individual needs, reduce reliance on medication, and enhance patient outcomes through improved therapist-patient relationships.

title: Nationell cykelled runt Vättern
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government task the Transport Administration (Trafikverket) with the development of a national cycling path around Lake Vättern. This initiative aims to enhance the quality and safety of cycling routes for both recreational cyclists and tourists, ensuring they meet the criteria set by Trafikverket for national cycling paths. The proposal highlights the need for improved infrastructure, including safe separation from motor traffic, to encourage usage, particularly by families with children.

title: En reformagenda för ökad livskvalitet
summary: The motion proposes a reform agenda aimed at enhancing the quality of life in Sweden, with the ultimate goal of becoming the happiest country in the world. It suggests that all political reforms should include impact assessments on quality of life, promote spaces for community interaction, advocate for flexible working hours and a revised alcohol policy, and address housing needs by preventing evictions and ensuring affordable homes are available. This comprehensive approach seeks to foster societal trust and well-being.

title: Landskapsskyltar vid landskapsgränser
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should explore the possibility of installing signs at the borders of Sweden's historical landscapes to enhance awareness of their cultural and historical significance, which has diminished over time. The aim is to promote national identity and tourism by making these landscapes more visible, thus acknowledging their important role in Swedish history and culture.

title: En andra fast förbindelse till Öland
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to investigate the feasibility of constructing a second permanent connection to Öland. The current Ölandsbron is over 50 years old and inadequate for modern traffic and safety requirements, which has led to increased traffic volumes that surpass original forecasts. The proposal emphasizes the importance of such infrastructure for commuting, education, food supply, and national security, suggesting that an additional connection would enhance the island's resilience in emergencies.

title: Viltsäkra vägar i Kalmar län
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament prioritizes the installation of wildlife fencing on accident-prone roads in Kalmar County to address the rising number of wildlife-related accidents. It highlights the significant increase in such accidents and emphasizes that the lack of fencing along highways like E22 contributes to the region consistently having the highest wildlife accident statistics in the country. The motion calls for the government to instruct the Transport Agency to focus on the most affected areas for fencing installation.

title: Prioritering av Kalmar län vid infrastruktursatsningar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament prioritize Kalmar County in upcoming infrastructure investments. It emphasizes the need to address long-standing structural inequalities in resource allocation that have adversely affected the region's economic growth potential. The motion argues for incorporating analyses of regional productivity-driven growth, preparedness aspects, and equitable distribution of infrastructure funds to ensure that Kalmar, a key area for food production and tourism, receives fair investment compared to other regions like Skåne and Stockholm.

title: Underlättande av strandnära bebyggelse
summary: The motion proposes a reform of the existing shoreline protection regulations in Sweden, advocating for a more balanced approach that facilitates the development of shoreline properties, particularly in less populated areas. It argues that the current protections, which limit building within 100 meters of the shoreline, hinder local growth and economic potential, and suggests that decision-making on shoreline development should be decentralized to individual municipalities to better reflect local conditions.

title: Sveriges ambassad till Jerusalem
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports the relocation of Sweden's embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, emphasizing the need for Sweden to reaffirm its neutrality in the Middle East following perceptions of a pro-Palestinian stance under previous governments.

title: Alkoholservering i Svenska hockeyligan (SHL)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of allowing the sale and consumption of strong beer in designated sections during specific sporting events in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). The motion argues that the current restrictions on alcohol sales at sporting events result in rushed consumption and overcrowding at concession stands, and emphasizes that SHL has a generally peaceful fan culture compared to other sports in Sweden. The proponents believe that allowing strong beer consumption could enhance the spectator experience while maintaining safety and order.

title: Förbifart Göteborg
summary: The proposal suggests that the Riksdag support an investigation into the construction of a bypass around Gothenburg to alleviate traffic congestion in the city. The existing traffic patterns lead to significant delays in areas such as the Tingstad Tunnel and Olskroksmotet. By routing traffic away from central Gothenburg, the bypass could improve the flow of both regular and emergency vehicles, benefit the environment, and reduce stress associated with traffic jams.

title: Kroppskameror för ökad trygghet
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament initiate an investigation into the use of body cameras in public transport, following concerns regarding safety for ticket inspectors amid increased violence and threats against them. Following a recent ruling that SL, the public transport authority, violated data protection regulations with their body camera deployment, the motion argues that a reassessment of legislation is necessary to ensure both employee safety and appropriate data handling practices.

title: Kryssningskaj vid Röda sten
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of constructing a cruise ship dock at Röda Sten in Gothenburg to enhance tourism appeal. Currently, larger cruise ships are directed to Skandiahamnen, a container port which detracts from the tourist experience. By establishing a cruise dock closer to the city, it is believed that this will attract more tourists and benefit local businesses, as visitors typically spend money during their trips.

title: Pilotprojekt i Göteborgs södra skärgård för att utveckla parkeringsarkar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:609 av Jimmy Ståhl och Dennis Dioukarev (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes a pilot project in the southern archipelago of Gothenburg to develop floating parking facilities (P-Arken) to address the parking issues faced by residents and visitors. Given the unique nature of the archipelago, with limited land for additional parking near ferry terminals, the project aims to enhance parking accessibility while also exploring the feasibility of car-sharing options to reduce individual car ownership and environmental impact. The suggestion emphasizes collaboration with local residents and academic institutions for design and planning.

title: Småbåtshamnar
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:608 av Jimmy Ståhl och Dennis Dioukarev (båda SD)
summary: The proposal by Jimmy Ståhl and Dennis Dioukarev aims to address the growing issue of abandoned boats in Sweden, with an estimated 400,000 boats, 35,000 of which are abandoned along the coast. The motion suggests that the Riksdag recognize the problem and calls for an investigation into categorizing these abandoned vessels as maritime finds or lost property to potentially return up to 70% of them to the market rather than scrapping them. This would provide support to small boat harbors that have struggled to find legal solutions to manage these boats.

title: Göteborg som experimentstad för ny teknik
summary: The suggestion proposes investigating the possibility of designating Gothenburg as an experimental city for new technologies. It highlights the city's strengths in innovation, particularly with institutions like Chalmers and Lindholmen Science Park, and advocates for creating conditions that allow for practical testing of innovations in real environments, which could enhance Sweden's reputation as a leader in innovation and technology.

title: Brukaravgifter i stället för trängselskatt
summary: The motion proposes replacing the congestion tax in Gothenburg with user fees to fund infrastructure projects. It argues that the congestion tax, which has been met with public resistance, does not effectively reduce congestion or improve accessibility. Instead, the motion suggests that user fees could be a more acceptable way to finance new infrastructure, as seen in other Swedish cities like Sundsvall and Motala. The proposal aims to align funding methods with public preferences while still addressing the city's infrastructure needs.

title: Muddring av farleden till Fiskebäckshamn
summary: The motion advocates for the Swedish government to engage with the City of Gothenburg to deepen the shipping channel to Fiskebäckshamn. This initiative is aimed at accommodating larger fishing vessels, thereby enhancing the operational capacity of Fiskebäckshamn, which is home to one of Sweden's largest fishing fleets. The proposal highlights the historical significance of Gothenburg in maritime trade and the need to adapt to evolving fishing industry requirements, as many vessels currently divert to other ports due to insufficient channel depth.

title: Avkvotering av föräldraförsäkringen
summary: The motion proposes the dequoting of parental insurance in Sweden, arguing that the current system, which reserves certain days for each parent, restricts families' autonomy. The motion emphasizes the importance of family stability and asserts that families should have the freedom to allocate parental leave days according to their individual needs rather than be constrained by state-imposed quotas.

title: Romansbedrägerier
summary: This parliamentary suggestion calls for an investigation into the legislation surrounding quick loans, mainly due to the rise of romance frauds in Sweden, where victims, often women, are deceived by foreign men in organized crime rings through online dating. The proposal highlights the lack of adequate legal frameworks to combat these frauds and the harmful impact on victims who often take out quick loans to appease their fraudsters, leading to severe financial and emotional distress. It also advocates for better collaboration among police, banks, and other authorities to tackle the issue through increased transparency and effective monitoring of suspicious transactions.

title: Bristen på deltidsbrandmän
summary: The motion addresses the shortage of part-time firefighters in Sweden, highlighting the critical role they play in maintaining public safety, especially in rural areas. It calls for the government to improve working conditions and recruitment efforts for part-time firefighters, suggesting measures such as tax relief and establishing the right to leave for those serving in this capacity. The motion emphasizes the need for improved preparedness in response to recent geopolitical tensions.

title: Brandsäkerhet i bostäder
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:601 av Alexander Christiansson och Ann-Christine Frohm (båda SD)
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament should establish a requirement for all residential homes to have at least one functioning smoke detector, a fire extinguisher, and a ground fault circuit interrupter. The motion emphasizes the historical lack of fire safety inspections and notes the high number of fire-related fatalities in homes, urging the government to investigate the implementation of similar regulations as those in neighboring Norway and Denmark, which have shown positive results in improving fire safety.

title: Stöd till förföljda kristna
summary: The proposal calls for the Swedish parliament to support persecuted Christians worldwide, highlighting that approximately 340 million Christians face oppression and persecution due to their faith. The motion references reports from the organization Open Doors, which tracks persecution in various countries, particularly in the Middle East and Africa. The motion urges Sweden to take a more active role in advocating for the rights and safety of these individuals, reflecting a commitment to human rights and religious freedoms.

title: Behovsprövning av barnbidraget
summary: The proposal suggests investigating a model for means testing the child allowance in Sweden. The current system provides a uniform allowance regardless of family income, which the motion argues is outdated and inefficient given the varying economic situations of families. By means testing the allowance, the goal is to allocate resources more effectively and ensure that financial support is directed to families who genuinely need it, thereby creating a fairer distribution of economic resources.

title: Utveckling av rot för miljöns skull
summary: This motion proposes the development of the ROT deduction system to encourage the preservation and maintenance of buildings from a sustainability perspective. It highlights the need to clarify the rules surrounding eligibility for ROT deductions, particularly concerning work done on items like windows, to promote the reuse of materials and prevent environmental degradation. The aim is to ensure that individuals can maintain their properties without the financial burden of unclear deduction criteria, thus preserving valuable natural resources.

title: Förbättring av förhållandena för det kustnära fisket
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:597 av Catarina Deremar och Anne-Li Sjölund (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes measures to preserve the coastal fishing industry in Sweden, emphasizing the need to address competition between humans and animal species for fish resources. It highlights the decline in livelihood for small-scale fishermen in Norduppland due to increasing populations of seals and birds that consume fish. The proposal advocates for a reduction in these animal populations through regulated hunting to ensure sustainable fishing practices and maintain job opportunities in rural areas, as well as addressing the negative impacts of trawling in the Baltic Sea.

title: Anpassning av klassindelning efter barnens kognitiva förmågor
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish government should adapt class divisions in schools according to children's cognitive abilities, instead of following a one-size-fits-all approach. It asserts that children have varying capacities for learning and that those who struggle or excel should be taught alongside peers at similar levels. By assessing cognitive skills early in primary education, this measure aims to customize the pace of teaching, thereby allowing all students to reach their full potential. The motion advocates for the inclusion of specially gifted classes in larger municipalities and calls for this approach to be considered in future evaluations of the Swedish school system.

title: Krav på brandsläckare i vägfordon
summary: This motion proposes the introduction of a requirement for fire extinguishers in all road vehicles in Sweden. It highlights the dangers posed by vehicle fires, citing statistics from 2022 where thousands of cars and trucks caught fire. The proposal argues that having fire extinguishers readily available could save lives and prevent property damage, particularly in the context of increasing electric vehicle usage, which may present unique fire challenges.

title: Söndagsöppet på Systembolaget
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish parliament supports extending the opening hours of Systembolaget, allowing the store to remain open until 21:00 on Fridays and Saturdays, as well as on Sundays. The motivation for this change is to address the current limitations on opening hours which may hinder local tourism and the possibility of farm sales.

title: Fleråriga ingenjörsutbildningar inom kärnkraft
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for the Swedish government to prioritize long-term engineering programs focused on nuclear power through strategic investments in higher education, as the country aims to enhance its expertise in the nuclear industry.

title: Jämtland som riksintresse för vindkraftsfrihet
summary: The motion proposes that Jämtland be designated as a national interest area free from wind power, emphasizing the region's natural beauty and tranquility, and expressing concern that wind power installations would disrupt the local environment.

title: Värna den jämtländska fjällturismen
summary: The motion proposes measures to support tourism in the Jämtland region by ensuring long-term care and maintenance of hiking trails on state land, updating practices regarding the balance between reindeer herding and other interests in the mountain area, and conducting an independent study on the impact of various activities on reindeer and the capacity for reindeer populations in different areas. The aim is to enhance tourism and safeguard the economy and jobs in Jämtland, which is currently threatened by reductions in tourism-related activities.

title: Större samhällsnytta vid infrastrukturinvesteringar
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of an independent expert committee within government departments to improve the decision-making process for infrastructure investments in Sweden. It suggests that the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket) receive new mandates for economic calculations and reporting, and that deviations from the prioritization of projects should be justified. The proposal aims to address significant criticisms regarding misallocation of public funds and the inadequacy of current economic assessments in making informed investment choices.

title: Höstlov på olika veckor
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should encourage municipalities to schedule autumn breaks in different weeks across various regions of the country. This change aims to reduce travel costs for families, as the current uniform week for autumn break leads to higher prices due to increased demand. The motion also suggests that staggered breaks could benefit the tourism industry in Sweden.

title: Lagstiftning för distansarbete
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigates how legislation needs to be updated to accommodate more remote work, in collaboration with labor market stakeholders. It highlights the lessons learned from the COVID-19 pandemic, which has led to a significant increase in remote work and changes in work-life balance. The motion outlines both the benefits and challenges of remote work, emphasizing the need to clarify responsibilities regarding work environments and to adapt regulations on employee rights and employer obligations regarding home working.

title: Samma förutsättningar för friluftslivet som för idrottslivet att främja folkhälsan
summary: The proposal aims to equalize the conditions for organized outdoor activities and organized sports in Sweden, asserting that both contribute to societal health and well-being. It highlights current disparities in social security contributions for organizations promoting these activities, advocating for a change in the social security law to ensure that outdoor organizations are treated the same as sports organizations, particularly regarding taxation rules. This is deemed necessary to provide fair treatment and to support the growing need for mental health solutions through physical activities in nature.

title: med anledning av skr. 2023/24:163 Nationell säkerhetsstrategi
summary: The motion emphasizes the importance of a robust military and civilian defense, a strong Swedish defense industry, continued investment in healthcare, infrastructure, and energy production, and the need to combat disinformation and hybrid threats. It highlights the changed security landscape since the last strategy was presented, particularly due to the threats posed by Russia and the importance of strengthening civil society for national resilience.

title: Reformerat lantmäteri
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:585 av Mikael Larsson och Catarina Deremar (båda C)
summary: The proposal by Mikael Larsson and Catarina Deremar advocates for reforms in the land surveying sector by allowing private contractors to perform specific land surveying tasks and promoting the establishment of more municipal land surveying authorities in Sweden. The authors emphasize the increasing demand for land surveying services, particularly in rural areas, and highlight the long processing times and high costs associated with the current state authority. They argue that enhancing the accessibility of land surveying services will support local businesses and improve efficiency in handling land-related matters.

title: Sparbankers kapitalförsörjning och mindre bankers regelverk
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:584 av Mikael Larsson och Catarina Deremar (båda C)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of the Swedish savings bank law, allowing savings banks to attract external capital and advocating for revising banking regulations to ensure proportionality and reasonableness. It emphasizes the critical role that local savings banks play in rural and small-town areas, providing tailored financial services to households and small businesses. The motion also highlights the successful model of Norwegian savings banks, which are allowed to issue equity certificates, promoting local investment and ensuring strong community ties.

title: Åtgärder för bättre järnvägsinfrastruktur i Uppsala län
summary: Catarina Deremar proposes measures to improve railway infrastructure in Uppsala County, emphasizing its importance for regional development and connectivity. The motion suggests ensuring adequate funding for infrastructure maintenance and specific railway investments, such as adapting stations for better accessibility and increasing capacity on key lines to enhance economic growth and public transport within the Stockholm-Mälardal region.

title: E-sport och spelande i Sverige
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognizes esports as a legitimate sport and a cultural form, advocating for its inclusion in sport governance and cultural policy. It calls for increased research on esports, the development of a national gaming strategy, and efforts to promote equality and fight racism within the esports community. Additionally, it seeks to clarify regulations regarding prize money in skill-based games and to enhance validation of skills gained through gaming for employment purposes.

title: Fritidsbåtar
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a registry for recreational boats, the introduction of producer responsibility for such boats, and the incorporation of recreational boats into the lost property law. The aim is to address the environmental hazards posed by abandoned and old boats, facilitate the recovery of stolen boats, and enhance recycling efforts for boats that have reached the end of their lifespan.

title: Möjlighet för mindre barn att åka kollektivt
summary: The proposal suggests improving public transport accessibility for young children, particularly in rural areas, by mandating that collective transport systems accommodate backward-facing seats for safety and comfort. This move aims to facilitate family travel without the necessity of a car, thus promoting freedom and reducing emissions, while acknowledging the limits of how many children and wheelchairs can be accommodated.

title: Att kunna lita på myndigheters besked
summary: The motion proposes that decisions made by government agencies regarding legal matters should be binding, ensuring that citizens can trust the information provided by these authorities. It highlights concerns over the current practice where tax rulings from the Tax Agency can be reinterpreted retroactively, leading to potential financial penalties for citizens. The motion argues for the necessity of binding agency decisions to uphold legal certainty and protect individual rights.

title: Rättvisa böter och inflationsjusterade regelverk för företag
summary: The suggestion proposes to adjust fixed penalty amounts in Swedish legislation to account for inflation and to convert certain fixed monetary penalties for traffic offenses into daily fines. The intent is to ensure that penalties remain equitable regardless of income level, as inflation diminishes the real value of fixed fines over time, resulting in more severe punishments for lower-income individuals. The proposal also calls for the automatic inflation adjustment of business regulations to prevent an increased regulatory burden on companies due to inflation.

title: med anledning av skr. 2023/24:153 Riksrevisionens rapport om Allmänna arvsfonden
summary: This motion proposes that the Swedish government assigns an appropriate authority to investigate how the General Inheritance Fund can enhance its funding distribution to provide more sustainable support to civil society organizations. The motion addresses criticisms from the National Audit Office regarding the fund's inability to balance its income and expenditures, as well as the need for more effective and long-term support mechanisms for various target groups, including children, youth, persons with disabilities, and the elderly.

title: med anledning av skr. 2023/24:163 Nationell säkerhetsstrategi
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:576 av Kerstin Lundgren och Anna Lasses (båda C)
summary: The proposal advocates for a comprehensive national security strategy that includes annual performance reviews and deeper engagement with stakeholders, aiming for a unified Nordic security approach. It emphasizes the need for value-based realism to strengthen democratic forces in response to authoritarian threats and highlights the importance of addressing climate change and food security as part of Sweden's national resilience. The motion calls for a strategic focus on both external security issues and internal needs, ensuring that all regions in the country are included in building a more robust and equitable society.

title: med anledning av prop. 2023/24:164 Stärkta skolbibliotek
summary: The motion addresses the need for clearer guidelines regarding which schools should be required to offer flexible library services and the sanctions for those that do not comply with the proposed amendments to the education and library laws. It highlights existing disparities in access to school libraries, particularly for students from socioeconomically disadvantaged backgrounds, and calls for an assessment of the economic implications of the proposed laws on school operations and funding.

title: Flytt av fordon
summary: The motion proposes to ease the process of removing vehicles that have been parked without permission on private property. It highlights the current difficulties faced by property owners in getting vehicles removed, especially when these improperly parked vehicles obstruct access to their properties. The suggestion calls for legislative changes that would allow property owners to have more control over which vehicles can be stationed on their land and to seek prompt assistance from relevant authorities for their removal. Furthermore, it recommends imposing fines for unauthorized parking on private property.

title: Rättshjälp vid tvist gentemot det allmänna
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:573 av Per Söderlund och Eric Palmqvist (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament investigate the possibility of providing legal aid to individuals disputing decisions made by public authorities. It argues that current processes can be costly and create inequalities among citizens, as those with fewer economic resources may be unable to pursue legal action against the state. The motion proposes a framework wherein the government would reimburse legal costs for individuals who succeed in such disputes, in order to ensure fairness and equal treatment under the law.

title: Vargfrågor
summary: The motion proposed by Per Söderlund of the Sweden Democrats aims to address the issue of wildlife-related damage caused by wolves, particularly in certain regions of Sweden where their population is dense. It suggests measures against 'animal rights terrorism' and proposes that the government should improve compensation for farmers affected by wolf attacks, including both direct and indirect damages. Furthermore, it advocates for culling certain wolf territories to restore balance and mitigate farmer distress. The motion highlights the fear among farmers of reporting wolf attacks due to potential reprisals from animal rights activists and calls for better policing and tougher laws to handle these threats.

title: Folkmordet 1915
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament recognize the genocide committed against Assyrians/Syrians/Chaldeans, Pontic Greeks, and Armenians in the Ottoman Empire during the years 1914-1925, known as Seyfo. It emphasizes the historical atrocities and their lasting consequences for these groups, arguing that Sweden should align itself with other nations that have officially acknowledged the genocide.

title: Förbud mot tillverkning och försäljning av röktobak i Sverige
summary: The motion proposes a ban on the manufacturing and sale of smoked tobacco in Sweden, citing health risks associated with smoking, including increased prevalence of diseases such as cancer and diabetes. The proposal highlights the societal costs related to smoking, which amount to approximately 30 billion SEK annually, and aims to improve public health by significantly reducing smoking rates. The motion emphasizes the responsibility of politicians to protect public health and suggests further investigation into implementing a comprehensive ban on smoked tobacco.

title: Bevarande av fornminnen för framtida generationer
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:569 av David Perez och Mattias Eriksson Falk (båda SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Riksdag recognize the need for reforms to preserve ancient monuments and archaeological finds for future generations. It highlights the discrepancy in the preservation of archaeological items during excavations, citing concerns from archaeologists and the National Heritage Board regarding the insufficient capacity to conserve various types of finds, particularly metal objects. The motion argues against the ongoing trend of discarding significant cultural artifacts and suggests exploring alternative preservation strategies to protect Sweden's cultural heritage.

title: Värnande av privatpersoners integritet
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament should support an investigation into how to protect the privacy of individuals, in light of increasing criminal activities that exploit easily accessible personal information from the internet. It emphasizes the need to strike a balance between maintaining public transparency and safeguarding citizens’ private data, particularly against the backdrop of rapid digitalization that has made personal information more available.

title: Amorteringsavdrag
summary: The motion proposes to investigate the possibility of introducing a tax deduction for mortgage repayments in Sweden to address the high levels of household debt exacerbated by rising interest rates and housing shortages in urban areas. The aim is to foster a culture of repayment rather than reliance on asset appreciation, which could mitigate financial risks for households and reduce dependency on interest deductions.

title: Momsbefrielse för återvunnet byggnadsmateriel
summary: The suggestion proposes an investigation into the possibility of exempting recycled building materials from value-added tax (VAT) in Sweden. The aim is to promote the reuse of construction materials, reduce environmental impact, and ultimately alleviate the housing shortage by making building processes more cost-effective. The motion highlights the current challenges in the construction industry, such as rising real interest rates and inflation, and emphasizes the need for economic incentives to encourage recycling and reuse of materials.

title: Jobbskatteavdrag för föräldrar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of implementing a tax deduction for parents with minor children, citing concerns over declining birth rates and the financial burdens associated with parenthood. The motion highlights increasing costs of living and aims to encourage families to have more children to ensure the sustainability of the welfare system.

title: Maxtak för personbilar
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the introduction of a maximum cap on the ownership of personal cars for private individuals. The motivation highlights the importance of cars for mobility in Sweden while addressing issues related to car ownership misuse, particularly in socio-economic excluded areas. It suggests that implementing such a cap, with exceptions for hobbyists, could mitigate abuse and improve ownership accountability.

title: Enhetlig moms
summary: David Perez from the Sweden Democrats (SD) proposes an investigation into the possibility of implementing a uniform VAT system, arguing that the current differentiated VAT rates create administrative burdens for entrepreneurs and hinder innovation. The motion emphasizes the need to simplify regulations to enhance conditions for entrepreneurship, while also acknowledging that there may be arguments for maintaining varied VAT rates to support essential goods for vulnerable groups.

title: Införande av ett nationellt disability card i Sverige
summary: The suggestion proposes the introduction of a national disability card in Sweden, which would serve as an official document to demonstrate the need for assistance for individuals with disabilities. This card aims to streamline access to accommodations at various activities and events, addressing the current lack of such a system in Sweden. The proposal highlights that the absence of a standard card leads to unnecessary complications for both individuals needing assistance and event organizers. The motion also suggests exploring options for a Swedish card or potentially joining the European Disability Card initiative.

title: Införande av psykisk misshandel som brott
summary: The proposal suggests the introduction of a new criminal offense, psychological abuse, to the Swedish Penal Code, based on the findings of the inquiry 'Criminal Responsibility for Psychological Violence.' It aims to define and penalize actions that systematically undermine a victim's self-esteem through manipulative and degrading behavior. The motion emphasizes that psychological abuse can occur independently or alongside physical violence and that such sustained psychological harm has long-lasting effects on victims, sometimes worse than those from physical violence. The proposal calls for immediate legislative action to protect victims and hold perpetrators accountable.

title: Schemalagda skolmåltider
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider implementing scheduled educational school meals, emphasizing the importance of nutrition for children's well-being and academic performance. It argues that many children lack good eating habits at home, leading to negative long-term effects, and suggests that scheduled lunchtime with a focus on food education could improve both mental health and learning outcomes.

title: Motverkande av ungas tobaksrökning
summary: The motion proposes to gradually raise the legal age for purchasing cigarettes and make it illegal to buy, sell, or give cigarettes to individuals under this age. The rationale is based on the harmful health effects of smoking, its environmental impact, and the aim to prevent future generations from taking up smoking. The proposal also suggests that existing smokers should receive support to quit alongside these new regulations, with the overall goal of creating a 'non-smoking generation.'

title: Järnvägsförbindelse mellan Helsingborg och Linköping via Jönköping
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:558 av Mikael Eskilandersson och Angelica Lundberg (båda SD)
summary: The proposal advocates for the planning of a new railway connection between Helsingborg and Linköping via Jönköping. It emphasizes the need for improved transport infrastructure to enhance competitiveness in the global economy, facilitate efficient goods and passenger transport, and connect several towns currently lacking railway access. The motion argues that such developments would support better commuting options and contribute to workforce supply for businesses in the region.

title: Järnvägsförbindelse mellan Jönköping och Göteborg
summary: The motion proposes the planning of a new railway connection between Jönköping and Göteborg to enhance transportation for both goods and passengers. It argues that the lack of a direct connection along the existing highway causes inefficiencies and extended travel times, undermining economic competitiveness. By establishing this railway, commuting and travel between these cities would be improved, thereby supporting industry and population mobility in the region.

title: Stänkskydd på personbilar
summary: The motion proposes the investigation of the reintroduction of mud flaps on passenger cars to improve traffic safety and reduce environmental impact. The absence of these flaps has led to an increase in stone chips on vehicles, costing car owners approximately 2.2 billion kronor annually. The motion argues that modern mud flaps mitigate the risks associated with flying debris and that Sweden's unique climate conditions necessitate tailored regulations, diverging from EU harmonization efforts.

title: Nya bestämmelser gällande däck
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into the possibility of implementing a summer ban on the use of studless friction tires and the establishment of an age limit for tires to enhance traffic safety. The argument highlights the risks associated with using friction tires during summer months, such as longer braking distances and increased potential for accidents. It also cites the lack of regulations concerning the age of tires, suggesting that older tires, even with adequate tread, could compromise vehicle safety.

title: Industri- och landsbygdspolitik
summary: The proposal by Birger Lahti and others from the Left Party advocates for a comprehensive policy aimed at revitalizing rural areas in Sweden. It addresses the need for government intervention to ensure equal access to essential services and infrastructure on the countryside, including transportation, broadband connectivity, public service points, and support for local businesses. Specific proposals include increasing mobile coverage, granting Postnord the duty to provide quality postal services across all regions, and promoting sustainable practices in sectors like agriculture and tourism to strengthen rural economies. Furthermore, it emphasizes the importance of education and job opportunities in these areas, suggesting debt relief for graduates who work in professions vital to rural communities.

title: En hållbar småföretagarpolitik
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:553 av Lorena Delgado Varas m.fl. (V)
summary: The motion proposes a comprehensive review of policies to support small business owners in Sweden, particularly solo entrepreneurs. It advocates for equal social security protections similar to those of employees, facilitation for parental leave, potential abolition of sickness pay for small firms, and initiatives to strengthen cultural and cooperative enterprises. The motion also emphasizes improving access to education, information, and funding for entrepreneurs, promoting more sustainable practices, and enhancing the framework for Sami businesses.

title: med anledning av skr. 2023/24:165 Riksrevisionens rapport om kortutbildade arbetssökandes övergång till reguljär utbildning
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for improved precision in directing short-educated job seekers to regular education and advocates for better information regarding financial support available during their studies. It suggests adjusting the unemployment requirements for study start support to help more unemployed individuals begin their studies, thereby enhancing their employability and reducing unemployment rates.

title: Standarder för hållbar hantering av sjukvårdstextilier inom vården
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament instruct the government to revise the Work Environment Authority's regulations to allow for lower washing temperatures in healthcare settings, combined with chemical or thermal disinfection methods. It emphasizes the need for updated standards based on the latest research and practices used in other European countries, aiming to enhance sustainability and cost-efficiency in the management of healthcare textiles without compromising microbiological safety.

title: Stärkt immaterialrätt bland små och medelstora företag
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government undertake a comprehensive review and mapping of the needs related to intellectual property rights among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). It emphasizes the importance of increasing knowledge and understanding of intellectual property among these businesses, as many utilize such protections less frequently than their counterparts in other EU countries. The motion highlights that intellectual property rights are essential for innovation, productivity, and investment in research and development, urging that enhanced support is necessary for SMEs to fully leverage their intellectual assets.

title: Tillgänglig idrott
summary: This motion proposes investments to enhance accessibility in sports across Sweden, aiming to promote a healthier and more cohesive society. It emphasizes the critical role of sports in fostering physical activity, social well-being, and academic success, while also mitigating risks of youth involvement in crime. The proposal includes various recommendations, such as encouraging municipalities to adopt sports policies, creating activity plans, establishing equipment lending libraries, integrating sports facilities in urban planning, and supporting volunteers in maintaining sports initiatives.

title: Ideella föreningar
summary: The proposal suggests that the Swedish Parliament support a motion to prevent Trafikverket from charging fees to non-profit organizations for costs related to signage and other activities on public roads. The justification highlights that Trafikverket's recent fee interpretations have imposed significant financial burdens on non-profit associations, jeopardizing cultural traditions, public health initiatives, and the viability of various events, such as midsummer celebrations and sporting competitions. The motion calls for a long-term solution to protect the interests of Sweden's civil society organizations.

title: Trygg och jämlik vård i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:547 av Anna-Caren Sätherberg och Kalle Olsson (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for ensuring safe and equitable healthcare throughout Sweden, addressing the significant national healthcare crisis exacerbated by inflation, rising pension costs, and an economic downturn. The motion highlights the urgent need for increased funding to support regional healthcare resources, particularly in areas like Region Jämtland Härjedalen, which face severe financial challenges, projected deficits, and increased patient wait times. It emphasizes prioritizing healthcare funding over tax cuts to guarantee that all regions can deliver necessary medical services to their residents.

title: Återgång till en politik för statlig närvaro i hela landet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:546 av Kalle Olsson och Anna-Caren Sätherberg (båda S)
summary: The motion advocates for a renewed commitment to increasing the presence of the state throughout Sweden, particularly in light of a recent significant job loss in Sveg due to the closure of the area's largest private employer. This situation underscores the need for state interventions to mitigate the impact of such closures and to address the long-term trend of centralizing public jobs in larger cities. The authors, Kalle Olsson and Anna-Caren Sätherberg, argue that the current government has not done enough to bolster state presence and support the labor market in vulnerable regions.

title: Åtgärder för ett mer jämställt uttag av föräldraförsäkring
summary: This motion proposes to consider measures aimed at achieving a more gender-equal distribution of parental leave in Sweden, highlighting the current imbalance where women utilize a disproportionate amount of parental benefits. The motion emphasizes the negative effects of this inequality on women's earnings, job standing, and pensions. It suggests potential solutions, such as increasing the number of reserved 'daddy days' for fathers, to promote a shared responsibility for childcare and strengthen early bonds between fathers and their children.

title: Krisberedskap som en del av den svenska läroplanen
summary: The motion proposes that crisis preparedness be integrated into the Swedish curriculum, emphasizing its importance for national resilience and security. As Sweden undergoes significant development of its total defense framework, the authors argue that equipping future generations with knowledge and skills related to crisis management is essential in light of contemporary security threats. The motion calls for formal recognition of crisis preparedness in curricula for primary education, aiming to enhance public awareness and community engagement in total defense efforts.

title: Våld mot djur
summary: The proposal emphasizes the need for enhanced knowledge initiatives by the Socialstyrelsen regarding the correlation between children and youth who commit acts of violence against animals and a heightened risk of developing violent behavior later in life. The motion highlights research indicating a link between animal cruelty and increased tendencies for violence towards humans, particularly affecting women. It advocates for social services to address this issue to prevent further violence in both human and animal contexts.

title: Avgiftsfri skolfrukost
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:542 av Yasmine Bladelius och Sanne Lennström (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish parliament considers the possibility of implementing free school breakfasts in response to the issue of children going hungry. The authors highlight concerns about children's ability to concentrate in school due to insufficient nutrition, especially before and after weekends. They argue that many families are struggling financially due to the economic crisis and rising food prices, suggesting that providing free breakfasts would support children's educational success.

title: Avgiftsfritt TBE-vaccin för barn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider implementing free TBE vaccinations for children aged 3 to 18 years. The aim is to increase access to vaccinations given the rising incidence of tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) in Sweden, which has more than doubled since the early 2000s. Currently, the cost of vaccination is a barrier for many families, potentially putting children at risk, especially in high-risk areas. The motion argues that public funding for these vaccinations would promote public health and enable more people to engage in outdoor activities safely.

title: Cykelhjälmstvång
summary: The motion proposes a re-evaluation of the law concerning the mandatory use of bicycle helmets for all cyclists in Sweden. It highlights the increasing number of bicycle accidents, which result in head injuries similar in severity to those from car accidents. The motion argues that many injuries could be prevented if the use of helmets were mandatory for all ages, similar to existing traffic safety regulations like seatbelt usage. It emphasizes the need for greater awareness and legislative action to enhance cyclist safety.

title: Bakåtvänt bilåkande för små barn
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament investigate the possibility of legislating the requirement for children aged 0 to 4 years to travel in rear-facing car seats, highlighting the importance of safety for young children during car journeys. It emphasizes the dangers of forward-facing seats and presents research indicating that rear-facing seats significantly reduce the risk of injury in the event of an accident. The motion advocates for a legal mandate to ensure that children are secured safely while traveling in vehicles.

title: Fler än två vårdnadshavare
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:538 av Yasmine Bladelius och Anna Wallentheim (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should present suggestions on how to allow children to have more than two legal guardians. It highlights the limitations of current legislation in accommodating diverse family structures, which can hinder the ability of children to receive essential care and support from non-biological guardians who play significant parental roles. The motion calls for a review of the law to better reflect contemporary family dynamics and prioritize the best interests of the child.

title: Social bostadspolitik
summary: The motion highlights the increasing inequalities in the housing market in Sweden, emphasizing the need for a social housing policy that addresses disparities between different demographics and economic statuses. It argues that simply building more homes is inadequate to resolve the underlying issues and calls for a comprehensive review of housing policies to facilitate structural changes aimed at assisting the most vulnerable and economically disadvantaged populations.

title: En helt avgiftsfri skola
summary: The proposal suggests clarifying the education law in Sweden to ensure that all schooling is entirely free of charges, including the prohibition of any minor fees that may currently be levied on students and their guardians. The motion argues that even small fees can create significant financial stress for families and hinder equal access to education. It aims to reinforce the principle of equality in education, stating that no student should have to miss out on school activities due to financial constraints.

title: Skydd för gemensam egendom
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:535 av Niklas Karlsson och Joakim Sandell (båda S)
summary: The proposal advocates for enhanced protection of communal property to prevent its easy sale by a slim political majority, arguing that such actions undermine the solidarity and equality within society. The signatories cite past instances of privatization that have benefitted wealthy individuals and entities, often at the expense of public services and assets built over decades. The suggestion calls for the establishment of democratic mechanisms to safeguard communal assets from hasty privatization and to ensure that any potential sales are subject to greater scrutiny and public discourse.

title: Kommunal förköpsrätt
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:534 av Ingela Nylund Watz och Joakim Sandell (båda S)
summary: The motion proposes the reintroduction of municipal pre-emption rights, allowing local governments the authority to intervene in planned property sales. This is aimed at promoting sustainable community development and combating organized crime linked to real estate transactions. The proposal emphasizes the need for legislative measures to address the challenges that have arisen since the previous law was abolished in 2010, as municipal tools are currently insufficient for effective planning and management of strategic land.

title: Underlätta för polisen att omhänderta bilar med för höga ljudnivåer
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support measures to empower the police to seize vehicles that exceed permitted noise levels. It highlights the increasing problem of noise pollution from both older and modified modern vehicles, which negatively impacts the quality of life for residents, particularly in urban areas. The proposal suggests that the current penalties are inadequate and calls for clearer regulations to allow police to efficiently remove offending vehicles on-site for technical inspections, with owners liable for costs related to non-compliance. This change aims to deter the operation of noisy vehicles and enhance public health and safety.

title: Ny bro eller tunnel över/under Saltsjö-Mälarsnittet i Södertälje
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:532 av Ingela Nylund Watz m.fl. (S)
summary: The motion proposes the construction of a new bridge or tunnel over or under the Saltsjö-Mälarsnittet in Södertälje to enhance traffic capacity, safety, and resilience in the face of vulnerabilities in the existing infrastructure. Highlighting the critical nature of this transport route for the Stockholm region, the motion stresses the need for redundancy in case of disruptions and aligns with EU infrastructure planning goals, thereby advocating for immediate action to develop this vital transportation link.

title: Sänkt energiskatt
summary: Cecilia Engström from the Christian Democrats proposes that the Swedish government investigate a reduction in the energy tax, which has increased significantly since the deregulation of the electricity market in 1996. The current tax rate, combined with VAT, burdens households, particularly those with financial difficulties. The proposal argues for a fairer tax system that encourages the use of renewable energy sources and supports vulnerable households by alleviating the impact of rising electricity prices. The intention is to promote both environmental sustainability and the economic welfare of families.

title: Rätten till grönt avdrag i samband med import av klimatskadliga solcellspaneler
summary: The motion proposes an investigation into whether the right to a green tax deduction for the purchase of solar panels should remain applicable for installations involving environmentally harmful solar panels. The Kristdemokraterna party emphasizes that Chinese solar panel production has significantly higher emissions than European production, raising concerns about the climate impact of installing such panels in Sweden. They advocate for a comprehensive lifecycle analysis to inform decisions regarding solar energy investments.

title: Inrättande av en ambassadör för religionsfrihet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:529 av Yusuf Aydin och Magnus Berntsson (båda KD)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden establish an ambassador for religious freedom to enhance its focus on protecting religious minorities globally, especially Christians facing persecution. This ambassador would oversee Sweden's foreign policy regarding religious liberties, engage in negotiations within the EU and UN, advocate for resolutions to protect these groups, and push for sanctions against states that violate religious freedoms. The goal is to elevate the issue of religious freedom in Swedish foreign policy and help those oppressed for their beliefs.

title: Konfliktmineraler och deras offer
summary: The motion proposes actions to address the issues of conflict minerals and the suffering of women in conflict zones. It emphasizes the urgent need for measures against gender-based violence, particularly in the context of war, and highlights the importance of including women in peace negotiations to achieve sustainable solutions. The motion also advocates for classifying cobalt as a conflict mineral and calls for increased involvement of civil society in combating the trade of such minerals and supporting affected individuals.

title: Erkännande av Somaliland som en självständig stat
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:527 av Ingemar Kihlström och Magnus Oscarsson (båda KD)
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should formally recognize Somaliland as an independent state, citing its democratic progress and stability in a region plagued by dictatorship and violence. The authors highlight Somaliland's adherence to democratic principles, its capacity for self-governance, and its ability to establish diplomatic relations, arguing that the recognition would support democracy and peace in contrast to relationships with more authoritarian states.

title: Förföljelse av kristna minoriteter
summary: The motion urges the Swedish Parliament to take more active measures through the UN and in international contacts to combat the persecution of Christian minorities globally. It highlights the increasing numbers of Christians facing severe persecution in various countries and calls for Sweden to promote religious freedom and support resolutions that demand protection for persecuted Christians, along with considering sanctions against countries that deny freedom of religion.

title: Flytt av Sveriges ambassad i Israel till Jerusalem
summary: The proposal urges the Swedish Parliament to support the relocation of Sweden's embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, asserting that this move would strengthen Sweden's relations with Israel and underline support for the only functioning democracy in the Middle East. It emphasizes the historical ties Sweden has had with Israel and argues that establishing the embassy in Jerusalem aligns with Israel's designation of the city as its capital. The motion also highlights Sweden's current diplomatic positioning and suggests that this change would foster better engagement in the regional dialogue between Israel and the Palestinian Authority.

title: Stöd för demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter på Kuba
summary: The suggestion advocates for the Swedish government to push within the EU for a reassessment of the political dialogue and cooperation agreement with Cuba, emphasizing the need for the Cuban regime to take concrete actions to improve human rights. The proposal highlights the ongoing oppression by the Cuban government, including violence against peaceful protesters, and calls for the EU to apply political and economic pressure to foster democratic freedoms in Cuba, rather than unintentionally supporting the regime through trade and aid without reform requirements.

title: Internationellt samarbete för Afghanistans kvinnor
summary: The proposal advocates for Sweden to collaborate with international partners to condemn the Taliban's restrictions on women's and girls' rights in Afghanistan. It emphasizes the need for Sweden to maintain humanitarian support, specifically targeting women and girls, through international organizations and civil society. Furthermore, the motion calls for a policy to ensure that no direct funding or aid is given to the Taliban regime, reflecting a commitment to protect the most vulnerable populations in Afghanistan amidst a worsening humanitarian crisis.

title: Stöd för ett fritt och demokratiskt Belarus
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament supports Svetlana Tichanovskaja as the legitimate representative of the Belarusian people and calls on the government to continue diplomatic and economic support for the Belarusian democratic opposition. It highlights the severe political repression in Belarus under the Lukashenko regime and emphasizes the need for Sweden to protect Belarusian opposition figures in exile and increase international pressure against the regime while supporting human rights in Belarus.

title: Stöd för demokrati och rättvisa i Venezuela efter valet 2024
summary: The motion advocates for Sweden's strong support for the restoration of democracy and justice in Venezuela following the controversial 2024 elections, where President Nicolás Maduro's regime was accused of manipulating the electoral process. It emphasizes the importance of international sanctions against Maduro's government, continued humanitarian aid for the Venezuelan population, and political and financial backing for opposition groups fighting for democratic reforms. The motion calls for a unified international response to uphold democratic values and assist the fight against authoritarianism in Venezuela.

title: Stöd till iranska oppositionen och skärpta sanktioner mot regimen
summary: The motion proposes that Sweden should take a stronger stance in supporting the Iranian democratic opposition by advocating for enhanced human rights and women's rights in Iran, as well as intensifying international sanctions against the Iranian regime. It emphasizes the systematic oppression faced by the Iranian people, particularly political dissenters and women, urging Sweden to collaborate with democratic nations and organizations to increase pressure on the regime and provide concrete support to human rights activists.

title: Ökad kunskap bland allmänheten om fertilitet
motion_id: Motion 2024/25:519 av Nima Gholam Ali Pour (SD)
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should consider investigating a strategy to increase public knowledge about fertility, emphasizing its importance for informed family planning and reproductive health. The suggestion outlines various factors affecting fertility in both men and women, such as age, lifestyle, and environmental influences, and highlights the current lack of awareness among the public, which has contributed to declining birth rates in Sweden. It argues for the need for educational initiatives comparable to those on contraception to address issues of involuntary childlessness and demographic challenges.

title: Nolltolerans för asocialt dominansbeteende
summary: The motion proposes the establishment of a zero-tolerance policy towards antisocial dominant behavior, urging an investigation into a model that would allow for immediate detention of individuals engaging in such behavior, particularly those who disturb public order or confront law enforcement.

title: Krigsmateriel och miljöregler
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should quickly investigate and implement a temporary law allowing for extended testing of military equipment in response to the ongoing war in Ukraine. The rationale is that current environmental regulations hinder ammunition manufacturers from conducting necessary tests, which could delay weapon deliveries to Ukraine, potentially impacting the war's outcome. The motion argues that environmental considerations should not override national defense needs during this critical period.

title: Målsättning att göra EU till renodlad frihandelsunion
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government should aim to reshape the European Union to function solely as a free trade union, allowing member states to participate without being subjected to wider EU regulations across various policy areas. The motion criticizes the current EU structure for its democratic deficits, increasing bureaucracy, and perceived erosion of individual freedoms, particularly referencing the impact of the Digital Services Act on free speech.

title: Reglering av utvisning för brott i en förordning
summary: The proposal suggests that the process for expelling foreign nationals convicted of serious crimes should be regulated by ordinance instead of being determined by courts, which is perceived as arbitrary. The motion argues for establishing mandatory expulsion in relation to certain crime categories and penalties to reduce judicial discretion, thereby making the criteria more democratic.

title: Upprustning av Västra stambanan
summary: The suggestion proposes that the Swedish Parliament prioritize the upgrading and expansion of the Västra stambanan as part of the upcoming infrastructure plan. The motion argues that this improvement will significantly reduce travel time between Stockholm and Gothenburg at a fraction of the cost of previous high-speed rail plans, which were seen as impractical and overly costly. It emphasizes the necessity of adding more tracks to alleviate congestion, particularly between Alingsås and Gothenburg.

title: Micro Modular Reactors till Skaraborg
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government consider Skaraborg as a site for the construction of Micro Modular Reactors (MMRs) as part of its planning for new nuclear power. It argues that Sweden is entering a phase of nuclear renaissance and highlights the advantages of MMR technology, such as increased safety and flexibility in energy production close to consumers, as well as contributing to the region's industrial developments, including a battery factory in Mariestad.

title: Ökad polisbemanning på landsbygden
summary: The motion proposes that every municipality in Sweden should have a legally mandated minimum police staffing level and calls for a parliamentary investigation to explore ways to reduce bureaucracy within the police force to enhance its efficiency. The motivation behind this proposal highlights increasing insecurity in rural areas, with a particular focus on the need for police accessibility for all citizens, regardless of their locality. It emphasizes that taxpayers deserve adequate police service and suggests that smaller municipalities could collaborate to meet staffing needs.

title: Reducera stammen av kanadagäss
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish Parliament support a reduction in the population of Canada geese in Sweden, which are identified as an invasive species causing public health issues such as contamination of water sources at beaches and parks. It suggests that the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency be tasked with leading efforts to significantly decrease the population of these geese.

title: Skövde flygplats som permanent beredskapsflygplats
summary: The motion proposes that the Swedish government initiate negotiations with Skövde municipality to reopen Skövde Airport as a permanent standby airport, citing its historical significance and utility for various services including emergency and military operations.
